motu: Matamana negana ai na Dirava ese guba bona tanobada e karadia.
english: In the beginning, God + 1:1 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * created the heavens and the earth.

motu: Tanobada na asi oromana bona asi anina; dibura danu gadobada vada e gorua ahu. Bena Dirava laumana na gado kopina ai e loava.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

motu: Dirava eto, Diari aine vara. Bena diari na e vara.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

motu: Dirava ese diari e itaia, vada e namo; bena Dirava ese diari bona dibura e haridia.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

motu: Dirava ese diari ladana e hatoa Dina; dibura ladana e hatoa Boi. Ado e rahi daba e rere, dina gini-gunana.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

motu: Dirava ma eto, Ḡau ta aine vara gadobada daenai, ranu baine haridia.
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

motu: Bena Dirava ese ḡau ta e karaia, henu ranudia bona atai ranudia ihididia. Bena unu e vara toma.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

motu: Dirava ese una ḡau ladana e hatoa Guba. Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina iharuana.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

motu: Dirava ma eto, Guba henunai e miamu ranudia na ae hahebou, gabu tamona ai, tano kaukauna baine hedinarai. Bena unu e vara toma.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

motu: Dirava ese tano kaukauna ladana e hatoa Tanobada; bona ranu na edia gabu ai e hahebou ladadia e hato Davara. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

motu: Dirava ma eto, Tanobada ai rei aine vara, bona ava idau-idau mai nadinadidia, bona huahua audia danu mai huahuadia, huahua idau-idaudia mai nadinadidia. Bena unu e vara toma:
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

motu: rei e vara tanobada ai, bona ava idau-idau mai nadinadidia, bona huahua audia mai huahuadia, huahua idau-idaudia mai nadinadidia. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

motu: Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina ihatoina.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

motu: Dirava ma eto, Diari ae vara guba ai, dina bona hanuaboi bae haridia, bona toa ai baela, guitau bona lahara toadia, bona dina toadia, bona laḡani toadia.
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

motu: Guba ai bae diari, tanobada bae hadiaria. Bena unu e vara toma.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

motu: Dirava ese diari badadia rua e kara: badana ese dina baine lohiaia, bona maraḡina ese hanuaboi baine lohiaia eto. Hisiu danu e kara.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

motu: Dirava ese guba ai e atodia, tanobada bae hadiaria totona;
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

motu: dina bona hanuaboi bae lohiadia bona diari bona dibura bae hididia totona. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

motu: Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina ihahanina.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

motu: Dirava ma eto, Mauri ḡaudia momo davara ai ae vara, bona manu tanobada daenai ae roho guba henunai.
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

motu: Bena Dirava ese lakara-donodono bona rui bona davara ai e maurimu bona e reremu ḡaudia iboudiai e karadia, bona roho manudia iboudiai danu. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

motu: Bena Dirava ese e hanamodia, eto, Besemui ba havaradia, ba hutuma, davara idoidiai bae honu honu dae; manu danu bae vara rohoroho tanobada ai.
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

motu: Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina iha-imana.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

motu: Dirava ma eto, Tanobada ese mauri ḡaudia idau-idau baine havaradia, boromakau, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia, bona tanobada boromadia idau-idau ta ta ena bese ai. Bena unu e vara toma.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

motu: Bena Dirava ese tanobada boromadia idau-idau bona boromakau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai e karadia, ta ta ena bese ena bese ai. Dirava ese e itaia, vada e namo.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

motu: Bena Dirava ma eto, Taunimanima aina karaia, lau laulaugu bona lau heida-idagu; davara gwarumedia bona atai manudia bona boromakau bona tanobada idoinai tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai ia ese baine biagudia.
english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

motu: Bena Dirava ese taunimanima e karaia, ia heida-idana, Dirava ida-idana e karaia: maruane bona hahine e karadia.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

motu: Bena Dirava ese e hanamodia, eto, Besemui ba havaradia, ba hutuma; tanobada ba hahonua bona ba biagua; davara gwarumedia bona atai manudia bona mauri ḡaudia tanobada ai e loamu iboudiai ba biagudia.
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

motu: Dirava ma eto. A itaia, mai nadinadidia avadia bona mai huahuadia audia vada na henimui, amui aniani;
english: God said, “Behold, + 1:29 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

motu: tanobada boromadia iboudiai danu, bona atai manudia iboudiai, bona mauri ḡaudia tanobada ai e loamu iboudiai, na ava raudia vada na henidia, adia aniani. Bena unu e vara toma.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

motu: Dirava ese e kara ḡaudia iboudiai e itadia, nanamo heherea. Ado e rahi, daba e rere, dina ihatauratoina.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

motu: Unuhetomana guba bona tanobada mai anidia vada e kara ḡuḡuru.
english: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

motu: Dina ihahituna ai, Dirava ese ena ḡaukara idoidiai e hadokodia: dina ihahituna ai ia ese ena ḡaukara iboudiai e ato diho, e laḡa ani.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

motu: Bena Dirava ese dina ihahituna e hanamoa bona e hahelaḡaia: badina be una dina ai ena ḡaukara iboudiai e ato diho, e laḡa ani. Adam
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

motu: Guba bona ikaradia herevadia bini: ihavaradia negana ai Dirava Iehova ese tanobada bona guba e karava dinana ai,
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh + 2:4 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * God made the earth and the heavens.

motu: uda audia ta be tanobada ai do we miava, aniani avadia ta do se vara; badina be Dirava Iehova ese medu tanobada ai do se hadihoa, asi tauna danu tano ibiru-henina.
english: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

motu: A varahu be tanobada amo eme dae, tano kopina idoinai vada eme hapariparia.
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese taunimanima tano ḡahuna amo e karaia, mauri laḡana ia uduna matudia ai e hahoho dobi, taunimanima na mauri tauna ai e halaoa.
english: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

motu: Dirava Iehova ese imea ta e karaia, ladana Eden, + 2:8 “Eden” anina be “moale”. * mairiveina kahana ai, bena vada e karaia tauna unuseni ai e atoa, baine noho.
english: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

motu: Dirava Iehova ese au danu tano ai e havaradia, ita-itadia bona ianidia nanamo audia iboudiai; mauri auna danu imea bogaraginai, namo bona dika idibaladia auna danu.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

motu: Eden imeana amo sinavai ta e aru ela, imea e hapariparia; e aru parara, sinavai hani ai ela.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

motu: Ginigunana ladana na Pison; ia be havila tanona e arua heḡeḡe: una tano ai gold * e davariamu,
english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

motu: gold * namo-hereana; bedolak + 2:12 “bedolak” bona “onuku” be nadi ladadia. * bona onuku nadidia danu unuseni ai.
english: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium + 2:12 or, aromatic resin * and onyx stone are also there.

motu: Sinavai iharuana ladana na Gihon: una sinavai be Etiopia tanona e arua heḡeḡe.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

motu: Sinavai ihatoina ladana na Tigris: ia be Asuria tanona mairiveina kahana amo e aru Iaomu. Sinavai ihahanina na Eufrate.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

motu: Dirava Iehova ese hari tau e abia, Eden imeana ai e atoa, ia ese baine biru henis bona baine reḡua.
english: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

motu: Dirava Iehova ese hari tau e haduaia, eto, Imea audia iboudiai huahuadia bavani, emu ura heḡereḡerena;
english: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

motu: a namo bona dika idibalaidia auna huahuana una mo basio ania; badina be ia bavania dinana ai oi na ba mase vaitani.
english: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

motu: Dirava Iehova ma eto, Hari tau na sibona baine noho na dia namo; lau ese ia bamona aina karaia.
english: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to + 2:18 or, suitable for, or appropriate for. * him.”

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese tano amo tanobada boromadia iboudiai e karadia, bona atai manudia iboudiai danu. Bena ia ese hari tau, Adam, vairanai e hakaudia, baine diba ia ese ladadia ede baine hato toma: mauri ḡaudia iboudiai ta ta Adam ese ladadia e hato.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

motu: Taunabunai, Adam ese boromakau iboudiai ladadia e hato, bona atai manudia bona tanobada danu; a Adam na asi bamona ta ia baine durua.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese Adam e hamahutaia hedavauhe. Bena ruduna turiana ta e abia lasi, turia gabuna be hidio ai e daia ahu.
english: Yahweh God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese Adam ena amo e abia lasi turiana na hahine ta e karalaia, Adam dekena e laohaia.
english: Yahweh God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

motu: Bena Adam eto, Ina na turiagu turiana bona hidiogu hidiona: ladana bae hatoa Hahine, badina be Tau ena amo vada e abia lasi. + 2:23 Heberu gadodia ai “tau” bona “hahine” na dia hereva idau-idau, Motu gado ai na heto; “tau” be “ish”, “hahine” be “isha”. Una dainai Adam eto, “Ladana” bae hatoa “Isha” badina be “ish” ena amo vada e abia lasi. *
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

motu: Badina bunai tau ese tamana sinana baine rakatanidia, adavana baine badinaia, raruosi na anidia tamona ai baela.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

motu: Idia raruosi, Adam mai adavana ida, na asi edia riorio ḡaudia, to asie hemaraiva.
english: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

motu: Gaigai ena aonega ese Dirava Iehova e kara boromadia iboudiai edia aonega e hereadia. Ia ese hahine e nanadaia, eto, Momokani Dirava eto umui na imea audia ta huahuana basio ani a?
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

motu: Bena hahine ese gaigai e haere henia, eto, Imea audia huahuadia baia ani;
english: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

motu: to Dirava eto “Imea bogaraginai e ginimu auna huahuana basio ania bona basio daua toho, ba mase na garina”.
english: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

motu: Gaigai ese hahine e hamaoroa, eto, Momokani, umui na basio mase:
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

motu: Dirava vada dibana raruosi bavania dinana ai na matamui bae papa, bena Dirava ida ba heḡereḡere, namo bona dika ba diba.
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

motu: Hahine ese e itaia, una au huahuana be aniani ḡauna namona, ita-itana danu namo, bona lalo-parara ihavarana ḡauna; bena ia ese e abia, adavana danu e henia, ia danu e ania.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

motu: Bena raruosi matadia e papa, vada e diba idia na ḡaḡaedia mo nonoho; bena idia ese suke raudia e turi hebou, edia riorio ḡaudia e kara.
english: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

motu: Bena raruosi ese Dirava Iehova gadona e kamonai, ia na dina kerumana ai imea lalonai e loava; bena Adam mai adavana ida Dirava Iehova vairana amo e komu, imea audia muridiai.
english: They heard Yahweh God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese Adam e boi henia, eto, Oi na edeseni ai?
english: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

motu: Ia na e haere, eto, Gadomu imea lalonai na kamonai, bena vada na gari, badina be ḡaḡaegu mo na noho, taunabunai na komu.
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

motu: Dirava Iehova eto, Daika ese e hamaorumu oi na ḡaḡaemu mo noho? Lau na haduamu basio ania nato huahuana vada o ania a?
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

motu: Adam e haere, eto, Vada o henigu baine bamogu hahinena ese una au huahuana e henigu, bena na ania.
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese hahine e gwau henia, eto, Ina na dahaka vada o karaia? Hahine na eto, Gaigai ese e koigu, bena na ania.

motu: Au giniginidia bona ava ḡiniḡinidia danu tano ai bae vara oiemu ai. Tanobada avadia anidia do bavani.
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and|strong="H7704" * you will|strong="H7704" * eat the|strong="H7704" * herb|strong="H6212" * of|strong="H7704" * the|strong="H7704" * field|strong="H7704" *.

motu: Vairamu varahuna ai bavaniani ela bona tano ba lou henia, badina be tano amo oma. Oi na tano ḡahuna: tano ḡahuna danu do ba lou henia.
english: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * were|strong="H4480" * taken|strong="H3947" * out|strong="H4480" * of|strong="H4480" * it|strong="H3588" *. For|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * are|strong="H4480" * dust|strong="H6083" *, and|strong="H7725" * you|strong="H3588" * shall|strong="H6083" * return|strong="H7725" * to|strong="H5704" * dust|strong="H6083" *.”

motu: Bena Adam ese adavana ladana e hatoa Heva + 3:20 “Heva” anina be “mauri”. * badina be ia na mauri taudia iboudiai sinadia.
english: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese boromakau kopidia amo hahedoki dabuadia e kara, Adam ena bona adavana Heva ena, raruosi e hadabualaidia.
english: Yahweh God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

motu: Bana Dirava Iehova eto, Taunimanima a itaia, ia na lau heḡereḡeregu ai vada ela, namo bona dika baine diba; readia ia ese imana ma baine toia roro, mauri auna huahuana baine abia, baine ania, bena baine mauri hanai-hanai.
english: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

motu: Taunabunai Dirava Iehova ese Moale imeana lalona amo e lulua lasi, tano amo e vara tanona baine biru henia.
english: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

motu: Ia ese Adam e lulua lasi; bena Moale imeana mairiveina kahana ai kerubi e haginidia, bona lahi darena e atoa, una dare matana e hegiro hanaihanaiva, mauri auna ilao-henina dalana e laoa ahu.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim + 3:24 cherubim are powerful angelic creatures, messengers of God with wings. See Ezekiel 10. * at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

motu: Adam na adavana Heva ida e eno bou: bena Heva e rogorogo, e mara, Kain e abia; eto, Tau ta Iehova ena amo vada name abia.
english: The man knew + 4:1 or, lay with, or, had relations with * Eve his wife. She conceived, + 4:1 or, became pregnant * and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”

motu: Ma e rogorogo lou, e mara, tadina Abel e abia. Abel na mamoe ireḡudia tauna a Kain na biru tauna.
english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

motu: Nega ta ai Kain ese tano anidia e mailai, Iehova ena boubou ḡauna ai baine halaoa eto.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.

motu: Abel danu ena mamoe serina roboadia mai digaradia e mailaidia. Bena Iehova ese Abel ena boubou ḡauna e haḡerea,
english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. Yahweh respected Abel and his offering,

motu: a Kain ena boubou ḡauna se hagerea. Kain na e badu dikadika, bena vairana e huaia.
english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

motu: A Iehova ese Kain e gwau henia, eto, Badina be dahaka o badumu? Dahaka dainai vairamu o huaiamu?
english: Yahweh said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

motu: Boma kara namo, basinama abimu dae a? Basioma kara namo, kara havara be iduara badinai e narimumu; e ura henimumu, to oi ese ba hadarerea.
english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

motu: Bena Kain ese tadina Abel e hereva henia, eto, Aitala uma. Bena raruosi na uma ai e nohova negana ai Kain ese tadina Abel e heatu henia, e alaia mase.
english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Kain e nanadaia, eto, Tadimu Abel be edeseni ai? Ia na e haere, eto, Lau na asi dibagu; be, lau na tadigu igimana tauna a?
english: Yahweh said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He|strong="H3068" * said, “ I|strong="H3045" * don’t know|strong="H3045" *. Am|strong="H3068" * I|strong="H3045" * my|strong="H8104" * brother’s keeper|strong="H8104" *?”

motu: Iehova ma eto, Dahaka vada o karaia? Tadimu rarana gadona na tano amo vada e tai henigumu.
english: Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

motu: Harihari ela, uduna e haḡaia tadimu rarana imamu amo e abia tanona ese baine hadikamu.
english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

motu: Harihari ela, ba biru negadia ai na tano ese anina basine henimu. A oi na heau bona loa kava tauna ai do baola tanobada ai.
english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth.”

motu: Bena Kain ese Iehova e hamaoroa, eto, Egu dika davana na metau herea; egu haheauka basine heḡereḡere.
english: Cain said to Yahweh, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

motu: A laloa, oi ese hari dina ai tanobada kopina amo vada o lulugu oho, vairamu danu egu amo vada o hunia. Lau na heau bona loa kava taugu ai bainala tanobada ai; taunabunai, baine davarigu tauna ese baine alagu mase.
english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Kain e hamaoroa, eto, Kain baine alaia tauna na davana bae henia hahitu. Bena Iehova ese Kain enai toa ta e atoa, lau ta ese idavarina negana ai bema alaia na garina.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

motu: Bena Kain na Iehova vairana amo e raka lasi, Nod tanona ai eha noho, Eden mairiveina kahana ai.
english: Cain left Yahweh’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

motu: Bena Kain na adavana ida e eno bou; bena hahine na e rogorogo, e mara, Enok e abia. Bena Kain ese hanua ta e hadaia, una hanua ladana e hatoa Enok, natuna ladana heḡereḡerena.
english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

motu: Enok natuna na Irad. Irad ese Mehuiael e havaraia, bona Mehuiael ese Metusael e havaraia, bona Metusael ese Lamek e havaraia.
english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

motu: Lamek e hodara: adavana ta ladana na Ada, ma ta ladana na Sila.
english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

motu: Ada e mara, Iabal e abia: ia na dabua kalagadia ai e nohomu bona boromakau e reḡudiamu taudia senedia.
english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

motu: Ia tadina ladana na Iubal: ia na gitara bona ivilikou e hataimu taudia senedia.
english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

motu: A Sila na e mara, Tubala-Kain e abia: ia na auri-laboralabora bona auri iḡaukaralaidia tauna ai ela. Hari Tubala-Kain taihuna ladana na Naamaha.
english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

motu: Bena Lamek ese adavana raruosi e hereva henidia, eto, Ada bona Sila, a hakala henigu! Adavagu raruosi e, egu hereva a kamonai! Tau ta ese e haberogu, na alaia; Tauhau ta ese e botagu, na alaia mase.
english: Lamech said to his wives, “ Adah|strong="H5711" * and|strong="H6963" * Zillah|strong="H6741" *, hear|strong="H8085" * my|strong="H8085" * voice|strong="H6963" *. You|strong="H3588" * wives of|strong="H6963" * Lamech|strong="H3929" *, listen|strong="H8085" * to|strong="H8085" * my|strong="H8085" * speech, for|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * have|strong="H3588" * slain|strong="H2026" * a|strong="H3068" * man|strong="H3206" * for|strong="H3588" * wounding|strong="H6482" * me|strong="H6963" *, a|strong="H3068" * young|strong="H3206" * man|strong="H3206" * for|strong="H3588" * bruising me|strong="H6963" *.

motu: Kain dainai dava bae henia hahitu e tomu; Benaini, Lamek dainai dava bae henia hahitu-ahui hitu.
english: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly|strong="H3588" * Lamech|strong="H3929" * seventy-seven|strong="H7657" * times|strong="H7651" *.”

motu: Bena Adam na adavana ida ma e eno bou: bena hahine e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Set: eto, Dirava ese natugu ta vada eme henigu, Abel Kain ese e alaia mase tauna, ibolona.
english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

motu: Bena Set ese natuna e havaraia, ladana e hatoa Enos. Una negana ai taunimanima ese Iehova ladana e hahanea matama.
english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.

motu: Adam besena karoana binai. Dirava ese taunimanima e karaia dinana ai ia ese Dirava ida-idana ai e karaia.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

motu: Maruane bona hahine e karadia, ladadia e hato Taunimanima; e karadia dinana ai danu e hanamodia.
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam. + 5:2 “Adam” and “Man” are spelled with the exact same consonants in Hebrew, so this can be correctly translated either way. *

motu: Adam ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese natuna ta e havaraia, ia ida-idana ai bona ia heḡereḡerena ai; bena ladana e hatoa Set.
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

motu: Set e vara murinai Adam ma laḡani sinahu-taurahani e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

motu: Adam ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta toi-ahui: bena e mase.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

motu: Set ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta dikoana ima negana ai, ia ese Enos e havaraia;
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

motu: bena Enos e vara murinai Set na laḡani sinahu-taurahani dikoana hitu e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

motu: Set ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta gwautarua: bena e mase.
english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

motu: Enos ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ta-ahui negana ai, ia ese Kenan e havaraia;
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

motu: bena Kenan e vara murinai Enos na laḡani sinahu-taurahani gwauta-ima e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

motu: Enos ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta dikoana ima: bena e mase.
english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

motu: Kenan ena mauri laḡanidia na hitu-ahui negana ai, ia ese Mahalalel e havaraia;
english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

motu: bena Mahalalel e vara murinai Kenan na laḡani sinahu-taurahani hari-ahui e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

motu: Kenan ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta bona gwauta: bena e mase.
english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

motu: Mahalalel ena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui ima negana ai, ia ese Iared e havaraia;
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

motu: bena Iared e vara murinai Mahalalel na laḡani sinahu-taurahani toi-ahui e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

motu: Mahalalel ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani taurahani-ta-ahui ima: bena e mase.
english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

motu: Iared ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta tauratoi-ahui rua negana ai, ia ese Enok e havaraia;
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

motu: bena Enok e vara murinai Iared na laḡani sinahu-taurahani e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

motu: Iared ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta tauratoi-ahui rua: bena e mase.
english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

motu: Enok ena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui ima negana ai, ia ese Metusela e havaraia.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

motu: Metusela e vara murinai Enok na Dirava ida e hebamo heheniva ela bona laḡani sinahu-toi e ore; natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia danu e havaradia.
english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Enok ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui ima;
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

motu: ia na Dirava ida e hebamo heheniva, murinai tau ta ese se itaia lou, badina be Dirava ese e abia.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

motu: Metusela ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui hitu negana ai, ia ese Lamek e havaraia;
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

motu: bena Lamek e vara murinai Metusela na laḡani sinahu-hitu taurahani-ahui rua e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

motu: Metusela ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta tauratoi-ahui taurahani-ta: bena e mase.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

motu: Lamek ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui rua negana ai, ia ese natuna ta e havaraia,
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

motu: ladana e hatoa Noa. + 5:29 “Noa” anina be “Laga-ani”. * Ia eto, Iehova ese vada e hadikaia tanona amo ina mero ese baine harohoda mauri, imada ḡaukaradia bona eda hekwarahi amo baita laḡa ani.
english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”

motu: Noa e vara murinai Lamek na laḡani sinahu-ima taurahani-ta-ahui ima e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

motu: Lamek ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-hitu hitu-ahui hitu: bena e mase.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

motu: Noa ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ima negana ai, ia ese Sem bona Ham bona Iafet e havaradia.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

motu: Nega vada e gini dae taunimanima vada e hutuma tanobada ai, natudia hahinedia danu vada e havaradia.
english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

motu: Bena Dirava natuna verina ese taunimanima natudia hahinedia e itadia, i'itadia, nanamo; bena e ura henidia ulatodia na e adavadia.
english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Lau laumagu na taunimanima lalodiai basine noho hanaihanai, badina be idia na hidio kavakava mo: edia mauri laḡanidia bae sinahu-ta ruahui hona.
english: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

motu: Una dinadia ai taunimanima ḡaḡau-babadadia tanobada ai e nohova. Dirava natuna verina ese taunimanima natudia hahinedia e adavadia negadia ai na natudia e havaradia: unu na taunimanima ḡaḡau-babadadia nega gunadia ai e nohova; sivaraidia danu babada.
english: The Nephilim + 6:4 or, giants * were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

motu: Iehova ese taunimanima edia kara havara e itaia, vada e bada herea tanobada ai, edia lalo-hadai iboudiai danu didika.
english: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

motu: Bena Iehova e helalo, taunimanima e havaradia tanobada ai dainai; lalona e hisihisi danu.
english: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Taunimanima, na karaia ḡauna, na tanobada kopina amo baina abia oho; oibe, taunimanima bona boroma bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia bona atai manudia danu; badina be na helalomu, na havaridia dainai.
english: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

motu: A Noa be Iehova ese e lalo namo heniava.
english: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.

motu: Noa sivaraina binai: Noa na kara maoromaoro tauna, ena uru ai e kara namo ḡuḡuruva. Ia na Dirava ida e havamo heheniva.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

motu: Noa ese natuna mamaruanedia tatoi e havaradia: Sem bona Ham bona Iafet.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

motu: Tanobada na dika, Dirava vairanai: tanobada idoinai daḡedaḡe ai e honu honu dae.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

motu: Dirava ese tanobada e itaia, vada e dika rohoroho; badina be taunimanima iboudiai ese edia kara vada e hadika tanobada ai.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

motu: Bena Dirava ese Noa e hereva henia, eto, Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai dokodia be lau vairagu ai vada eme kau; badina be idia daidiai tanobada na daḡedaḡe ai veda eme honu honu dae, taunabunai, lau ese baina habuadia tari tanobada ai.
english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

motu: A oi na sida audia amo lagatoi auta ba karaia; ia lalonai daiutu ba kara; bona lalona bona murina ba demadia ahu.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

motu: Ini ba karaia toma: latana na roha hitu-ahui ima; lababana roha gwauta-rua mai kahana; bona harana ena lata na roha hitu mai kahana.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, + 6:15 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

motu: Gaba-maurana ba karaia, ena dobu roha kahana mo; iduara danu ba karaia ohena ai, ere danu bae toi, ta henu ai, ma ta ia daenai, ma ihatoina danu iharuana daenai.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

motu: Badina be lau e e utu-utu badana tanobada baina ha-utua dae, mauri ḡaudia iboudiai guba henuna amo ihabua-taridia; ḡau iboudiai tanobada ai do bae mase ore.
english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.

motu: A taravagu oiemu ai baina atua, baina hamomokania; oi ma lagatoi ai ba gui, oi bona natumu bona adavamu bona ravamu hahinedia.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

motu: Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai idau-idau rua amo lagatoi ai ba hakaudia vareai, idia danu bae mauri; maruane ta, hahine ta, unu bavabidia toma.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

motu: Manu idau-idau, boromakau idau-idau, tano ai e raumu ḡaudia idau-idau, rua rua amo bae vasi, vada bae mauri.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

motu: Aniani ḡaudia idau-idau iboudiai danu bavabi kau, oiamu bona idia adia.
english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

motu: Bena Noa na unu e kara toma, Dirava ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

motu: Iehova ese Noa e hamaoroa, eto, Emu ruma taudia iboudiai lagatoi lalonai ba hakaudia vareai, badina be vada na itamu, ina uru ai oi sibomu kara maoromaoro taumu.
english: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

motu: Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai tanobada ai bavabidia: ḡoevaḡoevadia na hitu hitu amo bavabidia, maruane hitu hahine hitu, unu bavabidia toma; a asi ḡoevaḡoevadia na rua rua amo, maruane ta hahine ta bavabidia.
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

motu: Atai manudia idau-idau danu bavabidia, maruane hitu hitu amo, hahine hitu hitu amo, besedia na tanobada ai do bae vara lou helaoreana.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

motu: Badina be dina hitu bae ore murinai lau ese medu baina hadihoa tanobada ai, dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui, mauri ḡaudia iboudiai tanobada ai vada na karadia ihabua-taridia totona.
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

motu: Bena Iehova ona hahedua iboudiai na Noa ese e kara ḡuḡuru.
english: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

motu: Noa ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu tauratoi negana ai, utu-utu badana ese tanobada idoinai e utua dae.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

motu: Bena Noa bona natuna bona adavana bona ravana hahinedia laḡatoi ai e gui, utu-utu dainai.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

motu: Mauri ḡaudia ḡoevaḡoevadia bona asi ḡoevaoḡoevadia, bona manu, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia,
english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

motu: iboudiai na rua rua amo, maruane bona hahine, Noa ida e gui kau lagatoi ai, Dirava ese Noa e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

motu: Bena dina hitu e ore murinai, utu-utu badana na tanobada idoinai e utua dae. Utu-utu badana
english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

motu: Noa ena mauri laḡanina ihasinahu-tauratoina, hua iharuana, hua dinana ihagwauta-hituna, abata bada-hereana e lasi bona medu bada-hereana e diho matama.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

motu: Una medu na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui e dihova.
english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

motu: Una dina ai Noa mai adavana ida, bona natuna tatoiosi, Sem bona Ham bona Iafet, mai adavadia ida, lagatoi ai e gui.
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

motu: Boroma bona horomakau idau-idau danu, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia idau-idau, bona manu idau-idau, e gui kau;
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

motu: mauri ḡaudia ibouboudiai rua rua amo, Noa ida lagatoi ai e gui,
english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

motu: maruane hahine ida e gui kau, Dirava ena hahedua heḡereḡerena. Bena Iehova ese lagatoi ai e koudia ahu.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.

motu: Dina hari-ahui lalodiai utu-utu na tanobada idoinai e utua daeva, e bada e laova, a lagatoi e keni dae atai ai.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

motu: Utu-utu na e bada e laova; a lagatoi na ranu kopina ai e hureva.
english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

motu: Utu-utu na tanobada idoinai e utua dae vaitani; ororo iboudiai guba henunai e miava na e bubuni;
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

motu: ororo doridia ai ranu ena dobu na roha hani mai kahana.
english: The waters rose fifteen cubits + 7:20 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * higher, and the mountains were covered.

motu: Bena mauri ḡaudia iboudiai tanobada ai e mase, manu bona boromakau bona boroma idau-idau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia bona taunimanima;
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

motu: tano kaukauna ai e mauri nohova ḡaudia, ududia ai mai edia mauri laḡana ḡaudia, ibouboudiai e mase ore.
english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

motu: Tano kopina ai e mauriva ḡaudia iboudiai na e hebua tari, taunimanina bona boromakau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia bona atai manudia. Noa mo sibona, bona ia ida lagatoi ai e nohova ḡaudia, vada e mauri.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

motu: Ranu ese tanobada e habubunia ela bona dina sinahu-ta imahui.
english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

motu: Dirava ese Noa e laloa tao, bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai bona boromakau ia ida lagatoi ai e gui danu e lalodia tao. Bena Dirava ese lai ta e siaia tanobada ai; bena ranu na e kororo.
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

motu: Ranu e lohi lohi daeva gabudia bona guba iduaradia danu e kou ahu, guba amo e dihova meduna danu e hadokoa.
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

motu: Ranu na metaira-metaira tano amo e louva, e maraḡi e laova,
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

motu: ela bona hua ihahituna ena dina ihagwauta-hituna ai lagatoi e kuia kau Ararat ororona ai.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

motu: Ranu ma e maraḡi e laova, ela bona hua ihagwautana ena dina gini-gunana ai ororo doridia e hedinarai.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

motu: Dina hari-ahui ma e ore, bena Noa ese lagatoi gaba-mauruna e kehoa, mukou ta e harohoa;
english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

motu: una mukou e roho eva-eva ela bona ranu tanobada amo e kororo vaitani.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

motu: Pune ta danu e harohoa, baine diba ranu na tanobada kopina ai vada e maraḡi eiava lasi.
english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

motu: To pune na ena roho-kau gabuna ta se davaria, bena Noa dekena e lou lao lagatoi ai, badina be ranu ese tanobada kopina idoinai vada e habubunia. Bena Noa ese imana e toia roro, lagatoi lalonai e abia vareai.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

motu: Ia na dina hitu ma e noho; bena pune na lagatoi amo ma e harohoa.
english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

motu: Adorahi ai pune na e lou ela dekenai, uduna ai be olive rauna ta, ia ese vada e koria utu ḡauna; bena Noa vada e diba ranu na tanobada ai vada e maraḡi.
english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

motu: Dina hitu ma e noho; bena pune ma e harohoa; bena ia na vada se lou lagatoi ai, lasi vaitani.
english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

motu: Laḡani sinahu-tauratoi dikoana ta, hua gini-gunana ena dina gini-gunana ai, ranu na e kororo vaitani tanobada ai. Bena Noa ese lagatoi e kehoa, tanobada kopina e itaia, vada e kaukau.
english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

motu: Hua iharuana ena dina iharuahui-hituna ai tanobada e kaukau vaitani.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

motu: Bena Dirava ese Noa e hereva henia, eto,
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

motu: Laḡatoi amo ba diho mai adavamu ida, bona natumu mai adavadia ida.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

motu: Mauri ḡaudia iboudiai oi dekemu ai danu ba rakalaidia lasi, manu bona boromakau bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai. Bae vara rohoroho, bae mara momomomo, bae hutuma.
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

motu: Bena Noa na e diho, ia bona natuna bona adavana bona ravana.
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

motu: Boroma idoudiai danu bona manu iboudiai, bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai, ibouboudiai na lagatoi amo e didi didi lasi.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

motu: Bena Noa ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia Iehova ena; bena boroma ḡoevaḡoevadia bona manu ḡoevaḡoevadia iboudiai edia amo hidaosi e abidia, pata latanai e aladia, lahi ai e haḡoledia oho.
english: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

motu: Bena Iehova ese bonana namona e kamonai negana ai, ia eto, Tanobada na basina hadikaia lou taunimanima daidiai, badina be edia lalo-hadai be didika, maraḡidia negadia ela; mauri ḡaudia iboudiai danu basina aladia ore lou, vanegai na aladia na heto.
english: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

motu: Tanobada baine mia negadia ai na hadohado bona ḡeiḡei, keru bona sioahu, lahara bona guitau, dina bona boi, basie doko.
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

motu: Dirava ese Noa mai natuna ida e hanamodia, eto, Besemui ba havaradia, bae vara rohoroho, tanobada bae hahonua.
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

motu: Tanobada boromadia iboudiai bona atai manudia iboudiai bona tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai bona davara gwarumedia iboudiai ese garimui bae gari; umui ese danu ba biagudia.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

motu: E maurimu bona e loamu ḡaudia iboudiai na amui vamu; aniani avadia vada na henimui heḡereḡerena, ini danu na henimuimu, amui;
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

motu: ḡau tamona, hidio mai rarana basio ania, badina be rara na mauri badina.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

motu: Umui raramui danu, emui mauri badina, davana baina abia: boroma enai baina abia eiava taunimanima enai baina abia; taunimanima enai tadikakana rarana davana baina abia.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

motu: Taunimanina baine alaia mase tauna na taunimanima ese bae alaia mase; badina be Dirava ese taunimanima e karadia, ia ida-idana.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

motu: Benaini, besemui ba havaraida, bae hutuma; tanobada ai bae vara rohoroho, hae hutuma bada.
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

motu: Bena Dirava ese Noa mai natuna ida ma e hereva henidia, eto,
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

motu: Lau o ina, egu taravatu umui bona murimui bae vara garamui na henimuimu;
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

motu: mauri ḡaudia iboudiai danu umui ida nonoho na henidiamu, manu bona bokomakau bona tanobada boromadia iboudiai na henidiamu, lagatoi amo e raka lasi ḡaudia iboudiai.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

motu: Egu taravatu lau ese baina badinaia umui emui ai: mauri ḡaudia na utu-utu ta ese basine aladia lou; utu-utu badana ta basine utua dae lou, tanobada basine hadikaia lou.
english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

motu: Dirava ma eto, Egu taravatu na henimuimu, lauegu bona umui emui danu, mauri ḡaudia umui ida nonoho iboudiai edia danu, ela bona uru iboudiai, toana binai:
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

motu: egu kevau dagadaga ai na atoamu, taravatu toana ai bainela, lauegu bona tanobada ena.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese dagadaga tanobada baina hadagahulaia negana ai na kevau be dagadaga ai ba itaia.
english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

motu: Bena egu taravatu baina laloa, lauegu, umui emui bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai edia danu: utu-utu badana ta basina ha-utua dae lou, mauri ḡaudia basina habuadia tari lou.
english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

motu: Kevau na dagadaga ai baine hedinarai, bena baina itaia negana ai, hari mia-hanaihanai taravatuna, lau Dirava bona tanobada ena mauri ḡaudia iboudiai padadai, baina laloa tao.
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

motu: Dirava ese Noa ma e hamaoroa, eto, Lauegu ai bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai ediai na atuamu taravatuna toana binai. Noa ena Mauri dokona
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

motu: Noa natuna mamaruanedia, lagatoi amo e raka lasi taudia, ladadia na Sem bona Ham bona Iafet. Ham na Kanaan tamana.
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

motu: Noa natuna tatoiosi bunu; tanobada besedia iboudiai na idia tatoiosi ese e havaradia.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Noa eha biru, vine imeana e hadoa.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

motu: Bena vine ranuna e inua, e kekero; bena ena kalaga ai e hekure, asi dabuana.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

motu: Bena Ham, Kanaan tamana, ese tamana na ḡaḡaena mo e itaia; bena e raka lasi, tadikakana raruosi e hamaorodia.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

motu: Bena Sem bona Iafet ese dabua ta e abia, paḡadia ai e idia roro, e rakalaia muri, asie roha kerehai, ela tamadia e tarua, ḡaḡaena mo bae itaia na garina.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

motu: Noa ena kekero amo e noga, bena e diba natuna ihararuana ede vada e karaia toma. Bena eto,
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

motu: Kanaan ihabaina! Tadikakana edia hesiai taudia edia hesiai tauna ai bainela.
english: He said, “ Canaan|strong="H3667" * is|strong="H5650" * cursed. He will|strong="H1961" * be|strong="H1961" * a|strong="H3068" * servant|strong="H5650" * of|strong="H5650" * servants|strong="H5650" * to|strong="H1961" * his|strong="H1961" * brothers.”

motu: Ma eto, Iehova, Sem ena Dirava, aita imodaia; Kanaan ese ia isiaina baine lao heni.
english: He said, “ Blessed|strong="H1288" * be|strong="H1961" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, the|strong="H3068" * God|strong="H3068" * of|strong="H3068" * Shem|strong="H8035" *. Let|strong="H1961" * Canaan|strong="H3667" * be|strong="H1961" * his|strong="H3068" * servant|strong="H5650" *.

motu: Dirava ese Iafet baine hanamoa, Sem ena dabua kalagadia ai baine noho, Kanaan ese ia isiaina baine lao heni.
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let|strong="H1961" * him|strong="H1961" * dwell|strong="H7931" * in|strong="H7931" * the|strong="H1961" * tents of|strong="H5650" * Shem|strong="H8035" *. Let|strong="H1961" * Canaan|strong="H3667" * be|strong="H1961" * his|strong="H1961" * servant|strong="H5650" *.”

motu: Utu-utu badana murinai Noa na laḡani sinahu-toi imahui e mauri nohova.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

motu: Ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-taurahani-ta imahui: bena e mase.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

motu: Noa natuna tatoisi, Sem bona Ham bona Iafet, garadia bini, utu-utu badana murinai e havaradia.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

motu: Iafet natuna bini: Gomere bona Magog bona Madai bona Iavan bona Tubal bona Mesek bona Tira.
english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

motu: Gomere natuna bini: Asakena bona Rifat bona Togarama.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

motu: Iavan natuna bini: Elisa bona Tarasisi; bona Kitim besena bona Dodanim besena danu ia ese e havaradia.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

motu: Idia edia amo kone taudia iboudiai e vara, edia bese idau-idau ai bona edia gado idau-idau ai.
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

motu: Ham natuna bini: Kusu bona Misraim bona Put bona Kanaan.
english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

motu: Kusu natuna bini: Seba bona Havila bona Sabata bona Raama bona Sabateka. Raama natuna bini: Seba bona Dedan.
english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

motu: Kusu ese danu Nimrod e havaraia; ia na lohia tauna gini-gunana tanobada ai.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

motu: Ia danu hetaraki tauna mai goadana Iehova vairanai; una dainai taunimanima edia hereva ta e tomu “Hetaraki tauna mai goadana Iehova vairanai, Nimrod bamona”.
english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.

motu: Matamana ai ena basileia na Babel bona Ereke bona Akad bona Kalne, Sinara tanona ai.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

motu: Una tano amo e raka lasi, Asuria ela, Nineve hanuana e hadaia, ariarana mai lababadia e kara. Kala hanuana danu e hadaia,
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

motu: bona Resene, Nineve bona Kala padadiai: ia na hanua bada-hereana.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

motu: Misraim ese e havaradia besedia bini: Ludim bona Anamim bona Lehabim bona Napatuhim
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

motu: bona Patarusim bona Kasaluhim bona Kaftorim. Filistia taudia na Kasaluhim besena amo e vara.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

motu: Kanaan natuna bini: Sidono, tau roboana, bona Het.
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

motu: E havaradia besedia danu bini: Iebusu bona Amoro bona Girigasa
english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

motu: bona Hivi bona Araka bona Sini
english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

motu: bona Aravada bona Semara bona Hamat. Gabeamo Kanaan iduhudia na e karoho, kaha idau-idau ai eha noho;
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

motu: edia tano na Sidono amo e laomu ela bona Gasa, Gerara kahana ai, bona Lasa, Sodoma bona Gomora bona Adma bona Seboimi kahadia ai.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

motu: Ini iboudiai, mai edia iduhu idau-idau bona edia gado idau-idau bona edia tano idau-idau bona edia bese idau-idau na Ham ena amo e vara.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

motu: Sem danu, Iafet kakana, Ebere natuna tamadia, natuna mamaruanedia haida ma e havaradia.
english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

motu: Sem natuna bini: Elam bona Asuru bona Afasad bona Lud bona Aram.
english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

motu: Aram natuna bini: Usu bona Hulu bona Getere bona Masa.
english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

motu: Afasad ese Sela e havaraia, bona Sela ese Ebere e havaraia.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

motu: Ebere natuna mamaruanedia na rarua. Ta ladana na Peleg, + 10:25 “Peleg” anina be “e haria”. * badina be iena nega ai tanobada besedia na e haheparara. Tadina ladana na Iokotan.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

motu: Iokotan natuna bini: Alamodad bona Selefe bona Hasaramavete bona Iera
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

motu: bona Hadoram bona Usala bona Dikila
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

motu: bona Obala bona Abimael bona Seba
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

motu: bona Ofiri bona Havila bona Iobab. Ini iboudiai na Iokotan natuna.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

motu: Edia tano na Mesa amo e laomu, mairiveina ororona ladana Sefara kahana ai.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

motu: Ini iboudiai, mai edia iduhu idau-idau bona edia gado idau-idau bona edia tano idau-idau bona edia bese idau-idau na Sem ena amo e vara.
english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

motu: Noa natuna garadia bini, edia uru ai bona edia bese ai: idia edia amo tanobada besedia iboudiai e vara, utu-utu badana murinai.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.

motu: Tanobada idoinai taunimanima iboudiai gadodia be tamona, eredia danu heḡereḡere.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

motu: Nega ta, mairiveina kahana amo e laolaova ai, idia ese taora ta e davaria, Sinara kahana ai, bena unuseni ai e nohova.
english: As they traveled east, + 11:2 LXX reads “from the east”. * they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

motu: Bena idia na e hereva heheni, eto, Mani raro nadidia aita kara, aita tunu namonamo. Bena idia ese e tunu rarodia e abi, nadi ai e halao, bona rarokaka ta e abia, hekamo ḡauna ai e halaoa.
english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

motu: Bena idia ma eto, Mani hanua ta aita hadaia, bona kohoro ta danu, kohoro dorina na guba ai baine kau; unu amo harida baita hadaea, tanobada kopina ai biata loa eva-eva na garina.
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

motu: Bena Iehova e diho, hanua bona kohoro Adam besena ese e latebaia baine itaia eto.
english: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

motu: Iehova eto, Idia na bese tamona, iboudiai danu edia gado tamona; ina na idia ese eme karaia matama, gabeai ḡau ta ikarana ma bae ura, daika ese baine laodia ahu?
english: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

motu: Aina diho, edia gado baina ha-idaua, bena edia hereva na basie hediba heheni.
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese e hakarohodia rohoroho, tanobada kahadia idoidiai; edia hanua ilarebana danu e hadokoa.
english: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

motu: Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoa Babel; + 11:9 “Babel” anina be “Daradara”. * badina be unuseni ai Iehova ese taunimanima edia gado e ha-idaua, bona unu amo ia ese e hakarohodia rohoroho, tanobada kahadia idoidiai. Abram senena
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

motu: Sem garana bini. Sem ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu ta negana ai, ia ese Afasad e havaraia, utu-utu badana laḡani rua vada e kororo murinai.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

motu: Afasad e vara murinai, Sem na laḡani sinahu-ima e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Afasad ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui ima negana ai, ia ese Sela e havaraia.
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

motu: Sela e vara murinai, Afasad na laḡani sinahu-hani dikoana toi e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Sela ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese Ebere e havaraia.
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

motu: Ebere e vara murinai Sela na laḡani sinahu-hani dikoana toi e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Ebere ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui hani negana ai, ia ese Peleg e havaraia.
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

motu: Peleg e vara murinai, Ebere na laḡani sinahu-hani toi-ahui e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Peleg ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese Reu e havaraia.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

motu: Reu e vara murinai, Peleg na laḡani sinahu-rua dikoana taurahani-ta e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Reu ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui rua negana ai, ia ese Serug e havaraia.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

motu: Serug e vara murinai, Reu na laḡani sinahu-rua e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Serug ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui negana ai, ia ese Nahoro e havaraia.
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

motu: Nahoro e vara murinai, Serug na laḡani sinahu-rua e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Nahoro ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui taurahani-ta negana ai ia ese Tera e havaraia.
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

motu: Tera e vara murinai, Nahoro na laḡani sinahu-ta gwauta taurahani-ta e mauri nohova, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Tera ena mauri laḡanidia na hitu-hitu negana ai, ia ese Abram bona Nahoro bona Haran e havaradia.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

motu: Tera garana bini: Tera ese Abram bona Nahoro bona Haran e havaradia. Haran ese Lot e havaraia.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

motu: Tamana Tera do se mase negana ai, Haran e mase guna, e vara gabuna ai, Uru, Kaldea taudia edia hanua ta, unuseni ai eha mase.
english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

motu: Abram e headava; Nahoro danu e headava. Abram adavana ladana na Sarai. Nahoro adavana ladana na Milka, Haran natuna. Una Haran natuna na Milka bona Iska.
english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

motu: Sarai na e gabani.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

motu: Tera ese natuna Abram bona tubuna Lot, Haran natuna, bona ravana Sarai, Abram adavana, e abidia, Kaldea taudia edia hanua, Uru, amo e hakaudia lasi, Kanaan tanona baela eto. Bena gabu ta ai e kau, ladana Haran, unuseni ai e noho.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

motu: Tera ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahurua dikoana ima Tera na Haran ai e mase.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Abram e hamaoroa, eto, Emu tano bona varavaramu bona tamamu ena ruma ba rakatanidia, lau ese baina hamaorolaimu tanona baola.
english: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

motu: Lau ese bese badana ai baina halaomu; baina hanamomu, ladamu baina imodaia, hahenamo tauna ai baola.
english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

motu: Oi bae hanamomu taudia na baina hanamodia, a oi baine hadikamu tauna na baina hadikaia. Oi daimu ai tanobada besedia idoidiai do bae namo.
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

motu: Bena Abram na vada ela, Iehova ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena; Lot danu ia ida ela.
english: So Abram went, as Yahweh had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

motu: Abram ena mauri laḡanidia na hitu-ahui ima, Haran e rakatania negana ai. Abram ese adavana Sarai bona vavana Lot e hakaudia lao, edia kohu iboudiai bona edia hesiai memerodia Haran ai e davaridia danu e laohaidia; e tore tore isi, Kanaan tanona baela eto. Bena Kanaan tanona ai e kau.
english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

motu: Abram ese tano e rakaia hanai ela Sekem, ela bona au helaḡana ladana More. Una negana ai Kanaan taudia na dounu e nohova una tano ai.
english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

motu: Bena Iehova na Abram vairanai e hedinarai, eto, Lau ese ina tano na oi garamu baina henidia. Bena Abram ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova ena, Iehova ese ia vairanai e hedinarai gabuna ai.
english: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” + 12:7 or, seed * He|strong="H8033" * built|strong="H1129" * an|strong="H1129" * altar|strong="H4196" * there|strong="H8033" * to|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, who|strong="H3068" * had|strong="H3068" * appeared|strong="H7200" * to|strong="H3068" * him|strong="H5414" *.

motu: Bena ia ese una gabu e rakatania, ororo ta, Betele mairiveina kahana ai, ela, unuseni ai e taruha; Betele na tahodiho kahana ai, Ai na mairiveina kahana ai. Unuseni ai danu ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova ena. bona Iehova ladana e hahanea.
english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on Yahweh’s name.

motu: Ma eha laolao, diho kahana ela. Abram Aigupto ela
english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

motu: Una tano ai doe vada e vara dainai, ia na diho kahana ma ela, Aigupto ai baine hanoho eto, badina be doe na bada herea.
english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

motu: Bena Aigupto vada e kahira ai, ia ese adavana Sarai e hereva henia, eto, Momokani, oi na hane namo:
english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

motu: lau na tomamu Aigupto taudia bae itamu negana ai, idia baeto “Ina na ia adavana”, bena lau bae alagu mase bona oi bae abimu mauri.
english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

motu: Benaini, baoto oi na lau taihugu, bena oi daimu ai baina namo bona baina mauri danu.
english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

motu: Taunabunai, Abram na Aigupto ai e kau negana ai, Aigupto taudia ese hahine na e itaia, ia na hane namo.
english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

motu: Farao ena lohia taudia ese danu e itaia, bena idia ese Farao vairanai e heatolaia. Bena e hakaua dae Farao ena ruma ai.
english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

motu: Bena Farao ese Abram e kara namo henia, hahine dainai: mamoe bona boromakau bona doniki bona hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia bona kamelo e henia momomomo.
english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

motu: A Iehova ese hisihisi dikadia amo Farao mai ena ruma taudia ida e hahisidia, Sarai, Abram adavana, dainai.
english: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

motu: Bena Farao ese Abram e boiria, e gwau henia, eto, Ede vada o karagu toma? Dahaka dainai oi so hamaorogu ia na oi adavamu?
english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

motu: Edeheto o koigu, oto ia na oi taihumu; bena na adavaia? Vadaeni, adavamu binai: bavabia, ba raka oho.
english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

motu: Bena Farao ese ena hesiai taudia e haduadia, bae hakaua lao; bena e hakaua ela, ia mai adavana mai ena kohu idoinai ida.
english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

motu: Abram ese Aigupto tanona e rakatania, ia mai adavana ida. Ena kohu idoinai e laohaia; Lot danu e hakaua lao. Idia na diho kahana amo e lou.
english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

motu: Abram ena boromakau na momo herea, ena silver * bona ena gold * danu momo herea.
english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

motu: Diho kahana amo e laolao ela, Betele ai e kau, ena taruha gabuna gunana ai ma e taruha, Betele bona Ai padadiai;
