english: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

motu: gunaguna ihaboulaina patana e larebaia gabuna bunai. Unuseni ai Abram ese Iehova ladana e hahanea.
english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh’s name.

motu: Lot danu, Abram e bamoa tauna, ena mamoe bona ena boromakau na momo, ena dabua kalagadia danu momo.
english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

motu: Taunabunai una tano na dia heḡereḡere idia raruosi gabu tamona ai bae noho hebou, badina na edia kohu na momo bona gabu na dia bada.
english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

motu: Bena Abram ena boromakau ireḡudia taudia na Lot ena boromakau ireḡudia taudia ida e heai. Una negana ai Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia na una tano ai e nohova.
english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

motu: Bena Abram ese Lot e hamaoroa, eto, Mani ita raruosi basita heai, eda boromakau ireḡudia taudia danu basie heai, badina be ita na varavara.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

motu: Tano idoinai na oi vairamu ai mia, ani? Mani emu kara, egu ai ba raka siri; oi na lauri kahana boma lao, lau be idiba kahana bama lao; eiava oi na idiba kahana boma lao, lau be lauri kahana bama lao.
english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

motu: Bena Lot na e gaga isi, Ioridane kourana e itaia, idoinai mai ranuna: Iehova ese Sodoma bona Gomora do se habua tari negana ai una tano na Iehova ena imea na heto, eiava Aigupto tanona, Soara dalana ai e laomu, na heto.
english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

motu: Bena Lot na Ioridane kourana idoinai e abia hidi, mairiveina kahana ela. Idia raruosi na e haheparara.
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

motu: Abram na Kanaan tanona ai e noho; bona Lot na taora hanuadia ela, Sodoma kahana ai e taruha.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

motu: A Sodoma taudia na didika, Iehova vairanai e kara havara.
english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.

motu: Bena Lot e raka oho murinai Iehova ese Abram e hereva henia, eto, A gaga isi; o ginimu gabuna ai ba roha roha, mirigini kahana ai, diho kahana ai, mairiveina kahana ai, tahodiho kahana ai.
english: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

motu: Badina be o itaiamu tanona idoinai baina henimu, bona oi garamu baina henidia ela bona hanaihanai.
english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

motu: Oi garamu na tano ḡahuna na heto baina hahutumadia; taunabunai, tau ta tano ḡahuna dimura-dimuradia iduahidia bema diba, ia na oi garamu iduahidia bema diba.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

motu: A tore isi, ina tano ba rakaia hanai, latana amo, lababana amo; badina be lau ese baina henimu.
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

motu: Bena Abram na ena dabua kalagana e lokua, e tore isi, ela, Heberon ai e taruha, Mamare ena au helaḡadia badidiai. Unuseni ai ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova ena.
english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.

motu: Amarafel ese Sinara tanona e lohiaia, Ariok ese Elasara tanona e lohiaia, Kedoralaomere ese Elam tanona e lohiaia bona Tidala ese Goimi tanona e lohiaia negana ai,
english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

motu: idia hahaniosi eha tuari, Bera, Sodoma pavapavana, bona Birisa, Gomora pavapavana, bona Sinab, Adma pavapavana, bona Semebere, Seboimi pavapavana, bona Bela (ladana ta be Soara) pavapavana, e tuari henidia.
english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

motu: Ini iboudiai na Sidim kourana ai e tuari: tadi gohuna be unuseni ai.
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

motu: Laḡani gwauta-rua idia ese Kedoralaomere isiaina e lao heniava, a laḡani ihagwauta-toina ai idia na e gwau edeede.
english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

motu: Bena laḡani ihagwauta-hanina ai Kedoralaomere bona ia e duruava lohiadia na e tore isi, Refaim taudia na Astaroto-karanaimi ai e hadareredia, bona Susim taudia na Ham ai e hadareredia, bona Emim taudia na Savekiriataimi ai e hadareredia,
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

motu: Hori taudia danu edia ororo, ladana Seiri, ai e hadareredia, bona e hahavadia lao ela bona El-paran, tano ḡaḡaena badinai.
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

motu: Bena e lou ema bona En-mispat (ladana ta be Kade); bena Amalek taudia edia tano e havahua, bona Amoro taudia Hasasono-tamara ai e nohova edia tano danu.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

motu: Bena Sodoma pavapavana bona Gomora pavapavana bona Adma pavapavana bona Seboimi pavapavana bona Bela (ladana ta be Soara) pavapavana e tore isi, Sidim kourana ela, tuari totona;
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

motu: idia laima-osi ese Kedoralaomere, Elam pavapavana, bona Tidala, Goimi pavapavana, bona Amarafel, Sinara pavapavana, bona Ariok, Elasara pavapavana, hahaniosi na e tuari henidia.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

motu: Una Sidim kourana na mai kopukopuna, bena Sodoma pavapavana bona Gomora pavapavana e darere negana ai e heau, kopukopu ai eha heau kau, eha mase. A taunimanima oredia na ororo ai e heau mauri.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

motu: Bena pavapava hahaniosi ese kohu idoinai bona aniani idoinai e dadi ore, Sodoma ai bona Gomora ai; bena e raka oho.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

motu: Lot, Abram vavana, Sodoma ai e nohova; bena idia ese ia danu e abia mauri, e laohaia, mai ena kohu idoinai.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

motu: Bena e heau mauri tauna ta ela, Abram, Heberu tauna, e hamaoroa. Ia na Mamare, Amoro tauna, Eskol bona Anere kakadia, ena au helaḡadia badibadi-diai e nohova, bona idia tatoiosi ida e hetura.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

motu: Abram na e kamonai, vavana vada e abia mauri, bena ia ese ena hesiai taudia, ena taruha ai e nohova taudia, e haboudia, tuari ḡaudia e henidia, una tuari oreana muridia amo e hakaudia lao, ela bona Dan.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

motu: Hanuaboi ai ena orea e hapararaia, kahana kahana amo e tuari henidia, e hadareredia, e hahavadia ela bona Hoba, Damasko mirigini kahana ai.
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

motu: Kohu idoinai e abia lou, bona vavana Lot mai ena kohu ida, bona hahine, bona hanua taudia loḡora. Abram bona Melkisedek
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

motu: Kedoralaomere mai bamona ida e hadareredia, bena e lou ai na Sodoma pavapavana ida e hedavari Save kourana ai (Pavapava ena Koura).
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

motu: Bena Melkisedek, Salem pavapavana, Dirava Herea Mikamika ena hahelaḡa tauna, ese flaoa bona vine ranuna e laohai, e dabara.
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

motu: Ia ese Abram e hanamoa, eto, Dirava Herea Mikamika, guba bona tanobada ikaradia Diravana, ena hahenamo be Abram latanai baine mia;
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

motu: Dirava Herea Mikamika danu aita imodaia, badina be ia ese oi inaimu na imamu ai vada e atodia kau. Bena Abram ese e abi kohudia iboudiai e karoadia, karoa gwauta; bena karoa ta Melkisedek e henia.
english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave|strong="H5414" * him|strong="H5414" * a|strong="H3068" * tenth|strong="H4643" * of|strong="H3027" * all|strong="H3605" *.

motu: Bena Sodoma pavapavana ese Abram e hamaoroa, eto, Abi-mauri taudia lau ba henigu, a kohu be oi ese bavabi.
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

motu: A Abram ese Sodoma pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Lau ese Iehova, Herea Mikamika Diravana, guba bona tanobada ikaradia Diravana, vada na gwvau henia hamata,
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

motu: dabua varona ta eiava tamaka varona ta oiemu ai basina abia, gabeamo baoto “Lau ese Abram ena taḡa na henia” na garina.
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

motu: Egu memero adia aniani mo ba henigu; a kohu be e bamogu taudia tatoiosi, Anere bona Eksol bona Mamare, ahudia ba henidia, vadaeni.
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Iehova ena hereva na Abram enai e kau, mata hanai ai. Iehova eto, Abram, basio gari, lau na oiemu kesi, ahumu danu baine bada.
english: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

motu: Bena Abram eto, Ḡaubada Iehova e, dahaka ba henigu? Lau na asi natugu; dihigu be hari Eliesere, Damasko tauna.
english: Abram said, “Lord + 15:2 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai”. * Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

motu: Abram ma eto, Natugu ta so henigu dainai, hesiai merona egu ruma ai e vara na dihigu ai bainela.
english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva enai ma e kau, eto, Ina tau na dia oi dihimu; natumu adorana do baine vara, dihimu ai bainela.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

motu: Bena e hakaua lasi murimuri ai, eto, A gaga dae, guba ba itaia, hisiu ba duahidia diba eiava lasi: oi garamu danu unu bae hutuma toma.
english: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

motu: Bena Abram ese Iehova e abidadama henia; una dainai maorona e gwauraia.
english: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henia lou, eto, Lau Iehova ese Uru, Kaldea hanuana, amo na hakaumu lasi, ina tano baina henimu halaoreana, emu tano korikori ai bainela.
english: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

motu: Abram eto, Ḡaubada Iehova e, ede baina diba toma ina na egu tano korikori ai bainela?
english: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

motu: Iehova eto, Boromakau hahinena ta bavabia, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona nani hahinena ta, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona mamoe maruanena ta, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona kerea ta bona pune natuna ta.
english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

motu: Ini iboudiai e abi, e ivadia parara, ahu rua ai e habou, a manu na se ivadia.
english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

motu: Bena galo na unu vamu ai e roho kau, to Abram ese e luludia.
english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

motu: Dina e diho, bena Abram matana e mahuta, bona gari bada ese e butua tao.
english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Abram e hereva henia, eto, Ba diba ḡoevaḡoeva: garamu be sinahu-hani idau tano ai bae noho, daḡedaḡe taudia isiaidia bae lao heni;
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

motu: a isiaina bae lao heni besena lau ese baina hahemaoro henia; bena ia bogaragina amo bae raka lasi, mai edia taḡa.
english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

motu: Oi be tubu tama dekedia do baola mai mainomu ida: burukamu ai ba mase, bena bae gurimu.
english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

motu: A idia be uru ihahanina ai ina tano bae lou henia, badina be Amoro taudia ese edia kara havara do asie haḡuḡuru.
english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

motu: Dina e kerekere, hanua e boi; bena Abram ese lahi mai kwalahuna e itaia, e kara kede na heto, unu vamu ahu rua padadiai.
english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Abram e gwau henia hamata, eto, Lau ese ina tano na oi garamu vada na henidia, Aigupto sinavaina amo ela bona sinavai badana, ladana na Eufrate:
english: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

motu: Kene taudia edia tano, Kenisi taudia edia tano, Kadamono taudia edia tano,
english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

motu: Hiti taudia edia tano, Perisi taudia edia tano, Refaim taudia edia tano,
english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

motu: Amoro taudia edia tano, Kanaan taudia edia tano, Girigasa taudia edia tano, bona Iebusu taudia edia tano.
english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

motu: Sarai, Abram adavana, vada e gabani, natuna ta se havaraia iena. Ia na mai ena hesiai hahinena ta, hane Aigupto, ladana be Hagara.
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

motu: Bena Sarai ese Abram e hamaoroa eto, Dibamu Iehova ese natumu ta se henigu; na noimumu, egu hesiai hahinena avabia; readia natugu ta iena amo baina abia. Bena Abram ese Sarai ena hereva e abia dae.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

motu: Taunabunai, Abram na laḡani gwauta Kanaan tanona ai vada e noho negana ai, Sarai ese ena hesiai hahinena Hagara, hane Aigupto, e abia, adavana Abram e henia, baine adavaia.
english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

motu: Bena ia na Hagara ida e eno bou. Bena hahine na e rogorogo; bena dibana vada e rogorogo dainai ia ese biaguna hahinena se matauraia.
english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

motu: Bena Sarai ese Abram e gwau henia, eto, Oiemu kerere ese vada e hadikagu; egu hesiai hahinena na henimu, bavadavaia, a dibana vada e rogorogo dainai ia na se matauraigumu: Iehova ese ita raruosi baine hahemaoro henida.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May Yahweh judge between me and you.”

motu: A Abram ese Sarai e haere henia, eto, Hahine na oi imamu ai; emu ura heḡereḡerena ba kara henia. Bena Sarai ese e daḡedaḡe henia, ela bona hahine na e heau.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ta ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e davaria, ranu gurina ta badibadinai. Una ranu gurina na Suru dalana ai.
english: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

motu: Ia eto, Hagara, Sarai ena hesiai hahinemu, ede amo oma bona ede bo laomu? Hahine na e haere, eto, Biagugu hahinena Sarai vairana amo vada na heau.
english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She|strong="H6440" * said, “ I|strong="H2088" * am fleeing|strong="H1272" * from|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * face|strong="H6440" * of|strong="H6440" * my|strong="H6440" * mistress|strong="H1404" * Sarai|strong="H8297" *.”

motu: Aneru ma eto, A lou lao, ia erena ba kamonai.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

motu: Iehova ena aneru ma eto, Oi garamu lau ese baina hahutumadia, basie duahidia diba.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

motu: Iehova ena aneru ma e hamaoroa lou, eto, Benaini, vada o rogorogomu; mero ta bavabia, ladana ba hatoa Ismael, + 16:11 “Ismael” anina be “Dirava e kamonaimu”. * badina be Iehova ese emu tai vada e kamonai.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.

motu: Ia na raka edea tauna ai bainela; ia ese taunimanima iboudiai baine inai henidia, bona taunimanima iboudiai ese ia bae inai henia. Ia na tadikakana edia noho gabudia mairiveina kahana ai baine noho.
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

motu: Bena hahine ese Iehova, e hereva henia Diravana, ladana e hahanea, eto, Vada o ha=eregumu Diravamu! Badina be ia eto, Tano ḡaḡaena ai vada na mata hanai, e hahedinarai henigu Diravana vada na itaia.
english: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

motu: Taunabunai una ranu gurina ladana e hatoa Mauri bona Mata-hanai Gurina: ia na Kade bona Bered padadiai.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. + 16:14 Beer Lahai Roi means “well of the one who lives and sees me”. * Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

motu: Bena Hagara na e mara, mero ta e abia, Abram ena; bena Abram ese natuna, Hagara ese e havaraia merona, ladana e hatoa Ismael.
english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

motu: Hagara ese Ismael e havaraia negana ai, Abram ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahaniahui tauratoi.
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

motu: Abram ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahanai-ta-ahui taurahani-ta negana ai, Iehova ese ienai e hedinarai, e hereva henia, eto, Lau na Siahu Diravana; lau vairagu ai ba raka mai maoromaoromu ida;
english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.

motu: taravamu aina atua raruosi eda, bona garamu baina hahutumadia.
english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

motu: Bena Abram na tano ai e goru diho; bena Dirava ese e hereva henia, eto,
english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

motu: Lau ese taravamu na atuamu: bese diaḡau do ba havaradia lau daigu ai.
english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

motu: Ladamu danu basie hatoa lou “Abram”, a ladamu bae hatoa “Abraham”, + 17:5 “Abraham” anina be “Hutuma tamadia”. * badina be bese diaḡau ihavaradia tauna ai vada na halaomu.
english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

motu: Garamu lau ese baina hahutumadia, bese idau-idau do ba havaradia, hanua pavapavadia danu oiemu amo bae vara.
english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

motu: Taravamu na atuamu be lau ese baina badinaia ita raruosi eda, bona garamu murimu ai bae vara edia, ela bona uru iboudiai, baine mia hanaihanai taravatuna: emu Dirava ai bona murimu ai bae vara garamu edia Dirava ai do bainala.
english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

motu: Oi ese o noholaia hedoa-hedoamu tanona na oi bona murimu ai bae vara garamu danu baina henimui, Kanaan tanona idoinai na umui emui ela bona hanaihanai: lau na emui Dirava ai bainala.
english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

motu: Dirava ese Abraham ma e hamaoroa, eto, Oi danu egu taravatu do ba badinaia, oi bona murimu ai bae vara garamu ela bona uru idoidiai.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

motu: Ba badinaia, bona murimu ai bae badinaia. taravatuna binai: emui maruane iboudiai bae peritomedia,
english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

motu: kopimui bae ivadia, eda taravatu toana.
english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

motu: Uru iboudiai lalodiai, vara matamata mamaruanedia edia vara dinadia bae taurahani ai na bae peritomedia, umui emui ai bae vara memerodia, bona emui hesiai hahinedia ese emui ruma ai bae havaradia memerodia, idau bese memerodia edia bese taudia ediai ba hoidia danu bae peritomedia.
english: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

motu: Emui ruma ai bae vara memerodia bona ba hoidia memerodia, iboudiai ba peritomedia: unu amo egu taravatu toana na kopimui ai baine mia, badina be ia na mia-hanaihanai taravatuna.
english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

motu: A maruane ta basiema peritomea, ia na asi ahuna ena bese ai; ia na egu taravatu itata-utuna tauna.
english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

motu: Dirava ese Abraham ma e hamaoroa, eto, Adavamu Sarai ladana basio hatoa lou “Sarai”, a ladana ba hatoa “Sara”.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

motu: Lau ese baina hanamoa, natumui ta baine vara: momokani, baina hanamoa, ia na bese idau-idau sinadia ai bainela; hanua pavapavadia ia ese baine havaradia.
english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

motu: Bena Abraham na tano ai e goru diho, to lalona ai e kiri, eto, Ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta tauna ese natuna baine havaraia a? Sara danu ena mauri laḡanidiana taurahani-ta-ahui be baine mara a?
english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

motu: Bena Abraham ese Dirava e noia, eto, Ismael na oi vairamu ai bema noho bema namo.
english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

motu: A Dirava ese Abraham e haere henia, eto, Lasi, adavamu Sara ese natumu ta baine havaraia, ladana ba hatoa Isaak. + 17:19 “Isaak” anina be “Kiri”. * Egu taravatu baina badinaia ienai bona murinai bae vara garana ediai, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. + 17:19 Isaac means “he laughs”. * I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

motu: A Ismael ome gwauraia herevana vada na kamonai; benaini, vada na hanamoamu, ia besena baine vara, garana bae hutuma; lohia gwauta-rarua ia ese baine havaradia, bese badana ai baina halaoa.
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

motu: A egu taravatu na Isaak enai baina badinaia, merona bunai Sara ese baine abia, laḡani vairai.
english: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

motu: Dirava ese ena hereva e hadokoa, bena ia ese Abraham e rakatania.
english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

motu: Bena Abraham ese natuna Ismael e abia, bona ena hesiai tataudia iboudiai, ena ruma ai e vara taudia bona e hoidia taudia danu, e abidia, iboudiai e peritomedia una dina ai, kopidia e ivadia, Dirava ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

motu: Abraham ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ta-ahui taurahanita, e peritomea negana ai.
english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

motu: Natuna Ismael ena mauri laḡanidia na gwauta toi, e peritomea negana ai.
english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

motu: Abraham mai natuna Ismael ida dina tamona ai e peritomedia.
english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

motu: Ena ruma tataudia iboudiai danu, ena ruma ai e vara taudia bona bese idau edia amo e hoidia taudia, iboudiai na ia ida e pentomedia nega tamona ai.
english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

motu: Iehova ese Abraham enai ma e hedinarai lou, Mamare ena au Helaḡadia badidiai. Negana be dina tubua, bona ia na ena dabua kalagana iduarana ai e helaiva.
english: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

motu: Ia na e gaga isi, tatau tatoi e itadia, ia vairanai gigini; e itadia negana ai, ia na ena dabua kalagana iduarana amo e heau lasi, tano ai e goru diho,
english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

motu: eto, Ḡauka e, boma lalo namo henigu, lau, emu hesiai tauna, basioma rakagu hanai.
english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

motu: Mani ranu taina ae mailaia, aemui bae huri, bena ina au ikerukeruna ai lagamui bavani.
english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

motu: Aniani taina danu mani aina mailaia, taumui ihagoadadia; gabeamo emui dala ai do ba raka. Lau, emui hesiai tauna, egu ai vada o kau badina korikori binai. Idia eto, Emu hereva heḡereḡerena vada ba karaia.
english: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They|strong="H3588" * said|strong="H1696" *, “ Very|strong="H3651" * well|strong="H3820" *, do|strong="H6213" * as|strong="H6213" * you|strong="H3588" * have|strong="H5650" * said|strong="H1696" *.”

motu: Bena Abraham na dabua kalagana ai e heau vareai, Sara e hamaoroa, eto, Flaoa irau autoi avabi, ba kuia, ataga ba gabu.
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs + 18:6 1 seah is about 7 liters or 1.9 gallons or 0.8 pecks * of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

motu: Bena e heau lao, ena boromakau serina ai boromakau natuna ta, hidiona manoka-manokana bona mai digarana ḡauna, e abia, ena hesiai tauna ta e henia; bena ia ese e nadua haraḡa-haraḡa.
english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

motu: Bena bata bona rata e abi, bona ena mero ese e nadua boromakauna; bena hari tatoiosi vairadiai e dabara, au ikerukeruna ai, bona badibadidiai e gini ela bona vada e aniani vaitani.
english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

motu: Bena idia ese e nanadaia, eto, Adavamu Sara be edeseni ai? Ia eto, Ia na dabua kalagana lalonai.
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He|strong="H8283" * said, “ There|strong="H2009" *, in the|strong="H2009" * tent.”

motu: Bena idia ta eto, Laḡani vairai do baina lou henimu, bena adavamu Sara baine mara, mero ta baine abia. Sara na dabua kalagana iduarana murinai gini, bena ia ese una hereva e kamonai.
english: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah|strong="H8283" * heard|strong="H8085" * in|strong="H8085" * the|strong="H8085" * tent door|strong="H6607" *, which|strong="H1931" * was|strong="H1931" * behind him|strong="H7725" *.

motu: Una negana ai Abraham bona Sara vada e buruka herea, bona Sara ena nega vada e hanaia.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

motu: Taunabunai, Sara na e kiri, eto, Egu nega vada e ore, bona adavagu danu vada e buruka, be, moale baina davaria diba a?
english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Abraham e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai Sara e kirimu, e tomu “Burukagu ai natugu ta baina abia a”?
english: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’

motu: Be, hoa karana ta mia Iehova basine karaia diba, a? Laḡani vairai, vada na gwauraia hamata negana ai, do baina lou henimu, bena Sara ese natuna baine abia.
english: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

motu: Bena Sara e heḡore, eto, Lau na asina kiri. Badina be ia na e gari. A ia eto, Lasi, oi na o kiri.
english: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He|strong="H3588" * said, “ No|strong="H3808" *, but|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * did|strong="H3808" * laugh|strong="H6711" *.”

motu: Bena hari tatoiosi e tore isi, Sodoma dalana ai e raka; bona Abraham ese dala ai e bamodia.
english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Egu kara na Abraham ena amo baina hunia, namo eiava?
english: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

motu: Badina be Abraham na bese badana bona goadana ai bainela, bona tanobada besedia iboudiai na ia dainai hahenamo bae abia.
english: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

motu: Badina be vada na abia hidi, ia ese natuna bona garana do baine reḡudia, idia na Iehova ena dala ai bae raka, bona kara namodia bona maoromaorodia bae kara, Iehova ese ena gwauhamata Abraham enai baine hamomokania helaoreana.
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Sodoma bona Gomora haridia na didika bona edia kara havara danu na babada heherea dainai,
english: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

motu: harihari vada baina diho, baina itadia, edia kara na unu haridia dikadia egu ai vada e kau heḡereḡeredia eiava lasi: baina diba ḡoevaḡoeva.
english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

motu: Bena hari raruosi na e raka oho, Sodoma dalana ai ela; a Abraham na dounu Iehova vairanai gini.
english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.

motu: Bena Abraham na e raka kahira, e nanadaia, eto, O, kara maoromaoro taudia na kara dika taudia ida ba habuadia tari hebou a?
english: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

motu: Bema kara maoromaoro taudia imahui nonoho una hanua ai, ba habuaia tari a? Basio bogaia hisi, unu kara maoromaoro taudia imahui daidiai a?
english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

motu: Kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia na basio aladia bou ani? Kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia ahudia bae tamona na dia oiemu kara ani? Tanobada idoinai ihahemaoro-henina Diravana basine kara maoromaoro a?
english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Sodoma lalonai kara maoromaoro taudia imahui baina davaridia, hanua idoinai baina bogaia hisi idia daidiai.
english: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

motu: Bena Abraham ma e hereva, eto, Lau na ḡahu kavakava mo, to lalogu vada na ha-aukaia Ḡaubada iherevahenina:
english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

motu: readia kara maoromaoro taudia hariahui ima mo nonoho; o, hanua idoinai ba habuaia tari, ima mo lasi dainai a? Iehova eto, Hari-ahui ima baina davaridia, hanua na basina habuaia tari.
english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He|strong="H8033" * said, “ I|strong="H3808" * will|strong="H6662" * not|strong="H3808" * destroy|strong="H7843" * it|strong="H8033" * if I|strong="H3808" * find|strong="H4672" * forty-five there|strong="H8033" *.”

motu: Ia na ma eto, Readia hari-ahui nonoho dahaka. Iehova eto, Hari-ahui daidiai baina bogaia hisi.
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He|strong="H8033" * said|strong="H1696" *, “ I|strong="H3808" * will|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * do|strong="H6213" * it|strong="H6213" * for|strong="H6213" * the|strong="H6213" * forty’s sake|strong="H5668" *.”

motu: Ma eto, Ḡaubada e, baina noinoi lou basio badu ani? Toi-ahui bema noho ede bema heto? Iehova eto, Toi-ahui baina davaridia, basina habuaia tari.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He|strong="H8033" * said|strong="H1696" *, “ I|strong="H3808" * will|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * do|strong="H6213" * it|strong="H6213" * if I|strong="H3808" * find|strong="H4672" * thirty|strong="H7970" * there|strong="H8033" *.”

motu: Ma eto, Lalogu vada na ha-aukaia, Ḡaubada ihereva-henina: ruahui bema noho, ede bema heto? Iehova eto, Ruahui daidiai baina bogaia hisi.
english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He|strong="H8033" * said|strong="H1696" *, “ I|strong="H2009" * will|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * destroy|strong="H7843" * it|strong="H8033" * for|strong="H8033" * the|strong="H7843" * twenty|strong="H6242" *’s sake|strong="H5668" *.”

motu: Ma eto, Ḡaubada e, basio badu, ina nega tamona mo ma baina noinoi: gwauta hona bema noho, ede bema heto? Iehova eto, Gwauta daidiai baina bogaia hisi.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He|strong="H8033" * said|strong="H1696" *, “ I|strong="H3808" * will|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * destroy|strong="H7843" * it|strong="H8033" * for|strong="H8033" * the|strong="H7843" * ten|strong="H6235" *’s sake|strong="H5668" *.”

motu: Iehova na Abraham ida e hereva-hereva vaitani, bena ena dala e raka lao, a Abraham na ena noho gabuna e lou henia.
english: Yahweh went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

motu: Aneru raruosi na Sodoma ai e kau, dina kerekerena ai. Lot na hanua ikoukouna ai e helai, bena e itadia negana ai na vairadiai e heau, tano ai e goru diho,
english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

motu: eto, Egu lohia e, lau, emui hesiai tauna, egu ruma ai mani a dae kau, ba noho rani, aemui danu ba huri; bena daba ai ba tore isi, emui dala ai ba raka. Idia eto, Lasi; hanua ariarana ai baia noho rani.
english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They|strong="H3588" * said, “ No|strong="H3808" *, but|strong="H3588" * we|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H5650" * stay|strong="H3885" * in|strong="H1980" * the|strong="H3588" * street|strong="H7339" * all|strong="H3885" * night|strong="H3885" *.”

motu: To e noidia goadagoada, bena idia na ia ida e dae kau, ena ruma ai e raka vareai. Bena ia ese aniani e nadua, bona flaoa kavakava, se hatubua ḡauna, e gabua, e dabara, bena raruosi e ani.
english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

motu: Idia na do asie hekure ai, hanua taudia kikina-badana, hari Sodoma taudia, hanua kahadia iboudiai amo e heau bou heau bou ela, ruma na e ginia hegege.
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

motu: Bena idia ese Lot e boi henia, eto, Hari hanuaboi emu ruma ai e dae kau taudia be edeseni ai? Ba hakaudia lasi; baia dibadia.
english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

motu: Bena Lot na iduara amo e raka lasi bona iduara e koua ia murinai;
english: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.

motu: bena e hamaorodia, eto, Tadikakagu e, ina kara dikana basio karaia.
english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

motu: A itaia, natugu raruosi nonoho, ulato rami-hebou: mani aina hakaudia lasi emui ura heḡereḡerena ba kara henidia. A ini raruosi basio hadikadia, badina be egu guhi metaina ai e nohomu.
english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

motu: A idia eto. A gini siri. Ma eto, Ina tau sibona ema, bogaragidai e noho hedoamu: matona. baine hahemaoro henida e tomu. Harihari idia baia hadikadia maraḡi, a oi baia hadikamu bada. Bena idia ese Lot e doria siri, iduara bae taraia patapata eto.
english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

motu: To unu raruosi na ruma lalona amo imadia e toi roro, Lot e veria vareai, bena iduara e koua ahu.
english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

motu: A ariara ai e gini hebouva taudia kikina-badana na matadia e hakepuludia; bena iduara e tahua malakamalaka ela bona e hesiku.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

motu: Bena hari raruosi ese Lot e nanadaia, eto, Varavaramu iboudiai bini eiava? Bema ravamu eiava natumu mamaruanedia eiava natumu hahinedia haida ina hanua ai nonoho, ina gabu amo ba hakaudia lasi.
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

motu: Badina be ina gabu baia habuaia tari, badina be haridia dika-hereadia na Iehova enai vada e kau, taunabunai Iehova ese vada e siaimai, baia habuaia tari.
english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”

motu: Bena Lot e raka lasi, ela, ravana, ia natuna hahinedia haida adavadia, e hereva henidia, eto, A tore tore isi, ina gabu aita rakatania, badina be Iehova ese ina hanua baine habuaia tari. To ravana banava ia e hevaseha henidia eto.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!” But|strong="H3588" * he|strong="H3588" * seemed|strong="H5869" * to|strong="H1696" * his|strong="H3068" * sons-in-law|strong="H2860" * to|strong="H1696" * be|strong="H1961" * joking.

motu: Daba e rere, bena hari aneru ese Lot e haduaia goadagoada, eto, A tore isi haraḡa-haraḡa, adavamu bona natumu ulatodia raruosi bini avabidia, baola; ina hanua ihabua-tarina ai oi danu ba mase na garina.
english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

motu: E halahe, bena raruosi ese ia imana bona adavana imana bona natuna ulatodia raruosi imadia e abi, hanua murimurinai e hakaudia lasi; badina be Iehova ese e bogaia hisi.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

motu: E hakaudia lasi, bena eto, Ba heau mauri, basio roha muri, taora ai basio halahe. Ororo ba heau lao, ba mase na garina.
english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

motu: Bena Lot ese e noidia, eto, Egu lohia e, dia unuheto.
english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

motu: Mani a itagu, emui hesiai tauna; vada o harihari henigu bona vada o bogagu hisi bona vada o hamaurigu. A lau na asi goadagu ororo baina heau henidia, hahedika ese baine ḡavagu tao, bena baina mase.
english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

motu: A una hanua na kahirakahira, baina heau henia diba; ia danu hanua maraḡina mo. Mani emui kara unu bainala. Ia na hanua maraḡina ani? Bena mauri baina davaria.
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Emu noinoi tamona binai ma na abia daemu; hari o noilaiamu hanuana na basina habuaia tari.
english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

motu: Ba lao henia haraḡa; badina be ḡau ta basina karaia diba ela bona oi na unuseni ai ba kau. Una dainai una hanua ladana e hatoa Soara. + 19:22 “Soara” anina be “Maragi”. *
english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar. + 19:22 Zoar means “little”. *

motu: Dina e taolara ai Lot na Soara ai e kau.
english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

motu: Bena Iehova ese nadi siahudia bona lahi na guba amo e hadiho, Sodoma bona Gomora latadiai.
english: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

motu: Unu hanua ruaosi, bona una taora idoinai, bona hanua taudia, bona taora ai e vara ḡaudia, ibouboudiai ia ese a habuadia tari.
english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

motu: A Lot adavana e roha muri, bena ia na damena nadina ai e hahelao.
english: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

motu: Una daba ai Abraham e tore isi, Iehova ida e hereva-hereva gabuna e raka henia;
english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

motu: e roha lao, Sodoma bona Gomora bona taora idoinai e ita, una tano idoinai ai kwalahu e daeva, amu kwalahuna na heto.
english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

motu: Unuhetomana, taora hanuadia e habua tari negana ai, Dirava ese Abraham e laloa, bona Lot e hamauria, e noho kau heni hanuadia e habua tari negana ai.
english: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

motu: Bena Lot na Soara e rakatania, ororo e dara dae, unuseni ai e nohova, natuna ulatodia raruosi ida; badina be Soara ai baine noho na garina e gariva. Ia mai natuna ulatodia raruosi ida kohua ta ai e nohova.
english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

motu: Bena hane guna ese tadina e hamaoroa, eto, Tamada e burukamu, bona asi tauna ta tanobada ai baine adavada tanobada ena kara heḡereḡerena.
english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

motu: Aitala, tamada na vine ranuna amo baita hakekeroa, bena ia ida baita eno bou, tamada ena amo natuda baita abidia.
english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

motu: Bena una hanuaboi vine ranuna amo tamadia e hakekeroa, bena hane guna na ia ida e eno bou; a ia be ena hekure negana bona ena toreisi negana asi dibana.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

motu: Daba ai, hane guna ese tadina e hamaoroa, eto, Boi hanuaboi lau na tamagu ida na eno bou; hari hanuaboi ma baita hakekeroa lou, bena oi danu ia ida ba eno bou; bena ita raruosi na tamada ena amo natuda baita abidia.
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

motu: Bena una hanuaboi danu idia ese tamadia e hakekeroa; bena hane muritai na ia ida e eno bou; a ia be ena hekure negana bona ena tore isi negana asi dibana.
english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

motu: Taunabunai Lot natuna ulatodia raruosi na tamadia ese e harogorogodia.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

motu: Bena hane guna na mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Moab; Moab besena taudia iboudiai ema bona harihari senedia na ia.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

motu: Hane muritai danu mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Ben-ami; Amono besena taudia iboudiai ema bona harihari senedia na ia.
english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

motu: Una negana ai, Abraham na e tore isi, eha laolao, diho kahana ela, Gerara ai e noho, Kade bona Suru padadiai.
english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

motu: Bena Abraham ese Sara e herevalaia, eto, Ia na taihugu. Bena Abimelek, Gerara pavapavana, ese e abia.
english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

motu: Bena Dirava ese Abimelek e hahedinarai henia nihi ai, eto, A kamonai: oi na mase tauna, hari o abia hahinena dainai, badina be ia na tau ta adavana.
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

motu: A Abimelek na hahine do se raka henia kahi. Bena ia eto, Ḡaubada e, kara maoromaoro besena ba hamasea a?
english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

motu: Hari tau ese e hamaorogu, eto “Ina na lau taihugu”, ani? Bona hahine ese danu e hamaorogu, eto “Ia na lau taihugu”. Mai lalogu maoromaorona bona mai imaḡu ḡoevaḡoevadia ida ina kara vada na karaia.
english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

motu: Bena Dirava ese nihi ai e haere henia, eto, Lau dibagu oi na mai lalomu maoromaorona ida vada o karaia. Lau danu vada na rumu, vairagu ai ba kerere na garina; una dainai na laomu ahu, so raka henia kahi.
english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

motu: Taunabunai, una tau adavana ba henia lou, badina be ia na peroveta tauna; bena ia ese oi daimu ai baine ḡuriḡuri. bena ba mauri. A basio henia lou, ba diba momokani vada ba mase, oi bona emu ruma taudia iboudiai.
english: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

motu: Taunabunai Abimelek na daba vaburana ai e tore isi, ena hesiai taudia iboudiai e boiridia, unu ḡau e hamaoro-laidia: bena gari ese e butudia tao.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

motu: Bena Abimelek ese Abraham e boiria, eto, Ede vada o karamai toma? Ede na hadikamu toma dainai lau bona egu basileia ini vada o hakereremai toma? Hegwau-tao karana ta vada o kara henigu.
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

motu: Abimelek ese Abraham ma e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai ina kara vada o karaia?
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

motu: Bena Abraham e haere, eto, Badina be na laloa nato ina gabu ai Dirava imatauraina na lasi, bena adavagu dainai bae alagu nato.
english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

motu: Bona ina danu, ia na momokani lau taihugu: tamamai na tamona, a sinamai be idau; bena raruosi a headava.
english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

motu: A Dirava ena hahedua dainai, tamagu ena ruma na rakatania negana ai lau ese na hamaoroa, nato, Ini ba bogagu hisi toma: baita lao heni gabudia iboudiai ba herevalaigu, baoto “Ia na lau taihugu”.
english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

motu: Bena Abimelek ese mamoe bona boromakau bona hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia na Abraham e henia; bena ia adavana Sara e henia lou.
english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

motu: Abimelek danu eto, A itaia, egu tano idoinai na oi vairamu ai; emu ura gabuna ba noholaia.
english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

motu: Ia ese Sara danu e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, silver * monidia daha-ta oi taihumu vada na henia, emu hemarai iabi-ohona taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai; iboudiai vairadiai bae gwauraimu maoro.
english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

motu: Bena Abraham ese Dirava e ḡuria; bena Dirava ese Abimelek e hamauria, bona adavana bona ena hesiai hahinedia danu e hamauridia, bena natudia e havaradia.
english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

motu: Badina be Iehova ese Abimelek ena ruma hahinedia iboudiai vada e hagabanidia, Sara, Abraham adavana, dainai.
english: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Sara e vadivadi henia bona ena gwau-hamata heḡereḡerena e kara henia.
english: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

motu: Bena Sara e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia Abraham ena, edia ḡauka negana ai, Dirava ese e gwauraia guna heḡereḡerena.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

motu: Bena Abraham ese natuna, Sara e abia merona, ladana e hatoa Isaak. + 21:3 “Isaak” anina be “Kiri”. *
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac. + 21:3 Isaac means “He laughs”. *

motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, Abraham ese natuna Isaak e peritomea, Dirava ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

motu: Abraham ena maun laḡanidia na sinahu-ta, natuna Isaak e vara negana ai.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

motu: Bena Sara eto, Dirava ese egu kiri badina vada e havaraia; harina bae kamonai taudia iboudiai na lau ida baia kiri hebou.
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

motu: Ma eto, Daika ese Abraham bema hamaoroa, bema toma Sara ese natuna baine ubua? Gau tamona, iahuna ai natuna vada na henia.
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

motu: Mero na e bada oho bada oho ela bona rata e negea; bena Abraham ese aria badana e karaia, Isaak ese rata e negea dinana ai.
english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

motu: Bena Sara ese Hagara, hane Aigupto, natuna, Abraham ese e havaraia merona, e itaia, ia ese Isaak e kirikirilaia.
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

motu: Bena ia ese Abraham e hamaoroa, eto, Hesiai hahinena mai natuna ida a luludia, badina be ina hesiai hahinena natuna na oi dihimu ai basinela, natugu Isaak ida.
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

motu: Bena Abraham lalona e hisihisi bada, natuna dainai.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

motu: A Dirava ese Abraham e hereva henia, eto, Lalomu basine hisihisi ina mero dainai bona emu hesiai hahinena dainai. Sara ena hereva iboudiai bavabi dae, badina be Isaak ena amo oi besemu do baine vara.
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

motu: A hesiai hahinena natuna danu bese badana ai baina halaoa, badina be ia na oi natumu.
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

motu: Daba matana ai Abraham na e tore isi, lagwa e abia, bona ranu danu nani kopina ai, Hagara e henia; ia na paḡana ai e atoa, bona mero danu; bena e siaia lao. Bena hahine na vada ela, Bere-sieba tano ḡaḡaena ai ehaloa.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

motu: Ranu na nani kopina na vada e ore ai, ia ese mero maraḡina e abia, au maraḡina ta henunai e atoa diho;
english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

motu: bena taina e raka lao, diba bema kinoa heḡereḡerena; bena tano ai e helai diho, e tai dikadika, eto, Mero ena mase basina itaia.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

motu: Dirava ese mero gadona e kamonai, bena Dirava ena aneru ta ese guba amo Hagara e boi henia, eto, Hagara e, oi na edeheto? Asio gari, badina be Dirava ese mero gadona vada e kamonai.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The|strong="H8085" * angel|strong="H4397" * of|strong="H6963" * God|strong="H8064" * called|strong="H7121" * to|strong="H8085" * Hagar|strong="H1904" * out|strong="H4480" * of|strong="H6963" * the|strong="H8085" * sky|strong="H8064" *, and|strong="H8064" * said|strong="H7121" * to|strong="H8085" * her|strong="H7121" *, “ What|strong="H4100" * troubles you|strong="H3588" *, Hagar|strong="H1904" *? Don’t be|strong="H8064" * afraid|strong="H3372" *. For|strong="H3588" * God|strong="H8064" * has|strong="H4100" * heard|strong="H8085" * the|strong="H8085" * voice|strong="H6963" * of|strong="H6963" * the|strong="H8085" * boy|strong="H5288" * where|strong="H8033" * he|strong="H1931" * is|strong="H1931" *.

motu: A tore isi, mero na avabia isi, imamu ai ba dogoa tao, badina be lau ese bese badana ai baina halaoa.
english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

motu: Bena Dirava ese matana e hapapa; bena ia ese ranu gurina ta e itaia; bena nani kopina e hahonua, mero na ranu e ha-inulaia.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

motu: Dirava ese mero na e reḡua. Ia na e bada oho bada oho, tano ḡaḡaena ai eha noho; ia na taraki-taraki e diba ḡoeva.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

motu: Ia na Paran tano ḡaḡaena ai e nohova; bena sinana ese Aigupto hane-ulatona ta e abia, ia baine adavaia. Abraham bona Abimelek e herohemaino
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

motu: Una negana ai Abimelek bona Fikol, ena tuari oreana biaguna, ese Abraham e hamaoroa, eto, Vada name diba Dirava ese e bamomumu emu kara iboudiai lalodiai.
english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

motu: Taunabunai, Dirava ladana ai ba gwau henigu hamata, oi na basio koigu, bona natugu bona tubugu basio koidia; a lau ese vada na kara namo henimu heḡereḡerena oi danu lau ba kara namo henigu bona ina o noholaiamu tanona danu ba kara namo henia.
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

motu: Bena Abraham eto, Vada baina gwau hamata.
english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

motu: A Abraham ese Abimelek e gwau henia, Abimelek ena hesiai taudia ese ranu gurina ta e abia havara dainai.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

motu: Bena Abimelek eto, Asi dibagu daika ese unu e kara toma; oi ese so hamaorogu bona asi dibagu ema bona hari dina.
english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

motu: Bena Abraham ese mamoe bona boromakau e abidia, Abimelek e henia; bena idia raruosi e herohemaino.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

motu: Bena Abraham ese mamoe natudia hitu e abidia, kaha ta ai e atodia tabe.
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

motu: Abimelek ese Abraham e nanadaia, eto, Ene mamoe natudia hitu kaha ta ai o atodia tabe be dahaka?
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

motu: Abraham e haere, eto, Ini egu mamoe natudia hituosi avabi, lau ese ina ranu gurina na ḡeia toana.
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

motu: Bena una gabu ladana e hatoa Bere-sieba, + 21:31 “Bere-sieba” anina be “Gwau-hamata gurina”. * badina be raruosi unuseni ai e gwau hamata heheni.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, + 21:31 Beersheba can mean “well of the oath” or “well of seven”. * because they both swore an oath there.

motu: Taunabunai, idia raruosi na Bere-sieba ai e herohemaino; bena Abimelek bona Fikol, ena tuari oreana biaguna, e lou lao, Filistia tanona ela.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

motu: A Abraham ese au helaḡana ta e hadoa Bere-sieba ai, bona Iehova, Noho-hanaihanai Diravana, ladana e hahanea.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

motu: Bena Abraham na nega daudau Filistia tanona ai e noho hedoa.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Dirava ese Abraham e diba-ḡania, eto, Abraham e! Ia eto, Lau o ina.
english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He|strong="H1697" * said|strong="H1697" *, “ Here|strong="H2009" * I|strong="H2009" * am|strong="H1961" *.”

motu: Dirava eto, Oi natumu bavabia, natumu vara-edeana, o lalokau heniamu merona, Isaak. Moria tanona baola, bena baina hamaorolaimu ororona dorina ai boubou ḡauna ai, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna ai, ba halaoa.
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

motu: Daba matana ai, Abraham na e tore isi, ena doniki e abia, ena hesiai memerodia rarua bona natuna Isaak danu e abidia. Boubou lahina audia e siri vaitani, bena e tore isi, Dirava ese e gwauraia gabuna ela.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai Abraham ese matana e roha isi, gabuna na dauhai e itaia.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

motu: Bena Abraham ese ena memero e hamaorodia, eto, Umui raruosi doniki ida ba noho iniseni ai, a lau be ina mero ida baiala, raruosi baia toma diho, gabeai baia lou mai dekemui ai.
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

motu: Bena Abraham ese boubou lahina audia e abi, natuna paḡana ai e ato kau, bona lahi bona kaia imana ai e abi; bena raruosi e raka hebou.
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

motu: Bena Isaak ese tamana Abraham e hereva henia, eto, Tamagu e! Tau na e haere, eto, Natugu e, lau o ina. Mero na eto, Lahi bona au bini, a mamoe, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna, be edeseni ai?
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He|strong="H2009" * said, “ Here|strong="H2009" * I|strong="H2009" * am, my son|strong="H1121" *.” He|strong="H2009" * said, “ Here|strong="H2009" * is|strong="H2009" * the|strong="H2009" * fire and|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H2009" * wood|strong="H6086" *, but|strong="H2009" * where|strong="H2009" * is|strong="H2009" * the|strong="H2009" * lamb|strong="H7716" * for|strong="H6086" * a|strong="H3068" * burnt|strong="H5930" * offering|strong="H5930" *?”

motu: Abraham e haere, eto, Natugu e, mamoe lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna na Dirava sibona ena amo baita abia. Bena raruosi ma e raka lao.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

motu: Raruosi na Dirava ese e gwauraia gabuna ai e kau: unuseni ai Abraham ese boubou patana e larebaia, au pata latanai e lakwaia; bena natuna Isaak e hiria, boubou patana ai e atoa kau, au latadiai.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

motu: Bena Abraham ese imana e toia roro, kaia e abia, natuna vada aine alaia mase eto.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

motu: A Iehova ena aneru na guba amo e boi dobi, eto, Abraham e, Abraham e! Ia na e haere, eto, Lau o ina.
english: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He|strong="H3068" * said|strong="H7121" *, “ Here|strong="H2009" * I|strong="H2009" * am|strong="H3068" *.”

motu: Ia eto, Imamu mero latanai asio atoa kau, kara ta danu asio karaia ienai; badina be lau harihari name diba oi ese Dirava garina o garimu; badina be natumu vara-edeana egu ai to ruava.
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

motu: Bena Abraham ese matana e roha isi, e roha muri, mamoe maruanena ta doana au ai e hedoa dae e itaia. Bena Abraham na ela, mamoe maruanena e abia, boubou ḡauna ai e halaoa, natuna ibodohilaina.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

motu: Bena Abraham ese una gabu ladana e hatoa Iehova-ire; + 22:14 “Iehova-ire” anina be “Iehova baine haḡerea”. * bena unu e gwauraia toma ema bonaharihari e tomu, Ororo dorina ai Iehova ese baine haḡeregu.
english: Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. + 22:14 or, Yahweh-Jireh, or, Yahweh-Seeing * As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

motu: Iehova ena aneru ese Abraham ma e hereva henia lou, guba amo ma e boi dobi,
english: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

motu: eto, Iehova na e tomu: sibogu ladagu ai vada na gwau hamata, ini vada o kara toma dainai, natumu vara-edeana, o lalokau heniamu merona, egu ai so rua dainai,
english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says Yahweh, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

motu: lau ese baina hanamomu badabada, oi garamu baina hahutumadia, guba hisiudia bona kone mirina na heheto; oi garamu ese bae inai henidia taudia edia tano bae abihaidia,
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

motu: oi garamu daidiai tanobada besedia iboudiai baina hanamodia, badina be oi ese lau eregu o kamonai.
english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

motu: Bena Abraham na ena hesiai memerodia raruosi dekedia e lou lao; hahaniosi e lou ela Bere-sieba, Abraham ena noho gabuna bunai.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Abraham ese hari ta e kamonai, tadina Nahoro adavana Milka ida natudia vada e vara.
english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

motu: Tau guna ladana na Usu; ia tadina be Busu bona Kemuel, Aram tamana,
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

motu: bona Kesed bona Haso bona Pilidasa bona Idilapa bona Betuel.
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

motu: Hari Betuel na Rebeka tamana. Taurahaniosi bini Abraham tadina Nahoro, adavana Milka ida, natudia.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

motu: Ena hesiai hahinena Reuma ese danu natuna e havaradia: ladadia na Teba bona Gaham bona Tahasa bona Maaka.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

motu: Sara ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-ta ruahui hitu.
english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

motu: Sarana Kiriat-araba ai eha mase: una hanua na Kanaan tanona ai, ladana ta be Heberon. Abraham na ruma ai e raka vareai, Sara taina e tai.
english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

motu: Bena Abraham na mase rumana amo e diho, Hiti taudia e hamaorodia, eto,
english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

motu: Lau na umui bogaragimui ai na noho hedoamu; tano ta mani a henigu, egu gara gabuna ai bainela, unuseni ai egu mase baina guria.
english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

motu: Bena Hiti taudia ese e haere henia, eto,
english: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

motu: Ḡauka e, oi na lohia badana, ai bogaragimai ai; emai gara gabudia ai gabu herea-daena ta bavabia, emu mase ba guria; ai ta ese ena gara gabuna basine rua oiemu ai.
english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

motu: Bena Abraham e tore isi, una tano taudia, Hiti taudia, vairadiai e igo diho;
english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

motu: e hamaorodia, eto, Lalomui bema heḡereḡere egu mase iniseni ai bama guria, Efron Sohara boma noia daigu ai:
english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

motu: ia ese Makapela kohuana, ena tano hetoana ai, bema henigu. Davana korikori baina henia, egu gara gabuna ai baina halaoa.
english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

motu: Hari Efron na Hiti taudia bogaragidiai e helaiva. Bena Efron, Hiti tauna, ese Abraham e haere henia, Hiti taudia vairadiai bona ena hanua taudia iboudiai vairadiai, eto,
english: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

motu: Ḡauka e, lasi; una tano mai kohuana ida baina henimu; egu bese taudia iboudiai vairadiai vada baina henimu, emu mase iguridia gabuna ai bainela.
english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

motu: Bena Abraham ese una gabu taudia vairadiai e igo diho.
english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

motu: Bena Abraham ese Efron e hereva henia, una gabu taudia vairadiai, eto, Mani a hakala henigu: una tano davana mani aina henimu; avabia, bena egu mase unuseni ai baina guria.
english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

motu: Bena Efron ese Abraham e haere henia, eto,
english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

motu: Ḡauka e, a kamonai: una tano davana na silver * sekeledia sinahuhani. Ita raruosi padadai una na ḡau ta a? Emu mase unuseni ai ba guria.
english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver + 23:15 A shekel is about 10 grams, so 400 shekels would be about 4 kg. or 8.8 pounds. * between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

motu: Abraham ese Efron ena hereva e kamonai, Hiti taudia vairadiai tano davana unu e gwauraia toma, bena silver * sekele + 23:16 “Sekele” be Heberu edia metau hahetoho ḡauna ta. Sekele sinahu-hani = 6 kilograms sisivana. Davana na readia K100 heḡereḡerena, ita eda moni ai. * dia sinahu-hani, idia edia sekeleheḡereḡeredia, e henia.
english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

motu: Taunabunai Efron ena tano Makapela ai, Mamare badinai, mai kohuana bona mai auna iboudiai na
english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

motu: Abraham ena tano korikori ai ela. Hiti taudia vairadiai bona ena hanua lalonai e hebouva taudia iboudiai vairadiai e hoia.
english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

motu: Bena Abraham ese ia adavana Sara e guria, Makapela kohuana lalonai, Mamare badinai. Una gabu na Heberon, Kanaan tanona ai.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

motu: Una tano bona una kohua be Abraham ese e abi vaitani, Hiti taudia edia amo.
english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

motu: Abraham vada e buruka: ena mauri laḡanidia na diaḡau. Bona Iehova ese vada e harihari henia, ḡau momo momo vada e henia.
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

motu: Bena Abraham ese ena hesiai tauna badana, ena kohu idoinai e reḡuava tauna, e haduaia, eto, Imamu na mamugu ai bavatoa kau,
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

motu: Iehova, guba Diravana bona tanobada Diravana, ladana ai ba gwau hamata, natugu Isaak adavana na ini Kanaan taudia, bogaragidiai na noho hedoamu taudia, natudia ulatodia ta basio abia;
english: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

motu: a egu tano korikori baola, varavaragu dekediai, unuseni ai natugu Isaak adavana bavabia.
english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

motu: Bena una hesiai tauna e haere henia, eto, O, hane-ulato na reana lalona basine heḡereḡere lau baine bamogu ina tano baiama; unu bema heto, oi natumu bama hakaua lao, o rakatania tanona baiala, namo eiava?
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

motu: Abraham ma eto, Lasi vaitani, natugu na basio laohaia, una tano na basinela.
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

motu: Iehova, guba Diravana, ese tamagu ena ruma amo e abigu oho, egu tano korikori amo e hakaugu lasi, bona e gwau henigu hamata, eto “Ina tano na oi garamu baina henidia”; bena ia ese ena aneru oi vairamu ai baine siaia, bena natugu adavana una tano ai do bavabia.
english: Yahweh, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
