motu: A hane-ulato bema gwau edeede, basinema bamomu, emu gwau-hamata bema heruha. Ḡau tamona, natugu na basio laohaia, unu basiola.
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

motu: Bena hesiai tauna ese imana na Abraham mamuna ai e atoa kau, e gwau henia hamata, unu baine kara toma eto.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

motu: Bena una hesiai tauna na biaguna ena kamelo gwauta e abidia, bona kohu namodia haida danu, biaguna ena, e abi. Bena e tore isi, eha laolao, Mesopotamia tanona ela, hanua ta ladana Nahoro ai eha kau.
english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

motu: Bena adorahi ai, hahine na ranu utu ela negana ai, ia ese kamelo e hahekuredia ranu gurina badibadinai, una hanua murimurina kahana ai.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

motu: Bena e ḡuriḡuri, eto, Iehova e, biagugu Abraham ena Dirava e, na noimumu, hari ina dina ai egu ḡaukara ba hanamoa, bona biagugu Abraham ba bogaia hisi.
english: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

motu: Ame itagu, lau binai ranu gurina badibadinai na nohomu; a hanua ulatodia na ranu utu be maimu.
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

motu: Na noimumu, hane-ulato ta baina hamaoroa, bainato “Emu hodu bavatoa diho, ranu kuri ta ba henigu, baina inua”, bena ia baineto “Madi ba inua; emu kamelo danu baina ha-inulaidia”, haneulatona bunai oiemu. abi-hidi ulatona, emu hesiai tauna Isaak ba henia ulatona mo. Unu amo baina diba oi na biagugu vada o bogaia hisimu.
english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

motu: Ena ḡuriḡuri do se ore ai, hane-ulato ta ladana Rebeka ena hodu e ehea ema. Ia na Betuel natuna; tubuna hahinena na Milka, Abraham tadina Nahoro adavana.
english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

motu: Ia na haneulato rami-hebou namo-hereana: tau ta ese do se adavaia. Ia na guri ela, ena hodu e hahonua, ma ema.
english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

motu: Bena hari hesiai tauna e heau ela, e hereva henia, eto, Emu hodu ranuna kuri ta mani aina inua.
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

motu: Hane-ulato na eto, Ḡauka e, a inua. Bena ranu e seia, e ha-inulaia.
english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

motu: Ma eto, Ranu ma aina utu, emu kamelo baina ha-inulaidia.
english: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

motu: Bena ena hodu ranuna orena na dihu-lata lalonai e seia, bena ranugurina ma e loulou henia ela bona kamelo iboudiai e ha-inulaidia vaitani.
english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

motu: Hari hesiai tauna ese e raraia tao, se hereva, baine diba eto, Iehova ese ena laolao anina vada e havaraia eiava.
english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

motu: Bena ena kamelo na ranu e inu vaitani murinai, ia ese gold * gadeina ta, metauna na sekele kahana, bona gold * vaḡivaḡidia rua, metaudia na sekele gwauta, e vai.
english: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel + 24:22 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

motu: E nanadaia, eto, Oi be daika natuna? Tamamu ena ruma na mai gabuna, ai baia noho, eiava?
english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

motu: Hane-ulato na e haere, eto, Lau na Betuel natuna; tubugu hahinenana Milka, Nahoro adavana.
english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

motu: Ma eto, Uit momona bona rei kakoro momo dekemai ai mimia, emui mahuta gabuna ta danu mia.
english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

motu: Bena hari hesiai tauna e igo diho, Iehova e imodaia,
english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

motu: eto, Iehova, biagugu Abraham ena Dirava, na imodaiamu; ena hebogahisi bona ena momokani biagugu enai vada e hesiriumu, taunabunai ia ese egu dala ai vada e hakaugu maoro, ema bona biagugu varavarana edia ruma.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

motu: Bena hane-ulato na e heau ela, unu ḡau haridia na sinana ena rumataudia e hamaorolaidia.
english: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

motu: Hari Rebeka na mai taihuna ta, ladana na Laban; bena ia na e raka lasi haraḡa, una tau dekena ela, ranu gabuna ai.
english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

motu: Ia ese taihuna Rebeka ena gadei bona imana vaḡivaḡidia e ita, bena e raka lasi, hari ranu gabuna ai ena kamelo e naridiava tauna dekena ela.
english: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

motu: Bena e hereva henia, eto, Iehova ese vada e hanamomu taumu e, mani a dae kau. Dahaka dainai murimuri ai o nohomu? Badina be egu ruma vada na lailaia, bona kamelo edia gabu danu.
english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

motu: Bena una hesiai tauna na ruma ai e raka vareai. A Laban ese kamelo edia maduna e ruha, bena uit momona bona rei kakoro e henidia; bona hesiai tauna ranu e henia, ia mai bamona ida aedia bae huri.
english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

motu: Bena aniani e dabaraia ia vairanai; to ia eto, Basina aniani ela bona egu laolao badina aina gwauraia guna. Idia eto, A hereva.
english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said|strong="H1696" *, “ Speak|strong="H1696" * on|strong="H1696" *.”

motu: Bena ia eto, Lau na Abraham ena hesiai tauna.
english: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

motu: Iehova ese biagugu vada e hanamoa badabada, lohia badana ai vada e halaoa; mamoe seridia bona boromakau seridia vada e henia, bona silver * bona gold *, bona hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia, bona kamelo bona doniki.
english: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. Yahweh has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

motu: Biagugu adavana Sara na burukana ai natuna e abia; bena Abraham ese ia dihina ai vada e halaoa.
english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

motu: Bena biagugu ese e haduagu baina gwau hamata; eto “Natugu adavana na Kanaan taudia, bogaragidiai na noho hedoamu taudia, natudia ulatodia ta basio abia,
english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

motu: a tamagu ena ruma baola, varavaragu bogaragidiai natugu adavana bavabia”.
english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

motu: Bena biagugu na hamaoroa, nato “O hane-ulato na basine bamogu reana, bena ede baina heto?”
english: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

motu: Bena ia eto “Iehova, vairanai na rakamu Diravana, ese ena aneru baine siaia, baine bamomu bona emu dala baine lailaia; bena varavaragu bona tamagu ena ruma taudia bogaragidiai natugu adavana do ba davaria.
english: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

motu: Unu amo emu gwauhamata baine heruha, varavaragu dekediai ba kau negana ai; a idia na hane-ulato bema rua basiema henimu negana ai danu emu gwauhamata bema heruha”.
english: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

motu: Bena hari dina ai ranu gabuna ai na kau, bena na ḡuriḡuri, nato: Iehova e, biagugu Abraham ena Dirava, boma ura egu laolao anina namona boma havaraia,
english: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

motu: ini boma hamomokania toma: ina ranu gabuna ai na nohomu ai hane-ulato ta ranu utu bainema bena baina hereva henia, bainato “Emu hodu ranuna kuri ta a henigu, aina inua”, bena ia baineto
english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

motu: “Mani a inua, bona emu kamelo edia ranu danu baina utua”, baina diba hane-ulatona bunai, Iehova ese vada e abia hidi biagugu natuna baine adavaia ulatona.
english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

motu: Bena dounu na ḡuriḡuriva ai, Rebeka na hodu e ehea ema; e diho ela, guri ai ranu e utua. Bena na hamaoroa, nato “Mani emu kara, ranu kuri ta a henigu, aina inua”.
english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

motu: Bena ena hodu e atoa diho haraḡa, eto “A inua, bena emu kamelo edia ranu danu baina utua”.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

motu: Bena na nanadaia, nato “Oi be daika natuna?” Bena ia e haere, eto “Lau na Betuel natuna; tubugu na Nahoro bona ia adavana Milka”. Bena gadei na udu-baubauna ai na atoa, bona vaḡivaḡi imana ai.
english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

motu: Bena na igo diho, Iehova, biagugu ena Dirava, na imodaia, badina be ia ese e hakaugu maoro, biagugu tadina tubuna baina abia ia natuna baine adavaia helaoreana.
english: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

motu: Benaini, mani a hereva, biagugu ba bogaia hisi bona ihanamona karana ba karaia, eiava lasi; bena baina diba ede baina raka toma, idiba kahana amo eiava lauri kahana amo.
english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

motu: Bena Laban bona Betuel e haere, eto, Ina na Iehova ena amo; ai na basia haere henimu diba, basiato “Oibe” eiava “Lasi.”
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

motu: A itaia, Rebeka na vairamu ai gini: avabia, ba hakaua lao, biagumu natuna baine adavaia, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

motu: Abraham ena hesiai tauna una hereva e kamonai, bena tano ai e goru diho, Iehova e imodaia.
english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

motu: Bena ia ese herahera ḡaudia, gold * ḡaudia bona silver * gaudia bona dabua e hulala, Rebeka e henia; taihuna bona sinana danu herahia ḡaudia namo-hereadia e henidia.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

motu: Bena ia mai bamona ida e aniani, e inuinu, bena e mahuta. Daba ai e tore isi, eto, Mani a kahugu nege, biagugu baina lou henia.
english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

motu: A hane-ulato taihuna bona sinana eto, Hane-ulato na mani dekemai ai baine noho pura ta eiava dina gwauta, bena bainela.
english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

motu: A ia eto, Asio rugu: Iehova ese egu laolao anina vada e havaraia; mani a kahugu nege, biagugu baina lou henia.
english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

motu: Bena idia eto, Hane-ulato aita boiria, ia baine hereva.
english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese Rebeka e boiria, bena e nanadaia, eto, Lalomu vada eme heḡereḡere a, ina tau ida ba raka? Ia eto, Vada e heḡereḡere.
english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She|strong="H7121" * said|strong="H7121" *, “ I|strong="H2088" * will|strong="H2088" * go|strong="H3212" *.”

motu: Taunabunai taihudia Rebeka, mai ena hesiai hahinena ida e kahudia nege, Abraham ena hesiai tauna mai bamona ida danu.
english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

motu: Idia ese Rebeka e hanamoa, eto, Taihumai e, daha daha oiemu amo bae vara: oi garamu ese inaidia do bae hadareredia.
english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

motu: Bena Rebeka bona ena hesiai hahinedia e tore isi, kamelo ai e gui, hesiai tauna ida ela. Hari hesiai tauna ese Rebeka e hakaua lao.
english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

motu: Una negana ai Isaak na diho kahana ai e nohova; bena tano gagaena ai eha laolao, ranu gurina ta, ladana Bere-lahai-roi, ela.
english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

motu: Adorahi ta taora ai eha loaloa, dina kerekerena ai, bena e roha isi, kamelo e maiva e itadia.
english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

motu: Rebeka danu e roha isi, Isaak e itaia; bena ena kamelo amo e diho,
english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

motu: hesiai tauna e nanadaia, eto, Una taora ai e maimu tauna be daika? Hesiai tauna eto, Biagugu bunai. Bena Rebeka ese dabua ta e abia, vairana e govaia ahu.
english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The|strong="H3947" * servant|strong="H5650" * said, “ It|strong="H1931" * is|strong="H1931" * my|strong="H3947" * master.” She|strong="H1931" * took|strong="H3947" * her|strong="H3947" * veil|strong="H6809" *, and|strong="H1980" * covered|strong="H3680" * herself|strong="H1931" *.

motu: Bena hesiai tauna ese ena kara idoinai Isaak e hamaorolaia.
english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

motu: Bena Isaak ese Rebeka e hakaua lao, sinana Sara ena dabua rumana ai e hakaua vareai, e adavaia. Bena ia iura-henina ese lalona e hamarumarua, sinana taina e taiva negadia ai. s. 22. sekele kahana = 8 grams sisivana; sekele gwauta = 160 grams sisivana
english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

motu: Abraham ese hahine ta ma e adavaia, ladana na Ketura.
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

motu: Natudia ia bogana amo e vara ladadia bini: Simuran bona Iokosan bona Medan bona Midian bona Isabak bona Sua.
english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

motu: Iokosan ese Seba bona Dedan e havaradia. Dedan ese Asuri bona Letusi bona Leumi besedia e havaradia.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

motu: Midian ese Efa bona Efere bona Hanok bona Abida bona Eldaha e havaradia. Ini iboudiai na Ketura garana.
english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

motu: Abraham ese Isaak na ia dihina ai e halaoa.
english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

motu: A adavana oredia natudia na maurina ai e harihari henidia, bena e siaidia karoho, mairiveina kahana ai bae hanoho. Abraham e mase
english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

motu: Abraham ena mauri laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-ta hituahui ima.
english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

motu: Bena Abraham e mase: ia na buruka herea, ena mauri laḡanidia na diaḡau; bena varavarana ediai eha hebou.
english: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

motu: Bena ia natuna raruosi, Isaak bona Ismael, ese e abia, Makapela kohuana ai e guria: una kohua na Mamare kahana ai, Efron Sohara, Hiti tauna, ena tano ai.
english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

motu: Tanona bunai Abraham ese Hiti taudia edia amo e abia. Unuseni ai Abraham e guria, adavana Sara ida.
english: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

motu: Abraham ena mase murinai, Dirava ese natuna Isaak e hanamoa. Isaak na Bere-lahai-roi ranu gurina badibadinai e nohova. Ismael garana
english: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

motu: Ismael garana bini: ia na Abraham natuna, Sara ena hesiai hahinena Hagara, Aigupto hahinena, bogana amo.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

motu: Ismael garana ladadia bini: natuna roboana na Nebaioto; ia murinai e vara taudia be Kedara bona Adabeel bona Mibisam
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

motu: bona Misima bona Duma bona Masa
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

motu: bona Hadad bona Tema bona Ieturu bona Nafisi bona Kedema.
english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

motu: Ismael natudia bunu: ladadia bunu edia hanua bona edia taruha ladadia e hato; idia gwautararuosi na hanua ta ta e halohiadia.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

motu: Ismael ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahuta toi-ahui hitu. E mase, varavarana ediai eha hebou.
english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

motu: Edia tano na Havila ela bona Suru, Aigupto mairiveina kahana ai; tadikakadia iboudiai idia mo mairiveina kahana korikori ai e nohova. Esau bona Iakob e vara
english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

motu: Abraham natuna Isaak garana bini:
english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

motu: Isaak ena vara laḡanidia na hari-ahui negana ai, ia ese Rebeka, Betuel tau Suria natuna, Laban tau Suria taihuna, e adavaia. Betuel na Padan-aram tauna.
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

motu: Isaak ese Iehova e noia, adavana dainai, badina ia na gabani. Iehova ese ena noinoi e kamonaia; bena Rebeka e rogorogo.
english: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

motu: Hekapa na ia bogana ai e hedavelai; bena ia eto, Ini e karagu tomamu be ede baina heto? Bena Iehova enai e henanadai.
english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e haere henia, eto, Iduhu rua na bogamu ai, Bese rua na oiemu amo bae vara; Ta ese ma ta baine hadarerea, Tau guna ese tau muritai isiaina baine lao heni.
english: Yahweh said to her, “ Two|strong="H8147" * nations|strong="H1471" * are|strong="H1471" * in|strong="H3068" * your|strong="H3068" * womb|strong="H4578" *. Two|strong="H8147" * peoples|strong="H3816" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3068" * separated|strong="H6504" * from|strong="H1471" * your|strong="H3068" * body|strong="H4578" *. The|strong="H5647" * one|strong="H6810" * people|strong="H3816" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3068" * stronger than|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H5647" * other|strong="H8147" * people|strong="H3816" *. The|strong="H5647" * elder|strong="H7227" * will|strong="H3068" * serve|strong="H5647" * the|strong="H5647" * younger|strong="H6810" *.”

motu: Ena mara negana e gini dae, bena memero rarua e vara hekapa.
english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

motu: E vara guna merona na mia kakakaka, derana danu momo, dabua huika-huika na heto; ia ladana e hatoa Esau. + 25:25 “Esau” anina be “Huika-huika”. *
english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

motu: Gabeai tadina e vara, bena ia imana ese Esau aena geduna e dogoa tao; bena ladana e hatoa Iakob. + 25:26 “Iakob” anina be “Ibolona”. * Isaak ena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui, idia raruosi e vara negana ai. Esau bona Iakob e bada oho bada oho
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

motu: Memero raruosi na e bada oho bada oho. Esau na labana tauna mai aonegana, bona loaloa tauna; a Iakob na manada tauna bona konenoho tauna.
english: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

motu: Isaak ese Esau e lalokau heniava, badina be ena labana damudia e aniva; a Rebeka ese Iakob e lalokau heniava.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

motu: Dina ta Iakob ese aniani e nadua; bena Esau na gunika amo e lasi mai manorina ida.
english: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

motu: Esau ese Iakob e hereva henia, eto, Ena aniani kakakakana o naduamu na taina a henigu, aina ania, badina be e hitologu mase. Una dainai ia ladana ta e hatoa Edom. + 25:30 “Edom” anina be “Kakakaka”. *
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom. + 25:30 “Edom” means “red”. *

motu: Iakob eto, Emu roboa ahuna na a henigu, aniani davana.
english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

motu: Esau eto, Be, mokona ba masemu, roboa ahuna ese ede baine hanamogu toma?
english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

motu: Iakob eto, A gwau hamata guna. Bena Esau e gwau hamata, roboa ahuna Iakob e henia, aniani davana.
english: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He|strong="H3117" * swore|strong="H7650" * to|strong="H3117" * him|strong="H3117" *. He|strong="H3117" * sold|strong="H4376" * his|strong="H3290" * birthright|strong="H1062" * to|strong="H3117" * Jacob|strong="H3290" *.

motu: Bena Iakob ese flaoa bona vasiahu e henia; bena ia na e aniani, e inuinu danu. Bena e tore isi, e raka lasi. Esau ese ena roboa ahuna unu e dadaraia toma.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

motu: Doe bada e vara una tano ai, Abraham ena nega ai heḡereḡerena. Bena Isaak e tore isi, Gerara ela, Abimelek, Filistia pavapavana, dekena.
english: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

motu: Bena Iehova ese ienai e hedinarai, eto, Aigupto basiola; baina hadibalaimu tanona ai ba noho.
english: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

motu: Ina tano ai ba noho, bena lau baina bamomu bona baina hanamomu; badina be ini tano idoidiai oi baina henimu bona oi garamu baina henidia, oi tamamu Abraham na gwau henia hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

motu: Oi garamu danu baina hahutumadia, guba hisiudia na heheto bae hutuma; oi garamu daidiai tanobada besedia iboudiai bae namo;
english: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,

motu: badina be Abraham ese lau eregu e kamonai, egu hahedua, egu haheḡani, egu taravatu, iboudiai e badinadiava.
english: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

motu: Taunabunai Isaak be Gerara ai e nohova.
english: Isaac lived in Gerar.

motu: A una gabu taudia ese ia adavana e nanadailaia, bena ia eto, Ia na taihugu. “Ia na adavagu” baineto na e gari, badina be ia eto, Ina gabu taudia na bae alagu mase readia, Rebeka dainai, badina ia na hahine namo-hereana.
english: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

motu: Nega daudau unu e noho tomava, bena dina ta Abimelek, Filistia pavapavana, gabamauru amo e igo lasi, Isaak adavana Rebeka ida e itadia, e sihari.
english: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

motu: Bena ia ese Isaak e gwau henia, eto, Lalogu vada eme parara, hahine na oi adavamu. Dahaka dainai oi oto “Ia na taihugu”. Isaak e haere henia, eto, Badina be na gari, haida ese ia dainai bae alagu mase na garina.
english: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac|strong="H3327" * said|strong="H7121" * to|strong="H4191" * him|strong="H7121" *, “ Because|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * said|strong="H7121" *, ‘ Lest|strong="H6435" * I|strong="H3588" * die|strong="H4191" * because|strong="H3588" * of|strong="H5921" * her|strong="H5921" *.’”

motu: Bena Abimelek eto, Oi na ede vada o karamai toma? Tau ta oi adavamu ida bema eno bou, iboumai ai baiama kerere oi daimu ai.
english: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

motu: Bena Abimelek ese ena hanua taudia taravadia e atu, eto, Isaak enai baine dau kau eiava adavana enai baine dau kau tauna na baine mase.
english: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

motu: Isaak ese aniani e hado matama una tano ai, bena una laḡani tamona lalonai anidia sinahu sinahu e abi; badina be Iehova ese e hanamoa.
english: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

motu: Ia na taḡa tauna ai ela, ena taḡa danu e bada e laova;
english: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

motu: ena mamoe bona ena boromakau na hutuma herea, ena hesiai taudia danu hoho. Bena Filistia taudia ese e vaḡeḡe henia.
english: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

motu: Bena ranu guridia iboudiai Abraham ena nega ai ena hesiai taudia ese e ḡei na Filistia taudia ese e tahuni.
english: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

motu: Bena Abimelek ese Isaak e hamaoroa, eto, Ai emai amo a raka oho, badina be vada o hereamai.
english: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

motu: Bena Isaak na e raka oho, Gerara kourana ai e taruha, unuseni ai e nohova.
english: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

motu: Bena ranu guridia, tamana Abraham ena nega ai e ḡei bena Filistia taudia ese e tahuni, ia ese ma e gei lou; bona ladadia, tamana ese e hato heḡereḡeredia, ia ese ma e hato lou.
english: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

motu: Isaak ena hesiai taudia danu koura ai guri e ḡei, bona ranu e lohilohiva gabuna ta e davana.
english: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing + 26:19 Or, living. Or, fresh. * water.

motu: Bena Gerara seridia ireḡudia taudia na Isaak ena seri ireḡudia taudia ida e heatu, eto, Ina na ai emai ranu. Taunabunai, ia ese una ranu gabuna ladana e hatoa Esek, + 26:20 “Esek” anina be “Heai”. * badina be e heatulaia,
english: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, + 26:20 “Esek” means “contention”. * because they contended with him.

motu: Bena guri ta ma e ḡeia, to una danu e heatulaia, taunabunai ladana e hatoa Sitina. + 26:21 “Sitina” anina be “Inai”. *
english: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah. + 26:21 “Sitnah” means “hostility”. *

motu: Unu amo ma e raka oho bena guri ta ma e ḡeia. Una na asie heatulaia; taunabunai ladana e hatoa Rehoboto; + 26:22 “Rehoboto” anina be “Gabu”. * badina be ia eto, Iehova ese gabu ta vada e lailaia eda, iniseni ai baita noho namonamo. Isaak Beresieba ai
english: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. + 26:22 “Rehoboth” means “broad places”. * He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

motu: Unu amo ia na Bere-sieba ela.
english: He went up from there to Beersheba.

motu: Bena una hanuaboi Iehova na ienai e hedinarai, eto, Lau na tamamu Abraham ena Dirava: basio gari, badina be lau ese na bamomumu; baina hanamomu bona garamu baina hahutumadia, egu hesiai tauna Abraham dainai.
english: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

motu: Bena boubou patana ta unuseni ai e larebaia, bona Iehova ladana e hahanea. Unuseni ai danu e taruha, bona ena hesiai taudia ese ranu gurina e ḡeia.
english: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

motu: Abimelek na Gerara amo ema, ia bona turana ta Ahusata bona ena tuari oreana biaguna Fikol, tatoiosi Isaak dekena ema.
english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

motu: Bena Isaak ese e hereva henidia, eto, O inai henigu bona o lulugu: harihari lau dekegu vada oma badina be dahaka?
english: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

motu: Idia eto, Lalomai vada e parara Iehova ese vada e bamomu, taunabunai ai na a tomu: baita herohemaino bona baita gwau hamata heheni,
english: They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

motu: oi ese basio hadikamai, ai he ḡereḡeremai, emu ai asia dau kau, kara namodia mo a kara henimu, bona mai mainomu ida a siaimu, harihari Iehova ese e hanamomumu.
english: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of Yahweh.”

motu: Bena Isaak ese aria e karaia: iboudiai e aniani hebou bona e inuinu hebou.
english: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

motu: Daba ai e gwau hamata heheni. Bena Isaak ese e siaidia lao, mai mainodia ida ela.
english: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

motu: Una dina ai Isaak ena hesiai taudia ia dekena ela, guri e geia herevana e hamaorolaia, eto, Ranu vada a davaria.
english: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

motu: Bena una ranu gabuna ladana e hatoa Siba, + 26:33 “Siba” anina na “Gwau-hamata”. * taunabunai una hanua ladana na Bere-sieba ema bona harihari. Esau e headava
english: He called it “Shibah”. + 26:33 Shibah means “oath” or “seven”. * Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” + 26:33 Beersheba means “well of the oath” or “well of the seven” * to this day.

motu: Esau ena mauri laḡanidia na hari-ahui, bena e headava, hahine rarua e abidia: Iuditi, Be-eri tau Hiti natuna, bona Basemata, Elon tau Hiti natuna.
english: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

motu: A Isaak bona Rebeka lalodia na e hekwarahi unu hahine daidiai.
english: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

motu: Isaak na vada e ḡauka, matana danu e valahu-valahu, ḡau ta seitaia ḡoeva. Bena ia ese natuna roboana Esau e boiria, eto, Natugu o! Esau eto, Lau o ina.
english: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He|strong="H3588" * said|strong="H7121" * to|strong="H1961" * him|strong="H7121" *, “ Here|strong="H2009" * I|strong="H3588" * am|strong="H1961" *.”

motu: Isaak ma eto, Ame itagu, vada name buruka, egu mase dinana na asi dibagu.
english: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

motu: Taunabunai na noimumu, emu diba pauana bona emu peva bavabi, ba ha labana, dia ta bavalaia lauagu;
english: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

motu: bena vamu namona lalogu ese e ura heniamu heḡereḡerena na ba nadua, dekegu ba mailaia; baina ania, bena do basina mase ai baina hanamomu guna.
english: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

motu: Hari Isaak ena hereva natuna Esau e hamaorolaia na Rebeka danu e kamonai. Bena Esau na eha labana, dia ta baine alaia, baine mailaia eto.
english: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

motu: Bena Rebeka ese natuna Iakob e hereva henia, eto, Tamamu ese kakamu Esau e hamaorolaia herevana na kamonai;
english: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

motu: ia eto “Dia ta ba mailaia, vamu namona ba nadua lauagu; baina ania, bena do basina mase ai Iehova vairanai baina hanamomu guna”.
english: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’

motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, eregu ba kamonai, baina haduamu heḡereḡerena mo ba karaia.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

motu: Aola, nani serina ai nani natudia namodia rua bavabi, dekegu ba mailai; bena lau ese vamu namona ai baina halao tamamu ana, ia ese e ura heniamu ḡauna heḡereḡerena.
english: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

motu: Bena vada ba laohaia tamamu dekenai; baine ania bena do basine mase ai baine hanamomu.
english: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

motu: Bena Iakob ese sinana Rebeka e haere henia, eto, Kakagu Esau na tauna mai derana, a lau kopigu be manada.
english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

motu: Readia tamagu ese baine darahugu, baine dibagu koikoi taugu, bena baine uduguiraigu, basine hanamogu.
english: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

motu: Sinana eto, Heuduguirai na lau latagu ai baine mia: lau eregu a kamonai, aola, bavabi, dekegu ba mailai.
english: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

motu: Bena ia ese eha abidia, sinana dekena e mailai. Bena sinana ese vamu namona e nadua, tamana ese e ura henia ḡauna heḡereḡerena.
english: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

motu: Bena Rebeka ese natuna roboana Esau ena dabua namona ta ruma ai mia na e abia, natuna tau-muritai Iakob e hadokilaia;
english: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

motu: nani natudia kopidia danu imana ruaosi bona aiona e havavalai.
english: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

motu: Bena hari vamu bona flaoa e dabara, natuna Iakob e henia.
english: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

motu: Iakob na tamana dekena ela, eto, Tamagu e! Ia na e haere, eto, Lau o ina: natugu e, oi be daika?
english: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He|strong="H2009" * said, “ Here|strong="H2009" * I|strong="H2009" * am. Who|strong="H4310" * are|strong="H1121" * you|strong="H2009" *, my son|strong="H1121" *?”

motu: Iakob ese tamana e haere henia, eto, Lau binai Esau, natumu roboana, emu hahedua vada na badinaia; a helai tore, dia vada na alaia be bavania, bena ba hanamogu.
english: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

motu: Bena Isaak ese natuna e nanadaia, eto, Natugu e, ede o davaria haraḡa-haraḡa toma? Ia e haere, eto, Badina be Iehova emu Dirava ese e durugu.
english: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He|strong="H3588" * said, “ Because|strong="H3588" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * your|strong="H3068" * God|strong="H3068" * gave me|strong="H6440" * success|strong="H7136" *.”

motu: Bena Isaak ese Iakob e hamaoroa, eto, Natugu e, mani a raka kahi mai, baina darahumu oi na momokani lau natugu Esau eiava lasi.
english: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

motu: Bena Iakob na tamana Isaak dekena e raka kahi lao. Ia ese e darahua, bena eto, Gado be Iakob gadona, a ima be Esau imana.
english: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

motu: Ia na toana asi dibana, badina be imana na huika-huika, kakana Esau imana na heto; taunabunai ia ese e hanamoa.
english: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

motu: Bena Isaak eto, Momokani, oi na natugu korikori Esau ani? Ia eto. Oibe.
english: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He|strong="H2088" * said, “ I|strong="H2088" * am.”

motu: Bena Isaak eto, Mani a mailaia dekegu ai, natugu emu vamu baina ania, bena baina hanamomu. Taunabunai, ia ese e mailaia, bena e ania; vine ranuna danu e mailaia, bena e inua.
english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He|strong="H5315" * brought|strong="H5066" * it|strong="H5315" * near|strong="H5066" * to|strong="H1121" * him|strong="H1288" *, and|strong="H1121" * he|strong="H5315" * ate. He|strong="H5315" * brought|strong="H5066" * him|strong="H1288" * wine|strong="H3196" *, and|strong="H1121" * he|strong="H5315" * drank|strong="H8354" *.

motu: Bena tamana Isaak ese e hamaoroa, eto, Natugu e, mani a raka kahi mai, ame harahugu.
english: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

motu: Bena ia na e raka kahi, e harahua. Isaak ese ena dabua bonana e kamonai, bena e hanamoa, eto, Inai! Natugu bonana na Iehova ese e hanamoa imeana na heto:
english: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “ Behold|strong="H7200" *, the|strong="H7200" * smell|strong="H7381" * of|strong="H1121" * my|strong="H3068" * son|strong="H1121" * is|strong="H3068" * as|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H7200" * smell|strong="H7381" * of|strong="H1121" * a|strong="H3068" * field|strong="H7704" * which|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * has|strong="H3068" * blessed|strong="H1288" *.

motu: Taunabunai guba hununa Dirava ese baine henimu, Bona tanobada digarana danu, Uit momo bona vine ranuna momo danu.
english: God give you of the dew of the sky, of|strong="H7230" * the|strong="H5414" * fatness|strong="H4924" * of|strong="H7230" * the|strong="H5414" * earth|strong="H8064" *, and|strong="H8064" * plenty|strong="H7230" * of|strong="H7230" * grain|strong="H1715" * and|strong="H8064" * new|strong="H8492" * wine|strong="H8492" *.

motu: Taunimanima ese oi isiaimu bae lao heni, Bese idau-idau be vairamu ai bae igo diho; Tadikakamu biagudia ai baola, Sinamu natuna be vairamu ai bae igo diho; Bae uduguiraimu taudia na do bae uduguiraidia, Bae hanamomu taudia na do bae hanamodia.
english: Let peoples serve you, and|strong="H1121" * nations|strong="H5971" * bow|strong="H7812" * down|strong="H7812" * to|strong="H1121" * you|strong="H1288" *. Be|strong="H1121" * lord|strong="H1376" * over your|strong="H5647" * brothers|strong="H1121" *. Let your|strong="H5647" * mother’s sons|strong="H1121" * bow|strong="H7812" * down|strong="H7812" * to|strong="H1121" * you|strong="H1288" *. Cursed|strong="H1288" * be|strong="H1121" * everyone who|strong="H5971" * curses|strong="H1288" * you|strong="H1288" *. Blessed|strong="H1288" * be|strong="H1121" * everyone who|strong="H5971" * blesses|strong="H1288" * you|strong="H1288" *.”

motu: Isaak ese Iakob ihanamona e hadokoa, Iakob danu Isaak vairana amo e raka lasi, asi vanahana kakana Esau na labana amo e lasi.
english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

motu: Ia danu vamu namona e nadua, tamana dekena e laohaia, tamana e hamaoroa, eto, Tamagu e, a helai tore, natumu egu vamu avania, bena ba hanamogu.
english: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

motu: Tamana Isaak ese e nanadaia, eto, Oi be daika? Ia e haere, eto, Lau binai natumu roboana Esau.
english: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He|strong="H4310" * said, “ I|strong="H1121" * am your|strong="H1121" * son|strong="H1121" *, your|strong="H1121" * firstborn|strong="H1060" *, Esau|strong="H6215" *.”

motu: Bena Isaak kudouna e hetaha, eto, Hari tau be daika, vamu eha abia, e mailaia dekegu ai, oi do toma ai na ania ore, bona vada na hanamoa danu? Momokani, ia ese hahenamo anina do baine abia.
english: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

motu: Esau ese tamana ena hereva e kamonai ai e tai, e tai lolololo, tamana e tai henia, eto, Lau danu, tamagu e, lau danu ame hanamogu.
english: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

motu: Tamana eto, Tadimu vada ema, mai ena koikoi, ihanamomu vada e dadia.
english: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

motu: Esau eto, Ia ladana e hatoa Iakob + 27:36 “Iakob” anina be “Ibolona”. * na mai anina ani? Badina be nega rua vada e bologu: roboa ahuna e abia guna, harihari ihanamogu danu vada e abia. Hahenamo ta dia mia lauegu a?
english: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

motu: Isaak ese Esau e haere henia, eto, Inai! Oi biagumu ai vada na halaoa, bona tadikakana iboudiai vada na henia, ena hesiai taudia ai baela; uit bona vine ranuna danu vada na gwaurai iena. Natugu e, dahaka baina karaia oiemu ai?
english: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

motu: Bena Esau ese tamana e hamaoroa, eto, Tamagu e, emu hahenamo be tamona mo a? Tamagu e, lau danu ame hanamogu. Bena Esau e tai dikadika.
english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

motu: Bena tamana Isaak ese e haere henia, eto, Inai! tanobada digarana gabuna ai basio noho, Guba hununa atai amo e dihomu gabuna ai basio noho.
english: Isaac his father answered him, “ Behold|strong="H2009" *, your|strong="H5921" * dwelling|strong="H4186" * will|strong="H1961" * be|strong="H1961" * of|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * fatness|strong="H4924" * of|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * earth|strong="H8064" *, and|strong="H6030" * of|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * dew|strong="H2919" * of|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * sky|strong="H8064" * from|strong="H5921" * above|strong="H5921" *.

motu: To emu dare goadana ai ba mauri. Tadimu isiaina ba lao heni; To negana baine gini dae emu siahu baine herea, Bena ena maduna na paḡamu amo ba negea daure.
english: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It|strong="H5921" * will|strong="H1961" * happen|strong="H1961" *, when|strong="H1961" * you|strong="H5921" * will|strong="H1961" * break|strong="H6561" * loose|strong="H5921" *, that|strong="H1961" * you|strong="H5921" * will|strong="H1961" * shake his|strong="H5921" * yoke|strong="H5923" * from|strong="H5921" * off|strong="H5921" * your|strong="H5921" * neck|strong="H6677" *.”

motu: Esau ese Iakob e inai henia, tamana ena hahenamo dainai; bena lalona ai eto, Tamagu itai-taina dinadia be kahikahi; unu muridiai tadigu Iakob baina alaia mase.
english: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

motu: Haida ese Esau ena hereva Rebeka e hamaorolaia, bena Rebeka ese natuna tau-muritai Iakob e boiria, e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai, kakamu Esau ese lalona e hadaiamu, baine alamu mase e tomu.
english: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, eregu a kamonai: a tore isi haraḡa, Haran baola, taihugu Laban dekenai;
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

motu: nega taina ia dekenai ba noho, ela bona kakamu lalona baine keru.
english: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

motu: Ia na do baine laloa boio ede o karaia toma, bena ena badu do baine ore; una negana ai hereva baina siaia, bena ba lou mai. Umui raruosi dina tamona egu ai ba boio anina be dahaka?
english: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

motu: Bena Rebeka ese Isaak e hereva henia, eto, Name hesiku ini Hiti hahinedia daidiai. Iakob ese ini Hiti taudia natudia ina tano ai e nohomu ta baine adavaia, egu noho ede baine heto?
english: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

motu: Bena Isaak ese Iakob e boiria, e hanamoa, e hagania, eto, Kanaan taudia natudia ta basio adavaia;
english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

motu: Padan-aram baola, tubumu Betuel ena ruma ai ba dae kau, vavamu Laban natuna kekenidia ta bavadavaia.
english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

motu: Bena Siahu-idoinai Diravana ese baine hanamomu, besemu baine havaraia bona baine habadaia, bese bada-hereana ai baola.
english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

motu: Dirava ese Abrahame henia hahenamona oi danu baine henimu, oi garamu baine henidia danu, o noholaia hedoamu tanona, Dirava ese Abraham e henia tanona bavabia, emu tano korikori ai bainela.
english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

motu: Bena Isaak ese Iakob e siaia lao. Ia na Padan-aram ela, Laban Betuel, tau Suria, dekenai. Una Laban na Rebeka taihuna; Rebeka na Iakob bona Esau sinadia.
english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

motu: Esau vada e diba Isaak ese Iakob vada e hanamoa bona vada e siaia lao, Padan-aram ai baine headava: vada e diba danu e hanamoa negana ai e haḡania, eto “Kanaan taudia natudia ta basio adavaia”;
english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

motu: e diba danu Iakob na tamana sinana eredia vada e kamonai, Padan-aram ela.
english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

motu: Bena Esau lalona e parara tamana Isaak na Kanaan hahinedia se ura henidiava.
english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

motu: Taunabunai, Esau na Ismael dekena ela, Ismael Abraham natuna kekenina Mahalata, Nebaioto taihuna, e adavaia; ḡau tamona, adavana gunadia raruosi nonoho. Iakob ena nihi
english: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

motu: Iakob ese Bere-sieba e rakatania, Haran dalana ai e raka.
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

motu: Bena gabu ta ai e kau, unuseni ai baine noho rani eto, badina be dina vada e diho. Bena una gabu nadidia ta e abia, ena ikwina; bena e hekure diho, e mahuta.
english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

motu: Bena e nihi: ena nihi ai vadavada e itaia, tano amo e dae ela bona guba, bona Dirava ena aneru loḡora unu amo e dae e diho.
english: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

motu: Iehova na dorina ai e gini, eto, Lau na Iehova, tubumu Abraham ena Dirava, tamamu Isaak ena Dirava danu: lau ese ina o mahutalaiamu tanona oi baina henimu, oi garamu danu baina henidia.
english: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

motu: Oi garamu danu bae hutuma, tano ḡahuna na heto, tahodiho kahana ai bona mairiveina kahana ai bona mirigini kahana ai bona diho kahana ai do bae pere rohoroho; oi daimu ai bona garamu daidiai tanobada iduhudia idoidiai bae namo.
english: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

motu: Lau ese baina bamomu, ba lao heni gabudia iboudiai baina gimamu, bona baina hakaumu lou ina tano ba lou henia; lau basina rakatanimu ela bona na herevalai henimu karadia na baina kara ḡuḡuru.
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

motu: Iakob na mahuta amo e noga, bena eto, Momokani, Iehova na iniseni ai, to asi dibagu.
english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

motu: Bena kudouna e hetaha, eto, Ina gabu na mai garina; Dirava ena ruma binai; guba iduarana binai.
english: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

motu: Daba matana ai Iakob e tore isi, ena hekwina nadina e haginia, pupuna ai e halaoa, latanai dehoro e seia.
english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

motu: Bena una gabu ladana e hatoa Betele; + 28:19 “Betele” anina be “Dirava ena ruma”. * a una gabu ladana gunana be Lusu.
english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

motu: Bena Iakob e gwau hamata, eto, Bema Dirava ese baine bamogu, ina na rakalaiamu dalana ai baine gimagu, aniani baine henigu bona dabua danu,
english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

motu: ela bona tamagu ena ruma baina lou henia mai mainogu ida: unu baine karagu toma be Iehova na egu Dirava ai baina halaoa;
english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,

motu: ina nadi pupuna danu hari name haginia na Dirava ena ruma ai bainela. Ba henigu ḡaudia idoidiai danu baina karoa, karoa gwauta, karoa ta oi baina henimu.
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

motu: Iakob na e raka lao, ela bona mairiveina kahana taudia edia tano ai eha kau.
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

motu: Bena ranu gurina ta e itaia taora ai, mamoe seridia toi na badibadinai hehekure, badina be una ranu na mamoe seridia e hainulaidia. Nadi badana ta ai guri iduarana e koua ahu;
english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

motu: mamoe seridia idoidiai e hegogo unuseni ai, bena idia ese nadi na guri iduarana amo e kurea oho, mamoe seridia e ha-inulaidia, bena nadi na guri iduarana ai ekurea lou ena gabu ai.
english: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

motu: Bena Iakob ese mamoe ireḡudia taudia e nanadaidia, eto, Varavaragu e, ede amo oma? Idia eto, Ai be Haran taumai.
english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from|strong="H3290" * Haran|strong="H2771" *.”

motu: Ma e nanadaidia lou, eto Umui na Laban, Nahoro natuna, dibamui eiava? Idia eto, Dibamai.
english: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They|strong="H3045" * said, “We know|strong="H3045" * him|strong="H3045" *.”

motu: Ma e nanadaidia lou, eto, Ia be namo a? Idia eto, I, vada namo; natuna kekenina Rahela mani a itaia, ena mamoe serina e hakaua maimu.
english: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They|strong="H7965" * said, “ It|strong="H5973" * is|strong="H2009" * well|strong="H7965" *. See|strong="H2009" *, Rachel|strong="H7354" *, his|strong="H7354" * daughter|strong="H1323" *, is|strong="H2009" * coming|strong="H2009" * with|strong="H5973" * the|strong="H5973" * sheep|strong="H6629" *.”

motu: Iakob eto, Dina tubua binai, boromakau ihaboudia negana be dohore; mamoe seridia boma ha-inudia, boma lao, adia boma henidia.
english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

motu: Idia nae haere, eto, Lasi: mamoe seridia iboudiai bae hegogo guna, bena guri iduarana nadina baia kurea oho, bona mamoe seridia baia ha-inudia.
english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

motu: Ia idia ida dounu e herevava ai, Rahela na e kau, tamana ena mamoe serina e hakaudia, badina be ia ese e reḡudiava.
english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

motu: Iakob ese vavana Laban natuna kekenina Rahela e itaia, vavana Laban ena mamoe serina e hakaua mai, bena ia na e raka kahira, nadi guri iduarana amo e kurea oho, vavana Laban ena mamoe serina e ha-inudia.
english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

motu: Bena Iakob ese Rahela e harahua, bona e tai danu mai gao badana ida.
english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

motu: Iakob ese Rahela e hamaoroa ia na ia lalana Rebeka natuna; bena Rahela e heau ela, tamana e hamaoroa.
english: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

motu: Laban ese vavana Iakob harina e kamnonai, bena ia e heau ela, e rosia, e harahua; bena ena ruma e hakaua lao. Bena Iakob ese hari idoidiai Laban e hamaorolaia.
english: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

motu: Bena Laban ese e hamaoroa, eto, Momokani, oi na turiagu turiana bona hidiogu hidiona. Taunabunai, Iakob na ia ida e noho, hua tamona.
english: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

motu: Bena Laban ese Iakob e hereva henia, eto, Oi na varavaragu dainai isiaigu ba lao heni asi davamu a? Ame hamaorogu, davamu be dahaka?
english: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

motu: Hari Laban na mai natuna kekenidia rarua, vara guna ladana na Lea, tadina ladana be Rahela.
english: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

motu: Lea matana na dika, a Rahela na hane namo, mai hairaina.
english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

motu: Iakob ese Rahela e ura henia; taunabunai ia eto, Laḡani hitu isiaimu baina lao heni, natumu hane-muritai Rahela iabina totona.
english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

motu: Laban eto, Oi baina henimu be namo, idau tauna ta baina henia na dika; dekegu ai ba noho.
english: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iakob ese Laban isiaina e lao heni laḡani hitu, Rahela iabina totona; a lalona e tomava dina gadoi mo na heheto, badina be ia ese Rahela e ura henia lalo-dikava.
english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

motu: Bena Iakob ese Laban e hamaoroa, eto, Adavagu a henigu, badina be egu nega vada e ore, taunabunai aina adavaia na tomamu.
english: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

motu: Bena Laban ese una gabu taudia iboudiai e haboudia, aria e karaia.
english: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

motu: Hanua e boi, bena ia ese natuna Lea e hakaua vareai Iakob dekenai; bena Iakob ese e adavaia
english: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

motu: Laban ese danu ena hesiai hahinena Silpa na Lea e henia, ena hesiai hahinena ai bainela.
english: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

motu: Daba e rere, bena Iakob ese hahine na e itaia, Lea mo. Bena ia ese Laban e gwau henia, eto, Ede vada o karagu toma? Isiaimu asina lao heni Rahela iabina totona a? Dahaka dainai o koigu?
english: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

motu: Laban na e haere, eto, Ai emai kara iniseni ai be hane-muritai asia haheadavaia gunamu, a hane-guna e headava gunamu.
english: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

motu: Ina hahine ariana purana baine ore, murinai tadina danu baia henimu; davana be laḡani hitu ma isiaigu ba lao heni.
english: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

motu: Iakob na unu e kara toma: dina hitu e ore, bena Laban ese natuna Rahela e henia, baine adavaia.
english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

motu: Laban ese danu ena hesiai hahinena Bilha na Rahela e henia, ena hesiai hahinena ai bainela.
english: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

motu: Bena Iakob e raka vareai Rahela dekenai; ia ese Rahela e ura henia bada, a Lea e ura henia maragi. Ia ese Laban isiaina ma e lao heni, laḡani hitu.
english: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

motu: Iakob ese Lea e dadaraia dainai Iehova ese e bogaia hisi, natuna e henia; a Rahela na gabani.
english: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

motu: Bena Lea na e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia; ladana e hatoa Ruben: + 29:32 “Ruben” anina be “Mero a itaia”. * badina be ia eto, Iehova ese egu lalo- hisihisi vada e haḡerea; harihari adavagu ese baine ura henigu.
english: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

motu: Ma e rogorogo lou, e mara, mero ta e abia; bena eto, Iehova vada e kamonai adavagu vada e dadaraigumu, una dainai ina mero danu vada e henigu. Bena ladana e hatoa Simeon. + 29:33 “Simeon” anina be “Kamonai”. *
english: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

motu: Ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia; bena eto, Harihari adavagu ida baia hahebou, badina be memero tatoi vada na heni. Bena ladana e hatoa Levi. + 29:34 “Levi” anina be “Hahebou”. *
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

motu: Ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia; bena eto, Harihari Iehova aina imodaia. Bena ladana e hatoa Iuda. + 29:35 “Iuda” anina be “Heimodai”. * Una murinai ia na se rogorogo lou.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.

motu: Rahela na gabani, una dainai ia ese kakana e mama henia. Bena ia ese Iakob e gwau henia, eto, Natugu basio henigu vada baina mase.
english: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

motu: Bena Iakob ese Rahela e badu henia, eto, Lau Dirava a? Ia ese mero emu ai e ruamu.
english: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

motu: Hahine na eto, Egu hesiai hahinena Bilha binai: ia dekenai ba raka vareai; bena lau tuigu ai baine mara, iena amo natugu baina abia.
english: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia ese ena hesiai hahinena Bilha na Iakob e henia, bena ia ese e adavaia.
english: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

motu: Bena Bilha na e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia.
english: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

motu: Bena Rahela eto, Dirava ese vada e hahemaoro henigu, egu noinoi vada e abia dae, natugu vada e henigu. Bena ladana e hatoa Dan. + 30:6 “Dan” anina be “Hahemaoro”. *
english: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.

motu: Rahela ena hesiai hahinena Bilha ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ihararuana e abia.
english: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

motu: Bena Rahela eto, Kakagu ida a hedaverai, vada na kwalimu. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Napatali. + 30:8 “Napatali” anina be “Hedaverai”. *
english: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

motu: Lea vada e diba ia na basine rogorogo; bena ia ese ena hesiai hahinena Silpa e abia, Iakob e henia, baine adavaia.
english: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

motu: Bena Lea ena hesiai hahinena Silpa e rogorogo, e mara, mero ta e abia.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

motu: Bena Lea eto, Egu madinamo negana binai. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Gad. + 30:11 “Gad” anina be “Madi-namo”. *
english: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

motu: Bena Lea ena hesiai hahinena Silpa ma e rogorogo, e mara, mero ihararuana e abia.
english: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

motu: Bena Lea eto, Na moalemu; hahine iboudiai danu bae hanamogu. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Asere. + 30:13 “Asere” anina be “Moale”. *
english: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

motu: Uit iutuna negana ai, Ruben na ela, au-huahua ladana dudai haida e davaridia. bena e abi, sinana Lea dekena e laohai. Bena Rahela ese e noia, eto, Natumu ena dudai haida mani a henigu.
english: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

motu: A Lea ese e gwau henia, eto, Adavagu o henaoa na ḡau pipikina a? Matona natugu ena dudai ba dadi o tomu. Bena Rahela eto, Natumu ena dudai ba henigu, bena hari hanuaboi adavada ida ba eno bou.
english: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel|strong="H7354" * said|strong="H3651" *, “ Therefore|strong="H3651" * he|strong="H3651" * will|strong="H1571" * lie|strong="H7901" * with|strong="H5973" * you|strong="H3947" * tonight|strong="H3915" * for|strong="H8478" * your|strong="H3947" * son|strong="H1121" *’s mandrakes|strong="H1736" *.”

motu: Adorahi ai, Iakob na uma amo e lasi, bena Lea na vairana ela, eto, Hari hanuaboi raruosi baita eno bou, natugu ena dudai na heni davadia. Bena una hanuaboi idia raruosi e eno bou.
english: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He|strong="H1931" * lay|strong="H7901" * with|strong="H5973" * her|strong="H3290" * that|strong="H3588" * night|strong="H3915" *.

motu: Bena Dirava ese Lea e hakala henia; bena e rogorogo, e mara, mero iha-imana e abia, Iakob ena.
english: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

motu: Bena Lea eto, Egu hesiai hahinena na adavagu na henia davana binai, Dirava ese vada e henigu. Bena natuna ladana e hatoa Isakara. + 30:18 “Isakara” anina be “Davana”. *
english: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

motu: Lea ma e rogorogo lou, e mara, mero ihatauratoina e abia, Iakob ena.
english: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

motu: Bena ia eto, Dava namona Dirava ese vada e henigu; harihari adavagu na dekegu ai baine noho tari, badina be natuna mamaruanedia tauratoi vada na henia. Bena mero ladana e hatoa Sebulun. + 30:20 “Sebulun” anina be “Noho-tari”. *
english: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

motu: Una murinai ia ese natuna kekenina ta e abia, bena kekeni ladana e hatoa Daina.
english: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

motu: Una negana ai Dirava ese Rahela e haḡerea, ena noinoi e abia dae; Bena ia danu e rogorogo.
english: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

motu: E mara, mero ta e abia: bena eto, Dirava ese egu hemarai vada e abia oho.
english: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

motu: Bena ladana e hatoa Iosef; + 30:24 “Iosef” anina be “Ma ta”. * eto, Iehova ese ma ta bema henigu bema namo. Iakob ese ravana e koia
english: She named him Joseph, + 30:24 Joseph means “may he add”. * saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”

motu: Iosef e vara murinai, Iakob ese Laban e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara a kahugu nege, egu gabu korikori bainala, egu tano korikori baina lou henia.
english: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

motu: Adavagu bona natugu ba henigu, badina be idia daidiai oi isiaimu vada na lao heni. A kahugu nege; egu hekwarahi emu hesiai ilao-henina ai vada dibamu.
english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

motu: Laban eto, Na noimumu, mani emu kara basio raka oho; badina be lalogu vada eme parara Iehova ese vada e hanamogu oi daimu ai.
english: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”

motu: Davamu a gwauraia, bena baina henimu.
english: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

motu: Iakob ese e haere henia, eto, Ede na hekwarahi tomava emu hesiai ilao-henina ai vada o itaia; dibamu danu emu seri vada e hutuma lau imagu ai.
english: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

motu: Lau do asinama negana ai oi na vada o ogoḡami, harihari vada o taḡa; lau nama ema bona hari Iehova ese vada e hanamomu. A edena nega ai adavagu bona natugu ihataḡadia baina ḡaukara matama a?
english: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

motu: Bena Laban eto, Dahaka baina henimu? Iakob eto, Ḡau ta basio henigu, to egu ura bavabia dae, bena emu seri ma baina reḡudia.
english: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob|strong="H3290" * said|strong="H1697" *, “ You|strong="H5414" * shall|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * give|strong="H5414" * me|strong="H5414" * anything|strong="H1697" *. If you|strong="H5414" * will|strong="H1697" * do|strong="H6213" * this|strong="H2088" * thing|strong="H1697" * for|strong="H6213" * me|strong="H5414" *, I|strong="H5414" * will|strong="H1697" * again|strong="H7725" * feed|strong="H7462" * your|strong="H5414" * flock|strong="H6629" * and|strong="H7725" * keep|strong="H8104" * it|strong="H5414" *.

motu: Hari dina ai emu seri ba hididia, mamoe mai toutoudia eiava mai revarevadia bona mamoe koremadia bona nani mai toutoudia eiava mai revarevadia iboudiai baina hakaudia siri: lau davagu bunu.
english: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

motu: Nega gabedia ai vada ba dibagu, maoro eiava kerere: egu seri ai nani haida asi toutoudia asi revarevadia eiava mamoe kurokurodia ba davaridia, henao taugu ba gwauraigu.
english: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

motu: Bena Laban eto, Emu hereva heḡereḡerena, unu baita kara toma.
english: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

motu: Una dina ai ia ese nani mamaruanedia mai toutoudia bona mai revarevadia, bona nani hahinedia mai toutoudia bona mai revarevadia, bona mamoe koremadia, iboudiai e hakaudia siri, natuna e henidia, bae reḡudia.
english: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

motu: Bena e siaidia lao, dauhai bae noho, dina toi rakadia heḡereḡerena. A Laban ena seri oredia Iakob ese e reḡudia.
english: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

motu: Bena Iakob ese au rigidia matamatadia e utu, kopidia kahadia e nege, kahadia mimia, ita-itadia revareva na heheto.
english: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

motu: Bena unu rigi mai revarevadia ranu gabudia ai e hagini, seri e ha-inudia negadia ai. Bena nani bona mamoe hahinedia na ranu gabudia ai e rogorogo,
english: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

motu: unu rigi vairadiai; una dainai natudia e havaradia, kopidia na mai revarevadia.
english: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

motu: Ini nani bona mamoe natudia Iakob ese e abidia hidi, iena seri ida e haboudia, Laban ena seri ai se atodia.
english: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

motu: Bena nani bona mamoe hahinedia mai goadadia e rogorogova negadia ai, Iakob ese hari rigi vairadiai e hagini, ranu gabudia ai, rigi i'itadia ai bae rogorogo totona.
english: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;

motu: A manokadia e rogorogova negadia ai, hari rigi se hagini vairadiai. Taunabunai, nani bona mamoe manokadia na Laban ena seri ai, a goadadia na Iakob ena seri ai.
english: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

motu: Taunabunai, Iakob ena taḡa e bada e laova: ena seri e hutumava; ena hesiai hahinedia bona ena hesiai taudia bona ena kamelo bona ena doniki danu hutuma herea.
english: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

motu: Bena Iakob ese Laban natuna mamaruanedia edia maumau e kamonai: idia na e maumau, eto “Iakob ese tamamai ena kohu idoinai vada e abihaia, unu amo ena taḡa idoinai vada e abi”.
english: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

motu: Iakob danu e itaia. Laban vairana e huaia ienai.
english: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Iakob e hamaoroa. eto, Tubumu tamamu edia tano ba lou henia, varavaramu dekedia baola: lau ese baina bamomu.
english: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

motu: Bena Iakob ese Rahela bona Lea e boiridia, dekena baela, taora ai ena seri e reḡudiava gabuna ai.
english: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Vada na itaia, tamamui ese vairana e huaiamu bona lalona e idaumu egu ai; a tamagu ena Dirava ese vada e bamogu.
english: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

motu: Umui danu dibamui lau ese tamamui isiaina vada na lao heni mai goadagu idoinai.
english: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

motu: Tamamui ese vada e koigu, nega gwauta davagu vada e ha-idaua, a Dirava ese e laoa ahu dainai ia ese se hadikagu.
english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

motu: Ia eto “Mai toutoudia na oiemu”, bena seri idoinai ese mai toutoudia ḡaudia mo e havaradia; ma eto “Mai revarevadia na oiemu”, bena seri idoinai ese mai revarevadia ḡaudia mo e havaradia.
english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

motu: Unuhetomana Dirava ese tamamui ena seri iena amo vada e abi oho, lau vada e henigu.
english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
