english: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

motu: Bena Mose ese e haere henia, eto, Hanua amo aina raka lasi, imagu aina toi roro, Iehova enai; bena guba-rahu baine doko, medu-hetarina danu baine doko: unu amo vada ba diba tanobada na Iehova ena.
english: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to Yahweh. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is Yahweh’s.

motu: Ḡau tamona, lau dibagu oi bona oiemu hesiai taudia ese Dirava Iehova do basio matauraia.
english: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear Yahweh God.”

motu: Una negana ai flax * + 9:31 Flax be rei ta, varo bona dabua aukadia ikaralaidia ḡau. Bali bona uit bona rae danu rei haida, anidia na e abi, flaoa e karalai. * bona bali vada e dika: badina ba bali anina vada e dobi bona flax * vada e tubu.
english: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.

motu: A uit bona rae na asie dika badina be do asie tubu.
english: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.

motu: Bena Mose ese Farao e rakatania, hanua amo e raka lasi, imana e toi roro Iehova enai; bena guba-rahu bona medu-hetari na e doko, bona medu na se diho tanobada ai.
english: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to Yahweh; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.

motu: A Farao ese e itaia, medu bona medu-hetari bona guba-rahu vada e doko, bena is ese ena kara dika ma e habadaia, lalona ma e ha-aukaia lou, ia bona ena hesiai taudia danu.
english: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

motu: Farao lalona vada e auka, Israel taudia se kahudia nege, Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa heḡereḡerena.
english: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as Yahweh had spoken through Moses.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Farao dekenai a raka vareai; badina be ia lalona vada na ha-aukaia, ena hesiai taudia danu lalodia vada na ha-aukadia, egu toa bini bogaragtidiai baina hahedinarai helaoreana.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs among them;

motu: Bena Aigupto ede baina kara henia toma, bona Aigupto taudia bogaragidiai egu toa ede na hahedinarai toma, natumu ba hadibaia bona tubumu ba hadibaia; bona ba diba binai Iehova.
english: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am Yahweh.”

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron na Farao dekenai e raka vareai, e hereva henia, eto, Ieova, Heberu taumai emai Dirava, na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau vairagu ai ba hekokoroku ela bona edena nega ai? Egu orea taudia a kahudia nege, bae toma henigu diho.
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and said to him, “This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: ‘How long will you refuse to humble yourself before me? Let my people go, that they may serve me.

motu: A bema lasi, boma rudia, lau ese kerukeru kwadi baina siaidia emu tano ai;
english: Or else, if you refuse to let my people go, behold, tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country,

motu: idia ese tano kopina bae ḡovaia ahu, tano na basio itaia diba. Bena amui aniani orena, medu-hetarina ese se hadikaia ḡauna, na idia ese bae ania ore; bona au iboudiai dounu mimia taora ai vada bae ani ore.
english: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.

motu: Emu ruma danu, bona emu hesiai taudia iboudiai edia ruma, bona Aigupto taudia iboudiai edia ruma, na kwadi ai mo bae honu; unuhetomana tubumui tamamui ese asie itaia, edia vara dinadia amo ema bona hari. Bena is ese Farao vairana amo e raka lasi.
english: Your houses shall be filled, and the houses of all your servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians, as neither your fathers nor your fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were on the earth to this day.’” He turned, and went out from Pharaoh.

motu: Bena Farao ena hesiai taudia ese e hereva henia, eto, Ina tau ese baine hahekwakwanaida ela bona edena nega ai? Tatau be ba kahudia nege, baela, Iehova edia Dirava bae toma henia diho. Asi dibamu Aigupto vada e dika vaitani a?
english: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve Yahweh, their God. Don’t you yet know that Egypt is destroyed?”

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron ma e hakaudia vareai lou, Farao vairanai. Ia ese e hamaorodia, eto Aola, Iehova emui Dirava ba toma henia diho; a umui ida baela taudia be daidia?
english: Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh, and he said to them, “Go, serve Yahweh your God; but who are those who will go?”

motu: Mose eto, Emai memero bona emai iahu, natumai mamaruanedia bona natumai hahinedia, emai mamoe seridia bona emai boromakau seridia, iboudiai baia laohaidia; badina be aria ta baia karaia, Iehova ena.
english: Moses said, “We will go with our young and with our old. We will go with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds; for we must hold a feast to Yahweh.”

motu: Ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Bama kahumui nege, Iehova ese bema rumui. Emui lalo-hadai na dika. ?
english: He said to them, “Yahweh be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.

motu: Dia unuheto: umui tatau mo baola, Iehova ba toma henia diho, badina be emui ura bunai. Bena Farao vairana amo e luludia lasi.
english: Not so! Go now you who are men, and serve Yahweh; for that is what you desire!” Then they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Imamu a toia roro Aigupto tanona daenai, kwadi vada bae kau Aigupto tanona ai, aniani avadia iboudiai medu-hetarina ese se hadika na idia ese bae ani ore.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up on the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail has left.”

motu: Bena Mose ese ena itotohi toia roro Aigupto tanona daenai: bena Iehova ese lai laurabada kahana amo e siaia, una tano e toa henia boi, e toa henia rani. Dabi ai, una lai ese kwadi e mailaidia.
english: Moses stretched out his rod over the land of Egypt, and Yahweh brought an east wind on the land all that day, and all night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

motu: Bena kwadi na Aigupto tanona idoinai e heḡiḡi rohoroho ela bona Aigupto tanona hetoana idoinai; idia na dika rohoroho. Kwadi unuhohodia na nega ta asie hedinarai ema bona una negana, ma unuhohodia na basie hedinarai lou.
english: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the borders of Egypt. They were very grievous. Before them there were no such locusts as they, nor will there ever be again.

motu: Badina be tano kopina adoinai idia ese e ḡovaia ahu; tano vada e korema. Idia ese aniani avadia iboudiai e ani ore una tano ai, bona au huahuadia iboudiai medu-hetarina ese se hadika ḡaudia na idia ese e ani ore. E tubumu ḡauna ta, au eiava tano avana, se miava, Aigupto tanona idoinai.
english: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

motu: Bena Farao ese Mose bona Aaron e boiridia haraḡa-haraḡa, e hamaorodia, eto, Lau na Iehova emui Dirava vairanai bona umui vairamui ai vada na kara havara.
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against Yahweh your God, and against you.

motu: Taunabunai, na noimumu, ina nega tamona mo egu dika ba gwaua tao, bona Iehova emui Dirava ba noia, ia ese ina mase ḡauna egu amo baine abia oho.
english: Now therefore please forgive my sin again, and pray to Yahweh your God, that he may also take away from me this death.”

motu: Bena Mose na Farao vairana amo e raka lasi, Iehova e now henia.
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese lai badana lahara kahana amo e siaia, una lai ese kwadi e odadia isi, Davara Kakakakana lalonai e odadia lao; Aigupto tanona hetoadia idoidiai kwadi ta dia mia.
english: Yahweh sent an exceedingly strong west wind, which took up the locusts, and drove them into the Red Sea. + 10:19 “Red Sea” is the translation for the Hebrew “Yam Suf”, which could be more literally translated “Sea of Reeds” or “Sea of Cattails”. It refers to the body of water currently known as the Red Sea, or possibly to one of the bodies of water connected to it or near it. * There remained not one locust in all the borders of Egypt.

motu: A Iehova ese Farao lalona ma e ha-aukaia, bena Israel taudia se kahudia nege. Hahehisi ihataurahanai-tana: Dibura masemase
english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Imamu ba duduia isi, bena dibura ese Aigupto tanona idoinai baine gorua ahu; idia ese dibura bae mamia toho.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.”

motu: Bena Mose ese imama e duduia isi. Bena Aigupto tanona idoinai e dibura masemase, ela dina toi vada e ore.
english: Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt for three days.

motu: Taunimanima na asie heita heheni, bona edia helai noho gabudia amo asie tore isi, dina toi lalodiai. A Israel taudia iboudiai edia noho gabudia na didiari.
english: They didn’t see one another, and nobody rose from his place for three days; but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

motu: Bena Farao ese Mose e boiria, eto, Vada aola, Iehova ba toma henia diho, ḡau tamona emui mamoe seridia bona emui boromakau seridia ba rakatanidia, natumui mo ba hakaudia lao.
english: Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, “Go, serve Yahweh. Only let your flocks and your herds stay behind. Let your little ones also go with you.”

motu: A Mose eto, Lasi, emai boubou ḡaudia bona lahi ese baine ḡole oho ḡaudia ba hemimai, Iehova emai Dirava do baia boua.
english: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh our God.

motu: Emai boromakau baia laohaidia, ta basine mia; badina be unu amo Iehova emai Dirava baia boua, bona asi dibamai dahaka ḡau dahaka ḡau amo Iehova baia boua ela bona ihaboulaina gabuna ai baia kau.
english: Our livestock also shall go with us. Not a hoof shall be left behind, for of it we must take to serve Yahweh our God; and we don’t know with what we must serve Yahweh, until we come there.”

motu: A Iehova ese Farao lalona ma e ha-aukaia, bena se kahudia nege.
english: But Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he wouldn’t let them go.

motu: Bena Farao ese e hamaoroa, eto, A siri, nahuamu ba tohoa danu, lau vairagu basio itaia lou; badina be vairagu ba itaia lou dinana ai vada ba mase.
english: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”

motu: Bena Mose eto, Vada o hereva momokani; vairamu basina itaia lou.
english: Moses said, “You have spoken well. I will see your face again no more.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Hahehisi ta ma Farao latanai bona Aigupto latanai aina siaia, maurinai ia ese baine kahumui nege; baine kahumui nege negana ai danu baine lulumui vaitani.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will bring yet one more plague on Pharaoh, and on Egypt; afterwards he will let you go. When he lets you go, he will surely thrust you out altogether.

motu: Harihari Israel taudia ba haduadia, ta ta ese dekena tauna dekena tauna bae noidia, hahine danu unu bae kara toma, herahera ḡaudia, silver * bona gold * amo e karamu, bae noilai.
english: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbor, and every woman of her neighbor, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Aigupto taudia lalodia e hakerudia Israel taudia ediai; Mose danu ladana na bada Aigupto ai, Farao ena hesiai taudia ediai bona hanua taudia ediai.
english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

motu: Bena Mose eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Malokihi ai Aigupto tanona baina rakaia hanai;
english: Moses said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,

motu: bena Aigupto taudia natudia roboadia iboudiai bae mase, Farao, terono ai e helaimu tauna, natuna roboana, ela bona hesiai hahinena, uit iririlaina nadina e giroamu hahinena, natuna roboana, ela bona boromakau iboudiai natudia roboadia danu.
english: and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the female servant who is behind the mill, and all the firstborn of livestock.

motu: Aigupto tanona idoinai tai badana baine vara; nega ta unu asie tai toma ema bona hari, bona ina murinai danu unu basie tai toma.
english: There will be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has not been, nor will be any more.

motu: A Israel taudia mai edia boromakau ida sisia ta ese basine kwaru henidia: taunabunai, vada ba diba Iehova ese Aigupto taudia bona Israel taudia vada e hididia.
english: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that Yahweh makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.

motu: Bena ini emu hesiai taudia iboudiai lau dekegu baema, vairagu ai bae goru diho, baeto “A raka lasi, emu orea taudia iboudiai ida”; una murinai baina raka lasi. Bena ia na Farao vairana amo e raka lasi ma badu ḡaraḡarana ida.
english: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto Farao basine kamonai henimu, egu hoa karadia Aigupto tanona ai bae momo helaoreana.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh won’t listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.”

motu: Mose bona Aaron ese unu hoa karadia iboudiai Farao vairanai e kara; a Iehova ese Farao lalona e ha-aukaia, taunabunai ia ese Israel taudia na ena tano amo se kahudia nege.
english: Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh, but Yahweh hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go out of his land.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hereva henidia, Aigupto tanona ai, eto.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

motu: Ina hua na hua gini-gunana ai bainela umui emui ai, emui laḡani matamana huana ai bainela.
english: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.

motu: Israel taudia iboudiai edia hebou ai ba hereva henidia, ina hua dinana ihagwautana, ta ta ena iduhu ena iduhu ai mamoe natudia bae abidia, ruma ta mamoe natuna ta, unu bae abidia toma.
english: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;

motu: A ruma ta taudia basie hoho, una ruma taudia bona e gini hetabira rumana taudia na mamoe natuna ta bae abia hebou, taunimanina hahidaosi na vamu iani-orena bae davana heḡereḡerena.
english: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.

motu: Emui mamoe na asi toutouna ḡauna, maruane, laḡani tamona ḡauna; mamoe serina amo bavabia eiava nani serina amo.
english: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the goats.

motu: Ba balaia heni ela bona hua dinana ihagwauta-hanina ai; bena dina baine hakere ai Israel hegogona idoinai ese edia mamoe natudia bae aladia mase.
english: You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.

motu: Bena rarana bavabia, iduara ihua-ihuana kahana kahana audia bona daena auna ba dahulai, bae ani rumadia ai.
english: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.

motu: Una hanuaboi amui aniani na mamoe natuna hidiona, amu ai bae guraia, bona flaoa kavakava, muramura ai basie hatubua, bona aniani avadia iditadia.
english: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.

motu: Kasirina ai basio ania, bona basio nadua; tau-anina idoinai amu ai ba guraia, mai kwarana, mai imana, mai aena, bona mai bogana ida.
english: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.

motu: Bahuna taina basine mia rani; lahi ai ba haḡolea oho.
english: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.

motu: Ini bavania tona: emui rami ba hekasilai, emui tamaka aemui ai, emui itotohi imamui ai. Bavani haraḡa: una na Iehova ena lagau hanai.
english: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is Yahweh’s Passover.

motu: Badina be una hanuaboi ai Aigupto tanona baina rakaia hanai, natudia roboadia iboudiai baina aladia mase, taunimanima bona boromakau danu; bona Aigupto diravadia iboudia danu baina hahemaoro henidia; lau binai Iehova.
english: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the gods of Egypt. I am Yahweh.

motu: Hari rara na toa ai bainela emui noho rumadia ai; rara baina itaia negana ai, baina lagaumui hanai hahedika ta emui ai basine kau, basine alamui, imagu na Aigupto ai baine kau negana ai.
english: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

motu: Ina dina danu ba laloa tao hanaihanai; ariana danu ba karaia Iehova ena; uru iboudiai bae karaia, taravana danu bae atua.
english: This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

motu: Dina hitu flaoa dikeadia, asie hatubu ḡaudia, bavani; dina gini-gunana ai hatubu muramurana idoinai emui ruma ai mia na bavatoa tabe murimuri ai: badina be dina gini-gunana ela bona dina ihahituna, e hatubua flaoana baine ania tauna na Israel besena amo bae negea daure.
english: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

motu: Dina gini-gunana ai hebou helaḡana ai ba hebou, bona dina ihahituna ai hebou helaḡana ai ma ba hebou; unu dina ruaosi lalaidai ḡaukara ta basio karaia, hebou taudia adia aniani idabarana mo vadaeni.
english: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, only that may be done by you.

motu: Flaoa-asie-hatubua Ariana unu ba karaia toma: badina be emui orea loḡora Aigupto amo name hakaudia lasi dinana binai; taunabunai hari dina na uru iboudiai ese bae badinaia bona taravana bae atua ela bona hanaihanai.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.

motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-hanina adorahina ai asie hatubua flaoana bavania, ela bona dina iharuahui-tana adorahina.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.

motu: Dina hitu flaoa ihatubuna muramurana basie mia emui ruma ai: badina be e hatubua flaoana baine ania tauna, ena be noho-hedoa tauna eiava Isreal tauna korikori, to Israel hebouna amo bae nega daure.
english: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.

motu: E hatubua ḡauna ta basio ania; emui noho gabudia iboudiai flaoa dikeadia, asie hatubu ḡaudia, mo bavani.
english: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”

motu: Bena Mose ese Israel tau-badadia iboudiai e boiridia, e haduadia, eto, Mamoe natudia bavabi hidi, iduhu ta ta adia, lagau-hanai ḡauna bavalaia mase.
english: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.

motu: Muramura avana iḡuina bavabia, rara dihuna ai ba urua diho, iduara ihua-ihuama kahana kahana audia bona iduara daena auna na dihu rarana amo ba dahudia; bena atu ta ena ruma iduarana amo basine raka lasi ela bona daba.
english: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.

motu: Badina be Iehova ese ina tano baine rakaia hanai, Aigupto taudia baine aladia mase; a rara iduara daene auna ai bona iduara ihua-ihuana kahana kahana audia ai baine itaia negana ai, Iehova ese una iduara baine lagaua hanai, hahedika ḡauna baine laoa ahu, emui ruma ai basine raka vareai, basine hamasemui.
english: For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.

motu: Ina kara ba badinaia bona taravana bavatua, oiemu bona natumu edia, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.

motu: Benaini, Iehova ese baine henimui tanona ai ba kau, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena negana ai ina toma-diho karana ba badinaia.
english: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.

motu: Bena natumui bae nanadaimui, baeto “Ina toma-diho karana anina be dahaka?”,
english: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’

motu: umui ba haere, baoto “Ina na Iehova ena lagau-hanai boubou karana; Aigupto ai ia ese Israel taudia edia ruma e lagaudia hanai, Aigupto taudia mo e aladia mase, eda iduhu iboudiai e hamauridia”. Bena taunimanima iboudiai e igo diho, e toma diho, e toma diho.
english: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’” The|strong="H5921" * people|strong="H5971" * bowed|strong="H7812" * their|strong="H3068" * heads|strong="H6915" * and|strong="H1121" * worshiped|strong="H7812" *.

motu: Bena Israel taudia na ela, Mose bona Aaron e haduadia heḡereḡerena unu mo e kara toma. Hahehisi ihagwautana: Maruane roboadia ihamasedia
english: The children of Israel went and did so; as Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

motu: Bena una hanuaboi malokihina ai Iehova ese roboadia iboudiai Aigupto tanona idoinai e aladia mase, Farao, terono ai e helaiva tauna, natuna roboana, ela bona dibura rumana ai e hekouva tauna natuna roboana, bona boromakau natudia roboadia danu.
english: At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

motu: Bena Farao bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona Aigupto taudia iboudiai na hanuaboi ai e tore isi; bena taitai badana e vara Aigupto tanona ai, badina be ruma ta mase asi se kwabu.
english: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

motu: Bena hanuaboi ai Farao ese Mose bona Aaron e haduadia, eto, A tore isi, egu orea taudia bogaragidia amo ba raka lasi, umui bona Israel taudia iboudiai. Aola, Iehova ba toma henia diho, emui hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve Yahweh, as you have said!

motu: Emui mamoe seridia bona emui boromakau seridia danu ba laohai, emui hereva heḡereḡerena. Vada aola: lau danu ba hanamogu.
english: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”

motu: Aigupto taudia ese danu e haduadia goadagoada, edia tano amo bae raka lasi haraḡa-haraḡa eto. Badina be idia eto, Ai iboumai ai baia mase na garina.
english: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese edia flaoa, ranu ai e kui ḡaudia, e abi, edia kuikui dihudia danu e abi, edia dabua ai e kumi, e dibu ela.
english: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Mose ena hereva e badinaia, Aigupto taudia ediai herahera ḡaudia, gold * bona silver * amo e karava, bona dabua e noi.
english: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Aigupto taudia lalodia e hakerudia Israel taudia ediai, bena idia ese e noi ḡaudia na e henidia. Unu amo idia ese Aigupto taudia edia Kohu e dadi ore.
english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.

motu: Bena Israel taudia na Ramese amo e laolao ela bona Sukoto. Aedia amo e raka taudia na domaga tauratoi + 12:37 Domaga tauratoi 600,000. * sisivana, bona memero kekeni danu.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.

motu: Orea idau-idau taudia hutuma ese e bamodia; edia mamoe seridia bona edia boromakau seridia danu momo herea.
english: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.

motu: Bena hari flaoa ranu ai e kui, Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi negana ai e abia kau ḡauna, na e gabua; ia na asie hatubua ḡauna. Badina be Aigupto amo e luludia lasi negana ai idia na asi edia halahe dalana bona asi edia nega bae nanadu.
english: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves.

motu: Hari Israel besena Aigupto tanona ai e nohova laḡanidia iboudiai na sinahu-hani toi-ahui.
english: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

motu: Laḡani sinahu-hani toi-ahui e ore dinana korikorina, Iehova ena orea iboudiai na Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi.
english: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.

motu: Una hanuaboi na bae badinaia tarika-tarika Iehova vairanai, ia ese Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi dainai: una hanuaboi na Iehova ena, Israel taudia iboudiai bae badinaia ela uru iboudiai.
english: It is a night to be much observed to Yahweh for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of Yahweh, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

motu: Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hereva henidia, eto, Lagau-hanai taravatuna binai: idau tauna ta basine ania;
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,

motu: a emui hesiai taudia moni amo o hoidia na ba peritomedia, marinai vada bae ania.
english: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

motu: A noho-kau tauna bona e ḡaukaramu mai davana tauna na basie ania.
english: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

motu: Ruma lalonai bavania; hidiona taina basio laohaia murimuri ai, bona turiana ta basio hakwaidua.
english: It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones.

motu: Israel hebouna idoinai vada bae ania.
english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

motu: A idau bese tauna bogaragimui ai e nohomu na bame ura Iehova ena lagau-hanai baine badinaia, ena ruma taudia mamaruanedia baine peritomedia guna, murinai ia na baine raka kahira, baine ania; badina be ia na emui ruma tauna korikorina na heto. A se peritomea tauna na basine ania.
english: When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, and would like to keep the Passover to Yahweh, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. He shall be as one who is born in the land; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

motu: Taravatu be tamona, Israel tauna korikori enai bona noho-kau tauna enai.
english: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”

motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia na unu e kara toma. Mose bona Aaron ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena.
english: All the children of Israel did so. As Yahweh commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

motu: Bena una dina ai Iehova ese Israel taudia edia orea iboudiai na Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi.
english: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai Israel ai ba hahelaḡadia lauegu, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia; roboana be lauegu.
english: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Ina dina ba laloa tao, badina be hari dina ai Aigupto amo, iḡui rumana amo, vada o raka lasi; Iehova imana goadana ese ina gabu amo vada e hakaumui lasi. E hatubua flaoana na basio ania.
english: Moses said to the people, “Remember this day, in which you came out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought you out from this place. No leavened bread shall be eaten.

motu: Hari ina dina ai ome raka lasi, hua ladana Abib ai.
english: Today you go out in the month Abib.

motu: Bena kerukeru vanegai, Iehova ese Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Amoro, taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia edia tano ai baine hakaumu vareai, senemu e gwau henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona: una negana ai oi ese ina tomadiho karana ba karaia ina hua lalonai.
english: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

motu: Dina hitu lalodiai flaoa dikeadia, asie hatubu ḡaudia, bavani; bena dina ihahituna Iehova ena aria ba karaia.
english: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to Yahweh.

motu: Unu dina hituosi lalodiai asie hatubua flaoana mo bavania; e hatubua flaoana na basine hedinarai dekemu ai, bona hatubu muramurana basine mia emu noho gabuna idoinai.
english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.

motu: Una dina ai natumu do ba hamaoroa, baoto, “Ina na Iehova ese e kahagu Aigupto amo e hakaugu lasi negana dainai”.
english: You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.’

motu: Ia na toa ta ai bainela imamu ai, bona helalo-tao ḡauna ai bainela bagumu ai, Iehova ena taravatu udumu ai baine mia helaoreana. Badina be Iehova imana goadana ese Aigupto amo e hakaumu lasi;
english: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that Yahweh’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand Yahweh has brought you out of Egypt.

motu: taunabunai ina haheḡani ba badinaia ena nega korikori ai laḡani iboudiai lalodiai.
english: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Kanaan taudia edia tano ai baine hakaumu vareai, e gwau henimu hamata bona senemu e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena, bona baine henimu,
english: “It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it to you,

motu: una negana ai roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai ba hididia, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia danu; maruane iboudiai bae helaḡa, Iehova ena.
english: that you shall set apart to Yahweh all that opens the womb, and every firstborn that comes from an animal which you have. The males shall be Yahweh’s.

motu: Bena doniki natuna roboana davana na mamoe natuna ba heni; eiava davana basio heni negana ai aiona ba hakwaidua. A taunimanima natudia roboadia iboudiai na davadia ba kara.
english: Every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck; and you shall redeem all the firstborn of man among your sons.

motu: Bena negana baine kau natumu ese baine nanadaimu, baineto “Ina kara be dahaka?”, oi ese ba haere henia baoto “Iehova imana goadana ese Aigupto, maduna metaudia gabuna, amo e hakaumai lasi;
english: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand Yahweh brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

motu: bena Farao ese baine dogomai tao eto negana ai Iehova ese roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai Aigupto tanona ai e aladia mase, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia danu: taunabunai roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai na Iehova ena ihaboulaina ḡaudia ai na halaodiamu, a natugu roboadia na davadia na karamu”.
english: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to Yahweh all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

motu: Ia na toa ai bainela imamu ai bona bagumu ai: badina be Iehova imana goadana ese Aigupto ese Aigupto amo vada e hakauda lasi.
english: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out of Egypt.”

motu: Farao ese Israel taudia e kahudia nege murinai, Dirava ese dala kwadogina, Filistia taudia edia tano ai, se hakaudia; badina be Dirava eto “Idia na tuari mamina bae diba, bena bae helalo kerehai, Aigupto bae lou henia readia”.
english: When Pharaoh had let the people go, God didn’t lead them by the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, “Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt”;

motu: Bena Dirava ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e hakaudia lao, Davara Kakakakana badinai. Israel taudia ese mai edia tuari ḡaudia imadia ai Aigupto tanona e rakatania.
english: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

motu: Mose ese Iosef turiana danu e laohai; badina be Iosef ese Israel taudia taravadia vada e atua, eto “Momokani, Dirava ese baine vadivadi henimui; una negana ai umui ese lau turiagu bavabi kau”.
english: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, for he had made the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones away from here with you.”

motu: Bena idia na eha laolao, Sukoto amo ela bona Etam, tano ḡaḡaena isena ai.
english: They took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

motu: Iehova na idia vairadiai ela, dina ai ori dubuna lalonai, edia dala ihahedinaraina, bona hanuaboi ai lahi mamana lalonai, edia diari, bae laolao boi bae laolao rani helaoreana.
english: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:

motu: Bena hari ori dubuna asine rakatanidiava dina ai, bona lahi mamana asine rakatanidiava hanuaboi ai.
english: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hareva henia, eto
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba haduadia, bae lou, Pi-hahiroto vairanai bae taruha, Migdol bona davara padadiai, Baal-sefon vairanai; ia hevaira-hehenina ai davara badinai ba taruha.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea.

motu: Badina be Farao ese Israel taumui baine herevalaimui, baineto “Idia na tano ḡaḡaena ai e raka hehiri-hehirimu, lalodia vada e haboioboio”.
english: Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the land. The wilderness has shut them in.’

motu: Bena lau ese Farao lalona baina ha-aukaia, bena ia ese baine ḡavamui; a lau ese Farao mai ena tuari oreana idoinai baina hadareredia, bena Aigupto taudia vada bae diba lau na Iehova. Bena unu e kara toma.
english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies; and the Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh.” They did so.

motu: Una negana ai haida ese Aigupto pavapavana e hamaoroa Israel taudia vada e heau; bena Farao mai ena hesiai taudia ida e halalo, lalodia ma e idau Israel taudia ediai. Idia eto “Israel taudia ta kahudia nege, isiaida ilao-henina ai bae doko, anina be dahaka?”
english: The king of Egypt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they said, “What is this we have done, that we have let Israel go from serving us?”

motu: Bena ia ese ena kariota e abia heḡaeḡae, bona ena orea taudia e hakaudia lao.
english: He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him;

motu: Kariota namodia sinahu tauratoi e abidia hidi, bona kariota oredia danu e laohai, Aigupto kariotadia iboudiai, ta ta mai biagudia.
english: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, with captains over all of them.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, lalona e ha-aukaia, bena ia ese Israel taudia e ḡavadia; badina be Israel taudia vada e raka lasi, asi edia gari.
english: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high hand. + 14:8 or, defiantly. *

motu: Aigupto taudia ese e ḡavadia, Farao ena hosi bona ena kariota iboudiai, ena orea taudia hosi ai e gui danu, bona ena tuari taudia, bena idia ese Israel taudia e lasidia tao edia taruha ai, davara badibadinai, Pi-hahiroto badinai, Baal-sefon vairani.
english: The Egyptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon.

motu: Farao na e raka kahira; bena Israel taudia e roha isi, Aigupto taudia e itadia vada e lasidia tao, bena e gari dikadika, Iehova e tai henia.
english: When Pharaoh came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to Yahweh.

motu: Bena idia ese Mose e gwau henia, eto, Aigupto ai gara gabudia lasi a? Una dainai oi ese vada o hakaumai lasi, tano ḡaḡaena ai baia mase totona a? Badina be dahaka Aigupto amo vada o hakaumai lasi?
english: They said to Moses, “Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egypt?

motu: Ai na Aigupto ai asia hereva henimu, a, asiato “Emai ai a raka oho, ai na Aigupto taudia isiaidia baia lao heni”, a? Badina be Aigupto taudia isiaidia baiama lao heni be namo, a tano ḡaḡaena ai baiama mase na dika.
english: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”

motu: A Mose eto, Basio gari, ba gini tutuka-tutuka, Iehova ena hahemauri do ba itaia, hari dina ai baine hamaurilaimui, badina be Aigupto taudia harihari o itadiamu na basio itadia lou, lasi ona lasi vaitani.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today.

motu: Iehova na umui daimui ai baine tuari; umui na ba noho boioboio.
english: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka dainai o tai henigumu? Israel taudia ba haduadia, bae raka lao.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward.

motu: Oiemu itotohi danu ba duduia isi, imamu davara daenai ba toia roro, ba hapararaia; bena Israel taudia na tano kaukauna ai bae raka hanai.
english: Lift up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall go into the middle of the sea on dry ground.

motu: A lau be Aigupto taudia lalodia baina ha-aukadia, bena bae ḡavamui: bena lau ese Farao mai ena tuari oreana idoinai, ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia, baina hadareredia.
english: Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they will go in after them. I will get myself honor over Pharaoh, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

motu: Bena Farao bona ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia baina hadareredia negana ai Aigupto taudia na bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I have gotten myself honor over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.”

motu: Bena Dirava ena aneru, Israel ena taruha vairanai e nohova aneruna, na muridia kahana ela; bona ori dubuna danu idia vairadia kahana amo e heabi isi, idia muridia kahana ela,
english: The angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them.

motu: Aigupto taudia edia taruha bona Israel taudia edia taruha padadiai eha gini. Bena ori na dibura ai e miava, to ia ese diari e henidia hanuaboi ai; bona una hanuaboi idoinai orea ta ese orea ta se raka henia kahi.
english: It came between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night.

motu: Bena Mose ese imana e toia roro davara daenai; bena Iehova ese lai gubana amo davara e haloua, una hanuaboi idoinai. Bena davara na e haheparara, tano kaukauna e hedinarai.
english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese tano kaukauna ai davara e rakaia hanai; davara ranuaia e kara haba na heheto, idibidia kahana ai bona lauridia kahana ai.
english: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

motu: Bena Aigupto taudia ese davara bogaragina amo e ḡavadia, Farao ena hosi bena ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia iboudiai ese e ḡavadia. ?
english: The Egyptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

motu: A daba kahana ai Iehova ese lahi mamana bona ori dubuna amo Aigupto edia tuari oreadia e nenedia, bena e hahekwarahdia:
english: In the morning watch, Yahweh looked out on the Egyptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egyptian army.

motu: edia kariota uilidia e hepuni, bena kariota na asie heau namonamova. Taunabunai Aigupto taudia e hereva heheni, eto, Israel taudia vairadia amo baita heau, badina be Iehova ese idia e durudiamu, ita e tuari henidamu.
english: He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for Yahweh fights for them against the Egyptians!”

motu: Bena Iehova ese mose e hamaoroa, eto, Oi imamu na davara daenai ma ba toia roro, ranu ma baine lou, Aigupto taudia latadiai bona edia kariota latadiai bona edia hosi-gui taudia latadiai.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”

motu: Bena Mose ese imana e toia roro daenai, bena daba matana ai davara ma e lou gabuna ai; bena Aigupto taudia na davara vairanai e heau. Unu amo Iehova ese Aigupto taudia e hadareredia, davara bogaraginai:
english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. Yahweh overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

motu: ranu na e lou, kariota bona hosi-gui taudia bona Farao ena tuari oreana idoinai, davara bogaragina amo Israel taudia e ḡavadia taudia iboudiai na e habubunidia; ta we roho mauri.
english: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them.

motu: A Israel taudia na tano kaukauna ai e raka hanai, davara bogaraginai; ranu na e kara haba na heheto, idibadia kahana ai bona lauridia kahana ai.
english: But the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

motu: Unuhetomana Iehova ese Israel taudia na Aigupto taudia imadia amo e hamauridia una dina ai. Bena Israel taudia ese Aigupto taudia masedia ai e itadia, kone ai.
english: Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.

motu: Aigupto taudia na Iehova ese ede e karadia toma Israel taudia ese e itaia; bena iboudiai ese Iehova garina e gari. Idia ese Iehova e abidadama henia, ena hesiai tauna Mose danu e abidadama henia.
english: Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh and in his servant Moses.

motu: Bena Mose bona Israel taudia na ina ane e abia, Iehova ena; eto, Lau na ane baina abia, Iehova ena, badina be ia na vada e kwalimu herea; Hosi bona e gui tauna davara ai vada e tahodia dobi.

english: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”

motu: Badina be Farao ena hosi bona ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia na davara lalona amo ela; bena Iehova ese davara hurehuredia amo e habubunidia. A Israel taudia na tano kaukauna ai e raka, davara bogaragina ai.
english: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

motu: Bena Miriama, peroveta hahinena, Aaron taihuna, ese tareko e abia imana ai; bona hahine iboudiai edia tareko e abi, ia murina amo ela mai mavarudia ida.
english: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.

motu: Bena Miriama ese tatau edia ane davana e halou henidia, ane e abia, eto, Ane avabia, Iehova ena, badina be ia na vada e kwalimu herea; Hosi bona e gui tauna davara ai vada e tahodia dobi. Israel taudia ranu e masedia
english: Miriam answered them, “ Sing|strong="H7891" * to|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, for|strong="H3588" * he|strong="H3588" * has|strong="H3068" * triumphed|strong="H1342" * gloriously|strong="H1342" *. He|strong="H3588" * has|strong="H3068" * thrown|strong="H7411" * the|strong="H3588" * horse|strong="H5483" * and|strong="H3068" * his|strong="H3068" * rider|strong="H7392" * into|strong="H3220" * the|strong="H3588" * sea|strong="H3220" *.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia na Davara Kakakakana amo e hakaudia lao, tano ḡaḡaena ladana Suru amo e hakaudia hanai. Dina toi tano ḡaḡaena ai eha laolao, ranu asie davaria.
english: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

motu: Bena gabu ladana Mara ai e lasi, a una gabu ranuna asie inua diba, badina na idita; una dainai una gabu ladana e hatoa Mara. + 15:23 “Mara” anina be “Idita”. *
english: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah. + 15:23 Marah means bitter. *

motu: Bena laolao taudia ese Mose e maumauraia, eto, Ai na dahaka baia inua?
english: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

motu: Bena ia ese Iehova e noia; bena Iehova ese au ta e haheitalaia: ia ese una au ranu e urua diho, bena ranu gaiho vada e davaria. Una gabu ai Iehova ese taravatu bona haheḡani e henidia, e dibadia,
english: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

motu: eto, Oi ese Iehova emu Dirava gadona boma hakala henia, bona ia vairanai boma kara maoromaoro, ena haheḡani boma badina bona ena taravatu boma kara, lau na hisihisi idau-idau amo basinama hahisimu, Aigupto taudia na hahisidia heḡereḡeredia; badina be lau na Iehova, oi ihamaurimu Diravana.
english: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”

motu: Bena idia na Elim ai e kau; unuseni ai ranu guridia na gwauta-rua, bona pamu audia na hitu-ahui. Bena unu ranu badidiai e taruha.
english: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

motu: Israel hegogona idoinai na Elim amo ela, tano ḡaḡaena ladana Sin ai e kau, Elim Bona Sinai padadiai. Hua iharuana dinana ihagwauta-imana, Aigupto e rakatania murinai, idia na unuseni ai e kau.
english: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

motu: Bena Israel hegogona idoinai ese Mose bona Aaron e maumauraidia, tano ḡaḡaena ai.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;

motu: Israel taudia ese raruosi e gwau henidia, eto, Aigupto tanona ai Iehova ese bema alamai mase, vamu urodia badibadidiai a helaiva bona flaoa ianina ai bogamai e kunuva negana ai, bema namo; badina be umui raruosi ese ina tano ḡḡaena ai vada o hakaumai vareai, hitolo ese ina hegogo idoinai baine alamai mase totona.
english: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: lau na amui aniani guba amo baina hadihoa, medu na heto; dina ta ta ai taunimanima bae raka lasi, dina tamona ahuna bae haboua; unu amo baina dibadia, lauegu taravatu bae badina eiava lasi.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

motu: A dina ihatauratoina idia na dina rua ahudia bae heḡaeḡaelai.
english: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron ese Israel taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto, Hari adorahi ai vada ba diba Iehova ese Aigupto tanona amo vada e hakaumui lasi;
english: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that Yahweh has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

motu: bona daba ai Iehova hairaina do ba itaia. Badina be emui maumau, Iehova o maumauraiamu, herevadia ia ese vada e kamonai. A ai be daidia, umui ese o maumauraimaimu?
english: In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

motu: Mose ma eto, Iehova ese vamu baine henimui adorahi ai, bona daba ai aniani baine henimui, bogamui ihakunudia: badina be emui maumau, Iehova o maumauraiamu, herevadia ia ese vada e kamonai. A ai be daidia? Emui maumau be dia ai asio maumauraimaimu; Iehova hari o maumauauriamu.
english: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron e haduaia, eto, Israel hegogona idoinai ba hereva henidia, baoto “A raka kahira Iehova vairanai; badina be ia ese emui maumau herevadia vada e kamonai”.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to Yahweh, for he has heard your murmurings.’”

motu: Bena AAron ese Israel hegogona idoinai e hereva henidia negana ai idia ese tano ḡaḡaena e haḡerea, bena Iehova diaridiarina na ori ai e itadia.
english: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia edia maumau herevadia vada na kamonai. Harihari ba hereva henidia, baoto “Adorahi ai vamu bavania, bona daba ai aniani bavania, bogamui ba hakunu; bena vada ba diba lau be Iehova, emui Dirava”.
english: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am Yahweh your God.’”

motu: Adorahi ai, kibi momo e roho kau, taruha tanona e habubunia. Daba ai, hunu na taruhu tanona idoinai e miava,
english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

motu: bena hunu e kaukau negana ai ḡau maraḡidia kuborodia e hedinarai, itadia na medu hetarina na heto.
english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

motu: Israel taudia ese una ḡau e itaia, bena e henanadai heheni, eto, Ia be dahaka? Badina be asi dibadia una ḡau. Bena Mose ese e hamaorodia, eto, Amui aniani benai, Iehova ese vada e henimui ḡauna.
english: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.

motu: Iehova ena hahedua binai: Ba haboudia, ta ta ahuna ahuna ba habou, taunimanima ta nau auta; ruma biagudia ese edia ruma taudia adia unu bae habou toma.
english: This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer + 16:16 An omer is about 2.2 liters or about 2.3 quarts * a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”

motu: Bena Israel taudia na unu e kara toma. Haida e abi badabada, bona haida na sisidia mo e abi;
english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.

motu: to e hahetohoa negana ai e abi badabada tauna na asi bahuna, bona e abi gadoi tauna na se dabu; ta ta ena hitolo ena hitolo heḡereḡeredia e abi.
english: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.

motu: Mose ese ma e hamaorodia, eto, Bahu basine mia rani.
english: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”

motu: To Mose erena asie kamonai; haida ese e atoa tabe ela bona daba ai ia na mai gaigai-gaigaina, bona bonana na dika herea. Una dainai Mose ese e badu henidia.
english: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.

motu: Daba iboudiai e habou, ta ta ena hitolo ena hitolo heḡereḡeredia. A dina e dae ai e veve oho.
english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

motu: Dina ihatauratoina, idia ese dina rua anianidia e habou, taunimanima ta ta nau rua rua e abi: bena hebou igunalaina taudia iboudiai ela, Mose e hamaorolaia.
english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova ena hereva binai: kerukeru na laḡa-ani dinana, Iehova ena dina helaḡa; be gabu ḡaudia na ba gabu, ba nadu ḡaudia na ba nadu, bona bahu baine mia rani.
english: He said to them, “This is that which Yahweh has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”

motu: Bena bahu e atoa tabe ela bona daba ai se bodaga bona asi gaigai-gaigaina.
english: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.

motu: Mose ma eto, Hari dina ai bahu mo bavani, badina be hari na Iehova ena dina helaḡa; hari dina ai ḡau ta basio davaria tano ai.
english: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to Yahweh. Today you shall not find it in the field.

motu: Dina tauratoi ba habou, a dina ihahituna ai basio davaria, badina be ia na dina helaḡa.
english: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”

motu: Bena dina ihahituna ai taunimanima haida ela, bae habou eto; to ḡau ta asie davaria.
english: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e gwau henia, eto, Egu haheḡani bona egu taravatu ba dadaraidia ela bona edena nega ai?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

motu: A itaia, Iehova ese dina helaḡa vada e henimui, una dainai dina ihatauratoina ai ia ese dina rua anianidia e henimuimu. Dina ihahituna ai vada ba noho, ta ta ena kalaga ena kalaga ai: tau ta ena kalaga basine rakatania.
english: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

motu: Taunabunai, dina ihahituna ai taunimanima na laḡadia e aniva.
english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

motu: Israel taudia ese una aniani ladana e hatoa Mana: + 16:31 “Mana” anina be “Dahaka gau?” * ia na nadinadi kurokurona na heto, a mamina na bada-ranuna amo e karamu dikeadia na heheto.
english: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, + 16:31 “Manna” means “What is it?” * and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.

motu: Bena Mose eto, Iehova ena haheḡani binai: nau autamona mo bavatoa tabe, baine mia, uru gabedia ese tano ḡaḡaena ai na ubulaimui anianina, Aigupto tanona amo na hakaumui lasi negana ai, do bae itaia.
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron e haduaia, eto, Hodu ta avabia, mana nau auta heḡereḡerena ba udaia, Iehova vairanai bavatoa, uru gabedia edia.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept throughout your generations.”

motu: Taunabunai, Aaron ese maua helaḡana vairanai e atoa, unuseni ai baine mia, Iehova ese Mose e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

motu: Laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai Israel taudia ese mana e aniava, ela bona tano namona ai e kau; mana mo e aniava ela bona Kanaan tanona hetoana ai e kau.
english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

motu: Hari nau be nau gwauta anidia na efa + 16:36 “Efa” be Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta; anina be 18 litres sisivana. * ta anina heḡereḡerena.
english: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah. + 16:36 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel *

motu: Israel hegogona idoinai ese tano ḡaḡaena ladana Sin e rakatania, e laolao metaira-metaira, Iehova ese e haduadia heḡereḡerena, ela bona Refidim ai e taruha. Unuseni ai idia na asi edia inuinu ranuna.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

motu: Taunabunai idia ese Mose e gwau henia, eto, Inuinu ranuna a henimai. Mose eto, Dahaka dainai o gwau henigumu? Dahaka dainai Iehova o dibaḡaniamu?
english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses|strong="H4872" * said to|strong="H3068" * them|strong="H5414" *, “ Why|strong="H4100" * do|strong="H3068" * you|strong="H5414" * quarrel|strong="H7378" * with|strong="H5973" * me|strong="H5414" *? Why|strong="H4100" * do|strong="H3068" * you|strong="H5414" * test|strong="H5254" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *?”

motu: A taunimanima na ranu e masedia, bena idia ese Mose e maumauraia, eto, Dahaka dainai Aigupto ai vada o hakaumai lasi, bena ai bona natumai bona emai seri ranu-mase amo bavalamai?
english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e tai henia, eto, Ina orea taudia na ede baina karadia toma? Lalodia e hadaimu nadi amo bae hodogu mase e tomu.
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haere henia, eto Taunimanima vairadiai baola, Israel tau-badadia ba hakaudia lao; emu itotohi, sinavai badana o botalaia ḡauna, danu bavabia kau, baola.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

motu: A kamonai: lau na oi vairamu ai baina gini, Horeb nadi hagahagana ai, bena nadi hagahagana ba botaia, bena ranu unu amo baine aru lasi, taunimanima edia inuinu ḡauna. Bena Mose unu e kara toma, Israel tau-badadia vairadiai.
english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

motu: Bena una gabu ladana e hatoa Masa + 17:7 “Masa” anina be “Hedibaḡani”. “Meriba” anina be “Ḡadeḡade”. * bona Meriba, badina be Israel taudia e ḡadeḡade, bona Iehova e dibaḡania, eto “Iehova na dekedekeda ai eiva lasi?” Tuari e vara
english: He called the name of the place Massah, + 17:7 Massah means testing. * and Meribah, + 17:7 Meribah means quarreling. * because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or not?”

motu: Una negana ai Amalek ema, Israel taudia e tuari henidia Refidim ai.
english: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

motu: Bena Mose ese Iosua e haduaia, eto, Eda orea tataudia haida bavabidia hidi, baola, Amalek ba tuari henia. Kerukeru lau na ororo dorina ai do baina gini, Dirava ena itotohi imagu ai baina abia.
english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

motu: Bena Iosua ese Amalek e tuari henia, Mose ena hahedua heḡereḡerena. A Mose bona Aaron bona Huru na ororo dorina ela.
english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

motu: Bena Mose imana e duduia isi negana ai israel taudia e kwalimu, a imana e hadihoa negana ai Amalek taudia e kwalimu.
english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

motu: A Mose imana e mase. Bena raruosi ese nadi ta e abia, ia murinai e atoa; bena ia e halai kau. Bena Aaron bona Huru ese ia imana ruaosi e dudui isi, ta idibana ai ma ta laurina ai; bena imana asie marere ela bona dina e diho.
english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

motu: Unu amo Iosua ese Amalek mai ena orea taudia ida e hadareredia, dare matana amo.
english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Ina hereva na buka ta ai ba torea, taunimanima bae laloa tao helaoreana; bona Iosua ba hadibaia, lau na Amalek sivaraina ihelalolaina na baina haboioa, tanobada ai baine boio vaitani.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

motu: Bena Mose ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, bona ladana e hatoa Iehova-nisi. + 17:15 “Iehova-nisi” anina be “Iehova na egu pepe”. *
english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “Yahweh our Banner”. + 17:15 Hebrew, Yahweh Nissi *

motu: Ia eto, Iehova vada e gwau hamata: Iehova ese Amalek baine tuari henia ela uru iboudiai.
english: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

motu: Mose ravana, Ietero, Midian hahelaḡa tauna, ese Dirava ena kara Mose enai bona ena bese Israel ediai harina e kamonai, e kamonai danu Iehova ese Israel taudia Aigupto amo vada e hakaudia lasi.
english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how Yahweh had brought Israel out of Egypt.

motu: Bena Mose ese adavana e siaia oho murinai, Mose ravana, Ietero, ese Mose adavana, Sipora, e abia,
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

motu: bona natuna raruosi danu e abidia. Ta ladana na Geresom; + 18:3 “Geresom” anina be “idau tauna”. * badina be tamana eto, Lau na idau tano ai na noho hedoamu.
english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, + 18:3 “Gershom” sounds like the Hebrew for “an alien there”. * for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

motu: A tau muritai ladana na Eliesere; + 18:4 “Eliesere” anina be “Dirava ena hekaha”. * badina ba tamnana eto, Tamagu ena Dirava ese e kahagu, Farao ena dare amo e hamaurigu.
english: The name of the other was Eliezer, + 18:4 Eliezer means “God is my helper”. * for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

motu: Bena Ietero, Mose ravana, ese Mose natuna raruosi bona adavana e hakaudia lao, Mose na tano ḡaḡaena ai e taruha gabunai ai, Dirava ena ororo ai.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

motu: Bena ia ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Lau, oi ravamu, vada nama dekemu ai, adavamu bona natumu raruosi danu vada na hakaudia mai.
english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

motu: Bena Mose e raka lasi, ravana vairanai e igo diho, e harahua. Raruosi e hahenamo heheni, bena kalaga ai e raka vareai,
english: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova ena kara idoinai harina na ravana e hamaorolaia: Israel dainai Iehova ese Farao bona Aigupto taudia ede e karadia toma, bona Israel taudia dala ai be ede e hekwarahi toma, bona Iehova ese ede e hamauridia toma.
english: Moses told his father-in-law all that Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how Yahweh delivered them.

motu: Bena Ietero e moale, Iehova ese Israel taudia e hanamodiava, Aigupto taudia imadia amo e hamauridiava, dainai.
english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

motu: Ietero eto, Iehova aita imodaia, ia ese Aigupto taudia imadia amo bona Farao imana amo vada e hamaurimui, Israel taudia na Aigupto edia iḡui amo vada e ruhadia nege.
english: Jethro said, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

motu: Harihari lau dibagu Iehova ese dirava iboudiai e hereadiamu, badina be edia hekokoroku ai vada e hadareredia.
english: Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

motu: Bena Mose ravana, Ietero, ese ihaboulaina karana e karaia, Dirava ena; lahi ese e ḡolea oho ḡauna amo Dirava e boua. Bena Aaron bona Israel tau-badadia iboudiai e hebou, Mose ravana ida e aniani hebou, Dirava vairanai.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

motu: Daba ai, ose na hahemaoro gabuna ai e helai, taunimanima e hahemaoro henidia: bena taunimanima na Mose vairanai e gini, daba amo ela bona dina e diho.
english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

motu: Mose ravana ese ena kara idoinai e itaia, taunimanima ede e karadia toma, bena ia ese e nanadaia, eto, Taunimanina ini o karadia tomamu anina be dahaka? Dahaka dainai oi sibomu o helaimu, a taunimanima iboudiai na vairamu ai gigini, daba ela bona adorahi.
english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

motu: Mose ese ravana e haere henia, eto, Badina be taunimanima na lau dekegu ai e maimu, Dirava ena ura bae diba totona;
english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

motu: bona e hepapahuahumu negadia ai danu, idia na dekegu ai e maimu, benia na hahemaoro henidiamu, bona Dirava ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani na hadibalaidiamu.
english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

motu: Bena Mose ravana ese e hamaoroa, eto, Emu kara na dia namo;
english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

motu: oiemu goada bona ini taunimanima edia goada vada bae ore, badina be ina ḡaukara na metau herea; sibomu basio karaia diba.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

motu: Egu hereva a kamonai; lau ese baina hahealo henimu bena Dirava ese baine hanamomu: oi na Dirava vairanai ba gini, taunimanima daidiai; edia daradara ba hedinarai ia vairanai.
english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

motu: Oi ese danu ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani ba hadibadia, edia raka daladia bona edia ḡaukara ba hadibalaidia.
english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ini taunimanima iboudiai edia amo tatau namodia hahidaosi bavabidia hidi, Dirava garina e garimu taudia, kara gageva-gageva e inai henimu taudia. Edia dagi ba henidia: daha daha lohiadia, sinahu sinahu lohiadia, imahui imahui lohiadia, bona gwata gwata lohiadia.
english: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

motu: Idia ese taunimanima bae hahemaoro henidia, dina iboudiai: hereva badadia be oi emu bae mailaidia, a hereva maraḡidia be sibodia bae haero. Unu amo oiemu ḡaukara taina baine haraḡa, badina be idia ese maduna kahana bae huaia.
english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

motu: Ini ba kara toma, bona Dirava ese ini baine haḡanimu toma, bena ba haheauka diba; ini taunimanima iboudiai danu edia kalaga bae lou heni mai mainodia ida.
english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese ravana ena hereva e kamonai, bona ena hahedua heḡereḡerena e karaia.
english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

motu: Israel idoinai ai tatau namodia e abidia hidi, bese ikwaradia taudia ai e halaodia, daha daha lohiadia, sinahu sinahu lohiadia, imahui imahui lohiadia, bona gwauta gwauta lohiadia.
english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

motu: Dina iboudiai idia ese taunimanima e hahemaoro henidia; hereva aukadia be Mose vairanai e gwaurai, a hereva maraḡidia na sibodia e haero.
english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

motu: Bena Mose ese ravana e hatonia; bena ravana na ena tano korikori ela.
english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

motu: Hua ihatoina ai, Israel na Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai, dinana heḡereḡerena ai, idia na Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai e kau.
english: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

motu: Refidim e rakatania negana ai, idia na Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai e kau: bena tano ḡaḡaena ai e taruha, ororo badi-tanona ai. Unuseni ai Israel e taruha.
english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

motu: Bena Mose e dara dae Dirava dekenai. Iehova gadona na ororo amo ema ia enai, eto, Iakob ena bese taudia ini ba hereva henidia toma, Israel taudia ini ba hamaorodia toma. Baoto
english: Moses went up to God, and Yahweh called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

motu: “Aigupto taudia ede na karadia toma vada o itaia, dibamui danu ede na abimui toma, ugava hanidia latadiai na heto, bena na hakaumui mai dekegu ai.
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

motu: Harihari lau eregu boma kamonai bona egu taravatu boma badinaia, umui na egu bese korokori ai boma lao, bese iboudiai bogaragidiai, badina be tanobada idoinai be lauegu.
english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

motu: Egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baola; bese helaḡana ai baola”. Israel taudia unu ba hamaorodia toma.
english: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

motu: Bena Mose na ema, Israel tau-badadia e boiridia, Iehova ena haheḡani herevadia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia.
english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai e haere hebou, eto, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena ai baia karaia. Bena Mose ese taunimanima edia haere na Iehova e hamaorolaia.
english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.” Moses|strong="H4872" * reported|strong="H7725" * the|strong="H3605" * words|strong="H1697" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * to|strong="H1696" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, lau na ori badana ai baina vasi, bena baina hamaorolaimu herevadia na taunimanima bae kamonai; bena bae abidadama henimu ela hanaihanai. Bena Mose ese taunimanima edia hereva na Iehova e hamaorolaia.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Taunimanima dekedia baola; hari dina ai bona kerukeru ba hahelaḡadia; edia dabua danu bae huri;
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
