motu: dina ihatoina ai bae heḡaeḡae; badina be dina ihatoina ai Iehova baine diho Sinai ororona ai, taunimania iboudiai vairadiai.
english: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

motu: Hetoa danu bavabia, ororo baine ḡeḡea ahu, bena ba hamaorodia, baoto “Nahuamui ba toho, ororo ai basio dae kau, bona badibadina basiola; daika na ororo ai baine dae kau, vada bae alaia mase;
english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

motu: imadia amo basie daua toho, a nadi amo bae hodoa mase eiava diba amo bae tarakia mase; bema taunimanima eiava ubu-ubu ḡauna, to basine mauri. A kibi reḡena daudauna bae kamonai, bena ororo ai bae dara dae”.
english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

motu: Taunabunai Mose na ororo amo e hekei, taunimanima dekediai; bena e hahelaḡadia, edia dabua danu e huri.
english: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

motu: Bena ia ese e haduadia, eto, Ba heḡaeḡae ela bona dina ihatoina; hahine ta basio raka henia kahi.
english: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

motu: Dina ihatoina ai, daba kahana ai, guba e rahua bona kevaru e kevaru isi, bona badana ta ororo dorina ai e kau. Bena kibi ta reḡena e kamonai, reḡena na bada herea: taruha taudia iboudiai na kudoudia e hetaha.
english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

motu: Bena Mose ese taunimanima na edia taruha amo e hakaudia lasi, Dirava vairanai bae gini; idia na e raka ela bona ororo badi-tanona ai.
english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

motu: Una negana ai Sinai ororona na kwalahu ese e ḡovaia ahu, badina be Iehova na lahi ai e diho, ororo latani. Taunabunai, kwalahuna e dae badabada, amu kwalahuna na heto; ororo tanona idoinai danu e laga.
english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

motu: Kibi reḡena na e bada e laova; bena Mose na e hereva, bona Dirava ese guba rahurahu lalona amo e haere henia.
english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

motu: Bena Iehova vada e diho, Sinai ororona dorina ai. Iehova ese danu Mose e boiria, baine dara dae ororo dorina ai, bena Mose na e dara dae.
english: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, A hekei, taunimanima ba hadibadia, Iehova itana totona bae didi dara bena hutuma bae mase na garina.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia ese danu Iehova do basie raka henia kahi; sibodia bae hahelaḡa guna, Iehova ese ediai baine hedinarai taku na garina.
english: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e haere henia, eto, Taunimanima na ororo ai basie dara dae diba, badina be oi ese o haduamai, hetoa baia abia, ororo baine ḡeḡea ahu, baia hahelaḡaia oto.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

motu: Iehova ma eto, A hekei, bena Aaron ida ma ba dara dae; a hahelaḡa taudia bona taunimanima kavakavadia na basie didi dara Iehova enai, ia ese idia ediai baine hedinarai taku na garina.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”

motu: Taunabunai Mose e hekei taunimanima dekediai, unu hereva e hamaorolaidia.
english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

motu: Dirava ini e hereva toma.
english: God + 20:1 After “God”, the Hebrew has the two letters “Aleph Tav” (the first and last letters of the Hebrew alphabet), not as a word, but as a grammatical marker. * spoke all these words, saying,

motu: Lau binai Iehova, emu Dirava: Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo na hakamu lasi. ?
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

motu: Idau dirava ta basio abia lau vairagu ai.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

motu: Laulau ta basio koroa; ḡau ta laulauna, guba ḡauna ta, eiava tanobada ḡauna ta, tanobada henuna ḡauna ta, basio karaia:
english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

motu: basio toma henia diho, bona isiaina basio lao heni. Badina be lau Iehova emu Dirava na vaḡeḡe Diravana: e inai henigumu taudia edia kara dika davadia na natudia bona tubudia latadiai baina kara ela bona uru ihatoina bona ihahanina,
english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

motu: a e ura henigumu bona egu taravatu e badinamu taudia baina bogadia hisi ela uru daha.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

motu: Iehova emu Dirava ladana na basio hatoa kava hatoa kava; badina be Iehova ladana baine hatoa kava tauna na Iehova basineto ia na asi ena kerere.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, + 20:7 or, You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain * for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

motu: Dina Helaḡa ba laloa, ba hahelaḡaia.
english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

motu: Dina tauratoi lalodiai emu ḡaukara idoinai ba karaia,
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

motu: a dina ihahituna na dina helaḡana, Iehova emu Dirava ena. Una dina ai basio ḡaukara, oi eiava natumu maruanena eiava natumu hahinena eiava emu hesiai tauna eiava hesiai hahinena eiava emu boromakau, eiava idau tauna emu ruma ai e noho hedoamu.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

motu: Badina be dina tauratoi lalodiai Iehovva ese guba bona tanobada bona davara bona lalodia ḡaudia iboudiai e karadia, bena dina ihahituna ai e laḡa ani. Badina bunai Iehova ese dina ihahituna vada e hanamoa bona e hahelaḡaia.
english: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

motu: Tamamu sinamu ba matauraidia; unu amo emu mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova emu Dirava ese e henimumu tanona ai.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

motu: Basio ala-ala.
english: “You shall not murder.

motu: Basio heuda hanai.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

motu: Basio henao.
english: “You shall not steal.

motu: Dekemu tauna basio habadelaia ko8ikoi.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

motu: Dekemu tauna ena ruma basio ḡahusia, adavana danu basio ḡahusia, eiava ena hesiai tauna eiava ena hesiai hahinena eiava ena boromakau eiava ena doniki eiava ena kohu ta basio ḡahusi.
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai na guba rahurahu bona kevaru bona kibi reḡena bona ororo kwalahuna e kamonai bona e ita negana ai, idia na e gari, kudoudia danu e hataha. Idia na dauhai e gini,
english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

motu: Mose e hereva henia, eto, Oi ba hereva henimai, bena baia kamonai henimu; a Dirava basine hereva henimai, baia mase na garina.
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

motu: Bena Mose ese e hamaorodia, eto, Basio gari; badina be Dirava vada ema, baine dibamui totona, bena ia imatauraina dainai umui na basio kara dika.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

motu: Bena taunimanima na dounu dauhai e giniva, a Mose ese Dirava e noholaiava dagadagana e raka henia kahi.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Israel taudia na ini ba hamaorodia toma, baoto: Umui na vada o diba, lau gadogu na guba amo vada ema.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

motu: Silver * diravadia eiava gold * diravadia na basio kara.
english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana na tano amo ba larebaia, ia latanai emu boubou ḡaudia, heḡole-oho ḡaudia bona herohemaino ḡaudia, mamoe bona boromakau, ba henigu. lau ladagu ilalolaina vada na atoa gabudia iboudiai lau baina vasi bona baina henamomu.
english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

motu: A ihaboulaina patana na nadi amo boma larebaia, e utu nadidia amo basioma larebaia, badina be iutulaidia aurina ese bema hamirodia.
english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

motu: Ina danu: egu ihaboulaina patana na vadavada amo basio dae henia, ḡaḡaemu ai bae itamu na garina.
english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

motu: Ba henidia taravatudia bini.
english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

motu: Heberu tauna ta ba hoia, emu hesiai tauna ai ba halaoa, ia na laḡani tauratoi isiaimu baine lao heni, bena ihahituna ai ba kahua nege, asi davana.
english: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

motu: Sibona emu ai baine raka vareai, sibona ma baine raka lasi; a mai adavana ida bae raka vareai, mai adavana ida ma bae raka lasi.
english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

motu: A biaguna ese hahine ta baine henia, baine adavaia, bena natuna mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia na una hahine ena amo baine abidia, una hahine mai natuna ida na biaguna ena; hesiai tauna na sibona baine raka lasi.
english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

motu: A hesiai tauna baine hereva hedinarai, baineto “Baigugu bona adavagu bona adavagu bonanatugu na ura henidiamu; una dainai lau basina raka lasi”,
english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

motu: hari biaguna ese una tau na Dirava vairanai baine hakaua lasi, iduara ai eiava iduara auna ai taiana matuna baine daia uru; bena una tau ese biaguna isiaina baine lao heni ela bona mase.
english: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

motu: Tau ta ese natuna kekenina baine hoia, hesiai ai bainela, biaguna be basine kahua nege hesiai taudia mamaruanedia e kahudia negemu heḡereḡerena.
english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

motu: Bema biaguna ese baine adavaia bena basine ura henia, hahine varavarana ese ma bae davalaia bena bae abia lou. Basine hoia diba idau taudia ediai, badina be ia ese vada e dadaraia.
english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

motu: A bema natuna maruanena baine henia, ia ese ravana korikori ai baine halaoa.
english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

motu: Bema hahine ta ma baine abia, ia ese hahine gunana ana aniani bona ena dabua ihenina basine hamaraḡi, bona basine hadihoa.
english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

motu: A ini ḡau ai baine hadabua, ia na baine kahua nege, asi davana. Ala-ala Taravatudia
english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

motu: Ta ese tau ta baine alaia mase, ia danu bae alaia mase.
english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

motu: To bema iala-masena basine haeroa guna, a Dirava ese ia imana ai baine atoa, lau na gabu ta baina gwaurai henimu, ia baine heau mauri gabuna.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

motu: A tau ta ese iala-masena baine haeroa guna, bena baine alaia mase, egu ihaboulaina patana amo bavabia siri, vada baine mase.
english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

motu: Tamana eiava sinana baine botaia tauna na bae alaia mase.
english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

motu: Ta ese tau ta baine henaoa, bena baine hoia, eiava ia imana ai bae davaria, vada bae alaia mase.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

motu: Tamana eiava sinana baine uduguiraia tauna na bae alaia mase.
english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

motu: Taunimanima bae heatu, bena ese e heatu heniamu tauna na nadi amo baine hodoa, eiava imana amo baine botaia, a una tau na basine mase, baine hekure mo;
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

motu: murinai ma baine tore isi, itotohi amo baine loaloa, hari e haberoa tauna na basine kerere; ḡau tamona, ena hekure dinadia davadia baine henia, bona ena muramura dalana baine lailaia ela bona baine namo vaitani.
english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

motu: Tau ta ese ena hesiai tauna eiava hahinena baine dadabaia, bena imana ai baine mase, ena kerere davana bae henia.
english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

motu: A una hesiai tauna eiava hahinena do baine mauri, dina ta eiava dina rua, biaguna na basine kerere, badina be una hesiai rauna eiava hahinena na ena moni davana.
english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

motu: Tatau edia heatu ai rogorogo hahinena ta bae haberoa, bena hahine baine mara dika, natuna baine dika to ia be baine namo, adavana ese e haberoa tauna baine habadelaia, bena hahemaoro taudia bae hereva, moni hida ia ese hahine adavana baine henia.
english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

motu: A hahine danu baine dika, mauri davana na mauri baine henia,
english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

motu: eiava mata davana na mara, eiava ise davana na ise, eiava ia davana na ima, eiava ae davana na ae,
english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

motu: eiava heara davana na heara, eiava bero davana na bero, eiava hedadaba davana na hedadaba.
english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

motu: Tau ta ese ena hesiai tauna eiava ena hesiai hahinena matana baine haberoa, bena baine kepulu, ia na baine kahua nege, matana davana.
english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

motu: Eiava uduna baine botaia bena isena ta baine heraḡa, ia na baine kahua nege, isena davana.
english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

motu: Boromakau ta ese tau ta eiava hahine ta baine doaia mase, una boromakau na bae hodoa mase bona hidiona na basie ania; a biaguna be asi ena kerere.
english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

motu: To, bema una boromakau be nega haida unu vada e kara toma, nega gunadia ai, bona biaguna be mai dibana; bena biaguna basine koua kunuka-kunuka dainai tau ta eiava hahine ta ma baine doaia mase, boromakau na bae hodoa mase, bona biaguna danu bae alaia mase.
english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

motu: A dava bae gwauraia negana ai una dava baine henia, ena mauri ibodohilaina.
english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

motu: Bema tau ta natuna maruanena eiava natuna hahinena na boromakau ese baine doaia mase, unu bae karaia toma.
english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

motu: A bema tau ta ena hesiai tauna eiava ena hesiai hahinena na boromakau ese baine doaia mase, boromakau biaguna ese una hesiai tauna eiava hahinena biaguna na davana baine henia, silver * ena metau pound * ta mai kahana heḡereḡerena, bona boromakau danu bae hodoa mase.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels + 21:32 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 30 shekels is about 300 grams or about 10.6 ounces. * of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

motu: Tau ta ese guri ta hekehona ai baine rakatania, eiava guri baine ḡeia, bena basine koua ahu, bena boromakau ta eiava doniki ta una guri lalonai baine moru dobi,
english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

motu: guri biaguna ese davana baine karaia; ia ese boromakau eiava doniki biaguna moni baine henia, a mase ḡauna na iena.
english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

motu: Tau ta ena boromakau ese tau ta ena boromakau baine alaia mase, mauri ḡauna na bae hoia, bena raruosi ese davana bae haria; mase ḡauna danu bae haria.
english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

motu: Bema biaguna mai dibana una boromakau na vaia unu vada e kara toma, to basine koua kunuka-kunuka, ia ese davana do baine karaia, boromakau ta boromakau ta davana, bona mase ḡauna be iena.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

motu: Tau ta ese boromakau ta eiava mamoe ta baine henaoa, bena baine alaia eiava baine hoia, ia na davana do baine karaia: boromakau ta davana boromakau ima baine heni, eiava mamoe ta davana mamoe hani baine heni. Davana na unu baine karaia toma; a imana bema tuna, ia bema hoia, davana ihaḡuḡuruna.
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

motu: Henao taudia na ruma ihamakohina ai bae davaria, bena bae botaia mase, ia rarana na asi davana;
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

motu: a bema daba e rere murinai bae botaia mase, rarana na mai davana.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

motu: E henaoa boromakauna eiava donikina eiava mamoena na henao tauna dekenai bae davaria, ia na davana baine henia nega harua.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

motu: Tau ta ese boromakau baine hakaua vareai idau tauna ena uma ai eiava ena vine imeana ai, eiava baine kahua nege bena sibona baine vareai, ia na ena boromakau ese e hadika ḡaudia davadia na ena uma ḡaudia bona ena vine anidia hereadia amo do baine heni.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

motu: Lahi ese ava ḡiniḡini amo baine hanai, uit e utua ḡauna eiava uit dounu uma ai e tubumu ḡauna baine araia ore, lahi e haraia tauna ese davadia do baine heni.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

motu: Tau ta ese ena moni eiava ena kohu ia dekena tauna baine henia, baine naria totona, bena ta ese baine henaoa, henao tauna bae davaria negana ai, ia na davana baine heni nega harua.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

motu: Bema henao tauna basie davaria, ruma biaguna na hahemaoro gabuna bainela. Dirava vairanai baine gwau hamata, ia na dekena tauna ena kohu se daua toho.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

motu: Boromakau eiava doniki eiava mamoe eiava dabua bae heailai, bena tau ta baineto “Ḡauna binai egu”, kaha ruaosi na Dirava vairanai bae hahemaoro; bena hahemaoro ai baine kerere tauna ese davana nega harua ia dekena tauna baine henia.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

motu: Tau ta ese ena doniki eiava ena boromakau eiava ena mamoe eiava ena mauri ḡauna ta ia dekena tauna baine henia, baine naria totona, bena baine mase, eiava baine bero, eiava ta ese baine lulua oho, a tau ta una kara basine itaia,
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

motu: ia be Iehova vairanai baine gwau hamata, ia ese dekena tauna ena ḡau se daua toho, bena ḡau biaguna ese ena gwau-hamata baine abia dae, ena ḡau davana basine abia.
english: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

motu: A ta ese iena amo bema henaoa, ia ese davana na biaguna bema henia.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

motu: A uda boromadia ese bae koria, ia ese baine hahedinaraia, bena davana basine karaia.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

motu: Tau ta ese dekena tauna ena ḡau ta baine abia torehai, bena baine bero eiava baine mase, biaguna murinai, ia ese davana baine henia.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

motu: A bema biaguna vairanai, ia ese davana basine henia. Bema hoi-asi ḡauna, davana be vada e henia, basine henia lou.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

motu: Tau ta be hane-ulato rami-hebou, asi imaohenina, ida bae eno bou, ia ese baine adavaia, bona davana baine heni.
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

motu: A tamana ese baine rua, ia ese davana doi baine heni, bema adavaia heḡereḡerena.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

motu: Babalau hahinena na basio bogaia hisi, vada baine mase.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

motu: Mauri ḡauna idauna ta ida baine eno bou tauna sa bae alaia mase.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

motu: Ihaboulaina karana baine karaia, dia Iehova ena to idau dirava ta ena, tauna na baine havahuraia vaitani.
english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.

motu: Noho-hedoa tauna basio hadikaia bona basio hahisia, badina be umui danu Aigupto tanona ai o noho hedoava.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

motu: Vabu eiava ihareha basio hahisia;
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

motu: boma hahisidia bena bema tai henigu, lau na momokani edia tai baina tai baina kamonai,
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

motu: bena egu badu baine siahu, bena dare amo baina alamui mase: adavamui bae vabu bona natumui bae ihareha.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

motu: Egu orea taudia ogoḡamidia haida emu ai bae abi torehai, basio kara henidia abi-torehai taudia na heheto, bona heato-kau monina na ediai basio tahua.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

motu: Dekemu tauna ena dabua bavabia, ena abi-torehai toana, dina do basine diho ai ba henia lou;
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

motu: badina be una na ena hetaru ḡauna bona ena hahedoki: ede baine mahuta toma? Ia ese baine tai henigu, bena baina hakala henia, badina be lau na mai egu hebogahisi.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

motu: Dirava basio maumauraia, bona emu bese lohiana ta basio uduguiraia.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

motu: Taboro negana ai, ihaboulaina karadia ai basio halahe: emu uma anidia bona emu vine anidia ba heni momo. Natumu roboana lau ba henigu;
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “ You|strong="H5414" * shall|strong="H3117" * give|strong="H5414" * the|strong="H5414" * firstborn of|strong="H3117" * your|strong="H5414" * sons to|strong="H1961" * me|strong="H5414" *.

motu: emu boromakau bona emu mamoe danu unuheto. Dina hitu natuna roboana na sinana dekenai baine noho; dina ihataurahanina ai lau ba henigu.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

motu: Umui na hehelaḡa: taunabunai uda boromadia ese e alaia mase ḡauna na basio ania; sisia ba henidia.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

motu: Sivarai koikoi basio gwauraia. Kara dika taudia ida basio henega bou, hahebade koikoi igwaurina totona.
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

motu: Hutuma muridiai basio raka, kara dika ikarana totona, eiava hahemaoro ihagagevana totona.
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

motu: A ogoḡami tauna danu basio durua hahemaoro ihagagevana ai.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

motu: Inaimu ena boromakau eiava ena doniki baine heau boio bena oi ese ba davaria, ba hakaua lou lao ia dekenai.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

motu: Inaimu ena doniki ba itaia, ena maduna matauna dainai e goru dihomu, ba durua; ena be iduruna so uramu, to ba durua.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

motu: Ogoḡami tauna baine hahemaoro negana ai, hahemaoro basio hagagevaia ienai.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

motu: Basio hahebade koikoi; asi ena kerere tauna eiava kara maoromaoro tauna basio alaia mase; badina be kara dika tauna basina bogaia hisi.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

motu: Laloani monina basio abia; badina be lalo-ani monidia ese mata-kito taudia matadia e hakepuludiamu, bona kara maoromaoro taudia edia kara e hagagevadiamu.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

motu: Noho-hedoa tauna basio hahisia. Noho-hedoa mamina vada o abia, badina be umui danu Aigupto tanona ai o noho hedoava.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

motu: Laḡani tauratoi uma ḡaudia ba hado emu tano ai, bona anidia ba habou;
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

motu: a laḡani ihahituna ai ia na baine vahu, ogoḡami taudia ese anina bae abia. Orena na uda boromadia ese bae ania. Emu vine imeana bona emu olive imeana danu unu ba karadia toma.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

motu: Dina tauratoi ba ḡaukara. Dina ihahituna ai ba laḡa ani; emu boromakau bona emu doniki danu bae laḡa ani; emu hesiai hahinena natuna bona noho-hedoa tauna ese danu goada matamata bae abia.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

motu: Egu hereva iboudiai ba lalodia tao; dirava idaudia basio herevalaidia, bona ladadia basio hato.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

motu: Laḡani ta lalonai aria toi ba kara, egu.
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

motu: Asie-hatubua-flaoana ariana ba karaia: dina hitu asie hatubua flaoana bavania, gunaguna na haduamu heḡereḡerena, nega korikorina ai, hua ladana Abib lalonai, badina be una hua lalonai Aigupto amo o raka lasi. Asi tauna ta imana kavakava baine hedinarai lau vairagu ai.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

motu: Taboro ariana danu bba karaia, emu uma anidia ba utu matama negana ai. Lailai huana lalonai roge ariana danu ba karaia, emu uma anidia idoidiai emu roge ai ba habou vaitani negana ai.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

motu: Laḡani ta lalonai emu mamaruane iboudiai na nega toi Ḡaubada Iehova vairanai bae hedinarai.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Egu ihaboulaina rarana na e hatubua flaoana ida basio atodia hebou; egu aria digarana na basine mia rani.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

motu: Emu uma anidia roboadia namo-hereadia na Iehova emu Dirava ena dubu ai ba rakalaia vareai. Nani natuna hidiona na sinana ratana amo basio nadua.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “ You|strong="H3808" * shall|strong="H3068" * not|strong="H3808" * boil|strong="H1310" * a|strong="H3068" * young|strong="H1423" * goat|strong="H1423" * in|strong="H3068" * its|strong="H1310" * mother’s milk|strong="H2461" *.

motu: A itaia, aneru ta na siaiamu, oi vairamu ai bainela, dala ai baine simamu, bona vada na abia heḡaḡae gabuna ai baine hakaumu vareai.
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

motu: Ba hakala henia, erena ba kamonai; basio gwau edeede henia; badina be emu kara rea basine laloa nege, lau ladagu na ia lalonai dainai.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

motu: A ia erena ba kamonai bona lauegu hereva iboudiai ba badinadia; bena oi inaimu be lau inaigu ai baina halaodia, bona oi bae tuari henimu taudia na lau danu baina tuari henidia.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

motu: Egu aneru na oi vairamu ai bainela, Amoro taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia edia tano ai baine hakaumu vareai, bena lau ese baina habuadia tari.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

motu: Una negana ai edia dirava basio toma henidia diho bona isiaidia basio lao heni, bona edia kara danu basio tohotohodia; ba hadareredia vaitani, bona edia au-tubua ba ḡiḡidia rohoroho.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

motu: Iehova emui Dirava mo isiaina ba lao heni; bena emu flaoa bona emu ranu lau ese baina hanamodia, bona emu gorere baina abia oho;
english: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

motu: emu mauri ḡauna ta basine mara dika bona ta basine gabani emu tano ai; emu mauri dinadia baina haḡuḡurudia.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

motu: Egu hahegari na oi vairamu ai baina siaia, ediai ba kau taudia lalodia baina hadaradaradia, bena inaimu iboudiai na bae heau muri.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

motu: Nanigo danu baina siaidia vairamu ai, idia ese Hivi taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia oi vairamu ai baina luludia lasi.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

motu: Laḡani tamona lalonai basina luludia lasi, edia tano baine vahu na garina, bona uda boromadia bae hutuma bena bae hadikamu na garina.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

motu: Metaira-metaira baina luludia lasi, ela bona umui na ba hutuma, bena tano bavabia emui.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

motu: Emu tano hetoadia baina kara, Davara Kakakakana amo ela bona Filistia taudia edia davara, bona tano ḡaḡaena amo ela bona Eufrate sinavaina: badina be umu tano taudia oi imamu ai baina atodia, oi vairamu ai do ba luludia lasi.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

motu: Idia ida basio herohemaino, bona edia dirava ida basio herohemaino.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

motu: Emu tano ai basie noho, bae hahekwakwanaimu bena vairagu ai ba kara dika na garina; badina be edia dirava boma toma henidia diho, oi na boma hekwakwanai.
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova enai ba dara dae, oi bona Aaron bona Nadab bona Abihu bona Israel tau-badadia hitu-ahui: dauha amo ba toma henigu diho.
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

motu: Mose sibona ese Iehova baine raka henia kahi; bamona be basie raka kahira, bona edia orea taudia danu basie dara dae.
english: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

motu: Bena Mose ela, Iehova ena hereva iboudiai bona ena taravatu iboudiai Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia. Bena Israel taudia iboudiai e haere hebou, eto, Iehova ena hereva iboudiai baia badinadia.
english: Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do.”

motu: Mose ese Iehova ena hereva iboudiai e tore vaitanil; bena daba vaburana ai e tore isi, ororo badi-tanona ai ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, bona au=tubua gwauta-rua e holo, Israel idududia gwauta-ruaosi edia.
english: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

motu: Bena ia ese Israel eregabedia haida e siaidia, boromakau mamaruanedia e laohai, boubou ḡaudia ai e halaodia: haida lahi ese e ḡole oho ḡaudia, ma haida herohemano ḡaudia, Iehova ena.
english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.

motu: Bena Mose ese rara kahana na dihu ai e haboua, a rara kahana na ihaboulaina patana ai e seia.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

motu: Bena ia ese taravatu bukana e abia, Israel taudiavairadiai e duahia hedinarai. Bena idia eto, Iehova ena hereva iboudiai baia kamonai henidia, bona ena taravatu baia badinadia.
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”

motu: Bena Mose ese rara e abia, Israel taudia e nevarilaidia, eto, Ina na herohemaino rarana, Iehova na umui ida vada e herohemaino ini hereva ai.
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron bona Nadab bona Abihu, Israel tau-badadia hitu-ahuiosi ida, e dara dae,
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

motu: Israel edia Dirava e itaia, aena na sapairo + 24:10 “Sapairo” be nadi hururu-hururuna ta ladana. * nadina ai e hadai, e negari-negari, guba na heto.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire + 24:10 or, lapis lazuli * stone, like the skies for clearness.

motu: Ia imana na Israeltau-badadia latadiai se ato kau; idia ese Dirava e itaia, bena e aniani, ranu e inua danu. Mose Sinai ororona ai e dara dae
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Lau dekegu ai ba dara dae, ororo ai ba narigu; lau be hro-nadidia palakadia baina henimu, ini nadi ai taravatu bona haheḡani vada na tore, taunimanima ihadibaladia.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose na ena hesiai tauna Iosua ida e tore isi; bena Mose na Dirava ena ororo ai e dara dae.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

motu: Ia ese Israel tau-badidia e haduadia, eto, Iniseni ai ba noho, ela bona ai baia lou mai dekemui ai. hari Aaron bona Huru na dekemui ai nonoho; tau ta hahemaoro baine ura negana ai, ia na idia raruosi dekedia bainela.
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

motu: Mose na ororo ai e dara e dara dae, bena ori ese ororo e ḡovaia ahu.
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na ororo dorina ai e kau, bona ori ese ororo e ḡovaia ahu ela bona dina tauratoi e ore. Dina ihahituna ai Iehova ese Mose ladana e hatoa, ori bogaragina amo.
english: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

motu: Iehova hairaina ita-itana na lahi hururu-hururuna na heto ororo dorina ai: Israel taudia iboudiai ese e itaia.
english: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

motu: Bena Mose na e dara dae ori lalonai, dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui unuseni ai e nohova.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, edia herahia ḡaudia bae henigu; lalodia e namomu taudia iboudiai edia herahia ḡaudia bavabi dae, egu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

motu: Bavabi dae ḡaudia bini: gold * bona silver * bona auri labora-labora;
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

motu: dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia; nani huidia;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

motu: mamoe kopidia, e hakakakakadia ḡaudia, bona nani kopidia; kela + 25:5 “Kela”: hanua haida e tomu “Budabuda”. * audia;
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, + 25:5 or, fine leather * acacia wood,

motu: lamepa diaranuna bona muramura mai bonadia bona e gabu muramuradia;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

motu: onuku + 25:7 “Onuku” na herahera nadina ta ladana. * nadidia bona hahelaḡa taudia edia dabua ihaheralaidia bona edia vaina ihaheralaidia nadidia.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

motu: Gabu helaḡana danu bae karaia egu, bogaragidiai baina noho helaoreana.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

motu: Dubu auta danu ba karaia; dubu bona dubu lalona ḡaudia iboudiai be lau ese baina hadibalaimu heḡereḡerena ai ba kara. Maua Helaḡana
english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

motu: Maua ta danu bae karaia, kela reireidia amo; latana na kiubit rua mai kahana, lababana bona harana ena lata na kiubit + 25:10 “Kiubit” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ta, ena lata be 44 centimetres sisivana. * ta mai kahana.
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, + 25:10 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

motu: Lalona kahana gold * amo ba lahasia, bona murina kahana gold * amo ba ḡovaia, bona gold * amo ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

motu: Ring * hani na gold * amo ba kara, maua daigunina haniosi ai ba koko kau, kahana ai rua kahana ai rua.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

motu: Maduna danu ba kara, kela audia amo, bena gold * amo ba ḡovadia.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

motu: Ini maduna na ring * amo ba toi hanai, maua kahana kahana ai, ihualaina ḡaudia ai baela.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

motu: hari maduna na ring * lalodiai do bae mia, basie veridia lasi.
english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

motu: Bena taravatu nadidia, baina henimu ḡauna, do ba udaia maua lalonai.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

motu: Ikaruhi ta danu gold * namo-hereana amo ba karaia, ena lata kiubit rua mai kahana, ena lababa kiubit ta mai kahana.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

motu: Ikaruhi duduna duduna kerubi + 25:18 “Kerubi” na aneru laulaudia, e koro ḡaudia. * rua ba koro,
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

motu: duduna ta kerubi ta ma duduna ta kerubi ta; ikaruhi bona kerubi raruosi na gold * siri tamona amo ba kara.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

motu: Hari kerubi na hanidia amo ikaruhi bae hakerukerua; idia bae hevaira heheni, bona ikaruhi bae vaira henia.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

motu: Hari ikaruhi na maua latanai bavatoa kau, hebogahisi teronona ai bainela; bona taravatu nadidia, do baina henimu ḡauna, na maua lalonai ba udaia.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

motu: Unuseni ai baita hedavari: ikaruhi daenai, taravatu mauana latanai e miamu kerubidia raruosi padadia amo, lau ese baina hereva henimu; haheḡani iboudiai, Israel taudia ba henidia ḡaudia, na baina hadibalaimu. Pata Helaḡana
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

motu: Pata ta danu, kela audia amo ba karaia, latana na kiubit rua, lababana na kiubit ta, harana ena lata na kiubit ta mai kahana.
english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

motu: Gold * amo ba ḡovaia, bona ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

motu: Digina danu ba karaia, labalaba na tau ta imana palapalana heḡereḡerena, ia danu gold * namo-hereana amo ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

motu: Ring * hani danu gold * amo ba kara, pata aena haniosi ai ba koko kau.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

motu: Hari ring * be pata digina henunai ba koko kau, maduna audia bae hetoi hanai.
english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

motu: Maduna danu kela audia amo ba kara, bona gold * amo ba ḡovadia, pata ihualaina.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

motu: Pata ḡaudia danu, mereki bona nau bona bio bona kehere, iboudiai na gold * namo-hereana amo ba kara.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

motu: Nega iboudiai flaoa helaḡana na una pata latanai baine hedabara lau vairagu ai. Lamepa Patana
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

motu: Lamepa patana ta danu ba karaia, gold * namo-hereana amo. Aena bona duna na gold * amo ba koro: aena bona duna bona kehere bona heraherana, bure bona huahua, iboudiai na gold * siri tamona amo ba koro.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

motu: Rigina bae tauratoi, kahana toi kahana toi.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

motu: Rigi ta ena kehere bae toi, itadia sakada + 25:33 “Sakada” be au huahua ta ladana. * huahuadia na heheto, ta ta mai buredia bona mai huahuadia, rigi iboudiai.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

motu: Duna ai danu kehere bae hani, sakada huahuadia na heheto, ta ta mai buredia bona mai huahuadia.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

motu: Rigi rua rua amo danu buredia ta ta ba koro: rigi rua bure ta, rigi rua bure ta, rigi bure ta, rigidia henudia kahadia ai.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

motu: Hari rigi bona bure na gold * namo-hereana sirina tamona amo ba koro.
english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

motu: Bena lamepa hitu ba kara, gabudia ai bavatodia, edia diari na pata vairana kahana bae hadiaria.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

motu: Ihaḡoevadia ḡaudia bona momorudia iudadia merekidia iboudiai na gold * namo-hereana amo ba kara.
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

motu: Hari lamepa patana, mai kohuna idoinai, ikaralaina gold *-na ena metau be talent * + 25:39 “Talent” be Hebveru taudia edia metau hahetohona; talent ta ena metau na 54 kilograms sisivana. * ta.
english: It shall be made of a talent + 25:39 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * of pure gold, with all these accessories.

motu: Ba heita, ini ḡau ba kara hari ina ororo ai emu ai vada eme hedinarai heḡereḡerena.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

motu: Dubu auta ba karaia egu: haba be dabua aukadia bona namodia gwauta amo ba kara, vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia; ihaheraladia be dibana tauna ese kerubi laulaudia baine turi.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

motu: Dabua ta ena lata be kiubit ruahui taurahani, lababana be kiubit bhani; iboudiai edia lata bae heḡereḡere, edia lababa danu bae heḡereḡere.
english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, + 26:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

motu: Dabua ima ba siriudia, ma ima ba siriudia.
english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

motu: Bena imaosi ta isena ai, kunipa varo vaiurina amo ba kara; ma imaosi ta isena ai danu unu ba kara toma.
english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

motu: Dabua ta ai kunipa imahui ba kara, ma dabua ta ai imahui: hari kunipa bae hevaira heheni.
english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

motu: Bena hakapu-tao ḡaudia imahui gold * amo ba kara, dabua isedia ruaosi na unu hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo be hakapudia tao hesiriu, unu amo dubu tamona ai bainela.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

motu: Bena dabua haida nani huidia amo ba kara, kalaga ai baela, dubu ikoulaina; unu dabua iboudiai bae gwauta-ta.
english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

motu: Dabua ta ta edia lata na kiubit toi-ahui, lababadia na kiubit hani; iboudiai edia bae heḡereḡere, edia lababa danu bae heḡereḡere.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

motu: Ini dabua ima ba siriudia, ma tauratoi ba siriudia: ihatauratoina na iha-imana baine ha-ere-ruaia, kalaga vairanai.
english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

motu: Bena imaosi ta isena ai kunipa imahui ba kara, ma tauratoiosi ta isena ai kunipa imaosi ma ba kara.
english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

motu: Bena hakapu-tao ḡaudia imahui auri labora-labora amo ba kara, dabua isedia ruaosi na unu hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo ba hakapudia tao hesiriu, kalaga tamona ai bainela.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

motu: Hari e haruaia ḡauna na dubu murina kahana ai baine hetau dobi.
english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

motu: Hari kalaga dabuana ena lata na dubu harana ena lata baine hereaia, kahana kiubit ta, ma kahana kiubit ta, unu bae hetau dobi toma, dubu ikoulaina.
english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

motu: Kalaga guhina danu ba karaia, mamoe kopidia, e hakakakakadia ḡaudia, amo; ma guhi ta danu nani kopidia amo ba karaia, ia latanai bavatoa kau.
english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

motu: Dubu habana na kela audia amo kaha ta ta ba kara. + 26:15 bona ia murinai siridia: Hereva ta iniseni ai e hanaia “Kaha” anina English gado ai be “frame”. *
english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

motu: Kaha ta ena lata be kiubit gwauta, bona ena lababa be kiubit ta mai kahana.
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

motu: Hari kaha ta ta be ikoko rua rua amo bae koko hesiriu; dubu habana kahadia iboudiai kaha rua rua amo unu bae koko hesiriu toma.
english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

motu: Hari kaha iboudiai na ini ba haginidia toma: diho kahana ai kaha ruahui;
english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

motu: hahelai-kau ḡaudia hari-ahui silver * amo ba kara, kaha ruahuiosi henudiai bae mia, hahelai-kau ḡaudia kaha ta ta henudiai bae heato, ikoko rua rua amo ba kokodia tao.
english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

motu: Ma dubu kahana ta, mirigini kahana ai, kaha ruahui ba haginidia,
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

motu: mai silver * hahelai-kau ḡaudia hari-ahui, kaha ta ta henudiai hahelai-kau ḡaudia rua rua amo ba kokodia.
english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

motu: Dubu duduna, lahara kahana ai, kaha tauratoi ba haginidia,
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

motu: bona daiguni ruaosi danu kaha ta ta. ?
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

motu: Hari daiguni ḡaudia na henu ai bae kokodia hesiriu, a atai ai idia na ring * amo bae hesiriu. Ruaosi na unu bae heto; idia na daiguni ḡaudia ruaosi ai baela.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

motu: Taunabunai, kaha bae taurahani bona silver * hahelai-kau ḡaudia bae gwauta-tauratoi, kaha ta ta henudiai hahelai=kau ḡaudia rua rua.
english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

motu: Raroraro danu kela audia amo ba kara, au-ima dubu habana kahana ai,
english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

motu: ma au-ima kahana ai, ma au-ima dubu duduna ai, lahara kahana ai.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

motu: Bogaragi rarorarona na kaha iboudiai baine hahesiriudia, duduna ela bona duduna.
english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

motu: Hari kaha be gold * amo ba ḡovadia. Raroraro idogo-taodia ring *-dia na gold * amo ba kara, bona raroraro na gold * amo ba ḡovadia.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

motu: Dubu na ba haginia, hari ina ororo ai emu ai vada eme hedinarai heḡereḡerena.
english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

motu: Bena seseahu na dabua aukana bona namona amo ba karaia, dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana; ihaheralaina be dibana tauna ese kerubi laulaudia baine turi.
english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

motu: Gold * igaudia amo ba taua dae; ena ihua-ihua bae hani, kela audia amo ba kara bona gold * amo ba ḡovadia, bena silver * hahelai-kau ḡaudia ai ba haginidia. Unuhetomana seseahu ba taua dae.
english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

motu: hari seseahu na hakapu-tao ḡaudia amo ba taua dae; bena taravatu mauana na bae huaia vareai: seseahu na helaḡa gabuna bona helaḡa-herea gabuna baine seses ahu.
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

motu: Hari maua danu ikaruhi amo ba karuhia, helaḡa-herea gabuna ai.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

motu: Pata na seseahu murimurinai bavatoa; lamepa patana be dubu diho kahana ai bavatoa, pata baine vaira henia, a pata be mirigini kahana ai baine gini.
english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

motu: Kalaga iduarana seseahuna danu dabua aukana bona namona amo ba karaia, dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana, bona ihaheralaina danu bae turi.
english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

motu: Seseahu ena ihua-ihua bae ima; kela audia amo ba kara, bona gold * amo ba ḡovadia. Edia igau na gold * amo ba kara, a hahelai-kau ḡaudia imaosi na auri labora-labora amo ba kara.
english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana ba karaia, kela audia amo; latana na kiubit ima, lababana kiubit ima, harana ena lata kiubit toi, unu ba karaia toma.
english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits + 27:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits. + 27:1 The altar was to be about 2.3×2.3×1.4 meters or about 7½×7½×4½ feet. *

motu: Doa hani ba koro, pata daigunina haniosi ai; hari doa na pata ida au tamona amo ba kara. Kopina idoinai na auri labora-labora amo ba ḡovaia.
english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

motu: Kahuna iudalaina urodia bona ikado-laina gagana bona dihu bona kahi bona rahurahu na iboudiai auri labora-labora amo ba kara.
english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

motu: Pata digina na auri labora-labora amo ba ha-aukaia heḡeḡe, bona rina * hani auri labora-labora amo ba kara, hari iha-aukana auri labora-laborana ena daiguni haniosi ai.
english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

motu: Hari iha-aukana auri labora-laborana na pata baine ḡeḡea ahu, bona digina harana kahana ai baine diho.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

motu: Maduna audia danu ba kara, ihaboulaina patana ena; kela audia amo ba kara, bona auri labora-labora amo ba ḡovadia.
english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

motu: Hari maduna na ring * amo ba toidia hanai, ihaboulaina patana ohena kahana kahana ai, ihualaina ḡaudia.
english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana na maua na heto ba karaia, harana na reirei amo baine hekou. Vada ba karaia hari ina ororo ai emu ai vada eme hedinarai heḡereḡerena. Maḡu Helaḡana
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

motu: Dubu maḡuna danu ba karaia. Diho kahana ai maḡu latana na kiubit sinahu-ta; itautau dabuadia aukadia na
english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

motu: du ruahui amo bae hetau dae, du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu bae ruahui; hari du bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia na auri labora-labora amo ba kara. A edia igau bona edia hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver * amo ba kara.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

motu: Mirigini kahana ai danu maḡu latana na kiubit sinahu-ta; itautau dabuadia na du ruahui amo bae hetau dae, du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu bae ruahui. Du bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia na auri labora-labora amo ba kara, a edia igau bona edia hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver * amo ba kara.
english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

motu: Lahara kahana ai, maḡu lababana na kiubit imahui; du bae gwauta, badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu bae gwauta.
english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

motu: Mairiveina kahana ai, dubu vairanai, lababana na kiubit imahui.
english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

motu: Ikoukou kahana ai itatau dabuadia na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi;
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

motu: ma ikoukou kahana ai danu itautau dabuadia na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi.
english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

motu: Ikoukou dabuana na kiubit ruahui: dabua na vaiuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka; varo aukana amo bae turi, bona heraherana danu bae turi. Ia duna bae hani, bona du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia bae hani.
english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

motu: Maḡu duna iboudiai na silver * amo ba haheralaidia, bona edia igau na silver * amo ba kara. A du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia be auri labora-labora amo ba kara.
english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

motu: Maḡu ena be kiubit sinahu-tu, lababana be kiubit imahui, harana ena lata be kiubit ima. Itautau dabuadia be dabua aukadia. Du badidia ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia be auri labora-labora.
english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

motu: Dubu kohuna idoinai na auri labora-labora amo bae kara; dubu ikokodia bona maḡu ikokodia danu iboudiai na auri labora-labora ikokodia mo. Lamepa Helaḡana
english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

motu: Israel taudia ba haḡanidia, olive dehorona ḡoevaḡoevana bae mailaia, lamepa diaranuna ai bainela; bena lamepa baine ara hanaihanai.
english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida bae naria boi naria rani Iehova vairanai, hebou kalagana lalonai, maua helaḡana seseahuna murimurinai. Ina haheḡani na Israel taudia ese bae badinaia hanaihanai, uru iboudiai lalodiai.
english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

motu: Kakamu Aaron, mai natuna mamaruanedia ida, israel taudia bogaragidia amo ba hakaudia siri, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela helaoreana. Aaron mai natuna hahaniosi, Nadab bona Abihu bona Eleasara bona Itamara, unu bavabidia toma.
english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

motu: Kakamu Aaron ena dabua helaḡadia danu ba kara, mai toana bona mai hairaina ida baine noho helaoreana.
english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

motu: Mai dibadia taudia, lau ese aonega vada name henidia taudia, ba haḡanidia, dabua bae kara Aaron ena; bena ia baine helaḡa, lauegu hahela=aga tauna ai bainela.
english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

motu: Bae kara ḡaudia bini: keme ai e ha-inuamu vainana; hahedoki, muri hahedokina; hahedoki badana, kwara iḡe4ḡelaina dabuana; gaba ḡauna. Dabua helaḡadia bini bae kara, kakamu Aaron ena bona natuna mamaruanedia edia, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela helaoreana.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

motu: Idia na gold * bae abia, bona dabua idau-idau, vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

motu: Bena hahedoki helaḡana bae karaia namonamo, hari gold * bona dabua idau-idau, vaiuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka bona kurokuro, bae karalaia. ?
english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

motu: Paḡa ḡaudia rua ese hahedoki vairana kahana bona murina kahana bae siriudia.
english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

motu: Gaba ḡauna danu ḡau heḡereḡeredia ai bae karaia, dabua idau-idau, vairuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka bona kurokuro, bae karalaia.
english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

motu: Onuku nadidia rua bavabi, latadiai Israel natuna ladadia ba tore,
english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

motu: lada tauratoi nadi ta ai ma tauratoi nadi ta ai, murina murina amo ba tore edia vara heḡereḡeredia.
english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

motu: Nadi hururuhururudia iḡaukaralaidia tauna ese e ḡasidiamu heḡereḡerena, Israel natuna ladadia unu bas tore toma, unu nadi ruaosi ai. Bena isedia na gold * e moḡe ḡaudia amo ba koudia heḡeḡe.
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

motu: Bena unu nadi ruaosi be hari hahedoki ena paḡa ḡaudia ai bavatodia kau, helalo-tao ḡaudia ai baela, Israel natuna edia; Aaron ese ladadia na paḡana ruaosi ai baine hua, Iehova vairanai, helalo-tao toana.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.

motu: Nadi isedia na gold * e moḡe ḡoevaḡoeva ba karalai;
english: You shall make settings of gold,

motu: bona gold * namo-hereana danu ba moḡea, gold * varodia rua ba kara, bena unu gold * varodia na hari nadi isedia ida ba hunu kau.
english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

motu: Hahemaoro vainana danu ba karaia, hahedoki e karaia heḡereḡerena ba karaia ḡoevaḡoeva, gold * bona dabua idau-idau, vaiuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka bona kurokuro, ba karalaia.
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

motu: Latana bona lababana bae heḡereḡere, bae ere rua; latana bona lababana na palapala lababana heḡereḡerena ai ba karaia.
english: It shall be square and folded double; a span + 28:16 A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.) * shall be its length, and a span its width.

motu: Nadi hururu-hururudia ere hani ba turi kau: ere ta ai sadio bona topasio bona barekete;
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

motu: ere iharuana ai samarago bona sapairo bona vasiga;
english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, + 28:18 or, lapis lazuli * and an emerald;

motu: ere ihatoina ai huakinto bona akate bona ametuso;
english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

motu: ere ihahanina ai berulio bona onuku bona iaspi; iboudiai isedia na gold * e moḡe ḡaudia amo ba koudia heḡeḡe. + 28:20 Ini na nadi hururu-hururudia ladadia. *
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

motu: Hari nadi hururu-hururudia na gwauta-rua, Israel natuna gwauta-raruosi ihaheḡereḡeredia; nadi ta ta ai iduhu ta ta ladadia bae ḡasi.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

motu: Gold * namo-hereana ba moḡea, gold * varodia ba kara, vaina ena.
english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

motu: Ring * rua danu gold * amo ba kara, vaina ena; vaina isena ruaosi ai ba turi kau.
english: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

motu: Hari gold * varodia rua na vaina ring *-dia ruaosi ai ba mata kau,
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

motu: a varo dududia na hahedoki ena paḡa ḡaudia ai bae hemata kau.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

motu: Ma ring * rua gold * amo ba kara, vaina laloma kahana ai, isena ruaosi ai, ba turi kau;
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

motu: bona ring * rua gold * amo ma ba kara, hahedoki ai ba turi kau, paḡa ḡaudia na hahedoki ida e hesiriu gabudia ai, gaba ḡauna daenai.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

motu: Bena vaina ring *-dia bona hahedoki ring *-dia ba kwatu kubou, varo vaiurina amo, bona gaba ḡauna ai danu bae hemata kau; unuhetomana vaina bona hahedoki basie heruha diba.
english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

motu: Unuhetomana danu Israel natuna ladadia hahemaoro vainana ai na Aaron kemena ai bae mia, gabu helaḡana ai baine raka vareai negadia ai; bena baine lalodia hanai-hanai Iehova vairanai.
english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.

motu: Urim bona Tumim + 28:30 Urim bona Tumim na mari nadidia rua. * na vaina ai ba uda, Aaron kemena ai bae mia, Iehova vairanai baine raka vareai negadia ai: unu amo Aaron na nega iboudiai Israel taudia baine hahemaoro henidia Iehova vairanai, mai siahuna ida.
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

motu: Hahedoki badana na dabua vaiuri amo ba karaia.
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

motu: Matuna bogaragi ai ba karaia, kwara gabuna; matu isena danu ba turia, vaia hahedoki isedia e turimu heḡereḡerena, baine hedare garina.
english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

motu: Isena ai herahera ba turi, rimono + 28:33 “Rimono” be au huahua ta ladana. * huahuadia na heheto, varo vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia ba turilai, padadia ai gold * gabagabadia ba turi kau:
english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

motu: gold * gabagabana ta rimono huahuana ta gold * gabagabana ta rimono huahuana ta, unu ba turi toma, ela bona hahedoki isena ba haheraia heḡeḡe.
english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

motu: Ena ḡaukara helaḡana baine karaia negadia ai Aaron ese baine dokia, bena reḡena baine hedinarai, Iehova vairanai helaḡa gabuna ai baine raka vareai bona baine raka lasi negadia ai, baine mase garina.
english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.

motu: Gold * ḡoevaḡoeva mairina ta danu ba karaia, revarevana ba ḡasia, ini ba torea toma: HELAḠA IEHOVA ENA.
english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’

motu: Bena varo vaiurina bavabia, hari mairi na kwara iḡeḡelaina dabuana ai ba turia kau;
english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.
