motu: Seseahu ena ihua-ihua ima e kara, mai igaudia. Hari ihua-ihua kwaradia na gold * amo e ḡovadia, bona ihua-ihua na gold * amo e kapadia heḡeḡe. A edia hahelai-kau ḡaudia imaosi na auri labora-labora amo e kara.
english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

motu: Besalele ese maua helaḡana danu e karaia, kela reireidia amo; latana na kiubit rua mai kahana, lababana na kiubit ta mai kahana, bona harana ena lata na kiubit ta mai kahana.
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, + 37:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

motu: Lalona kahana na gold * amo e lahasia, bona murina kahana na gold * amo e ḡovaia, bona gold * amo e haheraia heḡeḡe.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

motu: Ring * hani na gold * amo e kara, maua daigunina haniosi ai e koko kau, kahana ai rua kahana ai rua.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

motu: Maduna danu e kara, kela audia amo, bona gold * amo e ḡovadia.
english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

motu: Unu maduna na ring * amo e toi hanai, maua kahana kahana ai, ihualaina ḡaudia ai baela totona.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

motu: Ikaruhina danu e karaia, gold * namo-hereana amo; ena lata na kiubit rua mai kahana, ena lababa na kiubit ta mai kahana.
english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

motu: Kerubi rua danu e kara, gold * amo e korodia, hari ikaruhi duduna duduna ai,
english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

motu: ta duduna ta ai ma ta duduna ta ai. Idia na ikaruhi ida gold * siri tamona amo e kara.
english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

motu: Hari kerubi na hanidia amo ikaruhi e hakerukerua; e hevaira heheni, bona ikaruhi danu e vaira henia. Pata Helaḡana e karaia
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

motu: Pata ta danu kela audia amo e karaia; latana na kiubit rua, lababana na kiubit ta, harana ena lata na kiubit ta mai kahana.
english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

motu: Gold * amo e ḡovaia bona e haheraia heḡeḡe.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

motu: Digina danu e karaia, lababana na tau ta imana palapalana heḡereḡerena; ia danu gold * amo e haheriaia heḡeḡe.
english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

motu: Ring * hani danu gold * amo e kara, pata aena haniosi ai e koko kau;
english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

motu: hari ring * be pata digina henuanai e koko kau, maduna audia bae hetoi hanai totona.
english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

motu: Maduna danu kela audia amo e kara, bona gold * amo e ḡovadia, pata ihualaina.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

motu: Pata ḡaudia danu, mereki bona nau bona bio bona udu-ahudia keheredia, iboudiai na gold * namo-hereana amo e kara. Lamepa Patana e karaia
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

motu: Lamepa patana danu e karaia, gold * namo-hereana amo. Aena bona duna na gold * amo e koro: aena bona duna bona kehere bona heraherana, bure bona huahua, iboudiai na gold * siri tamona amo e koro.
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

motu: Rigina na tauratoi, kahana toi kahana toi.
english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

motu: Rigi ta ena kehere na toi, itadia na sakada + 37:19 “Sakada” be au huahua ta ladana. * huahuadia na heto, ta ta mai buredia bona mai huahuadia, rigi iboudiai.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

motu: Duna ai danu kehere na hani, sakada huahuadia na heto, ta ta mai buredia bona mai huahuadia.
english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

motu: Rigi rua tua amo danu buredia ta ta e koro: rigi rua bure ta, rigi rua bure ta, rigi rua bure ta, rigidia henudia kahadia ai.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

motu: Hari rigi bona bure na gold * namo-hereana sirina tamona amo e koro.
english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

motu: Bena lamepa hitu e kara, bona ihaḡoevadia ḡaudia bona momoru iudadia merekidia, iboudiai na gold * namo—hereana anmo e kara.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

motu: Hari lamepa patana mai kohuna idoinai ikaralaina gold *-na ena metau be talent * ta. Muramura Patana e karaia
english: He made it of a talent + 37:24 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * of pure gold, with all its vessels.

motu: Bena pata helaḡana ta e karaia, muramura mai bonaida igabudia ḡauna: kela audia amo e karaia. Ena lata bona ena lababa na heḡereḡere, kiubit tamona; harana ena lata na kiubit rua; doana na ia ida au tamona amo e koro.
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

motu: Kopina na gold * namo-hereana amo e ḡovaia, pata bona aena bona doana; bona digina na gold * amo e haheraia heḡeḡe.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

motu: Ring * rua danu gold * amo e kara, pata digina henunai e kokodia kau, ta pata kahana ai, ma ta kahana ai, maduna itoi-hanaidia ḡaudia, bae huaia negadiai.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

motu: Maduna rua danu e kara, kela audia amo, bona gold * amo e ḡovadia.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

motu: Dehoro helaḡana danu e karaia, bona muramura mai bonadia e bulo, bae gabua ḡauna, muramura ikarana tauna korikori ese e karaiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana ia ese e karaia, kela audia amo; latana na kiubit ima, lababana na kiubit ima, harana ena lata na kiubit toi.
english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, + 38:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

motu: Doa hani e koro, pata daigunina haniosi ai; hari doa na pata ida au tamona amo e kara. Kopina idoinai na auri labora-labora amo e ḡovaia.
english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

motu: Kohuna idoinai danu auri labora-labora amo e kara: kahuna iudalaina urodia bona ikadolaina gagana bona dihu bona kahi bona rahurahu.
english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

motu: Pata digina na auri labora-labora amo e ha-aukaia heḡeḡe; hari auri labora-laborana na pata e ḡeḡea ahu, bona digina harana kahana ai e diho.
english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

motu: Ring * hani danu auri labora-labora amo e kara, hari iha-aukana auri labora-laborana ena daiguni haniosi ai, maduna bae hetoi hanai totona.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

motu: Maduna danu kela audia amo e kara, bona auri labora-labora amo e ḡovadia.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

motu: Hari maduna na ring * amo e toidia hanai, ihaboulaina patana kahana kahana ai, ihulaina ḡaudia ai baela totona. Ihaboulaina patana na maua na heto e karaia, harana na reirei amo e koua.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

motu: Dihu ta danu auri labora-labora amo e karaia, mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna, ia danu auri labora-labora. Hari dihu mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida na hebou kalagana iduarana ai e gimava hahinedia edia auri labora-labora hevarivaridia amo e karaia. Maḡu Helaḡana e karaia
english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Dubu maḡuna danu e karaia. Diho kahana ai itautau dabuadia aukadia e tau dae, edia lata idoinai kiubit sinahu-ta.
english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

motu: Du be ruahu; bona hahelai-kau ḡaudia danu ruahui, auri labora-labora amo e kara. Igau bona hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver * amo e kara.
english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

motu: Mirigina kahana ai danu itautau dabuadia e tau dae, edia lata idoinai na kiubit sinahu ta. Auri labora-labora dudia bona hahelai-kau ḡaudia na ruahui, mai silver * igaudia bona hakapu-tao ḡaudia.
english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

motu: Lahara kahana ai itautau dabuadia e tau dae, edia lata idoinai na kiubit imahui. Du bona hahelai-kau ḡaudia na gwauta; igau bona hakapu-tao ḡaudia be silver *.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

motu: Mairiveina kahana ai maḡu lababana be kiubit imahui:
english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

motu: ikoukou kahana ai itautau dabuadia edia lata na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi;
english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

motu: ma ikoukou kahana ai itautau dabuadia edia lata na kiubit gwauta-ima, mai du toi bona ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia toi.
english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

motu: Hari dabua iboudiai be dabua namodia bona aukadia.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

motu: Du edia hahelai-kau ḡaudia be auri labora-labora; edia igau bona edia hakapu-tao ḡaudia na silver *. Hari du kwaradia na silver * amo e ḡovadia, bona du be silver * amo e kapadia heḡeḡe.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

motu: Ikoukou dabuana na vaiuri bona mia-kaka bona kakakaka, varo aukana amo e turi, bona heraherana danu e turi. Ena lata na kiubit ruahui, bona harana ena lata na kiubit ima, maḡu dabuadia heḡereḡeredia.
english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

motu: Ia duna be hani, mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia danu hani, auri labora-labora ḡaudia. Edia igau na silver *. Du kwaradia na silver * amo e ḡovadia, bona du be silver * amo e kapadia heḡeḡe.
english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

motu: Dubu ikokodia bona maḡu ikokodia iboudiai na auri labora-labora ikokodia mo.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

motu: Hari dubu, taravatu dubuna, ikaralaina ḡaudia ihagaudia bini; Mose ena hahedua dainai e duahidia, Levi iduhuna taudia, Itamara, hahelaḡa tauna Aaron natuna, ese e gunalaia oreana, edia ḡaudara bunai.
english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

motu: Besalele, Uri natuna, Huru tubuna, Iuda iduhuna tauna, ese ḡau iboudiai e kara, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Iduruna tauna be Oholiab, Ahisamaka natuna, Dan iduhuna tauna: ia be ima karakara ḡaukaradia ihaerodia bona ikaradia mai dibana, turituri ḡaukaradia danu, dabua vaiuridia bona mia kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia ituridia, na mai dibana.
english: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

motu: Gold * idoinai, taunimanima ese edia herahia ihenina ai e heni bena dubu ḡaukaradia idau-idau ai e ḡaukaralaia gold *-na, ena metau be talent * ruahui taurahani-ta sekele sinahu-hitu toi-ahui gabu helaḡana ena sekele heḡereḡerena.
english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents + 38:24 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces. * and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel + 38:24 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces. * of the sanctuary.

motu: Silver * idoinai, hebou ai ladadia e tore taudia ese e heni ḡauna, ena metau be talent sinahu-ta sekele daha-ta sinahu-hitu hitu-ahui ima, gabu helaḡana ena sekele heḡereḡerena.
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents + 38:25 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds * and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, + 38:25 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

motu: Beka + 38:26 “Beka” ena metau be 8 grams sisivana. Domaga-tauratoi daha-toi sinahu-ima imahui: 603,550. * ta ta na ladadia e tore taudia ta ta ese e heni; e heni taudia iboudiai na tatau domaga-tauratoi daha-toi sinahu-ima imahui, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia. Una beka be gabu helaḡana ena sekele kahana heḡereḡerena.
english: a beka + 38:26 a beka is about 5 grams or about 0.175 ounces * a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel + 38:26 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

motu: Hari silver * be talent * sinahu-ta e ḡaukaralaia, dubu duna ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia bona seseahu duna ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia e karalai: hahelai-kau ḡauna ta talent * ta, hahelai-kau ḡauna ta talent * ta.
english: The one hundred talents + 38:27 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds. * of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

motu: A silver * sekele daha-ta sinahu-hitu hitu-ahui ima e ḡaukaralai, du igaudia e karalai, bona du kwaradia e ḡovalai, bona du e kapalai heḡeḡe.
english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels + 38:28 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1775 shekels is about 17.75 kilograms or about 39 pounds. * he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

motu: Auri labora-labora idoinai be talent * hitu-ahui sekele daha-rua sinahu-hani.
english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents + 38:29 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds * and two thousand four hundred shekels. + 38:29 70 talents + 2400 shekels is about 2124 kilograms, or 2.124 metric tons. *

motu: Ina auri labora-labora amo hebou kalagana iduarana ena hahelai-kau ḡaudia e kara, bona ihaboulaina patana, bona ihaboulaina patana iha-aukana ḡauna, bona ihaboulaina patana kohudia iboudiai;
english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

motu: bona maḡu duna ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia, bona maḡu ikoukouna ena hehelai-kau ḡaudia; bona dubu ikokodia bona maḡu ikokodia iboudiai.
english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

motu: Dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia amo gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia ikaralaidia dabuadia e kara, bona Aaron ena dabua helaḡadia danu, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Hahedoki helaḡana e karaia, gold * bona dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana bona kurokurona e karalaia.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

motu: Hari gold * na e hodoa ela bona vada e severa-severa herea, hena e utua, varo na heto, hari dabua vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia ihaheralaidia.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

motu: Paḡa ḡaudia e kara, hahedoki vairana kahana bona murina kahana e hahesiriudia.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

motu: Gaba ḡauna danu ḡau heḡereḡeredia ai e karaia, gold * bona dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana bona kurokurona e karalaia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Onuku nadidia e abi, nadi isedia na gold * e moḡe ḡauna amo e kou heḡeḡe; bena nadi kopidia e ḡasidia, Israel natudia ladadia e tore.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

motu: Bena unu nadi be hari hahedoki ena paḡa ḡaudia ai e atodia kau, helalo-tao ḡaudia ai baela, Israel natuna edia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ena vaina danu e karaia, hahedoki e karaia heḡereḡerena, gold * bona dabua vaiurina bona mia-kakana bona kakakakana bona kurokurona e karalaia.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

motu: Latana bona lababana na heḡereḡere, bona e ha-ere ruaia; latana bona lababana na tau ta imana palapalana heḡereḡerena.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, + 39:9 A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.) * and its width a span, being double.

motu: Nadi + 39:10 Ini na nadi hururu-hururudia haida ladadia. * hururu-hururudia ere hani e turi kau: ere ta ai sadio bona topasio bona barekete,
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

motu: ere iharuana ai samarago bona sapairo bona vasiga;
english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, + 39:11 or, lapis lazuli * and an emerald;

motu: ere ihatoina ai huakinto bona akate bona ametuso;
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

motu: ere ihahanina ai berulio bona onuku bona iaspi: iboudiai isedia na gold * e moḡe ḡauna amo e koudia heḡeḡe.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

motu: Hari nadi hururu-hururudia na gwauta-rua, Israel natuna gwauta-raruosi heḡereḡeredia; nadi ta ta ai iduhu ta ta ladadia bae ḡasidia.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

motu: Gold * varodia na vaina ai e turi kau.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

motu: Gold * e moḡe ḡaudia rua bona gold ring *-dia rua danu e kara, hari ring * na vaina isena ruaosi ai e turi kau.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

motu: Bena hari gold * varodia rua na vaina ring *-dia ruaosi ai e mata kau,
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

motu: a varo dududia na hari gold * e moḡe ḡaudia ruaosi ai e mata kau, unu amo hahedoki ena paḡa ḡaudia ai ma e mata kau.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

motu: Bena gold ring *-dia rua ma e kara, vaina laloma kahana ai vaina isena ruaosi ai e turi kau;
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

motu: ma ring * rua e kara, hahedoki ai e turi kau, paḡa ḡaudia na hahedoki ida e hasiriudia gabudia ai, gaba ḡauna daenai.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

motu: Bena vaina ring *-dia bona hahedoki ring *-dia e kwatu kubou, varo baiurina amo, bona gaba ḡauna ai danu e mata kau: unuhetomana vaina bona hahedoki na asie heruha, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena hahedoki badana na dabua vaiurina amo e karaia,
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

motu: mai matuna bogaraginai, kwara gabuna, e karaia; matuna isena danu e turia, vaia hahedoki isedia e turimu heḡereḡerena, bae hedare na garina.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

motu: Isena ai herahera e turi, rimono + 39:24 “Rimono” na au huahua ta ladana. * huahuadia na heheto, varo vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia bona kurokurodia e turilai;
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

motu: bona padadia ai gold * gabagabadia e turi kau:
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

motu: gold * gabagabana ta rimono huahuana ta gold * gabagabana ta rimono huahuana ta, ela bona hahedoki isena e haheraia heḡeḡe, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena muri hahedokidia danu e kara, Aaron mai natuna ida edia, dabua aukana namo-hereana amo e kara;
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

motu: bona Aaron ena kwara iḡeḡelaina dabuana bona kwara dabuadia namodia haida e kara; bona piribou na dabua aukadia amo e kara.
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

motu: Gaba ḡauna danu dabua aukana amo e karaia, bona heraherana na varo vaiuridia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia amo e turi, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena kwara koronana mairina na gold * namo-hereana amo e karaia, bona revarevana e ḡasia, ini e torea toma: HELAḠA IEHOVA ENA.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

motu: Bena varo vaiurina kwara iḡeḡelaina dabuana ai e turia kau, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena. Gaukara e haḡuḡurua
english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Taunabunai, hebou kalagana mai ena dubu ḡaukaradia iboudiai e ore vaitani. Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia na unu mo e kara toma.
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.

motu: Bena ḡau iboudiai e laohai Mose dekenai: dubu; kalaga mai kohuna idoinai; ena igau; ena haba kahadia; ena raroraro; ena du, mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia ida;
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

motu: guhi, mamoe kopidia e hakakakakadia ḡauna; ma guhi ta, nani kopidia ḡauna; seseahu;
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

motu: taravatu mauana mai ena maduna, bona mai ikaruhina;
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

motu: pata helaḡana, mai ena kohu idoinai bona mai ena flaoa helaḡana;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

motu: lamepa patana, gold * ḡoevaḡoeva e karalaia ḡauna, mai ena lamepa bona mai kohuna idoinai bona ena lamepa diaranuna;
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

motu: pata helaḡana, gold * ḡauna, mai ena dehoro helaḡana bona mai ena muramura mai bonaida; iduara dabuana;
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

motu: ihaboulaina patana, auri labora-labora ḡauna, mai iha-aukana auri labora-laborana, bona mai ena maduna, bona mai kohuna idoinai; hurihuri dihuna ai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida;
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

motu: maḡu dabuadia; maḡu duna mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia ida; ikoukou dabuana; varo bona ikoko; dubu bona hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia ikaralaidia ḡudia iboudiai;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

motu: gabu halaḡana dabuadia; Aaron mai natuna ida edia dabua helaḡadia, hahelaḡa karadia bae kara negadia ai bae doki ḡaudia.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia na ḡaukara idoinai unu e haḡugurua toma.
english: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

motu: Mose ese ḡaukara idoinai e itaia, bona vada e diba idia ese ḡau iboudiai vada e kara Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena. Bena Mose ese e hanamodia.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai hebou kalagana mai dubuna ida ba hagini. ?
english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Lalonai taravatu mauana bavatoa bona ba sesea ahu.
english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

motu: Pata helaḡana danu lalonai bavatoa, mai kohuna idoinai, ḡau ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai. Lamepa patana danu lalonai bavatoa; bona ena lamepa ba ha-ara.
english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

motu: Muramura patana, gold * ḡauna, na taravatu mauana vairanai bavatoa; bena dubu ba sesea ahu.
english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana na dubu vairanai bavatoa, hebou kalagana lalonai;
english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: bona hurihuri dihuna, mai ranuna, na hebou kalagana bona ihaboulaina patana padadiai bavatoa.
english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

motu: Maḡu dabuadia danu ba tau dae heḡeḡe, bona maḡu ba sesea ahu.
english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

motu: Bena dehoro helaḡana bavabia, dubu mai kohuna idoinai ba nevaridia: unu ba hahelaḡadia toma, bena bae helaḡa.
english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana danu mai kohuna ida ba nevaridia: unu ba hahelaḡadia toma; hari ihaboulaina patana baine helaḡa herea.
english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

motu: Hurihuri dihuna danu mai ihahelai-kauna ḡauna ida ba nevaridia, vada bae helaḡa.
english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

motu: Bena Aaron mai natuna ida hebou kalagana iduarana ai bae gini bou. Ba hadigudia;
english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

motu: bena Aaron na dabua helaḡadia do ba hadokilaia. Bena ba horoa, baine helaḡa; lauegu hahelaḡa tauna ai bainela.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

motu: Natuna danu bavabidia, ba hadokilaidia;
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

motu: bena ba horodia, tamadia o horoa heḡereḡerena, egu hahelaḡa taudia ai baela. Ihorodia dainai idia na hahelaḡa taudia ai baela, edia uru iboudiai, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

motu: Mose na unu e kara toma. Iehova ese haḡania heḡereḡerena, unu mo e kara toma.
english: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

motu: Laḡani iharuana gini-gunana dina na gini-gunana ai dubu na e haginia.
english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

motu: Mose ese dubu e haginia: hahelaikau ḡaudia na gabudia ai e atodia; haba kahadia e hagini; raroraro e toi hanai; bona du e holo.
english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

motu: Bena dubu na kalaga amo e koua heḡeḡe, bona guhi dabuana amo e ḡovaia ahu, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena taravatu nadidia e abi, maua helaḡana ai e uda. Maua ena maduna e toi hanai, bona ikaruhina amo e karuhia ahu.
english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

motu: Bena maua na dubu lalonai e huaia vareai, bona e sesea ahu, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Pata helaḡana na hebou kalagana ai e atoa, dubu mirigini kahana ai, seseahu murimurinai;
english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

motu: bona flaoa helaḡana na pata latanai e dabaraia, Iehova vairanai, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡere=herena.
english: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena lamepa patana na hebou kalagana ai e atoa, pata helaḡana e havaira henia, dubu diho kahana ai;
english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

motu: bena lamepa e ha-ara Iehova vairanai, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena muramura patana, gold * ḡauna, na hebou kalagana ai e atoa, seseahu vairanai;
english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

motu: bona muramura mai bonadia ia latanai e gabu, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena dubu e sesea ahu.
english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

motu: Bena hebou kalagana dubuna iduarana vairanai ia ese ihaboulaina patana e atoa, bona ḡole-oho boubouna bona flaoa boubouna ia latanai e ato, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena ihaboulaina patana bona hebou kalagana padadiai ia ese hurihuri dihuna e atoa, bona ranu e seia,
english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

motu: Mose bona Aaron bona Aaron natuna imadia bona aedia ihurilaidia ranuna.
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

motu: Hebou kalagana ai e raka vareai bona ihaboulaina patana e raka henia kahi negadia iboudiai idia na unu e digu tomava, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena maḡu dabuadia e tau dae heḡeḡe, dubu bona ihaboulaina patana e ḡeḡe ahu, bona e sesea ahu. Mose ena ḡaukara idoinai unu e haḡuḡurua toma.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

motu: Bena ori ese hebou kalagana e ḡovaia ahu, bona Iehova diaridiarina ese dubu e hahonua.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

motu: Taunabunai Mose na asi ena dala hebou kalagana ai baine raka vareai, badina be ori ese e ḡovaia ahu, bona Iehova diaridiarina ese dubu e hahonua.
english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

motu: Edia laolao iboudiai ori ese dubu e daetania negadia ai, Israel taudia na e tore isi, edia laolao ela.
english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

motu: A ori ese e ḡovaia ahu negadia ai, idia na asie tore isi, asie laolao, ela bona ma e daetania.
english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

motu: Badina be edia laolao iboudiai lalodiai Iehova ena ori ese dubu e ḡovaia ahu dina ai, bona hanuaboi ai lahi na ia lalonai, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
english: For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e boi henia, hebou kalagana amo, eto,
english: Yahweh + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Tau ta ese Iehova baine boua, ia na boromakau serina amo eiava mamoe serina amo ena ihaboulaina ḡauna baine abia.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

motu: Bema ḡole-oho boubouna na boromakau serina amo baine abia, ia eseboromakau maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine abia; baine laohaia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai baine alaia, Iehova ese baine abia dae helaorana.
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.

motu: Ia imana na lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna kwarana ai baine dau kau; bena Iehova ese ia bagunai baine abia dae, ena herohemaino ḡauna.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

motu: Ia ese boromakau maruanena baine alaia mase Iehova vairanai; bena Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, ese rarana bae abia, ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai bae nevaria heḡeḡe, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
english: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Hari bae haḡolea oho ḡauna na bae kopaia, bena bae ivaia.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

motu: Bena Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, ese lahi bae haraia ihaboulaina patana latanai, bona rakuraku audia lahi ai bae ato kau.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

motu: Bena Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, ese hidiona e iva ḡaudia bona kwarana bona digarana na rakuraku audia latadiai bae ato kau, ihaboulaina patana latanai;
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

motu: a bogarauna bona imana bona aena na ranu ai bae huridia guna. Bena idoinai be hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai, haḡole-oho ḡauna ai bainela lahi ai, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Bema ena ḡole-oho boubouna baine heni ḡauna na mamoe serinaeiava nani serina amo baine abia, ia ese maruane ta, asi bebeka-bebekana, baine abia.
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana mirigini kahana ai baine alaia mase, Iehova vairanai. Bena Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, ese rarana bae abia, ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai bae nevaria heḡeḡe.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

motu: Bena baine ivaia; bena hidiona e iva ḡaudia bona kwarana bona digarana na hahelaḡa tauna ese rakuraku audia latadiai baine ato kau, ihaboulaina patana ai.
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

motu: A bogarauna bona imana bona aena na ranu amo baine huridia guna. Bena idoinai be hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai, heḡole-oho ḡauna ai bainela lahi ai, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Bema ena boubou ḡauna, Iehova ena, be manu baine haḡole-oho, ia na kerea eiava pune natuna baine abidia.
english: “‘If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese manu na baine laohaia, ihaboulaina patana badibadinai aiona baine moḡea. Bena ihaboulaina patana latanai lahi ese baine ḡolea oho; a rarana be ihaboulaina patana isena ai baine seia.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

motu: Bogarauna bona huina na baine abidia, ihaboulaina patana mairiveina kahana ai baine negedia, lahi kahuna e negeamu gabuna ai.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

motu: Hanina amo baine darea parara; basine ivaia. Hahelaḡa tauna ese rakuraku audia latadiai baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai, heḡole-oho ḡauna ai bainela lahi ai, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Ta ese flaoa boubouna baine mailaia, Iehova ena, ia na flaoa namo-hereana baine abia, latanai dehoro baine seia, bona muramura mai bonana danu ia latanai baine atoa kau.
english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

motu: Baine mailaia Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, dekediai; bena flaoa mai dehorona taina bona muramura mai bonana idoinai baine abi; bena hahelaḡa tauna ta ese ihaboulaina patana latanai baine gabu, lahi ese baine ḡole-oho. Una na helalo toana, ḡole-oho boubouna, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: A flaoa boubouna orena na Aaron mai natuna ida adia; Iehova ena ḡole-oho bouboudia iboudiai ia mo helaḡa herea.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

motu: Flaoa amu ai o gabua ḡauna boma mailaia emu boubou ḡauna, ia na flaoa namo-hereana amo ba karaia; ihatubuna muramurana basio abia, a flaoa na dehoro ida ba bulo, eiava ba gabua kava, murinai dehoro ia latanai ba seia.
english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

motu: Eiava ataga boma mailaia emu boubou ḡauna, ia danu flaoa namo-hereana amo ba karaia; ihatubuna muramurana basio abia, a flaoana dehoro ida ba bulo.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

motu: Ba bakia sisi sisi, latanai dehoro ba seia: ia na flaoa boubouna.
english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

motu: Eiava emu boubou flaoana na uro ai boma nadua, ia danu flaoa namo-hereana amo ba karaia, mai dehorona.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

motu: Flaoa boubouna na unu ba karaia toma, bena Iehova enai ba mailaia, hahelaḡa tauna ese baine abia, ihaboulaina patana vairanai baine laohaia.
english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to Yahweh. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese flaoa boubouna amo helalo toana baine abia, ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Flaoa boubouna orena na Aaron mai natuna ida adia; Iehova ena ḡole-oho bouboudia iboudiai ia mo helaḡa herea.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

motu: Flaoa boubouna mai ihatubuna muramurana basio mailaia Iehova enai; hatubu muramurana eiava bada-ranuna na boubou ḡauna ai basio halaoa, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana lahina ai basio gabua.
english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to Yahweh shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: Unu na kohu ikaroadia herahiana na ba laohai Iehova enai, to ihaboulaina patana ai basio gabudia, bonadia na unu amo basie dae.
english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to Yahweh, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

motu: Emu flaoa bouboudia iboudiai na ba damenadia: emu flaoa boubouna na Iehova ena herohemaino damenana ai basie dabu; emu boubou iboudiai ida damena danu ba heni.
english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God + 2:13 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

motu: Emu uit ba karoa, herahia karoana Iehova ba henia, negana ai, uit anidia do asie auka ḡaudia bavabi, lahi latanai ba hakaukaudia, bena ba gwadadia, kopidia ba nege.
english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

motu: Bena latadiai dehoro ba seia, bona latadiai danu muramura mai bonana bavato kau: ia danu flaoa boubouna ḡauna.
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese uit taina bona dehoro taina baine abi, helalo toana, bona muramura mai bonana idoinai; ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna ai bainela, Iehova ena.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: Tau ta ese herohemaino boubouna baine mailaia, bema boromakau maruanena eiava hahinena, ia na asi bebeka-bebekana ḡauna baine mailaia Iehova vairanai.
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before Yahweh.

motu: Ia ese imana na ena boubou ḡauna kwarana ai baine atoa kau, bena baine alaia mase, hebou kalagana iduarana ai. Bena Aaron natuna, hahelaḡa taudia, ese rarana bae abia, ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai bae nevaria heḡeḡe.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

motu: Herohemaino boubouna, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡauna, baine heni negana ai, Iehova baine henia ḡaudia bini: boga bona bogarau urubina,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

motu: bona nadinadi ruaosi mai digaradia, bona demodo bona ase digarana. Ia ese baine abidia;
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

motu: bena Aaron natuna ese ihaboulaina patana lahina latanai ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna ida bae gabudia. Ia na ḡole-oho boubouna, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Herohemaino boubouna baine mailaia, Iehova ena, bema mamoe eiava nani, ia na maruane eiava hahine asi bebeka-bebekana baine mailaia.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

motu: Bema mamoe natuna baine heni, ena boubou, ia ese Iehova vairanai baine atoa,
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;

motu: imana na ena boubou ḡauna kwarana ai baine atoa kau, bena hebou kalagana vairanai baine alaia mase. Bena Aaron natuna ese rarana bae abia, ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai bae nevaria heḡeḡe.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

motu: Ina herohemaino boubouna amo, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho ḡaudia, Iehova ena, baine abi ḡaudia bini: iuna mai digarana idoinai ida ela bona doru turiana, bona boga bona bogarau urubina,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

motu: bona nadinadi ruaosi mai digaradia, bona demodo bona ase digarana.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai: ia na boubou anianina, ḡole-oho boubouna, Iehova ena.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: Bema nani baine heni, ena boubou, ia ese Iehova vairanai baine atoa,
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh.

motu: imana na ena boubou ḡauna kwarana ai baine atoa kau, hebou kalagana vairanai baine alaia mase. Bena Aaron natuna ese rarana bae abia, ihaboulaina patana latanai bona badinai bae nevaria heḡeḡe.
english: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

motu: Ena boubou ḡauna amo, lahi ese baine ḡole oho ḡaudia, Iehova ena, baine abi, ḡaudia bini: boga bona bogarau urubina,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

motu: bona nadinadi ruaosi mai digaradia ida, bona demodo bona ase digarana.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine gabua, ihaboulaina patana latanai; ia na boubou anianina, ḡole-oho boubouna, bonana namo ḡauna. Digara idoinai na Iehova ena.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.

motu: Mia-hanaihanai taravatuna binai, emui uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia idoidiai lalodiai: digara bona rara basio ani.
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose na e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba haduadia, baoto: Tau ta baine kara rea, Iehova ena taravatu ta baine tataia utu, ena boubou be iniheto.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,

motu: Bema hahelaḡa tauna, e horoa tauna, baine kara rea, unu amo orea taudia iboudiai na kara-rea taudia ai baine halaodia, ia ese boromakau natuna maruanena ta, asi bebeka-bebekana, na Iehova bainehenia, ena kara-rea boubouna.
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to Yahweh for a sin offering.

motu: Ia ese hari boromakau natuna maruanena baine mailaia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai, Iehova vairanai; imana na kwarana ai baine atoa kau, bena baine alaia mase Iehova vairanai.
english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before Yahweh.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna, e horoa tauna, ese rarana baine abia, hebou kalagana lalonai baine vareailaia.
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese imana kwakikwakina na rara ai baine urua diho, nega hitu Iehova vairanai baine nevaria, gabu helaḡana seseahuna vairanai.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese danu muramura mai bonana patana, hebou kalagana lalonai e miamu ḡauna, doana na rara taina amo baine dahudia, Iehova vairanai; bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana, ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna, badinai baine bubua nege, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena ia ese kara-rea boubouna boromakauna digarana idoinai baine abia: boga bona bogarau urubina,
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

motu: bona nadinadi ruaosi mai digaradia ida, bona demodo bona ase digarana;
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,

motu: herohemaino boubouna boromakauna enai e abiamu heḡereḡerena baine abia. Hahelaḡa tauna ese ihaboulaina patana latanai baine gabua, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho.
english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

motu: A boromakau kopina bona hidiona bona kwarana bona imana bona aena bona bogana bona bogarauna bona taḡena,
english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

motu: idoinai baine huaia Iasi taruha murimurinai, gabu ḡoevaḡoevana ai, lahi kahudia e negemu gabuna ai, baine gabua, Iahi ese baine ḡolea oho; Iahi kahudia e negemu gabuna ai baine heḡole-oho.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

motu: Israel oreana idoinai bema kara rea, a edia kerere bema hehuni; Iehova ena taravatu bema tata utu, unu amo bema kerere:
english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

motu: edia kerere baine hedinarai negana ai, hebou ese boromakau natuna maruanena ta baine heni, kara-rea boubouna ai bainela. Hebou kalagana vairanai bae mailaia;
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

motu: bena orea ena tau-badadia ese imadia na ia kwarana ai bae ato kau. Iehova vairanai, bena Iehova vairanai bae alaia mase.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh; and the bull shall be killed before Yahweh.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna, e horoa tauna, ese rarana baine abia, hebou kalagana lalonai baine vareailaia;
english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

motu: imana kwakikwakina na rara ai baine urua diho, nega hitu Iehova vairanai baine nevaria, seseahu vairanai,
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.

motu: bena pata helaḡana, hebou kalagana ai Iehova vairanai e miamu ḡauna, rara na doa baine dahulai; una murinai rara orena idoinai na ihaboulaina patana badinai baine bubua nege, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena ia ese digarana idoinai baine abia, ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho.
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

motu: Hari kara-rea boubouna ta boromakauna e karalaia heḡereḡerena ai, ina boromakaudanu unu bae karaia toma; unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese idia bagudiai herohemaino karana baine karaia, bena edia dika bae hegwau tao.
english: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

motu: A boromakau na taruha murimurinai baine huaia lasi, hari boromakau ta e gabua heḡereḡerena ai ina danu baine gabua, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho. Hebou ena kara-rea boubouna bunai.
english: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

motu: Hanua lohiana ta bema kara rea, Iehova, ena Dirava, ena taravatu ta bema tataia utu, unu amo bema kerere:
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

motu: lalona baine parara ia vada e kerere negana ai, ia ese nani maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine mailaia, ena boubou ḡauna;
english: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

motu: imana na nani kwarana ai baine atoa kau, bena ḡole-oho bouboudia Iehova vairanai e aladia masemu gabuna ai bainealaia mase: ia be kara-rea boubouna.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese boubouḡauna rarana baine abia, imana kwakikwakina amo ihaboulaina patana ai doa baine dahulai; bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana badinai baine bubua nege.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

motu: Bena digarana idoinai na ihaboulaina patana latanai bae gabua, herohemaino boubouna e karalaiamu heḡereḡerena; Iahi ese baine ḡolea oho. Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia; bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

motu: Hanua tauna ta bema kara rea, Iehova ena taravatu ta bema tataia utu, unu amo bema kerere:
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

motu: lalona baine parara vada e kerere negana ai, ia ese nani hahinena asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine mailaia, ena kara-rea boubouna ai bainela.
english: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.

motu: Bena imana na ena kara-rea boubouna ḡauna kwarana ai baine atoa kau; bena ḡole-oho bouboudia e aladia masemu gabuna ai baine alaia mase.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese rarana baine abia, imana kwakikwakina amo ihaboulaina patana, ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna, doana baine dahulai; bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana badinai baine bubua nege.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

motu: Bena digarana idoinai baine abia, herohemaino bouboudia e karalaidia heḡereḡerena; bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ihaboulaina patana latanai baine gabua, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena. Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

motu: A mamoe natuna bema mailaia, ena kara-rea boubouna, ia ese mamoe natuna hahinena asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine mailaia;
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

motu: imana na enakara-rea boubouna kwarana ai baine atoa kau, bena ḡole-oho bouboudia e aladia masemu gabuna ai ena kara-rea boubouna ḡauna baine alaia mase.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese kara-rea boubouna rarana baine abia, imana kwakikwakina amo ihaboulaina patana ai doa baine dahulai; bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana badinai baine bubua nege.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

motu: Bena digarana idoinai baine abia, herohemaino boubouna mamoena digarana e abiamu heḡereḡerena; bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, ḡole-oho bouboudia ida, Iehova ena. Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai baine herohemaino, bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

motu: Tau ta ese e itaia ḡauna eiava mai dibana ḡauna bema herevalaia diba hahemaoro gabuna ai, to basine herevalaia, ia na baine kerere.
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

motu: Eiava tau ta baine taubu, ḡau mirona ta, e mase ḡauna tau-anina, uda boromana eiava heubu ḡauna eiava tano ai e raumu ḡauna, basine itaia haraḡa bena enai baine dau kau, ia na baine kerere.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

motu: Eiava taunimanima edia miro ḡauna ta ai baine dau kau, to asi dibana; gabeamo lalona baine parara negana ai na baine kerere.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

motu: Eiava tau ta baine gwau hamata kava, baineto kara dikana ta eiava kara namona ta baine karaia, se laloa namonamo dainai; gabeai lalona baine parara ia na basine karaia diba, ia na baine kerere.
english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.

motu: Unu baine kerere toma tauna ese ena kerere baine gwauraia hedinarai;
english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;

motu: bona ena kerere boubouna baine mailaia Iehova dekenai, mamoe natuna hahinena ta eiava nani natuna hahinena ta ena seri amo, ena kara-dika boubouna. Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, ena dika iabi-ohona.
english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

motu: Imana bema tuna dainai mamoe natuna basinema mailaia diba, ia ese kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua baine mailaidia, ta kara-dika boubouna, ma ta ḡole-oho boubouna, Iehova ena.
english: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to Yahweh; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

motu: Ia ese hahelaḡa tauna dekena baine mailaidia. Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese kara-dika boubouna ḡauna baine abia guna, aiona baine moḡea, a basine ivaia parara.
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

motu: Rarana na ihaboulaina patana harana baine nevarilaia, bena rara orena na ihaboulaina patana badinai baine bubua nege: una na kara-dika boubouna.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

motu: Bena manu iharuanana ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela, taravatu heḡereḡerena. Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

motu: Imana bema tuna dainai, kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua basinema mailaidia diba, ia ese flaoa namo-hereana efa + 5:11 “Efa” be Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta; anina be 18 litres sisivana. * ta baine karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta baine mailaia, ena kara-dika boubouna. Dehoro basine seialatanai, bona muramura mai bonana na latanai basine atoa kau.
english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah + 5:11 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

motu: Ia ese hahelaḡa tauna dekena baine mailaia; bena hahelaḡa tauna ese una flaoa kahana na imana ai baine abia, helalo toana, ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, Iehova ena ḡole-oho bouboudia ida; una na kara-dika boubouna.
english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.

motu: Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, bena ena dika baine hegwau tao. A flaoa orena na hahelaḡa tauna ena, flaoa bouboudia haida heḡereḡeredia.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Tau ta baine koikoi, Iehova ena helaḡa ḡaudia iḡaukaralaidia baine hakerere, ia ese ena kara-dika boubouna baine mailaia, Iehova dekenai: mamoe maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta ena seri ai baine abia. Davana danu oi ese ba haeroa, silver * sekeledia ai, gabu helaḡana ena silver * sekeledia heḡereḡeredia: una na kara-dika boubouna.
english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel + 5:15 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

motu: Ḡaukara helaḡadia e hakerere davana danu baine heni, bona davana korikori latanai heato-kau ḡauna danu baine atoa kau; davana bema karoaia karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ai heato-kau ḡauna unu baine atoa kau toma, hahelaḡa tauna baine henia. Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, kara-dika mamoena amo; bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

motu: Tau ta baine kara dika, Iehova ena taravatu baine tata utu, ena be asi dibana, to ia na mai ena kerere, bona ena kara dika davana baine heni.
english: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

motu: Ia ese mamoe maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta ena seri ai baine abia, baine mailaia hahelaḡa tauna dekenai; davana danu oi ese ba haeroa, ena kara-dika boubouna ai bainela. Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese kara dika taunaena kara dika bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia; bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

motu: Ina na kara-dika boubouna; ia na Iehova vairanai vada e kara dika.
english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Tau ta baine kerere, Iehova baine koia, bona dekena tauna ena kohu inarina ai baine koikoi, eiava abitorehai iheni-louna ai baine koikoi, eiava baine dadidadi, eiava dekena tauna baine hahisia,
english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

motu: eiava boio ḡauna baine davaria bena baine herevalaia koikoi eiava baine gwau hamatalaia koikoi: unu baine koikoi toma tauna
english: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

motu: na mai ena kerere bona mai ena kara dika. Ia ese e dadihaia ḡauna, eiava taunimanima ihahisidia amo e abia ḡauna, eiava e henia baine naria ḡauna, eiava e davaria ḡauna,
english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

motu: eiava e gwau hamatalaia koikoi ḡauna, na una ḡau biaguna baine henia lou, mai ato-kauna ida: ato-kauna be una ḡau davanabema karoaia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta bema abia, ato-kauna na unubadana baine heni, ena kara-koikoi boubouna baine mailaia dinana ai.
english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

motu: Bena ena kara-koikoi boubouna baine mailaia Iehova enai, mamoe maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta, ena seri amo, oi ese davana ba gwauraia ḡauna, hahelaḡa tauna baine henia.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, Iehova vairanai; unu amo ena kara dika idoinai baine hegwau tao. Hahelaḡa taudia edia ḡaukara taravatudia
english: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron mai natuna verina ida ini ba haḡanidia toma. Ḡole-oho boubouna taravatuna binai: boubou ḡauna na ihaboulaina patana lahina latanai baine mia rani, lahi danu baine ara rani.
english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ena dabua bona ena piribou, dabua aukadia amo e kara ḡaudia, baine hadoki; bena ḡole-oho ḡauna kahuna na ihaboulaina patana latana amo baine abia oho, ihaboulaina patana badinai baine bubua.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

motu: Bena ena dabua aukadia baine doki oho, dabua idaudia baine hadoki; bena kahu na taruha murimurinai baine laohaia, gabu ḡoevaḡoevana ta ai baine bubua.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana lahina na baine ara hanaihanai, basine bodo. Daba iboudiai hahelaḡa tauna ese rakuraku audia baine ato kau, ma ḡole-oho boubouna idia latadiai baine atoa kau; herohemaino boubouna digarana danu lahi ese baine ḡolea oho.
english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

motu: Lahi na ihaboulaina patana latanai baine ara hanaihanai, basine bodo. Flaoa boubouna taravatuna
english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

motu: Flaoa boubouna taravatuna binai: Aaron natuna ese Iehova vairanai bae mailaia, ihaboulaina patana vairanai.
english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ta ese boubou flaoana kahana mai dehorona imana ai baine abia, bona muramura mai bonana idoinai, ihaboulaina patana ai baine gabua, helalo toana ai bainela, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.

motu: Flaoa orena na Aaron mai natuna ida bae ania: asi ihatubuna bae ania, gabu helaḡana ai, hebou kalagana maḡuna lalonai.
english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Ihatubuna muramurana ida basie buloa. Vada na henidia, idia ahudia ḡole-oho boubouna ai. Una na helaḡa herea, kara-rea bouboudia bona kara-koikoi bouboudia heḡereḡeredia.
english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

motu: Aaron ena iduhu mamaruanedia iboudiai bae ania diba; una na idia ahudia Iehova ena ḡole-oho bouboudia ai, emui uru iboudiai ela bona hanaihanai. Baine daua toho tauna na baine helaḡa.
english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida ese Iehova ini bae boua toma, ia ihorona dinana ai: flaoa namo-hereana efa ta bae karoaia, karoa gwauta, karoa ta be flaoa boubouna ai bainela ela bona hanaihanai, kahana daba ai ma kahana adorahi ai.
english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah + 6:20 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

motu: Dehoro ida bae buloa, ataga ai bae gabua. Bena oi ese ba mailaia, ba bakia, boubou ḡauna ai ba halaoa, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna danu Aaron natuna edia amo bae abia hidi, tamana ibolona ai bae horoa, ia ese Iehova unu baine boua toma. Mia-hanaihanai taravatuna binai: idoinai bae gabua Iehova ena, lahi ese baine ḡolea oho.
english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to Yahweh.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ena flaoa boubouna be baine heḡole-oho vaitani; basie ania. Kara-rea boubouna taravatuna
english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron mai natuna verina ida ini ba haḡanidia toma. Kara-rea boubouna taravatuna binai: kara-rea boubouna ḡauna na Iehova vairanai bae alaia mase, ḡole-oho bouboudiaḡaudia e aladia masemu gabuna ai, ia na helaḡa herea.
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine hahelaḡaia, kara dika boubouna ai bainela, bena baine ania; gabu helaḡana ai, hebou kalagana maḡuna lalonai, baine ania.
english: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.
