english: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Yahweh.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese dehoro taina imana ai mia baine abia, e haḡoevaiamu tauna idiba taiana abona bona idiba imana sinabadana bona idiba aena sinabadana baine dahulaidia, kara-dika boubouna rarana e dahulaidia gabudia ai.
english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

motu: A dehoro orena hahelaḡa tauna imana ai mia na e haḡoevaiamu tauna kwarana baine horolaia, ia dainai herohemaino karana baine karaia Iehova vairanai.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Yahweh.

motu: Bena ia ese hari kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua, ena moni heḡereḡerena ai e hoi, baine heni,
english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

motu: ta kara-rea boubouna ai bainela, ma ta ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela, flaoa boubouna ida; unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese herohemaino karana baine karaia, Iehova vairanai, e haḡoevaiamu tauna ena.
english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh.”

motu: Lepra tauna, ena moni dia heḡereḡere ihaḡoevana ḡaudia korikoridia baine abi, taravatuna bunai. Lepra rumadia taravatudia
english: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

motu: Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron ma e hamaorodia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Baina henimui emui tano korikori ai bainela tanona, Kanaan, ai ba kau murinai, readia ruma auta ai lepra gorerena baina atoa kau.
english: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

motu: Unu bema heto, ruma biaguna ese hahelaḡa tauna dekena bainela, baineto, Lau na laloamu gorere dikana ta be egu ruma ai mia.
english: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine hahedua, ruma ḡaudia iboudiai na ruma amo bae huadia lasi, hahelaḡa tauna baine raka vareai bena ruma ḡaudia baine gwauraidia miro na garina. Bena gabeamo hahelaḡa tauna na baine raka vareai, ruma baine itaia:
english: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

motu: bena gorere toana baine itaia; bema ruma habana na mai toutou gadoka-gadokadia eiava kakakakadia, bona toutou na dia haba kopina ai mo to sisina dobu,
english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

motu: hahelaḡa tauna ese ruma iduarana amo baine raka lasi bona ruma na baine koua kunuka-kunuka, ela bona dina hitu bae ore.
english: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

motu: Dina ihahituna ai, hahelaḡa tauna ma bainela, baine itaia, ruma habana ai toutou vada e bada eiava.
english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine hahedua, nadi mai toutoudia bae raḡadia oho, hanua murimurinai bae negedia, momoru gabuna ai.
english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

motu: Ruma laloma kahana idoinai danu bae kakasia, bona bae kakasia oho momoruna danu hanua murimurinai bae negea, miro ḡaudia e negemu gabuna ai.
english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

motu: Bena nadi matamatadia bae abi, e raḡadia oho ḡaudia bae bolodia; murinai ruma laloma kahana, idoinai taba-taba ḡauna amo bae tabaia ahu.
english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

motu: Unu nadi bae raḡadia oho bona ruma laloma kahana bae kakasia bona tabataba ḡauna amo bae tabaia ahu murinai unu gorere toutoudia ma bema vara lou ai na
english: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,

motu: hahelaḡa tauna ese ma baine ha itaia. Bema gorere toutoudia vada e bada ruma ai, una na lepra korikori, ruma e hadikaiamu; ruma na miro.
english: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

motu: Ia ese ruma na baine rohoa, nadi bona au bona tabataba ḡauna baine ḡiḡi dobi; bena bae laohai, hanua murimurinai, miro ḡaudia e negemu gabuna ai, bae nege.
english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

motu: Daika ese ruma lalonai vada e raka vareai, hahelaḡa tauna ese e koua murinai, ia na baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

motu: Una ruma ai e aniani tauna na ena dabua baine huri, bona una ruma ai e mahuta tauna danu ena dabua baine huri.
english: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

motu: A hahelaḡa tauna baine raka vareai negana ai na baine itaia, tabataba ḡauna amo e tabaia ahu murinai gorere toutoudia asie vara lou, ia ese una ruma baine gwauraia, vada e ḡoeva; badina be gorere vada e boio.
english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

motu: Bena ruma ihaḡoevana totona ia ese manu rua bona sida audia rua bona dabua kakakaka bona muramura avana baine abidia.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

motu: Manu ta be uro lalonai baine alaia mase, e arumu ranuna daenai;
english: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

motu: bena sida audia bona muramura avana bona dabua kakakaka bona manu maurina na manu masena rarana ai bona e arumu ranuna ai baine uru diho, bena ruma baine nevarilaia nega hitu.
english: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

motu: Ruma na unu baine haḡoevaia toma, manu rarana amo bona e arumu ranuna amo bona manu maurina amo bona sida audia amo bona muramura avana amo bona dabua kakakaka amo.
english: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

motu: Bena manu maurina na baine harohoa, hanua amo baine roho lasi uda ai. Unuhetomana ia ese ruma dainai herohemaino karana baine karaia. Bena ruma na baine ḡoeva.
english: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

motu: Lepra bona taunimanima kopidia e varamu goreredia taravatudia bunu;
english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

motu: bona dabua bona ruma lepra ese e hamirodiamu taravatudia;
english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

motu: bona ḡou bona taoha bona toutou taravatudia.
english: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

motu: Unu amo ba diba, mirona be edena bona ḡoevana be edena. Lepra taravatuna bunai.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This|strong="H2063" * is|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H3117" * law|strong="H8451" * of|strong="H3117" * leprosy|strong="H6883" *.

motu: Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hereva henidia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Tau ta ese enobou gorerena baine davana, ia na baine miro.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

motu: Ena enobou gorerena taravatuna binai: hura baine aru lasi eiava baine atua ahu, ia na miro.
english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

motu: E mahutalaia patana na miro, bona latadiai e helai kau ḡaudia iboudiai na mimiro.
english: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

motu: Ena mahuta patana ai baine dau kau tauna na ena dabua baine huri, bona ranu ai baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Gorere tauna ena helai ḡauna ai baine helai tauna danu ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Gorere tauna kopina baine daua toho tauna danu ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Gorere tauna ese ḡoeva tauna baine kanudia, una ḡoeva tauna ese ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Hosi doruna ai helai ḡauna na gorere tauna baine helai kau, una ḡau na miro.
english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

motu: Gorere tauna henunai e miava ḡauna ta tau ta ese baine daua toho, ia na baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho; bona ḡau unuhetomadia baine abi tauna na ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu, bena baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Gorere tauna ese imana ranu ai basine huri, a tau ta baine daua toho, una tau ese ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Gorere tauna ese baine daua toho urona na bae hamakohia, bona baine daua toho dihuna na ranu amo bae huria.
english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

motu: Hari mai ena hura-aru tauna hurana bema doko, ia na dina hitu lalodiai baine haheḡoeva: ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu, bena baine ḡoeva.
english: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, ia na kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua baine abidia, baine mailaidia Iehova vairanai, hebou kalagana iduarana ai; unuseni ai hahelaḡa tauna baine henia.
english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine hahelaḡadia, ta kara-dika boubouna ai bainela, ma ta ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela; unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, Iehova vairanai, ena hura-aru dainai.
english: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

motu: Tau ta vesina bema aru, ia na ranu ai baine digu, tauna idoinai baine huria, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Vesi na dabua ai eiava kopi amo e kara dabuadia ai bema aru, unu dabua iboudiai eiava unu kopi iboudiai na bae huri, bona bae taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Tau ta ese hahine ta ida bae eno bou, bena vesina baine aru, raruosi vada bae digu, bona bae taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Hahine ta rara baine karaia, ena nega korikori ai, ia be dina hitu baine miro; bona ta ese baine daua toho, ia danu baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

motu: Ena miro dinadia ai baine hekurelai ḡaudia iboudiai na bae helaḡa, bona baine helailai ḡaudia iboudiai danu bae helaḡa.
english: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

motu: Ena mahuta patana ai baine dau kau tauna na ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Ena helai ḡauna ai baine dau kau tauna danu ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: Ena mahuta ḡauna ta eiava ena helai ḡauna ta latadiai tau ta ese bema daua toho, una tau baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

motu: Tau ta ia ida bae eno bou, bena ia mirona ai baine miro, ia na baine taubu dina hitu, bona baine mahutalai patadia iboudiai bae miro.
english: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

motu: Hahine ta ena rara kara dinadia bema hoho, dia ena rara kara negana korikori ai, eiava ena nega korikori ai to baine daudau herea, ia na baine taubu ela bona una rara-kara baine doko, ena rara kara dinadia iboudiai heḡereḡerena ai, ia na baine taubu.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

motu: Baine mahutalai patadia iboudiai bae miro ena; l rara kara a adia korikoridia ai heḡereḡerena; bona baine helailai ḡaudia iboudiai danu bae miro, ena rara kara negana ai heḡereḡerena.
english: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

motu: Unu ḡau baine daudia toho tauna danu baine miro; ena dabua baine huri, bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

motu: A ena rara kara bema doko, ia na dina hitu baine duahidia, bena baine ḡoeva.
english: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

motu: Bena dina ihataurahanina ai, ia ese kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua baine abidia, hahelaḡa tauna dekena baine mailaidia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine hahelaḡadia, ta kara dika boubouna ai bainela, ma ta ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela. Unu amo hahelaḡa tauna ese ia bagunai herohemaino karana baine karaia, Iehova vairanai, ena rara kara dainai.
english: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.

motu: Iniheto amo umui ese Israel taudia na edia miro amo ba haḡoevadia, lauegu dubu helaḡana, bogaragidiai e miamu dubuna, bae hamiroa, bena edia miro ai bae mase na garina.
english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

motu: Taravatu bunu: hura-aru tauna taravatuna, bona vesi-aru amo e miromu tauna taravatuna,
english: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

motu: bona rara-kara hahinena taravatuna; kara miro taudia bona hahinedia taravatuna; bona hahine mai mirona ida e eno bou tauna taravatuna.
english: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, Aaron natuna raruosi ese Iehova e raka henia kahi dainai e mase negana murinai.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh, and died;

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, Kakamu Aaron, ia na dina iboudiai gabu helaḡana, seseahu lalonai, maua helaḡana ikaruhina vairanai, basine raka vareai, lasi ona lasi vaitani, baine mase garina; badina be lau na ori ai baina hedinarai, maua helaḡana ikaruhina latanai.
english: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

motu: A Aaron na gabu helaḡana lalonai baine raka vareai negadia ai, ia na ini baine raka vareai toma: boromakau natuna maruanena ta baine mailaia, kara rea boubouna; bona mamoe maruanena to baine mailaia, ḡole-oho boubouna.
english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

motu: Hahedoki helaḡana, dabua aukana ḡauna, bona piribou, dabua aukana ḡauna, baine kara, bona gaba dabuana baine ḡeḡea, bona kwara ḡauna, dabua aukana ḡauna, kwarana ai baine atoa. Baine digu guna, bena baine kara, badina be unu na dabua helaḡadia.
english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ediai ani mamaruanedia rua baine abidia, kara rea boubouna, bona mamoe maruanene ta, ḡole-oho boubouna.
english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

motu: Aaron ese ena kara rea boubouna boromakauna baine alaia mase, ia sibona dainai bona ena ruma taudia daidiai herohemaino karana baine karaia.
english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

motu: Una murinai ia ese nani mamaruanedia ruaosi baine abidia, Iehova vairanai baine atodia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena Aaron ese mari amo baine tahudia, nani maruanena ta Iehova ena, ma ta Asasele + 16:8 “Asasele” na lauma dikana ta ladana; Israel taudia e laloa ia na tano ḡaḡaena ai e nohova. * ena.
english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

motu: Bena nani maruanena ta, mari amo e davaria ḡauna na Iehova ena, Aaron ese baine alaia mase, kara rea boubouna;
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

motu: a nani maruanena iharuana, mari amo e davaria ḡauna na Asasele ena, mai maurina ida baine hakaua Iehova vairanai, herohemaino ḡauna na Asasele ena, mai maurina ida baine hakaua Iehova vairanai, herohemaino ḡauna; bena baine kahua bege, tano ḡaḡaena bainela, Asasele ena.
english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

motu: Aaron na ini baine kara toma: kara rea boubouna boromakauna baine mailaia guna, ia sibona dainai bona ena ruma taudia daidiai herohemaino karana baine karaia. Kara rea boubouna boromakauna baine alaia mase, ia sibona ena kara rea boubouna.
english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

motu: Bena ihaboulaina patana lahina amo gida baine abi, Iehoa vairanai, kebere ta ai baine uda, ela bona kebere baine honu; bona muramura mai bonana, e hamakohia sisisisi ḡauna, imana ai baine abia, seseahu lalonai baine rakalaia vareai.
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

motu: Bena hari muramura mai bonana na gida ai baine bubua, Iehova vairanai; ela bona hari muramura mai bonana kwalahuna ese maua helaḡana ikaruhina, taravatu nadidia e karuhidia ḡauna, baine ḡovaia, ia basine mase helaoreana.
english: He shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

motu: Bena boromakau rarana taina baine abia, imana kwakikwakina amo baine nevaria, maua helaḡana ikaruhina latanai bona vairanai, mairiveina kahana amo baine nevaria, nega hitu.
english: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

motu: Una murinai ia ese kara rea boubouna nanina baine alaia mase, taunimanima edia; ia rarana danu baine vareailaia, seseahu lalonai, boromakau rarana e karaia heḡereḡerena ma baine karaia, maua helaḡana ikaruhina latanai bona vairanai baine nevari.
english: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

motu: Unu amo ia ese gabu helaḡana dainai herohemaino karana baine karaia, Israel taudia edia miro bona edia kara dika bona edia kara rea daidiai; kara heḡereḡerena ma baine karaia hebou kalagana dainai, badina be ia na miro besena bogaraginai e miamu.
english: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

motu: Una negana ai tau ta ese hebou kalagana lalonai basine raka vareai, Aaron ese gabu helaḡana ihaḡoevana totona baine raka vareai negana amo ela bona ia sibona dainai bona ena ruma taudia daidiai bona Israel taudia iboudiai daidiai herohemaino karadia baine kara, ma baine raka lasi.
english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

motu: Bena gabu helaḡana amo baine raka lasi negana ai, ia ese ihaboulaina patana dainai herohemaino karana baine karaia: boromakau rarana taina bona nani rarana taina baine abi, ihaboulaina patana doana baine dahulai,
english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

motu: bona imana kwakikwakina amo baine nevarilaia nega hitu. Unuhetomana ia ese ihaboulaina patana na Israel taudia edia miro amo baine haḡoevaia bona baine hahelaḡaia.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

motu: Gabu helaḡana bona hebou kalagana bona ihaboulana patana daidiai herohemaino karadia baine kara murinai, ia ese nani maruanena maurina baine hakaua mai Iehova vairanai.
english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

motu: Bena Aaron ese imana ruaosi na nani maruanena kwarana ai baine ato kau; bena ia ese Israel taudia edia kara dika bona edia kara havara bona edia kara rea iboudiai baine gwaurai hedinarai; iboudiai na nani maruanena kwarana ai baine ato kau. Bena tano ḡaḡaena baine siaia lao; tau ta, e abia hidi heḡaeḡae tauna, ese baine hakaua lao.
english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

motu: Hari nani maruanena ese edia dika iboudiai baine huahai dauhai; bena tano ḡaḡaena ai baine ruhaia nege.
english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

motu: Bena Aaron na hebou kalagana lalonai ma baine raka vareai, dabua aukadia, gabu helaḡana ai e raka vareai negana ai e kara ḡaudia, ma baine dokidia oho, baine atodia.
english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

motu: Bena baine digu, gabu helaḡana ta ai; una murinai ena dabua ma baine kara, baine raka lasi, ena ḡole-oho boubouna bona Israel taudia edia ḡole-oho ḡauna baine aladia mase, baine haḡole oho, ia dainai bona idia daidiai herohemaino karana baine karaia.
english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

motu: Kara rea boubouna digarana danu ihaboulaina patana latanai baine haḡolea oho.
english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

motu: A hari Asasele ena nani e hakaua lao tauna ese ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu; una mirunai ia na taruha lalonai ma baine raka vareai lou diba.
english: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

motu: Bena kara rea boromakauna bona kara rea nanina, raradia na herohemaino totona gabu helaḡana ai e vareailai ḡaudia, na taruha murimurinai bae laohaidia, kopidia bona hidiodia bona taḡedia na bae gabudia, lahi ese baine ḡoledia oho.
english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

motu: Baine haḡoledia oho tauna ese ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu; bena taruha lalonai ma baine raka vareai.
english: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

motu: Baine mia hanaihanai haheḡanina binai, Israel taumui emui bona bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu taudia edia: hua ihahituna ena dina ihagwautana ai umui na bavani vaga bona ḡaukara ta basio karaia,
english: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

motu: badina be una dina ai ba herohemaino bona ba ḡoeva; emui dika iboudiai amo ba ḡoeva, Iehova vairanai.
english: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before Yahweh.

motu: Una dina na helaḡa herea emui ai, taunabunai bavani vaga. Baine mia hanaihanai haheḡanina bunai.
english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

motu: Una dina ai hahelaḡa tauna, tamana gabuna ai bae horoa bona bae hahelaḡaia tauna, ese herohemaino karana baine karaia; ia ese dabua aukadia helaḡadia baine kara,
english: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

motu: gabu helaḡana bona hebou kalagana bona ihaboulaina patana daidiai herohemaino karadia baine kara; bona hahelaḡa taudia bona orea taudia iboudiai daidiai herohemaino karana baine karaia.
english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

motu: Baine mia hanaihanai taravatuna bunai umui emui; unuhetomana laḡani ta ta amo Israel taudia bae herohemaino bona edia dika bae hegwau tao. Bena unu e kara toma, Iehova ese Mose e haduaia heḡereḡerena.
english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It|strong="H5921" * was|strong="H3068" * done|strong="H6213" * as|strong="H1961" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * commanded|strong="H6680" * Moses|strong="H4872" *.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida bona Israel taudia iboudiai ba hereva henidia, baoto, Iehova ena hahedua binai:
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded:

motu: Israel tauna ta ese horomakau maruanena eiava mamoe natuna eiava nani baine alaia mase, taruha lalonai eiava taruha murimurinai,
english: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

motu: a hebou kalagana iduarana ai basine mailaia, Iehova ena ihaboulaina ḡauna ai basine halaoa Iehova ena ruma vairanai, rarana na ia latanai, badina be rara vada e hahebubua kerere: ia na ena bese amo bae negea daure.
english: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to Yahweh before Yahweh’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.

motu: A Israel taudia na edia boubou ḡaudia taruha murimurinai bae aladia mase negadia ai, idia ese Iehova dekena bae mailaidia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai, unuseni ai hahelaḡa tauna bae henia, edia herohemaino bouboudia ai bae halaodia Iehova ena.
english: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to Yahweh.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese rara baine abia, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana baine nevarilaia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai; bona digara baine haḡolea oho, bonana namo ḡauna ai bainela Iehova ena.
english: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on Yahweh’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Taunabunai, idia na dirava koikoidia basie boudia, bona vairadiai basie lebulebu. Baine mia hanaihanai taravatuna bunai, idia ediai, edia uru iboudiai lalodiai.
english: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

motu: Ba haduadia danu, baoto: Israel tauna ta, eiava noho-hedoa tauna ta, ese ḡole-oho boubouna eiava idau boubouna ta baine alaia mase,
english: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

motu: a hebou kalagana iduarana ai basine mailaia, Iehova ena ihaboulaina ḡau, una tau be ena bese amo bae negea daure. Rara Taravatuna
english: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to Yahweh, that man shall be cut off from his people.

motu: Israel tauna ta eiava noho-hedoa tauna ta, ese vamu mai rarana baine ania, lau ese una tau baina badu henia; ia na ena bese amo bae negea daure.
english: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

motu: Badina be hidio ena mauri be rara ai; vada na henimui, ihaboulaina patana ena, laumamui ihaḡoevadia. Rara na haheḡoeva ḡauna, badina ia lalonai be mauri.
english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia vada na haḡanidia, nato: Asi tauna ta emui orea lalonai, bona asi tauna ta bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu, vamu mai rarana baine ania.
english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

motu: Israel tauna ta eiava noho-hedoa tauna ta baine labana, bena udaḡauna ta eiava roho manuna ta, aniani ḡauna, baine alaia mase, ia ese rarana baine hadihoa tano ai, bona ḡahu amo baine tahunia.
english: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

motu: Badina be mauri ḡaudia iboudiai edia mauri be rara ai. Taunabunai lau ese Israel taudia vada na haḡanidia, nato: Vamu mai rarana na basio ania, badina be mauri ḡaudia iboudiai edia mauri be rara ai; baine ania tauna na bae negea daure.
english: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

motu: A tau ta, Israel tauna eiava noho-hedoa tauna, ese mase kava ḡauna eiava uda ḡaudia daḡedaḡedia ese e alaia ḡauna, baine ania, ia na ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho; una murinai ia na baine ḡoeva.
english: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

motu: A ia na ena dabua basinema huri eiava basinema digu, ia na bema kerere.
english: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh said to Moses,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

motu: O noholaiva tanona, Aigupto, taudia na edia kara basio kara; baina hakaumui vareai tanona, Kanaan, taudia danu edia kara basio kara bona edia taravatu basio badinadia.
english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

motu: A lauegu haheḡani bavabidia dae, bona lauegu taravatu ba badinadia; lau binai Iehova. emui Dirava.
english: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Taunabunai, egu taravatu bona egu haheḡani ba badinadia; unu baine kara toma tauna be baine mauri. Lau binai Iehova.
english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.

motu: varavaramu ta ida basio eno bou; lau Iehova na gwaumu.
english: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.

motu: Tamamu ena geda ai basio hekure, sinamu ida basio eno bou; ia na sinamu, basio abia.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

motu: Tamamu adavana ta ida basio eno bou; ia na tamamu ena.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

motu: Taihumu ida basio eno bou; tamamu natuna hahinena ta eiava sinamu natuna hahinena ta, oi ida ruma tamona ai e vara, eiava idau ruma ai e vara, basio abia.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

motu: Tubumu kekenina ida basio eno bou; natumu maruanena natuna eiava natumu hahinena natuna basio abia, badina be iena hemarai na oiemu hemarai.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

motu: Tamamu adavana natuna hahinena, tamamu ese e havaraia, ida basio eno bou, ia na taihumu.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

motu: Lalamu ida basio eno bou; ia na tamamu ida hidiotamona.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

motu: Sinamu lahaina ida basio eno bou; ia na sinamu ida hidio tamona.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

motu: Tamamu lahaina ena geda ai basio hekure, ia adavana ida basio eno bou; ia be varavaramu.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

motu: Ravamu hahinena ida basio eno bou; ia na natumu adavana; basio abia.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

motu: Ihamu ida basio eno bou; ia na tadikakamu ena.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

motu: Hahine ta ida boma eno bou, ia natuna hahinena eiava tubuna kekenina ida basioma eno bou; idia na hidio tamona. Una na hemarai karana.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

motu: Hahine ta boma adavaia, ia tadina ida basio hodara.
english: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

motu: Hahine ta basio raka henia kahi, ia ida ba eno bou totona, rara e hekaramu negana ai.
english: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

motu: Dekemu tauna adavana ida basio heuda hanai; una na kara mirona.
english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

motu: Natumu ta dirava ladana Molek basio henia, ḡole-ohoboubouna ḡauna ai basinela; una na emu Dirava ladana ihadikana karana. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

motu: Tatau ida basio eno bou; una na kara mirona.
english: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

motu: Mauri ḡauna idauna ta ida basio eno bou; hahine danu unu basine kara toma; una kara na dika rohoroho.
english: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

motu: Ini kara mirodia iboudiai na basio kara; badina be vairamui ai baina luludia lasi besedia be unu kara amo e hahemiromu.
english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

motu: Tano danu vada e hamiroa; una dainai ena dika davana vada na henia. Tano na vada e dika; e noholaiava taudia vada e loridia lasi.
english: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

motu: A umui ese egu taravatu bona egu haheḡani ba badinadia, bona unu kara mirodia basio kara, umui Israel taumui bona bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu taudia danu.
english: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

motu: Badina be hari tano e noholaia gunava taudia ese unu kara mirodia e karava ema bona tano na vada e hamiroa.
english: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

motu: Bena umui ese unu ba hamiroa toma, ia ese umui danu baine lorimui lasi, e noholaia gunava taudia e loridia lasi na heto.
english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

motu: Badina be unu kara mirodia bae kara taudia iboudiai na edia bese amo bae negedia daure.
english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

motu: Taunabunai, egu hahedua ba badinaia: unu kara mirodia, e gunalaimui taudia ese e kara, na umui basio kara, unu kara amo basio hahemiro. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am Yahweh your God.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia iboudiai ba hamaorodia, baoto: Umui na ba helaḡa, badina be lau Iehova, emui Dirava, name helaḡa.
english: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.

motu: Iboumui ai sinamui bona tamamui ba matauraidia, bona egu dina helaḡadia ba badinadia. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Dirava koikoidia basio toma henidia diho, bona dirava laulaudia auri amo basio kara. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Emui herohemaino bouboudia, Iehova ena, be mailaidia negadia ai, kara idoidiai ba kara ḡoevaḡoeva, bena baine abimui dae.
english: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

motu: Boubou ḡauna hidiona na bavalaia dinana ai eiava dina iharuana ai bavania; dina ihatoina ai bahu na ba haḡolea oho.
english: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai boma ania, una na kara mirona; Iehova ese emui boubou basine abia dae:
english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

motu: ianina tauna baine kerere, badina be Iehova ena ḡau helaḡana vada e hahemaraia; ena bese amo l bae negea daure.
english: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

motu: Emui uma anidia ba utu negana ai, basio utua lao ela bona emu inoḡo hetoana korikori ai; bona tano ai bae moru ḡaudia basio gogo.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

motu: Emu vine anidia danu basio buruki ore, bona vine huahuadia tano ai bae moru be basio gogo: bae mia, ogoḡami tauna ana eiava noho-hedoa tauna ana. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Ḡau ta basio henaoa. Basio kara koikoi. Basio hereva koikoi.
english: “‘You shall not steal. “‘ You|strong="H3808" * shall|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * lie|strong="H8266" *. “‘ You|strong="H3808" * shall|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * deceive|strong="H3584" * one|strong="H3808" * another|strong="H5997" *.

motu: Lau ladagu ai basio gwau hamata koikoi; emu Dirava ladana basio hahemaraia. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

motu: Dekemu tauna basio daḡedaḡe henia, ena ḡau ta danu basio dadia. Ḡaukara tauna ena ḡaukara davana basio dogoa tao ela bona daba ai.
english: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘ The|strong="H5704" * wages|strong="H6468" * of|strong="H3808" * a|strong="H3068" * hired|strong="H7916" * servant|strong="H7916" * shall|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * remain|strong="H3885" * with you|strong="H5704" * all|strong="H5704" * night|strong="H3885" * until|strong="H5704" * the|strong="H5704" * morning|strong="H1242" *.

motu: Taiakudima tauna basio uduguiraia; mata-kepulu tauna basio hahekwakwanaia; emu Dirava garina ba gari. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

motu: Basio hahemaoro koikoi: ogoḡami tauna basio bogaia hisi, bona taḡa tauna basio matauraia; kara maoromaoro ai dekemu taudia ba hahemaoro henidia.
english: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

motu: Sivarai koikoi basio piupiulai, emu orea taudia bogaragidiai. Dekemu tauna ena mauri basio abia oho, hahebade koikoi dainai. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘ You|strong="H5921" * shall|strong="H3068" * not|strong="H3808" * endanger the|strong="H5921" * life|strong="H1818" * + 19:16 literally, “blood” * of|strong="H3068" * your|strong="H3068" * neighbor|strong="H7453" *. I|strong="H5921" * am|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Tadikakamu basio inai henia lalomu ai. Dekemu tauna ba sisiba henia, iena kerere amo oi danu ba kerere na garina.
english: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

motu: Kara dika davana basio haloua. Emu bese taudia natudia na basio lalo-hisihisi henidia. Dekemutauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

motu: Egu taravatu ba badinadia. Emu ubu-ubu ḡaudia orea idau-idaubasio haheḡodaḡodadia. Uhe idau-idau inoḡo tamona ai basio hado. Dabua idau-idau amo e karaia hahedokina basio dokilaia.
english: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘ You|strong="H5921" * shall|strong="H7704" * not|strong="H3808" * cross-breed different kinds|strong="H3610" * of|strong="H7704" * animals. “‘ You|strong="H5921" * shall|strong="H7704" * not|strong="H3808" * sow|strong="H2232" * your|strong="H5921" * field|strong="H7704" * with|strong="H5921" * two|strong="H3610" * kinds|strong="H3610" * of|strong="H7704" * seed|strong="H2232" *; “‘Don’t wear|strong="H5927" * a|strong="H3068" * garment made|strong="H5927" * of|strong="H7704" * two|strong="H3610" * kinds|strong="H3610" * of|strong="H7704" * material|strong="H8162" *.

motu: Tau ta ese hesiai kekenina ida baine eno bou, a una kekeni be mai maohenina, bona heni-tao monina dainai eiava hebogahisi dainai ena hesiai ilao-henina amo do se ruhaia nege, kara anina bae tahu henidia; to basie aladia mase, badina be hahine na do se ruhaia nege.
english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

motu: Kerere tauna ese ena kara dika boubouna baine mailaia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai Iehova baine henia. Ena boubou ḡauna na mamoe maruanena ta.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ena kara dika boubouna baine abia, Iehova vairanai herohemaino karana baine karaia, una tau dainai; bena ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

motu: Ba noholaia tanona ai ba kau bona emui au huahua idau-idau unuseniai ba hado negana ai anidia ba gwaurai helaḡa; laḡani toi lalodiai bae helaḡa emui ai, basio ani.
english: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. + 19:23 literally, “uncircumcised” * For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

motu: Laḡani ihahanina ai anidia bae helaḡa, boubou ḡaudia ai baela, Iehova ihanamolaina.
english: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.

motu: A laḡani iha-imana ai, anidia bavabi, bavani, anidia na emui ai bae hoho helaoreana. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Vamu mai rarana na basio ania. Mari karadia bona mea karadia basio kara.
english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

motu: Kwaramui huidia basio nau heḡeḡe, bona aukimui huidia basio utu heini.
english: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

motu: Mase daidiai kopimui basio iva bona revareva basio atu. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.

motu: Natumu kekenina basio hahemaraia, ariara hahinena ai basio halaoa, tano na lebulebu bona kara havara ai baine honu na garina.
english: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

motu: Egu dina helaḡadia ba badinadia; egu gabu helaḡana ba matauraia. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

motu: Rohe taudia bona babalau taudia na basio lao henidia; basio tahudia bona, edia kara miro ai basio miro. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Tau burukana vairanai ba tore isi; iahu ba matauraia; emu Dirava garina ba gari. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

motu: Bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu tauna na basio daḡedaḡe henia;
english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

motu: noho-hedoa tauna na emui bese tauna korikori heḡereḡerena baine noho bogaragimui ai. Ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena; badina be umui danu Aigupto tanona ai o noho hedoava. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Basio hahetoho koikoi. Lata hahetohodia bona metau hahetohodia bona anina hahetohodia basio ha-idau koikoi.
english: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

motu: Emui hahetoho ḡaudia bona edia metau ḡaudia bae maoro; bona emui efa + 19:36 “Efa” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta, flaoa e hahetoholaia. “Hini” danu edia hahetoho ḡauna ta, vine ranuna e hahetoholaia. * bona emui hini danu bae maoro. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava; Aigupto tanona amo na hakaumui lasi.
english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, + 19:36 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * and a just hin. + 19:36 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. * I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

motu: Egu taravatu iboudiai bona egu haheḡani iboudiai ba badinadia, karadia ba kara. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ma ba hamaorodia, baoto: Israel tauna ta eiava noho-hedoa tauna taese natuna na ḡole-oho boubouna ai baine halaoa, dirava koikoina Molek ena, ia na momokani baine mase: hanua taudia ese nadi amo bae hodoa mase.
english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring + 20:2 or, seed * to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

motu: Lau danu vairagu baina ha-aukaia una tau enai, bona ena beseamo baina negea daure; badina be natuna na Molek e henia, unu amo ia ese lauegu gabu helaḡana vada e hamiroa, bona lau ladagu helaḡana vada e hahemaraia.
english: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

motu: A hanua taudia ese hari natuna Molek e henia tauna bema bogaia hisi, basiema hodoa mase,
english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

motu: lau ese vairagu baina ha-aukaia una tau enai bona ena iduhu taudia iboudiai ediai; edia bese amo baina negea daure, ia bona ia ida Molek vairani, eha lebulebu taudia iboudiai danu.
english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

motu: Rohe taudia bona mea taudia baine lao henidia bona idia ida baine kara havara tauna danu, lau ese vairagu baina ha-aukaia ienai, bona ena bese amo baina negea daure.
english: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

motu: Taunabunai, sibomui ba hahelaḡa, bena ba helaḡa noho; badina be lau na Iehova emui Dirava.
english: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Egu taravatu ba badinadia, karadia ba kara: lau binai Iehova, ihahelaḡamui Diravana.
english: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

motu: Tamana eiava sinana e uduguiraiamu tauna na bae alaia mase; tamana eiava sinana e uduguiraia dainai, rarana be sibona latanai.
english: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

motu: Tau ta na dekena tauna adavana ida bae heuda hanai, tau bona hahine raruosi na bae aladia mase.
english: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

motu: Tau ta na tamana adavana ida bae heuda hanai, tamana baine hahemaraia, raruosi na bae aladia mase. Raradia na sibodia latadiai.
english: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

motu: Tau ta na rava maraḡi hahinena ida bae heuda hanai, raruosi na bae aladia mase. Idia na kara dika-hereana vada e karaia; raradiana sibodia latadiai.
english: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

motu: Tau ta na ma tau ta ida bae eno bou, una na kara mirona: raruosi na bae aladia mase; raradia na sibodia latadiai.
english: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

motu: Tau ta ese adavana baine eno henia bona ma sinana danu, una na kara dika-hereana:tatoiosi na lahi ai bae hamasedia, una kara dikana bogaragimui ai baine doko helaoreana.
english: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

motu: Tau ta na mauri ḡauna idauna ta ida bae eno bou, ia bae alaia mase bona hari mauri ḡauna danu bae alaia mase.
english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

motu: Eiava hahine ta na mauri ḡauna idauna ta ida bae eno bou, ia bona hari mauri ḡauna bavaladia mase; vada bae mase, raradia na sibodia latadiai.
english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

motu: Tau ta ese taihuna ta, tamana natuna eiava sinana natuna, baine abia, ia ida bae eno bou, una na hemarai karana; edia bese bogaragidia amo bae luludia lasi. Ia ese taihuna vada e hahemaraia; ena kara dika madunana baine huaia.
english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

motu: Tau ta na hahine ta ida bae eno bou, rara e karaia negana ai, ia ese hahine rarana vada e hahemaraia, bona hahine ese sibona rarana vada e hahemaraia; raruosi na edia bese amo bae negedia daure.
english: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

motu: Sinamu lahaina eiava lalamu ida basio eno bou, badina be idia na varavaramu; emui kara dika madunana ba huaia.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

motu: Tau ta na tamana lahaina adavana ida bae eno bou, una na tamana lahaina ihahemaraina karana; edia kara dika madunana bae huaia: bae noho gabani ela bona mase.
english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

motu: Tau ta na ihana ida bae eno bou, una na kara mirona; ia ese tadikakana vada e hahemaraia. Idia na bae noho gabani.
english: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

motu: Benaini: egu taravatu bona egu haheḡani ba badinadia, bona karadia ba kara; bena baina henimui ba noholaia tanona ese basine lorimui lasi.
english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.

motu: Vairamui ai baina luludia Iasi besedia edia kara basio tohotohodia; badina be idia ese ini kara bodagadia idoidiai vada e kara, una dainai lau ese na inai henidiamu.
english: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

motu: A lau ese vada na gwau henimui hamata, nato, Edia tano bavabia emui; baina henimui emui tano korikori, rata bona bada ranuna e arumu tanona bunai. Lau binai Iehova emui Dirava; bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo vada na abimui hidi.
english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

motu: Taunabunai, mauriḡaudia ḡoevaḡoevadia bona mirodia ba hididia, tano ai e loamu ḡaudia bona atai ai e rohomu manudia danu. Lau ese vada na gwauraidia miro ḡaudia, tano ai e loamu ḡaudia eiava atai ai e rohomu manudia eiava e raumu ḡaudia, na mirodia ai basio miro.
english: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

motu: Umui na ba helaḡa lauegu ai; badina be lau Iehova name helaḡa, bona bese idau-idau bogaragimui amo vadana hidimui, egu bese ai baola helaoreana.
english: You shall be holy to me, for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

motu: Rohe bona mea tauna eiava hahinena na bae aladia, nadi amo bae hododia mase. Raradia na sibodia latadiai.
english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto, Hahelaḡa taudia, Aaron natuna, ba hamaorodia, idia ta ese ena hanua masena ta latanai e helaḡalaimu karadia ai basine dau kau;
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

motu: varavarana mo latadiai: sinana, eiava tamana, eiava natuna, eiava tadikakana,
english: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

motu: eiava taihuna hane-ulato rami-hebou latanai; badina be ia na varavarana, bona asi adavana, ia dainai baine dau kau.
english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

motu: A ena hanua masena ta latanai e helaḡalaimu karadia ai basine dau kau, badina be ia na ena bese lohiana.
english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia na kwaradia basie naudia, bona aukidia huidia basie utu heini, bona kopidia basie ivadia.
english: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

motu: Edia Dirava enai bae helaḡa; edia Dirava ladana basie hahemaraia. Badina be boubou ḡaudia be idia ese lahi ai e hahelaḡadiamu, Iehova ena, bona edia Dirava ena flaoa idia ese e hahelaḡaiamu; taunabunai idia bae helaḡa.
english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

motu: Idia na ariara hahinedia eiava lebulebu hahinedia eiava diho hahinedia basie adavadia; badina be hahelaḡa tauna na helaḡa, ena Dirava enai.
english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

motu: Oi ese ia ba hahelaḡaia, badina be emu Dirava ena flaoa ia ese baine hahelaḡaia; bena emu ai baine helaḡa, badina be lau Iehova, umui ihahelaḡamui Diravana, na helaḡa.
english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna natuna hahinena baine lebulebu, bena ena lebulebu amo ia ese tamana baine hahemaraia, vada bae hamasea lahi ai.
english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana, tadikakana e biagudiamu tauna, dehoro helaḡana e horolaia tauna, e hahelaḡaia dabua helaḡadia baine dokilai tauna, ia ese huina basine ḡiḡi rohoroho, bona ena dabua basine dare.
english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

motu: Mase ta basine raka henia kahi; ena be tamana eiava sinana, to ia latanai e helaḡalaimu karadia ai basine dau kau.
english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

motu: Gabu helaḡana basine rakatania, ena Dirava ena gabu helaḡana basine hahemaraia; badina be ena Dirava ena dehoro helaḡana ese vada e hahelaḡaia. Lau binai Iehova.
english: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am Yahweh.

motu: Hane-ulato rami-hebou ta baine adavaia;
english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

motu: vabu eiava diho hahinena eiava vada e hamiroa hahinena eiava ariara hahinena basine adavaia. Hane-ulato rami-hebou ta, ena beseamo mo, baine adavaia;
english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

motu: unu amo natuna na basie hemarai ena bese taudia bogaragidiai; badina be lau Iehova ese vada na hahelaḡaia.
english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron ini ba hamaoroa toma, baoto: Uru ta ai emu iduhu tauna ta bema mai bebeka-bebekana, iana basine raka kahi mai, ena Dirava ena flaoa ihahelaḡana.
english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

motu: Badina be tau-anina mai bebeka-bebekana tauna na basine raka kahi mai: mata-kepulutauna, eiava ae-hedairike tauna, eiava vairana eiava regena ta mai berona tauna,
english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

motu: eiava imana eiava aena e bero tauna,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

motu: eiava doru-laoho tauna, eiava tau kwadogi-herea eiava mata-gegeva tauna, eiava kopi-hemaihemai gorerena tauna, eiava kopina mai taohana tauna, eiava abona nadinadina e heala tauna.
english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

motu: Asi tauna ta Aaron ena iduhu amo mai bebeka-bebekana baine raka kahi mai, boubou ḡaudia lahi ai baine hahelaḡadia Iehova ena, eiava ena Dirava ena flaoa baine hahelaḡaia, totona.
english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

motu: Ena Dirava ena flaoa, helaḡa ḡauna bona helaḡa-herea ḡauna, baine ani diba;
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

motu: a seseahu basine raka henia kahi, bona ihaboulaina patana basine raka henia kahi, badina be ia na mai bebeka-bebekana. Una dainai, ia na lauegu gabu helaḡadia basine hamirodia; badina be lau Iehova ese vada na hahelaḡadia.
english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

motu: Ini hereva iboudiai Mose ese Aaron mai natuna ida bona Israel taudia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia.
english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida taravadia bavatu, idia na Israel taudia edia boubou ḡaudia helaḡadia, lau dekegu ai e mailaidiamu ḡaudia, na bae matauraidia, lau ladagu helaḡana basie hahemaraia: lau binai Iehova.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto: Emui uru iboudiai lalodiai emui iduhu tauna ta ese Israel taudia edia boubou ḡaudia, e hahelaḡadiamu Iehova ena, baine raka henidia kahi mai mirona ida, una tau be lau vairagu ai bae negea daure. Lau binai Iehova.
english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

motu: Aaron ena iduhu tauna ta lepra eiava enobou gorerena baine davaria, ia ese aniani helaḡadia basine ani ela bona tauna baine ḡoeva. Bona ta ese mase dainai vada e miro ḡauna ta baine daua toho, eiava vesina e arumu tauna ta baine daua toho,
english: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,

motu: eiava tano ai e raumu ḡauna mirona ta baine daua toho, eiava edena miro edena miro amo vada e hahemiro tauna baine daua toho,
english: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

motu: una miro baine daua toho tauna na baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho; bona aniani helaḡana basine ania ela bona ranu ai baine digu.
english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

motu: A dina baine diho, bena baine ḡoeva; una murinai ia ese aniani helaḡana baine ania, badina be ena heubu ḡauna bunai.
english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

motu: E mase kava ḡauna eiava uda boromadia ese e hamasea ḡauna na basine ania, baine miro na garina: lau binai Iehova.
english: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

motu: Taunabunai, egu haheḡani bae badinadia; bae tata utu negana ai bae kara dika bona edia kara dika ai bae mase na garina. Lau Iehova ese vada na hahelaḡadia.
english: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

motu: Idau iduhu tauna ta ese aniani helaḡana basine ania; hahelaḡa tauna ena vadivadi ese basine ania; hesiai tauna mai davana ese basine ania.
english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

motu: A hahelaḡa tauna ese moni amo e hoia tauna ese baine ania; bona hahelaḡa tauna ena ruma ai hesiai ai e vara tauna ese danu baine ania.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna natuna hahinena ese idau iduhu tauna ta baine adavaia, ia ese aniani helaḡana, e duduia isi boubouna hidiona, na basine ania.
english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

motu: A hahelaḡa tauna natuna hahinena bema vabu, eiava bema diho, asi natuna, bena tamana ena ruma bema lou henia, unuseni ai bema noho, kekenina negana heḡereḡerena, ia be tamana ana aniani baine ania. A idau iduhu tauna ta basine ania diba.
english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.

motu: Tau ta ese aniani helaḡana baine ania kava, asi dibana vada e helaḡa dainai, ia ese davana na hahelaḡa tauna baine henia mai ato-kauna ida; ato-kauna na e ania ḡauna bema karoa, karoa ima, benakaroa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau.
english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

motu: Israel taudia edia boubou ḡaudia helaḡadia Iehova e heniamu na hahelaḡa taudia ese basie ani kava ani kava;
english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,

motu: aniani helaḡadia bae ani kava na e mailaidia taudia bae hakereredia; badina be lau Iehova ese vada na hahelaḡadia. Boubou Ḡaudia Taravatudia
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida bona Israel taudia iboudiai ba hamaorodia, baoto: Israel tauna ta eiava Israel taudia bogaragidiai e noho hedoamu tauna ta ese boubou ḡauna baine mailaia, gwau-hamata dainai eiava lalo-namo dainai, Iehova ena ḡole-oho ḡauna ai baine halaoa;
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering:

motu: Iehova ese baine abia dae helaoreana, ihenina tauna ese boromakau maruanena eiava mamoe maruanena eiava nani maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine mailaia.
english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

motu: A mai bebeka-bebekana ḡauna basine mailaia, badina be Iehova ese basine abia dae.
english: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

motu: Herohemaino boubouna baine mailaia tauna danu, gwau-hamata dainai eiava lalo-namodainai baine mailaia, Iehova ese baine abia dae helaoreana ihenina tauna ese boromakau eiava mamoe asi bebeka-bebekana ta baine mailaia.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

motu: Matakepulu ḡauna eiava ae-hedairike ḡauna eiava mai berona eiava mai totona eiava mai kuhikuhina eiava mai taohana ḡauna na basio mailaia, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana latanai basio haḡolea oho.
english: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.

motu: Boromakau maruanena eiava mamoe natuna na imana ta eiava aena ta baine kwadogi eiava baine lata, vada ba henia diba, lalo-namo boubouna, to basio mailaia gwau-hamatadavana.
english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

motu: Ḡau ta abona nadinadina na e toto eiava e pata eiava e hedare eiava e heiva na basio mailaia Iehova ena, emui boubou ḡauna ai basio halaoa, emui tano idoinai.
english: You must not offer to Yahweh that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

motu: Idau bese tauna ena amo unuhetomana ta bavabia, emui boubou ḡauna ai ba halaoa, Iehova ese basine abia dae, badina be idia na mimiro bona mai bebeka-bebekadia.
english: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Boromakau eiava mamoe eiava nani baine vara negana ai, ia na dina hitu sinana dekenai baine noho; dina ihataurahanina ai bona dina ihataurahanina murinai ia na heḡereḡere ḡole-oho boubouna ai ba halaoa, Iehova ena.
english: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: A sinana, boromakau hahinena eiava mamoe hahinena, na natuna ida dina tamona ai basio aladia hebou.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

motu: Emui hahenamo bouboudia Iehova ba henia negadia ai na ba hahelaḡadia namonamo, bena Iehova ese baine abidia dae.
english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

motu: Boubou hidiona na bavalaia dinana ai bavania; bahu na basine mia rani. Lau binai Iehova.
english: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.

motu: Benaini, egu haheḡani ba badinadia, karadia ba kara: lau binai Iehova.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.

motu: Lau ladagu helaḡana basio hahemaraia; Israel taudia ese lau ladagu bae hahelaḡaia: lau binai Iehova, umui ihahelaḡamui Diravana.
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

motu: Lau ese Aigupto tanona amo na hakaumui lasi, emui Dirava ai bainala helaoreana. Lau binai Iehova.
english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto Iehova ena aria bini; ini aria negadia ai emui hebou helaḡadia ba kara.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

motu: Dina tauratoi ai ba ḡaukara, a dina ihahituna na dina helaḡana, laḡa-ani dinana, hebou helaḡana dinana. Una dina ai basio ḡaukara; ia naIehova ena Dina Helaḡa, emui noho gabudia iboudiai.
