english: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

motu: Iehova ena aria bini; emui hebou helaḡadia edia nega korikori ai do ba kara.
english: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-hanina hanuaboina na Iehova ena lagau-hanai.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.

motu: Hua dinana ihagwauta-imana na asie hatubua flaoana ariana, Iehova ena; dina hitu lalodiai asie hatubua flaoana mo bavania.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

motu: Aria dinana gini-gunana ai emui hebou helaḡana ba karaia, bona ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

motu: Dina hituosi lalodiai emui ḡole-oho bouboudia Iehova ba henia; bena dina ihahituna ai emui hebou helaḡana ma ba karaia lou. Una dina ai danu ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Baina henimui tanona ai ba kau murinai, emui uma anidia ba utu negadia ai na emui iḡui roboana na hahelaḡa tauna dekena ba laohaia;
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

motu: bena ia ese iḡui baine abia, Iehova vairanai baine davea, Iehova ese baine hanamomui helaoreana. Dina Helaḡa murina dinana ai hahelaḡa tauna ese iḡui baine davea;
english: He shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

motu: bena una iḡui idavena dinana ai mamoe natuna maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana, laḡani tamona ḡauna, bavabia, ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna ai ba halaoa, Iehova ena.
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

motu: Flaoa boubouna danu ia ida ba heni: flaoa namo-hereana efa + 23:13 “Efa” be Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta; anina be 18 litres sisivana. * ta ba karoa, karoa gwauta, bena karoa rua bavabi, emui boubou ḡauna. Dehoro ida ba bulo, bena lahi ai ba haḡolea oho, bonana namo ḡauna ai bainela, Iehova ena. Inuinu boubouna danu idia ida ba heni, vine ranuna kehere ta.
english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah + 23:13 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin. + 23:13 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. *

motu: Flaoa basio ania; uit danu, e hakaukaua ḡauna eiava matamatana, basio ania; ela bona emui boubou ḡauna na emui Dirava dekenai ba laohaia dinana ai bavania. Ina taravatu baine mia hanaihanai emui uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

motu: Una dina amo, hari Dina Helaḡa murina dinana, emui iḡui roboadia ba heni davedave bouboudia ai baela dinana, pura hitu ba duahidia.
english: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

motu: Dina imahui ba duahidia, ela bona Dina Helaḡa ihahituna murina dinana; una dina ai flaoa matamatana boubouna Iehova ba henia.
english: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.

motu: Emui ruma amo flaoa namo-hereana efa ta ba karoa, karoa ima, bena karoa ta bavabia, ihatubuna muramurana ida ba buloa; bena ba gabua, igabu rua ba kara, davedave boubouna ḡaudia, emui flaoa matamatana amo.
english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah + 23:17 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.

motu: Bona flaoa igabudia ida mamoe natudia asi bebeka-bebekadia hitu, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, bona boromakau natuna maruanena ta, bona mamoe mamaruanedia rua, ḡole-oho boubouna ai baela, Iehova ena, flaoa boubouna bona inuinu bouboudia ida; idoinai bonana namo boubouna ai bainela lahi ai, Iehova ena.
english: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Kara rea boubouna danu ba henia, nani maruanena ta, bona herohemaino boubouna, mamoe natuna mamaruanedia rua, laḡani tamona ḡaudia.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese baine davedia, flaoa matamatana bouboudia ida, idoinai, hari mamoe natuna ruaosi ida, davedave boubouna ai bainela, Iehova ena. Idia na Iehova ena ḡau helaḡadia, hahelaḡa tauna ana.
english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

motu: Una dina tamona ai danu taunimanima ba boiridia hebou, emui hebou helaḡana ba karaia; una dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia. Ina taravatu baine mia hanaihanai, emui uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

motu: Emui uit eiava emui bali + 23:22 “Bali” be flaoa ikaralaina reina ta, uit bamona. * ba utua negana ai, basio utua ela bona emu inoḡo hetoana korikori ai, bona tano ai bae moru anidia basio gogo: bae mia, oroḡami tauna eiava noho-hedoa tauna ana. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Hua ihahituna dinana gini-gunana na laḡa-ani dinanahelaḡana ta emui, helalo-tao dinana mai kibi ihiriridia, bona hebou helaḡana dinana.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

motu: Una dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia; a ḡole-ohoboubouna Iehova ba henia.
english: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Hua ihahituna dinana ihagwautana na herohemaino dinana: una dina ai emui hebou helaḡana ba karaia, bona ba helalo kerehai, bona ḡole-oho boubouna Iehova ba henia.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: Una dina ai ḡaukara ta basio karaia, lasi vaitani; badina be ia na herohemaino dinana. Iehova emui Dirava ida ba herohemaino una dina ai.
english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.

motu: A tau ta una dina ai basine helalo, ia na ena bese amo bae negea daure.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

motu: Bona tau ta una dina ai baine ḡaukara, lau ese baina hamasea, ena bese taudia bogaragidia amo.
english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

motu: Ḡaukara ta basio karaia, lasi ona lasi vaitani: ina taravatu baine mia hanaihanai, emui uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

motu: Ina na dina helaḡa badana, emui laḡa-ani dinana badana, bona emui helalo dinana badana: hua dinana ihataurahani-tana ai dina baine diho elabona dina ihagwautana ai dina baine diho ina dina helaḡana ba badinaia.
english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ina hua ihahituna dinana ihagwauta-imana na kalaga ariana ba matamaia dina hitu lalodiai ba karaia, Iehova ena.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths + 23:34 or, feast of tents, or Succoth * for seven days to Yahweh.

motu: Aria dinana gini-gunana ai, hebou helaḡana ba karaia; hau dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

motu: Dina ta ta ai, ela bona dina hituosi bae ore, ḡole-oho bouboudia Iehova ba henia. Bena dina ihataurahanina ai emui hebou helaḡana ba karaia, bona ḡole-oho boubouna Iehova ba henia. Ia na hebou helaḡana badana; ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia una dina ai.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

motu: Iehova ena aria bunu; ba badinadia, dina helaḡadia bona hebou helaḡadia dinadia. Emui boubou ḡaudia na lahi ai ba gabudia: ḡole-oho bouboudia bona flaoa bouboudia, boromakau bona mamoe, inuinu bouboudia danu, ta ta ena dina ena dina ai.
english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

motu: Ini be idau; a Iehova ena dina helaḡa, pura ta ta ai, bona emui herahia ḡaudia, bona emui gwau-hamata bouboudiaiboudiai, bona emui lalo-namo bouboudia iboudiai, Iehova o heniamu, bema idau.
english: in addition to the Sabbaths of Yahweh, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to Yahweh.

motu: Benaini, hua ihahituna dinana ihagwauta-imana, uma anidia iboudiaiba haboudia murinai, Iehova ena aria ba karaia dina hitu lalodiai. Aria dinana gini-gunana na laḡa-ani helaḡa dinana, bona aria dinana ihataurahanina na laḡa-ani helaḡa dinana.
english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

motu: Dina gini-gunana ai au namodia huahuadia bavabi, bona reta, bona au rigidia mai raudia ida, bona arabimi + 23:40 “Arabimi” be au ta, sinavai isena ai e varamu. * sinavai isena amo; bena Iehova vairanai ba moale hebou, dina hituosi lalodiai.
english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.

motu: Laḡani ta ta lalodiai ina aria dinadia hituosi do ba badinadia: egu haheḡani bunai, uru uru idoidiai ela bona hanaihanai. Hua ihahituna ai una aria ba karaia.
english: You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

motu: Unu dina hituosi lalodiai umui na kalaga ai ba noho; Israel taudia iboudiai kalaga bae noholai;
english: You shall dwell in temporary shelters + 23:42 or, booths * for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters, + 23:42 or, booths *

motu: unu amo uru gabedia bae diba lau ese Israel taudia na kalaga ai na hanohodia, Aigupto tanona amo na hakaudia lasi negana ai. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters + 23:43 or, booths * when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’”

motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia e haboudia, Iehova ena aria herevadia e hadibalaidia.
english: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba haduadia, olive dehorona ḡoevaḡoevana, lamepa ḡauna, bae henimu, lamepa baine ara hanaihanai helaoreana.
english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

motu: Hebou kalagana Ialonai, maua helaḡana seseahuna murimurinai, baine ara; Aaron ese baine reḡua, hanuaboi iboudiai baine ara rani Iehova vairanai. Haheḡanina binai baine mia hanaihanai emui uru iboudiai lalodiai.
english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

motu: Aaron ese lamepa baine reḡudia, lamepa patana ai, gold * namo-hereana amo e karaia ḡauna, Iatanai bae ara hanaihanai, Iehova vairanai.
english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before Yahweh continually.

motu: Flaoa namo-hereana bavabia, ba gabua, igabu gwauta-rua. Flaoa efa ta ba karoa, karoa gwauta, bena karoa rua rua bavabi, igabu ta ta ikaralaidia.
english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah + 24:5 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * shall be in one cake.

motu: Bena Iehova vairanai ba dabara, gold * namo-hereana amo e karaia patana latanai; ere rua ai bavatodia, ere ta igabu tauratoi, ma ere ta igabu tauratoi.
english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.

motu: Ere ruaosi latadiai muramura mai bonana ḡoeva-daena bavatoa kau, iana flaoa ida helalo-tao toana ai baela, bona lahi boubouna ai baela, Iehova ena.
english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: Dina Helaḡa ta ta ai, hahelaḡa tauna ese flaoa helaḡana unu baine dabaraia toma Iehova vairanai; Israel taudia daidiai baine dabaraia, herohemaino toana, baine hesiriu hanaihanai.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

motu: Una flaoa na Aaron mai natuna ida adia; gabu helaḡana ai bae ania, Iehova ena Iahi bouboudia iboudiai ia mo sibona helaḡa herea. Mia-hanaihanai taravatuna bunai. Dirava iuduguiraina, davana
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

motu: Tau ta, sinana na hane Israel, tamana na Aigupto tauna, e raka lasi. Israel taudia bogaragidiai: bena ia na Israel tauna korikorina ta ida e heai. taruha lalonai.
english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

motu: Bena hari hane Israel natuna ese Lada Helaḡana e uduguiraia, hereva metaudia e gwaurai. Bena haida ese e hakaua lao, Mose vairanai. Sinana ladana na Selomiti Dibri, Dan iduhuna hahinena.
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

motu: Bena e ḡuia, ela bona Iehova ena hahemaoro herevana bae diba.
english: They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Heuduguirai tauna na taruha murimurinai ba hakaua lasi; bena ena heuduguirai herevadia e kamonai taudia iboudiai ese imadia na ia tubuana ai bae ato kau, murinai hebou taudia iboudiai ese nadi amo bae hodoa mase.
english: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

motu: Israel taudia ba hadibadia danu, ena Dirava baine uduguiraia tauna ese sibona ena dika madunana baine huaia.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

motu: Iehova ladana baine uduguiraia tauna na baine mase; hebou taudia iboudiai ese bae hodoa mase. Ena be noho-hedoa tauna eiava Israel tauna korikori, to Lada Helaḡana bema uduguiraia, vada bae hodoa mase.
english: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

motu: Tau ta baine alaia mase tauna danu bae alaia mase.
english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

motu: Mauri ḡauna ta baine alaia mase tauna ese davana baine heni; mauri ḡauna davana be mauri ḡauna.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

motu: Tau ta ese dekena tauna baine haberoa, e haberoa heḡereḡerena ai ia danu bae haberoa.
english: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

motu: Bero davana bero, mara davana mara, ise davana ise; e karaia heḡereḡerena ma ba kara henia.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

motu: Mauri ḡauna idauna baine alaia mase tauna ese davana baine heni; a taunimanima baine alaia mase tauna na bae alaia mase.
english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

motu: Noho-hedoa tauna bona Israel tauna korikori taravatudia na tamona: lau Iehova emui Dirava na gwaumu.
english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”

motu: Mose ese Israel taudia unu e haḡanidia toma; bena idia ese heuduguirai tauna e hakaua lasi, taruha murimurinai, nadi amo e hodoa mase. Iehova ese Mose e haduaia heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia na unu e kara toma.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, Sinai ororona ai, eto,
english: Yahweh said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Baina henimui tanona ai ba kau negana ai, tano ena nega helaḡadia ba badinadia, Iehova ena.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to Yahweh.

motu: Laḡani tauratoi emu uhe ba hado, bona laḡani tauratoi emu vine audia rigidia ba kwamadia heini, huahua ihahohodia totona.
english: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

motu: A laḡani ihahituna na tano ena laḡa-ani negana, laḡani helaḡana Iehova ena: uhe basio hado emutano ai, bona emu vine audia rigidia basio kwamadia heini.
english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

motu: Sibona baine tubu ḡauna na basio utua, bona vine huahuadia bae dobi na basio habou; tano ena laḡa-ani helaḡana bunai.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

motu: Tano ena laḡa-ani amo amui ba davaria:oi bona emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai hahinena bona dekemu ai e ḡaukaramu tauna bona dekemu ai e noho hedoamu tauna,
english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

motu: bona emu boromakau bona emu seri iboudiai emu tano lalonai. Tano anina idoinai na amui.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

motu: Laḡani helaḡadia hitu ba duahidia, laḡani kavakavadia hitu hitu amo: unu laḡani iboudiai bae hari-ahui taurahani-ta.
english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

motu: Bena hua ihahituna dinanaihagwautana ai kibi ba hiriria badabada; herohemaino dinana ai kibi bae hiriri emui tano idoinai.
english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

motu: Laḡani iha-imahuina ba hahelaḡaia, bainehelaḡa herea. Una laḡani lalonai iḡui taudia iboudiai bae ruhadia nege. Ia ladana be Iubile: ia lalonai taunimanima iboudiai edia tano korikori bona edia iduhu korikori bae lou henidia.
english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

motu: Laḡani iha-imahuina na emui Iubile: ia Ialonai uhe basio hado, bona sibona baine tubu ḡauna basio utua; emui vine danu rigidia basio kwamadia heini, bona huahuadia basio habou.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

motu: Badina be Iubile laḡanina na helaḡa emui ai: tano anina na bavania, vadaeni.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

motu: Iubile laḡanina ai umui ta ta ena tano ena tano bavabi lou.
english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

motu: Dekemu tauna enai ba hoihoi, basio koia, ia danu basine koimu.
english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

motu: Dekemu tauna ena tano ba hoia negana ai, ba laloa, Iubile murinai laḡani hida vada e lao bubuni; ia danu baine laloa, taboro hida do mimia.
english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

motu: Bema laḡani momo mimia, davana na baine bada, a bema laḡani gadoi mo mimia, davana na baine maraḡi, badina e hoimu ḡauna be taboro e hoimu.
english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

motu: Raruosi basio hekoi heheni, a emui Dirava garina be gari, badina be lau be Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Taunabunai, egu taravatu bona egu haheḡani ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara; unu amo ba noho namonamo emui tano ai.
english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

motu: Tano ese anina baine henimui: bavaniani, ba boga kunu, ba noho namonamo.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

motu: Ba henanadai reana, baoto “Laḡani ihahituna ai dahaka baia ania, basia hadohado bona basia taboro negana ai?”
english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”

motu: Benaini, laḡani ihatauratoina ai baina hanamomui, tano anina bavabia, laḡani toi davadia.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

motu: Bena laḡani ihataurahanina ai emui uhe ma ba hado, a emui uma anidia gunadia do bavani, ela bona laḡani ihataurahani-tana ena taboro negana baine kau.
english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

motu: Tano tabasio hoia vaitani, badina be tano na lauegu, umui ese o noholaiamu, e kara lauegu vadivadi na heto.
english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

motu: Ba hoi tanodia iboudiai na biagudia gunadia bae abi lou diba.
english: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

motu: Tadikakamu ta baine ogoḡami, bena ena tano kahana baine hoia, ia varavara-dosina ese una tano davana baine karaia, baine abia lou.
english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

motu: Bema asi iabi-louna tauna ta, a gabeamo ogoḡami tauna ma baine taḡa, iabi-lounabaine heḡereḡere,
english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

motu: ia na baine haeroa, laḡani hida vada ela ia ese e hoia, bena davana orena baine heni lou, ena tano ma baine abia lou.
english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

motu: A bema imana baine tuna, iabi-louna basine heḡereḡere, e hoia tauna ese bainebirulaia ela bona Iubile laḡanina; una negana ai tano tauna korikorina ese ena tano baine abia lou.
english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

motu: Hanua mai maḡuna lalonai tau ta ese ena ruma baine hoia, moni davana, ia na davana baine heni lou bona ena ruma baine abia lou diba, ela bona laḡani ta baine ore. Laḡani ta lalonai ia ese baine hoia lou diba.
english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

motu: A laḡani ta lalonai basine abia lou, una ruma na iena amo e hoia tauna ena ruma korikori ai bainela, iena bona ia garana edia; Iubile laḡanina ai biaguna gunana basine abia Iou.
english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

motu: A hanua maraḡidia, asi maḡudia hanuadia, lalodiai na ruma bae hoi be tano bae hoi heḡereḡerena, davadia bae heni lou bona ruma bae abi lou diba, bona Iubile laḡanidia ai biagudia gunadia ese bae abi lou.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Levi taudia edia hanua ai, Levi taudia ese edia ruma bae hoi lou diba, laḡani iboudiai.
english: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.

motu: A Levi tauna ta ena ruma basine hoia Iou, ia na Iubile laḡanina ai do baine abia lou. Badina be Levi taudia edia hanua rumadia na edia korikori, Israel taudia bogaragidiai.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

motu: Bona edia gabi-ruma tanodia na haida ese basie hoi; unu tano na ediatano korikori ela bona hanaihanai.
english: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

motu: Tadikakamu ta baine ogoḡami, asi ena heubu dalana, oi ese ba ubua, laolao tauna eiava vadivadi tauna na heto.
english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

motu: Moni eiava kohu iena amo basio abia; emu Dirava garina ba gari, bona tadikakamu ba hamauria.
english: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.

motu: Moni ba henia eiava aniani ba ubulaia na davadia basio abi.
english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

motu: Lau binai Iehova emui Dirava; Aigupto tanona amo na hakaumui lasi, Kanaan tanona baina henimui bona emui Dirava ai bainala totona.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

motu: Tadikakamu ta baine ogoḡami, bena emu ai sibona baine hehoi, basio kara henia o hoia tauna o kara heniamu heḡereḡerena;
english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

motu: a mai davana emu ai e ḡaukaramu tauna eiava noho-hedoa tauna heḡereḡerena oi dekemuai baine noho. Ia na oi isiaimu baine lao heni ela bona Iubile laḡanina;
english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

motu: bena emu ruma amo baine raka lasi, ia mai natuna ida, ena ruma taudia bona ena tano korikori baine lou henidia.
english: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

motu: Badina be idia na lauegu hesiai taudia, Aigupto tanona amo na hakaudia lasi; basio hoidia.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

motu: Basio hahisihisia; emu Dirava garina ba gari.
english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

motu: E noho hetabiramu besedia edia amo emui hesiai taudia bona hahinedia ba hoidia;
english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

motu: bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu taudia edia amo danu natudia emui tano ai e vara na ba hoidia diba, emui iḡui taudia ai baela.
english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

motu: Umui murimui ai dihimui ese danu bae abidia, edia korikori; isiaimui bae lao heni hanaihanai. A Israel taudia, varavaramui korikori, na basio hahisihisidia.
english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

motu: Bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu tauna na baine taḡa, bona tadikakamu ta baine ogoḡami, bena hari tadikakamu na sibona baine hehoi, una nohohedoa tauna enai eiava iena ruma tauna ta enai,
english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,

motu: unu e hehoi toma tauna na bae hamauria diba, tadikakana ese,
english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

motu: eiava tamana lahaina ese, eiava varavarana ta ese; eiava ia sibona moni baine davaria negana ai na sibona baine hahemauri.
english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

motu: Laḡani bae duahidia, biaguna enai e hehoi negana ela bona Iubile laḡanina; bena iruhana monina na unu laḡani hidaosi ahudia, hesiai tauna mai davana ahuna heḡereḡerena, baine heni.
english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

motu: Negana bema daudau, laḡani unuhohodia davadia baine heni, sibona e hehoilai monina amo;
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

motu: eiava negana bema kwadogi, laḡani unuhohodia davadia na biaguna baine henia, laḡani hidaosi mimia heḡereḡeredia ia ese iruhana monina na baine heni.
english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

motu: Ia na hesiai tauna mai davana, laḡani ta ta amo e ḡaukaramu, heḡereḡerena ai baine ḡaukara; biaguna ese basine hahisihisia oi vairamu ai.
english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

motu: Bema basine heruha guna, ia na Iubile laḡanina ai baine heruha, ia mai natuna ida.
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

motu: Badina be Israel taudia na lauegu hesiai taudia; Aigupto tanona amo na hakaudia Iasi, isiaigu ilao-henina totona. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Kaivakuku basio kara. Dirava laulauna nadi amo basio koroa bona basio haginia; au-tubua helaḡana ta eiava nadi helaḡana ta danu basio haginia bona basio toma henia diho, emui tano idoinai; badina be lau na Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Egu dina helaḡadia ba badinadia, bona egu dubu helaḡana ba matauraia: lau binai Iehova.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.

motu: Egu taravatu boma badinadia bona egu haheḡani karadia boma kara,
english: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

motu: lau ese medu namodia baina henimui, edia nega korikori ai, bena tano ese anina baine havaraia, bona imea audia bae huahua.
english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

motu: Uit ikwadina do basine ore ai vine huahuadia iutudia baine hematama, bona vine huahuadia iutudia do basine ore ai hadohado baine hematama. Bavaniani boga kunu, emui tano ai ba noho, asi emui kudou hetaha.
english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

motu: Lau ese maino baina henimui emui tano ai; vada ba laḡa ani, asi tauna ta ese baine hagarimui. Uda boromadia baina ha-oredia emui tano ai, bona tuari darena na basine hedinarai, emui tano idoinai.
english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

motu: Inaimui do ba hadareredia, emui dare amo bavaladia mase.
english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

motu: Laima umui emui amo ese sinahu-ta bae hadareredia, bona sinahu-ta umui emui amo ese gerebu-ta bae hadareredia; inaimui iboudiai na emui dare ai bae mase.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

motu: Lau ese baina haḡeremui, natumui momo baina henimui, baina hahutumamui. Egu gwau-hamata emui aido baina hamomokania.
english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

motu: Emui roge anidia basie ore; gunadia oredia do ba nege, matamatadia gabudia ilailaidia.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

motu: Bogaragimui ai baina noho; lau laumagu ese basine dadaraimui.
english: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

motu: Bogaragimui ai baina raka; emui Dirava ai bainala, umui danu egu bese taumui ai baola.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

motu: Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava: Aigupto tanona amo na hakaumui lasi, Aigupto taudia isiaidia basio lao heni nato; aiomui gadeadia na hamotudia, na haginimui maoromaoro. Gwau-edeede ahuna
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

motu: A basioma kamonai henigu; ini haheḡani iboudiai basioma badinadia;
english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

motu: egu taravatu boma tata utu, bona laumamui ese egu hahemaoro herevadia bema dadaraidia; egu haheḡani iboudiai karadia basioma kara, bona emui gwau-hamata egu ai basioma hamomokania;
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

motu: lau be ini baina kara henimuitoma: gari lalomui ai baina havaraia; baina havaroda-varodamui. Taumui bae siahu, bona matamui bae valahu-valahu, bona laumamui bae daure. Emui uhe ba hado, to anidia basio ani; inaimui ese bae ani.
english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

motu: Vairagu baina ha-aukaia emui ai. Inaimui ese bae hadareremui bona bae halohiamui. Ta ese basine havamui negana ai ba heau.
english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

motu: Ini ḡau muridiai ma basioma kamonai henigu, lau ese emui kara dika davadia nega hahitu baine henimui.
english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

motu: Emui goada heaḡina baina hahemaraia. Guba na auri ai baina halaoa emui ai; bona emui tanobada na auri laboralaborana ai baina halaoa.
english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

motu: Emui goada baine ore kava; emui uma anidia basie vara; emui imea audia basie huahua.
english: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

motu: Doene boma inai henigu bona boma gwau edeede henigu, lau ese baina hahisihisimui nega hahitu, emui kara dika daidiai.
english: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

motu: Uda boromadia baina kahudia nege bogaragimui ai; idia ese natumui bae dadihaidia, bona emui seri bae habuadia tari, bona umui bae hagadoimui. Emui dala ai ava bae tubu.
english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

motu: A dounu basioma lou henigu, dounu egu amo boma raka oho,
english: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

motu: lau ese umui emui amo baina raka oho, bona emui kara dika davadia nega hahitu ma baina henimui.
english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

motu: Dare na latamui ai baina siaia, taravatu itatautuna davana ihaḡuḡuruna totona. Emui hanua badadia ai ba hahebou negadia ai, lau ese dai-hanai goreredia baina siaidia bogaragimui ai, benainaimui imadia ai baina negemui.
english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

motu: Amui mauri anianina baina abia oho negana ai, hahine gwauta amu tamona ai flaoa bae gabua, amui bae hahetoho henimui; bavaniani, to bogamui basie kunu.
english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai do basioma kamonai henigu, a egu amo boma raka oho,
english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

motu: lau be umui emui amo baina raka oho mai badugu ida, bona emui kara dika davadia nega hahitu baina henimui, lau sibogu ese.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

motu: Bena natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia hidiodia do bavani.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

motu: Lau ese emui helaḡa gabudia ororo doridia ai na baina habuadia tari, bona emui muramura patadia baina uhedia hebubu, bona emui kaivakuku tau-anidiamasedia latadiai umui tau-animui masedia baina tahodia kau; bena laumaguese baine dadaraimui.
english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

motu: Emui hanua baina habuadia tari; emui dubu baina giḡidia rohoroho; emui muramura bonadia basina moalelai.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

motu: Emui tano baina havahua; inaimui bae noho henia, bena bae hoalaia.
english: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

motu: Bena baina lulumui lasi, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina hakarohomui rohoroho. Egu dare baina veria lasi, ia ese baine havamui; emui tano bona emui hanua bae vahu.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

motu: Una negana ai tano ese ena laḡa-ani baine moalelaia, baine vahudinadia iboudiai, umui inaimui edia tano ai ba noho hedoa dinadia ai. Tano na baine laḡa ani, bona ena laḡa-ani baine moalelaia.
english: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

motu: Ena vahudinadia iboudiai baine laḡa ani, laḡa-ani korikori, dia umui o noholaiavanegadia ai emui dina helaḡadia ai e laḡa aniva na heto.
english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

motu: A emui bese oredia na lalodia baina hadaradaradia, inaidia edia tano ai; au rauna lai ese e hohoamu reḡena ese baine hagaridia, bena bae heautania, dare bema heautania na heto; bena ta ese se hahavadia negana ai bae keto.
english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

motu: Tau ta ese se havadiamu negana ai bae hetutuhi heheni, dare bema heautania na heto. Inaimui vairadiai basio gini diba.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

motu: Mase ese baine ḡavamui tao, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, inaimui edia tano ese baine hadonomui.
english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

motu: Bae roho mauri taudia kwabukwabudia na inaimui edia tano ai bae manori, edia kara dika daidiai bona tamadia edia kara dika daidiai.
english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

motu: To bema helalo kerehai, edia kara dika bona tamadia edia kara dika, edia kara hedibaḡani egu ai bona edia raka muri karadia,
english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

motu: daidiai na rakatanidia bona inaidia edia tano ai na luludia lao karadia, bema gwaurai hedinarai; bona edia hekokoroku bema negea, lalodia bema hamanau, bona edia kara dika davadia do bema hua,
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

motu: lau ese egu gwau-hamata, Iakob bona Isaak bona Abraham na gwaurai henidia hamata ḡauna, baina helalolaia une, bona tano danu baina laloa.
english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

motu: A tano na do baine mia, ena laḡa-anibaine moalelaia, idia muridiai baine vahu dinadia iboudiai; bona idia ese edia kara dika davadia do bae hua; badina be egu haheḡani e dadaraidiava, bona laumadia ese egu taravatu e inai henidiava.
english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

motu: Ḡau tamona, inaidia edia tano ai bae noho negana ai, lau ese basina dadaraidia, basina inai henidia, basina habuadia tari, bona egu gwau-hamata idia ediai basina reaia; badina be lau na Iehova, edia Dirava.
english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God.

motu: Idia daidiai egu gwau-hamata, idia senedia, bese idau-idau vairadiai Aigupto amo na hakaudia lasi bonaedia Dirava ai nala taudia, na gwaurai henidia hamata ḡauna, do baina laloa tao. Lau binai Iehova.
english: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Haheḡani bona hahemaoro bona taravatu bini, Iehova ese Mose imana amo e kara, Sinai ororona ai, ia bona Israel taudia padadiai bae mia.
english: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Taunimanima ta baine helaḡa, gwau-hamata ta dainai, oiese ibodohilaina ḡauna ba gwauraia, Iehova ena.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to Yahweh in a vow, according to your valuation,

motu: Bema tau, laḡani ruahui ela bona laḡani tauratoi-ahui, ibodohilaina na silver * sekeledia imahui, gabuhelaḡana ena sekele + 27:3 “Sekele” bona “gera” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡaudia, metau hahetohodia. Uru gunadia, asi edia moni korikori, na \+fl silver e hahetohoa, ena metau na sekele hida; unu amo e hoihoi. Sekele ta be 16 grams sisivana. * heḡereḡeredia.
english: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel + 27:3 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of the sanctuary.

motu: Bema hahine, ibodohilaina na sekele toi-ahui.
english: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

motu: Taunimanima laḡanidia ima ela bona ruahui ibodohilaidia bini: bema maruane, sekele ruahui; bema hahine, sekele gwauta.
english: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

motu: Hua ta amo ela bona laḡani ima ibodohilaidia bini: bema maruane, silver * sekeledia ima; bema hahine, sekele toi.
english: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

motu: Laḡani tauratoi-ahui vada e hanai taudia ibodohilaidia bini: bema tau, sekele gwauta-ima; bema hahine, sekele gwauta.
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

motu: Aogoḡami dainai gwau-hamata tauna na ibodohilaidia bini basine heni diba, ia na hahelaḡa tauna vairanai baine hedinarai, bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ibodohilaina davana baine gwauraia, gwau-hamata tauna baine heni diba heḡereḡerena.
english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

motu: Ḡau helaḡana bema mauri ḡauna ta, taunimanima vaia Iehova ena ihaboulaina ai e halaomu ḡaudia ta, una ḡau danu baine helaḡa, tau ta ese Iehova vada e henia dainai.
english: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.

motu: Basine boloa: namona na dikana basine bololaia, bona dikana na namona basine bololaia. Bema boloa, mauri ḡaudia ruaosi na bae helaḡa.
english: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

motu: A bema mauri ḡauna mirona ta, Iehova ena ihaboulaina ai asie halaoamu ḡauna, gwau-hamata tauna ese una ḡau baine laohaiaha helaḡa tauna vairanai.
english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ibodohilaina davana baine gwauraia, ena namo eiava ena dika heḡereḡerena; oi hahelaḡa taumu ba gwauraia heḡereḡerena, dava korikorina bunai.
english: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

motu: Hari tau baine ura baine bodohilaia, ia ese dava bunai baine heni, mai atokauna ida. Atokauna na dava idoinai baine karoaia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau.
english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

motu: Tau ta ese ena ruma bema gwauraia hamata, baine helaḡa Iehova ena, hahelaḡa tauna ese ibodohilaina davana baine gwauraia, ena namo eiava ena dika heḡereḡerena; hahelaḡa tauna ese davana baine gwauraia heḡereḡerena, dava korikorina bunai.
english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

motu: Ruma biaguna baine ura ena ruma baine bodohilaia, ia ese dava bunai baine heni mai atokauna ida. Atokauna na dava idoinai baine karoaia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau. Bena ruma na iena.
english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

motu: Tau ta ese ena tano kahana, senena edia amo e abia tanona, bema hahelaḡaia Iehova ena, oi ese ibodohilaina davana ba haeroa, uhe una tano lalonai vada e hadomu heḡereḡerena. Bali + 27:16 “Bali”; na aniani reina ta, flaoa e karalaia. “Homere” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta. Homere ta anina be 370 litres sisivana. * homerena ta na silver * sekeledia imahui ida ba haheḡereḡerea.
english: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer + 27:16 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels * of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels + 27:16 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of silver.

motu: Iubile laḡanina ai ena tano bema hahelaḡaia, ibodohilaina na dava idoinai, oi ese ba gwauraia heḡereḡerena, baine heni.
english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

motu: A Iubile laḡanina murinai bema hahelaḡaia, hahelaḡa tauna ese baine haeroa, laḡani hida do mimia ela bona Iubile ta baine kau, bena unu laḡani hidaosi ihaheḡereḡeredia ai davana baine hamaraḡia.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

motu: Tano biaguna baine ura ena tano baine bodohilaia, ia ese dava baine heni mai atokauna ida. Atokauna na dava idoinai baine karoaia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau. Bena tano na iena.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

motu: A ibodohilaina basine ura, eiava tau ta ese baine hoia, ia na basine abia lou diba.
english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

motu: A Iubile baine kau ai, una tano na baine helaḡa Iehova ena, badina be ia na gwau-hamata ḡauna: hahelaḡa tauna ese baine abia, iena.
english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

motu: Tau ta ese ena tano ta, dia senena edia amo e abia to moni amo e hoia ḡauna, bema hahelaḡaia Iehova ena,
english: “‘If he dedicates a field to Yahweh which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

motu: hahelaḡa tauna ese ibodohilaina davana laḡani hidaosi lalodiai ela bona Iubile laḡanina baine gwauraia; bena una dina ai hari tau ese dava baine heni, Iehova ena helaḡa ḡauna.
english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.

motu: A Iubile laḡanina ai una tano biaguna korikori, senena amo e abia tauna, ese baine abia lou.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

motu: Dava iboudiai be gabu helaḡana ena sekele ai ba gwauraia: una sekele lalonai gera be ruahui.
english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs + 27:25 A gerah is about 0.5 grams or about 7.7 grains. * to the shekel. + 27:25 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. *

motu: Mauri ḡaudia natudia roboadia be Iehova ena; taunabunai tau ta ese roboa maruanena ta basine hahelaḡaia diba: boromakau natuna roboana eiava mamoe natuna roboana na Iehova ena.
english: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to Yahweh as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is Yahweh’s.

motu: A mauri ḡauna mirona natuna roboana na biaguna ese moni amo baine bodohilaia, dava baine heni, oi ese ba gwauraia heḡereḡerena, bona atokauna danu baine heni. Atokauna na dava idoinai baine karoaia, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau. A basinema bodohilaia, vada ba hoia, moni davana, dava na o gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

motu: Tau ta ese taunimanima ta eiava mauri ḡauna ta eiava tano ta Iehova baine henia vaitani, una na basine hoia diba bona basine bodohilaia diba: unuhetomadia na vada e helaḡa vaitani, Iehova ena.
english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to Yahweh.

motu: Bema taunimanima ta unu bae henia vaitani toma, idia na basie bodohilaia diba: vada bae alaia mase. Ḡau ikaroadia
english: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

motu: Tano anidia, nadinadi eiava huahua, bae karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta bae hahelaḡaia, Iehova ena.
english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

motu: Tau ta baine ura karoa helaḡana baine bodohilaia, ia na davana baine heni mai atokauna ida. Atokauna na dava baine karoa, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau.
english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

motu: Boromakau seridia bona mamoe seridia danu bae karoadia. Ireḡudia tauna ena itotohi henuna amo bae raka hanai; baine duahidia gwauta gwauta amo, bena ihagwautadia na bae helaḡa, Iehova ena.
english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

motu: Basine itaia, namona eiava dikana; bona basine boloa: bema boloa, ḡau ruaosi bema helaḡa. Bona basine bodohilaia diba.
english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

motu: Haheḡani bini, Iehova ese Mose e henia, Sinai ororona ai, Israel taudia edia.
english: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

motu: Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai laḡanina iharuana ena hua iharuana ai, hua dinana gini-gunana ai Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai, hebou kalagana Ialonai.
english: Yahweh + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

motu: E hamaoroa, eto, Israel oreana idoinai ba duahidia, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai. Mamaruane iboudiai ladadia ba tore,
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

motu: laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia iboudiai; Israel tataudia tuari baela diba iboudiai na oi bona Aaron ese ba duahidia, edia orea ta ta ai.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

motu: Iduhu ikwaradia taudia bavabidia, iduhu ta ta ai tatau ta ta bavabidia, idia ese bae durumui.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

motu: Idurumui taudia bini. Ruben ena idudu ai: Elisuru Sedeuru.
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of|strong="H1121" * Reuben|strong="H7205" *: Elizur the|strong="H5975" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Shedeur|strong="H7707" *.

motu: Simeon ena iduhu ai: Selumiele Surisadai,
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

motu: Iuda ena iduhu ai: Nason Aminadab.
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

motu: Isakara ena iduhu ai: Netanele Suara.
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

motu: Sebulun ena iduhu ai: Eliab Helon.
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

motu: Efraim Iosef ena iduhu ai: Elisama Amihud. Manase Iosef ena iduhu ai: Gamaliel Pedasuru.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

motu: Beniamina ena iduhu ai: Abidan Gideoni.
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

motu: Dan ena iduhu ai: Ahiesere Amisadai.
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

motu: Asere ena iduhu ai: Pagiele Okran.
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

motu: Gad ena iduhu ai: Eliasaf Reuele.
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

motu: Napatali ena iduhu ai: Ahira Enan.
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

motu: Tatau bini Israel oreana ai e abidia hidi, edia ruma biagudia bona edia iduhu ikwaradia taudia.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes + 1:16 or, chiefs, or, leaders * of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

motu: Ladadia unu e hatodia toma taudia na Mose bona Aaron ese e abidia.
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

motu: Bena hua iharuana ena dina gini-gunana ai idia ese orea idoinai e haboudia, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia iboudiai na ladadia e tore, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai.
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Mose ese taunimanima unu e duahidia toma, Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

motu: Ruben, Israel natuna roboana, garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 46,500. Ruben iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

motu: Simeon garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 59,300. Simeon iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

motu: Gad garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 45,650. Gad iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

motu: Iuda garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 74,600. Iuda iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

motu: Isakara garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada (Ia e hanai tatudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 54,500, Isakara iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

motu: Sebulun garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 57,400. Sebulun iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

motu: Efraim Iosef garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 40,500. Efraim iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

motu: Manase Iosef garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 32,200. Manase iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

motu: Beniamina garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 35,400. Beniamina iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

motu: Dan garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 62,700. Dan iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

motu: Asere garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 41,500. Asere iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

motu: Napatali garana e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

motu: iboudiai na 53,400. Napatali iduhuna ena numera bunai.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

motu: Mose bona Aaron bona Israel iduhudia ikwaradia taudia gwauta-raruosi ese e duahidia taudia bini.
english: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

motu: Israel besena e duahidia, edia iduhu ai bona tamadia edia ruma ai. Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai tataudia, tuari baela diba,
english: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

motu: iboudiai na 603,550.
english: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

motu: A Levi garana na idia ida asie duahidia hebou.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

motu: Badina be Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Levi iduhuna taudia na Israel taudia ida basio duahidia hebou bona ladadia basio tore hebou.
english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

motu: Levi taudia na ba duanaidia, taravatu mauana dubuna mai kohuna mai ḡauna iboudiai ida bae naridia. Idia ese dubu mai kohuna ida bae huaia lao; bae gimaia bona bae hataruhaia heḡeḡe.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

motu: Taravatu mauana dubuna ba laolaolaia negana ai, Levi taudia ese bae rohoa, ma bae haginia lou; idau iduhu tauna ta baine raka henia kahi, vada bae alaia mase.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

motu: Israel taudia na edia iduhu ta ta ai bae taruha, iduhu ta ta ena taruha ena taruha ai, edia pepe bae ha-oda heḡeḡe.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

motu: A Levi taudia na taravatu mauana dubuna bae taruhaiaheḡeḡe, badu Israel oreana enai ilao-ahuna totona. Taravatu mauana dubunana Levi taudia ese bae naria.
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

motu: Israel taudia na unu e kara toma, Iehova ese Mose e haḡana heḡereḡerena.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.

motu: Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e haḡanidia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Israel taudia na iduhu ta ta ai edia taruha bae hagini, edia iduhu pepedia badibadidiai; taruha iboudiai na hebou kalagana bae vaira henia bona bae ḡeḡea ahu.
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

motu: Mairiveina ai, dina e daemu kahana ai, Iuda taudia bae taruha, edia iduhu pepena badibadinai. Ikwaradia tauna na Nason Aminadab;
english: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 74,600.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

motu: Ia badibadinai Isakara taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Netanele Suara;
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 54,400.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

motu: Ma ia badibadinai na Sebulun taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Eliab Helon;
english: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 57,400.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

motu: Taunabunai Iuda oreana ena tuari taudia ibouboudiai na 186,400. Laolao negadia ai, idia na bae raka lasi guna.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

motu: Diho kahana Ruben taudia edia pepe bae hadaia bona bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Elisuru Sedeuru;
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 46,500.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

motu: Ia badibadinai Simeon taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Selumiele Surisadai;
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 59,300.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

motu: Ma ia badibadinai Gad taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Eliasaf Reuele;
english: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 45,650.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

motu: Taunabunai, Ruben oreana ena tuari taudia ibouboudiai na 151,450. Idia na raka lasi oreana iharuana
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

motu: Idia muridiai Levi taudia ese hebou kalagana bae huaia lasi, edia taruha kalagadia ida; tuari oreadia bogaragidiai bae huaia lao. Iboudiai edia taruha ta ta ai bae raka lasi, orea ta ta ena pepe ena pepe muridiai.
english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

motu: Lahara kahana Efraim taudia edia pepe bae hadaia. Ikwaradia tauna na Elisama Amihud;
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 40,500.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

motu: Ia badibadinai Manase taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Gamaliel Pedasuru;
english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 32,200.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

motu: Ma ia badibadinai Beniamina taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Abidan Gideoni;
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 35,400.
english: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

motu: Taunabunai, Efraim oreana ena tuari taudia ibouboudiai na 108,100. Idia na raka lasi oreana ihatoina.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

motu: Mirigini kahana Dan taudia edia pepe bae hadaia. Ikwaradia tauna na Ahiesere Amisadai;
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 62,700.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

motu: Ia badibadinai Asere taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Pagiele Okran;
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 41,500.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

motu: Ma ia badibadinai Napatali taudia bae taruha. Ikwaradia tauna na Ahira Enan;
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

motu: bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai na 53,400.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

motu: Taunabunai, Dan oreana ena tuari taudia ibouboudiai na 157,600. Idia na raka lasi oreana gini gabena; edia iduhu ta ta ai bae raka lasi.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

motu: Israel taudia edia iduhu ta ta ai e duahidia bini. Tuari taudia, edia iduhu ta ta amo e duahidia, ibouboudiai na 603,550.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

motu: A Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Levi taudia na Israel taudia ida asie duahidia hebou.
english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Israel taudia na unu e kara toma. Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, idia ese edia pepe ta ta badibadidiai e taruha, bona edia orea ta ta ai bona edia iduhu ta ta ai edia taruha amo e raka lasi.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

motu: Aaron bona Mose garadia bini, Iehova ese Mose Sinai ororona ai e hereva henia negana amo.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

motu: Aaron natuna ladadia bini: Nadab, tau roboana, bona Abihu, bona Eleasara, bona Itamara.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

motu: Aaron natuna bunu, e horodia bona e hahelaḡadia, hahelaḡa taudia ai e halaodia.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

motu: A Nadab bona Abihu na Iehova vairanai e mase, Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai, lahi idauna Iehova vairanai e vareailaia negana ai. Idia na asi natudia. Taunabunai, Eleasara bona Itamara ese hahelaḡa ḡaukaradia e karava, tamadia Aaron vairanai.
