english: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh when they offered strange fire before Yahweh in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Levi taudia ba hakaudia mai, hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vairanai bae gini, ia isiaina bae lao heni.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

motu: Ia vairanai bona hebou taudia iboudiai vairadiai hebou kalagana bae reḡua, bona dubu ḡaukaradia bae kara.
english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

motu: Hebou kalagana kohudia iboudiai bae naridia, bona hahelaḡa karadia bae kara dubu ai, Israel taudia daidiai.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

motu: Levi taudia na Aaron mai natuna ida imadia ai bavatodia kau; Israel taudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo idia bavabidia, ia ba henia.
english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida ba gwauraidia hidi, hahelaḡa dagina na ediai baine mia. Idau tauna ta baine raka kahi, vada bae alaia mase.
english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: A itaia, lau ese Levi taudia vada na abidia hidi, Israel taudia bogaragidia amo, Israel taudia edia roboa mamaruanedia ibolodia. Idia na lauegu.
english: “Behold, + 3:12 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

motu: Badina be roboa mamaruanedia be lauegu, Aigupto taudia natudia mamaruanedia roboadia iboudiai na aladia mase dinana ai, lau ese roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai na abidia lauegu, taunimanima natudia roboadia bona mauri ḡaudia iboudiai natudia roboadia. Idia na lauegu: lau binai Iehova.
english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

motu: Levi taudia iboudiai ba duahidia, tamadia edia ruma ai bona edia iduhu ai; hua ta vada - e hanaia mamaruanedia iboudiai ba duahidia.
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese e duahidia, Iehova ese ena hereva ai e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Moses counted them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.

motu: Levi natuna ladadia bini: Gereson bona Kohat bona Merari.
english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

motu: Gereson ese e havaradia iduhudia bini: Libni bona Simei.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

motu: Kohat ese e havaradia iduhudia bini: Amram bona Isahara bona Heberon bona Usiele.
english: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

motu: Merari ese e havaradia iduhudia bini: Mali bona Musi. Levi iduhudia bunu: ihavaradia taudia ladadia e nemaidia.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These|strong="H1992" * are|strong="H1992" * the|strong="H1121" * families|strong="H4940" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H1121" * Levites|strong="H3881" * according to|strong="H1121" * their|strong="H1992" * fathers’ houses|strong="H1004" *.

motu: Gereson garana na Libni taudia bona Simei taudia: Gereson iduhudia bunu.
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

motu: Edia mamaruane e duahidia, hua ta e hanaia amo, iboudiai na 7,500.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

motu: Gereson taudia edia taruha gabuna be dubu murina, lahara kahana ai.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

motu: Ikwaradia tauna na Eliasaf Laele.
english: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

motu: Hebou kalagana lalonai Gereson taudia bae reḡu ḡaudia bini: dubu bona kalaga dabuadia, bona guhi dabuadia, bona kalaga iduarana dabuadia,
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

motu: bona maḡu dabuadia, bona dubu maḡuna ikoukouna dabuadia, bona ihaboulaina patana, bona kwanau iboudiai. Bae reḡu ḡaudia bunu.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

motu: Kohat garana na Amram taudia bona Isahara taudia bona Heberon taudia bona Usiele taudia: Kohat iduhuna bunu.
english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

motu: Edia mamaruane e duahidia, hua ta e hanaia amo, iboudiai na 8,600; idia na dubu inarina taudia.
english: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

motu: Kohat taudia edia taruha gabuna be dubu diho kahana ai.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

motu: Ikwaradia tauna na Elisafan Usiele.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

motu: Bae reḡu ḡaudia bini: maua helaḡana, bona pata helaḡana, bona lamepa patana bona ihaboulaina patadia, bona gabu helaḡana ena kohu iboudiai, hahelaḡa taudia ese kara helaḡadia e karalaimu ḡaudia, bona seseahu. Bae reḡu ḡaudia bunu.
english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

motu: Eleasara, hahelaḡa tauna, Aaron natuna, na Levi taudia iboudiai ikwaradia, bona gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia ikaradia taudia edia heitatao tauna.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

motu: Merari garana na Mali taudia bona Musi taudia: Merari iduhudia bunu.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

motu: Edia mamaruane e duahidia, hua ta e hanaia amo, iboudiai na 6,200.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred. + 3:34 + 22,000 is the sum rounded to 2 significant digits. The sum of the Gershonites, Kohathites, and Merarites given above is 22,300, but the traditional Hebrew text has the number rounded to 2 significant digits, not 3 significant digits. *

motu: Ikwaradia tauna na Suriele Abihaili. Edia taruha gabuna na dubu mirigini kahana ai.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

motu: Bae reḡu ḡaudia bini: dubu habana kahadia, bona raroraro, bona ihua-ihua, bona hahelai-kau ḡaudia mai kohudia iboudiai;
english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

motu: bona maḡu duna iboudiai mai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia, bona edia ikokobona edia kwanau.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

motu: Dubu mairiveina kahana ai bae taruah taudia, hebou kalagana vairanai, dina e daemu kahana ai, be Mose bona Aaron mai natuna ida. Idia ese gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia bae kara, Israel taudia daidiai. Idau tauna ta baine raka kahi, vada bae alaia mase.
english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

motu: Levi taudia, Mose bona Aaron ese iduhu ta ta amo e duahidia, Iehova ena haheḡani dainai, ibouboudiai, hua ta e hanaia amo, na 22,000. Roboa mamaruanedia ibololaidia
english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Israel taudia natudia mamaruanedia roboadia ba duahidia, bona ladadia ba tore, hua ta vada e hanaia amo.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

motu: Bena Levi taudia bavabidia, lau Iehova egu, hari Israel taudia natudia mamaruanedia roboadia ibololaidia; Levi taudia edia boromakau danu bavabidia, Israel taudia edia boromakau natudia mamaruanedia roboadia ibololaidia.
english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am Yahweh—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese Israel taudia natudia mamaruanedia roboadia e duahidia, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

motu: Roboa mamaruanedia dia iboudiai hua ta e hanaia amo, e duahidia bona ladadia e tore. Ibouboudiai na 22,273.
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Levi taudia bavabidia, Israel taudia natudia mamaruanedia roboadia ibololaidia, bona Levi taudia edia boromakau bavabidia, edia boromakau ibololaidia. Levi taudia na lauegu: lau binai Iehova.
english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.

motu: A Israel taudia natudia mamaruanedia roboadia sinahu-rua hitu-ahui toi asi ibololaidia Levi oreana amo be davadia bakara:
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

motu: ta ta amo sekele ima ima amo ba heni. Unu sekele be gabu helaḡana ena sekele: sekele ta lalonai gera + 3:47 “Sekele” bona “gera” be Heberu taudia edia metau hahetoho ḡaudia. Sekele ena metau be 16 grams sisivana. Sekele ta lalonai gera be ruahui. * be ruahui.
english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel + 3:47 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs + 3:47 A gerah is about 0.5 grams or about 7.7 grains. *);

motu: Bena una moni, hari roboa mamaruanedia ese Levi taudia e hereadia taudia davadia, be Aaron mai natuna ida ba henidia.
english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

motu: Taunabunai hari Levi taudia ese asie bololaidia taudia davadia be Mose ese e abi,
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

motu: Israel taudia natudia mamaruanedia roboadia edia amo, sekele daha-ta sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui ima, gabu helaḡanaena sekele heḡereḡerena.
english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, + 3:50 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1365 shekels is about 13.65 kilograms or about 30 pounds. * according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

motu: Bena Mose ese una moni na Aaron mai natuna ida e henidia, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to Yahweh’s word, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: A Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e haḡanidia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Levi garana bogaragidia amo Kohat garana ba duahidia, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

motu: Laḡani toi-ahui ela bona laḡani imahui taudia, hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia bae kara diba taudia iboudiai na ba duahidia.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Kohat garana edia ḡaukara binai hebou kalagana lalonai: helaḡa herea ḡaudia bae reḡu.
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

motu: Taruha irohona negana ai, Aaron mai natuna ida bae raka vareai, seseahu bae kokia oho, taravatu mauana bae ḡovalaia.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

motu: Bena nani kopina amo ma bae ḡovaia, ma ia murimurinai dabua vaiurina amo bae ḡovaia. Ena maduna danu bae toi hanai.
english: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

motu: Bena vairagu ai a atoamu flaoana patana na dabua vaiurina amo bae Iahaia; ia latanai mereki bona nau bona bio bona kehere bae laidia, bona flaoa helaḡana danu bae laia kau.
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

motu: Bena dabua kakakakana amo bae ḡovadia ahu, bona ia latanai nani kopina. Ena maduna danu bae toi hanai.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

motu: Bena dabua vaiurina bae abia, lamepa patana mai ena lamepa bona ihaḡoevadia ḡaudia bona momoru iudadia merekidia bona dehoro kavabudia iboudiai bae kumilai.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

motu: Bena nani kopina amo ma bae kumidia, bona ihualaina patana ai bae hiri kau.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

motu: Gold * patana na dabua vaiurina amo bae ḡovaia ahu, bena nani kopina bae kumilaia bona ena maduna bae toi hanai.
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

motu: Bena gabu helaḡana kohudia iboudiai dabua vaiurina ai bae kumidia, ma nani kopina ai bae kumidia, bena ihualaina patana ai bae hiri kau.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

motu: Una murinai ihaboulaina patana kahuna bae negea, bona ihaboulaina patana na dabua mia-kakana amo bae lahaia.
english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

motu: Bena una dabua latanaiihaboulaina patana kohudia iboudiai bae lai kau: rahurahu bona kahi bona kahu iudalaina urodia bona ikadolaina gagadia. Bena idoinai na nani kopina amo ba ḡovaia ahu, bona maduna ba toi hanai.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida hari gabu helaḡana mai kohuna idoinai bae kumi vaitani, bena Israel taudia ese edia kalaga bae hua negana ai Kohat garana ese ihuadia totona bae raka kahi mai; ḡau tamona, ḡau helaḡana ta basie daua toho, bae mase na garina. Kohat garana edia huahua ḡaudia bunu, hebou kalagana lalona amo.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Aaron natuna Eleasara baine reḡu ḡaudia na lamepa dehorona, bona muramura mai bonadia, bona boubou flaoana, bona dehoro helaḡana. Ia ese danu dubu mai kohuna idoinai bona gabu helaḡana mai kohuna idoinai baine ita tao.
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hamaorodia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Kohat taudia na Levi oreana amo basio negedia daure;
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

motu: a ini ba karadia toma, basie mase to bae mauri helaoreana, ḡau helaḡadia bae raka henidia kahi negana ai: Aaron mai natuna ida bae raka vareai, ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara, bona ta ta ena maduna ena maduna, bae henidia;
english: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

motu: a idia be basie raka vareai, ḡau helaḡadia basie haḡeredia, lasi ona lasi vaitani, bae mase na garina.
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e haḡania, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Gereson garana ba duahidia, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

motu: Laḡani toi-ahui elabona laḡani imahui taudia, hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia bae kara diba taudia iboudiai, na bae duahidia.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Gereson garana edia ḡaukara, bae kara karadia bona bae hua ḡaudia, bini:
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

motu: dubu habana dabuadia, bona hebou kalagana mai guhina ida bona nani kopidia ia latanai heheato danu, bona hebou kalagana iduarana dabuadia,
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

motu: bona maḡu dabuadia, bona dubu bona ihaboulaina patana e ḡeḡedia ahumu maḡuna dabuadia, bona maḡu ikoukouna dabuadia, bona edia kwanau, bona edia ḡaukara ikaralaidia kohudia iboudiai. Unu kohu iḡaukaralaidia ḡaukaradia iboudiai idia ese bae kara.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

motu: Gereson taudia edia ḡaukara bona edia kohu ihuadia idoidiai na Aaron mai natuna ida ese bae hadibadia; umui ese ba haḡanidia, dahaka dahaka bae kara bona dahaka dahaka bae hua.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

motu: Gereson taudia edia ḡaukara bunu, hebou kalagana lalonai. Hahelaḡa tauna Aaron natuna Itamara ese baine itadia tao.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

motu: Merari garana ba duahidia, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai.
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

motu: Laḡani toi-ahui ela bona laḡani imahui taudia, hebou kalaganaḡaukaradia bae kara diba taudia iboudiai, na bae duahidia.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Edia ḡaukara hebou kalagana Ialonai be dubu habana kahadia, bona raroraro, bona ihua-ihuamai ihahelai-kaudia ḡaudia ida, bae hua.
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

motu: Maḡu dudia danu mai ihahelaikaudia ḡaudia ida, bona ikoko, bona kwanau, bona maḡu kohuna idoinai bona ihaginina ḡaudia iboudiai, idia ese bae hua; ta ta ena maduna ena maduna ba duanailai henidia.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.

motu: Merari taudia edia ḡaukara hebou kalagana ai bunai; hahelaḡa tauna Aaron natuna Itamara ese baine itadia tao.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose bona Aaron bona hebou ikwaradia taudia ese Kohat taudia e duahidia, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai;
english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

motu: Laḡani toi-ahui ela bona laḡani imahui taudia, hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia ikaradiamai dibadia taudia iboudiai, na e duahidia.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Iboudiai na 2,750.
english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

motu: Kohat taudia edia numera bunai, Mose bona Aaron ese iduhu ta ta amo hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia ikaradia mai dibadia taudia e duahidia negana ai. Iehova ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, idia ese unu e duahidia toma.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

motu: Gereson taudia danu, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai, e duahidia;
english: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

motu: laḡani toi-ahui ela bona laḡani imahui taudia, heboukalagana ḡaukaradia ikaradia mai dibadia taudia iboudiai, e duahidia.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

motu: Iboudiai na 2,630.
english: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

motu: Gereson taudia edia numera bunai, Mose bona Aaron ese iduhu ta ta amo hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia ikaradia mai dibadia taudia e duahidia negana ai. Iehova ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, idia ese unu e duahidia toma.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh.

motu: Merari taudia danu, edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai e duahidia,
english: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

motu: laḡani toi-ahui ela bona laḡani imahui taudia, hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia ikaradia mai dibadia taudia.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

motu: Iboudiai na 3,200.
english: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

motu: Merari taudia edia numera bunai, Mose bona Aaron ese e duahidia negana ai. Iehova ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, idia ese unu e duahidia toma.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

motu: Levi taudia ibouboudiai, Mose bona Aaron bona Israel ikwaradia taudia ese edia iduhu ta ta ai, ta ta tamadia edia ruma ai, e duahidia,
english: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,

motu: laḡani toi-ahui ela bona laḡani imahui taudia, hebou kalagana ḡaukaradiaikaradia mai dibadia bona madunadia ihuadia mai goadadia taudia.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

motu: Iboudiai na 8,580.
english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, idia ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara bona ena maduna ena maduna e henidia. Unuhetomana Mose ese e duahidia, Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba haḡanidia, lepra taudia iboudiai bona hura-aru taudia iboudiai bona mase ḡaudia ediaie dau kau dainai e taubu taudia iboudiai na taruha murimurina bae siaidia lao.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.

motu: Iboudiai, mamaruane bona hahine, na taruha murimurinai bae raka lasi, lau na noholaiamu taruhana bae hamiroa na garina.
english: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia unu e karadia toma; taruha murimurina e siaidia lao, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena. Kara dika davana
english: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, tau ta eiava hahine ta baine kara dika, Iehova vairanai baine kerere,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty,

motu: ia ese ena kara dika baine gwauraia hedinarai, bona ena kara dika ai e hadikaia tauna davana baine henia mai atokauna ida. Atokauna na davana korikori bema karoa, karoa ima, bena karoa ta heḡereḡerena ma baine atoa kau.
english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

motu: A bema asi dalana ia baine henia eiava varavarana ta baine henia, davana na Iehova baine henia, hahelaḡa tauna ena, bona ena herohemaino boubouna mamoena danu.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

motu: Bona Israel taudia edia helaḡa ḡaudia iboudiai Iehova vairanai bae dudui isi na hahelaḡa tauna ese baine abi, ia ana.
english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai edia helaḡa ḡaudia hahelaḡa tauna bae henia na iena ḡau. Mama Herevadia
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, hahine ta baine kerere,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

motu: tau ta ida bae heuda hanai; bena baine hunia, adavana asi dibana, tau ta asi dibana, ta danu basine davaria;
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

motu: to adavana baine mama, baine mama henia mai badina eiava baine mama henia asi badina;
english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

motu: una tau ese bali flaoana efa + 5:15 “Bali” na flaoa ikaralaina reina ta, uit bamona. “Efa” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta ladana. * ta baine karoa, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta asi dehorona bona asi muramurana baine abia kau, bona hahine baine hakaua lao, hahelaḡa tauna dekenai. Bena hari flaoa baine henia, mama boubouna, kara kerere ilalolaina.
english: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah + 5:15 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese hahine baine boiria, baine raka kahi mai Iehova vairanai.
english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna na ranu helaḡa baine abia, raro biona ta ai, bona tano ḡahuna taina dubu lalona amo una ranu ai baine udaia.
english: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

motu: Bena ia ese hahine huina baine ruhaia, Iehova vairanai; bona hari flaoa, mama boubouna bona kerere ilalolaina ḡauna, na hahine imana ai baine atoa. A hahelaḡa tauna ese hari ranu iditana, hahedika ḡauna, na ia sibona imana ai baine abia.
english: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

motu: Bena ia ese hahine baine taravaia, baineto “Bema adavamu so koia, tau ta ida so heuda hanai, ina ranu iditana, ena be hahedika ḡauna, to basine hadikamu;
english: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

motu: a bema adavamu o koia, tau ta ida o heuda hanai”
english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

motu: (hahelaḡa tauna ese hahine ma baine taravaia, baineto) “Iehova ese kara havara toana bona taravatu itata-utuna toanaai baine halaomu emu bese taudia bogaragidiai; mamumu ruaosi bae mase, bona bogamu baine gudu;
english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May Yahweh make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahweh allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

motu: momokani, ina hahedika ranuna na bogamu ai baine diho negana ai, bogamu do baine gudu, bona mamumu ruaosi bae mase”. Bena hahine na baineto “Amen, amen”.
english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

motu: Una murinai hahelaḡa tauna na unu hahedika herevadia buka ai baine tore, bena una revareva na hari ranu iditana amo ma baine huria heroho.
english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

motu: Bena una ranu iditana na ia ese hahine baine henia, baine inua totona. Baine inua, bena una hahedika ranuna na ia bogana ai baine idita.
english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

motu: A guna, hahelaḡa tauna ese mama boubouna flaoana na hahine imana amo baine abia, Iehova vairanai baine davea; bena baine laohaia ihaboulaina patana badibadinai.
english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before Yahweh, and bring it to the altar.

motu: Bena flaoa taina imana ai baine abia, ihaboulaina patana lahina ai baine haḡolea oho, helalo ḡauna; una murinai hahine ese una ranu iditana baine inua.
english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

motu: Bema una hahine ese adavana vada e koia, tau ta ida vada e heuda hanai, una ranu iditana baine inua bona bogana ai baine diho negana ai bogana baine gudu bona mamuna bae mase; bena hahedika toana ai bainela, ena bese taudia bogaragidiai.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

motu: A bema asi ena kerere, ia na basine dika; baine mauri, bona baine rogorogo, natuna baine abidia.
english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring. + 5:28 or, seed *

motu: Mama taravatuna bunai, hahine ta ese adavana baine koia, tau ta ida bae heuda hanai,
english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

motu: eiava tau ta ese adavana baine mama henia, taravatuna. Ia ese Iehova vairanai baine atoa; bena hahelaḡa tauna ese hari taravatu karana baine karaia.
english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before Yahweh, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

motu: Bena hari tau na asi ena kerere; a una hahine be ena kerere davana baine huaia.
english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, tau ta eiava hahine ta baine gwau hamata, Nasiri gwau-hamatana baineabia, ia na baine helaḡa, Iehova ena.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to Yahweh,

motu: Ia ese vine ranuna eiava kekero ḡauna ta basine inua; inuinu ḡaudia unuhetomadia iboudiai basine inu. Vine huahuadia ranudia basine inu, bona anidia basine ani; vine huahuadia matamatadia eiava kaukaudia basine ani.
english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

motu: Ena helaḡa dinadia iboudiai vine anidia, nadinadidia ela kopidia, na basine ani.
english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

motu: Ena helaḡa dinadia iboudiai danu huina iutuna eiava kwarana inauna aurina na ia kwarana ai basine dau kau. Iehova e gwaurai henia hamata dinadia iboudiai ia na baine helaḡa; huina do baine lata.
english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

motu: Ena helaḡa dinadia iboudiai danu ia ese mase tauna ta basine raka henia kahi.
english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to Yahweh he shall not go near a dead body.

motu: Ena be tamana eiava sinana eiava taihuna eiava tadikakana baine mase, to mase tauna enai basine miro; badina be vada e gwau hamata, baine helaḡa Iehova ena.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God + 6:7 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * is on his head.

motu: Taunabunai, ena gwau-hamata dinadia iboudiaiia na helaḡa, Iehova ena.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.

motu: A tau ta ia badibadinai bema mase taku, bena unu amo baine miro, dina hitu na baela, bena dina ihahituna ai ihaḡoevana dinana ai, ia ese kwarana baine naua.
english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, ia ese kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua baine abidia, hahelaḡa tauna dekena baine mailaidia, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine hahelaḡadia, ta kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna, ma ta ḡole-oho boubouna, una tau dainai herohemaino karana baine karaia; badina be ia na una mase dainai vada e kerere. Una dina ai, ia ese kwarana baine hahelaḡaia lou;
english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

motu: baine helaḡa, Iehova ena, ena gwau-hamata dinadia iboudiai. Mamoemaruanena ta, laḡani tamona ḡauna, danu baine mailaia, kerere iabi-ohona boubouna ai bainela. A dina gunadia be basine duahidia, badina be ena gwauhamata vada e dika.
english: He shall separate to Yahweh the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

motu: Nasiri tauna ese ena gwau-hamata dinadia baine haḡuḡurudia taravatuna binai: bae hakaua lao hebou kalagana iduarana ai;
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

motu: unuseni ai, ia ese ena herahia ḡaudia Iehova baine henia, mamoe natuna maruanena ta, asi bebeka-bebekana, laḡani tamona ḡauna, na ḡole-oho boubouna ai baine halaoa; bonamamoe natuna hahinena ta, asi bebeka-bebekana, laḡani tamona ḡauna, nakara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna ai baine halaoa; bona mamoe maruanenata, asi bebeka-bebekana, na herohemaino boubouna ai baine halaoa;
english: and he shall offer his offering to Yahweh: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,

motu: bona flaoa, asie hatubua ḡauna, boseana ta, lalonai be flaoa atagadia, flaoa namo-hereana dehoro ida e bulo bena e gabu ḡaudia, bona flaoa atagadia, latadiai dehoro e seia ḡaudia, bona flaoa boubouna, bona vine ranuna boubouna.
english: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese Iehova vairanai baine atodia: kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna bona ḡole-oho boubouna baine hahelaḡadia;
english: The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

motu: herohemaino mamoena danu baine hahelaḡaia, Iehova ena; bona asie hatubua flaoana boseana bona flaoa boubouna bona vine ranuna boubouna, iboudiai baine hahelaḡadia, hahelaḡa tauna ese.
english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

motu: Una murinai hari Nasiri tauna ese kwarana baine naua, hebou kalagana iduarana ai; bona huina, ena gwauhamata toana, na herohemaino bouboudia lahina ai baine gabua.
english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese mamoe maruanena larolarona maedana baine abia, bona flaoa dehoro ida e buloa atagana ta bona latanai dehoro e seia atagana ta danu baine abidia, hari Nasiri tauna imana ruaosi ai baine ato kau, kwarana baine naua murinai.
english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese baine abidia lou, Iehova vairanai baine davedia: una na hahelaḡa tauna ahuna helaḡana. Keme, e davea ḡauna, bona mamu, e duduia isi ḡauna, danu ia ahuna. Una murinai hari Nasiri tauna na vine ranuna baine inua.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

motu: Nasiri gwau-hamatana e abiamu tauna taravatuna bunai; ena boubou, Iehova baine henia ḡaudia, taravatudia danu unuheto. Ma boubou haida baine heni danu namo. E gwauraia; hamata heḡereḡerena, unu baine kara toma Nasiri taravatuna ihaḡuḡuruna. Iehova ena Hahenamo
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida ba hamaorodia, Israel taudia bae hanamodia negadia ai, ini bae gwau toma:
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

motu: Iehova ese baine hanamomui, bona baine gimamui;
english: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

motu: Iehova ese ia vairana diarina amo baine hadiarimui, bona baine harihari henimui;
english: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3068" * gracious|strong="H2603" * to|strong="H3068" * you|strong="H6440" *.

motu: Iehova ese baine haḡeremui, bona maino baine henimui.
english: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and|strong="H3068" * give|strong="H7760" * you|strong="H6440" * peace|strong="H7965" *.’

motu: Lau ladagu unu bae gwauraia toma Israel taudia latadiai; bena lau ese baina hanamodia.
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

motu: Mose ese dubu e haginia vaitani dinana ai, ia ese dubu mai kohuna idoinai dehoro amo e horodia bona e hahelaḡadia; ihaboulaina patana danu mai kohuna idoinai dehoro amo e horodia bona e hahelaḡadia.
english: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

motu: Una dina ai danu Israel lohiadia, iduhu ikwaradia taudia, e duahidia taudia iboudiai biagudia, ese
english: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

motu: edia herahia ḡaudia e mailaidia, Iehova vairanai e atodia. Ḡaudia be rerue mai rumarumadia tauratoi bona boromakau mamaruanedia dia gwauta rua: lohia rarua rarua amo rerue ta ta, bona lohia ta ta amo boromakau mamaruanena ta ta; idia ese dubu vairanai e hahelaḡadia.
english: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Edia herahia ḡaudia bavabi, hebou kalagana ena ḡaukara ḡaudia ai baela. Levi taudia ba henidia, ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara heḡereḡeredia.
english: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese rerue bona boromakau e abidia, Levi taudia e henidia.
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

motu: Rerue rua bona boromakau mamaruanedia hani Gereson natuna e henidia, edia ḡaukara heḡereḡerena;
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

motu: ma rerue hani bona boromakau mamaruanedia taurahani Merari natuna e henidia, edia ḡaukara heḡereḡerena: unu ḡaukara be Itamara, hahelaḡa tauna Aaron natuna, ese e biagudia.
english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

motu: A Kohat natuna be ḡau ta se henidia, badina be edia ḡaukara be dubu kohudia helaḡadia paḡadia ai bae hua.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

motu: Hari lohia taudia ese danu edia herahia ḡaudia haida ma e mailaidia, ihaboulaina patana ihahelaḡana totona ihaboulaina patana dehoro amo e horoa dinana ai. Unu herahia na ihaboulaina patana vairanai e atodia diho.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Dina ta ta ai lohia ta ta ena herahia ena herahia bae hahelaḡadia, unu amo ihaboulaina patana baine helaḡa.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

motu: Dina gini-gunana ai Nason Aminadab, Iuda iduhuna tauna, ese ena herahia e hahelaḡaia.

motu: Israel lohiadia na ihaboulaina patana ihahelaḡana herahiadia e heni, dehoro amo e horoa dinana ai, ḡaudia bini: silver * merekidia gwauta-rua; silver * kibokibodia gwauta-rua; gold * naudia gwauta-rua.
english: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

motu: Silver * merekidiata ta ena metau ena metau be sekele sinahu-ta toi-ahui; bona silver * kibokibodiata ta ena metau ena metau be sekele hitu-ahui. Silver * ḡaudia iboudiai ediametau idoinai be sekele daha-rua sinahu-hani, gabu helaḡana ena sekele + 7:85 bona siri haida ai: “Sekele” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta. Sekele ta anina be 16 grams sisivana. * heḡereḡerena.
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

motu: Hari gold * naudia gwauta-ruaosi, muramura mai bonadiae honu ḡaudia, ta ta ena metau ena metau be sekele gwauta, gabu helaḡana ena sekele heḡereḡerena; gold * ḡaudia iboudiai edia metau idoinai be sekele sinahu-ta ruahui.
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

motu: Boromakau mamaruanedia, ḡole-oho boubouna ḡaudia, iboudiai begwauta-rua; mamoe mamaruanedia danu gwauta-rua, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, be gwauta-rua, mai flaoa bouboudiaida e heni. Nani mamaruanedia, kara-dika iabi-ohona bouboudia ḡaudia, na gwauta-rua danu.
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

motu: Boromakau mamaruanedia, herohemaino bouboudia ḡaudia, na ruahui hani; mamoe mamaruanedia na tauratoi-ahui; nani mamaruanedia na tauratoi-ahui; mamoe natudia mamarua nedia, laḡani tamonaḡaudia, danu tauratoi-ahui. Ihaboulaina patana ihahelaḡana herahiadia bunu, dehoro amo e horoa dinana ai e heni.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

motu: Mose na hebou kalagana lalonai e raka vareai, Iehova ida bae herevahereva eto. Una negana ai Iehova gadona e kamonai, taravatu mauana ikaruhina daena amo bona kerubi ruaosi padadia amo ema, e hereva henia.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Aaron ba hamaoroa, lamepa na gabudia ai baine atodia negana ai, lamepa hituosi na lamepa patana vairana kahana bae.
english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

motu: Bena Aaron na unu e kara toma: lamepa na gabudia e ato, lamepa patana vairana kahana e hadiaria, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Hari lamepa na gold * amo e koroa, aena ela bona heraherana, idoinai na gold * amo e koroa; Iehova ese Mose e hadibalaia heḡereḡerena, hari lamepa patana na unu e koroa toma.
english: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Levi taudia na Israel taudia bogaragidia amo bavabidia, ba haḡoevadia.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

motu: Ini ba haḡoevadia toma: ranu helaḡana amo ba nevaridia; bena kopidia idoidiai bae naudia, edia dabua bae huridia, bona bae digu.
english: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

motu: Una murinai idia ese boromakau natuna maruanena ta bae abia, mai ena flaoa boubouna ida, flaoa namohereana dehoro ida e buloa ḡauna. Boromakau natuna maruanena ma ta danu bavabia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna.
english: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

motu: Bena Levi taudia nahebou kalagana vairanai ba hakaudia lasi; bona Israel oreana taudia iboudiai ba haboudia.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

motu: Bena Levi taudia na Iehova vairanai ba haginidia. Israel taudia ese imadia na Levi taudia latadiai bae ato kau;
english: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

motu: bena Aaron ese Levi taudia baine abidia, davedave boubouna ai baine halaodia, Israel taudia edia amo, Iehova isiaina bae lao heni totona.
english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.

motu: Bena Levi taudia ese imadia na boromakau mamaruanedia kwaradia ai bae ato kau; ta kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna ai ba halaoa, ma ta ḡole-oho boubouna ai ba halaoa, Iehova ena, Levi taudia daidiai herohemaino karana ba karaia.
english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

motu: Bena Levi taudia na Aaron mai natuna ida vairadiai ba haginidia, davedave boubouna ai baela Iehova ena.
english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.

motu: Levi taudia na Israel taudia bogaragidia amo unu ba hididia toma; idia na lauegu.
english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

motu: Una negana ai, ba haḡoevadia bona davedave boubouna ai ba halaodia murinai, idia na hebou kalagana lalonai bae raka vareai, bona ḡaukarana bae karaia.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

motu: Badina be Israel taudia bogaragidia amo vada o henigu; Israel hahinedia iboudiai natudia mamaruanedia roboadia ibolodia vada na abidia.
english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

motu: Badina be roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai Israel ai na lauegu, taunimanima natudia roboadia bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia natudia roboadia; Aigupto tanona ai roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai na aladia mase dinana ai na hahelaḡadia lauegu.
english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

motu: A Israel edia roboa mamaruanedia ibolodia na Levi taudia vada na abidia,
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

motu: Aaron mai natuna ida vada na henidia, Israel taudia bogaragidia; amo; hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia bae kara idia daidiai, bona Israel taudia daidiai herohemaino karana bae karaia, gabu helaḡana bae raka henia kahi bena gorere ese baine aladia na garina.
english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

motu: Ini kara iboudiai Mose bona Aaron bona Israel oreana taudia iboudiai ese Levi taudia e kara henidia; Iehova ese Levi taudia herevadia Mose e haḡanilaia heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia na unu e kara toma.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

motu: Levi taudia ese edia kara-dika amo e haheḡoeva bona edia dabua e huri; bena Aaron ese davedave boubouna ai e halaodia, Iehova vairanai. Aaron ese herohemaino karana vada, e karaia, idia daidiai, idia ihaḡoevadia totona.
english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

motu: Una murinai Levi taudia na hebou kalagana ai e raka vareai, Aaron mai natuna ida idurulaida ḡaukaradia e kara; Iehova ese Levi taudia herevadia Mose e haḡanilaia heḡereḡerena, idia na unu e kara toma.
english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Levi taudia herevadia bini edia vara laḡanidia bae ruahui ima negana ai bae ḡaukara matama, hebou kalagana lalonai;
english: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

motu: ela bona edia vara laḡanidia bae imahui negana ai ḡaukara na bae rakatania, basie karaia lou.
english: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

motu: Una murinai, idia ese varavaradia bae bamodia, hebou kalagana ireḡuna ai, to basie ḡaukara. Levi taudia edia ḡaukara na unu ba henidia toma.
english: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

motu: Israel taudia ese Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi murinai, laḡani iharuana ena hua gini-gunana ai Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia Sinai tano ḡaḡaenaai,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

motu: eto, Israel taudia ese lagau-hanai ariana bae badinaia, ena nega korikoriai.
english: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

motu: Una hua ena dina ihagwauta-hanina adorahina ai ba karaia, ena nega korikorina ai, taravatuna iboudiai heḡereḡerena.
english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese Israel taudia e haḡanidia, lagau-hanai ariana bae karaia eto.
english: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

motu: Bena hua gini-gunana ena dina ihagwauta-hanina adorahina ai lagau-hanai ariana e karaia, Sinai tano ḡaḡaena ai; Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia karadia iboudiai na a Israel taudia ese e karadia ḡuḡuru.
english: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

motu: A tatau haida vada e taubu, mase tauna enai vada e dau kau dainai, taunabunai idia na mai edia hekwakwanai lagau-hanai ibadinana ai una dina ai, bena idia ese Mose bona Aaron dekedia ela una dina ai.
english: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

motu: Idia ese Mose e hamaoroa eto, Ai a taubu, mase tauna enai vada a dau kau dainai. Badina be dahaka ai ese Iehova basia boua diba, nega korikorina ai, Israel taudia iboudiai ida
english: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

motu: Mose ese e haere henidia, eto, Do ba noho, ela bona lau baina kamonai, Iehova ede baine haḡanilaigu toma umui daimui ai.
english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ena be umui emui ai eiava garamui ediai tau ta baine taubu, mase tauria enai baine dau kau dainai, eiava dauhai baine laolao, to ia be Iehova ena lagau-hanai ariana baine badinaia.
english: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to Yahweh.

motu: Idia ese hua iharuana ena dinaihagwauta-hanina adorahina ai bae karaia; mai flaoana, asie hatubua ḡauna, bona mai aniani avadia iditadia ida do bae ania.
english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

motu: Bahu basine mia rani, turiana ta danu basie hakwaidua; lagau-hanai taravatudia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ai bae karaia.
english: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

motu: A tau ta se miromu eiava se laolaomu to lagau-hanai ariana basine badinaia, una tau be ena bese amo bae negea daure; badina be Iehova se boua, nega korikorina ai. Una tau be ena dika do baine huaia.
english: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

motu: Bema idau tauna ta dekemui ai baine noho hedoa, bena ia baine ura Iehova ena lagau-hanai ariana baine ania, lagau-hanai taravatudia heḡereḡeredia, ia be baine ania diba. Emui taravatu baine tamona, noho-hedoa taudia bona bese korikori taumui. Ori ese dubu e ḡovaia ahu
english: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to Yahweh, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”

motu: Dubu e haginia dinana ai, ori ese dubu, taravatu mauana kalagana, e ḡovaia ahu, ela bona hanua e boi, bena ita-itana na lahi na heto ela bonadaba e rere, dubu daenai.
english: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

motu: Nega idoinai unu mo heto, ori ese e ḡovaia ahu dina ai bona lahi hanuaboi ai.
english: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

motu: Bena ori ese kalaga e daetania negadia ai, Israel taudia na e tore isi, edia laolao ela; a ori e diho henia gabuna ai, Israel taudia na unuseni ai e taruha.
english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

motu: Iehova ena haheḡani dainai Israel taudia na e tore isi, bona Iehova ena haheḡani dainai idia na e taruha ori ese dubu e ḡovaia ahuva negana lalonai, idia na taruha ai e nohova.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of Yahweh they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

motu: Ena be ori ese dina hoho dubu e ḡovaia ahu, to Israel taudia ese Iehova ena haheḡani e laloa tao, bena asie tore isi.
english: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.

motu: Nega haida ori ese dina dia hoho dubu e ḡovaia ahu; bena Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena taruha ai e nohova, ma Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e tore isi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Yahweh they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Yahweh they traveled.

motu: Ma nega haida ori na adorahi ai e diho, e mia rani; daba ai ma e dae, bena idia na e tore isi. Eiava dina ta hanuaboi ta e miava, bena e daetanidia negana ai idia na e tore isi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

motu: ori ese dubu e ḡovaia ahu negana bema dina rua, eiava hua ta, eiava nega daudau, to Israel taudia taruha ai e nohova, asie tore isi; a e daetanidia negana ai idia na e tore isi.
english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

motu: Iehova ena haheḡani dainai e taruha, ma Iehova ena haheḡani dainai e tore isi; idia ese Iehova ena haheḡani e badinaia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Kibi rua ba kara, silver * amo ba korodia. Reḡedia na taunimanima ihaboudia bona taruha ikokina toadia ai baela.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

motu: Kibi ruaosi bae hiriri negadia ai, taunimanima iboudiai na dekemu ai bae hebou, hebou kalagana iduarana ai.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: A tamona bae hiriria negadia ai, bese lohiadia, Israel iduhudia ikwaradia, na dekemu ai bae hebou.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

motu: Kibi bae hiriri lalo-dika negana ai, mairiveina kahana taruhana bae kokia, bae huaia lao.
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

motu: Nega iharuana ma bae hiriri lalo-dika negana ai, diho kahana taruhana bae kokia, bae huaia lao. Hari kibi reḡedia be edia tore-isitoana.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

motu: A taunimanima ihaboudia ba ura negadia ai, kibi na bae hiriri, to basie hiriri lalo-dika.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia, Aaron garana, ese kibi bae hiriri: emui kibi taravatuna bunai, ela bona uru iboudiai.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

motu: Inaimui ese bema hadikamui emui tano ai, bena boma tuari henidia, una negana ai kibi boma hiriri lalo-dika; bena Iehova emui Dirava ese baine lalomui, bona inaimui imadia amo baine hamaurimui.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

motu: Emui moale dinadia ai danu, bona emui aria dinadia ai, eiava hua matamata negadia ai, emui ḡole-oho bouboudia bona emui herohemaino bouboudia ba hahelaḡadiamai kibi ihiriridia ida; unu amo emui Dirava ese baine lalomui tao. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava. Israel taudia Sinai e rakatania
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

motu: Laḡani iharuana ai, hua iharuana dinana iharuahuina ai, ori ese taravatu mauana dubuna e daetania.
english: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

motu: Israel taudia ese Sinai tano ḡaḡaena e rakatania, eha laolao, ela bona ori na Paran tano ḡaḡaena ai e diho.
english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

motu: Edia laolao gini-gunana binai, Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia dalana amo e laolaova.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

motu: Guna Iuda taruhana taudia edia orea ta ta amo edia pepe murina amo e raka; edia orea e gunalaidia tauna na Nason Aminadab.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

motu: Isakara taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Netanele Suara.
english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

motu: Sebulun taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Eliab Helon.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

motu: Bena dubu e kokia, Gereson natuna bona Merari natuna ese e huaia lao.
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

motu: Idia muridiai Ruben taruhana taudia edia orea ta ta amo edia pepe murina amo e raka; edia orea e gunalaidia tauna na Elisuru Sedeuru.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

motu: Simeon taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Selumiele Surisadai.
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

motu: Gad taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Eliasaf Reuele.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

motu: Bena Kohat taudia ese kohu helaḡadia e hua; idia do asie kau ai dubu be vada e haginia guna.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

motu: Idia muridiai Efraim taruhana taudia edia orea ta ta amo edia pepe murina amo e raka; edia orea e gunalaidia tauna na Elisama Amihud.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

motu: Manase taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Gamaliel Pedasuru.
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

motu: Beniamina taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Abidan Gideoni.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

motu: Bena gabe oreadia e tore isi. Dan taruhana taudia edia orea ta ta amo edia pepe murina amo e raka; edia orea e gunalaidia tauna na Ahiesere Amisadai.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

motu: Asere taruhana taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Pagiele Okran.
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

motu: Napatali taruhana taudia edia orea igunalaidia tauna na Ahira Enan.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

motu: Israel taudia e tore isi negana ai edia laolao dalana be unuheto, orea ta ta amo e raka.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

motu: Mose ese ihana Hobab Reuele, tau Midian, e hereva henia, eto, Ai na baia laolaomu, Iehova ese vada e hamaoromai baine henimai e tomu tanona baia lao henia. Taunabunai ba bamomai, bena namo ba davaria; badina be Iehova ese ḡau namodia vada e abi heḡeḡae, Israel taumai emai.
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

motu: A ia e haere, eto, Lau na basina bamomui, egu tano korikori baina lou henia, varavaragu dekedia bainala.
english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

motu: Mose ma eto, Basio rakatanimai; badina be oi dibamu ai na tano ḡaḡaena ai baia taruha, bena oi na ai matamai ai baola.
english: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

motu: Ba bamomai, bena Iehova ena herahia ḡaudia amo oi ahumu do baia henimu.
english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia na Iehova ena ororo amo e laolao matama, dina toi eha laolao, Iehova ena taravatu mauana danu dina toiosi ai idia vairadiai e huaia lao, edia laḡa-ani gabuna e tahua.
english: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

motu: Dina ai, Iehova ena ori esee hahekerukerudia, edia taruha e toretania negadia iboudiai.
english: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

motu: Maua helaḡana e huaia lao negadia ai, Mose eto, Iehova e, a tore isi, inaimu ba hakarohodia; e inai henimumu taudia na oi vairamu ai bae heau.
english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

motu: Bona e atoa diho negadia ai ma eto, Iehova e, Israel taudia gerebu gerebu ba lou henidia.
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

motu: Israel taudia na e maumau, hereva dikadia e gwaurai Iehova vairanai. Iehova na e kamonai, bena e badu, lahi na latadiai e hadihoa; una Iahi ese taruha isena e araia.
english: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Mose e tai henia, bena Mose ese Iehova e noia; bena lahi na e bodo.
english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

motu: Taunabunai una gabu ladana e hatoa Tabera, + 11:3 “Tabera” anina be “e ara”. * badina be Iehova ena lahi na bogaragidiai e arava.
english: The name of that place was called Taberah, + 11:3 Taberah means “burning” * because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.

motu: Bena orea idau-idau taudia Aigupto tanona amo Israel taudia idae raka lasi hebou taudia, na e gado dikadika, bona Israel taudia ma e taitai lou, eto, vamu be ede amo baita abia?
english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

motu: Aigupto ai gwarume ta ani asi davadia ani? Bona kiukamba bona melon bona liki bona onion bona galik na momo herea ani?
english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

motu: A harihari emai goada vada eme ore; ḡau ta Iasi, ina mana mo e heitamu.
english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

motu: Hari mana be nadinadi kurokurona na heto; ita-itana na bedolak + 11:7 “Bedolak” na Heberu taudia edia herahera nadina ta. * nadina na heto.
english: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium. + 11:7 Bdellium is a resin extracted from certain African trees. *

motu: Taunimanima ese e hagogo; bena huro nadidia amo e idi patapata, eiava gwada-gwada auna lalonai e gwadaia; bena uro ai e nadua, manemane e kara, mamidia na flaoa dehoro ida e bulo dikeadia mamidia na heheto.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

motu: Hanuaboi ai hunu taruha ai e dihova negana ai, hari mana danu e dihova.
english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

motu: Israel iduhudia iboudiai e taitai, ta ta ena kalaga iduarana ena kalaga iduarana ai; bena Mose ese edia taitai e kamonai. Iehova na e badu laloḡaraḡara; Mose danu e badu.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e hereva henia, eto, Dahaka dainai emu hesiai tauna ini vada o hadikagu toma? Edeheto oi na so lalo namo henigumu? Edeheto ina bese idoinai ireḡuna na lauegu maduna ai vada o halaoa?
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

motu: Ini taunimanima loḡora na lau natugu a? Lau ese na havaradia dainai oi na o tomu “lmamu ai a rosidia, rata e inuamu merona na heto, ela bona senedia na gwau henilaidia hamata tanona ai” a?
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

motu: Vamu na edeseni ai baina abia, ini taunimanima loḡora iubulaidia? Badina be idia na lau vairagu ai e taimu, e tomu “Vamu a henimai, baia ania”.
english: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

motu: Lau na sibogu ini taunimanima loḡora ireḡudia asiname heḡereḡere; maduna na metau herea, ihuana na asi goadagu.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

motu: Emu ura egu ai bema unuheto, namona be boma bogagu hisi, ina harihari boma alagu mase, bena egu hemarai na basie hedinarai.
english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, eto, Israel tau-badadia hitu-ahui bavabidia hidi, oi dibamu tau-badadia korikori bona mai siahudia taudia; bena ba haboudia hebou kalagana vairanai, oi ida bae gini.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

motu: Bena lau baina diho, baina hereva henimui unuseni ai; bona oi vada na henimu siahuna kahana baina abia lou, idia baina henidia; ini taunimanima ireḡudia madunana na oi ida ba huaia hebou, sibomu basio huaia.
english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

motu: Taunimanima danu ba hamaorodia, baoto: Sibomui ba hahelaḡa ela bona kerukeru, bena vamu bavania; badina be Iehova o tai henia, oto “Daika ese amai vamu baine henimai? Aigupto ai bogamai e kunuva”. Taunabunai, Iehova ese vamu baine henimui, bavania.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.

motu: Dia dina tamona eiava rua bona eiava ima eiava gwauta eiava ruahui,
