english: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

motu: a hua ena dina iboudiai vamu bavania, ela bona ianina ai ba hesiku, bena ba dadaraia. Badina be Iehova, bogaragimui ai e nohomu Diravana, vada o dadaraia, ia vairanai o tai, oto “Dahaka dainai Aigupto a rakatania?”
english: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

motu: A Mose eto, Be, egu bese taudia iboudiai be domaga tauratoi + 11:21 Domaga tauratoi: 600, 000. * aedia amo e rakamu: taudia; a oi na o tomu “Vamu baina henidia, bae ania, ela bona hua ta baine ore”.
english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

motu: Mamoe seridia bona nani seridia bae aladia ore, adia vamu, a? Eiava davara gwarumedia iboudiai bae abidia ore, idia bogadia ihakunudia a?
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haere henia, eto, Iehova imana e tunamu a? Do ba itaia, lauegu hereva baine momokani eiava lasi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

motu: Taunabunai Mose e raka lasi, Iehova ena hereva na Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia, a Bena tau badadia hitu-ahui e abidia hidi, hebou kalagana murimurinai e haginidia heḡeḡe.
english: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

motu: Bena Iehova na ori ai e diho, e hereva henia, a bona e henia siahuna kahana na hari hitu-ahuiosi e henidia; bena hari siahu idia latadiai e kau negana ai idia na e peroveta, to una negana ai mo.
english: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

motu: Tatau rarua taruha ai e nohova, ta ladana na Eledad, ma ta ladana na Medad; bena siahu na idia danu latadiai e kau. Idia be e abidia hidi taudia rarua, a hebou kalagana asiela, bena taruha lalonai e peroveta.
english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

motu: Bena eregabe tauna ta ese Mose dekena e heau lao, eto, Eledad bona Medad be taruha ai e perovetamu.
english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

motu: Bena Iosua Nunu, Mose ena hesiai tauna bona ena abi-hidi tauna ta, e hereva, eto, Mose Rahobada e, ba gwaudia tao.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

motu: A Mose ese e haere henia, eto, Lau daigu ai o vaḡeḡemu a? Iehova ena orea taudia iboudiai bema peroveta bona Iehova ena siahu be iboudiai latadiai bema kau bema namo.
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

motu: Bena Mose, Israel tau-badadia ida, taruha e lou henia.
english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese lai ta e siaia; bena una lai ese kibi momo davara kahana e harohodia diho edia taruha tanona ai, ela bona dina ta laolaona heḡereḡerena taruha kahana ai, bona ma kahana ai danu dina ta laolaona heḡereḡerena, tano daenai kiubit rua + 11:31 Kiubit rua = 88 centimetres sisivana. * heḡereḡerena.
english: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits + 11:31 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * above the surface of the earth.

motu: Bena taruha taudia e tore isi, kibi na e haboudia boi, e haboudia rani, ma dina iharuana ai e haboudia boi; e habou maraḡi tauna ese homere gwauta + 11:32 Homere gwauta = 3700 litres. * e haboudia. Bena edia kalaga badibadidiai e hakaukaudia.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; + 11:32 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels * and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

motu: A vamu na dounu ududia ai, do asie hadonoa, Iehova ena badu na ediai e siahu; bena ia ese dai-hanai gorerena dikana ta idia latadiai e siaia.
english: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

motu: Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoa Kibroto-hatava; + 11:34 “Kibroto-hatava” anina be “Gado-mase taudia edia gara”. * badina be unuseni ai gado esee abidia taudia na e guridia.
english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, + 11:34 Kibroth Hattaavah means “graves of lust” * because there they buried the people who lusted.

motu: Kibroto-hatava amo eha laolao, ela bona Haseroto ai e kau; unuseni ai e taruha.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

motu: Aaron bona Miriama ese Mose e maumauraia, ia adavana hane Kusu dainai, badina be ia ese Kusu hahinena vada e adavaia.
english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

motu: Idia eto, Iehova na Mose mo sibona uduna amo vada e hereva a? Eiava ai danu udumai amo vada e hereva? Iehova ese edia hereva e kamonai.
english: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

motu: Hari Mose na tanobada taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai ia mo sibona manau herea.
english: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

motu: A Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron bona Miriama e hereva henidia taku, eto, Umui tatoiosi a raka lasi, hebou kalagana baoma. Bena tatoiosi ela.
english: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The|strong="H3068" * three|strong="H7969" * of|strong="H3068" * them|strong="H3318" * came|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" *.

motu: Bena Iehova na ori dubuna ai e diho, hebou kalagana vairanai e gini, Aaron bona Miriama e boiridia, bena raruosi e raka henia kahi.
english: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

motu: Ia eto, Egu hereva a kamonai: daika umui bogaragimui ai be peroveta tauna, lau ese mata-hanai ai baina hahedinarai henia bona nihi ai baina hereva henia.
english: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

motu: A egu hesiai tauna Mose na dia unuheto; ia na egu bese ireḡuna tauna.
english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

motu: Ia ida baia hereva-hereva hedinarai, lau udugu amo, ia uduna amo; basia hereva hehuni. Iehova oromana danu ia ese matana amo baine itaia. Edeheto umui raruosi na egu hesiai tauna Mose imaumauraina asio garimu?
english: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

motu: Iehova ena badu e siahu ḡaraḡara unu raruosi ediai, bena ia ese e rakatanidia.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

motu: ori ese hebou kalagana e daetania negana ai, Miriama vada e lepra, kopina vada e kuroka-kuroka, snow * na heto. Aaron ese Miriamae haḡerea, e itaia vada e lepra.
english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

motu: Bena Aaron ese Mose e hereva henia eto, Ḡauka e, ai vada a kara kava, vada a kara dika; mani emu kara emai dika davana basio henimai,
english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

motu: Ina hahine na basine noho mase hahinena na heto, eiava sinana bogana amo e vara mai dikana kekenina na heto.
english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e noia, eto, Dirava e, lau na noimumu, ba hamauria.
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

motu: A Iehova ese Mose e haere henia, eto, Tamana ese vairana bema kanudia, ia na mai hemaraina ida bema noho ela dina hitu bema ore, ani? Benaini, ia be dina hitu taruha murimurinai baine noho, bena ma bae hakaua vareai.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

motu: Taunabunai, Miriama na taruha murimurinai e nohova ela bona dina hitu e ore; bona Israel taudia na edia laolao asie matamaia lou ela bona Miriama na taruha lalonai ma e hakaua vareai.
english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

motu: Una murinai idia ese Haseroto e toretania, ela, Paran tano-ḡaḡaena ai e taruha.
english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Hasinadoa taudia haida ba siaidia, Kanaan tanona, lau ese Israel taudia baina henidia tanona, baela. Iduhu ta ta amo ta ta ba siaidia, a lohia taudia mo bavabidia.
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Paran tano-ḡaḡaena amo e siaidia, Iehova ena hahedua heḡereḡerena; iboudiai na Israel lohiadia.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

motu: Ladadia bini: Ruben iduhuna amo, Samua Sakuru;
english: These were their names: Of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H8034" * tribe|strong="H4294" * of|strong="H1121" * Reuben|strong="H7205" *, Shammua|strong="H8051" * the|strong="H8034" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Zaccur|strong="H2139" *.

motu: Simeon iduhuna amo, Safata Hori;
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

motu: Iuda iduhuna amo, Kaleb lefune;
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

motu: Isakara iduhuna amo, Igala Iosef;
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

motu: Efraim iduhuna amo, Hosea Nunu;
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

motu: Beniamina iduhuna amo, Palti Rafu;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

motu: Sebulun iduhuna amo, Gadiel Sodi;
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

motu: Manase Iosef iduhuna amo, Gadi Susi;
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

motu: Dan iduhuna amo, Amiele Gemali;
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

motu: Asere iduhuna amo, Seturu Mikael;
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

motu: Napatali iduhuna amo, Nabi Vopsi;
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

motu: Gad iduhuna amo, Gevele Maki.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

motu: Hasinadoa taudia Mose ese e siaidia, Kanaan baela, ladadia bunu. A Mose ese Hosea Nunu ladana e nemaia Iosua.
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

motu: Taunabinai, Mose ese e siaidia, Kanaan tanona bae ha itaia. E haḡanidia, eto, Diho kahana amo baola ela bona ororo gabudia.
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

motu: Ba itaia, tano be edeheto, bona tano taudia be edeheto, gogoada eiava mamanoka, hutuma eiava gagadoi;
english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

motu: ba itaia danu, e noholaiamu tanona edeheto, namo eiava dika, bona edia hanua be edeheto, taruha mo eiava hanua mai maḡudia.
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

motu: Ba itaia danu, edia biru gabudia be edeheto, namo eiava dika, bona au be mimia eiava. Ba goada: tano anidia taidia ba loulai. Una negana be vine e huahua matama negana.
english: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

motu: Taunabunai idia na ela, e hasinadoa, Sin tano-ḡaḡaena amo ela bona Rehob, Hamat dalana ai.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

motu: Diho kahana amo ela, Heberon ai e kau; unuseni ai Ahiman bona Sesai bona Talmai, Anak garana, e nohova. Una Heberon e haginia murinai laḡani hitu vada ela bena Soan e haginia Aigupto ai.
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

motu: Bena Eskol + 13:23 “Eskol” anina be “Tako ta”. “Rimona” bona “suke” na au huahua ladadia. * kourana ai e kau, unuseni ai vine rigina ta e utua, mai vine huahuana tako ta; tatau rarua ese au ai e huaia. Rimono(, huahuadia haida bona suke huahuadia haida danu e gogo, e hua.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

motu: Una gabu ladana e hatoa Eskol kourana, badina be Israel taudia ese vine takona unuseni ai e utua dainai.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

motu: Dina hari-ahui e ore, bena edia hasinadoa amo e lou ema,
english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

motu: Mose bona Aaron bona Israel oreana taudia iboudiai dekediai e kau, Kade ai, Paran tano-ḡaḡaena ai. Bena tano sivaraina e hamaorolaidia, bona tanoanidia e haheitalaidia.
english: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

motu: Idia eto, O siaimai baia lao henia tanona ala, ia na rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona; tano huahuadia haida bini.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

motu: To, una tano taudia na gogoada, edia hanua danu babada heherea bona mai maḡudia; Anak garana danu a itadia unuseni ai.
english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

motu: Diho kahana ai Amalek taudia e nohomu; ororo gabudia ai Hiti taudia bona Iebusu taudia bona Amoro taudia e nohomu; a kone ai bona Ioridane sinavaina isena ai Kanaan taudia na e nohomu.
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

motu: Bena Kaleb ese taunimanima e tuidia; bena ia ese Mose e hereva henia, eto, Aitala, una tano baita abia; badina be ita na mai goadada, baita abia diba.
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

motu: A ia ida ela taudia eto, Una tano taudia basita tuari henidia diba, badina be idia na gogoada, ita na mamanoka.
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese edia hasinadoa Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia na hari dikana mo e gwauraia, eto; Una itana totona ala tanona na taunimanima ihamasedia tanona, bona unuseni ai a itadia taudia iboudiai na babada heherea.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

motu: Unuseni ai taunimanima gaḡau-babadadia a itadia, Anak garana, Nefili taudia amo evara besena. Ai na a laloa ai na kwadi na heheto, idia vairadiai, bona idia danu unu e itamai toma. + 13:33 “Kibroto-hatava” anina be “Gado-mase taudia edia gara”. *
english: There we saw the Nephilim, + 13:33 or, giants * the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. + 13:33 or, giants * We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

motu: Bena hebou taudia iboudiai e tai: Israel idoinai e tai rani.
english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

motu: Israel taudia iboudiai ese Mose bona Aaron e maumauraidia; hebou idoinai ese e gwau henidia, eto, Aigupto ai baiama mase eiava ina tano ḡaḡaena ai baiama mase bema namo.
english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

motu: Namona be dahaka Iehova ese una tano ai baine hakaumai vareai? Unuseni ai ai na dare amo bae alamai mase, bona adavamai, bona, natumai bae abidia mauri. Aigupto baia lou henia hari namo, ani?
english: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

motu: Bena sibodia e hereva heheni, eto, Biaguda ta baita abia hidi, Aigupto baita lou lao.
english: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron na Israel taudia loḡora edia hebou vairanai e goru diho;
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

motu: bona Iosua Nunu bona Kaleb lefune, hasinadoa taudia rarua, na edia dabua e dare,
english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

motu: Israel oreana idoinai e hamaorodia, eto, Una tano, ai ala a hasinadoa tanona, na tano namo-hereana.
english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

motu: Iehova ese baine lalo namo henida, ia ese una tano ai baine hakauda vareai, baine henida; oibe, hari rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona ia ese baine henida.
english: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Iehova basio inai henia, bona una tano taudia garidia basio gari. Idia na ita ada aniani na heto. Idia na asi igimadia; a Iehova na ita ida. Basio gari henidia.
english: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

motu: A hebou taudia iboudiai ese nadi amo bae hododia eto. Bena Iehova diaridiarina na hebou kalagana ai e hedinarai, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh|strong="H3068" *’s glory|strong="H3519" * appeared|strong="H7200" * in|strong="H3478" * the|strong="H3605" * Tent of|strong="H1121" * Meeting|strong="H4150" * to|strong="H3478" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * children|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Israel|strong="H3478" *.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto, Ini taunimanirna na bae dadaraigu ela bona edena nega ai? Toa iboudiai vada na henidia ore. Edena nega ai bae abidadama henigu?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

motu: Lau na dai-hanai gorerena amo baina habuadiatari. Idia na lau dihigu ai basiela. Oiemu amo bese ta, idia baine hereadia besena, baina havaraia.
english: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

motu: Bena Mose, ese Iehova e haere henia, eto, Unu baine heto, Aigupto taudia na bae kamonai; badina be oi ese ina bese taudia na idia bogaragidia amo e hakaudia lasi mai siahumu ida.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

motu: Bena idia ese ina tano taudia bae hamaorodia. Ina tano taudia na vada e kamonai oi na ina bese bogaraginai o nohomu, idia ida o hevaira hehenimu, oiemu ori amo o gorudia taomu, bona edia laolao ai o gunalaidiamu, dina ai ori dubuna amo bona hanuaboi ai lahi mamana amo.
english: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

motu: A harihari oi ese ina bese taudia boma habuadia ore, hari oi harimu e kamonai besedia na baeto
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

motu: “Iehova na asi siahuna ina bese na e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai baine hakaudia vareai; una dainai ia ese .tano ḡaḡaena ai vada e habuadia ore”.
english: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

motu: Taunabunai, lau I na noimumu, Ḡaubada ena siahu do baine herea, emu gwau-hamata heḡeregerena, oto:
english: Now please let the power of the Lord + 14:17 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

motu: Iehova ena badu e halahemu, ena hebogahisi e hesiriumu; ia ese kara dika bona kara havara e gwau taomu; ḡau tamona, kara dika taudia na basine kahudia nege, a tama edia kara dika davadia na natudia bona tubudia baine henidia, ela bona uru ihatoina bona ihahanina.
english: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

motu: Lau na noimumu, emu hebogahisi na bada herea dainai ina bese taudia edia kara dika do ba gwau tao, Aigupto amo ema bona ina gabu ai edia kara dika vada o gwau tao heḡereḡerena.
english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

motu: Bena.Iehova eto, Baina bogadia hisi, emu noinoi heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

motu: A momokani, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena bona Iehova hairaina ese tanobada baine hahonua heḡereḡerena,
english: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—

motu: ini taunirnanima iboudiai ese lau hairaigu vada, e itaia, bona toa idau-idau Aigupto ai bona tano gaḡaena ai vada eitadia, to nega, gwauta vada e dibaḡanigu bona eregu asie kamonai dainai,
english: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

motu: idia ese senedia na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona na basie itaia; momokani, vada e dadaraigu taudia ta ese basine itaia.
english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

motu: A egu hesiai tauna Kaleb, laumana na idau bona eme badinagu mai lalona idoinai dainai, ia be baina hakaua vareai, hari itana ela tanona lalonai; bena ia garana ese bae abia, edia tano.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

motu: A harihari, Amalek, taudia bona Kanaan taudia na koura ai e nohomu dainai umui be kerukeru ba lou, tano ḡaḡaena baola, Davara Kakakakana kahana ai.
english: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hereva henidia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Ina orea dikana ese lau bae maumauraigu ela bona edena nega ai? Israel taudia edia hereva, lau e maumauraigumu herevadia, vada na kamonai.
english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto: Iehova na e tomu “Lau na maurimu dainai, emui hereva lau vada na kamonai heḡereḡeredia unu baina karamui toma;
english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

motu: ina tano ḡaḡaena ai vada ba mase. Umui iboumui bogaragimui ai, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai bona vada e maumauraigu taudia.
english: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

motu: ta na lau ese na gwaurai henimui hamata ba noholaia nato tanona na basine raka vareai, a Kaleb lefune bona Iosua Nunu, idia raruosi mo baeiraka vareai.
english: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

motu: A natumui maragidia, umui o tomu bae abidia mauri, na lau ese baina hakaudia vareai, umui ese vada o dadaraia tanona na idia ese bae itaia.
english: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

motu: A umui be ina tano ḡagaena ai do ba mase.
english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

motu: Natumui ese laḡani hari-ahui tano ḡaḡaena aiedia mamoe bae reḡudia, emui kara havara hisidia bae ani, ela bona umui tau-animui bae pata vaitani tano ḡaḡaena ai.
english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

motu: O hasinadoa dinadia hari-ahui ihaheḡereḡeredia, laḡani hari-ahui emui kara havara hisidia bavani, dina ta ta, davadia laḡani ta ta hisidia bavani.
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

motu: Lau Iehova vada na hereva: momokani, ina orea dikana, lau e inai henigumu oreana, na unu baina karadia toma. Ina tano ḡaḡaena ai taudia bae manori, bona ina tano ḡaḡaena ai bae mase.”
english: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

motu: Hari hasinadoa taudia, Mose ese tano itana e siaidia, bena e lou negana ai tano harina dikana amo hebou taudia iboudiai e haherou-heroudia bena Mose e maumauraia,
english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

motu: taudia bunu, tano harina dika e gwauraia taudia, na dai-hanai gorerena ta ese e hamasedia ore, Iehova vairanai.
english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

motu: A Iosua Nunu bona Kaleb lefune na e mauri, hasinadoa taudia iboudiai idia raruosi mo e mauri.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

motu: Mose ese ini hereva na Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia negana ai, idia na lalodia e hisihisi bada.
english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

motu: Daba maraḡi ai, idia na e tore isi, ororo dorina ela, eto, Ame itamai, ai na iniseni ai, Iehova ese vada e gwaurai henimai hamata tanona hari aiala; badina be ai na vada a kara havara.
english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised; for we have sinned.”

motu: A Mose eto, Dahaka dainai Iehova ena haheḡani harihari o tataia utumu? Basio kwalimu diba.
english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

motu: Basiola, inaimui ese bae hadareremui na garina; badina be Iehova ese se barnomuimu.
english: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

motu: Amalek taudia bona Kanaan taudia na vairamui ai; bena edia dare ai ba mase; Iehova ena dala vada o rakatania dainai Iehova ese basine bamomui.
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

motu: A edia hekokoroku ai e raka lao, ororo dorina arno ela; ḡau tamona, Iehova ena taravatu mauana na taruha ai mia, Mose danu taruha ai noho.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

motu: Bena Arnalek taudia bona Kanaan taudia, unu ororo ai e nohova taudia, na ema, e hadareredia, e havadia lao, ela bona Horoma.
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hereva henidia, baoto: Baina henimui ba noholaia tanona ai ba kau,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

motu: bena boromakau ta eiava mamoe ta ba hahelaḡaia Iehova ena, ḡole-oho boubouna eiava gwau-hamata boubouna eiava lalo-namo boubouna eiava aria ta boubouna, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena;
english: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock—

motu: una negana ai boubou baine heni tauna ese flaoa namo-hereana efa + 15:4 “Efa” bona “Hini” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡaudia. * ta baine karoaia, karoa gwauta, karoa ta baine abia, bona dehoro hini ta baine karoaia, karoa hani, karoa ta baine abia; bena flaoa bona dehoro baine bulodia.
english: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah + 15:4 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin + 15:4 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. * of oil.

motu: Inuinu boubouna danu bavabia: vine ranuna hini ta ba karoaia, karoa hani, bena karoa ta ba heni; ḡole-oho ḡauna eiava gwau-hamata ḡauna eiava lalo-namo ḡauna ida.
english: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

motu: Eiava mamoe maruanena ta ba hahelaḡaia, flaoa namo-hereana efa ta ba karoaia, karoagwauta, bena karoa rua bavabi, bona dehoro hini ta ba karoaia, karoa toi, bena karoa ta bavabia; bena flaoa bona dehoro ba bulodia.
english: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah + 15:6 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

motu: Inuinu boubouna danu ba heni; vine ranuna hini ta ba karoaia, karoa toi, bena karoa ta bavabia, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Eiava boromakau maruanena ta bavabia heḡaeḡae, emu ḡole-oho boubouna eiava emu lalo-namo boubouna eiava emu gwau-hamata boubouna eiava emu herohemaino boubouna ai bahalaoa, Iehova ena;
english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,

motu: boromakau maruanena ida baine heni ḡaudia bini: flaoa namo-hereana efa ta baine karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa toi baineabi, bona dehoro hini ta baine karoaia, karoa rua, bena karoa ta baine abia; bena flaoa bona dehoro baine bulodia.
english: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah + 15:9 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

motu: Inuinu boubouna danu ba heni: vine ranuna hini ta ba karoaia, karoa rua, bena karoa ta bavabia, lahi boubouna ai ba halaoa, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Boromakau mamaruanedia ta ta ida, bona mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta ida, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia ta ta ida, bona nani natudia ta ta ida, unu ba heni toma.
english: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

motu: Mauri ḡaudia hida bavabidia heḡeḡae, unuhohodia mo unu ba heni toma.
english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

motu: Israel taudia korikori na una dala amo bae ḡaukara, edia boubou ḡaudia lahi ai bae ato kau negadia ai; unu hetomana bonana namo ḡaudia ai baela, Iehova ena.
english: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Bona idau bese tauna eiava bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu tauna, emui uru iboudiai lalodiai, baine ura bonana namo ḡauna lahi ai baine gabua Iehova ena, ia ese umui o karaiamu heḡereḡerena ma baine karaia.
english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, as you do, so he shall do.

motu: Emui hebou ai taravatu baine tamona, umui emui, bona idau tauna bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu ena; taravatu tamona, baine mia hanaihanai taravatuna, emui uru iboudiai lalodiai. Umui bona noho-hedoa tauna na heḡereḡere, Iehova vairanai.
english: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before Yahweh.

motu: Taravatu be tamona bona haheḡani be tamona, umui latamui ai bona bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu tauna latanai.
english: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hereva henidia, baoto: Baina hakaumui vareai tanona ai ba kau
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

motu: bona una tano anina bavani matama negana ai, emui herahia ḡaudia ba dudui isi Iehova vairanai.
english: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

motu: Emui flaoa matamatana amo ataga ta ba duduia isi, Iehova vairanai, emui uit ikwadina gabuna amo emui herahia ḡauna o duduia isimu heḡereḡerena.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

motu: Uru iboudiai Ialodiai, emui flaoa matamatana amo emui herahia ḡaudia ba dudui isi, Iehova vairanai.
english: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

motu: Boma kerere, ini haheḡani iboudiai, Iehova ese Mose vada e henia ḡaudia, basioma badinadia,
english: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—

motu: Iehova ese Mose uduna amo vada e henimui, e heni matama ema bona uru idoidiai lalodiai ma e heni loulou haheḡanidia,
english: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

motu: ibadinadia ai boma kerere, a hebou taudia asi dibadia: hebou idoinai ese boromakau natuna maruanena ta bae heni, ḡole-oho boubouna ai baehalaoa, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova vairanai. Ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna danu ia ida bae heni, taravatu heḡereḡerena, bona nani maruanena ta danu bae heni, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna.
english: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese Israel oreana taudia iboudiai daidiai herohemaino karana baine karaia, unu amo edia dika bae hegwau tao; badina be vada e kerere; to edia boubou na Iehova vada e henia, ḡole-oho boubouna bona kara-dikaiabi-ohona boubouna, edia kerere dainai.
english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.

motu: Bena hebou idoinai, Israel taudia bona bogaragidiai e noho hedoamu taudia na, edia dika bae hegwau tao, badina be iboudiai na una kara dika ese vada e hakereredia.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

motu: Tau ta baine kara rea, ia ese ena kara-rea iabi-ohona boubouna baineheni, nani hahinena ta, laḡani tamona ḡauna.
english: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese kerere tauna ena kara rea dainai herohemaino karana baine karaia, Iehova vairanai; unu amo ena dika baine hegwau tao.
english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

motu: Kara rea taravatuna baine tamona, Israel tauna korikori ena bona noho-hedoa tauna ena.
english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

motu: A Israel tauna korikori eiava noho-hedoa tauna na hekokoroku dainai baine kerere, ia be Iehova se matauraiamu. Ena bese amo bae negea daure;
english: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

motu: badina be ia ese Iehova ena hereva vada e dadaraia bona ena taravatu vada e tataia utu, una dainai ia na bae negea daure. Ena kara dika na basine hegwau tao. Dina Helaḡa Taravatuna
english: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

motu: Israel taudia na tano ḡaḡaena ai e nohova ai, idia ese tau ta e itaia, dina helaḡa ai au rakuraku e gogodia.
english: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

motu: Bena au rakuraku igogodia ai e davaria taudia ese e hakaua lao, Mose bona Aaron bona hebou taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
english: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

motu: Bena idia ese e ḡuia, badina be lalodia asie parara ede.bae karaia toma.
english: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haduaia, eto, Aine mase; hebou taudia iboudiai ese bae hodoa mase, taruha murimurinai.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

motu: Taunabunai hebou taudia iboudiai ese e hakaua lao, taruha murimurinai, bena idia ese nadi amo e hodoa mase, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena. Helalo Toadia
english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, edia uru iboudiai lalodiai edia dabua rimudia bae kara, edia dabua daigunidia ai; bona daiguni ta ta rimudia ai varo vaiurina ta ta bae turi kau.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes + 15:38 or, tassels (Hebrew צִיצִ֛ת) * on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe + 15:38 or, tassel * of each border a cord of blue.

motu: Bena emui dabua rimudia ba itadia negadia ai Iehova ena haheḡani ba lalodia tao bona ba badinadia; sibomui lalomui bona matamui edia ura basio badinadia, basio halebulebu,
english: It shall be to you for a fringe, + 15:39 or, tassel * that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

motu: a egu haheḡani iboudiai ba lalodia tao bona ba badinadia, bona ba helaḡa, emui Dirava ena.
english: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

motu: Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava; Aigupto amo na hakaumui lasi, emui Dirava ai bainala helaoreana. Lau binai Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”

motu: Kora Isahara, Kohat Levi tubuna, bona Datan Eliab, bona Abiram Eliab, bona Onu Pelete, Ruben iduhuna tauna, hahaniosi e heḡaeḡae;
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

motu: bena e tore isi, Mose dekena ela, idia bona orea lohiadia sinahu-rua imahui, hebou ese e abidia hidi taudia, iboudiai na mai haridia taudia.
english: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

motu: Idia na Mose bona Aaron vairadiai e hebou, e heai henidia, eto, Umui raruosi na o hekokorokumu; badina be hebou taudia iboudiai na hehelaḡa; oibe, ibouboudiai, bona Iehova na bogaragidiai e nohomu. Dahaka dainai umui raruosi ese Iehova ena orea taudia o lohiadiamu?
english: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”

motu: Mose ese una hereva e kamonai, bena ia na tano ai e goru diho.
english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

motu: Bena ia ese Kora mai ena orea taudia ida e hamaorodia, eto, Daba ai Iehova ese baine hahedinaraia, daika be iena, bona daika na helaḡa, bona daika na ienai baine kahi lao; bena baine abia hidi tauna ese baine raka henia kahi.
english: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

motu: Ini ba kara toma: oi Kora, bona emu orea taudia iboudiai, na gida keberedia helaḡadia bavabi;
english: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

motu: bena kerukeru gida ba uda, bona muramura mai bonadia na gida latadiai bavato kau, Iehova vairanai; bena Iehova ese baine abia hidi tauna na baine helaḡa. Levi taumui, umui hari o hekokorokumu.
english: put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

motu: Mose ese Kora ma e hereva henia, eto, Umui Levi taumui ese egu hereva: a kamonai.
english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

motu: Israel Diravana ese umui vada e abimui hidi Israel oreana taudia bogaragidia amo, ba raka henia kahi, Iehova ena dubu ai ba ḡaukara, bona hebou taudia vairadiai ba gini, iena hesiai taudia. Una na ḡau pipikina a?
english: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

motu: Ia ese vada e boirimui, umui bona varavaramui Levi taudia iboudiai, ia ba raka henia kahi. Be, hahelaḡa dagina danu o tahuamu a? a
english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

motu: Matona, oi bona emu orea taudia iboudiai vada o hebou, Iehova vada o heai henia. Aaron be daika, umui ese ia o maumauraiamu a?
english: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

motu: Bena Mose ese Datan Eliab bona Abiram Eliab e boiridia. A idia eto, Ai na basia vasi.
english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

motu: Rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona amo vadao hakaumai lasi, tano ḡaḡaena ai baia mase dahaka, harihari emai pavapava ai baola o tomu. Una na ḡau pipikina a?
english: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

motu: Ina danu, rata bona badaranuna tanona ta ai asio hakaumai vareai, uma bona vine imeadia asio henimai, ai ahumai. Ini taunimanima na matadia ba hakepuludia a a Ai na basia vasi.
english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

motu: Mose na e badu dikadika, Iehova e noia, eto, Edia boubou basio abi dae. Lau be edia doniki ta asina dadia, bona idia ta asina hadikaia.
english: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Kora e hamaoroa, eto, Kerukeru emu orea taudia ida baoma, Iehova vairanai ba gini, oi bona emu orea taudia bona Aaron.
english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

motu: Emui gida keberedia helaḡadia danu bavabi kau, muramura mai bonadia ba uda; ta ta ena kebere ena kebere bae mailaidia Iehova vairanai, kebere helaḡadia sinahu-rua imahui. Oi danu emu ba mailaia. Aaron danu ena baine mailaia.
english: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia na ta ta ena kebere ena kebere e abi, gida e uda, bona muramura mai bonadia gida latadiai; bena hebou kalagana iduarana ai e gini, Mose bona Aaron ida.
english: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

motu: Bena Kora ese orea idoinai e haboudia idia vairadiai, hebou kalagana iduarana ai. Bena Iehova diaridiarina e hedinarai, hebou taudia iboudiai ese e itaia.
english: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh|strong="H3068" *’s glory|strong="H3519" * appeared|strong="H7200" * to|strong="H3068" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * congregation|strong="H5712" *.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hamaorodia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Ena hebou amo ba raka siri, bena baina habuadia tari.
english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

motu: Bena idia na tano ai e goru goru :diho, eto, Dirava e, taunimanima iboudiai laumadia Diravana, tau tamona baine kara dika dainai ina hebou idoinai ba badu henidia a?
english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Hebou taudia ba hamaorodia, Kora bona Datan bona Abiram edia kalaga amo bae raka oho.
english: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

motu: Bona Mose e tore isi, Datan bona Abiram dekedia ela; Israel tau-badadia ese e ḡavaia.
english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

motu: Bena ia ese hebou taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Ene kara havara taudia edia kalaga amo ba raka oho, bona edia ḡau ta basio daua toho, idia edia dika ai ba dika na garina.
english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

motu: Taunabunai, idia na Kora bona Datan bona Abiram edia kalaga amo e raka siri. Bena Datan bona Abiram e raka lasi, idia bona adavadia bona natudia badadia bona natudia maraḡidia, edia kalaga iduaradia ai e gini.
english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

motu: Bena Mose eto, Ini amo ba diba, Iehova ese vada e siaigu, ini ḡaukara iboudiai ikaradia totona; dia lau sibogu asina kara.
english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

motu: Ini tatau be taunimanima iboudiai vaevae edia mase dalana ai bema mase, bona taunimanima iboudiai vaevae edia dika dalana ai bema dika, ba diba Iehova ese se siaigu.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

motu: A Iehova ese kara matamatana ta bema havaraia, tano uduna bema hahaḡaia idia bona edia ḡau iboudiai bema hadonodia, mauridia ai mase taudia edia gabu ai bema diho, vada ba diba idia ese Iehova vada e dadaraia.
english: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, + 16:30 Sheol is the place of the dead. * then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

motu: Ena hereva e doko ai, idia henudia tanona e parara;
english: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

motu: tanobada ese uduna e hahaḡaia bona e hadonodia, mai edia ruma taudia ida, bona Kora ena orea taudia iboudiai mai edia kohu ida.
english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

motu: Taunabunai, idia mai edia orea idoinai na mauridia ai mase taudia edia gabu ai e diho. Tano ese e habubunidia, hebou taudia bogaragidiai e mase ore.
english: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. + 16:33 Sheol is the place of the dead. * The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

motu: Bena Israel taudia, e ginidia heḡeḡe taudia, ese edia tai lolololo e kamonai ai, e heau karoho; eto, Tano ese baine hadonoda na garina.
english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

motu: Bena lahi na Iehova ena amo e diho, hari tatau sinahu-rua imahuiosi, muramura maibonadia e gabu taudia, e aradia ore.
english: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Aaron natuna Eleasara ba hamaoroa, Iahi bogaragina amo kebere helaḡadia baine abidia lasi, gidadia baine bubu nege; badina be idia na hehelaḡa.
english: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,

motu: Ene kara havara daidiai vada e mase taudia edia gida keberedia na hehelaḡa: ba hododia severa-severa, ihaboulaina patana iḡovana ḡaudia aibaela, badina be Iehova vairanai e hahelaḡadia, taunabunai idia na hehelaḡa. Unu amo idia na toa ai baela, Israel taudia edia.
english: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara hari auri labora-labora keberedia, lahi ese e aradia taudia edia kebere, e abidia, e hododia severa-severa, ihaboulaina patana iḡovana,
english: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

motu: bona helalo-tao toana, Israel taudia ese bae laloa tao, idau tauna ta, dia Aaron garana, na Iehova basine raka henia kahi, muramura mai bonana igabuna totona; Kora mai bamona ida heḡereḡeredia ai baela na garina. Iehova ese Eleasara unu e hamaoroa toma, Mose uduna amo.
english: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

motu: Kerukeru, Israel oreana taudia ibouboudiai ese Mose bona Aaron e maumauraidia, eto, Umui ese Iehova ena orea taudia vada o aladia mase.
english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

motu: Ibouboudiai na Mose bona Aaron ialadia totona e hebou; bena e roha lao, hebou kalagana e itaia, ori ese vada e ḡovaia ahu, bona Iehova diaridiarina vada e hedinarai.
english: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron na hebou kalagana iduarana amo e raka lasi.
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Ene e heboumu taudia edia amo a raka siri; lau ese aina habuadia tari. Bena raruosi na tano ai e goru diho.
english: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron e hamaoroa, eto, Emu gida keberena bavabia, muramura mai bonadia gida ai bavato kau; ba laohaia haraḡa-haraḡa hebou taudia dekediai, idia daidiai herohemaino karana bakaraia; badina be badu na Iehova ena amo vada e kau, dai-hanai gorerena vada e vara.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

motu: Bena Aaron ese kebere e abia, Mose ena hereva heḡereḡerena, bena e heau lao hebou taudia bogaragidiai. Dai-hanai gorerena na vadae vara matama, taunimanima ediai. Bena ia ese muramura mai bonadia na gida ai e ato kau, hebou taudia daidiai herohemaino karana e karaia.
english: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

motu: Ia ese mase taudia bona mauri taudia padadiai e gini; bena gorere vada e doko.
english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

motu: Gorere ese e hamasedia taudia na gerebu-ta daha-hani sinahu-hitu; + 16:49 Gerebu-ta daha-hani sinahu-hitu: 14,700. * a Kora ena kara havara dainai e mase taudia be ma idau.
english: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.

motu: Bena Aaron ese Mose e lou henia, hebou kalagaana iduarana ai Gorere vada e doko.
english: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, itotohi bae henimu, iduhu ta ta ikwaradia taudia ese edia itotohi ta ta bae henimu: itotohi iboudiai bae gwauta-rua. Itotohi ta ta ai iduhu ikwaradia taudia ladadia ta ta ba tore;
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

motu: bona Levi iduhuna taudia edia itotohi ai Aaron ladana ba torea. Iduhu ikwaradia taudia ta ta edia itotohi ta ta bavabi.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

motu: Bena hebou kalagana ai bavatodia, taravatu mauana vairanai, ita raruosi ta hedavarimu gabuna ai.
english: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

motu: Bena vada na abia hidi tauna ena itotohi baine gara kau: unu amo Israel taudia baina tudia, oi imaumauraimu bae hadokoa.
english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese Israel taudia unu e hamaorodia toma. Bena edia iduhu ikwaradia taudia ese itotohi e henia, iduhu ta itotohi ta iduhu ta itotohi ta, unu e henia toma; itotohi iboudiai na gwauta-rua. Aaronena itotohi danu edia itotohi ida e heato bou.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

motu: Bena Mose ese itotohi e abi, Iehova vairanai e atodia, taravatu mauana kalagana lalonai.
english: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.

motu: Kerukeru, Mose na taravatu mauana kalagana lalonai e raka vareai; bena Aaron ena itotohi, Levi iduhuna itotohina, e itaia, vada e gara kau bona vada e huahua, sakada + 17:8 “Sakada” be Heberu taudia edia au huahua ta. * huahuadia vada e dobi.
english: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

motu: Bena Mose ese itotohi iboudiai na Iehova vairana amo e abidia, e laohaidia, Israel taudia iboudiai dekediai: idia ese e itadia, bena ta ta ena itotohi ena itotohi e abidia.
english: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e haḡania, eto, Aaron ena itotohi bavatoa lou, taravatu mauana vairanai, toa ai bainela ini gwau-edeede taudia ediai; unu amo ba tudia, lau e maumauraigumu herevadia bae hadoko, bae mase na garina.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”

motu: Mose na unu e kara toma: Iehova ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena, unu mo e kara toma.
english: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, ai na vada a masemu, vada ame baia, iboumai ai vada ame baia.
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

motu: E raka kahiramu, Iehova ena dubu e raka henia kahimu, taudia iboudiai e masemu. Ai iboumai ai baia mase ore a?
english: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

motu: Iehova ese Aaron e hereva henia, eto, Kerere gabu helaḡana ai bae vara na oi bona natumu bona emu iduhu taudia latamui ai; bona hahelaḡa taudia edia kerere na oi bona natumu latamui ai.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

motu: Varavaramu danu, Levi iduhuna taudia, tamamu ena iduhu taudia, na oi ida bae raka kahi mai, oi ida bae ḡaukara hebou, bona oi isiaimu bae lao heni. Ḡau tamona, oi mai natumu ida mo taravatu mauana kalagana lalonai ba ḡaukara.
english: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.

motu: Idia ese oi isiaimu bae lao heni, bona hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia bae kara; a gabu helaḡana kohudia basie raka henidia kahi, bona ihaboulaina patana basie raka henia kahi, idia bae mase bona umui ba mase na garina.
english: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

motu: Idia na oi bae durumu, hebou kalagana inarina ai bona ena ḡaukara iboudiai ikaradia ai: idau iduhu tauna ta basine raka henimui kahi.
english: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.

motu: A umui ese gabu, helaḡana ḡaukaradia bona ihaboulaina patana ḡaukaradia ba kara; unu amo badu na Israel taudia latadiai basine kau lou.
english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

motu: O itaia, varavaramui Levi taudia na Israel taudia bogaragidia amo vada na abidia hidi, vada na henimui, Iehova ena, hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia bae kara.
english: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: A oi mai natumu ida na hahelaḡa taumui; ihaboulaina patana ḡaukaradia iboudiai bona seseahu lalonai e karamu karadia, iboudiai na umui ese ba kara. Lau isiaigu ba lao heni; hahelaḡa dagina lau ese vada na henimui. Idau tauna ta baine raka kahira, ia na baine mase.
english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

motu: Iehova ese Aaron ma e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, egu dudui-isi bouboudia vada na henimu: Israel taudia ese e hahelaḡadiamu ḡaudia iboudiai na vada na henimu; vada e horomui dainai oi vada na henimu bona natumu vada na henidia, oi ahumu bona idia ahudia, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

motu: Ḡau helaḡadia Iahi bouboudia amo bavabi ḡaudia bini: edia herahia ḡaudia iboudiai; edia flaoa bouboudia iboudiai; edia kara-dika iabi-ohodia bouboudia iboudiai; edia kerere iabi-ohodia bouboudia iboudiai; unu iboudiai bae helaḡa, oi amu bonanatumu adia.
english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

motu: Gabu helaḡana ai bavani, mamaruanemui iboumui ai ese; ia na helaḡa, amui aniani.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

motu: Amu bini: bae dudui isi ḡaudia, bona Israel taudia edia davedave bouboudia iboudiai; oi vada na henimu bona natumu mamaruanedia bona natumu hahinedia vada na henidia, oi ahumu bona idia ahudia ela bona hanaihanai, asi mirodia taudia iboudiai emu ruma ai na bae ani diba.
english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

motu: Dehoro namo-hereana bona vine ranuna namo-hereana bona uit namo-hereana bae mailai, edia uma anidia roboadia bona edia imea anidia roboadia Iehova bae henia, idoinai vada na henimu.
english: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.

motu: Edia uma anidia roboadia bona edia imea anidia roboadia iboudiai, Iehova dekena e mailaidia ḡaudia, na oiamu; asi mirodia taudia iboudiai emu ruma ai na bae ani.
english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

motu: Gwau-hamata daidiai Iehova bae henia ḡaudia Israel ai na oiemu.
english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

motu: Mauri ḡaudia natudia roboadia iboudiai, taunimanima natudia bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia natudia, na Iehova bae henia, iboudiai na oiemu. Ḡautamona, taunimanima natudia roboadia bona ḡau mirodia natudia roboadia na davadia bae kara.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

motu: Edia mauri huana tamona baine ore ai na davadia bae kara: davadia vada ba gwauraia, silver sekeledia, ima, gabu helaḡana ena sekele + 18:16 “Sekele” bona “gera” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡaudia. * heḡereḡerena; una sekele lalonai gera na ruahui.
english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel + 18:16 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs. + 18:16 A gerah is about 0.5 grams or about 7.7 grains. *

motu: A boromakau natuna roboana eiava mamoe natuna roboana eiava nani natuna roboana na davana basio karaia. Idia na hehelaḡa; raradia na ihaboulaina patana latanai ba nevaria, bona digaradia na ba haḡole oho, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena.
english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: A hidiodia na oiamu; kemena, e davea ḡauna, bona idiba mamuna na oiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

motu: Herahia helaḡadia, Israel taudia ese Iehova vairanai e dudui isimu ḡaudia, iboudiai name henimu, oiamu bona natumu mamaruanedia adia bona natumu hahinedia adia, umui ahumui ela bona hanaihanai. Ina, na herohemaino damenana Iehova vairanai, oiemu bona oi garamu edia, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”

motu: Iehova ese Aaron ma e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na emu inoḡo ta basio abia edia tano ai, bona ahumu ta basio abia idia bogaragidiai: lau na oi ahumu, oi na lau dihigu, Israel taudia bogaragidiai.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

motu: Israel taudia edia ḡau e karoamu, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta lau e henigumu, una karoa na Levi taudia; vada na henidiamu, idia ahudia, edia ḡaukara davana, hebou kalagana ai:lau, isiaigu lao henimu dainai.
english: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Ina murinai, Israel taudia ese hebou kalagana: basie raka henia kahi, edia kara dika ai bae mase na garina.
english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

motu: A Levi taudia ese hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia iboudiai bae kara; kerere ta bema vara, una kerere na idia latadiai. Ina taravatu na do baine hesiriu hanaihanai emui uru iboudiai lalodiai. Israel taudia bogaragidiai idia na asi ahudia.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

motu: Badina be hari karoa ihagwautadia, Israel taudia ese Iehova vairanai e dudui isi ḡaudia, lau ese Levi taudia vada na henidia, idia ahudia; una dainai vada na hamaorodia, Israel taudia bogaragidiai idia na asi ahudia.
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Levi taudia na ba: hamaorodia, baoto: Israel taudia edia karoa ihagwautadia, umui ahumui vada na, henimui ḡaudia, bavabi negadia ai na ene karoa ihagwautadia ma ba karoadia, karoa gwauta gwauta, bena karoa ta ta ba dudui isi, Iehova vairanai.
english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.

motu: Bena, ene ba dudui isi ḡaudia na emui boubou ḡaudia ai baela, uit na emui roge amo eiava vine ranuna na emui vine amo boma dudui isi heḡereḡerena.
english: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

motu: Unuhetomana umui na emui karoa ihagwautadia, Israel taudia e henimuimu ḡaudia, na iboudiai ma ba karoadia, Iehova ena dudui isi boubouna na hahelaḡa tauna Aaron ba henia.
english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

motu: Bae henimui herahiadia iboudiai amo emui boubou ḡaudia ba dudui isi Iehova vairanai: namo-hereadia bona mai helaḡadia karoadia mo ia ba henia.
english: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’

motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto: Karoa namona ba duduia isi, bena orena be Levi taudia adia, uit anina ikwadina gabuna amo bona vine ranuna itaolaina gabuna amo heḡereḡeredia.
english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

motu: Una na amui aniani: gabu iboudiai bavania, umui bona emui ruma taudia, hebou kalagana ḡaukaradia o karamu davana.
english: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Bena namo-hereana na ba duduia isi dainai umui na ianina ai basio kerere. A Israel taudia edia ḡau helaḡadia na basio abi havara, ba mase na garina.
english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hamaorodia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

motu: Iehova ena haheḡani ta binai. Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, idia ese boromakau hahinena kakakakana ta, asi bebeka-bebekana, maduna ta paḡana ai do asie atoa kau ḡauna, bae mailaia dekemui ai.
english: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara ba henia; ia ese baine laohaia taruha murimurinai, bena tau ta ese ia vairanai baine alaia mase.
english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara ese una boromakau rarana taina baine abia, nega hahitu imana kwakikwakina amo baine daveraia, hebou kalagana vairanai.
english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

motu: A boromakau tau-anina na ia vairanai bae haḡolea oho, kopina bona hidiona bona rarana bona taḡena.
english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese sida audia bona muramura avana bona dabua kakakakana na boromakau e ḡolea ohomu lahina ai baine tahodia kau.
english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu, bena taruha lalonai ma baine raka vareai, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

motu: Boromakau e haḡolea oho tauna danu ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

motu: Bena asi mirona tauna ta ese boromakau kahuna baine haboua, taruha murimurinai baine atoa, gabu ḡoevaḡoevana ta ai. Una kahu be baine mia, Israel oreana taudia edia. Idia ese ranu ai bae buloa, kara dika ihuri-ohona ḡauna. Ina na kara dikaboubouna ta.
english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

motu: A hari boromakau kahuna e habouamu tauna ese ena dabua baine huri, bona baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho. Ina taravatu baine mia hanaihanai, Israel taudia latadiai bona bogaragidiai e noho hedoamu taudia latadiai.
english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

motu: Ta ese mase tauna baine daua toho, ia na baine taubu ela bona dina hitu bae ore.
english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai bona dina ihahituna ai ranu ai baine digu, unu amo baine ḡoeva. A dina ihatoina ai bona dina ihahituna ai basine digu, ia na basine ḡoeva.
english: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

motu: Ta ese mase tauna tau-anina bainedaua toho bona basine haheḡoeva, ia ese Iehova ena dubu baine hamiroa: Israel amo bae negea daure. Kara dika ihuri-ohona ranuna asie dairilaia dainai ia na miro; mirona na dounu mia enai.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

motu: Tau ta ena kalaga ai baine mase taravatuna binai: una kalaga ai bae raka vareai bona una kalaga ai e nohomu taudia na bae taubu, ela bona dina hitu bae ore.
english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

motu: Bona hodu, uro, nau asi ikaruhidia danu bae miro.
english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

motu: Ta ese taruha murimurinai dare amo e alaia mase tauna, eiava e mase kava tauna, eiava tau ta turiana, baine daua toho, eiava gara ai baine dau kau, ia na baine taubu ela bona dina hitu bae ore.
english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

motu: Bena taubu taudia ese hari kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna kahuna taina bae abia, sinavai ranuna ida bae buloa dihu ta ai.
english: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

motu: Bena asi mirona tauna ta ese muramura avana baine abia, una ranu ai baine urua diho; bena kalaga, bona kalaga kohuna idoinai, bona kalaga taudia, bona turia e daua toho tauna, bona dare amo e alaia mase tauna e daua toho tauna, bona e mase kava tauna e daua toho tauna, bona gara ai e dau kau tauna, baine nevaridia.
english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

motu: Asi taubuna tauna ese mai taubuna tauna baine nevaria, dina ihatoina ai bona dina ihahituna ai. Bena dina ihahituna ai ia na sibona baine haheḡoeva: ia na ena dabua baine huri bona baine digu, bena dina baine diho ai ia na baine ḡoeva.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.
