motu: A taubu tauna na unu basinema haheḡoeva toma, ia na hebou bogaragina amo bae negea daure, badina be ia ese Iehova ena gabu helaḡana vada e hamiroa; miro ihuri-ohona ranuna amo asie nevaria dainai ia na taubu.
english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

motu: Edia taravatu bunai ela bona hanaihanai: kara dika ihuri-ohona ranuna baine nevarilaia tauna ese ena dabua baine huri; bona kara dika iabi-ohona ranuna ai baine dau kau tauna na baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

motu: Taubu tauna ese baine daua toho ḡauna na baine miro; bona una ḡau ma baine daua toho tauna danu baine taubu ela bona dina baine diho.
english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

motu: Hua gini-gunana ai Israel taudia oreana idoinai na Sin tano-ḡaḡaena ai e kau, Kade ai e taruha. Unuseni ai Miriama e mase; idia ese una gabu ai e guria.
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

motu: Una gabu na asi ranuna, hebou taudia edia. Bena idia na e hebou, Mose bona Aaron e inai henidia.
english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

motu: Idia ese Mose e ḡadeḡade henia, eto, Varavaramai na Iehova vairanai e mase negana ai, ai danu baiama mase bema namo.
english: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

motu: Dahaka dainai ai Iehova ena orea taumai na ina tano ḡaḡaena ai vada; o hakaumai vareai? Ai baia mase bona emai ubu-ubu ḡaudia baemase totona a?
english: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

motu: Dahaka dainai Aigupto amo vada o hakaumai lasi, ema bona ina gabu dikana? Ina gabu na asi uitina, asi sukena, asi vinena, asi rimonona; + 20:5 “Suke” bona “rimono” na Heberu taudia edia au huahua lalodia. * inuinu ranuna danu lasi.
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron na hebou taudia edia amo e raka oho, hebou kalagana iduarana ai e goru diho; bena Iehova diaridiarina e itaia.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Itotohi bavabia, taunimanima ba haboudia, oi bona kakamu Aaron dekemui ai; bena vairadiai nadi hagahagana ba haḡania, ranu na iena amo baine aru lasi. Unu amo oi ese ranu na nadi hagahagana amo ba ha-arua lasi, hebou taudia ba henidia bona edia ubu-ubu ḡaudiaba henidia, bae inua.
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

motu: Bena Mose ese itotohi Iehova vairana amo e abia, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
english: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron ese hebou taudia e haboudia, nadi hagahagana vairanai; e gwau henidia, eto, Gwau-edeede taumui e, a hakala; emui ranuna ina nadi hagahagana amo baia ha-arua lasi a?
english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”

motu: Bena Mose ese imanae duduia isi, nadi hagahagana na nega harua ena itotohi amo e botaia. Bena ranu na e aru lasi badabada; hebou taudia ese e inua, bona edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia.ese danu e inu.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e gwau henidia, eto, Asio abidadama henigu dainai, bona Israel taudia vairadiai lau ladagu asio hahelaḡaia dainai, umui raruosi ese ina orea taudia basio hakaudia vareai, lau ese vada na henidia tanona lalonai.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

motu: Ina ranu na Meriba; + 20:13 “Meriba” anina be “Ḡadeḡade”. * badina be Israel taudia ese Iehova e ḡadeḡade henia, bena ia ese ena siahu e hahedinarai henidia. Edom pavapavana e daḡedaḡe
english: These are the waters of Meribah; + 20:13 “Meribah” means “quarreling”. * because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

motu: Bena Mose ese gwaukau taudia Kade amo e siaidia, Edom pavapavana dekenai, bae hamaoroa, baeto “Tadimu Israel na ini e gwau tomamu: oi dibamu dahaka ḡau dahaka ḡau ese vada e butumai tao;
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “ Your|strong="H3605" * brother Israel|strong="H3478" * says|strong="H3541" *: You|strong="H3605" * know|strong="H3045" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * travail|strong="H8513" * that|strong="H3045" * has|strong="H3478" * happened|strong="H4672" * to|strong="H3478" * us|strong="H3045" *;

motu: senemai na Aigupto ela, bena nega daudau Aigupto ai a nohova; a Aigupto taudia ese ai bona tamamai e daḡedaḡe henimaiva.
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

motu: Iehova a tai heniava, bena ia ese emai taitai e kamonai, aneru ta e siaia, Aigupto amo e hakaumai lasi, ama, emu tano hetoana ai a nohomu, Kade hanuana ai.
english: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

motu: Harihari ai a noimumu, emu tano amo baia raka hanai. Uma ta amo basia raka hanai, eiava vine imeana ta amo basia raka hanai, bona guri ranudia basia inu; Pavapava Dalana ai baia raka. Dala amo basia raka siri, idiba kahana amo eiava lauri kahana amo, ela bona emu tano hetoana baia rakaia hanai.”
english: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

motu: Edom ese e haere henia, eto, Basio raka hanai, baina tuari henimu na garina.
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

motu: Israel taudia ese ma e noia, eto, Laolao dalana ai baia raka; emu ranu baia inua eiava emai ubu-ubu ḡaudia ese bae inu, ai na davana baia henimu. Aemai amo baia raka hanai, vadaeni.
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

motu: A ia ma e haere, eto, Basio raka hanai. Bena Edom ese tuari oreana badana mai goadana e hakaua lasi, idia ilao-ahudia.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

motu: Taunabunai Edom ese Israel taudia e laodia ahu, ena tano amo basie raka hanai. Bena Israel na idau dala amo ela. Aaron e mase
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

motu: Idia na Kade amo eha laolao, ela, iboudiai na Horo ororona ai e kau.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

motu: Bena Horo ororona ai, Edom ena tano hetoana ai, Iehova ese Mose bona Aaron e hamaorodia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

motu: Aaron na tubu tama dekediai baine hahebou; ia na Israel taudia vada na henidia tanona ai basine raka vareai, badina be ranu gabuna ai Meriba ai egu hereva o utua.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

motu: Aaron mai natuna Eleasara ida bavabidia, Horo ororona ai ba hakaudia dara.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

motu: Bena Aaron a ena dabua ba doki oho, ia natuna Eleasara ba hadokilaia. Aaron be unuseni ai baine mase, tubu tama dekedia bainela.
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena ai e karaia; hebou taudia iboudiai vairadiai idia tatoiosi na Horo ororona e dara dae.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

motu: Bena Mose ese Aaron ena dabua e doki oho, natuna Eleasara e hadokilaia. Bena Aaron na ororo dorina ai e mase, a Mose bona Eleasara na ororo amo e hekei diho.
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

motu: Hebou taudia iboudiai ese e itaia Aaron vada e mase, bena Israel taudia iboudiai ese dina toi-ahui ai ia taina e taiva.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

motu: Arada pavapavana, tau Kanaan, diho kahana ai e nohova, vada e kamonai Israel na Atarim dalana amo e maiva, bena ia ese e tuari henidia bona haida e abidia mauri.
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova e gwau henia hamata, eto, Ina bese be ai imamai ai ba henimai, bena ai ese edia hanua baia habuadia tari.
english: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Israel taudia edia noinoi e abia dae, Kanaan taudia na idia imadia ai e henidia; bena idia ese una bese taudia e aladia ore bona edia hanua e habuadia tari. Taunabunai una gabu ladana e hatoa Horoma. + 21:3 “Horoma” anina be “Hebua-tari”. *
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah. + 21:3 “Hormah” means “destruction”. *

motu: Bena Horo ororona amo ma e laolao, Davara Kakakakana dalana amo e laova, Edom tanona murimurina amo bae raka hanai eto. A dala ai e hesiku,
english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

motu: Iehova bona Mose e maumauraidia, eto, Dahaka dainai Aigupto amo o hakaumai lasi, tano ḡaḡaena ai baia mase helaoreana? Badina be asi amai; ranu danu lasi. A ina aniani ḡauna dikana ianina vada ame hesiku.
english: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”

motu: Bena Iehova ese hekori gaigaidia e siaidia, idia bogaragidiai; gaigai ese e koridia, bena Israel taudia hutuma e mase.
english: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

motu: Bena idia na Mose dekena ela, eto, Ai na vada a kara havara, Iehova vada a maumauraia, oi danu vada a maumauraimu: Iehova ba noia, ia ese ini gaigai na ai emai amo baine abidia oho. Taunabunai Mose na e ḡuriḡuri, taunimanima daidiai.
english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Gaigai laulauna ta ba koroa, au-tubua dorina ai ba kapaia kau; bena gaigai ese bae koridia taudia ese bae raraia tao ai na vada bae mauri.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese gaigai laulauna ta, auri labora-labora amo e koroa, bona au-tubua dorina ai e kapaia kau, bena gaigai ese e koridia taudia ese una auri labora-labora gaigaina e raraiatao, bena vada e mauri. Israel ma e laolao
english: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

motu: Israel taudia ma e laolao, Oboto ai e taruha.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

motu: Oboto ma e toretania, ela, Ie-abarim ai e taruha, tano ḡaḡaena ai. Una tano ḡaḡaenana Moab e hevaira henia, mairiveina kahana ai.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

motu: Ma e tore isi, ela, Serede kourana ai e tatuha.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

motu: Unu amo ma ela, Aranon sinavaina unukahana ai e taruha; una na tano ḡaḡaena ai, Amoro taudia edia tano isena ai. Hari Aranon sinavaina na Moab bona Amoro taudia edia tano hetoana.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

motu: Una dainai Iehova ena tuari bukana ai vada e tore, eto, Wahebe Sufa ai, Bona Aranon kouradia ai;
english: Therefore it is said in \+w The|strong="H5921"\+w* \+w Book|strong="H5612"\+w* \+w of|strong="H3068"\+w* \+w the|strong="H5921"\+w* \+w Wars|strong="H4421"\+w* \+w of|strong="H3068"\+w* \+w Yahweh|strong="H3068"\+w* *, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

motu: Koura ege-egedia Ela bona Ara ena noho gabuna, Bona Moab tanona hetoana. Israel edia Ane
english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

motu: Unu amo ma e laolao ela bona Bere: ranu gurina bunai Iehova ese e gwauraia, Mose na e hamaorolaia, eto, Taunirnanima ba haboudia, lau ese ranu baina henidia.
english: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

motu: Bena Israel ese ina ane e abia: Ranu e, a lohi lohi dae! Ane avabia!
english: Then Israel sang this song: “ Spring|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" *, well! Sing|strong="H7891" * to|strong="H3478" * it|strong="H5927" *,

motu: Hanua pavapavadia ese guri e ḡeia, Hanua lohiadia ese e hadobua, Dagi auna amo bona itotohi amo. Una tano ḡaḡaena amo ma e laolao, ela bona gabu ladana Matana;
english: the well, which the princes dug, which|strong="H5971" * the|strong="H5971" * nobles|strong="H5081" * of|strong="H8269" * the|strong="H5971" * people|strong="H5971" * dug|strong="H2658" *, with|strong="H5971" * the|strong="H5971" * scepter|strong="H2710" *, and|strong="H5971" * with|strong="H5971" * their|strong="H5971" * poles.” From|strong="H5971" * the|strong="H5971" * wilderness|strong="H4057" * they|strong="H5971" * traveled to|strong="H5971" * Mattanah|strong="H4980" *;

motu: Matana amo ela bona Nahaliele; Nahaliele amo ela bona Bamoto;
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

motu: Bamoto amo ela bona koura ta Moab kahana ai; ma unu amo ela bona Pisga ororona dorina: unu amo tano ḡaḡaena e roha tari lao. Israel ese Sihon bona Og e hadareredia
english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

motu: Israel ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, dekenai, eto,
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

motu: Mani emu kara emu tano amo baia raka hanai. Basia raka siri, uma ai eiava vine imeana ai basia raka vareai; guri ranudia danu basia inu. Pavapava Dalana amo baia raka, ela bona emu tano amo baia raka lasi.
english: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

motu: A Sihon ese Israel taudia e gwaudia tao, ena tano amo basie raka hanai eto. Ena orea taudia iboudiai e haboudia, tano ḡaḡaena ela, Israel taudia ilao-henidia totona; bena Iahasa ai e tuari henidia.
english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

motu: A Israel taudia ese dare amo e alaia mase, ena tano idoinai e abia, Aranon sinavaina amo ela bona Iabok sinavaina ela bona Amono taudia edia tano; a Amono taudia ese edia tano hetoana e ginia ahu auka masemase.
english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese edia hanua iboudiai e abidia; bena Hesebon bona Amoro hanuadia maraḡidia iboudiai e noholaidia.
english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

motu: Badina be Hesebon na Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, ena hanua; ia ese gunaguna Moab pavapavana gunana e tuari henia, bona ena tano idoinai e abia ela bona Aranon sinavaina.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

motu: Una dainai ane isisibana taudia eto: Aoma Hesebon. Sihon ena hanua baita hadaia, Bona baita ha-aukaia.
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “ Come|strong="H5892" * to|strong="H5921" * Heshbon|strong="H2809" *. Let|strong="H3651" * the|strong="H5921" * city|strong="H5892" * of|strong="H5892" * Sihon|strong="H5511" * be|strong="H5892" * built|strong="H1129" * and|strong="H5892" * established|strong="H3559" *;

motu: Badina be lahi Hesebon amo e tubu, Lahi hururu-hururuna Sihon ena hanua amo e dae; Ara Moab ai e araia, Aranon ororodia lohiadia e aradia ore.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a|strong="H3068" * flame|strong="H3852" * from|strong="H3318" * the|strong="H3588" * city|strong="H7151" * of|strong="H1167" * Sihon|strong="H5511" *. It|strong="H3588" * has|strong="H3588" * devoured Ar|strong="H6144" * of|strong="H1167" * Moab|strong="H4124" *, The|strong="H3588" * lords|strong="H1167" * of|strong="H1167" * the|strong="H3588" * high|strong="H1116" * places|strong="H1116" * of|strong="H1167" * the|strong="H3588" * Arnon.

motu: Moab e, madi, ihabaimu! Kemoso o toma henia dihomu taumui e, vada o baia! Natuna mamaruanedia vada e luludia oho, Natuna hahinedia vada e abidia mauri, Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, ese.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You|strong="H5414" * are|strong="H5971" * undone, people|strong="H5971" * of|strong="H1121" * Chemosh|strong="H3645" *! He|strong="H5414" * has|strong="H4428" * given|strong="H5414" * his|strong="H5414" * sons|strong="H1121" * as|strong="H5971" * fugitives|strong="H6412" *, and|strong="H1121" * his|strong="H5414" * daughters|strong="H1323" * into|strong="H1323" * captivity|strong="H7628" *, to|strong="H5414" * Sihon|strong="H5511" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H5414" * Amorites.

motu: Emai diba amo vada a haberodia; Hesebon vada e hebua tari ela bona Dibon, Tano vada a havahua ela bona Nofa, ela bona Medeba.
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon|strong="H2809" * has perished even|strong="H5704" * to|strong="H5704" * Dibon|strong="H1769" *. We|strong="H5704" * have|strong="H2809" * laid|strong="H8074" * waste|strong="H8074" * even|strong="H5704" * to|strong="H5704" * Nophah|strong="H5302" *, Which reaches|strong="H5704" * to|strong="H5704" * Medeba|strong="H4311" *.”

motu: Unuhetomana Israel na Amoro tanona e noho henia.
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

motu: Bena Mose ese hasinadoa taudia e siaidia, lasere ela; bona lasere hanuadia e abidia, Amoro taudia unuseni ai e nohova na e luludia lasi.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

motu: Bena idia na e raka Iasi, Basan dalana amo ela. Bena Og, Basan pavapavana, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai ida, e raka Iasi, Edrei ai e tuari henidia.
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

motu: A Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Basio gari henia; oi imamu ai vada na atoa kau: ia, bona ena orea taudia iboudiai, bona ena tano idoinai. Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, Hesebon ai o kara henia heḡereḡerena, ina tau danu unu ba kara henia toma.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

motu: Taunabunai idia ese ia bona natuna bona ena orea taudia iboudiai e hadareredia bona e luludia lasi; bena ena tano e abia, edia tano ai e halaoa.
english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

motu: Israel taudia ma e laolao, Moab taoradia ai e taruha, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, gabu ladana na Ieriko.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

motu: Balak Siporo ese Israel taudia edia kara idoinai Amoro taudia e kara henidia vada e itaia.
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

motu: Moab ai danu gari na bada, badina be Israel taudia na hutuma herea; una dainai Moab taudia ese Israel taudia garidia e gariva.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

motu: Bena Moab ese Midian lohiadia hamaorodia, eto, Ini hutuma na eda gabu idoinai bae habuaia tari, boromakau; ese rei e ani oremu na heto. Una negana ai Balak Siporo( na Moab pavapavana.
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak|strong="H1111" * the|strong="H3605" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Zippor|strong="H6834" * was|strong="H1931" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H1121" * Moab|strong="H4124" * at|strong="H4428" * that|strong="H3605" * time|strong="H6256" *.

motu: Taunabunai ia ese gwaukau taudia haida e siaidia, a Balaam Beoro dekenai, Petoro ai, Sinavai Badana isena ai, Amawa tanona ai, eto, A itaia, bese ta Aigupto amo vada ema, tano idoinai vada e hahonua davana; idia na lau vairagu ai vada e taruha.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

motu: Mani emu kara aoma, ina bese ba uduguiraia, badina be edia goada ese lauegu e hereaiamu; bena readia baina hadareredia diba bona baina luludia diba; badina be lau dibagu oi ese o hanamoamu tauna na baine namo, bona oi ese o uduguiraiamu tauna na baine dika.
english: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

motu: Taunabunai, Moab lohiadia bona Midian lohiadia ese idume na imadia ai e abi, ela, Balaam enai e kau, Balak ena hereva e hamaorolaia.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

motu: Bena Balaam ese e haere henidia, eto, Hari hanuaboi iniseni ai ba mahuta; bena Iehova ese baine hereva henigu heḡereḡerena ai baina haere henimui. Taunabunai, Moab lohiadia na Balaam dekenai e nohova.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahweh shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

motu: Bena Dirava na Balaam dekena ema, eto, Ini oi dekemu ai e nohomu taudia be daidia?
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

motu: Balaam ese Dirava e haere henia, eto, Balak Siporo, Moab pavapavana, vada e siaidia dekegu ai, eto,
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

motu: O itaia, bese ta Aigupto amo vada ema, tano idoinai vada e hahonua davana; mani emu kara, ina bese ba uduguiraia, bena baina tuari henidia bona ina tano amo baina luludia lasi.
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

motu: Dirava ese Balaam e hamaoroa, eto, Idia ida basiola, bona una bese basio uduguiraia; badina be lau ese vada na hanamodia.
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

motu: Daba ai Balaam e tore isi, Balak ena lohia taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Emui tano ba lou henia, badina be Iehova ese e rugumu, basina bamomui e tomu.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to go with you.”

motu: Taunabunai Moab lohiadia e lou ela, Balak dekenai, eto, Balaam na e gwau edeede, se bamomai.
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

motu: Taunabunai, Balak ese lohia haida ma e siaidia; e siaidia guna na dia hoho bona dagi maraḡi taudia, a harihari e siaidia na hoho bona dagi bada taudia.
english: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

motu: Idia na Balaam dekena ela, eto, Balak Siporo na e tomu, Ḡau ta basine laomu ahu, vada aoma.
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

motu: Lau ese baina matauraimu, bona ede ba hamaorogu toma unu mo baina kara toma. Taunabunai vada aoma, ina bese ba uduguiraia, egu noinoi heḡereḡerena.
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

motu: A Balaam ese Balak ena hesiai taudia e haere henidia, eto, Ena be Balak ese ena ruma, mai ena silver * idoinai bona ena gold * idoinai ida, bema henigu, to Iehova egu Dirava ena hahedua basinama ha-idaua diba; basinama hamaraḡia, basinamahabadaia danu.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.

motu: Taunabunai, iniseni ai ba mahuta, hari ina hanuaboi, ela.bona lau baina diba Iehova ede baine haduagu toma.
english: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else Yahweh will speak to me.”

motu: Bena hanuaboi ai Dirava ese Balaam e hahedinarai henia, eto, Ini taunimanima) ima na oi iboirimu vada ema. Vadaeni, a tore isi, idia ida baola; a lau ese baina hamaoromu heḡereḡerena ai mo ba karaia. Balaam ena a doniki e hereva
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

motu: Taunabunai, Balaam na daba ai e tore isi, ena doniki e abia heḡaeḡae, Moab lohiadia idoinai ida ela.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

motu: A ia na ela dainai, Dirava vada e badu; bena Iehova ena aneru ta dala ai e gini, ia ilao-ahuna. Ia be ena doniki ai e gui, ena hesiai taudia rarua danu ia e bamoa.
english: God’s anger burned because he went; and Yahweh’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

motu: Hari doniki ese Iehova ena aneru e itaia, dala ai gini, mai ena dare imana ai; bena doniki na dala amo e raka siri, rei lalonai. A Balaam ese doniki e kwadia, baine Iou dala ai eto.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru na gabu hekahina ta ai, dala na vine imeadia padadia amo ela gabuna ai, e gini. Dala kahana kahana ai na nadi maḡudia.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

motu: Doniki ese Iehova ena aneru ma e itaia, bena e raka siri maḡu badibadinai; bena Balaam aena e bero maḡu nadidia ai. Bena ma e kwadia lou.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

motu: Una murinai, Iehova ena aneru ma ela, gabu hekahi-hekahina taai e gini, idiba ai bona lauri ai asi raka siri dalana gabuna ai.
english: Yahweh’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

motu: Doniki ese Iehova ena aneru ma e itaia, bena tano ai e hekure diho Balaam henunai. Bena Balaam e badu dikadika, ena, itotohi amo e dadabaia.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

motu: Bena Iehova ese doniki uduna e hahaḡaia, bena ia ese Balaam e hereva henia, eto, Lau ede na karamu toma dainai nega toi o kwadigu?
english: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

motu: Balaam ese doniki e haere henia, eto, Vada o hakavakavagu dainai; imagu bema mai darena, bama alamu mase.
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

motu: Bena doniki ese Balaam ma e hereva henia, eto, Lau na emu doniki ani? Emu mauri dinadia iboudiai lau dorugu ai vada o loaloa ani? Lau ese nega ta ini na karamu toma a? Balaam eto, Lasi.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Balaam matana e hapapa; bena Balaam ese Iehova ena aneru e itaia dala ai, imana na mai darena. Bena e goru diho tano ai.
english: Then Yahweh opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

motu: Iehova ena aneru ese e gwau henia, eto, Dahaka dainai emu doniki na nega toi o kwadia? O itaia, lau na oi ilao-ahumu vada na raka lasi, badinabe emu kara na dika vairagu ai.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

motu: Bena doniki e itagu, bona nega toi egu amo e raka siri; basinema raka siri, oi bama alamu mase a ia bama hamauria.
english: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

motu: Bena Balaam ese Iehova ena aneru e haere henia, eto, Lau be na kerere, badina be asi dibagu oi na dala ai gini, o laogu ahu. A bema oi o laloamu bainala na dika, vada baina lou lao.
english: Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Balaam e hamaoroa, eto, Idia ida baola; a lau baina hamaorolaimu herevadia mo ba gwaurai. Bena Balaam na Balak lohiadia ida ela.

english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

motu: Bena Balaam na Balak ida ela, Kiriata-husoto ai e kau.
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

motu: Bena Balak ese Balaam e badu henia, imana ruaosi e pata hekapu, e gwau henia, eto, Inaigu iuduguiraidia totona na boirimu, to oi na nega hatoi vada o hanamodia.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

motu: A lou haraḡa, emu gabu baola; lau na dagi namona baina henimu nato, to Iehova ese vada e rumu, baina henimu nato dagina na basio abia.
english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”

motu: Bena Balaam ese Balak e haere henia, eto, Emu gwaukau taudia na hamaorodia, ani, nato
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

motu: “Ena be Balak ese ena ruma, mai ena silver * idoinai bona ena gold * idoinai ida, bema henigu, to Iehova ena hereva basinama ha-idaua diba; sibogu egu ura ai kara namonata eiava kara dikana ta basinama karaia diba, a Iehova ena hereva mo baina gwauraia”.
english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?

motu: Benaini, egu gabu taudia baina lou henidia; a guna baina hamaoromu, ina bese taudia ese oiemu bese taudia ede bae karadia toma dina gabedia ai.
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

motu: Bena ma e haroro, eto, Balaam Beoro ena hereva bini; Matana vada e papa tauna ena hereva bini;
english: He took up his parable, and said, “ Balaam|strong="H1109" * the|strong="H5002" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Beor|strong="H1160" * says|strong="H5002" *, the|strong="H5002" * man|strong="H1397" * whose|strong="H1397" * eyes|strong="H5869" * are|strong="H1121" * open|strong="H8365" * says|strong="H5002" *;

motu: Dirava ena hereva e kamonaimu tauna, Herea Mikamika ena aonega ai e aonegamu tauna, Siahu-idoinai Diravana hairaina e itaiamu Bena e toma dihomu to matana se hakapumu tauna, Ena hereva bini.
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows|strong="H3045" * the|strong="H5002" * knowledge|strong="H1847" * of|strong="H5869" * the|strong="H5002" * Most|strong="H5945" * High|strong="H5945" *, and|strong="H5869" * who|strong="H3045" * sees|strong="H2372" * the|strong="H5002" * vision|strong="H4236" * of|strong="H5869" * the|strong="H5002" * Almighty|strong="H7706" *, falling|strong="H5307" * down|strong="H5307" *, and|strong="H5869" * having his|strong="H8085" * eyes|strong="H5869" * open|strong="H1540" *:

motu: Na itaiamu, to dia ina harihari; Na roha heniamu, to dia gabu kahirana ai; Hisiu ta Iakob ena amo baine dae, Dagi auna ta Israel ena amo baine heabi isi; Moab baguna baine huaria, Set garana iboudiai kwaradia baine huaridia,
english: I see him, but not now. I|strong="H6258" * see|strong="H7200" * him|strong="H7200" *, but|strong="H3808" * not|strong="H3808" * near|strong="H7138" *. A|strong="H3068" * star|strong="H3556" * will|strong="H3478" * come|strong="H3478" * out|strong="H7200" * of|strong="H1121" * Jacob|strong="H3290" *. A|strong="H3068" * scepter|strong="H7626" * will|strong="H3478" * rise|strong="H6965" * out|strong="H7200" * of|strong="H1121" * Israel|strong="H3478" *, and|strong="H1121" * shall|strong="H1121" * strike|strong="H4272" * through|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * corners|strong="H6285" * of|strong="H1121" * Moab|strong="H4124" *, and|strong="H1121" * crush|strong="H4272" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * sons|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Sheth.

motu: Edom taudia baine luludia lasi, Seiri taudia, ana inai taudia, baine ha-oredia. Israel baine kwalimu,
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir|strong="H8165" *, his|strong="H3478" * enemy, also|strong="H6213" * shall|strong="H3478" * be|strong="H1961" * a|strong="H3068" * possession|strong="H3424" *, while|strong="H1961" * Israel|strong="H3478" * does|strong="H6213" * valiantly|strong="H2428" *.

motu: Iakob baine lohia; Hanua taudia na ta basine roho mauri.
english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and|strong="H5892" * shall|strong="H5892" * destroy|strong="H5892" * the|strong="H5892" * remnant|strong="H8300" * from|strong="H5892" * the|strong="H5892" * city|strong="H5892" *.”

motu: Ia ese Amalek e haḡerea, bena ini e haroro toma: Amalek na herea-dae besena, A dokona ai baine hebua tari.
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “ Amalek|strong="H6002" * was|strong="H7225" * the|strong="H7200" * first|strong="H7225" * of|strong="H7225" * the|strong="H7200" * nations|strong="H1471" *, but|strong="H7200" * his|strong="H5375" * latter end|strong="H5703" * shall|strong="H1471" * come to|strong="H7200" * destruction.”

motu: Bena Kene taudia e haḡeredia, ma e haroro, eto, Emu ruma na auka, Emu kohoro na hagahaga nadina ai,
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “ Your|strong="H7760" * dwelling|strong="H4186" * place|strong="H7760" * is|strong="H4186" * strong. Your|strong="H7760" * nest|strong="H7064" * is|strong="H4186" * set|strong="H7760" * in|strong="H7200" * the|strong="H7200" * rock|strong="H5553" *.

motu: To Kain baine hebua tari, Asuru ese baine abimu mauri.
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until|strong="H5704" * Asshur carries you|strong="H3588" * away|strong="H1197" * captive|strong="H7617" *.”

motu: Ma e haroro, eto, Inaio, Dirava ini baine kara toma, Bena daika baine roho mauri?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who|strong="H4310" * shall|strong="H4310" * live|strong="H2421" * when|strong="H2421" * God|strong="H4310" * does this|strong="H7760" *?

motu: Lagatoi na Kitim amo baema, Asuru bona Ebere bae hahisidia, Bena idia danu bae hebua tari.
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They|strong="H1931" * shall|strong="H3027" * afflict|strong="H6031" * Asshur, and|strong="H3027" * shall|strong="H3027" * afflict|strong="H6031" * Eber|strong="H5677" *. He|strong="H1931" * also|strong="H1571" * shall|strong="H3027" * come to|strong="H3027" * destruction.”

motu: Una murinai Balaam e tore isi, ena gabu ela; Balak danu e raka oho.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

motu: Israel taudia na Sitim ai e nohova; una negana ai idia na Moab hahinedia ida e kara havarava.
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

motu: Badina be unu hahine ese e boiridia, edia boubou karadia ai bae heduru; bena Israel taudia na ela, boubou ḡaudia e ani, bona Moab taudia edia dirava e toma henidia diho.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

motu: Unuhetomana Israel taudia ese Peoro ena Baal + 25:3 “Baal”: Ina hereva anina be “Lohiabada” eiava “Biaguna”. Bese gunadia Kanaan ai e nohova ese edia dirava ladadia unu e gwaurai tomava. Hanua idau-idau na maiedia dirava idau-idau, a iboudiai ladadia e gwaurai “Baal”. “Baal-Peoro” na Peoro taudia edia dirava. Hari Baal itomadiho-henidia ai lebulebu karadia momo e karava. * e toma henia diho; bena Iehova ese Israel taudia e badu henidia.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Iduhu lohiadia iboudiai bavabidia, dina siahuna ai ba taudia dae, Iehova vairanai; unu amo Iehova ena badu ḡaraḡara na Israel taudia edia amo baine heabi oho.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”

motu: Nena Mose ese Israel edia hahemaoro taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui ta ta emui iduhu taudia hahidaosi Moab hahinedia ida e kara havara bona Peoro ena Baal e toma henia diho na bavaladia mase.
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

motu: Una negana ai Mose bona Israel oreana taudia iboudiai na hebou kalagana iduarana ai e hebou mai taitaidia ida. Bena idia vairadiai Israel tauna ta be Midian hahinena ta e hakaua lao, varavarana dekediai.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Fineha Eleasara, hahelaḡa tauna Aaron tubuna, ese e itadia, bena e tore isi, hebou e rakatania, io e abia imana ai;
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

motu: bena una Israel tauna murina amo e raka, ela bona ena kalaga ai e raka vareai, unuseni ai ia ese raruosi e gwadadia mase, tau bona hahine danu. Unu amo dai-hanai gorerena e doko Israel ai;
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

motu: ḡau tamona gerebu-rua daha-hani + 25:9 Gerebu-rua daha-hani = 24,000. * be gorere ese e hamasedia.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Fineha Eleasara, hahelaḡa tauna Aaron tubuna, ese egu badu na Israel taudia edia amo vada e abia oho, badina be lauegu vaḡeḡe ai e vaḡeḡe idia bogaragidiai; una dainai egu vaḡeḡe ai asina aladia ore.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

motu: Taunabunai baoto: Lau na ia ida baia herohemaino;
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

motu: emai herohemaino toana be ia bona ia garana na hahelaḡa taudia ai baela, ela bona hanaihanai; badina be ena Dirava vaḡeḡena ai e vaḡeḡe, unu amo herohemaino karana vada e karaia, Israel taudia daidiai.
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

motu: Hari Israel tauna, Midian hahinena ida e gwadadia mase tauna, ladana na Simiri Salu, Simeon iduhuna lohiana ta.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

motu: A Midian hahinena, e gwadaia mase hahinena, ladana na Kosobi Suru; hari Suru na iduhu ta lohiana Midian ai.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Midian taudia ba tuari henidia, vada ba hadareredia;
english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

motu: badina be idia ese edia kara hedibaḡani amo vada e tuari henimui, Peoro dainai vada e dibaḡanimui, bona taihudia Kosobi, Midian lohiana natuna, dainai; Peoro bagunai gorere ese e butumui tao dinana ai e gwadaia mase hahinena bunai.
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

motu: Gorere vada e doko murinai, Iehova ese Mose bona Eleasara Aaron, hahelaḡa tauna, e hereva henidia, eto,
english: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

motu: Israel oreana taudia ibouboudiai ba duahidia, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia iboudiai. Iduhu ta ta amo ba duahidia, tuari mai dibadia taudia iboudiai Israel ai.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

motu: Bena Mose bona hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, Moab taorana ai, Ioridane sinavaina badibadinai, Ieriko ai, eto,
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

motu: Laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia ba duahidia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena. Israel taudia, Aigupto amo e raka lasi, ladadia bini.
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These|strong="H4605" * are|strong="H1121" * those|strong="H1121" * who|strong="H3068" * came|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H3068" * land of|strong="H1121" * Egypt|strong="H4714" *.

motu: Ruben na Israel natuna roboana. Ia natuna be Hanok, Hanok iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Palu, Palu iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

motu: bona Hesron, Hesron iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Karami, Karami iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

motu: Ruben ena iduhu idoinai bunai: edia numera be 43,730.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

motu: Palu natuna ta be Eliab.
english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

motu: Eliab natuna be Nemuele bona Datan bona Abiram. Hari Datan bona Abiram, be hebou ese e abidia.a hidi, bena idia raruosi bona Kora ese Mose bona Aaron e heai henidia, bona Iehova danu e heai henia,
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against Yahweh;

motu: ela bona tano ese e hadonodia, idia bona Kora bona Kora ena orea taudia, bena iboudiai e mase. Una negana ai danu lahi ese taunimanima sinahu-rua imahui e aladia mase, mata-hakani ḡauna ai ela.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Kora natuna na asie mase.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

motu: Simeon natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Nemuele, Nemuele iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Iamin, Iamin iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Iakin, Iakin iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

motu: bona Sera, Sera iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Saul, Saul iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

motu: Simeon ena iduhu idoinai bunai: edia numera be 22,200.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

motu: Gad natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Sefon, Sefon iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Hagi, Hagi iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Suni, Suni iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

motu: bona Osni, Osni iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Eri, Eri iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

motu: bona Arod, Arod iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Areli, Areli iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

motu: Gad natuna edia iduhu bunu: edia numera be 40,500.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

motu: Iuda natuna be Ere bona Onan; a idia na Kanaan tanona ai e mase.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

motu: Iuda natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Sela, Sela iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Perese, Perese iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Sera, Sera iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

motu: Perese natuna be Hesron, Hesron iduhuna e havaraia tauna, bona Hamulu, Hamulu iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

motu: Iuda ena iduhu idoinai bunai: edia numera be 76,500.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

motu: Isakara natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Tola, Tola iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Puva, Punu iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

motu: bona Iasub, Iasub iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Simron, Simron iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

motu: Isakara ena iduhu idoinai bunai: edia numera be 64,300.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

motu: Sebulun natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Sered, Sered iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Elon, Elon iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Ialeel, Ialeel iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

motu: Sebulun ena iduhu idoinai bunai: edia numera be 60,500.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

motu: Iosef natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Manase bona Efraim.
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

motu: Manase natuna bini: Makiri, Makiri iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Gilead Makiri, Gilead iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

motu: Gilead natuna bini: Iesere, Iesere iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Helek, Helek iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

motu: bona Asriel, Asriel iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Sekem, Sekem iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

motu: bona Semida, Semida iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Hefere, Hefere iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

motu: Selofehad Hefere na asi natuna maruanena ta, hahine mo; Selofehad natuna hahinedia ladadia na Mahala bona Noa bona Hogla bona Milka bona Tirisa.
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

motu: Manase ena iduhu idoinai bunai: edia numera be 52,700.
english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

motu: Efraim natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Sutela, Sutela iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Bekere, Bekere iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Tahan, Tahan iduhuna.e havaraia tauna.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

motu: Sutela natuna be Eran, Eran iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

motu: Efraim natuna edia iduhu bunu: edia numera be 32,500. Iosef garana bunu, edia iduhu ta ta ai.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

motu: Beniamina natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Bela, Bela iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Asbel, Asbel iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Ahiram, Ahiram iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

motu: bona Sefufam, Sufam iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Hufam, Hufam iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

motu: Bela natuna na Arad bona Naaman. Arad ese Arad iduhuna e havaraia, bona Naaman ese Naaman iduhuna e havaraia.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

motu: Beniamina natuna edia iduhu bunu: edia numera be 45,600.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

motu: Dan natuna be Suhama; ia na Suhama iduhuna e havaraia tauna; Dan ena iduhu idoinai bunai.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

motu: Suhama iduhuna ena numera be 64,400.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

motu: Asere natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Imna, Imna iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Isvi, Isvi iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Beria, Beria iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

motu: Beria natuna bini: Hebere, Hebere iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Malkiel, Malkiel iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

motu: Asere natuna hahinena ladana be Sera.
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

motu: Asere natuna edia iduhu bunu: edia numera be 53,400.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

motu: Napatali natuna mai edia iduhu bini: Iaseel, Iaseel iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Guni, Guni iduhuna e havaraia tauna;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

motu: bona Iesere, Iesere iduhuna e havaraia tauna; bona Silem, Silem iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

motu: Napatali iduhuna idoinai binai: edia numera be 45,400.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

motu: Israel taudia ibouboudiai e duahidia be 601,730. Tano iharina
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Tano na ba haria, ini taunimanima edia; ladadia bona edia numera heḡereḡeredia ai ba haria.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

motu: Iduhu badana be tano badana ba henia, a iduhu maraḡina be tano maraḡina ba henia: iduhu ta ta ahudia ba henidia edia numera heḡereḡeredia.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

motu: A edia inoḡo be mari amo bae abi; senedia edia iduhu ladadia heḡereḡeredia ahudia bae abi.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

motu: Iduhu badadia ai bona iduhu maraḡidia ai, edia inoḡo na mari amo bae abi. Levi taudia e duahidia
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

motu: Levi taudia danu edia iduhu ta ta ai e duahidia. Gereson be Gereson iduhuna e havaraia tauna; Kohat be Kohat iduhuna e havaraia tauna; Merari be Merari iduhuna e havaraia tauna.
english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

motu: Levi iduhudia bini: Libni bona Heberon bona Mali bona Musi bona Kora. Kohat na Amram tamana.
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

motu: Amram adavana ladana na Iokebed, Levi natuna hahinena, Aigupto ai e vara. Ia natuna Amram enai e abidia be Aaron bona Mose bona taihudia Miriama.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

motu: Aaron natuna be Nadab bona Abihu bona Eleasara bona Itamara;
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

motu: a Nadab, bona Abihu e mase, lahi ida; idauna Iehovavairanai bae hahelaḡaia eto negana ai.
english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

motu: Levi taudia e duahidia, edia numera be 23,000; una be mamaruane hua ta vada e hanaia taudia edia numera. Israel taudia ida asie duahidia hebou, badina be tano iharina ai idia na asi.ahudia, Israel taudia bogaragidiai.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

motu: Ini iboudiai be Mose bona Eleasara, hahelaḡa tauna, ese e duahidia; Moab taorana ai, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Ieriko ai, unuseni ai e duahidia.
english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

motu: A Mose bona Aaron, hahelaḡa tauna, ese Sinai tano-ḡaḡaena ai e duahidia taudia na ta dia mauri;
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

motu: badina be Iehova ese vada e herevalaidia, eto “Tano ḡaḡaena ai bae mase”. Taunabunai ta dia mauri; Kaleb lefune bona Iosua Nunu, idia raruosi mo sibodia dounu e mauri nohova.
english: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

motu: Una negana ai Selofehad Hefere natuna hahinedia na e raka kahira. Hari Hefere na Gilead natuna; Gilead be Makiri natuna; Makiri be Manase natuna. Taunabunai, idia na Manase Iosef ena iduhu hahinedia Hahine ladadia be Mahala bona Noa bona Hogla bona Milka bona Tirisa.
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

motu: Idia na Mose bona hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona iduhu lohiadia bona hebou taudia iboudiai vairadiai e gini, hebou kalagana iduarana ai, eto,
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

motu: Tamamai na tano ḡaḡaena ai e mase: ia na dia Kora ida Iehova e heai henia oreana tauna ta, to ia sibona ena kara dika dainai e mase. Ia na asi natuna maruanena ta.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

motu: Badina be dahaka tamamai ladana na ena iduhu amo baine heabi oho, asi natuna maruanena dainai? Tamamai varavarana bogaragidiai ai ahumai ba henimai.
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

motu: Mose ese idia sivaraidia na Iehova e hamaorolaia.
english: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Selofehad natuna hahinedia edia hereva na maoro; tamadia varavarana bogaragadiai ahudia ba henidia; tamadia ahuna na idia ese bae abia.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

motu: Ina danu, Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Tau ta baine mase, asi natuna mase maruanena, natuna hahinena ese ia ahuna baine abia;
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

motu: bema asi natuna hahinena danu, ahuna na tadikakana ba henia;
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

motu: bema asi tadikakana, ahuna na tamana lahaidia ba henidia;
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

motu: a bema asi:tamana lahaina ta, ahuna na varavara-dosina ba henia, ia ese baine abia. Ina na taravatu bona haheḡani Israel taudia ediai. Iehova ese Mose vada e henia heḡereḡerena. Mose ibolona
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, eto, Ina Abarim ororona ai ba dara dae, ba roha lao, Israel taudia vada na henidia tanona do ba itaia.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

motu: Ba itaia murinai oi na tubu tama dekediai ba hahebou, kakamu Aaron heḡereḡerena;
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

motu: badina be Sin tano-ḡaḡaena ai umui raruosi ese o gwau edeede henigu, hebou taudia ese e heai henigu negana ai, ranu gabuna ai asio rimodaigu idia vairadiai. Una ranu ladana na Meriba; ia na Kade kahana ai, Sin tanoḡaḡaena ai.
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova e haere henia, eto,
english: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

motu: Mani emu kara, Iehova, taunimanima iboudiai laumadia edia Dirava, ese tau ta baine abia hidi, ina orea taudia baine biagudia.
english: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

motu: Ia be vairadiai baine raka lasi bona vairadiai baine raka vareai; baine hakaudia lasi bona baine hakaudia vareai. Iehova ena orea taudia na basie noho kava, mamoe asi ireḡudia na heheto.
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, eto, Iosua Nunu avabia: ia be lauma ese vada e rohea tauna; oi imamu na ia tubuana ai bavato kau.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

motu: Bena ba haginia, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara vairanai bona hebou taudia iboudiai vairadiai; bena idia vairadiai dagi ba henia.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

motu: Oiemu siahu amo ba hasiahua; bena Israel oreana taudia iboudiai ese ia bae kamonai henia edia hebou ai.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

motu: Ia be hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara vairanai baine gini, bena Eleasara ese ia dainai Iehova ena ura baine tahua, Urim + 27:21 “Urim”: Esodo 28, v. 30 ba itaia. * ena amo; bena iena hereva dainai bae raka lasi bona iena hereva dainai bae raka vareai, ia bona Israel oreana taudia iboudiai.
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena mo e karaia: Iosua e abia, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona hebou taudia iboudiai vairadiai e haginia;
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

motu: bena imana na ia tubuana ai e atodia kau, dagi e henia, Iehova ena haheḡani Mose ena amo e henia heḡereḡerena.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia na ini ba haḡanidia toma, baoto: Egu boubou ḡaudia, Iahi ai o gabumu agu, bonana namo ḡaudia egu, ba lalodia tao bona ba henigu, nega korikoridia iboudiai.
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

motu: Ma ba hamaorodia, baoto: Lahi boubouna binai Iehova ba henia, dina ta ta amo mamoe natudia mamaruanedia, laḡani tamona ḡaudia asi bebeka-bebekadia, rua rua amo ba heni, emu ḡole-ohoboubouna ela hanaihanai.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

motu: Mamoe natuna ta be daba ai ba henia, iharuana be adorahi ai ba henia.
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

motu: Flaoa namo-hereana efa ta ba karoaia, karoagwauta, bona dehoro negari-negarina hini + 28:5 “Efa” bona “Hini” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡaudia ladadia. * ta ba karoaia, karoa hani; benaflaoa karoa ta bona dehoro karoa ta bavabi, ba bulo, ba gabu.
english: with one tenth of an ephah + 28:5 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin + 28:5 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. * of beaten oil.

motu: Ina na ḡole-oho boubouna, dina iboudiai ba hahelaḡaia, Sinai ororona ai na haḡanimui heḡereḡerena; ia na bonana namo ḡauna, lahi boubouna, Iehova ena.
english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: Inuinu bouboudia danu ba heni: vine ranuna hini ta ba karoaia, karoa hani, bena karoa ta mamoe natuna ta ida, ma karoa ta mamoe natuna ta ida, unu ba heni toma; gabu helaḡana ai hari vine ranuna ba seia Iehova ena; emui inuinu boubouna bunai.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin + 28:7 One hin is about 6.5 liters, so 1/4 hin is about 1.6 liters or 1.7 quarts. * for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

motu: Mamoe natuna iharuana na adorahi ai ba hahelaḡaia, flaoa boubouna bona inuinu boubouna danu, daba ai o hahelaḡadia heḡereḡerena; ia na lahi boubouna, bonana namo ḡauna, Iehova ena. Dina Helaḡa Bouboudia
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

motu: Dina Helaḡa ai, mamoe natudia mamaruanedia rua, laḡani tamona ḡaudia asi bebeka-bebekadia, ba hahelaḡadia; bona flaoa namo-hereana efata ba karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa rua dehoro ida ba bulo, bena ba hahelaḡaia; inuinu boubouna danu ba seia.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah + 28:9 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

motu: Dina Helaḡa iboudiai ḡole-oho bouboudia unu ba heni toma, dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna bonaena inuinu boubouna ida ba heni hebou. Hua matamata Bouboudia
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

motu: Hua matamatadia ai Iehova ena ḡole-oho boubouna na ini ba heniatoma: boromakau natudia mamaruanedia rua, mamoe maruanena ta, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia hitu, laḡani tamona ḡaudia asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

motu: Flaoa namo-hereana efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa toi toibe dehoro ida ba bulo, boromakau natudia ta ta ida ba heni; bona karoa rua be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe maruanena ida ba heni.
english: and three tenths of an ephah + 28:12 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

motu: Ma efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ta be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe natudia ta ta ida ba heni. Ini be ḡole-oho boubouna ḡaudia, bonana namoḡaudia; bae haḡoledia oho, Iehova ena.
english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: A edia inuinu bouboudia be iniheto: vine ranuna hini ta ba karoaia, karoa rua, bena karoa ta ta ba sei, boromakau natudia ta ta edia; ma hini ta ba karoaia, karoa toi, bena karoa ta ba seia, mamoe maruanena ena; ma hini rua ba karoadia, karoa hani hani amo, bena karoa ta ta ba sei, mamoe natudia ta ta edia. Ini na hua ta ta edia ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia, laḡani huadia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia; ia na kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna Iehova enai. Ini iboudiai na dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida ba heni hebou. Lagau-hanai Bouboudia
english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

motu: Hua gini-gunana ena dina ihagwauta-hanina be Iehova ena Lagau-hanai.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

motu: Ina hua ena dina ihagwauta-imana na aria dinana: dina hitu lalodia iasie hatubua flaoana mo bae ania.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

motu: Dina gini-gunana ai hebou helaḡana bavabia. Una dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia,
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

motu: a lahi boubouna ba haḡolea oho, Iehova ena: boromakau natudia mamaruanedia rua, mamoe maruanena ta, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia hitu, iboudiai na asi bebeka-bebekadia ḡaudia mo.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

motu: Edia flaoa bouboudia danu ba haḡole oho: flaoa namo-hereana efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta. Karoa toi toi bedehoro ida ba bulo, boromakau natudia ta ta ida ba heni; bona karoa rua be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe maruanena ida ba heni.
english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

motu: Ma efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta; bena karoa ta ta be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe natudia hituosi ta ta ida ba heni.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, emui kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna, herohemaino ḡauna.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

motu: Ini ḡau bevaia: daba iboudiai o haḡole oho ḡaudia ida ba heni hebou.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

motu: Dina hituosi lalodiai unu mo ba kara toma, dina ta ta ai: boubou vamuna ba haḡolea oho, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena; ia bona dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ba heni hebou.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

motu: Dinaihahituna ai hebou helaḡana bavabia, una dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia. Taboro Bouboudia
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

motu: Uma anidia ba utu matama dinana ai, emui pura ariana ai flaoa matamatana boubouna ba hahelaḡaia, Iehova ena; una negana ai hebou helaḡana bavabia, bona ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

motu: Ḡole-oho boubouna bahahelaḡaia, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena: boromakau natudia mamaruanedia rua, mamoe maruanena ta, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia hitu, laḡani tamona ḡaudia.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

motu: Edia flaoa bouboudia danu ba haḡole oho: flaoa namohereana efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta. Karoa toi toi be dehoro ida ba bulo, boromakau natudia ta ta ida ba heni; bona karoa rua be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe maruanena ida ba heni.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

motu: Ma efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta; bena karoa ta ta be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe natudia hituosi ta ta ida ba heni.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, emui herohemaina ḡauna.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

motu: Ini ḡau be vaia emui ḡole-oho bouboudia mai edia flaoa bouboudia ida ba heni hebou. Ba ita, asi bebeka-bebekadia ḡaudia mo ba hahelaḡadia. Inuinu bouboudia danu ba sei.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

motu: Hua ihahituna ena dina gini-gunana ai, umui na hebou helaḡana ta bavabia; una dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia. Una dina ai danu kibi ba hiriri,
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

motu: bona ḡole oho boubouna ba hahelaḡaia, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena: boromakau natuna maruanena ta; mamoe maruanena ta; bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia hitu, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Edia flaoa bouboudia danu ba haḡole oho: a flaoa namo-hereana efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta. Karoa toi dehoro ida; a babulo, boromakau ida ba heni; bona karoa rua dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe maruanena ida ba heni.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

motu: Ma efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ta be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe natudia hituosi ta ta ida ba heni.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona ḡauna, emui herohemaino ḡauna.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

motu: Ini ḡau be hua matamatana ena ḡole-oho boubouna mai ena flaoa boubouna ida, bona dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna mai ena flaoa boubouna bona mai edia inuinu bouboudia ida, ba heni hebou, taravatu heḡereḡeredia. Idia na bonana namo ḡauna, Iahi boubouna, Iehova ena.
english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

motu: Hua ihahituna ena dina ihagwautana ai, umui na hebou helaḡana ta bavabia. Ba vaga, bona ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

motu: Una dina ai ḡole-oho, boubouna ba hahelaḡaia, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena: boromakau natuna maruanena ta; mamoe maruanena ta; bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia hitu, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

motu: Edia flaoa bouboudia danu ba haḡole oho: flaoa namo-hereana efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta. Karoa toi dehoro ida ba bulo, boromakau ida ba heni; bona karoa rua dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe maruanena ida ba heni.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

motu: Ma efa ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ta be dehoro ida ba bulo, mamoe natudia hituosi ta ta ida ba heni.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
