motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini be herohemaino boubouna ida bona ḡole-oho boubouna, dina iboudiai e heni louloumu ḡauna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona edia inuinu bouboudia ida, ba heni hebou.
english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

motu: Hua ihahituna ena dina ihagwauta-imana ai, umui na hebou helaḡanata bavabia. Ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia; dina hitu lalodiai aria ba karaia, Iehova ena.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.

motu: Emui ḡole-oho boubouna na lahi ai ba haḡolea oho, bonana namo ḡauna Iehova ena: boromakau natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-toi; mamoe mamaruanedia rua; bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-hani, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

motu: Edia flaoa bouboudia ḡaudia danu ba haḡole oho: flaoa namo-hereana efa tauratoi bae karoadia, karoa gwauta gwauta amo. Bena karoa toi toi be boromakau gwauta-toiosi ta ta ida ba heni; karoa rua rua amo be mamoe mamaruanedia ruaosi ida ba heni;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

motu: bona karoa ta ta be mamoe natudia gwauta-haniosi ta ta ida ba heni.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida, ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

motu: Aria dinana iharuana ai, emui boubou be boromakau natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-rua, mamoe mamaruanedia rua, bona mamoe natudiamamaruanedia gwauta-hani, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia danu ba heni, boromakau ta ta edia, mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona mamoe natudia ta ta edia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona edia inuinu bouboudia ida, ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai emui boubou be boromakau mamaruanedia gwauta-ta, mamoe mamaruanedia rua, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-hani, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia danu ba heni, boromakau ta ta edia, mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta ta edia, bona mamoe natudia ta ta edia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

motu: Dina ihahanina ai emui boubou be boromakau mamaruanedia gwauta, mamoe mamaruanedia rua, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-hani, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia danu ba heni, boromakau ta ta edia, mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona mamoe natudia ta ta edia, taravatu heḡereḡeredia.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

motu: Dina iha-imana ai emui boubou be boromakau mamaruanedia taurahani-ta, mamoe mamaruanedia rua, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-hani, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia danu ba heni, boromakau ta ta edia, mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona mamoe natudia ta ta edia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida, ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

motu: Dina ihatauratoina ai emui boubou be boromakau mamaruanedia taurahani, mamoe mamaruanedia rua, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-hani, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia danu ba heni, boromakau ta ta edia, mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona mamoe natudia ta ta edia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubounabona ena inuinu bouboudia ida, ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

motu: Dina ihahituna ai, emui boubou be boromakau mamaruanedia hitu, mamoe mamaruanedia rua, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia gwauta-hani, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia danu ba heni, boromakau ta ta edia, mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona mamoe natudia ta ta edia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-oho boubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida, ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, umui na hebou helaḡana ta bavabia; una dina ai ḡaukara badana ta basio karaia.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

motu: Ḡole-oho boubouna ba haḡolea oho, bonana namo ḡauna, Iehova ena: boromakau maruanena ta, mamoe maruanena ta, bona mamoe natudia mamaruanedia hitu, laḡani tamona ḡaudia, asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

motu: Flaoa boubouna bona inuinu bouboudia danu baheni, boromakau; ena, bona mamoe maruanena ena, bona mamoe natudia ta ta edia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

motu: Nani maruanena ta danu ba hahelaḡaia, kara-dika iabi-ohona boubouna. Ini iboudiai be dina kavakava ena ḡole-ohoboubouna, mai ena flaoa boubouna bona ena inuinu boubouna ida, ba heni hebou.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

motu: Ini iboudiai na Iehova ba henia, emui aria dinadia ai, emui gwau-hamata ḡaudia bona emui herahia ḡaudia ida. Emui ḡole-oho bouboudia bona emui flaoa bouboudia bona emui inuinu bouboudia bona emui herohemaino bouboudia unu ba heni toma.
english: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

motu: Bena Mose ese ini hereva iboudiai na Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia, Iehova ese ia e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Mose ese Israel iduhudia lohiadia e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova ena haheḡani binai:
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

motu: tau ta ese Iehova baine gwau henia hamata, eiava Iehova vairanai baine gwau hamata kara ta baine karaia, ia na basine koikoi; ena gwau hamata do baine hamomokania.
english: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

motu: Tamana ena ruma ai nohona ai, hane-ulato ta ese Iehova baine gwau henia hamata, bona Iehova vairanai baine gwau hamata kara ta baine karaia,
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

motu: bena tamana ese ena gwau hamata baine kamonai a hereva ta basine gwauraia, una hane-ulato ena gwau hamata baine gini.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

motu: A ena gwau hamata baine kamonai negana ai tamana ese baine gwaua tao, ena gwau hamata na asi anina: Iehova ese danu baine gwaua tao, badina be hane-ulato tamana ese e gwaua tao.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

motu: Hane-ulato ese ena gwau hamata karana do basine haḡuḡurua negana ai baine headava,
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

motu: bena adavana ese ena gwau hamata sivaraina baine kamonai dinana ai hereva ta basine gwauraia, una hahine ena gwau hamata baine gini, anina do baine karaia.
english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

motu: A baine kamonai dinana ai adavana ese baine gwaua tao, ena gwau hamata na asi anina; Iehova ese danu baine gwaua tao.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.

motu: Vabu ta, eiava diho hahinena ta, ena gwau hamata do baine gini, anina do baine karaia.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

motu: Bema adavana dekenai e nohova ai na e gwau hamata,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

motu: bena adavana na e kamonai a hereva ta se gwauraia; gwauraia bona se gwaua tao, ena gwau hamata do baine gini, anina baine karaia.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

motu: A bema e kamonai dinana ai adavana ese e gwaua tao, ena gwau hamata na basine gini: adavana ese vada e gwaua tao; Iehova ese danu baine gwaua tao.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.

motu: Hahine ena gwau hamata adavana ese baine hamomokania diba, eiava baine gwaua tao diba.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

motu: A dina haida baela, adavana ese hereva ta basine gwauraia, una be ena gwau hamata hamomokania karana; vada e hamomokania, badina be e kamonai dinana ai ia na se hereva.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

motu: A baine kamonai murinai baine gwaua tao, hahine ena kerere be ia ese baine huaia.
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

motu: Iehova ena haheḡani bunu, ia ese Mose e henia: tau mai adavana ida taravatudia, bona tau mai natuna kekenina ida taravatudia, kekeni na tamana ena ruma nohona ai.
english: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

motu: Iehova ese Mose na e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Midian taudia ese Israel taudia vada e ala-ala henidia davana na bavala-ala henidia; una murinai tubu tama dekediai ba hahebou.
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

motu: Taunabunai Mose ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui bogaragimui amo haida ese edia tuari ḡaudia bae abi heḡaeḡae, Midian taudia bae tuari henidia, edia kara davana Iehova ese vada e gwauraia do ba kara henidia.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

motu: Israel iduhudia ta ta amo tuari taudia daha-ta daha-ta ba siaidia.
english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia loḡora edia amo iduhu ta ta edia daha-ta ta ta e siaidia: tuari taudia iboudiai be gerebu-ta daha-rua. + 31:5 gerebu-ta rdaha-rua = 12,000. *
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

motu: Bena Mose ese e siaidia, bae tuari; iduhu ta ta amo daha-ta ta ta e siaidia. Hahelaḡa tauna Fineha Eleasara danu e siaia; ia ese gabu helaḡana kohudia imana ai e abi kau, bona tuari kibidia danu.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

motu: Bena idia ese Midian taudia e tuari henidia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena; bena mamaruanedia iboudiai e aladia ore.
english: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.

motu: Midian pavapavadia laimaosi danu e aladia mase: Evi bona Rekem bona Suru bona Huru bona Reba. Balaam Beoro danu dare amo e alaia mase.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

motu: Midian hahinedia mai natudia ida Israel taudia ese e abidia mauri; edia boromakau iboudiai bona edia mamoe iboudiai bona edia kohu idoinai danu e abi.
english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

motu: Edia hanua iboudiai bona edia taruha iboudiai e doudia ore;
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

motu: bena e abi kohudia e laohai, bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia bona taunimanima danu e hakaudia lao.
english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

motu: Bena abi-mauri taudia bona seri bona kohu na e laohaidia, Mose bona hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara dekediai, Israel taudia edia hebou ai e hahedinaraidia, edia taruha ai, Ieriko ai, Moab taorana ai, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai.
english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

motu: Bena Mose bona hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona orea lohiadia na e raka lasi dekediai, taruha murimurinai idia ida e hedavari.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

motu: Bena Mose ese tuari lohiadia, daha-ta ta ta biagudia bona sinahu ta ta biagudia, tuari amovada e lou mai, na e badu henidia;
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

motu: e gwau henidia, eto, Dahaka dainai hahine iboudiai o hamauridia?
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

motu: A laloa, idia ese Balaam ena hereva amo Israel taudia e hahekwakwanaidia, Peoro ororona ai, bena gorere ese Iehova ena orea taudia e hamasedia.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

motu: Taunabunai, memero iboudiai bavaladia mase, bona hahine iboudiai danu;
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

motu: a kekeni bona ulato na ba hamauridia, bavabidia emui.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

motu: Bena dina hitu taruha murimurinai ba noho, taunimanima o aladia mase eiava mase taudia ediai o dau kau taumui iboumui ai. Dina ihatoina ai bona dina ihahituna ai ba haheḡoeva, bona emui abi-mauri kekenidia bona ulatodia ba haḡoevadia.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

motu: Emui, dabua danu, bona kopi eiava nani huidia eiava au amo e kara taudia, iboudiai ba haḡoevadia.
english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara ese tuari ela taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Haheḡani binai, Iehova ese Mose vada e henia:
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses.

motu: gold * bona silver * bona auri labora-labora bona auri bona tin * bona lead *,
english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

motu: lahi ai ba gabu diba ḡaudia, iboudiai na lahi ai ba gabudia, bena bae ḡoeva. A ranu helaḡa ai ba huridia danu; bona basio gabu diba ḡaudia danu ranu ai ba huridia.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

motu: Bena dina ihahituna ai emui dabua ba huridia, bena ba ḡoeva. Una murinai umui na taruha lalonai ba raka vareai.
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Tuari ai e abi ḡaudia, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia, ba hagaudia, oi bona hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bonaorea lohiadia ese.
english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

motu: Bena ba haridia, ahu rua: ta be tuari ela taudia ahudia, a ta be kone-noho taudia ahudia.
english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

motu: Bena tuari ela taudia ahudia ai, sinahu ima ima amo ta ta ba hahelaḡadia Iehova ena, taunimanima bona boromakau bona doniki bona mamoe;
english: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

motu: idia ahudia amo bavabidia, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara ba henia, boubou ḡaudia ai baela, baine dudui isi Iehova vairanai.
english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

motu: A kone-noho taudia ahudia ai, imahui imahui amo ta ta ba hahelaḡadia, taunimanima bona boromakau bona doniki bona mamoe; bena Levi taudia, Iehova ena dubu e reḡuamu taudia, ba henidia.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”

motu: Bena Eleasara bona Mose na unu e kara toma, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Tuari taudia ese vada e abidia mauri ḡaudia bini: mamoe 675,000,
english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

motu: boromakau 72,000,
english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

motu: doniki 61,000,
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

motu: bona taunimanima 32,000, iboudiai na kekeni bona ulato.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

motu: Tuari ela taudia ahudia bini: mamoe 337,500,
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

motu: unu amo Iehova ahuna na 675;
english: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

motu: boromakau 36,000, unu amo Iehova ahuna na 72;
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

motu: doniki 30,500, unu amo Iehova ahuna na 61;
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

motu: bona taunimanima 16,000, unu amo Iehova ahuna na 32.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

motu: Mose ese Iehova ahuna e abia, boubou ḡauna hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara e henia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Kone-noho taudia ahudia, Mose ese tuari ela taudia ahudia amo ehididia ḡaudia,
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

motu: na iniheto: mamoe 337,500,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

motu: boromakau 36,000,
english: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

motu: doniki 30,500,
english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

motu: bona taunimanima 16,000.
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

motu: Bena idia ahudia ai Mose ese imahui imahui amo ta ta e abidia, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia; bena ia ese Levi taudia, Iehova ena dubu e reḡuava taudia, e henidia, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Bena tuari lohiadia, daha-ta ta ta biagudia bona sinahu ta ta biagudia, ese Mose e raka henia kahi,
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

motu: eto, Emu hesiai taudia ese tuari taudia ai henumai ai vada e duahidia ore, ta se boio.
english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

motu: Bena herahia ḡaudia vada a mailaidia, Iehova ena, gold * ḡaudia tuari ai e abi: ima vaḡivaḡidia bona bae vaḡivaḡidia bona kwakikwaki vaḡivaḡidia, bona gadei, bona ageva; emai herohemaino ḡaudia Iehova vairanai.
english: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

motu: Bena Mose bona hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara ese hari gold * ḡaudia idau-idau idia imadia amo e abidia.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

motu: Hari gold * idoinai, daha-ta ta ta biagudia bona sinahu ta ta biagudia ese e mailaia, edia herahia ḡauna Iehova bae henia eto, ena metau be sekele 16,750. + 31:52 Sekele 16,750 = 274 kilograms sisivana, ita eda hahetoho ai. *
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels. + 31:52 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 16,750 shekels is about 167.5 kilograms or about 368.5 pounds. *

motu: Badina be tuari taudia ta ta ese edia kohu vada e gogo una tuari ai.
english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

motu: Bena Mose bona hahalaḡa tauna Eleasara ese hari daha ta ta biagudia bona sinahu ta ta biagudia e heni gold-na * e abia, hebou kalagana ai e vareailaia, Iehova vairanai Israel taudia ihelalolaidia ḡaudia a ai bainela totona.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

motu: Ruben bona Gad garadia edia seri na momo herea; bena idia ese lasere tanona bona Gilead tanona e itadia, idia na tano namohereadia, seri iubulaidia.
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

motu: Taunabunai unu iduhu ruaosi taudia na Mose dekena ela, Mose bona hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona hebou biagudia e hereva henidia, eto,
english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

motu: Ataroto bona Dibon bona lasere bona Nimra bona Hesebon bona Eleale bona Sebam bona Nebo bona Beon tanodia bini,
english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

motu: Iehova ese Israel oreana tauda imada ai vada e heni, na seri iubulaidia tanodia namodia; bona ai bini emu hesiai taumai emai seri na momo herea.
english: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

motu: Idia ma eto, Oi lalomu bema namo emai ai, mani emu kara ina tano boma henimai, emai tano; basio hakaumai hanai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai.
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

motu: A Mose ese Ruben bona Gad iduhudia taudia e gwau henidia, eto, Varavaramui ma bae ha tuari, a umui be iniseni ai ba helai diho a?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

motu: Dahaka dainai Israel taudia lalodia ba hamanokadia, Iehova ese vada e henidia tanona ai basie raka vareai o tomu?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

motu: Tamamui na unu e kara toma, lau ese Kade-baranea amo na siaidia tano bae hasinadoa negana ai.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

motu: Idia na ela, Eskol kourana ai e lasi, tano e itaia, bena e lou, Israel taudia lalodia e hamanokadia, Iehova ese vada e henidia tanona ai basie raka vareai eto.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.

motu: Una dina ai Iehova ena badu e vara, bena e gwau hamata, eto
english: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

motu: “Momokani, Israel taudia Aigupto amo vada e raka lasi, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia iboudiai, ta ese lau vada na gwauraia hamata, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob baina henidia nato, tanona basine itaia, lasi vaitani, badina be idia na asie abidadama henigu;
english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

motu: una dainai Kaleb lefune, Kenisi tauna, bona Iosua Nunu mo bae itaia, badina be idia raruosi mo Iehova vada e abidadama henia”.
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh completely.’

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Israel taudia e badu henidia, e siaidia lao, laḡani hari-ahui tano ḡagaena ai e loaloava, ela bona Iehova vairanai e kara havara uruna idoinai vada e mase ore.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight was consumed.

motu: Matona, umui na tamamui gabudia ai vada o vara isi, kara havara uruna ta, Iehova ena badu Israel latanai ihabadana.
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

motu: Badina be umui na ia iḡavana amo ba raka siri, ia ese idia ma baine siaidia tano ḡaḡaena ai ma bae noho; bena ina bese idoinai baine dika umui daimui ai.
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

motu: Bena idia na e raka henia kahi, eto, Iniseni ai maḡu baia kara, emai seri ikoulaidia, bona hanua baia hadai, natumai maraḡidia bae noholai.
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

motu: A tuari be baia tuari, Israel taudia vairadiai baiala, ela bona edia gabu ai baia hakaudia lao. Ḡau; au tamona, natumai maraḡidia be hanua mai maḡudia lalodiai bae noho, ina tano taudia daidiai.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

motu: A ai be emai ruma basia lou heni ela bona Israel taudia iboudiai ahudia bae abi.
english: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

motu: Ai ahumai na idia ida Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai eiava gabu ta ai basia abi, badina be ahumai na Ioridane sinavaina inikahana ai vada a abi, mairiveina kahana ai.
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

motu: Bena Mose ese e haere henidia, eto, Ene boma kara toma: emui tuari ḡaudia bavabi, Iehova vairanai ba raka lasi, tuari baola.
english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,

motu: Emui tuari taudia iboudiai na Ioridane sinavaina bae hanaia, Iehova vairanai, ela bona ana inai taudia na vairadiai baine luludia Iasi,
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

motu: bona tano idoinai na Iehova ena tano ai bae halaoa. Una murinai vada ba lou mai, asi emui kerere Iehova vairanai bona Israel taudia vairadiai; bena ina tano bavabia emui, Iehova vairanai.
english: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to Yahweh and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before Yahweh.

motu: A ene basioma kara toma, umui na ba kerere Iehova vairanai: emui kara dika davana do bavabia.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

motu: Benaini, hanua ba hadai, natumui maraḡidia bae noholai; bona maḡu ba kara, emui mamoe edia. Una murinai emui gwau hamata ba hamomokania.
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

motu: Bena Gad bona Ruben iduhudia taudia ese Mose e haere henia, eto, Ai bini emu hesiai taumai na oi lohia taumu emu haheḡani heḡereḡerena baia karaia.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

motu: Natumai maraḡidia bona adavamai bona emai mamoe bona emai boromakau na iniseni ai bae noho, Gilead hanuadia ai;
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

motu: a ai bini, emu hesiai taumai, na Iehova vairanai baia hanai, tuari mai dibamai taumai iboumai ai, baia tuari, oi lohia taumu emu haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese idia herevadia na hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona Israel iduhudia lohiadia e haḡanilaidia;
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

motu: eto, Bema Gad bona Ruben iduhudia taudia na umui ida Ioridane sinavaina bae hanaia, mai edia tuari ḡaudia, Iehova vairanai, bena tano idoinai bavabia emui, umui ese Gilead tanona do ba henidia, edia tano.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

motu: A edia tuari ḡaudia basie abidia, umui ida basie hanai, idia na umui ida ahumui bae abi Kanaan tanona ai.
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

motu: Bena Gad bona Ruben iduhudia taudia eto, Iehova ese emu hesiai taumai vada e haḡanimai heḡereḡerena, unu baia kara toma.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

motu: Emai tuari ḡaudia imamai ai baia abi, Iehova vairanai baia hanai, Kanaan tanona ai; bena ahumai ba henimai Ioridane sinavaina inikahana ai.
english: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

motu: Taunabunai Mose ese Gad iduhuna bona Ruben iduhuna bona Manase Iosef ena iduhu kahana na Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, bona Og, Basan pavapavana, edia basileia e henidia, edia tano idoidiai bona edia hanua iboudiai.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

motu: Bena Gad iduhuna taudia ese ini hanua mai maḡudia e hadai: Dibon bona Ataroto bona Aroere,
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

motu: bona Atroto-sofan bona lasere bona logobeha,
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

motu: bona Bete-nimra bona Bete-haran. Edia seri maḡudia danue kara.
english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

motu: Ruben iduhuna taudia danu hanua mai maḡudia e hadai: Hesebon bona Eleale bona Kiriataimi,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

motu: bona Nebo bona Baal-meono (ini ruaosi ladadiae ha-idau) bona Sibma. Idia e hadai hanuadia na ladadia idaudia e henidia.
english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

motu: A Makiri Manase ena iduhu taudia na Gilead tanona ela, bena e abia, Amoro taudia unuseni ai e nohova na e luludia lasi.
english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

motu: Bena Mose ese Gilead tanona na Makiri Manase e henia, ena noho gabuna.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

motu: Bena Iairi Manase ela, Gilead hanuadia e abidia, ladadia e hato Havoto-iairi.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

motu: BonaNoba na ela, Kenat tanona mai ena hanua ida e abidia, ladana e hatoa Noba, ia e nemaia.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

motu: Israel taudia edia laolao daladia bini. Mose bona Aaron ese orea ta ta ai Aigupto amo e hakaudia lasi negana ai,
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, bena Mose ese edia taruha sivaraidia bona edia tore-isi sivaraidiae tore. Edia tore-isi bona edia taruha herevadia bini:
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

motu: hua gini-gunana ena dina ihagwauta-imana ai, idia na Ramese amo e raka lasi; lagau-hanai murina dinana ai Israel taudia na Iehova ena siahu ai e raka lasi, Aigupto taudia iboudiai vairadiai,
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

motu: Aigupto taudia ese natudia roboadia e guridia dinana ai. Badina be Iehova ese natudia roboadia vada e aladia mase, bona edia dirava danu vada e hahemaoro henidia.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.

motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia na Ramese amo ela, bona Sukoto ai e taruha.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

motu: Sukoto amo e tore isi, ela, Etam ai e taruha, tano ḡagaena isena ai.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

motu: Etam amo e tore isi, e lou ela, Pi-hahiroto ai e kau: una na Baal-sefon mairiveina kahana ai. Bena Migdol ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

motu: Ma e laolao, Hahiroto badina amo ela, davara e rakaia hanai, tano ḡaḡaena ai e kau; bena dina toi idia na Etam tano-ḡaḡaena ai e laolao, Mara ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

motu: Mara amoe tore isi, ela, Elim ai e kau. Una gabu ai ranu guridia na gwauta-rua, bona pamu audia na hitu-ahui. Bena unuseni ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

motu: Elim amoe tore isi, ela, Davara Kakakakana isena ai e taruha;
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

motu: unu amo ma ela, Sin tano-ḡaḡaena ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

motu: Sin tano-ḡaḡaena amo e tore isi, ela, Dofka ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

motu: Dofka amo e tore isi, ela, Alusu ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

motu: Alusu amo e tore isi, ela, Refidim ai e taruha; unuseni ai inuinu ranuna ai e dabu.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

motu: Refidim amo e tore isi, ela, Sinai tano-ḡaḡaena ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

motu: Sinai tano-ḡaḡaena amo e tore isi, Kibroto-hatava ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

motu: Kibroto-hatava amo e tore isi, ela, Haseroto ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

motu: Haseroto amo e tore isi, ela, Ritma ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

motu: Ritma amo e tore isi, ela, Rimon-perese ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

motu: Rimon-perese amo e tore isi, ela, Libna ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

motu: Libna amo etore isi, ela, Risa ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

motu: Risa amo e tore isi, ela, Kehelata ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

motu: Kehelata amo e tore isi, ela, Sefere ororona ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

motu: Sefere ororona amo e tore isi, ela, Harada ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

motu: Harada amo e tore isi, ela, Makeloto ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

motu: Makeloto amo e tore isi, ela, Tahata ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

motu: Tahata amo e tore isi, ela, Tera ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

motu: Tera amo e tore isi, ela, Mitka ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

motu: Mitka amo e tore isi, ela, Hasamona ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

motu: Hasamona amo e tore isi, ela, Moseroto ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

motu: Moseroto amo e tore isi, ela, Bene-iakan ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

motu: Beneiakan amo e tore isi, ela, Horo-hagidigad ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

motu: Horo-hagidigad amo e tore isi, ela, Iotobata ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

motu: Iotobata amo e tore isi, ela, Abrona ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

motu: Abrona amo e tore isi, ela, Esiono-gebere ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

motu: Esiono-gebere amo e tore isi, ela, Sin tano-ḡaḡaena ai e taruha (ladanata be Kade).
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

motu: Kade amo e tore isi, ela, Horo ororona ai e taruha, Edom tano hetoana ai.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Aaron na ororo ai e dara dae, Iehova ena haheḡani dainai. Unuseni ai e mase, laḡani hari-ahui vada ela Israel taudia Aigupto tanona amo e raka Iasi murinai. Hua be hua iha-imana; dina be dina ginigunana.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

motu: Aaron ena vara laḡanidia na sinahu-ta ruahui toi, Horo ororonaai e mase negana ai.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

motu: Israel taudia vada ema harina na Kanaan lohiana ta, Arada pavapavana, ese e kamonai. Ia be diho kahana ai e nohova, Kanaan ai.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

motu: Horo ororona amo e tore isi, ela, Salmona ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

motu: Salmona amo e tore isi, ela, Punon ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

motu: Punon amo e tore isi, ela, Oboto ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

motu: Oboto amo e tore isi, ela, Ie-abarim ai e taruha, Moab tanona ai.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

motu: Ie amo e tore isi, ela, Dibon-gad ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

motu: Dibon-gad amo e tore isi, ela, Almon-diblataim ai e taruha.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

motu: Almon diblataim amo e tore isi, ela, Abarim ororodia ai e taruha, Nebo vairanai.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

motu: Abarim ororodia amo e tore isi, ela, Ieriko ai e taruha, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Moab taorana ai.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

motu: Edia taruha na Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Bet-iesimoto amo ela bona Abele-sitim, Moab taorana ai.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

motu: Bena Ieriko ai, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Moab taorana ai, Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, Kanaan tanona ai ba kau, negana ai,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

motu: una tano taudia iboudiai na vairamui ai ba luludia lasi; edia nadi helaḡadia iboudiai ba ḡiḡidia rohoroho, edia kaivakuku iboudiai ba doudia, edia atai gabudia helaḡadia iboudiai ba habuadia tari.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

motu: Tano bavabia emui, ba noholaia: badina be tano na vada na henimui, emui tano korikori.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

motu: Tano na mari amo ba haria, iduhu ta ta ahuna ahuna bae abi: iduhu badana be tano badana ba henia, iduhu maraḡina be tano maraḡina ba henia. Tau ta ese mari ai tano ta baine abia, una na iena tano.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

motu: A tano taudia iboudiai basioma luludia lasi vairamui ai, bae noho taudia na ḡahu vairamui ai eiava ginigini kopimui ai na heheto bae hahekwarahimui, ba noholaia tanona ai.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

motu: Bena idia baina kara henidia nato karadia na umui baina kara henimui.
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba haḡanidia, baoto: Kanaan tanona na emui tano, ela bona ena hetoa iboudiai. Kanaan tanona ai ba kau negana ai,
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

motu: emui tano hetoana diho kahana ai na Sin tano-ḡaḡaena amo Edom hetoana ai bainela, ela bona Tadi (Gohuna mairiveina kahana.
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

motu: Unu amo Akrabim ororona diho kahana amo bainela, ela bona Sin. Unu amo ia na Kade-baranea diho kahana amo bainela, ela bona Hasara-adara, ela bona Asamon;
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

motu: Asamon amo bainela, ela bona Aigupto Dokana, ma unu amo kone ai baine lasi.
english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

motu: Lahara kahana ai, emui hetoa na Davara Badana konena; emui tano hetoana bunai, lahara kahana ai.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

motu: Mirigini kahana ai, emui hetoa na Davara Badana amo bainela, ela bona Horo ororona.
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

motu: Horo ororona amo bainela, Hamat kahana ai, ela bona Sedad.
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

motu: Unu amo ma bainela, Sifron kahana ai, ela bona Hasara-enan. Mirigini kahana ai emui hetoa bunai.
english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

motu: Mairiveina kahana ai, emui hetoa na Hasara-enan amo bainela, elabona Sefam;
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

motu: bona Sefam amo bainela, ela bona Ribla, Ain mairiveina kahana ai; unu amo ma bainela, ela bona Kinerete Gohuna + 34:11 Kinerete Gohuna: ina na Galilea gohuna ladana ta. * mairiveina kahana.
english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

motu: Unu amo emui hetoa na Ioridane sinavaina, ela bona Tadi Gohuna. Ini hetoa lalodiai e miamu tanodia iboudiai na umui emui.
english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia e haḡanidia, eto, Ina tano na emui tano; mari ai ba haria. Iehova vada e hereva, iduhu taurahani-ta bona iduhu ta kahana ese bae abia.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

motu: Badina be Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia na edia tano vada e abia: iduhu lohiadia ta ta ese ahudia vada e abi.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

motu: Hari iduhu ruaosi mai kahana ese ahudia vada e abi, Ieriko ai, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, daba e reremu kahana ai.
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Tano iharina bae biagua taudia ladadia bini: Eleasara, hahelaḡa tauna; bona Iosua Nunu;
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

motu: bona iduhu ta ta amo iduhu lohiadia ta ta bavabidia hidi, tano iharina bae biagua.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

motu: Ladadia bini: Iuda iduhuna amo, Kaleb lefune;
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

motu: Simeon iduhuna amo, Semuel Amihud;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

motu: Beniamina iduhuna amo, Elidad Kislon;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

motu: Dan iduhuna amo, Buki Iogli, edia lohia ta;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

motu: Iosef garana amo, Haniel Efod, Manase iduhuna lohiana,
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

motu: bona Kemuel Siftan, Efraim iduhuna lohiana;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

motu: Sebulun iduhuna amo, Elisafan Paranaka, edia lohia ta;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

motu: Isakara iduhuna amo, Paltiel Asan, edia lohia ta;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

motu: Asere iduhuna amo, Ahihud Selomi, edia lohia ta;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

motu: Napatali iduhuna amo Pedahele Amihud, edia lohia ta.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

motu: Tataudia bunu, Iehova ese e haḡanidia, tano bae haria, Israel taudia ahudia bae henidia, Kanaan tanona ai.
english: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

motu: Ieriko ai, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Moab taorana ai, Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba haḡanidia, bae abia tanona lalonai Levi taudia na hanua bae henidia, mai hetabira tanodia ida.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

motu: Hanua be bae noholaidia, bona hetabira tanodia ai edia boromakau bona edia mamoe bona edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia idau-idau bae reḡudia.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

motu: Hari hetabira tanodia Levi taudia ba henidia na hanua maḡuna amo baela, ela bona kiubit daha-ta, + 35:4 Kiubit daha-ta = Roha sinahu-toi imahui sisivana. * hanua kahadia iboudiai.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits + 35:4 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * around it.

motu: Hanua murimurina ai ba hahetohoa, mairiveina kahana ai kiubit daha-rua, + 35:5 Kiubit daha-rua = Roha sinahu-hitu sisivana. * diho kahana ai kiubit daha-rua, lahara kahana ai kiubit daha-rua, bona mirigini kahana ai kiubit daha-rua; hanua be bogaraginai. Tano unubadana bae abia, edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia na una tano ai bae reḡudia.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

motu: Levi taudia ba henidia hanuadia tauratoi be roho-mauri hanuadia bae gwaurai, ala-ala tauna naediai baine heau kau, bena baine mauri; bona ma hanua hari-ahui rua danuba henidia.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

motu: Levi taudia ba henidia hanuadia bae hari-ahui taurahani; iboudiai na mai hetabira tanodia.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

motu: Ini hanua na Israel taudia ahudia amo ba henidia: iduhu badadia amo momo bavabi; iduhu maraḡidia amo gadoi mo bavabi. Iduhu ta ta ese ahudia amo Levi taudia ahudia bae henidia. Roho-mauri Hanuadia
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

motu: Iehova ese Mose ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ioridane sinaavaina ba hanaia, Kanaan tanona ai ba kau, negana ai,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

motu: hanua haida bavabidia hidi, emui roho-mauri hanuadia. Bena taunimanima ta baine hapadidia tauna na unu baine heau lao.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

motu: Unu hanua lalodiai mase tauna varavarana ese basine alamui diba; hahepadidi tauna na basie alaia ela bona hebou ese baine hahemaoro henia.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

motu: Levi taudia ba henidia hanuadia tauratoi be emui roho-mauri hanuadia ai ba halaodia:
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

motu: hanuatoi Ioridane sinavaina inikahana ai, bona hanua toi Kanaan tanona ai, ba henidia, roho-mauri hanuadia ai baela.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

motu: Unu hanua tauratoiosi na rohomauri hanuadia ai baela, Israel taumui emui, bona idau taudia bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu taudia edia: taunimanima ta baine hapadidia tauna na unu hanua baine heau lao.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

motu: A tau ta ese bamona na auri amo baine botaia mase, ia na roroma tauna: vada bae alaia mase.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

motu: Eiava nadi imana ai baine abia, bamona baine tutulaia, bena baine mase, ia na roroma tauna: vada bae alaia mase.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

motu: Eiava au ta imana ai baine abia, bamona baine botaia mase, ia na roroma tauna: vada bae alaia mase.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

motu: Mase tauna varavarana ese roroma tauna baine davaria negana ai, ia ese baine alaia mase.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

motu: Bamona na badu ai e gwadaia mase tauna, eiava bamona ialana e bani henia tauna,
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

motu: eiava bamona na imana amo e tutua mase mai baduna ida tauna, una tau bae alaia mase. Ia na roroma tauna: mase tauna varavarana ese baine davaria negana ai, ia ese baine alaia mase.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

motu: A tau ta, asi ena badu, ese bamona bema gwadaia, eiava bema hodoa,
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

motu: eiava nadi amo bema tutua mase, bena bamona bema mase, a ia be bamona se inai henia bona iala-masena se ura,
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

motu: hebou ese una hahepadidi tauna bona mase tauna varavarana baine hahemaoro henidia, ini taravatu heḡereḡeredia.
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

motu: Hebou taudia ese hahepadidi tauna na mase tauna varavarana imana amo bae hamauria, ena roho-mauri hanuana, e heau henia hanuana, lalonai bae hakaua vareai. Unuseni ai baine noho, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna badana, dehoro helaḡana amo e horoa tauna, baine mase negana ai.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

motu: A nega ta hahepadidi tauna ese ena roho-mauri hanuana, e heau henia hanuana,baine rakatania,
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

motu: bena mase tauna varavarana ese una roho-mauri hanuana murimurinai baine davaria, bena mase tauna varavarana ese hahepadidi tauna baine alaia mase, ia na asi ena kerere una rara dainai.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

motu: Badina be hahepadidi tauna na ena roho-mauri hanuana ai baine noho ela bona hahelaḡa taunabadana baine mase; a hahelaḡa tauna badana baine mase murinai hahepadidi tauna na ena tano korikori baine lou henia diba.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

motu: Uru iboudiai bona emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai ini taravatu bona ini haheḡani ba badinadia.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

motu: Tau ta ese taunimanima ta baine alaia mase, roroma tauna na bae alaia mase, dibadia taudia edia hahebade herevadia daidiai; a tau tamona ena hereva dainai basie alaia mase.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

motu: Roroma tauna ena mauri ibodohilaina monina eiava kohuna na basio abia: vada baine mase.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

motu: Bona roho-mauri hanuana ai vada e heau kau tauna ena mauri ibodohilaina monina eiava kohuna, hahelaḡa tauna badana maurina ai ena tano korikori baine lou henia helaoreana, na basio abia.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

motu: Taunabunai, ba noholaia tanona basio hamiroa; badina be rara ese tano e hamiroamu, bona tano ihaḡoevana na asi dala idauna ta, rara e habubua tauna rarana mo ese baine haḡoevaia diba.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

motu: Umui o noholaiamu tanona basio hamiroa, badina be lau danu na noholaiamu; badina be lau Iehova na Israel taudia bogaragidiai na nohomu.
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

motu: Gilead Makiri, Manase tubuna, ena orea amo ruma biagudia na Mose dekena ela. Idia na Iosef iduhuna taudia. Idia ese Mose e hereva henia, Israel iduhu lohiadia bona ruma biagudia vairadiai,
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

motu: eto, Iehova ese oi, emai lohia, vada e haḡanimu, tano na mari amo ba haria, Israel taudia ahudia ba henidia; bona vada e haḡanimu danu ai varavaramai Selofehad ahuna na natuna hahinedia ba henidia.
english: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

motu: Ḡau tamona, idia na idau iduhu taudia ese bema adavadia, ahudia na ai senemai ahudia amo bae heabi oho, adavadia edia iduhu ahudia ai bae heato kau; bena ai emai ai bae boio.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

motu: Ela bona Israel tauda eda Iubile laḡanina baine kau, bena idia ahudia na adavadia edia iduhu ahudia ai bae heato kau vaitani; bona senemai ahudia ediai bae boio vaitani.
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Israel taudia na Iehova ena hereva e haḡanilaidia, eto, Iosef garana edia hereva na maoro.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

motu: Iehova ena haheḡani Selofehad natuna ulatodia daidiai na iniheto: e ura henidiamu taudia bae adavadia, a tamadia ena iduhu taudia mo.
english: This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

motu: Unuhetomana iduhu ta ese iduhu ta ahuna basine abihaia Israel ai; a Israel taudia ta ta ese tamadia ahudia bae abidia tarika-tarika.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

motu: Bona ulato ta bema mai ahuna Israel iduhuna ta lalonai, ia ese tamana ena iduhu tauna ta baine adavaia; unu amo Israel taudia ta ta ese tamadia ahudia bae abidia tarika-tarika.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

motu: Taunabunai, iduhu ta ese iduhuta ahuna basine abihaia; a Israel iduhudia ta ta ese ahudia bae abi tarika-tarika.
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

motu: Bena Selofehad natuna ulatodia ese Iehova ena haheḡani e badinaia.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:

motu: Selofehad natuna ulatodia, Mahala bona Tirisa bona Hogla bona Milka bona Noa, ese tamadia varavaradia na e adavadia.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

motu: Manase Iosef ena iduhu ai e headava, bena ahudia na tamadia ena iduhu ai e miava.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

motu: Haheḡani bona taravatu bunu, Iehova ese Mose e henia, bena Mose ese Israel taudia e henidia, Ieriko ai, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Moab taorana ai.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

motu: Mose ena hereva bini, Israel taudia iboudiai e harorolai henidia tano ḡaḡaena ai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai. Gabu ladana na Araba, Sufu e hevaira henia; kahana ta ai be Paran, ma kahana ta ai be Tofele bona Laban bona Haseroto bona Disahab.
english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

motu: Horeb amo bema laolao, Seiri ororona amo bema lao ela bona Kade-baranea, Iaolao dinadia na bemagwauta-ta na heto.
english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

motu: Laḡani hari-ahui vada e lao bubuni, hua ihagwauta-tanaena dina gini gunana ai, Mose ese Israel taudia e haroro henidia, Iehova ese ia e henia haheḡanidia iboudiai na ia ese idia ma e henidia.
english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh + 1:3 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * had given him in commandment to them,

motu: Una be Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, Hesebon ai e nohova tauna, bona Og, Basan pavapavana, Astaroto ai bona Edrei ai e nohova tauna, e hadareredia murinai. Mose ena haroro gini-gunana
english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

motu: Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Moab tanona ai, Mose ese taravatu e gwaurai hedinarai matama, eto,
english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

motu: Iehova eda Dirava ese Horeb ai e hereva henida, eto: Umui na nega daudau vada o halahe ina ororo ai;
english: “Yahweh our God + 1:6 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

motu: harihari a tore isi, ba laolao, ororo kahadia baola, Amoro taudia edia tano bona hetabira tanodia Araba taorana ai, ororo ai bona taora ai, diho kahana ai bona kone kahana ai, Kanaan tanona ai bona Lebanon tanona ai, ela bona sinavai badana, ladana na Eufrate.
english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

motu: A itaia, una tano idoinai vairamui ai vada na lailaia; ba raka vareai, tano na bavabia, Iehova ese umui senemui, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob, e gwau henidia hamata, tano na idia baine henidia bona idia garadia baine henidia eto.
english: Behold, + 1:8 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring + 1:8 or, seed * after them.’”

motu: Una negana ai lau ese na hamaoromui, nato, Lau na sibogu basina reḡumui diba,
english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

motu: badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e hahutumamui; harihari umui na hutuma herea, guba hisiudia na heheto.
english: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

motu: Egu ḡuriḡuri be Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, ese nega daha amo do baine hahutumamui, bona baine hanamomui, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: May Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

motu: To lau sibogu ese ede baina reḡumui toma? Emui hekwarahi bona emui heiriheiri ede baina huahai toma?
english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

motu: Emui iduhu ta ta lalodiai tatau haida, mai aonegadia bona mai edia lalo-parara bona mai dibadia taudia, bavabidia hidi, bena lau ese ikwaramui taudia ai baina halaodia.
english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

motu: Bena umui ese o haere henigu, oto, Emu hereva vada e namo; ai na unu baia kara toma.
english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

motu: Taunabunai, emui iduhu lohiadia na abidia, mai aonegadia bona mai dibadia taudia, bena umui ikwaramui taudia ai na halaodia: daha biagudia, sinahu biagudia, imahui biagudia, gwauta biagudia, bona heitatao taudia, emui iduhu ta ta lalodiai.
english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

motu: Una negana ai danu emui hahemaoro taudia na haḡanidia, nato, Varavaramui ba hahemaoro henidia, tau ta tadikakana ida bae hemaka, eiava tau ta idau bese tauna ida bae hemaka, ba hahemaoro henidia mai maoromaoromui ida.
english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

motu: Ba hahemaoro henidia negadia ai emui hahemaoro basio hagagevaia: dagi maraḡi tauna bona dagi bada tauna bae heḡereḡere umui vairamui ai. Tau ta garina basio gari, badina be hahemaoro be Dirava ena. Bena kara ta dainai ba daradara, hereva na lau dekegu ai ba mailaia, lau ese baina haeroa.
english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

motu: Una negana ai, ba kara karadia iboudiai na haḡanilaimuiva.
english: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

motu: Bena Horeb amo ma ta laolao, tano ḡaḡaena badana bona dika-hereanaamo, umui danu dibamui, ela bona Amoro taudia edia tano, ororo kahadia ai, ta rakaia hanai, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese e haḡanida heḡereḡerena; bena Kade-baranea ai ta kau.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

motu: Bena lau ese na hamaoromui, nato, Umui naAmoro taudia edia ororo tanodia ai vada o kau; ina tano be Iehova eda Dirava ese be henidamu.
english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.

motu: O itaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese tano vada eme lailaia vairamui ai; ba raka vareai, bavabia, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimui heḡereḡerena. Basio gari; lalomui na basie hekwarahi.
english: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

motu: Bena umui iboumui ai na lau dekegu oma, oto, Mani emu kara, hasinadoa taudia baita siaidia guna, idia ese tano na do bae itaia bona sivaraina bae mailaia, edena dala amo baitala, bona edena hanua edena hanua ai baita kau.
english: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

motu: Emui hereva na haeroa, hereva namona; bena tatau gwauta-rarua umui bogaragimui amo na abidia, iduhu ta ta amo tatau ta ta na abidia.
english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

motu: Bena idia na ororo kahadia amo eha laolao, ela bona Eskol kourana ai e kau, unuseni ai e hasinadoa.
english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

motu: Una tano huahuadia taidia taidia imadia ai e abi, bena e lou henida, harina e hamaorolaida, eto, Iehova eda Dirava ese be henidamu tanona na tano namona.
english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which Yahweh our God gives to us.”

motu: To umui na o gwau edeede, asiola; Iehova, emui Dirava, ena hereva o utua.
english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.

motu: Emui kalaga ai o maumau noho, oto, Iehova ese vada e inai henida dainai ia ese Aigupto tanona amo e hakauda lasi, Amoro taudia imadia ai baine negeda bena idia ese bae alada ore totona.
english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

motu: Ede baitala? Tadikakada ese vada e hagarida, eto “Una tano taudia na babada bona lalata; ita na mamaraḡi bona kwakwadogi; edia hanua na babada, maḡudia danu e daemu ela bona guba ai; ina danu, Anakim taudia unuseni ai a itadia”.
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

motu: Bena na hamaoromui, nato, Kudoumui basie hetaha; idia garidia basio gari.
english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

motu: Iehova emui Dirava, umui vairamui ai e rakamu Diravana, ia ese umui daimui ai baine tuari, hoa karadia baine kara, umui vairamui ai Aigupto ai e karava heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

motu: Tano ḡaḡaena ai danu vada o itaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e abimui isi, tau ta ese natuna e geiamu na heto, emui laolao iboudiai lalodiai, ema bona ina gabu ai vada o kau.
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
