motu: Ḡau tamona, umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, asio abidadama henia.
english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,

motu: Ia ese dala ai e gunalaimui, emui taruha gabudia e tahu; emui dala danu e hahedinarai henimui, lahi amo hanuaboi ai, bona ori amo dina ai.
english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

motu: Iehova ese emui hereva e kamonai, bena e badu, e gwau hamata, eto,
english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

motu: Momokani, ina uru dikana taudia ta ese hari tano namona, lau ese senemui na gwau henidia hamata baina henidia nato tanona, basine itaia.
english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

motu: A Kaleb Iefune mo sibona ese baine itaia; bona aena amo vada e moia tao tanona lau ese ia baina henia, bona natuna baina henidia, badina be ia ese Iehova vada e abidadama henia mai lalona idoinai.
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”

motu: Iehova ese lau danu e badu henigu, umui daimui ai; eto, Oi na unuseni ai basio raka vareai,
english: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

motu: a Iosua Nunu, emu hesiai tauna, na una tano ai baine raka vareai. Ba hamaoroa, do baine goada; badina be ia ese Israel taudia baine hakaudia vareai.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

motu: Natumui maraḡidia, haida ese bae abidia mauri oto, bona natumui karukarudia, kara namo bona kara dika do asi dibadia, idia na bae raka vareai: una tano baina henidia, edia tano.
english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

motu: A umui na ba lou lao, tano ḡaḡaena ai ma ba halaolao, Davara Kakakakana kahana ai.
english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

motu: Bena umui ese o haere henigu, oto, Ai na vada a kara havara, Iehova enai. Ai na baiala, baia tuari, Iehova ese vada e haḡanida heḡereḡerena. Bena emui tuari ḡaudia; o abi kau, ororo kahadia ai ba ha tuari haraḡa-haraḡa oto.
english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh. We will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

motu: A Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ba hamaorodia, baoto: Tuari na basiola, badina be lau na dia umui ida; basiola, inaimui ese bae hadareremui na garina.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

motu: Unu na hamaoromui toma, to umui na asio kamonai: Iehova o gwau edeede henia, o hekokoroku, ororo ai o dara dae.
english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

motu: Bena Amoro taudia na unu ororo amo e hekei diho, e lulumui, nanigo ese bema lulumui na heto; bena Seiri ai e hadareremui, e havamui ela bona Horoma.
english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

motu: Bena o Iou, Iehova vairanai o taitai, a Iehova na emui taitai se kamonai bona emui hereva se abi dae.
english: You returned and wept before Yahweh, but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

motu: Taunabunai umui na nega daudau Kade ai o nohova.
english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

motu: Una murinai ta Iou lao, tano ḡaḡaena ai ta loaloa, Davara Kakakakana kahana ai, Iehova ese e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena. Dina hoho Seiri ororona ta rakaia heḡeḡe.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,

motu: Ina ororo badi-tanona ai vada o loa daudau; harihari mirigini kahana baola.
english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

motu: Bona Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Harihari umui na varavaramui, Esau garana, edia tano amo ba raka hanai; idia na Seiri ai e nohomu. Idia ese umui garimui bae gari. Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho:
english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

motu: basio tuari henidia, badina be edia tano taina basina henimui; oibe, aemu palapalana bema moia heḡereḡerena na basina henimui, badina be Seiri ororona na Esau na henia, ena tano.
english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

motu: Idia ediai aniani ba hoia, moni davana, bena bavania; bona idia ediai ranu ba hoia, moni davana, bena ba inua.
english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

motu: Badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e hanamomui, imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai Ialodiai; emui loaloa ina tano ḡaḡaena badana ai ia dibana. Ini laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e bamomuiva; ḡau ta ai asio dabu.
english: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

motu: Taunabunai ta laolao, varavarada Esau garana, Seiri ai e nohomu taudia, ta rakatanidia, Araba dalana danu ta rakatania, bona Elata bona Esiono-gebere ta rakatanidia. Bena ta lou lao, Moab tano-ḡaḡaena dalana ai tala.
english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e haduagu, eto, Moab taudia na basio daḡedaḡe henidia bona basio tuari henidia; badina be edia tano taina basina henimu; badina be Ara na Lot garana vada na henidia, edia tano.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

motu: (Gunaguna Emim besena unuseni ai e nohova: idia na hutuma bona taunimanima badadia; edia lata na Anakim taudia edia lata heḡereḡerena.
english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.

motu: Haida ese ladadia e hatomu “Refaim”, Anakim taudia e gwauraidiamu heḡereḡerena; a Moab taudia ese ladadia e hatomu “Emim”.
english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

motu: Hori taudia danu gunaguna Seiri ai e nohova, a Esau garana ese e luludia lasi, e habuadia tari, bona edia tano e abia, Israel na Iehova ese e henidia tanona e kara henia heḡereḡerena.)
english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)

motu: A tore isi, eto, Serede sinavaina ba hanaia. Taunabunai, ita na Serede sinavaina ta hanaia.
english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

motu: Kade-baranea ta rakatania ela bona Serede sinavainata hanaia na eda laolao laḡanidia na toi-ahui taurahani; una negana ai unauru ena tuari taudia iboudiai vada e mase ore eda taruha ai, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.

motu: Badina be Iehova imana ese e inai henidia, e habuadia, ela bona e mase ore.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

motu: Ina bese ena tuari taudia iboudiai e mase ore murinai,
english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

motu: Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,

motu: Hari dina ai Moab ena tano hetoana ba hanaia, Ara ai;
english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

motu: bena Amono garana edia tano hetoana ba raka henia kahi negana ai, basio daḡedaḡe henidia bona basio tuari henidia, badina be Amono garana edia tano taina basina henimui; badina be una tano na Lot garana vada na henidia, edia tano.
english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

motu: (Una tano ladana ta be “Refaim”, badina be gunaguna Refaim taudia unuseni ai e nohova. A Amono taudia ese ladadia e hato “Samsumim”:
english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

motu: idia na taunimanima badadia, bona hutuma, edia lata na Anakim taudia edia lata heḡereḡerena. A Iehova ese e habuadia tari; bena Amono taudia ese gabudia e abi bona edia tano e abia:
english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

motu: Esau garana Seiri ai e kara henidia heḡereḡerena, ia ese Hori taudia e habuadia tari, bena Esau garana ese edia tano e abia bona e noholaiamu ema bona harihari.
english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

motu: Avim besena danu unuheto: idia na hanua maraḡidia e noholai ela bona Gasa. A Kaftorim taudia na Kaftoro amo ema, e aladia ore, bena edia tano e abia.)
english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

motu: A tore isi, eto, emui laolao baola, Aranon kourana ba hanaia; Sihon, Amoro tauna, Hesebon pavapavana, na umui imamui ai, ena tano danu vada na henimui; ba raka vareai, ba tuari henia.
english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

motu: Hari dina ai lau ese gari baina havaraia guba henunai e nohomu besedia iboudiai lalodia ai; idia ese umui harimui bae kamonai, bena garimui bae gari; kudoudia bae hetaha bona daradia bae doko umui daimui ai.
english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

motu: Taunabunai, Kedemoto tano-ḡaḡaena amo lau ese gwaukau taudia nasiaidia, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, dekenai, maino herevadia bae gwaurai, baeto:
english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

motu: Mani emu kara emu tano amo baina raka hanai; dala ai mo baina raka hanai, basina raka siri, idiba kahana amo eiava lauri kahana amo.
english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

motu: Aniani na emu ai baina hoia, moni davana, bena baina aniani; ranu danu oiemu amo baina abia, moni davana, bena baina inua. Ḡau tamona ba gwau maoro, aegu amo baina raka hanai.
english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

motu: Esau garana, Seiri ai e nohomu, na unu e karagu toma, bona Moab taudia, Ara ai e nohomu, na unu e karagu toma; unu mo baina kara toma, ela bona Ioridane sinavaina baina hanaia. Iehova emai Dirava vada e henimai tanona ai baina raka vareai.
english: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”

motu: A Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ese e gwauda tao, basita raka hanai eto; badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese laumana e ha-aukaia bona lalona e hagoadaia, umui imamui ai baine atoa helaoreana, hari ina dina ai heḡereḡerena.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, A itaia, Sihon bona ena tano ina harihari aina henimu; avabia, ba noholaia.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

motu: Bena Sihon e raka lasi, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai, e tuari henida Iahasa ai.
english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

motu: Bena Iehova eda Dirava ese ita imada ai e atoa; ia bona natuna bona ena orea idoinai ta hadareredia.
english: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

motu: Una negana ai ena hanua iboudiai ta abidia, ta habuadia tari, tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, ta aladia ore, ta se roho mauri.
english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

motu: A ta abi boromakaudia bona ta habuadia tari hanuadia kohudia ta laohai.
english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

motu: Aroere, Aranon kourana isena ai, bona koura hanuana amo ela bona Gilead, hanua ta se auka, iboudiai ta abidia; Iehova eda Dirava ese ita imada ai e atodia.
english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.

motu: A Amono taudia edia tano, Iabok sinavaina isena ai, bona ororo hanuadia, na asio raka henidia kahi, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese e gwau tao gabudia iboudiai asio raka henidia kahi.
english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.

motu: Una dala amo ta raka siri, Basan dalana amo tala; bena Og, Basan pavapavana, e raka lasi, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai, Edrei ai e tuari henida.
english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

motu: A Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ia garina basio gari; badina be ia bona ena orea taudia iboudiai bona ena tano na oi imamu ai vada na atodia; Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, Hesebon ai e nohova tauna, o kara henia heḡereḡerena, ina tau danu unu ba kara henia toma.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova eda Dirava ese Og, Basan pavapavana, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai ida, ita imada ai e atodia; bena ta hadarerea vaitani, ena orea tauna ta se roho mauri.
english: So Yahweh our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.

motu: Una negana ai, ena hanua iboudiai ta abidia, hanua ta asita reaia; ta abi hanuadia iboudiai na tauratoi-ahui, Aragob tanona ai; Og, Basan pavapavana, ena basileia bunai.
english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

motu: Ini hanua iboudiai na mai maḡudia bona mai ikoukoudia bona mai ikahidia ida; hanua maraḡidia; si maḡudia danu diaḡau ta abidia.
english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

motu: Bena ta habuadia tari, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ta kara henia heḡereḡerena; hanua ta ta lalodiai tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, ta aladia ore;
english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

motu: a edia boromakau bona edia kohu ta abidia, eda.
english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

motu: Una negana ai Amoro pavapavadia raruosi edia tano ta abi, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Aranon kourana amo ela bona Heremon ororona.
english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

motu: (Hari Heremon ororona na Sidono taudia ese ladana e hatoamu “Sirion”, a Amoro taudia ese ladana e hatoamu “Seniri”).
english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

motu: Ororo doridia hanuadia iboudiai ta abidia, bona Gilead tanona idoinai bona Basan tanona idoinai, ela bona Saleka bona Edrei: Og, Basan pavapavana, ena hanua bunu.
english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

motu: (Hari Og, Basan pavapavana, na Refaim tauna; Refaim taudia iboudiai vada e mase ore, ia mo noho. Ena mahuta patana na auri amo e karaia; ḡauna na do mia Raba ai, Amono taudia edia tano ai. Vaevae ita Israel tauda eda kiubit amo e hahetohoa, ena lata na kiubit taurahani-ta, bona ena lababana kiubit hani.) + 3:11 kiubit ta = 44 centimetres sisivana, ita eda hahetoho ai. *
english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits + 3:11 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

motu: Una negana ai ta abia tanona, Aroere, Aranon kourana isena ai e miamu hanuana, amo, bona Gilead ororodia kahana mai hanuadia ida, lau ese Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia na henidia.
english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

motu: A Gilead kahana bona Basan, Og ena basileia, idoinai, Aragob tanona idoinai mai Basan ida, lau ese Manase iduhuna kahana taudia na henidia. (Una Basan tanona na ladana e hatoamu “Refaim taudia edia tano”.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

motu: Iairi Manase ese Basan tanona, Aragob tanona idoinai ela bona Gesuru taudia edia tano bona Maakata taudia edia tano, e abia, unu tano hanuadia ladadia e hato “Havoto-iairi”, ia inemaina; ladana na unu e hatoa tomamu emabona hari.)
english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

motu: Gilead tanona na Makiri na henia;
english: I gave Gilead to Machir.

motu: bona Gilead ela bona Aranon kourana na Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia na henidia; edia tano hetoana na koura bogaragina amo ela, ela bona Iabok sinavaina, Amono taudia edia tano hetoana.
english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

motu: Araba taorana danu na henidia, hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina, Kinerete + 3:17 “Kinerete” na Galilea gohuna ladana ta. * gohuna amo ela bona Tadi Gohuna, taora ai, bona Pisga ororona badi-tanona mairiveina kahana ai.
english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

motu: Una negana ai na haḡanimui, nato: Iehova ese ina tano vada e henimui, emui. Emui goada taudia iboudiai na edia tuari ḡaudia bae abi, tadikakamui Israel taudia vairadiai.
english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

motu: A adavamui bona natumui bona emui boromakau - dibagu emui boromakau na momo - vada na henimui hanuadia ai bae noho,
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

motu: ela bona Iehova ese tadikakamui na laḡa-ani baine henidia, bona umuidanu laḡa-ani baine henimui. Bena Iehova ese be henidiamu tanona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai na idia ese bae abia, edia tano; bona umui na iboumui ai ba lou lao, vada na henimui tanona ai ba noho.
english: until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

motu: Una negana ai Iosua na haḡania, nato, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese ini pavapava raruosi ede e karadia toma na matamu amo vada o itaia; benaini, ba lao henidia basileiadia danu unu baine karadia toma.
english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

motu: Idia garidia basio gari; Iehova, emu Dirava, ese oi daimu ai baine tuari.
english: You shall not fear them; for Yahweh your God himself fights for you.”

motu: Una negana ai danu lau ese Iehova na noia, nato,
english: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi na emu siahu bona imamu ena goada toadia vada o haheitalaigu matama; badina be edena dirava, guba ai eiava tanobada ai, ḡaukara badadia bona siahu toadia ikaradia mai dibana, oi heḡereḡeremu?
english: “Lord + 3:24 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

motu: Iehova e, mani emu kara bama raka hanai, taora namona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai bona ororo tanodia namodia ela bona Lebanon bama itadia.
english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

motu: A Iehova ese e badu henigu, umui daimui ai; bena se kamonai henigu. Ia ese e haere henigu, eto, Vadaeni, ena hereva na basio gwauraia lou.
english: But Yahweh was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

motu: Pisga ororona ba dara dae, dorina ai ba gini, ba roha lao, tano na matamu amo ba itaia, lahara kahana ai, mirigini kahana ai, diho kahana ai, mairiveina kahana ai; badina be ina Ioridane sinavaina na basio hanaia.
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

motu: A Iosua ba haḡania bona ba hagoadaia, bona lalona ba ha-aukaia; badina be ia ese ina besetaudia baine hakaudia hanai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai; bena oi ese matamu amo ba itaia tanona na ia ese baine henidia, edia tano.
english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

motu: Taunabunai, ita na koura ai ta taruha, Bete-peoro hevaira hehenina ai.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

motu: Israel e, vada na hadibalaimui taravatudia bona haheḡanidia ba kamonaidia bona ba badinadia; bena vada ba mauri, bona Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, baine henimui tanona ai ba raka vareai bona bavabia, emui.
english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.

motu: Vada na henimui haheḡanidia latadiai hereva ta basio atoa kau, bona edia amo hereva ta basio abia oho, a Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani ba badinadia, lau ese vada na henimui heḡereḡerena.
english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.

motu: Matamui amo vada o itaia, Iehova na ede e kara toma Baal-peoro ai; badina be Iehova emui Dirava ese Peoro taudia edia Baal e toma henia diho taudia umui bogaragimui ai e aladia mase,
english: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

motu: a umui Iehova, emui Dirava, o abidadama henia taumui iboumui ai vada ome mauri ema bona hari.
english: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.

motu: A laloa, Iehova egu Dirava ese vada e henigu taravatudia bona haheḡanidia lau ese vada na henimui, ba raka vareai bona bavabia tanona ai ba badinadia totona.
english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

motu: Ba badinadia, bona karadia ba kara; badina be emui aonega bona emui lalo-parara na unu amobae hedinarai, bese idau-idau vairadiai. Bena ini taravatu iboudiai baekamonai negana ai na baeto “Momokani ina bese badana na aonega bona lalo-parara besena”.
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

motu: Badina be edena bese badana edia dirava ese e raka henida kahimu, Iehova ita eda Dirava ta boi heniamu negadia ai e raka henida kahimu heḡereḡerena
english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?

motu: Bona edena bese badana edia taravatu bona edia haheḡani na mamaoro-mamaoro, lau ese hari dina ai na henimuimu taravatudia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia
english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa, laumamu ba gimaia, matamu amo vada o ita ḡaudia ba readia na garina, bena emu mauri dinadia iboudiai lalomu amo bae boio na garina. Natumu bona tubumu ba hadibadia,
english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

motu: Horeb ai Iehova emu Dirava vairanai o gini dinana ai, Iehova ese lau e hereva henigu, eto “Taunimanima ba haboudia vairagu ai, egu hereva bae kamonai, bena lau garigu bae gari, tanobada ai bae noho dinadia iboudiai, bona natudia bae hadibadia, idia danu unu bae kara toma”.
english: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

motu: Bena umui na o raka kahira, ororo badi-tanona ai o gini. Una negana ai Iahi hururu-hururudia na ororoamo e daeva guba ai, bona ori dubuna ese gabu idoinai e havaburaia.
english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

motu: Bena Iehova ese lahi bogaragina amo e hereva henimui; ena hereva vada o kamonai, to oromana asio itaia, gadona mo o kamonai.
english: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

motu: Bena ena taravatu e henimui, taravatu gwauta ba badinadia eto, bona huro-nadidia palakadia ruaosi ai etoredia.
english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese e haḡanigu, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani baina hadibalaimui, bena ba lao henia bona bavabia tanona ai ba badinadia.
english: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

motu: Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho; badina be Iehova ese Horeb ai lahi bogaragina amo e hereva henimui dinana ai ia oromana asio itaia,
english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

motu: boma kerere, laulau ta boma koroa na garina: tau laulauna eiava hahine laulauna,
english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

motu: eiava tanobada ena mauri ḡauna ta laulauna, eiava atai ai e rohomu manuna ta laulauna,
english: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

motu: eiava tano ai e raumu ḡauna ta laulauna, eiava davara ai e nohomu gwarumena ta laulauna.
english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

motu: Nahuamui ba toho danu, guba ai ba gaga dae, dina bona hua bona hisiu ba itadia, negadia ai na lalomui bae hekwakwanai bena ba toma henidia diho na garina. Idia be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e kara, guba henunai e nohomu besedia iboudiai ihanamodia.
english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

motu: A Iehova ese Aigupto amo vada e hakaumui lasi, e kara auri amuna amo bema verimui lasi na heto, ena bese korikori ai baine halaomui totona. Hari dina ai umui na iena bese.
english: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

motu: Iehova ese lau e badu henigu umui daimui ai, bena e gwau hamata, lau ese Ioridane sinavaina basina hanaia, bona Iehova emui Dirava ese baine henimui tanona namona basina raka vareai eto.
english: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;

motu: Lau na ina tano ai baina mase, basina hanaia Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai; a umui vada ba hanaia, una tano namona bavabia emui.
english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e henimui taravatuna na basio laloa boio; bona laulau ta basio koroa, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese una kara taravana vada e atua.
english: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na lahi ḡaraka-ḡaraka; ia na vaḡeḡe Diravana.
english: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

motu: Natumui bona tubumui bae vara, bona una tano ai ba buruka, murinai boma kerere, ḡau ta laulauana boma koroa, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai boma kara havara bona ena badu boma havaraia,
english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

motu: lau ese hari dina ai guba ladana ai bona tanobada ladana ai na hamaoromuimu umui na asi vanahana ba mase ore, una tano, iabina totona Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia tanona, lalona amo ba boio. Basio noho daudau unuseni ai: do ba mase ore.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

motu: Iehova ese baine hakarohomui rohoroho tanobada besedia bogaragidiai; vada ba gadoi, idau bese idau bese bogaragidiai, Iehova ese baine hakarohomui gabudia ai.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.

motu: Unuseni ai au diravadia bona nadi diravadia, taunimanima imadia amo e kara ḡaudia, asie roharohamu, asie kamonaimu, asie anianimu, asie bonabonamu, ḡaudia ba toma henidia diho.
english: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

motu: To unu amo Iehova, emui Dirava, do ba tahua; bena ba tahua mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai negana ai vada ba davaria.
english: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

motu: Dina gabedia ai, hisi bavani dinadia ai, ini kara iboudiai na emui ai bae vara; una negana ai Iehova, emui Dirava, do ba lou henia bona ba kamonai henia.
english: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na hebogahisi Diravana; ia na basine kahumui nege bona basine habuamui tari, bona ena gwau-hamata, senemui e gwau henidia hamata, na basine laloa boio.
english: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

motu: Nega gunadia sivaraidia ai ba tahua, Dirava ese taunimanima e karadia matama tanobada ai ema bona hari umui emui nega ai, bona guba dokona ela, bona guba dokona ai, ba henanadai, kara badana ta inihetomana na nega gunana ta ai, e vara bena sivaraina e gwauraia eiava.
english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

motu: Nega ta bese ta taudia, ese Dirava gadona lahi bogaragina amo e hereva vada e kamonai, umui o kamonaiva heḡereḡerena, bena dounu e mauri, eiava?
english: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

motu: Eiava nega ta Dirava ese bese ta vada e lao henia, idau bese bogaragina amo vada e abia, iena a?, hahehisi amo, toa amo, hoa karadia amo, tuari amo, imana goadana amo, imana itoi-rorona amo, hahegari badadia amo, vada e abia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui daimui ai bona umui vairarnui ai Aigupto ai, e karaia heḡereḡerena, a?
english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

motu: Umui emui ai vada e hedinarai: ba diba Iehova na Dirava; ia na asi idaina.
english: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.

motu: Guba amo e hereva henimui, baine hadibamui totona. Tanobada ai ena lahi badana e haheitalaimui; bena ena hereva na lahi bogaragina amo o kamonai.
english: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

motu: Senemui e ura henidia bena garadia e abidia hidi, bona umui na ia vairanai Aigupto amo e hakaumui lasi mai siahu-badana ida,
english: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

motu: bese badadia bona bese goadadia umui vairamuiai e luludia lasi, umui baine hakaumui vareai bona edia tano baine henimui totona, hari dina ai vada e karaiamu heḡereḡerena:
english: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

motu: una dainai hari dina ai vada ba diba bona lalomui ai bavabia dae, Iehova na Dirava, guba ai bona tanobada ai; ia na asi idaina.
english: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

motu: Taunabunai, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani, hari dina ai na henimuimu ḡaudia, na ba badinadia; bena ba namo, bona natumui danu bae namo umui murimui ai, bona emui dina bae hoho, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e henimui hanaihanaimu tanona ai. Roho-mauri Hanuadia
english: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for all time.

motu: Mose ese hanua toi e abidia hidi, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai,
english: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

motu: ala-ala tauna, bamona e alaia mase, dia e inai henia guna dainai, toe hapadidia dainai, ia ese unu hanua ta baine heau henia, baine; roho mauri helaoreana.
english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

motu: Hanuadia bini: Besere, tano ḡaḡaena ororodia ai, na Ruben iduhuna taudia edia; Ramoto, Gilead ai, na Gad iduhuna taudia edia; bona Golan, Basan ai, na Manase taudia edia. Haroro ihadokona
english: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

motu: Taravatu binai, Mose ese Israel taudia vairadiai e gwauraia.
english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

motu: Haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia bini, Mose ese Israel taudia e gwaurai henidia, Aigupto amo e raka Iasi murinai.
english: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

motu: Gabuna be Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Bete-peoro e vaira henia kourana ai, Sihon, Amoro pavapavana, Hesebon ai e nohova tauna, ena tano ai. Hari Sihon na Mose bona Israel taudia ese e hadarerea, Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai,
english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

motu: bena ena tano e abia. Og, Basan pavapavana, ena tano danu e abia. Unu pavapava raruosi na Amoro taudia edia pavapava: edia noho gabuna na mairiveina kahana ai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai;
english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

motu: Aroere, Aranon kourana isena ai, e matamaia, e laomu ela bona Sirion ororona (una na Heremon ladana ta);
english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

motu: bona Araba taorana idoinai, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, ela bona Araba gohuna, Pisga ororona badi-tanona ai.
english: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

motu: Mose ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, e haroro henidia, eto, Israel e, a kamonai: ini taravatu bona haheḡani hari dina ai baina gwauraidia hedinarai na ba kamonaidia, bona lalomai ai bavabidia dae, bona ba badinadia.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

motu: Iehova eda Dirava ese taravatu e henida Horeb ai;
english: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

motu: tamada se henidia, to ita, doini ta mauri nohomu bona hari dina ai ina gabu ai ta heboumu tauda iboudai vada e henida.
english: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

motu: Iehova ida o hevaira heheni una ororo ai, bena lahi bogaragina amo e hereva henimui.
english: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

motu: A lau be Iehova bona umui padamui ai na gini una negana ai, Iehova ena hereva na gwaurai henimui; badina be umui na lahi garina o gariva dainai ororo ai asio dara dae. Ia eto,
english: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

motu: Lau binai Iehova, emu Dirava: Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo na hakaumu lasi.
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

motu: Idau dirava ta basio abia lau vairagu ai.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

motu: Laulau ta basio koroa, ḡau ta laulauna: guba ḡauna ta, eiava tanobada ḡauna ta, eiava tanobada henuna ḡauna ta, basio karaia.
english: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

motu: Basio toma henia diho, bona isiaina basio lao heni. Badina be lau Iehova emu Dirava na vaḡeḡe Diravana: e inai henigumu taudia edia kara dika davadia na natudia bona tubudia latadiai baina kara ela bona uru ihatoina bona ihahanina;
english: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

motu: a lau e ura henigumu bona egu taravatu e badinamu taudia baina bogadia hisi ela bona uru daha.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

motu: Iehova emu Dirava ladana na basio hatoa kava hatoa kava; badina be Iehova ladana baine hatoa kava tauna na Iehova ese kara dika tauna ai baine halaoa;.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God; + 5:11 or, You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain; * for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

motu: Dina Helaḡa ba badinaia bona ba hahelaḡaia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e haḡanimu heḡereḡerena.
english: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.

motu: Dina tauratoi lalodiai emu ḡaukara idoinai ba karaia,
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

motu: a dina ihahituna na dina helaḡana, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena. Una dina ai basio ḡaukara, oi eiava natumu hahinena, eiava natumu hahinena, eiava emu hesiai tauna eiava emu hesiai hahinena, eiava emu boromakau eiava emu doniki eiava emu ubu-ubu ḡauna ta, eiava idau tauna emu ruma ai e noho hedoamu, emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai hahinena na oi ida bae laḡa ani helaoreana.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

motu: Ba laloa, oi na hesiai tauna Aigupto tanona ai, bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese imana e toia roro mai siahuna ida, unu amo e hakaumu lasi; taunabunai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimu, Dina Helaḡa ba badinaia.
english: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

motu: Tamamu sinamu ba matauraidia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimu heḡereḡerena; bena emu mauri dinadia bae hoho, bona emu noho baine namo, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e henimu tanona ai.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

motu: Basio ala-ala.
english: “You shall not murder.

motu: Basio heuda hanai.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

motu: Basio henao.
english: “You shall not steal.

motu: Dekemu tauna basio habadelaia koikoi.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

motu: Dekemu tauna adavana basio ḡahusia; ena ruma danu, eiava ena uma, eiava ena hesiai tauna, eiava ena hesiai hahinena, eiava ena boromakau, eiava ena doniki, eiava ena kohu ta, basio ḡahusi.
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

motu: Ini hereva na Iehova ese iboumui ai e gwaurai henimui, ororo ai o hebouva negana ai. Lahi bogaragina amo, bona ori bona dibura amo, e hereva henimui mai gao badana ida; una murinai hereva ta se gwauraia. A unu hereva na huro-nadidia palakadia rua ai e tore, bena e henigu.
english: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

motu: Umuiese dibura bogaragina amo una gado o kamonaiva, bona ororo o itaia, lahi ese e araiava, bena o raka henigu kahi, iduhu lohiadia bona tau-badadia iboumui ai;
english: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

motu: oto, O itaia, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese ia hairaina bona siahuna vada e haheitalaida; ia gadona danu lahi bogaragina amo vada ta kamonai. Hari dina ai tame diba Dirava ese taunimanima vada e hereva henidia, bona unu taunimanima na doini mamauri.
english: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

motu: A baia mase ena namo be dahaka? Badina be ina lahi badana ese baine aramai ore. Iehova, eda Dirava, gadona ma baia kamonai lou, vada baia mase;
english: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

motu: badina be tanobada idoinai taunimanima be daika, mauri Diravana gadona vada e kamonai, ita vada ta kamonai heḡereḡerena, Iahi bogaragina amo e hereva henia, bena vada e mauri?
english: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

motu: Oi na ba raka kahi lao, Iehova, eda Dirava, ena hereva iboudiai ba kamonai; bena Iehova, eda Dirava, ese baine hamaoromu herevadia iboudiai ba hamaoromai. Ai na baia kamonai, bona karadia baia kara.
english: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

motu: O hamaorolaigu herevadia na Iehova ese e kamonai. Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ini taunimanima edia hereva vada na kamonai; edia hereva iboudiai na mamaoro-mamaoro.
english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

motu: Nega iboudiai unu bemalaloa toma bema namo; bena bema matauraigu bona egu haheḡani iboudiai bema badina, unu amo edia noho bema namo, bona natudia edia noho bema namo, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

motu: Baola, ba haḡanidia, baoto “Emui kalaga ba lou heni”.
english: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’

motu: A oi be lau badibadigu ai ba gini, bena baina hamaorolaimu taravatudia bona haheḡanidia iboudiai o ese ba hadibalaidia; bena baina henidia tanona bae noholaia negana ai bae badinadia.
english: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”

motu: Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho, Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani ba badinadia; basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
english: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

motu: Iehova emui Dirava ese vada e haḡanilaimui dalana ai ba raka; bena ba mauri, bona emui noho baine namo bona emui dina bae hoho, ba noholaia tanona lalonai.
english: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

motu: Haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e henigu, baina hadibalaimui, bena ba raka hanai, emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai ba badinadia.
english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, garina ba gari, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani, na henimumu ḡaudia, iboudiai ba badinadia, oi bona natumu bona tubumu, emu mauri dinadia iboudiai; unu amo emu mauri dinadia bae hoho.
english: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel e, a kamonai, bona nahuamui ba toho; bena ba namo bona ba hutuma, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumutanona ai, Iehova, tamamui edia Dirava, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

motu: Israel e, a kamonai: Iehova na eda Dirava, Iehova mo sibona.
english: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, ba lalokau henia mai lalomu idoinai, mai laumamu idoinai, bona mai goadamu idoinai.
english: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

motu: Ini hereva, hari dina ai na haḡanilaimumu herevadia, na lalomu ai do bae mia;
english: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

motu: natumu danu ba hadibalaidia mai goadamu ida; ruma ai ba helai negadia ai, bona dala ai ba raka negadia ai, bona ba hekure negadia ai, bona ba tore isi negadia ai, ba herevalaidia.
english: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

motu: Idia na toa ai ba halaodia, imamu ai bona bagumu ai.
english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

motu: Emu iduara ihua-ihuana kahana kahana audia ai ba tore, bona emu ikoukou ai danuba tore.
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese senemui Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e gwau henidia hamata baine henemui eto tanona, ai baine hakaumui vareai ai; unuseni ai hanua badadia bona namodia, umui ese asio daidia,
english: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

motu: bona ruma, kohu namodia amo e honu umui ese asio habou, bona ranu guridia, umui ese asio ḡei, bavabi; bona vine imeadia bona olive audia umui ese asio hadodia na anidia bavani boga kunu.
english: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

motu: Una negana ai nahuamui ba toho, Iehova ba reaia na garina; ia ese Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo e hakaumui lasi.
english: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari; ia isiaina ba lao heni; ia ladana ai ba gwau hamata.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

motu: Idau dirava, hetabira tanodia ai e nohomu besedia edia dirava, basio toma henidia diho;
english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

motu: badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, bogaragimui ai e nohomu Diravana, na vaḡeḡe Diravana. Ba heita, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena badu na emui ai baine siahu bena tanobada kopina amo baine habuamui tari na garina.
english: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na basio dibaḡania, Masa ai o dibaḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena haheḡani bona ena hahedua bona ena taravatu vada e, henimui: ba badinadia mai goadamui ida.
english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

motu: Kara maoromaorodia bona kara namodia ba kara, Iehova vairanai; bena ba namo, ba raka vareai, tano namona, Iehova ese e gwau hamata senemui baine henidia eto tanona, bavabia, emui tano ai ba halaoa;
english: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,

motu: bona inaimui iboudiai na vairamui ai ba luludia lasi, Iehova ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena.
english: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

motu: Nega gabena ai natumu ese baine nanadaimu, baineto “Ini haheḡani bona hahedua bona taravatu Iehova, eda Dirava, ese vada e henida anidia be dahaka?”
english: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”

motu: Bena oi ese natumu ba haere henia, baoto: Ai na Farao isiaina a lao heniva Aigupto ai; bena Iehova ese ia imana siahuna amo e hakaumai lasi, Aigupto tanona amo;
english: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

motu: una negana ai Iehova ese toa bona hoa karadia, babada bona memetau, e hahedinarai, Aigupto Iatanai bona Farao Iatanai bona Farao ena ruma taudia latadiai, ai vairamai ai.
english: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

motu: Unu amo e hakaumai lasi, seneda e gwau henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona ai baine hakaumai vareai bona baine henimai helaoreana.
english: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e haḡanimai, ini taravatu iboudiai baia badinadia, bona Iehova, eda Dirava, garina baia gari, baia namo hanaihanai bona baine hamaurimai helaoreana, hari dina ai e hamauridamu heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

motu: Eda kara maoromaoro binai, ina haheḡani idoinai baita badinaia Iehova, eda Dirava, vairanai, vada e haḡanilaida heḡereḡerena.
english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hakaumui vareai, emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai, umui vairamui ai bese idau-idau baine luludia Iasi: Hititaudia, Girigasa taudia, Amoro taudia, Kanaan taudia, Perisi taudia, Hivi taudia, Iebusu taudia; bese hitu, badadia bona mai goadadia.
english: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui imamui ai baine atodia, bena ba hadareredia negana ai ba habuadia tari bona bavaladia ore; idia ida basio herohemaino, bona basio bogadia hisi.
english: and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

motu: Basio adavadia; umui natumui ulatodia na edia uhau basio henidia, bona idia natudia ulatodia basio abidia, emui uhau adavadia.
english: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.

motu: Badina be unu boma kara toma, idia ese natumui mamaruanedia na lauegu amo bema hakaudia siri, idau diravadia itomadiho-henidia totona; bena Iehova ena badu bema siahu, umui latamui ai, bona bema habuamui tari haraḡa-haraḡa.
english: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

motu: A ini ba karadia toma: edia ihaboulaina patadia baḡiḡi rohoroho; edia dubu au-tubuadia ba tara kohikohi; edia au helaḡadiaba hagaridia; edia kaivakuku na lahi ai ba doudia.
english: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.

motu: Badina be umui na bese helaḡana, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese tanobada besedia iboudiai bogaragidia amo vada e abimui hidi, iena bese korikori ai baine halaomui totona.
english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

motu: Iehova ese e lalokau henimui bona e abimui hidi, dia umui na bese badana dainai; lasi, bese iboudiai bogaragidiai umui na maraḡi herea.
english: Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;

motu: A Iehova ese e lalokau henimuimu bona ena gwauhamata senemui ediai ihamomokanina e uramu; una dainai mai imana siahuna ida vada e hakaumui lasi, iḡui rumana amo bona Aigupto pavapavana Farao imana amo vada e hamaurimui.
english: but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

motu: Taunabunai, ba diba, Iehova, emui Dirava, na Dirava korikori, heabidadama Diravana: ia na ena hebogahisi ai ena gwauhamata e hamomokanimu ela bona uru daha, e lalokau heniamu bona ena haheḡani e badinamu taudia ediai.
english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

motu: To e inai heniamu tauna ia ese basine bogaia hisi; davana do baine henia.
english: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.

motu: Taunabunai, haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahedua hari dina ai na henimuimu na ba badinadia namonamo.
english: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.

motu: Ini hahedua ba hakala henidia bona ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara dainai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena gwauhamata baine hamomokania bona ena hebogahisi baine hahesiriua, senemui e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

motu: Ia ese baine lalokau henimui, baine hanamomui, baine hahutumamui; garamui danu baine hanamodia, bona emui tano anidia baine hanamodia, emui uit bona emui vine ranuna bona emui dehoro bona emui boromakau natudia bona emui mamoe natudia, senemui e gwau henidia hamata baine henimui eto tanona ai.
english: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

motu: Bese iboudiai bogaragidiai umui baine hanamomomui badabada; taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ibouboudiai natudia bae havaradia, ta basine gabani.
english: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.

motu: Iehova ese gorere iboudiai na emui amo baine abi oho, Aigupto ai o davari goreredia na umui latamui ai basine atodia to inaimui iboudiai latadiai baine atodia.
english: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui oreadia iboudiai na umui ese bavaladia ore; basio bogadia hisi bona edia dirava basio toma henidia diho; badina be unu ba kara toma, vada ba hekwakwanai.
english: You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.

motu: Readia lalomu ai baoto “Ini bese ese lau e hereagumu: ede baina luludia lasi toma?”
english: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”

motu: To idia garidia basio gari. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese Farao bona Aigupto idoinai ede e karadia toma na ba laloa tao;
english: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

motu: hahehisi bona toa bona hoa karadia matamui ese e itadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese imana mai siahuna amo e hakaumui lasi na ba haeroa. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese o gari henidiamu besedia iboudiai na unu baine karadia toma.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which Yahweh your God brought you out. So shall Yahweh your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

motu: Oibe, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese nanigo baine siaidia bogaragidiai, ela bona bese kwabukwabudia, bae komu taudia, na bae ore vaitani.
english: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

motu: Basio gari henidia, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na bogaragimui ai e nohomu: ia na Dirava badana, hahegari Diravana.
english: You shall not be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is among you, a great and awesome God.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ini bese na metaira-metaira umui vairamui ai baine luludia lasi; basio habuadia haraḡa-haraḡa, uda boromadia bae momo emui tano ai na garina.
english: Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui imamui ai baine atodia, baine haheḡonudia patapata, ela bona bae ore vaitani.
english: But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

motu: Edia pavapava na imamui ai baine atodia; ladadia ba haboiodia guba henuna amo; ta ese basine laomui ahu diba, ela bona ba habuadia tari vaitani.
english: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

motu: Edia dirava laulaudia na lahi ai ba doudia; iheralaidia gold-na * bona silver-na * na basio hekise-hekise henibona basio abi, ba hekwakwanai na garina. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese unu ḡau e dadaraimu.
english: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

motu: Vada e dadaraia ḡauna na emui ruma ai basio vareailaia, ena dika ai ba dika na garina: ena amo ba raka oho, ba rakatania, ba gari henia bona ba inai henia, badina be ia na heuduguirai ḡauna.
english: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia iboudiai ba badinadia, unu amo ba mauri, bona ba hutuma, a ba raka vareai, Iehova ese senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona bavabia, emui tano ai ba halaoa.
english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai tano ḡaḡaena ai e hakaumui daladia ba haero, ihamanaumui bona lalomui itohodia totona unu e kara toma, baine diba, ena haheḡani ba badinadia eiava lasi.
english: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

motu: Ia ese e hamanaumui bona e hahitolomui, bena mana e henimui, aniani ḡauna matamatana emui ai, tamamui asi dibadia ḡauna. Unu amo e hadibamui, taunimanima na dia aniani amo mo se maurimu, a Iehova uduna amo e lasimu herevadia iboudiai amo danu.
english: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.

motu: Unu laḡani hari-ahui iboudiailalodiai emui dabua; asie dika, bona aemui asie gudu.
english: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

motu: Ba laloa danu, tamana ese natuna matana e hakaniamu na heto, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui matamui unu e hakani tomava.
english: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani ba badinadia; ena dala ai ba raka, bona ia garina ba gari.
english: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese tano namona ai be hakaumui vareaimu: sinavai momo tanona, mai ranu gabudia bona ranu guridia, koura ai bona ororo ai.
english: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

motu: Ia na uit momo bona bali + 8:8 “Bali” na flaoa ikaralaina reina ta, uit na heto. “Vine’” bona “suke” bona “Rimono” bona “olive” na Heberu taudia edia au huahua haida ladadia. * momo tanona, mai vine audia bona suke audia bona rimono audia bona olive audia, bona mai bada-ranuna danu.
english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

motu: Unuseni ai flaoa bavania boga-kunu; ḡau ta ai basio dabu. Una tanoena nadi na auri nadidia; ena ororo ai danu auri labora-labora ba ḡeia.
english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

motu: Bavaniani, bogamui bae kunu; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ba imodaia, tanona; namona na ia ese vada e henimui dainai.
english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba reaia na garina, eiava ena haheḡani eiava ena taravatu eiava ena hahedua hari dina ai na henimuimu ba readia na garina.
english: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

motu: Bavaniani, bogamui bae kunu; ruma namodia ba hagini, ba noholai;
english: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

motu: emui boromakau seridia bona emui mamoe seridia bae hutuma; emui silver * bona emui gold * bae bada; emui ḡau iboudiai bae momo.
english: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

motu: Una negana ai nahuamui ba toho, ba hekokoroku na garina, bona Iehova, Aigupto taudia edia tano bona edia iḡui rumana amo e hakaumui lasi Diravana, ba reaia na garina.
english: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

motu: Ia ese una tano ḡaḡaena badana bona dikana amo e hakaumui hanai; gaigai bona doadoa edia hekori amo e hamaurimui; bona tano kaukauna ai, asi ranuna tanona ai, ranu na nadi hagahagana amo e ha-arua lasi, amui.
english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

motu: Tane ḡaḡaena ai ia ese mana amo e ubumuiva, tamamui asi dibadia anianina, baine hamanaumui bona lalomai baine dibadia bona dokona ai baine hanamomui helaoreana.
english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

motu: Taunabunai, lalomu ai basioto “Lau siahugu bona imagu goadana ese ina taḡa vada na abia, egu”.
english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ba laloa, badina be ia ese siahu e henimuimu, taḡa bavabilaia, ena gwauhamata, senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata ḡauna, baine hamomokania totona, hari dina ai e karamu heḡereḡerena.
english: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, boma laloa boio, dirava idaudia boma raka henidia kahi, isiaidia boma lao heni bona boma toma henidia diho, hari dina ai na hamaoromui momokanimu, vada ba mase.
english: It shall be, if you shall forget Yahweh your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

motu: Iehova ese bese haida umui vairamui ai e habuadia tarimu na heto, umui danu baine habuamui tari; badina be o gwau edeede, Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona asio kamonai henia.
english: As the nations that Yahweh makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

motu: Israel e, a kamonai. Hari dina ai umui ese Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, bese badadia, goada ai e hereamui besedia, edia tano bavabi emui; hanua badadia danu, edia maḡu na guba ai e daemu hanuadia, bavabi emui.
english: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

motu: Unu bese taudia na babada bona lalata; idia na Anakim taudia: dibamui, bona haridia vada o kamonai, e tomu “Anak natuna vairadiai daika baine gini?”
english: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

motu: Vada ba diba, hari dina ai Iehova, emui Dirava, na vairamui ai baine hanai, lahi ḡaraka-ḡaraka na heto; baine habuadia bona baine hamanokadia; bena umui ese ba hahavadia bona bavaladia ore haraḡa, Iehova ese vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: Know therefore today that Yahweh your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as Yahweh has spoken to you.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vairamui ai baine luludia lasi murinai, lalomu ai basioto “Egu kara maoromaoro dainai Iehova ese ina tano vada e henigu”. Lasi; idia edia kara havara daidiai Iehova ese unu bese na vairamui amo baine luludia lasi.
english: Don’t say in your heart, after Yahweh your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness Yahweh has brought me in to possess this land;” because Yahweh drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

motu: Edia tano bavabia emui, dia emui kara maoromaoro eiava lalomui ḡoḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva daidiai, to unu bese edia kara havara daidiai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vairamui amo baine luludia lasi, senemui Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e gwaurai henidia hamata herevana ihamomokanina totona.
english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

motu: Taunabunai ba diba, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ina tano namona e henimuimu na dia emui kara maoromaoro daidiai; badina be umui na gwau-daḡe taumui.
english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

motu: Ba laloa tao, basio laloa boio, Iehova, emui Dirava, ede o habadua toma tano ḡaḡaena ai: Aigupto amo o raka lasi dinana ai ema bona ina gabu ai o kau, umui ese Iehova vada o gwau edeede henia.
english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked Yahweh your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against Yahweh.

motu: Horeb ai danu Iehova ena badu o havaraia; bena ena badu ai baine habuamui tari eto.
english: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahweh to wrath, and Yahweh was angry with you to destroy you.

motu: Ororo ai na dara dae, huro nadidia, Iehova ese e henimui taravatudia e torelai nadidia, iabidia; una negana ai lau na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahuiororo ai na nohova, aniani asina aniva, ranu asina inuva.
english: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which Yahweh made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

motu: Bena Iehova ese huro nadidia ruaosi e henigu, Dirava imana kwakikwakina e torelai ḡaudia; idia latadiai Iehova ena hereva iboudiai vada e hetore, hebou badana dinana ai, ororo ai, lahi bogaragina amo e hamaorolaimui herevadia.
english: Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

motu: Dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui e ore ai, Iehova ese unu nadi e henigu, taravatu nadidia.
english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, A tore isi, ina gabu amo a hekei; haraḡa-haraḡa; badina be Aigupto amo vada o hakaudia lasi taudiavada e kara havara; na haḡanilaidia dalana amo vada e raka siri haraḡa-haraḡa, kaivakuku ta vada e karaia.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ina bese taudia vada na itadia, idia na gwau-daḡe taudia.
english: Furthermore Yahweh spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

motu: A siri, baina habuadia tari, ladadia na baina roho guba henuna amo. Bena oiemu amo bese badana ta, idia baine hereadia besena, baina havaraia.
english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

motu: Taunabunai na raka muri, ororo amo na hekei. Ororo na lahi ese e araia. Taravatu nadidia ruaosi na imagu ai.
english: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

motu: Bena na roha lao, na itamui, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai vada o kara havara, boromakau natuna laulauna vada o koroa, Iehova vada e haḡanilaimui dalana amo vada o raka siri haraḡa-haraḡa.
english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which Yahweh had commanded you.

motu: Bena huro nadidia ruaosina abidia, imagu amo na tahodia dobi; idia na vairamui ai e makohi rohoroho.
english: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

motu: Bena Iehova vairanai na goru diho, nega gunana heḡereḡerena, dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui aniani asina aniva bona ranu asina inuva, emui karadika iboudiai daidiai; badina be Iehova vairanai o kara havara bona ena badu o havaraia.
english: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

motu: Iehova ese e badu henimui dikadikava bona e urava baine habuamui tari dainai kudougu e hetaha; a una negana ai danu Iehova ese egu noinoi ma e abia dae.
