english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Yahweh was angry against you to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me that time also.

motu: Iehova ese Aaron danu e badu heniava una negana ai, baine alaia mase eto; ia dainai danu na ḡuriḡuriva.
english: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

motu: Bena emui kara havara ḡauna, hari boromakau natuna laulauna, na abia, Iahi ai na gabua; bena na huaria sisisisi, ḡahu na heto; bena hari ḡahu na ororo amo e aruva sinavaina ai na negea.
english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

motu: Tabera ai danu, bona Masa ai, bona Kibroto-hatava ai, umui ese Iehova o habadua.
english: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to wrath.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Kade-baranea amo ma e siaimui, eto “Vada aola; vada na henimui tanona bavabia”. Una negana ai umui na o gwau edeede, Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani asio badinaia, bona asio abidadama henia, bona gadona asio kamonai.
english: When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

motu: Emui ai na kau dinana ema bona harihari umui ese Iehova vada o gwau edeede henia.
english: You have been rebellious against Yahweh from the day that I knew you.

motu: Taunabunai lau na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui Iehova vairanai nagoru dihova; badina be Iehova ese baine habuamui tari eto.
english: So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy you.

motu: Bena Iehova na noia, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, emu bese basio habuaia tari, dihimu basio aladia ore. Oi siahumu amo vada o hamauridia; oi imamu siahuna ai Aigupto amo vada o hakaudia lasi.
english: I prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

motu: Emu hesiai taudia, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob, ba lalodia; ina bese taudia edia gwau-daḡe bona ediakara havara bona edia kara dika basio lalodia;
english: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

motu: emu hahekau dainai a rakatania tanona taudia ese bae kirikirilaimu na garina, baeto “Iehova na asi goadana e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai baine hakaudia vareai”, bona “E inai henidia dainai vada e hakaudia lasi tano ḡaḡaena ai, baine aladia mase totona”.
english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

motu: Badina be idia na oiemu bese, oi dihimu; oi ese imamu o toia roro, emu siahu badana amo o hakaudia lasi.
english: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Huro nadidia rua ma ba utu palaka, gunadia heḡereḡeredia, bena ororo ai ba dara dae dekegu ai. Bona maua ta reirei amo ba karaia.
english: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

motu: Bena revareva baina tore unu huro nadidia ai, nadi gunadia ai e hetore heḡereḡeredia. Bena maua ai ba udadia.
english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

motu: Taunabunai lau ese kela + 10:3 “Kela”: hanua haida e tomu “budabuda”. * reireidia na abi, maua na karaia, bona huro nadidia rua na utu palaka, gunadia heḡereḡeredia, ororo ai na daralai dae.
english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

motu: Bena ia ese taravatu gwautaosi e tore, unu huro nadidia ai, gunadia ai e hetore heḡereḡeredia. Unu taravatu be Iehova ese ororo ai e henimui ḡaudia, lahi bogaragina amo e gwaurai, hebou dinana ai. Bena Iehova ese unu nadi vada e henigu.
english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.

motu: Bena na raka muri, ororo amo na hekei, hari nadi na na karaia heḡaeḡae mauana ai na udadia. Idia na doini mimia, Iehova ese ena haheḡani e henigu heḡereḡerena.
english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.

motu: (Israel taudia na Bene-iaakan ranu-guridia amo e laolao, ela bonaMosera ai e kau; unuseni ai Aaron e mase, bena e guria. Ia natuna Eleasara ese e boloa, hahelaḡa tauna dagina ai.
english: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

motu: Unu amo ma e laolao, Gudugoda ela. Gudugoda amo ma e laolao, Iotobata, sinavai momo tanona, ela.
english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Levi iduhuna e abia hidi, Iehova ena taravatu mauana bae huaia, bona Iehova vairanai bae gini; ena ḡaukara bae kara, bona ia ladana bae heatolaia, ema bona hari dina.
english: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to stand before Yahweh to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

motu: Una dainai Levi na asi ahuna tadikakana bogaragidiai. Ia ahuna na Iehova, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e hamaoroa heḡereḡerena.)
english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)

motu: Lau na dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui ororo ai na nohova, nega gunana heḡereḡerena; bena nega iharuana ai danu Iehova ese egu noinoi e abia dae, bena se habuamui tari.
english: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahweh listened to me that time also. Yahweh would not destroy you.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, A tore isi, emu orea taudia vairadiai ba raka; bena senedia na gwau henidia hamata baina henidia nato tanona ai bae raka vareai, bona bae abia edia.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

motu: Israel e, harihari Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ura be dahaka emui ai? Ina mo: Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari, bona ena dala iboudiai ba raka. Iehova, emui Dirava, ba ura henia, bona isiaina ba lao heni mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai;
english: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

motu: bona Iehova ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu iboudiai, lau ese umui ihanamomui totona hari ina dina ai vada na gwaurai henimui ḡaudia, ba badinadia.
english: to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

motu: A laloa, Iehova, emui Dirava, na guba biaguna bona atai gabudia lohiana; tanobada na iena, bona tanobada anina idoinai danu iena;
english: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

motu: to Iehova ese umui senemui e abidia dae, ena lalokau, bona garadia e abidia hidi, ena bese, umui sibomui, bese iboudiai bogaradiai, ema bona hari ina dina.
english: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

motu: Taunabunai, lalomui ba hahelaḡadia, bona emui gwau-daḡe ba negea.
english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na dirava edia Dirava bona lohia edia Lohia; ia na Ḡaubada; ia na siahu bona hahegari Diravana. Ia vairanai taunimanima iboudiai na heḡereḡere; ta ese ia lalona basine ania diba.
english: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

motu: Ia ese vabu bona ihareha na ena hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoevana amo e hanamodiamu, bona noho-hedoatauna e lalokau heniamu, e ubuamu bona e hadabualaiamu.
english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

motu: Taunabunai, noho-hedoa tauna ba lalokau henia; badina be umui danu Aigupto tanonaai o noho hedoava.
english: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari; ia isiaina ba lao heni; ia ba badinaia; ia ladana ai emui gwauhamata ba gwaurai.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

motu: Ia ba imodaia, ia na emui Dirava; siahu bona hahegari karadia iboudiai matamui ese vada e ita be ia ese e kara.
english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

motu: Senemui na Aigupto ela, taunimanima hitu-ahui hona; a harihari Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e hahutumamui, guba hisiudia na heheto.
english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba ura henia bona ba kamonai henia; ena hahedua bona ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani ba badinadia nega iboudiai.
english: Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

motu: Hari dina ai ba laloa namonamo: badina be ini hereva na dia natumui, ḡau ta asi dibadia bona ḡau ta asie itaia, asina herevalai henidiamu. Iehova, emui Dirava, ena mata-hakani, bona ena siahu, bona imana mai goadana ida e toia roro, ba haerodia.
english: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

motu: Ena toa bona ena hoa karadia, Aigupto ai e kara, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, bona ena tano idoinai, ede e karadia toma danu ba haeroa.
english: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

motu: Aigupto ena tuari oreadia danu, mai edia hosi bona mai edia kariota, Davara Kakakakana abatana amo e habubunidia, umui e havamui negana ai; Iehova ese ma e habuadia tari ema bona hari dina.
english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;

motu: Ba laloa danu ede e karamui toma tano ḡaḡaena ai, ema bona ina gabu ai o kau.
english: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

motu: Ma ba laloa, Datan mai tadina Abiram, Eliab Ruben natuna, ede e karadia toma: tano ese e hadonodia, idia bona edia ruma taudia bona edia kalaga bona edia mauri ḡaudia iboudiai, Israel taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

motu: Siahu karadia iboudiai Iehova ese vada e kara, umui ese matamui amo vada o ita.
english: but your eyes have seen all of Yahweh’s great work which he did.

motu: Taunabunai, hari dina ai vada na haḡanilaimui haheḡanidia ba badinadia; bena ba goada, ba raka vareai, iabina totona ba hanai tanona vada bavabia;
english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

motu: emui mauri dinadia bae hoho danu, Iehova ese senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai. Una tano na idia mai garadia ida bae abia eto; ia na rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona.
english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

motu: Badina be iabina totona ba rakavareai tanona na dia o rakatania tanona Aigupto bamona. Unuseni ai emui uhe o hado, bena aemui amo ihapariparidia ola, aniani avadia umadia na heheto.
english: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

motu: A iabina totona ba raka hanai tanona na ororo bona koura tanona, guba medudia ese e haparipariamu tanona,
english: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e reḡuamu tanona. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e haḡereamu, nega iboudiai, laḡani matamana ela bona laḡani dokona.
english: a land which Yahweh your God cares for. Yahweh your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

motu: Hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu haheḡanidia boma badinadia, Iehova, emui Dirava, boma ura henia, bona isiaina boma lao heni mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai,
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

motu: ia ese medu baine henimui ena nega korikori ai, medu gunadia bona medu gabedia, tano ihapariparina; bena emui uit bona emui vine ranuna bona emui dehoro ba haboudia.
english: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

motu: Rei matamata danu baine henimui, emui seri adia; bavaniani, bogamui bae kunu.
english: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, sibomui lalomui ba hekoi bena ba raka siri, dirava idaudia isiaidia ba lao heni bona ba toma henidia diho, na garina.
english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

motu: Unu boma kara toma, Iehova ena badu emui ai baine vara; bena ia ese guba baine koua, medu na basine diho bona tano anidia na basie vara; bena tano namona, Iehova ese e henimuimu tanona, lalona amo ba boio haraḡa.
english: and Yahweh’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which Yahweh gives you.

motu: Taunabunai, ini egu hereva na lalomui ai bona laumamui ai ba dogodia tao; idia na toa ai baela, imamui ai bona bagumui ai.
english: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

motu: Natumui ba hadibalaidia, ruma ai o helaimu negadia ai, bona dala ai o rakamu negadia; ai, bona o hekuremu negadia ai, bona o tore isimu negadia ai, do ba herevalaidia.
english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

motu: Emui iduara ihua-ihuadia kahana kahana audia ai ba tore, bona emui ikoukou ai danu ba tore;
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

motu: bena emui mauri dinadia bona natumui edia mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova ese senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai, guba na tanobada daenai baine mia negana idoinai.
english: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

motu: Badina be na haḡanilaimuimu haheḡanidia iboudiai boma badinadia namonamo, Iehova emui Dirava boma ura henia bona ena dala iboudiai lalodiai boma raka bona enai boma tao,
english: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

motu: bena Iehova ese ini bese iboudiai na umui vairamui ai baine luludia Iasi, bena bese badadia, umui e hereamui besedia, gabudia do bavabi.
english: then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

motu: Aemui bae moi tao gabudia na bavabi, emui. Emui tano bavabia, tano ḡaḡaena amo ela bona Lebanon, bona Eufrate sinavaina amo ela bona Davara Badana.
english: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

motu: Tau ta ese basine laomui ahu diba; Iehova ese gari baine havaraia, ba lao henia tanona Ialonai; iboudiai na umui garimui bae gari, ia ese e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: No man will be able to stand before you. Yahweh your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.

motu: O itaia, hari dina ai lau na hahenamo bona heuduguirai umui vairamui ai na atodiamu:
english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

motu: hahenamo be Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani, hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu ḡaudia, ba badinadia davana;
english: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I command you today;

motu: heuduguirai be Iehova emui Dirava ena haheḡani basio badinadia, a hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu dalana amo ba raka siri bona dirava idaudia, asi dibamui diravadia, muridiai ba raka na davana.
english: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese bavabia emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona Ialonai baine hakaumui vareai negana ai, umui ese hahenamo na Gerisim ororona ai bavatoa, bona heuduguirai na Ebal ororona ai bavatoa.
english: It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

motu: Idia na Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, lahara kahana ai, dina e dihomu kahana ai, Kanaan taudia Araba ai e nohomu edia tano ai. Una tano na hevaira henina ai, More au helaḡana badinai.
english: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

motu: Badina be umui ese Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, ba raka vareai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e henimuimu tanona bavabia, emui tano. Bena bavabia bona ba noholaia negana ai,
english: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

motu: nahuamui ba toho, taravatu bona haheḡani iboudiai, hari ina dina ai na henimuimu ḡaudia, na ba badinadia.
english: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.

motu: Taravatu bona haheḡani bini, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, vada e henimui tanona ai ba badinadia namonamo, tanobada ai ba mauri noho dinadia iboudiai.
english: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

motu: Gabudia bavabi besedia edia dirava e toma henidia dihomu gabudia iboudiai ba habuadia tari, ororo badadia ai bona ororo maraḡidia ai bona au mauridia henudiai.
english: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

motu: Edia ihaboulaina patadia ba ḡiḡidia dobi; edia pupu nadidia ba hamakohidia rohoroho; edia au helaḡadia ba. doudia; edia kaivakuku ba hamakohidia, bona ladadia ba roho una gabu ai.
english: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.

motu: Iehova emui Dirava, na unu basio kara henia toma.
english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God.

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese gabu ta baine abia hidi, emui iduhu iboudiai lalodia amo, unuseni ai ladana baine atoa, bona unuseni ai baine noho. Una gabu ba tahua;
english: But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

motu: bena ba lao henia, emui ḡole-oho bouboudia, bona emui boubou idauidaudia, bona emui karoa ihagwautadia, bona emui dudui-isi ḡaudia, bonaemui gwauhamata ḡaudia, bona emui herahia ḡaudia, bona emui boromakau natudia roboadia, bona emui mamoe natudia roboadia, iboudiai ba laohai.
english: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

motu: Unuseni ai danu Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai bavaniani, bona ba moale hebou, emui ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, umui bona emui ruma taudia, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e hanamomui.
english: There you shall eat before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which Yahweh your God has blessed you.

motu: Harihari iniseni ai ta karamu karadia na unuseni ai basio kara. Iniseni ai ta ta ena ura ena ura ta karamu,
english: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

motu: badina be emui laḡa-ani gabuna bonaemui tano korikori, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui gabuna, na do asio kau.
english: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God gives you.

motu: A Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai ba hanai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui emui tano korikori ai ba halaoa tanona; bena ia ese inaimui bogaragidia amo baine hamaurimui ela bona mai mainomui ida ba noho;
english: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,

motu: una negana ai vada na haḡailaimui ḡaudia iboudiai ba laohaidia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese, ia ladana unuseni ai baine mia totona, baine abia hidi gabuna ai: emui ḡole-oho bouboudia, bona emui boubou idau-idaudia, bona emui karoa ihagwautadia, bona emui dudui-isi ḡaudia, bona emui gwauhamata ḡaudia, Iehova ena.
english: then it shall happen that to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to Yahweh.

motu: Una negana ai umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai ba moale hebou, umui bona natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia, bona emui hesiai taudia bona emui hesiai hahinedia; bona Levi tauna emui hanua ai e nohomu danu, badina be ia na asi ahuna bona asi ena tano umui bogaragimui ai.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, emui ḡole-oho bouboudia na basio hahelaḡadia gabu kavakava ai,
english: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;

motu: a Iehova ese emui iduhu bogaragidia amo baine abia hidi gabuna ai mo; unuseni ai emui ḡole-oho bouboudia ba hahelaḡadia, bona unuseni ai na haḡanilaimuimu karadia iboudiai ba kara.
english: but in the place which Yahweh chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

motu: Ḡau tamona, emui hanua idau-idau iboudiai lalodiai, mauri ḡaudia haida, uda nanidia bona dia na heheto, bavaladia diba, bona hidiodia bavani, emui ura heḡereḡerena, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena hahenamo vada e henimui heḡereḡerena; vada e taubu taudia bona asie taubu taudia bae ani diba.
english: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

motu: A mai raradia na basio ani; rara na tano ai ba hahebubua, ranu na heto.
english: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

motu: Ini na basio ani diba, emui hanua idau-idau iboudiai lalodiai: emuiuit eiava emui vine ranuna eiava emui dehoro karoadia ihagwautadia, eiava emui boromakau eiava emui mamoe natudia roboadia, eiava emui gwauhamata ḡaudia eiava emui herahia ḡaudia eiava emui dudui-isi ḡauna.
english: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai bavani, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai, oi bona natumu maruanena bona natumu hahinena, bona emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai hahinena, bona Levi tauna emu hanua ai e nohomu; bona emu ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai ba moale.
english: but you shall eat them before Yahweh your God in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God in all that you put your hand to.

motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa, Levi tauna basio reaia, emu tano ai ba noho dinadia iboudiai.
english: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese emui tano baine habadaia, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena, bena gado dainai baoto “Lau na vamu baina ania”, una negana ai vamu do bavania, emui ura heḡereḡerena.
english: When Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna bema daudau, emui boromakau eiava emui mamoe, Iehova ese vada e henimui ḡaudia, bavaladia diba, vada na haḡanimui heḡereḡerena; bena emui hanua ai bavani, emui ura heḡereḡerena.
english: If the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahweh has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.

motu: Uda nanina eiava dia boma ani heḡereḡerena, unu danu bavani; vada e taubu bona asie taubu taudia bae ani diba.
english: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

motu: Ḡau tamona, mai raradia basio ani; badina be rara be mauri, bona mauri be hidio ida basio ani.
english: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

motu: Basio ania; tano ai ba bubua, ranu na heto.
english: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

motu: Basio ania, bena ba namo, umui bona natumui umui murimui ai, Iehova vairanai o kara maoromaoromu dainai.
english: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

motu: To, emui ḡau helaḡadia bona emui gwauhamata ḡaudia vada ba laohaidia, Iehova ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai;
english: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which Yahweh shall choose.

motu: bona emui ḡole-oho bouboudia hidiodia bona raradia naIehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana ai ba hahelaḡadia. Bena emui boubou ḡaudia raradia na Iehova emui Dirava ena ihaboulaina patana ai ba sei, a hidiodia be bavani.
english: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on Yahweh your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on Yahweh your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, ini na haḡanilaimuimu herevadia iboudiai na karadia ba kara; bena ba namo, natumui danu umui murimui ai bae namo hanaihanai, kara namodia bona kara maoromaorodia Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai o karamu dainai.
english: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

motu: Iehova, umui Dirava, ese gabudia bavabi besedia baine negedia daure, bena umui ese gabudia bavabi bona edia tano ba noholaia;
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

motu: una negana ai nahuamui ba toho, idia do bae hebua tari murinai edia dala ai ba raka na garina, bona edia dirava ba herevalaidia, baoto “Ini bese na edia dirava ede e toma henidia diho tomamu Lau danu unu baina kara toma”, na garina.
english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na unu basio kara henia toma; badina be lebulebu karadia iboudiai Iehova ese e inai henimu be idia ese vada e kara, edia dirava ihanamolaidia; oibe, natudia mamaruanedia bona natudia hahinedia na lahi ai e haḡoledia oho, edia dirava ihanamolaidia.
english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

motu: Vada na henimui haheḡanidia iboudiai ba badinadia namonamo; latadiai hereva ta basio atoa kau, bona edia amo hereva ta basio kokia.
english: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

motu: Bogaragimui ai peroveta tauna eiava nihi tauna ta bema tore isi, toa ta eiava hoa karana ta bema gwauraia guna,
english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

motu: gabeamo ia ese e gwauraia guna toana eiava hoa karana bema vara, bena ia bema toma “Dirava idaudia, umui do asi dibamui diravadia, baita tahudia bona isiaidia baita lao heni”,
english: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

motu: una peroveta tauna eiava nihi tauna ena hereva basio abia dae. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e tohomuimu, baine diba, Iehova emui Dirava o lalokau heniamu mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai ida eiava lasi.
english: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to know whether you love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, murina amo ba raka, ia garina ba gari, iena haheḡani ba badinadia, ia gadona ba kamonai, ia isiaina ba lao heni, bona ienai ba tao.
english: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

motu: A una peroveta tauna eiava una nihi tauna na bavalaia mase; badina be gwau-edeede karadia e hahedibalai, e tomu Iehova, emui Dirava, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaumui lasi bona iḡui rumana amo e ruhamui nege Diravana, ba gwau edeede henia, ma e tomu, Iehova, emui Dirava, vada e haḡanilaimui dalana amo ba raka siri. Kara havara na bogaragimui amo unu ba negea daure toma.
english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Yahweh your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

motu: Readia tadikakamu korikorina eiava natumu maruanena eiava natumu hahinena eiava adavamu lalokauna eiava turamu lalokauna ese lalomu baine ania hehuni, baineto “Dirava idaudia isiaidia baita lao heni”. Unu dirava na readia oi asi dibamu bona senemu asi dibadia diravadia,
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

motu: a bogaragidiai o nohomu besedia edia dirava, gabu kahikahidia ai eiava gabu daudaudia ai, eiava tanobada dokona kahana amo ela bona tanobada dokona kahana.
english: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

motu: Unu bema kara toma, ena lalo-ani basio abia dae, bona basio kamonaihenia, bona basio bogaia hisi, bona basio hamauria, bona basio hunia.
english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

motu: Bavalaia mase; oi imamu baine guna ia ialana ai, murinai taunimanima iboudiai imadia ienai bae kau.
english: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

motu: Nadi amo ba hodoa mase, badina be ia ese Iehova, emu Dirava, Aigupto tanona amo bona iḡui rumana amo e hakaumui lasi Diravana, ena amo baine hakaumui siri eto dainai.
english: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai bae kamonai bona bae gari, gabeai kara havara unuhetomana nega ta basie karaia lou, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

motu: Readia Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui hanuana ta ai harina ba kamonai,
english: If you hear about one of your cities, which Yahweh your God gives you to dwell there, that

motu: kara havara taudia haida bogaragimui amo vada e raka lasi, hanua taudia lalodia vada e ani, eto, “Dirava idaudia, umui do asi dibamui diravadia, isiaidia baita lao heni”.
english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

motu: Unu bema heto, umui na ba tahua bona ba henanadai malaka-malaka. Bema momokani kara dika-hereana unuhetomana vada e karaia bogaragimui ai,
english: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

motu: una hanua taudia na dare amo bavaladia mase; hanua na ba habuaia tari, bona taunimanima iboudiai bona boromakau iboudiai na dare amo bavaladia ore.
english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

motu: Kohuna idoinai na ariara ai ba habou, unuseni ai ba doudia; kohu na bae ara, hanua danu baine ara, e kara ḡole-oho boubouna na heto, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena. Gabu na baine vahu hanaihanai, hanua na basie haginia lou.
english: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to Yahweh your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

motu: = helaḡana ta imamu ai basio abia. Bena Iehova na ena badu siahuna ma baine keruma; ia na baine bogamui hisi bona baine hahutumamui, senemui e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that Yahweh may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, bona ena, haheḡani iboudiai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu na boma badinadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai boma kara maoromaoro, bena unu baine karamui toma.
english: when you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

motu: Umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, natuna. Mase daidiai kopimui basio iva bona ramamui basio nau.
english: You are the children of Yahweh your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

motu: Badina be umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, ena bese helaḡana, Iehova ese tanobada kopina ai e nohomu besedia iboudiai edia amo vada e abimui hidi, ena orea korikori ai baine halaomui totona.
english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God, and Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

motu: Ḡau dikadia basio ani.
english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

motu: Bavani ḡaudia bini: boromakau, bona mamoe, bona nani;
english: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

motu: dia + 14:5 “Dia” na uda ḡauna ta, itana na nani na heto. * badana, bona dia maraḡina, bona uda diana, bona uda nanina, bona ororo diana, bona taora diana, bona ororo mamoena.
english: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

motu: Imadia aedia palapaladia aukadia bona pararadia, bona aniani e hadonomu ma e lori lasimu, ududia ai ma e ḡauamu, ḡaudia iboudiai bavani.
english: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

motu: Ḡau tamona, adia aniani e ḡaua loumu eiava imadia aedia pararadia ḡaudia haida na basio ani. Ḡaudia bini: kamelo bona hea bona koni, + 14:7 “Hea” bona “Koni” na uda ḡaudia maraḡidia, mada bamona. * badina be adia aniani e ḡaua loumu to imadia aedia palapaladia asie parara. Idia na mimiro emui ai.
english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

motu: Boroma danu na miro emui ai, badina be imana aena palapaladia e parara, to ana aniani se ḡauaia loumu. Hidiodia na basio ani, bona masedia ai basio daudia toho.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

motu: Ranu ai e nohomu ḡaudia na mai taiadia bona mai unadia bavani.
english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

motu: A asi taiadia bona asi unadia ḡaudia na basio ani: idia na mimiro emui ai.
english: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

motu: Manu ḡoevadia iboudiai na bavani.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

motu: A ini na basio ani: ugava-bada, bona larata, bona ugava maraḡina;
english: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

motu: bona pivai bona bogibada, mai bamodia manudia ida;
english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

motu: mukou danu, mai ia bamona manudia ida;
english: every raven of any kind,

motu: bona kokokoko bona kito bona kanaḡe bona kipa, mai bamodia manudia ida;
english: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

motu: bona baimumu maraḡina, bona baimumu badana, bona kema;
english: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

motu: bona boebedi, bona lokoru, bona manubada;
english: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

motu: bona boge bona noko, mai bamodia manudia ida; bona turumu, bona sisiboi.
english: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

motu: Mai hanidia bona mai imadia aedia ḡaudia na mimiro emui ai, basio ani.
english: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

motu: Mai hanidia; ḡaudia ḡoevaḡoevadia iboudiai na bavani.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

motu: E mase kava ḡauna na basio ania. Emu hanua ai e noho hedoamu tauna ba henia diba, bena baine ania; eiava idau bese tauna enai ba hoia. Badina be umui na bese helaḡana, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena. Nani natuna hidiona na sinana ratana amo basio nadua.
english: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. motu: Laḡani ta ta amo emu uma anidia ba karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ba hahelaḡaia.
english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

motu: Bena aria ba karaia; Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai, ia baine abia hidi gabuna ai, emu karoa ihagwautadia bavani, uit bona vine ranuna bona dehoro; bona emu boromakau natudia roboadia bona emu mamoe natudia roboadia danu bavani, nega iboudiai Iehova, emu Dirava, garina ba gari helaoreana.
english: You shall eat before Yahweh your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear Yahweh your God always.

motu: A dala daudau dainai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu negadia ai oi ese hari karoa helaḡadia basio laohai diba, Iehova, emu Dirava, vada e abia hidi bona ladana vada e nemailaia gabuna na daudau dainai,
english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,

motu: vada ba hoia, moni davana. Bena moni na imamu ai bavabia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena abi-hidi gabuna baola,
english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.

motu: unuseni ai lalomu e ura henimuḡaudia na emu moni amo ba hoi, boromakau eiava mamoe eiava vine ranuna eiava inuinu ḡauna ta, emu ura heḡereḡerena. Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai bavaniani, bona ba moale, oi bona emu ruma taudia iboudiai.
english: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

motu: Levi tauna danu emu hanua ai e nohomu na basio reaia, badina be ia na asi ahuna bona asi ena tano bogaragimui ai.
english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

motu: Laḡani toi toi amo, emu karoa ihagwautadia, una laḡani ihatoina anina amo, bavabi, emu hanua rogena ai bavato;
english: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

motu: bena Levi tauna (badina be asi ahuna bona asi ena tano bogaragimui ai), bona noho-hedoa taunabona ihareha bona vabu emu hanua ai nonoho na baela, adia bae ha abi, bena bogadia bae kunu. Unuheto amo Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, bona imamu amo e karamu karadia iboudiai baine hanamodia.
english: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

motu: Laḡani ihahitudia dokodia ai, abi-torehai iboudiai na bae hegwau tao.
english: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

motu: Ini ba kara toma: taunimanima ta ta ese dekena tauna e henia torehai ḡauna baine gwaua tao, iabi-louna basine gwauraia, dekena taunaena amo eiava varavarana ena amo; badina be Iehova ese abi-torehai igwau-taodiavada e gwauraia.
english: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because Yahweh’s release has been proclaimed.

motu: Idau bese tauna enai iabi-louna ba gwauraia diba; to emu ḡau ta bema varavaramu imana ai, vada ba gwaua tao.
english: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

motu: A tau ta basine ogoḡami umui bogaragimui ai; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, vada e henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai Iehova ese baine hanamomui.
english: However there will be no poor with you (for Yahweh will surely bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)

motu: = tamona, Iehova, emui Dirava, erena ba kamonai, bona hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia ba badinadia.
english: if only you diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena. Bese loḡora ba henidia torehai, to ediai basio abi torehai; bona bese loḡora ba halohiadia, to idia ese basie halohiamui.
english: For Yahweh your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

motu: Bogaragimui ai varavaramui ta bema ogoḡami, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona hanuana ta ai, lalomu basio ha-aukaia, bonarimamu basio hagorua, varavaramu ogoḡamina enai.
english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

motu: Imamu ba hahekidaia era, bona ba henia, ena dabu heḡereḡerena.
english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa danu, lalomu ba hadaia kerere na garina, baoto “Laḡani ihahituna, abi-torehai igwau-taodia laḡanina, vada eme kahikahi”, bena varavaramu ogoḡaminaba vaira hua henia, bona ḡau ta basio henia; bena ia ese Iehova baine tai henia, oi baine habadelaimu, kara dika taumu.
english: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.

motu: Ba henia mai lalomu idoinai; lalomu basine hisihisi o heniamu dainai. Badina be unu amo Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, emu ḡaukara iboudiai bona imamu karadia idoidiai lalodiai.
english: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

motu: Badina be ogoḡami na basine doko emui tano ai; taunabunai na haḡanilaimumu, imamu ba hahekidaia era varavaramu enai, bona ogoḡami tauna enai eiava asi ena ḡau tauna enai, emui tano lalonai.
english: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

motu: Varavaramu ta, Heberu tauna ta eiava Heberu hahinena ta, boma hoia, ia na laḡani tauratoi lalodiai isiaimu baine lao heni, bena laḡani ihahituna ai ba ruhaia nege.
english: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

motu: Ba ruhaia nege negana ai, ima kavakavana ai basio kahua nege;
english: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

motu: a emu seri amo, emu uit amo bona emu vine ranuna amo imana anina ba heni dudukau. Herahia ba henia; Iehova, emu Dirava, ese herahia vada e henimu heḡereḡerena, ia ba henia.
english: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

motu: Ba laloa tao, umui danu hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto tanona ai, bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e ruhamui nege; taunabunai ina haheḡani name henimui hari ina dina ai.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

motu: A ia ese oi mai emu ruma taudia ida bema lalokau henimui, dekemui ai ena noho na namo dainai, bena bema toma “Lau na asina uramu baina rakatanimu”,
english: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

motu: auri mai matana ta bavabia, iduara ai taiana abona ba daia uru; bena ia ese oi isiaimu baine lao heni ela bona mase. Emu hesiai hahinena danu unu ba karaia toma.
english: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

motu: Basio laloa iruha-negena na karaaukana; badina be laḡani tauratoi oi isiaimu vada e lao heni, hesiai tauna mai davana ena nega vada e haruaia. Taunabunai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, emu kara iboudiai lalodiai.
english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God will bless you in all that you do.

motu: Roboa mamaruanedia emu boromakau seridia ai bona emu mamoe seridia ai ba hahelaḡadia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena. Boromakau natuna roboana na basio haḡaukaraia; mamoe natuna roboana na huina basio abia;
english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

motu: unu na laḡani ta ta amo emu ruma taudia ida bavani, Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai, ia ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai.
english: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.

motu: A bema mai bebeka-bebekana, eiava aena bema hedairike, eiava matana bema kepulu, eiava bema mai ena dika ta, basio hahelaḡaia Iehova, emu Dirava, ena.
english: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.

motu: Hanua ai bavania; vada e taubu taudia bona asie taubu taudia bae ani diba, uda nanidia bona dia o animu heḡereḡerena.
english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

motu: Ḡau tamona, mai rarana basio ania; rarana na tano ai ba bubua nege, ranu na heto.
english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

motu: Hua ladana Abib ba laloa, bona Lagau-hanai ariana ba karaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; badina be Abib huana ai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese hanuaboi ai Aigupto tanona amo e hakaumui lasi.
english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God; for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

motu: Lagau-hanai boubouna na emui seri amo bavabia, ba hahelaḡaia Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; ia ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna ai ba hahelaḡaia.
english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

motu: E hatubua flaoana basio ania una aria lalonai; dina hitu asie hatubua flaoana mo, hisihisi toana, bavania, badina be Aigupto tanona o heautania haraḡa-haraḡa. Una kara amo emui mauri dinadia iboudiai na Aigupto tanona o rakatania dinana ba laloa tao.
english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

motu: Dina hitu lalodiai flaoa ihatubuna muramurana na basine hedinarai emui tano idoinai; bona aria dinana ginigunana adorahina a ai emui boubou ḡauna hidiona na basine mia rani.
english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

motu: Lagauhanai boubouna na Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui hanuadia ai basio alaia,
english: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you;

motu: a Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna ai, unuseni ai lagau-hanai boubouna ḡauna bavalaia, adorahiai, dina baine diho ai, Aigupto amo o raka lasi dinana ai.
english: but at the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

motu: Ba nadua, bena bavania, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai; bena daba ai ba lou, emui kalaga baola.
english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

motu: Dina tauratoi lalodiai asie hatubua flaoana bavania. Dina ihahituna ai hebou helaḡana bavabia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; una dina ai ḡaukara ta basio karaia.
english: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work.

motu: Pura hitu ba duahidia; emui uma anidia ba utu matama dinana amo ba duahidia.
english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

motu: Bena pura ariana ba karaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; emui herahia ba henia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena herahia vada e hanamolaimui heḡereḡerena.
english: You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai ba moale, oi bona natumu maruanena, bona natumu hahinena, bona emu hesiai tauna, bona emu hesiai hahinena, bona Levi tauna emu hanua ai noho, bona noho-hedoa tauna bona ihareha bona vabu bogaragimui ai e nohomu; Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine nemailaia gabuna ai ba moale hebou.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

motu: Ba laloa tao, umui na hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto ai; bena ini taravatu iboudiai ba badinadia namonamo.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

motu: Kalaga ariana ba karaia, emui uma anidia na ikwadilaina gabuna amo bona emui vine ranuna na vine imoilaina gurina amo ba habou ḡuḡuru negana ai.
english: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

motu: Emui aria ai ba moale hebou, oi bona natumu maruanena bona natumu hahinena, bona emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai hahinena, bona Levi tauna bona noho-hedoa tauna bona ihareha bona vabu emuhanua ai nonoho.
english: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

motu: Dina hitu lalodiai aria ba karaia, Iehova emui Dirava ena, Iehova ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui, emui biru ai bona imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai Ialodiai; bena ba moale hisi dae.
english: You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

motu: Laḡani ta lalonai emui maruane iboudiai na nega toi Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai bae hedinarai, ia ese baine abia hidi gabuna ai: asie hatubua flaoana ariana negana ai, bona pura ariana negana ai, bona kalaga ariana negana ai. Imadia asi anidia basie hedinarai Iehova vairanai:
english: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty.

motu: ta ta ena goada ena goada heḡereḡerena ena herahia baine heni, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena herahia vada e hanamolaimui heḡereḡerena.
english: Every man shall give as he is able, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you.

motu: Hahemaoro taudia bona heitatao taudia ba duanaidia, Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui hanuadia iboudiai lalodiai, emui iduhu ta ta amo bavabidia hidi. Idia ese taunimanima bae hahemaoro henidia mai maoromaorodia ida.
english: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

motu: Hahemaoro basio hagagevaia, tau ta iduruna totona. Hahemaoro ihagagevana davana basio abia, badina be hahemaoro ihagagevana; davana na aonega tauna matana e hakepuludiamu bona kara maoromaoro tauna, ena hereva e hakoikoidiamu.
english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

motu: Kara maoromaoro ba ḡava, bena ba mauri, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui tanona na emui tano korikori ai bainela.
english: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

motu: Au helaḡana ta basio hadoa, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana ba larebaia gabuna ai;
english: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

motu: bona pupu nadina ta basio haginia, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e inai henidiamu.
english: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God hates.

motu: Boromakau ta eiava mamoe ta mai bebeka-bebekana eiava mai enadika ta basio hahelaḡaia Iehova, emui Dirava, ena: badina be una na kara dika-rohorohona Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai.
english: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

motu: Tau ta eiava hahine ta boma davaria bogaragimui ai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui hanuadia ta lalonai, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai vada e kara havara ena taravatu vada e tataia utu,
english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

motu: dirava idaudia isiaidia vada e lao heni bona vada e toma henidia diho, eiava dina eiava hua eiava hisiu vada e toma henidia diho, unu amo egu taravatu vada e tataia utu,
english: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

motu: bena haida ese bema hamaorolaimui: ba kamonai negana ai anina do ba tahua malaka-malaka. Bena boma diba momokani una kara dika-rohorohona vada e karaia Israel ai,
english: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

motu: una kara dikana e karaia tauna eiava hahinena na hanua ikoukouna murimurinai ba hakaua lasi, bena nadi amo ba hodoa mase.
english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

motu: Dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi edia hahebade dainai una tau eiava una hahine ba hodoa mase; a tau tamona ena hahebade dainai basio hodoa mase.
english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

motu: Dibadia bena e habadea taudia ese bae hodoa guna; idia muridiai taunimanima iboudiai ese bae hodoa, ela bona baine mase. Unuhetomana, dika na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

motu: Daradara bema vara, daika ese rara e haida; hahebubua, eiava daika ena hahebade na momokani, eiava daika ese heatu e matamaia, bona hanua taudia ese danu bema hepapahuahulaia; bena ba tore isi, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi gabuna baola,
english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.

motu: hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo bona hahemaoro dagina enai e miamu tauna vairadiai ba gini, ba nanadaidia. Bena idia ese bae haeroa bona) na bae haere henimui.
english: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

motu: Bena Iehova ese baine abia hidi gabuna amo bae haere henimui herevana ba bavabia dae, bona bae gwaurai henimui karadia iboudiai ba kara,
english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

motu: bae haduamui heḡereḡerena ai bona bae haere henimui eḡerena ai mo ba kara. Edia hahemaoro herevana amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
english: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

motu: A tau ta bema hekokoroku, hahelaḡa tauna, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai e ginimu bona isiaina e lao henimu tauna, basine kamonai henia, eiava hahemaoro tauna basine kamonai henia, una tau baine mase; unu amo kara dika na Israel ena amo ba negea daure.
english: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai bae kamonai, bena bae gari, bona basie hekokoroku lou.
english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai ba kau, bavabia, emui tano korikori ai ba halaoa, bona ba noholaia; una negana ai boma ura pavapava ta ba haginia, e noho hetabiramu besedia na heheto,
english: When you have come to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

motu: Iehova emui Dirava, ese baine abia hidi tauna na emui pavapava ai ba halaoa. Emui bese tauna ta bavabia, emui pavapava ai ba halaoa; idau bese tauna ta, basio abia.
english: you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ia ese ena hosi basine hahohodia, bona ena orea taudia basine siaidia lou Aigupto ai, hosi ihahohodia totona. Badina be Iehova ese vada e hereva henimui, eto “Nega ta una dala amo basio lou lao”.
english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Yahweh has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

motu: Adavana danu basine hahohodia, idia ese lalona bae ania na garina; bona silver * momo bona gold * momo basine habou.
english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

motu: Ena basileia teronona ai baine helai negana ai, ia ese ina taravatu buka ta ai baine torea, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi iduhuna amo, edia taravatu bukana amo baine torea hanai.
english: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

motu: Buka na dekenai baine mia, bona ena mauri dinadia iboudiai baine duahia. Unu amo Iehova, ena Dirava, imatauraina ai baine manada, bona ina taravatu bona ini haheḡani baine badinadia bona karadia baine kara.
english: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

motu: Lalona danu basine hekokoroku, ena bese taudia basine dadaraidia, bona haheḡani amo basine raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai; bena ena mauri dinadia bae hoho bona natuna edia mauri dinadia bae hoho, ena basileia Israel ai.
english: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo bona Levi taudia iboudiai na asi ahudia bona asi edia tano Israel ai. Ahudia na ḡole-oho bouboudiabona boubou idau-idau taunimanima ese e mailaidiamu, Iehova ena.
english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.

motu: Asi ahudia edia bese taudia bogaragidiai: Iehova na idia ahudia, e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia ahudia na boubou ḡaudia, boromakau eiava mamoe e mailaidiamu taudia edia amo bae abi. Ḡaudia bini: larolarona, bona vahana ruaosi, bona boukana, hahelaḡa tauna bae henia.
english: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

motu: Ini danu ba henia: emu uma anidia roboadia, bona emu vine ranuna bona emu dehoro roboadia, bona emu mamoe huina roboana.
english: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e abia hidi, emui iduhu iboudiai lalodia amo, baine gini, hahelaḡa karadia baine kara Iehova ladana ai, ia bona ia garana ela bona hanaihanai.
english: For Yahweh your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in Yahweh’s name, him and his sons forever.

motu: Levi tauna ta, ena ura korikori dainai ena noho hanuana Israel ai bema rakatania, Iehova baine abia hidi gabuna bema lao henia,
english: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose,

motu: ia ese hahelaḡa karadia baine kara Iehova ena Dirava ladana ai, varavarana Levi taudia Iehova vairanai hahelaḡa karadia unuseni ai e karamu heḡereḡerena.
english: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.

motu: Bona idia ida ana baine abia, iboudiai ahudia bae heḡereḡere, a ahuna ena hanua amo baine abia na ma idau.
english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui tanona ai ba raka vareai negana ai, unu bese edia kara bodagadia na basio kara.
english: When you have come into the land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

motu: Ta ese natuna maruanena eiava natuna hahinena na lahi ai basine haḡolea oho. Ta ese babalau eiava mari eiava rohe karadia basine kara, eiava mea ḡaudia basine abi,
english: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

motu: eiava basine vada, eiava lauma basine nanadaidia, eiava kara hehunidia basine kara, eiava mase taudia basine hahanedia.
english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

motu: Badina be unu kara bodagadia e karamu taudia na Iehova ese e dadaraidiamu; bona unu kara bodagadia daidiai Iehova ese umui vairamui amo e luludia lasimu.
english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.

motu: Umui na asi bebeka-bebekamui ba gini Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai.
english: You shall be blameless with Yahweh your God.

motu: Badinabe hari gabudia bavabidia besedia ese rohe taudia bona mari taudia e kamonai henidiamu; a umui be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e gwaumui tao, basio karaia e tomu.
english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese peroveta tauna ta, lau heḡereḡeregu, emui bese bogaragina amo baine abia hidi; bena ia erena ba kamonai:
english: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

motu: Horeb ai, hebou badana dinana ai, Iehova, emui Dirava, o noia heḡereḡerena, oto “Mani emu kara Iehova, emai Dirava, erena basia kamonai lou, bona ina lahi badana basia itaia lou, baia mase garina”.
english: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Edia hereva iboudiai na mamaoro-mamaoro:
english: Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

motu: lau na ediabese bogaragina amo peroveta tauna ta baina abia hidi, oi heḡereḡeremu; lauegu hereva na ia uduna amo baina gwaurai, bena lau ese baina haḡanilaia herevadia na ia ese baine gwaurai henidia.
english: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

motu: Bena daika ese lauegu hereva, ia ese lau ladagu ai baine gwaurai, na basine abi dae, lau ese davana baina henia.
english: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

motu: A peroveta tauna ta ese lau asina haḡanilaia herevana ta lau ladagu ai baine gwauraia, eiava dirava idaudia ladadia ai baine hereva, una peroveta tauna na baine mase.
english: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”

motu: Readia oi lalomu ai baoto “Iehova ese se gwauraia herevana na ede baia diba toma?”
english: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”

motu: Benaini; peroveta tauna ta ese hereva ta Iehova ladana ai baine gwauraia, bena una hereva na basine momokani bona anina basine vara, una na Iehova ese se gwauraia herevana. Peroveta tauna na sibona ena hekokoroku ai vada e hereva; ia garina basio gari.
english: When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona inoholaina besedia do baine negedia daure, bena umui ese ba luludia lasi, edia hanua bavabidia bona edia ruma ba noholaidia.
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

motu: Una negana ai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai hanua toi ba gwauraidia hidi.
english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

motu: Daladia danu ba lailai; bena Iehova; emui Dirava, ese baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona na ba hapararaia kaha toi. Bena ala-ala tauna ese unu hanua ta baine heau henia.
english: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.

motu: Ala-ala tauna taravatuna binai: dekena tauna se inai henia to e hapadidia tauna baine roho mauri, unu hanua ta baine heau henia negana ai.
english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

motu: Tau ta bamona ida uda bema lao, au bema utu; bena ira bema davea, au ta iutuna totona, a ira anina na ira auna amo bema hedave oho, bamona enai bema tubu, bema hamasea, ia na unu hanua toiosi ta baine heau henia, baine roho mauri;
english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

motu: mase tauna varavarana ese hapadidi tauna baine hahavaia mai baduna ida, bena dala na daudau dainai baine ḡavaia tao bona baine alaia mase na garina; a ia be mase karana se karaia, badina be bamona se inai henia.
english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

motu: Taunabunai na haḡanimuimu, hanua toi ba gwauraidia hidi.
english: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

motu: A ina haheḡani idoinai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimui na ba badinaia namonamo, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia bona ena dala ba rakalaia hanaihanai; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese emui tano baine habadaia, senemui e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena, bona senemui e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona idoinai baine henimui: una negana ai umui ese hanua toi ma ba gwauraidia hidi, unu gunadia toiosi ida bae mia;
english: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

motu: asi ena kerere tauna rarana na Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai baine hebubu, bena una rara na umui latamui ai baine mia na garina.
english: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

motu: A tau ta ese ia dekena tauna bema inai henia, bena bema bani henia, bema heatu henia, bona bema haberoa dikadika; bena tau na baine mase, bona ala-ala tauna be una hanua ta baine heau henia,
english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

motu: ena hanua korikori lohiadia ese unu amo bae ha-abia, mase tauna varavarana bae henia, benaia danu baine mase.
english: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

motu: Basio bogaia hisi, a Israel na asi ena kerere tauna rarana amo ba haḡoevaia; unu amo vada ba namo.
english: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai, dekemu tauna ena tano hetoa holoahuna, uru gunadia taudia ese e holoa ḡauna, na basio raḡaia oho.
english: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

motu: Dibana tauna tamona ena hereva basine heḡereḡere, kerere tauna ta ena kara dika eiava ena kerere ihamomokanina: a dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi edia hereva ese hahebade bae hamomokania.
english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

motu: Koikoi tauna ta ese tau ta bema habadelaia, baineto ia na vada e kerere,
english: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

motu: raruosi na Iehova vairanai bae gini, bona hahelaḡa tauna bona hahemaoro dagina unu negana ai vada e abia taudia vairadiai.
english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

motu: Bena hahemaoro taudia bae tahua namonamo: bema hahebade tauna na mai koikoina, tadikakana vada e habadelaia koikoi,
english: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,

motu: bavabia, ia ese tadikakana baine kara henia eto heḡereḡerena na ia ba kara henia.
english: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

motu: Bena taunimanima oredia na bae kamonai bona bae gari, kara dika unuhetomana basie karaia lou umui bogaragimui ai.
english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

motu: Basio hebogahisi: mauri davana na mauri; mata davana na mata; ise davana na ise; ima davana na ima; ae davana na ae.
