english: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

motu: Inaimu ba tuari henidia negadia ai, hosi bona kariota momo bona tuari taudia hutuma ba itadia, to garidia basio gari; badina be Iehova, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaumui lasi Diravana, ese e bamomuimu.
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for Yahweh your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

motu: Tuari gabuna ba raka henia kahi negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna na baine raka lasi, orea taudia baine hereva henidia,
english: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

motu: baineto: Israel e, a kamonai; hari dina ai inaimui ba tuari henidia; kudoumui basie hetaha, laumamui basie daure, basio daradara, basio gari henidia.
english: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e, bamomuimu; ia ese inaimui baine tuari henidia umui daimui ai, bona imadia amo baine hamaurimui.
english: for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

motu: Bena heitatao taudia ese orea taudia bae hereva henidia, baeto: Bema tau ta ena ruma matamatana vada e haginia, a do se kehoa, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, tuari ai bema mase bena idau tauna ta ese bema kehoa na garina.
english: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

motu: Eiava bema tau ta vine imeana vada e hadoa, a anina do se abia, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, tuari ai bema mase bena idau tauna ese ena vine anidia roboadia bema abi na garina.
english: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.

motu: Eiava bema tau ta ese, maohenina vada e abia a do se adavaia, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, tuari ai bema mase bena idau tauna ese hane-ulato bema adavaia na garina.
english: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”

motu: Heitatao taudia ese orea taudia ma bae hereva henidia, baeto: Bema tau ta gari ese e butua taomu, ia na ena ruma baine lou henia, bamona lalodia baine hamanokadia na garina.
english: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”

motu: Orea taudia na unu bae hamaorodia toma, bena heitatao taudia ese tuari biagudia bae duanaidia.
english: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.

motu: Hanua ta ba raka henia kahi, ba tuari henia totona, maino ba gwaurai henidia guna.
english: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

motu: Maino herevadia amo bema haere henimui, bona edia hanua ikoukoudia bema keho emui, idia iboudiai na emui hesiai taudia ai baela, isiaimui bae lao heni.
english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

motu: A maino basiema ura, bema ura tuari, vada ba koua heḡeḡe,
english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

motu: ela bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese una hanua baine henimui. Bena edia mamaruane ibouboudiai bavaladia mase;
english: When Yahweh your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

motu: a hahine mai natudia ida bavabidia mauri, bona boromakau bona hanua rumadia mai kohudia ida na bavabi emui. Bena inaimui adia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui, vada bavania.
english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which Yahweh your God has given you.

motu: Dauha hanuadia, bavabia tanona murimurinai, na unu ba karadia toma.
english: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

motu: A ini Iehova, emui Dirava, ese edia hanua vada e henimui emui hanua ai baela besedia na mauri ḡauna ta basio bogaia hisi: ibouboudiai bavaladia mase.
english: But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

motu: Bavaladia ore: Hiti taudia, bona Amoro taudia, bona Kanaan; taudia bona Perisi taudia, bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e haḡanimui heḡereḡerena.
english: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Yahweh your God has commanded you;

motu: Unuheto amo idia ese edia dirava itomadiho-henidia karadia bodagadia iboudiai na basiehadibamui, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, basio kara dika henia.
english: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin against Yahweh your God.

motu: Hanua ta boma tuari henia, bena boma koua heḡeḡe ela bona nega bema, daudau, una gabu auna na emui ira amo basio hagaridia, badina be huahuadia na amui aniani. Imea audia na taunimanima a? Una dainai ba tuari henidia a?
english: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?

motu: A huahuadia asie animu audia mo ba hagaridia, bena hanua maḡuna ihamakohina audia ai ba halaodia, ela bona; una e tuari henimuimu hanuana bavabia.
english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai, mase tauna ta; tano paka ai boma davaria, basioma diba daika ese e aIaia,
english: If someone is found slain in the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,

motu: emui tau badadia bona emui hahemaoro taudia ese bae raka Iasi, mase tauna bona hetabira hanuadia padadia bae hahetoho,
english: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.

motu: edena be kahikahi; bena una kahikahi hanuana ena tau badadia ese boromakau natuna hahinena ta edia seri amo bae abia, do asie ḡaukaralaia bona aiona madunana do asie atoa kau ḡauna.
english: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.

motu: Hari hanua tau-badadia ese bae laohaia, koura ta maisinavaina, tano asie ruaia bona ḡau ta asie hadoa gabuna, unuseni ai aiona bae hakwaidua.
english: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia, Levi iduhuna amo, bae raka kahira; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e abidia hidi, ia isiaina bae lao heni bona Iehova ladana bae heatolaia totona, bona hepapahuahu eiava heatu iboudiai idia ese bae hahemaorolai.
english: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them Yahweh your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Yahweh’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.

motu: Bena una mase tauna enai e kahikahi hanuana ena tau badadia ese una boromakau natuna hahinena koura ai aiona e hakwaidua ḡauna daenai imadia bae huri;
english: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.

motu: baeto: Imamai ese ina rara asie hahebubua, bona matamai ese ihahebubuna asie itaia.
english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

motu: Iehova e, emu bese Israel, o hamauria besena, ba bogaia hisi; ina asi ena kerere tauna rarana na emu bese Israel bogaraginai basine mia. Bena una rara kererena na ediai baine hegwau tao.
english: Forgive, Yahweh, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.

motu: Taunabunai, asi ena kerere tauna rarana na bogaragimui amo baine heabi oho, umui na Iehova vairanai ba kara maoromaoro negana ai.
english: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

motu: Inaimui ba tuari henidia negana ai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese imamui ai baine atodia kau, bena bavabidia mauri.
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,

motu: Una negana ai, hane namo ta abi-mauri taudia bogaragidiai boma itaia, bena boma ura henia, benaboma abia adavamu,
english: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,

motu: vada ba laohaia emu ruma. Ia na kwarana baine naua bona kahauna baine utu,
english: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

motu: bona ena abi-mauri toana dabuadia baine doki oho, bena emu ruma ai baine noho, tamana sinana taidia baine tai ela bona hua ta baine ore. Una murinai ba raka vareai ia dekenai, bona bavadavaia; ia na oi adavamu ai bainela.
english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

motu: A gabeamo basioma ura henia, vada ba kahua nege; basio hoia moni davana, bona emu hesiai hahinena ai basio halaoa, badina be vada o hahemaraia.
english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

motu: Tau ta adavana bema rarua, ta bema ura henia, ma ta bema inai henia; bena natuna na hahine raruosi, e ura heniamu hahinena bona e inai heniamu hahinena, edia amo bema abidia, a roboana na e inai heniamu hahinena ena amo,
english: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,

motu: ena kohu baine haria natuna ahudia baine henidia dinana ai, ia na e ura heniamu hahinena natuna na dihina ai basine halaoa, roboana korikori, e inai heniamu hahinena natuna, gabuna basine abia.
english: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;

motu: A natuna roboana, e inai heniamu hahinena ena amo e havaraia, na baine hahedinaraia ahu rua ihenina ai, badina be ia na ena goada roboana; una dainai roboa ahuna be ena.
english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

motu: Tau ta natuna bema daḡedaḡe bona bema gwau edeede, tamana bona sinana eredia basinema kamonai, ena be bae dadabaia to basine kamonai henidia,
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

motu: tamana bona sinana ese bae dabaia tao, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai bae hakaua lao, hanua ikoukouna badinai;
english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.

motu: bena hanua taubadadia bae hamaorodia, baeto “Natumai binai e daḡedaḡemu bona e gwau edeedemu, bona eremai se kamonaimu; ia na aniani dika tauna bona vine ranuna e inu momomu tauna”.
english: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

motu: Bena hanua taudia iboudiai ese bae hodoa mase. Unu amo kara havara na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure: Israel taudia iboudiai ese harina bae kamonai, bena bae gari.
english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

motu: Tau ta ese kara dikana ta baine karaia, bena una kara davana be mase, bena au ai ba taua dae ela bona baine mase,
english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

motu: ia na au ai basine hetau dae rani; ba taua dae dinana ani ba guria. Badina be au ai e taua dae tauna na Dirava ese e uduguiraiamu. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona na basio hamiroa.
english: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

motu: Varavaramu ena boromakau eiava ena mamoe bema boio, bena oi ese boma itaia, basio rakatania; ba hakaua lao, varavaramu ba henia.
english: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

motu: A biaguna ena ruma basinema kahikahi, eiava boma daradara biaguna be daika, ba laohaia oiemu ruma, unuseni ai ba naria ela bona biaguna ese baine tahua, bena ba henia lou.
english: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

motu: Eiava ena doniki eiava ena dabua eiava ena ḡau ta bema boio, bena oi ese boma davaria, vada ba henia lou; basio rakatania.
english: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

motu: Varavaramu ena boromakau eiava ena doniki na dala ai bema keto, bena boma itaia, ketona ai basio rakatania; ihagini-torenaai varavaramu ba durua.
english: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

motu: Tau ta ese hahine ena dabua basine dokilaia; hahine ta danu tau ena dabua basine dokilaia. Unu e kara tomamu tauna eiava hahinena na Iehova ese e dadariamu.
english: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

motu: Manu rumana ta boma davaria, au ai eiava tano ai, lalonai be manu hahinena mai natuna ida eiava mai gatoina ida, manu hahinena na natuna ida basio abidia;
english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

motu: a sinadia ba harohoa mauri, natuna mo bavabidia. Unu ba kara toma, vada ba namo; emu mauri dinadia danu bae hoho.
english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

motu: Ruma matamatana ba haginia negana ai, guhi isena ai helaoahu ḡauna ba karaia, emu ruma guhina amo tau ta baine moru dobi bena rarana na emu ruma latanai baine mia na garina.
english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

motu: Uhe idau-idau emu vine imeana ai basio hado, anina idoinai, uhe bonahuahua, baine helaḡa na garina.
english: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.

motu: Emu tano iruana ḡauna na boromakau bona doniki basie veri hebou.
english: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

motu: Mamoe huidia bona uda varodia e hatu hebou dabu; ma na basio hahedokilaia.dinadia.
english: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

motu: Emu dabua rimudia ba kara, emu hetaru dabuana isena haniosi ai.
english: You shall make yourselves fringes + 22:12 or, tassels * on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.

motu: Tau au ta ese hane-ulato ta bema adavaia, bena ia ida baine eno boumurinai bema dadaraia,
english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

motu: bena hemarai herevana bema tahotaholaia, ladana bema hadikaia bema toma “Ina hahine na abia, a ia ida a eno bou negana ai na diba ia na dia rami-hebou ulatona”.
english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

motu: una hahine tamana bonasinana ese ena rami-hebou toadia bae abi, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai baehahedinarai, hanua ikoukouna ai.
english: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

motu: Bena hahine tamana ese hanua taubadadia baine hereva henidia, baineto “Natugu na ina tau na henia, baine adavaia, to se ura heniamu dainai
english: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

motu: ia ese vada e hahemaraia, eto ia na dia rami-hebou ulatona; a natugu ena rami-hebou toadia bini”. Bena idia ese hari dabua na bae papaia, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai.
english: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

motu: Bena hanuatau-badadia ese una tau bae abia; bena bae dadabaia,
english: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

motu: bona ena kereredavana, silver * sekeledia + 22:19 “Sekele” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta. Sekele 50 = 850 grams sisivana. Sekele 100 = 1.7 kilograms sisivana. * sinahu-ta, na iena amo bae abia, hahine tamanabae henia. Badina be una tau ese Israel hane-ulato rami-hebouna ta ladanavada e hadikaia. Bona baine abia, ia adavana; basine hadihoa, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai.
english: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, + 22:19 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 100 shekels is about a kilogram or 2.2 pounds. * and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

motu: A una tau ena hahebade bema momokani, una hahine ena rami-heboutoadia bema lasi,
english: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

motu: idia ese una hahine na tamana ena ruma iduarana amo bae hakaua lasi murimuri ai; bena hanua taudia ese bae hodoa mase, badina be ia na Israel ai vada e kara havara, tamana ena ruma ai vada e noho, ariara hahinena na heto. Unu amo kara havara na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

motu: Tau ta ese ma tau ta adavana ida bae heuda hanai, bena enoboudia ai bae davaridia, raruosi na bae mase: tau baine mase, hahine danu baine mase. Unu amo kara havara na Israel bogaragina amo ba negea daure.
english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

motu: Hane-ulato rami-hebou ta bema mai maohenina, bena tau ta ese hanualalonai bema davaria bona bema eno henia,
english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

motu: raruosi na bavabidia, hanua ikoukouna amo ba hakaudia lasi, bena ba hododia mase. Hane-ulato bahodoa mase badina, ena be hanua lalonai, to ia na se lolo; bona tau ba hodoa mase, badina be ia ese dekena tauna maohenina vada e hahemaraia. Unu amo kara havara na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
english: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

motu: A tau ta ese hane-ulato mai maohenina na tano paka ai bema davaria, bena bema rosia bona bema eno henia, una tau mo sibona baine mase;
english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

motu: a hane-ulato enai kara ta basio karaia, badina be ia na se kerere, taunabunaiasi badina ia baine mase. Una na tau ta baine tore isi, dekena tauna baine aIaia mase, na heto.
english: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

motu: Badina be tano paka ai e davaria, bena hane-ulatona e lolo, a asi iduruna tauna ta unuseni ai.
english: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

motu: Tau ta ese hane-ulato rami-hebou ta asi maohenina bema davaria, bena bema rosia bona bema eno henia, bena taunimanima ese bae davaria,
english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

motu: hari tau ese hane-ulato tamana na silver * sekeledia imahui baine henia, bona hane-ulato baine adavaia danu; badina be ia ese vada e hahemaraia. Ia na basine hadihoa, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai.
english: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels + 22:29 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

motu: Tau ta ese tamana adavana basine abia, basine eno henia.
english: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

motu: Abona nadinadina e heala eiava usina e heutu tauna na Iehova ena hebou lalonai basine raka vareai.
english: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

motu: Ariara natuna na Iehova ena hebou lalonai basine raka vareai; ia garana danu Iehova ena hebou lalonai basie raka vareai, ela bona uru ihagwautana.
english: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

motu: Amono tauna ta eiava Moab tauna ta Iehova ena hebou ai basine raka vareai, ela bona uru ihagwautana, eIa bona hanaihanai;
english: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever,

motu: badina be Aigupto amo oma negana ai idia na raka hanaimui ai aniani bona ranu asie henimui. Badina danu idia ese Balaam Beoro na Petoro, Mesopotamia tanona hanuana, amo e boiria, bona davana e henia, baine uduguiraimui totona.
english: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ese Balaam na se hakala henia; iuduguiraimui herevana na ihanamolaimui herevana ai e halaoa, badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e ura henimui.
english: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.

motu: Ihamainodia bona ihanamodia na basio tahu, emui mauri dinadia iboudiai.
english: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

motu: Edom tauna ta basio inai henia, badina be ia na tadikakamu. Aigupto tauna ta danu basio inai henia, badina be ena tano ai o noho hedoava.
english: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

motu: Uru ihatoina ai bena idia garadia ese Iehova ena hebou lalonai bae raka vareai.
english: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

motu: Tuari baola bena ba taruha negadia ai, nahuamui ba toho, ḡau dikadia garidia.
english: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.

motu: Tau ta hanuaboi ai baine miro, ia na taruha baine rakatania, murimuri ai baine noho;
english: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

motu: adorahi ai baine digu, bena dina baine diho murinai ia na taruha lalonai ma baine raka vareai.
english: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.

motu: Taruha murimurinai ba hamurimuri.
english: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

motu: Isiva ta emu tuari ḡaudia ida bavabi kau, bena o uramu ba helai diho negana ai guri ba ḡeia, bena ba kukuri murinai tano amo ba tahunia.
english: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na emui taruha bogaraginai e loamu, baine hamaurimui bona inaimui na vairamui ai baine hadareredia totona. Taunabunai, emui taruha baine helaḡa, ia ese ḡau mirona ta bogaragimui ai baine itaia bena emui amo baine raka oho na garina.
english: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

motu: Hesiai tauna ta ese biaguna bema heautania, oi dekemu ai bema heau kau, biaguna basio henia lou.
english: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

motu: Ia na dekemu ai baine noho, emu ruma taudia bogaragidiai; baine abia hidi bona baine ura henia gabuna ai emu maḡu lalonai, unuseni ai baine noho; basio daḡedaḡe henia.
english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

motu: Israel hahinena ta ariara hahinena ai basinela, dirava ta ihanamolaina; bona Israel tauna ta tau ta ida basine eno bou, dirava ta ihanamolaina.
english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

motu: Ariara hahinena davana eiava sisia davana na Iehova, emu Dirava, ena ruma ai basio vareailaia, emu gwauhamata davana ai basio halaoa; badina be unu kara ruaosi na Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e dadaraimu.
english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, + 23:18 literally, dog * into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

motu: Emu ḡau ta na varavaramu basio henia torehai, mai atokauna ida bavabi lou totona; ena abi-torehai bema moni eiava aniani eiava ma ḡau ta, to atokauna na basio tahua.
english: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

motu: Idau bese tauna ena amo atokauna bavabia; a varavaramu ena amo basio abia. Unu amo Iehova, emu Dirava, ena hahenamo na imamu ḡaukaradia latadiai baine mia, bavabia emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai.
english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, ba gwau henia hamata negana ai, emu gwauhamata ihamomokanina ai basio halahe. Badina be Iehova, emu Dirava, ese emu gwauhamata anina na emu ai baine tahua; bema lasi, ia ese baine gwauraimu kara dika tauna.
english: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

motu: A basioma gwau hamata, oi na asi emu kara dika.
english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

motu: Udumu bibinadia amo bae lasi herevadia ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara; lalomu ena ura dainai udumu vada e hereva, Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai, taunabunai karana ba karaia.
english: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

motu: Dekemu tauna ena vine imeana ai ba raka vareai negana ai, vine anidia bavani, emu hitolo heḡereḡerena, a haida basio uda emu moda ai.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

motu: Dekemu tauna ena uit umana ai ba raka vareai negana ai, uit anidia na imamu ai ba buruki, a emu ilapa amo basio utu.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

motu: Tau ta baine headava, gabeai adavana basine ura henia, hahine ena kara mirona ta dainai, ia ese hekoho revarevana baine torea, baine henia; bena baine hadihoa.
english: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

motu: Hahine na baine diho; bena baine ura negana ai ia na bainela, tau ta ma baine adavaia.
english: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

motu: A adavana ihararuana basinema ura henia, bena hekoho revarevana baine henia bona baine hadihoa, eiava hari adavana ihararuana bema mase,
english: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

motu: ia adavana gunana, e hadihoa guna tauna, basine abia lou diba; vada e miro ienai. Una na kara mirona Iehova enai; Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine henimu emu tano ai ba halaoa tanona na basio hamiroa.
english: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to Yahweh. You shall not cause the land to sin, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

motu: Headava matamata tauna na tuari basinela, bona ḡaukara ta basio henia. Ena ruma ai baine noho, adavana baine hamoalea, ela bona laḡani ta baine ore.
english: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

motu: Asi tauna ta ese uit iririlaina nadidia, henu nadina eiava atai nadina, baine abia, abitorehai toana; badina be unu bema kara toma, una tau ena mauri badina bema abia oho.
english: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.

motu: Tau ta ese bamona, Israel tauna ta, baine dabaia tao, ena hesiai tauna ai baine halaoa eiava baine hoia, ia na henao tauna; bae alaia mase. Unu amo kara dika unuhetomana na bogaragimui amo ba negea daure.
english: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

motu: Nahuamu ba tohoa, lepra garina. Hahelaḡa taudia Levi oreana amo ese bae hadibalaimui karadia iboudiai ba kara; lau ese idia vada na haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, umui danu unu ba kara toma.
english: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

motu: Aigupto amo o raka lasi negana ai Iehova, emu Dirava, na dala ai Miriama ede e karaia toma vada ba laloa tao.
english: Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.

motu: Dekemu tauna na ḡau ta ba henia torehai negana ai, ena ruma ai basio dae kau, ena abitorehai toana iabina.
english: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

motu: Murimuri ai ba gini, ela bona abitorehai tauna baine raka lasi, ena abitorehai toana baine henimu.
english: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

motu: Bema ogoḡami tauna, ena abitorehai toana basio dogoa tao rani;
english: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

motu: dina baine diho ai ba henia lou; bena ena hetaru ai baine mahuta, bona baine hanamomu. Una na kara maoromaoro oiemu ai, Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai.
english: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before Yahweh your God.

motu: Emu hesiai tauna mai davana, Israel tauna eiava noho-hedoa tauna, bema ogoḡami, emu kara na basine auka ienai.
english: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.

motu: Dina ta ta amo davana ba henia; dina do basine diho vada ba henia. Badina be ia na e ogoḡamimu, bona davana iabina e uramu. Ia ese Iehova baine tai henia, oi baine habadelaimu, bena oi na ba kerere na garina.
english: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to Yahweh, and it be sin to you.

motu: Tama na basie aladia mase natudia daidiai, bona memero na basie aladia mase tamadia daidiai; a ta ta ena kara dika ena kara dika daidiai bae aladia mase.
english: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

motu: Hahemaoro basio hagagevaia, idau tauna enai eiava ihareha enai. Vabu ena dabua na basio abia, abitorehai davana.
english: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;

motu: Ba laloa tao, oi na hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto ai, bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e hamaurimu. Badina bunai lau ese ini na haḡanimu toma.
english: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

motu: Emu uma anina ba utua negana ai, iḡui ta boma reaia, basio lou henia, basio abia. Idau tauna eiava ihareha eiava vabu ese baine abia. Unu boma kara toma, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine hanamomu, oi imamu ḡaukaradia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

motu: Emu olive audia huahuadia ba hamorudia negana ai, au rigidia na basio kwadidia nega harua. Orena na idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu ese bae abi.
english: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

motu: Emu vine imeana ai danu vine ba pada negana ai, tano ai bae moru ḡaudia na basio gogodia; idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu ese bae gogo.
english: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

motu: Ba laloa tao, oi na hesiai iḡuidia ai o nohova Aigupto ai; badina bunai lau ese ini na haḡanimu toma.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

motu: Taunimanima bae heai, bena hahemaoro gabuna baela, hahemaoro taudia ese bae hahemaoro henidia; asi ena kerere tauna na bae kahua nege, bona kerere tauna na ena dika davana bae henia.
english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

motu: Kerere tauna davana bema hedadaba, hahemaoro tauna baine hahedua, bena ia vairanai; kerere tauna bae hagorua diho bona bae kwadia, nega hidaosi, ena kerere metauna heḡereḡerena.
english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

motu: Bae kwadia diba ela bona nega hari-ahui, a hari-ahui basie hanai, bae kwadia momo ela bona bae hadikaiana garina.
english: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

motu: Boromakau ese uit e moimoilaiamu negana ai na uduna basio ḡuia.
english: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.

motu: Tadikaka bae noho hebou, bena ta baine mase asi natuna, vabu na idau tauna ta basine adavaia. Ihana na ia dekenai baine raka vareai, baine adavaia; vabu ihana ena kara korikori baine karaia.
english: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

motu: Bena natudia roboana na mase tauna dihina ai bainela, unu amo ia ladana basine boio Israel ai.
english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

motu: A ihana na iabina basinema ura, hari vabu na hanua tau-badadia dekediabainela, hanua ikoukouna ai; baineto “Ihagu na se uramu tadikakana dihina baine havaraia Israel ai; vabu ihana ena kara ikarana ai e gwau edeedemu”,
english: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

motu: Bena hanua tau-badadia ese una tau bae boiria, bae hereva henia. Benaena hereva bema ha-aukaia, bema toma “Lau na iabina asina uramu”,
english: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

motu: vabuna baine raka kahira, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai una tau ena tamaka na aena amo baine veria oho, bona vairana baine kanudia, baineto “Tadikakana garana basine havaradia tauna na ene baine heto”.
english: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

motu: Bena una tau ena ruma na Israel ai ladana bae hatoa “Tamaka veri-oho tauna ena ruma”.
english: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

motu: Tatau rarua bae heatu, bena idia ta adavana baine raka kahira, adavana na e heatu heniamu tauna imana amo baine hamauria totona, bena imana baine toia roro, una tau na usina eiava abona amo baine abia,
english: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

motu: una hahine na imana ba utui oho; basio bogaia hisi.
english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

motu: Emu moda ai metau hahetoho ḡaudia rua, momokanina bona koikoina, ruaosi basio uda hebou.
english: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

motu: Emu ruma ai danu efa + 25:14 “Efa” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta flaoa e hahetohoa ḡauna. * rua, momokanina bona koikoina, basie mia.
english: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

motu: Emu metau hahetoho ḡauna baine maoromaoro, bona emu efa baine maoromaoro; bena emu mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova, emu Dirava, baine henimu tanona ai.
english: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

motu: Badina be kara koikoidia unuhetomadia e karamu taudia na Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e dadaraidiamu.
english: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

motu: Ba laloa tao, Amalek ese ede e karamui toma, Aigupto amo o raka Iasi negana ai.
english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

motu: Dala ai e davarimui, taumui e boerava bona e manoriva negana ai, bena e manokava dainai murimui ai e raka heveriveriva taudia na e aladia mase; ia na Dirava garina se gariva.
english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese inaimui iboudiai bogaragidiai laḡa-ani baine henimui, Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai. Una negana ai Amalek ilalolaina ba rohoa oho, guba henunai. Basio laloa boio.
english: Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine henimu emu tano ai ba halaoa tanona bavabia bona ba noholaia negana ai,
english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

motu: tano anina roboana, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine henimu tanona ai baine vara ḡauna, kahana bavabia, bosea ai ba udaia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine abia hidi bona ladana baine hahenemailaia gabuna baola.
english: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa karadia una dina ai e karamu tauna dekena baola.l, baoto “Hari dina ai na gwauraia hedinaraimu, lau na Iehova ese seneda e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ani vada na kau”.
english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna ese bosea oi imamu amo baine abia, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana vairanai baine atoa diho.
english: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God’s altar.

motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai ba hereva, ini ba gwau toma: Senegu na tau Aram, laolao tauna; ia na Aigupto ela, taunimanima kwabu-kwabudiaida, unuseni ai ia ese bese badana bona goadana e havaraia; garana na hutuma.
english: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father + 26:5 or, forefather * was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

motu: Aigupto taudia ese e daḡedaḡe henimai, e hahisimai, maduna metaudia na paḡamai ai e atodia.
english: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

motu: Bena Iehova, senemai edia Dirava, a tai henia; bena Iehova ese gadomai e kamonai, bona emai hisihisi bona emai hekwarahi bona emai maduna e haḡeredia.
english: Then we cried to Yahweh, the God of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

motu: Bena Iehova ese imana e toia roro, mai siahuna ida, Aigupto amo e hakaumai lasi, mai hahegari karadia bona toa idau-idau bona hoa karadia ida;
english: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

motu: e hakaumai ema bona ina gabu ai, bona ina tano vada e henimai, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona.
english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

motu: Taunabunai lau vada nama, oi Iehova vada o henigu tanona anina roboana vada na mailaia. Unu ba hereva toma; bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai bosea na bavatoa diho. Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai ba toma diho.
english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God, and worship before Yahweh your God.

motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese oi bona emu ruma taudia vada e hanamolaimui ḡaudia na ba moalelai: Levi tauna bona dekemu ai e noho hedoamu tauna ida ba moale hebou.
english: You shall rejoice in all the good which Yahweh your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

motu: Laḡani ihatoina ai, emu uma anidia ba karoadia negana ai, karoa ihagwautana amo Levi tauna bona idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu ba harihari henidia, emu hanua lalonai bae aniani, bogadia bae kunu.
english: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

motu: Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, vairanai ba hereva, baoto: Ḡau helaḡadia iboudiai egu ruma amo vada na abidia lasi, Levi tauna bona idau tauna bona ihareha bona vabu vada na harihari henidia, emu haheḡani heḡereḡerena. Emu haheḡani ta asina tataia utu, bona ta asina laloa boio.
english: You shall say before Yahweh your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

motu: Hari karoa ihagwautana taina asina ania, mase na tailaia negana ai; bona taina asina abia, na taubu negana ai; bona mase latanai e helaḡalaimu karadia e kara tauna na taina asina henia. Iehova, egu Dirava, erena vada na kamonai, bona o haḡanigu karadia iboudiai na kara.
english: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to Yahweh my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

motu: Guba ai emu noho gabuna helaḡana amo ba roha dobi, emu bese Israel ba hanamoa, ina vada o henimai tanona, senemai o gwaurai henidia hamata tanona, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, danu ba hanamoa.
english: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

motu: Hari dina ai Iehova ese e haḡanimuimu, ini taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia iboudiai ba badinadia; taunabunai ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai.
english: Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

motu: Hari dina ai vada o gwau hamatamu, o tomu, Iehova na emui Dirava; iena dala ai ba raka, ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani bona ena hahemaoro herevadia ba badinadia, bona ia erena ba kamonai.
english: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.

motu: Hari dina ai danu Iehova vada e gwau hamatamu, e tomu, umui na ena bese korikori, ena gwau-hamata heḡereḡerena. Mae tomu, ena haheḡani iboudiai ba badinadia;
english: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

motu: bena ia ese baine abimui isi, e karadia besedia iboudiai daediai, imodaimui ai bona harimui ai bona imatauraimui ai; Iehova, emui Dirava, ena bese helaḡana ai baola, iena hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.

motu: Bena Mose bona Israel tau-badadia ese Israel taudia e haḡanidia, eto: Hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia ba badinadia.
english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

motu: Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona ai ba raka vareai, dinana ai, huro nadidia badadia ba hagini, bona taba-taba ḡaunaamo bae tabaia ahu.
english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

motu: Ina taravatu herevadia iboudiai na latadiai ba tore, ba hanai negana ai. Unu amo Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine henimui tanona bavabia, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, Iehova, senemuiedia Dirava, ese vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

motu: Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, bena hari na haḡanilaimuimu nadidia ba haginidia, Ebal ororona ai; bena taba-taba ḡauna amo ba tabaia ahu.
english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

motu: Bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana nadi amo ba larebaia unuseni ai; auri amo asie utudia nadidia.
english: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

motu: Asie utu nadidia amo Iehova, emui Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana ba larebaia; bena una pata latanai ḡole-oho bouboudiaba hahelaḡadia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena.
english: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.

motu: Herohemaino bouboudia danu ba hahelaḡadia. Unuseni ai danu bavaniani bona ba moale hebou, Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai.
english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.

motu: Huro nadidia ai ina taravatu herevadia iboudiai ba tore hedinarai.
english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

motu: Bena Mose bona hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo ese Israel taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto: Israel taumui e, eremui. A hakala. Hari dina ai umui na Iehova, emui Dirava, ena bese ai vada ola.
english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona ba kamonai; ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu hari ina dina ai na henimuimu vada ba badinadia.
english: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

motu: Una dina ai danu Mose ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto:
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

motu: Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, bena ini na Gerisim ororona ai bae gini, taunimanima bae hanamodia: Simeon bona Levi bona Iuda bona Isakara bona Iosef bona Beniamina.
english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

motu: Ma iduhu ikwaradia bini Ebal ororona ai bae gini, heuduguirai herevadia bae gwaurai: Ruben bona Gad bona Asere bona Sebulun bona Dan bona Napatali.
english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

motu: Bena Levi taudia na bae hereva badabada, Israel taudia iboudiai bae hamaorodia, baeto:
english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

motu: Laulau ta au amo eiava nadi amo eiava auri amo e koroamu tauna na.bae uduguiraia. Unuhetomana, taunimanima imadia amo e karaiamu bona gabu hehunina ai e haginiamu, be Iehova ese e dadaraiamu. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai bae haere, baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H3068" * answer|strong="H6030" * and|strong="H3068" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Tamana bona sinana se matauraidiamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Dekena tauna ena tano hetoana e raḡaiamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Matakepulu tauna e koiamu, dala amo e hakaua sirimu, tauna bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Idau tauna enai eiava ihareha enai eiava vabu enai hahemaoro e hagagevaiamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Tamana adavana ida e eno boumu tauna na bae uduguiraia, badina be ia ese tamana vada e haida hahemaraia. (Bena taunimanima; iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with + 27:20 i.e., has sexual relations with * his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Mauri ḡauna idauna ta ida e eno boumu tauna a na bae uduguirai. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Taihuna, tamana natuna eiava sinana natuna, ida e eno boumu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Rava bada hahinena ida e eno boumu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Dekena tauna e alaia mase hehunimu tauna na bae uduguriaia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Dava e abiamu, asi ena kerere tauna baine alaia mase totona, tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say, ‘Amen.’

motu: Ini taravatu herevadia se abi daemu bona se badinamu tauna na bae uduguiraia. (Bena taunimanima iboudiai baeto “Amen”.)
english: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * shall|strong="H5971" * say|strong="H1697" *, ‘Amen.’”

motu: Benaini, Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, bona ena haheḡani iboudiai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimui na boma badinadia namonamo bona karadia boma kara, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine abimui isi, tanobada besedia iboudiai daediai.
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

motu: Oibe, Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, ini hahenamo iboudiai na latamui ai bae diho bona dekemui ai bae kau.
english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

motu: Hanua lalonai vada ba namo, bona taruha ai ba namo.
english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

motu: Taumui anidia bae namo, bona emui tano anidia bae namo. Emui mauri ḡaudia anidia bae namo, bona emui seri bae hutuma; emui mamoe natudia bae mauri.
english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

motu: Emui bosea bae namo, bona emui dihu bae namo.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

motu: Emui raka vareai baine namo, bona emui raka lasi baine namo.
english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

motu: Inaimui bae tuari henimui negadia ai Iehova ese baine hadareredia; dala tamona ai bae mai henimui, a dala hitu amo vairamui ai bae heau.
english: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

motu: Iehova ese emui roge baine hanamodia, bona imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai baine hanamodia. Iehova, emui Dirava, baine henimui tanona ai ia ese baine hanamomui.
english: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani boma badinadia, bona ena dala ai boma raka, Iehova ese baine hahelaḡamui, iena bese ai baine halaomui, vada e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.

motu: Bena tanobada taudia iboudiai ese bae itaia, Iehova ese ia ladana e hanemailaimui; bena idia na garimui bae gari.
english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

motu: Iehova ese baine hataḡamui, ḡau namodia iboudiai: taumui anidia, bona emui seri anidia, bona emui tano anidia; Iehova ese senemui e gwau henidia hamata baine henimui eto tanona ai.
english: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.

motu: Iehova ese ena guba kohuna namona baine keho henimui, medu na emui tano ai baine hadihoa, ena nega korikori ai, bona imamui ḡaukaradia iboudiai baine hanamodia. Bese momo ba henidia torehai, a ediai basio abi torehai.
english: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

motu: Iehova ese kwara ai baine halaomui, iu ai basiola. Atai ai mo baola; henu amo basiola. Iehova, emui Dirava, ena haheḡani hari dina ai na henimuimu na boma badinadia namonamo bona karadia boma kara,
english: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

motu: hari dina ai na henimuimu haheḡanidia amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana amo eiava lauri kahana amo bona dirava idaudia basio lao henidia bona isiaidia basio lao heni, bona ia ese unu baine karamui toma.
english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, erena basioma kamonai, bona ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu iboudiai hari dina ai na haḡanilaimuimu na basioma badinadia namonamo bona karadia basioma kara, ini uduguirai anidia iboudiai na latamui ai bae diho, bona dekemui ai bae kau.
english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

motu: Hanua lalonai vada ba dika, bona taruha ai ba dika.
english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

motu: Emui bosea bae dika, bona emui dihu bae dika.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

motu: Taumui anidia bae dika, bona emui tano anidia bae dika; emui seri basie hutuma, bona emui mamoe natudia basie mauri.
english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

motu: Emui raka vareai bona emui raka Iasi do bae dika.
english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

motu: Iehova ese heuduguirai bona daradara bona lalo-hesiku latamui aibaine siaia, emui ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, ela bona ba dika vaitani bona ba mase haraḡa; badina be emui kara havara ai vada o rakatanigu.
english: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

motu: Iehova ese gorere metaudia amo baine hahisimui, ela bona o lao heniamu emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona ai ba mase ore.
english: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

motu: Iehova ese tau-varoda, bonakeru, bona ḡoudae-ḡoudae, bona siahu, bona doe, bona gesegese, bonavalavala, amo baine hahisimui; bae hahisimui ela bona ba mase.
english: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

motu: Guba na kwaramui daediai auri labora-labora heḡereḡerena ai bainela; tanobadana aemui henudiai auri heḡereḡerena ai bainela.
english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

motu: Ḡahu na emui tano ai baine diho medu na heto; guba amo baine diho latamui ai, ela bona ba mase ore.
english: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

motu: Iehova ese baine hadareremui, inaimui vairadiai. Dala tamona ai ba raka lasi, ba tuari henidia; dala hitu amo vairadiai ba heau. Tanobada basileiadia iboudiai ese bae dadaraimui.
english: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

motu: Masemui ai atai manudia iboudiai bona tanobada boromadia ese hidiomui bae ani; tau ta basine luludia oho.
english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

motu: Iehova ese Aigupto iohururudia bona toto dikadia amo baine hahisihisimui. Udumui bae totototo, bona kopimui bae kuhikuhi; basio namo diba.
english: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

motu: Iehova ese baine hakavamui, bona matamui baine hakepuludia, bona lalomui baine hadaradaradia.
english: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

motu: Dina tubua ai ba hedarahu, matakepulu tauna ese dibura ai e hedarahumu na heto. Emui ḡaukara ta anina basine vara. Taunimanima ese bae daḡedaḡe henimui, bona emui amo bae dadidadi, dina iboudiai tau ta ese basine hamaurimui.
english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

motu: Hahine ta bavadavaia, to idau tauna ese baine eno henia. Ruma auta ba haginia, to basio noholaia. Vine imeana ba hadoa, to anina basio abia.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

motu: Emu boromakau na vairamu ai bae alaia, to oi na hidiona taina basio ania. Emu doniki na vairamu ai bae dadia, basie henimu lou. Emu mamoe na inaimu bae henidia, tau ta basine durumu.
english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

motu: Natumu mamaruanedia bona natumu hahinedia na idau bese taudia bae henidia; matamu amo ba raraidia, bona iruru-matamu bae diho, to irudia na imamu basie goada.
english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

motu: Do asi dibamu besena ese emu tano anina bona imamu amo ba kara ḡaudia, iboudiai bae dadihai; bae daḡedaḡe henimu bona bae hahisimu dina iboudiai lalodiai,
english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

motu: ela bona matamu bae ita ḡaudia ese do bae hakavamu.
english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

motu: Iehova ese iohururu amo baine hahisimu, tuimu ai bona aemu ai, bona aemu palapaladia amo ela bona kwaramu tubuana; muramura ta ese baine.basine hamaurimu, diba.
english: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

motu: Umui, bona ikwaramui; ai ba halaoa pavapavana, na Iehova ese baine kahumui nege, umui asi dibamui bona senemui asi dibadia besena bogaraginai ba noho; unuseni ai dirava idaudia, au amo bona nadi amo e karadiamu diravadia, isiaidia ba lao heni.
english: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

motu: Umui na hahegari ḡauna ai bona hereva lada-isina ai bona udu gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai baola, Iehova ese bogaragidiai bae kahumui nege besena taudia ediai.
english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.

motu: Uhe momo ba hado, a anidia ba gogo bae maraḡi: badina be kwadi ese bae ha-ore.
english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

motu: Vine audia bahado bona ba reḡu, a vine basio gogo bona vine ranuna basio inua; gaigai-gaigai ese bae ani ore.
english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

motu: Olive audia na bae vara emui tano idoinai, a olive dehorona basio hedahulai; badina be emui olive huahuadia bae ruru nege.
english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

motu: Natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia bae vara, to dekemui ai basie noho; mai iḡuidia bae hakaudia lao.
english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

motu: Emui au iboudiai bona emui uma anidia na kwadi ese bae ani.
english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

motu: Bogaragimui ai e noho hedoamu tauna na atai ai bainela; umui be henu amo baola.
english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

motu: Ia ese baine henimui torehai; emui ai basine abi torehai. Ia na kwara ai bainela; umui na iu ai baola.
english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

motu: Ini hahedika iboudiai na latamui ai bae diho; bae ḡavamui bona emui ai do bae kau, ela bona ba mase ore. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, erena asio kamonai, bona ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu asio badinadia.
english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

motu: Idia na toa ai bona hoa ḡaudia ai baela, umui emui ai bona garamui ediai, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

motu: Iehova emui Dirava isiaina ilao-henina asio moalelaia bona ḡau momoemui ai mimia daidiai asio moale henia;
english: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

motu: una dainai inaimui na Iehova ese baine siaidia, bae tuari henimui totona. Isiaidia do ba lao heni, mai hitolomui bona mai ranu-masemui ida; dabua ai ba dabu, ḡau iboudiai badabu; auri gadeadia na aiomui ai bae ato; ela bona bae alamui ore.
english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

motu: Iehova ese bese ta dauha amo baine mailaia, tanobada dokona amo. Ugava e rohomu heḡereḡerena baema, umui bae tuari henimui. Una bese na edia gado asi dibamui;
english: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

motu: vaira-hua taudia, iahu basie matauraidia bona memero basie bogadia hisi.
english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

motu: Idia ese emui boromakau natudia bona emui tano anidia bae ani ore, ela bona umui na ba mase ore; emui uit bona emui vine ranuna bona emui dehoro sisina taina basie rakatania; emui boromakau natudia bona emui mamoe natudia danu ta basie rakatania, ela bona umui na ba mase ore.
english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

motu: Emui hanua na edia tuari oreadia ese bae koudia ahu, ela bona emui maḡu badadia, o abidadama henidiamu ḡaudia, na bae heḡiḡi dobi, emui tano idiodia. Edia tuari oreadia ese emui hanua bae koudia hegege, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui tanona idoinai.
english: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God has given you.

motu: Taumui anidia amo e vara hidiodia, natumui mamaruanedia bona natumui hahinedia Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui hidiodia, bavani, inaimui bae koumui ahu bona bae hadabumui dainai.
english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

motu: Bogaragimui ai readia tau ta tau-anina manada-manada bona aniani inonoḡadia mo e animu; to ena karabaine auka bona baine daḡedaḡe, tadikakana enai bona adavana enai bona natuna hahidaosi dounu mauridia ediai.
english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

motu: Bena natuna vada e mase hidiodia e animu na taidia basine henidia, badina be ena hitolo baine bada herea, emui hanua iboudiai lalodiai inaimui ese baine koumui ahu bona baine hadabumui dainai.
english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

motu: Eiava bogaragimui ai readia hahine ta tau-anina manada-manada bona aniani inonoḡadia mo e animu, aena danu taina se hamareremu, badina be ia na aboni-noho hahinena; to ena kara baine auka, adavana enai bona natuna maruanena enai bona natuna hahinena enai.
english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

motu: Bena momo aena padadia amo e lasimu bona natuna bogana amo e varamu na baine anidia hehuni, badina be ena hitolo baine bada herea, emui hanua lalodiai inaimui ese baine koumui ahu bona baine hadabumui dainai.
english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

motu: Ina buka ai e tore taravatudia iboudiai basioma badinadia bona karadia basioma kara, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ladana ḡoeva-daena bona herea-daena basioma matauraia,
english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hahisimui bona garamui baine hahisidia, hisihisi metaudia, bae hesiriu daudau hisihisidia, bona gorere metaudia, bae hesiriu daudau goreredia, amo baine hahisimui.
english: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

motu: Ia ese Aigupto goreredia iboudiai, o garilaidiamu ḡaudia, latamui ai baine hadihodia, bae gugubamui.
english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

motu: Bona ina taravatu bukana ai asie tore goreredia bona hisihisidia iboudiai Iehova ese baine hadihodia latamui ai, ela bona ba mase ore.
english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

motu: Vada o hutuma, guba hisiudia na heheto, a do ba gadoi; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona asio kamonai.
english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

motu: Iehova na ihanamomui bona ihahutumamui vada e moalelai; to ia na ihadikamui bona ihamasemui do baine moalelai; ba raka vareai emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona amo baine butumui tao.
english: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

motu: Iehova ese baine hakarohomui rohoroho, bese idau-idauiboudiai bogaragidiai, tanobada dokona amo ela bona tanobada dokona. Unuseni ai dirava idaudia, umui asi dibamui bona senemui asi dibadia diravadia, au bona nadi amo e karadia diravadia, isiaidia ba lao heni.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

motu: Unu bese bogaragidiai basio noho namonamo, bona aemui basie laḡa ani. Iehova ese kudoumui baine hahetahadia, bona matamui baine hakepuludia, bona laumamui baine hadauredia.
english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

motu: Emui mauri dainai ba daradara: dina ai bona hanuaboi ai kudoumui bae hetaha, ba mauri eiava lasi.
english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

motu: Daba ai baoto “Hanua bema boi”. Hanuaboi ai baoto “Daba bema rere”. Lalomui bae garilai ḡaudia bona matamui bae ita ḡaudia daidiai unu ba hereva toma.
english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

motu: Iehova ese lagatoi ai baine laohaimui, Aigupto ba lou henia; na hamaorolaimui nato “Basio itaia lou” dalana amo ma ba lou. Unuseni ai sibomui ba hehoi toho, inaimui edia hesiai taudia bona edia hesiai hahinedia ai baola totona; a tau ta ese basine hoimui.
english: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

motu: Taravatu herevadia bini, Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia Moab tanona ai, Israel taudia ma baine haḡanilaidia totona; ini hereva na Horeb ai e henidia taravatudia latadiai e ato kau.
english: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
