motu: Mose ese Israel taudia iboudiai e boiridia, e hamaorodia, eto: Iehova ese Aigupto tanona ai umui vairamui ai e kara karadia na o itadia, Farao mai ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ida bona ena tano i (idoinai ede e karadia toma.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your|strong="H7200" * eyes|strong="H5869" * have|strong="H5869" * seen|strong="H7200" * all|strong="H7200" * that|strong="H7200" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * did|strong="H5869" * in|strong="H1419" * the|strong="H7200" * land of|strong="H5869" * Egypt to|strong="H7200" * Pharaoh, and|strong="H1419" * to|strong="H7200" * all|strong="H7200" * his|strong="H7200" * servants, and|strong="H1419" * to|strong="H7200" * all|strong="H7200" * his|strong="H7200" * land;

motu: Hedibaḡani badadia bona toa bona hoa karadia na matamui ese e itadia;
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

motu: a Iehova ese lalo-parara bona mata-itaita bona taia-kamonai nado se henimui ema bona hari dina.
english: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

motu: Laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai vada nahakaumui tano ḡaḡaena ai; emui dabua na asie dika taumui ai, bona emui tamaka na asie dika aemui ai.
english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

motu: Flaoa asio ania; vine ranuna eiava kekero muramurana ta asio inua. Taunabunai, vada o diba, lau na Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.

motu: Ina gabu oma negana ai, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, bona Og, Basan pavapavana, e raka lasi, e tuari henida. Bena ita ese ta hadareredia,
english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

motu: edia tano ta abia, Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhu kahana taudia ta henidia, edia tano ai bae halaoa totona.
english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

motu: Taunabunai, ini taravatu herevadia ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara, emui ḡaukara iboudiai anidia bae vara helaoreana.
english: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

motu: Hari dina ai umui na iboumui ai Iehova, emui Dirava, vairanai gigini: iduhu ikwaradia taumui, iduhu tau-badadia, heitatao taumui, bona Israel taumui iboumui ai;
english: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

motu: bona natumui, bona adavamui, bona idau bese taudia emui taruha ai e noho hedoamu, bona emui au-siri bona emui ranu-ututaudia.
english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

motu: Hari dina ai Iehova emui Dirava, ida ba herohemaino, bona ia ida ba hegwau-hamata heheni totona vada oma.
english: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,

motu: Iena bese taudiaai baine halaomui hari ina dina ai, bona emui Dirava ai bainela, e gwau henimui hamata bona senemui Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

motu: Dia umui sibomui ida ina herohemaino bona ina hegwau-hamata heheni asina karamu,
english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

motu: a ita ida Iehova, eda Dirava, vairanai e heboumu taudia iboudiai ida, bona ma hebou asiema taudia ida danu.
english: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

motu: Umui dibamui, ani, Aigupto tanona ai ede ta noho tomava, bona dala ai bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo ede ta raka hanai tomava.
english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

motu: Ediakara havara danu vada o itaia; edia kaivakuku danu, au bona nadi bona silver * bona gold * amo e karadia, vada o itadia.
english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, bogaragimui ai tau ta eiava hahine ta eiava doḡoro ta eiava iduhu ta ese hari dina ai Iehova, eda Dirava, bae dadaraia bona unu bese edia dirava isiaidia bae lao heni na garina; eiava bogaragimui ai mase huahuana ta ramuna eiava huahua iditana ta ranuna baine mia na garina.
english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

motu: Readia unuhetomana ta ese ini gwau-hamata herevadia ikamonaina ai sibona baine hahemarumaru, baineto “Ena be na rakamu mai lalogu aukana ida, to vada baina namo”; bena unu amo pariparina bona kaukauna bae dika bou.
english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

motu: A Iehova ese basine bogaia hisi. Iehova ena badu bona ena vaḡege bae siahu ḡaraḡara una tau latanai; bena heuduguirai ina buka ai e hetore na ia latanai bae kau, bona Iehova ese ia ladana baine rohoa, guba henunai baine boio.
english: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.

motu: Iehova ese Israel iduhudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo baine abia siri, bona baine hadikaia, heuduguirai herevadia iboudiai vada e gwaurai hamata bona ina taravatu bukana lalonai vada e tore heḡereḡeredia.
english: Yahweh will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

motu: Uru gabedia ai, umui garamui bona dauha amo ena laolao ai bainema tauna ese una tano ena dika bona ena gorere Iehova ese baine hahisilaia na bae itaia;
english: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which Yahweh has made it sick,

motu: bae itaia danu tano idoinai na teio + 29:23 “Teio” na nadi ta ladana; lahi ai e aramu negana ai, bonana dikana e daemu. Ladana English gado ai be “sulphur”. * bona damena ese vada e hadikaia, tano ḡaḡaena; ai vada e halaoa; ḡau ta asie hadoamu, ḡau ta se tubumu, rei danu se varamu, e dika vaitanimu Sodoma bona Gomora bona Adma bona Seboimi na heheto, Iehova ese ena badu ḡaraḡarana ai e habuadia tari hanuadia.
english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

motu: Oibe, idia bona bese iboudiai baeto “Badina be dahaka Iehova ese ina tano na ini e karaia toma? Ina badu ḡaraḡarana anina be dahaka?”
english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

motu: Bena taunimanima baeto “Badina be idia ese Iehova, senedia edia Dirava, ena taravatu, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaudia lasi negana ai e henidia taravatuna, e laloa nege,
english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

motu: dirava idaudia isiaidia e lao heni bona e toma henidia diho, asi dibadia bona ia ese se henidia diravadia.
english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

motu: Una dainai Iehova ena badu vada e siahu ina tano enai bona heuduguirai idoinai ina buka ai e hetore na anina e havaraia;
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

motu: edia tano amo e raḡadia oho, ena badu siahuna ai, bona e luludia lasi idau tano ai bae noho, hari ina dina ai e nohomu heḡereḡerena.”
english: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

motu: Ḡau hehunidia na Iehova, eda Dirava, ena; to hedinarai ḡaudia na ita eda bona ita garada edia ela bona hanaihanai, ini taravatu herevadia iboudiai baita badinadia helaoreana.
english: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

motu: Ini hahenamo bona heuduguirai herevadia vada na gwaurai henimui na anidia iboudiai do bae vara vaitani negana ai umui do ba helalo. Iehova, emui Dirava, ese bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baine hakarohomui rohoroho gabudia ai.
english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where Yahweh your God has driven you,

motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lou henia, ia erena ba kamonai, ena haheḡani iboudiai hari ina dina ai vada na gwaurai henimui na ba badinadia, umui bona natumui danu, mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai.
english: and return to Yahweh your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hamaurimui, baine bogamui hisi; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese bese idau-idau bogaragidiaie hakarohomui rohoroho gabudia amo ma baine haheboumui lou.
english: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.

motu: Ena be taunimanima haida be guba dokona henuna ai e nohomu, to ia ese unu amo baine haheboumui bona unu amo baine hakaumui mai.
english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese senemui edia tano ai ma baine hakaumui vareai; bavabia, emui tano. Ia ese baine hanamomui bona baine hahutumamui, ela bona senemui edia hutuma ba hereaia.
english: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui lalomui bona garamui lalodia baine hahelaḡadia; bena ba lalokau henia mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai; bena vada ba mauri.
english: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ini heuduguirai iboudiai na inaimui latadiai bona e badu henimui, e daḡedaḡe henimui, taudia latadiai baine gwaurai.
english: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

motu: A umui na Iehova erena ma ba kamonai, bona ena haheḡani iboudiai, hari ina dina ai na haḡanilaimui, ḡaudia, na ba badinadia.
english: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

motu: Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui; imamui ḡaukaradia anidia baine habada, bona garamui baine hahutumadia, bona emui seri baine hahohodia, bona emui taboro baine habada.
english: Yahweh your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, erena boma kamonai, ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu, ina taravatu bukana ai vada e hetore ḡaudia, na boma badinadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, boma lou henia mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai ida, ia ese unu baine karamui toma.
english: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

motu: Badina be hari ina dina ai na haḡanilaimui haheḡanina na dia auka herea bona dia daudau herea.
english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

motu: Ḡauna na dia guba ai; ta basioto “Daika ita daidai baine dae guba ai, baine mailaia edai, bena baita kamonaia bona karana baita karaia?”
english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

motu: Ḡauna na dia davara unukahana ai; ta basioto “Daika ita daidai bainela davara unukahana ai, baine mailaia edai, bena baita kamonaia bona karana baita karaia?”
english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

motu: A ḡauna na badibadimu ai, bona udumu ai, bona lalomu ai, karana ba karaia totona.
english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

motu: 0 itaia, hari ina dina ai mauri bona namo, bona mase bona dika, vairamui ai vada na atodia.
english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

motu: Hari ina dina ai vada na haḡanimuimu, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia, ena dala ai ba raka, bona ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu bona ena hahemaoro herevadia ba badinadia; unu amo ba mauri, bona ba hutuma, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine hanamomui, ba raka vareai bona emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai.
english: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

motu: A lalomui bema auka bona taiamui bema kudima, bena haida muridia amo baola, dirava idaudia ba toma henidia diho bona isiaidia ba lao heni,
english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

motu: lau ese hari dina ai na hamaoromui gunamu, vada ba mase; Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, unukahai tano ta bavabia emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai emui mauri dinadia basie hoho.
english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

motu: Guba bona tanobada na boi henidiamu, lau na habadelaimuimu herevadia na hari dina ai idia ese bae hamomokani: lau na mauri bona mase, bona hahenamo bona heuduguirai, na vairamui ai vada na atodia. Taunabunai, mauri bavabia hidi; bena umui ba mauri, bona garamui bae mauri;
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

motu: bena Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia, bona erena ba kamonai, bona ba badinaia tarika-tarika. Badina be ia na emui mauri, bona ia bagunai emui mauri dinadia bae hoho, Iehova ese senemui, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob, e gwaurai henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona ai do ba noho.
english: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

motu: Mose ese ini hereva iboudiai na Israel taudia e hamaorolaidia.
english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

motu: Bena ia ese ma e hereva henidia, eto, Hari dina ai lauegu mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta ruahui. Asi goadagu baina raka Iasi bona baina raka vareai; bona Iehova ese vada e hamaorogu, eto “Oi na ina Ioridane sinavaina basio hanaia”.
english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na umui vairamui ai baine hanai; ia ese unu bese na umui vairamui ai baine habuadia tari, bena edia tano bavabia, emui tano ai ba halaoa. Iosua ese baine gunalaimui, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

motu: Iehova ese baine habuadia tari, Sihon bona Og, Amoro taudia edia pavapava, e habuadia tari bona edia tano e habuaia tari heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

motu: Iehova ese umui imamui ai baine atodia, bena vada na haḡanilaimui haheḡanidia heḡereḡeredia ba kara henidia.
english: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

motu: Ba goada, lalomui ba ha-aukadia, idia garidia basio gari; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine bamomui. Ia ese basine lalomui rea, bona basine rakatanimui.
english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

motu: Bena Mose ese Iosua e boiria, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai e hereva henia, eto, Ba goada, lalomu ba ha-aukaia; ina orea ida ba raka vareai, Iehova ese seneda e gwaurai henidia hamata baine henidia eto tanona ai. Tano na ba henidia, edia tano ai bainela.
english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which Yahweh has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

motu: Iehova na oi vairamu ai bainela; ia ese baine bamomu. Ia ese basine lalomu rea, bona basine rakatanimu. Basio gari; kudoumu basine hetaha.
english: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

motu: Mose ese ina taravatu idoinai e torea, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi natuna, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaiava taudia, bona Israel tau-badadia iboudiai, e henidia.
english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

motu: Mose ese e haḡanidia, eto, Laḡani ihahitudia dokodia ai, heruha-nege laḡanina ena nega helaḡana ai, kalaga ariana dainai
english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

motu: Israel taudia ese Iehova, emui Dirava, ena abi-hidi gabuna ai ia vairanai bae hebounegana ai, ina taravatu ba duahia hedinarai Israel taudia vairadiai, ibouboudiai vada bae kamonai.
english: when all Israel has come to appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai ba haboudia: tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, bona idau taudia emui hanua ai e noho hedoamu danu. Bena bae kamonai, lalodia bae parara, Iehova, emui Dirava, garina bae gari, bona ina taravatu ena hereva iboudiai bae badinadia, bona karadia bae kara.
english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear Yahweh your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

motu: Natudia danu do asi dibadia, vada bae kamonai bona bae diba; bena Iehova, emui Dirava, garina bae gari, Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia murinai emui tano ai ba halaoa tanona lalonai ba noho dinadia iboudiai.
english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

motu: Iehova ese :Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: dina na vada eme kahikahi oi vada ba mase. Iosua a boiria, raruosi na hebou kalagana lalonai ba raka vareai, unuseni ai lau ese baina haḡania. Bena Mose bona Iosua na ela, hebou kalagana lalonai e raka vareai.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses|strong="H4872" * and|strong="H4872" * Joshua|strong="H3091" * went|strong="H3212" *, and|strong="H4872" * presented|strong="H7126" * themselves|strong="H3320" * in|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3068" * Tent of|strong="H3068" * Meeting|strong="H4150" *.

motu: Bena Iehova na kalaga ai e hahedinarai henidia, ori dubuna ai. Hari ori dubuna na kalaga iduarana badinai e hedinarai.
english: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: oi na tubu tama dekediai ba mahuta. Bena ina bese taudia bae tore isi, dirava idaudia, bae lao henia tanona taudia edia dirava, bae toma henidia diho, lau bae rakatanigu, bona egu taravatu vada na henidia be bae tataia utu.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

motu: Una dina ai egu badu baine siahu ediai; baina rakatanidia, vairagu na edia amo baina hunia; bena bae hebua tari, dika momo bona hekwarahi momo ediai bae kau. Bena una dina ai idia baeto “Ina dika na latadai vada e kau badina be eda Dirava na bogaragidai se nohomu ani?”
english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

motu: Momokani, una dina ai lau ese vairagu baina hunia, edia kara dika bona dirava idaudia vada e lao henidia daidiai.
english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

motu: Taunabunai, ina ane ba torea bona Israel taudia ba hadibalaidia. Ududia ai bavatoa: ina ane ese Israel taudia baine habadelaidia lau vairagu ai.
english: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

motu: Badina be senemui na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai baina hakaudia vareai, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona; unuseni ai bae aniani, bogadiabae hakunu, taudia bae bada. Una negana ai idia ese dirava idaudia bae tahudia, bona isiaidia bae lao heni, a lau bae dadaraigu, bona egu taravatu bae tataia utu.
english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

motu: Bena dika momo bona hekwarahi momo ediai bae kau negana ai, ina ane ese baine habadelaidia; badina be idia garadia ududia amo basine boio. Badina be lau dibagu lalohadai dahaka dahaka ina harihari lalodia ai e varamu, na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona ai do asina hakaudia vareai negana ai.
english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

motu: Taunabunai, Mose ese ina ane e torea una dina ai, bona ia ese Israel taudia e hadibalaidia.
english: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

motu: Iehova ese Iosua Nunu e haḡania, eto, Ba goada, lalomu ba ha-aukaia: Israel taudia do ba hakaudia vareai, lau ese vada na gwaurai henidia hamata tanona lalonai. Lau danu baina bamomu.
english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

motu: Mose ese ina taravatu ena hereva iboudiai na buka ai e tore ḡuḡuru.
english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

motu: Bena Mose ese Levi taudia, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaiava taudia, e haḡanidia, eto,
english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, saying,

motu: Ina taravatu bukana bavabia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena taravatu mauana badibadinai bavatoa; ia ese umui baine habadelaimui.
english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

motu: Badina be emui gwau-edeede bona emui daḡedaḡe be dibagu; hari dinaai, lau na doini dekemui ai na mauri nohomu ai, umui ese Iehova vada Ia gwau edeede henia; matona, baina mase murinai ede ba kara toma?
english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against Yahweh. How much more after my death?

motu: Emui iduhu tau-badadia iboudiai bona emui heitatao taudia ba haboudia, lau eseini hereva baina gwaurai henidia, bena guba bona tanobada na umui ihabadelaimui ai baina halaodia.
english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

english: About Asher he said, “Asher is|strong="H1961" * blessed|strong="H1288" * with|strong="H1961" * children|strong="H1121" *. Let|strong="H1961" * him|strong="H1288" * be|strong="H1961" * acceptable|strong="H7521" * to|strong="H1961" * his|strong="H1288" * brothers|strong="H1121" *. Let|strong="H1961" * him|strong="H1288" * dip|strong="H2881" * his|strong="H1288" * foot|strong="H7272" * in|strong="H1121" * oil|strong="H8081" *.

motu: Emu tamaka na auri bona auri labora-laborana; Emu goada na emu mauri dinadia ida bae heḡereḡere.
english: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As|strong="H3117" * your|strong="H3117" * days|strong="H3117" *, so your|strong="H3117" * strength|strong="H1679" * will|strong="H3117" * be|strong="H3117" *.

motu: Iesurunu o, Dirava na asi idaina. Ia na guba oridia ai e guimu, oi idurumu totona: Ia na guba amo e maimu, mai hairaina ida.
english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who|strong="H5828" * rides|strong="H7392" * on|strong="H7392" * the|strong="H7392" * heavens|strong="H8064" * for|strong="H8064" * your|strong="H8064" * help|strong="H5828" *, in|strong="H7392" * his|strong="H7392" * excellency|strong="H1346" * on|strong="H7392" * the|strong="H7392" * skies|strong="H7834" *.

motu: Noho-hanaihanai Diravana na emu noho gabuna; Mia-hanaihanai imadia na henumu ai. Inaimu na vairamu ai e luludia, Eto “A habuadia tari”.
english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath|strong="H8478" * are|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * everlasting|strong="H5769" * arms|strong="H2220" *. He|strong="H6440" * thrust out|strong="H1644" * the|strong="H6440" * enemy from|strong="H6440" * before|strong="H6440" * you|strong="H6440" *, and|strong="H5769" * said, ‘ Destroy|strong="H8045" *!’

motu: Taunabunai Israel na e noho namonamova, Iakob ena ranu gabuna e miava, Uit bona vine ranuna tanona ai; Oibe, hunu na guba amo baine diho ena tano ai.
english: Israel dwells in safety, the|strong="H5869" * fountain|strong="H5869" * of|strong="H5869" * Jacob|strong="H3290" * alone, In|strong="H3478" * a|strong="H3068" * land|strong="H8064" * of|strong="H5869" * grain|strong="H1715" * and|strong="H3478" * new|strong="H8492" * wine|strong="H8492" *. Yes, his|strong="H3478" * heavens|strong="H8064" * drop|strong="H6201" * down|strong="H7931" * dew|strong="H2919" *.

motu: Israel e, oi na namo. Daika na oi sisivamu? Iehova ese vada e hamauria besena; Emu hekaha kesina, Bona emu kwalimu darena. Inaimu na vairamu ai bae goru diho; Edia atai gabudia helaḡadia ba moidia tao.
english: You are happy, Israel! Who|strong="H4310" * is|strong="H3068" * like|strong="H3644" * you|strong="H5921" *, a|strong="H3068" * people|strong="H5971" * saved|strong="H3467" * by|strong="H5921" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, the|strong="H5921" * shield|strong="H4043" * of|strong="H3068" * your|strong="H3068" * help|strong="H5828" *, the|strong="H5921" * sword|strong="H2719" * of|strong="H3068" * your|strong="H3068" * excellency|strong="H1346" *? Your|strong="H3068" * enemies will|strong="H3068" * submit|strong="H3584" * themselves|strong="H5921" * to|strong="H3478" * you|strong="H5921" *. You|strong="H5921" * will|strong="H3068" * tread|strong="H1869" * on|strong="H5921" * their|strong="H3068" * high|strong="H1116" * places|strong="H1116" *.”

motu: Mose na Moab taorana amo Nebo ororona ela, e dara dae ela bona Pisga dorina, Ieriko hegaga hehenina ai. Bena Iehova ese tano idoinai e haheitalaia: Gilead tanona ela bona Dan;
english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

motu: bona Napatali tanona idoinai; bona Efraim bona Manase tanodia; bona Iuda tanona idoinai ela bona Davara Badana, Lahara kahana ai;
english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

motu: bona diho kahana; bona Ieriko kourana taoradia, pamu audia gabuna bunai, ela bona Soara.
english: and the south, + 34:3 or, Negev * and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henia, eto, Tanona bunai Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob na gwaurai henidia hamata, nato “Umui garamui baina henidia”. Harihari vada na haheitalaimu, matamu amo vada o itaia; to basio lao henia.
english: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

motu: Taunabunai Mose, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, na unuseni ai e mase, Moab tanona ai, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e guria, Moab kourana ta ai, Bete-peoro hegaga hehenina ai. A e guria gabuna na tauta asi dibana ema bona hari.
english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

motu: Mose ena mase negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na sinahu-ta ruahui; a matana se valahu-valahu, bona tauna se manoka.
english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

motu: Dina toi-ahui Israel taudia ese Mose taina e tai, Moab taoradia ai, ela bonaedia taitai bona edia lalo-hisihisi, Mose dainai, dinadia vada e ore ai.
english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

motu: Bena Iosua Nunu na aonega laumana ese e rohea; badina be Mose ese imana na ia tubuana ai vada e ato kau. Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese e kamonai henia, bona Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia haheḡanidia na idia ese e badinadia.
english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Una negana ema bona harihari, peroveta tauna ta basine hedinarai Israel ai, Mose heḡereḡerena; ia na Iehova ida e hevaira heheni bona e hahediba heheni.
english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,

motu: Toa bona hoa karadia, Iehova ese Aigupto tanona e siaia negana ai ia ese Farao bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona ena tano idoinai e kara henidia na ikaradia ai ia na asi idaina.
english: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

motu: Bona siahu karadia bona hahegari karadia, Mose ese Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai e kara, ikaradia ai ia na asi idaina.
english: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

motu: Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose e mase murinai, Iehova ese Iosua Nunu, Mose iduruna tauna, e hereva henia, eto,
english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

motu: Egu hesiai tauna Mose vada e mase; taunabunai, a tore isi, ina Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, oi bona ina bese idoinai, hari Israel taudia na henidiamu tanona ai ba raka vareai.
english: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

motu: Aemui palapaladia bae moi tao tanodia iboudiai baina henimui, Mose na gwau henia hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

motu: Tano ḡaḡaena bona ina Lebanon ororona amo ela bona sinavai badana ladana Eufrate, Hiti taudia edia tano idoinai ela bona Davara Badana dina e dihomu kahana ai na bavabia, emui tano.
english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

motu: Emu mauri dinadia iboudiai tau ta ese basine laomu ahu diba. Mose na bamoava heḡereḡerena, oi baina bamomu; lau na basina lalomu rea bona basina rakatanimu.
english: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

motu: Ba goada; ba haheauka. Badina be senedia na gwaurai henidia tanona na oi ese ina bese ba henidia, edia tano ai bainela.
english: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ba goada bona ba haheauka. Egu hesiai tauna Mose e henimu taravatuna idoinai ba badinaia bona karana ba karaia; iena amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai basiola; bena ba lao heni gabudia iboudiai emu kara anidia bae namo.
english: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

motu: Ina taravatu bukana herevadia na udumu ai bae mia; ia anina ba laloa boi, ba laloa rani. Unu amo ia lalonai e tore herevadia iboudiai ba badinadia bona karadia ba kara; bena emu raka baine namo bona emu kara anidia bae namo.
english: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

motu: Vada na haḡanimu, ani, ba goada bona ba haheauka. Basio gari, daramu basine doko; badina be Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e bamomumu, emu laolao iboudiai lalodiai.
english: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God + 1:9 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * is with you wherever you go.”

motu: Bena Iosua ese bese lohiadia e haduadia, eto,
english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

motu: Taruha amo ba raka hanai, taunimanima ba haḡanidia, baoto “Amui dala lakwana bavabia heḡaeḡae, badina be dina toi basie ore ai na ina Ioridane sinavaina ba hanaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese be henimuimu tanona ai ba raka vareai, bona bavabia emui tano.”
english: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.’”

motu: Bena Iosua ese Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia e hamaorodia, eto,
english: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

motu: Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose e haḡanilaimui herevana ba laloa tao. Ia eto “Iehova, emui Dirava, ese emui laḡa-ani gabuna baine henimui bona ina tano danu baine henimui e tomu”.
english: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.

motu: Adavamui bona natumui maraḡidia bona emui boromakau na hari Mose e henimui tanona ai bae noho, Ioridane sinavaina inikahana ai; a tuari mai dibamui taumui iboumui ai na emui tuari ḡaudia bavabi kau, tadikakamui vairadiai ba raka hanai, ba durudia,
english: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them

motu: ela bona Iehova ese tadikakamui edia laḡa-ani gabuna baine henidia, umui e henimui heḡereḡerena. Bena idia danu Iehova, emui Dirava, ese be henidiamu tanona bae abia, edia tano ai bae halaoa. Una negana ai, umui emui tano, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henimui tanona Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahan ai, vada ba lou henia bona ba noholaia.
english: until Yahweh has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which Yahweh your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”

motu: Bena idia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Vada o haḡanilaimai karadia iboudiai baia kara, bona ba siaimai gabudia baiala.
english: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai lalodiai Mose a kamonai heniava na heto, oi danu baia kamonai henimu; bona Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baine bamomu, Mose e bamoava heḡereḡerena.
english: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.

motu: Daika ese baine papamu ahuahu bona emu haheḡani herevadia baine dadarai, una tau bae alaia mase. Ḡau tamona, ba goada bona ba haheauka.
english: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

motu: Iosua Nunu ese hasinadoa taudia rarua Sitim amo e siaidia hehuni. E haduadia, eto, Aola, tano ba itaia, bona Ieriko hanuana danu. Raruosi na ela; bena ariara hahinena ta, ladana Rahaba, ena ruma ai e dae, unuseni ai e noho.
english: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

motu: Haida ese Ieriko pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Israel taudia haida na hari ina hanuaboi vada ema, ina tano bae hasinadoa totona.
english: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, + 2:2 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”

motu: Bena Ieriko pavapavana ese ena gwau-kau e siaia, Rahaba enai, eto, Dekemu ema bona emu ruma ai e dae kau taudia ba hakaudia lasi, badina be ina tano idoinai bae hasinadoa totona vada ema.
english: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”

motu: A hahine na unu tatau raruosi vada e abidia, vada e hunidia. Bena ia na eto, Momokani, unu tatau na dekegu ema, to lau na asi dibagu idia ede amo ema;
english: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.

motu: bena dina e diho ai, hanua ikoukouna bae koua negana ai, idia na e raka lasi. Ede ela na asi dibagu; a idia muridia amo baola haraḡa, bona ba halasidia tao.
english: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

motu: A hahine na ruma guhina ai vada e hakaudia, flax * + 2:6 Flax be rei ta, varo bona dabua aukadia ikaralaidia ḡau. * tuhutuhudia guhi ai e laha ḡaudia henudiai vada e hunidia.
english: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

motu: Taunabunai e tahudia taudia ese Ioridane dalana ai e tahudia lao, ela bona turu-hanai gabudia. E tahudia ela, bena hanua ikoukouna vada e koua ahu.
english: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

motu: Hasinadoa taudia do asie hekure ai, hahine na dekedia e dae kau guhi ai,
english: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.

motu: e hereva henidia, eto, Lau na dibagu Iehova ese ina tano vada e henimui. Umui daimui ai gari ese e butumai taomu, bona ina tano taudia iboudiai kudoudia e hetahamu.
english: She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

motu: Badina be ai vada a kamonai Iehova ese Davara Kakakakana na vairamui ai e hakaukaua, Aigupto tanona amo o raka lasi negana ai. Vada a kamonai danu Amoro pavapavadia raruosi, Sihon bona Og, ede o aladia mase toma, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai.
english: For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

motu: A kamonai negana di kudoumai e hetaha, bona ta se haheauka umui daimui ai. Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, na guba Diravana bona tanobada Diravana.
english: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ladana ai ba gwau henigu hamata: lau ese umui na bogamui hisi heḡereḡerena umui danu tamagu ena ruma ba bogaia hisi, bona toa korikorina ba henigu,
english: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;

motu: tamagu bona sinagu bona taihugu bona tadikakagu bona edia iboudiai ba hamauridia, iboumai ai mase amo ba rauamai.
english: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”

motu: Raruosi ese e haere henia, eto, Ai emai mauri davana na oiemu mauri. Emai ḡaukara harina basio hapiua, bena ai ese hebogahisi bona kara momokani baia hahedinarai henimu, Iehova ese ina tano baine henimai negana ai.
english: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when Yahweh gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”

motu: Una hahine ena ruma na hanua maḡuna ai e hadaia; ia na maḡu latanai e nohova. Bena ia ese idia raruosi e abidia, gaba-mauru amo kwanau ai e tudia dobi.
english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.

motu: E hamaorodia, eto, Ororo kahadia baola, e tahumuimu taudia bae davarimui na garina. Dina toi unuseni ai ba komu, ela bona e tahumuimu taudia bae lou mai; una murinai emui ura dalana ai ba raka.
english: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”

motu: Raruosi ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ai na a uramu ai na basia kerere, ina gwau-hamata emai ai vada o abia na basia hakererea.
english: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.

motu: Taunabunai, ai na ina tano lalonai baiama negana ai, ina varo kakakakana na o tumai dobi gaba-mauruna ai ba kwatua kau. Tamamu bona sinamu bona taihumu bona tamamu ena ruma taudia iboudiai na ruma lalonai ba haboudia.
english: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.

motu: Idia ta emu ruma iduarana amo baine raka lasi ariara ai, rarana na ia sibona kwarana ai; ai na asi emai kerere. A dika baine kau oi ida ruma lalonai e nohomu tauna ta enai, ia rarana na ai kwaramai ai.
english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.

motu: A emai ḡaukara harina na tau ta boma hamaorolaia, ai na basiama kerere, ina emai ai vada o abia gwauhamatana basia hamomokania negana ai.
english: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”

motu: Hahine na eto, Emui hereva heḡereḡerena, unu baine heto. Bena ia ese e siaidia; bona idia e raka oho murinai ia ese varo kakakakana e kwatua kau, hari gaba-mauru ai.
english: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.

motu: Raruosi e raka lao, ororo kahadia ela, dina toi unuseni ai e nohova, ela bona e tahudia taudia vada e lou; badina be e tahudia taudia na dala idoinai e tahudia, to asie davaridia.
english: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.

motu: Bena raruosi na ororo amo e hekei, sinavai e hanaia, Iosua Nunu dekenai e kau. Bena edia laolao sivaraina idoinai e hamaorolaia.
english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.

motu: Idia ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Momokani, Iehova ese tano idoinai ita imada ai vada e atoa; tano taudia iboudiai na kudoudia e hetahamu ita daidai.
english: They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”

motu: Daba matana ai, Iosua na e tore isi, Sitim e rakatania, Israel taudia iboudiai ida, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai e kau. Bena maoromaoro asie hanaia; do e taruha guna.
english: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

motu: Dina toi e ore murinai, bese lohiadia ese taruha bogaragina amo e raka hanai,
english: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

motu: taunimanima e haḡanidia, eto, Hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo Iehova emui Dirava ena maua helaḡana bae huaia ba itadia negana ai, ba tore isi, ia murina amo ba raka.
english: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.

motu: Uno amo emui raka dalana ba diba, badina be ina dala amo nega hata asio raka. A maua helaḡana basio raka henia kahi; umui bona ia padamui na kiubit daha rua sisivana bae mia. + 3:4 Kiubit daha rua = 890 metres sisivana. *
english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits + 3:4 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters, so 2,000 cubits is about 920 meters. * by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

motu: Bena Iosua ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, eto, Hari dina ai sibomui ba hahelaḡa, badina be kerukeru Iehova ese hoa karadia baine kara bogaragimui ai.
english: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”

motu: Iosua ese danu hahelaḡa taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Taravatu mauana bavabia isi, taunimanima vairadiai ba raka guna. Bena idia ese taravatu mauana e abia isi, taunimanima vairadiai e raka ela.
english: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Hari dina ai baina imodaimu matama, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai, bena bae diba lau ese oi na bamomumu, Mose na bamoava heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia, taravatu mauana e huaiamu taudia, ba haḡanidia, baoto “Ioridane sinavaina ai ba diho ela bona ranu isena ai, bena ba gini”.
english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

motu: Bena Iosua ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Ini aoma, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”

motu: Iosua ma eto, Ini amo vada ba diba Mauri Diravana na umui bogaragimui ai e nohomu; momokani, ia ese Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Girigasa taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Iebusu taudia na vairamui ai baine luludia lasi.
english: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

motu: A kamonai: tanobada idoinai Lohiana ena taravatu mauana ese baine gunalaimui, Ioridane sinavaina ai.
english: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord + 3:11 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.

motu: Taunabunai, tatau gwautararua bavabidia, ta ta iduhu ta ta amo.
english: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia, Iehova, tanobada idoinai lohiana, ena maua e huaiamu taudia, aedia palapaladia na Ioridane sinavaina ranuna ai bae turu dobi negana ai, Ioridane sinavaina ena aru baine doko, bona sinavai dorina amo e maimu ranudia na bae gini tao.
english: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese edia taruha gabuna e rakatania, Ioridane sinavaina ihanaina totona. Bena hahelaḡa taudia ese taravatu mauana e huaia lao, Israel taudia vairadiai,
english: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

motu: ela bona taravatu mauana ihuana taudia aedia na sinavai ranuna ai e turu dobi. Hari Ioridane sinavaina ena kara be taboro negana ai abata e daeva.
english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

motu: Bena sinavai dorina amo e maiva ranuna na dauhai e gini tao, hanua ladana Adam badibadinai; una na Saretan kahana hanuana ta. A e laova, Araba gohuna (ladana ta be Tadi gohuna) e aru heniava ranuna e kororo. Bena Israel taudia na e raka hanai, Ieriko hegaga hehenina ai.
english: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.

motu: A Israel taudia iboudiai tano kaukauna ai e raka hanaiva negana ai, hahelaḡa taudia, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, na tano kaukauna ai e gini, Ioridane bogaraginai, ela bona bese idoinai Ioridane e rakaia hanai vaitani.
english: The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

motu: Bese idoinai ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia vaitani, bena Iehova ese Iosua e hagania, eto,
english: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

motu: Iduhu gwauta-rua amo tatau ta ta amo bavabidia;
english: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

motu: ba haḡanidia, baoto “Nadi gwauta-rua Ioridane bogaraginai, hahelaḡa taudia e gini gabuna amo, bavabidia, ba huadia lao, hari hanuaboi ba taruha gabuna ai bavatodia”.
english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”

motu: Bena Iosua ese vada e abidia hidi taudia na iduhu ta ta amo ta ta e boiridia.
english: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

motu: Bena Iosua ese e haḡanidia, eto, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena taravatu mauana vairanai baola, Ioridane sinavaina bogaraginai; bena ta ta nadi ta ta bavabi isi, paḡamui ai ba hua, Israel iduhudia heḡereḡeredia.
english: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of Yahweh your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;

motu: Ina na toa ai bainela bogaragimui ai. Bena kerukeru vanegai natumui ese bae nanadaimui, baeto “Ini nadi anidia be dahaka?”
english: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’

motu: umui na ba hadibadia, baoto “Ioridane sinavaina na Iehova ena taravatu mauana vairanai e kororo; Ioridane amo e huaia hanai negana ai, ranu na e kororo”. Bena ini nadi na Israel taudia edia helalo-tao ḡaudia ai baela, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iosua ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e karaia: nadi gwauta-rua Ioridane sinavaina bogaragina amo e abidia, Israel iduhudia gwauta-ruaosi toadia, Iehova ese Iosua e haḡania heḡereḡerena. Bena e huadia lao, edia taruha gabuna ai e atodia diho.
english: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.

motu: A Iosua na nadi gwauta-rua e abidia, Ioridane bogaraginai e haginidia, hahelaḡa taudia, hari taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, e gini gabuna. Idia na mimia ema bona hari dina.
english: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.

motu: Badina be hahelaḡa taudia, maua helaḡana e huaia taudia, na Ioridane bogaraginai e gini, ela bona Iehova ese Iosua e haduaia taunimanima baine haḡanilaidia karadia iboudiai vada e ore, Mose ena haheḡani iboudiai Iosua e henia heḡereḡeredia. Bena taunimanima iboudiai e hanai haraḡa-haraḡa.
english: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that Yahweh commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai e raka hanai vaitani, bena maua helaḡana bona hahelaḡa taudia e hanai, taunimanima vairadiai.
english: When all the people had completely crossed over, Yahweh’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.

motu: Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia, mai edia tuari ḡaudia imadia ai, na Israel taudia vairadiai e raka hanai, gunaguna Mose ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena.
english: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.

motu: Tuari taudia gerebu hani + 4:13 Gerebu hani = 40,000. * Iehova vairanai e raka hanai, tuari ela, Ieriko taorana ai.
english: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Iosua e imodaia, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai; idia ese e matauraia bada, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai, gunaguna Mose e matauraiava heḡereḡerena.
english: On that day, Yahweh magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia, taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, ba haḡanidia, Ioridane sinavaina amo bae dae.
english: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iosua ese hahelaḡa taudia e haḡanidia, eto, Ioridane sinavaina amo ba dae.
english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, na Ioridane sinavaina bogaragina amo e dae; bena aedia na tano kaukauna ai e kau negana ai, Ioridane sinavaina ma e aru lou, abata ma e lasi, gunaguna heḡereḡerena.
english: When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.

motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwautana ai Israel taudia na Ioridane sinavaina amo e dae ela, Gilgal ai e taruha, Ieriko mairiveina kahana ai.
english: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

motu: Hari nadi gwauta-ruaosi, Ioridane ai e abi ḡaudia, na Iosua ese e haginidia Gilgal ai.
english: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.

motu: Bena ia ese Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Kerukeru vanegai natumui bae nanadaimui, baeto “Ini nadi anidia be dahaka?”
english: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’

motu: umui ese natumui ba hadibadia, baoto “Israel na ina Ioridane sinavaina amo e raka hanai, tano kaukauna ai”.
english: Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

motu: Badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese Ioridane ranuna na emui ai e hakororoa, ela bona o raka hanai vaitani, gunaguna Iehova, emui Dirava, ese Davara Kakakakana na ai emai ai e hakororoa ela bona ai vada a raka hanai heḡereḡerena.
english: For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as Yahweh your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,

motu: Taunabunai, tanobada taudia iboudiai bae diba Iehova imana na mai goadana; bona umui danu Iehova, emui Dirava, garina ba gari ela bona hanaihanai.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear Yahweh your God forever.’”

motu: Amoro pavapavadia iboudiai Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Iahara kahana ai, e nohova, bona Kanaan taudia edia pavapava iboudiai, kone kahana ai e nohova, na harina e kamonai, Iehova ese Ioridane sinavaina e hakororoa Israel taudia ediai ela bona idia vada e hanaia, bena kudoudia e hetaha bona laumadia e daure, Israel taudia daidiai.
english: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Vasiga bavabi, Israel taudia ma ba peritomedia lou, nega iharuana.
english: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”

motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese vasiga e abi, Israel taudia e peritomedia, Gibeata-haraloto ai.
english: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

motu: Iosua ese e peritomedia badina binai: Aigupto amo e raka lasi mamaruanedia iboudiai, tuari taudia iboudiai, na dala ai vada e mase, tano ḡaḡaena ai, Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai.
english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.

motu: E raka lasi tataudia iboudiai be vada e peritomedia guna; a dala ai e vara, tano ḡaḡaena ai, tataudia, tamadia na Aigupto amo e raka lasi murinai, na asie peritomedia.
english: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

motu: Badina be Israel taudia na laḡani hari-ahui tano ḡaḡaena ai e loaloava, ela bona bese idoinai, tuari taudia Aigupto amo e raka lasi iboudiai, na e mase ore; badina be idia na Iehova erena asie kamonai. Bena Iehova ese e gwau henidia hamata, senedia e gwau henidia hamata baine henida eto tanoml, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, na basine haheitalaidia eto.
english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice. Yahweh swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which Yahweh swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

motu: Taunabunai idia natudia, idia ibolodia ai e halaodia taudia, na Iosua ese e peritomedia; badina be dala ai asie peritomedia.
english: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

motu: Bese idoinai e peritomedia murinai, idia na edia taruha ai e nohova ela bona hisihisi vada e ore.
english: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Hari dina ai Aigupto ena hemarai na emui amo vada na keia oho. Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoamu Gilgal, + 5:9 “Gilgal” anina be “Hekei”. * ema bona hari dina.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal + 5:9 “Gilgal” sounds like the Hebrew for “roll.” * to this day.

motu: Israel taudia na Gilgal ai e nohova negana ai, idia ese lagau-hanai ariana e karaia. Hua dinana ihagwauta-hanina adorahina ai e karaia, Ieriko taorana ai.
english: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

motu: Lagau-hanai dinana e ore, kerukeru idia na una tano anina e ania, asie hatubua flaoana dikeadia bona e gabua uitina.
english: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.

motu: Tamo anina e ania, bena ma kerukeru mana e doko; Israel taudia na mana asie ania lou, a Kanaan tanona anina e ania una laḡani ai.
english: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

motu: Ieriko badibadinai Iosua na e roha isi, tau ta e itaia, dare e veria lasi imana ai. Bena Iosua ese e raka henia kahi, e nanadaia, eto, Oi na ai ida, eiava inaimai?
english: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”

motu: Ia na e haere, eto, Lasi, lau na Iehova ena tuari oreana baina halohiaia totona nama. Bena Iosua na tano ai e goru diho, e toma henia diho, eto, Egu lohia ese ena hesiai tauna ede be haḡania tomamu?
english: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua|strong="H3091" * fell|strong="H5307" * on|strong="H5307" * his|strong="H3068" * face|strong="H6440" * to|strong="H1696" * the|strong="H6440" * earth, and|strong="H3068" * worshiped|strong="H7812" *, and|strong="H3068" * asked|strong="H4100" * him|strong="H6440" *, “ What|strong="H4100" * does|strong="H4100" * my|strong="H3068" * lord|strong="H3068" * say|strong="H1696" * to|strong="H1696" * his|strong="H3068" * servant|strong="H5650" *?”

motu: Iehova ena tuari oreana lohiana ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Emu tamaka na aemu amo a koki oho, badina be o ginimu gabuna na tano helaḡana. Bena Iosua na unu e kara toma.
english: The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.

motu: Ieriko hanuana na e hekou ahu, Israel laudia daidiai; ta se raka lasi, bona ta se raka vareai.
english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, Ieriko hanuana na oi imamu ai vada na atoa, mai pavapavana bona mai ena tuari oreana ida.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.

motu: Hanua ba rakaia heḡeḡe, mai tuari oreana idoinai ida, nega hatamona. Dina ta ta amo unu ba kara toma, ela bona dina tauratoi bae ore.
english: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.

motu: Hahelaga taudia hahitu ese nani mamaruanedia doadia amo e kara kibidia hitu bae abi, maua helagana vairanai bae raka. Dina ihahituna ai, hanua ba rakaia hegeḡe nega hahitu; hahelaga taudia danu kibi bae hiriri.
english: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

motu: Bena kibi reḡena ba kamonai e hiriri daudaumu, una negana ai taunimanima iboudiai bae lolo lalodika; bena hanua maḡuna baine heḡiḡi dobi, taunimanima iboudiai na maorodia ai vada bae raka baela.
english: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the city wall will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight in front of him.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iosua Nunu ese hahelaḡa taudia e boiridia, eto, Taravatu mauana bavabia isi; hahelaḡa taudia hahitu danu nani mamaruanedia doadia amo e kara kibidia hitu bae abi, Iehova ena maua helagana vairanai bae raka.
english: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh’s ark.”

motu: Ia ese taunimanima danu e hamaorodia, eto, Aola, hanua ba rakaia hegeḡe; tuari taudia ese Iehova ena maua helaḡana vairanai bae raka.
english: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before Yahweh’s ark.”

motu: Iosua ese taunimanima vada e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, hahelaḡa taudia hahituosi ese nani mamaruanedia doadia amo e kara kibidia hituosi e abi, Iehova vairanai; bena e raka lao, kibi e hiriri. Idia muridiai Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia.
english: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of Yahweh’s covenant followed them.

motu: Tuari taudia na kibi e hiriri taudia vairadiai e raka; a orea taudia loḡora na maua helaḡana murinai e raka. Kibi na e hiriri loulou.
english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.

motu: A Iosua ese taunimanima e haḡanidia, eto, Basio lolo, bona basio hereva-hereva; hereva ta udumui amo basine lasi, ela bona dina baine gini dae bainato “A lolo”. Bena ba lolo.
english: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”

motu: Taunabunai ia ese Iehova ena maua helaḡana e siaia, hanua baine haḡeḡea nega hatamona. Bena taruha e lou lao, unuseni ai e noho rani.
english: So he caused Yahweh’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.

motu: Daba matana ai Iosua e tore isi, bona hahelaga taudia ese Iehova ena maua helaḡana e abia isi.
english: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up Yahweh’s ark.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia hahituosi ese nani mamaruanedia doadia amo e kara kibidia hituosi e abi, Iehova ena maua helaḡana vairanai e raka, kibi e hiriri loulou. Vairadiai tuari taudia e raka; Iehova ena maua helaḡana murinai orea taudia e raka; kibi e hiriri loulou.
english: The seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of Yahweh’s ark went on continually, and blew the trumpets. The armed men went in front of them. The rear guard came after Yahweh’s ark. The trumpets sounded as they went.

motu: Dina iharuana ai danu hanua e rakaia hegeḡe nega hatamona; bena taruha ma e lou lao. Dina tauratoi unu e kara toma.
english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

motu: Dina ihahituna ai, idia na daba vaburana ai e tore tore isi, hanua unu e rakaia heḡeḡe toma, nega hahitu; una dina tamona ai nega hahitu hanua e rakaia hegege.
english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

motu: Nega ihahituna ai, hahelaḡa taudia ese kibi e hiriri negana ai, Iosua ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, eto, A lolo, badina be Iehova ese hanua vada e henimui.
english: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for Yahweh has given you the city!

motu: Hanua mai anina idoinai na Iehova ese vada e revaia, baine hebua tari; a ariara hahinena Rahaba, mai ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida, bae mauri, badina be ia ese iseda hasinadoa taudia e hunidia.
english: The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

motu: A umui be nahuamui ba toho, e gwaudia ahu ḡaudia ta bavabia, bena sibomui ba hahedika, bona Israel taruhana ba hadikaia bona ba hahekwarahia na garina.
english: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of the devoted thing; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.

motu: A silver * bona gold * idoinai, bona auri laboralabora ḡaudia bona auri ḡaudia, na hehelaḡa Iehova ena; Iehova ena habouhabou rumana ai ba haboudia.
english: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to Yahweh. They shall come into Yahweh’s treasury.”

motu: Taunabunai taunimanima na e lolo, bona kibi taudia na kibi e hiriri. Taunimanima ese kibi reḡedia e kamonai, bona ma e lolo lalodika. Bena hanua maḡuna e heḡigi dobi; taunimanima na maorodia ai e raka vareai, hanua e abia.
english: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.

motu: Hanua idoinai e habuaia tari; tatau bona hahine, memero bona iahu, boromakau bona mamoe bona doniki, ibouboudiai na dare matana amo e aladia mase.
english: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.

motu: Iosua ese hasinadoa taudia raruosi e hamaorodia, eto, Ariara hahinena ena ruma ai ba dae kau, hahine mai varavarana iboudiai ida ba hakaudia lasi, o gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”

motu: Taunabunai hari eregabe taudia gunaguna hasinadoa ela na e raka vareai, Rahaba mai tamana bona sinana bona taihuna bona varavarana iboudiai ida e hakaudia lasi; varavarana iboudiai e laohaidia, Israel taudia edia taruha murimurinai e rakatanidia.
english: The young men who were spies went in, and brought out Rahab with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. They also brought out all of her relatives, and they set them outside of the camp of Israel.

motu: Bena hanua na lahi amo e doua, mai anina idoinai ida; a gold * bona silver * bona auri labora-labora gaudia bona auri gaudia e abidia, Iehova ena ruma ai e haboudia, dava-bada ḡaudia e haboudiava gabuna ai.
english: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of Yahweh’s house.

motu: A ariara hahinena Rahaba, tamana ena ruma taudia bona varavarana iboudiai ida, Iosua ese e hamauridia. Hahine na Israel ai e nohomu ema bona harihari; badina be ia ese Iosua ena hesiai taudia bae hasinadoa totona e siaidia na e rauadia.
english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

motu: Una negana ai Iosua ese hereva aukana e henidia, eto, Ina hanua Ieriko baine hadaia lou tauna na Iehova ese baine uduguiraia. Ruma badidia baine hagini davana na natuna roboana baine mase, bona ikoukou baine hagini davana na natuna tau-muritai baine mase.
english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Iosua e bamoa; ia harina na tano idoinai e piua.
english: So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.

motu: A Israel taudia na e revadia ḡaudia ediai e kerere; badina be Akan Karami, Sabdi Sera tubuna, luda iduhuna tauna, ese e gwaudia ahu ḡaudia haida e abi; taunabunai Iehova ena badu vada e siahu, Israel taudia latadiai.
english: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things; for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against the children of Israel.

motu: Una negana ai Iosua ese tatau haida Ieriko amo e siaidia, e dae lao, hanua ladana Ai baela. Una hanua na Bet-avene badibadinai, Betele mairiveina kahana ai. E hamaorodia, eto, Aola, una tano ba hasinadoa.
english: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy out the land.” The|strong="H7971" * men went|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" * and|strong="H7971" * spied|strong="H7270" * out|strong="H7971" * Ai|strong="H5857" *.

motu: Bena idia na e dae ela, Ai hanuana e hasinadoa. Bena idia na e lou, Iosua dekenai, e hamaoroa, eto, Taunimanima iboudiai na basiela; daha rua eiava daha toi mo baela, Ai hanuana bae tuari henia. Iboudiai na basio hahekwarahidia, basio siaidia; badina be hanua maraḡina mo.
english: They returned to Joshua, and said to him, “Don’t let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all the people to toil there, for there are only a few of them.”

motu: Taunabunai, orea taudia bogaragidia amo daha toi sisivana e dae ela. Ai taudia ese e hadareredia, e hahavadia,
english: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.

motu: toi-ahui tauratoi sisivana e aladia mase. Hanua ikoukouna amo e hahavadia lao, ela bona Sebarimi, bena hekei gabuna ai e aladia mase. Bena Israel taudia na kudoudia e hetaha, bona lalodia e manokamanoka ranu na heto.
english: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.

motu: Bena Iosua ese ena dabua e dare, bona tano ai e goru diho, Iehova ena taravatu mauana vairanai, ela bona dina e diho, ia bona Israel tau-badadia danu. Gahu e abia danu, kwaradia ai e bubu.
english: Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.

motu: Bena Iosua eto, Inaio! Ḡaubada Iehova o! dahaka dainai ina bese taudia Ioridane sinavaina amo vada o hakaudia hanai? Amoro taudia imadia ai ba negemai bena bae habuamai tari totona a? Lalomai bema heḡereḡere Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai baiama noho bema namo.
english: Joshua said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to cause us to perish? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan!

motu: Ḡaubada e, Israel na inaidia vairadiai vada e heau; lau na ede baina hereva toma?
english: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?
