motu: Badina be Kanaan taudia bona ina tano ai e nohomu besedia iboudiai ese harina vada e kamonai, bena bae ḡeḡemai ahu, ai ladamai na tanobada ai bae kokia oho. Bena oi ladamu herea-daena na ede ba tomaia?
english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will you do for your great name?”

motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, A tore isi, dahaka dainai ene e goru diho tomamu?
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?

motu: Israel vada e kerere, egu taravatu, na gwaurai henidia ḡauna, vada e tataia utu; vada na gwau ahu ḡaudia idia ese vada e abidia; vada e henao, vada e koikoi, unu ḡau na edia kohu lalodiai vada e hunidia.
english: Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some of the devoted things, and have also stolen, and also deceived. They have even put it among their own stuff.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia na inaidia vairadiai asi gini dibadia, bena vada e heau; badina be idia danu vada na revadia mase. Lau na basina bamomui lou, ela bona hari na gwau ahu ḡaudia na bogaragimui amo bavabidia oho, ba ha-oredia vaitani.
english: Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.

motu: A tore isi, taunimanima ba hahelaḡadia, baoto: Sibomui ba hahelaḡa, kerukeru dina ena badina be Iehova, Israel eda Dirava, na e tomu “Israel e, inaimui vairadiai na basio gini diba, ela bona na gwau ahu ḡaudia na bogaragimui amo ba negedia daure”.
english: Get up! Sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, “There is a devoted thing among you, Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted thing from among you.”

motu: Taunabunai, kerukeru daba ai baoma, iduhu ta ta amo ba raka kahira; bena Iehova ese baine duanaia iduhuna na doḡoro ta ta amo ma bae raka kahira; bena Iehova ese baine duanaia doḡorona na ruma ta ta amo ma bae raka kahira; bena Iehova ese baine duanaia rumana be ruma taudia na ta ta amo ma bae raka kahira.
english: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which Yahweh selects shall come near by families. The family which Yahweh selects shall come near by households. The household which Yahweh selects shall come near man by man.

motu: Bena na gwau ahu ḡaudia enai bae davaridia tauna na lahi ai bae hamasea, ena kohu idoinai danu lahi ai bae doua; badina be ia ese Iehova ena taravatu vada e tataia utu, bona hemarai karana ta vada e karaia Israel ai.
english: It shall be, that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed Yahweh’s covenant, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”

motu: Daba matana ai Iosua e tore isi, Israel taudia e hakaudia kahira, iduhu ta ta amo; bena luda iduhuna e heduanai.
english: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.

motu: luda taudia ma e hakaudia kahira, doḡoro ta ta amo; bena Sera ena doḡoro e heduanai. Sera ena doḡoro taudia ma e hakaudia kahira, ruma ta ta amo; bena Sabdi ena ruma e heduanai.
english: He brought near the family of Judah, and he selected the family of the Zerahites. He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was selected.

motu: Sabdi ena ruma taudia ma e hakaudia kahira, tatau ta ta amo; bena Akan Karami, Sabdi Sera tubuna, luda iduhuna tauna, e heduanai.
english: He brought near his household man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

motu: Bena Iosua ese Akan e hereva henia, eto, Natugu e, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ba heatolaia, heimodai ia mo ba henia. Mani a hamaorogu, oi na ede o kara toma; egu ai basio hunia.
english: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done! Don’t hide it from me!”

motu: Bena Akan ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Momokani, lau na vada na kerere, Iehova, Israel Diravana, vairanai. Lau na ini na kara toma:
english: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against Yahweh, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.

motu: ta abi kohudia lalodiai lau na hahedoki dabuana namo-hereana ta, Sinara ḡauna, na itaia, bona silver * sekeledia sinahu rua, bona gold * tua ta, ena metau na sekele imahui; na hekise-hekise henidia, bena na abidia; a itaia, ḡaudia na tano ai e hepuni, egu kalaga ai; silver * be henudiai.
english: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels + 7:21 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it.”

motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese haida e siaidia; e heau lao, bena kohu na e davaria, ena kalaga ai e hepuni, hari silver * danu henudiai.
english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.

motu: Bena kalaga lalona amo e abidia lasi, Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai dekedia e laohaidia, Iehova vairanai e atodia.
english: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel idoinai ese Akan Sera e abia, silver * bona hahedoki bona gold * tuana danu e abidia, bona natuna mamaruanedia bona natuna hahinedia, bona ena boromakau bona ena doniki bona ena mamoe, bona ena kalaga, bona ena kohu idoinai; ibouboudiai na Akoro kourana e laohaidia.
english: Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his cattle, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor.

motu: Bena Iosua eto, Dahaka dainai vada o hahekwarahimai? Hari dina ai Iehova ese oi e hahekwarahimumu. Bena Israel taudia iboudiai na nadi amo e hodoa; ena ḡau iboudiai danu lahi ai e doudia, bona nadi amo e hododia.
english: Joshua said, “Why have you troubled us? Yahweh will trouble you today.” All Israel stoned him with stones, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

motu: Bena ia latanai nadi e senu, una nadi senusenua bada-hereana na mia ema bona hari dina ai. Bena Iehova ena badu ma e keru lou. Taunabunai una gabu ladana e hatoamu Akoro + 7:26 “Akoro” anina be “hekwarahi”. * Kourana, ema bona hari dina ai.
english: They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. Yahweh turned from the fierceness of his anger. Therefore the name of that place was called “The valley of Achor” to this day.

motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Basio gari; kudoumu basine hetaha. Tuari taudia iboudiai avabidia; a tore isi, Ai hanuana baola. A itaia, lau ese Ai pavapavana bona ena orea taudia bona ena hanua bona ena tano vada na henimu; idia na oi imamu ai.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.

motu: Ieriko bona Ieriko pavapavana o kara henidia heḡereḡerena, Ai hanuana bona Ai pavapavana unu ba kara henidia toma; ḡau tamona, ena kohu bona ena ubu-ubu ḡaudia bavabi emui. Emu orea ta ba siaidia hehuni, hanua murina kahana amo bae hahoadia.
english: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it.”

motu: Taunabunai Iosua e tore isi, tuari taudia iboudiai ida; e heḡaeḡae, Ai hanuana baela. Iosua ese goada taudia gerebu toi + 8:3 Gerebu toi = 30,000. * e abidia hidi, hanuaboi ai e siaidia, bae guna.
english: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

motu: E haḡanidia, eto, A kamonai: hanua murina kahana ai ba bani henidia; basio raka oho, ba noho heḡaeḡae.
english: He commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Don’t go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.

motu: A lau be egu orea taudia ida hanua baia raka henia kahi. Bena hanua taudia bae raka lasi, vanegai heḡereḡerena, bae tuari henimai totona; a ai be idia vairadiai baia heau.
english: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. It shall happen, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them.

motu: Bena bae havamai; una dala ai hanua amo baia veridia oho dauhai: badina be idia na baeto “Vairada ai e heaumu, vanegai e heau heḡereḡerena”. Taunabunai ai na idia vairadiai baia heau;
english: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They flee before us, like the first time.’ So we will flee before them,

motu: bena umui na ba tore isi, emui komu gabuna ba rakatania, hanua na bavabia; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese imamui ai baine atoa kau.
english: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for Yahweh your God will deliver it into your hand.

motu: Hanua na bavabia negana ai, vada ba doua, Iehova ena hahedua heḡereḡerena. Vadaeni, vada name haḡanimui.
english: It shall be, when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do this according to Yahweh’s word. Behold, I have commanded you.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iosua ese e siaidia, bena edia komu gabuna ela, Betele bona Ai padadiai, Ai lahara kahana ai. A Iosua na ena orea taudia ida e nohova una hanuaboi ai.
english: Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but Joshua stayed among the people that night.

motu: Iosua na daba maraḡi ela, taunimanima e haboudia, bena idia bona Israel tau-badadia ida e dae ela, taunimanima vairadiai Ai ela.
english: Joshua rose up early in the morning, mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

motu: Bena tuari taudia iboudiai, ia ida ela taudia, na e dae ela, hanua e raka henia kahi, Ai mirigini kahana ai e taruha. Edia taruha bona Ai hanuana padadia ai na koura dobudobuna ta.
english: All the people, even the men of war who were with him, went up and came near, and came before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai. Now there was a valley between him and Ai.

motu: A taunimanima daha ima sisivana e abidia, Betele bona Ai padadiai bae bani henidia, Ai lahara kahana ai.
english: He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

motu: Taunabunai iboudiai na edia gabu e abi, orea badana na hanua mirigini kahana ai, a e komu oreana na lahara kahana ai. A Iosua na koura ai e noho rani.
english: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

motu: Ai pavapavana ese una kara e itaia, bena ia mai ena tuari taudia bona ena hanua taudia iboudiai na hanua amo e didi lasi, bena ia mai ena orea taudia, Ai hanuana taudia, e tore isi haraḡa, e didi lasi, Araba hekeidihona ela, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia totona; asi dibana orea ta be hanua murina kahana ai vada e komu.
english: When the king of Ai saw it, they hurried and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the Arabah; but he didn’t know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.

motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese e koidia, e kara vada e darere na heto, bena e heau, tano ḡaḡaena e heau lao.
english: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

motu: Bena Ai taudia iboudiai e heau hebou, bae hahavadia totona; bena idia ese Iosua e havaia, hanua na e rakatania.
english: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

motu: Ai bona Betele lalodiai tau ta dia noho; asi tauna ta Israel se havadia. I lanua na hekehona ai e rakatania, idia e havadia lao.
english: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Io na imamu ai ba toia roro, Ai ba dudui henia; badina be oi imamu ai baina atoa kau. Taunabunai Iosua ese ena io na imana ai e toia roro, hanua e dudui henia.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.” Joshua|strong="H3091" * stretched|strong="H5186" * out|strong="H5186" * the|strong="H3588" * javelin|strong="H3591" * that|strong="H3588" * was|strong="H3068" * in|strong="H3068" * his|strong="H5414" * hand|strong="H3027" * toward|strong="H3027" * the|strong="H3588" * city|strong="H5892" *.

motu: Bena imana e toia roro negana ai, hari e komu oreana na edia komu gabuna amo e tore isi haraḡa, e heau lao, hanua lalonai e heau vareai, vada e abia; bena maoromaoro e doua.
english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.

motu: Taunabunai, Ai taudia na e roha kerehai, hanua e doua kwalahuna guba ai e dae e itaia. Bena asi edia heau dalana ta; badina be tano ḡaḡaena e heau lao taudia na ma e lou, e havadia taudia ma e lou henidia.
english: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.

motu: Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese e itaia, e komu oreana ese hanua vada e abia, bona hanua e doua kwalahuna na e daeva, bena idia na e lou, Ai taudia e hadareredia.
english: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned back and killed the men of Ai.

motu: Bena hari orea ta ma hanua amo e raka lasi, e tuan henidia; taunabunai Israel taudia na kahana kahana ai, idia na ihua-pada ai. Bena Israel ese e hadareredia, ta se mauri bona ta se heau.
english: The others came out of the city against them, so they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. They struck them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

motu: A Ai pavapavana na e abia mauri, Iosua dekena e hakaua lao.
english: They captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua.

motu: Israel taudia na Ai taudia iboudiai, hari tano ḡaḡaena ai e havadia taudia, na e aladia ore, iboudiai na dare amo e aladia mase. Una murinai idia na Ai e lou ela, noho taudia ma dare amo e aladia ore.
english: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

motu: Una dina ai e aladia mase taudia iboudiai na gerebu-ta daha-rua, + 8:25 Gerebu-ta daha-rua = 12,000. * tatau bona hahine; Ai taudia iboudiai bunu.
english: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.

motu: Badina be Iosua ese io imana ai se veria lou ela bona Ai taudia iboudiai vada e aladia ore.
english: For Joshua didn’t draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

motu: A Israel taudia ese ubu-ubu ḡaudia bona kohu una hanua lalona amo e abidia edia, Iehova ese Iosua e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city, according to Yahweh’s word which he commanded Joshua.

motu: Taunabunai Iosua na Ai hanuana e doua bona e haseriseria; unu e mia tomamu ema bona hilrihari.
english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

motu: Bena ia ese Ai pavapavana e alaia mase, au ta ai e taua dae ela bona adorahi. Dina e diho, bena Iosua ese e haḡanidia dainai haida ese mase tauna na au amo e abia dobi, hanua ikoukouna ai e atoa diho; bena nadi e senu senu kau ia latanai. Una senusenu badana na doini mia, ema bona harihari.
english: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day.

motu: Bena Iosua ese ihaboulaina patana ta e larebaia, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena, Ebal ororona ai,
english: Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

motu: Mose, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena, Mose ena taravatu bukana ai e torea, eto: Ihabiulaina patana na nadi kavakava, asie utu ḡaudia, amo ba karaia. Bena ia latanai ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia e hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena.
english: as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: an altar of uncut stones, on which no one had lifted up any iron. They offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh and sacrificed peace offerings.

motu: Unuseni ai Mose ese ena taravatu ma e torea lou una nadi ai; Israel taudia vairadiai e torea.
english: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses’ law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

motu: Bena Israel idoinai, Israel taudia korikori bona bogaradiai e noho hedoava taudia, Israel tau-badadia bona heitatao taudia bona hahemaoro taudia ida, taravatu mauana kahana kahana ai e gini, hahelaḡa taudia Levi iduhuna amo, Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, vairadiai. Kahana na Gerisim ororona vairanai e gini, ma kahana Ebal ororona vairanai, Mose, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, ena haheḡani gunaguna e henidia heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia ihanamodia totona.
english: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.

motu: Una murinai ia ese taravatu herevadia iboudiai e duahi, hahenamo herevadia bona heuduguirai herevadia, taravatu bukana ai e tore herevadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
english: Afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

motu: Mose ena haheḡani herevana ta Iosua ese se hamorua; iboudiai e duahidia hedinarai, Israel taudia edia hebou ai, tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, bona noho-hedoa taudia danu, vairadiai.
english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn’t read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who were among them.

motu: Ioridane sinavaina unukahana pavapavadia iboudiai, ororo ai bona taora ai, ela bona Davara Badana konena Lebanon kahana ai, Hiti bona Amoro bona Kanaan bona Perisi bona Hivi bona Iebusu taudia edia pavapava, ese una hari e kamonai;
english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it

motu: bena mai lalodiai tamona e hebou, Iosua bona Israel taudia bae tuari henidia eto.
english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

motu: A Gibeon taudia na Iosua harina e kamonai, Ieriko bona Ai hanuadia ede e karadia toma;
english: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

motu: bena hedibaḡani karana ta e karaia. Idia na aniani e habou, laolao taudia na heheto, puse gunadia bona vine-ranuna kopidia gunadia, vada e hedare ma e bani ḡaudia, na edia doniki dorudia ai e ato kau.
english: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wineskins,

motu: Tamaka gunadia, vada e bani ḡaudia, bona dabua gunadia, vada e hedare ḡaudia, e dokidia; adia flaoa danu vada e auka bona vada e valavala.
english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

motu: Bena Iosua dekena ela, Gilgal taruhana ai, ia bona Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Ai na gabu daudau amo vada ama, umui ida baita herohemaino a tomu.
english: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Hivi taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui na readia ina tano ai o nohomu. Ede baita herohemaino toma?
english: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”

motu: A idia ese Iosua ma e hamaoroa, eto, Ai na oiemu hesiai taudia. Iosua ese ma e nanadaidia, eto, Umui be daidia? Bona ede amo vada oma?
english: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua|strong="H3091" * said to|strong="H5650" * them, “ Who|strong="H4310" * are|strong="H5650" * you|strong="H4310" *? Where do|strong="H4310" * you|strong="H4310" * come from|strong="H5650" *?”

motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Emu hesiai taudia na gabu daudau amo, Iehova, emui Dirava, ladana dainai vada ama. Badina be ia harina vada a kamonai, bona ena kara iboudiai Aigupto ai e karava sivaraidia;
english: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of Yahweh your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,

motu: bona Amoro pavapavadia raruosi, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, bona Og, Basan pavapavana, Astaroto ai e nohova, na ede o karadia toma vada a kamonai.
english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

motu: Bena emai tano lohiadia bona emai tano taudia iboudiai ese e haḡanimai, eto “Dala lakwana bavabia, idia dekedia baola, baoto: Ai na emui hesiai taudia, mani aita herohemaino”.
english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’

motu: Amai flaoa binai, emai dala lakwana, dekemui baiama totona a tore isi dinana ai emai ruma amo a abia lasi mai siahu-siahuna ida. A itaia, harihari ia na vada eme auka, eme valavala danu.
english: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.

motu: Ini vine ranuna kopidia danu, a hahonudia negana ai idia na mamatamata; a itaia, harihari idia na vada e hedare patapata. Emai dabua bona emai tamaka danu vada e dika, dala daudau amo vada ama dainai.
english: These wineskins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey.”

motu: Bena Israel taudia na edia aniani taidia taidia e ani; Iehova ena hahedua asie tahua.
english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.

motu: Bena Iosua na idia ida e herohemaino bona e gwau hamata, basine aladia mase eto. Hebou ikwarana taudia danu unu e gwau hamata toma.
english: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.

motu: Dina toi vada ela, una herohemaino karana murinai, bena sivaraidia e kamonai, idia na dekedia taudia, bona badidiai e nohomu.
english: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.

motu: Bena Israel taudia na edia laolao ela, dina ihatoina ai idia edia hanua ai e kau. Edia hanua be Gibeon bona Kefira bona Beroto bona Kiriat-iearimi.
english: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese asie aladia mase, badina be hebou ikwarana taudia ese vada e gwau henidia hamata, Iehova, Israel edia Dirava, ladana ai.
english: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.

motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai ese edia lohia e maumauraidia. A hebou ikwarana taudia iboudiai ese hebou taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Ai ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, ladana ai vada a gwau henidia hamata; harihari ita ese basita daudia toho diba.
english: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.

motu: A ini baita karadia toma: baita hamauridia, badu ita edai baine kau na garina, badina be ai ese a gwau henidia hamata.
english: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”

motu: Hari lohia ma eto, Baita hamauridia. Taunabunai, idia na au-siri bona ranu-utu taudia ai ela, hebou taudia iboudiai edia, hebou ikwaradia taudia edia hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: The princes said to them, “Let them live.” So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them.

motu: Bena Iosua ese e boiridia, e gwau henidia, eto, Dahaka dainai o koimai? Umui oto “Ai na gabu daudau amo vada ama”, a ḡau be gabu kahikahi ai o nohomu.
english: Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?

motu: Taunabunai, heuduguirai herevana na latamui ai baina gwauraia: umui na hesiai iḡuidia ai ba noho; au ba siri bona ranu ba utu, egu Dirava ena ruma ena.
english: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”

motu: Idia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Ai bini emu hesiai taudia na harina a kamonai, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese ena hesiai tauna Mose e haḡania, ina tano taudia iboudiai baine aladia mase vairamui ai; taunabunai, ai na a gari dikadika, emai roho-mauri dalana a tahua, umui daimui ai. Bena ini a kara toma.
english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

motu: Harihari ai na oi imamu ai; edena kara ba laloa namo bona maoro, unu ba karamai toma.
english: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”

motu: Taunabunai ia ese Israel taudia imadia amo e hamauridia; asie aladia mase.
english: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.

motu: A una dina ai Iosua ese au-siri taudia bona ranu-utu taudia ai e halaodia, Israel taudia edia, bona Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ena, ema bona harihari, e heabi hidi gabuna ai.
english: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for Yahweh’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.

motu: Adoni-sedek, Ierusalem pavapavana, ese Iosua harina e kamonai, ia ese Ai vada e habuaia tari, una hanua mai pavapavana ida vada e kara henidia Ieriko mai pavapavana ida e kara henidia heḡereḡerena; e kamonai danu Gibeon taudia na Israel taudia ida vada e herohemaino bona idia ida e noho hebouva.
english: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

motu: Bena e gari dikadika; badina be Gibeon na hanua badana, pavapava ta ena hanua na heto; ia ese Ai e hereaiava, bona hanua taudia iboudiai na tuari taudia mai goadadia.
english: they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.

motu: Taunabunai, Adonisedek, Ierusalem pavapavana, ese ena gwau-kau na Hohama, Heberon pavapavana, bona Pirama, Iaramutu pavapavana, bona Iafia, Lakisi pavapavana, bona Debiri, Eglon pavapavana, dekedia e siaia, eto,
english: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,

motu: Dekegu aoma, ba durugu, Gibeon baita tuari henia; badina be idia na Iosua bona Israel taudia ida vada e herohemaino.
english: “Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”

motu: Bena Amoro pavapavadia laimaosi, Ierusalem pavapavana bona Heberon pavapavana bona Iaramutu pavapavana bona Lakisi pavapavana bona Eglon pavapavana, e hebou, edia tuari oreadia iboudiai e hakaudia lao, Gibeon vairanai e taruha, e tuari henia.
english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

motu: Bena Gibeon taudia ese edia gwau-kau na Iosua dekena e siaia lao, Gilgal taruhana ai, eto, Imamu na emu hesiai taudia latamai amo basio abia oho; aoma haraḡa, ba hamaurimai bona ba durumui; badina be Amoro pavapavadia iboudiai ororo kahadia amo vada e hebou, vada e tuari henimai.
english: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”

motu: Taunabunai Iosua na Gilgal amo e dae ela, mai ena orea idoinai bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai ida.
english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Idia garidia basio gari, badina be oi imamu ai vada na atodia; idia ta oi vairamu ai basine gini.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.”

motu: Taunabunai Iosua na hanuaboi horana idoinai Gilgal amo e raka rani, e hahoadia.
english: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hagaridia, Israel taudia vairadiai; bena Israel taudia ese hutuma bada e aladia mase Gibeon ai, bona oredia e hahavadia lao, Bete-horono e dae lao dalana ai, heaudia ai e aladia mase, ela bona Aseka bona Makeda.
english: Yahweh confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.

motu: Israel taudia vairadia amo ma e heau lao, Bete-horono amo ma e hekei diho; unuseni ai Iehova ese medu hetaridia badadia guba amo e hadihodia idia latadiai, ela bona Aseka; unu amo e amasedia. Medu hetarina amo e mase taudia ese Israel taudia edia dare amo e mase taudia na e hereadia.
english: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

motu: Iehova ese Israel taudia imadia amo Amoro taudia e hadareredia dinana ai, Iosua ese Iehova e noia, Israel taudia vairadiai e hereva, eto, Dina o, Gibeon daenai ba rahu tao, Oi hua danu, Aialono kourana ai!
english: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”

motu: Bena dina e rahu tao, bona hua na gabuna ai e noho, ela bona Israel taudia ese inaidia amo davadia e abi. Iasara ena buka ai na ini e torea toma, ani? Dina na atai ai e rahu tao, se ḡelo, ela bona dina ta heḡereḡerena.
english: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.

motu: Nega ta dina hata Iehova ese tau ta unu se kamonai henia toma, guna eiava murinai; badina be Iehova ese Israel edia tuan ai e tuariva.
english: There was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh listened to the voice of a man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.

motu: Bena Iosua na Israel taudia iboudiai ida e lou ela, Gilgal taruhana e lou henia.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

motu: Unu hanua pavapavadia laimaosi na e heau, Makeda kohuana ai e komu.
english: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

motu: Bena haida ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Hari pavapava laimaosi vada e davaridia, Makeda kohuana ai e komumu.
english: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

motu: Bena Iosua eto, Nadi badadia bae keidia lao, kohua iduarana bae kurea ahu, bena kito taudia na badibadinai ba rakatanidia;
english: Joshua said, “Roll large stones to cover the cave’s entrance, and set men by it to guard them;

motu: a umui na basio halahe, inaimui do ba hahavadia, muridia amo bavala-ala henidia, edia hanua na basie heau vareai; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui imamui ai vada e atodia.
english: but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities; for Yahweh your God has delivered them into your hand.”

motu: Iosua bona Israel taudia ese vada e habuadia tari, ela bona hutuma bada vada e mase ore, ta ta mo hanua mai maḡudia lalodiai e heau vareai, bena e mauri.
english: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,

motu: Una murinai Israel taudia iboudiai na Iosua dekena e lou lao, Makeda taruhana ai e nohova mai mainodia ida; tau ta ese malana se hamarerea, Israel taudia iherevalaidia.
english: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

motu: Bena Iosua eto, Kohua iduarana a kehoa, unu pavapava laimaosi ba hakaudia lasi, lau dekegu ai ba mailaidia.
english: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”

motu: Bena unu e kara toma: hari pavapava laimaosi e hakaudia lasi, Iosua dekena e laohaidia: Ierusalem pavapavana bona Heberon pavapavana bona laramutu pavapavana bona Lakisi pavapavana bona Eglon pavapavana.
english: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

motu: Laimaosi e hakaudia lasi Iosua vairanai; bena Iosua ese Israel taudia iboudiai e boiridia; bena ia ese tuari lohiadia, tuari ai e bamoava taudia, e hamaorodia, eto, A raka kahi mai, aemui na ini pavapava aiodia ai ba moi kau. Taunabunai, idia na e raka kahira, aedia na aiodia ai e moi kau.
english: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.” They|strong="H5921" * came|strong="H1961" * near|strong="H7126" *, and|strong="H1980" * put|strong="H7760" * their|strong="H3605" * feet|strong="H7272" * on|strong="H5921" * their|strong="H3605" * necks|strong="H6677" *.

motu: Iosua ma e hamaorodia, eto, Basio gari, kudoumui na basie hetaha; ba goada, ba haheauka, badina be Iehova ese inaimui iboudiai ini baine karadia toma, ba tuari henidia negadia ai.
english: Joshua said to them, “Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for Yahweh will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”

motu: Una murinai, Iosua ese laimaosi e aladia mase, au auima ai e taudia dae; e hetau dae ela bona dina e diho.
english: Afterward Joshua struck them, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until the evening.

motu: Dina e diho, bena Iosua e hahedua, bena haida ese au amo e abidia dobi, Ialonai e komuva kohuana ai ma e tahodia vareai; bena nadi badadia e abi, kohua iduarana e kurea ahu. Unu e mia tomamu ema bona han dina. Hanua momo e habuadia tari
english: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

motu: Una dina ai Iosua ese Makeda e abia, e habuaia tari; hanua pavapavana e alaia mase, bona hanua taudia iboudiai e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Ieriko pavapavana e kara henia heḡereḡerena, Makeda pavapavana danu unu e kara henia toma.
english: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Makeda amo ela, Libna ai e kau; bena e tuari henia.
english: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Libna danu, mai pavapavana ida, Israel taudia imadia ai e atodia. Bena e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai dare amo e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Ieriko pavapavana e kara henia heḡereḡerena, Libna pavapavana danu unu e kara henia toma.
english: Yahweh delivered it also, with its king, into the hand of Israel. He struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining in it. He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Libna amo ela, Lakisi ai e kau, e koua heḡeḡe bona e tuari henia.
english: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Lakisi danu Israel taudia imadia ai e atoa; dina iharuana ai e abia, e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai dare amo e aladia ore, Libna ai e karaia heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

motu: Horama, Gesere pavapavana, ema, Lakisi taudia idurudia totona, a Iosua ese ia mai ena orea taudia iboudiai e hadareredia, e aladia ore.
english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.

motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Lakisi amo ela, Eglon ai e kau; e koua heḡeḡe bona e tuari henia;
english: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.

motu: una dina ai e abia, e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia ore, Lakisi ai e karaia heḡereḡerena.
english: They took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Eglon amo ela, Heberon ai e kau, e tuari henia;
english: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.

motu: e abia, dare amo e aladia, hanua pavapavana danu e alaia, bona hanua maraḡidia taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Eglon ai e karaia heḡereḡerena, unu ma e kara toma: e habuaia tari, bona taunimanima iboudiai e aladia ore.
english: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.

motu: Bena Iosua bona Israel taudia iboudiai na e lou, Debiri ela, e tuari henia;
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

motu: bena e abia, mai pavapavana bona mai ena hanua iboudiai ida. Bena e habuaia tari, hanua taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri. Heberon e kara henia bona Libna mai pavapavana ida e kara henidia heḡereḡerena, Debiri mai pavapavana ida unu e karadia toma.
english: He took it, with its king and all its cities. They struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

motu: Taunabunai, Iosua ese tano idoinai e hadarerea: ororo kahadia bona diho kahana, taora bona ororo gabaedia, mai pavapavadia iboudiai ida; ta se hamauria. Mai laḡadia ḡaudia iboudiai e aladia ore, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded.

motu: Iosua ese e hadareredia, Kade-baranea amo ela bona Gasa, bona Gosen tanona idoinai ela bona Gibeon.
english: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

motu: Hanua pavapavadia iboudiai e abidia, bona edia tano danu una nega tamona ai e abidia vaitani; badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, na Israel edia tuari ai e tuariva.
english: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

motu: Bena Iosua e lou lao, Israel taudia iboudiai ida, Gilgal taruhana e lou henia.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

motu: Iabin, Hasoro pavapavana, ese unu hari e kamonai, bena ia ese gwau-kau e siaia, Iobab, Madon pavapavana, dekenai,
english: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,

motu: bona Simron pavapavana bona Akasaf pavapavana dekediai, bona ororo gabudia pavapavadia dekediai, mirigini kahana ai, bona Araba taorana pavapavadia, Kineroto diho kahana ai, bona koura hanuadia pavapavadia, bona Doro ororodia hanuadia pavapavadia, lahara kahana ai.
english: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,

motu: Gwau-kau e siaia danu Kanaan taudia dekediai, mairiveina kahana ai bona lahara kahana ai, bona Amoro taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Perisi taudia dekediai, bona Iebusu taudia dekediai, ororo kahadia ai, bona Hivi taudia dekediai, Heremon ororona badi-tanona ai, Mispa tanona ai.
english: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

motu: Iboudiai e tore isi, edia tuari taudia iboudiai ida, taunimanima hutuma bada, kone mirina na heto, mai edia hosi momo herea bona edia kariota momo herea danu.
english: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

motu: Unu pavapava iboudiai na edia tuari oreadia e haboudia, ela, Merom ranudia badidiai e taruha, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia totona.
english: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, Idia garidia basio gari; badina be kerukeru hora inihetomana ai lau ese imamui ai baina atodia, iboudiai na bae mase ore Israel vairadiai: edia hosi aedia varovarodia ba utu, bona edia kariota na lahi ai ba doudia.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iosua mai ena tuari oreadia iboudiai na ediai e hedinarai taku Merom ranudia badidiai, bena e tuari henidia.
english: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Israel taudia imadia ai e atodia: Israel taudia ese e hadareredia, e hahavadia ela bona Sidono badana bona Misirefoto-maimi, ma e hahavadia ela bona Mispe kourana, mairiveina kahana ai; iboudiai e aladia ore, ta se roho mauri.
english: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

motu: Bena Iosua ese Iehova ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e kara henidia: edia hosi na aedia varovarodia e utu, bona edia kariota na lahi ai e doudia.
english: Joshua did to them as Yahweh told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

motu: Una negana ai Iosua na e lou, hanua ta ladana Hasoro e abia, bona pavapavana na dare amo e alaia mase; badina be nega gunadia Hasoro ese unu basileia iboudiai e hereadiava.
english: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai una hanua lalonai na idia ese dare amo e aladia mase, ela bona iboudiai vada e habuadia ore; ta se mauri. Bena Hasoro na lahi amo e doua.
english: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.

motu: Unu pavapava edia hanua iboudiai, mai pavapavadia iboudiai ida, Iosua ese e abidia, dare amo e aladia mase, e habuadia ore, Mose, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
english: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded.

motu: A Israel taudia na ororo komutadia doridia ai e hadai hanuadia asie doudia; tamona mo, Hasoro, Iosua ese e doua.
english: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.

motu: Unu hanua kohudia na Israel taudia ese e abi, edia kohu ai e halao; bona boromakau danu. A taunimanima be iboudiai dare amo e aladia mase, e habuadia ore; ta se mauri.
english: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.

motu: Iehova ese ena hesiai tauna Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Mose ese Iosua ma e hagania, bena Iosua na unu e kara toma. Iehova ese Mose e haḡanilaia karadia iboudiai Iosua ese e kara; ta se reaia.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese una tano idoinai e abia, ororo kahadia, bona diho kahana idoinai, bona Gosen tanona, bona koura iboudiai, bona Araba tanona, bona Israel ororodia bona kouradia:
english: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

motu: Halak ororona amo, Seiri kahana ai, ela bona Baal-gad, Lebanon kourana ai, Heremon ororona baditanona ai. Hanua pavapavadia iboudiai e hadareredia bona e aladia mase.
english: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

motu: Iosua ese nega daudau unu pavapava e tuari henidia.
english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

motu: Asi hanua ta Israel ida e herohemaino, Hivi taudia Gibeon ai e nohova mo sibodia; iboudiai na tuari ai e abidia.
english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

motu: Badina be Iehova ese lalodia e ha-aukadia, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia bena Israel ese bae habuadia tari totona; basie bogadia hisi, a bae aIadia ore, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

motu: Una negana ai Iosua na e tore isi, Anakim taudia e habuadia tari, ororo gabudia ai, Heberon ai, Debiri ai, Anab ai, Iuda ororodia iboudiai, bona Israel ororodia iboudiai; Iosua ese e aladia ore bona edia hanua e habuadia tari.
english: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

motu: Anakim tauna ta se mauri, Israel taudia edia tano idoinai; a Gasa ai bona Gata ai bona Asdod ai na haida dounu e mauri nohova.
english: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese tano idoinai e abia, Iehova ese Mose e herevalai henia herevadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia. Bena Iosua ese Israel taudia e henidia, iduhu ta ta ena tano ena tano e henidia. Una negana ai tuari e doko, bona tano na e laḡa ani.
english: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

motu: Hanua pavapavadia una tano ai, Israel taudia ese e hadareredia bona edia tano e abi, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, Aranon kourana ela bona Heremon ororona bona Araba taorana idoinai mairiveina kahana ai, ladadia bini.
english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

motu: Ta be Sihon, Amoro pavapavana: ia na Hesebon ai e nohova. E halohiaiava tanona na Aroere amo, Aranon kourana isena ai, bona koura bogaragina amo ela bona labok sinavaina, Amono taudia edia tano hetoana. Una na Gilead tanona kahana.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

motu: Bona Araba tanona danu iena, Kineroto gohuna mairiveina kahana amo ela bona Bet-iesimoto, ela bona Araba gohuna (Tadi Gohuna), bona diho kahana tanona ela bona Pisga ororona badi-tanodia.
english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

motu: Ma ta be Og, Basan pavapavana, Refaim tauna ta: ia na Astaroto ai bona Edrei ai e nohova.
english: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

motu: E halohiadiava tanodia na Heremon ororona bona Saleka bona Basan tanona idoinai ela bona Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia edia tano hetoadia. Gilead tanona kahana danu iena, ela bona Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ena tano hetoana.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

motu: Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose bona Israel taudia ese e hadareredia; bena Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese idia raruosi edia tano e abi, Ruben iduhuna taudia bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia e henidia, edia tano ai bae halaoa.
english: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

motu: Hanua pavapavadia una tano ai danu Iosua bona Israel taudia ese e hadareredia, Ioridane sinavaina lahara kahana ai, Baal-gad amo, Lebanon kourana ai, ela bona Halak ororona, Seiri kahana ai. Bena Iosua ese edia tano e abi, Israel iduhudia e henidia, edia tano ai bae halao, iduhu ta ta ena tano ena tano ai baela;
english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

motu: ororo bona koura, Araba taorana bona ororo gabaedia bona tano ḡagaedia, bona diho kahana tanodia; Hiti taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia edia tano.
english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

motu: Iosua vada e buruka, ena mauri laḡanidia na momo herea. Iehova ese e hereva henia, eto, Oi na vada o buruka, emu mauri laḡanidia na momo herea; a tano bada-hereana na do asio abia.
english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

motu: Dounu mimia tanodia bini: Filistia taudia edia tano iboudiai, bona Gesuru taudia edia tano iboudiai.
english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

motu: Sihoro, Aigupto mairiveina kahana tanona, amo mirigini kahana e laomu ela bona Ekron hetoana na Kanaan taudia edia tano e tomamu. Filistia lohiadia na laima: Gasa lohiana, Asdod lohiana, Askelono Iohiana, Gata lohiana, bona Ekron lohiana. Avim taudia edia tano danu do asio abia.
english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

motu: Diho kahana ai dounu mimia tanodia be Kanaan taudia edia tano idoinai; bona Meara, Sidono taudia edia tano, ela bona Afek, ela bona Amoro taudia edia tano hetoana;
english: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

motu: bona Gebala taudia edia tano, bona Lebanon tanona idoinai, mairiveina kahana ai, Baal-gad amo, Heremon ororona badi-tanona ai, ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina.
english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

motu: Ororo ai e nohomu taudia iboudiai, Lebanon amo ela bona Misirefoto-maimi, Sidono taudia iboudiai, lau ese baina luludia lasi Israel taudia vairadiai. Ḡau tamona, tano na ba haria, Israel taudia ahudia ba henidia.
english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

motu: Taunabunai ina tano ba haria, iduhu taurahani-ta bona Manase iduhuna kahana na ahudia ba henidia.
english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

motu: A Manase iduhuna kahana na Ruben bona Gad iduhudia ida ahudia vada e abi guna; Mose ese e henidia, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai. Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henidia:
english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:

motu: Aroere amo, Aranon kourana isena ai, bona koura bogaragina hanuana amo bona Medeba taorana amo ela bona Dibon;
english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

motu: bona Sihon, Amoro taudia edia lohia, Hesebon pavapavana, ena hanua iboudiai, ela bona Amono taudia edia tano hetoana;
english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

motu: bona Gilead; bona Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia edia tano; bona Heremon ororona idoinai; bona Basan idoinai ela bona Saleka,
english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

motu: Og, Astaroto bona Edrei pavapavana, ena tano idoinai Basan ai. Hari Og be Refaim tauna; Refaim besena idoinai ia mo sibona dounu noho. Ini na Mose ese e hadareredia bena e luludia lasi.
english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Israel taudia na Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia asie luludia lasi; Gesuru taudia bona Maakata taudia na doini Israel taudia bogaragidiai e nohomu ema bona harihari.
english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

motu: Levi iduhuna taudia mo Mose ese tano ta se henidia, badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, vada e hereva, boubou ḡaudia lahi ai e gabudia na idia ahudia.
english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

motu: Mose ese Ruben iduhuna taudia na edia doḡoro ta ta ai ahudia e henidia.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

motu: Edia tano na Aroere amo e matamaiamu, Aranon kourana isena ai. Koura bogaragina hanuana na idia edia, bona Medeba taorana idoinai.
english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

motu: Hesebon danu edia, mai ena taora hanuadia iboudiai; bona Dibon, bona Bamoto-baal, bona Bete-baal-meono;
english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

motu: bona lahasa, bona Kedemoto, bona Mefata;
english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

motu: bona Kiriataimi, bona Sibma, bona Seretesahara, una koura ororona ai;
english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

motu: bona Bete-peoro, bona Pisga ororona gabaena, bona Bet-iesimoto.
english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

motu: Taora hanuadia iboudiai na idia edia; bona Sihon, Amoro taudia edia lohia, Hesebon pavapavana, ena basielia idoinai. Una Sihon na Mose ese e hadarerea: ia bona Midian lohiadia, Evi bona Rekeme bona Suru bona Huru bona Reba. Una na Sihon ena basileia lohiadia, una tano e noholaia.
english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

motu: Balaam Beoro danu, rohe tauna ta, Israel taudia ese dare amo e alaia mase, taunimanima loḡora ida.
english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

motu: Ruben iduhuna taudia edia tano hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina isena. Ruben iduhuna taudia ahudia bunu, edia deḡoro ta ta amo bona edia hanua badadia bona maraḡidia ta ta amo e abi.
english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

motu: Mose ese Gad iduhuna taudia na edia doḡoro ta ta ai ahudia e henidia.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

motu: Edia tano na lasere, bona Gilead hanuadia iboudiai, bona Amono taudia edia tano kahana, ela bona Aroere, Raba mairiveina kahana ai.
english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

motu: Hesebon amo ela bona Ramata-mispe bona Betonimi danu idia edia; bona Mahanaim ela bona Debiri hetoana.
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

motu: Koura ai, Bete-haram bona Bete-nimra bona Sukoto bona Safon na edia, bona Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, ena basileia orena; hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina ela bona ranu na Kinerete + 13:27 “Kinerete” bona “Kineroto” na Galilea gohuna ladana haida. * gohuna amo e aru lasimu gabuna ai, Ioridane mairiveina kahana ai.
english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

motu: Gad iduhuna taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta amo bona edia hanua badadia bona maraḡidia ta ta amo e abi.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

motu: Mose ese Manase iduhuna kahana taudia na edia doḡoro ta ta ai ahudia e henidia.
english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

motu: Edia tano na Mahanaim amo ela bona Basan tanona idoinai, Og, Basan pavapavana, ena basileia idoinai, bona lairi ena hanua iboudiai Basan ai: hanua iboudiai na tauratoi-ahui.
english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

motu: Gilead kahana danu idia edia, bona Astaroto bona Edrei, Og ena basileia hanuadia Basan ai: unu na Makiri Manase garana e henidia, Makiri iduhuna kahana taudia ahudia, edia doḡoro ta ta ai e abi.
english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

motu: Taunimanima ahudia bini Mose ese e hari, Moab taoradia ai, Ioridane unukahana ai, Ieriko mairiveina kahana ai.
english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

motu: A Levi iduhuna taudia na Mose ese tano ta se henidia; Iehova, Israel Diravana, e hereva heḡeregerena, idia ahudia be ia.
english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

motu: Israel taudia na Kanaan tanona ai ahudia e abi herevadia bini: hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona Israel iduhudia ikwaradia taudia ese tano e haria.
english: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

motu: Iharina na mari amo, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, iduhu taurahani-ta bona iduhu kahana edia.
english: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

motu: A iduhu rua bona iduhu kahana na Mose ese ahudia e henidia Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai. Levi iduhuna na ahuna se henia;
english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

motu: a Iosef garana na iduhu rua, Manase iduhuna bona Efraim iduhuna. Levi taudia na tano ta asie henidia, a bae noholai hanuadia mo e henidia, bona rei gabudia, edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia iubulaidia.
english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

motu: Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena, Israel taudia na unu e kara toma: tano na e haria.
english: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

motu: Iuda taudia na Iosua dekena ela, Gilgal ai. Bena Kaleb lefune, Kenisi tauna, ese e hereva henia, eto, Oi dibamu Iehova ese oi herevamu bona lau herevagu na Mose, Dirava ena tau, ede e herevalai henia toma, Kadebaranea ai.
english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that Yahweh spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

motu: Lauegu mauri laḡanidia na hari-ahui negana ai, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e siaigu, Kade-baranea amo bainala, tano baina hasinadoa, eto; bena tano sivaraina na loulaia, lalogu na hadailaia heḡereḡerena.
english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of Yahweh sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

motu: Tadikakagu, e bamogu taudia, ese taunimanima lalodia e hamanokadiava; a lau ese Iehova, egu Dirava, na badinaia tarika-tarikava.
english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.

motu: Una dina ai Mose e gwau hamata, eto, Momokani, oi aemu vada e moia tao tanona na emu tano ai bainela, oiemu bona oi garamu edia, ela bona hanaihanai, badina be Iehova, emu Dirava, vada o badinaia tarika-tarika.
english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed Yahweh my God.’

motu: Harihari a itagu, Iehova ese vada e hamaurigu, ena hereva heḡereḡerena, ini laḡani hari-ahui ima lalodiai, Israel dounu tano ḡaḡaena ai e laolaova ai na Iehova ese ina hereva Mose e hamaorolaia dinana amo ema bona hari; harihari egu mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ahui ima.
english: “Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.

motu: Hari dina ai egu goada na doini mia, Mose ese e siaigu dinana ai heḡereḡerena; tuari ai eiava lao mai ai egu goada na heḡereḡere, unu dina ai bona hari ina dina ai danu.
english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

motu: Taunabunai, ina ororo tanona una dina ai Iehova ese e herevalaia na harihari ba henigu. Badina be una dina ai harina o kamonai Anakim taudia na unuseni ai, o kamonai danu edia hanua na babada bona mai maḡudia. Reana Iehova ese baine bamogu, bena baina luludia lasi, Iehova ena hereva hegereḡerena.
english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”

motu: Bena Iosua ese e hanamoa, Heberon tanona na Kaleb lefune e henia, ena tano korikori ai bainela.
english: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

motu: Taunabunai Heberon na Kaleb lefune, Kenisi tauna, ena tano, ema bona harihari, badina be ia ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, e badinaia tarika-tarika.
english: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed Yahweh, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

motu: Hari Heberon ladana gunana na Kiriat-araba. Una Araba na herea tauna Anakim besena ai. Una negana ai tuari e doko, bona tano na e laḡa ani.
english: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

motu: Iuda iduhuna taudia na ahudia e abi, edia doḡoro ta ta ai. Edia tano na diho kahana e laomu, ela bona Edom hetoana bona Sin tano ḡagaena, diho kahana korikori ai.
english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

motu: Edia tano hetoana diho kahana ai na Tadi Gohuna dokona, diho kahana e vaira henia taberona amo ela.
english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

motu: Akrabim e dae henia tanona diho kahana amo ela, ela bona Sin; unu amo Kade-baranea diho kahana amo bona Hesron badibadina amo ela, ela bona Adara. Unu amo Karaka e lao henia,
english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

motu: bona unu amo Asamon ma e lao henia; bena Aigupto Dokana badibadinai kone ai e hadoko. Emui tano hetoana diho kahana ai bunai.
english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

motu: Edia tano hetoana mairiveina kahana ai na Tadi Gohuna isena, ela bona Ioridane sinavaina na una gohu ai eha lasi gabuna ai. Bona mirigini kahana ai tano hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina eha lasi gabuna taberona amo ela,
english: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

motu: ela bona Bete-hogla. Bena Bet-araba mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Bohan Ruben ena nadi.
english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

motu: Unu amo Akoro kourana amo ela, ela bona Debiri. Bena mirigini kahana amo ela, Gilgal dalana ai. Hari Gilgal ese Adumimi e dae henia tanona e vaira henia, koura diho kahana ai. Hari tano hetoana ma ela, En-semese ranudia badibadidia amo, ela bona En-rogele.
english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

motu: En-rogele amo ma ela, Hinom natuna ena koura amo, ela bona Iebusu ororona (ladana ta be Ierusalem) diho kahana. Unu amo ma ela, ela bona Hinom kourana unukahana ororona dorina ai, lahara kahana ai, Refaim kourana dokona mirigini kahana ai.
english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

motu: Una ororo dorina amo tano hetoana Ina ela, ela bona Nefetoa ranudia; ma unu amo ela, ela bona Efron ororona hanuadia; unu amo e hegeḡe lao, ela bona Baala (ia ladana ta be Kiriatiearimi).
english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

motu: Ma Baala lahara kahana amo e heḡeḡe lao, ela bona Seiri ororona; bena learimi ororona (ladana ta be Kesalono) mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Bete-semese, bena Timuna badibadina amo ela.
english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

motu: Bena Ekron ororona mirigini kahana amo ela, e heḡeḡe lao, ela bona Sikerono; ma unu amo ela bona Baala ororona; bena kone ai e lasi, labnele ai.
english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

motu: Lahara kahana edia tano hetoana na Davara Badana konena. Iuda iduhuna taudia edia doḡoro ta ta ai e henidia tanona hetoana bunai.
english: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

motu: Iosua ese Kaleb lefune ahuna e henia Iuda iduhuna taudia bogaragidiai, Iehova ese e hagania hegereḡerena. Ia ahuna na Kiriat-araba (hari Araba na Anak tamana), ladana ta be Heberon.
english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

motu: Bena Kaleb ese Anak garana tatoi unu amo e luludia lasi, Sesai bona Ahiman bona Talmai.
english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

motu: Una murinai ia ese Debiri taudia e tuari henidia. Debiri ladana gunana be Kiriatasefere.
english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

motu: Kaleb eto, Kiriata-sefere baine hadarerea bona baine abia tauna na lau ese natugu kekenina Aksa baina henia, ia adavana.
english: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

motu: Bena Otoniele Kena, Kaleb natuna lahaina, ese e abia, taunabunai Kaleb ese natuna kekenina Aksa e henia, ia adavana ai e halaoa.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

motu: Raruosi e headava murinai, hahine na adavana ese lalona e ania, tamana baine noia, tano ta baine henia. Hahine na ena doniki amo e diho negana ai na Kaleb ese e nanadaia, eto, Emu ura be dahaka?
english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

motu: Hahine na e haere henia, eto, Harihari ḡauna ta a henigu: egu noho gabuna vada o henigu diho kahana ai; harihari ranu gabudia danu henigu. Bena Kaleb ese ranu gabudia e henia, atai kahana ai bona hen kahana ai.
english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So|strong="H5414" * he|strong="H3588" * gave|strong="H5414" * her|strong="H5414" * the|strong="H3588" * upper|strong="H5942" * springs|strong="H1543" * and|strong="H4325" * the|strong="H3588" * lower|strong="H8482" * springs|strong="H1543" *.

motu: Iuda iduhuna taudia ahudia bini, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

motu: Iuda taudia edia hanua diho kahana, Edom ena tano hetoana badinai, bini: Kabsele bona Edere bona laguru,
english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

motu: bona Kina bona Dimona bona Adada,
english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

motu: bona Kede bona Hasoro bona Itnan,
english: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

motu: bona Sifi bona Telem bona Bealoto,
english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

motu: bona Hasoro-hadata bona Kerioto-hesron (ladana ta be Hasoro),
english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

motu: bona Amama bona Sema bona Molada,
english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

motu: bona Hasara-gada bona Hesemon bona Bete-pelete,
english: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

motu: bona Hasara-sual bona Bere-sieba bona Bisiotia,
english: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

motu: bona Baala bona Imi bona Eseme,
english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

motu: bona Eltolad bona Kesili bona Horoma,
english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

motu: bona Siklag bona Madamana bona Sansana,
english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

motu: bona Lebaoto bona Silihim bona Ain bona Rimon: hanua iboudiai na ruahui taurahani-ta, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

motu: Bona taora ai, Estaol bona Sora bona Asna,
english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

motu: bona Sanoa bona En-ganim bona Tapua bona Enam,
english: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

motu: bona laramutu bona Adulama bona Soko bona Aseka,
english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

motu: bona Saaraimi bona Aditaim bona Gedera bona Gederotaim: hanua gwauta-hani mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

motu: Senan danu, bona Hadasa bona Migdal-gad,
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

motu: bona Dilean bona Mispe bona lokotele,
english: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

motu: bona Lakisi bona Boskata bona Eglon,
english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

motu: bona Kabon bona Lahamam bona Kitilisi,
english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

motu: bona Gederoto bona Bete-dagon bona Naamaha bona Makeda: hanua gwauta-tauratoi mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

motu: Libna danu, bona Etere bona Asana,
english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

motu: bona Ifta bona Asna bona Nesib,
english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

motu: bona Keila bona Aksib bona Maresa: hanua taurahani-ta, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

motu: Ekron danu, mai ena hanua bona ena hanua maraḡidia ida;
english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

motu: bona Ekron amo ela bona davara, Asdod kahana hanuadia iboudiai mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

motu: Asdod danu, mai ena hanua bona ena hanua maraḡidia ida; bona Gasa, mai ena hanua bona ena hanua maraḡidia ida; ela bona Aigupto Dokana bona Davara Badana konena.
english: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

motu: Ororo kahadia ai, Samiri bona latiri bona Soko,
english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

motu: bona Dana bona Kiriata-sana (ladana ta be Debiri),
english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

motu: bona Anab bona Estemo bona Anim,
english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

motu: bona Gosen bona Holon bona Gilo: hanua gwauta-ta mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
