english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

motu: Arab danu, bona Duma bona Esan,
english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

motu: bona lanim bona Bete-tapua bona Afeka,
english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

motu: bona Humuta bona Kiriat-araba (ladana ta be Heberon), bona Sioro: hanua taurahani-ta mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

motu: Maono danu, bona Karamele bona Sifi bona luta,
english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

motu: bona Iesrele bona Iokodeam bona Sanoa,
english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

motu: bona Kain bona Gibea bona Timuna: hanua gwauta mai edia hanua maragidia ida.
english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

motu: Halahulu danu, bona Bete-suru bona Gedoro,
english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

motu: bona Maarata bona Bet-anoto bona El-tekon: hanua tauratoi mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

motu: Kiriata-baal danu (ia ladana ta be Kiriat-ieanmi), bona Raba: hanua rua mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

motu: Tano ḡaḡaena ai, Bet-araba bona Midin bona Sekaka,
english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

motu: bona Nibsan, damena hanuana, bona En-gedi: hanua tauratoi mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

motu: A Iuda taudia na asi goadadia Iebusu taudia, Ierusalem ai e nohova taudia, bae luludia lasi; taunabunai Iebusu taudia bona Iuda taudia na Ierusalem ai e noho heboumu ema bona harihari.
english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

motu: Iosef garana edia tano hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina, Ieriko badibadinai, Ieriko ranu gabudia mairiveina kahana ai, amo e matamaia; tano ḡaḡaena ela, bena ororo kahadia amo ela, Ieriko amo ela bona Betele.
english: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

motu: Betele amo ma ela, ela bona Lusu, ma unu amo ela, ela bona Ataroto: Araki taudia edia tano hetoana bunai.
english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

motu: Bena lahara kahana ela, ela bona laflete taudia edia tano hetoana; ma unu amo ela, ela bona Bete-horono henu hanuana hetoana; ma unu amo ela, ela bona Gesere. Unu amo e lasi, kone ai e hadoko.
english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

motu: Iosef natuna, Manase bona Efraim, ese ahudia e abi. Efraim taudia ahudia
english: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

motu: Efraim taudia edia tano hetoadia, edia doḡoro ta ta amo e abidia tanodia, na iniheto. Ataroto-adara amo ela, ela bona Bete-horono atai hanuana.
english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

motu: Unu amo davara kahana ela; Mikimetata na mirigini kahana ai; ma mairiveina kahana ela, ela bona Taanata-silo, ela bona lanoa mairiveina kahana ai.
english: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

motu: Ianoa amo e diho ela, ela bona Ataroto bona Naara, bena Ieriko badibadina amo ela, ela bona Ioridane sinavaina ai e hadoko.
english: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

motu: Tapua amo lahara kahana ma ela, ela bona Kana Dokana; unu amo kone ai e hadoko. Efraim taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta amo e abi.
english: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

motu: Hanua haida danu, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida, Manase taudia edia tano ai, e gwauraidia hidi Efraim taudia edia.
english: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Kanaan taudia Gesere ai e nohova na asie luludia lasi; taunabunai Kanaan taudia na Efraim taudia bogaragidiai e nohomu bona idia isiaidia e lao henimu mai hekwarahidia ida ema bona harihari.
english: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

motu: Manase iduhuna taudia ese ahudia e abi; hari Manase na Iosef natuna roboana. Makiri be Manase natuna roboana bona Gilead tamana: ia ese Gilead tanona bona Basan tanona e abi, badina be ia na tuari tauna.
english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

motu: Manase iduhuna taudia oredia danu ahudia e abi, edia doḡoro ta ta amo: Abiesere ena, bona Helek ena, bona Asriel ena, bona Sekem ena, bona Hetere ena, bona Semida ena: Manase Iosef garana mamaruanedia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

motu: Selofehas, Hefere Gilead natuna, Makiri Manase lubuna, na asi natuna maruanena, hahine mo haida. Natuna hahinedia ladadia bini: Mahala bona Noa bona Hogla bona Milka bona Tirisa.
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

motu: Idia laimaosi na ela, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona lohia taudia vairadiai e gini, eto, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, varavaramai ida ahumai baine henimai eto. Bena Iehova ena haheḡani hegereḡerena, ia ese ahudia e henidia, tamadia lahaidia ida.
english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of Yahweh he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

motu: Taunabunai, Manase iduhuna ese ahu gwauta e abidia; bona Gilead bona Basan tanodia danu, Ioridane sinavaina unukahanai;
english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

motu: badina be Manase garana hahinedia na ahudia e abi, mamaruanedia ida. A Manase iduhuna kahana ese Gilead tanona e abia.
english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

motu: Manase taudia edia tano hetoana na Asere amo ela, ela bona Mikimetata, Sekem mairiveina kahana ai. Unu amo ia na diho kahana ela, ela bona En-tapua taudia edia tano.
english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

motu: Tapua tanona na Manase taudia edia tano; a Tapua hanuana, Manase taudia edia tano hetoana ai, na Efraim taudia edia hanua.
english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

motu: Unu amo tano hetoana ma ela, ela bona sinavai maragina ladana Kana. Sinavai diho kahana hanuadia na Efraim taudia edia, Manase taudia edia hanua bogaragidiai. Manase taudia edia tano hetoana na sinavai mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona kone ai e hadoko.
english: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

motu: Diho kahana tanona na Efraim taudia edia; mirigini kahana tanona na Manase taudia edia. Hetoa na davara. Mirigini kahana ai na Asere taudia edia tano; mairiveina kahana ai na Isakara taudia edia tano.
english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

motu: Isakara taudia bona Asere taudia edia tano ai ini hanua na Manase taudia edia: Bete-seana mai ena hanua maragidia ida; Ibleam mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; Doro mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; En-doro mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; Taanak mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; Megido mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida; ororo toiosi hanuadia bunu.
english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

motu: A Manase taudia na asi goadadia unu hanua bae abidia vaitani; Kanaan taudia ese una tano dounu e noholaia.
english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

motu: Israel taudia na e goada e laova negana ai, idia ese Kanaan taudia e abidia, edia hesiai taudia ai e halaodia, a asie luludia lasi.
english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

motu: Bena Iosef iduhuna taudia ese Iosua e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka dainai oi na tano tamona vada o henimai, ai ahumai ai bainela? Ai na hutuma, Iehova ese emai iduhu vada e hanamoa dainai.
english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because Yahweh has blessed us so far?”

motu: Iosua ese e haere henidia, eto, Umui na hutuma, bona Efraim taudia edia tano ororo kahadia ai na dia bada o tomu; matona, uda baola, emui sega ba tara, Perisi taudia edia tano ai bona Refaim taudia edia tano ai.
english: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

motu: Iosef iduhuna taudia ma eto, Ororo kahadia na dia heḡereḡere ai emai ai; a Kanaan taudia taora ai e nohomu na mai edia auri kariotadia; Bete-seana mai ena hanua maraḡidia taudia, bona Iesrele kourana ai e nohomu taudia danu.
english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

motu: Bena Iosua ese Iosef iduhuna taudia, Efraim taudia bona Manase taudia, ma e haere henidia, eto, Umui na hutuma, bona emui goada na herea; ahu tamona mo basio abia,
english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

motu: a ororo kahana idoinai na emui. Ena be uda, to ba taraia, bona bavabia, ela bona ena hetoa iboudiai. Ena be Kanaan taudia na mai edia auri kariotadia bona mai goadadia, to umui ese ba luludia lasi.
english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

motu: Israel besena taudia ibouboudiai na Silo ai e hebou, unuseni ai hebou kalagana e haginia: tano idoinai vada e darere idia vairadiai.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

motu: Israel iduhudia hitu ese ahudia do asie abi.
english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese Israel taudia e gwau henidia, eto, Ela bona edena nega ai ba halahemu, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, vada e henimui tanona lalonai basio raka vareai bona ahumui basio abi?
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?

motu: Iduhu ta ta amo tatau tatoi tatoi amo bavabidia hidi; bena lau ese baina siaidia, baela, tano ai bae loa eva-eva, sivaraina bae torea, ahudia iabidia totona; bena dekegu bae lou mai.
english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

motu: Bae haria, ahu hitu. Iuda iduhuna na ena hetoa lalonai baine noho, diho kahana ai, bona Iosef natuna edia iduhu na edia hetoa lalodiai bae noho, mirigini kahana ai.
english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

motu: Tano sivaraina ba torea, kaha hitu ai, bena revarevana na lau dekegu ai ba mailaia. Bena lau ese umui emui ai mari baina kara, Iehova, eda Dirava, vairanai.
english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

motu: A Levi taudia na asi ahudia umui padamui ai, badina be Iehova ena hahelaḡa taudia ai baela: ahudia bunai. Bona Gad iduhuna bona Ruben iduhuna bona Manase iduhuna kahana ese ahudia vada e abi, Ioridane sinavaina mairiveina kahana ai, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henidia gabudia.
english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

motu: Taunabunai, hari tatau e tore isi, Iosua ese e haḡanidia, tano sivaraina bae torea; eto, Aola, ba loa eva-eva, tano sivaraina ba torea, bena ba lou mai; bena lau ese ina Silo ai emui mari baina kara, Iehova vairanai.
english: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh in Shiloh.”

motu: Bena unu tatau ela, tano ai e loa eva-eva, sivaraina na buka ta ai e torea, kaha hitu ai; bena Iosua dekena ma e lou lao, Silo taruhana ai.
english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

motu: Bena Iosua na Silo ai edia mari e kara, Iehova vairanai. Unuseni ai Iosua ese tano e haria, Israel taudia edia, iduhu ta ta ahudia e henidia. Beniamina ahuna
english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

motu: Mari ese e duanaia guna oreana na Beniamina iduhuna, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: edia tano na Iuda iduhuna bona Iosef iduhuna edia tano padadiai.
english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

motu: Mirigini kahana edia tano hetoana na Ioridane sinavaina amo e matamaia; unu amo e dae ela, Ieriko ororona nesena amo ela, mirigini kahana ai, ma ororo amo ela, lahara kahana ai, ela bona Bet-avene tano gagaena ai e hadoko.
english: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

motu: Unu amo hetoa na diho kahana ela, Lusu (ladana ta be Betele) e lao henia, bena Lusu ororona nesena amo ela; unu amo e diho ela, ela bona Ataroto-adara, Bete-horono henu hanuana diho kahana ororona ai.
english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

motu: Hetoa na diho kahana ma ela, Bete-horono diho kahana ororona lahara kahana amo ela, ela bona Kiriata-baal (ladana ta be Kiriat-iearimi) ai e hadoko. Una na Iuda iduhuna hanuana ta. Hetoa bunai, Iahara kahana ai.
english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

motu: Diho kahana ai, hetoa na Kiriat-iearimi badibadinai e matamaia, unu amo ela, ela bona Efron; ma ela, ela bona Nefetoa ranu gabudia.
english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

motu: Unu amo ma ela, ela bona Hinom natuna ena koura e vaira henia ororona baditanona: una na Refaim kourana dokona, mirigini kahana ai. Ma unu amo e diho, Hinom kourana lalonai, Iebusu taudia edia ororo nesena diho kahana ai, ma e diho ela bona En-rogele.
english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

motu: Unu amo hetoa na e heḡege lao, mirigini kahana e lao toma, ela bona En-semese, ma unu amo ela, ela bona Geliloto, Adumimi dara-daena italaina; ma e diho ela, ela bona Bohan Ruben ena Nadi.
english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

motu: Unu amo Bet-araba ororona nesena mirigini kahana amo e hanai, bena e diho ela bona Araba.
english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

motu: Ma unu amo Bete-hogla ororona nesena mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Tadi Gohuna mirigini kahana taberona, Ioridane sinavaina na gohu ai e aru lasi gabuna ai. Hetoa bunai, diho kahana ai.
english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

motu: Mairiveina kahana ai, hetoa na Ioridane sinavaina. Beniamina iduhuna taudia edia tano bunai, edia doḡoro ta ta ai. Unu hetoa Ialodiai do bae noho.
english: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

motu: Beniamina taudia edia hanua, edia doḡoro ta ta ai e abidia, ladadia bini: Ieriko; Bete-hogla; Emekesi;
english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

motu: Bet-araba; Semaraim; Betele;
english: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

motu: Avim; Para; Ofra;
english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

motu: Kefaramoni; Ofni; Geba: hanua gwauta-rua, mai edia hanua maragidia ida.
english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

motu: Ini danu: Gibeon; Rama; Beroto;
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

motu: Mispe; Kefira; Mosa;
english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

motu: Rekem; Iripele; Tarala;
english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

motu: Sela; Ha-elaf; Iebusu (ladana ta be Ierusalem); Gibea; Kiriat-iearimi: hanua gwauta-hani, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida. Beniamina taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

motu: E duanaia oreana iharuana na Simeon iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai: edia tano na Iuda taudia edia tano bogaraginai.
english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

motu: Ahudia bini: Bere-sieba; Sieba; Molada;
english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

motu: Hasara-sual; Bala; Eseme;
english: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

motu: Eltolad Betulu; Horoma;
english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

motu: Siklaḡ Bete-makaboto; Hasara-susa;
english: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

motu: Bete-lebaoto; Saruhene: hanua gwauta-toi mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

motu: Ini danu: Ain; Rimon; Etere; Asana: hanua hani mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

motu: Hanua maraḡidia iboudiai danu, hetabira tanodia ai, na idia edia, ela bona Baalata-bere bona Rama, diho kahana ai. Simeon taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

motu: Simeon taudia edia tano na Iuda taudia edia tano lalonai; badina be Iuda ahuna na bada herea. Una dainai Simeon taudia na ahudia e abi, idia edia tano lalonai. Sebulun ahuna
english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

motu: E duanaia oreana ihatoina na Sebulun iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai. Edia tano e abia ela bona Saridi.
english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

motu: Unu amo hetoana na lahara kahana ai ela, ela bona Mareala, ma ela bona Dabesete; unu amo sinavai maraḡina isena amo ela, Iokoneam mairiveina kahana ai.
english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

motu: A Saridi amo hetoa na mairiveina dina dae kahana ai ela, ela bona Kisloto-taboro;
english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

motu: ma unu amo ela bona Daberata. Bena e dae ela, ela bona Iafia. Unu amo ma ela, mairiveina dina dae kahana ai, ela bona Gata-hefere bona Ete-kasin. Ma unu amo ela, ela bona Rimon bona Nea.
english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

motu: Mirigini kahana ai, hetoa na Hanaton amo ela, ela bona Iftahele kourana ai e hadoko.
english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

motu: Katata bona Nahalala bona Simron bona Idala bona Betelehem danu idia edia. Edia hanua iboudiai na gwauta-rua, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

motu: Sebulun taudia ahudia bunu, edia dogoro ta ta ai: unu hanua e abi, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida. Isakara ahuna
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

motu: E duanaia oreana ihahanina na Isakara iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

motu: Edia tano bini: Iesrele; Kesuloto; Sunem;
english: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

motu: Hafaraim; Sion; Anaharata;
english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

motu: Rabiti; Kision; Ebe;
english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

motu: Remete; En-ganim; En-hada; Bete-pase.
english: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

motu: Edia tano hetoana danu ela, ela bona Taboro bona Sahasuma bona Bete-semese; bena hetoa na Ioridane sinavaina ai e hadoko. Hanua iboudiai na gwautatauratoi, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

motu: Isakara taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maraḡidia. Asere ahuna
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

motu: E duanaia oreana iha-imana na Asere iduhuna, edia doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

motu: Edia tano bini: Helkat bona Hali bona Betene bona Akasaf
english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

motu: bona Alamelek bona Amad bona Misala. Lahara kahana ai, edia tano hetoana na ela, ela bona Karamele bona Sihoro-libnata.
english: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

motu: Una amo mairiveina kahana amo ela, ela bona Bete-dagon bona Sebulun bona Iftahele kourana; ma mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Bet-emek bona Neiele; ma mirigini kahana amo ela, ela bona Kabulu
english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

motu: bona Ebron bona Rehob bona Hamon bona Kana, ma ela bona hanua badana Sidono.
english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

motu: Unu amo hetoa ma ela, ela bona Rama, ela bona maḡu badana hanuana Turo; unu amo ma ela, ela bona Hosa, bona kone ai e hadoko; Mahalab bona Aksib
english: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

motu: bona Umaha bona Afek bona Rehob danu idia edia. Hanua iboudiai na ruahui-rua, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

motu: Asere taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maragidia. Napatali ahuna
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

motu: E duanaia oreana ihatauratoina na Napatali iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

motu: Edia tano hetoana na Helef amo e matamaia, oak * auna Saananim ai amo, bona Adaminekeb bona labnele amo, ela bona Lakumu; bena Ioridane sinavaina ai e hadoko.
english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

motu: Bena hetoa na lahara kahana ai ela, ela bona Asnoto-taboro, ma unu amo ela bona Hukok. Sebulun na diho kahana ai, Asere na lahara kahana ai, bona Iuda na mairiveina kahana ai, Ioridane sinavaina badinai.
english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

motu: Hanua mai maḡudia bini: Sidim, Sere, Hamat, Rakata, Kinerete,
english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

motu: Adama, Rama, Hasoro,
english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

motu: Kede, Edrei, Enhasoro,
english: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

motu: Irono, Migdalele, Horeme, Bet-anata, Bete-seme. Hanua iboudiai na gwauta taurahani-ta, mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida.
english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

motu: Napatali taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maraḡidia. Dan ahuna
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

motu: E duanaia oreana ihahituna na Dan iduhuna, ena doḡoro ta ta ai.
english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

motu: Edia tano bini: Sora; Estaol; Iri-semese;
english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

motu: Saalabin; Aialono; Itla;
english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

motu: Elon; Timuna; Ekron;
english: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

motu: Elteke; Gibeton; Baalata;
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

motu: lehud; Beneberak; Gatarimon;
english: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

motu: Meiakon; Rakon; bona lopa kahana tanodia.
english: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

motu: A Dan taudia edia tano na edia amo e heabi oho: bena e tore isi, Leseme taudia e tuari henidia. Hanua na e abia, bona hanua taudia e aladia ore; bena edia hanua ai e halaoa, e noholaia, bona ladana e hatoa Leseme-dan, senedia e nemaia.
english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

motu: Dan taudia ahudia bunu, edia doḡoro ta ta ai: hanua bona hanua maraḡidia. Tano iharina e haḡuḡurua
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

motu: Tano na e haria vaitani, hetoa iboudiai e gwauraidia ore, bena Israel taudia ese Iosua Nunu ahuna e henia, idia bogaragidiai.
english: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

motu: Iehova ena hahedua dainai idia ese ia e noilaia hanuana e henia, ladana na Timnata-sera, Efraim ororo-tanodia ai. Ia ese hanua ma e hadaia lou, bena e noholaia.
english: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

motu: Tanodia bunu, hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona Israel iduhudia ikwaradia taudia ese mari amo e hari Silo ai, Iehova vairanai, hebou kalagana iduarana ai. Tano iharina na unu e haḡuḡurua toma.
english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

motu: Iehova ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

motu: Israel taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Roho-mauri hanuadia bavabidia hidi, Mose uduna amo na haḡanimui heḡereḡerena.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,

motu: Bena taunimanima ta baine hapididia tauna ese unu baine heau lao: unuseni ai mase tauna varavarana imana amo ba roho mauri.
english: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

motu: Hapadidi tauna na unu hanua ta baine heau henia, bena hanua ikoukouna ai baine gini, hanua tau-badadia vairadiai ia sibona sivaraina baine gwauraia hedinarai. Bena idia ese hanua lalonai bae hakaua vareai, gabu ta bae henia, unuseni ai baine noho.
english: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

motu: Mase tauna varavarana ese bema ḡavaia, hapadidi tauna na basie henia; badina be ia ese dekena tauna e hapadidia, dia badu dainai se alaia mase.
english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

motu: Bena hapadidi tauna na una hanua ai baine noho, ela bona hebou vairanai baine gini, hebou ese baine hahemaoro henia. Ma baine noho, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna badana baine mase; una murinai ia na ena hanua korikon bona ena ruma korikori, e heautania gabuna, ma baine lou henia diba.
english: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

motu: Taunabunai, idia na Kede, Galilea tanona ai, Napatali ororodia ai, bona Sekem, Efraim ororodia ai, bona Kiriat-araba (ladana ta be Heberon), Iuda ororodia ai, e abidia hidi.
english: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

motu: Bona Ioridane sinavaina unukahanai, Ieriko mairiveina kahana ai, idia na Besere, tano ḡaḡaena ororo-taorana ai, Ruben taudia edia, bona Ramoto, Gilead tanona ai, Gad taudia edia, bona Golan, Basan tanona ai, Manase taudia edia, e abidia hidi.
english: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

motu: Hanua bunu idia ese e gwauraidia, Israel taudia iboudiai edia, bona noho hedoa tauna ena: hapadidi tauna na unuseni ai baine heau maun, mase tauna varavarana ese baine alaia mase na garina, ela bona hebou vairanai baine gini.
english: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

motu: Iduhu ikwaradia taudia Levi iduhuna amo na hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara bona Iosua Nunu bona Israel iduhudia ikwaradia taudia dekedia ela,
english: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

motu: Silo ai, Kanaan tanona ai, e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania, ai na hanua haida baia abi, baia noholai, bona rei gabudia danu baia abi, emai seri iubulaidia, eto.
english: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “Yahweh commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese idia ahudia amo Levi taudia edia hanua bona edia rei gabudia e henidia, Iehova ena haheḡani heḡeregerena. Gabudia bini:
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.

motu: Mari ese e duanaia guna oreana na Kohat ena. Levi taudia, hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vevena, ese hanua gwauta-toi mari amo e abidia, Iuda bona Simeon bona Beniamina iduhudia edia tano lalodiai;
english: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

motu: a Kohat ena orea taudia oredia ese hanua gwauta mari amo e abidia, Efraim bona Dan iduhudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana edia tano lalodiai.
english: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

motu: Gereson ena orea taudia ese hanua gwauta-toi mari amo e abidia, Isakara bona Asere bona Napatali iduhudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana edia tano lalodiai, Basan ai.
english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

motu: Merari ena orea taudia ese hanua gwauta-rua e abidia, Ruben bona Gad bona Sebulun iduhudia edia tano lalodiai.
english: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

motu: Ini hanua, mai edia rei gabudia ida, Israel taudia ese Levi taudia e henidia, mari amo, Iehova ese Mose e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.

motu: Iuda iduhuna bona Simeon iduhuna ahudia amo e henidia hanuadia ladadia bini.
english: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:

motu: Levi taudia hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vevena, Kohat oreana ai, mari ese e duanaidia guna taudia,
english: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

motu: edia hanua ta be Kiriat-araba, Anak tamana Araba ena hanua, Iuda ororodia ai, (ladana ta be Heberon), mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

motu: Ḡau tamona, hetabira tanodia bona hanua maraḡidia na Kaleb lefune e henia, ena gabu.
english: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

motu: A hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vevena e henidia tanodia be hari Heberon mai ena rei gabudia ida, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Libna mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

motu: bona latiri mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Estemoa mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Holon mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Debiri mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Ain bona luta bona Bete-semese, mai edia rei gabudia ida. Unu iduhu ruaosi edia amo e abi hanuadia na taurahani-ta.
english: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

motu: Ma Beniamina iduhuna amo e abi hanuadia be Gibeon bona Geba, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Anatoto bona Alamon, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Aaron vevena e henidia hanuadia iboudiai a gwauta-toi.
english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

motu: Kohat oreana taudia oredia, Levi taudia, ese Efraim iduhuna taudia edia amo edia hanua e abidia.
english: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

motu: E henidia hanuadia be Sekem mai ena rei gabudia ida, Efraim ororodia ai, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Gesere mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Kibsaim bona Bete-horono, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

motu: Dan iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Elteke bona Gibeton, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
english: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Aialono bona Gata-rimon, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.

motu: Manase iduhuna kahana taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Taanak bona Gata-rimon, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua rua.
english: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.

motu: Kohat oreana taudia oredia edia hanua iboudiai be gwauta, mai edia rei gabudia ida.
english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

motu: Gereson oreana taudia, Levi taudia, ese Manase iduhuna kahana taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Golan, Basan tanona ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Be-estera, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua rua.
english: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

motu: Isakara iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Kision, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Daberata, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Iaramutu, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Enganim, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.

motu: Asere iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Misala, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Abdon, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Helkat, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Rehob, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.

motu: Napatali iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Kede, Galilea tanona ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Hamoto-doro, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Karatan, mai ena rei gabudia ida: hanua toi.
english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

motu: Gereson oreana taudia edia hanua iboudiai be gwauta-toi, mai edia rei gabudia ida.
english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

motu: Levi taudia oredia, Merari oreana taudia, ese Sebulun iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be lokoneam bona Karata, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
english: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Dimna bona Nahalala, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.

motu: Ruben iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Besere bona lahasa, mai edia rei gabudia ida;
english: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Kedemoto bona Mefata, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

motu: Gad iduhuna taudia edia amo e abi hanuadia be Ramoto, Gilead tanona ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida, hapadidi taudia edia roho-mauri hanuana ta bunai; bona Mahanaim, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

motu: bona Hesebon bona lasere, mai edia rei gabudia ida: hanua hani.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

motu: Levi taudia oredia, Merari oreana taudia, edia hanua iboudiai be gwauta-rua.
english: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.

motu: Levi taudia edia hanua, Israel taudia edia tano lalodiai, iboudiai na hari-ahui taurahani, mai edia rei gabudia ida.
english: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

motu: Ini hanua iboudiai na mai edia rei gabudia.
english: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Israel taudia edia tano e henidia, senedia e gwaurai henidia hamata tanona idoinai e henidia: una tano e abia, edia tano, bena e noholaia.
english: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

motu: Bena Iehova ese laḡa-ani e henidia, edia tano kahadia iboudiai, senedia e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena. Inaidia iboudiai ta ese se laodia ahu diba, badina be Iehova ese inaidia iboudiai na idia imadia ai e atodia.
english: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.

motu: Iehova ese ena gwau-hamata namodia, Israel taudia e gwaurai henidia hamata gaudia, na ta se reaia: iboudiai ia ese e hamomokanidia.
english: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

motu: Bena Iosua ese Ruben bona Gad iduhudia taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia e boiridia,
english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

motu: e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e haḡanilaimui karadia iboudiai vada o kara, lau eregu danu vada o kamonai, vada na haḡanilaimui karadia iboudiai vada o kara.
english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

motu: Varavaramui asio rakatanidia dina momo Ialodiai ema bona hari ina dina ai. Iehova, emui Dirava, ena hahedua vada o badinaia.
english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.

motu: Harihari Iehova, emui Dirava, ese varavaramui na laḡa-ani vada e henidia, e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena: taunabunai a lou lao, emui noho gabuna, emui tano korikori, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henimui tanona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, ba lou henia.
english: Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan.

motu: A nahuamui ba toho, Iehova ena hesiai tauna Mose ese e henimui haheḡanidia bona taravatudia ba badinadia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia, ena dala iboudiai ba raka bona ena haheḡani ba badinadia, bona ia enai ba tao bona ia isiaina ba lao heni mai lalomui idoidiai bona mai laumamui idoidiai.
english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

motu: Taunabunai Iosua ese e hanamodia, bena e siaidia. Bena idia na edia noho gabuna ela.
english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

motu: Manase iduhuna kahana be Mose ese edia tano e henidia Basan ai, a iduhu kahana be Iosua ese edia tano e henidia, Ioridane sinavaina lahara kahana ai, varavaradia badibadidiai. Bena Iosua ese e siaidia, edia noho gabudia baela, negana ai, ia ese e hanamodia,
english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

motu: eto, Emui noho gabudia ba lou lao, mai kohumui logora ida: boromakau momo herea, bona silver *, bona gold *, bona auri labora-labora, bona auri, bona dabua momo. Ḡau tamona, tuari ai o abi kohudia na varavaramui ida ba heharilai heheni.
english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

motu: Taunabunai Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana e lou, Israel taudia e rakatanidia Silo ai, Kanaan tanona ai; edia tano korikori, Gilead tanona, e lou henia, Iehova ena haheḡani Mose uduna amo e henidia dainai e abia tanona bunai.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

motu: Idia na Ioridane sinavaina isena ai e kau, Kanaan tanona ai. Unuseni ai Ruben iduhuna bona Gad iduhuna taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia ese ihaboulaina patana bada-hereana ta e larebaia, Ioridane sinavaina isena ai.
english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese harina e kamonai: haida eto, A itaia, Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia ese ihaboulaina patana ta vada e larebaia, Kanaan tanona hetoana ai. Ioridane sinavaina isena ai, Israel taumui emui tano lalonai.
english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

motu: Israel taudia ese una hari e kamonai, bena iboudiai na Silo ai e hebou, bae tuari henidia eto.
english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese hahelaḡa tauna Eleasara natuna Fineha e siaia, Gilead tanona bainela, Ruben bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia dekediai.
english: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

motu: Hanua lohiadia gwauta danu ia ida e siaidia, Israel iduhudia ta ta amo; iboudiai na edia iduhu ikwaradia taudia.
english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

motu: Idia na Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia dekediai e kau, Gilead tanona ai; bena e hamaorodia, eto,
english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

motu: Iehova ena orea idoinai ini e gwau tomamu: Ina kerere vada o havaraia anina be dahaka? Israel Diravana enai vada o kerere; hari dina ai Iehova ena amo vada o raka oho, vada o gwau edeede henia, ihaboulaina patana vada o larebaia.
english: “The whole congregation of Yahweh says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following Yahweh, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against Yahweh?

motu: Eda kara dika Peoro ai dia bada a? Ena be Iehova ena orea latanai hisihisi e kau, to una dika amo do asita ḡoeva.
english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,

motu: Matona, hari dina ai Iehova ena amo ba raka oho a? Hari dina ai umui ese Iehova o gwau edeede heniamu; kerukeru ia ese Israel besena idoinai baine badu henida.
english: that you must turn away today from following Yahweh? It will be, since you rebel today against Yahweh, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

motu: Emui tano basinema ḡoeva, boma hanai, Iehova ena tano, ena dubu e ginimu tanona, lalonai ahumui boma abi, ai bogaragimai ai. A Iehova basio gwau edeede henia, bona ai danu gwau-edeede taudia ai basio halaomai; ihaboulaina patana idauna ta, dia Iehova, eda Dirava, ena, basio larebaia.
english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of Yahweh, in which Yahweh’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against Yahweh, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than Yahweh our God’s altar.

motu: Akan Sera na e gwau ahu ḡaudia ai e kerere, bena badu na Israel oreana idoinai latanai e kau, ani? Davana na mase, bona dia ia sibona latanai.
english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

motu: Bena Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase iduhuna kahana taudia ese Israel ikwaradia taudia e haere henidia, eto,
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

motu: Dirava korikori na Iehova! Dirava korikori na Iehova! Ia dibana, bona Israel danu baine diba: bema Iehova a gwau edeede henia eiava vairanai a kara havara, hari dina ai basio hamaurimai.
english: “The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, the Mighty One, God, Yahweh, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against Yahweh (don’t save us today),

motu: Eiava bema hari ihaboulaina patana a larebaia Iehova idadaraina totona, eiava latanai ḡole-oho bouboudia eiava flaoa bouboudia eiava herohemaino bouboudia baia hahelaḡadia totona, Iehova ese davana baine henimai.
english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following Yahweh; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let Yahweh himself require it.

motu: Lasi, ai na a larebaia, kerukeru vanegai umui natumui ese ai natumai bae gwau henidia na garina, baeto “Iehova, Israel Diravana, enai dahaka bavabia?
english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with Yahweh, the God of Israel?

motu: Iehova ese Ioridane sinavaina na hetoa ai vada e halaoa, ai bona umui Ruben taumui bona Gad taumui padadai; umui na asi ahumui Iehova enai.” Natumui unu bema gwau toma, bena ai natumai ese Iehova itomadiho-henina bema rakatania.
english: For Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in Yahweh.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing Yahweh.

motu: Taunabunai, a hereva heheni, ato, Mani ihaboulaina patana ta aita larebaia, dia gole-oho boubouna eiava boubou ta ḡauna,
english: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

motu: a toa, ai bona umui padadai, bona ai garamai bona umui garamui padadiai, ai na Iehova itomadiho-henina totona emai ḡole-oho bouboudia bona emai herohemaino bouboudia bona emai boubou haida a hahelaḡadiamu; kerukeru vanegai umui natumui ese ai natumai bae gwau henidia na garina, baeto “Umui na asi ahumui Iehova enai”.
english: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of Yahweh before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in Yahweh.’

motu: Emai lalo-hadai binai: kerukeru vanegai ai eiava ai garamai unu boma gwau henimai toma, ai na baiama haere, baiama toma “A itaia, ina na Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana idaidana; tamamai ese e larebaia, dia ḡole-oho bouboudia eiava boubou haida daidiai, a toa, ai bona umui padadai”.
english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of Yahweh’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

motu: Ai na Iehova asia gwau edeede henia, lasi vaitani. Iena amo asia raka oho, lasi vaitani. Ai na ihaboulaina patana asia Iarebaia, gole-oho bouboudia eiava flaoa bouboudia eiava boubou haida ihahelaḡadia, Iehova, eda Dirava, ena ihaboulaina patana, ena dubu vairanai e ginimu ḡauna, latanai e karamu hegereḡerena.
english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against Yahweh, and turn away today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides Yahweh our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Fineha bona hanua Iohiadia, Israel ikwaradia taudia, ese Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase taudia edia hereva e kamonai, bena lalodia e namo.
english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Fineha Eleasara ese Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia bona Manase taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Harihari ai na dibamai Iehova na ita bogaragidai, badina be umui na asio kara havara Iehova vairanai, a Israel na Iehova imana amo vada o hamauridia.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahweh. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of Yahweh’s hand.”

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Fineha Eleasara bona hanua lohiadia ese Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia e rakatanidia Gilead tanona ai, e lou lao, Kanaan tanona ela, Israel taudia dekediai; bona idia vairadiai harina e piua.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

motu: Bena Israel taudia na e moale, una hereva dainai. Israel taudia ese Dirava e hanamoa, bona tuari herevadia, Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia edia tano bae habuaia tari herevadia, na e hadoko.
english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

motu: A Ruben taudia bona Gad taudia ese una ihaboulaina patana ladana e hatoa Toa: idia eto, Badina be ia na toa, ita padadai, Iehova na Dirava toana.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God.”

motu: Nega daudau vada ela. Iehova ese Israel taudia na laḡa-ani e henidia, inaidia iboudiai e tuidia. Iosua vada e buruka, ena mauri laḡanidia na hoho.
english: After many days, when Yahweh had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

motu: Bena Iosua ese Israel besena idoinai e boiridia, edia tau-badadia bona edia hanua Iohiadia bona edia hahemaoro taudia bona edia heitatao taudia e hereva henidia, eto, Lau vada na buruka, egu maun laḡanidia na hoho.
english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

motu: Vada o itaia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ini bese ibolidiai ede vada e karadia toma umui daimui ai; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui daimui ai vada e tuari.
english: You have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is Yahweh your God who has fought for you.

motu: A kamonai: dounu nonoho besedia edia tano na vada na habuadia tari besedia edia tano ida vada na henimui, Ioridane sinavaina amo eIa bona Davara Badana, lahara kahana ai.
english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese baine doridia lao, vairamui ai baine luludia lasi; edia tano do bavabia, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.

motu: Taunabunai ba haheauka, Mose ena taravatu bukana ai e tore herevadia iboudiai ba badinadia; iena amo basio raka siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

motu: Ini bese haida, doini bogaragimui ai e nohomu, ida basio hetura; edia dirava ladadia basio hato, Iadadia ai basio gwau hamata, isiaidia basio Iao heni, bona basio toma henidia diho.
english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ba badinaia, gunaguna ema bona harihari vada o badinaia hegereḡerena.
english: but hold fast to Yahweh your God, as you have done to this day.

motu: Badina be Iehova ese bese badadia bona goadadia na umui vairamui ai vada e luludia lasi: tau ta ese se laomui ahu diba, ema bona hari dina ai.
english: “For Yahweh has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.

motu: Umui ta ese daha ta iluludia mai dibana; badina be Iehova, emui Dirava, ese umui daimui ai e tuarimu, e gwau henimui hamata heḡereḡerena.
english: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.

motu: Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho; Iehova, emui Dirava, ba lalokau henia.
english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.

motu: Badina be boma raka muri, ini bese kwabukwabudia doini bogaragimui ai e nohomu ida boma hetura, edia ulato boma adavadia, bona emui ulato boma henidia bae adavadia,
english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

motu: ba diba momokani Iehova, emui Dirava na ini bese basine luludia lasi vairamui ai; do bae noho, idoa eiava rikiriki na heheto, emui ai, eiava ikwadi ḡauna ohemui ai eiava ginigini matamui ai na heheto, ela bona ina tano namona, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui tanona, lalona amo ba boio.
english: know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you.

motu: Lau na tanobada taudia iboudiai e lao bubunimu dalana amo ba laomu. Umui iboumui ai vada o diba, lalomui ai bona laumamui ai Iehova, emui Dirava, ese ena gwau-hamata namodia iboudiai emui ai vada e hamomokanidia, ta se reaia. Iboudiai vada e momokani, ta se moru.
english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

motu: A Iehova, emui Dirava, ena gwau-hamata namodia emui ai vada e momokani heḡereḡerena, Iehova ese ḡau dikadia danu latamui ai baine hadihodia diba, ela bona baine habuamui tari, ina tano namona, Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui tanona, lalona amo ba boio.
english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you,

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, ese vada e henimui taravatuna na boma tataia utu, dirava idaudia isiaidia boma lao heni bona boma toma henidia diho, ia ese unu baine karamui toma: Iehova ena badu emui ai baine ḡaraḡara, bena vada e henimui tanona namona amo ba boio haraḡa.
english: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”

motu: Iosua ese Israel iduhudia iboudiai e haboudia Sekem ai, bona edia tau-badadia bona edia hanua lohiadia bona edia hahemaoro taudia bona edia heitatao taudia e boiridia. Bena idia na Dirava vairanai e gini.
english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

motu: Bena Iosua ese taunimanima iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Senemui negadia ai Tera, Abraham bona Nahoro tamadia, na Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai e nohova; unuseni ai idia ese dirava idaudia e toma henidia diho.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.

motu: Bena senemui Abraham na sinavai unukahana amo na abia, Kanaan tanona idoinai na hakaua hanai, natuna momo na henia; Isaak danu na henia,
english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, + 24:3 or, seed * and gave him Isaac.

motu: bona Isaak na Iakob bona Esau na henia. Esau na Seiri ororodia na henia, ena tano ai bainela; a Iakob mai natuna ida na Aigupto ela.
english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

motu: Bena Mose bona Aaron na siaidia, Aigupto na hahisia, bogaraginai na kara karadia amo; una murinai na hakaumui lasi.
english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

motu: Tamamui na Aigupto amo na hakaudia lasi; bena kone ai o lasi; bena Aigupto taudia ese tamamui e ḡavadia, mai edia kariota bona mai edia hosigui taudia, ela bona Davara Kakakakana.
english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

motu: Bena tamamui ese Iehova e tai henia negana ai, ia ese umui bona Aigupto taudia padadia e havaburaia, davara amo e habubunidia. Aigupto ede na kara henia toma na matamui ese e itaia. Murinai tano ḡaḡaena ai o nohova, nega daudau.
english: When they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.

motu: Bena na hakaumui vareai, Amoro taudia edia tano Ialonai, Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai; idia ese e tuan henimui, bena imamui ai na atodia. Edia tano o abia; lau ese umui vairamui ai na habuadia tari.
english: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

motu: Bena Balak Siporo, Moab pavapavana, e tore isi, Israel e tuari henia; ia ese Balaam Beoro e boiria, baine uduguiraimui totona;
english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

motu: a Balaam asina hakala henia, taunabunai ia ese e hanamomui; ia imana amo na hamaurimui.
english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

motu: Una murinai Ioridane sinavaina o hanaia, Ieriko ai o kau. Bena Ieriko taudia ese e tuari henimui; Amoro taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Girigasa taudia bona Hivi taudia bona Iebusu taudia ese danu e tuari henimui; a lau ese umui imamui ai na atodia.
english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

motu: Nanigo danu na siaidia vairamui ai, idia ese Amoro pavapavadia raruosi na umui vairamui ai e luludia lasi, dia emui dare ese bona dia emui peva ese.
english: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

motu: Asio ruaia tanona na henimui; asio hadai hanuadia o noholai; asio hado imeadia, vine imeadia bona olive imeadia, huahuadia o ani.
english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova garina ba gari, ia isiaina ba lao heni mai momokanimui bona mai kamonaimui ida. Senemui ese Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai bona Aigupto ai e toma henidia diho diravadia ba rakatanidia, Iehova isiaina ba lao heni.
english: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

motu: A Iehova isiaina ilao-henina ai boma daradara, hari ina dina ai ba haeroa, daika isiaina ba lao heni, senemui sinavai unukahana ai isiaidia e lao heni diravadia, eiava Amoro taudia edia dirava, ina o noholaiamu tanona diravadia. A lau be egu ruma taudia ida Iehova isiaina baia lao heni.
english: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

motu: Bena hebou taudia ese e haere henia, eto, Ai ese Iehova basia rakatania, dirava idaudia basia toma henidia diho, lasi vaitani.
english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

motu: Badina be Iehova, eda Dirava, ese ita bona tamada na Aigupto tanona amo bona iḡui rumana amo e hakauda lasi, bona unu toa badadia e karava ita vairadai, bona eda laolao dalana idoinai ai e hamauridava, edia tano ta rakadia hanai taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
english: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

motu: Iehova ese danu taunimanima iboudiai na ita vairadai e luludia lasi, Amoro taudia una tano ai e nohova ibouboudiai e luludia lasi. Taunabunai ai danu Iehova isiaina baia lao heni, badina be ia na emai Dirava.
english: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

motu: A Iosua ese hebou taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova isiaina basio lao heni diba; badina be ia na Dirava helaḡana, vageḡe Diravana; ia na emui kara dika bona emui kara havara basine gwaudia tao.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

motu: Iehova boma rakatania bona dirava idaudia isiaidia boma lao heni, ia ese ihanamomui baine hadokoa, ma baine hadikamui.
english: If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

motu: Hebou taudia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Lasi, ai na Iehova isiaina baia lao heni.
english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”

motu: Bena Iosua ese e hamaorodia, eto, Emui hereva ihahedinaraina na umui sibomui; Iehova vada o abia hidi, ia isiaina ba lao heni o tomu. Idia na e haere, eto, Ai sibomai ese vada a gwauraia hedinarai.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.” They|strong="H3588" * said, “ We|strong="H3588" * are|strong="H5971" * witnesses|strong="H5707" *.”

motu: Iosua ma eto, Benaini, dirava idaudia bogaragimui ai mimia na ba negedia, bona lalomui ba hamanadadia, Iehova, Israel Diravana, enai.
english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”

motu: Hebou taudia ese Iosua e haere henia, eto, Iehova, eda Dirava, isiaina baia lao heni, ia erena baia kamonai.
english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iosua na hebou taudia ida e herohemaino una dina ai; bona taravatu bona haheḡani e henidia, Sekem ai.
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

motu: Bena Iosua ese unu hereva na Dirava ena taravatu bukana ai e tore; bena nadi badana ta e abia, oak * auna henunai e haginia, Iehova ena gabu helaḡana ai.
english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iosua ese taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, ina nadi na ita ihabadelaida toana ai vada ela; badina be Iehova ese e henida herevadia iboudiai na ina nadi ese vada e kamonai: taunabunai Iehova, emui Dirava, ba koia negana ai, ina nadi ese baine hahemaoro henimui.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all Yahweh’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

motu: Bena Iosua ese idia iboudiai e siaidia karoho, ta ta ena tano ena tano baela. Iosua e mase
english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, Iosua Nunu, Iehova ena hesiai tauna, e mase. Ena laḡani iboudiai na sinahu-ta dikoana gwauta.
english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

motu: Ena tano ai e guria, Timnata-sera ai; una na Efraim ororodia ai, Gaasa ororona mirigini kahana ai.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

motu: Israel taudia ese Iehova isiaina e lao heniva, Iosua ena maun dinadia iboudiai lalodiai, bona tau-badadia, Iosua ena mase murinai dounu e mauriva bona Iehova ena kara Israel taudia ediai na matadia amo e itava taudia, edia mauri dinadia lalodiai danu.
english: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.

motu: Iosef turiana, Israel taudia ese Aigupto amo e mailaidia, na Sekem ai e guridia, Iakob ese Sekem tamana Hamoro ena amo e hoia tanona ai. Davana be silver * monidia sinahu-ta e heni; bena Iosef garana edia tano ai ela. + 24:32 Genese, Karoa 33, siri 19 ba itaia. * Eleasara e mase
english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. + 24:32 Hebrew: kesitahs. A kesitah was a kind of silver coin. * They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

motu: Eleasara Aaron danu e mase; bena Gibea ai e guria, natuna Fineha vada e henia hanuana bunai, Efraim ororodia ai.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.

motu: Iosua ena mase murinai Israel taudia ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Daika ese baine gunalaimai, Kanaan taudia baia tuari henidia negadia ai.
english: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh, + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

motu: Iehova eto, Iuda ese baine gunalaimui; a itaia, tano na ia imana ai vada na atoa.
english: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, + 1:2 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * I have delivered the land into his hand.”

motu: Bena Iuda vevena ese Iuda kakana Simeon vevena e hamaorodia, eto, Ai baia abia tanona aitala, bena Kanaan taudia baita tuari henidia; gabeamo umui bavabia tanona baitala. Taunabunai, Simeon taudia na idia ida ela.
english: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.

motu: Bena Iuda na eha tuari. Bena Iehova ese Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia na idia imadia ai e atodia: gerebu ta + 1:4 Gerebu ta = l0,000. * e hadareredia Besek ai.
english: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

motu: Una Besek ai idia ese Adoni-besek e davaria, bena e tuari henia, Kanaan taudia bona Perisi taudia e hadareredia.
english: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

motu: A Adoni-besek e heau; bena idia ese e ḡavaia ela bona e abia mauri; bena imana sinabadadia bona aena sinabadadia e utudia oho.
english: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

motu: Bena Adoni-besek eto, Pavapava hitu-ahui imadia sinabadadia bona aedia sinabadadia na utudia oho, bena egu pata henunai aniani momorudia e ani; lau ese na kara henidia heḡereḡerena, Iehova ese unu vada e kara henigu toma. Bena idia ese Ierusalem e laohaia: unuseni ai e mase.
english: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God + 1:7 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

motu: Bena Iuda taudia ese Ierusalem e tuari henia, e abia, hanua taudia na dare amo e aladia ore, bena hanua e doua.
english: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
