english: The children of Dan said to him, “Don’t let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall on you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.”

motu: Bena Dan taudia na edia laolao ela; a Mika vada e diba, idia edia goada ese iena goada e hereaiava; bena e lou, ena ruma e lou henia.
english: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

motu: Dan taudia na Mika ese e kara ḡaudia bona ena hahelaḡa tauna e abidia, ela, Laisi ai e kau, asie raivaraivava bona ḡau ta asie laioava taudia na dare amo e aladia mase, bona edia hanua e doua.
english: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.

motu: Asi ihamauridia tauna ta, badina be Sidono na daudau, bona idia na bese ta ida asie hoihoi. Una gabu na Bete-rehob kourana ai. Bena idia ese hanua ma e hadaia lou, bena e noholaia.
english: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

motu: Hanua ladana e hatoa Dan, senedia Dan, Israel natuna, inemaina. A gunaguna una hanua ladana na Laisi.
english: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.

motu: Dan taudia ese Dirava laulauna, e koroa ḡauna, e haginia edia. Ionatan Geresom, Mose tubuna, mai garana ida, na Dan taudia edia hahelaḡa taudia ai ela, ela bona e ḡuidia dinana.
english: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese hari e koroa laulauna, Mika ese e karaia ḡauna, e haginia, Dirava ena dubu na Silo ai e miava negadia iboudiai.
english: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.

motu: Unu dinadia ai, Israel na asi pavapavana negana ai, Levi tauna ta Efraim ororodia ai e nohova, gabu daudau ai. Ia ese hesiai hahinena ta Betelehem-luda amo e abia, e adavaia.
english: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.

motu: Una hahine vada e badu, bena e diho, tamana ena ruma e lou lao, Betelehem-luda ai; hua hani unuseni ai e nohova.
english: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.

motu: Bena adavana e tore isi, ia murina amo ela, baine hamarumarua bena baine hakaua lao eto. Ena hesiai tauna bona doniki rua e laohaidia. Hahine ese tamana ena ruma ai e abia dae; bena tamana ese e itaia negana ai ia danu e abia dae mai moalena ida.
english: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys. She brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young lady saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

motu: Bena ravana, hari hahine tamana, ese e dogoa tao, dina toi; taunabunai e aniani hebou, e inuinu hebou, bona e mahuta unuseni ai.
english: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

motu: Dina ihahanina ai, idia na daba matana ai e tore isi, bena hari Levi tauna e heḡaeḡae, baine raka eto. A hahine tamana ese ravana e noia, eto, Mani bavaniani guna, taumu baine auka, bena ba raka.
english: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

motu: Taunabunai, tatau raruosi e ege diho, e aniani hebou bona e inuinu hebou. Bena hahine tamana ese ma e noia, eto, Mani emu kara do ba mahuta, lalomu baine moale.
english: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”

motu: Hari Levi tauna e tore isi, baine raka eto; a ravana ese e noia loulou, ela bona ma e hekure diho.
english: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

motu: Dina iha-imana ai, ia na daba matana ai e tore isi, baine raka eto. A hahine tamana eto, Taumu do ba ha-aukaia ela bona adorahi. Taunabunai raruosi ma e aniani hebou.
english: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

motu: Bena Levi tauna mai ena hahine bona mai ena hesiai tauna ida e tore isi, bae raka eto. A hahine tamana eto, O itaia, dina e ḡelomu; mani emu kara iniseni ai ba mahuta rani. O itaia, ado vada e rahi; iniseni ai ba noho, lalomu baine moale, ma kerukeru daba matana ai ba tore isi, emu laolao baola, emu ruma ba lou henia.
english: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”

motu: A Levi tauna na se ura unuseni ai baine mahuta. Ia na e tore isi, ela, Iebusu (una na Ierusalem ladana ta) vairanai e kau. Ia na mai ena donih rua, dorudia na mai helai-kau ḡaudia; ena hahine danu na ia ida.
english: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.

motu: Iebusu e raka henia kahi negana ai dina vada e kerekere; bena hesiai tauna ese biaguna e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara aita raka siri, ina Iebusu taudia edia hanua ai baita mahuta.
english: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”

motu: A biaguna ese e haere henia, eto, Basita raka siri, ini idau taudia edia hanua ai basita raka vareai, badina be idia na dia Israel besena taudia. Aita raka hanai, Gibea baitala.
english: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”

motu: Ia ese ena hesiai tauna ma e hamaoroa, eto, Aoma, unu gabu ta aitala, Gibea ai eiava Rama ai baita mahuta.
english: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”

motu: Bena e raka lao, dala ai ela; Gibea vada e kahirakahira, bena dina vada e diho. Una Gibea na Beniamina iduhuna taudia edia hanua.
english: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

motu: Bena dala amo e raka siri, hanua ai bae raka vareai, Gibea ai bae mahuta eto. Bena e raka vareai, hanua ariarana ai e helai diho, badina be asi tauna ta ese ena ruma e abidia dae, bae mahuta totona.
english: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.

motu: Tau buruka ta ena biru ḡaukarana amo ema, adorahi kahana ai; ia be Efraim ororodia amo ema Gibea ai e noho hedoava tauna; a hanua taudia na Beniamina taudia.
english: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.

motu: Tau buruka na e gaga dae, hari laolao tauna e itaia, hanua ariarana ai. Tau buruka eto, Oi na ede bo Iaomu, bona ede amo oma?
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city; and the old man said, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”

motu: Tau na e haere, eto, Ai na Betelehem-Iuda amo vada ama, gabu daudauna Efraim ororodia ai baia laomu. Lau na unu amo nama, Betelehem-Iuda nala; harihari egu ruma ba laomu, bena asi tauna ta vada e abigu dae ena ruma ai.
english: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to Yahweh’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.

motu: Ai na rei kakoro bona aniani vada a abi kau, emai doniki edia bona adia; flaoa bona vine ranuna danu a abi kau, lauagu bona ina hahine ana bona hari eregabe tauna emu hesiai taudia ida adia; ḡau ta ai basita dabu.
english: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”

motu: Tau buruka eto, Maino na emui ai baine mia; lau ese emui dabu ḡaudia iboudiai baina henimui; ḡau tamona, hanua ariarana ai basio noho rani.
english: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia ese ena ruma ai e hakaudia vareai, bona doniki na adia e henidia. Bena idia ese aedia e huridia; bena e aniani bona e inuinu.
english: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

motu: Edia moale lalonai hanua taudia haida, lebulebu taudia, ema, ruma na e ginia heḡeḡe, bena iduara na e botabotaia. Bena idia ese ruma biaguna, hari tau buruka, na e hamaoroa, eto, Emu ruma ai e dae kau tauna na ba hakaua lasi, ai baia dibaia.
english: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house, beating at the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, “Bring out the man who came into your house, that we can have sex with him!”

motu: A ruma biaguna na idia dekediai e raka lasi, eto, Varavaragu e, una kara dikana basio karaia. Ina tau na lauegu vadivadi; una kara mirona basio karaia.
english: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don’t do this folly.

motu: O itaia, lau natugu hane-ulato rami-hebouna noho, bona iena hahine danu noho. Idia baina mailaidia dekemui ai; bavabidia, emui ura heḡereḡerena ai ba kara henidia; a ina tau na basio kara miro henia.
english: Behold, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine. I will bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them what seems good to you; but to this man don’t do any such folly.”

motu: A hanua taudia na asie kamonai henia. Taunabunai, una Levi tauna ese ena hahine na e abia, e doria lasi idia dekediai. Idia ese e abia, e eno henia hanuaboi idoinai, ela bona daba e rere. Daba vaburana ai e kahua nege.
english: But the men wouldn’t listen to him; so the man grabbed his concubine, and brought her out to them; and they had sex with her, and abused her all night until the morning. When the day began to dawn, they let her go.

motu: Daba e rere, bena hahine na ela, biaguna ena noho rumana iduarana ai e hekida diho, ela bona dina e dae.
english: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, until it was light.

motu: Daba ai biaguna e tore isi, ruma iduaradia e keho, ena laolao ai ma bainela eto; bena ena hahine e itaia, iduara vairanai e hekida diho, imana ruaosi na iduara raka-vareai ai heheato.
english: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

motu: Ia ese e hereva henia, eto, A tore isi, aitala. A hahine na se haere. Bena doniki doruna ai e atoa kau. Bena una tau e tore isi, ena ruma ela.
english: He said to her, “Get up, and let’s get going!” but no one answered. Then he took her up on the donkey; and the man rose up, and went to his place.

motu: Ena ruma lalonai e raka vareai, bena kaia e abia, ena hahine tau-anina e abia, e utua parara, rege gwauta-rua; bena e siaidia, Israel tanona idoinai.
english: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.

motu: Bena e itaia taudia iboudiai eto, Kara unuhetomana na nega hata se vara bona nega hata se hedinarai, Israel taudia na Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi dinana amo ema bona hari ina dina. Ba haeroa, ba henegalaia, ba herevalaia.
english: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”

motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai e raka lasi, ibouboudiai na mai lalodia tamona e hebou, Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba, bona Gilead amo danu, Iehova vairanai e hebou Mispa ai.
english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.

motu: Hanua lohiadia iboudiai, Israel iduhudia iboudiai amo, danu e hebou, Dirava ena orea taudia vairadiai: idia na talau domaga-hani, + 20:2 Domaga-hani = 400,000. * aedia amo e rakava, mai edia dare.
english: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.

motu: Bena Beniamina iduhuna taudia na harina e kamonai, Israel taudia na unu e hebou tomava Mispa ai. Bena Israel taudia eto, A hamaoromai, ena kara dikana na ede e vara toma?
english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) The children of Israel said, “Tell us, how did this wickedness happen?”

motu: Bena hari Levi tauna, vada e alaia hahinena adavana, ese e haere henidia, eto, Lau na egu hahine ida Beniamina hanuana ta ladana Gibea ai a kau, unuseni ai baia mahuta ato.
english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

motu: Bena Gibea taudia na lau ihadikagu totona e tore isi, hanuaboi ai ruma na e koua heḡeḡe, bae alagu mase eto. A egu hahine na e abia bona e hahemaraia; bena vada e mase.
english: The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

motu: Taunabunai, hahine na na abia, tau-anina na utua parara, regena na siaidia, Israel taudia na edia tano ai vada e halaoa tanona idoinai: badina be idia na lebulebu karana bona hemarai karana vada e karaia, Israel bogaraginai.
english: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

motu: Israel taumui iboumui ai, ba haeroa: emui lalo-hadai bona emui hahedua ba gwaurai hedinarai.
english: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel.”

motu: Bena hebou taudia e tore isi, tau tamona na heto, eto, Ita ta ena kalaga basinela, bona ta ena ruma basine lou henia.
english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.

motu: A Gibea na ini baita karaia toma: mari amo baita diba, daika daika ese bae tuari henia.
english: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;

motu: Israel iduhudia iboudiai lalodia amo, sinahu-ta amo gwauta baita abidia hidi, bona daha-ta amo sinahu-ta baita abidia hidi, bona gerebu-ta amo daha-ta baita abidia hidi. Idia na baela, aniani ḡaudia bae ha abi, ina orea taudia adia; bena Gibea ai bae kau negana ai, idia ese Gibea taudia edia kara havara iboudiai Israel bogaraginai vada e kara na davadia do bae henidia.
english: and we will take ten men of one hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and one hundred of one thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand to get food for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that the men of Gibeah have done in Israel.”

motu: Taunabunai Israel taudia iboudiai na mai lalodia tamona e hebou, una hanua bae tuari henia totona.
english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

motu: Bena Israel iduhudia iboudiai ese edia gwau-kau taudia e siaidia, Beniamina iduhuna taudia dekediai, eto, Ena kara dikana bogaragimui ai e vara anina be dahaka?
english: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What wickedness is this that has happened among you?

motu: Hari kara havara taudia Gibea ai taodia ba tore, ai ese baia aladia mase, kara havara na Israel bogaraginai baine ore. A Beniamina taudia na tadikakadia Israel taudia eredia asie kamonai.
english: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.” But|strong="H3808" * Benjamin|strong="H1144" * would|strong="H3478" * not|strong="H3808" * listen|strong="H8085" * to|strong="H3478" * the|strong="H8085" * voice|strong="H6963" * of|strong="H1121" * their|strong="H5414" * brothers|strong="H1121" *, the|strong="H8085" * children|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Israel|strong="H3478" *.

motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na hanua hanua amo ela, Gibea ai e hebou, Israel taudia oredia bae tuari henidia totona.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

motu: Una dina ai Beniamina taudia hanua hanua amo e hebou na tatau gerebu-rua daha-tauratoi + 20:15 Gerebu-rua daha-tauratoi = 26,000. * mai edia dare; bona Gibea taudia edia tuari taudia mai goadadia be tatau sinahu-hitu.
english: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were counted seven hundred chosen men.

motu: Ini iboudiai bogaragidiai na ima-lauri taudia mai goadadia sinahu-hitu; idia iboudiai na vilipopo amo nadi bema tahoa, hui autamona basiema reaia.
english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

motu: Beniamina iduhuna taudia na unuhohodia; a Israel iduhudia oredia edia tatau na domaga hani + 20:17 Domaga-hani = 400,000. * mai edia dare. Unu iboudiai na tuari taudia. Beniamina taudia e kwalimu
english: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.

motu: Israel taudia na e tore isi, Betele ela, Dirava e nanadaia, eto, Edena iduhu bainela guna, Beniamina taudia baine tuari henidia? Iehova eto, Iuda iduhuna baine guna.
english: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” Yahweh|strong="H3068" * said, “ Judah|strong="H3063" * first|strong="H1121" *.”

motu: Daba ai, Israel taudia e tore isi, Gibea vairanai e taruha.
english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia e tuari henidia, Gibea vairanai e gini.
english: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.

motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na Gibea amo e raka lasi, Israel taudia gerebu-rua daha-rua + 20:21 Gerebu-rua daha-rua = 22,000. * e aladia mase una dina ai.
english: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.

motu: A Israel taudia na e haheauka, tuari gabuna ai ma e gini lou, tuari dinana gini-gunana ai e gini heḡereḡerena.
english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.

motu: Israel taudia na e dae lao, Iehova vairanai e tai boi; bena idia ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Tadikakamai Beniamina taudia ma baia tuari henidia lou eiava? Iehova eto, A tuari henidia.
english: The children of Israel went up and wept before Yahweh until evening; and they asked of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?” Yahweh|strong="H3068" * said, “ Go|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" * against|strong="H5973" * him|strong="H6440" *.”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia ma e tuari henidia lou, dina iharuana ai.
english: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na Gibea amo ma e raka lasi, dina iharuana ai, Israel taudia gerebu-ta daha-taurahani + 20:25 Gerebu-ta daha-taurahani = 18,000. * e aladia mase. Unu iboudiai na tuari taudia mai edia dare.
english: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men. All these drew the sword.

motu: Bena Israel taudia, tuari oreana idoinai, na ela, Betele ai e kau, bena e taitai. Idia na Iehova vairanai e helaiva, e vaga una dina ai, ela bona dina e diho. Bena ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia e hahelaḡadia, Iehova vairanai.
english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iehova e nanadaia; badina be unu dinadia ai Iehova ena taravatu mauana na unuseni mia,
english: The children of Israel asked Yahweh (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

motu: bona Fineha Eleasara, Aaron tubuna, na una maua vairanai Iehova isiaina e lao heniva unu dinadia ai. Taunabunai idia ese e henanadai, eto, Tadikakamai Beniamina taudia ma baia tuari henidia lou, eiava vada baia hadokoa? Iehova eto, Ma baola; kerukeru umui imamui ai baina atodia. Beniamina taudia e darere
english: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, “Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?” Yahweh|strong="H3068" * said|strong="H3318" *, “ Go|strong="H3318" * up|strong="H5927" *; for|strong="H3588" * tomorrow|strong="H4279" * I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * deliver|strong="H5414" * him|strong="H5414" * into|strong="H5927" * your|strong="H3068" * hand|strong="H3027" *.”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel na edia tuari taudia haida e siaidia, Gibea bae bani henia.
english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai, Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia ma e tuan henidia, Gibea vairanai ma e gini, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia.
english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na ituari-henidia e raka lasi, hanua na e rakatania; bena nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia idia na e ala-ala matama, Israel taudia haida laolao daladia ai e aladia mase, Betele dalana ai bona Gibea dalana ai, bona tano paka ai danu haida e aladia mase. E aladia taudia na Israel taudia toi-ahui sisivana.
english: The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

motu: Bena Beniamina taudia e hereva heheni, eto, Vairadai vada e darere, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia. A Israel taudia e hereva heheni, eto, Aita heau, hanua amo baita veridia oho laolao daladia ai.
english: The children of Benjamin said, “They are struck down before us, as at the first.” But the children of Israel said, “Let’s flee, and draw them away from the city to the highways.”

motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai na e tore isi, ela, Baal-tamara ai e gini heḡaeḡae; a Israel taudia hahidaosi hanua e bani henia taudia na edia komu gabuna, Geba lahara kahana, amo e heau lasi.
english: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar. Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place, even out of Maareh Geba.

motu: Bena tuari taudia mai goadadia gerebu-ta + 20:34 Gerebu-ta = 10,000. * Israel taudia iboudiai edia amo e abidia hidi na Gibea e tuari henia. Tuari na auka herea; Beniamina taudia danu lalodia asie parara edia darere negana na kahira-kahira.
english: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn’t know that disaster was close to them.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Beniamina taudia e hadareredia Israel vairanai. Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia gerebu-rua daha-ima sinahu-ta + 20:35 Gerebu-rua daha-ima sinahu-ta = 25,100. * e aladia mase una dina ai: iboudiai na tuari taudia mai edia dare.
english: Yahweh struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.

motu: Taunabunai Beniamina taudia na lalodia e parara vada e darere. Israel taudia na Beniamina taudia vairadiai e heau, badina be Gibea ibani-henina vada e siaidia taudia e abidadama henidia.
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.

motu: Una negana ai hanua e bani henia taudia e heau lasi haraḡa-haraḡa, Gibea e daea, bena idia ese hanua taudia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia mase.
english: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

motu: Israel taudia bona hanua e bani henia taudia na edia henega ai toa ta vada e gwauraia guna. Toana binai: lahi kwalahuna ori na heto hanua amo baine dae negana ai
english: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.

motu: Israel taudia na bae gini kerehai tuari ai. Una negana ai Beniamina taudia ese vada e ala-ala matama, Israel taudia toi-ahui sisivana vada e aladia mase. Bena idia eto, Momokani, idia na vairadai vada e darere, tuari gunana ai heḡereḡerena.
english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”

motu: A hari toa, lahi kwalahuna, e dae matama negana ai, Beniamina taudia e roha kerehai; madi, hanua idoinai kwalahuna e daeva guba ai.
english: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.

motu: Una negana ai Israel taudia na e gini kerehai; bena Beniamina taudia kudoudia e hetaha, badina be vada e diba vada be dareremu.
english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.

motu: Taunabunai, idia na Israel taudia vairadia amo e lou, tano gaḡaena ela. A tuari ese e ḡavadia tao, bona hanua amo ema taudia ese edia dala e ginia ahu, bena dare amo e aladia ore.
english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.

motu: Oibe, idia ese Beniamina taudia e ginidia ahu, bona e hahavadia lao, bona e aladia, Noha amo ela bona Gibea mairiveina kahana ai.
english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.

motu: Beniamina taudia gerebu-ta daha-taurahani + 20:44 Gerebu-ta daha-taurahani = 18,000. * e mase, iboudiai na tuari taudia mai goadadia.
english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.

motu: Ma e kerehai, tano gaḡaena ai e heau, ela bona Rimon nadi-hagana. Daha-ima be laolao daladia ai e aladia mase; oredia ma e hahavadia ela bona Gidomo ai daha-rua ma e aladia mase.
english: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.

motu: Taunabunai, Beniamina taudia una dina ai e mase iboudiai na gerebu-rua daha-ima; + 20:46 Gerebu-rua daha-ima = 25,000. * iboudiai na tuari taudia mai goadadia, imadia na mai daredia.
english: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.

motu: A tatau sinahu-tauratoi e heau mauri, Rimon nadi-hagana ela, tano ḡaḡaena ai; idia na hua hani Rimon nadi-hagana ai e nohova.
english: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.

motu: Israel taudia na tuari amo e lou, Beniamina taudia ma e ala-ala henidia, taunimanima bona boromakau bona e davari ḡaudia iboudiai e habuadia tari; bona e davari hanuadia na e doudia.
english: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin, and struck them with the edge of the sword—including the entire city, the livestock, and all that they found. Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire.

motu: Israel taudia na Mispa ai vada e gwau hamata guna, eto, Ita ese natuda hane-ulatona ta Beniamina tauna ta basita henia, basine adavaia.
english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”

motu: A Israel taudia na Betele ela, Dirava vairanai e helai boi, e tai dikadika,
english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

motu: eto, Iehova e, Israel Diravana, badina be dahaka ina kara vada e vara Israel ai, bena hari dina ai Israel ai iduhu ta na lasihia?
english: They said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”

motu: Bena daba ai, idia na e tore isi haraḡa, boubou patana ta e larebaia, latanai ḡole-oho bouboudia bona herohemaino bouboudia e hahelaḡadia.
english: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

motu: Israel taudia na eto, Israel iduhudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo edena iduhu Iehova vairanai asiema, ta hebouva negana ai? Badina be vada e gwau hamata mai hereva metauna ida, Mispa sela, Iehova vairanai se hebou, tauna na baine mase eto.
english: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to Yahweh?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese tadikakadia Beniamina taudia e bogadia hisi, eto, Hari dina ai iduhu ta na Israel amo vada e henege daure.
english: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.

motu: E roho mauri taudia na adavadia ede baita henidia toma? Badina be Iehova vairanai vada ta gwau hamata, tato, natuda ulatodia basita henidia, basie adavadia.
english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by Yahweh that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”

motu: Idia ma eto, Edena iduhu Israel ai na Iehova vairanai se hedinarai, Mispa ai? Bena vada e laloa, Iabese-gilead amo tau ta hebou gabuna sela.
english: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.

motu: Badina be hebou taudia e hagaudia negana ai, Iabese-gilead taudia na lasihidia, ta se hedinarai.
english: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.

motu: Taunabunai, hebou taudia ese edia tuari taudia mai goadadia gerebu-ta daha-rua + 21:10 Gerebu-ta daha-rua = 12,000. * e siaidia lao, e haganidia, eto, Aola, Iabese-gilead taudia na dare isena amo bavaladia mase, hahine bona memero maraḡidia danu bavaladia mase.
english: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.

motu: Ini ba kara toma: mamaruane iboudiai bona tatau ida vada e eno bou hahinedia iboudiai na bavaladia ore.
english: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”

motu: A Iabese-gilead taudia bogaragidiai rami-hebou ulatodia sinahu-hani e davaridia; bena Silo taruhana e laohaidia, Kanaan tanona ai.
english: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

motu: Bena hebou taudia iboudiai ese gwau-kau herevana e siaia, Beniamina taudia dounu Rimon haga-nadina ai e nohova dekediai, maino e gwauraia.
english: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

motu: Una negana ai Beniamina taudia na e lou. Bena hebou taudia ese hari Iabese-gilead hahinedia bogaragidia amo e hamauridia ulatodia na idia e henidia. To asie davana.
english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Beniamina taudia e bogadia hisi, Iehova ese Israel besena vada e hapararaia dainai.
english: The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

motu: Bena Israel tau-badadia eto, Tatau oredia adavadia ede baita davaridia toma? Badina be Beniamina hahinedia vada e mase ore.
english: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”

motu: Ma eto, Beniamina taudia kwabukwabudia na ahudia bae abi baine namo, iduhu ta Israel bogaragina amo baine boio na garina;
english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.

motu: ḡau tamona, natuda ulatodia na basita henidia diba. Badina be Israel taudia vada e gwau hamata, eto, Beniamina tauna na hane-ulato ta baine henia, baine adavaia totona, tauna na do baine baia.
english: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”

motu: Taunabunai idia ma eto, Laḡani ta ta amo taunimanima ese Iehova ena aria ta e karaiamu Silo ai, Betele mirigini kahana ai, Betele amo Sekem e lao heniamu dalana mairiveina kahana ai, Lebona diho kahana ai.
english: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”

motu: Bena idia ese Beniamina taudia e haḡanidia, eto, Aola, vine imeadia ai ba komu,
english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

motu: ba henari; bena Silo ulatodia bema raka lasi, mavaru ai bema mavaru, umui ese vine imeadia amo ba heau lasi, ta ta adavamui ba dabaidia tao, Silo ulatodia bogaragidia amo, bena Beniamina tanona baola.
english: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

motu: A tamadia eiava taihudia na ai dekemai baema, bae hahebade, negana ai, ai ese baia hamarumarudia, baiato “Idia na emui harihari-bada ai mani ba henimai, badina be tuari ai asia abidia mauri, asia henidia bae adavadia, bona umui danu asio henidia: boma henidia, umui na harihari boma kerere”.
english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.’”

motu: Bena Beniamina taudia na unu e kara toma, mavaru ulatodia e dabaidia tao, e adavadia, taudia hohodia heḡereḡeredia. Bena idia na ela, edia tano e lou henia, edia hanua e hadai lou, e noholaidia.
english: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.

motu: Una negana ai Israel taudia na e karoho, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela, edia iduhu heḡereḡeredia. Iboudiai na edia tano korikori e lou henidia.
english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Israel na asi pavapavana; Israel taudia na ta ta ena lalo-hadai ena lalo-hadai heḡereḡeredia e kara.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

motu: Nega ta, hahemaoro taudia ese tano e lohiaia negana ai, doe bada-hereana e vara. Una negana ai, Betelehem-iuda tauna ta mai adavana bona mai natuna mamaruanedia rarua ida edia hanua e toretania, Moab tanona ai eha noho.
english: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A certain man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in the country of Moab with his wife and his two sons.

motu: Una tau ladana na Elimelek; adavana ladana na Naomi; natuna mamaruanedia raruosi ladadia be Malon bona Kilion. Idia na Efrata taudia, Betelehem-iuda amo; Moab tanona ai e kau, unuseni ai e nohova.
english: The name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi. The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah. They came into the country of Moab and lived there.

motu: Bena Elimelek, Naomi adavana, unuseni ai e mase; una hahine mai natuna raruosi ida e noho hedoava.
english: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died; and she was left with her two sons.

motu: Idia raruosi ese Moab ulatodia rarua e adavadia; ta ladana be Oropa, ma ta ladana be Ruta. Edia headava murinai idia na unuseni ai e nohova ela bona laḡani gwauta e ore.
english: They took for themselves wives of the women of Moab. The name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other was Ruth. They lived there about ten years.

motu: Bena Malon bona Kilion raruosi e mase; sinadia na sibona e nohova, asi adavana bona asi natuna.
english: Mahlon and Chilion both died, and the woman was bereaved of her two children and of her husband.

motu: Taunabunai, ia mai ravana hahinedia raruosi ida e heḡaegae, Moab bae toretania, hahine badana ena tano bae lou henia; badina be harina ienai vada e kau Moab ai, Iehova ese ena abi-hidi taudia vada e bogadia hisi, adia vada e henidia.
english: Then she arose with her daughters-in-law, that she might return from the country of Moab; for she had heard in the country of Moab how Yahweh + 1:6 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * had visited his people in giving them bread.

motu: Bena ena noho gabuna e rakatania, ia mai ravana raruosi ida, Iuda dalana a e raka ela.
english: She went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her. They went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

motu: A Naomi ese ravana raruosi e haduadia, eto, Madi, sinamui edia ruma ba lou heni; Iehova ese baine hanamomui, umui ese mase taudia o hanamodiava bona lau vada o hanamogu heḡereḡerena;
english: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go, return each of you to her mother’s house. May Yahweh deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead and with me.

motu: Iehova ese laga-ani baine henimui, adavamui matamatadia edia ruma ai. Bena e harahudia. Idia na e tai dikadika.
english: May Yahweh grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.” Then|strong="H5375" * she kissed|strong="H5401" * them|strong="H5414" *, and|strong="H3068" * they|strong="H3068" * lifted|strong="H5375" * up|strong="H5375" * their|strong="H3068" * voices|strong="H6963" *, and|strong="H3068" * wept|strong="H1058" *.

motu: Bena raruosi ese e haere henia, eto, Lasi, oi baia bamomu, emu bese taudia dekedia baitala.
english: They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”

motu: A Naomi eto, Ravagu e, a lou lao; ba bamogu anina be dahaka? Natugu haida ma baina havaradia, umui adavamui ai baela a?
english: Naomi said, “Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

motu: Ravagu e, a lou, emui dala ai baola; lau be vada name buruka, basina headava lou. A bama headava lou, hari ina hanuaboi bama headava, natugu mamaruanedia bama havaradia,
english: Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, ‘I have hope,’ if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons,

motu: umui boma haheauka noho ela bona idia taudia bema lo a? Boma noho vado idia daidiai a? Lasi, ravagu e. Ḡau tamona, lalogu eme hisihisi umui daimui ai, badina be Iehova ese vada e murigu.
english: would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for Yahweh’s hand has gone out against me.”

motu: Ma e taitai louva; bena Oropa ese ravana e hatonia, a Ruta na se rakatania.
english: They lifted up their voices and wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.

motu: Naomi eto, A itaia, bamomu ese ena bese taudia bona ena dirava vada e lou henidia; ia murinai ba raka.
english: She said, “Behold, + 1:15 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”

motu: A Ruta eto, Basio haḡanigu, basioto baina rakatanimu; badina be oi baola gabuna lau danu bainala, bona oi ba noho gabuna lau danu baina noho; oiemu bese na lauegu bese ai bainela, bona oiemu Dirava na lauegu Dirava ai bainela;
english: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God + 1:16 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * my God.

motu: oi ba mase gabuna ai lau danu baina mase, unuseni ai bae gurigu. Ḡau ta ese basine hapararada, mase mo sibona; mauri ai baina rakatanimu, Iehova ese dava badana baine henigu, ma baine hametaua danu.
english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”

motu: Rava-bada hahinena ese e itaia, Ruta na lalona vada e ha-aukaia baine bamoa; bena ia na hereva ta se gwauraia.
english: When Naomi saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

motu: Taunabunai, raruosi e raka bou, ela bona Betelehem ai e kau. Betelehem ai e kau negana ai hanua taudia iboudiai e heau bou heau bou ema; bena hahine na eto, Ina na Naomi a?
english: So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them, and they asked, “Is this Naomi?”

motu: Ia na e haere henidia, eto, Ladagu basio hatoa Naomi; + 1:20 “Naomi” anina be “Gaiho”; “Mara” anina be “Idita”. * ba hatoa Mara; badina be Ḡaubada ena kara egu ai na idita.
english: She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. + 1:20 “Naomi” means “pleasant”. * Call me Mara, + 1:20 “Mara” means “bitter”. * for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

motu: Mai ahugu nala, a Iehova ese ima kavakava vada e halougu. Dahaka dainai ladagu o hatoamu Naomi; a Iehova ese vada e hahemaoro henigu, bona Ḡaubada ese vada e hahisigu?
english: I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since Yahweh has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”

motu: Unuhetomana Naomi na Moab tanona amo e lou, ravana Ruta, hane Moab, danu ia ida. Bali + 1:22 “Bali” na aniani reina ta, flaoa e karalaia ḡauna, uit na heto. * iutuna e matamaia negana ai Betelehem ai e kau.
english: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

motu: Naomi adavana varavarana ta noho, taga tauna, Elimelek ena iduhu tauna, ladana na Boa.
english: Naomi had a relative of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and his name was Boaz.

motu: Ruta, hane Moab, ese Naomi e hamaoroa, eto, Mani uma bainala, baine lalo namo henigu tauna murinai baina raka, bali anidia momorudia baina gogodia. Ia ese e haere henia, eto, Ravagu, vada aola.
english: Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to|strong="H3212" * her|strong="H4672" *, “ Go|strong="H3212" *, my|strong="H4672" * daughter|strong="H1323" *.”

motu: Bena ia na ela, bali iutuna taudia muridia amo e raka, bali anidia momorudia e gogova. Ena raka ai, ia na Boa, Elimelek ena iduhu tauna, ena uma ai e raka vareai.
english: She went, and came and gleaned in the field after the reapers; and she happened to come to the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.

motu: Bena Boa na Betelehem amo ema, bali iutuna taudia e hanamodia, eto, Iehova ese baine bamomui. Idia na e haere, eto, Iehova ese baine hanamomu.
english: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.” They|strong="H3068" * answered him|strong="H5973" *, “ May|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * bless|strong="H1288" * you|strong="H5973" *.”

motu: Bena Boa ese bali iutuna taudia ireḡudia tauna e nanadaia, eto, Una na daika ena hesiai hahinena?
english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was set over the reapers, “Whose young lady is this?”

motu: Bali iutuna taudia ireḡudia tauna ese e haere henia, eto, Una na Moab hahinena, Naomi ida Moab tanona amo ema.
english: The servant who was set over the reapers answered, “It is the Moabite lady who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab.

motu: la ese e noigu, eto “Mani emu kara uma ai baina raka vareai, bali anidia momorudia na iutuna taudia muridiai baina gogo”. Taunabunai ia na daba ai ema, se laḡa ani ema bona harihari.
english: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves.’ So she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, except that she rested a little in the house.”

motu: Bena Boa ese Ruta e hereva henia, eto, Natugu, eregu a kamonai: idau uma ai bali anidia momorudia basio gogo, ina uma basio rakatania; egu hesiai hahinedia badibadidiai ba noho.
english: Then Boaz said to Ruth, “Listen, my daughter. Don’t go to glean in another field, and don’t go from here, but stay here close to my maidens.

motu: Bali e utuamu gabuna ba itaia tao: idia muridiai ba raka. Eregabe taudia vada na taravadia, emu ai basie dau kau. Ba ranu mase negadia ai danu hodu ba lao henidia, eregabe taudia vada e utua ranuna taina ba inua.
english: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”

motu: Bena hahine na tano ai e goru diho, eto, Dahaka dainai lau, idau hahinena, o lalo namo henigumu bona o haḡeregumu?
english: Then she fell on her face and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, “Why have I found favor in your sight, that you should take knowledge of me, since I am a foreigner?”

motu: Boa ese e haere henia, eto, Harimu vada na kamonai, adavamu e mase murinai ravamu ede o karaia toma; tamamu bona sinamu bona o vara tanona o rakatanidia, ai idau taumai bogaragimai ai oma.
english: Boaz answered her, “I have been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, and how you have left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and have come to a people that you didn’t know before.

motu: Iehova ese davamu baine henimu, emu kara heḡereḡerena; Iehova, Israel taumai emai Dirava, hanina henunai o gorumu Diravana, ese davamu namona baine henimu.
english: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”

motu: Hahine na eto, Egu lohia e, vada o lalo namo henigu; ena be lau na dia oiemu hesiai hahinedia heḡereḡeredia to oi ese taugu vada o haloa bona hereva namodia amo vada o hanamogu.
english: Then she said, “Let me find favor in your sight, my lord, because you have comforted me, and because you have spoken kindly to your servant, though I am not as one of your servants.”

motu: Aniani negana ai, Boa ese e hereva henia, eto, Ini aoma, flaoa ba bitua, vine ranuna ai ba urua diho. Hahine na bali iutuna taudia bogaragidiai e helai diho. Bena Boa ese e gabua balina taina e henia; hahine ese e abia, e ania, bogana e kunu, bahuna danu mia.
english: At meal time Boaz said to her, “Come here, and eat some bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.” She|strong="H6256" * sat|strong="H3427" * beside|strong="H6654" * the|strong="H4480" * reapers|strong="H7114" *, and|strong="H3899" * they|strong="H6256" * passed|strong="H3427" * her|strong="H6642" * parched|strong="H7039" * grain|strong="H7039" *. She|strong="H6256" * ate, was|strong="H3427" * satisfied|strong="H7646" *, and|strong="H3899" * left|strong="H3498" * some|strong="H4480" * of|strong="H3427" * it|strong="H6256" *.

motu: Ia na e tore isi, bali anidia ma baine gogo eto. Bena Boa ese ena eregabe taudia e haduadia, eto, Iḡui padadiai danu baine gogo, basio gwaua tao;
english: When she had risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and don’t reproach her.

motu: bona iḡui amo bali anidia haida ba buruki, tano ai ba nege, bena baine gogo; basio gwau henia.
english: Also pull out some for her from the bundles, and leave it. Let her glean, and don’t rebuke her.”

motu: Taunabunai ia na uma ai ma e gogo ela bona ado e rahi. Bena e gwadaia, momona e negea, bali efa + 2:17 “Efa” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta. * ta heḡereḡerena e abia.
english: So she gleaned in the field until evening; and she beat out that which she had gleaned, and it was about an ephah + 2:17 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of barley.

motu: E laohaia, hanua ela, ravana e haheitalaia; bona bahu danu e henia.
english: She took it up, and went into the city. Then her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned; and she brought out and gave to her that which she had left after she had enough.

motu: Ravana ese e nanadaia, eto, Edeseni ai bali anidia o gogo hari ina dina ai? Edeseni ai o ḡaukara? E hageremu tauna na Dirava ese baine hanamoa. Bena ia ese ena ḡaukara gabuna na ravana e hadibalaia, eto, Dekenai na ḡaukara tauna hari dina ai ladana be Boa.
english: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where have you gleaned today? Where have you worked? Blessed be he who noticed you.” She|strong="H5973" * told|strong="H5046" * her|strong="H5046" * mother-in-law|strong="H2545" * with|strong="H5973" * whom she|strong="H5973" * had|strong="H1961" * worked|strong="H6213" *, “ The|strong="H6213" * man’s name|strong="H8034" * with|strong="H5973" * whom I|strong="H3117" * worked|strong="H6213" * today|strong="H3117" * is|strong="H3117" * Boaz|strong="H1162" *.”

motu: Bena Naomi ese ravana e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova, nega idoidiai mauri taudia bona mase taudia e bogadia hisimu Diravana, ese ia baine hanamoa. Naomi ma eto, Una tau na iseda iduhu tauna, ita varavarada.
english: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “May he be blessed by Yahweh, who has not abandoned his kindness to the living and to the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is a close relative to us, one of our near kinsmen.”

motu: Ruta, hane Moab, eto, Ia danu e hamaorogu, eto “Egu eregabe taudia badibadidiai ba noho ela bona egu taboro baine ore”.
english: Ruth the Moabitess said, “Yes, he said to me, ‘You shall stay close to my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”

motu: Naomi ese ravana Ruta e hamaoroa, eto, Ravagu, namona binai, iena hesiai hahinedia ida ba raka bou, idau uma ai dika emu ai baine kau na garina.
english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, and that they not harm you in any other field.”

motu: Taunabunai ia na Boa ena hesiai hahinedia ida e raka bou, momoru e gogo, ela bona bali iutuna bona uit iutuna vada e ore. Rava-bada hahinena dekenai e nohova.
english: So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.

motu: Ravana Naomi ese Ruta e hereva henia, eto, Ravagu e, emu noho gabuna ta baina lailaia bena unuseni ai ba noho namonamo ani?
english: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, “My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?

motu: Varavarada Boa, ena hesiai hahinedia o bamodia tauna, na hari ina hanuaboi ena bali e tapoamu, ena gwada-gwada gabuna ai.
english: Now isn’t Boaz our kinsman, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he will be winnowing barley tonight on the threshing floor.

motu: Taunabunai, a digu, kopimu dehoro amo ba dahua, emu dabua namona ba hahedokia, bena hari gwadagwada gabuna baola; to ienai basio hedinarai ela bona baine aniani bona baine inuinu vaitani.
english: Therefore wash yourself, anoint yourself, get dressed, and go down to the threshing floor; but don’t make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

motu: Bena baine hekure negana ai ena hekure gabuna do ba itaia, gabeai ba raka vareai, ena hetaru aena amo bavabia isi, ba hekure diho; bena ede ba kara toma ia ese baine hadibamu.
english: It shall be, when he lies down, that you shall note the place where he is lying. Then you shall go in, uncover his feet, and lie down. Then he will tell you what to do.”

motu: Ruta eto, Emu hahedua heḡereḡerena baina karaia.
english: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”

motu: Taunabunai ia na hari gwada-gwada gabuna ela, ravana ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena e karaia.
english: She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her.

motu: Boa na e aniani bona e inuinu vaitani, bena mai moalena ida e hekure diho, uit senuna gwaduna ai. Bena Ruta na asi reḡereḡena ela, hetaru na aena amo e abia isi, e hekure diho.
english: When Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain. She came softly, uncovered his feet, and lay down.

motu: Malokihi, Boa na e noga, e hoa, e helai tore, hahine na e itaia, ia aena badinai e hekure.
english: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.

motu: Ia eto, Oi be daika? Hahine na e haere, eto, Lau binai Ruta, emu hesiai hahinena; emu hesiai hahinena ba tarugu, badina be oi na adavagu e mase tauna varavarana.
english: He said, “Who are you?” She|strong="H3588" * answered, “ I|strong="H3588" * am Ruth|strong="H7327" * your|strong="H5921" * servant. Therefore|strong="H5921" * spread|strong="H6566" * the|strong="H5921" * corner|strong="H3671" * of|strong="H5921" * your|strong="H5921" * garment|strong="H3671" * over|strong="H5921" * your|strong="H5921" * servant; for|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * are|strong="H4310" * a|strong="H3068" * near|strong="H5921" * kinsman|strong="H1350" *.”

motu: Boa eto, Natugu e, Iehova ese baine hanamomu; ina emu kara namona gini-gabena ese emu kara namona gini-gunana vada e hereaia: badina be oi na uhau, mai edia ogoḡami eiava mai edia taḡa, so sihari henidia.
english: He said, “You are blessed by Yahweh, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich.

motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, basio gari; emu noinoi heḡereḡerena do baina kara henimu, badina be egu hanua taudia iboudiai dibadia oi na kara-namo hahinena.
english: Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.

motu: Momokani, lau na adavamu e mase tauna varavarana; ḡau tamona, ia varavara-dosina ta do noho.
english: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.

motu: Hari hanuaboi iniseni ai ba noho. Daba ai, ia na baine ura baine adavamu, namo; a bema lasi, lau ese baina adavamu. Iehova maurina ladana ai na herevamu. A hekure diho ela bona daba.
english: Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman’s duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as Yahweh lives. Lie down until the morning.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia na ia aena badinai e hekure ela bona daba. Daba vaburana ai, taunimanima do basie heita heheni negana ai, ia na e tore isi. Boa ese e hahedua, eto, Tau ta basine diba hari hahine na gwada-gwada gabuna ema.
english: She lay at his feet until the morning, then she rose up before one could discern another. For he said, “Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.”

motu: Bena ia ese hahine na e hereva henia, eto, O dokiamu dabuana a mailaia, avabia papa. Hahine na e abia papa, bena Boa ese bali efa tauratoi e uda, e henia, baine laohaia; bena hahine na hanua e lou lao.
english: He said, “Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it.” She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city.

motu: Ravana dekenai e kau negana ai, ravana ese e nanadaia, eto, Natugu e, edeheto? Bena ia ese Boa ena kara idoinai sivaraina e gwauraia.
english: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, “How did it go, my daughter?” She told|strong="H5046" * her|strong="H3605" * all|strong="H3605" * that|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * man|strong="H3605" * had|strong="H6213" * done|strong="H6213" * for|strong="H6213" * her|strong="H3605" *.

motu: Ma eto, Ia danu bali efa tauratoiosi bini e henigu, eto “Ima kavakava ai ravamu basio lou henia”.
english: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’”

motu: Ravana eto, Natugu e, ba henari ela bona ba diba ede baine kara toma: badina be hari tau na laḡana basine ania to han dina ai ina ḡau baine haḡuḡurua.
english: Then she said, “Wait, my daughter, until you know what will happen; for the man will not rest until he has settled this today.”

motu: Boa na hanua ikoukouna ela, unuseni ai e helai diho; bena hari mase tauna varavara-dosina, Boa ese e herevalaia tauna, e raka hanai. Boa ese e boi henia, eto, Turagu e, mani aoma, iniseni ai a helai. Bena hari tau ema, e helai diho.
english: Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him, “Come over here, friend, and sit down!” He came over, and sat down.

motu: Bena Boa ese hanua tau-badadia gwauta e boiridia, eto, Mani a helai diho. Bena e helai diho.
english: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, “Sit down here,” and they sat down.

motu: Bena ia ese hari tau e hereva henia, eto, Naomi na Moab tanona amo vada e lou mai, bona e uramu varavarada Elimelek ena tano baine hoia e tomu.
english: He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s.

motu: Taunabunai, na lalomu, oi baina hamaoromu na tomu: ba ura oi ese ba iloia, iniseni ai e helaimu taudia vairadiai bona hanua tau-badadia vairadiai. Ba ura bavabia, vada bavabia; a basio ura vada ba hamaorogu, baina diba; badina be iabina mai siahuna tauna na oi, bona oi murimu ai lau. Hari tau eto, Baina abia.
english: I thought I should tell you, saying, ‘Buy it before those who sit here, and before the elders of my people.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know. For there is no one to redeem it besides you; and I am after you.” He|strong="H3588" * said, “ I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H5971" * redeem|strong="H1350" * it|strong="H3588" *.”

motu: Boa ma eto, Tano Naomi imana amo bavabia dinana ai, Ruta, hane Moab, mase tauna vabuna, danu bavabia, mase tauna dihina ihavarana totona.
english: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the field from the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also from Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance.”

motu: Bena hari tau eto, Lau na basina abia diba, sibogu dihigu ai baina dabu na garina. Oi ese bavabia, badina be lau be basina abia diba.
english: The near kinsman said, “I can’t redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption for yourself; for I can’t redeem it.”

motu: Nega gunadia ai Israel taudia edia kara na iniheto, tano e hoihoilai negadia ai: hoihoi ihamomokanina toana na tau ta ese ena tamaka ta e kokia oho, ena tano e hoia tauna e henia. Ihamomokanina toana bunai Israel ai.
english: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a man took off his sandal, and gave it to his neighbor; and this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.

motu: Taunabunai hari tau ese Boa e hamaoroa, eto, Oi ese bavabia; bena ena tamaka ta e kokia oho.
english: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.

motu: Bena Boa ese hanua tau-badadia bona hanua taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Hari dina ai umui ese vada o itaia bona vada o kamonai lau ese Naomi ena amo Elimelek ena ḡau idoinai bona Kilion ena ḡau idoinai bona Malon ena ḡau idoinai vada na hoi;
english: Boaz said to the elders and to all the people, “You are witnesses today, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, from the hand of Naomi.

motu: bona Ruta, hane Moab, Malon vabuna, danu vada na hoia, baina adavaia, mase tauna dihina ihavarana totona, ladana basine boio ena iduhu ai bona ena hanua ai helaoreana. Hari dina ai vada o itaia bona vada o kamonai danu.
english: Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead may not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”

motu: Bena hanua ikoukouna ai e helaiva taudia bona hanua tau-badadia eto, Ai na vada a itaia bona vada a kamonai. Iehova ese emu ruma ai be dae kaumu hahinena na Rahela bona Lea, Israel besena ihavarana hahinedia, heḡereḡeredia ai baine halaoa. Oi danu Efrata ai ba taḡa, bona Betelehem ai harimu baine namo;
english: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.

motu: emu ruma taudia danu Perese Iuda, Tamara bogana amo e vara tauna, ena ruma taudia heḡereḡeredia ai baela, Iehova ese ina eregabe hahinena ena amo natumu baine henimu dainai.
english: Let your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the offspring + 4:12 or, seed * which Yahweh will give you by this young woman.”

motu: Taunabunai Boa ese Ruta e abia, e adavaia. Raruosi e eno bou, bona Iehova ese hahine e hanamoa; bena hahine na e rogorogo, mero ta e abia.
english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and Yahweh enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.

motu: Bena hanua hahinedia ese Naomi e hereva henia, eto, Iehova aita hanamoa, badina be hari dina ai oi garamu vada e henimu. Ia ladana baine bada Israel ai.
english: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.

motu: Ia ese emu mauri baine hamatamataia, bona burukamu ai baine narimu; badina be ravamu, e lalokau henimumu hahinena, tatau hahitu e hereadiamu hahinena, ia ese vada e havaraia.
english: He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has given birth to him.”

motu: Bena Naomi ese mero karukaruna e abia, e rosia, bona e reḡua.
english: Naomi took the child, laid him in her bosom, and became nurse to him.

motu: Bena dekena hahinedia ese mero ladana e hatoa, eto, Naomi na mai natuna, bena ladana e hatoa Obed. Ia na Iese tamana; Iese na David tamana.
english: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

motu: Perese garana bini: Perese ese Hesron e havaraia;
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,

motu: Hesron ese Ram e havaraia; Ram ese Aminadab e havaraia;
english: and Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab,

motu: Aminadab ese Nason e havaraia; Nason ese Salmon e havaraia;
english: and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon,

motu: Salmon ese Boa e havaraia; Boa ese Obed e havaraia;
english: and Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed,

motu: Obed ese Iese e havaraia; Iese ese David e havaraia.
english: and Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.

motu: Efraim ororodia ai, hanua ta ladana na Ramataim-sofimi ai, tau tae nohova, ladana na Elkana. Ia tamana be Ierohama; Ierohama tamana na Elihu; Elihu tamana na Tohu; Tohu tamana na Sufu, Efraim iduhuna tauna ta.
english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

motu: Elkana na e hodara: adavana ta ladana na Hana, ma ta ladana na Penina. Penina na mai natuna haida, a Hana na e gabani.
english: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

motu: Ina tau na laḡani ta ta amo ena hanua e rakatania, Silo ela; unuseni ai ia ese Iehova Sabaota e toma henia diho, bona ena boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia Iehova ena. Unuseni ai Eli natuna mamaruanedia raruosi, Hofni bona Fineha, na Iehova ena hahelaḡa taudia.
english: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to Yahweh + 1:3 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to Yahweh, were there.

motu: Ena boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia dinana ai, Elkana ese adavana Penina bona ia natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia iboudiai na ahudia e henidia.
english: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;

motu: A Hana be ahu tamona e henia; ena be e lalokau henia bada, to ahu tamona e henia, badina be Iehova ese gabana e ha-aukaia.
english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.

motu: Bena hari hahine ta ese e ha-uraia bona lalona e hahisia, Iehova ese gabana vada e ha-aukaia dainai.
english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.

motu: Laḡani iboudiai unu mo heto; Iehova ena dubu ela negadia ai, ia ese unu e ha-uraia tomava. Una dainai Hana e taitaiva, bonase anianiva.
english: So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.

motu: Bena adavana Elkana ese e nanadaia, eto, Hana e, dahaka dainai o taitaimu? Dahaka dainai so anianimu? Dahaka dainai lalomu e hisihisimu? Egu lalokau oiemu ai ese memero gwauta edia se hereaia a? Hana ena ḡuriḡuri
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

motu: Silo ai e aniani bona e inuinu murinai, Hana e tore isi. Una negana ai hahelaḡa tauna Eli na Iehova ena dubu iduarana badibadinai e helaiva.
english: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.

motu: Hana na lalona e hisihisi badava, bena Iehova e ḡuria mai taitaina ida.
english: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.

motu: Bona e gwau hamata, eto, Iehova Sabaota e, emu hesiai hahinena egu hisihisi boma itaia, boma lalogu tao, basioma lalogu boio, a natugu maruanena ta na emu hesiai hahinena boma henigu; bena lau ese Iehova ma bama henia lou, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai huina basinema utua.
english: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”

motu: Hahine na ma e ḡuriḡuri Iehova va vairanai; bena Eli ese uduna e itaia.
english: As she continued praying before Yahweh, Eli saw her mouth.

motu: Hana na lalona ai mo e ḡuriḡuriva; bena bibinana e marere-marereva, to gadona na se hekamonaiva, taunabunai Eli banava eto hahine na vada e kekero.
english: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

motu: Bena Eli ese e gwau henia, eto, Ba kekero ela bona edena negai? Vine ranuna na emu amo bavatoa siri.
english: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

motu: A Hana ese e haere henia, eto, Ḡauka e, lasi. Lau na lalo-hisihisi hahinegu. Vine ranuna eiava kekeromuramurana ta asina inua, a lalogu anina na halasiamu Iehova vairanai.
english: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.

motu: Basio laloa emu hesiai hahinena na lebulebu hahinena; egu hereva iboudiai na lalogu ena hisihisi bona ena hekwarahi amo vada e vara.
english: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”

motu: Bena Eli ese e haere henia, eto, Mai mainomu ida aola; Israel Diravana ese o noilaia ḡauna na baine henimu.
english: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God + 1:17 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

motu: Hahine ma eto, Emu hesiai hahinena ba hanamoa. Bena hahine na ena dala ela, e aniani, vairana danu se huaia lou. Samuel e vara
english: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

motu: Daba ai, idia na e tore isi haraḡa, Iehova vairanai e toma diho; bena edia ruma e lou henia, Rama ai. Bena Elkana na adavana Hana ida e eno bou, bona Iehova ese e laloa tao;
english: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.

motu: bena Hana e rogorogo, bena ena nega korikori ai e mara, mero ta e abia, ladana e hatoa Samuel; + 1:20 “Samuel” anina be “Dirava ena amo e noia”. * badina be ia eto, Lau ese Iehova ena amo na noia.
english: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, + 1:20 Samuel sounds like the Hebrew for “heard by God.” * saying, “Because I have asked him of Yahweh.”

motu: Hari Elkana mai ena ruma taudia iboudiai na ela, laḡani ta boubouna bae hahelaḡaia Iehova ena bona ena gwauhamata anina baine heni totodia.
english: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

motu: A Hana na sela; ia ese adavana e hamaoroa, eto, Mero na rata baine topoa nege negana ai, lau ese baina laohaia, Iehova vairanai baine hedinarai, bona unuseni ai baine noho hanaihanai.
english: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahweh, and stay there forever.”

motu: Adavana Elkana ese e haere henia, eto, Emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ba karaia, a rata do baine topoanege guna. Ḡau tamona, Iehova ese ena hereva baine hamomokania. Taunabunai, hahine na e noho, natuna e ubua, ela bona rata e topoa nege.
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may Yahweh establish his word.” So|strong="H6213" * the|strong="H6213" * woman waited and|strong="H1121" * nursed|strong="H3243" * her|strong="H6213" * son|strong="H1121" * until|strong="H5704" * she|strong="H5704" * weaned|strong="H1580" * him|strong="H6213" *.

motu: Mero na rata e topoa nege murinai, sinana ese e laohaia; boromakau maruanena ta, laḡani toi ḡauna, bona flaoa efa + 1:24 “Efa” be Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡauna ta; anina be 18 litres sisivana. * ta, bona vine ranuna kopi ta, danu e abi kau. E laohaia, ela bona Iehova ena dubu Silo ai e kau. Mero na do maraḡi.
english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah + 1:24 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to Yahweh’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.

motu: Bena idia ese boromakau e alaia, bona mero na Eli dekena e hakaua lao.
english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

motu: Hahine na eto, Ḡauka e, oi o maurimu heḡereḡerena, ḡauka e, lau be gunaguna oi vairamu ai na gini bona Iehova na ḡuria hahinegu.
english: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to Yahweh.

motu: Ina mero dainai na ḡuriḡuri; bena Iehova ese na noia ḡauna e henigu.
english: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova vada na henia; ena mauri dinadia iboudiai ia na Iehova ena. Bena idia ese Iehova e toma henia diho unuseni ai.
english: Therefore I have also given him to Yahweh. As long as he lives he is given to Yahweh.” He worshiped Yahweh there.

motu: Hana danu e ḡuriḡuri, eto: Lalogu ese Iehova e imodaiamu; egu goada vada e herea Iehova dainai. Udugu ese inaigu e kirikirilaidiamu, badina be emu hahemauri na moalelaiamu.
english: Hannah prayed, and said, “ My|strong="H3068" * heart|strong="H3820" * exults|strong="H5970" * in|strong="H5921" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *! My|strong="H3068" * horn|strong="H7161" * is|strong="H3068" * exalted|strong="H7311" * in|strong="H5921" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *. My|strong="H3068" * mouth|strong="H6310" * is|strong="H3068" * enlarged|strong="H7337" * over|strong="H5921" * my|strong="H3068" * enemies, because|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * rejoice|strong="H8055" * in|strong="H5921" * your|strong="H3068" * salvation|strong="H3444" *.

motu: Ta dia helaḡa Iehova heḡereḡerena, asi dirava ta, oi mo sibomu, asi nadi-gini ta emai Dirava heḡereḡerena.
english: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for|strong="H3588" * there|strong="H3068" * is|strong="H3068" * no|strong="H1115" * one|strong="H6918" * besides|strong="H1115" * you|strong="H3588" *, nor|strong="H1115" * is|strong="H3068" * there|strong="H3068" * any|strong="H3588" * rock|strong="H6697" * like|strong="H3068" * our|strong="H3068" * God|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Heaḡi herevadia basio gwaurai lou, hekokoroku herevadia na udumu amo basie lasi; badina be Iehova na aonega Diravana, ia ese kara iboudiai e hahetohodiamu.
english: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let|strong="H3808" * arrogance|strong="H6277" * come|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" * of|strong="H3068" * your|strong="H3068" * mouth|strong="H6310" *, for|strong="H3588" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * is|strong="H3068" * a|strong="H3068" * God|strong="H3068" * of|strong="H3068" * knowledge|strong="H1844" *. By|strong="H3068" * him|strong="H3318" * actions|strong="H5949" * are|strong="H3068" * weighed|strong="H8505" *.

motu: Goada taudia edia peva e hakwaidudiamu, a manoka taudia na goada e hariolaimu.
english: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those|strong="H3782" * who|strong="H1368" * stumbled|strong="H3782" * are|strong="H1368" * armed with|strong="H7198" * strength|strong="H2428" *.

motu: Una negana ai Elkana na Rama e lou lao. A hari mero na Iehova isiaina e lao heniva, hahelaḡa tauna Eli vairanai.
english: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.

motu: Eli natuna na lebulebu taudia; idia ese Iehova asie matauraia.
english: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.

motu: Hari hahelaḡa taudia edia kara taunimanima ediai na iniheto. Tau ta ena boubou ḡauna e mailaia negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna ena hesiai tauna na ema, vamu dounu e naduava negana ai, diniga mai matana toi na imana ai e abia;
english: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;

motu: bena oburo eiava uro eiava tohe eiava keikei lalonai e kodoa dobi, bena hari diniga amo e kodo isi ḡaudia iboudiai na hahelaḡa tauna ana. Israel taudia iboudiai na Silo ela negadia ai na unu e karadia tomava.
english: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.

motu: Ma ina danu: digara do se haḡolea oho negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna ena hesiai tauna na bema mai, boubou ḡauna e mailaia tauna bema hereva henia, bema toma, Vamu taina na hahelaḡa tauna ba henia, baine gabua; badina be o naduamu ḡauna na oiemu amo basine abia, kasirina mo e uramu.
english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”

motu: Bena una tau bema toma “Mani digara bae haḡolea oho guna, bena emu ura heḡereḡerena bavabia”, ia na bema haere, bema toma “Lasi, harihari ba henigu; bema lasi, lau ese baina dadihaia”.
english: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

motu: Taunabunai, hari eregabe edia kara havara na bada herea Iehova vairanai; badina be idia ese Iehova ena ihaboulaina ḡaudia na asie matauraidia.
