motu: Taunabunai, mani emu kara, raragu na basine hebubu Iehova ese se hagereamu tanona ai. Badina be Israel pavapavana ese egu mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu, tau ta ese aba na ororo ai e tahuamu na heto.
english: Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of Yahweh; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains.”

motu: Bena Saulo eto, Lau vada na kara havara. Natugu David e, a lou mai, basina hadikamu lou; badina be hari ina dina ai lauegu mauri na ḡau hereana oi matamu ai. Lau be vada na kara kava, vada na kerere dikadika.
english: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.”

motu: Bena David e haere, eto, Pavapava e, emu io binai; emu eregabe ta ainema, baine abia.
english: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it.

motu: Iehova ese taunimanima iboudiai edia kara maoromaoro bona edia heabidadama davadia e henidiamu; badina be Iehova ese lau imagu ai e atomu hari dina ai, a lau imagu na Iehova ese e horoa tauna ihadikana asina dau lasi.
english: Yahweh will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed.

motu: A itaia, hari dina ai oiemu maun na ḡau hereana lau vairagu ai; una heḡereḡerena lauegu mauri na ḡau hereana ai bainela Iehova vairanai, bena dika iboudiai lalodia amo ia ese baine hamaurigu.
english: Behold, as your life was respected today in my eyes, so let my life be respected in Yahweh’s eyes, and let him deliver me out of all oppression.”

motu: Bena Saulo ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Natugu David e, hahenamo na oi latamu ai baine mia. Kara momo do ba kara, iboudiai na anidia bae vara. Taunabunai David na ena dala ai ela, a Saulo be ena gabu e lou henia.
english: Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So|strong="H6213" * David|strong="H1732" * went|strong="H3212" * his|strong="H1732" * way|strong="H1870" *, and|strong="H1121" * Saul|strong="H7586" * returned|strong="H7725" * to|strong="H7725" * his|strong="H1732" * place|strong="H4725" *.

motu: David be lalona ai eto, Dina ta lau na Saulo imana ai baina mase; egu dala namona be baina heau mauri, Filistia taudia edia tano bainala. Bena Saulo ese Israel tanona ai baine tahugu malaka-malaka elabona baine hesiku; bena ia imana amo baina roho mauri.
english: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So I will escape out of his hand.”

motu: Taunabunai, David e tore isi, e raka hanai, ia bona ena orea tataudia sinahu-tauratoiosi, Akisi Maoko, Gata pavapavana, dekena ela.
english: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

motu: Bena David na Akisi dekenai e nohova, Gata ai: ia bona ena orea taudia, mai adavadia bona mai natudia ida, bona ia adavana raruosi, Ahinoama, hane Iesrele, bona Abigail, hane Karamele, Nabala vabuna.
english: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

motu: Haida ese Saulo e hamaoroa, David vada e heau, Gata vada ela, bena ia ese ia itahuna e hadokoa.
english: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.

motu: Bena David ese Akisi e noia, eto, Boma lalo namo henigu, gabu ta boma henigu emu hanua maraḡina ta ai, unuseni ai baina noho. Namona be dahaka lau binai emu hesiai tauna na oi dekemu ai baina noho, pavapava taumu emu hanua ai?
english: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”

motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai Akisi ese Siklag e henia; una dainai Siklag na luda pavapavadia edia hanua ta, ema bona hari dina.
english: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.

motu: David na Filistia taudia edia tano ai e nohova dinadia be laḡani ta hua hani.
english: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

motu: Bena David mai ena orea taudia ida e tore isi, Gesuru taudia bona Girisi taudia bona Amalek taudia na e tuari henidia: idia be sene negana amo una tano e noholaiava, ela bona Suru, ma ela bona Aigupto tanona.
english: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.

motu: David ese tano e habuaia tari, tau ta eiava hahine ta se hamauria, a mamoe bona boromakau bona doniki bona kamelo bona dabua e abidia; bena Akisi dekena e lou lao.
english: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.

motu: A Akisi e henanadaiva, e tomava “Hari dina ai daidia o tuari henidia?” negadia ai na David e haereva, e tomava “Iuda diho kahana taudia”, eiava “Ierahamele diho kahana taudia”, eiava “Kene diho kahana taudia”.
english: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David|strong="H1732" * said, “ Against|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * South|strong="H5045" * of|strong="H3117" * Judah|strong="H3063" *, against|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * South|strong="H5045" * of|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H5921" * Jerahmeelites|strong="H3397" *, and|strong="H3063" * against|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * South|strong="H5045" * of|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H5921" * Kenites|strong="H7017" *.”

motu: David ese tau ta eiava hahine ta se hamauria badina korikori be harina na Gata bae laohaia na garina; ia lalona e hadaia, eto, Harimai bae piua, baeto “David na unu ini e kara toma” na garina. Ena kara be unuheto, Filistia tanona ai e nohova negana idoinai.
english: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”

motu: A Akisi ese David e abidadama henia; lalona e hadaia, eto, Ena kara daidiai ena bese taudia Israel ese e inai henia hereamu, taunabunai ia ese lau isiaigu baine lao heni hanaihanai.
english: Achish believed David, saying, “He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever.”

motu: Unu dinadia ai Filistia taudia ese edia tuari oreadia e haboudia, Israel taudia bae tuari henidia totona. Bena Akisi ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Ba diba, oi bona emu orea taudia na lau ida tuari oreana lalonai baitala.
english: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”

motu: David ese Akisi e haere henia, eto, Namo; oi do ba diba emu hesiai tauna ede baine kara toma. Bena Akisi ese David ma e hamaoroa, eto, Lau igimagu tauna ai baina halaomu, egu mauri dinadia iboudiai.
english: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said|strong="H3651" * to|strong="H6213" * David|strong="H1732" *, “ Therefore|strong="H3651" * I|strong="H3117" * will|strong="H5650" * make|strong="H6213" * you|strong="H3605" * my|strong="H8104" * bodyguard|strong="H8104" * forever|strong="H3605" *.”

motu: Samuel be vada e mase; Israel taudia iboudiai ia taina vada e tai, bona Rama, ena hanua korikori, ai vada e ḡuria. Saulo ese danu rohe taudia bona mea taudia na Israel tanona amo vada e luludia lasi.
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

motu: Filistia taudia na e hebou, bona ema, Sunem ai e taruha. Bena Saulo ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, Gilboa ai e taruha.
english: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

motu: Saulo ese Filistia taudia edia tuari oreana e itaia, bena e gari, kudouna e hetaha dikadika.
english: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

motu: Bena Saulo ese Iehova e nanadaia negana ai, Iehova na se haere, nihi amo eiava Urim + 28:6 Urim. Esodo, Karoa 28, siri 30 ba itaia. * amo eiava peroveta taudia edia amo.
english: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

motu: Bena Saulo ese ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Rohe hahinena ta a tahua, bena dekena bainala, iena amo baina henanadai. Ena hesiai taudia ese e haere henia, eto, Rohe hahinena ta be En-doro ai e nohomu.
english: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His|strong="H1245" * servants|strong="H5650" * said to|strong="H3212" * him|strong="H1245" *, “ Behold|strong="H2009" *, there|strong="H2009" * is|strong="H2009" * a|strong="H3068" * woman who|strong="H5650" * has|strong="H5650" * a|strong="H3068" * familiar spirit at|strong="H7586" * Endor|strong="H5874" *.”

motu: Bena Saulo ese oromana e ha-idaua, bona dabua idaudia e dokidia; bena ela, tatau rarua ida. Hanuaboi ai idia na una hahine dekenai e kau. Bena Saulo eto, E rohemu laumana amo ba haere henigu, bona ladana baina hatoa tauna laumana ba hadaea.
english: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”

motu: Hahine na e haere henia, eto, Saulo ena kara dibamu namonamo, ani? Ia na rohe taudia bona mea taudia na Israel tanona amo vada e luludia lasi. Dahaka dainai egu mauri o idoaiamu, ihamasegu totona?
english: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”

motu: Bena Saulo ese Iehova ladana ai hereva metaudia amo e gwau henia hamata, eto, Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena, dava dikana ta emu ai basine kau ina kara dainai.
english: Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, “As Yahweh lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”

motu: Bena hahine eto, Daika baina hadaea emu ai? Ia eto, Samuel ba hadaea egu ai.
english: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He|strong="H4310" * said, “ Bring|strong="H5927" * Samuel|strong="H8050" * up|strong="H5927" * for|strong="H4310" * me|strong="H5927" *.”

motu: Hahine ese Samuel e itaia, bena e lolo lalo dika. Bena hahine ese Saulo e gwau henia, eto, Dahaka dainai o koigu? Oi na Saulo.
english: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”

motu: Pavapava ese e hamaoroa, eto, Asio gari; dahaka o itaiamu? Hahine ese Saulo ma e hamaoroa, eto, Dirava ta na itaiamu; ia na tano lalona amo e daemu.
english: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The|strong="H7200" * woman said to|strong="H5927" * Saul|strong="H7586" *, “ I|strong="H3588" * see|strong="H7200" * a|strong="H3068" * god coming|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" * out|strong="H4480" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H7200" * earth|strong="H5927" *.”

motu: Ma e nanadaia, eto, Ita-itana be edeheto? Hahine na eto, Tau burukanata e daemu; ia na dabua badana e hetarulaia. Bena Saulo dibana una na Samuel; bena tano ai e goru diho, e toma henia diho.
english: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She|strong="H1931" * said, “ An|strong="H3588" * old|strong="H2205" * man|strong="H2205" * comes|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" *. He|strong="H1931" * is|strong="H1931" * covered|strong="H5844" * with|strong="H3045" * a|strong="H3068" * robe|strong="H4598" *.” Saul|strong="H7586" * perceived|strong="H3045" * that|strong="H3588" * it|strong="H1931" * was|strong="H7586" * Samuel|strong="H8050" *, and|strong="H7586" * he|strong="H1931" * bowed|strong="H7812" * with|strong="H3045" * his|strong="H3045" * face to|strong="H5927" * the|strong="H3588" * ground, and|strong="H7586" * showed respect|strong="H3045" *.

motu: Bena Samuel ese Saulo e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka dainai vada o haraivagu, vada o hadaegu? Saulo e haere, eto, Lalogu na e hekwarahi badamu, badina be Filistia taudia ese e tuari henigumu bona Dirava ese vada e rakatanigu, bona se haere henigumu, peroveta edia amo eiava nihi amo. Taunabunai oi vada na boirimu, ede baina kara toma na ba hamaorolaigu.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul|strong="H7586" * answered|strong="H6030" *, “ I|strong="H5921" * am very|strong="H3966" * distressed|strong="H6887" *; for|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * Philistines|strong="H6430" * make|strong="H6213" * war|strong="H3898" * against|strong="H5921" * me|strong="H5921" *, and|strong="H6030" * God|strong="H3808" * has|strong="H4100" * departed|strong="H5493" * from|strong="H5493" * me|strong="H5921" *, and|strong="H6030" * answers|strong="H6030" * me|strong="H5921" * no|strong="H3808" * more|strong="H5750" *, by|strong="H3027" * prophets|strong="H5030" *, or|strong="H3808" * by|strong="H3027" * dreams|strong="H2472" *. Therefore|strong="H5921" * I|strong="H5921" * have|strong="H3045" * called|strong="H7121" * you|strong="H5921" *, that|strong="H3045" * you|strong="H5921" * may|strong="H6213" * make|strong="H6213" * known|strong="H3045" * to|strong="H5927" * me|strong="H5921" * what|strong="H4100" * I|strong="H5921" * shall|strong="H3027" * do|strong="H6213" *.”

motu: Samuel eto, Iehova ese vada e rakatanimu bona e inai henimumu, matogana lau ma o nanadaigumu a?
english: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?

motu: Iehova ese vada e kara henimu, lauegu ai e gwauraia heḡereḡerena; badina be Iehova ese basileia na oi imamu amo vada e dadihaia, dekemu tauna David vada e henia.
english: Yahweh has done to you as he spoke by me. Yahweh has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

motu: Badina be Iehova erena so kamonai, bona ena badu ḡaraḡara Amalek taudia ediai anina so hamomokania; una dainai Iehova ese ini vada e karamu toma hari ina dina ai.
english: Because you didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you today.

motu: Ina danu, Iehova ese oi bona Israel taudia danu Filistia taudia imadia ai baine atomui; bena kerukeru oi bona natumu mamaruanedia na lau dekegu baoma. Iehova ese danu Israel ena tuari oreana na Filistia ena tuari oreana imadia ai baine atodia.
english: Moreover Yahweh will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Yahweh will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”

motu: Bena Saulo na maoromaoro e goru parapara tano ai, bona gari ese e butua tao, Samuel ena hereva daidiai; ia taunadanu e manori, badina be ḡau ta se ania, dina idoinai bona hanuaboi idoinai.
english: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.

motu: Bena hari hahine na Saulo dekena ema, e itaia, gari ese vada e butua tao; bena ia ese e hereva henia, eto, A itagu, lau binai emu hesiai hahinena na eremu na kamonai, bona emu hereva ikamonai-henina amo egu mauri na atoa diho.
english: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

motu: Taunabunai, harihari oi danu emu hesiai hahinena erena ba kamonai: mani emu kara, aniani taina oi vairamu ai baina dabaraia, bena bavania, taumu do baine auka. bena emu dala ai baola.
english: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”

motu: Ia e gwau hedadarai, eto, Basina aniani. A ena hesiai taudia bona una hahine ese e noia goadagoada; bena ia ese idia eredia e kamonai. Taunabunai ia na tano amo e tore isi, mahuta patana ai e helai diho.
english: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.

motu: Una hahine na mai ena boromakau natuna ta, ubu-ubu ḡauna, ruma ai; taunabunai ia ese e alaiaharaga. Bena flaoa e abia, e kuia, asi ihatubuna ḡauna, bena e gabua,
english: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

motu: Saulo bona ena hesiai taudia vairadiai e dabaraia, bena idia ese e ania. Bena idia na e tore isi, una hanuaboi ai e raka ela.
english: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.

motu: Filistia taudia ese edia tuari oreadia e haboudia Afek ai; bona Israel taudia na Iesrele ranu gurina badibadinai e taruha.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

motu: Filistia lohiadia na edia sinahu sinahu ida bona edia daha daha ida e raka lao; bona idia muridiai David bona ena orea taudia na Akisi ida e raka.
english: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.

motu: Bena Filistia edia tuari biagudia eto, Ini Heberu taudia na dahaka e karamu iniseni ai? Akisi ese Filistia edia tuari biagudia e haere henidia, eto, Ina na David, ani, Israel pavapavana Saulo ena hesiai tauna; ia na dina momo bona laḡani haida lau dekegu ai vada e noho, bona ena kerere ta asina davaria, egu ai e hanai negana ema bona hari ina dina.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to|strong="H5704" * the|strong="H3117" * princes|strong="H8269" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H3117" * Philistines|strong="H6430" *, “Isn’t this|strong="H2088" * David|strong="H1732" *, the|strong="H3117" * servant|strong="H5650" * of|strong="H4428" * Saul|strong="H7586" * the|strong="H3117" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H4428" * Israel|strong="H3478" *, who|strong="H5650" * has|strong="H1961" * been|strong="H1961" * with|strong="H3117" * me|strong="H4672" * these|strong="H2088" * days|strong="H3117" *, or|strong="H3808" * rather|strong="H3808" * these|strong="H2088" * years|strong="H8141" *? I|strong="H3117" * have|strong="H1961" * found|strong="H4672" * no|strong="H3808" * fault|strong="H3972" * in|strong="H8141" * him|strong="H4672" * since|strong="H3117" * he|strong="H3117" * fell|strong="H5307" * away|strong="H5307" * until|strong="H5704" * today|strong="H3117" *.”

motu: A Filistia edia tuari biagudia ese e badu henia, bena e gwau henia, eto, Ena tau a siaia lou, o henia gabuna baine lou lao; ia na ita ida basine diho tuari gabuna, tuari lalonai baine inai henida na garina. Badina be ina tau na ena lohia ida ede baine herohemaino toma? Ini tatau kwaradia amo ani?
english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

motu: Ina na David, ani, edia mavaru ai e anelaia, eto, Saulo ese ena daha daha e aladia, A David ese ena gerebu gerebu e aladia.
english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘ Saul|strong="H7586" * has|strong="H7586" * slain|strong="H5221" * his|strong="H1732" * thousands|strong="H7233" *, and|strong="H6030" * David|strong="H1732" * his|strong="H1732" * ten|strong="H7233" * thousands|strong="H7233" *’?”

motu: Bena Akisi ese David e boiria, eto, Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena, oi na mai momokanimu ida, bona lau na tomamu oi na lau ida baita raka hebou tuari lalonai be namo; badina be lau ese emu kerere ta asina davaria, lau dekegu ai o kau dinana amo ema bona hari dina. Ḡau tamona, hari lohia na asie ura henimumu.
english: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As Yahweh lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.

motu: Taunabunai, harihari a lou, mai mainomu ida aola, Filistia taudia lohiadia ba habadudia na garina.
english: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”

motu: Bena David ese Akisi e hamaoroa, eto, Lau be dahaka vada na karaia? Emu hesiai tauna enai dahaka kerere vada o davaria, oi isiaimu na lao heni matama dinana amo ema bona hari, bena una dainai lau na basinala, egu lohia bona egu pavapava inaina ituari-henidia a?
english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

motu: Bena Akisi ese David e haere henia, eto, Lau dibagu oi na asi emu kerere lau vairagu ai, Dirava ena aneru heḡereḡerena; ḡau tamona Filistia edia tuari biagudia vada e hereva, eto “Ia na ita ida tuari basinela”.
english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’

motu: Taunabunai, daba matana ai ba tore isi, emu lohia ena hesiai taudia, oi oma negana ai e bamomuva taudia, ida; daba matana ai ba tore isi, gabu baine diari-diari vada ba raka.
english: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

motu: Taunabunai David na daba matana aie raka, mai ena orea taudia ida, Filistia tanona bae lou henia totona. A Filistia taudia na Iesrele e dae lao.
english: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai David na ena orea taudia ida Siklag ai e kau, e diba, Amalek taudia ese diho kahana tanodia bona Siklag danu vada e tuari henidia. Siklag na vada e hadarerea, vada e doua,
english: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

motu: bona hahine bona hanua taudia iboudiai, kikina-badana, vada e abidia mauri. Ta asie alaia, to iboudiai e hakaudia lao, edia dala ela.
english: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

motu: Taunabunai, David mai ena orea taudia ida hanua ai e kau negana ai, e itaia, lahi ese vada e araia, bona adavadia bona natudia, mamaruanedia bona hahinedia, vada e abidia mauri.
english: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

motu: Bena David mai bamona ida e tai lolololo, ela bona edia goada vada e ore, asi goadadia ma bae tai.
english: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

motu: David adavana raruosi danu vada e abidia mauri: Ahinoama, Iesrele hahinena, bona Abigail, Karamele tauna Nabala vabuna.
english: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

motu: David lalona na e hisihisi bada; badina be ena orea taudia ese nadi amo ihodona e herevalaia. Badina be iboudiai na lalodia e dika. natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia daidiai. A David na e haheauka, Iehova, ena Dirava, enai goada e abia.
english: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.

motu: Bena David ese hahelaḡa tauna Abiatara, Ahimelek natuna, e hamaoroa, eto, Hahedoki helaḡana na dekegu a mailaia. Taunabunai, Abiatara ese hahedoki helaḡana na David dekena e mailaia.
english: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought|strong="H5066" * the|strong="H1732" * ephod to|strong="H1121" * David|strong="H1732" *.

motu: Bena David ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Una orea na baina ḡavadia a? Baina lasidia tao a? Ia ese e haere henia, eto, A ḡavadia; badina be momokani bo lasidia taomu, bona abi-maun taudia ba hamauridia.
english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He|strong="H3588" * answered him|strong="H7592" *, “ Pursue|strong="H7291" *, for|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * surely|strong="H3588" * overtake|strong="H5381" * them|strong="H7291" *, and|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H3068" * without|strong="H3588" * fail|strong="H5337" * recover|strong="H5337" * all|strong="H5337" *.”

motu: Taunabunai David na e tore isi, bamona sinahu tauratoiosi danu ia ida, ela, Besoro sinavaina ai e kau, haida unuseni ai e rakatanidia.
english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

motu: A David na e ḡava, ia bona tatau sinahu hani; sinahu rua e noho, badina be taudia e manori, asi goadadia Besoro sinavaina bae hanaia.
english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

motu: Aigupto tauna ta e davaria, tano paka ai, bena David dekena e hakaua lao. Flaoa e henia, bena e ania; inuinu ranuna danu e henia.
english: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

motu: Suke huahuana manena taina e henia, bona vine huahuadia kakorodia tako rua. E aniani vaitani, bena lalona e mauri lou; badina be dina toi hanuaboi toi ia na se aniani bona se inuinu.
english: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.

motu: David ese e nanadaia. eto, Oi na daika ena orea tauna? Bona ede amo oma? Ia eto, Lau na eregabe ta Aigupto amo Amalek tauna ta ena hesiai tauna. Dina toi vada ela, e goreregu, bena biagugu ese e rakatanigu.
english: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He|strong="H3588" * said, “ I|strong="H3588" * am|strong="H2470" * a|strong="H3068" * young|strong="H5288" * man|strong="H5288" * of|strong="H3117" * Egypt|strong="H4713" *, servant|strong="H5650" * to|strong="H3117" * an|strong="H3588" * Amalekite|strong="H6003" *; and|strong="H3117" * my|strong="H1732" * master left|strong="H5800" * me|strong="H5800" *, because|strong="H3588" * three|strong="H7969" * days|strong="H3117" * ago|strong="H3117" * I|strong="H3588" * got sick|strong="H2470" *.

motu: Ai na Kerete taudia edia tano diho kahana, bona Iuda tanona, bona Kaleb ena tano diho kahana, a tuari henidia; bena Siklag na lahi amo a doua.
english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

motu: David eto, Ba hakaugu lao una orea enai, ani? Hari tau eto, Dirava ladana ai ba gwau henigu hamata, basio alagu mase, bona biagugu imana ai basio atogu, bena baina hakaumu lao una orea enai.
english: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He|strong="H1732" * said, “ Swear|strong="H7650" * to|strong="H3381" * me|strong="H4191" * by|strong="H3027" * God|strong="H3027" * that|strong="H2088" * you|strong="H3381" * will|strong="H3027" * not|strong="H2088" * kill|strong="H4191" * me|strong="H4191" * and|strong="H3027" * not|strong="H2088" * deliver|strong="H5462" * me|strong="H4191" * up|strong="H5462" * into|strong="H3381" * the|strong="H3027" * hands|strong="H3027" * of|strong="H3027" * my|strong="H1732" * master, and|strong="H3027" * I|strong="H2088" * will|strong="H3027" * bring|strong="H3381" * you|strong="H3381" * down|strong="H3381" * to|strong="H3381" * this|strong="H2088" * troop|strong="H1416" *.”

motu: E hakaua lao, bena e itadia, idia na tano idoinai e taruhaia evaeva, e anianiva, e inuinuva, e mavaruva, kohu bada-herea Filistia taudiaedia tano ai bona Iuda tanona ai vada e dadi daidiai.
english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

motu: Dina e diho ai, David ese e ala-ala henidia, ela bona daba, ela bona dina ma e diho. Tauta se roho mauri, aeregabe taudia sinahu hani mo kamelo ai e gui, e heau.
english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

motu: Amalek taudia ese e abi ḡaudia iboudiai na David ese ma e abi lou. David ese danu adavana raruosi e hamauridia.
english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

motu: Ḡau ta se boio, maraḡina eiava badana, eiava natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia, eiava e dadi kohudia, eiava e abi ḡaudia ta. David ese idoinai e loulaia.
english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

motu: David ese danu mamoe seridia bona boromakau seridia iboudiai e abidia mauri; bena orea taudia ese ia vairanai e luludia lao, eto, Ini na David ena dadidadi ḡaudia.
english: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

motu: Bena David na hari tatau sinahu-rua, tau-manori dainai David murinaiasie raka bena Besoro sinavaina badibadinai e rakatanidia taudia, na dekediai e kau. Idia na e raka lasi, David bona ena orea taudia ida bae hedavari totona. Bena David ese e raka henidia kahi, e hanamodia.
english: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

motu: Bena David ida ela oreana lalona amo, kara dika bona lalo-hadai dikadia taudia iboudiai eto, Idia na ita ida asitala dainai ta abi lou kohudia na taidia basita henidia, a idia ta ta adavadia bona natudia bae hakaudia, baela.
english: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

motu: A David eto, Tadikakagu e, Iehova ese vada e henida ḡaudia na unu basio karalai toma; ia ese vada e hamaurida, bona e tuari henida oreana na imada ai vada e atodia.
english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

motu: Daika ese baine kamonai henimui, ina kara ai. Badina be tuari ela tauna ahuna bona kohu badibadinai e nohova tauna ahuna bae heḡereḡere; ahudia na bae tamona.
english: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

motu: Una dina amo ema bona hari dina ai, ia ese Israel taudia taravadia unu e atu toma, bona unu e hahemaoro henidia toma.
english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

motu: David na Siklag ai e kau, bena e abi kohudia kahana na turana Iuda tau-badadia dekediai e siaia, eto, Harihari ḡauna binai, Iehova inaina edia amo a dadi ḡaudia.
english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of Yahweh’s enemies.”

motu: Dekediai e siaia taudia bini: Betele taudia, Ramoto diho kahana taudia, latiri taudia,
english: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

motu: Aroere taudia, Sifimoto taudia, Estemoa taudia,
english: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

motu: bona Rakala taudia, bona Ierahamele hanuadia taudia, bona Kene hanuadia taudia,
english: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

motu: bona Horoma taudia, bona Borasana taudia, bona Ataka taudia,
english: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

motu: bona Heberon taudia. Unu gabu iboudiai na David mai bamona ida vada e loa evaeva henidia gabudia.
english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

motu: Filistia taudia ese Israel taudia e tuari henidia; bena Israel taudia na Filistia taudia vairadia amo e heau, ela bona Gilboa ororona ai Filistia taudia ese e aladia ore.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

motu: Bena Filistia taudia ese Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia ida e lasidia tao; bena Filistia taudia ese Saulo natuna mamaruanedia Ionatan bona Abinadab bona Malkisua e aladia mase.
english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

motu: Tuari na auka herea, Saulo enai; peva taudia ese e davaria, bona edia diba amo e haberoa.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

motu: Bena Saulo ese ena kesi ihuana tauna e hamaoroa, eto, Emu dare a veria lasi, ba gwadagu mase, ini asie peritomedia taudia na baema, bae gwadagu bona bae kirikirilaigu na garina. A ena kesi ihuana tauna na e gwau edeede, badina be e gari dikadika. Taunibunai, Saulo ese ena dare e abia, bena matana ai sibona e hetoḡe.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

motu: Ena kesi ihuana tauna ese e itaia, Saulo vada e mase, bena ia danu ena dare matana ai sibona e hetoḡe, ia ida e mase hebou.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

motu: Saulo na unu e mase toma, bona natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi, bona ena kesi ihuana tauna, bona ena orea taudia iboudiai, dina tamona ai e mase bou.
english: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

motu: Bena Israel taudia haida koura kahana ai bona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai e nohova na vada e diba Israel taudia vada e heau bona Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia ida vada e mase; una negana ai edia hanua e rakatanidia, e heau. Bena Filistia taudia ema, unu hanua e noholaidia.
english: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

motu: Daba rerena ai Filistia taudia na ema, mase taudia edia dabua bae abi eto. Bena Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi ida masedia ai e dabaridia, Gilboa ororona ai.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

motu: Bena Saulo kwarana e utua oho, ena tuari dabuadia danu e koki oho. Bena idia ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia karoho, Filistia rtnona idoinai, hari namona na edia kaivakuku dubudia ai bona edia bese taudia vairadiai bae piua totona.
english: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.

motu: Saulo ena tuari dabuadia na Astaroto ena dubu ai e atoa; bona tau-anina na Bete-sana hanuana maḡuna ai e kapaia kau.
english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

motu: A Iabese-gilead taudia na harina e kamonai, Filistia taudia ese Saulo unu e karaia toma,
english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

motu: bena boga-auka taudia iboudiai e tore isi, e raka rani, Saulo tau-anina natuna mamaruanedia tau-anidia na Bete-sana maḡuna amo e abidia dobi. Bena Iabese ela, unuseni ai e hagabudia.
english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

motu: Bena turiadia e abidia, au ta ladana tamarisk * henunai e guridia, Iabese ai. Bena dina hitu e ani vaga.
english: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk + 31:13 or, salt cedar * tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

motu: Saulo ena mase murinai, David na Amalek taudia ialadia amo e lou; bena David na dina rua e nohova Siklag ai.
english: After the death of Saul, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had stayed two days in Ziklag,

motu: Dina ihatoina ai, tau ta ema, Saulo ena taruha amo; ena dabua vada e hedare bona tano na kwarana tubuana ai heato. Ia na David dekenai e kau, bena e igo diho.
english: on the third day, behold, + 1:2 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the earth and showed respect.

motu: David ese e nanadaia, eto, Ede amo oma? Ia e haere, eto, Lau na Israel taudia edia taruha amo vada na roho mauri.
english: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He|strong="H1732" * said to|strong="H3478" * him|strong="H1732" *, “ I|strong="H2088" * have|strong="H3478" * escaped|strong="H4422" * out|strong="H4422" * of|strong="H4264" * the|strong="H1732" * camp|strong="H4264" * of|strong="H4264" * Israel|strong="H3478" *.”

motu: David ese ma e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka e vara? A hamaorogu. Ia ma e haere, eto, Orea taudia na tuari amo e heau, bena hutuma vada e keto, vada e mase; Saulo mai natuna lonatan ida danu vada e mase.
english: David said to him, “How did it go? Please tell me.” He|strong="H1732" * answered|strong="H5046" *, “ The|strong="H4480" * people|strong="H5971" * have|strong="H1961" * fled|strong="H5127" * from|strong="H4480" * the|strong="H4480" * battle|strong="H4421" *, and|strong="H1121" * many|strong="H7235" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H4480" * people|strong="H5971" * also|strong="H1571" * have|strong="H1961" * fallen|strong="H5307" * and|strong="H1121" * are|strong="H5971" * dead|strong="H4191" *. Saul|strong="H7586" * and|strong="H1121" * Jonathan|strong="H3083" * his|strong="H1732" * son|strong="H1121" * are|strong="H5971" * dead|strong="H4191" * also|strong="H1571" *.”

motu: Bena David ese han tau eregabe, una hereva e hamaorolaia tauna, ma e nanadaia, eto, Ede o diba toma Saulo mai natuna lonatan ida vada e mase?
english: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”

motu: Hari eregabe tauna eto, Lau na so vada na loa kavava Gilboa ororona ai. Saulo na unuseni ai, ena io ai e heto'o tao, bona kariota bona hosi ai e gui taudia na vada e mai heniamu.
english: The young man who told him said, “As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Saul was leaning on his spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed close behind him.

motu: Ia e roha mun, e itagu; bena e boirigu. Lau na haere, nato, Lau o ina.
english: When he looked behind him, he saw me and called to me. I answered, ‘Here I am.’

motu: Ia e nanadaigu, eto, Oi be daika? Na haere, nato, Lau na Amalek tauna.
english: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’

motu: Ia ma eto, Badibadigu ai ba gini, bavalagu mase; badina be hisihisi ese e gugubagumu, a doini na maunmu.
english: He said to me, ‘Please stand beside me, and kill me, for anguish has taken hold of me because my life lingers in me.’

motu: Bena badibadinai na gini, na alaia mase; badina be na diba momokani ena keto murinai na basine maun diba. Bena havava ḡauna na kwarana ai bona toea na imana ai na kokidia; vada na mailaidia, egu lohia, oi dekemu ai.
english: So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.”

motu: Bena David ese ena dabua e abi, e daredia; ia bamona iboudiai danu unu e kara toma.
english: Then David took hold on his clothes and tore them; and all the men who were with him did likewise.

motu: Bena e lalo hisihisiva, e taiva, bona e ani vagava, ela bona dina e diho; Saulo bona natuna Ionatan bona Iehova ena orea taudia bona Israel besena taidia e taiva, badina be idia na dare amo vada e mase.
english: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, + 1:12 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * and for the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.

motu: Bena David ese una hari e mailaia tau-eregabena ma e nanadaia, eto, Oi na ede amo oma? Ia e haere, eto, Lau na tau Amalek, noho-hedoa tauna ta, natuna.
english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He|strong="H1732" * answered|strong="H5046" *, “ I|strong="H2088" * am the|strong="H5046" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * a|strong="H3068" * foreigner|strong="H1121" *, an|strong="H2088" * Amalekite|strong="H6003" *.”

motu: David ese ma e nanadaia, eto, Edeheto oi na imamu itoi-rorona, Iehova ese e horoa tauna iala-masena, na garina to gari a?
english: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”

motu: Bena David ese eregabe taudia ta e boiria, eto, A ha alaia. Bena e rahua mase.
english: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.

motu: David ese e hamaoroa, eto, Raramu be sibomu kwaramu ai, badina be sibomu vada o hahebade, oto “Iehova ese e horoa tauna na na alaia mase”. David ese Saulo bona Ionatan taidia e tai
english: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain Yahweh’s anointed.’”

motu: Bena David ese Saulo mai natuna Ionatan ida taidia e tai, ena tai anena binai.
english: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son

motu: Bona e hahedua, Iuda taudia bae hadibalaidia eto. A itaia, ḡauna na lasara ena buka ai vada e torea. Ia eto:
english: (and he commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow; behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):

motu: Israel e, oi hairaimu na emu ororo doridia ai vada e hamasea; Goada taudia madi, vada e keto.
english: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the|strong="H5921" * mighty|strong="H1368" * have|strong="H3478" * fallen|strong="H5307" *!

motu: Gata ai basio herevalaia Askelono ariaradia ai basio gwauraia hedinarai; Filistia hahinedia bae moale na garina, asie peritomedia taudia natudia hahinedia na bae hisi dae na garina.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t publish|strong="H1319" * it|strong="H8055" * in|strong="H6189" * the|strong="H5046" * streets|strong="H2351" * of|strong="H1323" * Ashkelon, lest|strong="H6435" * the|strong="H5046" * daughters|strong="H1323" * of|strong="H1323" * the|strong="H5046" * Philistines|strong="H6430" * rejoice|strong="H8055" *, lest|strong="H6435" * the|strong="H5046" * daughters|strong="H1323" * of|strong="H1323" * the|strong="H5046" * uncircumcised|strong="H6189" * triumph|strong="H5937" *.

motu: Umui Gilboa ororomui e, hunu eiava medu na latamui ai basie diho, animui na basie vara ḡahuḡala; badina be unuseni ai goada tauna ena kesi e hamiroa, Saulo ena kesi, dehoro amo asie horoa ḡauna.
english: You mountains of Gilboa, let there|strong="H8033" * be|strong="H2022" * no|strong="H1097" * dew|strong="H2919" * or|strong="H7704" * rain|strong="H4306" * on|strong="H5921" * you|strong="H3588" *, and|strong="H8033" * no|strong="H1097" * fields|strong="H7704" * of|strong="H2022" * offerings|strong="H8641" *; for|strong="H3588" * there|strong="H8033" * the|strong="H5921" * shield|strong="H4043" * of|strong="H2022" * the|strong="H5921" * mighty|strong="H1368" * was|strong="H7586" * defiled|strong="H1602" * and|strong="H8033" * cast away|strong="H1602" *, the|strong="H5921" * shield|strong="H4043" * of|strong="H2022" * Saul|strong="H7586" * was|strong="H7586" * not|strong="H3588" * anointed|strong="H4899" * with|strong="H5921" * oil|strong="H8081" *.

motu: E aladia taudia raradia amo, siahu taudia hidiodia amo, Ionatan ena peva na se lou, Saulo ena dare na se lou kava.
english: From the blood of the slain, from|strong="H7725" * the|strong="H7725" * fat|strong="H2459" * of|strong="H1368" * the|strong="H7725" * mighty|strong="H1368" *, Jonathan|strong="H3083" *’s bow|strong="H7198" * didn’t turn|strong="H7725" * back|strong="H7725" *. Saul|strong="H7586" *’s sword|strong="H2719" * didn’t return|strong="H7725" * empty|strong="H7387" *.

motu: Saulo bona lonatan, mai lalokaudia bona mai raho-namodia, mauri ai bona mase ai asie haheparara. Ugava edia haraḡa na e hereadia, leona edia goada na e hereadia.
english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In|strong="H7586" * their|strong="H3808" * death|strong="H4194" *, they|strong="H3808" * were|strong="H7586" * not|strong="H3808" * divided|strong="H6504" *. They|strong="H3808" * were|strong="H7586" * swifter|strong="H7043" * than|strong="H3808" * eagles|strong="H5404" *. They|strong="H3808" * were|strong="H7586" * stronger|strong="H1396" * than|strong="H3808" * lions.

motu: Israel hahinemui e, Saulo taina ba tai; ia ese dabua kakakaka e hadokilaimuiva, gold * heraheradia amo emui dabua e haheralaidia.
english: You daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who|strong="H3478" * clothed|strong="H3847" * you|strong="H5921" * delicately in|strong="H5921" * scarlet|strong="H8144" *, who|strong="H3478" * put|strong="H3847" * ornaments|strong="H5716" * of|strong="H1323" * gold|strong="H2091" * on|strong="H5921" * your|strong="H5921" * clothing|strong="H3830" *.

motu: Goada taudia madi ihabaidia, tuari bogaraginai vada e keto. Ionatan na emu ororo doridia ai e hamasea.
english: How the mighty have fallen in the middle of the battle! Jonathan|strong="H3083" * was|strong="H4421" * slain|strong="H2491" * on|strong="H5921" * your|strong="H5921" * high|strong="H1116" * places|strong="H1116" *.

motu: Tadigu Ionatan e, lalogu na e hisihisi hereamu oi daimu ai. Oi ese vada o lalo namo henigu, vada o lalokau l-enigu bada; emu lalokau egu ai ese hahine ilalokau-henidia e hereaia.
english: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan. You|strong="H5921" * have|strong="H6887" * been|strong="H6887" * very|strong="H3966" * pleasant|strong="H5276" * to|strong="H5921" * me|strong="H5921" *. Your|strong="H5921" * love to|strong="H5921" * me|strong="H5921" * was|strong="H3966" * wonderful|strong="H6381" *, surpassing the|strong="H5921" * love of|strong="H5921" * women.

motu: Goada taudia madi vada e keto, bona tuari gaudia vada e kwaidu.
english: How the mighty have fallen, and|strong="H5307" * the|strong="H5307" * weapons|strong="H3627" * of|strong="H3627" * war|strong="H4421" * have|strong="H5307" * perished!”

motu: Una murinai David ese Iehova e nanadaia, eto, Iuda hanuadia haida baina dae henidia eiava? Iehova ese e haere henia, eto, A dae lao. David eto Edena baina dae henia? Iehova eto, Heberon.
english: After this, David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” Yahweh|strong="H3068" * said|strong="H3651" * to|strong="H3068" * him|strong="H7592" *, “ Go|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" *.” David|strong="H1732" * said|strong="H3651" *, “Where shall|strong="H3068" * I|strong="H3651" * go|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" *?” He|strong="H3651" * said|strong="H3651" *, “ To|strong="H3068" * Hebron|strong="H2275" *.”

motu: Taunabunai, David na unua ela, mai adavana raruosi ida: Ahinoama, Iesrele hahinena, bona Abigail, Nabala tau Karamele vabuna.
english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

motu: Bena David ese ena orea taudia e hakaudia dae; iboudiai na edia ruma taudia ida ela. Bena Heberon hanuadia ai e nohova.
english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

motu: Bena Iuda taudia na ela; unuseni ai idia ese David e horoa, Iuda iduhuna pavapavana ai e halaoa. Una negana ai idia ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Iabese-gilead taudia ese Saulo e guria.
english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

motu: Bena David ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Iabese-gilead taudia dekediai, e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova ese baine hanamomui, badina be emui abidadama na biagumui Saulo enai o hahedinaraia, bena o guria.
english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

motu: Iehova ese ena hebogahisi bona ena heabidadama emui ai baine hahedinarai. Bona lau danu baina hanamomui, una kara o karaia dainai.
english: Now may Yahweh show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

motu: Taunabunai, imamui ba ha-aukadia, ba goada; badina be biagumui Saulo vada e mase, bona Iuda taudia ese vada e horogu, edia pavapava ai bainala. Saulo natuna na Israel pavapavana ai ela
english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

motu: Una negana ai Abnere, Nere natuna, Saulo ena tuari oreana biaguna, ese Saulo natuna Isiboset e abia, Mahanaim e laohaia,
english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

motu: pavapava ai e halaoa: Gilead bona Asuru bona Iesrele bona Efraim bona Beniamina oreadia edia pavapava, bona Israel idoinai pavapavana.
english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

motu: Isiboset Saulo ena mauri laḡanidia na hari-ahui, Israel besena e lohiaia matama negana ai; laḡani rua hona e lohiaia. A Iuda iduhuna ese David e badinaia.
english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

motu: David ese laḡani hitu hua tauratoi Iuda iduhuna e lohiaia, Heberon ai. Tuari e vara
english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

motu: Abnere Nere, Isiboset Saulo ena hesiai taudia ida, na Mahanaim e rakatania, Gibeon ela.
english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

motu: Bena loab Seruia, David ena hesiai taudia ida, na e raka lasi, Gibeon gohugohuna isena ai idia ida e hedavari. Bena e helai diho, orea ta gohugohu kahana ai, ma orea ta kahana ai.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

motu: Bena Abnere ese loab e hamaoroa, eto, Eregabe taudia na bae tore isi, ita vairadai bae heatu heatu helulu. Ioab eto, Ae tore isi.
english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab|strong="H3097" * said, “ Let|strong="H4994" * them|strong="H6440" * arise|strong="H6965" *!”

motu: Bena e tore isi, e raka hanai, gwauta-rarua Beniamina bona Isiboset Saulo edia, bona David ena hesiai taudia danu gwauta-rarua.
english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

motu: Bena ta ta ese ana dagae ana daḡae kwaradia e heabi heheni, edia dare amo ohedia e gwada; bena e keto hebou. Taunabunai, una gabu ladana e hatoa Helkatahasurim; + 2:16 “Helekata-hasurim” anina be “Dare mataka-mataka gabuna”. * gabuna na Gibeon ai.
english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim. + 2:16 “Helkath Hazzurim” means “field of daggers”. *

motu: Una dina ai tuari na auka herea, bona David ena hesiai taudia ese Abnere bona Israel taudia na e hadareredia. Abnere ese Asahele e alaia mase
english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

motu: Seruia natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi na unuseni ai: Ioab bona Abisai bona Asahele. Hari Asahele na mai heau dibana, ena heau na uda diana ena heau na heto.
english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

motu: Bena Asahele ese Abnere e ḡavaia; iḡavana ai se heau siri, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai.
english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

motu: Bena Abnere e roha mun, eto, Asahele, ena oi a? Asahele e haere, eto, Ina na lau.
english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He|strong="H2088" * answered, “ It|strong="H6437" * is|strong="H2088" *.”

motu: Abnere eto, Idibamu kahana ai eiava laurimu kahana ai a heau siri, eregabe tauna ta ba dabaia tao, ena ḡau ba dadi. A Asahele na Abnere iḡavana amo se heau siri.
english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

motu: Bena Abnere ese Asahele e hereva henia lou, eto, Iḡavagu amo ba raka siri; baina gwadamu mase anina be dahaka? Kakamu Ioab vairanai ede baina igo isi toma?
english: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”

motu: A lalona e ha-aukaia, se raka siri. Taunabunai, Abnere ese ena io dorina amo ia bogana e gwadaia; bena io na doruna amo e lasi; e keto, bena e keto gabuna ai e mase. Bena Asahele e mase gabuna ai e kau taudia iboudiai na unuseni ai e gini.
english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

motu: A Ioab bona Abisai ese Abnere e gavaia. Dina e dihova ai, idia na Ama ororona ai e kau; una ororo na Gia vairanai, Gibeon tanoḡaḡaena e lao heniamu dalana ai.
english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

motu: Bena Beniamina taudia e hebou, Abnere murinai; orea tamona ai e hahebou, ororo ta dorina ai e gini.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

motu: Bena Abnere ese loab e boi henia, eto, Dare baine ala-ala hanaihanai a? Asi dibamu dokona na baine idita a? Edena negai emu orea taudia ba haḡanidia, tadikakadia ihahavadia amo bae lou?
english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

motu: Bena Ioab eto, Dirava e maurimu heḡereḡerena, oi basioma hereva ina orea taudia ese tadikakadia ihahavadia na daba ai bema hadokoa.
english: Joab said, “As God + 2:27 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ioab ese kibi e hiriria; bena ena orea taudia iboudiai e gini, Israel taudia ihahavadia e hadokoa, bona asie tuari lou.
english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

motu: Una hanuaboi idoinai Abnere mai ena orea taudia ida e raka, Araba tanona e rakaia hanai, Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, ma e raka, ela bona dina tubua ai Mahanaim ai e kau.
english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

motu: Ioab na Abnere iḡavana amo e lou ela, ena orea taudia iboudiai e haboudia; David ena hesiai taudia gwauta taurahani-ta vada lasihidia, bona Asahele danu.
english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

motu: A David ena hesiai taudia ese Beniamina taudia sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui, Abnere ena orea taudia, vada e aladia mase.
english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

motu: Bena idia ese Asahele e abia, tamana ena gara ai e guria, Betelehem ai. Bena loab mai ena orea taudia ida e raka rani; daba e rere, idia na Heberon ai e kau.
english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

motu: Saulo ena orea bona David ena orea na e tuari heheni: tuan na vada e daudau. David na e goada e laova, a Saulo ena orea na e manoka e laova. David natuna e vara
english: Now there was long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

motu: David ese natuna mamaruanedia haida e havaradia Heberon ai. Roboana na Amnon; ia na Ahinoama, hane Iesrele, natuna.
english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

motu: Iharuana na Kilea, Abigail natuna; una Abigail na Nabala, tau Karamele, vabuna. Ihatoina na Absalom, Maaka natuna; una Maaka na Talmai, Gesuru pavapavana, natuna hahinena.
english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

motu: Ihahanina na Adonia, Hagiti natuna; bona iha-imana na Sefatia, Abitala natuna.
english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

motu: Ihatauratoina na Itireama, David adavana Egla natuna. Una na David ese e havaradia, Heberon ai. Abnere na David ida e herohemalno
english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

motu: Saulo ena orea bona David ena orea e tuari heheniva ai na Abnere ese ena siahu e habadaia, Saulo ena orea ai.
english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

motu: Saulo vabuna ta ladana na Rispa, Aia natuna. Bena Isiboset ese Abnere e gwau henia, eto, Dahaka dainai tamagu vabuna ta ida o eno bou?
english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

motu: Bena Abnere e badu dikadika, Isiboset ena hereva dainai, eto, Be, lau na Iuda ena sisia kwarana ta a? Han dina ai, tamamu Saulo iduhuna bona tadikakana bona turana doini na badinadiamu. Oi na David imana ai asina atomu. Matona han dina ai o habadegumu, hahine ta ida na kerere dainai.
english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

motu: Iehova ena gwauhamata, David enai, anina basinama havaraia, Dirava ese Abnere davana bema henia, ma bema habadaia.
english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:

motu: Gwauhamata na binai: basileia na Saulo ena iduhu amo baine heabi oho, David ena terono baine hahedai, Israel bona Iuda baine lohiadia, Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba.
english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

motu: Bena Isiboset ese Abnere se haere henia, badina be ia garina e gari.
english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

motu: Bena Abnere ese gwaukau taudia na David dekena e siaidia, Heberon ai, eto, Tano be daika ena? Aita herohemaino, bena lau imagu ese baine durumu, Israel idoinai na emu ai baina vena hanai.
english: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”

motu: David eto, Namo; aita herohemaino. Ḡau tamona, dekegu baoma negana ai na Saulo natuna hahinena, Mikala, ba hakaua mai guna; bema lasi, vairagu basio itaia.
english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

motu: Bena David ese gwaukau taudia na Isiboset Saulo dekena e siaidia, eto, Adavagu Mikala a henigu, badina be na mao henia davana na Filistia taudia sinahu-ta peritome ai e iva heḡeḡe kopidia amo vada na karaia.
english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

motu: Bena Isiboset e hesiai, hahine na adavana Paltiel Laisi ena amo e vena lou.
english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

motu: A adavana ese e bamoa, bona murina amo e tai, ela bona Bahurimi. Bena Abnere ese e hamaoroa, eto, A lou aola. Bena e lou ela.
english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

motu: Bena Abnere na Israel tau-badadia ida e henega bou, eto, Nega taina daudau vada e lao bubuni, umui ese David vada o ura heniava, emui pavapava ai bainela.
english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

motu: Harihari, karana ba karaia; badina be Iehova ese David vada e gwau henia hamata, eto, Egu hesiai tauna David imana amo lau ese egu orea Israel na Filistia taudia imadia amo bona inaina iboudiai imadia amo baina hamauria.
english: Now then do it! For Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

motu: Abnere ese Beniamina taudia danu e hereva henidia. Bena Abnere na Heberon ela, Israel besena bona Beniamina iduhuna idoinai edia lalo-hadai ede bae kara toma eto na David baine hamaorolaia totona.
english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

motu: Bena Abnere, tatau ruahui ida, David dekena ela, Heberon ai. Una negana ai, David ese aria ta e karaia, Abnere mai bamona ida adia.
english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

motu: Bena Abnere ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Aina tore isi, bainala, Israel taudia iboudiai baina haboudia, egu lohia bona egu pavapava vairamu ai. Idia na oi ida bae herohemaino; bena o ura henidiamu taudia iboudiai na ba biagudia. Taunabunai David ese Abnere e siaia oho; ia na mai mainona ida ela. Ioab ese Abnere e alaia mase
english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

motu: Una negana ai, David ena hesiai taudia na Ioab ida tuari amo e kau; e dadi kohudia momo e mailai. A Abnere na dia David dekenai Heberon ai; badina be vada e siaia oho, bena mai mainona ida ela.
english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

motu: Ioab mai ena tuari oreana idoinai ida e kau; bena haida ese e hamaoroa, eto, Abnere Nere na pavapava dekena ema; ma vada e kahua nege, mai mainona ida ela.
english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

motu: Bena Ioab na pavapava dekena ela, eto, Ede vada o kara toma? A itaia, Abnere na dekemu ema; dahaka dainai vada o siaia oho, bena ela?
english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

motu: Oi dibamu Abnere Nere na ikoimu totona ema, emu raka lasi emu raka vareai bona emu kara iboudiai baine diba totona.
english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

motu: Ioab na David vairana amo e raka lasi, bena ia ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, Abnere bae ḡavaia. Bena Siragohugohuna amo e hakaua lou mai; a David na asi dibana.
english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

motu: Bena Abnere na Heberon e lou henia negana ai na Ioab ese hanua ikoukouna amo e hakaua siri, baine hereva henia hehuni eto; bena bogana e gwada, bena e mase, ia tadina Asahele rarana davana.
english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

motu: Gabeai, David e kamonai negana ai, ia eto, Lau bona egu basileia na asi emai kerere Iehova vairanai, Abnere Nere rarana dainai.
english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

motu: Ioab latanai, bona tamana ena iduhu taudia latadiai, baine kau. Uru iboudiai Ioab ena iduhu ai haida na enobougorerena bae davaria, eiava bae lepra, eiava hahine edia ḡaukara bae kara, eiava dare amo bae mase, eiava bae hitolo.
english: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

motu: Badina bunai Ioab bona tadina Abisai ese Abnere e alaia mase, badina be ia ese Gibeon tuarina ai idia tadidia Asahele e alaia mase davana. Abnere taina e tai
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

motu: Bena David ese Ioab bona ena orea taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Emui dabua ba dare, puse dabuadia ba hedokilai, Abnere taina ba tai. Hanua pavapavana David na mase patana murinai e raka.
english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

motu: Abnere na Heberon ai e guria; bena hanua pavapavana na gadona e habadaia, Abnere gurina badibadinai e tai; taunimanima iboudiai danu e taitai.
english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

motu: Bena haulua pavapavana na Abnere taina e tai, eto, Abnere na kava tauna ena mase ai baineme mase a?
english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

motu: Imamu na asie ḡuidia, aemu na asi gadeadia. Kara dika taudia vairadiai e ketomu tauna na heto, oi vada o keto. Bena taunimanima iboudiai na ia taina ma e tai.
english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * wept|strong="H1058" * again|strong="H3254" * over|strong="H5921" * him|strong="H6440" *.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai na David dekena ela, lalona e ania toho, ia na dina ai do baine aniani. A David na hereva metauna e gwauraia, eto, Dina do basine diho ai flaoa eiava aniani ḡauna ta baina mamia toho, Dirava ese do baine hadikagu, baine hadikagu bada.
english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese e haeroa, bona lalodia e namo, hanua pavapavana ena kara iboudiai ese lalodia e hanamodiava heḡereḡerena.
english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai hebou taudia iboudiai bona Israel idoinai lalodia na e parara, una Abnere Nere iala-masena na dia hanua pavapavana ena ura.
english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ena hesiai taudia na e hamaorodia, eto, Umui asi dibamui a, lohia tauna, tau badana ta, hari ina dina ai vada e mase Israel ai.
english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

motu: Ena be e horogu, pavapava ai e halaogu, to hari ina dina ai vada na manoka-manokamu; ina Seruia natuna na egu ai eme auka herea. Iehova ese kara dika tauna davana do baine henia, ena kara dika heḡereḡerena.
english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”

motu: Isiboset Saulo e kamonai Abnere na Heberon ai e mase, bena e gari dikadika, bona Israel taudia iboudiai danu kudoudia e hetaha.
english: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

motu: Saulo natuna na mai ena tuari oreadia maraḡidia biagudia rarua; ladadia na Baanaha bona Rekab. Raruosi na Beniamina iduhuna tauna ta, ladana Rimon, Beroto tauna, natuna. (Hari Beroto danu e gwauraiamu Beniamina hanuana ta;
english: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;

motu: Beroto taudia na e heau, Gitaimi ela, unuseni ai e noho hedoamu ema bona hanhan).
english: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).

motu: Ionatan Saulo na mai natuna ta, ae-hedairike merona. Saulo bona Ionatan sivaraidia na Iesrele amo e kau negana ai, una mero ena mauri laḡanidia na ima hona. Bena ireḡuna hahinena ese e abia isi, e heaulaia; heauna ai mero na e moru, bena aena e hedairike. Mero ladana na Mefiboset.
english: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

motu: Han Rimon, tau Beroto, natuna raruosi, Rekab bona Baanaha, e raka lasi, dina tubua ai Isiboset ena ruma ai e kau, tauna na laḡana e ania negana ai.
english: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.

motu: Iduara igimana hahinena na uit ihaḡoevana ai matana vada e ḡaraia, vada e mahuta; taunabunai Rekab mai tadina Baanaha ida e dae kau hehuni.
english: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

motu: Ruma lalonai e raka vareai negana ai, idia ese Isiboset na ena mahuta daiutuna ai ena mahuta patana latanai mahutana ai e rahua mase, bona kwarana e utua oho. Bena idia na kwara e abia, Araba dalana amo e raka boi e raka rani,
english: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

motu: Isiboset kwarana na David dekena e laohaia Heberon ai. Idia ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Oi inaimu Isiboset Saulo, emu maun iabi-ohona dalana e tahuava tauna, kwarana binai. Han dina ai Iehova ese Saulo mai garana ida davadia vada e henidia, oi, egu lohia bona egu pavapava, vada e hadava henimu.
english: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! Yahweh has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring. + 4:8 or, seed *”

motu: A David ese Rimon tau Beroto natuna raruosi, Rekab mai tadina Baanaha ida, e haere henidia, eto, Iehova, dika iboudiai lalodia amo vada e hamaurigu Diravana, e maunmu heḡereḡerena,
english: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

motu: tau ta ese e hamaorogu, eto “A kamonai, Saulo vada e mase”, bona e laloa ia na hari namona ta vada e mailaia, negana ai na na dabaia tao, Siklag ai na alaia mase, ena hari davana unu na henia toma.
english: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

motu: Matona, kara dika taudia ese kara maoromaoro tauna ta na ena ruma korikori ai bona ena mahuta patana ai vada e alaia mase, ia rarana davana na umui imamui amo basina abia, tanobada ai basina habuamui tari a?
english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”

motu: Bena David ese ena eregabe taudia e haḡanidia; bena idia ese raruosi na e aladia mase, imadia bona aedia e utudia oho, bena tau-anidia na Heberon gohugohuna badibadinai e taudia dae. A Isiboset kwarana e abia, Abnere ena gara ai e guria, Heberon ai.
english: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.

motu: Bena Israel iduhudia iboudiai na David dekena ela, Heberon ai, eto, Ai na oi turiamu bona oi hidiomu.
english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

motu: Nega gunadia ai, Saulo ese e lohiadava negadia ai, oi ese ai Israel taumai o hakaumai lasi bona o hakaumai vareai. Bena Iehova ese e hamaoromu, eto “Oi ese egu bese Israel do ba reḡua, bona pavapavana ai baola”.
english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel tau-badadia iboudiai na hanua pavapavana dekena ela, Heberon ai; bena King David na idia ida e hegwauhamata heheni Heberon ai, Iehova vairanai. Bena idia ese David e horoa, Israel pavapavana ai e halaoa.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.

motu: David ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui, e lohia matama negana ai; ena lohia laḡanidia na hari-ahui.
english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

motu: Laḡani hitu hua tauratoi ia ese Iuda iduhuna e lohiaia Heberon ai, ma laḡani toi-ahui toi ia ese Israel idoinai bona Iudea idoinai e lohiadia Ierusalem ai. David ese Siona e abia
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

motu: Hanua pavapavana na ena tuari taudia ida Ierusalem ela, Iebusu taudia, una tano taudia, bae tuari henidia totona. Idia ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na iniseni ai basio dae kau, a mata-kepulu taudia bona ae-hedairie taudia ese bae laomu ahu. Edia lalo-hadai be David na unuseni ai basine dae kau diba.
english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

motu: A David ese Siona kohorona e abia: David ena hanua bunai.
english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

motu: Una dina ai David eto, Daika ese Iebusu taudia baine hadareredia, ia na ranu gabuna amo baine dae, ae-hedairike taudia bona mata-kepulu taudia, David laumana ese e inai henidiamu taudia, baine tuari henidia. Unu amo ina hereva e vara: Mata-kepulu taudia bona ae-hedairike taudia na ruma ai basie dae kau.
english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

motu: Bena David na una kohoro ai e nohova, ladana e hatoa “David ena hanua”. David ese danu hanua ma e hadaia heḡeḡe, hetoa ladana Milo lalonai.
