Hahine na e haere, eto, Mornokani, egu lohia bona egu pavapava o maurimu heḡereḡerena, egu lohia bona egu pavapava emu hereva amo taunimanima ta basine raka sin diba, idiba kahana ai eiava lauri kahana ai. Emu hesiai tauna Ioab ese e haḡanigu; ia ese ini hereva iboudiai na emu hesiai hahinena uduna ai e atoa.
english: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The|strong="H3605" * woman answered|strong="H6030" *, “ As|strong="H1697" * your|strong="H3605" * soul|strong="H5315" * lives|strong="H5315" *, my|strong="H3605" * lord the|strong="H3605" * king|strong="H4428" *, no|strong="H3605" * one|strong="H3605" * can|strong="H5650" * turn|strong="H7760" * to|strong="H1696" * the|strong="H3605" * right|strong="H3231" * hand|strong="H3027" * or|strong="H6310" * to|strong="H1696" * the|strong="H3605" * left|strong="H8041" * from|strong="H5315" * anything|strong="H3605" * that|strong="H3588" * my|strong="H3605" * lord the|strong="H3605" * king|strong="H4428" * has|strong="H4428" * spoken|strong="H1696" *; for|strong="H3588" * your|strong="H3605" * servant|strong="H5650" * Joab|strong="H3097" * urged me|strong="H5315" *, and|strong="H6030" * he|strong="H1931" * put|strong="H7760" * all|strong="H3605" * these|strong="H1696" * words|strong="H1697" * in|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H3605" * mouth|strong="H6310" * of|strong="H4428" * your|strong="H3605" * servant|strong="H5650" *.

motu: Kara iha-idaudia totona emu hesiai tauna Ioab na unu e kara toma. A egu lohia na Dirava ena aneru heḡereḡerena, tanobada ḡaudia iboudiai na mai dibana.
english: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ioab e hereva henia, eto, A kamonai, na gwau maoromu: aola, eregabe tauna Absalom ba hakaua lou mai.
english: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”

motu: Bena Ioab na tano ai e goru diho, hanua pavapavana e toma henia diho, bona e hanamoa. Ioab eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava, hari dina ai emu hesiai tauna dibana oi ese vada o lalo namo henigumu, badina be hanua pavapavana ese ena hesiai tauna ena noinoi vada e abia dae.
english: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ioab na e tore isi, Gesuru ela, Absalom e hakaua mai Ierusalem ai.
english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Ia na sibona ena ruma ai baine noho edea, vairagu basinema. Taunabunai, Absalom na sibona ena ruma ai e noho edea, hanua pavapavana dekenai se raka vareai.
english: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.

motu: Israel idoinai raho-namo tauna ta asie imodaiava, Absalom heḡereḡerena; aena henuna amo ela bona kwarana tubuana ia na asi bebeka-bebekana.
english: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.

motu: Laḡani ta ta dokodia ai ia ese huina e utua, e metauva dainai; bena e utua negadia ai na huina metauna e hahetohoa; metauna na sekele sinahu-rua, + 14:26 Sekele sinahu-rua = 6 Ibs sisivana. * hanua pavapavana ena metau hahetohona ḡaudia amo.
english: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, + 14:26 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 200 shekels is about 2 kilograms or about 4.4 pounds. * after the king’s weight.

motu: Absalom natuna na e vara, mamaruanedia tatoi, hahine tamona. Natuna hahinena ladana e hatoa Tamara; ia na hane namo.
english: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.

motu: Taunabunai, Absalom na Ierusalem ai e nohova, hanua pavapavana dekenai se raka vareai, ela bona Iaḡani rua vada e ore.
english: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

motu: Bena Absalom ese gwau-kau e siaia, Ioab na hanua pavapavana, dekenai bainela; a Ioab na e gwau edeede. Nega iharuana ia ese gwau-kau e siaia, a Ioab ma e gwau edeede.
english: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

motu: Bena ia ese ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, Ioab ena uma na lauegu uma badibadinai; ena bali na unuseni ai; aola, a doua. Taunabunai, Absalom ena hesiai taudia ese uma na e doua.
english: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

motu: Bena Ioab e tore isi, Absalom dekena ela, ena ruma ai, e nanadaia, eto, Badina be dahaka emu hesiai taudia ese egu uma vada e doua?
english: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

motu: Bena Absalom ese Ioab e haere henia, eto, Badina be gwau-kau na dekemu ai na siaia, nato “Baoma, hanua pavapavana dekena baina siaimu lao, ba henanadai, baoto: Dahaka dainai Gesuru amo nama? Unuseni ai bama noho ema bona harihari bema namo.” Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana dekenai aina raka vareai na tomu; bena bema mai egu kerere, ia ese baine alagu mase.
english: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”

motu: Bena Ioab na hanua pavapavana dekena ela, e hamaoroa. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Absalom e boiria. Absalom na hanua pavapavana dekenai e kau, bena tano ai e igo diho, hanua pavapavana vairanai. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Absalom e harahua.
english: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.

motu: Una murinai Absalom ese ena kariota ta e abia, bona hosi, bona tatau imahui, ia vairanai bae heau.
english: After this, Absalom prepared a chariot and horses for himself, and fifty men to run before him.

motu: Absalom ena kara be daba ai e tore isi haragava, hanua ikoukouna ilao-henina dalana badinai e giniva. Bena tau ta bema mai, hanua pavapavana vairanai ihahemaoro-henina totona, Absalom ese bema boi henia, bema toma, Oi na edena hanua amo? Bena una tau bema haere, iduhu ta ladana bema hatoa, bema toma “Emu hesiai tauna ena iduhu na unai Israel ai” negana ai na
english: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He|strong="H3605" * said|strong="H7121" *, “ Your|strong="H3605" * servant|strong="H5650" * is|strong="H2088" * of|strong="H4428" * one|strong="H2088" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H3605" * tribes|strong="H7626" * of|strong="H4428" * Israel|strong="H3478" *.”

motu: Absalom ese bema hereva henia, bema toma, A kamonai, emu hereva na namo bona maoro, a tau ta hanua pavapavana ese se duanaia baine hahemaoro henimu.
english: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”

motu: Absalom rna bema toma, Lau na ina tano ai hahemaoro bama karaia bema namo; bena mai edia noinoi eiava mai edia daradara taudia iboudiai na dekegu bema mai, bena bama hahemaoro henidia.
english: Absalom said moreover, “Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man who has any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!”

motu: Ina danu, tau ta ese itomadiho-henina totona bema raka henia kahi, Absalom ese imana bema toi roro, bema rosia, bena bema harahua.
english: It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and kissed him.

motu: Israel taudia na hahemaoro totona hanua pavapavana dekena e maiva iboudiai na Absalom ese unu e karadia tomava; unu amo Absalom ese Israel taudia lalodia e aniva.
english: Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

motu: Laḡani hani e ore, bena Absalom ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara a kahugu nege, Heberon bainala, unuseni ai egu gwauhamata, Iehova na gwau henilaia hamata ḡauna, na anina do baina havaraia.
english: At the end of forty years, Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to Yahweh, in Hebron.

motu: Badina be emu hesiai tauna na Gesuru ai, Aram tanona ai, na nohova negana ai na gwau hamata, nato, Iehova na baine hakaugu lou ela bona Ierusalem ai baina kau, lau ese Iehova baina toma henia diho.
english: For your servant vowed a vow while I stayed at Geshur in Syria, saying, ‘If Yahweh shall indeed bring me again to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahweh.’”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e haere henia, eto, Mai mainomu ida aola. Bena Absalom e tore isi, Heberon ela.
english: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So|strong="H6965" * he|strong="H4428" * arose|strong="H6965" * and|strong="H6965" * went|strong="H3212" * to|strong="H3212" * Hebron|strong="H2275" *.

motu: A Absalom ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia hehuni, Israel iduhudia iboudiai ediai, eto, Kibi reḡena ba kamonai negana ai baoto “Absalom na hanua pavapavana Heberon ai e nohomu”.
english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, ‘Absalom is king in Hebron!’”

motu: Ierusalem taudia sinahu-rua, Absalom ese e vavedia taudia, na ia ida ela; a idia na mai lalo-goevaḡoevadia ida ela, ḡau ta asi dibadia.
english: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.

motu: Absalom ese hahelaḡa karadia e karava lalonai ia ese hereva e siaia, David iduruna tauna ta ladana Ahitofel, tau Gilo, enai, ena hanua Gilo amo bainema eto. Lalo-hadai dikana e henegalaia bada; bona Absalom enai e taova taudia na e hutuma e laova. David na e heau
english: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong, for the people increased continually with Absalom.

motu: Bena gwaukau tauna ta ese David dekenai e kau, eto, Israel taudia na Absalom e lalokau heniamu.
english: A messenger came to David, saying, “The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.”

motu: Bena David ese ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ia ida Ierusalem ai e nohova na e hamaorodia, eto, O tore tore isi, aita heau; eiava Absalom imana amo basita roho mauri diba. Aitala haraḡa, ia baine lasida tao bona baine hadikada bona hanua na dare matana amo baine habuaia tari na garina.
english: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, A itaia, emu hesiai taudia vada heheḡaeḡae; emai lohia bona emai pavapava emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena baia kara.
english: The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana e raka lasi, mai ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida. A hanua pavapavana ese vada e adavadia hahinedia gwauta e rakatanidia, ruma inarina totona.
english: The king went out, and all his household after him. The king left ten women, who were concubines, to keep the house.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na e raka lasi, bona ena orea taudia iboudiai na ia murinai e raka; bena hanua dokona rumana badinai e gini.
english: The king went out, and all the people after him; and they stayed in Beth Merhak.

motu: Bena ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ese e rakaia hanai; bona Kerete taudia iboudiai bona Pelete taudia iboudiai, bona Gata taudia sinahu-tauratoiosi, Gata amo vada e ḡavaia taudia, na hanua pavapavana vairana amo e raka lao.
english: All his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Itai, tau Gata, e hereva henia, eto, Dahaka dainai oi danu ai ida ta laomu? A lou lao, hanua pavapavana ida ba noho; badina be oi na idau tauna bona noho-hedoa tauna.
english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, “Why do you also go with us? Return, and stay with the king; for you are a foreigner and also an exile. Return to your own place.

motu: Varani mo oma, ma han baina hakaumu loaloa a? Lau na ede bainala na asi dibagu. A lou, tadikakamu danu ba hakaudia; bena Iehova ese ena hebogahisi bona ena heabidadama na baine hahedinarai henimu.
english: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and take back your brothers. Mercy and truth be with you.”

motu: A Itai ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Iehova e maurimu bona oi, egu lohia bona egu pavapava, o maurimu heḡereḡerena, egu lohia bona egu pavapava ba noho gabuna ai lau, emu hesiai tauna, danu baina noho henia, mase ai eiava maun ai.
english: Ittai answered the king and said, “As Yahweh lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”

motu: Bena David ese Itai e hamaoroa, eto, Mato, vada a raka lao. Taunabunai Itai, tau Gata, e raka ela, mai ena orea taudia iboudiai ida, bona natudia maraḡidia danu.
english: David said to Ittai, “Go and pass over.” Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones who were with him.

motu: Unu taunimanima iboudiai e raka hanaiva negana ai, hanua hanua taudia ibouboudiai na e tai lolova. Hanua pavapavana ese sinavai maragina ladana Kidron e hanaia, bena taunimanima iboudiai na tano ḡaḡaena dalana amo e raka ela.
english: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over toward the way of the wilderness.

motu: Abiatara na ema, bona Sadok danu, Levi taudia iboudiai ida, Dirava ena taravatu mauana e huaia; bena idia ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana e atoa diho, ela bona taunimanima iboudiai na hanua badana amo vada e raka lasi.
english: Behold, Zadok also came, and all the Levites with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God; and they set down God’s ark; and Abiathar went up until all the people finished passing out of the city.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Sadok e hamaoroa, eto, Dirava ena maua helaḡana na ba huaia lou lao hanua lalonai. Iehova ese bema lalo namo henigu, ia ese baine hakaugu lou, bena ma baina itaia, bona iena noho gabuna ma baina itaia;
english: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again, and show me both it and his habitation;

motu: a ia bema toma “Lau na asina lalo namo henimumu”, vadaeni, lau binai, ena ura heḡereḡerena ai baine kara henigu.
english: but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you,’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese hahelaḡa tauna Sadok ma e hamaoroa, eto, O itaiamu? Mai mainomu ida hanua a lou henia, oi bona Abiatara, bona natumui raruosi, oi natumu Ahimasa bona Abiatara natuna Ionatan.
english: The king said also to Zadok the priest, “Aren’t you a seer? Return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

motu: A itaia, tano ḡaḡaena ai, turu-hanai gabuna ai, baina henari, ela bona hereva ta umui emui amo egu ai baine kau.
english: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”

motu: Taunabunai, Sadok bona Abiatara ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana e huaia lou lao Ierusalem ai; idia na unuseni ai e nohova.
english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried God’s ark to Jerusalem again; and they stayed there.

motu: Bena David na Olive ororona amo e dara dae, mai taina ida. Aena asi tamakadia ela, bona kwarana danu e koua; bena ia ida ela taudia iboudiai ese kwaradia e koudia, bona e dara dae mai taidia ida.
english: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered and went barefoot. All the people who were with him each covered his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

motu: Bena haida ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Absalom ida e henega boumu taudia ta na Ahitofel. Bena David eto, Iehova e, na noimumu, Ahitofel ena hahealo na kavakava ai ba halaoa.
english: Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David|strong="H1732" * said, “ Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, please|strong="H4994" * turn the|strong="H3068" * counsel|strong="H6098" * of|strong="H3068" * Ahithophel into foolishness|strong="H5528" *.”

motu: David na ororo dorina ai e kau, Dirava e toma henia dihova gabuna ai, unuseni ai Husai, tau Araki, na ia ihedavari-henina ema; ena dabua vada e hedare, bona kwarana na mai tanona.
english: When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn and earth on his head.

motu: David ese e hereva henia, eto, Bema oi na lau ida baitala negana ai oi ese ba hametaugu.
english: David said to him, “If you pass on with me, then you will be a burden to me;

motu: A hanua ba lou lao, Absalom ba hereva henia, baoto “Hanua pavapavana e, lau na emu hesiai tauna ai bainala; nega gunadia ai tamamu isiaina na Iao heniva heḡereḡerena, harihari oi isiaimu baina lao heni”. Unu amo oi ese Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai ba utu, lau daigu ai.
english: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then you will defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara na unuseni ai, oi ida, ani? Taunabunai, dahaka dahaka ba kamonai hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai, unu na hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara ba hadibalaidia.
english: Don’t you have Zadok and Abiathar the priests there with you? Therefore whatever you hear out of the king’s house, tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

motu: Ina danu, idia natudia raruosi, Ahimasa Sadok bona Ionatan Abiatara, na unuseni ai; ba kamonai herevadia iboudiai na idia edia amo lau dekegu ba siaidia.
english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok’s son, and Jonathan, Abiathar’s son. Send to me everything that you shall hear by them.”

motu: Taunabunai David turana Husai na hanua lalonai e raka vareai, Absalom na Ierusalem ai e dae kau negana ai.
english: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

motu: David ese ororo dorina taina e rakaia hanai, bena ia na Siba, Mefiboset ena hesiai tauna, ida e hedavari. Hari Siba ese doniki rua e hakaudia, edia maduna na flaoa igabu sinahu-rua, vine huahuadia kaukaudia tako sinahu-ta, au huahuadia idau-idau sinahu-ta, bona vine ranuna kopi ta.
english: When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, and on them two hundred loaves of bread, and one hundred clusters of raisins, and one hundred summer fruits, and a container of wine.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Siba e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai ini ḡau vada o mailai. Siba e haere, eto, Doniki na hanua pavapavana ena ruma taudia edia gui ḡaudia; flaoa bona au huahuadia na eregabe taudia adia; vine ranuna na tano gaḡaena ai bae manori taudia ese bae inua.
english: The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba|strong="H6717" * said, “ The|strong="H8354" * donkeys|strong="H2543" * are|strong="H4100" * for|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H8354" * king|strong="H4428" *’s household|strong="H1004" * to|strong="H4428" * ride|strong="H7392" * on|strong="H7392" *; and|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H8354" * bread|strong="H3899" * and|strong="H4428" * summer|strong="H7019" * fruit|strong="H7019" * for|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H8354" * young|strong="H5288" * men|strong="H5288" * to|strong="H4428" * eat|strong="H3899" *; and|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H8354" * wine|strong="H3196" *, that|strong="H4428" * those who|strong="H5288" * are|strong="H4100" * faint|strong="H3287" * in|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H8354" * wilderness|strong="H4057" * may|strong="H4428" * drink|strong="H8354" *.”

motu: Hanua pavapavana eto, Biagumu natuna be edeseni ai? Siba ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Ia na Ierusalem ai e nohomu; badina be ia na eto “Hari dina ai Israel taudia ese tamagu ena basileia na ma bae henigu lou”.
english: The king said, “Where is your master’s son?” Ziba|strong="H6717" * said to|strong="H7725" * the|strong="H3588" * king|strong="H4428" *, “ Behold|strong="H2009" *, he|strong="H3588" * is|strong="H3117" * staying|strong="H3427" * in|strong="H3427" * Jerusalem|strong="H3389" *; for|strong="H3588" * he|strong="H3588" * said, ‘ Today|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H3588" * house|strong="H1004" * of|strong="H1121" * Israel|strong="H3478" * will|strong="H4428" * restore|strong="H7725" * me|strong="H7725" * the|strong="H3588" * kingdom|strong="H4468" * of|strong="H1121" * my|strong="H7725" * father|strong="H1121" *.’”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Siba e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai, Mefiboset ena ḡau iboudiai harihari na oiemu. Siba eto, Lau na na toma henimu dihomu. Egu lohia bona egu pavapava, ba lalo namo henigu hanaihanai.
english: Then the king said to Ziba, “Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours.” Ziba|strong="H6717" * said, “ I|strong="H2009" * bow|strong="H7812" * down|strong="H7812" *. Let me|strong="H4672" * find|strong="H4672" * favor|strong="H2580" * in|strong="H4428" * your|strong="H3605" * sight|strong="H5869" *, my|strong="H3605" * lord, O|strong="H3068" * king|strong="H4428" *.”

motu: King David na Bahurimi ai e kau, bena Saulo varavarana ta unuseni ai, ladana Simei Gera, na e raka lasi; rakana ai ia na e heuduguirai havara havara.
english: When King David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera. He came out and cursed as he came.

motu: Bena ia ese David na nadi amo e hodoa, bona King David ena hesiai taudia iboudiai danu e hododia. Hanua taudia iboudiai bona tuari taudia iboudiai na David idibana kahana ai bona laurina kahana ai e gini.
english: He cast stones at David and at all the servants of King David, and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

motu: Bena Simei e uduguirai henia, eto, Rara ihahebubuna taumu, asi emu kara namona ta taumu, a raka oho, a raka oho.
english: Shimei said when he cursed, “Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!

motu: Iehova ese Saulo, dagina o abia tauna, mai ena iduhu taudia ida raradia davadia idoinai na oiemu amo vada e abia; bona Iehova ese basileia na natumu Absalom imana ai vada e atoa. A itaia, emu dika na vada latamu ai vada e kau; badina be oi na rara ihahebubuna tauna.
english: Yahweh has returned on you all the blood of Saul’s house, in whose place you have reigned! Yahweh has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son! Behold, you are caught by your own mischief, because you are a man of blood!”

motu: Bena Abisai Seruia ese hanua pavapavana e hereva henia, eto, Dahaka dainai ina sisia masena ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava e uduguiraimumu? Mani ainala, kwarana baina utua oho.
english: Then Abishai the son of Zeruiah said to the king, “Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head.”

motu: A hanua pavapavana eto, Seruia natuna e, lau oiemu ai be dahaka? Bema ia na e heuduguiraimu badina be Iehova ese vada e haḡania, eto “David ba uduguiraia”, bena daika baineto “Dahaka dainai unu o kara tomamu?”
english: The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him, ‘Curse David,’ who then shall say, ‘Why have you done so?’”

motu: Bena David ese Abisai bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, natugu korikori ese lauegu mauri baine abia oho e tomamu; o, ina Beniamina iduhuna tauna ese egu mauri iabi-ohona basine ura badabada a? Aine noho, baine heuduguirai; badina be Iehova ese vada e haḡania.
english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for Yahweh has invited him.

motu: A reana Iehova ese egu hisihisi baine itaia, bena hari dina ai Iehova ese dava namona ta baine henigu, ina heuduguirai davana.
english: It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”

motu: Taunabunai David mai ena orea taudia ida na dala amo e raka, a Simei na ororo gabaena ai e raka, ia hegaga-hehenina ai, bena rakana ai e heuduguirai, bona nadi amo e hodoa, bona ḡahu e tahoa.
english: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana mai bamona iboudiai ida na Ioridane sinavaina ai e kau, taudia na boboera. Unuseni ai laḡana e ania. Absalom na Ierusalem ai
english: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.

motu: Absalom bona Israel taudia iboudiai na Ierusalem ai e kau, Ahitofel danu ia ida.
english: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

motu: Bena Husai, tau Araki, David turana, na Absalom dekena ela. Bena Husai ese Absalom e hamaoroa, eto, Hanua pavapavana ena mauri baine daudau! Hanua pavapavana ena mauri baine daudau!
english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

motu: Bena Absalom ese Husai e hamaoroa, eto, Turamu enai emu heabidadama binai a? Dahaka dainai turamu ida asiola?
english: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

motu: Husai ese Absalom e haere henia, eto, Lasi badina be Iehova bona ini taunimanima bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese vada e abia hidi tauna na lau ese danu baina abia dae, bona ia dekenai baina noho.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever Yahweh and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.

motu: Bona ina danu, daika isiaina baina lao heni? Ia natuna, ani? Tamamu isiaina na lao heniva heḡereḡerena, oi isiaimu danu baina lao heni.
english: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”

motu: Bena Absalom ese Ahitofel e hamaoroa, eto, Emu lalo-hadai a gvvaurai, ede baita kara toma?
english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”

motu: Ahitofel ese Absalom e haere henia, eto, Tamamu e adavadia hahinedia, ruma inarina totona e rakatanidia, na dekediai ba raka vareai; bena Israel taudia iboudiai bae kamonai, oi ese tamamu lalona vada o hadikaia emu ai, bena emu ai e taomu taudia iboudiai na imadia bae ha-aukadia.
english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese kalaga auta na ruma guhina latanai e haginia, Absalom ena; bena Absalom na tamana ese e adavadia hahinedia dekediai e raka vareai, Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai e gwaurai na e kara Dirava ena hereva na heto. David bona Absalom ese Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai iboudiai na unu e abidia dae tomava.
english: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.

motu: Ahitofel ese Absalom e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara tatau gerebu-ta daha-rua + 17:1 Gerebu-ta daha-rua = 12,000. * aina abidia hidi, bena baina tore isi, hari hanuaboi ai David baina ḡavaia.
english: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.

motu: Bena tauna dounu e boeramu bona lalona dounu e metaumu ai baina lasia tao, bona baina hagaria; bena e bamoamu taudia iboudiai na bae heau. Hanua pavapavana mo sibona baina rahua mase;
english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,

motu: a ena orea taudia iboudiai na dekemu baina hakaudia mai, headava matamata hahinena ese adavana enai e raka vareaimu na heto. Tau tamona ena mauri iabi-ohona dalana o tahuamu; bena taunimanima iboudiai na bae maino.
english: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”

motu: Una lalo-hadai na Absalom bona Israel tau-badadia iboudiai ese e moalelaia.
english: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

motu: Bena Absalom eto, Husai tau Araki danu a boina, iena hereva baita kamonai.
english: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

motu: Bena Husai na Absalom dekenai e kau negana ai, Absalom ese e nanadaia, eto, Ahitofel na unu ini e gwau tomamu; iena lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena baita karaia eiava? Bema lasi, oi na ba hereva.
english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”

motu: Bena Husai ese Absalom e hamaoroa, eto, Ina nega ai Ahitofel ese vada e henimui lalo-hadaina na dia namo.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”

motu: Husai ma eto, Oi dibamu, tamamu bona ena orea taudia na goada-herea taudia, bona e badu dikadikamu, bea hahinena tano paka ai haida ese natuna vada e dadidia oho na heto. Ina danu, tamamu na tuari mai dibana tauna; ia na ena orea taudia ida basine noho rani.
english: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

motu: A laloa, ina harihan ia na guri ta ai eiava gabu ta ai vada e komumu. Bena tuari baine hematama negana ai haida bema keto, bae kamonai taudia na baeto Absalom murinai e rakamu taudia vada e mase oremu.
english: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’

motu: Bena goada-herea tauna, lalona na leona lalona na heto tauna, na gari ese baine butua tao; badina be Israel taudia iboudiai na dibadia tamamu na goada-herea tauna, bona ia e bamoamu taudia danu goada-herea taudia.
english: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.

motu: A lauegu lalo-hadai be Israel taudia iboudiai na oi dekemu bae hebou, Dan amo ela bona Bere-sieba; bae hutuma kone mirina na heto. Bena oi danu tuari baola.
english: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

motu: Taunabunai ita ese ia e nohomu gabuna ai baita lasia tao, bona latanai baita diho hunu tano latanai e dihomu na heto; bena ia bona e bamoamu taudia iboudiai na tau ta basine mauri.
english: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.

motu: A bema hanua ta ai baine raka vareai, Israel taudia iboudiai na kwanau bae laohai, una hanua na baita veria dobi, ela bona koura lalonai, ela bona ia nadina momoruna ta basine mia.
english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”

motu: Bena Absalom bona Israel taudia iboudiai eto, Husai tau Araki ena lalo-hadai ese Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai na e hereaiamu. Badina be Iehova ese dalana vada e lailaia Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai namona baine hadarerea, Iehova ese Absalom baine hadikaia helaoreana.
english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For Yahweh had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahweh might bring evil on Absalom.

motu: Bena Husai ese hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara e hamaorodia, eto, Ahitofel ena lalo-hadai Absalom bona Israel tau-badadia e henidia na unu ini e hamaorodia toma, a Iauegu lalo-hadai na henidia na unu ini na hamaorodia toma.
english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

motu: Taunabunai, hereva ba siaia haraḡa, David ba hamaoroa, baoto “Hari ina hanuaboi tano ḡaḡaena ena turu-hanai gabudia badibadidiai basio noho, a ba hanai vaitani, hanua pavapavana bona e bamoarnu taudia iboudiai bae hadonodia ore na garina”.
english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”

motu: Una negana ai Ionatan bona Ahimasa na En-rogele ai e nariva; hesiai kekenina ta vaevae e laova, hereva e henidiava, bena idia ese King David e hamaoroa laova; badina be idia na hanua badana ai raka-vareaidia ai bae itadia na garina.
english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.

motu: A mero ta ese e itadia, bena ia ese Absalom e hamaoroa; taunabunai raruosi na e raka oho haraḡa, Bahurimi ela, tau ta ena ruma ai e kau. Una tau na mai ena ranu gurina ta, ena maḡu lalonai; bena raruosi na ranu gurina ai e diho.
english: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.

motu: Bena ruma hahinena na ranu gurina e koua ahu, bena latanai uit nadinadidia e ḡiḡi eva-eva. Una kara na tau ta asi dibana.
english: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

motu: Bena Absalom ena hesiai taudia na una ruma ai e dae kau; bena idia ese hahine na e nanadaia, eto, Ahimasa bona Ionatan na edeseni ai? Han hahine ese e haere henidia, eto, Sinavai maragina amo e turu hanai. Bena e tahudia, to asie davaridia; bena Ierusalem e lou lao.
english: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The|strong="H7725" * woman|strong="H1004" * said to|strong="H7725" * them|strong="H7725" *, “ They|strong="H3808" * have|strong="H5650" * gone|strong="H5674" * over|strong="H5674" * the|strong="H7725" * brook|strong="H4323" * of|strong="H1004" * water|strong="H4325" *.” When|strong="H7725" * they|strong="H3808" * had|strong="H3083" * sought|strong="H1245" * and|strong="H7725" * could not|strong="H3808" * find|strong="H4672" * them|strong="H7725" *, they|strong="H3808" * returned|strong="H7725" * to|strong="H7725" * Jerusalem|strong="H3389" *.

motu: Vada e raka oho murinai, idia raruosi na ranu gurina amo e dae; bena ela, King David e hamaoroa. Idia ese David e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, sinavai ba hanaia haraḡa; badina be Ahitofel ese oi ihadikamu dalana na unu ini e gwau tomamu.
english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”

motu: Bena David bona e bamoava taudia iboudiai na e tore isi, Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia. Daba ai, iboudiai vada e hanai, ta se noho.
english: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.

motu: Ahitofel vada e diba iena lalo-hadai na asie abia dae, bena ena doniki e abia, ena hanua korikori e lou lao. Ena kohu iboudiai e atodia namonamo bena sibona e hemata. E mase; bena tamana ena gara ai e guria. David na Mahanaim ai
english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.

motu: David na Mahanaim ai e kau. Bena Absalom ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, Israel taudia iboudiai ida.
english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

motu: Absalom ese Amasa vada e gwauraia, tuari oreana baine biagua, Ioab gabuna ai. Hari Amasa na Ismael tauna ta, ladana Itira, natuna; adavana na Abigail Nahasa, Ioab sinana Seruia tadina.
english: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

motu: Israel taudia bona Absalom na Gilead tanona ai e taruha.
english: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

motu: David na Mahanaim ai e kau negana ai, Sobi Nahasa, tau Amono, na Raba amo, bona Makiri Amiele na Lo-debara amo, bona Barasilai, tau Gilead, na Rogelim amo,
english: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

motu: mahuta ḡaudia bona nau bona uro e mailaidia; bona uit, bali, flaoa, uit kakorodia, bini, lentils *,
english: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,

motu: bada ranuna, butter *, mamoe, bona cheese *, boromakau ratana amo e karaia ḡauna, danu. E mailaidia David ana bona ia e bamoava taudia adia; badina be idia na eto, Ini taunimanima na tano ḡaḡaena ai e hitolodiamu, taudia e boeramu, bona e ranu masemu danu.
english: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”

motu: Bena David ese e bamoava taudia na e haboudia, biagudia e gwauraidia, daha ta ta biagudia bona sinahu ta ta biagudia e haginidia.
english: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

motu: David ese tuari oreana e haria, kaha toi, bena e siaidia lao; kaha ta be Ioab ese e biagua, ma kaha ta Abisai Seruia, Ioab tadina, ese e biagua, ma kaha ihatoina Itai, tau Giti, ese e biagua. Bena hanua pavapavana ese tuari taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Lau danu umui ida baitala.
english: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”

motu: A tuari taudia eto, Oi na basiola; badina be ai baiama heau, idia na basiema lalomai. Ena be emai orea kahana bema mase, a basiema lalomai. A oi idaimu na ai gerebu ta heḡereḡerena; taunabunai namona be ikahamai na hanua amo ba siaidia.
english: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e haere henidia, eto, Edena dala umui ese o laloamu dala namona, una na baina karaia. Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana na ikoukou badibadinai e gini; bena tuari oreana idoinai e raka lasi, sinahu ta ta amo, bona daha ta ta amo.
english: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.” The|strong="H3605" * king|strong="H4428" * stood|strong="H5975" * beside|strong="H3027" * the|strong="H3605" * gate|strong="H8179" *, and|strong="H3967" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * went|strong="H3381" * out|strong="H6213" * by|strong="H3027" * hundreds|strong="H3967" * and|strong="H3967" * by|strong="H3027" * thousands.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ioab bona Abisai bona Itai e haḡanidia, eto, Lau daigu ai han eregabe tauna Absalom ba bogaia hisi. Taunimanima iboudiai ese hanua pavapavana ena hereva e kamonai, ia ese tuari biagudia iboudiai na han Absalom herevana e haganilaidia negana ai.
english: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.

motu: Taunabunai, tuari oreana idoinai ela, Israel taudia e tuari henidia; bena Efraim udana ai e tuari heheni.
english: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.

motu: Unuseni ai David ena hesiai taudia ese Israel taudia e hadareredia; una dina ai ala-ala na bada herea, taunimanima gerebu-rua + 18:7 Gerebu-rua = 20,000. * e mase.
english: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

motu: Tuari na una tano idoinai e da'ania guḡuru; hutuma na uda ahu ese e hamasedia, gadoina mo dare ai e mase. Absalom e mase
english: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

motu: Bena Absalom na David ena hesiai taudia ida e hedavari taku. Absalom na ena doniki ai e gui; bena doniki na oak auna badana ta rigina momo henudiai e heau vareai. Bena kwarana na oak rigina ai e headai; bena e hetau veriveri. A doniki na ia henuna amo e heau oho.
english: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.

motu: Tau ta ese e itaia, bena ia ese Ioab e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai, Absalom na itaia, oak auna ta ai e hetau dae.
english: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”

motu: Ioab ese hari e hamaoroa tauna na e gwau henia, eto, Be, o itaia a? Matona, so lapaia dobi tano ai? Silver monidia gwauta bona gaba ḡauna ta bama henimu mai moalegu ida.
english: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”

motu: A una tau ese Ioab e haere henia, eto, Ena be silver * monidia daha ta imagu ai bama mamidia, to imagu na hanua pavapavana natuna ihadikana totona basinama toia roro. Badina be ai a kamonai hanua pavapavana ese oi bona Abisai bona Itai e haḡanimui, eto, Lau daigu ai eregabe tauna Absalom ba hamauria.
english: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’

motu: Ina danu, ena mauri bama hadikaia, (ḡau ta hanua pavapavana ena amo basine hehuni diba), oi na boma gini tabe.
english: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”

motu: Ioab eto, Lau na nega basina ha-orea dekemu ai. Bena ia ese io autoi imana ai e abidia, Absalom kudouna e gwadaia, oak auna ai dounu e mauriva negana ai.
english: Then Joab said, “I’m not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.

motu: Bena eregabe taudia gwauta, Ioab ena kesi ihuana taudia, ese Absalom e ginia ahu, e rahua mase, e alaia.
english: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

motu: Bena Ioab ese kibi e hiriria; bena tuari taudia iboudiai na Israel taudia ihahavadia amo e lou; badina be Ioab ese e gwaudia tao.
english: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.

motu: Bena idia ese Absalom e abia, guri badana ta lalonai e tahoa dobi, uda ai; bena nadi momo-herea e senudia, ia latanai. Bena Israel taudia iboudiai e heau, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela.
english: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then all Israel fled, each to his own tent.

motu: Absalom ena mauri ai pupu ta e abia, Pavapava Kourana ai e haginia, ia sibona ena; badina be ia eto “Lau na asi natugu, ladagu ihahedinaraina”. Hari pupu na ia sibona ladana e henemailaia; ladana na doini e hatoamu “Absalom pupuna” ema bona hari dina.
english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.

motu: Bena Ahimasa Sadok eto, Mani aina heau, harina na hanua pavapavana dekena baina laohaia, ia na Iehova ese ia inaina edia siahu amo vada e hamauria.
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how Yahweh has avenged him of his enemies.”

motu: Bena Ioab ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hari dina ai harina basio laohaia; dina ta harina ba laohaia, a hari dina ai hari ta basio laohaia, badina be hanua pavapavana natuna vada e mase.
english: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”

motu: Bena Ioab ese Kusu tauna e haduaia, eto, Aola, o ita ḡaudia na hanua pavapavana ba hamaorolaia. Kusu tauna na Ioab vairanai e igo diho, bena e heau.
english: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.

motu: Bena Ahimasa Sadok ese Ioab ma e hamaoroa, eto, Dahaka baine vara na herevana; mani emu kara lau danu Kusu tauna murina amo baina heau. Ioab eto, Natugu e, dahaka dainai ba heau; ina hari ilaohaina na asi davana.
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab|strong="H3097" * said, “ Why|strong="H4100" * do|strong="H3254" * you|strong="H4100" * want|strong="H7323" * to|strong="H1961" * run|strong="H7323" *, my|strong="H1961" * son|strong="H1121" *, since|strong="H5750" * you|strong="H4100" * will|strong="H1961" * have|strong="H1961" * no|strong="H4672" * reward|strong="H1309" * for|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H1961" * news|strong="H1309" *?”

motu: Ahimasa eto, Dahaka baine vara na herevana; baina heau. Taunabunai Ioab ese e hamaoroa, elo, A heau. Bena Ahimasa na taora dalana amo e heau, Kusu tauna e heautania.
english: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He|strong="H4100" * said to|strong="H1961" * him|strong="H1870" *, “ Run|strong="H7323" *!” Then|strong="H1961" * Ahimaaz ran|strong="H7323" * by|strong="H5674" * the|strong="H5674" * way|strong="H1870" * of|strong="H1870" * the|strong="H5674" * Plain|strong="H3603" *, and|strong="H1870" * outran|strong="H7323" * the|strong="H5674" * Cushite|strong="H3569" *.

motu: David na ikoukou ruaosi padadiai e helaiva; bena hegima tauna na maḡu amo e dae ela bona ikoukou guhina ai e gini. Bena e roha lao, tau ta e itaia, sihona e heauva.
english: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.

motu: Bena hegima tauna e boi dobi, hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa. Hanua pavapavana e haere, eto, Bema ia na sibona, unu na hari ia e mailaiamu. E heau mai haraḡa, una gabu e kahi henia.
english: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.

motu: Bena hegima tauna na tau ma ta e itaia, e heauva; bena hegima tauna na ikoukou e boi lao, eto, A itaia, ta ma sibona e heau e maimu. Hanua pavapavana eto, Ia danu hari ta e mailaiamu.
english: The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, “Behold, a man running alone!” The|strong="H7200" * king|strong="H4428" * said|strong="H7121" *, “ He|strong="H7121" * also|strong="H1571" * brings|strong="H1319" * news|strong="H1319" *.”

motu: Hegima tauna ma eto, Mata ai e heaumu tauna ena heau ita-itana na Ahimasa Sadok ena heau hegereḡerena. Hanua pavapavana eto, Ia na tau namona, hari namona e mailaiamu.
english: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The|strong="H7200" * king|strong="H4428" * said, “ He|strong="H4428" * is|strong="H2088" * a|strong="H3068" * good|strong="H2896" * man|strong="H1121" *, and|strong="H1121" * comes with|strong="H4428" * good|strong="H2896" * news|strong="H1309" *.”

motu: Bena Ahimasa ese hanua pavapavana e boi henia, eto, Namo herea. Bena ia na tano ai e goru diho, hanua pavapavana vairanai, eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, aita imodaia; ia ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava e tuari heniava taudia na vada e hadareredia.
english: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Hari eregabe tauna Absalombe namo a? Ahimasa e haere, eto, Ioab ese emu hesiai tauna e siaigu negana ai, heloḡo-heloḡo bada-hereana ta na itaia, a asina diba dahaka heloḡo-heloḡona.
english: The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” Ahimaaz answered, “ When|strong="H7200" * Joab|strong="H3097" * sent|strong="H7971" * the|strong="H7200" * king|strong="H4428" *’s servant|strong="H5650" *, even|strong="H3808" * me|strong="H7971" * your|strong="H7200" * servant|strong="H5650" *, I|strong="H3045" * saw|strong="H7200" * a|strong="H3068" * great|strong="H1419" * tumult|strong="H1995" *, but|strong="H3808" * I|strong="H3045" * don’t know|strong="H3045" * what|strong="H4100" * it|strong="H7200" * was|strong="H4428" *.”

motu: Hanua pavapavana eto, A raka siri, iniseni ai ba gini. Bena ia na e raka siri, e gini.
english: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came and stood still.

motu: Bena Kusu tauna e kau. Kusu tauna eto, Hari namona, egu lohia bona egu pavapava emu. Badina be hari dina ai Iehova ese e tuari henimuva taudia iboudiai edia siahu amo vada e harohomu mauri.
english: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for Yahweh has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Kusu tauna e nanadaia, eto, Hari eregabe tauna Absalom be namo a? Kusu tauna e haere, eto, Egu lohia bona egu pavapava inaina bona ihadikamu totona e tuari henimumu taudia iboudiai na una eregabe tauna ida bae heḡereḡere baine namo.
english: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The|strong="H3605" * Cushite|strong="H3569" * answered, “ May|strong="H1961" * the|strong="H3605" * enemies|strong="H6965" * of|strong="H4428" * my|strong="H3605" * lord the|strong="H3605" * king|strong="H4428" *, and|strong="H6965" * all|strong="H3605" * who|strong="H3605" * rise|strong="H6965" * up|strong="H6965" * against|strong="H5921" * you|strong="H3605" * to|strong="H1961" * do|strong="H3605" * you|strong="H3605" * harm|strong="H7451" *, be|strong="H1961" * as|strong="H1961" * that|strong="H3605" * young|strong="H5288" * man|strong="H5288" * is|strong="H3605" *.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na darana e doko; ikoukou daena daiutuna ai e dae kau, e tai. Bona daekauna ai danu e tai, eto, Natugu Absalom o, natugu o, natugu Absalom o! Oi gabumu ai bama mase, Absalom o; natugu o, natugu o!
english: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”

motu: Haida ese Ioab e hamaoroa, eto, Hanua pavapavana na e taitaimu, Absalom taina e taimu.
english: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”

motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai kwalimu na taitai ai e hahelao, taunimanima iboudiai ediai; badina be una dina ai idia e kamonai “Hanua pavapavana na natuna dainai lalona e hisihisimu”.
english: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”

motu: Bena una dina ai taunimanima na asi rakirakidia hanua lalonai e didi vareai helada, tuari amo e heau bena mai hemaraidia ida asi rakirakidia edia hanua ai e raka vareai helada taudia na heheto.
english: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

motu: Hanua pavapavana na vairana e govaia ahu, bena e tai lolololo, eto, Natugu Absalom o, Absalom o, natugu o, natugu o!
english: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

motu: Bena Ioab na ruma ai e dae kau, hanua pavapavana dekenai, bena eto, Hari dina ai emu hesiai taudia iboudiai vairadia na hemarai amo vada o ḡovadia. Hari dina ai, idia ese emu mauri vada e rauaia, bona natumu mamaruanedia bona natumu hahinedia bona adavamu bona unu vada o adavadia hahinedia iboudiai danu vada e hamauridia,
english: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

motu: a oi ese e inai henimumu taudia be o ura henidiamu, bona e ura henimumu taudia be o inai henidiamu. Hari dina ai vada o hahedinaraia, tuari biagudia bona hesiai taudia na so lalodiamu; badina be hari dina ai lalogu vada eme parara, Absalom na hari dina ai bema mauri bona ai iboumai ai baiama mase, bena oi na boma moale.
english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.

motu: Be, a tore isi, a raka lasi, emu hesiai taudia na hereva namodia ba henidia; badina be Iehova ladana ai na gwaumu, basio raka lasi negana ai, hari hanuaboi tau ta oi dekemu ai basine noho; bena emu ai baine kau dikana ese hahedika gunadia, tauhaumu negana ema bona hanhari, iboudiai na baine hereadia.
english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by Yahweh, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na e tore isi, ikoukou ai e helai diho. Bena haida ese taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, hanua pavapavana na ikoukou ai e helaimu. Bena taunimanima iboudiai na hanua pavapavana vairanai e hebou. Una negana ai Israel taudia iboudiai na vada e heau karoho, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma vada ela.
english: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

motu: Bona taunimanima iboudiai, Israel iduhudia iboudiai lalodiai, na e hedoria masemaseva, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese inaida imadia amo e hamauridava bona Filistia taudia imadia amo e harohoda mauriva, a harihari ia na Absalom ena amo eda tano vada e heautania.
english: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

motu: To Absalom, eda pavapava ai ta horoa tauna, na tuan ai vada e mase. Matona, hanua pavapavana ihakau-louna asio herevalaiamu badina be dahaka? King David na Ierusalem e lou lao
english: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

motu: Bena King David ese gwaukau ta e siaia, hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara dekediai, eto, Iuda tau-badadia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Badina be dahaka hanua pavapavana ihakau-louna ena ruma ai na o halahemu a Israel taudia iboudiai edia hereva na hanua pavapavana enai vada e kaui
english: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

motu: Umui na varavaragu, lau turiagu bona lau hidiogu; matona, dahaka dainai hanua pavapavana ihakau-louna ai umui na vada o halahemu?
english: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

motu: Amasa danu ba hamaoroa, baoto, Oi na lau turiagu bona lau hidiogu ani? Ina murinai oi na egu tuari oreana basioma biagua, Ioab gabuna ai, Dirava ese davagu metauna bema henigu, ma bema hametaua.
english: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

motu: Bena ia ese Iuda taudia iboudiai lalodia e ani, bona e hatamonadia; taunabunai idia ese hereva e siaia, hanua pavapavana enai, eto, A lou, oi bona emu hesiai taudia iboudiai danu.
english: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana na e lou, Ioridane sinavaina ela; bona Iuda taudia na Gilgal ela, hanua pavapavana ida bae hedavari bona Ioridane sinavaina amo bae hakaua hanai totona.
english: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

motu: Bena Simei Gera, tau Beniamina, na Bahurimi amo e diho haraḡa-haraḡa Iuda taudia ida David ihedavari-henina ela;
english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

motu: bona Beniamina taudia danu daha ta ia ida ela. Bena Siba, Saulo ena iduhu taudia edia hesiai tauna, mai natuna mamaruanedia gwauta-ima bona ena hesiai taudia ruahui, e rou hekei guna lao Ioridane sinavaina ai, hanua pavapavana do se kau ai,
english: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

motu: bena e turu hanai, hanua pavapavana ena orea taudia bae hakaudia hanai bona hanua pavapavana isiaina baine lao heni totona. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ioridane sinavaina baine hanaia eto negana ai, Simei Gera na hanua pavapavana vairanai e igo diho,
english: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the|strong="H6440" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Gera fell down|strong="H6440" * before|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" * when|strong="H1121" * he|strong="H2568" * had|strong="H4428" * come|strong="H5288" * over|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H6440" * Jordan|strong="H3383" *.

motu: e hereva henia, eto, Egu lohia e, basioto lau na kerere, bona emu hesiai tauna egu kerere, egu lohia bona egu pavapava na Ierusalem o rakatania dinana ai na havaraia, na basio laloa une; hanua pavapavana ese basioma laloa tao.
english: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

motu: Badina be lau emu hesiai tauna dibagu vada na kara dika; a itaia, hari dina ai vada nama, Iosef iduhuna taudia iboudiai vada na gunalaidia, egu lohia bona egu pavapava ihedavari-henimu.
english: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

motu: Bena Abisai Seruia e haere, eto, Hari Simei bae alaia mase, ani? Badina be Iehova ese vada e horoa tauna na ia ese e uduguiraia.
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh’s anointed?”

motu: A David eto, Seruia natuna e, dahaka ta kara dainai umui ese hari dina ai ba inai henigu? Hari dina ai tau ta bae hamasea Israel ai a? O tomu asi dibagu a, hari dina ai lau na Israel pavapavana?
english: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Simei e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na basio mase. Bena hanua pavapavana ese e gwau henia hamata.
english: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

motu: Bena Mefiboset, Saulo dihina, na hanua pavapavana ihedavan-henina ema. Aena se haḡoevadiava, aukina huina se utuava, bona ena dabua se huridiava, hanua pavapavana e raka oho dinana amo ema bona mai namona ida e lou mai.
english: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

motu: Ia na Ierusalem amo e raka lasi, hanua pavapavana ida e hedavari; bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Mefiboset e, dahaka damal lau ida asitala.
english: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

motu: Ia e haere, eto, Pavapava e, egu lohia, egu hesiai tauna ese e koigu; badina be emu hesiai tauna ese na hamaoroa, nato, Doniki ta ba heḡaeḡaelaia, baina gui kau, hanua pavapavana ida bainala. Badina be emu hesiai tauna aegu eme hedairike.
english: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

motu: Ia ese emu hesiai tauna vada e habadelaigu koikoi, egu lohia bona egu pavapava vairamu ai. A egu lohia bona egu pavapava na Dirava ena aneru na heto; taunabunai, emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena do ba kara henigu.
english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

motu: Badina be tamagu ena iduhu taudia iboudiai na egu lohia bona egu pavapava vairamu ai e revadia mase; a oi ese emu hesiai tauna na emu pata ai e anianimu taudia bogaragidiai o atogu. Dahaka dainai hanua pavapavana ma baina tai henia lou?
english: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e hamaoroa, eto, Emu noho na basio herevalaia lou. Vada na haeroa vaitani: oi bona Siba ese tano ba haria.
english: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

motu: Bena Mefiboset ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Vadaeni, idoinai ia ese baine abia; badina be egu lohia bona egu pavapava na mai namomu ida vada o lou mai.
english: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

motu: Barasilai, tau Gilead, na Rogelim amo ema, hanua pavapavana e bamoa ela bona Ioridane sinavaina, sinavai amo baine hakaua hanai totona.
english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

motu: Barasilai na buruka herea, ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ahui. Hanua pavapavana na Mahanaim ai e nohova negana ai hari Barasilai ese e ubuava; badina be ia na taḡa bada tauna.
english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Barasilai e hamaoroa, eto, Aita hanai, lau ese baina narimu Ierusalem ai.
english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

motu: A Barasilai ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Laḡani hida baina mauri dainai hanua pavapavana ida Ierusalem bainala?
english: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

motu: Hari dina ai egu mauri laḡanidia na taurahani-ahui; ḡau namodia bona ḡau dikadia baina hididia diba a? Emu hesiai tauna ese na animu bona na inumu gaudia baina mamidia diba a? Ane e abimu taudia bona hahinedia edia ane baina kamonai diba a? Matona, emu hesiai tauna ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava baina hahekwarahimu anina be dahaka?
english: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

motu: Emu hesiai tauna ese Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai do baina bamomu taina. Anina be dahaka hanua pavapavana ese unu ba hanamogu toma?
english: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

motu: Mani emu kara emu hesiai tauna do baina lou lao, egu hanua korikori ai baina mase, tamagu bona sinagu edia gara badibadinai. A emu hesiai tauna Kimuhamu binai, ia ese egu lohia bona egu pavapava ida baine hanai, bena emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena do ba kara henia.
english: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana e haere, eto, Kimuhamu na lau ida baia hanai, bena oiemu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena baina kara henia, bona egu ai ba gwaurai ḡaudia iboudiai do baina henimu.
english: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia; hanua pavapavana danu e hanai. Bena hanua pavapavana ese Barasilai e harahua bona e hanamoa; bena ia ese ena hanua korikori e lou henia.
english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

motu: A hanua pavapavana na Gilgal ela, bona hari Kimuhamu na ia ida ela. Iuda taudia iboudiai, bona Israel besena kahana, ese David e bamoa.
english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai na hanua pavapavana enai e kau, e nanadaia, eto, Badina be dahaka tadikakamai Iuda taudia ese vada e dadihaimai, hanua pavapavana bona ena ruma taudia na Ioridane sinavaina amo vada e hakaudia hanai, bona David ena orea taudia iboudiai danu ia ida.
english: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

motu: Bena Iuda taudia iboudiai ese Israel taudia e haere henidia, eto, Badina be hanua pavapavana na ai varavaramai. Ina kara dainai o badu henimaimu badina be dahaka? Ai na hanua pavapavana ena aniani taidia a animu a? Eiava herahia ḡauna ta vada e henimai a?
english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

motu: Bena Israel taudia ese Iuda taudia e haere henidia, eto, Ai ahumai na gwauta, hanua pavapavana enai; David enai ai ahumai na bada, umui ahumui be maraḡi. Matona, dahaka dainai o dadaraimaimu? Ai na asia guna, hanua pavapavana iabi-louna dalana iherevalaina ai a? A Iuda taudia edia hereva daḡedaḡena na bada, Israel taudia edia hereva daḡedaḡena na maraḡi. + 19:43 Israel besena ai iduhu iboudiai na gwauta-rua: gwauta na “Israel” e gwauraidia a rua na “Iuda” e gwauraidia. *
english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

motu: Kara-kava kara-kava tauna ta e nohova, ladana na Sieba Bikri, Beniamina tauna ta. Ia ese kibi e hiriria, bena eto, Ita na asi ahuda David enai, Asi ahuda ta Iese natuna enai. Israel e, ta ta ena kalaga ena kalaga a lou heni.
english: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia iboudiai ese David e rakatania, Sieba Bikri murina amo ela; a Iuda taudia ese edia hanua pavapavana e ḡavaia, Ioridane sinavaina amo ela bona Ierusalem.
english: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

motu: David na ena ruma ai e kau, Ierusalem ai; bena hanua pavapavana ese e adavadia hahinedia gwautaosi, hari ruma inarina totona e rakatanidia hahinedia, na e abidia, ruma ta ai e koudia ahu mai igimadia; unuseni ai e ubudia, a dekediai se raka vareai. Taunabunai idia na e hekou ahu, e nohova vabu na heheto, ela bona e mase.
english: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Amasa e hamaoroa, eto, Iuda taudia ba boiridia, dina toi do basie ore idia na lau dekegu ai bae hebou iniseni ai, bona oi danu baoma.
english: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”

motu: Taunabunai, Amasa na Iuda taudia iboiridia ela, to e halahe, vada e gwauraia hamata dinadia ai se lou mai.
english: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.

motu: Bena David ese Abisai e hamaoroa, eto, Absalom ese e hadikada maraḡi, a hari Sieba Bikri ese baine hadikada bada. Emu lohia ena hesiai taudia bavabidia, ia ba ḡavaia, hanua mai magudia haida baine abidia bena baine hahekwarahida na garina.
english: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”

motu: Bena Ioab bona Kerete taudia bona Pelete taudia bona goada taudia iboudiai na Abisai murinai ela; Ierusalem amo e raka lasi, Sieba Bikri bae hahavaia totona.
english: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

motu: Nadi-bada Gibeon ai enai e kau negana ai, Amasa na ema, idia ida e hedavari. Ioab ese tuari dabuana e hahedokilaia, Iatanai dare mai iudalaina ḡauna mai varona ida na gabana ai e ḡeḡea; bena rakana ai dare na iudalaina ḡauna amo e moru.
english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

motu: Bena Ioab ese Amasa e hereva henia, eto, Tadigu, oi namo a? Bena Ioab ese imana idibana amo Amasa aukina huina e abia, baine harahua totona.
english: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

motu: A Amasa na dare se itaia, Ioab imana ai. Taunabunai, Ioab ese ia bogana e gwadaia, bona bogarauna na tano ai e heḡiḡi dobi; ma se gwadaia harua. A tau na e mase. Bena Ioab bona tadina Abisai ese Sieba Bikri ma e hahavaia.
english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

motu: A Ioab ena orea tauna ta ese Amasa badibadinai e gini, eto, Daika ese Ioab bona David e lalo namo henidiamu, ia na Ioab murina amo baine raka.
english: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”

motu: Hari Amasa na sibona rarana lalonai e hekure, laolao dalana ai; raka-hanai taudia na e itaia, bena e gini. Bena una tau ese e itadia, idia na vada e gini, bena ia ese Amasa e abia, laolao dalana amo e huaia lao, rei lalonai e atoa, bena dabua amo e tarua ahu.
english: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

motu: Laolao dalana amo vada e abia oho murinai, taunimanima iboudiai na Ioab murina amo ela, Sieba Bikri e hahavaia. Sieba e mase
english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

motu: Sieba na Israel iduhudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo e raka hanai ela bona Abele, Bete-maka kahana hanuana ta; bena Bikri ena taunimanima iboudiai e hebou, ia murina amo ela, hanua lalonai e didi vareai.
english: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

motu: Bena Ioab ena orea idoinai ema, Sieba e koua ahu, Abele, Bete-maka hanuana, lalonai. Bena tano e senua hanua vairanai, hanua maḡuna hegaga-hehenina ai, bena maḡu iḡiḡi-dobina ai e gugu mase.
english: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.

motu: Bena aonega hahinena ta hanua lalona amo e boiboi, eto, A kamonai, a kamonai; Ioab a hamaoroa, aine raka mai, baina hereva henia.
english: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”

motu: Ioab na dekena e raka kahi lao, bena hahine na eto, Oi na Ioab a? Ia na e haere, eto, Oibe. Bena hahine ese e hereva henia, eto, Emu hesiai hahinena egu hereva ba kamonai. Ia na e haere, eto, Na hakalamu.
english: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He|strong="H7126" * answered|strong="H1697" *, “ I|strong="H1697" * am.” Then|strong="H7126" * she said|strong="H1697" * to|strong="H8085" * him|strong="H8085" *, “ Hear|strong="H8085" * the|strong="H8085" * words|strong="H1697" * of|strong="H1697" * your|strong="H8085" * servant.” He|strong="H7126" * answered|strong="H1697" *, “ I|strong="H1697" *’m listening|strong="H8085" *.”

motu: Hahine na eto, Sene negadia ai ini e gwau tomava “Abele ai lalo-hadai namona ba tahua”, bena unu e kara tomava.
english: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.

motu: Lau be maino bona heabidadama Israel ai e badinadiamu taudia ta; a oi na Israel hanuana gunana ta ihabua-tarina dalana o tahuamu. Dahaka dainai Iehova ahuna ba hadonoa?
english: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up Yahweh’s inheritance?”

motu: Ioab e haere, eto, Unu asina ura tomamu, asina uramu ḡau ta baina hadonoa eiava baina habuaia tari.
english: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

motu: Una na koikoi. A tau ta Efraim ororodia amo, ladana Sieba Bikri, ese King David vada e tuan henia; ia mo sibona ba henigu, bena hanua amo baina raka oho. Una hahine ese Ioab e hamaoroa, eto, Benaini, ia kwarana na magu amo baia tahoa hanai emu ai.
english: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The|strong="H5921" * woman|strong="H8034" * said|strong="H1697" * to|strong="H3212" * Joab|strong="H3097" *, “ Behold|strong="H2009" *, his|strong="H5375" * head|strong="H7218" * will|strong="H4428" * be|strong="H3808" * thrown|strong="H7993" * to|strong="H3212" * you|strong="H3588" * over|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * wall|strong="H2346" *.”

motu: Bena hahine ese hanua taudia iboudiai dekedia ela, mai aonegana ida e hereva henidia. Bena idia ese Sieba Bikri kwarana e utua oho, e tahoa lasi Ioab enai. Taunabunai, ia ese kibi e hiriria, bena idia na una hanua amo e raka oho, ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ela. Bena Ioab na Ierusalem e lou lao, hanua pavapavana dekena ela. David ena heitatao taudia
english: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

motu: Ioab ese Israel tuari oreana idoinai e biaguava; Benaia Iehoiada ese Kerete taudia bona Pelete taudia e biagudiava;
english: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,
