motu: Ta ta ena herahia ena herahia e mailai, silver * ḡaudia bona gold * ḡaudia, bona dabua, bona dahudahu muramurana bona aniani mamidia ihanamodia muramuradia, bona hosi bona doniki; unuheto laḡani ta ta lalodiai e heni.
english: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.

motu: Solomon ese kariota bona hosi-gui taudia e haboudia. Ena kariota na daha-ta sinahu-hani; bona hosi-gui taudia na gerebu-ta daha-rua, + 10:26 Gerebu-ta daha-rua = 12,000. * kariota hanuadia ai e hanohodia, bona haida na hanua pavapavana dekenai Ierusalem ai danu.
english: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese silver * na ḡau pipikina ai e halaoa Ierusalem ai, nadi na heto; bona sida audia na e hahohodia, Sefela sukedia na heheto.
english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

motu: Solomon ena hosi na Aigupto bona Kue amo e abidia; hanua pavapavana ena hoihoi taudia ese Kue amo e abidia, mai davadia.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

motu: Kariota ta na Aigupto amo e abia, davana na silver * sekeledia sinahu-tauratoi, + 10:29 Silver sekeledia sinahu-tauratoi = 10 kilograms sisivana. * bona hosi ta davana na silver * sekeledia sinahu-ta imahui. + 10:29 Silver sekeledia sinahu-ta imahui = 2 ½ kilograms sisivana. * Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ena hoihoi taudia ese ma e hoihoilaidia lou, Hiti taudia edia pavapava iboudiai bona Suria pavapavadia ediai.
english: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels + 10:29 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.

motu: King Solomon ese idau bese hahinedia diaḡau e ura henidiava: Farao natuna hahinena, bona Moab bona Amono bona Edom bona Sidono bona Hiti hahinedia.
english: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

motu: Unu bese na Iehova ese Israel taudia vada e herevalai henidia, eto, Basio adavadia bona basie adavamui, badina be idia na momokani lalomui bae girodia hanai, edia dirava ediai. A Solomon ese unu hahine na e ura henidia lalo-dikava.
english: of the nations concerning which Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.

motu: Ia adavana korikori, lohia hahinedia, na sinahu hitu; ma hahine haida sinahu toi danu e adavadia; bena adavana verina ese lalona e aniava.
english: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

motu: Badina be Solomon vada e buruka negana ai, ia adavana ese lalona e giroa hanai, dirava idaudia ediai; ia lalona ese Iehova, ena Dirava, se badinaia momokani, tamana David lalona ese e badinaiava heḡereḡerena.
english: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father was.

motu: Badina be Solomon ese Astaroto, Sidono taudia edia dirava hahinena, bona Milkom, Arnono taudia edia dirava dikana, e badinadiava.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

motu: Taunabunai, Solomon na e kara havara Iehova vairanai, Iehova se badinaia ḡoevaḡoeva, tamana David ese e badinaiava heḡereḡerena.
english: Solomon did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and didn’t go fully after Yahweh, as David his father did.

motu: Bena Solomon ese Kemoso, Moab taudia edia dirava dikana, bona Molek, Amono taudia edia dirava dikana, edia atai gabuna helaḡana e hadaia, ororo ta dorina ai, Ierusalem mairiveina kahana ai.
english: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

motu: Unu mo e kara toma, adavana idau bese hahinedia edia; bena idia ese edia dirava vairadiai muramura mai bonadia e gabu bona boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia.
english: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Solomon e badu henia, badina be ia lalona ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, nega rua e hahedinarai henia
english: Yahweh was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Yahweh, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

motu: bona e hagania dirava idaudia basine badinadia Diravana, na e rakatania. Ia ese Iehova ena haheḡani se badinaia.
english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Solomon e hamaoroa, eto, Lalomu na eneheto bona egu gwauhamata bona egu taravatu, na haḡanilaimu ḡaudia, na so badinadia dainai, lau na momokani basileia oiemu amo baina darea oho, emu hesiai tauna baina henia.
english: Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

motu: A, tamamu David bagunai oiemu mauri dinadia ai basina karaia, a oi natumu imana amo do baina darea oho.
english: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.

motu: Ḡau tamona, basileia idoinai basina darea oho; a iduhu ta na natumu baina henia, egu hesiai tauna David bagunai, bona Ierusalem, na abia hidi hanuana, dainai. Solomon inaina
english: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”

motu: Iehova ese Solomon ana inai tauna ta e haginia; ia na Hadad, Edom tauna, Edom pavapavadia edia iduhu tauna ta.
english: Yahweh raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.

motu: Badina be David na Edom ai e nohova negana ai, Ioab, tuari oreana biaguna badana, na mase taudia iguridia totona ela, bena ia ese Edom mamaruanedia iboudiai e aladia mase;
english: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom

motu: badina be Ioab bona Israel oreana idoinai na hua tauratoi unuseni ai e nohova, ela bona Edom mamaruanedia iboudiai vada e aladia ore.
english: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),

motu: A Hadad na Aigupto e heau lao, Edom taudia haida, ia tamana ena hesiai taudia, ida. Una negana ai, Hadad na do mero maragi.
english: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.

motu: Idia na Midian amo e tore isi, Paranlai eha kau, bena Paran taudia haida e abidia, idia ida Aigupto ela, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, dekenai e kau. Farao ese ruma auta e henia, bona aniani e henia loulou, dina iboudiai; bona tano danu e henia.
english: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

motu: Farao ese Hadad e lalo namo henia; taunabunai ia ese ia adavana, Queen * Tapene, tadina e henia, baine adavaia.
english: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

motu: Hari Tapene tadina ena amo ia ese natuna maruanena, ladana Genubata, e havaraia; bena Tapene ese una mero na Farao ena ruma ai rata amo e butua oho. Hari Genubata na Farao ena ruma ai e nohova, Farao natuna mamaruanedia bogaragidiai.
english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

motu: A Hadad na Aigupto ai harina e kamonai, David na tubu tama dekediai vada e mahuta, bona Ioab, tuari oreana biaguna badana, vada e mase; bena Hadad ese Farao e noia, eto, Mani a kahugu nege, egu tano korikori bainala.
english: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”

motu: A Farao ese e haere henia, eto, Egu ai dahaka ḡau ai o dabumu dainai emu tano korikori ilou-henina dalana o tahuamu? A ia ma e noia, eto, Mani emu kara a kahugu nege mo.
english: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He|strong="H3588" * answered, “ Nothing|strong="H3808" *, however|strong="H3588" * only|strong="H3588" * let|strong="H7971" * me|strong="H7971" * depart|strong="H3212" *.”

motu: Dirava ese inaina ta ma e hatorea isi, ladana na Reson Eliada; ia ese biaguna Hadadesere, Soba pavapavana, vada e heautania.
english: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

motu: Ia ese tatau haida e haboudia, dadidadi oreana ta biaguna ai e hahelao, David ena ala-ala murinai. Bena idia na Damasko ela, unuseni ai e nohova; bena ia na Damasko pavapavana ai e halaoa.
english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

motu: Solomon ena dina iboudiai una tau ese Israel taudia e inai henidiava, bona e kara dika henidiava, Hadad heḡereḡerena. Ia ese Israel e inai henia badava, bona Suria e lohiaiava.
english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

motu: Ieroboam Nebata, Efraim tauna ta, Sereda amo, Solomon ena hesiai tauna ta, sinana na vabu ta ladana Serua, ia ese danu hanua pavapavana e inai heniava.
english: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

motu: Hanua pavapavana e inai heniava badina binai: Solomon ese Milo kohorona e haginia, bona tamana David ena hanua maḡuna e ha-aukaia.
english: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

motu: Hari eregabe tauna Ieroboam na mai aonegana; bena Solomon ese e itaia ia na ḡaukara dikadika tauna dainai ia ese Iosef ena iduhu ai e hagaukaradia taudia biagudia ai e halaoa.
english: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

motu: Una negana ai, Ieroboam na Ierusalem amo e raka lasi, bena peroveta tauna ta, ladana Ahia, tau Silono, ese dala ai e davaria. Hari Ahia na dabua matamatana ta vada e hahedokilaia; bona idia raruosi na sibodia una tano paka ai.
english: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.

motu: Bena Ahia ese ena dabua matamatana e dokia oho, e darea, siri gwauta-rua.
english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

motu: Bena ia ese Ieroboam e hamaoroa, eto, Siri gwauta bavabi emu; badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: a itaia, basileia na Solomon imana amo baina darea, iduhu gwauta na oi baina henimu;
english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

motu: a ia be egu hesiai tauna David bagunai bona Israel iduhudia amo na abia hidi hanuana Ierusalem dainai, iduhu ta do baine abia.
english: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),

motu: Badina be ia ese vada e rakatanigu, Astaroto, Sidono taudia edia dirava hahinena, bona Kemoso, Moab diravana, bona Milkom, Amono diravana, vada e toma henidia diho; ia danu egu dala ai se rakamu, lau vairagu ai kara maoromaoro se karamu, bona egu taravatu bona egu hahedua herevadia se badinadiamu, tamana David ese e badinadiava heḡereḡerena.
english: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

motu: Ḡau tamona, lau na basileia idoinai ia imana amo basina abia oho; ena mauri dinadia iboudiai ena lohia gabuna ai baina hanohoa, egu hesiai tauna David, na abia hidi bona egu haheḡani bona egu taravatu e badinadiava tauna, dainai.
english: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,

motu: A basileia na ia natuna imana amo baina abia oho, bena oi baina henimu, iduhu gwauta.
english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ia natuna na iduhu ta baina henia, egu hesiai tauna David ena lamepa na Ierusalem, na abia hidi lau ladagu baine noholaia hanuana, lalonai lau vairagu ai baine mia helaoreana.
english: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

motu: A oi baina abimu, lalomu e ura henimu ḡaudia iboudiai na oi ese ba lohiadia, bona Israel pavapavana ai baola.
english: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

motu: Bena baina haḡanilaimu haheganidia ihoudiai boma kamonaidia, bona egu dala ai boma raka, bona egu taravatu bona egu haheḡani boma badinadia, egu hesiai taudia David e karava heḡereḡerena, lau ese baina bamomu, bona garamu baina haginia auka, David na kara henia heḡereḡerena, bona Israel na oi baina henimu.
english: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.

motu: David garana na ina dainai baina hahisihisia, to dia ela bona hanaihanai.
english: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”

motu: Taunabunai, Solomon ese Ieroboam iala-masena dalana e tahua. A Ieroboam e tore isi, e heau, Aigupto ela, Sisaka, Aigupto pavapavana, dekenai; ia na Aigupto ai e nohova ela bona Solomon e mase. Solomon e mase
english: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

motu: Solomon ena kara oredia, ena kara iboudiai bona ena aonega, na Solomon ena kara bukana ai vada e tore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

motu: Solomon na Israel idoinai Ierusalem ai e lohiaia laḡanidia na hari-ahui.
english: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

motu: Bena Solomon na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; tamana David ena hanua ai e guria. Ia natuna Rehoboam ese ia gabuna ai e lohia.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

motu: Rehoboam na Sekem ela, badina be Israel taudia iboudiai na Sekem ela, pavapava ai bae halaoa totona.
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

motu: Ieroboam Nebata na harina e kamonai; badina be ia na dounu Aigupto ai, King Solomon e heautania negana ai e lao henia gabuna ai. Bena Ieroboam na Aigupto amo e lou.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

motu: Bena idia ese ia iboirina e hesiai; bena Ieroboam bona Israel hegogona idoinai ema, Rehoboam e hereva henia, eto,
english: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

motu: Tamamu ese emai maduna e hametaua. Taunabunai, harihari tamamu ena hesiai ilao-henina aukana bona ena maduna metauna ai latamai ai na ba haharaḡaia; bena ai ese oi isiaimu baia lao heni.
english: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

motu: Ia na eto, Ba raka oho, dina toi heḡereḡerena, ma ba lou mai dekegu ai. Taunabunai, taunimanima na e raka oho.
english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So|strong="H7725" * the|strong="H7725" * people|strong="H5971" * departed|strong="H3212" *.

motu: Bena King Rehohoam na tau badadia, tamana Solomon maurina ai ia vairanai e giniva taudia, ida e henega bou, e nanadaidia, eto, Emui hahealo be dahaka egu ai? Ini taunimanima na ede baina haere henidia toma?
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Hari dina ai ini taunimanima edia hesiai tauna ai boma lao, isiaidia boma lao heni, bona ba haere henidia negana ai hereva namodia boma gwaurai; bena idia na oiemu hesiai taudia ai baela hanaihanai.
english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

motu: To una hahealo tau badadia ese e henia na ia ese e dadaraia; bona eregabe taudia, ia ida e vara isi hebouva bona ia vairanai e giniva taudia, ida e henega bou.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

motu: Ia ese e nanadaidia, eto, Emui hahealo be dahaka? Ini taunimanima ese vada e hamaorogu, eto “Tamamu ese ai latamai ai vada e atoa madunana na ba haharaḡaia”. Ede baita haere henidia toma?
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

motu: Bena hari ia ida e vara isi hebou taudia ese e haere henia, eto, Hari vada e hamaoromu, eto “Tamamu ese emai maduna e hametaua a oi ese ba haharaḡaia”, taudia na ini ba haere henidia toma, baoto “Lau imagu kwakikwakina maraḡina udunana ese tamagu mamuna udunana na e hereaiamu;
english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

motu: taunabunai, tamagu ese maduna metauna na umui latamui ai e atoa, a lau ese ma baina hametaua, bona tamagu ese hekwadi varodia amo e hahisimui, a lau ese doadoa amo baina hahisimui”.
english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

motu: Taunabunai, dina ihatoina ai, Ieroboam bona taunimanima iboudiai na Rehoboam dekena ema, hanua pavapavana ena hereva heḡereḡerena, eto “Dina ihatoina ai dekegu ma baoma”.
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese taunimanima na e gwau daḡe henidia, tau badadia edia hahealo e dadaraia,
english: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

motu: bona eregabe taudia edia hahealo heḡereḡerena ai e hereva henidia. Eto, Tamagu ese maduna metauna na umui latamui ai e atoa, a lau ese ma baina hametaua; bona tamagu ese hekwadi varodia amo e hahisimui, a lau ese doadoa amo baina hahisimui.
english: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ese taunimanima eredia se kamonai; badina be ini kara na Iehova ese e havaradia, ena hereva, Ahia tau Silono ese Ieroboam Nebata e hamaorolaia herevana, na baine hamomokania helaoreana.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from Yahweh, that he might establish his word, which Yahweh spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

motu: Israel taudia iboudiai na e itaia, hanua pavapavana ese idia eredia se kamonai; bena idia ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Ai ahumai be dahaka David enai a? Asi ahumai ta Iese natuna enai. Israel e, emui kalaga ba lou henidia! David e, emu ruma ba gimaia! Taunabunai, Israel taudia na edia kalaga e lou henidia.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

motu: A Rehoboam ese Israel taudia Iuda hanuadia ai e nohova na e lohiadia. Basileia na e haheparara
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

motu: Bena Rehoboam ese Adorama, e haḡaukaradia taudia biagudia, na e siaia; a Israel taudia iboudiai ese nadi amo e hodoa mase. Bena King Rehoboam na ena kariota ai e gui haraḡa, Ierusalem baine heau lao eto.
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel idoinai ese David garana e gwau edeede henidiamu ema bona ina dina.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

motu: A Israel taudia na e kamonai Ieroboam vada e lou mai, bena idia ese e boiria, hebou lalonai; bena Israel idoinai pavapavana ai e halaoa. Ta na David garana murinai se raka, Iuda iduhuna taudia mo sibodia.
english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

motu: Rehoboam na Ierusalem ai e kau negana ai, ia ese Iuda iduhuna taudia iboudiai bona Beniamina iduhuna taudia e haboudia, tuari taudia mai goadadia domaga-ta gerebu-taurahani; + 12:21 Domaga-ta gerebu-taurahani = 180,000. * Israel taudia bae tuari henidia bona basileia na Solomon natuna Rehoboam bae henia lou eto.
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

motu: A Dirava ena hereva na Dirava ena tau ladana Semaia dekenai e kau, eto,
english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

motu: Rehoboam Solomon, Iuda pavapavana, bona Iuda bona Beniamina iduhudia taudia, bona taunimanima oredia iboudiai na ba hamaorodia, baoto
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

motu: “Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Basiola, varavaramui Israel taudia na basio tuari henidia; ta ta emu ruma emu ruma ba lou lao, badina be ina na lauegu amo e vara”. Taunabunai idia ese Iehova ena hereva e hakala henia, edia ruma e lou heni, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena. Ieroboam ese Israel e hakererea
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s word, and returned and went their way, according to Yahweh’s word.

motu: Bena Ieroboam ese Sekem e hadaia, Efraim ororodia ai, unuseni ai e nohova. Bena unu amo e raka lasi, Penuel e haginia.
english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.

motu: Bena Ieroboam na lalona ai eto, Ina basileia ese David garana baine lou henia.
english: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

motu: Ini taunimanima ese Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai bema lao henia, boubou ḡaudia ihahelaḡadia totona, idia lalodia ese edia lohia Rehoboam, Iuda pavapavana, bema lou henia; bena lau bae alagu mase, bona Rehoboam, Iuda pavapavana, bae lou henia.
english: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana na hahealo e tahua, bena boromakau natudia laulaudia rua gold * amo e karadia. Bena ia ese taunimanima e hamaorodia, eto, Ierusalem vada o lao henia davana. Israel taumui e, Aigupto tanona amo e hakaumui lasi diravadia bini a itadia.
english: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

motu: Bena ia ese ta Betele ai e haginia, ma ta be Dan ia.
english: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

motu: Bena ina na kara dika ai ela; badina be taunimanima ese ta e lao henia Betele ai, ma ta ilao-henina totona e laova bona Dan ia.
english: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

motu: Ia ese danu dubu haida e haginidia atai gabudia ai, bona hahelaga taudia e duanaidia taunimanima iboudiai lalodia amo, dia Levi taudia mo lalodiai.
english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

motu: Ieroboam ese danu aria e gwauraia, hua ihataurahanina dinana ihagwautaimana ai bae karaia, Iuda ai e karaiava ariana heḡereḡerena; bona boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, ihaboulaina patana latanai. Betele ai danu unu e kara toma, hari boromakau natudia laulaudia, e karadia ḡaudia, na e boudia. Bona hari atai ai e karadia gabu-helaḡadia edia hahelaga taudia na ia ese Betele ai e hanohodia.
english: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana Betele ai e karaia na hua ihataurahanina dinana ihagwauta-imana ai e dae henia, ia sibona ese lalona ai e haeroa huana ai; aria ta e gwauraia Israel taudia edia, bona ihaboulaina patana e dae henia, muramura mai bonana igabuna totona.
english: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.

motu: Dirava ena tau ta Iuda amo ema, Iehova ena hereva dainai, bena Betele ai e kau. Ieroboam na ihaboulaina patana badinai gini, muramura mai bonana igabuna totona.
english: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

motu: Bena hari tau ese ihaboulaina patana e boi henia lao, Iehova ena hereva dainai; eto, ihaboulaina patana e, ihaboulaina patana e, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: a itaia; mero ta baine vara David ena iduhu ai, ladana bae hatoa Iosia; bena ia ese atai gabudia edia hahelaḡa taudia, oi latamu ai muramura mai bonana e gabua taudia, na oi latamu ai boubou gaudia ai baine halaodia, bena oi latamu ai taunimanima turiadia bae gabudia.
english: He cried against the altar by Yahweh’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! Yahweh says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”

motu: Una dina ai ia ese toa ta e herlidia, eto, Ina na hari Iehova vada e hereva toana: a itaia, ihaboulaina patana bae giḡia dobi, bona ia latanai e miamu kahudia na bae hebubu nege.
english: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which Yahweh has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Dirava ena tau ena hereva, ihaboulaina patana Betele ai e boi henia lao ḡauna, e kamonai negana ai, Ieroboam ese imana na ihaboulaina patana amo e toia roro, eto, A dabaia tao. Bena hari imana ia e toi roro henia ḡauna na e auka; bena asi ena dala baine veria lou.
english: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana danu e heḡiḡi dobi, bona latana kahuna e hebubu nege, hari Dirava ena tau ese Iehova ena hereva dainai vada e henidia toana heḡereḡerena.
english: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by Yahweh’s word.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Dirava ena tau e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, ba noia, lau daigu ai ba ḡuriḡuri, imagu ma baine namo lou helaoreana. Bena Dirava ena tau ese Iehova e noia; bena hanua pavapavana imana na e namo lou, ma e goada, guna heḡereḡerena.
english: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of Yahweh your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me.” The|strong="H6440" * man|strong="H6440" * of|strong="H4428" * God|strong="H3068" * interceded|strong="H6419" * with|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, and|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" *’s hand|strong="H3027" * was|strong="H3068" * restored|strong="H7725" * to|strong="H7725" * him|strong="H6440" *, and|strong="H3068" * became|strong="H1961" * as|strong="H1961" * it|strong="H7725" * was|strong="H3068" * before|strong="H6440" *.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Dirava ena tau e hamaoroa, eto, Egu ruma aitala, laḡamu bavania, bena davamu baina henimu.
english: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

motu: A Dirava ena tau ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Ena be emu ruma kahana boma henigu, to oi ida basina raka vareai hebou. Aniani basina ania eiava ranu basina inua ina gabu ai;
english: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

motu: badina be Iehova ena hereva ese e haganigu, eto, Aniani basio ania bona ranu basio inua, bona oma dalana amo ma basio lou.
english: for so was it commanded me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”

motu: Taunabunai, ia na dala idauna ta amo e lou ela, Betele ema dalana amo ma se lou.
english: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

motu: Betele ai peroveta tauna burukana ta e nohova. Bena natuna haida ema, Dirava ena tau una dina ai Betele ai vada e kara karadia iboudiai na sivaradia e hamaorolaia; una tau ese hanua pavapavana e hamaorolaia herevadia danu idia ese tamadia e hamaorolaia.
english: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

motu: Bena tamadia ese e nanadaidia, eto, Edena dala amo ela? Bena natuna ese Dirava ena tau, hari Iuda amo ema tauna, ena lao dalana e haheitalaia.
english: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

motu: Bena ia ese natuna e hamaorodia, eto, Doniki ba haheḡaeḡaea egu. Taunabunai, idia ese doniki e haheḡaeḡaea ena, bena ia na e gui kau.
english: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.

motu: Bena ia na Dirava ena tau murina amo ela, oak auna henunai helaina ai e davaria; bena e nanadaia, eto, Oi na Dirava ena tau Iuda amo oma a? Ia eto, Oibe.
english: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He|strong="H3063" * said, “ I|strong="H4672" * am.”

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Egu ruma aitala, bavaniani.
english: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

motu: A ia eto, Oi ida basina lou diba, bona oi ida basina raka vareai; oi ida basina aniani bona ranu basina inua ina gabu ai;
english: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

motu: badina be Iehova ena hereva ese e hamaorogu, eto “Basio aniani bona ranu basio inua unuseni ai, bona oma dalana amo ma basio lou”.
english: For it was said to me by Yahweh’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”

motu: Bena hari peroveta tauna ese e haere henia, eto, Lau danu peroveta tauna, oi heḡereḡeremu; bena aneru ta ese e hereva henigu, Iehova ena hereva dainai, eto “Ba hakaua lou emu ruma ai, baine aniani bona ranu baine inua totona”. To ia ese e koia.
english: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.

motu: Taunabunai raruosi na e lou ela, bena ena ruma ai e aniani, bona ranu e inua.
english: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.

motu: Pata ai e helaiva ai na Iehova ena hereva na hari tau e loulaia peroveta-tauna enai e kau;
english: As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

motu: bena ia ese hari Dirava ena tau Iuda amo na e gwau henia, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: oi ese Iehova ena hereva vada o utua, Iehova, emu Dirava, ena haheḡani asio badinaia;
english: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh’s word, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,

motu: a vada o lou mai, e haḡanimu eto “Basio aniani bona ranu basio inua” gabuna ai vada ome aniani bona ranu vada ome inua; una dainai oi tau-animu na senemu edia gara gabuna ai basine heato.
english: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”

motu: E aniani bona ranu e inua murinai, ia ese doniki e haheḡaeḡaea, e hakaua lou peroveta-tauna ena.
english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

motu: A e raka laova ai, leona ta ese dala ai e davaria, bena e alaia mase. Tau-anina na dala ai e henege dobi, bena doniki na ia badibadinai e gini; leona danu una tau tau-anina badibadinai e gini.
english: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

motu: Taunimanima haida e raka hanai, bena una tau tau-anina dala ai henege-dobina ai e itaia, bona leona na tau-anina badibadinai gini. Bena idia na ela, hari peroveta tauna burukana e noholaiava hanuana lalonai harina e piua.
english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

motu: Una tau e hakaua lou peroveta-tauna na sivarai e kamonai, bena ia eto, Una na Dirava ena tau, Iehova ena hereva e utua tauna; una dainai Iehova ese leona vada e henia, bena leona ese vada e darea bona vada e alaia mase, Iehova ese e hamaorolaia herevana heḡereḡerena.
english: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to Yahweh’s word. Therefore Yahweh has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke to him.”

motu: Bena ia ese natuna na e hamaorodia, eto, Doniki a haheḡaeḡaea egu. Bena e haheḡaeḡaea.
english: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

motu: Bena ia na ela, una tau tau-anina na dala ai henege-dobina ai e davaria, bona doniki bona leona na ia badibadinai gigini. Leona ese una tau tau-anina na se ania, bona doniki danu se darea.
english: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

motu: Bena peroveta tauna ese Dirava ena tau tau-anina e abia isi, doniki doruna ai e atoa kau, hanua e loulaia lao, bae taitaia bona bae guria totona.
english: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

motu: Bena hari tau tau-anina na sibona ena gara ai e atoa; bena idia ese e taitaia, eto, Tadigu o, ihabaimu.
english: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

motu: E guria murinai, ia ese natuna e hamaorodia, eto, Baina mase negana ai, hari Dirava ena tau vada ta haguria garana ai ba gurigu; lau turiagu na ia turiana badibadidiai bavato.
english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

motu: Badina be iena hereva, Iehova ena hereva dainai ia ese ihaboulaina patana Betele ai bona Samaria hanuadia edia atai gabudia dubudia iboudiai e boi henidia lao herevana, na momokani anina do baine vara.
english: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

motu: Ina kara murinai, Ieroboam ese ena dala dikana se rakatania, a taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidia amo atai gabudia edia hahelaga taudia haida ma e abidia; e urava taudia na ia ese e hahelaḡadia, atai gabudia edia hahelaḡa taudia ai baela.
english: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

motu: Bena una kara na kara dikana ai ela, Ieroboam ena iduhu enai, tanobada kopina amo baine henege daure bona baine hebua tari totona.
english: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.

motu: Una negana ai Ieroboam natuna Abia na e gorerea.
english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

motu: Bena Ieroboam ese adavana e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, oromamu ba ha-idaua, taunimanima basie diba oi na Ieroboam adavana; bena Silo baola. A itaia, peroveta tauna Ahia, e herevalaigu ina bese ena pavapava ai bainala eto tauna, na unuseni ai.
english: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.

motu: Flaoa igabudia gwauta bona dikea haida bona bada-ranuna kavabu ta bavabi kau, ia dekena baola; ia ese baine hamaoromu dahaka baine vara ina mero enai.
english: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”

motu: Ieroboam adavana na unu e kara toma; e tore isi, Silo ela, Ahia ena ruma ai e kau. Hari Ahia na ḡau ta se ita, badina be matana e valahu-valahu, e buruka dainai.
english: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Ahia e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, Ieroboam adavana na e maimu, baine nanadaimu natuna dainai; badina be ia na e gorereamu. Unu ini ba hereva henia toma. Hahine na e kau negana ai, ia na e koikoi, eto ia na hahine idauna ta.
english: Yahweh said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”

motu: A ia na iduara amo e raka vareai negana ai Ahia na ia aena reḡedia e kamonai; bena ia na eto, Ieroboam adavana e, a raka vareai. Dahaka dainai o koikoimu, o tomu oi na hahine idauna ta? Badina be hereva metauna vada e henigu oiemu.
english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

motu: Aola, Ieroboam ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Taunimanima bogaragidia amo na abimu dae, egu bese Israel ihakauna ai na halaomu,
english: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

motu: basileia na David ena iduhu amo na dadia oho, oi na henimu, ḡau tamona oi na dia egu hesiai tauna David heḡereḡerena; ia ese egu haheḡani e badinadiava, bona murigu amo e rakava mai lalona idoinai, bona kara maoromaoro mo lau vairagu ai e karava.
english: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,

motu: A oi ese e gunalaimu taudia iboudiai na kara dika ai vada o hereadiamu, vada ola, dirava idaudia bona e haveve auridia amo e kara kaivakukudia vada o kara emu; unu amo vada o habadugu, bona vada o negegu murimu kahana ai.
english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

motu: Una dainai lau ese dika baina havaraia, Ieroboam ena ruma latanai, bona mamaruane iboudiai Israel ai, e ḡuidia taudia bona asie ḡuidia taudia, na Ieroboam ena amo baina utudia oho, bona Ieroboam ena iduhu baina habuaia tari vaitani, tau ta ese boromakau taḡedia e gabumu bona e haḡole ohomu na heto.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, + 14:10 or, male * he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.

motu: Ieroboam ena orea tauna ta hanua ai bema mase, sisia ese bae ania; eiava ta tano paka ai bema mase, atai manudia ese bae ania, badina be Iehova ese unu vada e gwauraia toma”.
english: The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for Yahweh has spoken it.”’

motu: Taunabunai, a tore isi, emu ruma aola. Aemu na hanua lalonai bae raka vareai negana ai, mero na baine mase.
english: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

motu: Bena Israel idoinai na ia taina bae tai, bona bae guria; badina be Ieroboam ena orea amo ia mo sibona gara ai bae guria, badina be ia enai Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese ḡau ta ai e lalo namo heniamu, Ieroboam ena iduhu ai.
english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

motu: Ina danu, Iehova ese Israel pavapavana ta baine haginia; una dina ai ina tau ese Ieroboam ena iduhu baine negea daure. Bona ina negana amo
english: Moreover Yahweh will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.

motu: Iehova ese Israel baine hamarerea, siriho na ranu ai e marere-mareremu na heto; bona Israel taudia na ina tano namona, ia ese senedia e henidia tanona, amo baine raḡadia oho, Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai baine hakarohodia rohoroho. Badina be idia ese edia au-tubua helaḡadia e karadia amo Iehova e habadua.
english: For Yahweh will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, + 14:15 That is, the Euphrates. * because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking Yahweh to anger.

motu: Ia ese Israel baine negea daure, Ieroboam ena kara dikadia, sibona e karadikalai ḡaudia bona Israel taudia e hakaradia dikalai gaudia daidiai.
english: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”

motu: Bena Ieroboam adavana e tore isi, e raka lav, Tirisa ai e kau; bena ruma iduarana ai e kau negana ai, mero vada e mase.
english: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

motu: Israel idoinai ese e guria, bona taina e tai, Iehova ena hereva, ena hesiai tauna, peroveta tauna Ahia, uduna amo e gwauraia heḡereḡerena. Ieroboam e mase
english: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

motu: Ieroboam ena kara oredia, ena tuari bona ena lohia karadia, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana lalonai eme hetore.
english: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

motu: Ieroboam ena lohia negana na laḡani ruahui-rua. Bena ia na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; bona ia natuna Nadab ese ia gabuna ai e lohia. King Rehoboam
english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

motu: Rehoboam, Solomon natuna, na Iuda ai e lohia. E lohia matama negana ai ena vara laḡanidia na hari-ahui ta, bena laḡani gwauta-hitu ia na Ierusalem ai e lohia, una na Iehova ese Israel iduhudia iboudiai bogaragidia amo e abia hidi hanuana, ia ladana unuseni ai baine atoa totona. Ia sinana ladana na Naamaha, hane Amono.
english: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

motu: Bena Iuda taudia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, edia kara dika amo e havaḡeḡea. Una kara ai idia ese tamadia e hereadiava.
english: Judah did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

motu: Badina be idia ese atai gabudia bona au-tubua helaḡadia e karadia, bona ororo badadia iboudiai doridia ai bona au mauridia henudiai au-tubua helaḡadia e haginidia;
english: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

motu: bona lebulebu karadia e karava edia gabu helaḡadia ai. Iehova ese Israel taudia vairadiai e luludia lasi besedia edia kara bodagadia iboudiai na idia ese ma e karadia.
english: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahweh drove out before the children of Israel.

motu: King Rehoboam ena lohia laḡanina iha-imana ai, Sisaka, Aigupto pavapavana, na ema, Ierusalem e tuari henia.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

motu: Ia ese Iehova ena dubu kohudia ḡoeva-daedia bona pavapava ena ruma kohudia goeva-daedia e abidia oho, ḡau iboudiai e laohaidia. Gold * kesidia danu, Solomon ese e kara gaudia, na iboudiai e abidia oho.
english: and he took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

motu: Bena King Rehoboam ese auri labora-labora kesidia e kara, idia ibolodia; bona hegima oreana biagudia, pavapava ena ruma iduarana e gimaiava taudia, imadia ai e atodia, bae naridia.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the door of the king’s house.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na Iehova ena dubu ai e raka vareaiva negadia iboudiai, hegima taudia ese unu kesi e abidia kauva, ma e loulaidiava, edia hegima rumana ai e atodiava. Rehoboam e mase
english: It was so, that as often as the king went into Yahweh’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.

motu: Rehoboam ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

motu: Rehoboam bona Ieroboam e hetuari heheni hanaihanaiva.
english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

motu: Bena Rehoboam na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; David ena hanua lalonai e guria, tubu tama ida. Ia sinana ladana na Naamaha, hane Amono. Ia gabuna ai natuna Abiama e lohia.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

motu: King Ieroboam, Nebata natuna, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahanina ai, Abiama ese Iuda e lohiaia matama;
english: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

motu: laḡani toi e lohiaia, Ierusalem ai. Sinana ladana na Maaka Abisalomo.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

motu: Tamana ena dala dikadia iboudiai e rakava; ia ese Iehova, ena Dirava, se badinaia momokaniva, tubuna David lalona ese e badinaiava heḡereḡerena.
english: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father.

motu: Ḡau tamona, David dainai Iehova, ena Dirava, ese lamepa ta e henia Ierusalem ai; ia murina amo natuna e haginia, bona Ierusalem e ha-aukaia.
english: Nevertheless for David’s sake, Yahweh his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;

motu: Badina be David na Iehova vairanai e kara maoromaorova, bona e haḡanilaia karadia ta amo se raka siri ena mauri dinadia iboudiai; a Uria tau Hiti enai mo e kerere.
english: because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

motu: Ena mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai Rehoboam bona Ieroboam e hetuari heheniva.
english: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

motu: Abiama ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore, ani? Abiama bona Ieroboam e hetuari heheniva.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

motu: Bena Abiama na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; David ena hanua ai e guria. Ia gabuna ai natuna Asa e lohia. King Asa
english: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.

motu: Ieroboam, Israel pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iharuahuina ai, Asa ese Iuda e lohiaia matama;
english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

motu: laḡani hari-ahui ta e lohiaia, Ierusalem ai. Sinana ladana na Maaka Abisalomo.
english: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

motu: Asa na e kara maoromaorova Iehova vairanai, senena David e karava heḡereḡerena.
english: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.

motu: Gabu helaḡadia ai lebulebu karadia e karava taudia na ia ese tano amo e atodia lasi, bona tubuna bona tamana ese e karadia kaivakukudia iboudiai na ia ese e abidia oho.
english: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

motu: Ia ese danu sinana Maaka ena pavapava dagina e abia oho, badina be iena hahedua dainai haida ese kaivakuku dikana ta e karaia, Asera ena. Asa ese una kaivakuku e utua gari, bena Kidron sinavaina badibadinai e hagabua.
english: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

motu: A atai gabudia helaḡadia na se abidia oho. Ḡau tamona Asa lalona ese Iehova e badinaia momokaniva, ena dina iboudiai lalodiai.
english: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Yahweh all his days.

motu: Bena tamana ena ḡau helaḡadia bona ia sibona ena ḡau helaḡadia, silver * bona gold * bona herahera ḡaudia idau-idau, ia ese Iehova ena dubu ai e vareailaidia.
english: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

motu: Asa bona Israel pavapavana Baasa na e hetuari heheniva, edia dina iboudiai.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

motu: Baasa, Israel pavapavana, na e raka lasi, Iuda baine tuari henia totona, bena ia ese Rama e haginia, Asa, Iuda pavapavana, enai baela baema taudia ilao-ahudia.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

motu: Bena Asa ese Iehova ena dubu kohudia amo silver * bona gold * orena idoinai e abia, bona pavapava ena ruma kohudia namodia iboudiai danu, bena ena hesiai taudia imadia ai e atodia kau. King Asa ese e siaidia lao, Suria pavapavana Ben-hadad, Tabarimono Hesiono natuna, Damasko ai e nohova tauna, dekenai; eto,
english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

motu: Raruosi aita herohemaino, lau tamagu bona oi tamamu heḡereḡeredia. A ita, herahia ḡaudia, silver * bona gold *, vada na siai vasimu; aola, Israel pavapavana Baasa ida emui herohemaino ba ḡigia rohoroho; bena ia na lauegu amo baine raka oho.
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

motu: Ben-hadad ese King Asa e kamonai henia, bena ena tuari oreadia biagudia e siaidia, Israel hanuadia bae tuari henidia. Idia ese Iono bona Dan bona Abele-bete-maka bona Kineroto idoinai bona Napatali tanona idoinai e hadareredia.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

motu: Baasa e kamonai, bena Rama ihaginina e hadokoa, ela, Tirisa ai e nohova.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

motu: Bena King Asa ese Iuda taudia iboudiai e haḡaukaradia vaitani, ta se hanohoa kava; bena idia ese Rama nadidia bona audia e huadia, Baasa ese vada e hagini ḡaudia; bena unu ḡau amo King Asa ese Geba, Beniamina tanona ai, bona Mispa, e haginidia.
english: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

motu: Asa ena kara oredia, ena siahu idoinai bona e kara karadia iboudiai, bona e hadai hanuadia, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani? A burukana ai ia ese hisihisi ta e davaria aena ai.
english: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

motu: Bena Asa na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; senena David ena hanua ai e guria. Ia gabuna ai ia natuna Iehosafat e lohia. King Nadab
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iharuana ai, Nadab Ieroboam ese Israel e lohiaia matama. Laḡani rua ia ese Israel e lohiaia.
english: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

motu: Iehova vairanai e kara havara, tamana ena dala ai e raka, bona ena kara dika ai Israel e hakaraia dika danu.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

motu: Baasa Ahia, Isakara iduhuna tauna, ese e revaia. Bena Baasa ese e alaia mase, Gibeton ai: una na Filistia taudia edia hanua ta. Badina be Nadab bona Israel taudia iboudiai ese Gibeton vada e koua ahu.
english: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

motu: Taunabunai, Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoina ai, Baasa ese Nadab e alaia mase; bena gabuna ai e lohia.
english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

motu: Pavapava dagina e abia, bena maoromaoro ia ese Ieroboam ena iduhu taudia iboudiai e aladia mase; Ieroboam ena iduhu tauna ta maurina ai se rakatania, ela bona una iduhu e habuaia tari, Iehova ena hereva, ena hesiai tauna Ahia tau Silono uduna amo e gwauraia, heḡereḡerena.
english: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of Yahweh, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

motu: Unu e kara toma, Ieroboam ena kara dika, sibona e kara-dikalai ḡaudia bona Israel taudia e hakaradia dikalai ḡaudia, daidiai, bona Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena badu e havaraia dainai.
english: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger.

motu: Nadab ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

motu: Asa bona Baasa e hetuari heheniva, edia dina iboudiai lalodiai. King Baasa
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoina ai, Baasa Ahia ese Israel idoinai e lohiaia matama Tirisa ai; ia ese laḡani ruahui-hani e lohiaia.
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

motu: Iehova vairanai e kara havara, Ieroboam ena dala ai e rakava, bona ena kara dika ai ia ese Israel taudia e hakaradia dika.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na Iehu Hanani enai e kau, Baasa latanai.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

motu: Eto, Ḡahu amo na abimu isi, egu bese Israel ihakauna tauna ai na halaomu; a oi na Ieroboam ena dala ai vada o raka, egu bese Israel vada o hakaraia dika, bona edia kara dika amo vada o habadugu.
english: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

motu: Una dainai, lau ese Baasa bona ena iduhu baina negedia daure; emu iduhu na Ieroboam Nebata ena iduhu heḡereḡerena ai baina halaoa.
english: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

motu: Baasa ena iduhu tauna ta hanua ai bema mase, sisia ese bae ania; eiava ta ma tano paka ai bema mase, atai manudia ese bae ania.
english: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

motu: Baasa ena kara oredia, ede ede e kara tomava, bona ena siahu herevadia, na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

motu: Bena Baasa na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; Tirisa ai e guria. Ia gabuna ai, ia natuna Elaha e lohia.
english: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna lehu Hanani ena amo ma e kau, Baasa mai ena iduhu taudia ida latadiai, ena kara dika iboudiai Iehova vairanai e karava ḡaudia ai, ia imana gaukaradia amo e habadua, Ieroboam ena iduhu ida vada e heḡereḡere bona e habuaia tari dainai. King Elaha
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena laḡani iharuahui-tauratoina ai, Elaha Baasa ese Israel e lohiaia matama, Tirisa ai; laḡani rua hona e lohiaia.
english: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

motu: A ena hesiai tauna Simiri, ena kariota oreana kahana biaguna, ese ia ihadikana dalana e tahua. Elaha na Tirisa ai, Arasa ena ruma ai e inuinu ela bona e kekero. Hari Arasa na pavapava ena ruma igimana tauna, Tirisa ai.
english: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

motu: Una negana ai Simiri e raka vareai, e rahua mase, e alaia; bena gabuna ai e lohia. Unu na Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena laḡani iharuahui-hituna lalonai.
english: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

motu: Ia e lohia matama negana ai, ena terono ai e helai kau dinana ai, ia ese Baasa ena iduhu taudia iboudiai e aladia ore; varavarana maruanena ta eiava turana maruanena ta se roho mauri.
english: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall + 16:11 or, male * among his relatives or his friends.

motu: Taunabunai, Simiri ese Baasa ena iduhu idoinai e habuaia tari, Iehova ese ena peroveta tauna Iehu uduna amo Baasa latanai e gwauraia herevana heḡereḡerena;
english: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

motu: Baasa bona natuna Elaha edia kara dika daidiai, bona idia raruosi ese Israel besena e hakaraia dika dainai, bona edia kaivakuku amo Iehova, Israel Diravana, e habadua dainai.
english: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

motu: Elaha ena kara orena, ede ede e kara tomava, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani? King Simiri
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena laḡani iharuahui-hituna ai, Simiri na dina hitu Tirisa ai e lohia. Una negana ai tuari taudia na Gibeton, Filistia taudia edia hanua ta, ituari-henina ela, e koua heḡeḡe.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

motu: Tuari oreana na edia taruha ai harina e kamonai, Simiri ese hanua pavapavana ihadikana dalana e tahua, bona vada e alaia mase. Taunabunai, una dina ai Israel idoinai ese Omri, tuari oreana biaguna, e abia, Israel pavapavana ai e halaoa, taruha ai.
english: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

motu: Taunabunai, hari Omri na Gibeton amo e dae ela, bona Israel idoinai ia ida; bena Tirisa e koua heḡeḡe.
english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

motu: Simiri ese e itaia, idia ese hanua vada e abia, bena ia ese hanua pavapavana ena ruma laloma daiutuna e haginia tutuka ḡauna lalonai e raka vareai, bena ia sibona daenai e doua, bena e mase.
english: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

motu: Una na ena kara dika daidiai, Iehova vairanai e kara havara bona Ieroboam ena dala ai e raka, kara dika e karava bona Israel danu e hakaraia dikava, daidiai.
english: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

motu: Simiri ena kara orena, bona ena hahedika karana, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani? King Omri
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

motu: Bena Israel taudia na haheparara; kahana na Tibni Ginata murinai e raka, hanua pavapavana ai bae halaoa eto; ma kahana na Omri murina amo e raka.
english: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

motu: A Omri murinai e raka taudia ese Tibni murinai e raka taudia na e hadareredia. Taunabunai, Tibni e mase, bona Omri na pavapava ai ela.
english: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena laḡani ihatoiahui-tana ai, Omri ese Israel e lohiaia matama; ena lohia laḡanidia na gwauta-rua. Laḡani tauratoi ia ese Tirisa ai e nohova.
english: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.

motu: Bena ia ese Samaria ororona na Semere ena amo e hoia; davana na silver talent * rua. + 16:24 Silver talent rua: reana K1600 heḡereḡerena, ita eda moni ai. * Bena ia ese maḡuna e karaia, bona hanua e hadaia, ladana e hatoa Samaria, ororo biaguna Semere inemaina.
english: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents + 16:24 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds. * of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

motu: Omri na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, e gunalaia taudia iboudiai edia kara havara ia ese e hereadia.
english: Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

motu: Badina be ia ese Ieroboam Nebata ena dala ai e rakava, bona kara dika ai, ia ese Israel taudia e hakaradia dikava, Iehova, Israel Diravana, e habadua, edia kaivakuku daidiai.
english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

motu: Omri ena kara orena, bona ena siahu e hahedinaraia, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

motu: Bena Omri na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta, Samaria ai e guria; bona natuna Ahaba ese ia gabuna ai e lohia. King Ahaba
english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

motu: Asa, Iuda pavapavana, ena laḡani ihatoiahui-taurahanina ai, Ahaba Omri ese Israel e lohiaia matama. Ahaba Omri ese laḡani ruahui-rua Israel e lohiaia, Samaria ai.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

motu: Ahaba Omri na Iehova vairanai e kara havara; e gunalaia taudia iboudiai na ia ese e hereadia.
english: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight above all that were before him.

motu: Ia na e laloa Ieroboam Nebata ena kara dika daladia ai baine raka na ḡau pipikina; una dainai ia ese lesebel, Etebaal, Sidono pavapavana, natuna hahinena, e adavaia; bona ela, Baal isiaina e lao heniava bona e toma henia dihova danu.
english: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

motu: Ia ese Baal ena dubu auta e haginia, Samaria ai; lalonai Baal ena ihaboulaina patana ta danu e larebaia.
english: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

motu: Ahaba danu au-tubua helaḡana ta e haginia. Ahaba ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, e habadua herea, e gunalaia taudia Israel pavapavadia iboudiai na ia ese e hereadia.
english: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

motu: Iena nega ai Hiele, tau Betele, ese Ieriko e hadaia; ruma badidia e haginidia davana na natuna roboana Abiram, bona ikoukou e haginidia davana na natuna tau-muritai Segubu, Iehova ena hereva Iosua Nunu uduna amo e gwauraia heḡereḡerena. + 16:34 Iosua, Karoa 6, siri 26, ba itaia. *
english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

motu: Elia, tau Tisbe, Gilead ai e nohova tauna ta, ese Ahaba e hereva henia, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, vairanai na ginimu Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena, hunu bona medu basie diho ini laḡani lalodiai, a lauegu hereva dainai mo bae diho.
english: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na ienai e kau, eto,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

motu: Ini amo a raka oho, mairiveina kahana baola, sinavai maraḡina ladana Keriti isena ai ba komu; una na Ioridane mairiveina kahana ai.
english: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

motu: Sinavai ranuna do ba inua; bona galo vada na haḡanidia, idia ese bae ubumu unuseni ai.
english: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia na ela, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena e kara, sinavai maraḡina Keriti isena ai e nohova, Ioridane mairiveina kahana ai.
english: So he went and did according to Yahweh’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.

motu: Daba ai, galo ese ana aniani bona vamu e mailaiva, bona adorahi ai danu ana aniani bona vamu e mailaiva; sinavai ranuna danu e inuva.
english: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.

motu: A nega taina vada ela, bena sinavai maraḡina e kororo, badina be medu na se dihova una tano ai. Elia na Sarepata ai
english: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na ienai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

motu: A tore isi, Sarefata, Sidono kahana hanuana ta, baola, unuseni ai ba noho. A itaia, lau ese vabu ta unuseni ai vada na hagania, baine ubumu.
english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia na e tore isi, Sarefata ela; hanua ikoukouna badinai e kau, bena vabu ta e itaia, rakuraku audia e gogova. Bena e boi henia, eto, Ranu kuri ta a mailaia, aina inua.
english: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

motu: Baine mailaia eto, bena ma e boi henia, eto, Aniani taina imamu ai a mailaia.
english: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”

motu: A hahine na eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, e maurimu heḡereḡerena, asi egu aniani maedana; flaoa sina taina mo tohe ai, bona dehoro taina kavabu ai. Harihari rakuraku audia siri rua na gogomu, bainala, aniani baina nadua, lau bona natugu merona amai; baia ania, bena vada baia mase.
english: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”

motu: Bena Elia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Asio gari; aola, emu hereva heḡereḡerena ba karaia. To guna dikea ta ba gabua, lauagu ba mailaia; una murinai oi bona natumu amui ba gabu.
english: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.

motu: Badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: flaoa tohena na anina basine ore, bona dehoro kavabuna na basine kaurakaura, ela bona Iehova ese medu na tanobada ai baine hadihoa dinana baine kau.
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.’”

motu: Bena hahine na ela, Elia ena hereva heḡereḡerena e karaia; bena ia bona Elia bona hari hahine ena ruma taudia na dina hoho e anianiva.
english: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

motu: Flaoa tohena na anina se ore, bona dehoro kavabuna na se kaurakaura, Iehova ena hereva Elia uduna amo e gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
english: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.

motu: Una murinai, hari ruma biaguna hahinena natuna e gorerea; mero ena gorere e bada e laova, ela bona laḡana e ore.
english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

motu: Bena hahine ese Elia e hamaoroa, eto, Dirava ena tau e, dahaka egu ai o karamu? Egu kara dika ihelalolaina bona natugu ihamasena totodia vada oma.
english: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”

motu: Elia ese e hereva henia, eto, Natumu a henigu. Bena ia ese hahine kemena amo e abia, e rosia lao, ela bona atai daiutuna, ena hekure gabuna; bena ena mahuta ḡauna ai e kurea.
english: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

motu: Bena ia ese Iehova e boi henia, eto, Iehova, egu Dirava e, oi ese hari vabu, dekenai na nohomu hahinena, latanai hahedika vada o hadihoa, natuna vada o alaia mase, a?
english: He cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”

motu: Bena nega toi ia ese hari mero latanai e goru kau, bona Iehova e tai henia, eto, Iehova, egu Dirava e, ina mero laumana na ba henia lou.
english: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Elia gadona e kamonai; bena hari mero laumana na e lou, bena e mauri lou.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

motu: Bena Elia ese mero e abia, atai daiutuna amo e diholaia ruma ai, bena sinana e henia. Elia eto, A itaia, natumu vada eme mauri.
english: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”

motu: Hahine ese Elia e hamaoroa, eto, Harihari name diba oi na Dirava ena tau, bona Iehova ena hereva oi udumu ai na momokani.
english: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”

motu: Dina hoho vada ela, bena laḡani ihatoina ai Iehova ena hereva na Elia enai e kau, eto, Aola, Ahaba enai ba hedinarai, bena medu na tanobada ai baina hadihoa.
english: After many days, Yahweh’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”

motu: Taunabunai Elia na ela, Ahaba enai baine hedinarai totona. Una negana ai doe na bada herea Samaria ai.
english: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

motu: Bena Ahaba ese Obadia e boiria; ia na ruma biaguna tauna. (Hari Obadia ese Iehova e matauraia bada;
english: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Yahweh greatly;
