motu: bona Iesebel ese Iehova ena peroveta taudia e aladiava negana ai na Obadia ese peroveta taudia sinahu-ta e abidia, imahui imahui amo kohua ai e hunidia, bona aniani bona ranu e henidia.)
english: for when Jezebel cut off Yahweh’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

motu: Ahaba ese Obadia e hamaoroa, eto, Tano ba rakaia hanai, ranu gabudia iboudiai bona koura iboudiai ba itadia; readia rei taina baita davaria, bena hosi bona doniki baita hamauridia, bona mauri ḡaudia haida na basie mase.
english: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”

motu: Taunabunai raruosi na tano e hapararaia, bae rakaia hanai totona; Ahaba sibona kaha ta ela, ma Obadia sibona kaha ta ela.
english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

motu: Obadia na dala ai e rakava ai na Elia ese e davaria. Bena Obadia na dibana ia, bena e goru diho, eto, Elia e, egu lohia, ena oi a?
english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

motu: Ia ese e haere henia, eto, Lau binai. Aola, biagumu ba hamaoroa, baoto “A itaia, Elia na iniseni ai”.
english: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

motu: Obadia eto, Egu dika be dahaka, bena emu hesiai tauna na Ahaba imana ai bavatogu, baine alagu totona a?
english: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, e maurimu heḡereḡerena, egu lohia ese bese ta eiava basileia ta enai oi itahumu ai se hakwabua; bona idia bema toma “Ia na dia iniseni ai” negana ai, ia na una basileia eiava una bese edia amo hereva aukadia bema abi, idia ese asie davarimu.
english: As Yahweh your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

motu: Harihari, oi na o tomu “Aola, biagumu ba hamaoroa, baoto: Elia na iniseni ai”.
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’

motu: Matona, emu amo baina raka oho, Iehova ena Lauma na maoromaoro baine abimu, asi dibagu gabuna baine laohaimu; bena Ahaba baina hamaoroa bona ia basine davarimu negana ai, ia ese lau baine alagu mase; ena be lau na oiemu hesiai tauna bona merogu negana amo Iehova vada na matauraia.
english: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that Yahweh’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared Yahweh from my youth.

motu: Ta ese egu lohia vada e hamaoromu a, lau ede na kara toma, Iesebel ese Iehova ena peroveta taudia e aladia mase negana ai? Iehova ena peroveta taudia sinahu-ta na abidia, imahui imahui amo kohua ai na hunidia, bona aniani bona ranu na henidia.
english: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed Yahweh’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of Yahweh’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

motu: A harihari oi na o tomu “Aola, biagumu ba hamaoroa, baoto ‘Elia na iniseni ai’”; bena ia ese baine alagu mase.
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

motu: Elia eto, Iehova Sabaota, vairanai na ginimu Diravana, e maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau na momokani ia vairanai baina hedinarai, hari ina dina ai.
english: Elijah said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”

motu: Taunabunai, Obadia na Ahaba ihedavari-henina ela, e hamaoroa; bena Ahaba na Elia ihedavari-henina ela.
english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

motu: Ahaba ese Elia e itaia. Bena Ahaba ese e hereva henia, eto, Israel iharaivana taumu, ena oi a?
english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

motu: Ia ese e haere, eto, Lau ese Israel asina haraivaia; a oi hari, oi bona tamamu ena iduhu ese. Badina be Iehova ena haheḡani vada o rakatanidia, bona Baal muridiai vada o raka.
english: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken Yahweh’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.

motu: Taunabunai, harihari a hesiai, Israel taudia iboudiai lau dekegu ai ba haboudia, Karamele ororona ai, bona Baal ena peroveta taudia sinahu-hani imahui bona Asera ena peroveta taudia sinahu hani, Iesebel ena pata ai e anianimu taudia. Karamele ororona ai
english: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ahaba ese Israel taudia iboudiai e boiridia, bona peroveta taudia e haboudia, Karamele ororona ai.
english: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

motu: Bena Elia ese taunimanima iboudiai e raka henidia kahi, e hereva henidia, eto, Lalo rua ai ba raka ege raka ege ela bona edena nega? Bema Iehova na Dirava, ia murina ai ba raka; a bema Baal, ia murina amo ba raka. Bena taunimanima na hereva ta ai asie haere henia.
english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * didn’t say|strong="H1697" * a|strong="H3068" * word|strong="H1697" *.

motu: Bena Elia ese taunimanima na e hamaorodia, eto, Lau na Iehova ena peroveta tauna, lau mo sibogu noho, a Baal ena peroveta taudia na sinahuhani imahui.
english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of Yahweh; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

motu: Boromakau mamaruanedia rua ba henimai; bena idia ese ta bae abia hidi, bae ivaia sisi, au rakuraku latanai bae atoa kau, a lahi basie karaia. A lau be boromakau maruanena iharuana do baina heḡaeḡaelaia, au rakuraku latanai baina atoa, a lahi basina karaia.
english: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

motu: Bena umui ese emui dirava ladana ba hahanea, a lau ese Iehova ladana baina hahanea; bena edena dirava na lahi amo baine haere, ia hari Dirava. Taunimanima iboudiai na e haere, eto, Hereva namona bunai.
english: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on Yahweh’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * answered|strong="H6030" *, “ What|strong="H1697" * you|strong="H3605" * say|strong="H1697" * is|strong="H3068" * good|strong="H2896" *.”

motu: Bena Elia ese Baal ena peroveta taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui ba guna. Boromakau maruanena ta bavabia hidi, ba heḡaeḡaelaia; badina be umui na hutuma. Bena emui dirava ladana ba hahanea; a lahi basio karaia.
english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

motu: Bena e henidia boromakauna maruanena na idia ese e abia, e heḡaeḡaelaia; bena Baal ladana e hahanea, daba amo ela bona dina tubua eto, Baal e, a haere henimai. A asi gado ta, bona ta se haere. Bena ihaboulaina patana e raka ege raka egea heḡeḡe.
english: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

motu: Dina tubua ai Elia ese e hevaseha henidia, eto, A lolo badabada, badina be ia na dirava ta; reana e helalomu, eiava vada e hamurimuri, eiava vada eha laolao; eiava reana e mahutamu bena vada ba haoa.
english: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”

motu: Bena idia na e lolo badabada, bona vaia edia kara dare bona io amo sibodia e heivava, ela bona raradia e aru lohilohiva.
english: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

motu: Dina tubua amo ma e lolo, ela bona boubou ḡaudia ihahelaḡadia negana e kau; a asi gado ta; ta se haere, bona ta se kamonai.
english: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

motu: Bena Elia ese taunimanima iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto, Dekegu a raka kahi mai. Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese e raka henia kahi. Bena ia ese Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana, vada e hegiḡi dobi ḡauna, ma e larebaia lou.
english: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired Yahweh’s altar that had been thrown down.

motu: Elia ese nadi gwauta-rua e abidia, Iakob natuna edia iduhu ihaheḡereḡeredia. (Una na Iehova ena hereva ienai e kau, eto. “Oi ladamu bae hatoa Israel”, tauna.)
english: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom Yahweh’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

motu: Unu nadi amo ia ese ihaboulaina patana e larebaia, Iehova ladana ai; bena dadaira ta e ḡeia heḡeḡe, ena bada na hadohado nadinadidia bosea rua bema hahonua na heto.
english: With the stones he built an altar in Yahweh’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs + 18:32 1 seah is about 7 liters or 1.9 gallons or 0.8 pecks * of seed.

motu: Au rakuraku e lae heḡaeḡae, bena boromakau maruanena na e ivaia sisi, au latadiai e atoa kau. Bena eto, Hodu auhani ranu amo ba hahonudia, gole-oho boubouna ḡauna latanai ba seia, bona au latadiai danu.
english: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

motu: Ma eto, A haruaia; bena nega iharuana e karaia. Ma eto, Ma a hatoia; bena nega ihatoina ma e karaia.
english: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

motu: Bena ranu ese ihaboulaina patana e arua heḡeḡe, bona dadaira na e utua dae.
english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

motu: Boubou ḡaudia ihahelaḡadia negana e kau. Bena peroveta tauna Elia na e raka kahira, eto, Iehova e, Abraham bona Isaak bona Israel edia Dirava, hari dirla ai baine hedinarai oi na Israel Diravana, bona lau na emu hesiai tauna, bona ini ḡau iboudiai na oiemu hereva dainai vada na kara.
english: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

motu: A haere henigu, Iehova e, a haere henigu; bena ina bese taudia na bae diba oi Iehova na Dirava, bona oi ese lalodia vada o haloudia.
english: Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena lahi e moru dobi, hari ḡole-oho boubouna ḡauna e haḡolea oho, bona au, bona nadi, bona ḡahu; bona dadaira ranuna danu e hakaukaua.
english: Then Yahweh’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai ese e itaia, bena idia na e goru goru diho, eto, Iehova, ia na Dirava; Iehova, ia na Dirava.
english: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “Yahweh, he is God! Yahweh, he is God!”

motu: Bena Elia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Baal ena peroveta taudia a dabaidia tao, ta basine roho mauri. E dabaidia tao; bena Elia ese e laohaidia, sinavai maraḡina ladana Kison badibadinai e aladia mase.
english: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They|strong="H1992" * seized|strong="H8610" * them|strong="H1992" *; and|strong="H8033" * Elijah brought|strong="H3381" * them|strong="H1992" * down|strong="H3381" * to|strong="H3381" * the|strong="H7819" * brook|strong="H5158" * Kishon|strong="H7028" *, and|strong="H8033" * killed|strong="H7819" * them|strong="H1992" * there|strong="H8033" *.

motu: Bena Elia ese Ahaba e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, bavaniani, ba inuinu; badina be medu guruna na e maimu.
english: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

motu: Taunabunai Ahaba na ela, baine aniani bona baine inuinu totona. A Elia na Karamele dorina e dae ela; bena tano ai e igo diho, vairana na tuina padadiai e atoa.
english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

motu: Bena ia ese ena hesiai tauna e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, davara kahana ba raraia. Ia na ela, e roha lao, eto, Ḡau ta lasi. Ma eto, A lou lao nega hitu.
english: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He|strong="H7725" * went|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" * and|strong="H7725" * looked|strong="H5027" *, then|strong="H7725" * said, “ There|strong="H5927" * is|strong="H1870" * nothing|strong="H3972" *.” He|strong="H7725" * said, “ Go|strong="H5927" * again|strong="H7725" *” seven|strong="H7651" * times|strong="H6471" *.

motu: Nega ihahituna ai, ia na eto, A itaia, ori maraḡina ta, tau ta imana na heto, davara amo e daemu. Bena Elia eto, Aola, Ahaba ba hamaoroa, baoto “Emu kariota bavabia heḡaegae, ba diho baola, medu ese baine laomu ahu na garina”.
english: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He|strong="H3808" * said, “ Go|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" *, tell Ahab, ‘ Get|strong="H5927" * ready and|strong="H3381" * go|strong="H5927" * down|strong="H3381" *, so|strong="H1961" * that|strong="H3808" * the|strong="H5927" * rain|strong="H1653" * doesn’t stop|strong="H3808" * you|strong="H3808" *.’”

motu: Nega sisina taina ela, bena guba e dubaia ahu, mai orina mai laina ida, bona medu na bada herea. A Ahaba na e gui, Iesrele ela.
english: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

motu: Bena Iehova imana na Elia latanai; bena ena rami e hekasilaia bona Ahaba vairanai e heau, ela bona Iesrele ikoukouna.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

motu: Ahaba ese Elia ena kara iboudiai na Iesebel e hamaorolaia, bona peroveta taudia iboudiai dare amo e aladia mase sivaraina danu.
english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

motu: Bena Iesebel ese gwaukau tauna ta Elia dekena e siaia lao, eto, Kerukeru hora inihetomana do basine kau ai oiemu mauri na idia ta ena mauri ida basinama haheḡereḡerea, dirava ese davagu bae henigu, bona ma bae habadaia danu.
english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”

motu: Bena Elia na e gari, e tore isi, e heau, maurina e tahua; bena Beresieba ai, Iuda tanona ai, e kau. Ena hesiai tauna na unuseni ai e rakatania.
english: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

motu: Bena ia na sibona tano gaḡaena ai ela, dina ta laolaona heḡereḡerena; bena roteme + 19:4 “Roteme” na au ta ladana, Heberu gado ai. * auna ta henunai e helai diho. Bena e noinoi baine mase; eto, Vadaeni, Iehova e, egu mauri avabia oho; badina be senegu asina hereadiamu.
english: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O Yahweh, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

motu: Bena e hekure diho, roteme auna henunai e mahuta; bena aneru ta ese e daua toho, e hereva henia, eto, A tore isi, avaniani.
english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

motu: Bena e itaia, ia kwarana badibadinai na dikea igabuna ta, nadi siahu amo e guraia ḡauna, bona ranu hodu ta. E aniani, ranu e inua, bena ma e hekure lou.
english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru na nega iharuana ema, e daua toho, eto, A tore isi, bavaniani, hari be laolao na be bada hereamu oiemu ai na garina.
english: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

motu: Bena ia na e tore isi, e aniani, bona ranu e inua; bena una aniani goadana ai dina hari-ahui boi hari-ahui e laolaova, ela bona Dirava ena ororo, ladana Horeb, ai e kau.
english: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

motu: Unuseni ai ia na kohua ta ai e raka vareai, e noho. Bena Iehova ena hereva na ienai e kau, eto, Elia e, dahaka o karamu iniseni ai?
english: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

motu: Elia eto, Lau na Iehova Sabaota dainai na vaḡeḡe hereamu; badina be Israel taudia ese emu taravatu vada e rakatania, emu ihaboulaina patadia vada e ḡiḡidia dobi, emu peroveta taudia na dare amo vada e aladia mase; ema bona lau mo sibogu na nohomu, bona lau danu egu maun e tahuamu, bae abia oho e tomamu.
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

motu: Iehova eto, A raka lasi, ororo ai ba gini Iehova vairanai. Bena Iehova na e raka hanai; lai badana mai goadana ida ese ororo e hapararadia bona nadi e hamakohidia rohoroho Iehova vairanai. A Iehova na dia una lai lalonai. Lai murinai tano e laga; a Iehova na dia tano-laga lalonai.
english: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.” Behold|strong="H2009" *, Yahweh|strong="H3068" * passed|strong="H5674" * by|strong="H5674" *, and|strong="H3068" * a|strong="H3068" * great|strong="H1419" * and|strong="H3068" * strong|strong="H2389" * wind|strong="H7307" * tore|strong="H7665" * the|strong="H6440" * mountains|strong="H2022" * and|strong="H3068" * broke|strong="H7665" * in|strong="H3068" * pieces|strong="H7665" * the|strong="H6440" * rocks|strong="H5553" * before|strong="H6440" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *; but|strong="H3808" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * was|strong="H3068" * not|strong="H3808" * in|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H6440" * wind|strong="H7307" *. After|strong="H3318" * the|strong="H6440" * wind|strong="H7307" * there|strong="H2009" * was|strong="H3068" * an|strong="H6440" * earthquake|strong="H7494" *; but|strong="H3808" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * was|strong="H3068" * not|strong="H3808" * in|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H6440" * earthquake|strong="H7494" *.

motu: Tano-laga murinai na lahi; a Iehova na dia lahi lalonai. Lahi murinai na ere maimu-maimuna ta.
english: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

motu: Elia e kamonai, bena vairana na ena dabua amo e ḡovaia ahu, bena e raka lasi, kohua iduarana ai e gini. Bena ere ta ienai e kau, eto, Elia e, oi dahaka o karamu iniseni ai?
english: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

motu: Ia na eto, Lau na vaḡeḡe herea, Dirava, Iehova Sabaota dainai; badina be Israel taudia ese oiemu taravatu vada e rakatania, emu ihaboulaina patadia danu vada e ḡigidia dobi, emu peroveta taudia na dare amo vada e aladia mase; bona lau mo sibogu na nohomu. Bena lauegu mauri e tahuamu, bae abia oho e tomamu.
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, emu dala ai ba lou lao ela bona Damasko tano-ḡaḡaena. Ba kau negana ai, Hasaele ba horoa, Suria pavapavana;
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

motu: bona lehu Nimisi ba horoa, Israel pavapavana; bona Elisaia, Safata tau Abel-mehola natuna, ba horoa, peroveta tauna ai bainela, oi ibolomu.
english: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

motu: Bena Hasaele ena dare amo baine roho mauri tauna na lehu ese baine alaia mase, bona Iehu ena dare amo baine roho mauri tauna na Elisaia ese baine alaia mase.
english: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

motu: Ḡau tamona, taunimanima daha hitu do baina hamauridia Israel ai, tuidia asie hadai Baal vauranai asie igo diho bona ududia amo asie harahua taudia iboudiai. Elia ese Elisaia e boiria
english: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

motu: Unu amo e raka oho, bena ia ese Elisaia Safata e davaria; tauna na tano e ruaiava, boromakau mamaruanedia ruahui-hani na rua rua amo ia vairanai e rakava, a ia be gabe ḡaudia ruaosi badidiai. Elia na ia badina amo e raka hanai, bona ena hahedoki na ia latanai e tahoa kau.
english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

motu: Bena Elisaia ese boromakau e rakatanidia, Elia murina amo e heau, eto, Tamagu bona sinagu aina harahudia, bena oi baina ḡavamu. A Elia ese e hamaoroa, eto, A lou lao; dahaka emu ai na kara?
english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He|strong="H3588" * said to|strong="H7725" * him|strong="H6213" *, “ Go|strong="H3212" * back|strong="H7725" * again|strong="H7725" *; for|strong="H3588" * what|strong="H4100" * have|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * done|strong="H6213" * to|strong="H7725" * you|strong="H3588" *?”

motu: Bena ia iḡavana amo e lou lao, boromakau mamaruanedia e abidia, e aladia mase, hidiodia na maduna audia amo e nadudia, bena taunmanima e henidia, e ani. Bena ia na e tore isi, Elia murina amo ela, ia isiaina e lao heni.
english: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.

motu: Ben-hadad, Suria pavapavana, ese ena tuari oreana idoinai e haboua; pavapava toiahui-rua na ia ida, bona hosi, bona kariota. Bena ia na ela, Samaria e koua heḡeḡe bona e tuari henia.
english: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

motu: Bena ia ese gwaukau taudia haida e siaidia, hanua lalonai baela, Ahaba, Israel pavapavana, dekenai. Idia eto, Ben-hadad na ini e gwau tomamu:
english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,

motu: Emu silver * bona emu gold * na egu; adavamu hereadia bona natumu hereadia danu na egu.
english: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana na e haere, eto, Pavapava e, egu lohia, emu hereva na momokani; lau bona lauegu idoinai na oiemu.
english: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

motu: Gwaukau taudia ma ema, eto, Ben-hadad na ini e gwau tomamu: Emu ai na hesiai, nato “Emu silver * bona emu gold * na dekegu ba siaidia, adavamu bona natumu danu”;
english: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

motu: ḡau tamona, kerukeru, nega inihetomana, egu hesiai taudia baina siaidia vasi, bena emu ruma ai bona emu hesiai taudia edia ruma ai bae hetahu, lalodia bae ura ḡaudia iboudiai na imadia ai bae abi, bae laohai.
english: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese ena tano tau-badadia iboudiai e boiridia, eto, Mani a roharoha, ina tau ese e hahekwarahidamu toana a itaia; badina be e hesiai, egu ai adavagu bona natugu bona egu silver * bona egu gold * e gwaurai, bona asina rudia ienai.
english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”

motu: Bena tano tau-badadia bona taunimanima iboudiai ese e hamaoroa, eto, Basio laloa, bona basio gwau maoro.
english: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia ese Ben-hadad ena gwaukau taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Egu pavapava bona egu lohia ba hamaoroa, baoto “Emu hesiai tauna enai o gwaurai guna ḡaudia iboudiai na baina kara, a ina na basina karaia diba”. Gwaukau taudia na e raka oho, una hereva na e hamaorolaia.
english: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The|strong="H3605" * messengers|strong="H4397" * departed|strong="H3212" * and|strong="H7971" * brought|strong="H7725" * him|strong="H7971" * back|strong="H7725" * the|strong="H3605" * message|strong="H1697" *.

motu: Bena Ben-hadad ese hereva na ienai e siaia, eto, Egu dirava ese davana bae henigu, ma bae habadaia danu, bema murigu ai e rakamu taudia ese Samaria ḡahuna ima ta ta bae abi davana diba negana ai.
english: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

motu: Israel pavapavana ma e haere, eto, A hamaoroa; heagi herevadia na ena tuari dabuadia e hahedokilaimu tauna ese basine gwaurai, a e dokidia ohomu tauna ese hari.
english: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”

motu: Ben-hadad na pavapava haida ida kalaga ai e inuinuva ai na una gwaukau herevana na ienai e kau. Bena ia ese ena orea taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Emui tuari gabudia ai ba gini. Bena edia tuari gabudia ai eha gini, hanua ituari-henina totona.
english: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

motu: Bena peroveta tauna ta ese Ahaba, Israel pavapavana, e raka henia kahi, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hegogo badana vada o itaia a? A kamonai, hari dina ai lau ese oi imamu ai baina atoa; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Ahaba eto, Daidia edia amo? Ia eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Kaha ta ta lohiadia edia hesiai taudia edia amo. Ahaba ma eto, Daika ese tuari baine matamaia? Ia na e haere, eto, Oi.
english: Ahab said, “By whom?” He|strong="H3068" * said, “ Yahweh|strong="H3068" * says|strong="H3541" *, ‘ By|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3541" * young|strong="H5288" * men|strong="H5288" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3541" * princes|strong="H8269" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3541" * provinces|strong="H4082" *.’” Then|strong="H3068" * he|strong="H3068" * said, “ Who|strong="H4310" * shall|strong="H3068" * begin the|strong="H3541" * battle|strong="H4421" *?” He|strong="H3068" * answered, “ You|strong="H4310" *.”

motu: Bena Ahaba ese kaha ta ta lohiadia edia hesiai taudia e haboudia, idia na sinahu-rua toi-ahui rua; una murinai ia ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, idia na daha hitu.
english: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

motu: Dina tubua ai, idia na e raka lasi. Una negana ai Ben-hadad na kalaga ai vada e inuinu kekero, ia bona iduruna taudia pavapava toi-ahui rua danu.
english: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

motu: Kaha ta ta lohiadia edia hesiai taudia na e raka lasi guna. Bena Ben-hadad ese kito taudia e siaidia lao; bena idia na hari e piu henia, eto, Taunimanima na Samaria amo e didi lasimu.
english: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

motu: Ia eto, Bema maino ai e maimu, bavabidia mauri, eiava bema tuari totona e maimu danu bavabidia mauri.
english: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

motu: Taunabunai, kaha ta ta lohiadia edia hesiai taudia na e raka lasi guna; bena tuari oreana idoinai na idia muridiai e raka.
english: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

motu: Bena ta ta ana daḡae ana daḡae e aladia mase. Bena Suria taudia na e heau, bona Israel taudia ese e hahavadia. A Ben-hadad, Suria pavapavana, na hosi ai e heau, hosi-gui taudia ida.
english: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana na e raka lasi, hosi bona kariota e abidia. Ia ese Suria taudia e aladia mase; ala-ala na bada herea.
english: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.

motu: Bena peroveta tauna ese Israel pavapavana e raka henia kahi, eto, Benaini, ba hahegoada, ba haeroa namonamo, dahaka ba karaia; badina be keru negana baine ore, Suria pavapavana ese ma baine tuari henimu lou.
english: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”

motu: Bena Suria pavapavana ena hesiai taudia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Edia dirava na ororo diravadia, una dainai idia ese e hadarereda; a taora ai baitama tuari henidia ita ese baita hadareredia.
english: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.

motu: Ini ba kara toma: pavapava bavabidia oho, ta ta ena orea ena orea amo, bona tuari biagudia na idia gabudia ai bavatodia;
english: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

motu: bena tuari oreana ta ma ba haboua, vada o haboioa ḡauna heḡereḡerena, hosi ta hosi ta gabuna ai, kariota ta kariota ta gabuna ai; bena taora ai baita tuari henidia, bona baita hadareredia. Bena ia ese edia hereva e kamonai, bona unu e kara toma.
english: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He|strong="H3651" * listened|strong="H8085" * to|strong="H6213" * their|strong="H8085" * voice|strong="H6963" * and|strong="H6963" * did|strong="H6213" * so|strong="H3651" *.

motu: Keru negana e ore ai, Ben-hadad ese Suria taudia e haboudia, bena Afek ela, Israel bae tuari henidia totona.
english: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

motu: Israel taudia na e haboudia, lakwa e henidia, bena Suria taudia ituari-henidia ela. Israel taudia na idia vairadiai e taruha, nani seri maraḡidia rua na heheto, a Suria taudia ese tano e hahonuava.
english: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

motu: Bena Dirava ena tau ta e raka kahira, Israel pavapavana e hereva henia, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Suria taudia eto “Iehova na ororo diravana, a dia koura diravana”, una dainai lau ese ina orea bada-hereana idoinai na imamu ai baina atoa; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “Yahweh is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Bena edia taruha ai e hetalai heheni dina hitu lalodiai; dina ihahituna ai e tuari matama. Bena Israel taudia ese Suria taudia na e rahudia mamase, una dina tamona ai tuari ae-raka taudia na domaga ta + 20:29 Domaga ta = 100,000. * e aladia mase.
english: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

motu: Oredia na Afek hanuana lalonai e heau vareai, bena hanua maḡuna ese idia gerebu-rua daha-hitu + 20:30 Gerebu-rua daha-hitu = 27,000. * e kohudia tao. Ben-hadad danu e heau, bena hanua rumana ta lalonai laloma daiutuna ai e vareai.
english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.

motu: Bena ena hesiai taudia ese e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai; ai na vada a kamonai, Israel pavapavadia na mai edia hebogahisi; ai mani puse dabuadia baia riodia, bona kwaramai ai kwanau baia ato; bena baia raka lasi, Israel pavapavana dekena baiala, reana emu mauri baine rauaia.
english: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese puse dabuadia e riodia, bona kwaradia ai kwanau e ato; bena Israel pavapavana dekena ela, eto, Emu hesiai tauna Ben-hadad na e tomu “Mani emu kara ba rauagu”. Ia eto, Ia na dounu e maurimu a? Ia na tadigu.
english: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He|strong="H1931" * said, “ Is|strong="H1931" * he|strong="H1931" * still|strong="H5750" * alive|strong="H2416" *? He|strong="H1931" * is|strong="H1931" * my|strong="H5650" * brother.”

motu: Unu tatau ese toana e nariava ela bona e itaia davari, bena nega tamona eto, Oibe, tadimu Ben-hadad. Bena ia eto, Vada aola, a hakaua mai. Bena Ben-hadad na e raka lasi ia dekenai; bena ia ese ena kariota ai e hadaea kau.
english: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then|strong="H3318" * he|strong="H4480" * said|strong="H3318" *, “ Go|strong="H3318" *, bring|strong="H3318" * him|strong="H5921" *.” Then|strong="H3318" * Ben Hadad came|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" * to|strong="H3318" * him|strong="H5921" *; and|strong="H5927" * he|strong="H4480" * caused him|strong="H5921" * to|strong="H3318" * come|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" * into|strong="H5927" * the|strong="H5921" * chariot|strong="H4818" *.

motu: Bena Ben-hadad ese e hamaoroa, eto, Tamagu ese tamamu ena amo e abi oho hanuadia na lau ese ma baina henimu lou, bona emu hoihoi gabudia danu ba kara Damasko ai, tamagu ese Samaria ai e kara heḡereḡerena. Bena Ahaba eto, Unu bema heto, baina kahumu nege. Bena raruosi e hegwau hamata heheni; bena ia ese e kahua nege.
english: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “ I|strong="H7760" *”, said Ahab, “ will|strong="H5892" * let|strong="H7971" * you|strong="H7971" * go|strong="H7971" * with|strong="H1285" * this|strong="H7725" * covenant|strong="H1285" *.” So|strong="H3947" * he|strong="H7971" * made|strong="H3772" * a|strong="H3068" * covenant|strong="H1285" * with|strong="H1285" * him|strong="H7971" * and|strong="H7971" * let|strong="H7971" * him|strong="H7971" * go|strong="H7971" *.

motu: Iehova ena haheḡani dainai, peroveta oreana tauna ta ese ia bamona ta e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara a botagu. A tauna na ibotana se ura.
english: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by Yahweh’s word, “Please strike me!” The|strong="H5221" * man|strong="H1121" * refused|strong="H3985" * to|strong="H3068" * strike|strong="H5221" * him|strong="H5221" *.

motu: Bena ia ese ma e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova gadona to kamonaia dainai, ba rakatanigu murinai maoromaoro leona ta ese baine alamu mase. E rakatania, bena maoromaoro leona ta ida e hedavari, bena leona ese e alaia mase.
english: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

motu: Bena ma tau ta e davaria, e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara a botagu. Hari tau ese e botaia; e rahua bona e haberoa.
english: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The|strong="H5221" * man struck|strong="H5221" * him|strong="H5221" * and|strong="H4994" * wounded|strong="H5221" * him|strong="H5221" *.

motu: Taunabunai, hari peroveta tauna na ela, dala isena ai hanua pavapavana e nariava, matana na bero ikumilaina dabuana ai e kumia, oromana e ha-idaua.
english: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana e raka hanai negana ai, ia ese hanua pavapavana e boi henia, eto, Emu hesiai tauna na tuari bogaragina nala; bena tuari tauna ta e lou, tau ta dekegu e mailaia, eto “Ina tau ba dogoa tao; bema baine boio, ena mauri idavalaina na oiemu mauri, eiava silver talent * ta ba heni”.
english: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent + 20:39 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds * of silver.’

motu: A emu hesiai tauna na unu ini ihekwarahilaidia ai, tauna na vada e heau. Israel pavapavana ese e haere henia, eto, Ihahemaoro-henimu na unu baine heto, sibomu ese o gwauraiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The|strong="H6213" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H4428" * Israel|strong="H3478" * said|strong="H3651" * to|strong="H3478" * him|strong="H6213" *, “ So|strong="H3651" * shall|strong="H3478" * your|strong="H6213" * judgment|strong="H4941" * be|strong="H1961" *. You|strong="H6213" * yourself|strong="H6213" * have|strong="H1961" * decided|strong="H2782" * it|strong="H1931" *.”

motu: Bena hari matana ikoulaina dabuana na e kokia oho haraḡa; bena Israel pavapavana ese toana e itaia ia na peroveta oreana tauna ta.
english: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

motu: Bena peroveta tauna ese e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau na revaia mase tauna na oi ese imamu amo o kahua nege, una dainai iena mauri idavalaina na oiemu mauri, bona iena bese idavalaina na oiemu bese.
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana na mai lalo-metauna bona mai baduna ida ena ruma e lou ela; bena Samaria ai e kau.
english: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

motu: Naboto, tau Iesrele, na mai ena vine imeana ta Iesrele ai, Ahaba, Samaria pavapavana, ena pavapava rumana badinai.
english: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

motu: Bena Atlaba ese Naboto e hereva henia, eto, Emu vine imeana a henigu, egu uma ai baina halaoa, ia na egu ruma badinai; bena lau ese vine imeana namo-hereana ta amo baina bodohilaia, eiava ba ura davana na moni baina henimu.
english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

motu: A Naboto ese Ahaba e haere henia, eto, Iehova na se uramu senegu edia amo na abia tanona na oi baina henimu.
english: Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

motu: Bena Ahaba na mai lalo-ḡaraḡarana bona mai baduna ida ena ruma ai e raka vareai, Naboto tau Iesrele ena hereva dainai; badina be ia na eto, Senegu edia amo na abia tanona na basina henimu. Bena ena mahuta ḡauna ai e hekure, vairana e hunia, bona se aniani.
english: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

motu: A adavana Iesebel na ia dekena ela, e nanadaia, eto, Badina be dahaka lalomu e hisihisimu bona so anianimu?
english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

motu: Bena ia ese e haere henia, eto, Badina be Naboto tau Iesrele na hereva henia, nato “Emu vine imeana a henigu moni davana, eiava ba ura lau ese vine imeana ta baina henimu, ia ibodohilaina”; bena ia na e haere, eto “Egu vine imeana basina henimu”.
english: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”

motu: Bena adavana Iesebel ese e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na harihari Israel o lohiaiamu a? A tore isi, bavaniani, lalomu na baine moale; lau ese Naboto tau Iesrele ena vine imeana baina henimu.
english: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

motu: Taunabunai, una hahine ese revareva haida e tore Ahaba ladana ai, bona ena toa amo e hamomokanidia; bena ia ese unu revareva na Naboto ena hanua tau-badadia bona lohiadia, ia ida e noho hebouva taudia, dekedia e siai lao.
english: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

motu: Revareva lalodiai ini e torea toma: Anivaga ba gwauraia, bona Naboto na atai ai ba hahelaia kau, taunimanima bogaragidiai;
english: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

motu: bona kara dibaka taudia rarua na ia vairanai bavatodia. Bena raruosi ese ia bae habadelaia, baeto “Oi na Dirava bona hanua pavapavana o uduguiraidia”. Bena ba hakaua lasi, nadi amo ba hodoa mase.
english: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”

motu: Bena ena hanua tau-badadia bona lohiadia, ia ida e noho hebouva taudia, ese Iesebel e siaia herevana heḡereḡerena e karaia. Dekediai e siai lao revarevadia ai e torea heḡereḡerena ai,
english: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

motu: idia ese anivaga e gwauraia, bona Naboto na atai ai e hahelaia, taunimanima bogaragidiai.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

motu: Bena kara dibaka taudia raruosi na e raka vareai, ia vairanai e helai; bena hari kara dibaka taudia ese Naboto e habadelaia, taunimanima vairadiai, eto, Naboto ese Dirava bona hanua pavapavana na e uduguiraidia. Taunabunai, idia ese hanua murimurinai e laohaia, nadi amo e hodoa mase.
english: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.

motu: Bena hereva na Iesebel dekena e siaia lao, eto, Naboto na nadi amo vada e hodoa, vada e mase.
english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

motu: Iesebel na e kamonai Naboto vada e hodoa mase, bena maoromaoro ia ese Ahaba e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, Naboto tau Iesrele ena vine imeana, e rua moni davana ai basine henimu eto ḡauna, na bavabia oiemu; badina be Naboto na dia mauri, ia na vada e mase.
english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

motu: Ahaba na Naboto ena mase harina e kamonai, bena maoromaoro e tore isi, Naboto tau Iesrele ena vine imeana baine lao henia, baine ḡaunaia eto.
english: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

motu: Una negana ai Iehova ena hereva na Elia, tau Tisbe, enai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

motu: A tore isi, aola, Ahaba, Israel pavapavana, ida ba hedavari. Ia na Samaria ai, Naboto ena vine irneana vada e lao henia, baine ḡaunaia totona.
english: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

motu: Ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Vada o ala-ala bona vada o ḡaunaia a? Ma ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Sisia ese Naboto rarana e demaria gabuna ai oi raramu danu bae demaria.
english: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”

motu: Ahaba ese Elia e hereva henia, eto, Inaigu e, vada o davarigu a? Elia ese e haere henia, eto, Vada na davarimu; badina be sibomu vada o hehoi, Iehova vairanai kara havara ba karaia totona.
english: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He|strong="H6213" * answered, “ I|strong="H3282" * have|strong="H3068" * found|strong="H4672" * you|strong="H6213" *, because|strong="H3282" * you|strong="H6213" * have|strong="H3068" * sold|strong="H4376" * yourself|strong="H6213" * to|strong="H3068" * do|strong="H6213" * that|strong="H3068" * which|strong="H3068" * is|strong="H3068" * evil|strong="H7451" * in|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *’s sight|strong="H5869" *.

motu: A kamonai, lau ese dika baina hadihoa latamu ai; baina negemu daure vaitani, Ahaba ena amo mamaruane iboudiai Israel ai, e ḡuidia taudia bona asie ḡuidia taudia, baina utudia oho.
english: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, + 21:21 or, male * and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

motu: Emu iduhu na Ieroboam Nebata ena iduhu bona Baasa Ahia ena iduhu heḡereḡeredia ai baina halaoa, badina be lau vada o habadugu, bona Israel vada o hakaraia dika.
english: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

motu: Iesebel danu Iehova ese e herevalaia, eto, Sisia ese Iesebel bae ania, Iesrele tano-hetoana lalonai.
english: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

motu: Ahaba ena iduhu tauna ta hanua ai bema mase, sisia ese bae ania; eiava ena iduhu tauna ta tano paka ai bema mase, atai manudia ese bae ania.
english: The dogs will eat whoever dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field.”

motu: Tau ta sibona se hehoi, Iehova vairanai kara havara ikarana totona, Ahaba heḡereḡerena; ia lalona na adavana Iesebel ese e ania.
english: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

motu: Kara dikahereadia danu e karava, dirava koikoidia igavadia ai, Amoro taudia, Iehova ese Israel taudia vairadiai e luludia lasi besena, e karava heḡereḡerena.
english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

motu: Ahaba ese unu hereva e kamonai, bena ia ese ena dabua e dare, puse dabuadia e dokilaidia, e anivagava, puse dabuadia ai e hekureva, bona mai lalo-metauna ida e loava.
english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Elia, tau Tisbe, enai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

motu: Ahaba vada o itaia, lau vairagu ai e hahemanaumu a? Lau vairagu ai e hahemanaumu dainai lau ese dika basina hadihoa iena nega ai, a natuna ena nega ai lau ese dika baina hadihoa, ena iduhu latanai.
english: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”

motu: Laḡani toi lalodiai Suria bona Israel na asie tuari.
english: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

motu: A laḡani ihatoina ai Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, na e diho ela, Israel pavapavana dekenai.
english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese ena hesiai taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Umui dibamui Ramoto-gilead na iseda, a ita na asi regereḡeda ta nohomu, Suria pavapavana imana amo asita abiamu, ani?
english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

motu: Bena ia ese Iehosafat e hereva henia, eto, Oi na lau ida aitala, Ramoto-gilead ai baita tuari, ani? Iehosafat ese Israel pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Lau oi na tamona, lauegu orea bona oiemu orea danu tamona, lauegu hosi bona oiemu hosi danu tamona.
english: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat|strong="H3092" * said to|strong="H3478" * the|strong="H3092" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H4428" * Israel|strong="H3478" *, “ I|strong="H3478" * am as|strong="H3644" * you|strong="H3644" * are|strong="H5971" *, my|strong="H3478" * people|strong="H5971" * as|strong="H3644" * your|strong="H3478" * people|strong="H5971" *, my|strong="H3478" * horses|strong="H5483" * as|strong="H3644" * your|strong="H3478" * horses|strong="H5483" *.”

motu: Bena Iehosafat ese Israel pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova ena hereva do ba tahua guna.
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese peroveta taudia e haboudia, tatau sinahu-hani sisivana; bena e nanadaidia, eto, Ramoto-gilead baina tuari henia eiava basina tuari henia? Idia na e haere, eto, Vada aola; badina be Ḡaubada ese hanua pavapavana imana ai baina atoa.
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They|strong="H5921" * said, “ Go|strong="H3212" * up|strong="H5927" *; for|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * Lord will|strong="H4428" * deliver|strong="H5414" * it|strong="H5414" * into|strong="H5927" * the|strong="H5921" * hand|strong="H3027" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H5921" * king|strong="H4428" *.”

motu: A Iehosafat eto, Iehova ena peroveta tauna ma ta dia noho iniseni ai, bena ia ma baitama nanadaia a?
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”

motu: Israel pavapavana ese Iehosafat e haere henia, eto, Tau ta do noho, iena amo Iehova ena hereva baitama tahua; ladana na Mikaia, Imla natuna. A lau ese na inai heniamu, badina be ia na nega ta ḡau namodia egu ai se perovetalai, a ḡau dikadia mo. A Iehosafat eto, Hanua pavapavana na unu basine gwau toma.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat|strong="H3092" * said|strong="H3651" *, “Don’t let|strong="H3808" * the|strong="H5921" * king|strong="H4428" * say|strong="H3478" * so|strong="H3651" *.”

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese ena heitatao tauna ta e boiria, eto, Mikaia Imla ba hakaua mai haraḡa.
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

motu: Una negana ai Israel pavapavana bona Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, na edia terono ai hehelai, edia pavapava dabuadia e kara, uit ikwadina gabuna ai, Samaria hanua ikoukouna ai; bona peroveta taudia iboudiai na idia vairadiai e peroveta.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

motu: Bena Sedekia Kenana ese ena auri doadia e kara, bona e hereva, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ini ḡau amo Suria taudia ba doridia lao, ela bona ba habuadia tari.
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

motu: Bona peroveta taudia iboudiai danu unu e peroveta toma; ma eto, Ramoto-gilead baola, ba kwalimu; Iehova ese hanua pavapavana imana ai baine atoa.
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

motu: Gwaukau tauna na Mikaia iboirina ela, bena e hamaoroa, eto, A kamonai: peroveta taudia edia hereva na vada e hatamonaia, hanua pavapavana ihanamona; oiemu hereva danu idia ta ena hereva ida baine heḡereḡere, hereva namona ba gwauraia.
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

motu: A Mikaia eto, Iehova na e maurimu heḡereḡerena, Iehova ede baine hereva henigu toma, una mo baina gwauraia.
english: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”

motu: Ia na hanua pavapavana dekenai e kau; bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Mikaia, ai ese Ramoto-gilead na baia tuari henia eiava basia tuari henia? Bena Mikaia ese e haere henia, eto, Aola, ba kwalimu; Iehova ese hanua pavapavana imana ai baine atoa.
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He|strong="H3068" * answered him|strong="H5414" *, “ Go|strong="H3212" * up|strong="H5927" * and|strong="H3068" * prosper|strong="H6743" *; and|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H3068" * deliver|strong="H5414" * it|strong="H5414" * into|strong="H5927" * the|strong="H5414" * hand|strong="H3027" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H5414" * king|strong="H4428" *.”

motu: A hanua pavapavana ese ma e hamaoroa, eto, Nega hida baina haduamu, Iehova ladana ai hereva ta basio gwaurai henigu, a hereva momokani mo?
english: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

motu: Bena Mikaia eto, Lau ese Israel idoinai na itadia, ororo ai e heau karoho, mamoe asi ireḡudia na heheto; bena Iehova eto, Ini na asi biagudia, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma aela, mai mainodia ida.
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

motu: Israel pavapavana ese Iehosafat e hamaoroa, eto, Na hamaoromu ani, ia na hereva namodia latagu ai basinema gwaurai, a hereva dikadia mo?
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

motu: Mikaia ma eto, Taunabunai, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai; Iehova na ena terono ai helaina ai na itaia, bona guba oreana idoinai ia badinai gigini, haida idibana kahana ai bona haida laurina kahana ai.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Daika ese Ahaba baine koia, bena bainela, Ramoto-gilead ai baine mase. Bena ta ese hereva ta e gwauraia, ma ta hereva ta.
english: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

motu: Bena lauma ta e raka lasi, Iehova vairanai e gini, eto, Lau ese baina koia.
english: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

motu: Iehova ese e nanadaia, eto, Edena dala amo? Ia eto, Bainala, koikoi laurnana ai baina hahelao, ena peroveta taudia iboudiai ududia ai. Iehova eto, Ba koia, emu koikoi baine kwalimu; aola, unu ba kara toma.
english: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’ He|strong="H3651" * said|strong="H3651" *, ‘ I|strong="H3651" * will|strong="H1961" * go|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" * and|strong="H6213" * will|strong="H1961" * be|strong="H1961" * a|strong="H3068" * lying|strong="H8267" * spirit|strong="H7307" * in|strong="H6213" * the|strong="H3605" * mouth|strong="H6310" * of|strong="H7307" * all|strong="H3605" * his|strong="H3605" * prophets|strong="H5030" *.’ He|strong="H3651" * said|strong="H3651" *, ‘ You|strong="H3605" * will|strong="H1961" * entice|strong="H6601" * him|strong="H6213" *, and|strong="H6213" * will|strong="H1961" * also|strong="H1571" * prevail|strong="H3201" *. Go|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" * and|strong="H6213" * do|strong="H6213" * so|strong="H3651" *.’

motu: Taunabunai, o kamonaimu, Iehova ese koikoi laumana na emu peroveta taudia iboudiai ududia ai vada e atoa; Iehova ese hereva dikana oi latamu ai vada e gwauraia.
english: Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

motu: Sedekia Kenana na e raka kahira, bena ia ese Mikaia na vahana ai e pataia, bona eto, Iehova Laumana na ede e rakatanigu toma oi ihereva-henimu totona a?
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

motu: Mikaia eto, Laloma daiutuna ai ba raka vareai, komu totona, dinana ai vada ba itaia.
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana eto, Mikaia ba dabaia tao, Amon, hanua lohiana, bona Ioasa, hanua pavapavana natuna, dekediai ba loulaia;
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

motu: baoto “Hanua pavapavana na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina tau na dibura rumana ai ba koua, flaoa kavakava bona ranu taidia mo ba henia, ela bona maino ai baina lou mai”.
english: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

motu: Bena Mikaia eto, Bema oi na maino ai ba lou mai, bena Iehova na lauegu amo vada se hereva. Ma eto, Taunimanima ibouboumui ai, a kamonai. Ahaba na tuan ai e mase
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel pavapavana bona Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, na Ramoto-Gilead ela.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

motu: Bena Israel pavapavana ese Iehosafat e hereva henia, eto, Lau ese ita-itagu baina ha-idaua, bainala tuari lalonai, a oi be emu pavapava dabuadia ba doki. Bena Israel pavapavana ese sibona ita-itana e ha-idaua, ela tuari lalonai.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

motu: Suria pavapavana ese ena kariota biagudia toi-ahui ruaosi vada e haḡanidia, eto, Taunimanima maraḡidia eiava badadia basio tuari henidia, a Israel pavapavana mo.
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

motu: Kariota biagudia ese Iehosafat e itaia, bena idia eto, Momokani, una na Israel pavapavana. Taunabunai, idia na e heau kerehai, ia bae heatu henia eto. A Iehosafat na e lolo.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

motu: Kariota biagudia ese e itaia, ia na dia Israel pavapavana, bena iḡavana amo e lou.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

motu: A tau ta ese diba ta e kinoa kava, Israel pavapavana ena auri dabuana bona ena keme aurina padadiai e taraki. Taunabunai ia ese ena kariota e heaulaiava tauna na e hamaoroa, eto, A haheaua hegiro, tuari murimurinai ba laohaigu, badina be vada na bero.
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

motu: Una dina ai tuari na auka herea. Israel pavapavana na ena kariota ai e doria tao, Suria taudia e vaira henidia ela bona ado e rahi, bena e mase; berona rarana na kariota reireina ai e aru dobi.
english: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

motu: Dina e diho, bena tuari oreana ai haida e lolo, eto, Ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ena tano ena tano baela.
english: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

motu: Hanua pavapavana na unu e mase toma, bena Samaria e laohaia. Hanua pavapavana na Samaria ai e guria.
english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

motu: A kariota na Samaria gohugohuna badinai e huria, bena sisia ese ia rarana e demaria, bona ariara hahinedia ese e digulaia, Iehova ese e gwauraia guna herevana heḡereḡerena.
english: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke.

motu: Ahaba ena kara orena, e kara karadia iboudiai bona ena aivori + 22:39 “Aivori” na ḡau aukana ta mai hairaina, elefant doadia amo e karaiamu. * rumana e haginia, bona e hadai hanuadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana lalonai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

motu: Taunabunai Ahaba na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; ia natuna Ahasia na ia gabuna ai e lohia. King Iehosafat
english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

motu: Ahaba, Israel pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina lalonai, Iehosafat, Asa natuna, ese Iuda e lohiaia matama.
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

motu: E lohiaia matama negana ai ena mauri laḡanidia na toi-ahui ima; bena Ierusalem ai e lohia, laḡani ruahui ima. Sinana ladana na Asuba Silihi.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

motu: la na tamana Asa ena dala idoinai lalonai e raka, una dala amo se raka siri; kara maoromaoro e karava Iehova vairanai. Ḡau tamona, atai gabudia helagadia na se kokidia oho; taunimanima na dounu edia boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadiava bona muramura mai bonana e gabuava unu atai gabudia ai.
english: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

motu: Iehosafat na Israel pavapavana ida danu e herohemaino.
english: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

motu: Iehosafat ena kara oredia, ena siahu ede e hahedinaraia toma bona ena tuari sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

motu: Ia ese danu enobou karadia helaḡadia e karava taudia oredia, tamana Asa ena nega ai dounu e nohova taudia, na e aladia ore.
english: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

motu: Una negana ai Edom na asi pavapavana; lohia ta ese pavapava ḡaukarana e karaiava.
english: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

motu: Bena Iehosafat ese Tarasisi lagatoidia haida e raidia, gold * iabina totona Ofiri baela eto; a asiela, badina be idia na Esiono-gebere ai e tata kau.
english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

motu: Bena Ahasia, Ahaba natuna, ese Iehosafat e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara lauegu hesiai taudia na lagatoi ai bae gui, oiemu hesiai taudia ida. A Iehosafat na se ura.
english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

motu: Bena Iehosafat na tubu tama dekediai e mahuta; idia dekediai e guria, senena David ena hanua ai. Bena ia natuna Iehoram ese ia gabuna ai e lohia. King Ahasia
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

motu: Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-hituna ai, Ahasia, Ahaba natuna, ese Israel e lohiaia matama Samaria ai. Laḡani rua hona ia ese Israel e lohiaia.
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

motu: Ia na e kara havarava, Iehova vairanai, tamana bona sinana edia dala ai e rakava, bona Ieroboam Nebata, Israel e hakaraia dika tauna, ena dala ai danu.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

motu: Ia ese Baal isiaina e lao heniva bona e toma henia dihova, bona Iehova, Israel Diravana, e habaduava, tamana ese e habaduava daladia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.

motu: Ahaba e mase murinai, Moab taudia ese Israel taudia e daḡedaḡe henidia.
english: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

motu: Una negana ai Ahasia na ena atai daiutuna Samaria ai gaba-mauru amo e hedagwa dobi; bena mai gorerena ida e hekureva. Taunabunai, ia ese gwaukau taudia haida e siaidia, eto, Aola, Baal-sebub, Ekron diravana, enai ba henanadai, ina gorere amo baina namo eiava.
english: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover of this sickness.”

motu: A Iehova ena aneru ese Elia, tau Tisbe, e hereva henia, eto, A tore isi, aola, Samaria pavapavana ena gwaukau taudia ida ba hedavari, ba hamaorodia, baoto: Israel na asi Diravana dainai Baal-sebub, Ekron diravana, inanadaina o laomu a?
english: But Yahweh’s + 1:3 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God + 1:3 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: O hekure kau patana amo basio diho, a momokani vada ba mase. Taunabunai Elia na ela.
english: Now therefore Yahweh says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

motu: Gwaukau taudia na e lou lao, hanua pavapavana dekenai, bena ia ese e nanadaidia, eto, Dahaka dainai vada o lou mai?
english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Tau ta ema, ai ida a hedavari, bena ia ese e hamaoromai, eto, Hanua pavapavana, e siaimui tauna, dekena ba lou lao, ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel na asi Diravana dainai oi ese haida na Baal-sebub, Ekron diravana, inanadaina o siaidiamu a? Taunabunai, o hekure kau patana amo basio diho, a momokani vada ba mase.
english: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “Yahweh says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”

motu: Ia ese ma e nanadaidia, eto, Tau edehetomana ema, umui ida o hedavari, bena ini ḡau e hamaorolaimui?
english: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”

motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Hui dabuana e hahedokilaia, bona boromakau kopina gabana ai e ḡeḡea. Ia eto, Una na Elia, tau Tisbe.
english: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He|strong="H1931" * said, “ It|strong="H1931" *’s Elijah the|strong="H1931" * Tishbite|strong="H8664" *.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese imahui biagudia ta ia dekena e siaia lao, mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida. Ia na Elia dekena ela, ororo ta dorina ai helaina ai e davaria, bena e hereva henia, eto, Dirava ena tau e, hanua pavapavana na e tomu “A diho aoma”.
english: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, + 1:9 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”

motu: A Elia ese hari imahui biagudia e haere henia, eto, Bema lau na Dirava ena tau, Iahi na guba amo baine diho, bena baine ḡolemui oho, oi bona emu orea taudia imahuiosi danu. Bena lahi na guba amo e diho, una tau mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida e goledia oho.
english: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese imahui biagudia ma ta ia dekena e siaia, mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida. Ia na e dae ela, e hamaoroa, eto, Dirava ena tau e, hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani binai, e tomu “A diho haraḡa”.
english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”

motu: A Elia ese e haere henia, eto, Bema lau na Dirava ena tau, lahi na guba amo baine diho, baine ḡolemui oho, oi bona emu orea taudia imahuiosi danu. Bena Dirava ena lahi na guba amo e diho, una tau mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida e ḡoledia oho.
english: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese orea ihatoina biaguna, mai ena orea taudia imahuiosi ida, ma e siaidia. Bena hari imahui biagudia ihatoina na e dae ela, Elia vairanai tuina e hadai, e noia, eto, Dirava ena tau e, na noimumu, egu mauri bona ini emu hesiai taudia imahuiosi edia mauri emu ai ḡau badana ai boma halaoa.
english: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.

motu: Lahi na guba amo e diho, unu imahui biagudia raruosi mai edia orea taudia ida e ḡoledia oho; to harihari lauegu mauri do ba laloa bada.
english: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Elia e hamaoroa, eto, Ia ida baola, garina basio gari. Taunabunai, ia na e tore isi, unu tau ida ela, hanua pavapavana dekenai.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then|strong="H6965" * he|strong="H3068" * arose|strong="H6965" * and|strong="H6965" * went|strong="H3381" * down|strong="H3381" * with|strong="H3068" * him|strong="H6440" * to|strong="H1696" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" *.

motu: Bena ia ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Gwaukau taudia na Baal-sebub, Ekron diravana, inanadaina o siaidia. O laloamu Israel na asi Diravana, bena ia to nanadaia a? Taunabunai, oi na o hekure kau patana amo basio diho; momokani, vada ba mase.
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”

motu: Taunabunai, ia na vada e mase, Iehova ena hereva Elia ena amo e gwauraia heḡereḡerena. Ia tadina Iehoram na ia gabuna ai e lohia, lehoram Iehosafat, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iharuana ai ia e lohia matama; badina be hari Ahasia na asi natuna maruanena ta.
english: So he died according to Yahweh’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

motu: Ahasia ena kara oredia e kara ḡaudia na Israel Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

motu: Iehova ese Elia na koehirihiri amo guba ai baine daelaia eto; una negana ai Elia bona Elisaia na Gilgal amo e laova.
english: When Yahweh was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

motu: Bena Elia ese Elisaia e hamaoroa, eto, Mani emu kara iniseni ai do ba noho, badina be Iehova ese vada e siaigu, Betele bainala. A Elisaia eto, Iehova e maurimu bona oi o maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau basina rakatanimu. Taunabunai, raruosi na Betele ela.
english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha|strong="H3427" * said, “ As|strong="H5704" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * lives|strong="H5315" *, and|strong="H3068" * as|strong="H5704" * your|strong="H3068" * soul|strong="H5315" * lives|strong="H5315" *, I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * not|strong="H3588" * leave|strong="H5800" * you|strong="H3588" *.” So|strong="H7971" * they|strong="H3588" * went|strong="H3381" * down|strong="H3381" * to|strong="H5704" * Bethel|strong="H1008" *.

motu: Bena peroveta oreana taudia Betele ai e nohova na Elisaia dekena e raka lasi, e hereva henia, eto, Oi dibamu hari dina ai Iehova ese biagumu na oiemu amo baine abia oho a? Ia eto, Oibe, dibagu; asio hereva.
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh will take away your master from over you today?” He|strong="H3588" * said|strong="H3318" *, “ Yes|strong="H3588" *, I|strong="H3588" * know|strong="H3045" * it|strong="H5921" *. Hold your|strong="H3068" * peace|strong="H2814" *.”

motu: Bena Elia ese e hereva henia, eto, Elisaia e, mani emu kara iniseni ai do ba noho, badina be Iehova ese vada e siaigu, Ieriko bainala. A ia na eto, Iehova e maurimu bona oi o maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau basina rakatanimu. Taunabunai idia na Ieriko ai e kau.
english: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to Jericho.” He|strong="H3588" * said, “ As|strong="H5315" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * lives|strong="H5315" *, and|strong="H3068" * as|strong="H5315" * your|strong="H3068" * soul|strong="H5315" * lives|strong="H5315" *, I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * not|strong="H3588" * leave|strong="H5800" * you|strong="H3588" *.” So|strong="H7971" * they|strong="H3588" * came|strong="H3068" * to|strong="H3068" * Jericho|strong="H3405" *.

motu: Bena peroveta oreana taudia Ieriko ai e nohova ese Elisaia e raka henia kahi, e hereva henia, eto, Oi dibamu hari dina ai Iehova ese biagumu na oiemu amo baine abia oho a? Ia na e haere, eto, Oibe, dibagu; asio hereva.
