english: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to Yahweh in Jerusalem.

motu: Iosia ese rohe taudia bona mea taudia bona laulau helaḡadia bona kaivakuku, bona kara dika-hereadia iboudiai Iuda ai bona Ierusalem ai e heitava, na e atodia tabe, taravatu herevadia, hahelaḡa tauna Hilkia ese Iehova ena dubu ai e davaria bukana ai e hetore gaudia, iboudiai anidia ihavaradia helaoreana.
english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, + 23:24 teraphim were household idols. * and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in Yahweh’s house.

motu: Nega gunadia ai asi pavapava ta ia heḡereḡerena, Iehova e lou henia mai lalona idoinai, mai laumana idoinai, bona mai goadana idoinai ida, Mose ena taravatu idoinai heḡereḡerena; bona ia murinai danu asi pavapava ta e tore isi, ia heḡereḡerena.
english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to Yahweh with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

motu: A Iehova na ena badu-garaḡara siahuna amo se raka oho. Ena badu dounu e haḡaraḡaraiava Iuda enai, Manase ese e habadua loulouva dainai.
english: Notwithstanding, Yahweh didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.

motu: Iehova eto, Lau ese Iuda danu lau vairagu amo baina abia oho, Israel na abia oho heḡereḡerena; bona ina hanua, na abia hidi hanuana, Ierusalem, bona ina dubu, na herevalaia nato “Lau ladagu na unuseni ai baine mia” dubuna, na baina negedia daure.
english: Yahweh said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”

motu: Iosia ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

motu: Iena nega ai Farao Neko, Aigupto pavapavana, na Asuria pavapavana dekena ela, Eufrate sinavaina ai. Bena King Iosia na ia ihedavari-henina ela. Bena Farao Neko ese e itaia negana ai e alaia mase, Megido ai.
english: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

motu: Bena ena hesiai taudia ese kariota ta amo masena ai e laohaia, Megido amo ela bona Ierusalem; bena iena gara korikori ai e guria. Bena Iuda taudia ese Iehoahasa, Iosia natuna, e abia, e horoa, pavapava ai e halaoa, tamana gabuna ai. Iehoahasa, Iuda pavapavana
english: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

motu: Iehoahasa e lohia matama negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui-toi; ia na hua toi hona Ierusalem ai e lohia. Sinana ladana na Hamutala; ia na leremia, tau Libna, natuna.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

motu: Iehoahasa na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, senena edia kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

motu: Bena Farao Neko ese e ḡuia, Ribla ai, Hamat tanona ai, Ierusalem ai basine lohia helaoreana; bona heaiva monina na tano taudia ediai e gwauraia, silver talent * sinahu-ta bona gold talent * ta. + 23:33 Readia K92,000 sisivana, ita edia moni ai. *
english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent + 23:33 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * of gold.

motu: Bena Farao Neko ese Eliakim, Iosia natuna, e abia, pavapava ai e halaoa, tamana Iosia gabuna ai, bona lada matamatana e henia, Iehoiakim eto. A Iehoahasa na e hakaua ela Aigupto; bena unuseni ai e mase.
english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

motu: Bena Iehoiakim ese silver * bona gold * na Farao e henia, a tano taudia edia amo tax * e abia, Farao ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena ai moni baine henia totona. Silver bona gold * na tano taudia edia amo e abi, ta ta ena taḡa ena taga e hahetohoa heḡereḡerena, Farao Neko baine henia totona. Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana
english: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

motu: Iehoiakim e lohia matama negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui-ima; ena lohia laḡanidia Ierusalem ai na gwauta-ta. Sinana ladana na Sebida; ia na Pedaia, tau Rumaha, natuna.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, senena edia kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

motu: Iena nega ai Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, na ema; bena Iehoiakim ese ia isiaina e lao heni ela bona laḡani toi e ore; bena e hegiro, e gwau edeede henia.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

motu: Bena Iehova ese tuari oreadia na Kaldea bona Suria bona Moab bona Amono amo e siaidia, ia bae tuari henia bona Iuda tanona bae habuaia tari totona, Iehova ena hereva, ena hesiai peroveta taudia ududia amo e gwauraia, heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

motu: Momokani, ina na Iehova ena haheḡani dainai Iuda latanai e kau, ia vairana amo bae heabi oho totona, Manase ena kara dika, e kara karadia iboudiai, daidiai,
english: Surely at the commandment of Yahweh this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

motu: bona asi edia kerere taudia raradia ia ese e hahebubua dainai. Badina be ia ese Ierusalem na asi edia kerere taudia raradia amo e hahonua; bona Iehova ese una kara na se laloa nege.
english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.

motu: Iehoiakim ena kara oredia, e kara karadia iboudiai, sivaraidia na Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

motu: Taunabunai, Iehoiakim na tubu tama ida e mahuta, bona ia natuna lehoiakini na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

motu: Una negana ai Aigupto pavapavana na ena tano amo se raka lasi lou, badina be Babulono pavapavana ese Aigupto pavapavana ena tano, Aigupto sinavaina amo ela bona Eufrate sinavaina, iboudiai vada e abidia. Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana
english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

motu: Iehoiakini e lohia matama negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na gwautataurahani; ia na hua toi hona Ierusalem ai e lohia. Sinana ladana na Nehusuta, Elnatan, Ierusalem tauna, natuna.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, tamana ena kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara. Iehoiakini e abia mauri
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

motu: Una negana ai Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ena hesiai taudia ese Ierusalem e dae henia, bona hanua e koua heḡeḡe.
english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

motu: Bena Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ena hesiai taudia ese hanua e koua heḡeḡeva lalonai, ia na hanua ai e kau.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

motu: Bena Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, na sibona Babulono pavapavana imana ai e heato, ia bona sinana bona ena hesiai taudia, bona ena lohia taudia bona ena ruma itataona taudia. Babulono pavapavana ese e abia mauri, ena lohia laḡanina ihataurahanina ai;
english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

motu: bona Iehova ena dubu kohudia iboudiai bona pavapava ena ruma kohudia e laohaidia, bona gold * gaudia iboudiai Iehova ena dubu ai e miava, Solomon, Israel pavapavana, ese e kara gaudia, na e utudia sisi-sisi, Iehova ese vada e gwauraia guna heḡereḡerena.
english: He carried out from there all the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in Yahweh’s temple, as Yahweh had said.

motu: Ierusalem taudia iboudiai na e laohaidia, lohia iboudiai bona tuari taudia mai goadadia iboudiai, iḡui taudia gerebu ta; + 24:14 Gerebu-ta = 10,000. * bona ima namo taudia bona auri igaukaralaina mai dibadia taudia. Tau ta se noho, ogogami dikadika taudia mo.
english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

motu: Ia ese Iehoiakina na Babulono e laohaia; hanua pavapavana sinana danu, bona adavana hahidaosi, bona ena heitatao taudia bona tano lohiadia, e ḡuidia, Ierusalem amo e laohaidia, ela bona Babulono.
english: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

motu: Babulono pavapavana ese tuari taudia daha-hitu, bona ima namo taudia bona auri iḡaukaralaina mai dibadia taudia daha-ta, na Babulono e laohaidia; iboudiai na mai goadadia bona tuari mai dibadia.
english: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

motu: Bena Babulono pavapavana ese Matania, Iehoiakini tamana lahaina, na pavapavana ai e halaoa, ia gabuna ai, bona lada matamatana e henia, e nemaia Sedekia. Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana
english: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

motu: Sedekia e lohia matama negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui-ta; ena lohia laḡanidia Ierusalem ai na gwauta-ta. Sinana ladana na Hamutala, Ieremia, tau Libna, natuna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, Iehoiakim ena kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

motu: Iehova ena badu dainai unu kara e vara, Ierusalem ai bona Iuda ai, ela bona negana e kau bena idia na ia vairana amo e negedia daure. Bena Sedekia ese Babulono pavapavana e gwau edeede henia.
english: For through the anger of Yahweh, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then|strong="H1961" * Zedekiah|strong="H6667" * rebelled|strong="H4775" * against|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H4428" * Babylon.

motu: Sedekia ena lohia laḡanina ihataurahani-tana ai, hua ihagwautana dinana ihagwautana lalonai, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, na ena tuari oreana idoinai ida Ierusalem ihadikana ema, e koua heḡeḡe bona tano e larebaia heḡeḡe.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

motu: Taunabunai, hanua e koua heḡeḡe ela bona King Sedekia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-tana.
english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

motu: Bena hua ihahanina dinana ihatamahani-tana ai, hanua lalonai doe vada e bada herea, bona tano idoinai taunimanima na asi adia.
english: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

motu: Una negana ai, hanua maḡuna e hamaurua. Ena be Kaldea taudia na hanua vada e koua heḡeḡe, to hanua pavapavana bona tuari taudia iboudiai na hanuaboi e heau, maḡu ruaosi padadia ikoukouna amo, hanua pavapavana ena uma-uma badibadinai; bena Araba kahana ela.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

motu: A Kaldea taudia edia tuari oreana ese hanua pavapavana na e ḡavaia, ela bona Ieriko taorana ai e lasi tao; ena tuari oreana idoinai na iena amo e karoho rohoroho.
english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

motu: Bena idia ese hanua pavapavana e abia mauri, Babulono pavapavana dekena e laohaia, Ribla ai. Ia ese e revaia.
english: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

motu: Bena Sedekia natuna mamaruanedia na ia vairanai e aladia mase; bena Sedekia matana e hakepuludia, bena auri gadeadia amo e ḡuia, Babulono e laohaia.
english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

motu: Hua iha-imana dinana ihahituna ai, (una na King Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahani-tana ai), Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, Babulono pavapavana ena hesiai tauna ta, na Ierusalem ai e kau.
english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

motu: Bena ia ese Iehova ena dubu bona pavapava ena ruma bona Ierusalem rumadia iboudiai e doudia; ruma badadia iboudiai e dou.
english: He burned Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

motu: Bena Kaldea tuari oreana taudia iboudiai, hegima oreana biaguna ida ema taudia, ese Ierusalem heḡegemadai maḡudia e haheḡigidia dobi.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

motu: Bena hanua taudia kwabukwabudia dounu hanua ai e nohova, bona e heau Babulono pavapavana enai e hanai taudia, bona taunimanima oredia, na Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese dauha e laohaidia.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

motu: A hegima oreana biaguna ese ogoḡami dikadika taudia haida e rakatanidia, vine imeadia ireḡudia bona tano iruana.
english: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

motu: Auri labora-labora au-tubuadia Iehova ena dubu ai, bona rerue bona auri labora-labora nauna badana Iehova ena dubu ai, na Kaldea taudia ese e hamakohidia, bona auri labora-laborana na e laohaia Babulono.
english: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

motu: Bona uro bona gaga bona lamepa ihaḡoevadia ḡaudia, bona muramura mai bonadia urodia, bona auri labora-labora ḡaudia, kara helaḡadia ai e ḡaukaralaiva ḡaudia, na iboudiai e laohai.
english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

motu: Gida keberedia bona bio, bona gold * amo bona silver * amo e kara ḡaudia ibouboudiai na hari hegima oreana biaguna ese e laohai.
english: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

motu: Hari au-tubua ruaosi, bona nau badana, bona rerue, Solomon ese e kara Iehova ena dubu ena, auri labora-laboraidia lalodiai metauna na asi ihahetohona.
english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

motu: Au-tubua ta ena lata na kiubit gwauta-taurahani; ia latanai na kwarana ikorona, auri labora-labora ḡauna, ena lata na kiubit toi; bona reke-hetomana bona rimono huahuadia laulaudia, iboudiai na auri labora-labora amo e kara, na hari au-tubua kwarana ikorona ḡauna e ḡeḡelaia. Au-tubua iharuana danu unuheto, mai ena reke-hetomana. + 25:17 Siri 13 ela bona 17. Hanua Pavapavadia Buka Gini-gunana Karoa 7 ba itaia. *
english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, + 25:17 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

motu: Bena hari hegima oreana biaguna ese hahelaḡa tauna badana Seraia, bona hahelaḡa tauna ihararuana Sefania, bona dubu iduarana inaridia taudia tatoiosi, e abidia.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

motu: Hanua amo danu tuari oreana biaguna ta bona hanua pavapavana ena kaunsil taudia laima hanua lalonai e davaridia na e abidia; bona tuari biaguna ena toretore tauna, ena ḡaukara be tano taudia ihagaudia, bona tano taudia tauratoi-ahui hanua lalonai e davaridia danu,
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

motu: Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese e abidia, Babulono pavapavana dekena e laohaidia Ribla ai.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

motu: Bena Babulono pavapavana ese e rahudia mase Ribla ai, Hamat tanona ai, e aladia mase. Taunabunai, Iuda taudia na edia tano amo e abidia oho, dauha e laohaidia.
english: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

motu: Taunimanima kwabukwabudia na Iuda tanona ai e nohova, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e rakatanidia dainai. Bena ia ese Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, e duanaia, baine biagudia.
english: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

motu: Bena tano paka ai e nohova oreadia biagudia iboudiai, mai edia orea taudia ida, e kamonai Babulono pavapavana ese Gedalia vada e duanaia baine biagudia negana ai, idia na edia orea taudia ida Gedalia dekena ela, Mispa ai. Taudia bini: Ismael Netania; lohanan Karea; Seraia Tanahumete, tau Netofa; bona Iaasania, tau Maakata natuna.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

motu: Bena Gedalia ese idia bona edia orea taudia e gwau henidia hamata, eto, Basio gari Kaldea lohiadia daidiai; tano lalonai ba noho, bona Babulono pavapavana isiaina ba lao heni, bena ba namo.
english: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

motu: A hua ihahituna ai, Ismael, Netania Elisama natuna, hanua pavapavana ena iduhu tauna ta, na tatau gwauta ida ema. Idia ese Gedalia bona Iuda taudia bona Kaldea taudia ia ida Mispa ai e nohova na e tuari henidia bona e aladia mase.
english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai kikina-badana, bona orea biagudia, na e tore isi, Aigupto ela; badina be idia na Kaldea taudia garidia e gariva.
english: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

motu: Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, ena noho-hedoa laḡanina ihatoiahui-hituna ai, hua ihagwauta-ruana dinana iharuahui-hituna ai, Evil-merodak, Babulono pavapavana, e lohia matama. Bena ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai ia ese Iehoiakini, Iuda pavapavana, e bogaia hisi, dibura rumana amo e ruhaia nege;
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

motu: ia ese e hereva namo henia, bona helai ḡauna hereana e henia, pavapava iboudiai ia ida Babulono ai e nohova daediai.
english: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

motu: Taunabunai, Iehoiakini na ena dibura dabuadia e doki oho. Una murinai ena mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai ia na hanua pavapavana ena pata ai e anianiva;
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;

motu: bona hanua pavapavana ese ahuna e henia, dina ta ta amo, ena mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

motu: Adam, Set, Enos;
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

motu: Kenan, Mahalalel, Iared;
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

motu: Enok, Metusela, Lamek;
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

motu: Noa, Sem, Ham, Iaet. Noa garana
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

motu: Ifet natuna: Gomere, Magog, Madai, lavan, Tubal, Mesek, Tira.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

motu: Gomere natuna: Asakena, Difata, Togarama.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

motu: Ivan natuna: Elisa bona Tarasisi; bona Kitim besena bona Dodanim besena danu ia ese e havaradia.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

motu: Ham natuna: Kusu, Aigupto, Put, Kanaan. Kusu natuna: Seba, Havila, Sabata, Raama, Sabateka.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

motu: Raama natuna: Sieba, Dedan.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

motu: Kusu ese Nimrod e havaraia; ia na lohia tauna gini-gunana tanobada ai.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

motu: Aigupto ese e havaradia besedia bini: Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Napatuhim,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

motu: Patarusim, Kasaluhim, Kaftorim. Filistia taudia na Kasaluhim besena amo e vara.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

motu: Kanaan natuna bini: Sidono, tau-roboana, bona Het.
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

motu: E havaradia besedia bini: Iebusu, Amoro, Girigasa,
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

motu: Hivi, Araka, Sini,
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

motu: Aravada, Semara, Hamat.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

motu: Sem natuna: Elam, Asuru, Afasad, Lud, Aram, Usu, Hulu, Getere, Mesek.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

motu: Afasad ese Sela e havaraia, bona Sela ese Ebere e havaraia.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

motu: Ebere natuna mamaruanedia na rarua: ta ladana Peleg + 1:19 “Peleg” anina be “e haria”. * (badina be iena nega ai tano hetoadia e kara); ia tadina ladana na Iokotan.
english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

motu: Ikotan natuna: Alamodad, Selefe, Hasaramavete, Iera,
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

motu: Hadoram, Usala, Dikila,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

motu: Ebal, Abimael, Sieba,
english: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

motu: Ofiri, Havila, Iobab. Ini iboudiai na Iokotan natuna. Sem garana
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

motu: Sem, Afasad, Sela,
english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

motu: Ebere, Peleg, Reu,
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

motu: Serug, Nahoro, Tera,
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

motu: Abram (ladana ta be Abraham). Ismael bona Ketura garadia
english: Abram (also called Abraham).

motu: Abraham natuna: Isaak bona Ismael.
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

motu: Edia uru ladadia bini: Ismael natuna roboana na Nebaioto; bona murina amo Kedara, Adabeel, Mibisam,
english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

motu: Misima, Duma, Masa, Hadad, Tema,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

motu: Ieturu, Nafisi, Kedema. Ismael natuna bunu.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

motu: Ketura na Abraham ese e adavaia hahinena. Una hahine ese e havaradia memerodia: Simuran, Iokosan, Medan, Midian, Isabak, Sua. Iokosan natuna: Sieba bona Dedan.
english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

motu: Midian natuna: Efa, Efere, Hanok, Abida, Eldaha. Ini iboudiai na Ketura vevena. Esau garana
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

motu: Abraham ese Isaak e havaraia. Isaak natuna: Esau bona Israel.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

motu: Esau natuna: Elifasa, Reuele, Ieusu, Ialam, Kora.
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

motu: Elifasa natuna Teman, Omara, Sefi, Gatam, Kena, Timna, Amalek.
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

motu: Reuele natuna: Nahata, Sera, Sama, Misa.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

motu: Seiri natuna: Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Esere, Disan.
english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

motu: Lotan natuna: Hori bona Homam. Lotan taihuna na Timna.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

motu: Sobal natuna: Alian, Manahata, Ebal, Sefi, Onam. Sibeon natuna: Aia bona Ana.
english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

motu: Ana natuna: Dison. Dison natuna: Hamaran, Eseban, Itiran, Keran.
english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

motu: Esere natuna: Bilhan, Saavan, laakan. Dison natuna: Usu bona Aran.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

motu: Israel taudia do asi edia pavapava negadia ai na Edom tanona e lohiaiava pavapavadia bini. Bela Beoro, ena hanua badana ladana na Dinihaba.
english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

motu: Bela e mase, bena Iobab, Sera tau Bosra natuna, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

motu: Iobab e mase, bena bena Husam, Teman tanona tauna, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

motu: Husam e mase, Hadad Bedad, Moab tanona ai Midian e hadarerea tauna, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai; ena hanua badana ladana na Aviti.
english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

motu: Hadad e mase, bena Samula, tau Masareka, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

motu: Samula e mase, bena Saul, Rehoboto, Eufrate sinavaina hanuana ta, tauna, na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

motu: Saul e mase, bena Baal-hanana Akahoro na e lohia, ia gabuna ai.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

motu: Baal-hanana e mase, bena Hadad na e lohia, ia gabuna ai; ena hanua badana ladana na Pai. Adavana ladana na Mehetabel; ia na Matared natuna, tubuna na Mesahab.
english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

motu: Hadad na e mase. Edom iduhu-lohiadia bini: Timna, Alia, letete,
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

motu: Oholibama, Elaha, Pinon,
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

motu: Kena, Teman, Mibsara,
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

motu: Magdiel, Iram. Unu na Edom iduhulohiadia.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

motu: Israel natuna bini: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Iuda, Isakara, Sebulun,
english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

motu: Dan, Iosef, Beniamina, Napatali, Gad, Asere. Iuda garana
english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

motu: Iuda natuna: Ere, Onan, Sela; ini memero tatoiosi na Batasua, hane Kanaan, ese e havara henia. Hari Ere, Iuda natuna roboana, na e kara dika, Iehova vairanai; bena Iehova ese e alaia mase.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s + 2:3 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * sight; and he killed him.

motu: Ia rava-maraḡina hahinena Tamara ese danu Perese bona Sera na iena amo e havaradia. Iuda natuna mamaruanedia iboudiai na laima.
english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

motu: Perese natuna: Hesron bona Hamulu.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

motu: Sera natuna: Simiri, Etana, Hemana, Kalakolo, Dara, laimaosi.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

motu: Karami natuna: Akara, Israel ena kwasima e havaraia tauna; ia na e gwaua ahu ḡauna ai e kerere.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

motu: Etana natuna na Asaria.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

motu: Hesron natuna mamaruanedia e havaradia ladadia bini: Ierahamele, Ram, Kelubai.
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

motu: Ram na Aminadab tamana; Aminadab na Nason tamana; una Nason na Iuda taudia edia lohia ta.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

motu: Nason na Salma tamana; Salma na Boa tamana;
english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

motu: Boa na Obed tamana; Obed na Iese tamana.
english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

motu: Iese natuna roboana na Eliab, iharuana na Abinadab, ihatoina na Simea,
english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

motu: ihahanina na Netanele, iha-imana na Radai,
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

motu: ihatauratoina na Oseme, ihahituna na David.
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

motu: Taihudia na Seruia bona Abigail. Seruia natuna: Abisai, Ioab, Asahele, tatoi.
english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

motu: Abigail ese Amasa e havaraia; Amasa tamana na letere, tau Ismael.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

motu: Kaleb, Hesron natuna, ese natuna e havaradia, adavana Asuba enai bona lerioto enai. Asuba natuna bini: Iesere bona Sobab bona Aradono.
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

motu: Asuba e mase murinai, Kaleb ese Efrata e adavaia; una hahine ese natuna Huru e havara henia.
english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

motu: Huru na Uri tamana, bona Uri na Besalele tamana.
english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

motu: Una murinai Hesron na Makiri natuna hahinena, Gilead taihuna, ida e eno bou. Una hahine na e adavaia negana ai iena mauri laḡanidia na tauratoi-ahui; bena una hahine ese natuna Segubu e havara henia.
english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

motu: Segubu na lairi tamana; hari lairi ena hanua na ruahui-toi Gilead tanona ai.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

motu: A Gesuru bona Aram ese Havoto-iairi na idia edia amo e abia oho, bona Kenat mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida danu; e abi hanuadia iboudiai na tauratoiahui. Unu iboudiai na Makiri, Gilead tamana, garana.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

motu: Hesron e mase murinai, Kaleb ese Efrata, ia tamana Hesron adavana, ida e eno bou; bena una hahine ese natuna Asahuru e havara henia; ia na Tekoa tamana.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

motu: Ierahamele, Hesron natuna roboana, natuna: Ram, roboa merona, Buna, Orene, Oseme, Ahia.
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

motu: Ierahamele na mai adavana ma ta danu, ladana na Atara; ia na Onam sinana.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

motu: Ram, Ierahamele natuna roboana, natuna: Maasa, Iamin, Ekere.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

motu: Onam natuna: Samai bona lada. Sarnai natuna: Nadab bona Abisuru.
english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

motu: Abisuru adavana ladana na Abihaili; una hahine ese natuna Ahabana bona Molidi na e havara henia.
english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

motu: Nadab natuna: Selede bona Apaimi. Selede na e mase, asi natuna.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

motu: Apairni natuna: Isi. Isi natuna na Sesana. Sesana natuna na Ahalai.
english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

motu: Iada, Samai tadina, natuna: Ietere bona Ionatan. Ietere na e mase, asi natuna.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

motu: Ionatan natuna: Pelete bona Sasa. Unu na Ierahamele vevena.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

motu: Hari Sesana natuna na hahinedia mo, asi natuna maruanena. A Sesana na mai ena hesiai tauna ta, Aigupto tauna, ladana na Iaraha.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

motu: Taunabunai, Sesana ese ia natuna hahinena na ena hesiai tauna Iaraha e henia, baine adavaia; bena una hahine ese natuna Atai e havara henia.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

motu: Atai na Natan tamana; Natan na Sabada tamana;
english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

motu: Sabada na Efelala tamana; Efelala na Obed tamana;
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

motu: Obed na Iehu tamana; Iehu na Asaria tamana;
english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

motu: Asaria na Helese tamana; Helese na Eleasa tamana;
english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

motu: Eleasa na Sisimai tamana; Sisimai na Salumu tamana;
english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

motu: Salumu na Iekamia tamana; Iekamia na Elisama tamana.
english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

motu: Kaleb, lerahamele tadina, natuna roboana na Maresa; ia na Sifi tamana. Maresa natuna na Heberon.
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

motu: Heberon natuna: Kora, Tapua, Rekeme Sema.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

motu: Sema na Rahama tamana; Rahama na lorokeama tamana. Rekeme na Samai tamana.
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

motu: Samai natuna na Maono, Maono na Bete-suru tamana
english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

motu: Efa na Kaleb ese e adavaia hahinena; una hahine ese Haran bona Mosa bona Gasese e havara henia. Haran na Gasese tamana.
english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

motu: Iahadai natuna: Regeme, Iotam, Gesana, Pelet, Efa, Saafa.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

motu: Maaka na Kaleb ese e adavaia hahinena; una hahine ese Sebere bona Tirihana e havara henia.
english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

motu: Ia ese Saafa danu e havaraia (ia na Madamana tamana), bona Seva (ia na Makabena bona Gibea tamadia). Kaleb natuna hahinena na Aksa.
english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

motu: Kaleb vevena bunu. Huru, Efrata natuna roboana, natuna: Sobal (ia na Kiriat-iearimi tamana)
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

motu: Salma (ia na Betelehem tamana); bona Harefe (ia na Bete-gadere tamana).
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

motu: Sobal, Kiriat-iearimi tamana, na mai ena bese haida danu: Haroe; Menuhoto besena kahana;
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

motu: bona Kiriata-iearimi iduhudia: Itiri bona Puti bona Sumata bona Misira besedia; idia edia amo Sorata bona Estaol besedia e vara.
english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

motu: Salma besena bini: Betelehem, bona Netofa besena, bona Ataroto-bete-ioab, bona Manahata besena kahana, bona Soro besena.
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

motu: Itorena taudia Iabese ai e nohova danu besedia bini: Tirata bona Simeata bona Sukata besedia. Unu na Kene taudia, Hamat ena amo e vara; una Hamat na Rekab iduhuna senena.
english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

motu: David natuna Heberon ai e vara: roboana na Amnon, Ahinoama, hane Iesrele, bogana amo; iharuana na Daniel, Abigail, hane Karamele, bogana amo;
english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

motu: ihatoina na Absalom; ia sinana na Maaka, Talmai, Gesuru pavapavana natuna hahinena; ihahanina na Adonia; ia sinana na Hagiti;
english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

motu: iha-imana na Sefatia, Abitala bogana amo; ihatauratoina na Itireama, adavana Egla bogana amo.
english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

motu: Natuna mamaruanedia tauratoi Heberon ai e vara; ia na laḡani hitu hua tauratoi unuseni ai e lohia. Ma laḡani toi-ahui toi Ierusalem ai e lohia.
english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

motu: Ini na Ierusalem ai e havaradia: Simea, Sobab, Natan, Solomon; ini hahaniosi na Batasua, Amiele natuna, bogana amo.
english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

motu: Idia muridiai: Ibihara, Elisama, Elifelete,
english: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

motu: Noga, Nefeg, Iafia,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

motu: Elisama, Eliada, Elifelete; taudia taurahani-ta.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

motu: Ini iboudiai na David natuna mamaruanedia; ma haida be e adavadia hahinedia natudia. Taihudia na Tamara. Solomon garana
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

motu: Solomon garana: Rehoboam; ia natuna Abia; ia natuna Asa; ia natuna Iehosafat;
english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

motu: ia natuna Ioram; ia natuna Ahasia; ia natuna Ioasa;
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

motu: ia natuna Amasia; ia natuna Asaria; ia natuna Iotam;
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

motu: ia natuna Ahasa, ia natuna Hesekia; ia natuna Manase;
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

motu: ia natuna Amon; ia natuna Iosia.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

motu: Iosia natuna: roboana na Iohanan; iharuana Iehoiakim; ihatoina na Sedekia; ihahanina na Salumu.
english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

motu: Iehoiakim garana: natuna na Iekonia; ia natuna na Sedekia.
english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

motu: Iekonia, abi-mauri tauna, natuna: Sealtiele,
english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

motu: Malkiram, Pedaia, Senasara, Iekamia, Hosama, Nedabia.
english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

motu: Pedaia natuna: Serubabele bona Simei. Serubabele natuna: Mesulama bona Hanania; idia taihudia na Selomiti;
english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

motu: bona Hasuba, Ohele, Berekia, Hasadia, lusaba-hesede, tatau laima.
english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

motu: Hanania natuna na Pelatia, ia natuna na Iesaia; ia natuna na Refaia; ia natuna na Aranana; ia natuna na Obadia; ia natuna na Sekania.
english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

motu: Sekania natuna na Semaia. Semaia natuna: Hatusu, Igala, Baria, Nearia, Safata, taudia tauratoi.
english: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

motu: Nearia natuna: Elioenai, Hesekia, Asarikama, taudia tatoi.
english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

motu: Elioenai natuna: Hodavia, Eliasibi, Pelaia, Akubu, Iohanan, Delaia, Anani, taudia hahitu.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

motu: A Iuda natuna: Perese, Hesron, Karami, Huru, Sobal.
english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

motu: Sobal natuna Re-aia na lahata tamana; Iahata na Ahumai bona Lahada tamadia. Unu na Sorata iduhudia.
english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

motu: Ini na Etam natuna: Iesrele, Isma, Idibasa; taihudia ladana na Haseleleponi.
english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

motu: Penuel na Gedoro tamana; Esere na Husa tamana. Idia na Huru natuna; una Huru na Betelehem tamana Efrata natuna roboana.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

motu: Asahuru, Tekoa tamana, adavana na rarua, Hela bona Naara.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

motu: Naara ese ia natuna e havara henia ḡaudia bini: Ahusama, Hefere, Temeni, Haahasatari. Naara natuna bunu.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

motu: Hela natuna: Serete, Isara, Etenana.
english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

motu: Koso na Anubu bona Sobeba tamadia, bona Aharahele, Harumu natuna, ena iduhu senena.
english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

motu: Iabese + 4:9 “Iabese” anina be “hisihisi”. * ese kara maoromaoro ai tadikakana e hereadia; sinana ese ia ladana e hatoa Iabese, eto, Badina be hisi-ani ai na havaraia.
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, + 4:9 “Jabez” sounds similar to the Hebrew word for “pain”. * saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

motu: Iabese ese Israel Diravana e noia, eto, Boma hanamogu, egu tano hetoa boma habadaia bona imamu na bema lau dekegu ai, bona dika amo boma rauagu, bena basinema hahisigu. Bena e noia ḡauna na Dirava ese e havara henia.
english: Jabez called on the God + 4:10 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God|strong="H3027" * granted|strong="H6213" * him|strong="H7121" * that|strong="H3478" * which|strong="H7451" * he|strong="H6213" * requested|strong="H7592" *.

motu: Kelubu, Suha tadina, na Mehin tamana; Mehiri na Esetono tamana;
english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

motu: Esetono na Bete-rafa bona Pasea bona Tehina tamadia; Tehina na Irinahasa tamana. Unu na Reka taudia.
english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

motu: Kena natuna na Otoniele bona Seraia; Otoniele natuna na Hatata bona Meonotai.
english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath. + 4:13 Greek and Vulgate add “and Meonothai” *

motu: Meonotai na Ofra tamana; Seraia na Ioab tamana. Ioab na Geharasimi + 4:14 “Geharasimi” anina be “ima karakara dibakana taudia edia koura”. * taudia senedia; Geharasimi e gwauraidia badina be idia na ima karakara dibakana taudia.
english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

motu: Kaleb lefune natuna: Iru, Elaha, Naama; Elaha natuna na Kena.
english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

motu: Iehalelele natuna: Sifi, Sifaha, Tiria, Asarele.
english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

motu: Esera natuna: Ietere, Merede, Efere, Ialono. Ini na Bitia natuna, (ia na Farao natuna hahinena Merede ese e adavaia); hahine na e gaba manoka, bena natuna e havaradia, Miriama bona Samai bona Isiba, Estemoa tamana.
english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

motu: Bona adavana hane Heberu ese Ierede, Gedoro tamana, bona Hebere, Soko tamana, bona lekutiele, Sanoa tamana, e havaradia.
english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

motu: Hodia adavana, Nahama taihuna, natuna na Keila, tau Garama, bona Estemoa, tau Maakata, tamadia.
english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

motu: Sirnono natuna: Amnon, Rina, Benhanana, Tilono. Isi natuna: Sohete bona Ben-sohete.
english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

motu: Sela Iuda natuna: Ere, Leka tamana, bona Laada, Maresa tamana. Ia be Bet-asabea dabua aukadia ikaradia taudia edia iduhu senedia danu.
english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

motu: Ia garana haida be lokimi bona Koseba taudia, bona Ioasa, bona Sarafa; hari Sarafa na Moab ai e lohia, bena e lou lao Leheme. (Ini na sene negadia ai e tore ḡaudia.)
english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

motu: Unu na uro ikaradia taudia, bona Netaimi ai bona Gedera ai e nohova taudia; unuseni ai hanua pavapavana ida e nohova, iena ḡaukara ikaradia totona. Simeon garana
english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

motu: Simeon natuna: Nemuele, Iamin, Iaribi, Sera, Saul;
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

motu: ia natuna na Salumu, ia natuna na Mibisam, ia natuna na Misirna.
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

motu: Misima natuna na Hamuele; ia natuna na Sakuru; ia natuna na Sirnei.
english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

motu: Sirnei na mai natuna mamaruanedia gwauta-tauratoi bona hahinedia tauratoi, a tadikakana natudia be dia hoho; dia iboudiai asie vara momomomo, Iuda taudia heḡereḡeredia.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

motu: Edia noho gabudia na Bere-sieba, Molada, Hasara-sual,
english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

motu: Bilha, Eseme, Tolada,
english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

motu: Betuel, Horoma, Siklag,
english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

motu: Bete-makaboto, Hasara-susirni, Bete-biri, bona Saaraimi. Edia hanua badadia bunu, ela bona David e lohia negana.
english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

motu: Edia hanua maraḡidia na Etam, Ain, Rimon, Tokene, Asana; hanua ima,
english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

motu: mai edia hanua maraḡidia iboudiai ida, hari hanua badadia e ginidia heḡeḡe-madai ḡaudia, ela bona Baal. Edia noho gabudia bunu; bona senedia ladadia e tore ḡaudia e baladia heni.
english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

motu: Mesobaba; Iamlek; Iosa Amasia;
english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

motu: Ioel; Iehu Iosibia, Seraia Asiele tubuna;
english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

motu: Elioenai; Iaakoba; Iesohaia; Asaia; Adiele; Iesimiele; Benaia;
english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

motu: bona Sisa Sifi; ia na Alono ledaia tubuna, bona hari Alono na Sirnri Semaia tubuna.
english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

motu: Ini ladadia e hetore taudia be edia iduhu lohiadia, bona edia iduhu na e bada e laova.
english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

motu: Idia na e laolao ela bona Gedoro rakavareaina kourana mairiveina kahana ai, edia seri adia rei gabudia e tahudia.
english: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

motu: Unuseni ai idia na rei ḡoeva-daedia gabudia e davaridia; una tano na taora bada, asi tautauna, heato kava, badina be e noholaia gunava taudia na Ham besena taudia.
english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

motu: Ini ladadia e hetore taudia na Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai ema, edia kalaga e habuadia tari, bona Meunimi taudia unuseni ai e davaridia danu e ha-oredia, ema bona ina dina; bena edia gabu e noholaia, badina be edia seri adia rei gabudia na unuseni ai.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

motu: Bena idia haida, Simeon iduhu tataudia sinahu-ima, na Seiri ororona ela; ihakaudia taudia na Isi natuna hahaniosi, Pelatia bona Nearia bona Refaia bona Usiele.
english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

motu: Bena idia ese Amalek taudia kwabukwabudia, guna vada e roho mauri taudia, na e habuadia tari; bena unuseni ai e nohomu ema bona ina dina.
english: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

motu: Ruben, Israel natuna roboana, natuna bini. (Ia na tau-roboana; ḡau tamona, tamana ena geda e hamiroa dainai ia ahuna na Iosef Israel natuna e henidia; taunabunai edia uru ladadia ai ia ladana se hetore, tau-guna ahuna iabina tauna.
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

motu: Ena be Iuda na mai goadana tadikakana bogaragidiai, bona lohia ta iena amo e vara, to roboa ahuna na Iosef ena.)
english: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

motu: Ruben, Israel natuna roboana, natuna: Hanok, Palu, Hesron, Karami.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

motu: Ioel natuna na Semaia; ia natuna na Goḡ ia natuna na Simei;
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

motu: ia natuna na Mika; ia natuna na Re-aia; ia natuna na Baal.
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

motu: Ia natuna na Bera, Tiglata-pilnesere, Asuria pavapavana, ese e abia mauri bena e laohaia tauna; ia na Ruben iduhuna taudia edia lohia ta.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

motu: Ia varavarana, edia iduhu ta ta ai, edia uru ladadia e hagaudia heḡereḡerena: Ieiele, lohia tauna, bona Sekaria;
english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

motu: bona Bela Asasa, Sema Ioel tubuna, ia na Aroere ai e nohova, ela bona Nebo bona Baal-meono.
english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

motu: Ia na mairiveina kahana ai danu e nohova, ela bona tano ḡaḡaena iraka-vareaina gabuna, Eufrate sinavaina inikahana ai; badina be edia boromakau vada e hutuma Gilead tanona ai.
english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

motu: Saulo ena nega ai idia ese Hagara taudia e tuari henidia bona e hadareredia; bena edia kalaga ai e nohova, Gilead mairiveina kahana idoinai lalonai. Gad garana
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

motu: Gad garana na idia italaidia ai e nohova, Basan tanona ai, ela bona Saleka.
english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

motu: Ioel na lohia tauna; iharuana na Safama; bona lanai bona Safata danu na Basan ai.
english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

motu: Varavaradia, tamadia edia iduhu heḡereḡeredia ai, bini: Mikael, Mesulama, Sieba, Iorai, Iakan, Sia, Ebere, taudia hahitu.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

motu: Unu na Abihaili Huri natuna; Huri na Iaroa natuna, Iaroa na Gilead natuna, Gilead na Mikael natuna, Mikael na Iesisai natuna, Iesisai na lado natuna, Iado na Busu natuna.
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

motu: Ahi, Abdiele Guni natuna, na edia iduhu e lohiadia.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

motu: Edia noho gabudia na Gilead, Basan mai ena hanua ida, bona Saron ena rei gabudia iboudiai ela bona rei dokodia.
english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

motu: Ini iboudiai na Iotam, Iuda pavapavana, bona Ieroboam, Israel pavapavana, negadia ai edia uru ta ta ladadia ai e tore. Iduhu ma bona iduhu-kahana sivaraidia
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

motu: Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana na mai edia goada taudia, kesi bona dare ihuadia bona peva imaredia bona tuari mai dibadia taudia; iboudiai na gerebu-hani daha-hani sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui, + 5:18 Gerebu-hani daha-hani sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui = 44,760. * heheḡaeḡae tuari totona.
english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

motu: Idia ese Hagara taudia, bona leturu bona Nafisi bona Nodaba, e tuari henidia;
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

motu: ituari-henidia ai hekaha e davaria. bena Hagara taudia mai bamodia ida na idia imadia ai e heato kau; badina be tuari lalonai idia ese Dirava e boi henia, bena ia ese edia noinoi e abia dae, idia ese ia e abidadama henia dainai.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

motu: Bena edia ubu-ubu ḡaudia na e laohaidia: edia kamelo gerebu-ima, edia mamoe domaga-rua gerebu-ima, + 5:21 Gerebu-ima = 50,000. Domaga-rua gerebu-ima = 250,000. Domaga-ta = 100,000. * bona edia doniki daha-rua; tatau domaga-ta danu e abidia mauri.
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

motu: Hutuma bada e mase, badina be tuari na Dirava ena amo e vara. Bena edia gabu e noholaia ela bona e laohaidia idau gabu ai e hanohodia negana.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

motu: Manase iduhu-kahana taudia na una tano ai e nohova; idia na hutuma herea, Basan amo ela bona Baal-heremon bona Seniri bona Heremon ororona.
english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

motu: Tamadia edia iduhu kwaradia bini: Efere, Isi, Eliele, Asriel, Ieremia, Hodavia, bona Iahadiele, tuari taudia mai goadadia bona mai haridia, tamadia edia iduhu kwaradia.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

motu: A idia ese tamadia edia Dirava e kara havara henia, bona una tano taudia edia dirava e toma henidia diho, Dirava ese idia vairadiai vada e habuadia tari ḡaudia.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel Diravana ese Pulu, Asuria pavapavana, bona Tiglata-pilnesere, Asuria pavapavana, na lalodia e haḡaraḡara, bena idia ese hari Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana taudia e laohaidia oho, Hala bona Haboro bona Hara bona Gosan sinavaina badinai e hanohodia, ema bona ina dina.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

motu: Levi natuna: Gereson, Kohat, Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

motu: Kohat natuna: Amram, Isahara Heberon, Usiele.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

motu: Arnram natuna: Aaron, Mose, Miriama. Aaron natuna: Nadab, Abihu, Eleasara, Itamara.
english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

motu: Eleasara na Fineha tamana Fineha na Abisua tamana;
english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

motu: Abisua na Buki tamana; Buki na Usisi tamana,
english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

motu: Usisi na Serahia tamana; Serahia na Meraioto tamana;
english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

motu: Meraioto na Amaria tamana; Amaria na Ahitubu tamana;
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

motu: Ahitubu na Sadok tamana; Sadok na Ahimasa tamana;
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

motu: Ahimasa na Asaria tamana; Asaria na Iohanan tamana;
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

motu: Iohanan na Asaria tamana; Solomon ese Ierusalem ai e haginia dubuna lalonai una Asaria ese hahelaḡa karadia e kara.
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

motu: Asaria na Amaria tamana Arnaria na Ahitubu tamana;
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

motu: Ahitubu na Sadok tamana; Sadok na Salumu tamana;
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

motu: Salumu na Hilkia tamana; Hilkia na Asaria tamana;
english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

motu: Asaria na Seraia tamana; Seraia na Iehosadak tamana.
english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

motu: Iehova ese Iuda bona Ierusalem taudia na Nebukadnesara imana amo idau gabu ai e hanohodia lao negana ai, hari Iehosadak danu e laohaia.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

motu: Levi natuna: Gereson, Kohat, Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

motu: Gereson natuna ladadia bini: Libni bona Simei.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

motu: Kohat natuna: Amram, Isahara, Heberon, Usiele.
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

motu: Merari natuna: Mali bona Musi. Levi taudia edia iduhu bini, tamadia heḡereḡeredia:
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

motu: Gereson natuna na Libni; Libni natuna na Iahata; Iahata natuna na Sima;
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

motu: Sima natuna na Ioa; Ioa natuna na Ido; Ido natuna na Sera; Sera natuna na leaterai.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

motu: Kohat natuna na Aminadab; Aminadab natuna na Kora; Kora natuna na Asiri;
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

motu: Asiri natuna na Elkana; Elkana natuna na Ebiasafa; Ebiasafa natuna na Asiri;
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

motu: Asiri natuna na Tahata; Tahata natuna na Uriele; Uriele natuna na Usia, Usia natuna na Saul.
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

motu: Elkana natuna na Amasai bona Ahimoto;
english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

motu: Ahimoto natuna na Elkana; Elkana natuna na Sofai; Sofai natuna na Nahata;
english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

motu: Nahata natuna na Eliab; Eliab natuna na Ierohama; Ierohama natuna na Elkana.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

motu: Samuel natuna roboana na loel; iharuana na Abia.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

motu: Merari natuna na Mali; Mali natuna na Libni; Libni natuna na Simei, Simei natuna na Usa;
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

motu: Usa natuna na Simea; Simea natuna na Hagia, Hagia natuna na Asaia. Ane-abi taudia
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

motu: Maua helaḡana Iehova ena dubu ai e atoa murinai, David ese ini tatau e atodia, unuseni ai ane-abi gaukarana bae gunalaia.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house after the ark came to rest there.

motu: Idia na hebou kalagana dubuna vairanai toma-diho anedia e abi ema bona Solomon ese Iehova ena dubu e haginia Ierusalem ai; bona toma-diho karadia e kara, ta ta ena nega ena nega ai.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

motu: Ina ḡaukara e karaia taudia, mai natudia ida, ladadia bini. Kohat iduhuna amo: Ane-abi tauna Hemana, Ioel natuna. (Hari Ioel na Sarnuel natuna,
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

motu: Samuel na Elkana natuna, Elkana na Ierohama natuna, Ierohama na Eliele natuna, Eliele na Toa natuna,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

motu: Toa na Sufu natuna, Sufu na Elkana natuna, Elkana na Mahata natuna, Mahata na Amasai natuna,
english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

motu: Amasai na Elkana natuna, Elkana na Ioel natuna, Ioel na Asaria natuna, Asaria na Sefania natuna,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

motu: Sefania na Tahata natuna, Tahata na Asiri natuna, Asiri na Ebiasafa natuna, Ebiasafa na Kora natuna.
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

motu: Kora na Isahara natuna, Isahara na Kohat natuna, Kohat na Levi natuna, Levi na Israel natuna.)
english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

motu: Bona ia tadina Asaf; ia na ia idibana kahana ai e giniva. (Hari Asaf na Berekia natuna, Berekia na Simea natuna,
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

motu: Simea na Mikael natuna, Mikael na Baaseia natuna, Baaseia na Malkia natuna,
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

motu: Malkia na Eteni natuna, Eteni na Sera natuna, Sera na Adaia natuna,
english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

motu: Adaia na Etana natuna, Etana na Sima natuna, Sima na Simei natuna,
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

motu: Simei na Iahata natuna, Iahata na Gereson natuna, Gereson na Levi natuna.)
english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

motu: Lauri kahana ai na tadikakadia Merari garana, Etana Kisi. (Una Kisi na Abdi natuna, Abdi na Maluku natuna,
english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

motu: Maluku na Hasabia natuna, Hasabia na Amasia natuna, Amasia na Hilkia natuna,
english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

motu: Hilkia na Amasi natuna, Amasi na Bani natuna, Bani na Semere natuna,
english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

motu: Semere na Mali natuna, Mali na Musi natuna, Musi na Merari natuna, Merari na Levi natuna.)
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

motu: Bona tadikakadia Levi taudia na e gwauraidia hidi, Dirava ena dubu ai gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia iboudiai ikaradia taudia. Aaron garana
english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

motu: A Aaron mai garana ida ese boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, ḡole-oho bouboudia ihaboulaina patana latanai bona muramura mai bonadia patana latanai, helaḡa-herea gabuna gaukaradia iboudiai daidiai bona Israel ena herohemaino ikarana totona, Dirava ena hesiai tauna Mose ena haheḡani iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

motu: Aaron garana bini: natuna na Eleasara; Eleasara natuna na Fineha, Fineha natuna na Abisua,
english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

motu: Abisua natuna na Buki, Buki natuna na Usisi, Usisi natuna na Serahia,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

motu: Serahia natuna na Meraioto; Meraioto natuna na Amaria; Amaria natuna na Ahitubu;
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

motu: Ahitubu natuna na Sadok; Sadok natuna na Ahimasa.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

motu: Ini na edia noho gabudia, edia taruha ta ta hetoadia heḡereḡeredia ai. Aaron garana Kohat iduhuna taudia na mari ese e duanaidia;
english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

motu: bena Heberon, Iuda tanona ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida, e henidia;
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

motu: a hanua badana tanodia mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida na Kaleb Iefune e henia.
english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

motu: Aaron garana na roho-mauri hanuadia e henidia: Heberon; Libna, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Iatiri; Estemoa, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

motu: Hilene, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Debiri, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

motu: Asana, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Betesemese, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

motu: Bona Beniamina iduhuna amo: Geba, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Alemete, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Anatoto, mai ena rei gabudia ida. Edia iduhu lalodiai edia hanua iboudiai na gwauta-toi.
english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

motu: Kohat taudia oredia na hanua gwauta mari amo e henidia, Manase iduhuna kahana ena amo.
english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

motu: Gereson taudia edia iduhu ta ta amo na hanua gwauta-toi e gwaurai henidia, Isakara bona Asere bona Napatali bona Manase (Basan ai) iduhudia amo.
english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

motu: Merari taudia edia iduhu ta ta amo na hanua gwauta-rua e gwaurai henidia, Ruben bona Gad bona Sebulun iduhudia amo.
english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel taudia ese Levi taudia na hanua, mai edia rei gabudia ida, e henidia.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

motu: Bona Iuda bona Simeon bona Beniamina iduhudia amo ini ladadia vada e tore hanuadia na mari amo e henidia.
english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

motu: Kohat taudia edia iduhu haida na edia hanua e abidia, Efraim taudia edia tano amo.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

motu: Roho-mauri hanuadia na e henidia: Sekem, mai ena rei gabudia ida, Efraim ororodia ai; Gesere, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

motu: Iokomeama, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Bete-horono, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

motu: Aialono, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Gata-rimon, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

motu: Bona Manase iduhu-kahana amo: Anere, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Bileama, mai ena rei gabudia ida. Kohat taudia edia iduhu oredia edia gabu bunu.
english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

motu: Gereson taudia na Manase iduhu-kahana amo ini hanua e henidia: Golan, Basan ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Astaroto, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

motu: Bona Isakara iduhuna amo: Kede, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Dabera, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

motu: Ramoto, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Aneme, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

motu: Bona Asere iduhuna amo: Masala, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Abdon, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

motu: Hukoko, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Rehob, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

motu: Bona Napatali iduhuna amo: Kede, Galilea ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Hamon, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Kiriataimi, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

motu: Merari taudia orena na ini hanua Sebulun iduhuna amo e henidia: Rimono, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Taboro, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

motu: Bona Ioridane sinavaina unukahana ai, Ieriko ai, Ioridane mairiveina kahana ai, Ruben iduhuna amo: Besere, tano ḡaḡaena ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Iahasaha, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

motu: Kedemoto, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Mefata, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

motu: Bona Gad iduhuna amo: Ramoto, Gilead ai, mai ena rei gabudia ida; Mahanaim, mai ena rei gabudia ida;
english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

motu: Hesebon, mai ena rei gabudia ida; bona Iasere, mai ena rei gabudia ida.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

motu: Isakara natuna: Tola, Pua, Iasub, Simron; tatau hahani.
english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
