motu: Tola natuna: Usisi, Refaia, Ieriele, Iahamai, Ibsam, Semuel. Idia na edia iduhu, Tola iduhuna, ikwaradia. Idia na tuari taudia mai goadadia edia uru ai; iboudiai na gerebu-rua daha-rua sinahu-tauratoi, + 7:2 Gerebu-rua daha-rua sinahu-tauratoi = 22,600. * David ena nega ai.
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

motu: Usisi natuna na Isirahia. Isirahia natuna: Mikael, Obadia, Ioel, Isihia; tatau laima, iboudiai na lohia taudia;
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

motu: bona idia ida, edia uru ta ta ai bona edia iduhu ta ta heḡereḡeredia ai na tuari oreadia, iboudiai na gerebu-toi daha-tauratoi; + 7:4 Gerebu-toi daha-tauratoi = 36,000. * badina be adavadia bona natudia na hutuma.
english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

motu: Idia varavaradia, Isakara ena iduhu iboudiai lalodiai, na tuari taudia mai goadadia gerebu-taurahani daha-hitu, + 7:5 Gerebu-taurahani daha-hitu = 87,000. * edia uru ai ladadia e tore. Beniamina garana
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

motu: Beniamina natuna: Bela, Bekere, Iediaele, tatoiosi.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

motu: Bela natuna: Esbon, Usisi, Usiele, Ierimoto, Iri, Iaimaosi, iduhu kwaradia, tuari taudia mai goadadia. Edia uru ai ladadia e tore, iboudiai na gerebu-rua daha-rua toi-ahui hani. + 7:7 Gerebu-rua daha-rua toi-ahui hani = 22,034. *
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

motu: Bekere natuna: Semira, Ioasa, Eliesara, Elioenai, Omri, Ieremoto, Abia, Anatoto, Alemete.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

motu: Unu iboudiai na Bekere natuna; edia uru ai ladadia e tore. Idia na edia iduhu kwaradia, bona tuari taudia mai goadadia. Iboudiai na gerebu-rua sinahu-rua. + 7:9 Gerebu-rua sinahu-rua = 20,200. *
english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

motu: Iediaele natuna na Bilhan. Bilhan natuna; Ieusu, Beniamina, Ehud, Kenana, Setana, Tarasisi, Ahisahara.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

motu: Unu iboudiai na Iediaele natuna, edia iduhu ikwaradia taudia, tuari taudia mai goadadia. Iboudiai na gerebu-ta daha-hitu sinahu-rua, + 7:11 Gerebu-ta daha-hitu sinahu-rua = 17,200. * heheḡaegae tuari totona.
english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

motu: Supim bona Hupim na Iri natuna; Husim na Ahere natuna. Napatali garana
english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

motu: Napatali natuna: Iasiel, Guni, Iesere, Salumu; sinadia na Bilha. Manase garana
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

motu: Manase natuna na Asriel, Aram hahinena bogana amo; una hahine ese Makiri, Gilead tamana, danu e havaraia.
english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

motu: Makiri ese ulato e abidia, Hupirn bona Supim bae adavadia. Ia taihuna ladana na Maaka. Iharuana ladana na Selofehad; Selofehad na mai natuna hahinedia.
english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

motu: Bena Makiri adavana Maaka ese mero ta e havaraia, ladana e hatoa Perehe; ia tadina ladana na Serese; ia natuna ladadia na UIama bona Rakeme.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

motu: Ulama natuna na Bedana. Unu na Gilead garana; Gilead na Makiri natuna, Makiri na Manase natuna.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

motu: Ia taihuna Hamolekete ese Isihod bona Abiesere bona Mahala e havaradia.
english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

motu: Semida natuna: Ahiana, Sekem, Likihi, Aniama. Efraim garana
english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

motu: Efraim natuna na Sutela, (Sutela natuna na Bered, Bered natuna na Tahata, Tahata natuna na Eleada, Eleada natuna na Tahata,
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

motu: Tahata natuna na Sabada, Sabada natuna na Sutela); bona Esere, bona Eleada. Unu na Gata taudia, una tano ai vada e vara taudia, ese e aladia mase, badina be idia na e diho ela, edia boromakau ihenaodia.
english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

motu: Tamadia Efraim na taidia e tai, dina hoho; bena tadikakana ese ia tauna ihalona ema.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

motu: Bena Efraim na adavana dekenai e vareai; bena hahine na e rogorogo, mero ta e havaraia, ladana e hatoa Beria, badina be dika na ena ruma latanai vada e kau.
english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, + 7:23 “Beriah” is similar to the Hebrew word for “misfortune”. * because there was trouble with his house.

motu: Ia natuna hahinena na Seera; una hahine ese Bete-horono, henu bona atai hanuadia, bona Usene-sera e haginidia.
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

motu: Natuna maruanena na Refa; Refa natuna na Resefe; Resefe natuna na Tela; Tela natuna na Tahan;
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

motu: Tahan natuna na Ladan; Ladan natuna na Amihud; Amihud natuna na Elisama;
english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

motu: Elisama natuna na Nunu; Nunu natuna na Iosua.
english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

motu: Edia tano bona edia noho gabuna na Betele, mai hanuadia ida; bona laurabada kahana ai Naaran; bona lahara kahana ai Gesere, mai hanuadia ida; bona Sekem, mai hanuadia ida; bona Aiaha, mai hanuadia ida;
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

motu: bona Manase taudia edia tano hetoana ai danu, Bete-seana mai hanuadia ida; bona Taanak, mai hanuadia ida; bona Megido, mai hanuadia ida; bona Doro, mai hanuadia ida. Unu hanua lalodiai Iosef Israel garana e nohova. Asere garana
english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

motu: Asere natuna: Imna, Isva, Isvi, Beria, bona taihudia Sera.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

motu: Beria natuna: Hebere bona Malkiel, Birisaiti tamana.
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

motu: Hebere natuna: laflete, Somere, Hotama, bona taihudia Sua.
english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

motu: Iaflete natuna: Pasaka, Bimihala, Asavata. Unu na laflete natuna.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

motu: Ia tadina Semere natuna: Roga, Iehuba, Aram.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

motu: Ia tadina Helere natuna: Sofa, Imna, Selese, Amala.
english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

motu: Sofa natuna: Sua, Haranefere, Sual, Beri, Imra,
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

motu: Besere, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Itiran, Bera.
english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

motu: Ietere natuna: Iefune, Pisipa, Ara.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

motu: Ula natuna: Ara, Haniel, Risia.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

motu: Unu iboudiai na Asere taudia, edia iduhu kwaradia, e abidia dae taudia, tuari taudia mai goadadia, Iohia ikwaradia. Edia uru ai ladadia e tore, tuan lao totona; iboudiai na tatau gerebu-rua daha-tauratoi.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

motu: Beniamina natuna roboana na Bela; iharuana na Asbel; ihatoina na Ahara;
english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

motu: ihahanina na Noha; iha-imana na Rafa.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

motu: Bela natuna: Adara, Gera, Abihud,
english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

motu: Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa,
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

motu: Gera, Sefufana, Hurama.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

motu: Ehud natuna bini (idia na Geba taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, gabeai e laohaidia, Manahata ai e hanohodia):
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

motu: Naaman, Ahia, Gera (ladana ta Hegelama); ia na Usa bona Ahihud tamadia.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

motu: Saharaimi ese natuna e havaradia, Moab tanona ai, adavana raruosi Husim bona Baara e hadihodia murinai.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

motu: Natuna haida adavana Hodese enai e havaradia: Iobab, Sibia, Mesa, Malkam,
english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

motu: Ieusu, Sakia, Mirima. Natuna bunu; idia na iduhu kwaradia.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

motu: Natuna haida danu adavana Husim enai e havaradia: Abitub bona Elpala.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

motu: Elpala natuna: Ebere, Misama, Semede (ia ese Ono, bona Lod mai hanuana ida, e haginidia),
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

motu: bona Beria bona Sema (idia na Aialono taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, bona idia ese Gata taudia e hadareredia),
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

motu: bona Ahio bona Sasaka bona Ieremoto.
english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

motu: Beria natuna: Sebadia, Arada, Edere,
english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

motu: Mikael, Ispa, loha.
english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

motu: Elpala natuna: Sebadia, Mesulama, Hiski, Hebere,
english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

motu: Isimerai, Islia, Iobab.
english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

motu: Sirnei natuna: Iakimi, Sikri, Sabdi,
english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

motu: Elienai, Siletai, Eliele,
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

motu: Adaia, Beraia, Simirata.
english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

motu: Sasaka natuna: Isipana, Ebere, Eliele,
english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

motu: Abdon, Sikri, Hanana,
english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

motu: Hanania, Elam, Antotia,
english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

motu: Ifideia, Penuel.
english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

motu: Ierohama natuna: Samaserai, Seharia, Atalia,
english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

motu: Iaresia, Elia, Sikn.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

motu: Unu na iduhu kwaradia bona lohia taudia, edia uru lalodiai. Idia na Ierusalem ai e nohova. Saulo senena bona garana
english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

motu: Ieiele, Gibeon tamana, na Gibeon ai e nohova; ia adavana ladana na Maaka.
english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

motu: Natuna roboana na Abdon; ia murinai Suru, Kisa, Baal, Nadab,
english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

motu: Gedoro, Ahio, Sekere,
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

motu: bona Mikloto (ia na Simea tamana). Idia na varavaradia italaidia ai e nohova Ierusalem ai, tadikakadia ida.
english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

motu: Nere na Kisa tamana, Kisa na Saulo tamana, Saulo na Ionatan bona Malkisua bona Abinadab bona Esebaal tamadia.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

motu: Ionatan natuna na Merib-baal; Merib-baal na Mika tamana.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

motu: Mika natuna: Pitono, Melek, Tarea, Ahasa.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

motu: Ahasa na Iehoada tamana; Iehoada na Alemete bona Asamavete bona Simiri tamadia; Simiri na Mosa tamana.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

motu: Mosa na Binea tamana; Binea natuna na Rafa; Rafa natuna na Eleasa; Eleasa natuna na Asele.
english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

motu: Asele natuna na tauratoi, ladadia bini: Asarikama, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia, Hanana. Unu iboudiai na Asele natuna.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

motu: Ia tadina Esek natuna bini: roboana na Ulama; iharuana na Ieusu; ihatoina na Elifelete.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

motu: Ulama natuna na tuari taudia mai goadadia, peva taudia, natudia bona tubudia na hutuma, iboudiai na sinahu-ta imahui. Unu iboudiai na Beniamina taudia.
english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

motu: Taunabunai Israel idoinai ladadia e tore, edia uru ta ta ai; ini na Israel Pavapavadia Bukana ai e hetore. Iuda taudia na e abidia oho, Babulono ai e hanohodia, asie momokani dainai.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, + 9:1 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

motu: Edia tano ai bona edia hanua ai e noho henidia lou matama taudia na Israel taudia, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi taudia, bona dubu ena hesiai taudia.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

motu: Iuda bona Beniamina bona Efraim bona Manase taudia haida na Ierusalem ai e nohova.
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

motu: Ta be Utai, Amihud natuna; Amihud na Omri natuna, Omri na Imri natuna, Imri na Bani natuna; Bani na Perese Iuda garana ta.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

motu: Bona Silono taudia: Asaia, tau-guna, mai natuna hahidaosi ida.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

motu: Sera garana: Ieuele bona varavara verina, tatau sinahu-tauratoi taurahanita-ahui.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

motu: Bona Beniamina taudia: Salu (ia na Mesulama natuna, Mesulama na Hodavia natuna, Hodavia na Hasenua natuna);
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

motu: bona Ibneia Ierohama; bona Elaha (ia na Usisi natuna, Usisi na Mikri natuna); bona Mesulama (ia na Sefatia natuna, Sefatia na Reuele natuna, Reuele na Ibnia natuna);
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

motu: bona varavaradia, edia uru ta ta ai, tatau sinahutaurahanita imahui tauratoi. Ini iboudiai na iduhu kwaradia, ta ta ena iduhu ena iduhu ai.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia: Iedaia, Iehoiaribi, Iakin,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

motu: bona Asaria (ia na Hilkia natuna, Hilkia na Mesulama natuna, Mesulama na Sadok natuna, Sadok na Meraioto natuna, Meraioto na Ahitubu natuna - ia na Dirava ena dubu itataona tau badana);
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

motu: bona Adaia (ia na Ierohama natuna, Ierohama na Pasahuru natuna, Pasahuru na Malkia natuna); bona Maasai (ia na Adiele natuna, Adiele na Iahasera natuna, Iahasera na Mesulama natuna, Mesulama na Mesilemiti natuna, Mesilemiti na Imere natuna);
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

motu: bona varavaradia, edia iduhu kwaradia, tatau daha-ta sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui, Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia mai dibadia herea taudia.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

motu: Levi taudia: Semaia (ia na Hasub natuna, Hasub na Asarikama natuna, Asarikama na Hasabia natuna, Merari garana taudia);
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

motu: bona Bakabakara; bona Herese; bona Galala; bona Matania (ia na Mika natuna, Mika na Sikri natuna, Sikri na Asaf natuna);
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

motu: bona Obadia (ia na Semaia natuna, Semaia na Galala natuna, Galala na Iedutunu natuna); bona Berekia (ia na Asa natuna, Asa na Elkana natuna; hari Elkana na Netofa taudia edia hanua ai e nohova).
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia bini: Salumu, Akubu, Talmon, Ahiman, mai varavaradia ida. Ikwaradia na Salumu.
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

motu: Guna idia na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou e gimaiava, mairiveina kahana ai. Levi taudia edia taruha ikoukouna igimana taudia bunu.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

motu: Salumu (ia na Kore natuna, Kore na Ebiasafa natuna, Ebiasafa na Kora natuna) bona iena iduhu, Kora iduhuna, taudia na dubu ḡaukaradia e biagudia bona kalaga raka-vareaina e gimaia, senedia ese Iehova ena taruha e biaguava bona raka-vareaina e gimaiava heḡereḡerena.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.

motu: Nega gunadia ai, Fineha Eleasara ese e biagudia, bona Iehova na ia ida.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

motu: Sekaria Meselemia na ikoukou igimana tauna, hebou kalagana raka-vareaina ai.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

motu: Ini iboudiai, raka-vareai ikoukoudia igimadia dainai e duanaidia taudia, na sinahu-rua gwauta-rua; edia uru ta ta ai ladadia e tore, edia hanua heḡereḡeredia ai. David bona mata-hanai tauna Samuel ese e haginidia, abidadama dagina ai.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

motu: Taunabunai, idia bona natudia na Iehova ena dubu, kalaga dubuna, ikoukoudia ibiagudia bona igimadia taudia.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia na kaha haniosi ai, laurabada bona lahara, mirigini bona tahodiho, e gimadiava;
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

motu: bona varavaradia hanua ai na taravadia e atu, dina hitu hitu amo baema, edia nega edia nega ai, bae bamodia totona.
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

motu: Badina be ikoukou igimadia taudia badadia hahaniosi na Levi taudia; idia ese Dirava ena dubu daiutudia bona kohudia e nariva.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

motu: Idia na Dirava ena dubu heḡeḡemadai e nohova, badina be edia ḡaukara korikori na bae gimaia, bona daba daba iboudiai bae kehoa.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

motu: Idia haida ese tomadiho ai e ḡaukaralaiva ḡau helagadia e nariva; edia ḡaukara be e atodia vareai bona e abidia lasi negadia ai bae hagaudia.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

motu: Ma haida edia ḡaukara na dubu kohudia bona ḡau helaḡadia iboudiai, bona flaoa namo-hereana, bona vine ranuna, bona dehoro, bona muramura mai bonadia, bona aniani mamidia ihanamodia muramuradia, inaridia.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

motu: Ma haida, hahelaḡa taudia natudia, ese aniani mamidia ihanamodia muramuradia e bulo hegaeḡaeva.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

motu: Matitia, Levi tauna ta, Salumu tau Kora natuna roboana, ese ataga igabudia e nariava.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

motu: Bona varavaradia haida, Kohat iduhuna taudia, ese flaoa helaḡana igabuna e nariava, dina helagadia iboudiai e heḡaeḡaelaiava.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

motu: Unu na ane-abi taudia, Levi iduhudia ikwaradia taudia, dubu daiutudia ai e nohova, bona asi edia ḡaukara idauna ta, badina be dina hanuaboi e gaukarava.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

motu: Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia bunu; idia na hegunalai taudia, edia uru ta ta ai; idia danu Ierusalem ai e nohova. Saulo senena bona garana
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

motu: Ieiele, Gibeon tamana, na Gibeon ai e nohova; ia adavana ladana na Maaka.
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

motu: Natuna roboana na Abdon; ia murinai Suru, Kisa, Baal, Nere, Nadab,
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

motu: Gedoro, Ahio, Sekaria, Mikloto.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

motu: Mikloto na Simeama tamana. Idia na varavaradia italaidia ai e nohova Ierusalem ai, tadikakadia ida.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

motu: Nere na Kisa tamana, Kisa na Saulo tamana, Saulo na Ionatan bona Malkisua bona Abinadab bona Esebaal tamadia.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

motu: Ionatan natuna na Merib-baal; Merib-baal na Mika tamana.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

motu: Mika natuna: Pitono, Melek, Tarea, Ahasa.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

motu: Ahasa na Iara tamana; Iara na Alemete bona Asamavete bona Simin tamadia; Simiri na Mosa tamana;
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

motu: Mosa na Binea tamana; Binea natuna na Refaia; Refaia natuna na Eleasa; Eleasa natuna na Asele.
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

motu: Asele natuna na tauratoi, ladadia bini: Asarikama, Bokeru, Ismael, Searia, Obadia, Hanana. Asele natuna bunu.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

motu: Filistia taudia ese Israel taudia e tuari henidia; bena Israel taudia na Filistia taudia vairadia amo e heau, ela bona Gilboa ororona ai Filistia taudia ese e aladia ore.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

motu: Bena Filistia taudia ese Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia ida e lasidia tao; bena Filistia taudia ese Saulo natuna mamaruanedia Ionatan bona Abinadab bona Malkisua e aladia mase.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

motu: Tuari na auka herea, Saulo enai; peva taudia ese e davaria, bena edia diba amo e haberoa.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

motu: Bena Saulo ese ena kesi ihuana tauna e hamaoroa, eto, Emu dare a veria lasi, ba gwadagu mase, ini asie peritomedia taudia na baema, bae kirikirilaigu na garina. A ena kesi ihuana tauna na e gwau edeede, badina be e gari dikadika. Taunabunai, Saulo ese ena dare e abia, bena matana ai sibona e hetoḡe.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But|strong="H3588" * his|strong="H5375" * armor|strong="H3627" * bearer|strong="H5375" * would not|strong="H3808" *, for|strong="H3588" * he|strong="H3588" * was|strong="H7586" * terrified|strong="H3966" *. Therefore|strong="H5921" * Saul|strong="H7586" * took|strong="H3947" * his|strong="H5375" * sword|strong="H2719" * and|strong="H2719" * fell|strong="H5307" * on|strong="H5921" * it|strong="H5921" *.

motu: Ena kesi ihuana tauna ese e itaia, Saulo vada e mase, bena ia danu ena dare matana ai e hetoḡe, bena e mase.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

motu: Saulo na unu e mase toma, bona natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi bona ena ruma taudia iboudiai na ia ida e mase bou.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

motu: Bena Israel taudia iboudiai koura ai e nohova ese tuari oreana e itaia vada e heau, bona Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia ida vada e mase; una negana ai idia ese edia hanua e rakatanidia, e heau. Bena Filistia taudia ema, unu hanua e noholaidia.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

motu: Daba rerena ai Filistia taudia na ema, mase taudia edia dabua bae abi eto. Bena Saulo mai natuna mamaruanedia tatoiosi ida masedia ai e davaridia, Gilboa ororona ai.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

motu: Bena ena dabua e koki oho, bona kwarana bona ena tuari dabuadia e abi, e laohai. Bena idia ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia karoho, Filistia tanona idoinai, hari namona na edia kaivakuku dubudia ai bona edia bese taudia vairadiai bae piua totona.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

motu: Bena ena tuari dabuadia na edia dirava edia dubu ai e atodia, bona kwarana na edia dirava ta ladana Dagon ena dubu ai e kapaia kau.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

motu: A Iabese-gilead taudia iboudiai na Filistia taudia edia kara iboudiai Saulo enai haridia e kamonai,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

motu: bena boga-auka taudia iboudiai e tore isi, Saulo tau-anina bona natuna mamaruanedia tau-anidia na e abidia oho, Iabese e laohaidia, turiadia na Iabese oak auna henunai e guridia. Bena dina hitu e anivaga.
english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

motu: Taunabunai Saulo na e mase, asi ena momokani dainai; ia na Iehova enai se momokani, Iehova ena haheḡani se badinaia, bona rohe hahinena enai hahekau e tahua,
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

motu: a Iehova enai hahekau se tahua. Taunabunai, Iehova ese e alaia mase, bona basileia na David lese e henia.
english: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

motu: Bena Israel idoinai na David dekenai e hebou, Heberon ai, eto, A itaia, ai na oi turiamu bona oi hidiomu.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

motu: Nega gunadia ai, Saulo e lohiava ai, oi ese Israel o hakaua lasi bona o hakaua vareai. Bena Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e hereva henimu, eto, Oi na egu bese Israel ireḡuna tauna ai bona egu bese Israel pavapavana ai baola.
english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel tau-badadia iboudiai na hanua pavapavana dekena ela, Heberon ai; bena David na idia ida e hegwauhamata heheni Heberon ai, Iehova vairanai. Bena idia ese David e horoa, Israel pavapavana, Iehova ena hereva Samuel ena amo heḡereḡerena. David ese Siona e abia
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh. They anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.

motu: David bona Israel idoinai na Ierusalem (ladana ta na Iebusu) ela. Iebusu taudia, una tano e noholaiava taudia, na unuseni ai.
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

motu: Iebusu taudia ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na iniseni ai basio raka vareai. Ḡau tamona, David ese Siona kohorona e abia; una na David ena hanua.
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

motu: David eto, Daika ese Iebusu taudia baine hadareredia guna, ia na lohia bona tuari biaguna ai bainela. Bena Ioab Seruia na e dae guna; una dainai ia na lohia ai ela.
english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

motu: Bena David na una kohoro ai e nohova; una dainai ladana e hatoa “David ena hanua”.
english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

motu: Bena ia ese hanua e hadaia heḡeḡe, Milo kohorona amo e matamaia ela bona e heḡeḡe dae. A Ioab ese hanua orena e haginia lou.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

motu: Bena David na e bada herea e laova, badina be Iehova Sabaota na ia ida. David ena goada taudia
english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh of Armies was with him.

motu: David ena goada taudia lohiadia bini. Idia ese e durua goadagoadava ena basileia lalonai, Israel idoinai ida, pavapava ai bae halaoa totona, Iehova ese Israel e herevalaia heḡereḡerena.
english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.

motu: David ena goada taudia herevadia bini: Iasobeama, Hakamoni tauna, na tatau tatoi ikwaradia tauna. Nega ta ai ia ese ena io amo tatau sinahu-toi e aladia mase.
english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

motu: Unu tatoiosi bogaragidiai, ia murinai na Eleasara; ia na Dodo, tau Ahohi, natuna.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

motu: Filistia taudia na tuari totona Pasadamimi ai e hebou negana ai, una tau danu David ida unuseni ai. Bali umana ta na unuseni ai, bena Israel taudia na Filistia taudia vairadia amo e heau.
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

motu: A ia na uma bogaraginai e gini, e gimaia, bona Filistia taudia e aladia mase; una kwalimu badana amo Iehova ese e hamauridia.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.

motu: Lohia toiahuiosi bogaragidia amo tatau tatoi na nadi-gini ela, David dekenai, Adulama kohuana ai. Una negana ai Filistia taudia edia tuari oreana na Refaim kourana ai e taruha.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

motu: David na gabu aukana ai, a Filistia taudia na Betelehem ai e hegimava.
english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

motu: Bena David na mai lalo-hekisehekisena ida e hereva, eto, Ta ese Betelehem ikoukou badibadinai guri e miamu ranuna kuri ta bema henigu, bama inua.
english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

motu: Bena hari goadaherea taudia tatoiosi na Filistia taudia edia taruha amo e tata uru, Betelehem ikoukou badibadinai guri e miamu ranuna e utua, bena e abia, David dekena e laohaia. A David ese inuna se ura; ia na e bubua diho Iehova ena;
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,

motu: eto, Egu Dirava vairanai, unu baina kara toma na lalogu ai se heḡereḡeremu, lasi ona lasi vaitani. Ini tatau edia mauri rarana baina inu a? Badina be edia mauri inegedia asie laloa, bena e mailaia. Taunabunai, ia na inuna se ura. Ini kara be goada-herea taudia tatoiosi ese e kara.
english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

motu: Abisai, Ioab tadina, na hari toiahuiosi biagudia. Ia ese tatau sinahu-toi na ena io amo e aladia mase; bena ladana e dae, idia tatoiosi ida heḡereḡere.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

motu: Hari toiahuiosi bogaragidiai, ia mo sibona harina vada e bada, bena biagudia ai ela. A ia na hari tatoiosi ida se heḡereḡere.
english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

motu: Benaia Iehoiada na boga-auka tauna ta, Kabsele amo; ia na kara badadia ikaradia tauna. Ia ese Ariele natuna raruosi Moab amo na e aladia mase. Ia danu e hekei lao, leona ta na guri lalonai e alaia mase, snow e dihova dinana ai.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

motu: Aigupto tauna ta danu ia ese e alaia mase; una tau na tau bada-hereana, ena lata na kiubit ima. Una Aigupto tauna imana na mai iona; una io na dabua ihatuna tauna ena au na heto. A Benaia ese mai auna ida ia e lao henia, io na Aigupto tauna imana amo e dadihaia, bena sibona ena io amo e gwadaia mase.
english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits + 11:23 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. Therefore this Egyptian was about 7 feet and 6 inches or 2.28 meters tall. * high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

motu: Ini kara na Benaia Iehoiada ese e karava, bena ia harina na hari goada-herea taudia tatoiosi haridia ida e gwauraidia hebou.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

motu: Ia na mai harina unu toiahuiosi bogaragidiai; ḡau tamona hari tatoiosi ida se heḡereḡere. Bena David ese ia igimana oreana biaguna ai e halaoa.
english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

motu: Goada-herea taudia tuari oreadia lalodiai ladadia bini: Asahele, Ioab tadina; Elhanan Dodo, tau Betelehem;
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

motu: Samota, tau Harod; Helese, tau Pelono;
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

motu: Ira Ikese, Tekoa tauna; Abiesere, Anatoto tauna;
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

motu: Sibekai, tau Husata; Ilai, tau Ahohi;
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

motu: Maharai, tau Netofa; Helede Baanaha, tau Netofa;
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

motu: Itai Ribai, tau Gibea, Beniamina iduhuna tauna; Benaia, tau Piratono;
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

motu: Hurai, Gaasa sinavaidia amo; Abiele, Araba tauna;
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

motu: Asamavete, Baharumu tauna; Eliaba, tau Saalbon;
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

motu: Haseme, tau Gisono; Ionatan Sage, tau Harara;
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

motu: Ahiama Sakara, tau Harara; Elifala Uru;
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

motu: Hefere, tau Mekerata; Ahia, tau Pelono;
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

motu: Hesero, Karamele tauna; Naarai Esebai;
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

motu: Ioel, Natan tadina; Mibhara Hagri;
english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

motu: Seleke, Amono tauna; Naharai, tau Beroto, Ioab Seruia ena kesi ihuana tauna;
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

motu: Ira, tau Itiri; Gareb, tau Itiri;
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

motu: Uria, Hiti tauna; Sabada Ahalai;
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

motu: Adina Sisa, Ruben iduhuna tauna, Ruben taudia edia lohia ta, bona tatau toi-ahui ia ida;
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

motu: Hanana Maaka; Iosafat, tau Mitini;
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

motu: Usia, tau Astaroto; Sama bona Ieiele, Hotama tau Aroere natuna raruosi;
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

motu: Iediaele Simri, bona ia tadina loha, tau Tisi;
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

motu: Eliele, Mahava tauna; Ieribai bona Iosavia, Elnama natuna raruosi; Itima, Moab tauna;
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

motu: Eliele; Obed; bona Iaasiel, tau Mesoba.
english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

motu: Ini na David dekena ela Siklag ai taudia. Una negana ai David na asi ena raka evaeva dalana, Saulo Kisa dainai. Goada-herea taudia, tuari ai e duruava taudia, haida be idia.
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

motu: Idia na peva taudia; diba ikinodia bona vilipopo nadidia idavedia, ima-idibadia eiava ima-lauridia amo, na mai dibadia; idia na Beniamina taudia, Saulo varavarana.
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

motu: Ginigunana na Ahiesere, bona ia murinai na Ioasa; raruosi Sema, tau Gibea, natuna. Idia muridiai na lesiele bona Pelet, Asamavete natuna raruosi; Beraka; Iehu, tau Anatoto;
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

motu: Isimaia, Gibeon tauna, goada-herea tauna ta tatau toiahuiosi bogaragidiai bona toiahuiosi igunalaidia tauna ta; Ieremia; Iahasiel; Iohanan; Iosabad, tau Gedera;
english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

motu: Elusai; Ierirnoto; Bealia; Semaria; Sefatia, Harufu tauna;
english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

motu: Elkana; Isia; Asarele; Ioesere bona Iasobeama, Kora taudia;
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

motu: Ioela bona Sebadia, Ierohama tau Gedoro natuna raruosi.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

motu: Goada-herea bona tuari mai dibadia taudia haida Gad iduhuna amo na David dekena e hanai. Ia na ena gabu aukana ai, tano gagaena ai. Idia na kesi bona io dibadia herea; vairadia na leona vairadia na heheto; edia heau na uda diana ororo ai e heaumu na heto.
english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

motu: Gini-gunana na Esere; iharuana na Obadia; ihatoina na Eliab;
english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

motu: ihahanina na Misimana; iha-imana na Ieremia;
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

motu: ihatauratoina na Alai; ihahituna na Eliele;
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

motu: ihataurahanina na Iohanan; ihataurahani-tana na Elsabad;
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

motu: Ihagwautana na Ieremia; ihagwauta-tana na Makabanai.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

motu: Ini Gad taudia na tuari lohiadia; dagimaragi taudia be sinahu-ta e biagudia, dagi-bada taudia na daha-ta e biagudia.
english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

motu: Tatau bini Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, hua gini-gunana lalonai, abata e lasiva negana ai; bena idia ese koura ai e nohova taudia iboudiai, laurabada kahana ai bona lahara kahana ai, e luludia karoho.
english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

motu: Beniamina bona Iuda iduhudia taudia haida na David ena gabu aukana ema.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

motu: David na ihedavan-henidia e raka lasi, bena e hereva henidia, eto, Bema hetura ai vada oma, lau idurugu totona, bena lau lalogu bona umui lalomui bae tamona; a bema inaigu ediai taogu itorena totona vada oma, ena be lau imagu na asi edia kerere, bena seneda edia Dirava ese baine itamui bona baine gwau henimui.
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

motu: Bena Lauma ese Amasai, toiahuiosi biagudia, na e rohea; bena ia na eto, David e, ai na oiemu; Iese natuna e, ai na oi ida! Maino avabia, maino oi latamu ai, bona idurumu taudia latadiai danu! Badina be emu Dirava ese e durumumu. Bena David ese e abidia dae, bona ena tuari taudia biagudia ai e halaodia.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

motu: David na Filistia taudia ida ema, Saulo bae tuari henia totona, negana ai Manase taudia haida na e hanai, David ena kaha ai. (Ḡau tamona, ia ese Filistia taudia se durudia, badina be Filistia lohiadia na e henega bou, bena e siaia oho, eto, Ia na biaguna Saulo dekena ma baine hanai negana ai, dika na kwaramai ai baine kau na garina.)
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

motu: Siklag ela negana ai hari Manase taudia na ienai e hanai ladadia bini: Adna, Iosabad, Iediaele, Mikael, Iosabad, Elihu, Siletai; idia na daha lohiadia Manase ai.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

motu: Idia ese David e durua, ala-ala taudia ilao-ahudia; badina be idia iboudiai na goada-herea taudia bona tuari lohiadia.
english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

motu: Dina ta ta amo tatau na David dekena e maiva, bae durua totona, ela bona tuari oreana na bada herea, e kara Dirava ena tuari oreana ta na heto. David ena tuari oreana Heberon ai
english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

motu: Tuari taudia edia orea ta ta e hagaudia ḡaudia bini; idia na David dekena ela, Heberon ai, Saulo ena basileia na ia bae henia eto, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena.
english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to Yahweh’s word.

motu: Iuda taudia, mai edia kesi bona edia io, na tuari taudia daha-tauratoi sinahu-taurahani.
english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

motu: Simeon taudia, goada-herea taudia tuari ai, na daha-hitu sinahu-ta.
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

motu: Levi taudia na daha-hani sinahu-tauratoi.
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

motu: Tau lohia Iehoiada, Aaron ena iduhu tauna, ida ela taudia na daha-toi sinahu-hitu.
english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

motu: Sadok, tau eregabe, goada-herea tauna, bona tuari lohiadia ruahui-rua, ia tamana ena iduhu amo.
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

motu: Beniamina taudia, Saulo varavarana, na daha-toi; idia hutuma na ema bona hari Saulo ena iduhu enai e tao.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

motu: Efraim taudia gerebu-rua sinahu-taurahani, + 12:30 Gerebu-rua sinahu-taurahani = 20,800. * goada-herea taudia, mai haridia, tamadia edia iduhu ai.
english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

motu: Manase iduhu-kahana taudia na gerebu-ta daha-taurahani, + 12:31 Gerebu-ta daha-taurahani = 18,000. * vada e duanaidia, baela David na pavapava ai bae halaoa.
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

motu: Isakara lohiadia na sinahu-rua, nega ihaerona mai dibadia bona Israel na ede baine karaia toma danu dibadia taudia; varavaradia iboudiai na idia edia siahu henunai.
english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

motu: Sebulun taudia na gerebu-ima, + 12:33 Gerebu-ima = 50,000. * tuari manada taudia, edia tuari ḡaudia iboudiai na imadia ai, bona lalodia na tamona, David bae durua eto.
english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

motu: Napatali amo tuari lohiadia daha-ta, mai edia tuari taudia gerebu-toi daha-hitu, + 12:34 Gerebu-toi daha-hitu = 37,000. * mai kesidia bona mai iodia ida.
english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

motu: Dan taudia na gerebu-rua daha-taurahani sinahu-tauratoi, + 12:35 Gerebu-rua daha-taurahani sinahu-tauratoi = 28,600. * mai edia tuari ḡaudia ida.
english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

motu: Asere taudia na gerebu-hani, + 12:36 Gerebu-hani = 40,000. * tuari manada taudia, heheḡaeḡae tuari.
english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

motu: Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana Ioridane sinavaina unukahana amo, tatau iboudiai na domaga-ta gerebu-rua, + 12:37 Domaga-ta gerebu-rua = 120,000. * mai edia tuari ḡaudia iboudiai imadia ai.
english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

motu: Ini tuari taudia iboudiai na edia tuari oreadia ta ta ai e raka lao Heberon, edia lalo-hadai korikori be David na Israel idoinai pavapavana ai bae halaoa; Israel taudia oredia iboudiai danu edia lalo-hadai tamona na unuheto.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

motu: Dina toi unuseni ai David ida e nohova, e anianiva bona e inuinuva, badina be tadikakadia ese adia vada e abi heḡaeḡae.
english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

motu: Bona noho hetabira taudia danu, ela bona Isakara bona Sebulun bona Napatali ese aniani ḡaudia e mailai, doniki bona kamelo bona hosi bona boromakau mamaruanedia dorudia ai: flaoa momo; suke manedia; vine huahuadia, e hakaukaudia ḡaudia, takodia; vine ranuna bona dehoro; boromakau mamaruanedia bona mamoe; badina be Israel tanona ai e moaleva dainai.
english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

motu: David na daha lohiadia bona sinahu lohiadia bona hegunalai taudia iboudiai ida e henega bou.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

motu: David ese Israel hegogona idoinai e hamaoroa, eto, Lalomui bema heḡereḡere bona Iehova, eda Dirava, bema ura, ita ese hereva baita siaia, varavarada Israel tanona idoinai e nohomu ediai, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia rei hanuadia ai e nohomu ediai danu; bena idia na baema, ita ida baitame tao hebou.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana baita loulaia, badina be Saulo ena nega ai asita haḡerea.
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

motu: E hegogo taudia iboudiai lalodia e hatamona unu bae kara toma, badina be taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai una na kara maorona.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

motu: Taunabunai David ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia, Aigupto sinavaina ladana Sihoro amo ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina ai, Dirava ena maua helaḡana na Kiriat-iearimi amo bae mailaia totona.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

motu: Bena David bona Israel idoinai na Baala ela (una na Kiriat-ieanmi, Iuda hanuana ta), Dirava ena maua helaḡana, Iehova, kerubi daediai e helaimu Diravana, ladana e nemailaia ḡauna, na unu amo bae daelaia eto.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana na rerue matamatana latanai Abinadab ena ruma amo e laohaia; Usa bona Ahio ese rerue e heaulaia.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

motu: David bona Israel idoinai na Dirava vairanai e moale hisi dae mai goadadia idoinai, mai anedia bona hatai-hatai ḡaudia idau-idau bona tareko bona botabota auridia bona kibi reḡedia ida.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

motu: Idia na Kidono ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai e kau, bena Usa ese imana e toia roro, maua helaḡana baine dogoa tao eto, badina be boromakau mamaruanedia na e hetutuhi.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

motu: Bena Iehova ena badu na Usa latanai e kau; bena e rahua mase, imana na maua helaḡana e toi roro henia dainai; bena unuseni ai e mase, Dirava vairanai.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

motu: Bena David na e badu, Iehova ese Usa e rahua mase dainai; bena una gabu ladana e hatoamu Perese-usa, + 13:11 “Perese-usa” anina be “Usa ialana”. * ema bona harihari.
english: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

motu: Una dina ai David ese Dirava garina e gari, eto, Dirava ena maua helaḡana na egu gabu ede baina laohaia toma?
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

motu: Taunabunai David ese maua helaḡana na ena gabu, David ena hanua, se laohaia, to e heaulaia siri, Obed-edom, tau Gata, ena ruma e laohaia.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana na Obed-edom ena ruma ai e miava, ena ruma taudia ediai, hua toi, bona Iehova ese Obed-edom ena ruma taudia bona ena ḡau iboudiai e hanamodia.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

motu: Hirama, Turo pavapavana, ese gwaukau taudia na David dekena e siaidia; bona sida audia, bona nadi iḡaukaralaidia taudia, bona kamuta taudia, iena ruma auta bae haginia totona.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

motu: Bena David lalona e parara, Iehova ese ia vada e haginia, Israel pavapavana, bona ena basileia danu vada e hadaea herea, ena orea taudia Israel bagudiai. David natuna haida e vara Ierusalem ai
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

motu: David ese hahine haida ma e adavadia Ierusalem ai, bona natuna mamaruanedia bona natuna hahinedia haida e havaradia.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

motu: Natuna Ierusalem ai e havaradia taudia ladadia bini: Samua, Sobab, Natan, Solomon,
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

motu: Ibihara, Elisua, Elpelete,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

motu: Noga, Nefeg, Iafia,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

motu: Elisama, Beliada, Elifelete. David ese Filistia taudia e hadareredia
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

motu: Filistia taudia na e kamonai David vada e horoa, Israel idoinai pavapavana; bena Filistia taudia iboudiai na David itahuna e dae ela. David e kamonai, bena e raka lasi, baine tuari henidia.
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

motu: Filistia taudia na vada ema, Refaim kourana taudia tuari e lasi henidia.
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

motu: Bena David ese Dirava e nanadaia, eto, Bainala, Filistia taudia baina tuari henidia a? Imagu ai bavatodia eiava? Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, lau ese oi imamu ai baina atodia.
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh|strong="H3068" * said to|strong="H3068" * him|strong="H5414" *, “ Go|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" *; for|strong="H5921" * I|strong="H5414" * will|strong="H3068" * deliver|strong="H5414" * them|strong="H5414" * into|strong="H5927" * your|strong="H3068" * hand|strong="H3027" *.”

motu: Bena ia na Baal-perasimi ela; unuseni ai David ese e hadareredia. David eto, Dirava ese inaigu na lau imagu amo vada e haheḡiḡidia dobi, abata ese ḡau ta bema ḡiḡia dobi na heto. Una dainai una gabu ladana e hatoamu Baal-perasimi. + 14:11 “Baal-perasimi” anina be “gau ihaheḡiḡi-dobidia lohiana” *
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim. + 14:11 “Baal Perazim” means “The Lord who breaks out”. *

motu: Edia kaivakuku diravadia na unuseni ai e rakatanidia; bena David na e haheḡani, bena e doudia.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

motu: Filistia taudia ese koura taudia tuan ma e lasi henidia.
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

motu: Bena David ese Dirava ma e nanadaia lou negana ai, Dirava ese e hamaoroa, eto, Basio gavadia; ba raka heḡeḡe, baka + 14:14 “Baka” be au ta ladana Heberu gado ai. * audia italaidia amo ba mai henidia.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

motu: Bena reḡe ta baka audia dondia ai ba kamonai, e kara tuari taudia e raka hanaimu na heheto, vada ba raka lasi, ba tuari henidia; badina be Dirava vada e raka lasi guna oi vairamu ai, Filistia edia tuari taudia irahu-masedia totona.
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

motu: Bena David ese Dirava ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena e karaia; bena Filistia taudia e rahudia mase, Gibeon amo ela bona Gesere.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

motu: Bena David harina na tano iboudiai e piua rohoroho, bona Iehova ese ia garina igari-henina e havaraia, bese iboudiai ediai.
english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.

motu: David na ruma haida e haginidia ia sibona ena, David ena hanua ai; bona Dirava ena maua helaḡana gabuna e lailaia, bona kalagana e haginia.
english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

motu: Bena David eto, Asi tauna ta ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana baine huaia, a Levi taudia mo; badina be Iehova ese vada e abidia hidi, Iehova ena maua helaḡana bae huaia bona ia isiaina bae lao heni ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

motu: Bena David ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia Ierusalem ai, Iehova ena maua helaḡana na ena gabu, vada e heḡaeḡaelaia gabuna, ai bae daelaia totona.
english: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

motu: Bena David ese Aaron garana ona Levi taudia e haboudia.
english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

motu: Kohat garana amo: Uriele, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-ta ruahui.
english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

motu: Merari garana amo: Asaia, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-rua ruahui.
english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

motu: Gereson garana amo: loel, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-ta toi-ahui.
english: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

motu: Elisafan garana amo: Semaia, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-rua.
english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

motu: Heberon garana amo: Eliele, tau lohia, mai varavarana taurahani-ahui.
english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

motu: Usiele garana amo: Aminadab, tau lohia, mai varavarana sinahu-ta gwauta-rua.
english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

motu: Bena David ese hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Abiatara, bona Levi taudia Uriele bona Asaia bona Ioel bona Semaia bona Eliele bona Aminadab e boiridia,
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

motu: e hereva henidia, eto, Umui na Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia; sibomui ba hahelaḡa, umui bona varavaramui danu; Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena maua helaḡana vada na heḡaeḡaelaia gabuna ai ba daelaia totona.
english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

motu: Nega gunana ai asie huaia dainai, Iehova, eda Dirava, ese e makohi dagu henida; badina be asita naria namonamo, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na sibodia e hahelaḡa, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena maua helaḡana bae daelaia totona.
english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

motu: Bena Levi taudia ese Dirava ena maua helaḡana na mai madunana ida paḡadia ai e huaia, Mose ese Iehova ena hereva amo e haḡanilaidia dalana heḡereḡerena ai.
english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.

motu: David ese danu Levi lohiadia na e haḡanidia, varavaradia haida bae duanaidia, ane bae abi, bona reḡereḡe ḡaudia idau-idau, hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia bona botabota ḡaudia, ihataidia bona ibotadia amo moale reḡedia bae hadae badabada.
english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

motu: Taunabunai, Levi taudia ese Hemana Ioel e duanaia, varavarana ta Asaf Berekia ida; bona varavaradia Merari garana amo, Etana Kusaia;
english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

motu: bona idia ida ma varavaradia haida orea iharuana ai, Sekaria, Iaasiel, Semiramoto, Iehiele, Uni, Eliab, Benaia, Maaseia, Matitia, Elifelehu bona Mikineia; bona ikoukou igimadia taudia, Obed-edom bona leiele.
english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

motu: Ane-abi taudia Hemana bona Asaf bona Etana na aurilaboralabora botabota ḡaudia bae botadia;
english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

motu: Sekaria, Asiele, Semiramoto, Iehiele, Uni, Eliab, Maaseia bona Benaia na hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bae hatai, Alamoto dalana ai;
english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

motu: a Matitia, Elifelehu, Mikineia, Obed-edom, Ieiele bona Asasia na hatai-hatai ḡaudia maraḡidia bae hatai, Seminiti + 15:21 “Alamoto”; “Seminiti”. Ini na Heberu taudia edia ane iabidia eiava ihataidia daladia herevadia; a anidia korikori vada e boio. * dalana ai.
english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

motu: Kenania, Levi taudia edia ane-abi igunalaina tauna, ese ane baine hakaua, badina be ia na mai dibana.
english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

motu: Berekia bona Elkana na maua helaḡana ena ikoukou igimana taudia ai baela.
english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Sebania, Iosafat, Netanele, Amasai, Sekaria, Benaia bona Eliesere na kibi bae hiriri. Dirava ena maua helaḡana vairanai. Obed-edom bona lehia danu na maua helaḡana ena ikoukou igimana taudia ai baela.
english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

motu: Taunabunai David bona Israel tau-badadia bona daha lohiadia na ela, mai moaledia ida Iehova ena taravatu mauana Obed-edom ena ruma amo bae daelaia totona.
english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

motu: Bena Dirava ese Levi taudia, hari Iehova ena taravatu mauana e huaia taudia, na e durudia dainai, idia ese boromakau mamaruanedia hitu bona mamoe mamaruanedia hitu na e abidia, boubou ḡaudia ai e halaodia.
english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

motu: David na dabua aukana namo-hereana e hahedokilaia; bona Levi taudia maua helaḡana e huaia, bona ane-abi taudia, bona Kenania, ane-abi igunalaina tau, danu dabua unuhetomadia e hahedokilai. David danu hahedoki helaḡana, dabua aukana amo e karaia ḡauna, e hahedokilaia.
english: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel idoinai ese Iehova ena taravatu mauana e daelaia, mai honedia bona mai kibi idau-idau bona botabota ḡaudia reḡedia ida; bona hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia e hatai lalo-dika danu.
english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

motu: Iehova ena taravatu mauana na David ena hanua ai e kau negana ai, Mikala, Saulo natuna hahinena, na gaba-mauru amo e igo lasi, bena King David e itaia, e mavaruva bona e galaḡalava; bena lalona amo e ihi-ihiraia.
english: As the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

motu: Bena Dirava ena maua helaḡana e huaia vareai, David ese vada e haginia kalagana lalonai e atoa; bena ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia na Dirava vairanai e hahelaḡadia.
english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

motu: David ese ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia vaitani, bena ia ese taunimanima na Iehova ladana ai e hanamodia,
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.

motu: bena Israel tataudia bona hahinedia iboudiai ta ta adia e henidia hagau-hagau: flaoa igabuna ta, bona vamu taina, bona vine huahuadia kaukaudia mane ta.
english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

motu: Ia ese danu Levi taudia haida e duanaidia, Iehova ena maua helaḡana vairanai toma-diho karadia bae kara; Iehova, Israel Diravana, bae ḡuria, bona bae hanamoa, bona bae imodaia.
english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:

motu: Gini-gunana na Asaf; ia murinai na Sekaria, Ieiele, Semiramoto, Iehiele, Matitia, Eliab, Benaia, Obed-edom bona Ieiele. Idia na hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia bae hatai; Asaf na botabota auridia baine botadia;
english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

motu: bona hahelaḡa taudia Benaia bona lahasiel na kibi bae hiriri loulou, Dirava ena taravatu mauana vairanai. David ena hahenamo anena
english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

motu: Una dina ai David ese Asaf mai varavarana ida e duanaidia, Iehova ihanamolaina anedia bae abi matama.
english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to Yahweh by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

motu: Iehova ba hanamoa, ia ladana ba hahanea; ena kara ba gwauraidia hedinarai bese idau-idau vairadiai.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call|strong="H7121" * on|strong="H3068" * his|strong="H3068" * name|strong="H8034" *. Make|strong="H3045" * what|strong="H3045" * he|strong="H3068" * has|strong="H3068" * done|strong="H5949" * known|strong="H3045" * among|strong="H8034" * the|strong="H3068" * peoples|strong="H5971" *.

motu: Ane bavabi iena, ia ihanamolaina anedia bavabi, ena hoa karadia iboudiai sivaraidia ba gwaurai.
english: Sing to him. Sing|strong="H7891" * praises|strong="H2167" * to|strong="H7891" * him|strong="H3605" *. Tell|strong="H3605" * of|strong="H3605" * all|strong="H3605" * his|strong="H3605" * marvelous|strong="H6381" * works|strong="H6381" *.

motu: Ia ladana helaḡana ba heatolaia; Iehova e tahuamu taudia lalodia do bae moale.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let|strong="H8055" * the|strong="H3068" * heart|strong="H3820" * of|strong="H3068" * those who|strong="H3068" * seek|strong="H1245" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * rejoice|strong="H8055" *.

motu: Iehova ba tahua, bona ena goada danu; ia vairana ba tahua loulou.
english: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek|strong="H1245" * his|strong="H3068" * face|strong="H6440" * forever more.

motu: Ena hesiai tauna Abraham garana e! Iakob natuna, ena abi-hidi taudia, e! Hoa karadia ia ese vada e kara ba lalodia tao, hoa karadia ia ese vada e kara, bona ena hanemaoro herevadia danu.
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his|strong="H2142" * wonders|strong="H4159" *, and|strong="H4941" * the|strong="H6213" * judgments|strong="H4941" * of|strong="H6310" * his|strong="H2142" * mouth|strong="H6310" *,
you offspring + 16:13 or, seed * of Israel his servant, you|strong="H2233" * children|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Jacob|strong="H3290" *, his|strong="H3478" * chosen ones|strong="H1121" *.

motu: Ia na Iehova, eda Dirava; ena hahemaoro na tanobada idoinai e miamu.
english: He is Yahweh our God. His|strong="H3605" * judgments|strong="H4941" * are|strong="H3068" * in|strong="H3068" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * earth.

motu: Ia ese ena gwauhamata e laloa hanaihanaimu, bona ena haheḡani herevadia danu ela bona uru daha.
english: Remember his covenant forever, the|strong="H6680" * word|strong="H1697" * which|strong="H1697" * he|strong="H1285" * commanded|strong="H6680" * to|strong="H1697" * a|strong="H3068" * thousand generations|strong="H1755" *,

motu: Abraham ida e hegwauhamata heheni, Isaak e gwau henia hamata;
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his|strong="H3327" * oath|strong="H7621" * to|strong="H7621" * Isaac|strong="H3327" *.

motu: Iakob enai e hamomokania, taravatu ai bainela, Israel enai baine mia hanaihanai ḡauna.
english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and|strong="H3478" * to|strong="H3478" * Israel|strong="H3478" * for|strong="H2706" * an|strong="H3478" * everlasting|strong="H5769" * covenant|strong="H1285" *,

motu: Eto “Kanaan tanona baina henimu, oi ahumu korikori ai bainela”.
english: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The|strong="H5414" * lot|strong="H2256" * of|strong="H5159" * your|strong="H5414" * inheritance|strong="H5159" *,”

motu: Idia na dounu gagadoi, asi haridia, e noho hedoava una tano ai,
english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very|strong="H4592" * few|strong="H4592" *, and|strong="H1961" * foreigners|strong="H1481" * in|strong="H4962" * it|strong="H1961" *.

motu: bese ta bese ta lalodia amo e loa eva-evava, basileia ta lalona amo ela bona ma orea ta ai;
english: They went about from nation to nation, from|strong="H1980" * one kingdom|strong="H4467" * to|strong="H1980" * another people|strong="H5971" *.

motu: una negana ai ta asine gwau maoro henia idia baine daḡedaḡe henidia; hanua pavapavadia ia ese e gwau henidia, idia daidiai.
english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he|strong="H3808" * reproved|strong="H3198" * kings|strong="H4428" * for|strong="H5921" * their|strong="H5921" * sakes|strong="H5921" *,

motu: Eto “Vada na horodia taudia basio daudia toho, egu peroveta taudia na basio hadikadia.”
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do|strong="H7489" * my|strong="H5060" * prophets|strong="H5030" * no|strong="H5060" * harm|strong="H7489" *!”

motu: Tanobada idoinai, ane avabia, Iehova ena! daba daba iboudiai ena hahemauri ba herevalaia.
english: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his|strong="H3605" * salvation|strong="H3444" * from|strong="H3117" * day|strong="H3117" * to|strong="H3068" * day|strong="H3117" *.

english: Declare his glory among the nations, and|strong="H5971" * his|strong="H3605" * marvelous|strong="H6381" * works|strong="H6381" * among|strong="H6381" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * peoples|strong="H5971" *.

motu: Badina be Iehova na bada, ia ihanamona danu baine bada; ia mo bae matauraia, dirava idaudia iboudiai na basie matauraidia.
english: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He|strong="H1931" * also|strong="H3068" * is|strong="H3068" * to|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3068" * feared|strong="H3372" * above|strong="H5921" * all|strong="H3605" * gods.

motu: Badina be bese idau-idau edia dirava na kaivakuku mo, a Iehova na guba vada e karaia.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but|strong="H3588" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * made|strong="H6213" * the|strong="H3605" * heavens|strong="H8064" *.

motu: Hemataurai bona heimodai na ia vairanai, goada bona moale na ena gabu ai.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength|strong="H5797" * and|strong="H6440" * gladness|strong="H2304" * are|strong="H1926" * in|strong="H6440" * his|strong="H6440" * place|strong="H4725" *.

english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of the peoples, ascribe|strong="H3051" * to|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * glory|strong="H3519" * and|strong="H3068" * strength|strong="H5797" *!

motu: hairai ba gwauraia, Iehova ladana ena, boubou ḡauna ba mailaia, ia vairana baoma. Dabua helaḡadia ai Iehova ba toma henia diho;
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring|strong="H5375" * an|strong="H5375" * offering|strong="H4503" *, and|strong="H3068" * come|strong="H3051" * before|strong="H6440" * him|strong="H6440" *. Worship|strong="H7812" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * in|strong="H3068" * holy|strong="H6944" * array|strong="H1927" *.

motu: tanobada idoinai, ia vairanai ba heude-heude; oibe, tanobada vada e gini tutuka-tutuka, basine marere ela bona hanaihanai.
