english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The|strong="H3605" * world|strong="H8398" * also is|strong="H3605" * established|strong="H3559" * that|strong="H3605" * it|strong="H3559" * can’t be|strong="H6440" * moved|strong="H4131" *.

motu: Guba baine moale, tanobada baine hisi dae; bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baeto: Iehova na pavapava!
english: Let the heavens be glad, and|strong="H3068" * let|strong="H1523" * the|strong="H3068" * earth|strong="H8064" * rejoice|strong="H1523" *! Let|strong="H1523" * them|strong="H3068" * say among the|strong="H3068" * nations|strong="H1471" *, “ Yahweh|strong="H3068" * reigns|strong="H4427" *!”

motu: Davara baine lolo, mai lalona ḡaudia iboudiai ida; uma danu bae moale, mai anidia iboudiai.
english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let|strong="H7481" * the|strong="H3605" * field|strong="H7704" * exult|strong="H5970" *, and|strong="H7704" * all|strong="H3605" * that|strong="H3605" * is|strong="H3605" * in|strong="H3220" * it|strong="H4393" *!

motu: Una negana ai uda audia na moale anedia bae abi Iehova vairanai, badina be ia na tanobada ihahemaoro-henina totona e maimu.
english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for|strong="H3588" * he|strong="H3588" * comes|strong="H6440" * to|strong="H3068" * judge|strong="H8199" * the|strong="H6440" * earth.

motu: Iehova ba hanamoa, badina be ia na namo, ena hebogahisi na e hesiriu hanaihanaimu.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for|strong="H3588" * his|strong="H3068" * loving|strong="H2896" * kindness|strong="H2617" * endures|strong="H5769" * forever|strong="H5769" *.

motu: Ma baoto: Ihamaurimai Diravana e, ba harohomai mauri; bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo ba haboumai gogogogo bona ba hamaurimai; oi ladamu helaḡana baia imodaia totona, oi ihanamomu baia heaḡilaia helaoreana.
english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather|strong="H6908" * us|strong="H5337" * together|strong="H6908" * and|strong="H1471" * deliver|strong="H5337" * us|strong="H5337" * from|strong="H4480" * the|strong="H4480" * nations|strong="H1471" *, to|strong="H1471" * give|strong="H3034" * thanks|strong="H3034" * to|strong="H1471" * your|strong="H4480" * holy|strong="H6944" * name|strong="H8034" *, to|strong="H1471" * triumph|strong="H7623" * in|strong="H8034" * your|strong="H4480" * praise|strong="H8416" *.”

motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, bae hanamoa, matamana amo ela bona dokona. Bena taunimanima iboudiai eto “Amen”, bona Iehova e imodaia. David ena abi-hidi taudia
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from|strong="H4480" * everlasting|strong="H5769" * even|strong="H5704" * to|strong="H5704" * everlasting|strong="H5769" *. All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * said, “Amen,” and|strong="H3478" * praised|strong="H1984" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Taunabunai, David ese Asaf mai varavarana ida na Iehova ena taravatu mauana vairanai e rakatanidia, maua helaḡana vairanai toma-diho karadia bae kara loulou, dina ta ta edia kara heḡereḡeredia;
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

motu: bona Obed-edom mai varavarana tauratoi-ahui taurahani danu. A Obed-edom Iedutunu bona Hosa na e gwauraidia, ikoukou bae gima.
english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

motu: Hahelaga tauna Sadok mai tadikakana hahelaḡa taudia ida danu e rakatanidia, Iehova ena kalaga helaḡana vairanai, atai gabuna Gibeon ai;
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

motu: unuseni ai ḡole-oho bouboudia ḡaudia na ihaboulaina patana latanai bae hahelaḡadia loulou, daba ai bona adorahi ai, Iehova ena taravatu, Israel e haḡanilaia ḡauna, lalonai e tore herevadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
english: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

motu: Idia ida na Hemana bona ledutunu, bona e abidia hidi bona ladadia e hato taudia oredia. Eto, Iehova bae hanamoa, badina be ena hebogahisi e hesiriu hanaihanaimu.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;

motu: Hemana bona ledutunu na mai edia kibi bona mai edia botabota auridia, ane daidiai, bona Dirava ihanamolaina anedia iabidia idurulaina ḡaudia danu. Iedutunu natuna na e duanaidia, ikoukou bae gimadia.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai e karoho, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ela. Bona David na ena gabu ela, ena ruma taudia baine hanamodia totona.
english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

motu: David na ena ruma ai e nohova. Una negana ai David ese peroveta tauna Natan e hereva henia, eto, A itaia, lau na sida rumana ai na nohomu, a Iehova ena taravatu mauana na kalaga ai e miamu.
english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of Yahweh’s covenant is in a tent.”

motu: Bena Natan ese David e hamaoroa, eto, Lalomu ai e miamu ḡauna idoinai do ba karaia, badina be Dirava na oi ida.
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

motu: A una hanuaboi Iehova ena hereva na Natan enai e kau, eto,
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

motu: Aola, egu hesiai tauna David ba hamaoroa, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu noho rumana auta basio haginia.
english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

motu: Badina be ruma ta ai asina noho, Israel na hakaua isi dinana amo ema bona ina dina, a kalaga ta amo ela bona kalaga ta, bona noho gabuna ta ela bona noho gabuna ta, vada na noho eva-eva.
english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

motu: Israel idoinai ida na loa heniva gabudia iboudiai lalodiai Israel ena hahemaoro taudia, na haḡanidia egu orea Israel bae reḡua taudia, ta na hereva henia a, nato “Dahaka dainai egu sida rumana auta to haginia?”
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

motu: Taunabunai, harihari egu hesiai tauna David ba hamaoroa, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Rei gabuna amo bona mamoe ireḡudia amo na abimu, egu bese Israel lohiana ai baola helaoreana;
english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

motu: emu loa daladia iboudiai lalodiai vada na bamomu, bona oi inaimu iboudiai na oi vairamu ai vada na negedia daure; bona oi ladamu do baina hadaea, tanobada ai lada-bada taudia heḡereḡeredia.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.

motu: Egu bese Israel ena gabu baina duanai henia, bona baina hadaia, bena ena gabu korikori ai baine noho, basie hamarerea lou. Daḡedaḡe taudia ese basie habuaia lou, gunaguna e karava heḡereḡerena,
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

motu: egu bese Israel ena hahemaoro taudia na duanaidia negana amo; bona inaimu iboudiai baina hadareredia. Ina danu na hamaoromumu, Iehova ese emu iduhu baine haginia.
english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.

motu: Emu dina bae ore bena tubu tama dekedia baola negana ai oi ese o havaraia merona, oi natumu mamaruanedia ta, lau ese baina abia isi, bona ena basileia danu baina haginia.
english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

motu: Ia ese egu ruma auta baine haginia; bona lau ese iena terono baina haginia ela bona hanaihanai.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

motu: Lau na ia tamana ai bainala, bona ia na lau natugu ai bainela; egu hebogahisi na iena amo basina abia oho, e gunalaimu tauna ena amo na abia oho heḡereḡerena;
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

motu: a egu ruma ai bona egu basileia ai baina hamomokania hanaihanai, bona iena terono baine gini ela bona hanaihanai.
english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

motu: Ini hereva iboudiai bona ina mata-hanai idoinai heḡereḡeredia ai, Natan ese David e hamaorolaia.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

motu: Bena King David e raka vareai, Iehova vairanai e helai, eto, Dirava Iehova e, lau be daika bona egu iduhu be dahaka, bena oi ese vada o hakaugu ema bona hari?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

motu: Dirava e, una na ḡau pipikina oi vairamu ai; oi ese emu hesiai tauna ena iduhu vada o herevalaia, nega dau ai baine vara ḡauna, bona uru gabedia vada o haheitalaigu, Dirava Iehova e!
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.

motu: Ma dahaka David ese baine hamaorolaimu, emu hesiai tauna vada o hanamoa dainai? Badina be emu hesiai tauna na vada o dibaiamu.
english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

motu: Iehova e, emu hesiai tauna bagunai bona sibomu emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ai, ina kara hereana idoinai vada o karaia, bona ini kara badadia iboudiai vada o hahedinarai.
english: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

motu: Iehova e, oi na asi idaimu, Dirava ta na ma lasi, taiamai ai a kamonai ḡaudia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia.
english: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

motu: Edena bese tanobada ai na emu bese Israel heḡereḡerena? Dirava ese vada e hamauria, iena bese ai bainela; oi sibomu ladamu o hadaia, kara badadia bona hahegari karadia o karava daidiai; bona bese idau-idau na oiemu bese, Aigupto arrto o hamauria besena, vairana amo o luludia lasi.
english: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

motu: Bena emu taunimanima Israel na emu bese ai o halaodia, ela bona hanaihanai; bona oi danu, Iehova e, edia Dirava ai o hahelao.
english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

motu: Iehova e, emu hesiai tauna bona ena iduhu o herevalaidia herevana na vada baine gini hanaihanai, bona o gwauraia heḡereḡerena ba karaia.
english: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

motu: Bena oi ladamu baine gini, bona bae imodaia hanaihanai, baeto “Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na Israel taudia edia Dirava”; bona emu hesiai tauna David ena iduhu na oi vairarnu ai baine gini.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

motu: Badina be oi, egu Dirava, ese emu hesiai tauna vada o hahedinarai henia, ena iduhu ba haginia oto; una dainai emu hesiai tauna ese goada vada e davaria, oi vairamu ai baine ḡuriḡun.
english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

motu: Iehova e, oi na Dirava, bona oi ese ina ḡau namona na emu hesiai tauna vada o gwaurai henia hamata;
english: Now, Yahweh, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

motu: taunabunai, mani emu kara emu hesiai tauna ba hanamoa, bena oi vairamu ai baine hesiriu hanaihanai; badina be, Iehova e, oi ese vada o hanamoa ḡauna na baine namo ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

motu: Una murinai David ese Filistia taudia e hadareredia bona e hamanaudia; bena ia ese Gata mai ena hanua maraḡidia iboudiai ida na Filistia taudia imadia amo e abidia oho.
english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

motu: Ia ese Moab danu e hadarerea, bena Moab taudia na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela, bona heaiva gaudia e henia.
english: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

motu: David ese Hadadesere, Soba pavapavana, danu e hadarerea, Hanlat kahana ai, ena pupu na Eufrate sinavaina badibadinai ihaginina totona e laova negana ai.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

motu: Bena David ese kariota daha-ta bona hosi-gui taudia daha-hitu bona ae-raka taudia gerebu-rua + 18:4 Gerebu-rua = 20,000. * na iena amo e abidia. David ese kariota hosidia iboudiai na mamudia varovarodia e utu, a kariota sinahu-ta hosidia mo asie utudia.
english: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

motu: Bena Suria taudia na Damasko amo ela, Hadadesere, Soba pavapavana, bae durua eto; una negana ai David ese Suria taudia gerebu-rua daha-rua + 18:5 Gerebu-rua daha-rua = 22,000. * e aladia mase.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

motu: Bena David ese tuari oreadia haida na Suria ai e atodia, Damasko ai; bona Suria taudia na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela, bona heaiva ḡaudia e henia. Iehova ese David na kwalimu e henia, e laova gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

motu: Hadadesere ena hesiai taudia ese gold * kesidia e abi ḡaudia na David ese Ierusalem e laohaidia.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

motu: Hadadesere ena hanua rua, Tibihata bona Kunu, amo David ese aun labora-labora momo herea e abi; bena Solomon ese ranu nauna bada-hereana bona au-tubua bona ḡau idau-idau na una auri-laboralabora amo e kara.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

motu: Tou, Hamat pavapavana, e kamonai David ese Hadadesere, Soba pavapavana, ena tuari oreana idoinai vada e hadarerea.
english: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

motu: Bena ia ese natuna Hadorama na King David dekena e siaia lao, baine hahenamo henia bona baine imodaia totona, ia ese Hadadesere vada e tuari henia bona vada e hadarerea dainai; badina be una Hadadesere na nega momo Tou ida e tuari. Ia ese gold * bona silver * bona bronze * + 18:10 “Bronze” na auri labora-laborana ta ladana. * amo e karadia ḡaudia idau-idau na e siaidia lao;
english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

motu: unu ḡau danu King David ese e hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena, vada e hadareredia besedia iboudiai edia amo e dadi silver *-na bona gold *-na ida. Besedia be Edom bona Moab bona Arnono bona Filistia bona Amalek taudia.
english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

motu: Abisai, Seruia natuna, ese Edom taudia gerebu-ta sinahu-taurahani + 18:12 Gerebu-ta sinahu-taurahani = 18,000. * na Damena Kourana ai e aladia mase.
english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

motu: Bena ia ese tuari oreadia na Edom ai e atodia; bona Edom taudia iboudiai na David ena hesiai taudia ai ela. Iehova ese David na kwalimu e henia, e laova gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

motu: Taunabunai, David ese Israel idoinai e lohiaia, bona ia ese ena orea taudia iboudiai e hahemaoro henidia mai maoromaorona ida.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

motu: Ioab Seruia na tuari oreana lohiana; Iehosafat Ahilud na e tore pepadia inaridia tau;
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

motu: Sadok Ahitubu bona Ahimelek Abiatara na hahelaḡa taudia; Savasa na toretore tauna;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

motu: Benaia Iehoiada na Kerete bona Pelete taudia biagudia. David natuna mamaruanedia na heitatao taudia badadia, hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara lalonai.
english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

motu: Una murinai, Nahasa, Amono pavapavana, e mase, bena natuna na ia gabuna ai e lohia.
english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

motu: Bena David eto, Hanunu Nahasa baina kara momokani henia, badina be tamana ese e kara momokani heniguva. Taunabunai, David ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia, tauna ihalona totona, tamana dainai. Bena David ena hesiai taudia na Hanunu dekenai e kau, Amono taudia edia tano ai, tauna ihalona totona.
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So|strong="H6213" * David|strong="H1732" * sent|strong="H7971" * messengers|strong="H4397" * to|strong="H7971" * comfort|strong="H5162" * him|strong="H5921" * concerning|strong="H5921" * his|strong="H7971" * father|strong="H1121" *. David|strong="H1732" *’s servants|strong="H5650" * came|strong="H5983" * into|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * land of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H5921" * children|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Ammon|strong="H5983" * to|strong="H7971" * Hanun|strong="H2586" * to|strong="H7971" * comfort|strong="H5162" * him|strong="H5921" *.

motu: A Amono lohiadia ese Hanunu e hereva henia, eto, Oi na o laloamu David ese tauhalo taudia na dekemu vada e siaidia mai dainai ia ese tamamu e matauraiamu a? David ese ena hesiai taudia dekemu ai vada e siaidia badina korikori be bae hetahu, bae hahedarere, bona tano bae hasinadoa, ani?
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

motu: Taunabunai, Hanunu ese David ena hesiai taudia e abidia, auki-huidia e nau, bona edia hahedoki e utudia kwadogi koekoedia ai; bena e siaidia oho. Bena idia na ela.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

motu: Haida ese idia sivaraidia na David e hamaorolaia, bena ia ese haida e siaidia, idia ida bae hedavari, badina be idia na e hemarai bada herea. Hanua pavapavana, eto, Ieriko ai ba noho ela bona aukimui huidia ma bae tubu, bena ba lou mai.
english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

motu: Amono taudia vada e diba, David lalona vada e hadikaia ediai; bena Hanunu bona Amono taudia ese silver talent * + 19:6 Silver talent daha-ta na readia K800,000 heḡereḡerena, ita eda moni ai. * daha-ta e siaidia, kariota bona hosi-gui taudia na bae vatudia, Mesopotamia bona Arama-maaka bona Soba amo.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents + 19:6 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds, so 1000 talents is about 30 metric tons * of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

motu: Idia ese kariota gerebu-toi daha-rua + 19:7 Gerebu-toi daha-rua = 32,000. * bona Maaka pavapavana mai ena tuari oreana ida e vatudia; bena idia na ema, Medeba vairanai e taruha. Amono taudia danu edia hanua amo e haboudia, bena tuari ela.
english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

motu: David e kamonai, bena ia ese Ioab, bona tuari taudia mai goadadia iboudiai na e siaidia lao.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

motu: Bena Amono taudia na e raka lasi, edia tuari ḡaudia e abidia, hanua raka-vareaina ai e gini heḡaeḡae. A hari pavapavana, ema taudia, na sibodia tano paka ai e noho.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

motu: Ioab na e itaia, tuari na vairanai bona murina kahana ai vada e atodia, bena ia ese Israel edia goada taudia e abidia hidi, Suria taudia ituari-henidia e siaidia lao.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

motu: A ena tuari taudia oredia na tadina Abisai e henia, baine biagudia, Amono taudia ituari-henidia baela.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

motu: Ia eto, Suria taudia na egu ai bema goada herea, vada ba durugu; a Amono taudia na emu ai bema goada herea, lau ese baina vasi durumu.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

motu: Ba goada balaheni; baita haheauka, eda bese dainai, bona eda Dirava ena hanua daidiai; Iehova ese ena lalo-hadai namodia heḡereḡeredia ai baine kara.
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ioab mai bamona ida ela, Suria taudia e tuari henidia, bena idia na ia vairana amo e heau.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

motu: Amono taudia e itaia, Suria taudia vada e heau, bena idia danu Abisai, Ioab tadina, vairana amo e heau, hanua lalonai e heau vareai. Bena Ioab na Ierusalem ela.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

motu: Suria taudia na vada e diba, Israel taudia ese idia vada e hadareredia, bena idia ese gwaukau taudia e siaidia lao, Suria taudia Eufrate sinavaina unukahana ai e nohova na e hakaudia mai; Sofaka, Hadadesere ena tuari oreana biaguna, ese e kwaradia.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, + 19:16 or, the Euphrates River * with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

motu: Haida ese David e hamaoroa, bena ia ese Israel taudia iboudiai e haboudia; Ioridane sinavaina e hanaia, e lao henidia, bona ena orea e haheḡaeḡaea, idia ituari-henidia totona. David ese tuari taudia e haginidia hegaeḡae, Suria taudia vairadiai; bena idia na ia ida e tuan.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

motu: Bena Suria taudia na Israel taudia vairadia amo e heau. Suria edia kariota daha-hitu taudia bona ae-raka taudia gerebu-hani + 19:18 Gerebu-hani = 40,000. * David ese e aladia mase, bona Sofaka, edia tuari oreana biaguna, danu e alaia mase.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

motu: Hadadesere ena hesiai taudia ese e itaia Israel taudia ese idia vada e hadareredia, bena idia na David ida e herohemaino, bona ia isiaina e lao heni. Taunabunai una negana amo Suria taudia na asie ura Amono taudia ma bae durudia lou.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

motu: Komukau negana ai, hanua pavapavadia edia tuari lao negana, Ioab ese tuari oreana e hakaua lasi, bena Amono taudia edia tano e e habuaia tari; bena ma ela, Raba e koua heḡeḡe. A David na Ierusalem ai e noho. Bena Ioab ese Raba e tuari henia, bena e hadarerea.
english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

motu: Bena David ese edia hanua pavapavana ena havava ḡauna na kwarana amo e abia oho: metauna na gold talent * ta, bona lalonai na mai herahera nadina herea-daena ta. Gauna na David kwarana ai e atoa kau. Bena hanua kohuna idau-idau na hanua lalona amo e hua lasi, kohu momo herea.
english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, + 20:2 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

motu: Hanua taudia danu e hakaudia lasi, ḡaukara e henidia, iri bona auri isivadia bona ira amo bae ḡaukara. David ese Amono hanuadia iboudiai na unu e karadia toma. Bena David bona ena orea taudia iboudiai na Ierusalem e lou lao. David ena orea taudia ese taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia e aladia mase
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

motu: Una murinai idia na Filistia taudia ida e tuan lou, Gesere ai. Bena Sibekai, tau Husata, ese Sipai, taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia garadia ta, e alaia mase. Bena Filistia taudia na vada e darere.
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

motu: Bena Filistia taudia ida ma e tuari lou; una negana ai Elhanan lairi ese Lahami, Goliata tau Gata tadikakana, na e alaia mase. Una tau ena io auauna na dabua ihatuna tauna ena au na heto.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

motu: Ma e tuari lou, Gata ai; unuseni ai tau ḡaulatalata ta e nohova, imana ruaosi bona aena ruaosi kwakikwakidia na tauratoi tauratoi amo; kwakikwakina iboudiai na ruahui-hani. Ia na taunimanima ḡaubadabadadia garadia ta.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

motu: Una tau ese Israel taudia e ḡonaḡonalaidia, bena Ionatan, David kakana Simea natuna, ese e alaia mase.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

motu: Ini na Gata taudia ḡaubadabadadia garadia; David imana amo bona ena hesiai taudia imadia amo e hamasedia.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

motu: Satana ese Israel e inai henia, bena David e dibaḡania, Israel taudia baine hagaudia.
english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

motu: Taunabunai, David ese Ioab bona tuari biagudia e hamaorodia, eto, Aola, Israel taudia ba hagaudia, Bere-sieba amo ela bona Dan; bena hereva ba mailaia, baina diba idia be hahida.
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

motu: A Ioab eto, Iehova ese ena bese na nega sinahu-ta amo baine habadaia. Egu lohia bona egu pavapava e, idia iboudiai na egu lohia ena hesiai taudia, ani? Dahaka dainai egu lohia ese ina ḡau e ura heniamu? Dahaka dainai ia ese Israel baine hakererea?
english: Joab said, “May Yahweh make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

motu: A hanua pavapavana ena hereva ese Ioab e laoa ahu. Taunabunai, Ioab na e raka lasi, Israel tanona idoinai e rakaia hanai, bena Ierusalem ma e lou lao.
english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

motu: Bena Ioab ese taunimanima ihagaudia herevana na David e henia. Israel idoinai lalonai dare taudia na domaga gwauta-ta, + 21:5 Domaga gwauta-ta = 1,100,000. Domaga-hani gerebu-hitu = 470,000. * bona Iuda lalonai dare taudia na domaga-hani gerebu-hitu.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

motu: A ia ese Levi taudia bona Beniamina taudia na se duahidia, badina be hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani na Ioab lalona ese e dadaraia.
english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

motu: A Dirava ese una kara na e badulaia, bena ia ese Israel e hahisia.
english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

motu: Bena David ese Dirava e hamaoroa, eto, Vada na kerere dikadika ina kara ikarana ai; a harihari lau na noimumu emu hesiai tauna ena dika bavabia oho; badina be vada na kara kava herea.
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Gad, David ena mata-hanai tauna, e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

motu: Aola, David ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: ḡau toi na dudui henimumu, tamona bavabia hidi, bena unu baina kara henimu toma.
english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

motu: Taunabunai, Gad na David dekena ela, e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu. Edena o uramu bavabia:
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:

motu: doe laḡani toi lalodiai; eiava inaimu edia hahebua-tari, hua toi lalodiai idia edia dare ese bae lasimu tao; eiava Iehova ena dare, dina toi lalodiai dai-hanai gorerena na tano ai baine kau, bona Iehova ena aneru na Israel tanona idoinai lalonai baine hahebua tari. Lalomu a hadaia, edena haere na e siaigu Diravana baina henia.
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

motu: Bena David ese Gad e haere henia, eto, Daragu eme doko dikadika; Iehova imana ai baina moru be namo, badina be ena hebogahisi na bada herea, a taunimanima imadia ai basina moru.
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese dai-hanai gorerena ta Israel latanai e siaia; bena Israel taudia gerebu-hitu + 21:14 Gerebu-hitu = 70,000. * e mase.
english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

motu: Bena Dirava ese aneru na Ierusalem ihabua-tarina e siaia lao, a baine habuaia tari eto negana ai Iehova ese e itaia, bena ia na una dika amo e helalo kerehai; bena ia ese taunimanima ihabua-taridia aneruna e hamaoroa, eto, Vadaeni, imamu a haloua. Iehova ena aneru na Oronana, tau Iebusu, ena uit ikwadina gabuna badibadinai gini.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

motu: Bena David na e gaga isi, Iehova ena aneru e itaia, tanobada bona guba padadiai gini, imana amo dare e veria lasi bona Ierusalem daenai e toia roro. Bena David bona hanua tau-badadia na puse dabuadia e hahedokilai bona tano ai e goru parapara.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then|strong="H5375" * David|strong="H1732" * and|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H6440" * elders|strong="H2205" *, clothed|strong="H3680" * in|strong="H5921" * sackcloth|strong="H8242" *, fell|strong="H5307" * on|strong="H5921" * their|strong="H3068" * faces|strong="H6440" *.

motu: Bena David ese Dirava e hereva henia, eto, Lau na haheḡani, taunimanima bae hagaudia nato, ani? Lau na vada na kara dika bona na kara havara; a ini mamoe na dahaka e karaia? Iehova egu Dirava e, na noimumu, oi imamu ese lau bona tamagu ena iduhu baine hadikamai, a dai-hanai gorerena na emu bese taudia latadiai basine mia.
english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Yahweh my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Gad e haḡania, ia ese David baine hamaoroa, David na bainela, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ta baine larebaia, Oronana tau Iebusu ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

motu: Taunabunai David na ela, Gad ena hereva, Iehova ladana ai e gwauraia, ḡauna dainai.
english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.

motu: Una negana ai Oronana na uit e kwadiva; bena e roha kerehai, aneru e itaia. Bena natuna mamaruanedia hahaniosi ia dekenai na e komu.
english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

motu: David na Oronana dekena ela negana ai, Oronana na e roha lao, David e itaia; bena uit ikwadina gabuna amo e raka lasi, tano ai e goru diho, David e toma henia diho.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

motu: David ese Oronana e hamaoroa, eto, Uit ikwadina gabuna tanona a henigu, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana na ia latanai baina larebaia totona. A henigu, bena davana korikori baina henimu, dai-hanai gorerena na taunimanima edia amo baine heabi oho helaoreana.
english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

motu: Bena Oronana ese David e haere henia, eto, Avabia; egu lohia bona egu pavapava na ena lalo-hadai namona heḡereḡerena baine karaia. A itaia, boromakau mamaruanedia na henimumu, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai baela, bona uit ikwadilaina audia na rakuraku audia ai baela, bona uit na flaoa boubou ḡauna ai bainela; idoinai na henimumu.
english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

motu: A King David ese Oronana e hamaoroa, eto, Lasi, a davana korikori ai baina hoia; oiemu ḡau na basina abia Iehova ena, bona davadia asina kara ḡaudia na basina hahelaḡadia.
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

motu: Taunabunai, David ese gold * sekele sinahu-tauratoi + 21:25 Gold sekele sinahu-tauratoi na readia K2,400 heḡereḡeredia, ita eda moni ai. * e hahetohodia, Oronana e henia, una tano davana.
english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels + 21:25 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 600 shekels was about 6 kilograms or about 192 Troy ounces. * of gold by weight for the place.

motu: Bena David ese Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ta unuseni ai e larebaia, bona ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, bona Iehova e hahanea. Bena ia ese guba lahina amo e haere henia, ḡole-oho bouboudia patana latanai.
english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

motu: Bena Iehova ese hari aneru e haḡania; bena aneru ese ena dare na iudalaina ḡauna ai ma e toia vareai. Dubu Helaḡa tanona
english: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

motu: Una negana ai David ese e itaia, Oronana tau Iebusu ena uit ikwadina gabuna ai Iehova ese vada e haere henia; bena ena boubou ḡaudia na e hahelaḡadia unuseni ai.
english: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

motu: Badina be una negana ai Iehova ena kalaga helaḡana, Mose ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e karaia ḡauna, bona ḡole-oho bouboudia patana, na Gibeon ai, atai gabuna ai;
english: For Yahweh’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

motu: a David na asi ena dala unu bainela, Dirava inanadaina totona, badina be ia ese Iehova ena aneru ena dare garina e gariva.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.

motu: Bena David eto, Dirava Iehova ena dubu na iniseni ai baine gini, bona Israel ena ḡole-oho bouboudia patana danu. David ese Dubu Helaḡa gabuna e haheḡaeḡaea
english: Then David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

motu: David e haheḡani, idau bese taudia Israel tanona lalonai na bae haboudia; bena ia ese nadi-utu taudia e haḡaukaradia, Dirava ena dubu ihaginilaina nadidia na bae haḡoeva heḡaegae.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

motu: David ese danu auri momo herea e habou, raka-vareai iduaradia ikokodia bona hakapu-tao auridia ikaradia totona, bona auri labora-labora momo herea danu, metauna na asi ihahetohona dalana;
english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

motu: bona sida audia danu, asi iduahidia, badina be Sidono taudia bona Turo taudia ese sida audia momo herea na David dekena e mailaidia.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

motu: Badina be David eto, Natugu Solomon na eregabe, bona ḡaukara ai do asine manada, bona namona be Iehova ena dubu hairaina baine herea dae vaitani; harina bona hairaina herevadia na tano idoidiai latadiai bae da'ania; una dainai lau ese baina heḡaeḡaelaia. Taunabunai, David na do se mase ai, ia ese dubu kohuna momo herea e habou guna.
english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

motu: Bena ia ese natuna Solomon e boiria, e haḡania, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena dubu auta baine haginia.
english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.

motu: David ese Solomon e hamaoroa, eto, Natugu e, lalogu na e ura dubu auta baina haginia nato, Iehova, egu Dirava, ladana ena.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.

motu: A Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto: Oi na rara momo vada o hahebubu, bona tuari babada o kara; dubu auta basio haginia lau ladagu ena, badina be rara momo na tano ai vada o hahebubu lau vairagu ai.
english: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

motu: A itaia, natumu ta baine vara; ia na maino tauna ai bainela, bona lau ese maino baina henia, ana inai taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai. Badina be ladana bae hatoa Solomon; + 22:9 “Solomon” anina be “maino tauna”. * bona iena nega ai lau ese Israel na maino bona laḡa-ani baina henia.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

motu: Ia ese dubu auta baine haginia, lau ladagu ena. Ia na lau natugu ai bainela, bona lau na ia tamana ai bainala; bona ena pavapava teronona na Israel ai baina haginia ela bona hanaihanai.
english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, Iehova ese baine bamomu, bona Iehova, emu Dirava, ena dubu do ba haginia vaitani, ia ese vada e herevalaimu heḡereḡerena.
english: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Iehova ese aonega bona lalo-parara baine henimu, bena Israel igunalaina tauna ai baine halaomu negana ai na Iehova, emu Dirava, ena taravatu do ba badinaia.
english: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Israel edia taravatu bona hahemaoro herevadia Mose e haḡanilaia ḡaudia na boma badinadia ḡoevaḡoeva negana ai, namomu do baine bada. Ba goada, ba boga auka. Basio gari, basio kudou hetaha.
english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

motu: Mai hekwarahi-badagu ida Iehova ena dubu kohudia vada na abi heḡaegae: gold talent * domaga-ta, + 22:14 Domaga-ta = 100,000. Domaga-gwauta = 1,000,000. * silver talent * domagagwauta, bona auri labora-labora bona auri, asi ihahetohodia dalana badina be momo herea daidiai. Bona au bona nadi danu vada na abi heḡaeḡae. Ini latadiai ma haida bavato kau.
english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents + 22:14 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 100,000 talents is about 3 metric tons * of gold, one million talents + 22:14 about 30,000 metric tons * of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

motu: Emu ḡaukara taudia na hutuma: nadi-utu taudia, nadi-hagini taudia, kamuta taudia, bona ima-karakara taudia idau-idau, asi iduahidia,
english: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

motu: gold * bona silver * bona auri labora-labora bona auri iḡaukaralaidia diba herea taudia. A tore isi, a ḡaukara! Iehova ese baine bamomu!
english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”

motu: David ese danu Israel lohiadia iboudiai e haḡanidia, idia ese ia natuna Solomon bae durua. Ia eto,
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

motu: Iehova, emui Dirava, na umui ida ani? Ia ese maino vada e henimui kaha iboudiai ani? Badina be ina tano taudia na lau imagu ai vada e atodia, bona tano na vada e hagedaia tari, Iehova mai ena bese taudia ida vairadiai.
english: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.

motu: Harihari mai Ialomui bona daramui ida Iehova, emui Dirava, ba tahua. A tore isi; Dirava Iehova ena gabu helaḡana ba haginia, bena Iehova ena taravatu mauana bona Dirava ena ḡau helaḡadia na Iehova ladana bagunai vada o haginia rumana lalonai bae vareailaidia.
english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”

motu: David vada e buruka, ena mauri dinadia vada e hoho; una negana ai ia ese natuna Solomon na Israel pavapavana ai e halaoa. Hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia orea bona edia ḡaukara
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

motu: David ese Israel lohiadia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia iboudiai e haboudia.
english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

motu: Levi taudia, laḡanidia toi-ahui vada e hanai taudia, na e duahidia, iboudiai na gerebu-toi daha-taurahani. + 23:3 Gerebu-toi daha-taurahani = 38,000. *
english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

motu: David eto, Idia bogaragidia amo gerebu-rua daha-hani + 23:4 Gerebu-rua daha-hani = 24,000. * na Iehova ena dubu gaukaradia bae kara, daha tauratoi na heitatao taudia bona hahemaoro taudia ai baela,
english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

motu: daha hani na ikoukou igimadia taudia ai baela, bona daha hani ese hatai-hatai ḡaudia, hahenamo totona vada na kara ḡaudia, amo Iehova bae hanamnoa.
english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

motu: Bena David ese orea ta ta ai e hididia, Levi natudia, Gereson bona Kohat bona Merari, besedia dodidiai.
english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

motu: Gereson natuna na Ladan bona Simei.
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

motu: Ladan natuna na Iehiele, tau lohia, bona Setama bona Ioel, tatoiosi.
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

motu: Simei natuna na Selomoto bona Hasiele bona Haran, tatoiosi. Idia na Ladan ena iduhu lohiadia.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

motu: Simei natuna na lahata bona Sina bona Ieusu bona Beria. Unu hahaniosi na Simei natuna.
english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

motu: Iahata na tau lohia, Sisa na ihararuana; a Ieusu bona Beria natudia mamaruanedia na dia hoho, una dainai idia na iduhu tamona mo e gwauraidia.
english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

motu: Kohat natuna na Amram bona Isahara bona Heberon bona Usiele, hahaniosi.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

motu: Amram natuna na Aaron bona Mose. Aaron na e atoa idau, helaḡa herea ḡaudia baine hahelaḡadia totona; ia bona ia garana ese muramura mai bonadia na Iehova vairanai bae gabu ela bona hanaihanai, bona ia isiaina bae lao heni bona hahenamo herevadia bae gwaurai ia ladana ai ela bona hanaihanai.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

motu: A Mose, Dirava ena tau, natuna danu Levi oreana taudia ida e gwauraidia hebou.
english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

motu: Mose natuna na Geresom bona Eliesere.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

motu: Geresom natuna na Sebuele, tau lohia.
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

motu: Eliesere natuna na Rehabia, tau lohia. Eliesere na asi natuna mamaruanedia haida, a Rehabia natuna na hutuma herea.
english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

motu: Isahara natuna na Selomiti, tau lohia.
english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

motu: Heberon natuna na Ieria, tau lohia; ihararuana na Amaria, ihatatoina na Iahasiel, bona ihahahanina na lekameama.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

motu: Usiele natuna na Mika, tau lohia; ihararuana na Isia.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

motu: Merari natuna na Mali bona Musi. Mali natuna na Eleasara bona Kisa.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

motu: Eleasara na e mase, asi natuna mamaruanedia to hahine mo; bena idia varavaradia, Kisa natuna mamaruanedia, ese e adavadia.
english: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

motu: Musi natuna na Mali bona Edere bona Ieremoto, tatoiosi.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

motu: Levi garana bunu, edia iduhu ta ta ai; idia na iduhu kwaradia; laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia e hagaudia heḡereḡerena amo ta ta ladadia e tore, idia ese Iehova ena dubu ḡaukaradia bae kara totona.
english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

motu: Badina be David eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese maino na ena bese taudia vada e henidia, bona ia na Ierusalem ai e noho hanaihanaiamu;
english: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

motu: taunabunai Levi taudia na kalaga helaḡana bona ena ḡaukara kohudia na basie hua lou.
english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

motu: Badina be David ena hereva oredia be Levi taudia, laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia, ihagaudia herevadia.
english: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

motu: Edia ḡaukara be Aaron garana bae durudia, Iehova ena dubu gaukaradia ikaradia ai: maḡu bona daiutu bae naridia, ḡau helaḡadia bae haḡoevadia, bona Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia idau-idau bae kara;
english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

motu: bona flaoa helaḡana, bona boubou flaoadia, bona asie hatubua flaoana atagadia, bona boubou dikeadia, bona dehoro ida e buloa boubouna, bona hahetoho ḡaudia idau-idau iboudiai, na bae regudia.
english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

motu: Daba iboudiai bae gini, Iehova bae hanamoa bona bae imodaia, bona adorahi ai danu,
english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;

motu: bona ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia Iehova vairanai bae hahelaḡadia loulou negadia ai danu, dina helaḡadia ai bona hua matamata dinadia ai bona aria dinadia ai, taravatu ese e gwaurai ḡaudia heḡereḡeredia ai.
english: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;

motu: Hebou kalagana bona gabu helaḡana na unu bae naridia toma, bona tadikakadia Aaron garana bae durudia, Iehova ena dubu ḡaukaradia ikaradia ai.
english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of Yahweh’s house.

motu: Aaron garana edia orea bini. Aaron natuna na Nadab bona Abihu bona Eleasara bona Itamara.
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

motu: A Nadab bona Abihu na tamadia maurina ai e mase, asi natudia; taunabunai Eleasara bona Itamara na hahelaḡa taudia ai ela.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

motu: Bena Eleasara garana ta, ladana Sadok, bona Itamara garana ta, ladana Ahimelek, ese David e durua, edia iduhu taudia na orea ta ta lalodiai e haboudia bona edia ḡaukara e henidia.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

motu: Eleasara garana bogaragidiai lohia taudia na momo, a Itamara garana bogaragidiai lohia taudia be dia hoho; una dainai Eleasara garana na orea ai e haboudia, edia iduhu kwaradia gwauta-tauratoi henudiai, bona Itamara garana na orea ai e haboudia, edia iduhu kwaradia taurahani henudiai.
english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

motu: Mari amo edia orea e hididia, iboudiai na heḡereḡere; badina be haida na gabu helaḡana itataona taudia bona haida na Dirava ena itatao taudia, Eleasara garana amo bona Itamara garana amo danu.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

motu: Bena itorena tauna Semaia Netanele, Levi tauna ta, ese iboudiai ladadia e tore, hanua pavapavana bona bese lohiadia bona hahelaḡa taudia Sadok bona Ahimelek Abiatara, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, vairadiai; iduhu ta na Eleasara garana amo e abia hidi, ma iduhu ta Itamara garana amo.
english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

motu: Mari ese e duanaia guna tauna na Iehoiaribi, iharuana na ledaia,
english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

motu: ihatoina na Harimi, ihahanina na Seorimi,
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

motu: iha-imana na Malkia, ihatauratoina na Miamini,
english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

motu: ihahituna na Hakoso, ihataurahanina na Abia,
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

motu: ihataurahani-tana na Iesua, ihagwautana na Sekania,
english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

motu: ihagwauta-tana na Eliasibi, ihagwautaruana na lakimi,
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

motu: ihagwauta-toina na Hupa, ihagwauta-hanina na Iesebeaba,
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

motu: ihagwauta-imana na Bilga, ihagwauta-tauratoina na Imere,
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

motu: ihagwautahituna na Hesiri, ihagwauta-taurahanina na Hapisese,
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

motu: ihagwauta-taurahanitana na Petahia, iharuahuina na Iehesekele,
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

motu: iharuahui-tana na lakin, iharuahuiruana na Gamulu,
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

motu: iharuahui-toina na Delaia, iharuahui-hanina na Maasia.
english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

motu: Ini ta ta na mai edia ḡaukara, Iehova ena dubu ai e raka vareai negadia ai, Iehova, Israel Diravana ese senedia Aaron e haḡania bena Aaron ese taravadia e atu heḡereḡerena.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

motu: Levi garana orena ai: Amram natuna edia amo, Subaele; Subaele natuna edia amo, Iehedeia.
english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

motu: Rehabia enai: Rehabia natuna edia amo, Isihia, tau lohia.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

motu: Isihara taudia edia amo, Selomoto; Selomoto natuna edia amo, Iahata.
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

motu: Heberon natuna: Ieria, tau lohia, ihararuana na Amaria, ihatatoina na Iahasiel, ihahahanina na lekameama.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

motu: Usiele natuna, Mika; Mika natuna, Samiri;
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

motu: Mika tadina, Isihia; Isihia natuna edia amo, Sekaria
english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

motu: Merari natuna: Mali bona Musi. Iaasia natuna, Beno.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

motu: Merari natuna, Iaasia ena amo: Beno, Sohama, Sakuru, Ibri.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

motu: Mali ena amo: Eleasara; ia na asi natuna.
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

motu: Kisa ena amo, Kisa natuna: lerahamele.
english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

motu: Musi natuna: Mali, Edere, lerimoto. Levi garana bunu, edia iduhu ta ta ai.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

motu: Ini danu, iduhu kwaradia ta ta mai tadidia ta ta ida, man e abi, tadikakadia Aaron garana heḡereḡeredia, King David bona Sadok bona Ahimelek, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia iduhu kwaradia, vairadiai.
english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

motu: David bona ḡaukara biagudia ese Asaf bona Hemana bona Iedutunu natudia haida e abidia hidi, edia ḡaukara be hatai-hatai ḡaudia maraḡidia bona badadia bona botabota ḡaudia amo bae peroveta. Unu ḡaukara taudia ladadia bona edia ḡaukara herevadia bini.
english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

motu: Asaf natuna edia amo: Sakuru, Iosef, Netania, Asarela. Idia na Asaf natuna, bona Asaf ese e biagudia. Hari Asaf na hanua pavapavana ena hahedua heḡereḡerena ai e perovetava.
english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

motu: Iedutunu ena amo: Iedutunu natuna Gedalia, Seri, Iesaia, Simei, Hasabia, Matitia, tauratoiosi. Tamadia Iedutunu ese e biagudia; una tau na Iehova ihanamona bona i'imodaina ai hatai-hatai ḡaudia amo e perovetava.
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.

motu: Hemana ena amo: Hemana natuna Bukia, Matania, Usiele, Sebuele; bona Ierimoto, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti; bona Romamatiesere, Iosobekasa, Maloti, Hotiri, Mahasioto.
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

motu: Unu iboudiai na Hemana, hanua pavapavana ena mata-hanai tauna, natuna. Una tau na Dirava ese vada e gwau henia hamata, i'imodaina baine habadaia; badina be Dirava ese Hemana na natuna mamaruanedia gwauta-hani bona natuna hahinedia tatoi e henia.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

motu: Idia iboudiai na Iehova ena dubu lalonai tamadia ese e biagudiava ane ḡaukaradia ai, mai botabota auridia bona hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia ida, Dirava ena dubu gaukarana lalonai. Asaf bona Iedutunu bona Hemana na hanua pavapavana ese e biagudiava.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

motu: Idia bona tadikakadia Iehova ihanamolaina anedia iabidia e hadibalaidia taudia, iboudiai mai dibadia momo, na sinahu-rua taurahani-ahui taurahani.
english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

motu: Idia na mari e abi, ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara iduanaidia totona. Maraḡidia bona badadia, hahediba taudia bona e hadibadia taudia, na e kara henidia negeregere.
english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

motu: Mari ese e duanaia guna tauna, Asaf enai, na Iosef. Iharuana na Gedalia, mai tadikakana bona natuna verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

motu: Ihatoina na Sakuru, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida gwauta-rua.
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihahanina na Isiri, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Iha-imana na Netania, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihatauratoina na Bukia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihahituna na lesarela, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihataurahanina na lesaia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihataurahani-tana na Matania, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwautana na Simei, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-tana na Asarele, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-ruana na Hasabia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-toina na Subaele, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-hanina na Matitia, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwautaimana na Ieremoto, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-tauratoina na Hanania, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-hituna na Iosobekasa, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-taurahanina na Hanani, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Ihagwauta-taurahanitana na Maloti, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Iharuahuina na Eliata, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Iharuahui-tana na Hotiri, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Iharuahuiruana na Gidalti, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Iharuahui-toina na Mahasioto, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

motu: Iharuahui-hanina na Romamatiesere, mai natuna bona tadikakana verina ida, gwauta-rua.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia edia orea bini. Kora taudia edia amo: Meselemia Kore, Asaf natuna ta.
english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

motu: Meselemia na mai natuna haida: tau-roboana na Sekaria, iharuana na lediaele, ihatoina na Sebadia, ihahanina na Iataniele,
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

motu: iha-imana na Elam, ihatauratoina na Iehohanan, ihahituna na Eliehoenai.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

motu: Obed-edom danu na mai natuna haida: tau-roboana na Semaia, iharuana na Iehosabad, ihatoina na Ioa, ihahanina na Sakara, iha-imana na Netanele,
english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

motu: ihatauratoina na Amiele, ihahituna na Isakara, ihataurahanina na Peuletai; badina be Dirava ese e hanamoa.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

motu: Ia natuna Semaia ese danu natuna mamaruanedia haida e havaradia; idia na edia iduhu kwaradia, badina be idia na mai dibadia momo taudia.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

motu: Semaia natuna: Otni, Refaele, Obed, Elsabad; Elsabad tadikakana Elihu bona Semakia na mai dibadia momo taudia.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

motu: Ini iboudiai na Obed-edom natuna, bona idia natudia bona tadikakadia, mai dibadia momo taudia, edia diba vada e heḡereḡere ḡaukara ikarana ai, iboudiai na tauratoi-ahui rua, Obed-edom garana amo.
english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

motu: Meselemia na mai natuna bona tadikakana, mai dibadia momo taudia, gwauta-taurahani.
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

motu: Bona Hosa, Merari garana ta, danu na mai natuna haida: Simri, tau lohia, (ia na dia tau-roboana, a tamana ese lohia tauna ai e halaoa);
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

motu: ihararuana na Hilkia; ihatatoina na Tebalia; ihahahanina na Sekaria. Hosa natuna bona tadikakana iboudiai na gwauta-toi.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

motu: Ini ikoukou igimadia taudia edia orea, ta ta mai edia lohia taudia, na mai edia ḡaukara Iehova ena dubu ḡaukaradia ikaradia ai, tadikakadia heḡereḡeredia.
english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.

motu: Iduhu ta ta ai, edia ikoukou iduanai-henidia totona, mari e abi, maraḡidia bona badadia heḡereḡere.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

motu: Mari ese Selemia e duanaia, laurabada kahana ena. Ia natuna Sekaria danu, hahealo tauna ta mai aonegana, na mari ese e duanaia, mirigini kahana ena.
english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

motu: Obed-edom na e duanaia, diho kahana ena, bona natuna na habou-habou rumana ena.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

motu: Supim bona Hosa na e duanaidia, lahara kahana ena; Salekete ikoukouna na unuseni ai, e dae laomu dalana ai. Edia nega edia nega ai e gima.
english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

motu: Laurabada kahana ai na tatau tauratoi, dina ta ta ai; mirigini kahana ai na hahani, dina ta ta ai; diho kahana ai danu hahani, dina ta ta ai; bona habou-habou rumana ai rarua rarua amo.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

motu: Lahara kahana dehena ai na tatau hahani dala ai bona rarua dehe ai.
english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia edia orea bunu; idia na Kora taudia bona Merari garana.
english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

motu: Ahia, Levi iduhuna tauna, ese Dirava ena dubu kohudia bona herahia helaḡadia ihaboudia rumadia e nariva.
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

motu: Ladan natuna, Gereson iduhuna taudia Ladan ena amo e vara, Gereson iduhuna ikwarana taudia Ladan, tau Gereson, ena amo e vara: Iehieli.
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

motu: Iehieli natuna, Setama bona tadina Ioel ese Iehova ena dubu kohudia ihaboudia rumadia e nariva.
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.

motu: Amram bona Isahara bona Heberon bona Usiele iduhudia amo:
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

motu: Sebuele (ia na Geresom garana bona Geresom na Mose garana) na habou-habou rumadia itataodia tauna badana.
english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

motu: Ia tadikakana: Eliesere ena amo, natuna Rehabia; ia natuna Iesaia; ia natuna Ioram; ia natuna Sikri; ia natuna Selomoto.
english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

motu: Hari Selomoto bona tadikakana ese herahia helaḡadia hanua pavapavana David bona iduhu kwaradia bona daha biagudia bona sinahu biagudia bona tuari oreadia biagudia ese e hahelaḡadia gaudia, ihaboudia rumadia iboudiai na e itadia taova.
english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

motu: Tuari ai e abi kohudia amo idia ese herahia ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena dubu inanatalaina ḡaudia ai baela.
english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.

motu: Bona mata-hanai tauna Samuel, bona Saulo Kisa, bona Abnere Nere, bona Ioab Seruia, ese e hahelaḡadia ḡaudia danu; herahia helaḡadia iboudiai na Selomoto mai tadikakana ida ese e nariva.
english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

motu: Isihara iduhuna amo, Kenania mai natuna ida e duanaidia, murimuri kahana ḡaukaradia bae kara, Israel ena; heitatao taudia bona hahemaoro taudia ai baela.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

motu: Heberon iduhuna amo, Hasabia mai tadikakana ida, mai dibadia momo taudia daha-ta sinahu-hitu, ese Israel tanona Ioridane sinavaina lahara kahana e itaia taova, Iehova ena ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, bona hanua pavapavana isiaina ilao-henina danu.
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh and for the service of the king.

motu: Heberon iduhuna lalona amo leria na Heberon iduhudia idau-idau iboudiai edia lohia. (David ena lohia laḡanina ihahari-ahuina ai hetahu e karaia, bena mai dibadia momo taudia haida na idia bogaragidiai e davaridia, lasere, Gilead hanuana ta, ai.)
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

motu: King David ese ia mai tadikakana ida e duanaidia, mai dibadia momo taudia daha-rua sinahu-hitu, iduhu kwaradia, Ruben bona Gad iduhudia bona Manase iduhu-kahana taudia na idia ese bae itadia tao, Dirava ena ḡaukara iboudiai lalodiai, bona hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara ai danu.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

motu: Israel taudia ladadia bini, iduhu kwaradia bona daha bona sinahu Iohiadia bona edia orea biagudia, hanua pavapavana isiaina e lao heniva, laḡani lalonai hua ta ta ai orea edia lao mai e ita taova; orea ta ta taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani. + 27:1 Gerebu-rua daha-hani = 24,000. *
english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

motu: Iasobeama, Sabdiele natuna, na orea gini-gunana e biaguava, hua gini-gunana ai; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

motu: Ia na Perese garana; bona ia ese tuari lohiadia iboudiai e biagudiava, hua gini-gunana ai.
english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

motu: Dodai tau Ahohi ese hua iharuana oreana e biaguava; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

motu: Hua ihatoina oreana biaguna na Benaia, hahelaḡa tauna Iehoiada natuna; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

motu: Ina Benaia na goada-herea tauna ta, vanegai toi-ahuiosi bogaragidiai, bona ia ese toi-ahuiosi e biagudiava; ia natuna Amisabad ese ena orea e biagudiava.
english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

motu: Ihahanina na Asahele, Ioab tadina, hua ihahanina ena, bona ia natuna Sebadia ia murinai; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

motu: Hua iha-imana oreana biaguna na Samahutu, tau Isiraha; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

motu: Ihatauratoina, hua ihatauratoina ena, na Ira, Ikese tau Tekoa natuna; ena orea taudia na gerebu-rua daha-hani.
