english: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to Yahweh, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

motu: Bena idia ese lagau-hanai mamoena na lahi ai e gabua, taravatu heḡereḡerena; bona herahia helaḡadia ḡaudia na uro maraḡidia bona badadia bona nau lalodiai e nadudia, bena e laohaidia haraḡa, hanua taudia dekediai.
english: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.

motu: Gabeamo idia na sibodia adia bona hahelaḡa taudia adia e nadu, badina be hahelaḡa taudia, Aaron vevena, ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia bona digaradia ihahelaḡadia e hekwarahilai ela bona hanua e boi. Una dainai Levi taudia ese sibodia adia bona hahelaḡa taudia, Aaron vevena, adia e nadu.
english: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

motu: Ane-abi taudia, Asaf vevena, na edia gabu ai e nohova, David ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena; bona Asaf bona Hemana bona ledutunu, hanua pavapavana ena mata-hanai tauna, danu. Bona ikoukou igimadia taudia na ikoukou ta ta ai e nohova; asi badina edia ḡaukara bae rakatania, badina be tadikakadia, Levi taudia, ese adia e nadu.
english: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

motu: Taunabunai Iehova isiaina ilao-henina idoinai e heḡaeḡaelaia una dina ai, lagau-hanai ariana bae karaia bona ḡole-oho boubouna ḡaudia Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana latanai bae hahelaḡadia totona, King Iosia ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
english: So all the service of Yahweh was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on Yahweh’s altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.

motu: Bena Israel taudia hahidaosi unuseni ai e hebouva ese lagau-hanai ariana e karaia una negana ai, bona asie hatubua flaoana ariana danu e karaia, dina hitu lalodiai.
english: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

motu: Peroveta tauna Samuel negana amo, lagau-hanai ariana ta se karaia Israel ai; Israel pavapavana ta ese lagau-hanai ariana ta se karaia, una Iosia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona Iuda bona Israel unuseni ai e hebouva taudia iboudiai bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ese e karaia ḡauna heḡereḡerena.
english: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

motu: Iosia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahanina ai una lagau-hanai ariana e karaia. Iosia e mase
english: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.

motu: Una idoinai murinai, Iosia ese dubu vada e lailaia vaitani negana ai, Neko, Aigupto pavapavana na tuari totona Karakemisi, Eufrate sinavaina badibadinai, ela; bena Iosia ese ia ituari-henina totona e lao henia.
english: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

motu: A ia ese gwaukau taudia na dekena e siaidia lao, eto, Iuda pavapavana e, ita padadai be dahaka? Hari dina ai lau ese oi ihadikamu totona asinama, a na tuari heniamu oreana na mai henia; bona Dirava ese vada e haḡanigu, baina kara haraḡa. Dirava na lau ida; ia ilao-ahuna ba hadokoa, ia ese baine habuamu tari na garina.
english: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

motu: Ḡau tamona, Iosia na se ura iena amo baine raka oho; a ia na sibona toana e ha-idaua, baine tuari henia totona. Ia ese Neko ena hereva Dirava uduna amo na se kamonaidia, a Megido taorana ai tuari e kwatua.
english: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

motu: A peva taudia ese King Iosia e tarakia. Bena hanua pavapavana ese ena hesiai taudia na e hamaorodia, eto, Dauha a laohaigu, badina be vada na bero dikadika.
english: The archers shot at King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, “Take me away, because I am seriously wounded!”

motu: Taunabunai ena hesiai taudia ese kariota amo e abia dobi, ma ena kariota iharuana amo e laohaia Ierusalem ai. Bena e mase; tubu tama edia gara ai e guria. Iuda bona Ierusalem idoinai ese Iosia taina e tai.
english: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

motu: Ieremia ese Iosia e rohe-ahulaia, bona ane-abi tataudia bona hahinedia ese danu Iosia e rohe-ahulaia, ema bona ina dina. Ini na edia kara ai e halaoa Israel ai; ḡaudia bunu idia na Rohe-ahu Bukana lalonai e hetore.
english: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.

motu: Iosia ena kara oredia, bona ena ḡaukara namodia Iehova ena taravatu ai e tore heḡereḡeredia,
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in Yahweh’s law,

motu: bona e kara karadia, matamana ela dokona, a itaia, idia na Israel bona Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore.
english: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

motu: Tano taudia ese Iehoahasa, Iosia natuna, e abia, pavapava ai e halaoa Ierusalem ai, tamana gabuna ai.
english: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.

motu: Iehoahasa ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui-toi, e lohia matama negana ai; ia na hua toi hona e lohiava Ierusalem ai.
english: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

motu: Bena Aigupto pavapavana ese ena dagi e abia oho Ierusalem ai, bona heaiva na tano taudia edia amo e gwauraia, silver talent * sinahu-ta + 36:3 Silver talent sinahu-ta = 5 tonnes sisivana. Gold talent ta = 54 kilograms sisivana. * bona gold talent * ta.
english: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent + 36:3 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * of gold.

motu: Bena Aigupto pavapavana ese Iehoahasa tadina Eliakim na Iuda bona Ierusalem pavapavana ai e halaoa, bona ladana e ha-idaua Iehoiakim. A Neko ese kakana Iehoahasa e abia, Aigupto e laohaia. King Iehoiakim
english: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

motu: Iehoiakim ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui-ima, e lohia matama negana ai; ena lohia laḡanidia na gwauta-ta Ierusalem ai. Ia na Iehova, ena Dirava, vairanai e kara havara.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight.

motu: Bena Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e tuari henia, bona auri gadeadia ai e ḡuia, Babulono baine laohaia totona.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.

motu: Nebukadnesara ese danu Iehova ena dubu kohudia haida na Babulono e laohai, iena ruma badana ai e atodia Babulono ai.
english: Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of Yahweh’s house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

motu: Iehoiakim ena kara oredia, kara dika-hereadia ia ese e kara, sivaraidia, bona hereva dikadia ia latanai e gwaurai, a itaia, idia na Israel bona Iuda Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai e hetore. Bena ia natuna Iehoiakini na e lohia, ia gabuna ai. Iehoiakini na Babulono e laohaia
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

motu: Iehoiakini ena mauri laḡanidia na taurahani, + 36:9 “Taurahani”. 2 Hanua Pavapavadia Karoa 24, siri 8 lalonai e torea “gwauta-taurahani”. * e lohia matama negana ai; ia na hua toi dina gwauta hona Ierusalem ai e lohiava. Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havarava.
english: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

motu: Bena gara-kau negana ai, King Nebukadnesara e hesiai, bena Babulono e hakaua lao; Iehova ena dubu kohudia herea-daedia danu e laohai. Bena kakana Sedekia na Iuda bona Ierusalem pavapavana ai e halaoa. King Sedekia
english: At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of Yahweh’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

motu: Sedekia ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui-ta, e lohia matama negana ai; ena lohia laḡanidia Ierusalem ai na gwauta-ta.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

motu: Ia na Iehova, ena Dirava, vairanai e kara havara; bona peroveta tauna Ieremia, Iehova uduna herevadia e gwaurai tauna, vairanai se hahemanau.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from Yahweh’s mouth.

motu: King Nebukadnesara ese e haduaia dainai ia na Dirava ladana ai vada e gwau hamata; to ia ese hari King Nebukadnesara e gwau edeede henia. Ia ese aiona e ha-aukaia bona lalona danu e ha-aukaia, Iehova, Israel Diravana, basine haḡerea.
english: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia badadia bona hanua taudia danu e gwau edeede dikadika, bese idau-idau edia kara dika-hereadia iboudiai e tohotohodia; bona Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai, ia ese vada e hahelaḡaia ḡauna, na idia ese e hamiroa.
english: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted Yahweh’s house which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

motu: Iehova, senedia edia Dirava, ese hereva na ena gwaukau taudia ududia amo e siai havara-havara, badina be ia ese ena taunimanima bona ena noho gabuna e bogadia hisi.
english: Yahweh, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;

motu: A vaia idia ese Dirava ena gwaukau taudia e ḡonaḡonalaidia, ena hereva e dadaraidia bona ena peroveta taudia e hevasehalaidia, ela bona Iehova ena badu e vara, ena bese taudia latadiai, ela bona asi ihanamo-louna dalana. Iuda iabi-maurina
english: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.

motu: Una dainai, ia ese Kaldea pavapavana e hakaua mai, idia ihadikadia totona. Ia ese edia eregabe taudia na dare amo e aladia mase, edia dubu ena helaḡa gabuna ai. Tauhau eiava hane-ulato, tau badana eiava tau burukana, se bogadia hisi; iboudiai na una tau imana ai e atodia.
english: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or infirm. He gave them all into his hand.

motu: Bona Dirava ena dubu kohudia iboudiai, badadia bona maraḡidia, bona Iehova ena dubu ḡaudia herea-daedia, bona hanua pavapavana bona ena lohia taudia edia ḡau herea-daedia, iboudiai ia ese Babulono e laohai.
english: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.

motu: Dirava ena dubu e doua, bona Ierusalem maḡuna e ḡigia dobi, bona ena ruma badadia iboudiai na lahi amo e dou, bona ena kohu ḡoeva-daedia iboudiai e habuadia tari.
english: They burned God’s house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels.

motu: Dare amo e roho mauri taudia na ia ese e abidia mauri, Babulono e laohaidia; bena idia ese ia bona ia natuna isiaidia e lao heniva ela bona Parasa basileiana e gini matama.
english: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,

motu: Unuheto Iehova ena hereva Ieremia uduna amo e gwauraia na vada e hamomokania, ela bona tano ese ena dina helaḡadia vada e moalelaidia. Una e haḡaḡaea dinadia iboudiai na e helaga, ela bona laḡani hitu-ahui e ore. Kurese ena Haheḡani
english: to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

motu: Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai, Iehova ena hereva Ieremia uduna amo e gwauraia na anina baine vara totona, Iehova ese Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, e rohea; bena ia ese haheḡani ta e gwauraia ena basileia idoinai lalonai, bona e tore danu.
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

motu: Haheḡani na binai. Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ini e gwau tomamu: Iehova, guba Diravana, ese tanobada basileiadia iboudiai vada e henigu, bona vada e haḡanigu, ena dubu auta baina haginia Ierusalem ai, Iuda tanona ai. Daika daika umui bogaragirnui ai na iena bese tauna, Iehova, ia ena Dirava, ese baine bamoa. Ia na baine dae lao.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up.’”

motu: Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai, Iehova ena hereva Ieremia uduna amo e gwauraia na anina baine vara totona Iehova ese Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, e rohea; bena ia ese haheḡani ta e gwauraia ena basileia idoinai laionai, bona e torea danu.
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

motu: Haheḡani na binai. Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Iehova, guba Diravana, ese tanobada basileiadia iboudiai vada e henigu, bona vada e haḡanigu ena dubu auta baina haginia Ierusalem ai, Iuda tanona ai.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God + 1:2 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

motu: Daika daika umui bogaragimui ai na iena bese tauna, Iehova, ia ena Dirava, ese baine bamoa. Ia na Ierusalem, Iuda tanona ai, baine dae lao, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena dubu baine haginia lou. Ia na Ierusalem ai e nohomu Diravana.
english: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Yahweh, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

motu: Bona edena gabu edena gabu ai doini e noho hedoamu taudia ta ta na unu e nohomu gabudia taudia ese bae durudia, silver * bona gold * bona kohu bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia bae henidia, bona lalo-namo herahiadia danu, Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai ena. Ierusalem ilou-henina
english: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

motu: Bena Iuda bona Beniamina iduhu kwaradia na e tore isi, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia danu, Dirava ese vada e rohedia taudia iboudiai, Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai bae haginia lou totona;
english: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem.

motu: bona dekedia taudia iboudiai ese silver * ḡaudia bona gold * bona kohu bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia bona dava-bada ḡaudia na e henidia, mai edia lalo-namo herahiadia iboudiai ida.
english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

motu: Hanua pavapavana Kurese ese danu Iehova ena dubu kohudia, Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem amo e laohai bona ena dirava edia dubu ai e ato ḡaudia, na e abidia lasi.
english: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of Yahweh’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

motu: Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ese e abidia lasi, moni inarina tauna Mitredata imana ai e atodia; bena una tau ese e hagaudia, Iuda lohiana Sesebasara e henia.
english: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

motu: Ihagaudia bini: gold * naudia toi-ahui, silver * naudia daha-ta, kaia ruahui taurahani-ta,
english: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

motu: gold * kibokibodia toi-ahui, silver * kibokibodia idaudia sinahu-hani gwauta, bona ma ḡau idau-idau daha-ta danu.
english: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

motu: Gold * bona silver * ḡaudia iboudiai na daha-ima sinahu-hani. Ini iboudiai na Sesebasara ese e daelaidia, e laohaidia idau gabu ai e hanohodia taudia na Babulono amo Ierusalem e hakaudia dae lao negana ai.
english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

motu: Iuda tanona taudia bini, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese vada e abidia mauri, Babulono tanona vada e laohaidia, bena edia noho-hedoa amo ma e dae lao. Idia na Ierusalem bona Iuda e lou lao, ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ela.
english: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;

motu: Idia na Serubabele bona lesua bona Nehemia bona Seraia bona Reelaia bona Morodekai bona Bilsan bona Mispara bona Bigvai bona Rehumu bona Baanaha ida ela. Israel tataudia ihagaudia binai:
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. motu: Paroso garana, daha-rua sinahu-ta hitu-ahui rua;
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

motu: Sefatia garana, sinahu-toi hitu-ahui rua;
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

motu: Ara garana, sinahu-hitu hitu-ahui ima;
english: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.

motu: Pahatamoab garana (unu na Iesua bona Ioab garadia), daha-rua sinahu-taurahani gwauta-rua;
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.

motu: Elam garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
english: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

motu: Satu garana, sinahu-taurahanita hari-ahui ima;
english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty-five.

motu: Sakai garana, sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui;
english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.

motu: Bani garana, sinahu-tauratoi hari-ahui rua;
english: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.

motu: Bebai garana, sinahu-tauratoi ruahui toi;
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.

motu: Asgada garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua ruahui rua;
english: The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred twenty-two.

motu: Adonikama garana, sinahu-tauratoi tauratoi-ahui tauratoi;
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-six.

motu: Bigvai garana, daha-rua imahui tauratoi;
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.

motu: Adini garana, sinahu-hani imahui hani;
english: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.

motu: Atere garana (unu na Hesekia garana), taurahanita-ahui taurahani;
english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

motu: Besai garana, sinahu-toi ruahui toi;
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-three.

motu: Iora garana, sinahu-ta gwauta-rua;
english: The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.

motu: Hasumu garana, sinahu-rua ruahui toi;
english: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty-three.

motu: Gibara garana, taurahanita-ahui ima;
english: The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.

motu: Betelehem garana, sinahu-ta ruahui toi;
english: The children of Bethlehem, one hundred twenty-three.

motu: Netofa taudia, imahui tauratoi;
english: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.

motu: Anatoto taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui taurahani;
english: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

motu: Asamavete taudia, hari-ahui rua;
english: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.

motu: Kiriat-arimi bona Kefira bona Beroto taudia, sinahu-hitu hari-ahui toi;
english: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

motu: Rama bona Geba taudia, sinahu-tauratoi ruahui ta;
english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

motu: Mikma taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui rua;
english: The men of Michmas, one hundred twenty-two.

motu: Betele bona Ai taudia, sinahu-rua ruahui toi;
english: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty-three.

motu: Nebo taudia, imahui rua;
english: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.

motu: Magabisi taudia, sinahu-ta imahui tauratoi;
english: The children of Magbish, one hundred fifty-six.

motu: Elam ma ta taudia, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
english: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

motu: Harimi taudia, sinahu-toi ruahui;
english: The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

motu: Lod bona Hadidi bona Ono taudia, sinahu-hitu ruahui ima;
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.

motu: Ieriko taudia, sinahu-toi hari-ahui ima;
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

motu: Senaha taudia, daha-toi sinahu-tuaratoi toiahui.
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia: Iedaia (Iesua ena iduhu tauna) garana, sinahu-taurahanita hitu-ahui toi;
english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

motu: Imere garana, daha-ta imahui rua;
english: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

motu: Pasahuru garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua hari-ahui hitu;
english: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

motu: Harimi garana, daha-ta gwauta-hitu.
english: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.

motu: Levi taudia: lesua bona Kadmiele garadia (idia na Hodavia garana), hituahui hani.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

motu: Ane-abi taudia: Asaf garana, sinahu-ta ruahui taurahani.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia garadia: Salumu garana, Atere garana, Talmon garana, Akubu garana, Hatita garana, Sobai garana. Iboudiai na sinahu-ta toi-ahui taurahani-ta.
english: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.

motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia: Siha garana, Hasufa garana, Tabaoto garana,
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

motu: Kero garana, Siaha garana, Padono garana,
english: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

motu: Lebana garana, Hagabaha garana, Akubu garana,
english: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

motu: Hagaba garana, Samalai garana, Hanana garana,
english: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,

motu: Gidele garana, Gahara garana, Re-aia garana,
english: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

motu: Resini garana, Nekoda garana, Gasama garana,
english: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

motu: Usa garana, Pasea garana, Besai garana,
english: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

motu: Asna garana, Meunimi garana, Nefisimi garana,
english: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,

motu: Bakabuku garana, Hakufa garana, Harahuru garana,
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

motu: Basalutu garana, Mehida garana, Harasa garana,
english: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

motu: Barako garana, Sisera garana, Tema garana,
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

motu: Nesia garana bona Hatifa garana.
english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

motu: Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia: Sotai garana, Hasoferete garana, Peruda garana,
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,

motu: Iaala garana, Darakono garana, Gidele garana,
english: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

motu: Sefatia garana, Hatili garana, Pokerete-hasabaimi garana bona Ami garana.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia na sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui rua.
english: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

motu: Ini na Tele-mela bona Tele-harasa bona Kerubu bona Adana bona Imere amo ema taudia, a edia iduhu bona senedia ladadia ihamomokanidia asi dibadia, idia na Israel besena eiava lasi:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, + 2:59 or, seed * whether they were of Israel:

motu: Delaia garana, Tobia garana bona Nekoda garana, sinahu-tauratoi imahui rua.
english: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

motu: Hahelaga taudia garadia danu: Habaia garana, Hakoso garana, Barasilai garana (una tau ese Barasilai tau Gilead natuna hahinedia ta e adavaia, bena idia ladadia ta ai e henemai).
english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

motu: Unu na ladadia e tahu, uru ladadia bukadia ai, to asie davaridia; una dainai hahelaḡa dagina amo e atodia tabe, idia na dia ḡoḡoeva dainai.
english: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

motu: Hanua lohiana ese e hamaorodia, idia na aniani helaḡa-hereana basie ania, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna ta ese Urim bona Tumim + 2:63 Urim bona Tumim. Esodo 28, s. 30 ba itaia. * ediai baine henanadai.
english: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

motu: Hegogo idoinai be taunimanima gerebu-hani daha-rua sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui; + 2:64 Gerebu-hani daha-rua sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui = 42,360. *
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

motu: bona edia hesiai tataudia bona hahinedia danu daha-hitu sinahu-toi toi-ahui hitu; edia ane-abi tataudia bona hahinedia danu na sinahu-rua.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

motu: Edia hosi na sinahu-hitu toi-ahui tauratoi; edia doniki badadia na sinahu-rua hari-ahui ima;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

motu: edia kamelo na sinahu-hani toi-ahui ima; bona edia doniki maraḡidia na daha-tauratoi sinahu-hitu ruahui.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

motu: Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai e kau negana ai, iduhu kwaradia haida ese lalo-namo herahiadia e heni, Dirava ena dubu ena, gabuna korikorina ai baine gini helaoreana.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.

motu: Edia taḡa heḡereḡerena idia ese una ḡaukara idurulaina monina e heni, gold * darikidia gerebu-tauratoi daha-ta, bona silver * minadia + 2:69 “Dariki” bona “mina” na Parasa taudia edia moni ladadia. Ini gold bona silver monidia iboudiai na reana K200,000 sisivana. * daha-ima, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki sinahu-ta.
english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, + 2:69 a daric was a gold coin issued by a Persian king, weighing about 8.4 grams or about 0.27 troy ounces each. * five thousand minas + 2:69 A mina is about 600 grams or 1.3 U. S. pounds, so 5,000 minas is about 3 metric tons. * of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona taunimanima haida na Ierusalem ai bona hetabira tanodia ai e nohova; ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona dubu ena hesiai taudia na edia hanua lalodiai e nohova. Israel taudia iboudiai danu edia hanua lalodiai e nohova.
english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

motu: Hua ihahituna e kau negana ai, Israel taudia na hanua lalodiai e nohova. Bena taunimanima na Ierusalem ela, e hegogo hebou, tau tamona na heto.
english: When the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

motu: Bena Iesua Iosadak, mai bamona hahelaḡa taudia ida, bona Serubabele Sealtiele, mai varavarana ida, e tore isi, Israel Diravana ena ihaboulaina patana e larebaia, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia na ia latanai bae hahelaḡadia totona, Dirava ena tau Mose ena taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena.
english: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana na ena gabu ai e haginia, badina be gari ese e butudia tao, unu tano taudia daidiai; bena ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia na ia latanai e hahelaḡadia Iehova ena, daba ai bona adorahi ai.
english: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

motu: Bona kalaga ariana e karaia, e torea heḡereḡerena, bona dina ta ta amo ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia hahidaosi e hahelaḡadia, taravatu ese dina ta ta ahudia e gwaurai heḡereḡerena.
english: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;

motu: Una murinai idia ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia loulouva, hua matamata bouboudia bona Iehova ena aria negadia korikoridia bouboudia, bona ta ta edia lalo-namo bouboudia, Iehova e heni ḡaudia, iboudiai danu.
english: and afterward the continual burnt offering, the offerings of the new moons, of all the set feasts of Yahweh that were consecrated, and of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to Yahweh.

motu: Hua ihahituna dinana gini-gunana ai idia ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia matama, Iehova ena. A Iehova ena dubu badina na do asie hadaia.
english: From the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh; but the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was not yet laid.

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese nadi iḡaukaralaidia taudia bona kamuta taudia na moni e henidia; bona aniani bona inuinu ḡaudia bona dehoro na Sidono bona Turo taudia e henidia, sida audia na Lebanon amo bae lasilaidia kone ai bona lopa ai bae atodia na davana, Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena gwau-maoro heḡereḡerena. Dubu ihagini-louna e matamaia
english: They also gave money to the masons and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.

motu: Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai e lou henia laḡanina iharuana huana iharuana lalonai, Serubabele Sealtiele bona lesua losadak na e ḡaukara matama, tadikakadia oredia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia, bona abi-mauri amo Ierusalem vada e lou henia taudia iboudiai ida. Idia ese laḡani ruahui vada e hanai taudia Levi oreana lalonai e duanaidia, idia ese Iehova ena dubu ḡaukarana bae itaia tao.
english: Now in the second year of their coming to God’s house at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem, began the work and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of Yahweh’s house.

motu: Bena Iesua, mai natuna bona varavarana ida, bona Kadmiele mai natuna, Iuda vevena taudia, ida, ese Dirava ena dubu ai e ḡaukarava taudia na e itadia tao hebou, Henadab natuna bona Levi taudia mai natudia bona varavaradia ida.
english: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together to have the oversight of the workmen in God’s house: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.

motu: Ruma-hagini taudia ese Iehova ena dubu badina e hadaia negana ai, hahelaḡa taudia ese edia dabua helaḡadia e hahedokilai, bena mai kibidia ida e raka kahira, bona Levi taudia, Asaf garana, mai edia botabota auridia ida, e raka ela, Iehova ihanamolaina totona, David, Israel pavapavana, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
english: When the builders laid the foundation of Yahweh’s temple, they set the priests in their vestments with trumpets, with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahweh, according to the directions of David king of Israel.

motu: Bena ane e abi hadava-hadava, Iehova e imodaia bona e hahenamo henia, eto, Badina be ia na namo; Badina be ena hebogahisi e hesiriu hanaihanaimu, Israel enai. Bena Iehova e hanamoa negana ai, taunimanima iboudiai na e lolo mai gao badadia ida, Iehova ena dubu badina vada e hadaia dainai.
english: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahweh, because the foundation of Yahweh’s house had been laid.

motu: A hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona iduhu kwaradia loḡora, tau burukadia, dubu gunana e itaia taudia na e tai lolololo, ina dubu badina e hadaia e itaia negana ai; a hutuma na moale dainai e lolo badabada.
english: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. Many also shouted aloud for joy,

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima asie diba maoro dahaka reḡe, moale eiava taunimanima edia taitai reḡedia; badina be taunimanima na e lolo badabada, bona reḡena na dauhai danu e kamonaiva.
english: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard far away.

motu: A Iuda bona Beniamina taudia inaidia na e kamonai hari noho-hedoa amo vada e lou mai taudia ese Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena dubu e haginiava;
english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to Yahweh, the God of Israel,

motu: bena idia ese Serubabele bona iduhu kwaradia dekedia ela, e hereva henidia, eto, Mani emui kara ai na umui ida dubu baita haginia hebou; badina be ai ese emui Dirava a toma henia dihomu, umui heḡereḡeremui, bona a bouamu danu, Esarahadon, Asuria pavapavana, ese e mailaimai bona ina gabu ai e hanohomai negana amo ema bona harihari.
english: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”

motu: A Serubabele bona lesua bona iduhu lohiadia oredia Israel ai ese e haere henidia, eto, Umui na asi emui ḡaukara ai emai ai, emai Dirava ena dubu ihaginina ai; a ai sibomai ese baia haginia, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ena, King Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, vada e haḡanimai heḡereḡerena.
english: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to Yahweh, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”

motu: Bena tano taudia ese Iuda taudia lalodia e ani bona e hagaridia, una ḡaukara ai;
english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

motu: bona hahealo taudia haida davadia e kara, edia ura ḡaukarana bae laoa ahu, Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena dina iboudiai, ela bona Darauese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia negana.
english: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

motu: Bena Ahasuero e lohia matama negana ai, idia ese hahebade pepana e torea, Iuda bona Ierusalem inoholaidia taudia ihahebadelaidia.
english: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

motu: Aratasasta e lohiava negana ai, Bisilama bona Mitredata bona Tabele mai bamodia oredia ida ese Aratasasta, Parasa pavapavana, e tore henia. Edia revareva be Aram revarevadia bona gadona amo e torea.
english: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language.

motu: Rehumu, tuari oreana biaguna, bona Simisai, itorena tauna, ese Ierusalem ihadikana revarevana ta na King Aratasasta e tore henia.
english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows.

motu: Rehumu, tuan oreana biaguna, bona Simisai, itorena tauna, mai bamodia oredia ida, hahemaoro taudia, lohia taudia, heitatao taudia, bona Parasa bona Ereke bona Babulono bona Susa taudia (unu na Elam taudia),
english: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,

motu: bona lohia badana bona herea-daena Osonopara ese e laohaidia Samaria hanuadia bona Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana orena lalodiai e hanohodia besedia oredia, ese revareva e torea.
english: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote.

motu: E siaia revarevana lalonai e tore herevadia bini: Revareva King Aratasasta ena: Emu hesiai taudia, Sinavai Badana inikahana basileiana ai e nohomu taumai, ese a hahenamo henimuimu.
english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To|strong="H5922" * King|strong="H4430" * Artaxerxes, from|strong="H1768" * your|strong="H1768" * servants|strong="H5649" *, the|strong="H5922" * people beyond|strong="H5675" * the|strong="H5922" * River|strong="H5103" *.

motu: Harihari oi, pavapava taumu, ba diba, hari Iuda taudia oiemu amo dekemai ema na Ierusalem vada ela. Idia ese una daḡedaḡe bona kara dika hanuana ma e haginia loumu; maḡu na be ha-oreamu, bona ruma badidia e banidia.
english: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations.

motu: Oi pavapava taumu ba diba, ina hanua na bema haginia lou bona maguna bema ha-orea, bena idia ese heaiva eiava kohu davadia eiava tax * basie heni, bena oi pavapava taumu emu taḡa na baine maraḡi.
english: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

motu: Ai ese pavapava ena ruma damenana a animu dainai, dia namo ai ese hanua pavapavana ihahemaraina baia itaia; taunabunai ina hereva a siaia vasimu, oi pavapava taumu ihadibamu,
english: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,

motu: bena senemu sisigadia bukana ai bae hetahu. Una sisiga bukana ai ba davaria bona ba diba, ina hanua na daḡedaḡe hanuana, pavapava bona basileia ihadikadia ḡauna. Nega gunadia amo taravatu idadaraina karadia vada e tubu ia lalonai; una dainai ina hanua na e habuaia tari.
english: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.

motu: Oi pavapava taumu a hadibamumu, ina hanua bema gini lou bona maḡuna bema ore negana ai, oi na asi emu ḡau ta, Sinavai Badana inikahana basileiana idoinai lalonai.
english: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese ena haere e siaia. Haere na binai: Revareva Rehumu, tuari oreana biaguna, bona Simisai, itorena tauna, mai bamodia oredia Samaria bona Sinavai Badana enekahana basileiana orena lalodiai e nohomu edia: Na hahenamo henimuimu.
english: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace|strong="H8001" *.

motu: Dekemai o siaia mai revarevana na vairagu ai vada e duahia hedinarai.
english: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

motu: Bena na hahedua, bena vada e hetahu; vada e davaria una hanua ese nega gunadia amo hanua pavapavadia vada e tuari henidia, bona ia lalonai daḡedaḡe bona taravatu idadaraina karadia vada e kara.
english: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.

motu: Pavapava herea-daedia ese Ierusalem vada e lohiaia; Sinavai Badana enekahana basileiana idoinai ese heaiva bona kohu davadia bona tax * na idia e henidia.
english: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them.

motu: Taunabunai ba hahedua, unu tatau ese edia ḡaukara bae hadokoa, bona hanua na basie haginia lou, ela bona lau ese hahedua herevana ta ma baina gwauraia.
english: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, ina kara ai basio manoka. Anina be dahaka ina hekwakwanai ḡauna na baine tubu badabada, hanua pavapavana ihadikalaina.
english: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

motu: King Aratasasta ena revareva herevadia na Rehumu bona itorena tauna Simisai mai bamodia ida vairadiai e duahi hedinarai; bena idia na Iuda taudia Ierusalem ai dekedia ela haraḡa, bona mai goadadia bona mai siahudia ida edia ḡaukara ai e hadokodia.
english: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.

motu: Bena Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai iḡaukaralaina e doko vaitani, ela bona Darauese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina iharuana.
english: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

motu: Peroveta taudia Hagai bona Sekaria Ido ese Iuda taudia, Iuda ai bona Ierusalem ai, e haroro henidia, Israel Diravana, idia e biagudia Diravana, ladana ai.
english: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.

motu: Bena Serubabele Sealtiele bona lesua losadak na e tore isi, Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai ihagini-louna e matamaia; Dirava ena peroveta taudia na idia ida, e durudiava.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God’s house which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.

motu: Una negana ai, Tatenai, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai, mai bamodia ida, na idia dekediai e kau, e hereva henidia, eto, Daika ese hahedua e henimui, ina dubu ba haginia lou bona maḡuna ba ha-ahua?
english: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, came to them, with Shetharbozenai and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?”

motu: Ma e nanadaidia, eto, Ina ruma e haginiamu taudia ladadia be daidia?
english: They also asked for the names of the men who were making this building.

motu: A Iuda tau-badadia na edia Dirava ese e raraidia tao, bena asie hadokodia, ela bona harina na Darauese enai baine kau, bena iena haere na revareva amo bae davaria.
english: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.

motu: Tatenai, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai mai bamona, lohia haida Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana ai e nohova taudia, ida edia revareva, King Darauese enai e siaia ḡauna, herevadia bini.
english: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.

motu: Idia ese sivarai e torea, ia dekena e siaia, eto: Revareva King Darauese ena: maino idoinai avabia.
english: They sent a letter to him, in which was written: To|strong="H5922" * Darius|strong="H1868" * the|strong="H3606" * king|strong="H4430" *, all|strong="H3606" * peace|strong="H8001" *.

motu: Pavapava taumu vada ba diba, ai na Iuda basileiana ala, Dirava badana ena dubu enai. Ia na nadi bada-hereadia amo e haginia bona au na haba ai heheato; ina ḡaukara na e goadalaiamu, bona idia imadia ai anina e varamu.
english: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.

motu: Bena ai ese unu tau-badadia na ini a nanadaidia toma, ato, Daika ese hahedua e henimui, ina dubu ba haginia bona maḡuna ba ha-ahua?
english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”

motu: Bena ladadia a henanadailai, oi ihadibalaimu, idia ikwaradia taudia ladadia baia tore ato.
english: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

motu: Bena idia ese e haere henimai, eto, Ai na guba bona tanobada Diravana ena hesiai taudia, bona laḡani momo vada e lao bubuni Israel pavapavana badana ta ese e haginia bona e ha-orea dubuna na ai ese ma a haginia loumu.
english: Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.

motu: A senemai ese guba Diravana e habadua dainai, ia ese Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, tau Kaldea, imana ai e atodia; bena una tau ese ina dubu e ḡiḡia dobi, bona taunimanima na Babulono kahana e laohaidia.
english: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Kurese, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ginigunana ai, hanua pavapavana ese hahedua herevana e gwauraia, ina Dirava ena dubu baia haginia lou eto.
english: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.

motu: Bona gold * bona silver * gaudia, una Dirava ena dubu kohudia, Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem dubuna amo vada e abi lasi bona Babulono dubuna ai vada e vareailai ḡaudia, na King Kurese ese Babulono dubuna amo e abi lasi, tau ta ladana Sesebasara e henia. Ia ese una tau na lohia tauna ai e halaoa;
english: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

motu: bona e hamaoroa, eto, Ini ḡau avabidia, baola, Ierusalem dubuna lalonai ma bavatodia; bona Dirava ena dubu na gabuna korikori ai ma bae haginia lou.
english: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let God’s house be built in its place.’

motu: Bena hari Sesebasara na ema, bona Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai badina e hadai. Bena una negana ema bona hari, ihaginina vada a ḡaukaralaia, to do se ore.
english: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God’s house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed.

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana lalona bema heḡereḡere, pavapava edia pepa e haboumu rumadia Babulono ai lalodiai bae hetahu, bae diba, King Kurese ese hahedua pepana ta e karaia, ina Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai ihagini-louna e hahedualaia eiava lasi. Bena hanua pavapavana ese ena ura baine hadibalaimai ina kara ai.
english: Now therefore, if it seems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.”

motu: Bena King Darauese e hahedua; bena Babulono tanona ai e hetahu, basileia pepadia e habou rumadia lalodiai.
english: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched.

motu: Bena Ekebatana, Media basileiana ena hanua badana, Ialonai pepa ta e davaria; una pepa ai e tore herevadia bini: Sivarai ta.
english: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:

motu: King Kurese ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana lalonai, King Kurese ese hahedua herevana ta e gwauraia, eto, Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai herevana binai: dubu na bae haginia lou, boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadiamu bona ḡole-oho boubou gaudia e laohaidiamu gabuna; harana latana na kiubit tauratoi-ahui bona lababana danu kiubit tauratoi-ahui, unu bae haginia toma.
english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: Concerning God’s house at Jerusalem, let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid, with its height sixty cubits + 6:3 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and its width sixty cubits;

motu: Nadi ere toi bona au ere ta bae kara. Davana na pavapava ena moni amo ba heni.
english: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.

motu: Ina danu, Dirava ena dubu ena gold * bona silver * ḡaudia Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem dubuna lalona amo e abi bona Babulono e mailai ḡaudia, na bae heni lou, Ierusalem dubuna bae laohai, bena ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai ma bae ato lou. Dirava ena dubu lalonai bavatodia.
english: Also let the gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem, everything to its place. You shall put them in God’s house.

motu: Taunabunai, Tatenai, Sinavai Badana enekahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai, mai bamomui Sinavai Badana enekahana ai e nohomu lohiadia ida, umui na dauhai a noho.
english: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.

motu: Hari Dirava ena dubu ḡaukarana aine hekara; Iuda lohiadia bona tau-badadia ese hari Dirava ena dubu na gabuna korikorina ai bae haginia.
english: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

motu: Ina danu na haganimuimu, ene Iuda tau-badadia na ini ba durudia toma, hari Dirava ena dubu ihagini-louna ai: davana idoinai na ene tatau ba henidia ḡuḡuru haraḡa, pavapava ena moni, hari Sinavai Badana enekahana basileiana ena heaiva ḡauna, amo.
english: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.

motu: Bona dahaka ai e dabumu, boromakau natudia mamaruanedia eiava mamoe mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia guba Diravana iboulaina; bona uit bona damena bona vine ranuna bona dehoro, hahelaḡa taudia Ierusalem ai edia dabu heḡereḡeredia, na dina ta ta amo ba henidia, basio reaia;
english: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,

motu: bena idia ese boubou ḡaudia namodia na bae hahelaḡadia guba Diravana ena, bona bae guriḡuri, hanua pavapavana mai natuna ida edia mauri daidiai.
english: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

motu: Lau na haheduamu danu, tau ta ese ina haheḡani bema ha-idaua, bena au ta iena ruma amo bae raḡaia, bona una tau na una au ai bae gwadaia uru, bena ena ruma na boromakau taḡena ihabouna gabuna ai bae halaoa.
english: I have also made a decree that whoever alters this message, let a beam be pulled out from his house, and let him be lifted up and fastened on it; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

motu: Ina hereva baine ha-idaua, eiava hari Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai baine ḡigia dobi, pavapavana eiava besena na una gabu ai ladana vada e hanohoa Diravana ese baine hadarerea. Lau Darauese na haheduamu; ba karaia balaheni.
english: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.

motu: Bena King Darauese ese e siaia herevana heḡereḡerena, Tatenai, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana, bona Setara-bosenai, mai bamodia ida, ese King Darauese ena hahedua ḡaudia na e karadia balaheni.
english: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.

motu: Bena Iuda tau-badadia ese dubu e haginia, bona edia ḡaukara anina e tubu, peroveta tauna Hagai bona Sekaria Ido edia haroro herevadia daidiai. Dubu ihaginina e haḡugurua, Israel Diravana ena haheḡani bona Kurese bona Darauese bona Aratasasta, Parasa pavapavadia, edia hahedua daidiai.
english: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

motu: King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina ihatauratoina ai, hua ladana Adara ena dina ihatoina ai, una dubu e haḡuḡurua.
english: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

motu: Bena Israel taudia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia oredia, ese hari Dirava ena dubu ihahelaḡana karadia e kara, mai moaledia ida.
english: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.

motu: Idia ese boromakau mamaruanedia sinahu-ta bona mamoe mamaruanedia sinahu-rua bona mamoe natudia sinahu-hani na boubou ḡaudia ai e halaodia, hari Dirava ena dubu ihahelagana totona; bona nani mamaruanedia gwauta-rua e hahelaḡadia Israel idoinai ena kara dika boubouna ḡaudia, Israel ena iduhu gwauta-ruaosi ihaheḡereḡeredia.
english: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia e hididia, edia orea ta ta ai, bona Levi taudia danu unu e karadia toma, Ierusalem ai, Dirava isiaina ilaohenina totona, Mose ena buka ai e hetore heḡereḡerena.
english: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-hanina ai, hari noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia ese lagau-hanai ariana e karaia.
english: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

motu: Badina be hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na sibodia vada e hahegoeva hebou; idia iboudiai na goḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva. Taunabunai idia ese lagau-hanai mamoedia e ala mase, noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia iboudiai edia, bona bamodia hahelaḡa taudia edia, bona idia sibodia edia.
english: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together, all of them were pure. They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

motu: Israel taudia noho-hedoa amo vada e lou ese e ani, bona idia ida e hebou bona una tano taudia edia kara mirodia vada e rakatani, Iehova, Israel Diravana, bae toma henia diho totona, taudia iboudiai danu.
english: The children of Israel who had returned out of the captivity, and all who had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, ate,

motu: Dina hitu lalodiai idia ese se hatubua flaoana ariana e karaia, mai moaledia ida, badina be Iehova ese vada e hamoaledia, bona Asuria pavapavana lalona vada e haloua idia ediai, taunabunai ia ese Dirava, Israel Diravana, ena dubu iḡaukaralaina ai e durudia.
english: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; because Yahweh had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of God, the God of Israel’s house.

motu: Una murinai, Aratasasta, Parasa pavapavana, e lohiava negana ai, Esera na e dae lao. Una Esera na Seraia natuna, Seraia na Asaria natuna, Asaria na Hilkia natuna,
english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

motu: Hilkia na Salumu natuna, Salumu na Sadok natuna, Sadok na Ahitubu natuna,
english: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

motu: Ahitubu na Amaria natuna, Amaria na Asaria natuna, Asaria na Meraioto natuna,
english: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

motu: Meraioto na Serahia natuna, Serahia na Usisi natuna, Usisi na Buki natuna,
english: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

motu: Buki na Abisua natuna, Abisua na Fineha natuna, Fineha na Eleasara natuna, Eleasara na Aaron, hahelaḡa tauna badana, natuna.
english: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

motu: Hari Esera na Babulono amo e dae lao. Ia be itorena tauna ta, Mose ena taravatu, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese e heni ḡauna, dibana herea. Hanua pavapavana ese iena ura idoinai e henia, badina be Iehova, ena Dirava, imana na ia latanai.
english: this Ezra went up from Babylon. He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which Yahweh, the God of Israel, had given; and the king granted him all his request, according to Yahweh his God’s hand on him.

motu: Bena King Aratasasta ena lohia laḡanina ihahituna ai, Israel taudia haida danu Ierusalem e dae lao, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia haida, bona ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia, bona gabu helaḡana ena hesiai taudia.
english: Some of the children of Israel, including some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

motu: Ia be hua iha-imana lalonai Ierusalem ai e kau, hanua pavapavana ena lohia laḡanina ihahituna ai.
english: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

motu: Badina be hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai ia na Babulono tanona amo e dae lao matama, bona hua iha-imana dinana gini-gunana ai Ierusalem ai e kau, badina be ena Dirava imana namona na ia latanai.
english: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon; and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God on him.

motu: Badina be Esera ese lalona vada e hadaia, ia ese Iehova ena taravatu baine haeroa bona karana baine karaia, bona ena taravatu bona ena hahedua herevadia na Israel ai baine hahedibalai.
english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.

motu: King Aratasasta ese revareva ta Esera, hahelaḡa tauna bona itorena tauna, Iehova ena haheḡani bona ena taravatu Israel latanai mai dibana tauna, e henia. E henia revarevana herevadia bini:
english: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of Yahweh’s commandments, and of his statutes to Israel:

motu: Aratasasta, pavapava edia pavapava, vada e torea revarevana, hahelaḡa tauna Esera, guba Diravana ena taravatu itorena tauna, enai.
english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To|strong="H4430" * Ezra|strong="H5831" * the|strong="H1768" * priest|strong="H3549" *, the|strong="H1768" * scribe|strong="H5613" * of|strong="H4430" * the|strong="H1768" * law|strong="H1882" * of|strong="H4430" * the|strong="H1768" * perfect|strong="H1585" * God of|strong="H4430" * heaven|strong="H8065" *. Now|strong="H3706" *

motu: Lau vada na hahedua, Israel taudia eiava edia hahelaḡa taudia eiava Levi taudia egu basileia lalonai daika daika ena urakwalimu dainai Ierusalem lao e uramu na oi ida baola.
english: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm, who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem, go with you.

motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia hahituosi ese vada e siaimumu, Iuda bona Ierusalem henanadaidia ba kara, emu Dirava ena taravatu, oi imamu ai e miamu ḡauna heḡereḡerena;
english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand,

motu: bona hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia ida edia herahia ḡaudia, silver * bona gold *, idia ese Israel Diravana, Ierusalem ai e nohomu, vada e henia ḡaudia na oi ese ba laohai;
english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

motu: bona silver * bona gold * idoinai, Babulon tanona iboudiai ba davari gaudia, bona taunimanima bona hahelaḡa taudia edia herahia gaudia, mai lalo-namodia ida vada e gwaurai hamata edia Dirava, Ierusalem ai e nohomu Diravana, ena dubu ena.
english: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem.

motu: Taunabunai, ina moni ba gaukaralaia balaheni, boromakau mamaruanedia bona mamoe mamaruanedia bona mamoe natudia, mai edia flaoa boubouna ḡaudia bona inuinu boubouna ḡaudia ida, na ba hoi, bena emui Dirava ena dubu ena ihaboulaina patana Ierusalem ai latanai ba hahelaḡadia.
english: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

motu: Bena silver * bona gold * oredia na oi mai tadikakamu ida emui lalo-hadai bona emui Dirava ena ena ura heḡereḡeredia ai ba gaukaralai.
english: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.

motu: Hari emu Dirava ena dubu gaukaradia ikaralaidia ḡaudia vada a henimui na ba laohai, Ierusalem Diravana vairanai bavato.
english: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

motu: Bona dahaka ḡau dahaka ḡau ai o dabumu, emu Dirava ena dubu ena, bavabi, bena hanua pavapavana ena moni amo davadia do ba kara.
english: Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to give, give it out of the king’s treasure house.

motu: Ina danu, lau King Aratasasta ese moni inarina taudia iboudiai Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lalonai, na haḡanimuimu: dahaka dahaka hahelaḡa tauna Esera, guba Diravana ena taravatu itorena tauna, ese emui ai baine gwaurai, vada ba kara balaheni,
english: I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, requires of you, it shall be done with all diligence,

motu: ela bona silver talent * sinahu-ta bona uit koro + 7:22 “Talent” bona “koro” bona “bata” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡaudia haida. * sinahu-ta bona vine ranuna bata sinahu-ta bona damena asi hahetohona.
english: up to one hundred talents + 7:22 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * of silver, and to one hundred cors + 7:22 1 cor is the same as a homer, or about 55.9 U. S. gallons (liquid) or 211 liters or 6 bushels. * of wheat, and to one hundred baths + 7:22 1 bath is one tenth of a cor, or about 5.6 U. S. gallons or 21 liters or 2.4 pecks. 100 baths would be about 2,100 liters. * of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

motu: Dahaka dahaka guba Diravana ese baine haganilai, vada ba kara ḡuguru, guba Diravana ena dubu ena, iena badu na hanua pavapavana mai natuna ida edia basileia latanai baine kau na garina.
english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

motu: Ai na a hadibamuimu danu, hahelaḡa taudia, eiava Levi taudia, eiava ane-abi taudia, eiava ikoukou igimadia taudia, eiava gabu helaḡana ena hesiai taudia, eiava hari Dirava ena dubu ena hesiai taudia haida, na ta ena amo heaiva monidia eiava kohu davadia eiava tax * monidia basio abi.
english: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God.

motu: Oi danu, Esera e, emu Dirava ena aonega, imamu ai e miamu ḡauna, heḡereḡerena ai, hahemaoro taudia maraḡidia bona badadia ba duanaidia; idia ese Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana taudia. emu Dirava ena taravatu mai dibadia taudia, iboudiai na bae hahemaoro henidia. A asi dibadia taudia ba hadibadia.
english: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn’t know them.

motu: Daika ese emu Dirava ena taravatu bona hanua pavapavana ena taravatu basine badinaia, hahemaoro aukana na ia latanai bae karaia, bena baine mase, eiava tano amo baine raka oho, eiava ena kohu bae heabi oho, eiava dibura rumana ai baine hekou ahu.
english: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

motu: Iehova, ita seneda edia Dirava, aita hanamoa, badina be ia ese kara unuhetomana na hanua pavapavana lalona ai e havaraia, Iehova ena dubu Ierusalem ai ihahairaina;
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem;

motu: ia ese danu hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia vairadiai bona hanua pavapavana ena heitatao taudia mai siahudia vairadiai ena hebogahisi vada e henigu. Lau na boga auka, badina be Iehova, egu Dirava, imana na latagu ai; bena Israel tau-badadia na haboudia, lau ida baia dae lao totona.
english: and has extended loving kindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. I was strengthened according to Yahweh my God’s hand on me, and I gathered together chief men out of Israel to go up with me.

motu: King Aratasasta ena lohia negana ai lau ida Babulono tanona amo a dae ala taudia edia iduhu kwaradia bona edia uru ladadia bini.
english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:

motu: Fineha garana amo: Geresom. Itamara garana amo: Daniel. David garana amo: Hatusu;
english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.

motu: ia be Sekania natuna ta. Paroso garana amo: Sekaria; ia ida tatau sinahu-ta imahui ladadia e hetore.
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.

motu: Pahata-moab garana amo: Eliehoenai Serahia, bona tatau sinahu-rua ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

motu: Satu garana amo: Sekania lahasiel, bona tatau sinahu-toi ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

motu: Adini garana amo: Ebed Ionatan, bona tatau imahui ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

motu: Elam garana amo: Iesaia Atalia, bona tatau hitu-ahui ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

motu: Sefatia garana amo: Sebadia Mikael, bona tatau taurahani-ahui ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

motu: Ioab garana amo: Obadia Iehiele, bona tatau sinahu-rua gwauta-taurahani ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.

motu: Bani garana amo: Selomiti Iosifia, bona tatau sinahu-ta tauratoi-ahui ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.

motu: Bebai garana amo: Sekaria Bebai, bona tatau ruahui-taurahani ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

motu: Asgada garana amo: Iohanan Hakatan, bona tatau sinahu-ta gwauta ia ida.
english: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.

motu: Adonikama garana amo haida na gabeai ema: Elifelete bona Ieuele bona Semaia, bona tatau tauratoi-ahui idia ida.
english: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last, their names are: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

motu: Bigvai garana amo: Utai bona Sakuru, bona tatau hitu-ahui idia ida.
english: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

motu: Ahava e aru laomu sinavaina badinai na haboudia, bona dina toi unuseni ai a taruha. Taunimanima bona hahelaḡa taudia na nenedia negana ai, asi tauna ta unuseni ai Levi garana amo.
english: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days. Then I looked around at the people and the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.

motu: Bena Eliesere, Ariele, Semaia, Elnatan, Iaribi, Elnatan, Natan, Sekaria bona Mesulama, orea igunalaina taudia, bona loiaribi bona Elnatan, lalo-parara taudia, na boiridia;
english: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.

motu: bena na siaidia lao, Ido, gabu ladana Kasifia ikwarana tauna dekenai, bona na hamaorodia, hari Ido bona tadikakana, dubu ena hesiai taudia, ede bae hereva henidia toma, gabu ladana Kasifia ai. Herevana binai: idia ese eda Dirava ena dubu ena hesiai taudia na dekemai ai bae siaidia mai. I
english: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

motu: Bena eda Dirava imana namona na ai latamai ai dainai, idia ese lalo-maoro tauna ta, Mali, Levi Israel natuna, garana ta, e hakaua mai. Una tau ladana na Serebia; ia na natuna bona varavarana ida ema, tatau gwauta-taurahani.
english: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

motu: Hasabia danu e hakaua mai, bona ia ida Merari garana tauna ta ladana lesaia, bona varavarana mai natudia ida, tatau ruahui.
english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia sinahu-rua ruahui danu e hakaudia mai; unu na David bona ena heitatao taudia ese e gwauraidia, Levi taudia isiaidia bae lao heni. Ini iboudiai na ladadia e hegwaurai.
english: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.

motu: Bena anivaga ta na gwauraia, hari Ahava sinavaina badibadinai, eda Dirava vairanai baia hahemanau bona dala maoromaorona ta iena amo baia tahua, ai emai bona natumai edia bona emai ḡau iboudiai ediai.
english: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.

motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana inoina na hemarai, emai raka dalana ai tuari taudia bona hosi-gui taudia oreana ta ese inaimai edia amo baine gimamai: badina be ai ese hanua pavapavana vada a hamaoroa, ato “Emai Dirava imana na namo, ia e tahuamu taudia iboudiai latadiai, bona ena badu siahuna ese iena amo e raka ohomu taudia na e inai henidiamu”.
english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”

motu: Taunabunai ai na a anivaga, bona eda Dirava unu a noia toma; bena ia ese emai noinoi e hakala henia.
english: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia badadia gwauta-rua na gwauraidia hidi: Serebia bona Hasabia, bona varavaradia gwauta idia ida.
english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

motu: Bena silver * bona gold * bona ḡau idau-idau, hanua pavapavana mai ena hahealo taudia bona ena lohia taudia ida, bona Israel taudia unuseni ai vada e hebou danu, edia herahia ḡaudia vada e heni eda Dirava ena dubu ḡaudia, na hahetoho, na henidia hagau-hagau.
english: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.
