motu: Na hahetoho bona idia imadia ai na ato gaudia bini: silver talent * sinahu-tauratoi imahui, bona silver * ḡaudia talent * sinahu-ta davana; bona gold talent * + 8:26 Ini gold bona silver ḡaudia iboudiai davadia na readia K1,900,000 sisivana, ita eda moni ai. * sinahu-ta,
english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, + 8:26 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

motu: bona gold * kibokibodia, davadia na dariki daha-ta; bona auri labora-labora namo-hereana bona kimore-kimorena, davana na gold * davana ida heḡereḡere, ḡaudia rua.
english: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, + 8:27 a daric was a gold coin issued by a Persian king, weighing about 8.4 grams or about 0.27 troy ounces each. * and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.

motu: Bena na hereva henidia, nato, Umui na hehelaḡa Iehova ena, bona ini ḡau danu hehelaḡa, bona hari silver * bona gold * na herahia ḡaudia, lalo-namo ai e heni, Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, ena.
english: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.

motu: Ba gimadia bona ba baladia heni, ela bona hahelaḡa taudia badadia bona Levi taudia bona Israel iduhu kwaradia vairadiai ba hahetohodia, Ierusalem ai, Iehova ena dubu daiutudia lalodiai.
english: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”

motu: Taunabunai hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ese silver * bona gold * bona ḡau idau-idau metaudia idoinai e abi, eda Dirava ena dubu Ierusalem ai bae laohai totona.
english: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

motu: Bena hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-ruana ai, ai na Ahava sinavaina amo a raka oho, Ierusalem baiala totona. Eda Dirava imana na latamai ai, bena ia ese inai taudia imadia amo bona dala ai e bani henimai taudia edia amo e hamaurimai.
english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.

motu: Ai na Ierusalem ai a kau, bena dina toi unuseni ai a noho.
english: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.

motu: Dina ihahanina ai, eda Dirava ena dubu lalonai, hari silver * bona gold * bona ḡau idau-idau na e hahetohodia, hahelaḡa tauna Meremoto Uria imana ai e atodia. Ia ida be Eleasara Fineha, bona Levi taudia Iosabad Iesua bona Noadia Binui.
english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.

motu: Iboudiai na e hagaudia bona e hahetohodia, bona iboudiai metaudia e tore.
english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.

motu: Una negana ai, abi-mauri taudia, edia noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia, ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia na e hahelaḡadia, Israel Diravana ena: boromakau mamaruanedia gwauta-rua Israel idoinai dainai, bona mamoe mamaruanedia taurahanita-ahui tauratoi bona mamoe natudia hitu-ahui hitu; bona nani mamaruanedia g vauta-rua danu, kara dika boubouna ḡaudia. Ina idoinai na ḡole-oho boubouna Iehova ena.
english: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.

motu: Idia ese hanua pavapavana ena hahedua pepadia na hanua pavapavana ena tuari biagudia bona Sinavai Badana inikahana basileiana lohiadia e henidia; bena idia ese taunimanima bona Dirava ena dubu e durudia.
english: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.

motu: Unu ḡaukara muridiai, heitatao taudia na lau dekegu ema, eto, Israel taudia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na ini tano taudia, kara dika-herea taudia, Kanaan bona Hiti bona Perisi bona Iebusu bona Amono bona Moab bona Aigupto bona Amoro taudia, edia amo do asie raka oho.
english: Now when these things were done, the princes came near to me, saying, “The people of Israel, the priests, and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, following their abominations, even those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

motu: Badina be natudia hahinedia haida vada e abidia, idia adavadia bona natudia adavadia ai e halaodia; una kara amo bese helaḡana na ini tano taudia ida vada e hebulo; bona ina hebeatai karana ai heitatao taudia bona hanua tau-badadia vada e guna.
english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”

motu: Una hereva na kamonai negana ai, egu dabua bona egu hahedoki badana na dare, bona kwaragu bona aukigu huidia na rakasidia, bena na helai diho, daragu e doko.
english: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.

motu: Mai dara-dokogu ai na helaiva ai, noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia edia gwau hebeatai dainai Israel Diravana ena hereva bagudiai kudoudia e hetaha taudia na dekegu ai e hebou, ela bona adorahi boubouna negana.
english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me because of the trespass of the exiles; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.

motu: Bena adorahi boubouna negana ai, lau na egu anivaga amo na tore isi, mai dabuagu bona hahedokigu hedaredia ida; bena tuigu na hadai, imagu na Iehova, egu Dirava, na toi roro henia,
english: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to Yahweh my God;

motu: nato: Egu Dirava e, na hemaraimu, vairagu danu e kakakakamu, egu Dirava e, vairagu iabi-isina emu ai na heto'o ahumu; badina be emai kara dika vada e dae kwaramai daediai, bona emai kerere vada e dae ela bona guba.
english: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.

motu: Senemai negana amo ema bona ina dina, ai na vada a kerere dikadika; bona emai kara dika daidiai ai bona emai pavapava bona emai hahelaḡa taudia na tano haida pavapavadia imadia ai vada e atomai, bona dare bona abi-mauri bona dadidadi bona hemarai bada-herea ediai vada o negemai, ina dina heḡereḡerena ai.
english: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

motu: A harihari nega kwadogi ai Iehova, emai Dirava, ese vada e hanamomai, ai kwabukwabumai vada e hanohomai, bona emai hekamo-kau gabuna vada e henimai ena gabu helaḡana lalonai, emai Dirava ese matamai baine hadiaridia bona emai igui ai taina baine hagoadamai totona.
english: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from Yahweh our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a stake in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and revive us a little in our bondage.

motu: Badina be ai na iḡui taumai; ḡau tamona emai Dirava ese emai igui ai se rakatanimai, a vada e bogamai hisi Parasa pavapavadia vairadiai, emai goada taidia ma baine hamatamata, bena emai Dirava ena dubu baia haginia lou, bona ena dika gabudia baia banidia, bona imaḡu-ahumai ai bainela, Iudea ai bona Ierusalem ai.
english: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

motu: A harihari, emai Dirava e, ina murinai ai na ma dahaka baia gwaurai? Badina be emu haheḡani vada a dadaraidia.
english: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,

motu: Unu haheḡani na emu hesiai peroveta taudia edia amo o henimai, oto, O raka vareaimu bona bo ḡaunaiamu tanona na miro, tano taudia edia kara mirodia daidiai; edia kara dika-hereadia ese edia miro amo vada e hahonua, duduna ela bona duduna.
english: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.

motu: Taunabunai, natumui hahinedia na idia natudia mamaruanedia basio henidia, bona idia natudia hahinedia na basio abidia, natumui mamaruanedia edia, bona edia maino eiava noho-namo daladia na nega ta basio tahua; bena ba goada, tano anidia bavani, bona ba rakatani dihimui edia, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Now therefore don’t give your daughters to their sons. Don’t take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’

motu: Ina idoinai na ai latamai ai vada e kau, emai kara dikadia bona emai kerere bada-hereadia daidiai; a oi, emai Dirava, ese mata-hakani sisina mo vada o henimai, dia emai kara dika davadia korikori, bona ina kwabukwabumai o hanohomai;
english: “After all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,

motu: mato, ai na emu haheḡani baia tata utu lou, bona hari kara dika-hereadia e karamu taudia ida ma baia headava hanai a? Basioma badu henimai ela bona boma habuamai tari, bena kwabukwabuna ta eiava roho-maurina ta basinema noho, a?
english: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?

motu: Iehova e, Israel Diravana, oi na maoromaoro, badina be ai na kwabukwabumai, a roho mauri taumai, ina dina ai. O itaiamu, ai na oi vairamu ai mai emai kerere; badina be asi tauna ta oi vairamu ai baine gini diba, ina kara dainai.
english: Yahweh, the God of Israel, you are righteous; for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, + 9:15 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * we are before you in our guiltiness; for no one can stand before you because of this.”

motu: Esera e ḡuriḡuriva bona dika e gvaurai hedinaraiva, e taitaiva bona Dirava ena dubu vairanai e goru dihova, Ialonai hegogo bada-hereana, tatau bona hahine, memero bona kekeni, israel idoinai amo na ia dekenai e hebou; badina be taunimanima na e tai dikadikava dainai.
english: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.

motu: Bena Sekania, Iehiele natuna, (ia na Elam natuna ta), ese Esera e hereva henia, eto, Eda g vauhamata eda Dirava enai vada ta hamakohia, idau hahinedia ina tano besedia amo vada ta adavadia; ḡau tamona, ena be unu vada ta kara toma to Israel na doini mai ena helaro.
english: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

motu: Taunabunai, ita ese eda Dirava aita gwau henia hamata, ini hahine iboudiai mai natudia ida, baita hadihodia, egu lohia, bona eda Dirava ena haheḡani dainai kudoudia e hetahamu taudia, edia hahealo heḡereḡerena; bena karana baita karaia, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

motu: A tore isi, badina be ina na oiemu ḡaukara, bona ai na oi ida; ba goada, ba karaia.
english: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”

motu: Bena Esera e tore isi, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia igunalaidia taudia, bona Israel idoinai, e haduadia, bae gwau hamata, e gwauraia heḡereḡerena ai bae kara. Taunabunai idia na e gwau hamata.
english: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.

motu: Bena Esera na Dirava ena dubu vairana amo e raka oho, lehohanan Eliasibi ena daiutu ela, unuseni ai e noho rani; aniani se ani, ranu se inu; badina be noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia edia hebeatai e tailaia.
english: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

motu: Bena hahedua na Iuda bona Ierusalem idoinai lalodiai e gwauraia hedinarai, noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia na Ierusalem ai bae hebou;
english: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;

motu: bona dina toi lalodiai tau ta basinema mai, bena heitatao taudia bona hanua tau-badadia na bae hahedua, ena kohu baine heabi oho, bona ia danu noho-hedoa amo vada e lou taudia edia hebou lalona amo bae gwaua tao.
english: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.

motu: Bena Iuda bona Beniamina taudia iboudiai na Ierusalem ai e hebou, dina toi lalodiai; dina na hua ihataurahani-tana dinana iharuahuina. Bena taunimanima iboudiai na hanua ariarana ai e helai, Dirava ena dubu vairanai, e heude-heudeva, una kara dainai bona medu e diho badabadava dainai.
english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Esera na e tore isi, e hereva henidia, eto, Umui na vada o kara kerere, idau hahinedia vada o adavadia, unu amo Israel ena kerere vada o habadaia.
english: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

motu: Taunabunai, emui kerere na Iehova, senemui edia Dirava, vairanai ba gwaurai hedinarai, bona iena ura be karaia: ina tano taudia bona idau hahinedia edia amo ba raka oho.
english: Now therefore make confession to Yahweh, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”

motu: Bena hebou taudia iboudiai e haere, e hereva badabada, eto, Momokani, emu hereva heḡereḡerena do baia karaia.
english: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.

motu: A taunimanima na hutuma, bona ina na medu momo negana; ai na murimuri ai basia gini diba. Bona ina na dia dina tamona eiava dina rua ḡaukarana; badina be ai na vada a kerere bada ina kara ai.
english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

motu: Emai heitatao taudia ese hebouna bae abia; emai hanua lalodiai idau hahinedia vada e adavadia taudia iboudiai na bae hegwaurai hidi negadia ai baema, bona hanua tau-badadia bona hahemaoro taudia danu idia ida, hanua iboudiai amo, ela bona eda Dirava ena badu ḡaraḡara ina kara dainai na ita eda amo baine heabi oho.
english: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”

motu: Ionatan Asahele bona lahaseia Tikva sibodia ese una hereva e utua, bona Mesulama bona Sabetai, Levi tauna, ese e durudia.
english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

motu: Bena noho-hedoa amo e lou taudia na unu e kara toma. Hahelaḡa tauna Esera ese tatau haida e abidia hidi, iduhu kwaradia iduhu ta ta ai; bona ta ta ladadia e hato. Hua ihagwautana dinana gini-gunana ai e hebou matama, una kara bae tahua totona;
english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

motu: ela bona hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai idau hahinedia vada e adavadia taudia iboudiai e davaridia vaitani.
english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia natudia bogaragidia amo e davaridia idau hahinedia vada e adavadia, taudia bini: Maaseia, Eliesere, laribi, Gedalia. Ini na Iesua Iosadak mai tadikakana ida natudia.
english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

motu: Idia na e gwau hamata, adavadia bae hadihodia; edia kara dika boubouna na mamoe maruanena ta edia seri amo, edia kara dika irohona.
english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

motu: Imere natuna bogaragidia amo: Hanani bona Sebadia.
english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

motu: Harimi natuna bogaragidia amo: Maaseia, Elia, Semaia, Iehiele, Usia.
english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

motu: Pasahuru natuna bogaragidia amo: Elioenai, Maaseia, Ismael, Netanele, Iosabad, Elasa.
english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

motu: Levi oreana amo: Iosabad, Simei, Kelaia (ladana ta Kelita), Petahia, Iuda, Eliesere.
english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

motu: Ane-abi oreana amo: Eliasibi. Ikoukou igimadia oreana amo: Salumu, Telem, Uri.
english: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

motu: Israel besena amo: Paroso natuna bogaragidia amo: Ramia, Isia, Malkia, Miamini, Eleasara, Hasabia, Benaia.
english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

motu: Elam natuna bogaragidia amo: Matania, Sekaria, Iehiele, Abdi, Ieremoto, Elia.
english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

motu: Satu natuna bogaragidia amo: Elioenai, Eliasibi, Matania, Ieremoto, Sabada, Asisa.
english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

motu: Bebai natuna bogaragidia amo: Iehohanan, Hanania, Sabai, Atalai.
english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

motu: Bani natuna bogaragidia amo: Mesulama, Maluku, Adaia, lasub, Seala, Ieremoto.
english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

motu: Pahatamoab natuna bogaragidia amo: Adna, Kelala, Benaia, Maaseia, Matania, Besalele, Binui, Manase.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

motu: Harimi natuna bogaragidia amo: Eliesere, Isihia, Malkia, Semaia, Simeon,
english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

motu: Beniamina, Maluku, Semaria.
english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

motu: Hasumu natuna bogaragidia amo: Matenai, Matata, Sabada, Elifelete, Ieremai, Manase, Simei.
english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

motu: Bani natuna bogaragidia amo: Maadai, Amram, Uele,
english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

motu: Benaia, Bedeia, Keluhi,
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

motu: Vania, Meremoto, Eliasibi,
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

motu: Matania, Matenai, Iaasu.
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

motu: Binui natuna bogaragidia amo: Simei,
english: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

motu: Selemia, Natan, Adaia,
english: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

motu: Maknadebai, Sasai, Sarai,
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

motu: Asarele, Selemia, Semaria,
english: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

motu: Salumu, Amaria, Iosef.
english: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

motu: Nebo natuna bogaragidia amo: Ieiele, Matitia, Sabada, Sebina, Iadai, Ioel, Benaia.
english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

motu: Ini iboudiai ese idau hahine e adavadia, bena mai natudia ida e hadihodia.
english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

motu: Nehemia, Hakalia natuna, ena hereva bini. Laḡani iharuahuina huana ladana Kisleve lalonai, lau na hanua badana Susa ai noho;
english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. motu: bena varavaragu ta ladana Hanani na tatau haida ida Iuda amo ema. Bena na nanadaidia, Iuda taudia dounu e nohova, heabi-oho amo e roho mauriva taudia, bona Ierusalem henanadaidia na kara.
english: Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them about the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

motu: Bena idia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Heabi-oho amo e roho mauri bona una basileia ai dounu e nohomu taudia na e hekwarahi badamu bona e hemaraimu; Ierusalem maguna vada e heḡigi dobi, bona ikoukouna na lahi ese vada e araia oho.
english: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem is also broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”

motu: Unu hereva na kamonai, bena na helai diho, na tai; dina haida na tailaiava bona na anivaga loulouva bona na ḡuriḡuri loulouva, guba Diravana vairanai.
english: When I heard these words, I sat down and wept, and mourned several days; and I fasted and prayed before the God + 1:4 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * of heaven,

motu: Bena na ḡuriḡuri, nato, Iehova e, guba Diravana, Dirava badana bona mai garina, e ura heniamu bona ena haheḡani e badinamu taudia ida e herohemainomu bona e bogadia hisimu Diravana;
english: and said, “I beg you, Yahweh, + 1:5 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * the God of heaven, the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

motu: taiamu a hakala bona matamu a hapapa, lau emu hesiai tauna egu ḡuriḡuri, dina bona hanuaboi oi vairamu ai Israel besena, emu hesiai taudia, daidiai na gwauraiamu ḡauna, na ba kamonai. Israel taudia edia kara dika, ai ese oi a kara henimu gaudia, na na gwaurai hedinaraimu; oibe, lau bona tamagu ena iduhu taudia vada a kara dika.
english: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, while I confess the sins of the children of Israel which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.

motu: Ai ese oi vada a kara havara henimu, bona haheḡani bona taravatu bona hahedua herevadia, emu hesiai tauna Mose o haḡanilaia ḡaudia, na asia badinadia.
english: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances, which you commanded your servant Moses.

motu: Emu hesiai tauna Mose o haḡanilaia herevana ba laloa tao; oto “Boma gwau hebeatai, lau ese baina hakarohomui rohoroho bese idau-idau bogaragidiai;
english: “Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you among the peoples;

motu: a boma lou henigu bona egu haheḡani boma badinadia bona karadia boma kara, bena ena be emui karoho taudia be guba dokodokodia henudiai to lau ese unu amo ma baina haboudia, vada na abia hidi lau ladagu baine noho henia gabuna ai baina hakaumui vareai”.
english: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet I will gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.’

motu: Idia na oiemu hesiai taudia bona oiemu bese; oi ese emu siahu badana bona imamu goadana amo vada o hamauridia.
english: “Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power and by your strong hand.

motu: Ḡaubada e, taiamu a hakala, lau emu hesiai tauna bona emu hesiai taudia, oi ladamu igari-henina e moalelaiamu taudia, emai ḡuriḡuri ame kamonai; bona hari dina ai emu hesiai tauna na kwalimu ba henia, bona ba bogaia hisi, ina tau vairanai. Madi, lau na hanua pavapavana ena kehere iloalaina tauna.
english: Lord, + 1:11 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” Now|strong="H4994" * I|strong="H3117" * was|strong="H8034" * cup bearer to|strong="H1961" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" *.

motu: King Aratasasta ena lohia laḡanina iharuahuina ai, hua ladana Nisan lalonai, vine ranuna na ia vairanai e heato negana ai, lau ese vine ranuna na abia isi, hanua pavapavana na henia. A, ema bona una dina ai lalogu nega ta se hisihisi ia vairanai.
english: In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaigu, eto, Dahaka dainai vairamu o huaiamu, a ḡau be so gorere? Ina na dia ḡau ta, to lalo hisihisina mo. Bena na gari dikadika.
english: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then|strong="H2088" * I|strong="H3588" * was|strong="H3820" * very|strong="H3966" * much|strong="H7235" * afraid|strong="H3372" *.

motu: Lau ese hanua pavapavana na hamoroa, nato, Hanua pavapavana baine mauri hanaihanai! Dahaka dainai senegu edia gara e miamu hanuana vada e ḡaḡae bona ikoukouna na lahi ese vada e araia oho negana ai vairagu na basina huaia?
english: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ma e nanadaigu, eto, Emu noinoi be dahaka? Taunabunai, lau ese guba Diravana na ḡuria.
english: Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So|strong="H2088" * I|strong="H5921" * prayed|strong="H6419" * to|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * God|strong="H8064" * of|strong="H4428" * heaven|strong="H8064" *.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na hamaoroa, nato, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, bona lau, emu hesiai tauna, boma lalo namo henigu, boma siaigu lao Iuda, senegu edia gara e miamu hanuana bainala, baina haginia lou totona.
english: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, I ask that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ma e nanadaigu (ia adavana, pavapava hahinena, na ia badinai helai), eto, Baola bena edena nega ai ma ba lou mai? Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana lalona vada e heḡereḡere baine siaigu, bona lau ese negana na gwaurai henia.
english: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “How long will your journey be? When will you return?” So|strong="H7971" * it|strong="H5414" * pleased|strong="H3190" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" * to|strong="H5704" * send|strong="H7971" * me|strong="H5414" *, and|strong="H7971" * I|strong="H5414" * set|strong="H5414" * a|strong="H3068" * time|strong="H2165" * for|strong="H5704" * him|strong="H5414" *.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ma na hamaoroa, nato, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, revareva haida boma henigu, Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiadia edia, bena idia na bae gwau maoro baina raka hanai ela bona Iuda ai baina kau;
english: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;

motu: bona revareva ta danu, Asaf, hanua pavapavana ena uda igimana tauna, ena, bena ia ese au baine henigu, dubu kohorona ikoukoudia bona hanua maguna bona baina noholaia rumana ikaralaidia ḡaudia. Bena hanua pavapavana ese na gwaurai ḡaudia e henigu, badina be egu Dirava imana namona na latagu ai.
english: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I will occupy.” The|strong="H5921" * king|strong="H4428" * granted|strong="H5414" * my|strong="H8104" * requests, because|strong="H5921" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H5921" * good|strong="H2896" * hand|strong="H3027" * of|strong="H4428" * my|strong="H8104" * God|strong="H5414" * on|strong="H5921" * me|strong="H5414" *.

motu: Bena Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiadia dekediai na kau, bona hanua pavapavana ena revareva na henidia. Hanua pavapavana ese tuari lohiadia bona hosi-gui taudia na vada e siaidia, lau ida.
english: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

motu: A Sanbalata, tau Horono, bona Tobia, hesiai tauna, tau Amono, ina sivarai e kamonai, bena lalodia na e dika herea, ta na Israel taudia edia namo dalana itahuna vada ema dainai.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

motu: Taunabunai lau na Ierusalem nala, dina toi unuseni ai na noho.
english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

motu: Bena hanuaboi ai na tore isi, lau bona tatau hida mo lau ida; tau ta asina hamaoroa Dirava ese Ierusalem ihanamona dalana na lalogu ai ede vada e havaraia toma. Egu ai na asi gui gaudia, tamona mo lau ese na guilaia.
english: I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem. There wasn’t any animal with me except the animal that I rode on.

motu: Bena hanuaboi ai lau na Koura Ikoukouna amo na raka lasi, ela bona Sisia Ranu Gurina bona Boromakau Tagena Ikoukouna; Ierusalem maguna heḡiḡi-dobina na itaia, bona ikoukouna danu, Iahi ese e araia oho gaudia.
english: I went out by night by the valley gate toward the jackal’s well, then to the dung gate; and I inspected the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

motu: Unu amo nala ela bona Ranu Lohilohi Ikoukouna bona Pavapava Gohuna, a hari latanai na ḡui ḡauna na asi ena raka-hanai gabuna.
english: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool, but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

motu: Bena hanuaboi ai koura amo ma nala, maḡu na itaia; bena na hegiro, Koura Ikoukouna amo na raka vareai, bena na lou.
english: Then I went up in the night by the brook and inspected the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

motu: Heitatao taudia na asi dibadia edena gabu nala bona dahaka na karaia; lau ese Iuda taudia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua lohiadia bona heitatao taudia bona taunimanima oredia, ḡaukara bae karaia taudia, na do asina hamaorodia.
english: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Eda hekwarahi o itaiamu, Ierusalem na e gagae, bena ena ikoukou vada e ara oho. Aoma, Ierusalem maguna baita haginia, bena eda hemarai na basine mia.
english: Then I said to them, “You see the bad situation that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let’s build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

motu: Na hamaorodia danu egu Dirava imana na latagu ai, namo ihavarana totona; bona hanua pavapavana ese vada e hamaorolaigu herevadia danu na hamaorolaidia. Bena idia eto, Aita tore tore isi, aita haginia. Taunabunai idia ese imadia e ha-aukadia, ḡaukara namona ikarana dainai.
english: I told them about the hand of my God which was good on me, and also about the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They|strong="H5921" * said|strong="H1697" *, “ Let|strong="H5046" *’s rise|strong="H6965" * up|strong="H6965" * and|strong="H6965" * build|strong="H1129" *.” So|strong="H6965" * they|strong="H5921" * strengthened|strong="H2388" * their|strong="H5921" * hands|strong="H3027" * for|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * good|strong="H2896" * work|strong="H1697" *.

motu: A Sanbalata, tau Horono, bona Tobia, hesiai tauna, tau Amono, bona Geseme, tau Arabia, na e kamonai, bena idia ese e kirikirilaimai bona e gonagonalaimai, eto, Ina na dahaka o karamu? Hanua pavapavana o dagedaḡe heniamu a?
english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

motu: Bena na haere henidia, nato, Guba Diravana ese baine hanamomai, bona ai, iena hesiai taudia, baia tore isi, baia haginia; a umui na asi ahumui bona asi siahumui bona asi ilalolaimui Ierusalem ai.
english: Then I answered them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial in Jerusalem.”

motu: Bena Eliasibi, hahelaḡa tauna badana, na tadikakana hahelaḡa taudia ida e tore isi; bena idia ese Mamoe Ikoukouna e haginia. Idia ese e hahelagaia, bena iduara e atodia; e hahelaḡaia lao ela bona Sinahu Kohorona, bona unu amo ela bona Hananele Kohorona.
english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate. They sanctified it, and set up its doors. They sanctified it even to the tower of Hammeah, to the tower of Hananel.

motu: Ia ohedia ai Ieriko taudia ese magu e haginia; bona idia ohedia ai Sakuru Imri ese magu e haginia.
english: Next to him the men of Jericho built. Next to them Zaccur the son of Imri built.

motu: Hasena natuna verina ese Gwarume Ikoukouna e haginia; auna e atodia bona iduara e haginidia mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida.
english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

motu: Idia ohedia ai Meremoto Uria, Hakoso tubuna, ese magu e bania; bona idia ohedia ai Mesulama Berekia, Mesesabele tubuna, ese magu e bania. Ma idia ohedia ai Sadok Baana ese maḡu e bania.
english: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.

motu: Ma idia ohedia ai Tekoa taudia ese magu e bania, a lohiadia ese edia Ḡaubada ena ḡaukara asie goadalaia.
english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.

motu: Ioiada Pasea bona Mesulama Besodeia ese Ikoukou Gunana e bania; auna e atodia bona iduara e haginidia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida.
english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

motu: Idia ohedia ai Melatia, Gibeon tauna, bona ladono, Meronoto tauna, bona Gibeon bona Mispa taudia ese maḡu e bania; idia na Sinavai Badana unukahana basileiana lohiana ena siahu henunai e nohova taudia.
english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

motu: Idia ohedia ai Usiele Harahaia, gold * iḡaukaralaina taudia ta, ese maḡu e bania; bona ia ohena ai Hanania, muramura mai bonadia ibulodia taudia ta, ese magu e bania. Idia ese Ierusalem e haginia lou ela bona Lababa-bada Maḡuna.
english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.

motu: Idia ohedia ai Refaia Huru, Ierusalem tano kahana lohiana, ese magu e bania;
english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

motu: idia ohedia ai ledaia Harumafa ese maḡu e bania, ena ruma italaina ai; bona ia ohena ai Hatusu Hasabaneia ese maḡu e bania.
english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

motu: Malkia Harimi bona Hasub Pahata-moab ese maḡu kahana ta e bania bona Amu Kohorona e haginia lou.
english: Malchijah the son of Harim and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab repaired another portion and the tower of the furnaces.

motu: Ia ohena ai Salumu Halohese, Ierusalem tano kahana lohiana, mai natuna hahinedia ida, ese maḡu e bania.
english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters made repairs.

motu: Hanunu bona Sanoa inoholaina taudia ese Koura Ikoukouna e bania. Idia ese e haginia lou, bona iduara e atodia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida. Idia ese maḡu kiubit daha-ta e bania, ela bona Boromakau Taḡena Ikoukouna.
english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits + 3:13 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * of the wall to the dung gate.

motu: Malkia Rekab, Bete-hakereme tanona lohiana, ese Boromakau Taḡena Ikoukouna e bania; e haginia lou, bona iduara e atodia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida.
english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem, repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

motu: Salumu Kolohose, Mispa tanona lohiana, ese Ranu Lohilohi Ikoukouna e bania; e haginia lou, guhiguhina e karaia, bona iduara e atodia, mai ikoulaidia auridia bona kahitao auridia ida. Ia ese Sela gohuna maḡuna e haginia, pavapava ena uma-uma badibadinai, ela bona David ena Hanua amo e diho vadavadana.
english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the spring gate. He built it, covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars; and he repaired the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.

motu: Ia murinai Nehemia Asabuku, Bete-suru tano kahana lohiana, ese magu e bania ela bona David ena gara italaina, bona taunimanima imadia amo e karaia gohuna, bona goada-dikadika taudia edia ruma.
english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

motu: Ia murinai Levi taudia ese maḡu e bania: Rehumu Bani; bona ia ohena ai Hasabia, Keila tano kahana lohiana, ese iena kaha e bania.
english: After him, the Levites—Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

motu: Ia murinai idia tadikakadia ese maḡu e bania: Bavai Henadad, Keila tano kahana lohiana;
english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

motu: bona ia ohena ai Esere Iesua, Mispa lohiana, ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, tuari ḡaudia e haboudia rumana italaina ai, Maḡu Magevana ai.
english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

motu: Ia ohena ai Baruku Sabai ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, Maḡu Magevana amo ela bona hahelaḡa tauna badana Eliasibi ena ruma iduarana.
english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

motu: Ia ohena ai Meremoto Uria, Hakoso tubuna, ese magu kahana ta e bania, Eliasibi ena ruma iduarana amo ela bona Eliasibi ena ruma dokona.
english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

motu: Ia ohena ai, hahelaḡa taudia, Taora taudia, ese maḡu e bania.
english: After him, the priests, the men of the surrounding area made repairs.

motu: Idia ohedia ai, Beniamina bona Hasub ese maḡu e bania, edia ruma italaina ai. Idia ohedia ai, Asaria Maaseia, Anania tubuna, ese maḡu e bania, iena ruma badibadinai.
english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

motu: Ia ohena ai, Binui Henadad ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, Asaria ena ruma amo ela Maḡu Magevana,
english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

motu: ma unu amo ela bona daiguni, Palala Usai ese Maḡu Magevana italaina ai maḡu e bania, bona pavapava ena atai rumana latanai e haginia kau kohorona, hegima taudia edia maḡu badibadinai, danu e bania. Ia ohena ai, Pedaia Paroso
english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

motu: bona dubu ena hesiai taudia Ofele ai e nohova ese maḡu e bania ela bona Ranu Ikoukouna mairiveina kahana ai bona una atai kohorona italaidia gabuna ai.
english: (Now the temple servants lived in Ophel, to the place opposite the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

motu: Ia ohena ai, Tekoa taudia ese maḡu kahana ta e bania, hari atai kohorona badana italaina ai, ela bona Ofele maḡuna.
english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

motu: Hosi Ikoukouna atai kahana ai, hahelaḡa taudia ese maḡu e bania, ta ta ena ruma ena ruma italaidia ai.
english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

motu: Idia ohedia ai, Sadok Imere ese magu e bania, iena ruma italaina ai. Ia ohena ai, Semaia Sekania, Mairiveina Ikoukouna igimana tauna, ese maḡu e bania.
english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate, made repairs.

motu: Ia ohena ai, Hanania Selemia bona Hanunu, Salafa natuna ihatauratoina, ese magu kahana ta e bania. Ia ohena ai, Mesulama Berekia ese maḡu e bania, ena daiutu italaina ai.
english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

motu: Ia ohena ai, Malkia, gold * iḡaukaralaina taudia ta, ese maḡu e bania ela bona dubu ena hesiai taudia edia ruma bona hoihoi taudia edia ruma, Tuari Taudia Ihagaudia Ikoukouna italaina ai, bona daiguni latana daiutuna.
english: After him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths to the house of the temple servants, and of the merchants, made repairs opposite the gate of Hammiphkad and to the ascent of the corner.

motu: Hari daiguni latana daiutuna bona Mamoe Ikoukouna padadiai gold * iḡaukaralaina taudia bona hoihoi taudia ese maḡu e bania.
english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

motu: Ai ese maḡu a haginia sivaraina na Sanbalata e kamonai negana ai ia na e badu dikadika, bena ia ese Iuda taudia e kirikirilaidia.
english: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.

motu: Tadikakana bona Samaria tuari oreana vairadiai e hereva, eto, Ini Iuda taudia mamanodia na dahaka e karamu? Ḡau bae hamatamatadia a? Boubou karadia bae kara a? Dina tamona ai bae ha-orea a? Lahi ai e ara nadidia na momoru senusenudia amo bae kara lou a?
english: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

motu: Tobia, tau Amono, na ia badibadinai; bena ia eto, Oibe, idia na dahaka e haginiamu; uda sisiana ta na edia nadi maḡuna latanai bema dae kau, ia ese bema hahegiḡia dobi.
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

motu: Emai Dirava e, a kamonai; badina be e dadaraimaimu; edia heihi-ihirai na idia sibodia kwaradia ai ba haloua. Ba negedia daure, bena iḡuidia ai bae noho tanona lalonai edia ḡau bae dadihaidia.
english: “Hear, our God, for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land of captivity.

motu: Edia kerere basio gwau tao, bona edia kara dika vairamu amo basio kokidia oho; badina be idia ese oi vada e habadumu, maḡu ihaginina taudia vairadiai.
english: Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

motu: Taunabunai, maḡu a haginia; maḡu idoinai a ha-ahua, tano amo ela bona harana kahana. Badina be taunimanima lalodia e urava ḡaukara.
english: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

motu: A Sanbalata bona Tobia, bona Arabia bona Amono bona Asdod taudia, ese Ierusalem maḡuna ibanina ḡaukarana vada e haheaua bona e heḡigi dobi gabudia na e ha-ahu matama sivaraidia e kamonai negana ai, idia na e badu dikadika;
english: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, they were very angry;

motu: bena iboudiai e henega bou, idia na baema, Ierusalem bae tuari henia bona lalona bae haheḡonua.
english: and they all conspired together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion among us.

motu: Bena ai na emai Dirava a guria, bona kito taudia a duanaidia, dina hanuaboi ilao-ahudia bae gimamai.
english: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night because of them.

motu: A Iuda eto, Kohu-hua taudia na edia goada e oremu, bona momoru na bada herea; ai na asia heḡereḡere maḡu baia ḡaukaralaia.
english: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading and there is much rubble, so that we are not able to build the wall.”

motu: Bona inaimai eto, Basie diba bona ḡau ta basie itaia ela bona ita na bogaragidiai baita kau; bena baita aladia mase bona ḡaukara baita hadokoa.
english: Our adversaries said, “They will not know or see, until we come in among them and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”

motu: Iuda taudia idia badibadidiai e nohova na ema, bena nega gwauta e hamaoromai, eto, Idia na edia noho gabudia iboudiai amo ihadikada totona baema.
english: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

motu: Taunabunai, maḡu harana kwadogi-hereadia gabudia muridia kahadia ai be taunimanima na atodia, edia iduhu ta ta ai, mai edia dare io peva ida.
english: Therefore I set guards in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places. I set the people by family groups with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

motu: Lau na roharoha, bena na tore isi, hanua lohiadia bona heitatao taudia bona taunimanima oredia na hamaorodia, nato, Idia garidia basio gari. Ḡaubada ba laloa tao; ia na bada bona mai garina. Bona ba tuari, tadikakamui bona natumui mamaruanedia bona hahinedia bona adavamui bona emui ruma daidiai.
english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

motu: Inaimai e kamonai ai na vada a diba, bona Dirava ese edia lalo-hadai vada e laoa ahu, negana ai, ai iboumai ai ese maḡu a lou henia, ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara ai.
english: When our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, all of us returned to the wall, everyone to his work.

motu: Una dina amo ela, egu hesiai taudia edia orea kahana na maḡu e ḡaukaralaia, a kahana be edia io kesi peva bona tuari dabuadia e abi hata; bona hegunalai taudia na Iuda iduhuna taudia iboudiai,
english: From that time forth, half of my servants did the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

motu: maḡu e haginia taudia, muridiai e gini. Kohu-hua taudia edia maduna e haheḡereḡeredia, bena imadia kahana ta e ḡaukara, kahana ta be edia tuari ḡaudia e abi heni.
english: Those who built the wall, and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands did the work, and with the other held his weapon.

motu: Maḡu e haginiava ai ḡaukara taudia na ta ta ena dare ena dare gabadia ai e kara; kibi ihiririna tauna na lau badibadigu ai e gini.
english: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.

motu: Bena lau ese hanua lohiadia bona heitatao taudia bona taunimanima oredia na hamaorodia, nato, Gaukara na bada, bona e heato roro gabu idoinai, bona ita na mai padada magu latanai, bona padada danu daudau.
english: I said to the nobles, and to the rulers and to the rest of the people, “The work is great and widely spread out, and we are separated on the wall, far from one another.

motu: Edena kaha amo kibi reḡena ba kamonai, unuseni ai ba heau hegogo mai, ai dekemai ai. Eda Dirava na ita daidai baine tuari.
english: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”

motu: Taunabunai, ai na ḡaukara a hekwarahilaia; orea kahana taudia ese io e abi hata, daba matana amo ela bona hisiu e dae ai.
english: So we did the work. Half of the people held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared.

motu: Una negana ai, lau ese taunimanima ma na hamaorodia, nato, Taunimanima iboudiai mai edia hesiai taudia ida na Ierusalem ai bae noho rani; bena hanuaboi bae gimamai, a dina ai bae ḡaukara.
english: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”

motu: Taunabunai, lau bona tadikakagu bona egu hesiai taudia bona kito taudia, lau murigu amo e rakava taudia, na iboumai ai emai dabua asia doki oho; ta ta ena tuari ḡauna ena tuari ḡauna na imana ai e abi hata.
english: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me took off our clothes. Everyone took his weapon to the water.

motu: Una negana ai maumau badana e vara, hanua taudia bona adavadia ese tadikakadia Iuda taudia na e maumauraidia.
english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

motu: Badina be haida eto, Ai mai natumai mamaruanedia bona hahinedia ida na huhutuma; aniani ḡaudia baia ha-abi, baia aniani, baia mauri.
english: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

motu: Ma haida eto, Emai uma bona emai vine imeadia bona emai ruma na a gwau hamatalaimu, abitorehai davadia, aniani iabina, doe dainai.
english: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

motu: Ma haida eto, Ai na moni vada a abi torehai, hanua pavapavana ena tax * ihenina totona, una dainai emai uma bona emai vine imeadia vada a gwau hamatalai.
english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

motu: Ai hidiomai na tadikakamai hidiodia heḡereḡeredia, bona ai natumai na idia natudia heḡeregeredia; ḡau tamona, natumai mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na hesiai taudia bona hahinedia ai a halaodiamu; bona natumai hahinedia haida na hesiai iḡuidia ai e nohomu; a asi emai dala una kara baia laoa ahu, badina be haida ese emai uma bona emai vine imeadia vada e abi.
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, + 5:5 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

motu: Edia maumau bona unu hereva na kamonai negana ai, lau na badu dikadika.
english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

motu: Na haeroa; bena hanua lohiadia bona heitatao taudia ediai gwau na atu. Na hamaorodia, nato, Umui na abitorehai davadia o abimu, ta ta tadikakana tadikakana edia amo. Bena hebou bada-hereana ta na gwauraia, idia ihahemaoro-henidia totona.
english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Ai na emai goada heḡereḡerena ai tadikakamai Iuda taudia, idau bese ediai e hoidia taudia, na ma a hoidia lou; a umui ese tadikakamui o hoidiamu, ai ese ma baia hoidia totona. Idia na asi reḡereḡedia, bona asi edia hereva ta.
english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.

motu: Taunabunai lau nato, Emui kara na dia namo. Eda Dirava igari-henina dalana ai boma raka, ani, e inai henidamu besedia edia heihi-ihirai ilao-ahuna?
english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?

motu: Ina danu, lau bona tadikakagu bona egu hesiai taudia ese moni bona aniani a henidia torehaimu. Ini abitorehai davadia iabidia baita hadokoa.
english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

motu: Hari dina ai edia uma, edia vine imeadia, edia olive imeadia bona edia ruma ba henidia lou; bona karoadia sinahu ta ta amo moni eiava aniani eiava vine ranuna eiava dehoro ediai o g vaurai danu ba halou henidia.
english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

motu: Bena idia eto, Unu na baia halou henidia, bona ḡau ta ediai ma basia gwauraia; emu hereva heḡereḡerena baia karaia. Bena hahelaḡa taudia na boiridia, idia edia amo gwauhamata helaḡana na abia, edia gwauhamata heḡereḡerena ai do bae karaia.
english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then|strong="H2088" * I|strong="H1697" * called|strong="H7121" * the|strong="H6213" * priests|strong="H3548" *, and|strong="H7725" * took|strong="H7650" * an|strong="H6213" * oath|strong="H7650" * of|strong="H1697" * them|strong="H1992" *, that|strong="H1697" * they|strong="H1992" * would|strong="H1697" * do|strong="H6213" * according to|strong="H7725" * this|strong="H2088" * promise|strong="H1697" *.

motu: Bena vairagu ramina na davedavea, nato, Ina gwauhamata basie hamomokania taudia iboudiai na Dirava ese edia ruma amo bona edia ḡaukara amo unu baine davedavedia oho toma. Taunabunai baine davedavedia oho bona baine bubudia oho. Bena hebou idoinai eto “Amen”, bona Iehova e imodaia. Bena taunimanima ese edia gwauhamata heḡereḡerena ai e kara.
english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * assembly|strong="H6951" * said|strong="H1697" *, “Amen,” and|strong="H6965" * praised|strong="H1984" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *. The|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * did|strong="H6213" * according|strong="H3602" * to|strong="H3068" * this|strong="H2088" * promise|strong="H1697" *.

motu: Ina danu: e duanaigu Iuda tanona ai e nohova taudia edia hekwara tauna ai bainala negana amo, King Aratasasta ena lohia laḡanina iharuahuina ela bona laḡanina ihatoiahui-ruana, laḡani gwauta-rua, lau ese hekwara ahuna asina ania, bona tadikakagu danu asie ani.
english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

motu: Hekwara taudia gunadia, lau e gunalaigu taudia, ese maduna metaudia na taunimanima latadiai e ato, bona aniani bona vine ranuna bona silver * sekeledia hari-ahui na edia amo e abi. Edia hesiai taudia ese danu taunimanima e lohiadiava. A lau na unu asina kara toma, Dirava garina dainai.
english: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels + 5:15 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.

motu: Lau ese danu hari maḡu ḡaukarana na karaia balaheni, tano taina asina abia; bona egu hesiai taudia iboudiai na unuseni ai e hebou, ḡaukara totona.
english: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.

motu: Ina danu: tatau sinahu-ta imahui na lauegu pata ai e anianiva, Iuda taudia bona heitatao taudia, bona e noho hetabira besedia lalodia amo dekemai ema taudia danu.
english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

motu: E hegaeḡaelai ḡaudia, dina tamona ena, na boromakau ta bona mamoe namo-hereadia tauratoi; kokoroku danu e heḡaeḡaelai lauagu; bona dina gwauta gwauta amo kopi-pusedia mai vine-ranudia ida momo herea. Ḡau tamona, lau ese hekwara ahuna anianidia asina gwaurai; badina be hesiai ilao-henina na metau, ini taunimanima latadiai.
english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

motu: Egu Dirava e, ina orea dainai na kara karadia iboudiai ba lalo tao, lau ihanamogu.
english: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.

motu: Sivarai na Sanbalata bona Tobia bona Geseme tau Arabia bona inaimai oredia e hamaorodia lau ese maḡu vada na haginia bona na ha-ahua vaitani (gau tamona una negana ai ikoukou iduaradia do asina hagini);
english: Now when it was reported to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),

motu: bena Sanbalata bona Geseme ese hereva na dekegu e siaia mai, eto, Aoma, Ono taorana hanuana ta ai baita hebou. A edia lalo-hadai be bae hadikagu.
english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

motu: Bena lau ese gwaukau taudia na dekedia na siaidia lao, nato, Lau na ḡaukara badana ta na karaiamu; basina vasi diba. Anina be dahaka ḡaukara na baine doko, lau ese baina rakatania bona baina vasi negana ai?
english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease while I leave it and come down to you?”

motu: Nega hani hereva na unu e siaia toma, bona nega hani lau ese unu na haere henidia toma.
english: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.

motu: Dala heḡereḡerena ai Sanbalata ese nega iha-imana ena hesiai tauna na dekegu e siaia mai, imana ai na revareva ta, ikeho-hata ḡauna.
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

motu: Lalonai ini e torea toma: Bese idau-idau bogaragidiai e herevalaiamu, bona Geseme ese danu e gwauraiamu, oi bona luda taudia emui lalo-hadai be ba daḡedaḡe, una dainai ena maḡu o haginiamu; bona oi na o uramu edia pavapava ai baola. Sivarai be unu e gwauraia tomamu.
english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

motu: Bona peroveta taudia haida danu vada o haginidia Ierusalem ai, oi bae gwauraimu hedinarai, baeto, Pavapava ta na luda ai. Harihari ini hereva na hanua pavapavana bae hamaorolaia lao. Benaini, aoma, baita haeroa hebou.
english: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”

motu: Bena hereva na ia dekena na siaia lao, nato, O gwauraimu karadia ta asia karaia; oi sibomu lalomu ai o lalo davarimu.
english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

motu: Badina be idia iboudiai edia ura be bae hagarimai; ini e laloa toma: Imadia na gaukara ai bae manoka, bena gaukara na basine hekara. Dirava e, harihari imagu a ha-aukadia.
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.

motu: Semaia, Delaia Mehetabel natuna, na e hekou ahu; bena ena ruma ai na dae kau negana ai ia eto, Dirava ena dubu ai baita hedavari, gabu helaḡana ai, bona gabu helaḡana iduarana baita koudia ahu; badina be oi iala-masemu e maimu, hanuaboi baema oi iala-masemu totona.
english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”

motu: A lau nato, Lau heḡereḡeregu tauna ta baine heau a? Lau heḡereḡeregu tauna ta na gabu helaḡana ai baine raka vareai, mauri idavarina totona, a? Lau na basina raka vareai.
english: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

motu: Bena lalogu na e parara, vada na diba, Dirava ese se siaia a una peroveta herevana na lau ihadikagu totona e gwauraia badina be Tobia bona Sanbalata ese vada e vatua.
english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

motu: Ina dainai e vatua: lau na baina gari bona ina kara baina karaia, bena baina kerere; unu amo ladagu bae hadikaia, bena bae ihi-ihiraigu.
english: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

motu: Egu Dirava, ba laloa, Tobia bona Sanbalata edia kara na inihetomadia; bona peroveta hahinena Noadia bona peroveta taudia oredia, ihagarigu e uramu taudia, danu.
english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”

motu: Taunabunai, maḡu ḡaukarana na dina imahui-rua lalodiai e ha-orea, hua ladana Elulu dinana iharuahui-imana ai e ore.
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

motu: Inaimai iboudiai na sivarai e kamonai negana ai, e noho hetabira besedia iboudiai na e gari bona e hemarai dikadika; badina be lalodia e parara ina ḡaukara na emai Dirava ena heduru dainai a ha-orea.
english: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.

motu: Ina danu: unu dinadia ai luda lohiadia ese revareva momo Tobia enai e siai lao, bona Tobia ena revareva na idia ediai e kau.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

motu: Badina be hutuma luda ai na mai edia gwauhamata helaḡadia ienai; badina be ia na Sekania Ara rava-maraḡina, bona ia natuna Iehohanan ese Mesulama Berekia natuna hahinena vada e adavaia.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

motu: Bona iena kara namodia na lau vairagu ai e herevalaidia, bona lauegu hereva na ia e hamaorolaia. Bena Tobia ese revareva haida e siaidia mai, lau ihagarigu.
english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

motu: Maḡu vada e ahu, bona iduara vada na haginidia, bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona Levi taudia vada na duanaidia murinai,
english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

motu: lau ese tadigu Hanani bona kohoro hekwara tauna Hanania na duanaidia, Ierusalem bae itaia tao; badina be ia ese heabidadama ai bona Dirava igari-henina ai hutuma na e hereadiava.
english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Ierusalem ikoukoudia basie kehodia ela bona dina na baine siahu, bona dounu igimadia e ginimu ai iduara na bae koudia bona auri amo bae ha-aukadia. Bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia bogaragidia amo hegima taudia ba duanaidia, ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai bona ta ta ena ruma ena ruma italaidia ai bae gima.
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

motu: Hanua na lababa bona bada, a inoholaina taudia na dia hoho, bona ruma na do asie haginidia. E lou taudia ladadia
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

motu: Bena Dirava ese lalo-hadai ta lalogu ai e havaraia, Iohia taudia bona heilatao taudia bona orea taudia na baina haboudia, edia uru ta ta ai ladadia bae tore totona. Bena e dae ema guna taudia edia uru bukana na davaria. Una buka lalonai ini e torea toma:
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

motu: Basileia taudia Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e abidia mauri bona dauha e laohaidia bena edia noho-hedoa amo ma e lou mai taudia bini. Idia na Ierusalem bona Iuda e lou lao, ta ta ena hanua ena hanua ela.
english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

motu: Idia na Serubabele bona Iesua bona Nehemia bona Asaria bona Raamia bona Nahamani bona Morodekai bona Bilsan bona Misperete bona Bigvai bona Nehumu bona Baanaha ida ema. Israel tataudia ihagaudia bini:
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. motu: Paroso garana, daha-rua sinahu-ta hitu-ahui rua;
english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

motu: Sefatia garana, sinahu-toi hitu-ahui rua;
english: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

motu: Ara garana, sinahu-tauratoi imahui rua;
english: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

motu: Pahata-moab garana (unu na Iesua bona Ioab garadia), daha-rua sinahu-taurahani gwauta-taurahani;
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

motu: Elam garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
english: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

motu: Satu garana, sinahu-taurahani hari-ahui ima;
english: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.

motu: Sakai garana, sinahu-hitu tauratoi-ahui;
english: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.

motu: Binui garana, sinahu-tauratoi hari-ahui taurahani;
english: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

motu: Bebai garana, sinahu-tauratoi ruahui taurahani;
english: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.

motu: Asgada garana, daha-rua sinahu-toi ruahui rua;
english: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

motu: Adonikama garana, sinahu-tauratoi tauratoi-ahui hitu;
english: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.

motu: Bigvai garana, daha-rua tauratoi-ahui hitu;
english: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.

motu: Adini garana, sinahutauratoi imahui ima;
english: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.

motu: Atere garana (unu na Hesekia garana), taurahanita-ahui taurahani;
english: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

motu: Hasumu garana, sinahu-toi ruahui taurahani;
english: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.

motu: Besai garana, sinahu-toi ruahui hani;
english: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.

motu: Harifi garana, sinahu-ta gwauta-rua;
english: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.

motu: Gibeon garana, taurahanita-ahui ima;
english: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.

motu: Betelehem bona Netofa taudia, sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui taurahani;
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.

motu: Anatoto taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui taurahani;
english: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.

motu: Bet-asamavete taudia, hari-ahui rua;
english: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.

motu: Kiriat-iearimi bona Kefira bona Beroto taudia, sinahu-hitu hari-ahui toi;
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.

motu: Rama bona Geba taudia, sinahutauratoi ruahui ta;
english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.

motu: Mikma taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui rua;
english: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

motu: Betele bona Ai taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui toi;
english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

motu: Nebo hanuana ta taudia, imahui rua;
english: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

motu: Elam ma ta garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua imahui hani;
english: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

motu: Harimi garana, sinahu-toi ruahui;
english: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.

motu: Ieriko garana, sinahu-toi hari-ahui ima;
english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

motu: Lod bona Hadidi bona Ono garadia, sinahu-hitu ruahui ta;
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.

motu: Senaha garana, daha-toi sinahutaurahanita toi-ahui.
english: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia: ledaia garana (lesua ena iduhu), sinahu-taurahanita hitu-ahui toi;
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.

motu: Imere garana, daha-ta imahui rua;
english: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.

motu: Pasahuru garana, daha-ta sinahu-rua hari-ahui hitu;
english: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

motu: Harimi garana, daha-ta gwauta-hitu.
english: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.

motu: Levi taudia: Iesua garana amo Kadmiele garana (hari Kadmiele na Hodeva garana), hitu-ahui hani.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

motu: Ane-abi taudia: Asaf garana, sinahu-ta hari-ahui taurahani.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia: Salumu garana, Atere garana, Talmon garana, Akubu garana, Hatita garana, Sobai garana, sinahu-ta toi-ahui taurahani.
english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia: Siha garana, Hasufa garana, Tabaoto garana,
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

motu: Kero garana, Sia garana, Padono garana,
english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

motu: Lebana garana, Hagaba garana, Salmai garana,
english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

motu: Hanana garana, Gidele garana, Gahara garana,
english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

motu: Re-aia garana, Resini garana, Nekoda garana,
english: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

motu: Gasama garana, Usa garana, Pasea garana,
english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

motu: Besai garana, Meunimi garana, Nefusesimi garana,
english: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

motu: Bakabuku garana, Hakufa garana, Harahuru garana,
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

motu: Basaliti garana, Mehida garana, Harasa garana,
english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

motu: Barako garana, Sisera garana, Tema garana,
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

motu: Nesia garana, Hatifa garana.
english: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.

motu: Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia: Sotai garana, Soferete garana, Perida garana,
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

motu: laala garana, Darakono garana, Gidele garana,
english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

motu: Sefatia garana, Hatili garana, Pokerete-hasabaimi garana, Amon garana.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

motu: Dubu ena hesiai taudia bona Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia iboudiai na sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui rua.
english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

motu: Ini na Tele-mela bona Tele-harasa bona Kerubu bona Adono bona Imere amo ema, a edia iduhu bona senedia ladadia ihamomokanidia asi dibadia, idia na Israel besena taudia eiava lasi:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, + 7:61 or, seed * whether they were of Israel:

motu: Delaia garana, Tobia garana, Nekoda garana, sinahu-tauratoi hari-ahui rua.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

motu: Hahelaga taudia edia amo danu: Hobaia garana, Hakoso garana, Barasilai garana (una tau ese Barasilai tau Gilead natuna hahinena ta e adavaia, bena idia ladadia ta e henemai).
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

motu: Idia na ladadia e tahu, lada-tore bukadia ai, to asie davaridia; una dainai hahelaḡa dagina amo e atodia siri, idia na dia ḡoḡoeva dainai.
english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

motu: Hekwara tauna ese e hamaorodia, idia na aniani helaḡa-hereana basie ania, ela bona hahelaḡa tauna ta baine tore isi, Urim bona Tumim + 7:65 Urim bona Tumim. Esodo 28, s. 30. ba itaia. * baine nanadaidia.
english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

motu: Hegogo idoinai be taunimanima gerebu-hani + 7:66 Gerebu-hani daha-rua sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui = 42,360. * daha-rua sinahu-toi tauratoi-ahui,
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

motu: bona edia hesiai tataudia bona hahinedia danu, daha-hitu sinahu-toi toi-ahui hitu; edia ane-abi tataudia bona hahinedia na sinahu-rua hari-ahui ima.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

motu: Edia hosi na sinahu-hitu toi-ahui tauratoi; edia doniki badadia na sinahu-rua hari-ahui ima;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;
