motu: edia kamelo na sinahu-hani toi-ahui ima; bona edia doniki na daha-tauratoi sinahu-hitu ruahui.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

motu: Iduhu kwaradia haida ese ḡaukara idurulaina ḡaudia e heni. Hekwara tauna ese gold * darikidia daha-ta, nau imahui, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki sinahu-ima toi-ahui e heni.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, + 7:70 a daric was a gold coin issued by a Persian king, weighing about 8.4 grams or about 0.27 troy ounces each. * fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

motu: Bona iduhu kwaradia haida ese ḡaukara idurulaina ḡaudia e heni: gold * darikidia gerebu-rua bona silver * minadia daha-rua sinahu-rua.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas + 7:71 A mina is about 600 grams or 1.3 U. S. pounds, so 2,200 minas is about 1.3 metric tons. * of silver.

motu: Taunimanima oredia e heni ḡaudia be gold * darikidia gerebu-rua + 7:72 “Dariki” bona “Mina” na moni ladadia. Gerebu-rua = 20,000. * bona silver * minadia daha-rua, bona hahelaḡa taudia edia hahedoki tauratoi-ahui hitu.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

motu: Taunabunai, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona orea taudia haida bona dubu ena hesiai taudia bona Israel idoinai na edia hanua lalodiai e nohova. Hua ihahituna e kau ai Israel taudia iboudiai na edia hanua ai nonoho.
english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai na e hegogo hebou, tau tamona na heto, Ranu Ikoukouna ariarana lalonai. Bena idia ese itorena tauna Esera e hamaoroa, Mose ena taravatu, Iehova ese Israel vada e henia ḡauna, bukana na baine mailaia.
english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

motu: Hua ihahituna dinana gini-gunana ai, hahelaḡa tauna Esera ese taravatu na hebou taudia, tatau bona hahine bona natudia badadia, ikamonaina mai dibadia memerodia, vairadiai e mailaia.
english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

motu: Vairana na Ranu Ikoukouna ariarana e henia, bena taravatu lalona amo e duahia, daba maraḡi amo ela bona dina tubua, tatau bona hahine bona natudia badadia, ikamonaina mai dibadia memerodia, vairadiai; bona taunimanima iboudiai taiadia e kirara, taravatu bukana herevadia na e hakala henidia.
english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

motu: Itorena tauna Esera na hereva patapatana ta, una ḡaukara dainai au amo e karaia ḡauna, latanai e gini. Ia badibadinai e gini taudia be Matitia bona Sema bona Anaia bona Uria bona Hilkia bona Maaseia, ia idibana kahana ai; bona Pedaia bona Misael bona Malkia bona Hasumu bona Hasabadana bona Sekaria bona Mesulama, ia laurina kahana ai.
english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

motu: Esera ese buka e kehoa taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, badina be ia na taunimanima iboudiai daediai; bena e kehoa negana ai taunimanima iboudiai na e gini tore.
english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

motu: Bena Esera ese Iehova, Dirava badana, e hanamoa; bona taunimanima iboudiai na e haere, eto, Amen, Amen; bona imadia na e abi isi. Bena e igo diho, tano ai e goru diho, Iehova e toma henia diho.
english: Then Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God. All|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H5971" * answered|strong="H6030" *, “Amen, Amen,” with|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3605" * lifting|strong="H4607" * up|strong="H6030" * of|strong="H3068" * their|strong="H3605" * hands|strong="H3027" *. They|strong="H3068" * bowed|strong="H7812" * their|strong="H3605" * heads|strong="H6915" *, and|strong="H3068" * worshiped|strong="H7812" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * with|strong="H3068" * their|strong="H3605" * faces to|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3605" * ground.

motu: Levi taudia haida danu, Iesua bona Bani bona Serebia bona Iamin bona Akubu bona Sabetai bona Hodia bona Maaseia bona Kelita bona Asaria bona Iosabad bona Hanana bona Pelaia, ese taunimanima e durudia, taravatu anina idavarina ai, taunimanima na dounu edia gabu ai nohodia ai.
english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.

motu: Bena Dirava ena taravatu bukana amo e duahia hedinarai, bona anina e gwauraia; taunabunai taunimanima lalodia na e parara.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

motu: Bena Nehemia, hekwara tauna, bona Esera, hahelaḡa tauna bona itorena tauna, bona hari Levi oreana, taunimanima e hadibadia taudia, ese taunimanima iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto, Ina dina na helaḡa, Iehova, emui Dirava, ena; basio helalo bona basio tai. Badina be taunimanima ese taravatu herevadia e kamonai negana ai na e tai.
english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to Yahweh your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Emui dala ai baola, digara bavania, vine ranuna gaihona ba inua, bona ana asie heḡaeḡaelaia tauna ahuna na ba siai henia; badina be ina dina na helaḡa, eda Ḡaubada ena. Bona lalomui basie hisihisi, badina be Iehova imoalelaina na emui goada ḡauna.
english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”

motu: Taunabunai, Levi taudia ese taunimanima iboudiai e hadorodia, elo, Asi reḡereḡemui ba noho, badina be ina dina na helaḡa; lalomui be basie hisihisi.
english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai na e karoho, bae aniani, bae inuinu, bona hari ahu bae siai lao bona bae moale hisi dae na totona; badina be vada e gwaurai henidia herevadia na anidia vada e diba.
english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

motu: Dina iharuana ai, taunimanima iboudiai edia iduhu kwaradia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ida, na itorena tauna Esera dekenai e hebou, taravatu herevadia anidia bae tahu totona.
english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

motu: Bena taravatu lalonai e hetore herevadia vada e davari, Iehova ese Mose ena amo vada e haheḡani, Israel taudia na kalaga ai bae noho, hua ihahituna ariana dinadia lalodiai;
english: They found written in the law how Yahweh had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

motu: bona edia hanua iboudiai lalodiai bona Ierusalem lalonai ina hereva bae hapiua bona bae gwaurai hedinarai: Ba raka lasi, ororo baola, olive audia bona uda olivedia bona keroro bona pamu audia bona rau momo audia idau-idau rigidia ba mailai, kalaga ikaradia totona, vada e torea heḡereḡerena.
english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, + 8:15 or, booths * as it is written.”

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima na e raka lasi, ḡau e ha abi, bona edia kalaga e kara, edia ruma guhidia latadiai bona edia ruma maḡudia lalodiai, bona Dirava ena dubu maḡudia ai, bona Ranu Ikoukouna ariarana ai bona Efraim Ikoukouna ariarana ai.
english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, + 8:16 or, booths * everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

motu: Hari hegogo idoinai, abi-mauri gabuna amo vada e lou taudia, ese kalaga e kara bona kalaga lalodiai e noho; badina be Iesua Nunu ena nega ema bona una dina Israel taudia na unu do asie kara toma. Bena moale na bada herea.
english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters + 8:17 or, booths * and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

motu: Bena dina ta ta amo, dina gini-gunana ela bona dina dokona, ia ese Dirava ena taravatu bukana lalona amo e duahia. Dina hitu lalodiai aria e karaia; bena dina ihataurahanina ai hebou helaḡana ta e hekara, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

motu: Una hua dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, Israel taudia na e hebou, e anivaga, puse dabuadia e hahedokilai, bona tano na kwaradia ai e ato.
english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.

motu: Bena Israel taudia na idau bese taudia edia amo e raka oho, e gini, edia kara dika bona tamadia edia kara havara na e gwaurai hedinarai.
english: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

motu: Bena edia gabu ai e gini tore, Iehova, edia Dirava, ena taravatu bukana lalona amo e duahia, hora toi lalodiai; ma hora toi lalodiai edia dika e gwaurai hedinarai, bona Iehova, edia Dirava, e toma henia diho.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped Yahweh their God.

motu: Iesua, Bani, Kadmiele, Sebania, Buni, Serebia, Bani bona Kenani na Levi taudia edia vadavada ai e gini; bena idia ese Iehova, edia Dirava, e tai henia mai gao badadia ida.
english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

motu: Bena Levi taudia, Iesua bona Kadmiele bona Bani bona Hasabaneia bona Serebia bona Hodia bona Sebania bona Petahia, na eto, A gini tore, Iehova, emui Dirava, ba hanamoa, asi matamana bona asi dokona, ela hanaihanai. Oi ladamu herea-daena bae hanamoa; ia ese hahenamo iboudiai bona heimodai iboudiai na e hereadiamu.
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

motu: Bena Esera eto, Oi na Iehova, oi mo sibomu. Oi ese guba o karaia, guba gubadia danu mai hisiudia iboudiai, bona tanobada mai latana ḡaudia iboudiai, bona davara mai lalodia gaudia iboudiai. Oi ese o hamauridia hanaihanaimu; guba hisiudia ese oi e toma henimu dihomu.
english: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

motu: Oi na Iehova, Abram e abia hidi bona Uru, Kaldea hanuana, amo e hakaua lasi bona ladana e hatoa “Abraham” Diravana.
english: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,

motu: Oi ese ia lalona o dibaia, ia na mai momokanina oi vairamu ai, bona o gwau henia hamata, Kanaan taudia bona Hiti taudia bona Amoro taudia bona Perisi taudia bona Iebusu taudia bona Girigasa taudia edia tano na ia garana ba henidia; bena emu gwauhamata vada o hamomokania, badina be oi na maoromaoro.
english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.

motu: Oi ese senemai edia hisihisi o itaia Aigupto ai, bona edia taitai o kamonai Davara Kakakakana isena ai;
english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

motu: bona toa bona hoa karadia o kara, Farao bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai bona ena tano taudia iboudiai ihadikadia; badina be oi vada o diba idia ese senemai e kara dagedage henidia; bona ladamu o hahoria ema bona ina dina.
english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.

motu: Oi ese davara o haparararaia idia vairadiai, bena idia na davara bogaragina amo e raka hanai, tano kaukauna ai; bona e hahavadia taudia na dobu gabudia ai o tahodia dobi, nadi ranu badadia lalodiai na heto.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

motu: Dina ai ori dubuna amo o hakaudia, bona hanuaboi ai lahi mamana amo o hakaudia, edia lao dalana o hadiaria.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

motu: Oi na Sinai ororona dorina ai o diho, bona guba amo o hereva henidia, hahemaoro herevadia maoromaorodia bona taravatu momokanidia bona haheḡani bona hahedua herevadia namodia o henidia.
english: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

motu: Emu dina helaḡana danu o hadibalaidia, bona haheḡani bona hahedua herevadia bona taravatu na emu hesiai tauna Mose ena amo o henidia.
english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

motu: Oi ese aniani na guba amo o henidia, edia hitolo dainai, bona ranu na nadi amo o ha-arua lasi, edia ranu-mase dainai; bona o hamaorodia, bae raka vareai, o gwau hamatalaia tanona bae abia.
english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

motu: A idia bona ai senemai na e hekokorokuva bona aiodia e ha-aukava bona emu haheḡani asie badinadiava;
english: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

motu: e gwau edeedeva bona hoa karadia idia bogaragidiai vada o kara na asie lalodiava; a aiodia e ha-aukadia, bona hegunalai tauna ta e duanaia, edia iḡui gabuna Aigupto ai bae lou henia eto. A oi na dika igwau-taona Diravana, mai emu harihari-bada bona mai emu hebogahisi; badu ai o halahemu, bona lalokau ai o honuhonu-daemu; bena to rakatanidia.
english: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

motu: Ena be idia ese auri e havevea, boromakau natuna laulauna e karaia, eto “Ina na emui dirava, Aigupto amo e hakaumui lasi diravana”, bona oi ihadikamu karadia badadia e kara,
english: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,

motu: to emu hebogahisi badana dainai tano ḡaḡaena ai to rakatanidia; ori dubuna, dala ai vada e hakaudia ḡauna, ese dina ai se rakatanidia, bona lahi mamana, edia lao dalana e hadiaria ḡauna, danu se rakatanidia hanuaboi ai.
english: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

motu: Emu Lauma namona o henidia, baine hadibadia, bona emu mana na ududia amo so rua; ranu danu o henidia, edia ranu-mase dainai.
english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

motu: Laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai oi ese tano gaḡaena ai o hamauridiava; ḡau ta ai asie dabuva; edia dabua asie mouka-mouka, bona aedia asie gudu.
english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

motu: Oi ese basileia idau-idau bona bese idau-idau o henidia, bona tano daigunidia iboudiai; taunabunai idia ese Sihon, Hesebon pavapavana, bona 0g, Basan pavapavana, edia tano e ḡaunaidia.
english: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

motu: Oi ese garadia o hahutumadia, guba hisiudia heḡereḡeredia, bona senedia vada o hamaorodia lalona ai bae raka vareai bona bae ḡaunaia tanona na lalonai o hakaudia vareai.
english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.

motu: Taunabunai, garadia na tano ai e raka vareai, e ḡaunaia; bena oi ese tano inoholaina taudia, Kanaan taudia, na idia vairadiai o hadareredia, bona imadia ai o atodia, mai edia pavapava bona edia tano taudia ida, idia ese edia ura heḡereḡerena bae kara henidia totona.
english: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

motu: Bena hanua mai maḡudia na tuari ai e abidia, bona tano namona danu; ruma mai kohu namo-hereadia ida, bona ranu habou-habou gabudia, nadi ai e ḡei ḡaudia, bona vine imeadia bona olive imeadia bona huahua audia momo herea, iboudiai na e abidia, e ḡaunaidia. Taunabunai, e anianiva, bogadia e kunuva, bona taudia e digarava, bona emu harihari-bada e moalelaiava.
english: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

motu: Ḡau tamona, idia na e gwau edeede bona e daḡedaḡe henimu, emu taravatu na muridiai e negedia, bona emu peroveta taudia ese e sisiba henidia, dekemu bae hakaudia lou totona, negadia ai, idia ese e aladia mase; idia ese danu oi ladamu iḡonaḡonalaina karadia e karava.
english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

motu: Una dainai oi ese inaidia imadia ai o atodia, bena idia ese e hahisihisidia; bena edia hisihisi negana ai e tai henimu, bona oi ese guba ai o kamonai henidia; bona emu hebogahisi bada-hereadia heḡereḡeredia ai oi ese ihamauridia taudia o henidia, bena idia ese idia inaidia imadia amo e hamauridia.
english: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.

motu: A lagadia e aniva murinai idia na oi vairamu ai ma e kara dika lou, bona oi ese ma o negedia daure inaidia imadia ai; taunabunai idia ese e lohiadia. Ḡau tamona, idia na ma e hegiro bona e tai henimu negana ai, oi ese guba ai ma o kamonai henidia; bona nega momo oi ese o hamauridia, emu hebogahisi heḡereḡeredia.
english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

motu: Oi ese o sisiba henidia, emu taravatu enai ba haloudia totona. Ḡau tamona idia na e hekokorokuva, emu haheḡani asie badinadia, a emu hahemaoro herevadia, taunimanima na henudiai bema noho ḡaudia, na e tata utu, bona e gini muri dabudabu, aiodia e ha-auka, basie kamonai eto.
english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

motu: Laḡani momo lalodiai oi ese o haheauka henidia, bona emu Lauma ena amo o sisiba henidia, peroveta taudia ududia amo; a idia na asie ura bae kamonai. Una dainai oi ese tano besedia imadia ai o atodia.
english: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

motu: Ḡau tamona emu hebogahisi badadia lalodiai oi ese so ha-oredia bona so rakatanidia; badina be oi na harihari-bada bona hebogahisi Diravana.
english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

motu: Taunabunai, emai Dirava e, Dirava badana, mai siahumu bona mai garimu Diravana, gwauhamata bona hebogahisi o badinadiamu Diravana, basio laloa hari hisihisi iboudiai Asuria pavapavadia edia nega amo ema bona ina dina ai emai pavapava bona emai lohia bona emai hahelaḡa taudia bona emai peroveta taudia bona tamamai bona emu orea taudia iboudiai latamai ai vada e kau na ḡau pipikidia.
english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

motu: Ḡau tamona, latamai ai vada e kau ḡaudia iboudiai lalodiai oi na vada o kara maoromaoro; badina be oi o kara momokani bona ai be a kara dika;
english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.

motu: emai pavapava bona emai lohia bona emai hahelaḡa taudia bona tamamai ese taravatu asie badinadia, bona emu haheḡani bona emu sisiba, o henidia ḡaudia, na nahuadia asie toho.
english: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

motu: Edia basileia lalonai, bona emu harihari-bada, o henidia ḡauna, lalonai, bona tano badana bona namona, vairadiai o atoa ḡauna, lalonai, oi isiaimu asie lao heni; bona edia kara dika amo asie raka oho.
english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.

motu: A itaia, ina dina ai ai na hesiai taumai; senemai o henidia, anina bona ena herahia ḡaudia bae moalelai, tanona lalonai a itamai, ai na hesiai taumai.
english: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

motu: Hari pavapava, emai kara dika amo daemai ai vada o atodia taudia, ese ia anina herea-daena e abiamu; idia na mai siahudia danu, tau-animai bona emai ubu-ubu gaudia bae biagudia, edia ura heḡereḡerena ai; bona ai na vada a hekwarahi mase. Israel taudia na e ḡwau hamata taravatu bae badinaia
english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

motu: Ina idoinai dainai ita ese gwauhamata aukana ta karaiamu bona ta toreamu, bona eda lohia bona eda Levi taudia bona eda hahelaḡa taudia ese edia toa amo e hamomokaniamu.
english: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”

motu: Edia toa amo e hamomokaniamu taudia bini: Nehemia, hekwara tauna, Hakalia natuna; Sedekia,
english: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,

motu: Seraia, Asaria, Ieremia,
english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

motu: Pasahuru, Amaria, Malkia,
english: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,

motu: Hatusu, Sebania, Maluku,
english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

motu: Harimi, Meremoto, Obadia,
english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

motu: Daniel, Ginetono, Baruku,
english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

motu: Mesulama, Abia, Miamini,
english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

motu: Maasia, Bilgai, Semaia. Hahelaga taudia bunu.
english: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.

motu: Levi taudia: Iesua, Asania natuna; Binui, Henadad natuna ta; Kadmiele;
english: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

motu: bona tadikakadia, Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaia, Hanana,
english: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

motu: Mika, Rehob, Hasabia,
english: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,

motu: Sakuru, Serebia, Sebania,
english: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

motu: Hodia, Bani, Beninu.
english: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.

motu: Iduhu kwaradia: Paroso, Pahata-moab, Elam, Satu, Bani,
english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

motu: Buni, Asgada, Bebai,
english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

motu: Adonia, Bigvai, Adini,
english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

motu: Atere. Hesekia, Asuru,
english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

motu: Hodia, Hasumu, Besai,
english: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,

motu: Harifi, Anatoto, Nebai,
english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,

motu: Magapiasa, Mesulama, Hesiri,
english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

motu: Mesesabele, Sadok, Iadua,
english: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,

motu: Pelatia, Hanana, Anaia,
english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

motu: Hosea, Hanania, Hasub,
english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,

motu: Halohese, Pilha, Sobek,
english: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,

motu: Rehumu, Hasabana, Maaseia,
english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

motu: Ahia, Hanana, Anana,
english: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,

motu: Maluku Harimi, Baanaha.
english: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.

motu: Bese orena, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi taudia, ikoukou igimadia taudia, ane-abi taudia, dubu ena hesiai taudia, bona tano taudia edia amo vada e raka oho Dirava ena taravatu enai vada e tao taudia, mai adavadia bona natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia ida, mai aonegadia bona mai lalopararadia taudia iboudiai, ese
english: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters—everyone who had knowledge and understanding—

motu: tadikakadia, edia bese lohiadia, ida e tao heboumu, gwauhamata metauna bona helaḡana lalonai e vareaimu, Dirava ena taravatu, ena hesiai tauna Mose ena amo e heni ḡauna, bae rakalaia, bona Iehova, eda Ḡaubada, ena haheḡani iboudiai bona ena hahemaoro herevadia bona ena hahedua herevadia bae badinadia, bona karadia bae kara.
english: joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of Yahweh our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;

motu: Ita ese natuda hahinedia na tano taudia basita henidia, eiava idia natudia hahinedia na basita abidia, natuda mamaruanedia adavadia ai basiela;
english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;

motu: bona tano taudia ese kohu eiava aniani na dina helaḡa ai bema mailai, hoihoi totona, ita na ediai basita hoihoi, Dina Helaḡa ai eiava helaḡa dinana ta ai; bona laḡani ihahituna ai baita kau ai uma anidia bona abitorehai davadia baita gwau tora.
english: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy from them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year crops and the exaction of every debt.

motu: Ita ta hegwauhamata hehenimu, laḡani ta ta amo ita ta ta ese sekele kaha toiosi ai ta baita heni, Dirava ena dubu ḡaukarana ena,
english: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel + 10:32 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * for the service of the house of our God:

motu: flaoa helaḡana, bona flaoa bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia, e hahelaḡadia louloumu ḡaudia, bona dina helaḡadia, hua matamatadia, bona e gwaurai ariadia, bona ḡau helaḡadia, bona kara dika bouboudia Israel ena dika iabi-ohona ḡaudia, bona eda Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia iboudiai, inanatalaidia.
english: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

motu: Ita ese danu hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia bona hanua taudia na mari amo vada ta duanaidia, boubou audia bae mailai, Dirava ena dubu lalonai, eda iduhu ta ta heḡereḡeredia ai, bae gwaurai negadia ai laḡani ta ta amo, Iehova eda Dirava ena ihaboulaina patana latanai bae ha-ara, taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena.
english: We, the priests, the Levites, and the people, cast lots for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed year by year, to burn on Yahweh our God’s altar, as it is written in the law;

motu: Ta gwau hamatamu, eda tano anidia roboadia bona huahua audia iboudiai anidia roboadia na laḡani ta ta amo Iehova ena dubu baita laohai;
english: and to bring the first fruits of our ground and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to Yahweh’s house;

motu: bona natuda mamaruanedia roboadia bona eda boromakau natudia roboadia danu eda Dirava ena dubu baita laohaidia, hahelaḡa taudia eda Dirava ena dubu ai e ḡaukaramu dekediai, taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena, bona roboa gaudia eda nani bona eda mamoe seridia amo danu;
english: also the firstborn of our sons and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

motu: bona eda flaoa, e tari baroko guna ḡaudia, bona eda herahia ḡaudia, au-huahua idau-idau bona vine ranuna bona dehoro, na hahelaḡa taudia dekedia baita laohai, eda Dirava ena dubu ena habou-habou daiutudia lalodiai; bena eda tano anidia baita karoadia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta na Levi taudia dekedia baita laohai, badina be hari Levi taudia ese karoa ihagwautadia e haboumu, eda digi hanuadia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, our wave offerings, the fruit of all kinds of trees, and the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all our farming villages.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna, Aaron garana, na Levi taudia ida bae tao hebou, Levi taudia ese karoa ihagwautadia bae abi negana ai; bena Levi taudia ese edia karoa ihagwautadia ma bae karaoadia, karoa gwauta, bena una ikaroana amo karoa ta na eda Dirava ena dubu ai bae daelaia, habou-habou daiutudia ai bae haboua.
english: The priest, the descendent of Aaron, shall be with the Levites when the Levites take tithes. The Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

motu: Badina be Israel taudia bona Levi garana taudia ese herahia ḡaudia, aniani bona vine ranuna bona dehoro, na habou-habou daiutudia lalodiai bae vareailai, gabu helaḡana kohudia e miamu, bona hahelaḡa taudia, dubu ḡaukaradia e karamu taudia, bona ikoukou igimadia taudia bona ane-abi taudia e nohomu gabuna ai. Eda Dirava ena dubu basita laloa herekwa.
english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are, and the priests who minister, with the gatekeepers and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.

motu: Bese igunalaina taudia na Ierusalem ai e nohova. Taunimanima oredia na mari e kara, bena taunimanima gwauta gwauta lalodia amo ta ta na hanua helaḡana Ierusalem ai bae hanoho, a oredia ihataurahanitadia na hanua idau-idau ai bae noho.
english: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

motu: Bena taunimanima ese Ierusalem inoho ura-kwalimuna taudia iboudiai e hanamodia.
english: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

motu: Ini na basileia lohiadia, Ierusalem ai e nohova taudia; a Iuda hanuadia ai ta ta ena tano ena tano ai e nohova, edia hanua lalodiai, Israel taudia, hahelaḡa taudia, Levi taudia, dubu ena hesiai taudia, bona Solomon ena hesiai taudia garadia.
english: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

motu: Ierusalem ai Iuda vevena bona Beniamina vevena taudia haida e nohova. Iuda vevena amo: Ataia, Usia natuna, (Usia na Sekaria natuna, Sekaria na Amaria natuna, Amaria na Sefatia natuna, Sefatia na Mahalalel natuna, Mahalalel na Perese garana);
english: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

motu: bona Maaseia, Baruku natuna, (Baruku na Kolohose natuna, Kolohose na Hasaia natuna, Hasaia na Adaia natuna, Adaia na Ioiaribi natuna, Ioiaribi na Sekaria natuna, Sekaria na Silono tauna natuna).
english: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

motu: Perese garana iboudiai Ierusalem ai e nohova na boga-auka tataudia sinahu-hani tauratoi-ahui taurahani.
english: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

motu: Beniamina vevena bini: Salu, Mesulama natuna, (Mesulama na Ioed natuna, loed na Pedaia natuna, Pedaia na Kolaia natuna, Kolaia na Maaseia natuna, Maaseia na Itiele natuna, Itiele na lesaia natuna).
english: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

motu: Bona ia murinai Gabai bona Salai bona tatau sinahu-taurahanita ruahui-taurahani.
english: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

motu: Ioel Sikri ese e itadia tao, bona Iuda Hasenua na hanua itataona tauna iharuana.
english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia edia amo: Iedaia Ioiaribi, Iakin,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

motu: Seraia, (ia na Hilkia natuna, Hilkia na Mesulama natuna, Mesulama na Sadok natuna, Sadok na Meraioto natuna, Meraioto na Ahitubu natuna); ia na Dirava ena dubu biaguna.
english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

motu: Bona idia tadikakadia, dubu ḡaukaradia e karava taudia, tatau sinahu-taurahani ruahui-rua; bona Adaia, (ia na Ierohama natuna, Ierohama na Pelalia natuna, Pelalia na Amasi natuna, Amasi na Sekaria natuna, Sekaria na Pasahuru natuna, Pasahuru na Malkia natuna),
english: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

motu: bona ia tadikakana, iduhu kwaradia, tatau sinahu-rua hari-ahui rua; bona Amasahai, (ia na Asarele natuna, Asarele na Ahasai natuna, Ahasai na Mesilemoto natuna, Mesilemoto na Imere natuna),
english: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

motu: bona idia tadikakadia, goada dikadika taudia, sinahu-ta ruahui taurahani; idia itataodia tauna na Sabdiele Hagedolimi.
english: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

motu: Levi taudia edia amo: Semaia, (ia na Hasub natuna, Hasub na Asarikama natuna, Asarikama na Hasabia natuna, Hasabia na Buni natuna);
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

motu: bona Sabetai bona losabad, Levi edia lohia taudia bogaragidia amo; idia ese Dirava ena dubu murimurina kahana ḡaukaradia e biagudia.
english: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

motu: Bona Matania, (ia na Mika natuna, Mika na Sabdi natuna, Sabdi na Asaf natuna); ia na Dirava ihanamolaina guriḡurina igwauraina imatamana tauna. Bona Bakabukia, tau iharuana tadikakana bogaragidiai, bona Abda, (ia na Samua natuna, Samua na Galala natuna, Galala na Iedutunu natuna).
english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

motu: Levi taudia iboudiai hanua helaḡana lalonai na tatau sinahu-rua taurahani-ahui hani.
english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

motu: Ikoukou igimadia taudia Akubu bona Talmon mai tadikakadia ida, ikoukou e gimadiava taudia, na tatau sinahu-ta hitu-ahui rua.
english: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

motu: Israel orena, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia oredia, na Iuda hanuadia iboudiai Ialodiai e nohova, ta ta ena tano ena tano ai.
english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

motu: A dubu ena hesiai taudia na Ofele ai e nohova; bona Siha bona Gispa ese dubu ena hesiai taudia e biagudia.
english: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

motu: Ierusalem ai Levi taudia itataodia tauna na Usisi, (ia na Bani natuna, Bani na Hasabia natuna, Hasabia na Matania natuna, Matania na Mika natuna, Mika na Asaf vevena, ane-abi taudia, ta); ia ese Dirava ena dubu ḡaukaradia e ita tao.
english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana ese haheḡani ta e heni, idia daidiai, bona ane-abi taudia ese dina ta ta adia ahudia e abi.
english: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

motu: Petahia Mesesabele, Sera Iuda vevena ta, na hanua pavapavana ena ere-gwaurai tauna, taunimanima itataodia ḡaukaradia iboudiai ai.
english: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

motu: A hanua maraḡidia, mai edia biru tanodia ida, herevadia bini. Iuda taudia haida na Kiriat-araba mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Dibon mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Iekabasele mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida,
english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

motu: bona Iesua bona Molada bona Bete-pelete, lalodiai e nohova.
english: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

motu: Edia noho gabudia haida danu na Hasara-sual,
english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

motu: bona Bere-sieba mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Siklag, bona Mekona mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida,
english: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,

motu: bona En-rumon, bona Sora, bona Iaramutu,
english: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

motu: bona Sanoa bona Adulama mai edia hanua maraḡidia ida, bona Lakisi mai ena biru tanodia ida, bona Aseka mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida. Taunabunai, idia na e taruha, Bere-sieba amo ela bona Hinom kourana.
english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

motu: Beniamina taudia danu Geba amo ela Mikmasa ai bona Aia ai, bona Betele mai ena hanua maraḡidia ida, lalodiai e nohova;
english: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,

motu: bona Anatoto ai bona Nob ai bona Anania ai,
english: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

motu: bona Hasoro ai bona Rama ai bona Gitaimi ai,
english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

motu: bona Hadidi ai bona Seboimi ai bona Nebalata ai,
english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

motu: bona Lod ai, bona Ono, ima karakara dibaka taudia edia koura, lalonai.
english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

motu: Levi taudia edia orea haida Iuda ai na Beniamina taudia ida e hataodia hebou.
english: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia, Serubabele Sealtiele bona Iesua ida e dae ela taudia, ladadia bini: Seraia, Ieremia, Esera,
english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

motu: Amaria, Maluku, Hatusu,
english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

motu: Sekania, Rehumu, Meremoto,
english: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

motu: Ido, Ginetoi, Abia,
english: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,

motu: Miamini, Maadia, Bilga,
english: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

motu: Semaia, Ioiaribi, Iedaia,
english: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

motu: Salu, Amok Hilkia, Iedaia. Unu na hahelaḡa taudia mai varavaradia ida edia lohia, Iesua ena nega ai.
english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

motu: Levi taudia: Iesua, Binui, Kadmiele, Serebia, Iuda, Matania. Hari Matania mai varavarana ida ese Dirava ihanamolaina anedia iabidia e gunalaidia.
english: Moreover the Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving songs, he and his brothers.

motu: Bona varavaradia Bakabukia bona Uno na ane-abi negadia ai idia italaidia ai e gini.
english: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were close to them according to their offices.

motu: Iesua na loiakim tamana, Ioiakim na Eliasibi tamana, Eliasibi na loiada tamana,
english: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,

motu: Ioiada na Ionatan tamana, Ionatan na ladua tamana.
english: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

motu: Ioiakim ena nega ai hahelaḡa taudia na iduhu kwaradia: Seraia ena na Meraia; Ieremia ena na Hanania;
english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

motu: Esera ena na Mesulama; Amaria ena na Iehohanan;
english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

motu: Maluki ena na Ionatan; Sebania ena na Iosef;
english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

motu: Harimi ena na Adna; Meraioto ena na Helekai;
english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

motu: Ido ena na Sekaria; Ginetono ena na Mesulama;
english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

motu: Abia ena na Sikri; Miniamini ena, Moadia ena na Pilitai;
english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

motu: Bilga ena na Samua; Semaia ena na Iehonatan;
english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

motu: Ioiaribi ena na Matenai; Iedaia ena na Usisi;
english: of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

motu: Salai ena na Kalai; Amok ena na Ebere;
english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

motu: Hilkia ena na Hasabia; Iedaia ena na Netanele.
english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

motu: Levi taudia herevadia na iniheto. Eliasibi bona Ioiada bona Iohanan bona ladua edia nega ai iduhu kwaradia ladadia e tore; bona hahelaḡa taudia ladadia danu ela bona Darauese, tau Parasa, ena pavapava negana.
english: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.

motu: Levi garana, iduhu kwaradia, na Sisiga Bukana ai e torea ema bona Iohanan Eliasibi ena nega.
english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

motu: Levi Iohiadia: Hasabia, Serebia bona Iesua Kadmiele na varavaradia e gini hetalai henidia, bae heimodai bona bae hahenamo totona, David, Dirava ena tau, ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena ai bae nari hedava hedava.
english: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers close to them, to praise and give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God, section next to section.

motu: Matania bona Bakabukia bona Obadia bona Mesulama bona Talmon bona Akubu na ikoukou igimadia taudia, ikoukou edia habou-habou rumadia e gimadia.
english: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.

motu: Unu na Ioiakim, Iesua Iosadak natuna, bona Nehemia, hekwara tauna, bona Esera, hahelaḡa tauna bona itorena tauna, edia nega ai. Ierusalem maḡuna ihahelaḡana
english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe.

motu: Ierusalem maḡuna ihahelaḡana negana ai idia ese Levi taudia e tahudia, edia noho gabudia iboudiai lalodia amo, Ierusalem bae mailaidia totona, bena maḡu ihahelaḡana karadia bae moalelai, mai hahenamodia bona mai anedia ida, bona botabota auridia bona hatai-hatai ḡaudia badadia bona maraḡidia ida.
english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.

motu: Bena ane-abi oreadia taudia e hebou, Ierusalem heḡeḡemadai amo, bona Netofa hanuadia amo,
english: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;

motu: bona Bete-gilgal amo, bona Geba bona Asamavete kahadia amo, badina be ane-abi taudia ese edia hanua e hagini Ierusalem heḡeḡemadai ai.
english: also from Beth Gilgal and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na sibodia e haheḡoeva; bena idia ese taunimanima bona ikoukou bona maḡu na e haḡoevadia.
english: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.

motu: Bena lau ese Iuda lohiadia na hakaudia dae maḡu latanai, bona orea badadia rua na duanaidia; bena idia na e raka hebou mai hahenamodia ida. Orea ta be idiba kahana amo e raka lao, maḡu latanai, ela bona Boromakau Taḡena Ikoukouna.
english: Then I brought the princes of Judah up on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;

motu: Idia muridia amo Hosaia bona Iuda lohiadia edia orea kahana e raka,
english: and after them went Hoshaiah, with half of the princes of Judah,

motu: bona Asaria, Esera, Mesulama,
english: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

motu: Iuda, Beniamina, Semaia, Ieremia,
english: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,

motu: bona hahelaḡa taudia natudia haida mai kibidia ida. Sekaria (ia na Ionatan natuna, Ionatan na Semaia natuna, Semaia na Matania natuna, Matania na Mikaia natuna, Mikaia na Sakuru natuna, Sakuru na Asaf natuna),
english: and some of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;

motu: bona ia varavarana Semaia, Asarele, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Netanele, Iuda bona Hanani; idia ese David, Dirava ena tau, ena hatai-hatai ḡaudia e abi kau; bena itorena tauna Esera ese e gunalaidia.
english: and his brothers, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.

motu: Ranu Lohilohi Ikoukouna ai e kau, bena maoromaoro e dae ela, David ena hanua vadavadana amo, maḡu nese-dae gabuna ai, David ena ruma daenai, ela bona Ranu Ikoukouna ai, mairiveina kahana ai, e kau.
english: By the spring gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of David’s city, at the ascent of the wall, above David’s house, even to the water gate eastward.

motu: Hahenamo oreana iharuana na lauri kahana amo ela, bena lau na idia muridia amo na raka, orea kahana ida. Maḡu latana amo ala, Amu Kohorona atai kahana amo ela bona Lababa-bada Maḡuna;
english: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people on the wall above the tower of the furnaces, even to the wide wall,

motu: bena Efraim Ikoukouna atai kahana amo, bona Ikoukou Gunana bona Gwarume Ikoukouna bona Hananele ena Kohoro bona Sinahu-ta Kohorona amo ala, ela bona Mamoe Ikoukouna; bena Hegima Ikoukouna ai a doko.
english: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate; and they stood still in the gate of the guard.

motu: Bena hahenamo oreadia ruaosi na Dirava ena dubu ai e gini, bona lau danu, heitatao oreana kahana ida.
english: So the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house stood, and I and the half of the rulers with me;

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia Eliakim, Maaseia, Miniamini, Mikaia, Elioenai. Sekaria bona Hanania danu unuseni ai, mai edia kibi;
english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

motu: bona Maaseia, Semaia, Eleasara, Usisi, Iehohanan, Malkia, Elam bona Esere danu. Bena ane-abi taudia ese ane e abi; Ieselahia ese e gunalaidia.
english: and Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

motu: Una dina ai boubou karadia badadia e kara, bona e moale, badina be Dirava ese e hamolaedia herea; hahine mai natudia ida danu e moale. Ierusalem ena moale reḡedia na dauha amo e kamonai.
english: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women and the children also rejoiced, so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far away.

motu: Una dina ai tatau haida e duanaidia, habou-habou rumadia, kohu bona herahia ḡaudia bona aniani roboadia bona karoa ihagwautadia ḡaudia e habou gabudia, itataodia; unuseni ai hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia ahudia bae habou, taravatu ai e gwaurai ḡaudia, hanua hanua edia biru gabudia heḡereḡeredia; badina be Iuda taudia ese hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi oreana, dubu ḡaukarana e karaiava taudia, na e moalelaidia.
english: On that day, men were appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them according to the fields of the cities the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites; for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who served.

motu: Idia bona ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia danu ese edia Dirava isiaina e lao heniva; bona haheḡoeva karadia e karava, David bona natuna Solomon edia haheḡani heḡereḡerena.
english: They performed the duty of their God and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the commandment of David and of Solomon his son.

motu: Badina be nega gunadia ai, David bona Asaf edia nega ai, ane-abi taudia na mai edia lohia ta, bona Dirava iheatolaina bona ihanamona anedia e abi.
english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

motu: Bena Serubabele bona Nehemia edia nega ai Israel idoinai ese ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia ahudia na dina ta ta amo e henidia; bona Levi taudia ahudia e ato tabe; bena Levi taudia ese Aaron garana taudia ahudia ma e ato tabe.
english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.

motu: Una dina ai idia ese Mose ena buka e duahia, taunimanima vairadiai; lalonai e davaria, vada e torea, Amono tauna ta eiava Moab tauna ta na nega ta Dirava ena orea hebouna lalonai basine vareai;
english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and it was found written in it that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,

motu: badina be Israel taudia asie hedavari henidia ranu bona aniani ida, a Balaam e vatua, baine uduguiraidia totona; ḡau tamona iseda Dirava ese heuduguirai na hahenamo herevana ai e halaoa.
english: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them; however, our God turned the curse into a blessing.

motu: Taunimanima na taravatu e kamonai negana ai, idia ese bese idaudia amo e vara taudia na Israel edia amo e abidia oho.
english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.

motu: Ina kara do se vara negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna Eliasibi, e duanaia eda Dirava ena dubu daiutudia baine biagua tauna, na Tobia bamona,
english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,

motu: bena ia ese daiutu badana ta e lailaia Tobia ena. Una daiutu na guna idia ese boubou flaoana bona muramura mai bonana bona dubu kohudia, bona aniani bona vine ranuna bona dehoro karoadia ihagwautadia, haheḡani heḡereḡerena ai Levi taudia bona ane-abi taudia bona ikoukou igimadia taudia e henidia gaudia, bona herahia, hahelaḡa taudia e henidia ḡaudia, e haboulaiva daiutuna.
english: had prepared for him a great room, where before they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers; and the wave offerings for the priests.

motu: Una kara e vara negana ai lau na dia Ierusalem ai; badina be Aratasasta, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoiahui-ruana ai lau na hanua pavapavana dekena nala. Nega taina vada ela, bena hanua pavapavana na noia baine kahugu nege;
english: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king; and after some days I asked leave of the king,

motu: bena Ierusalem nama. Una negana ai lau ese hari kara dikana na davaria, Eliasibi ese Tobia iduruna totona vada e karaia, daiutu ta Dirava ena dubu maḡuna ikoukoudia lalodiai e heḡaeḡaelaia iena.
english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.

motu: Bena na badu dikadika, bena Tobia ena ruma ḡaudia iboudiai na daiutu lalona amo na tahodia lasi.
english: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.

motu: Na hahedua, bena daiutu e haḡoevadia. Bena lau ese Dirava ena dubu kohudia na una daiutu lalonai ma na atodia lou, bona boubou flaoana bona muramura mai bonadia danu.
english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.

motu: Lau na davaria danu Levi taudia ahudia na asie henidia; una dainai Levi taudia bona ane-abi taudia, ḡaukara e karava taudia, na vada e heau, ta ta ena uma ena uma vada ela.
english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.

motu: Taunabunai lau ese heitatao taudia na gwau henidia, nato, Dahaka dainai Dirava ena dubu vada o laloa herekwa? Bena na haboudia, bona edia ḡaukara gabudia na henidia.
english: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

motu: Bena Iuda idoinai ese aniani bona vine ranuna bona dehoro karoadia ihagwautadia na habou-habou rumadia lalodiai e vareailaidia.
english: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain, the new wine, and the oil to the treasuries.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna Selemia bona itorena tauna Sadok bona Levi tauna Pedaia na duanaidia, habou-habou ḡaudia ibalahenidia taudia ai baela; bona Hanana, Sakuru Matania natuna, na duanaia, idia idurudia tauna ai bainela; badina be idia na kara momokani taudia. Edia ḡaukara na tadikakadia adia bae henidia hagau-hagau.
english: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.

motu: Dirava e, ba lalogu tao, ina kara dainai, bona egu kara namodia egu Dirava ena dubu bona ena ḡaukara ihanamolaidia totona vada na kara ḡaudia na basio lalodia nege.
english: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.

motu: Unu dinadia ai lau ese haida na itadia Iuda ai, idia ese vine huahuadia na dina helaḡa ai e moimoilai, bona uit bali senudia e mailai, doniki latadiai; bona vine ranuna bona vine huahuadia bona suke huahuadia bona kohu idau-idau iboudiai na dina helaḡa ai Ierusalem ai e vareailai. Bena aniani e hoihoilai dinana ai na sisiba henidia.
english: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.

motu: Turo taudia hanua badana ai e nohova danu, gwarume bona hoihoi ḡaudia idau-idau e vareailai, dina helaḡa ai Iuda taudia ediai bona Ierusalem lalonai e hoihoilai.
english: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

motu: Bena Iuda lohiadia na gwau henidia, nato, Ina kara dikana umui ese o karaiamu be dahaka, dina helaḡa o hadikaiamu?
english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?

motu: Senemui na unu e kara toma, bena eda Dirava ese ina dika idoinai ita latadai bona ina hanua badana latanai e havaraia, ani? A umui ese badu ma o havaraiamu Israel latanai, dina helaḡa o hadikaiamu dainai.
english: Didn’t your fathers do this, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”

motu: Dina helaḡa e kahira-kahira ai, Ierusalem ikoukouna ai dina e diho negana ai, lau ese na haduadia iduara bae koudia, bona na haḡanidia basie kehodia ela bona dina helaḡa baine ore. Bena egu hesiai taudia haida na ikoukou itataodia na atodia, maduna ta dina helaḡa ai basie vareailaia helaoreana.
english: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.

motu: Bena nega ta eiava rua hoihoi taudia, kohu idau-idau e hoi taudia, na Ierusalem murimurinai e taruhava.
english: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

motu: A lau ese na sisiba henidia, nato, Dahaka dainai maḡu vairanai o taruhamu? Una kara ba karaia lou negana ai, baina dabaimui tao. Una negana amo idia na dina helaḡa ai asiema lou.
english: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

motu: Bena Levi taudia na haḡanidia, idia na sibodia bae haheḡoeva, bena baema, ikoukou bae gimadia, dina helaḡa bae hahelaḡaia helaoreana. Egu Dirava e, ina danu ba laloa tao, lau ihanamogu, bona emu hebogahisi badana heḡereḡerena ai ba hamaurigu.
english: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.

motu: Unu dinadia ai lau ese Iuda taudia haida, Asdod bona Amono bona Moab hahinedia vada e adavadia taudia, na itadia;
english: In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;

motu: idia natudia orea kahana na Asdod gadona ai e herevava, bona Iuda gadona igwauraina asi dibadia, a bese ta ta gadodia mo.
english: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

motu: Bena na heai henidia, bona na uduguiraidia, bona haida be na dadabadia bona huidia na butu. Bena na haduadia, Dirava ladana ai bae gwau hamata; nato, Natumui hahinedia na idia natudia mamaruanedia basio henidia, bona idia natudia hahinedia na basio abidia, umui adavamui eiava natumui mamaruanedia adavadia ai basio halaodia.
english: I contended with them, cursed them, struck certain of them, plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.

motu: Solomon, Israel pavapavana, na hahine unuhetomadia daidiai e kerere, ani? Bese momo bogaragidiai asi pavapava ta ia heḡereḡerena; ena Dirava ese e lalokau henia, bona Dirava ese Israel idoinai pavapavana ai e halaoa; ḡau tamona, idau bese hahinedia ese ia e hakaraia dika.
english: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

motu: Matona, ai ese umui baia kamonai henimui, bona ina kara dika-hereana baia karaia, bona eda Dirava baia kara henia koikoi, idau bese hahinedia iadavadia ai, a?
english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”

motu: Iehoiada natuna ta, hahelaḡa tauna Eliasibi tubuna, na Sanbalata, tau Horono, rava-maragina, una dainai lau ese egu amo na lulua oho.
english: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I chased him from me.

motu: Egu Dirava e, ba lalodia tao, badina be idia ese hahelaḡa dagina, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia edia gwauhamata, na e hamiro.
english: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese idau bese ḡaudia iboudiai amo na haḡoevadia, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona Levi taudia na haginidia, edia ḡaukara ta ta ai;
english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;

motu: bona boubou au-rakurakudia dalana na lailaia, e gwaurai negadia ai, bona aniani roboadia dalana danu. Egu Dirava e, ba lalogu tao, baina namo helaoreana.
english: and for the wood offering, at appointed times, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.

motu: Ahasuero ena nega ai, (una Ahasuero na basileia sinahu-ta ruahui-hitu e lohiadia, India amo ela bona Etiopia),
english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),

motu: unu dinadia ai King Ahasuero na ena pavapava teronona ai e helaiva, hanua badana ladana Susa ai.
english: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace,

motu: Bena ena Iohia laḡanina ihatoina ai, ia ese aria ta e karaia, ena Iohia taudia bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai, bona Parasa bona Media tuari lohiadia, bona basileia lohiadia bona ikwaradia taudia, adia.
english: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him.

motu: Una negana ai ia ese ena basileia herea-daena taḡadia bona ena siahu hairaina bada-herea e haheitalaidia, dina momo lalodiai; unu dina iboudiai na sinahu-ta taurahani-ahui.
english: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.

motu: Unu dina vada e ore murinai, hanua pavapavana ese aria ta ma e karaia, hanua badana Susa lalonai e nohova taudia kikina-badana iboudiai adia. Una aria na hanua pavapavana ena ruma uma-umana maḡuna lalonai e dabaraia, ela bona dina hitu e ore.
english: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace.

motu: Seseahu dabuadia kurokurodia bona vaiundia na e taudia dae, bona varo aukadia bona varo kakakakadia amo silver * ikekedia ai bona nadi hururu-hururu au-tubuadia ai e matadia kau. Helai ḡaudia na gold * bona silver * amo e kara, bona reireina na nadi hururu-hururudia kakakakadia bona kurokurodia amo e karaia, bona mairi bona dava-bada nadidia amo e haheraia.
english: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.

motu: Inuinu ḡaudia na gold * keheredia ai e sei bona e diu henidia; unu kehere na idau-idau; bona vine ranuna momo, pavapava e inumu ḡauna, hanua pavapavana ena harihari-bada heḡereḡerena.
english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

motu: I'inuna na taravatu heḡereḡerena, ta asie haduaia baine inu; badina be hanua pavapavana ese ena ruma ireḡuna taudia iboudiai vada e haḡanidia, eto ta ta ena ura ena ura heḡereḡeredia bae kara.
english: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

motu: Queen Vasati danu aria ta e karaia, hahine adia, King Ahasuero ena ruma ai.
english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.

motu: Dina ihahituna ai hanua pavapavana lalona e moaleva, vine ranuna e inuava dainai, bena ia ese Mehumana bona Bisita bona Harabona bona Bigita bona Abagata bona Setara bona Karakasa, King Ahasuero ena ruma irefiuna taudia hahituosi, na e haḡanidia,
english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

motu: idia ese Queen Vasati na bae hakaua vareai hanua pavapavana vairanai, mai ena havava ḡauna kwarana ai, hanua taudia bona hanua hanua lohiadia na ia hairaina baine haheitalaidia totona; badina be ia na hane namo, mai hairaina.
english: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

motu: A Queen Vasati e gwau edeede; hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani hari ruma ireḡuna taudia ese e mailaia na ibadinana se ura. Una dainai, hanua pavapavana lalona e siahu, e badu ḡaraḡara.
english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs. Therefore the king was very angry, and his anger burned in him.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese aonega taudia, nega mai dibadia taudia, na e hereva henidia. (Hanua pavapavana na vaia ena kara unu e kara tomava, taravatu bona hahemaoro mai dibadia taudia ediai.
english: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and judgment;

motu: Ia badinai e giniva taudia be Karasena bona Setara bona Adamata bona Tarasisi bona Merese bona Marasena bona Memukana, Parasa bona Media lohiadia hahituosi; idia na nega idoinai hanua pavapavana vairana e itaiava, bona helai gabudia hereadia ai e helaiva una basileia lalonai.)
english: and next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat first in the kingdom),

motu: Ia na eto, Taravatu ai ede e torea tomamu, Queen Vasati ede baita kara henia toma? Badina be ia ese King Ahasuero ena haheḡani, ena ruma ireḡuna taudia ududia amo e siaia, na se badinaia.
english: “What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”

motu: Bena Memukana na hanua pavapavana bona hanua hanua lohiadia vairadiai e hereva, eto, Queen Vasati vada e kerere, dia hanua pavapavana mo enai, to lohia iboudiai bona taunimanima iboudiai ediai, King Ahasuero ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.

motu: Badina be ina hanua pavapavana adavana ena kara na hahine iboudiai ese sivaraina bae kamonai, bena idia ese adavadia basie matauraidia; badina be idia na baeto “King Ahasuero na e hahedua, Queen Vasati na ia vairanai bae hakaua mai, to sema”.
english: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she didn’t come.’

motu: Hari ina dina ai, hanua pavapavana adavana ena kara sivaraina vada e kamonai dainai, Parasa bona Media lohiadia adavadia ese hanua pavapavana ena lohia iboudiai ediai bae herevalaia, bena hemarai bona badu na bae bada herea.
english: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.

motu: Bema hanua pavapavana lalona baine heḡereḡere, pavapava haheduana ta na iena amo bainela, Parasa taudia bona Media taudia edia taravatu ai baine hetore, bena ta ese basine ha-idaua diba. Hahedua na iniheto: Vasati na King Ahasuero vairanai ma basine raka vareai lou; a hanua pavapavana ese ena dagi na hahine ta, ia e hereaiamu hahinena, baine henia.
english: “If it pleases the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it cannot be altered, that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she.

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani herevana na ena basileia bada-hereana idoinai bae piua, bena hahine iboudiai, lohia hahinedia bona hanua hahinedia, ese adavadia bae matauraidia.
english: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”

motu: Ina hahealo herevana na hanua pavapavana bona hanua hanua lohiadia ese e moalelaia; bena hanua pavapavana na Memukana ena lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ai e kara.
english: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

motu: Ia ese revareva e siaidia, e lohiadia basileiadia iboudiai ediai, basileia ta ta edia revareva daladia amo, bona bese ta ta edia gado ai, tatau ta ta ena ruma ena ruma bae biagudia, bona edia bese herevadia korikoridia bae gwaurai.
english: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, King Ahasuero lalona ma e keru, bena ia ese Vasati e helalolaia une, bona ena kara bona hari hahedua herevana ia latanai e gwauraia na e helalolai.
english: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia eto, Rami-hebou ulatodia matamatadia mai hairaidia bae tahudia, hanua pavapavana ena.
english: Then the king’s servants who served him said, “Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese heitatao taudia baine duanaidia, ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai; bena idia ese rami-hebou ulatodia matamatadia mai hairaidia iboudiai na bae haboudia, Susa bae siaidia mai; bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai tauna Hegai, hanua pavapavana adavana edia ruma ireguna tauna, ese una ruma ai do baine naridia, bona dahudahu muramuradia baine henidia.
english: Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to the citadel of Susa, to the women’s house, to the custody of Hegai the king’s eunuch, keeper of the women. Let cosmetics be given them;

motu: Bena edena hane-ulato na hanua pavapavana ese baine ura henia bada be pavapava hahinena dagina baine abia, Vasati gabuna ai. Hanua pavapavana ese ina hereva e moalelaia, bena unu e kara toma.
english: and let the maiden who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti.” The thing pleased the king, and he did so.

motu: Hanua badana Susa ai, Iuda tauna ta e nohova, ladana na Morodekai lairi, Simei Kisa tubuna, Beniamina tauna.
english: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite,

motu: Morodekai na abi-mauri taudia ida Ierusalem amo e laohaia, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese Iekonia, Iuda pavapavana, na e abia mauri bona e laohaia negana ai.
english: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

motu: Hari Morodekai ese Hadasa (ladana ta be Eseta), tamana lahaina natuna, vada e ubua, badina be tamana bona sinana vada e mase. Ia na hane namo mai hairaina; bena tamana bona sinana e mase negana ai, Morodekai ese e abia, ia natuna ai e halaoa.
english: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter; for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was fair and beautiful; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ena hahedua herevana bona ena haheḡani e gwauraia hedinarai, bena ulato momo na hanua badana Susa ai e haboudia, Hegai ena hereḡu ai, negana ai Eseta danu e abia, hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai e atoa, Hegai, hahine inaridia tauna, ena hereḡu ai.
english: So, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together to the citadel of Susa, to the custody of Hegai, Esther was taken into the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

motu: Bena hari hane-ulato ese una tau lalona e hamoalea; bena ia ese hane-ulato na e lalo namo henia, bona dahudahu muramuradia e henia haraḡa. Ana aniani danu e henia, bona hesiai kekenidia hahitu, hanua pavapavana ena ruma kekenidia bogaragidia amo e abidia hidi, na e henia. Bena ia bona ena hesiai kekenidia na gabu namo-hereana e henidia, hahine edia ruma ai.
english: The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.

motu: Eseta na ena iduhu bona ena bese se hahedinaraidia, badina be Morodekai ese vada e haḡania ia na basine gwauraidia hedinarai.
english: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.

motu: A dina iboudiai Morodekai ese hahine edia ruma maḡuna vairanai e rakava, baine diba Eseta na edeheto bona ena noho na edeheto totona.
english: Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women’s house, to find out how Esther was doing, and what would become of her.
