motu: Ini ulato na hahine taravatudia henunai e nohova ela bona hua gwauta-rua e ore; una na ihahairaidia negana korikorina, hua tauratoi muro dehorona amo bona hua tauratoi muramura mai bonadia bona hahine edia dehoro haida amo. Bena ulato ta ta edia nega e kau, King Ahasuero dekenai bae raka vareai, negadia ai na
english: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months (for so were the days of their purification accomplished, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women).

motu: hanua pavapavana dekenai baine raka vareai hane-ulatona ena ura ḡauna na e henia, hanua pavapavana adavana edia ruma amo baine laohaia, bainela pavapava ena ruma ai.
english: The young woman then came to the king like this: whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women’s house to the king’s house.

motu: Adorahi ai ela, bena daba ai ma e lou, hahine edia ruma iharuana ela, Saasagasa, hanua pavapavana ese e adavadia hahinedia inaridia tauna, ena hereḡu ai e nohova. Ia na hanua pavapavana dekenai basinema raka vareai lou, a hanua pavapavana ese bema ura henia, ia ese ladana bema hatoa, bena bema boiria.
english: In the evening she went, and on the next day she returned into the second women’s house, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, who kept the concubines. She came in to the king no more, unless the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.

motu: Eseta, Morodekai tamana lahaina Abihaili natuna, Morodekai ese e natua kekenina, ena nega e kau, hanua pavapavana dekenai baine raka vareai; bena ia ese ḡau ta se gwauraia, hanua pavapavana ena hesiai tauna Hegai, hahine e naridiava tauna, ena lalo-hadai ḡauna mo. E itaia taudia iboudiai ese Eseta e lalo namo heniava.
english: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, came to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s eunuch, the keeper of the women, advised. Esther obtained favor in the sight of all those who looked at her.

motu: King Ahasuero ena lohia laḡanina ihahituna ai, hua ihagwautana, ladana Tebete, lalonai, Eseta na King Ahasuero dekenai e hakaua vareai, hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai.
english: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Eseta e ura henia bada, hahine oredia iboudiai e ura henidia maragi; bona ulato iboudiai bogaragidia amo ia sibona ese hanua pavapavana ena harihari bona ena hahenamo e abidia badabada. Taunabunai, ia ese havava ḡauna na ia kwarana ai e atoa, bona pavapava hahinena ai e halaoa, Vasati ibolona.
english: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese aria badana e karaia, ena lohia bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai adia; una na Eseta ena aria. Bona basileia iboudiai edia laḡa-ani e henidia, bona harihari ḡaudia e heni hagauhagau, pavapava ena harihari-bada heḡereḡerena. Morodekai ese hanua pavapavana iala-masena e laoa ahu
english: Then the king made a great feast for all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces, and gave gifts according to the king’s bounty.

motu: Ulato na hahine edia ruma iharuana ai e haboudia negana ai, Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ruma ikoukouna ai e helaiva.
english: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate.

motu: Eseta ese ena iduhu bona ena bese do se gwaurai hedinarai, Morodekai ena haheḡani heḡereḡerena; badina be Eseta ese dounu Morodekai e kamonai henia, gunaguna ia dekenai e nohova negana ai e kamonai heniava heḡereḡerena.
english: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai, like she did when she was brought up by him.

motu: Bena unu dinadia ai, Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e helaiva ai, Bigitana bona Terese, hanua pavapavana ena raka-vareaina e gimaiava taudia, na e badu, King Ahasuero na bae dabaia tao eto.
english: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

motu: Ina na Morodekai e diba, bena ia ese Queen Eseta e hadibaia, bena Eseta ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, Morodekai ladana ai.
english: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.

motu: Hereva na e tahua, e davaria vada e momokani; bena unu tatau raruosi na tau-dae auna ai e matadia. Bena sivarai na Sisiga Bukana ai e torea, hanua pavapavana vairanai.
english: When this matter was investigated, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king’s presence.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, King Ahasuero ese Hamana Hamedata, tau Agag, e abia dae, dagi badana e henia, bona ia ida e lohia hebou taudia iboudiai daediai e hahelaia.
english: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia iboudiai, pavapava ena ikoukou ai e nohova taudia, na e igo diho; idia ese Hamana e toma henia diho, badina be hanua pavapavana na unu vada e haheḡanilaia toma. A Morodekai na se igo diho bona se toma henia diho.
english: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai didn’t bow down or pay him homage.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia, hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e nohova taudia, ese Morodekai e nanadaia, eto, Dahaka dainai hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani o tataia utumu?
english: Then the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”

motu: Dina momo lalodiai idia ese e hereva henia loulou, to ia ese se kamonai henidia. Bena idia ese Hamana e hamaoroa; bae itaia, Morodekai ena hereva baine kwalimu eiava. Badina be ia ese vada e hamaorodia ia na Iuda tauna.
english: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn’t listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.

motu: Hamana ese e itaia, Morodekai na se igo diho bona se toma henia diho, bena Hamana na e badu dikadika.
english: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.

motu: A Morodekai na ia sibona ese baine dabaia tao na se ura. Taunabunai, haida ese e hadibaia, Morodekai ena bese be edena; bena Hamana ese Iuda taudia, Morodekai ena bese taudia, iboudiai ihabua-taridia dalana e tahua, Ahasuero ena basileia idoinai lalonai.
english: But he scorned the thought of laying hands on Mordecai alone, for they had made known to him Mordecai’s people. Therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even Mordecai’s people.

motu: King Ahasuero ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-ruana ai, hua gini-gunana, ladana Nisan, lalonai, idia ese mari karana ta, ladana Puru, na Hamana vairanai e karaia, dina ta ta amo bona hua ta ta amo, ela bona mari ese hua ihagwauta-ruana, ladana Adara, na e duanaia.
english: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

motu: Bena Hamana ese King Ahasuero e hereva henia, eto, Bese ta na e noho rohorohomu, emu basileia kahadia iboudiai taudia bogaragidiai e noho hedoa-hedoamu; edia taravatu na idau, dia bese oredia iboudiai edia heḡereḡeredia, bona hanua pavapavana ena taravatu asie badinadiamu; una dainai dia namo hanua pavapavana ese baine haheauka henidia.
english: Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.

motu: Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, boma haheḡani, bae habuadia tari, bena lau ese silver talent * gerebu ta hanua pavapavana ena moni e reguamu taudia imadia ai baina ato, bena idia ese hanua pavapavana ena kohu-habou rumadia ai bae ato.
english: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents + 3:9 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces * of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana ese ia imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina, ena toa ikarana ḡauna, na kwakikwakina amo e veria oho, Hamana Hamedata, tau Agag, Iuda taudia adia inai, na e henia.
english: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Hamana e hamaoroa, eto, Moni na oiemu, taunimanima danu oiemu, emu lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ba karalaidia.
english: The king said to Haman, “The silver is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you.”

motu: Bena hua gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-toina ai, hanua pavapavana ena toretore taudia e boiridia, bona haheḡani pepana ta, Hamana ena haheḡani herevadia iboudiai ihaheḡereḡeredia, na e tore, hanua pavapavana ena heitatao taudia, bona ena basileia iboudiai ikwaradia taudia, bona bese iboudiai lohiadia, ediai, basileia ta ta edia revareva daladia amo, bona bese ta ta edia gado ai. King Ahasuero ladana ai e tore, bona kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina amo hanua pavapavana toana e karaia.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called in on the first month, on the thirteenth day of the month; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king’s local governors, and to the governors who were over every province, and to the princes of every people, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.

motu: Revareva na gwaukau taudia imadia ai e siaidia lao, hanua pavapavana ena basileia kahadia iboudiai ediai, eto, dina tamona ai, hua ihagwauta-ruana, ladana Adara, dinana ihagwauta-toina ai, Iuda tataudia iboudiai kikina-badana bona hahine bona natudia na bae habuadia tari, bae aladia mase, bae ha-oredia vaitani, bona edia kohu bae dadi.
english: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder their possessions.

motu: Pepa unuhetomadia ta ta be basileia ta ta ai bae halasidia, taravatu na heto, bona bae duahi hedinarai, taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, bae hegaeḡae, una dina bae naria, totona.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day.

motu: Gwaukau taudia na e heau ela, hanua pavapavana ena hahedua heḡereḡerena; bona haheḡani na hanua badana Susa ai e gwauraia hedinarai danu. Bena hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na e helai diho, vine ranuna e inua; a Susa ai hanua taudia na e daradara.
english: The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed.

motu: Unu kara iboudiai na Morodekai vada e diba; bena ia ese ena dabua e daredia, puse dabuadia e hahedokilai, bona kahu ai e hebubu tao. Bena hanua bogaragina ela, e tai lolololo, e tai hahane;
english: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed loudly and bitterly.

motu: bena ma ela, ela bona hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou vairanai, badina be puse dabuana e hahedokilaia tauna ta na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou lalonai basine raka vareai diba.
english: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

motu: Bona hanua pavapavana ena hahedua herevadia bona ena haheḡani e kau basileiadia iboudiai lalodiai, Iuda taudia na e tai noho tai nohova, e anivagava, e taitaiva, e tai hahane-hahaneva; bona hutuma na puse dabuadia e hahedokilaiva bona kahu ai e hebubu taova, bena e hekure nohova.
english: In every province, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

motu: Eseta ena hesiai kekenidia bona ena hesiai taudia na dekena ema, bona e hamaoroa; bena pavapava hahinena na lalona e hisihisi bada. Ia ese dabua haida e siaidia, Morodekai ese ena puse dabuadia baule doki oho bona unu dabua baine hahedokilai eto; to ia ese se abidia.
english: Esther’s maidens and her eunuchs came and told her this, and the queen was exceedingly grieved. She sent clothing to Mordecai, to replace his sackcloth, but he didn’t receive it.

motu: Bena Eseta ese Hataka, hanua pavapavana ena hesiai tauna ta, hanua pavapavana ese vada e hagania ia isiaina baine lao heni tauna, e boiria, e haḡania, Morodekai dekena bainela, baine diba una kara be dahaka bona anina be dahaka.
english: Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs, whom he had appointed to attend her, and commanded him to go to Mordecai, to find out what this was, and why it was.

motu: Bena Hataka na e raka lasi, Morodekai dekena ela, hanua ariarana ai, hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou vairanai.
english: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king’s gate.

motu: Bena Morodekai ese ienai vada e vara ḡaudia iboudiai e hamaorolaia, bona e hamaoroa danu moni hida Hamana ese vada e gwauraia hamata, hanua pavapavana ena kohu-habou gabuna ai baine atoa, Iuda taudia ihabua-taridia davana.
english: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.

motu: Morodekai ese danu haheḡani pepadia, Susa ai e tore ḡaudia, ta e henia, Eseta baine haheitalaia totona; bona e hamaoroa anina na baine hadibalaia, bona baine noia, ia na hanua pavapavana dekenai baine raka vareai, baine noinoi, ena bese taudia daidiai baine noia.
english: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.

motu: Bena Hataka na ela, Morodekai ena hereva na Eseta e hamaorolaia.
english: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

motu: Bena Eseta ese Hataka e hereva henia, gwaukau herevana e henia Morodekai ena, eto,
english: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

motu: Hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia bona ena basileia taudia iboudiai na dibadia tau ta eiava hahine ta na laloma maḡuna ai baine raka vareai hanua pavapavana dekenai, se boiria negana ai, taravatuna be tamona: iboudiai na bae karadia heḡereḡere, bae aladia mase mo. Ḡau tamona, hanua pavapavana ese ena dagi auna, gold * ḡauna, amo ta baine dudui henia, una tau eiava una hahine na baine mauri. Bona lau na dina toi-ahui asie boirigu, hanua pavapavana dekenai baina raka vareai totona.
english: “All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, comes to the king into the inner court without being called, there is one law for him, that he be put to death, except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter, that he may live. I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.”

motu: Bena idia ese Eseta ena hereva na Morodekai e hamaorolaia.
english: They told Esther’s words to Mordecai.

motu: Bena Morodekai ese e hamaorodia, ina haere na bae laohaia, Eseta bae henia, baeto: Basioto hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai oi na ba roho maun, a Iuda taumai iboumai ai baia mase.
english: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.

motu: Badina be nega inihetomana ai udumu boma hakapua, hekaha bona hahemauri na idau kaha amo bae hedinarai Iuda taudia edia, a oi bona tamamu ena iduhu taudia na ba mase. Daika dibana, oi na reana nega inihetomana bagunai dagi vada o abia ina basileia lalonai.
english: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

motu: Bena Eseta ese e hamaorodia, Morodekai na bae haere henia, baeto:
english: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,

motu: Aola, Iuda taudia iboudiai Susa ai ba davandia na ba haboudia, lau daigu ai bavanivaga; dina toi hanuaboi toi basio aniani bona ranu basio inua. Lau bona egu hesiai kekenidia danu baia anivaga, umui heḡereḡeremui. Una murinai, ena be vada e taravatua to hanua pavapavana dekenai baina raka vareai; bama mase be vada baina mase.
english: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”

motu: Bena Morodekai na e raka oho, ḡau iboudiai e kara, Eseta ese e haḡania heḡereḡerena.
english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai Eseta ese ena dagi dabuadia e hahedokilaidia, bena ela, hanua pavapavana ena ruma maguna lalonai e gini, hanua pavapavana ena daiutu vairanai. Hanua pavapavana na ena terono ai e helaiva, ena ruma lalonai, ruma iduarana hevaira hehenina ai.
english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese Queen Eseta na maḡu ai ginana ai e itaia, bena e lalo namo henia. Ena dagi auna, gold * ḡauna, na imana ai mia, bena ia ese e toia roro, Eseta e dudui henia. Bena Eseta e raka kahira, hari dagi auna dorina e daua toho.
english: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Queen Eseta, edeheto? Emu ura be dahaka? Ena be egu basileia kahana to baina henimu.
english: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”

motu: Bena Eseta eto, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na hari dina ai raruosi baoma, aniani vada na heḡaeḡaelaia hanua pavapavana ana, na raruosi bavania.
english: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Hamana a boiria haraḡa, ai raruosi na Eseta ena ura heḡereḡerena baia karaia. Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na ela, Eseta ese vada e heḡaeḡaelaia anianina bae ania totona.
english: Then the king said, “Bring Haman quickly, so that it may be done as Esther has said.” So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

motu: Bena vine ranuna e inuva negana ai, hanua pavapavana ese Eseta e nanadaia, eto, Emu noinoi ḡauna be dahaka? Baina henimu. Emu ura be dahaka? Ena be egu basileia kahana, to baina henimu vaitani.
english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

motu: A Eseta eto, Egu noinoi bona egu ura be iniheto:
english: Then Esther answered and said, “My petition and my request is this.

motu: bema oi hanua pavapavana ese o lalo namo henigumu, bona o uramu egu noinoi ḡauna ba henigu bona egu ura ba haḡuḡurua, mani emu kara hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na raruosi kerukeru ma baoma, baina heḡaeḡaelaia anianina ma bavania, bena hanua pavapavana emu hereva heḡereḡerena do baina karaia.
english: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.”

motu: Una dina ai, Hamana na e raka lasi mai moalena ida; lalona na e moale bada. A Hamana ese Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e itaia, ia na se tore isi bona ia vairanai se gari, bena ena badu na e ḡaraḡara Morodekai enai.
english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Hamana na e haheauka, bona ena ruma ela. Bena ia ese haida e siaidia lao, ia turana bona adavana Serese bae hakaudia mai.
english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

motu: Bena Hamana ese e hereva henidia, ena taḡa hairaidia, bona natuna mamaruanedia na edehohodia, bona dagi idau-idau hanua pavapavana ese vada e henia, ia ihanamolaina totona, bona hanua pavapavana ese vada e abia dae, ena lohia taudia bona ena hesiai taudia iboudiai daediai, sivaraidia e gwaurai.
english: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, all the things in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

motu: Hamana ma eto, Queen Eseta ese danu ta se boiria, hanua pavapavana baine bamoa, vada e heḡaeḡaelaia anianina ianina totona, a lau mo sibogu; bona ma vada e vavegu lou, kerukeru hanua pavapavana ida ma baiala.
english: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.

motu: A ina idoinai na do se hanamolaigu ḡuḡurumu, hari Morodekai, Iuda tauna, na doini hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai helaina ai na itaiamu negadia ai.
english: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

motu: Bena ia adavana Serese bona turana iboudiai ese e hamaoroa, eto, Tau-dae auna ta, ena lata na kiubit imahui, + 5:14 kiubit imahui = 22 metres sisivana. * na baine hekara; bena daba ai hanua pavapavana ba hamaoroa, baine hahedua, Morodekai na una ḡau dorina ai bae mataia. Bena hanua pavapavana ida aniani ianina baola mai moalemu ida. Ina hereva na Hamana ese e abia dae; bena e hahedua, hari tau-dae auna bae karaia.
english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits + 5:14 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

motu: Una hanuaboi ai hanua pavapavana na se mahutava; bena e boiboi, sisiga bukana bae mailaia. Una buka lalonai kara mai haridia vada e hetore; bena hanua pavapavana vairanai e duahidia hedinarai.
english: On that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

motu: E torea sivaraina ta be Morodekai ese Bigitana bona Terese e hahebadelaidia sivaraina. Idia be hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia rarua, iduara raka-vareaina e gimaiava taudia; bena idia ese King Ahasuero idabai-taona dalana e tahua.
english: It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who were doorkeepers, who had tried to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana e henanadai, eto, Hari Morodekai na dahaka hahenamona eiava edena dagi badana vada e henia, ina kara dainai? Hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia, ia vairanai ginidia taudia, na eto, Ḡau ta asie kara henia.
english: The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?” Then|strong="H2088" * the|strong="H5921" * king|strong="H4428" *’s servants|strong="H5288" * who|strong="H5288" * attended|strong="H8334" * him|strong="H5921" * said|strong="H1697" *, “ Nothing|strong="H3808" * has|strong="H4428" * been|strong="H3808" * done|strong="H6213" * for|strong="H5921" * him|strong="H5921" *.”

motu: Hanua pavapavana eto, Daika na maḡu lalonai noho? Una negana ai Hamana na hanua pavapavana ena ruma maḡuna lalonai vada e raka vareai, ena ura be vada e heḡaeḡaelaia tau-dae auna ai Morodekai baine mataia dalana na hanua pavapavana baine herevalai henia.
english: The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king’s house, to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hamana na unuseni ai, magu ai e ginimu. Hanua pavapavana eto, Aine raka vareai.
english: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, + 6:5 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * Haman stands in the court.” The|strong="H5975" * king|strong="H4428" * said, “Let him|strong="H5975" * come|strong="H5288" * in|strong="H4428" *.”

motu: Taunabunai, Hamana na e raka vareai. Bena hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ede bae karaia toma? Hamana na sibona lalona e hadaia, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese daika ihanamona bema moalelaia bada, a lau ihanamogu be bema moalelaia maraḡi?
english: So Haman came in. The king said to him, “What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?” Now|strong="H4428" * Haman|strong="H2001" * said in|strong="H6213" * his|strong="H6213" * heart|strong="H3820" *, “ Who|strong="H4310" * would|strong="H4310" * the|strong="H6213" * king|strong="H4428" * delight|strong="H2654" * to|strong="H6213" * honor|strong="H3366" * more|strong="H4480" * than|strong="H4480" * myself|strong="H3820" *?”

motu: Bena Hamana ese hanua pavapavana e haere henia, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ini bae karaia toma:
english: Haman said to the king, “For the man whom the king delights to honor,

motu: pavapava dabuadia bae mailai, oi pavapava taumu vada o doki oho ḡaudia, bona hosi ta, latanai hanua pavapavana vada o gui bona kwarana ai havava ḡauna, pavapava toana, vada e atoa ḡauna;
english: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.

motu: bena dabua bona hosi na hanua pavapavana emu lohia badadia ta bae henia. Bena una tau ese hari hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na baine hadabualaia bona hosi latanai baine hahelaia kau; bena hanua ariarana amo baine hakaua hanai, bona vairanai baine haroro, baineto “Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ini bae karaia toma”.
english: Let the clothing and the horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man whom the king delights to honor with them, and have him ride on horseback through the city square, and proclaim before him, ‘Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!’”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Hamana e hamaoroa, eto, A kara haraḡa, dabua bona hosi avabidia, emu hereva heḡereḡerena; bena Morodekai, tau Iuda, hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou ai e helaimu tauna, na unu ba kara henia toma. Vada o herevalai ḡaudia ta basio reaia.
english: Then the king said to Haman, “Hurry and take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king’s gate. Let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.”

motu: Bena Hamana ese dabua bona hosi e abidia, Morodekai e hadabualaia bona e hahelaia kau, bena hanua ariarana amo e hakaua hanai, e haroro, eto, Hanua pavapavana ese ihanamona e moalelaiamu tauna na ini bae karaia toma.
english: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and proclaimed before him, “Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!”

motu: Bena Morodekai na hanua pavapavana ena ikoukou e lou henia; a Hamana na ena ruma e lou lao haraḡa, mai taitaina ida, kwarana danu e ḡovaia ahu.
english: Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.

motu: Bena Hamana ese adavana Serese bona turana iboudiai na enai vada e vara ḡaudia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia. Bena ena aonega taudia bona adavana Serese ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ina Morodekai, vairanai vada o moru matama tauna, bema Iuda besena tauna ta, oi na basio laoa ahu diba, to ia vairanai ba moru vaitani.
english: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”

motu: Idia na dounu ia ida e herevava ai, hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia na e kau; bena idia ese Hamana e hakaua lao haraḡa, Eseta ese vada e heḡaeḡaelaia anianina ianina totona.
english: While they were yet talking with him, the king’s eunuchs came, and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana bona Hamana na e raka vareai, Queen Eseta ida bae aniani hebou totona.
english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

motu: Dina iharuana ai, idia na vine ranuna e inuva ai, hanua pavapavana ese Eseta ma e nanadaia lou, eto, Queen Eseta e, emu noinoi be dahaka? Do baina henimu. Emu ura ḡauna be dahaka? Ena be egu basileia kahana ba gwauraia, to bavabia vaitani.
english: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

motu: Bena Queen Eseta e haere, eto, Pavapava e, bema o lalo namo henigumu bona lalomu na bema heḡereḡere, egu noinoi dainai egu mauri ba henigu, bona egu ura dainai egu bese ba hamauria.
english: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

motu: Badina be vada e hoimai, lau bona egu bese taudia, bae habuamai tari, bae alamai mase, bona bae ha-oremai vaitani totona. Bema hoimai, hesiai taudia bona hesiai hahinedia ai bema halaomai, lau na basinama hereva; badina be ai emai hisihisi na ḡau maraḡina, a hanua pavapavana imamu bema pari be ḡau badana, basita haheḡereḡeredia diba.
english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

motu: Bena King Ahasuero ese Queen Eseta e nanadaia, eto, Tauna na daika ina kara baine karaia e tomu? Ia be edeseni ai?
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

motu: Bena Eseta e haere, eto, Daḡedaḡe tauna, inai tauna, ina tau dikana Hamana. Bena Hamana na e gari dikadika, hanua pavapavana mai adavana ida vairadiai.
english: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then|strong="H2088" * Haman|strong="H2001" * was|strong="H4428" * afraid|strong="H1204" * before|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" * and|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H6440" * queen|strong="H4436" *.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na aniani gabuna amo e tore isi mai baduna ida, e raka lasi, ena ruma uma-umana ai. A Hamana na e noho, Queen Eseta enai ena mauri baine noia eto; badina be lalona vada e parara, hanua pavapavana ese ia ihadikana baine gwauraia.
english: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana na ena ruma uma-umana amo e lou, vine ranuna e inuva gabuna ai ma e raka vareai; una negana ai Hamana na Eseta ena ege-diho patana ai vada e goru diho. Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Egu ruma ai bona vairagu ai adavagu baine eno henia a? Hanua pavapavana na dounu e hereva ai, idia ese Hamana vairana e ḡovaia ahu.
english: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

motu: Bena Harabona, hanua pavapavana isiaina e lao heniva tauna ta, eto, Ina danu, Hamana ena tau-dae auna, Morodekai, ena hereva amo hanua pavapavana e hamauria tauna, imatana totona e heḡaeḡaelaia ḡauna, na ena ruma ai gini; ena lata na kiubit imahui.
english: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits + 7:9 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" * said|strong="H1696" *, “ Hang|strong="H8518" * him|strong="H6440" * on|strong="H5921" * it|strong="H5921" *!”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana eto, Una ḡau ai a mataia. Taunabunai idia ese Hamana e mataia, ia ese Morodekai imatalaina e heḡaeḡaelaia ḡauna dorina ai. Bena hanua pavapavana ena badu vada e keru.
english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.

motu: Una dina ai King Ahasuero ese Hamana, Iuda taudia adia inai tauna, ena ruma na Queen Eseta e henia. Bena Morodekai na hanua pavapavana vairanai e gini, badina be Eseta vada e hamaoroa idia raruosi na varavara.
english: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ia imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina, ena toa ikaralaina ḡauna, Hamana ena amo vada e abia oho, Morodekai e henia. Bena Eseta ese Morodekai na Hamana ena ruma biaguna ai e halaoa.
english: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

motu: Bena Eseta ese hanua pavapavana ma e hereva henia lou. Ia na ia aena badinai e goru diho, mai taina ida e noia, Hamana tau Agag ena lalo-hadai dikana, Iuda taudia ihadikadia dalana vada e lailaia, na baine gwaua tubu.
english: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese ena dagi auna, gold * ḡauna, na e toia roro, Eseta e dudui henia.
english: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.

motu: Bena Eseta e tore isi, hanua pavapavana vairanai e gini, eto, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, bona boma lalo namo henigu, boma haeroa bema kara maoromaoro oi vairamu ai, bona boma moalelaigu, haheḡani herevana ta bae torea, Hamana Hamedata, tau Agag, ena revareva, hanua pavapavana ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai Iuda taudia bae habuadia tari totona e tore ḡaudia, bae gwaudia tao.
english: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.

motu: Badina be dika badana na egu bese taudia latadiai be kaumu na itana ai ede baina haheauka toma? Varavaragu ihabua-taridia baina itaia negana ai, ede baina haheauka toma?
english: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”

motu: Bena King Ahasuero ese Queen Eseta bona Morodekai, tau Iuda, na e e hamaorodia, eto, A itaia, Hamana ena ruma na Eseta vada na henia, bona tauna na tau-dae ḡauna ai vada e mataia, badina be ia ese Iuda taudia baine dabaidia tao eto.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.

motu: Bona Iuda taudia herevadia na emui ura heḡereḡerena ba tore, hanua pavapavana ladagu ai, bona hanua pavapavana imagu kwakikwakina vaḡivagina amo toana ba karaia; badina be haheḡani herevana hanua pavapavana ladana ai e torea bona imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina amo toana e karadia na ta ese basine gwaua tao diba.
english: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

motu: Una negana ai hanua pavapavana ena toretore taudia na e boiridia, hua ihatoina, ladana Sivana, dinana iharuahui-toina ai. Bena haheḡani herevana e torea, Morodekai ese e haḡanidia heḡereḡerena, Iuda taudia daidiai, basileia sinahu-ta ruahui-hitu, India amo ela bona Etiopia, edia heitatao taudia bona edia basileia ikwaradia taudia bona edia bese lohiadia ediai, basileia ta ta edia revareva daladia amo bona bese ta ta edia gado ai, bona Iuda taudia ediai danu, edia revareva dalana amo bona edia gado ai.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

motu: King Ahasuero ladana ai e torea, bona hanua pavapavana imana kwakikwakina vaḡivaḡina amo toa e karaia. Bena revareva na gwaukau taudia imadia ai e siaidia; unu gwaukau taudia na heau-dikadika hosidia ai e gui, hanua pavapavana ena hosi maḡuna ai e vara bona hanua pavapavana isiaidia ilao-henina ai e loalaidia hosidia.
english: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

motu: Unu revareva lalodiai hanua pavapavana na e gwau maoro, Iuda taudia hanua ta ta lalodiai bae hebou diba, edia mauri igimadia totona, bona bese ta eiava basileia ta ena tuari taudia ese bema ala-ala henidia, idia ese idia bona natudia bona adavadia na bae habuadia tari bona bae aladia mase bona bae ha-oredia vaitani, bona edia kohu bae dadi,
english: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,

motu: dina tamona ai, King Ahasuero ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai; una dina be hua ihagwauta-ruana ladana Adara, dinana ihagwauta-toina.
english: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

motu: Pepa unuhetomadia ta ta be basileia ta ta ai bae halasidia, taravatu na heto, bona bae duahi hedinarai taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai; bena Iuda taudia na bae heḡaeḡae, una dina ai inaidia davadia bae henidia.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

motu: Taunabunai, gwaukau taudia na edia hosi, hari heau-dikadika ḡaudia, hanua pavapavana isiaina ilao-henina ai e ḡaukaralaidiava ḡaudia, na latadiai e gui, e heau haraḡa-haraḡa, hanua pavapavana ena hahedua aukana dainai. Hari haheḡani herevana na hanua badana Susa ai danu e gwauraia hedinarai.
english: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

motu: Bena Morodekai na hanua pavapavana vairana amo e raka lasi. Pavapava dabuadia e hahedokilai, vaiuridia bona kurokurodia; ena havava ḡauna na gold * ḡauna bada-hereana; ena hahedoki na dabua aukana ḡoeva-daena bona dabua kakakakana amo e karaia. Bena Susa taudia na e lolo bona e moale hisi dae;
english: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

motu: diari bona moale bona lalo-namo bona heimodai na Iuda taudia latadiai.
english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ena hahedua herevana bona ena haheḡani e kamonai basileiadia bona hanuadia iboudiai Ialodiai, Iuda taudia na e moaleva bona e hisi daeva, aria e karava bona e kone nohova. Bona unu tano taudia hutuma na sibodia Iuda taudia ai e hegwaurai, badina be Iuda taudia garidia e gariva.
english: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

motu: Hua ihagwauta-ruana, ladana Adara, dinana ihagwauta-toina ai, hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani bona ena revareva anidia bae vara negana vada e kau. Una dina ai Iuda taudia inaidia ese bae hadareredia eto, ḡau tamona Iuda taudia ese inaidia e hadareredia una dina lalonai.
english: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),

motu: King Ahasuero ena basileia lalodiai Iuda taudia na edia hanua lalodiai e hebou, una dina ai, ihadikadia dalana e tahuava taudia na bae dabaidia tao totona. A asi tauna ta ese baine laodia ahu diba, badina be taunimanima iboudiai ese idia garidia e gariva.
english: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.

motu: Bona basileia lohiadia bona heitatao taudia bona hekwara taudia bona hanua pavapavana ena hesiai taudia iboudiai ese Iuda taudia e durudia, badina be Morodekai garina e gariva.
english: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

motu: Badina be Morodekai na bada herea hanua pavapavana ena ruma ai, bona harina vada e piua, basileia heḡeḡemadai iboudiai lalodiai; badina be una tau Morodekai ena siahu e bada e laova.
english: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.

motu: Taunabunai, Iuda taudia ese inaidia iboudiai na dare amo e aladia; e aladia mase bona e habuadia tari, bona e inai henidia taudia na edia ura heḡereḡerena ai e kara henidia.
english: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.

motu: Hanua badana Susa ai Iuda taudia ese tatau sinahu-ima e aladia mase bona e habuadia tari.
english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

motu: E aladia taudia haida ladadia be Parasanadata bona Dalafono bona Aspata,
english: They killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,

motu: bona Porata bona Adalia bona Aridata,
english: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,

motu: bona Paramasta bona Arisai bona Aridai bona Vaisata;
english: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha,

motu: ini na Hamana Hamedata, Iuda taudia inaidia, natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi.
english: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

motu: Una dina ai haida ese hanua pavapavana e hadibaia, hanua badana Susa ai taunimanima edehohodia vada e aladia mase.
english: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Queen Eseta e hamaoroa, eto, Hanua badana Susa lalonai Iuda taudia ese tatau sinahu-ima vada e aladia mase, bona Hamana natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi danu. Hanua pavapavana ena basileia oredia ai be edehohona vada e aladia mase! Harihari emu noinoi be dahaka? Vada baina henimu. Dahaka ma o uramu? Baine hekara ḡuḡuru.
english: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”

motu: Bena Eseta eto, Hanua pavapavana lalomu bema heḡereḡere, Iuda taudia Susa ai na hari dina haheḡanina heḡereḡerena ai kerukeru ma bae karaia; bona Hamana natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi tau-dae auna ai bae taudia dae.
english: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

motu: Taunabunai, hanua pavapavana na e haheḡani, unu bae karadia toma; haheḡani na Susa ai e gwauraia hedinarai, bona Hamana natuna mamaruanedia gwautaosi na e taudia dae.
english: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

motu: Bena Iuda taudia Susa ai na hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-hanina ai ma e hebou, Susa ai tatau sinahu-toi ma e aladia mase; a kohu asie dadi. Purimi Ariana
english: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

motu: Iuda taudia oredia hanua pavapavana ena basileia lalodiai e nohova danu e hebou, edia mauri igimana totona; bena inaidia imadia amo e roho mauri, bona e inai henidia taudia gerebu-hitu daha-ima + 9:16 Gerebu-hitu daha-ima = 75,000. * na e aladia mase; a kohu na asie dadi.
english: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

motu: Una na hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-toina ai; bena dina ihagwauta-hanina ai idia na lagadia e ani, aria bona moale dinana ai e halaoa.
english: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

motu: A Iuda taudia Susa ai na dina ihagwauta-toina ai bona dina ihag vauta-hanina ai e hebou, bena dina ihagwauta-imana ai lagadia e ani, aria bona moale dinana ai e halaoa.
english: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

motu: Taunabunai, Iuda taudia hanua hanua lalodiai, hanua asi maḡudia ai e nohova taudia, ese hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-hanina na moale bona aria bona kone-noho dinana ai e halaoamu, bona una dina ai idia na aniani namo-hereadia e herahialai hehenimu.
english: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.

motu: Bena Morodekai ese ini ḡau iboudiai sivaraidia e tore, bona revareva e tore, Iuda taudia iboudiai ediai e siaidia, King Ahasuero ena basileia iboudiai lalodiai, gabu kahikahidia bona daudaudia.
english: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

motu: E haḡanidia, eto hua ladana Adara dinana ihagwauta-hanina bona ihagwauta-imana ai, laḡani ta ta lalodiai, na bae badinadia,
english: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

motu: Iuda taudia na inaidia imadia amo e roho mauri dinadia, bona edia lalo-hisihisi na moale ai bona edia taitai na laḡa-ani ai e hahelao huana; unu dina na aria bona moale dinadia ai bae halaodia; bona unu dina ai idia na aniani namo-hereadia bae herahialai heheni, bona ogogami taudia bae harihari henidia.
english: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.

motu: Bena Iuda taudia na e gwau hamata, sibodia vada e matamaia bona Morodekai ese vada e tore henidia heḡereḡerena ai bae karaia.
english: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,

motu: Badina be Hamana Hamedata, tau Aga, Iuda taudia iboudiai adia inai tauna, ese Iuda taudia ihabua-taridia dalana e lalo-hadailaia, bona mari karana ta ladana Puru e karaia, idia ihadareredia bona ihabua-taridia totona.
english: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

motu: A Eseta na hanua pavapavana vairanai e gini negana ai, hanua pavapavana ese hahedua revarevana e torea, unu amo Hamana ena lalo-hadai dikana na ia sibona kwarana ai e kau, bona ia bona natuna mamaruanedia na tau-dae auna ai e taudia dae.
english: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

motu: Taunabunai, unu dina ladadia e hato Purimi, hari hereva Puru dainai. Bena ina revareva ai e hetore herevadia bona ina kara ai vada e ita ḡaudia bona ediai vada e vara ḡaudia daidiai,
english: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, + 9:26 Purim is the Hebrew plural for pur, which means lot. * from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,

motu: Iuda taudia na e haheḡani bona e gwau hamata, idia sibodia bagudiai bona garadia- bona edia orea ai bae vareai taudia bagudiai, eto unu dina ruaosi be basie readia a bae badinadia, vada e tore herevadia heḡereḡeredia, laḡani ta ta amo vada e gwauraia negana ai;
english: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

motu: bona unu dina na bae lalodia tao bona bae badinadia uru iboudiai lalodiai, iduhu iboudiai bona basileia iboudiai bona hanua iboudiai lalodiai. Unu amo hari Purimi dinadia ibadinadia karadia basie boio, Iuda taudia bogaragidiai, bona garadia bogaragidiai danu unu dina ilalolaidia na basine doko.
english: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring. + 9:28 or, seed *

motu: Bena Queen Eseta, Abihaili natuna, bona Morodekai, tau Iuda, ese revareva iharuana ma e torea, mai siahudia ida, hari Purumi herevana ihamomokanina.
english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

motu: Revareva na vada e siaidia lao, Iuda taudia iboudiai ediai, King Ahasuero ena basileia sinahu-ta ruahui-hitu lalodiai; maino herevadia bona hereva momokanidia ai e hetore, eto
english: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,

motu: unu Purimi dinadia na bae badinadia, negadia korikori ai, Morodekai, tau Iuda, bona Queen Eseta ese Iuda taudia vada e haḡanidia, bona idia sibodia ese idia bagudiai bona garadia bagudiai vada e gwau hamata, heḡereḡerena, bona edia anivaga bona edia taitai negadia danu.
english: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.

motu: Queen Eseta ena haheḡani ese ini kara e haginidia, bona revareva ese e hamomokanidia.
english: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

motu: King Ahasuero na heaiva e abia, tano idoinai lalonai, bona kone kahana tanodia danu.
english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

motu: Ena siahu bona ena goada herevadia, bona Morodekai ena dagi badana hanua pavapavana ese e henia sivaraina idoinai, na Media bona Parasa Pavapavadia Sisigadia Bukana ai vada e hetore, ani?
english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

motu: Badina be Morodekai, tau Iuda, na King Ahasuero henuna tauna; Iuda taudia bogaragidiai ia na bada herea, bona varavarana logora ese e moalelaia; badina be ena bese ena namo e tahuava, bona ena bese taudia iboudiai na maino dalana e herevalai henidiava.
english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

motu: Usu tanona ai tau ta e nohova, ladana Iobu. Ia na asi ena kerere ta, bona kara maoromaoro tauna; Dirava garina e gariva, bona kara dika amo e raka ohova.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, + 1:1 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * and turned away from evil.

motu: Natuna gwauta vada e vara, mamaruanedia hahitu bona hahinedia tatoi.
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

motu: Ena mamoe na daha hitu, ena kamelo na daha toi, ena boromakau mamaruanedia na daha ta, ena doniki hahinedia na sinahu-ima; bona ena hesiai taudia na hutuma herea. Taunabunai, mairiveina kahana taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai ina tau na sibona herea.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

motu: Natuna mamaruanedia na ta ta ena ruma ena ruma ai aria e karava, e abidia hidi dinadia ai; bena idia ese taihudia tatoiosi e vavedia, idia ida bae aniani bona bae inuinu hebou.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

motu: Iobu ena kara be aria dinadia e ore ai, ia na e hesiai, haheḡoeva karadia idia daidiai e kara; bona daba matana ai e tore isi, boubou ḡaudia e haḡoledia oho, idia hahidaosi daidiai; badina be lobu na eto, Readia natugu na vada e kara dika bona lalodia ai Dirava vada e uduguiraia. Iobu na unu e kara toma loulouva.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

motu: Dina ta, Dirava natuna verina na Iehova vairanai e hedinarai, bona Satana danu ema, idia bogaragidiai.
english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, + 1:6 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * Satan also came among them.

motu: Iehova ese Satana e nanadaia, eto, Oi na ede amo oma? Satana ese Iehova e haere henia, eto, Tanobada ai na loa eva-evamu, na raka laomu na raka maimu.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then|strong="H6030" * Satan|strong="H7854" * answered|strong="H6030" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, and|strong="H1980" * said|strong="H6030" *, “ From|strong="H1980" * going|strong="H1980" * back|strong="H1980" * and|strong="H1980" * forth|strong="H1980" * in|strong="H1980" * the|strong="H3068" * earth, and|strong="H1980" * from|strong="H1980" * walking|strong="H1980" * up|strong="H6030" * and|strong="H1980" * down|strong="H1980" * in|strong="H1980" * it|strong="H1980" *.”

motu: Iehova ese Satana ma e nanadaia, eto, Egu hesiai tauna Iobu vada o haeroa a? Tanobada ai ia na asi idaina; ia na asi ena kerere ta, bona kara maoromaoro tauna; Dirava garina e garimu, bona kara dika amo e raka ohomu, ani?
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

motu: Bena Satana ese Iehova ma e haere henia, eto, Iobu na asi badina Dirava garina e garimu a?
english: Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

motu: Ia bona ena ruma, bona ena orea bona ena ḡau iboudiai, na vada o maḡudia, ani? Imana gaukaradia vada o hanamodia, bona tano ai ena taga na vada e habadadia.
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

motu: A harihari imamu a toia roro, ena orea bona ena ḡau iboudiai ba daudia toho; bena ia ese oi vairamu ai baine uduguiraimu.
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese Satana e hamaoroa, eto, A itaia, ena orea bona ena ḡau iboudiai na imamu ai; ḡau tamona ia sibona mo basio daua toho. Bena Satana na Iehova vairana amo e raka lasi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, + 1:12 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So|strong="H7971" * Satan|strong="H7854" * went|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" * from|strong="H3318" * the|strong="H3605" * presence|strong="H6440" * of|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Dina ta, natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na tau-guna ena ruma ai e aniani hebouva bona vine ranuna e inua hebouva negana ai,
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

motu: gwaukau tauna ta na Iobu enai e kau, eto, Boromakau mamaruanedia na e ruaruava, bona doniki na idia badibadidiai e anianiva;
english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

motu: bena Sabea taudia ese e guru henidia, e abidia, bona hesiai taudia na dare matana amo e aladia mase; lau mo sibogu na roho mauri, bena oi ihadibamu nama.
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

motu: Dounu e herevava ai, ta ma ema, eto, Dirava ena lahi na guba amo e moru, mamoe bona hesiai taudia e aradia, e goledia oho; lau mo sibogu na roho mauri, bena oi ihadibamu nama.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

motu: Ia na dounu e herevava ai, ta ma ema, eto, Kaldea taudia na orea toi ai e hebou, kamelo idadidia ema; bena e abidia, bona hesiai taudia na dare matana amo e aladia mase; lau mo sibogu na roho mauri, bena oi ihadibamu nama.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

motu: Ia na dounu e herevava ai, ta ma ema, eto, Natumu mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na tau-guna ena ruma ai e aniani hebouva bona vine ranuna e inua hebouva;
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

motu: bena lai gubana na tano ḡaḡaena amo e huhu kau, ruma daigunina haniosi e hohodia rohoroho; bena ruma na hari eregabe latadiai e kohu, iboudiai na e mase. Lau mo sibogu na roho mauri, bena oi ihadibamu nama.
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

motu: Bena Iobu na e tore isi, ena dabua e darea bona kwarana e naua; bena tano ai e goru diho, Dirava e toma henia diho.
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

motu: Bena eto, Gagaegu mo sinagu bogana amo nama, bona ḡaḡaegu mo baina lou. Iehova ese e heni, Iehova ese ma e abi oho; Iehova ladana bae imodaia.
english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be Yahweh’s name.”

motu: Ina idoinai lalonai, Iobu na se kerere bona Dirava se gwau dika henia.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

motu: Ma dina ta ai, Dirava natuna verina na Iehova vairanai ma e hedinarai lou, bona Satana ma ema, idia bogaragidiai, Iehova vairanai baine hedinarai totona.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Satana e nanadaia, eto, Oi na ede amo oma? Satana ese Iehova e haere henia, eto, Tanobada ai na loa eva-evamu, na raka laomu na raka maimu.

motu: Haroro Tauna na eto: Asi anidia ḡaudia, asi anidia ḡaudia; ḡau iboudiai be asi anidia.
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

motu: Tau ta ena hekwarahi idoinai dina henunai e karaiamu anina be dahaka?
english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

motu: Uru ta e lao bubunimu, ma uru ta e vara isimu; a tanobada na e mia hanaihanaimu.
english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

motu: Dina e daemu, ma e dihomu; bena ena dae gabuna ma e ḡava heniamu.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

motu: Lai ese diho kahana e toa heniamu, bena e toa heḡeḡemu, mirigini kahana e toa heniamu; e toa heḡeḡe-heḡeḡemu, ena dala gunadia ai ma e toa loumu.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

motu: Sinavai iboudiai na davara ai e aru lasimu, a davara na se honumu; sinavai ese e aru henidia gunava gabudia ma e aru henidia loumu.
english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai na hekwarahi ai e honumu; tau ta basine herevalaia diba. Mata be basine itaia ore; taia be basine kamonai ḡuḡuru.
english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

motu: E vara guna ḡauna ma baine vara lou; e karaia guna karana ma bae karaia lou; ḡau matamatana ta se miamu, dina henunai.
english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

motu: Ḡau be edena, bae herevalaia, baeto “A itaia, ina na matamata”? Lasi, nega gunadia ai e miava, ita do asita vara negadia ai.
english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, + 1:10 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

motu: E vara guna ḡaudia na ta ese se lalodia taomu, bona do bae vara ḡaudia na ta ese basine lalodia tao, gabeai bae vara urudia lalodiai.
english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

motu: Lau, Haroro Tauna, ese Israel taudia na biagudia Ierusalem ai.
english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

motu: Bena guba henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai na tahudia, mai lalogu idoinai bona mai aonegagu ida. Dirava ese taunimanima natudia unu vada e hahekwarahidia tomamu.
english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God + 1:13 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

motu: Dina henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai vada na itadia; iboudiai na asi anidia, lai ianina na heto.
english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

motu: Ḡau gageva-gagevana na basie hamaoromaoroa diba, bona lasihidia ḡaudia na basie duahidia diba.
english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

motu: Lalogu ai nato: Aonega badana vada na abia; egu aonega ese Ierusalem e biagua gunava taudia iboudiai edia aonega na e hereadiamu; oibe, lalogu ese aonega bona lalo-parara vada e dibadia bada.
english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

motu: Bena lalogu na hadaia, aonega baina dibaia, bona kavakava bona lebulebu baina dibadia. Bena lalogu vada e parara, ina danu lai ianina mo.
english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

motu: Badina be aonega bada lalonai lalo-hekwarahi danu bada; bona lalo-parara e habadaiamu tauna ese lalo-hisihisi danu e habadaiamu.
english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

motu: Lalogu ai nato: Be, moale baina dibaia; ba hahemoale. To una danu na asi anina.
english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

motu: Kiri na herevalaia, nato “Ia na kavakava”; bona moale na herevalaia, nato “Ena namo be dahaka?”
english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

motu: Tau-anigu ihanamona dalana vine ranuna i'inuna amo na lalogu ai na tahua; ḡau tamona, lalogu ese dounu aonega e badinaiava. Kavakava idogo-taona dalana danu na tahua, baina itaia nato, taunimanima natuna na edia mauri dinadia oreoredia guba henunai ede bae namo toma.
english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

motu: Ḡaukara badadia na kara: ruma na hadai, bona vine imeadia na hado egu.
english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

motu: Uma bona imea na kara, bona huahua audia idau-idau na idia lalodiai na hado.
english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

motu: Ranu gabudia na ḡei, egu imea audia ihapariparidia.
english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

motu: Hesiai taudia bona hahinedia na hoidia, bona hesiai memerodia bona kekenidia na egu ruma ai e vara. Egu nani bona egu mamoe seridia na momo herea, Ierusalem ai e gunalaigu taudia iboudiai edia e hereadia.
english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

motu: Silver * bona gold * na haboudia egu; bona pavapava idau-idau edia kohu bona tano idau-idau kohudia danu. Ane-abi taudia bona hahinedia danu na abidia; bona hahine momo na adavadia, taunimanima edia moale dalana bunai.
english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

motu: Unu amo na herea dae; Ierusalem ai e gunalaigu taudia iboudiai na na hereadiava, bona egu aonega na egu ai e miava danu.
english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

motu: Matagu edia ura ta ediai asina rua, bona lalogu ena moale dalana ta enai asina laoa ahu; badina be lalogu ese egu hekwarahi idoinai e moalelaiava, egu hekwarahi idoinai ahuna bunai.
english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

motu: Bena imagu ḡaukaradia iboudiai bona ikaradia hekwarahidia idoidiai na haerodia; bena lalogu e parara, idoinai na asi anina, lai ianina mo. Ihanamogu ḡauna ta lasi dina henunai.
english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

motu: Bena aonega bona kavakava bona lebulebu ma na haerodia; badina be hanua pavapavana murina amo e maimu tauna na ede baine kara toma? E kara gunava karadia mo, ani.
english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

motu: Bena lalogu e parara, aonega ese kavakava e hereaiamu, diari ese dibura e hereaiamu na heto.
english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

motu: Aonega tauna matana na kwarana ai, a kavakava tauna na dibura ai e rakamu; ḡau tamona na diba, iboudiai dokodia be tamona mo.
english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

motu: Bena lalogu ai nato: Kavakava tauna enai e kaumu ḡauna na lauegu ai danu baine kau; matona, na aonega hereamu anina be dahaka? Ma lalogu ai nato: Ina danu asi anina.
english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

motu: Aonega tauna bona kavakava tauna na raruosi basie lalodia tao daudau; badina be dina gabedia ai iboudiai na bae lalodia boio vaitani. Aonega tauna na e masemu, kavakava tauna heḡereḡerena.
english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

motu: Taunabunai, mauri na inai heniava; badina be dina henunai e karava karadia na lalogu ese e hisihisilaiva. Badina be iboudiai na asi anidia, Iai ianina mo.
english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

motu: Dina henunai na hekwarahilaiva ḡaudia iboudiai na na inai henidiava; badina be murigu ai bainema tauna enai baina rakatanidia.
english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

motu: Bona daika dibana ia na baine aonega eiava baine kavakava? A mai aonegagu ida dina henunai na hekwarahilaiva ḡaudia iboudiai na ia ese baine biagudia. Ina danu asi anina.
english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

motu: Taunabunai, lalogu na na haloua bona daragu e doko, egu hekwarahi idoinai ai dina henunai na ḡaukaralaiva ḡaudia daidiai;
english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

motu: badina be nega haida tau ta ese mai aonegana bona mai lalo-pararana bona mai idibakana ida e karava ḡaudia iboudiai na baine rakatanidia, bena se hekwarahilaiva tauna ese baine moalelai. Ina danu asi anina, bona dika herea.
english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

motu: Tau ta ena ḡaukara iboudiai bona ena hekwarahi idoinai dina henunai davadia be dahaka baine abi?
english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

motu: Badina be ena dina iboudiai na hisihisi ai e honumu, bona ena ḡaukara na lalo-hekwarahi ḡauna; hanuaboi ai danu ia lalona se laḡa animu. Ina danu asi anina.
english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

motu: Tau ta ena dala namo-hereana binai: baine aniani, baine inuinu, bona ena hekwarahi baine moalelaia. Bena lalogu e parara, ina danu be Dirava imana amo;
english: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

motu: badina be bema ia dauhai, daika bema aniani eiava bema moale?
english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

motu: Badina be Dirava ese e lalo namo heniamu tauna na aonega bona lalo-parara bona moale e heniamu; a kara dika tauna na ina hekwarahi e heniamu, ia ese kohu baine habou bona baine hasenu, Dirava ese e lalo namo heniamu tauna ihenina totona. Ina danu asi anina, lai ianina mo.
english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai na mai edia nega korikori, bona ḡaukara iboudiai guba henunai e karamu be mai negadia:
english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

motu: vara mai negana, mase mai negana; hadohado mai negana, ḡeiḡei mai negana;
