motu: Ḡaukara tauna ena hekwarahi anina be dahaka baine abia?
english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

motu: Dirava ese taunimanima natudia vada e henidia bae hekwarahilai ḡaukaradia vada na itadia.
english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

motu: Ia ese ḡau iboudiai vada e hahairaidia, ta ta ena nega ena nega ai; a taunimanima lalodia vada e haduhudia, idia ese Dirava ena ḡaukara, matamana ela bona dokona, basie davaria diba.
english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

motu: Lau dibagu taunimanima edia dala namona tamona binai: bae moale, edia mauri dinadia iboudiai lalodiai bae hahemoale.
english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

motu: Ina danu, iboudiai bae aniani bona bae inuinu, bona edia hekwarahi idoinai bae moalelaia; una na Dirava ena harihari ḡauna taunimanima ediai.
english: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

motu: Lau dibagu Dirava ena kara Iboudiai na bae mia hanaihanai; ḡau ta ma basie atoa kau eiava basie abia oho; Dirava ese unu vada e karaia toma, taunimanima na ia vairanai bae gari helaoreana.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

motu: Harihari e miamu ḡaudia na gunaguna e miava, bona do bae vara ḡaudia danu gunaguna e miava; bona Dirava ese vada e heabi oho ḡaudia na e tahudiamu.
english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

motu: Dina henunai ma na itaia, hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva gabuna ai kara dika e miava, bona kara maoromaoro gabuna ai kara gageva-gagevadia danu e miava.
english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

motu: Lalogu ai nato: Dirava ese kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia baine hahemaoro henidia; badina be ia ese bae vara ḡaudia iboudiai bona ḡaukara iboudiai edia nega vada e gwaurai.
english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

motu: Lalogu ai ma nato: Dirava ese taunimanima natudia e tohodiamu, baine hahedinarai henidia idia na boroma mo.
english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

motu: Badina be taunimanima natudia ediai e varamu bona boroma ediai e varamu dalana be tamona; ta e masemu heḡereḡerena, ma ta danu e masemu. Iboudiai laḡadia na heḡereḡere, taunimanima ese boroma asie hereadiamu; badina be iboudiai na asi anidia.
english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

motu: Iboudiai na gabu tamona e laomu; iboudiai na ḡahu amo, bona iboudiai na ḡahu ai ma baela.
english: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

motu: Daika dibana taunimanima laumana na e daemu bona boroma laumana na tano ai e dihomu eiava?
english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

motu: Taunabunai vada na diba, taunimanima ena dala namo-hereana binai, ena ḡaukara baine moalelaia, badina be ia ahuna bunai. Ia murinai bae vara ḡaudia na daika ese baine haheitalaia.
english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

motu: Ma na roha lao, hahehisi karadia iboudiai dina henunai e karamu na itadia. Hahehisi ese e hahisidiamu taudia iruru-matadia na itadia, bona tau ta ese taudia se halodia. Siahu na hahehisi taudia ediai; bona taudia ihalodia tauna ta lasi.
english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

motu: Bena na laloa, vada e mase guna taudia na nanamo; idia ese doini e maurimu taudia na e hereadiamu.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

motu: A herea-daena be do se vara bena kara dikadia dina henunai e karamu na do se ita tauna hari.
english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

motu: Bena na itaia, hekwarahi idoinai bona ima-idibaka ḡaukaradia iboudiai na tau ta ese dekena tauna e vaḡeḡelai heniamu amo e varamu. Ina danu asi anina, lai ianina mo.
english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

motu: Kavakava tauna ese imana e lokumu, bona sibona tau-anina e aniamu.
english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

motu: Ima tamona na laḡa-ani amo baine honu be namo; ima ruaosi na hekwarahi bona lai ianina amo bae honu na dika.
english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

motu: Bena kara asi anina dina henunai ma na itaia. Kara na binai:
english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

motu: tau ta na asi bamona ta, asi natuna, asi tadikakana; ḡau tamona ena hekwarahi na se dokomu, bona ena roharoha ai ena taḡa na nega ta se heḡereḡeremu; bena nega ta se henanadaimu, seto “Daika bagunai na hekwarahimu bona moale ai na dabumu?” Ina danu asi anina, kara asi moalena.
english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

motu: Rarua ese tamona e hereaiamu; badina be edia hekwarahi davana namona e abiamu.
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

motu: Badina be ta bema keto, bamona ese bema abia isi; a ta bema raka edea bena bema keto negana ai asi iabi-isina tauna, ia madi ihabaina.
english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

motu: Ina danu, rarua bema hekure hebou, tau-anidia bema siahu; a ta bema hekure edea, tauna ede bema siahu toma?
english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

motu: Tau ta ese tau tamona baine hadarerea diba reana, a tatau rarua ese bae laoa ahu diba. Varo ere toi na basie motu haraḡa.
english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

motu: Eregabe tauna mai aonegana, ena be ia na e vara ogoḡami tauna mo basileia lalonai bena dibura rumana lalona amo e raka lasi pavapava ai ela, to ia ese pavapava burukana mai ena kavakava, aonega taudia edia hahealo iabi-daena vada e rakatania tauna, na e hereaiamu.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.
For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

motu: Mauri taudia iboudiai dina henunai e raka eva-evamu na itadia, bona una pavapava burukana baine boloa eregabena danu.
english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

motu: Unu taunimanima iboudiai na asi iduahidia; ia ese iboudiai e biagudiava. Ḡau tamona, gabeai baema taudia ese basie moalelaia. Momokani, ina danu asi anina, bona lai ianina.
english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

motu: Dirava ena dubu ai ba raka vareai negadia ai na aemu ba nari; ikamonaina totona ba raka kahira be namo, kavakava taudia edia boubou ḡaudia ihahelaḡadia na e hereaiamu, badina be idia na asi dibadia e kara dikamu.
english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

motu: Udumu basine hereva haraga-haraga, bona lalomu na hereva ta igwauraina ai basine haraḡa Dirava vairanai; badina be Dirava na guba ai a oi na tanobada ai, una dainai emu hereva na bae gadoi.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

motu: Badina be nihi na hekwarahi momo amo e varamu, bona hereva momo na kavakava tauna gadona amo.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

motu: Dirava ba gwau hamata henia negana ai, anina ikarana ai basio halahe; badina be ia ese kavakava taudia se moalelaidiamu. Emu gwauhamata anina ba karaia.
english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

motu: Basioma gwau hamata be namo, a ba gwau hamata bena anina basio karaia na dika.
english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

motu: Udumu ba naria, kara dika ai basine hakaumu vareai; bona gwaukau tauna vairanai basioto “Na kerere”. Namona be dahaka Dirava ese eremu baine badulaia, bona imamu ḡaukaradia baine habuadia tari?
english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

motu: Badina be nihi bae momo negadia ai, hereva asi anidia bae vara momo; a oi ese Dirava garina ba gari.
english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

motu: Basileia ta ai ogoḡami taudia e hahisidiamu bona hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva bona ahu korikori e dadihaidiamu boma itaia negana ai basioma hoalaia; badina be herea tauna na herea-dae tauna henunai, bona idia raruosi daediai na herea mikamika taudia haida.
english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

motu: A e birulaiamu tanona na pavapava ese baine biagua, una na namo.
english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

motu: Moni e ura heniamu tauna ese moni baine abi, to lalona basine heḡereḡere; bona taḡa e ura heniamu tauna ese ena taḡa baine habadaia, to lalona basine heḡereḡere. Ina danu asi anina.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

motu: Kohu bae momo, to iha oredia taudia danu bae hoho; bena kohu biaguna ese anidia basine abi, a matana amo baine itadia mo, ani?
english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

motu: Ḡaukara tauna na bogana baine kunu eiava baine hitolo, to ena mahuta baine namo; a taḡa tauna na baine ani paru dainai basine mahuta diba.
english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

motu: Dika badana ta guba henunai vada na itaia: taḡa tauna na ena taḡa igogosina ai e dika;
english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

motu: hekwakwanai negana ai una taḡa e boio, bena ia na mai natuna, to imana e tuna.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

motu: Sinana bogana amo ema heḡereḡerena ai ma bainela, ḡaḡaena ai, ema heḡereḡerena; ena hekwarahi danu asi anina, ḡau ta na imana ai basine laohaia.
english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

motu: Ina danu dika badana ta: ema heḡereḡerena ai ma bainela; ia na lai iabina e hekwarahilaia,
english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

motu: bona ena dina iboudiai na dibura bona lalo-hisihisi bona lalo-hekwarahi bona gorere bona tudaga lalodiai e ha-oredia, anina be dahaka?
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

motu: Vada na itaia, ina na namo bona heḡereḡere: taunimanima na btine aniani, bona baine inuinu, bona ena hekwarahi idoinai Dirava ese ena mauri dinadia oreoredia dina henunai vada e henia lalodiai baine moalelaia; badina be ia ahuna korikori bunai.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

motu: Dirava ese taḡa bona kohu vada e henidia taudia iboudiai na siahu danu vada e henidia, bae moalelaidia, bona ahudia bae abi dae, bona edia hekwarahi ai bae moale; una na Dirava ena harihari ḡauna.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

motu: Badina be idia ese edia mauri dinadia basie lalodia bada; badina be Dirava ese e hamoalediamu, bona una mo bae laloa bada.
english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

motu: Dika ta vada na itaia dina henunai, taunimanima e hametaudiamu ḡauna:
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:

motu: tau ta be Dirava ese taḡa bona kohu bona dagi e heniamu, bena ena ura ḡauna ta ai se dabumu; ḡau tamona, Dirava ese imoalelaina siahuna se heniamu, a idau tauna ta ese e moalelaidiamu. Ina na asi anina, hahehisi badana.
english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

motu: Tau ta natuna bema sinahu-ta, bona ena mauri bema daudau, ela bona ena mauri laḡanidia bema momo herea, a ena mauri ihanamona ḡaudia basinema moalelaidia bona ena mase negana ai basiema ḡuria; lau na tomamu masena ai e vara merona ese ia e hereaiamu.
english: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;

motu: Badina be ena mai na asi anina, ena lao be dibura e lao heniamu, bona ia ladana na dibura ai e bubunimu;
english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

motu: oibe, dina na se itaia, bona ḡau ta asi dibana, ḡau tamona ia na laḡa-ani e davariamu; a una tau be lasi.
english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.

motu: Ena be ena mauri laḡanidia bema daha rua, to ḡau namona ta basinema moalelaia: be, iboudiai na gabu tamona se laomu a?
english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

motu: Taunimanima edia hekwarahi idoinai na ududia daidiai; ḡau tamona, bogadia na asie kunumu.
english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

motu: Aonega tauna ese kavakava tauna ede e hereaia tomamu? Ogoḡami tauna na mauri taudia vairadiai ede baine kara toma bema mai dibana, to ahuna be dahaka namona?
english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

motu: Matada e itamu ḡaudia ese ta lalo haguhilaimu ḡaudia na e hereadiamu; ina danu asi anina, lai ianina mo.
english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

motu: Vada e vara ḡaudia iboudiai na ladadia vada e hato guna, bona dibada taunimanima be dahaka, bona dibada ia ese goada-herea tauna basine hepapahuahu henia diba.
english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

motu: Hereva bae momo, kavakava danu baine bada; idia ese taunimanima ede bae hanamodia toma?
english: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?

motu: Badina be daika dibana taunimanima ena namo be dahaka, ena mauri asi anina dinadia oreoredia lalodiai? E raka hanaimu laulau ta na heto, ani? Badina be daika ese baine hamaoroa, ia murinai dahaka baine hedinarai dina henunai?
english: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?

motu: Lada namona ese dehoro namo-hereana e hereaiamu, bona mase dinana ese vara dinana e hereaiamu.
english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

motu: Taitai rumana ilao-henina be namo, aria rumana ilao-henina na dika; badina be taunimanima iboudiai ini e doko tomamu, bona mauri taudia ese bae helalolaia.
english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

motu: Lalo-hisihisi ese kiri e hereaiamu; badina be vaira ḡegeva ese lalona e hamoaleamu.
english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

motu: Aonega taudia lalodia na taitai rumana ai, a kavakava taudia lalodia na kiri rumana ai.
english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

motu: Aonega tauna ena gwau-gwau e hakala heniamu tauna be namo, kavakava taudia edia ane e kamonaimu tauna na dika.
english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

motu: Kavakava taudia edia kiri na au ginigini uro henunai e aramu reḡedia na heheto; ina danu asi anina.
english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

motu: Momokani, hahehisi ese aonega tauna e hakavaiamu. bona koikoi henitaona ese lalona e hamiroamu.
english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

motu: Kara dokona ese kara matamana e hereaiamu, bona lalo-manau ese lalo-heaḡi e hereaiamu.
english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The|strong="H1697" * patient in|strong="H1697" * spirit|strong="H7307" * is|strong="H1697" * better|strong="H2896" * than|strong="H2896" * the|strong="H1697" * proud|strong="H1362" * in|strong="H1697" * spirit|strong="H7307" *.

motu: Basio badu haraḡa, badina be badu ese kavakava taudia lalodia e noho henidiamu.
english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

motu: Basioto “Dahaka dainai nega gunadia ese ina nega e hereaia?” Badina be dia aonega amo so henanadaimu.
english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

motu: Kohu iabina mai aonegana ida be namo, dina e itaiamu taudia ihanamodia;
english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

motu: badina be aonega ena hegima na moni ena hegima na heto, bona lalo-parara ena hahenamo be aonega ese lalo-parara tauna e naria balahenimu.
english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

motu: Dirava ena ḡaukara ba haeroa: ia ese vada e hagagevaia ḡauna na daika ese baine hamaoromaoroa.
english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

motu: Emu namo e badamu dinana ai ba moale, bona emu dika e badamu dinana ai ba laloa, Dirava ese unu ruaosi vada e karadia, taunimanima na basie diba dahaka dahaka ia murinai bae vara helaoreana.
english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

motu: Egu mauri asi anina lalonai, ḡau iboudiai vada na itadia: kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kara maoromaoro ai e masemu, bona kara dika tauna na ena kara dika ai ena mauri e hadaudauamu.
english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

motu: Metaira ba kara maoromaoro, metaira ba aonega; sibomu ba heala anina be dahaka?
english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

motu: Metaira ba kara dika, bona basio kavakava; emu nega do basine ore ai vada ba mase anina be dahaka?
english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

motu: Ina na ba kahua tao bona una na basio kahua nege be namo; badina be Dirava garina e garimu tauna na idia iboudiai bogaragidia amo baine raka lasi.
english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

motu: Aonega ese aonega tauna e hagoadaiamu; bena ia ese hanua lohiadia gwauta e hereadiamu.
english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

motu: Momokani, asi kara-maoromaoro tauna ta tanobada ai e kara namomu mo, bona nega ta se kara dikamu.
english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

motu: Taunimanima edia hereva iboudiai basio hakala henidia, emu hesiai tauna baine uduguiraimu bena ena hereva ba kamonai na garina.
english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

motu: Lalomu ai vada o diba, nega momo oi ese haida na vada o uduguiraidia.
english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

motu: Ina idoinai aonega amo vada na tohoa. Lau nato “Baina aonega”; to aonega egu amo na idauhai.
english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

motu: E miamu ḡauna na idauhai; ia na dobu, dobu masemase. Daika ese baine davaria diba?
english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

motu: Lalogu na haloua, baina diba, bona aonega bona ḡau badidia baina tahudia; bona kara dika ena kavakava bona kavakava ena kava kukuha baina dibadia.
english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

motu: Bena ḡau idita-hereana ta na davaria, mase iditana e hereaiamu ḡauna; una ḡau be lalona na idoa bona huo bona imana na gadea hahinena. Dirava e hamoaleamu tauna na iena amo e roho maurimu; a kara dika tauna na ia ese e abiamu.
english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

motu: Haroro Tauna e tomamu: A itaia, ina na vada na davaria. Lalo-hadai idau-idau vada na haboudia, ede bae hatamona toma;
english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

motu: Ialogu ai vada na tahua loulou, to asina davaria. Daha ta lalodia amo tau tamona na davaria, a ini iboudiai lalodia amo hahine ta asina davaria.
english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

motu: A itaia, ina mo vada na davaria: Dirava ese taunimanima e karadia mai edia maoromaoro, a idia ese dala idau-idau vada e tahudia.
english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”

motu: Daika na aonega tauna heḡereḡerena; Daika na ḡau anidia mai dibana? Tau na aonega ese vairana e hahururu-hururuamu, bona ena vaira auka e abia ohomu.
english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani ba badinaia, bona emu gwauhamata helaḡana dainai kudoumu basine hetaha.
english: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.

motu: Ia vairana amo ba raka oho; ena be ḡaukara mamina na dika to basio halahe, badina be ia ese ena ura iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ai e karamu.
english: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,

motu: Badina be hanua pavapavana ena hereva na herea; daika ese baine nanadaia, baineto “Dahaka o karamu?”
english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

motu: Haheḡani e badinaiamu tauna na basine dika; bona aonega tauna lalona baine parara, nega bona dala be ededia.
english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

motu: Badina be, ena be taunimanima edia hekwarahi na metau, to ḡaukara iboudiai na mai negadia bona mai daladia.
english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

motu: Badina be ia na asi dibana dahaka baine vara, bena daika ese baine hamaoroa diba ede baine vara toma?
english: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

motu: Asi tauna ta mai siahuna ia laumana baine dogoa tao eiava mai siahuna ena mase dinana enai. Tuari ai tau ta basine raka siri diba; bona dika ese kara dika tauna basine hamauria.
english: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

motu: Ina idoinai na itaia, kara iboudiai dina henunai e karamu na haerodia negana ai. Na itaia danu, taunimanima haida ese bamodia e biagudiamu bona e hahisidiamu.
english: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.

motu: Na itaia danu, kara dika taudia na e guridia; gunaguna-idia na gabu helaḡana ai e raka vareai e raka lasi, bona hanua lalonai e imodaidia edh kara daidiai. Ina danu asi anina.
english: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.

motu: Kara dika davadia na asie heni haraḡamu dainai, taunimanima natudia lalodia ese kara dika e ura heni badamu.
english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

motu: Ena be kara dika tauna na nega sinahu-ta e kara dikamu bona ena mauri e hadaudauamu, to lau dibagu Dirava garina e garimu taudia na bae namo, badina be ia vairanai e garimu.
english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

motu: A kara dika tauna basine namo; ena mauri basine hadaudaua laulau na heto; badina be ia na Dirava vairanai se garimu.
english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

motu: Kara ta tanobada ai na asi anina: kara namo taudia haida na kara dika taudia ahudia heḡereḡeredia ai e abimu, bona kara dika taudia haida na kara namo taudia ahudia heḡereḡeredia ai e abimu. Lau nato una danu asi anina.
english: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.

motu: Moale na hanamoamu, badina be taunimanima na asi ena ḡau namona ta dina henunai; a baine aniani, baine inuinu bona baine moale; badina be unu ese ena hekwarahi ai bae bamoa, ena mauri dinadia Dirava ese dina henunai baine henia lalodiai.
english: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

motu: Lalogu na hadaia, aonega baina diba, bona tanobada ai e karaiamu ḡaukarana baina itaia; e kara boimu e kara ranimu, matadia asie mahutamu.
english: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),

motu: Bena Dirava ena kara idoinai na itaia, dina henunai e karamu ḡaukaradia anidia na taunimanima ese basine davaridia diba. Ena be itahudia ai baine hekwarahi bada, to basine davaridia; ena be aonega tauna baineto mai dibana, to basine davaridia diba.
english: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.

motu: Ina idoinai na laloa bona na haeroa: kara maoromaoro taudia bona aonega taudia bona edia kara danu na Dirava imana ai; taunimanima na asi dibadia ia ese e ura henidiamu eiava e inai henidiamu. Ḡau iboudiai idia vairadiai na asi anidia;
english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

motu: badina be kara tamona na iboudiai ediai e kaumu, kara maoromaoro tauna enai bona kara dika tauna enai, tau namona enai bona tau dikana enai, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva tauna enai bona lalo-bodaga tauna enai, boubou ḡauna e hahelaḡaiamu tauna enai bona boubou ḡauna se hahelaḡaiamu tauna enai. Kara namo tauna bona kara dika tauna na heḡereḡere; e gwau hamatamu tauna bona gwauhamata se uramu tauna na heḡereḡere.
english: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

motu: Dina henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai edia dika ta binai: kara tamona na iboudiai ediai e kaumu. Ina danu, taunimanima lalodia na dika ai e honu honu daemu, edia mauri dinadia ai lalodia na kakavakava, una murinai mase gabuna e laomu.
english: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

motu: To mauri taudia iboudiai ida e heturamu tauna na mai ena helaro; badina be e maurimu sisiana ese vada e mase leonana na e hereaiamu.
english: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

motu: Badina be mauri taudia na dibadia do bae mase; a mase taudia na ḡau ta asi dibadia, bona asi ahudia, a ilalo-taodia na e boiomu.
english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

motu: Edia heura-heni bona edia heinai-heni bona edia vaḡeḡe vada e ore vaitani; bona dina henunai e karamu karadia iboudiai lalodiai idia na asi ahudia, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

motu: Aola, amu bavania mai moalemu ida, bona emu vine ranuna ba inua mai lalo-namomu ida; badina be Dirava ese emu kara vada e hanamoa guna.
english: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

motu: Nega iboudiai dabua kurokurodia ba hahedokilai; dehoro na kwaramu ai baine mia hanaihanai.
english: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

motu: Adavamu, o ura heniamu hahinena, ida ba moale hebou, emu mauri asi anina dinadia Dirava ese dina henunai vada e henimu iboudiai lalodiai, badina be oi ahumu bunai emu mauri ai, bona dina henunai o hekwarahilaimu ḡaukaradia lalodiai.
english: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

motu: Oi imamu ese baine davaria ḡaukarana na ba karaia mai goada-badamu ida; badirla be o lao heniamu gabuna, mase taudia edia gabu, lalonai na asi ḡaukara ta, asi lalo-hadai ta, asi lalo-parara ta, bona asi aonega ta.
english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, + 9:10 Sheol is the place of the dead. * where you are going.

motu: Dina henunai ma na itaia lou: heau helulu ai heau haraḡa taudia asie gunamu, bona tuari ai goada taudia asie kwalimumu, bona aonega taudia ese aniani asie aniamu, bona lalo-parara taudia ese taḡa asie abiamu, bona idibaka taudia na asie lalo-namo henidiamu; a nega bona kara na e vara kavamu mo, iboudiai ediai.
english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

motu: Badina be taunimanima ese ena nega se dibaiamu. Gwarume na hekoi rekena ai e hetoamu eiava manu na idoa ai e heidoamu na heto, taunimanima natudia na unu e heidoa tomamu, nega dika ese e hahoadiamu negana ai.
english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

motu: Ina aonega toana na dina henunai vada na itaia danu; bona na laloa, ia na ḡau badana.
english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

motu: Hanua maragina ta ena taunimanima na dia hoho; bena hanua pavapavana badana ta ese e tuari henia, e koua heḡeḡe, bona tano e larebaia heḡeḡe ia iabina totona.
english: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

motu: A una hanua lalonai na ogoḡami tauna ta mai aonegana; bona ia ese ena aonega amo una hanua e hamauria. A asi tauna ta ese una ogoḡami tauna e laloa tao.
english: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

motu: A lau na tomamu, ena be ogoḡami tauna ena aonega e dadaraiamu bona ena hereva asie kamonaimu, to aonega ese goada e hereaiamu.
english: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

motu: Aonega tauna ena hereva asi regerege gabuna ai e gwauraimu ese lohia ena haroro kavakava taudia bogaragidiai na e hereaiamu.
english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

motu: Aonega ese tuari ḡaudia na e hereadiamu, a kara dika tauna tamona ese ḡau namodia diagau e hadikadiamu.
english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

motu: Muramura mai bonadia ikaradia tauna ena dehoro lalonai lao e masemu, bena una dehoro bonana na e dikamu; unuhetomana kavakava sisina ese aonega bona matau e hadikadiamu.

english: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese bema badu henimu, emu gabu basioma rakatania; badina be hemataurai ese kerere badadia e tahunidiamu.
english: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.

motu: Dika ta vada na itaia dina henunai, hanua pavapavana ena kerere ta na heto reana.
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.

motu: Kererena binai: kavakava na atai gabudia ai e abia daemu, a taḡa taudia na henu ai e helaimu.
english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.

motu: Hesiai taudia vada na itadia, hosi ai e guimu; bona hanua lohiadia vada na itadia, aedia amo e rakamu, hesiai taudia na heheto.
english: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.

motu: Guri e ḡeiamu tauna na una guri lalonai baine moru; bona haba e dareamu tauna na gaigai ese baine koria.
english: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

motu: Nadi e taradiamu tauna na nadi ese bae haberoa; bona au e poladiamu tauna na au ese bema hadikaia reana.
english: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

motu: Auri asi ganona basie segea negana ai, ḡaukara tauna ena hekwarahi baine bada, a aonega ese ḡaukara e haheauamu.
english: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.

motu: Mea tauna ese gaigai do se hamanadaia negana ai ia na bema hekori, mea tauna iboirina na asi anina.
english: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.

motu: Aonega tauna uduna herevadia ese taunimanima edia hahenamo e abiamu, a kavakava tauna bibinana ese e ha-oreamu.
english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

motu: Ia uduna herevadia matamadia na kavakava, bona ena hereva dokona na kava bona dika rohoroho.
english: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

motu: Kavakava tauna ena hereva na momo, a tau ta asi dibana dahaka baine vara, bona daika ese baine hamaoroa ia murinai dahaka baine vara.

The|strong="H5921" * light is|strong="H1931" * darkened|strong="H2821" * in|strong="H5921" * its|strong="H5921" * clouds|strong="H6183" *.

motu: King Usia e mase laḡanina lalonai, lau ese Ḡaubada na itaia, terono ai e helaiva, atai ai e heabi isiva; ena dabua latana isena ese dubu e hahonuava.
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

motu: Ia daenai serapi na gigini; idia ta ta hanidia na tauratoi tauratoi amo: rua amo ia vairana e ḡovaia, ma rua amo aena e ḡovadia, ma rua amo rohova.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

motu: Bena e heboi heheni, eto: Iehova Sabaota na helaḡa, helaḡa, helaḡa; ia hairaina ese tanobada idoinai e hahonuamu.
english: One called to another, and said, “ Holy|strong="H6918" *, holy|strong="H6918" *, holy|strong="H6918" *, is|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * of|strong="H3068" * Armies|strong="H6635" *! The|strong="H3605" * whole|strong="H3605" * earth is|strong="H3068" * full|strong="H4393" * of|strong="H3068" * his|strong="H3605" * glory|strong="H3519" *!”

motu: Bena boiboi tauna gadona ese raka-vareai iduaradia badidia e hamareredia, bo na kwalahu ese dubu e hahonua.
english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

motu: Bena lau nato, Madi, ihabaigu! Badina be lau vada name baia; badina be lau na bibina miroka taugu, bona bibina miroka taudia bogaragidiai na nohomu; badina be matagu ese Pavapava, Iehova Sabaota vada e itaia.
english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

motu: Bena serapi ta na dekegu e roho mai, imana ai na gida ta, ihaboulaina patana amo auri ikahina ai e abia ḡauna.
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

motu: Bena udugu e daua toho, eto, A itaia, ina ḡau ese udumu vada e daua toho; emu kerere vada eme heabi oho, bona emu dika vada eme hegwau tao.
english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

motu: Bena Ḡaubada gadona na kamonai; eto, Daika baina siaia? Daika na ai daimai ai bainela? Bena lau nato, Lau o ina, a siaigu.
english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then|strong="H7971" * I|strong="H2005" * said|strong="H8085" *, “ Here|strong="H2005" * I|strong="H2005" * am|strong="H2005" *. Send|strong="H7971" * me|strong="H7971" *!”

motu: Bena ia eto, Aola, ina bese ba hamaoroa, baoto: Ba kamonai loulou, to lalomui basie parara; ba ita loulou, to basio diba.
english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘ You|strong="H3045" * hear|strong="H8085" * indeed|strong="H8085" *, but|strong="H7200" * don’t understand|strong="H3045" *. You|strong="H3045" * see|strong="H7200" * indeed|strong="H8085" *, but|strong="H7200" * don’t perceive|strong="H3045" *.’

motu: Ini taunimanima na lalodia ba haduhudia, bona taiadia ba hakudimadia, bona matadia ba hakapudia; matadia amo bema ita, bona taiadia amo bema kamonai, bona lalodia bema parara, bena bema kerehai bona bema namo lou na garina.
english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make|strong="H8085" * their|strong="H8085" * ears heavy|strong="H3513" *, and|strong="H7725" * shut|strong="H8173" * their|strong="H8085" * eyes|strong="H5869" *; lest|strong="H6435" * they|strong="H5971" * see|strong="H7200" * with|strong="H5971" * their|strong="H8085" * eyes|strong="H5869" *, hear|strong="H8085" * with|strong="H5971" * their|strong="H8085" * ears, understand|strong="H8085" * with|strong="H5971" * their|strong="H8085" * heart|strong="H3820" *, and|strong="H7725" * turn|strong="H7725" * again|strong="H7725" *, and|strong="H7725" * be|strong="H3820" * healed|strong="H7495" *.”

motu: Bena lau nato, Ḡaubada e, ela bona edena nega ai? Bena ia eto: Ela bona hanua badadia bae vahu, asi inoholaidia tauna ta baine mia, bona ruma na asi taunimanimadia ai baela, bona tano idoinai baine vahu vaitani;
english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He|strong="H5704" * answered, “ Until|strong="H5704" * cities|strong="H5892" * are|strong="H5892" * waste|strong="H8077" * without|strong="H1004" * inhabitant|strong="H3427" *, houses|strong="H1004" * without|strong="H1004" * man, the|strong="H5704" * land becomes utterly|strong="H5704" * waste|strong="H8077" *,

motu: bona Iehova ese taunimanima na dauha baine laohaidia, bona bae rakatanidia gabudia bae momo tano bogaraginai.
english: and Yahweh has removed men far away, and|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3068" * forsaken|strong="H5805" * places|strong="H5805" * are|strong="H3068" * many|strong="H7227" * within|strong="H7130" * the|strong="H3068" * land|strong="H7130" *.

motu: Ena be karoa gvauta amo karoa ta baine mia, to ma baine ara lou, terebinth * auna eiava oak * auna e hagariamu bena badina mo e miamu na heto. Ia badina na uhe helaḡana.
english: If there is a tenth left in it, that|strong="H1961" * also|strong="H5750" * will|strong="H1961" * in|strong="H7725" * turn|strong="H7725" * be|strong="H1961" * consumed|strong="H1197" *, as|strong="H1961" * a|strong="H3068" * terebinth, and|strong="H7725" * as|strong="H1961" * an|strong="H1961" * oak whose stump remains|strong="H5750" * when|strong="H1961" * they are|strong="H1961" * cut down, so|strong="H1961" * the|strong="H7725" * holy|strong="H6944" * seed|strong="H2233" * is|strong="H1961" * its|strong="H7725" * stump.”

motu: Ahasa Iotam, Usia tubuna, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai, Resini, Suria pavapavana, bona Peka Remalia, Israel pavapavana, na Ierusalem e dae lao, bae tuari henia totona, a asie hadarerea diba.
english: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

motu: Bena David garana e kamonai Suria na Efraim ida vada e henega hebou negana ai, ia bona ena orea taudia kudoudia e hetaha, uda audia na lai ai e helado-heladomu na heto.
english: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Isaia e hamaoroa, eto, Ahasa ihedavari-henina totona a raka lasi, oi bona natumu Seara-iasubu, atai gohuna dadairana dokona ai, Dabua-huri Tauna ena tano lao dalana ai, Dabua-huri Tauna ena tano lao dalana ai, ia ida ba hedavari.
english: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

motu: Ba hamaoroa, baoto, Nahuamu ba tohoa, lalomu basine hekwarahi; basio gari bona basio kudou-hetaha ini lahi tutututudia ruaosi, e ara oremu ḡaudia, hari Resini bona Suria bona Remalia natuna, edia badu-ḡaraḡara dainai.
english: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

motu: Badina be Suria, Efraim bona Remalia natuna ida, oi ihadikamu dalana vada e laloa hata, e tomu
english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

motu: “Iuda ihadikana totona baita dae lao, baita hagaria, bena baita hadarerea bona baita abia iseda, bona Tabele natuna na pavapava ai baita halaoa ia bogaraginai”.
english: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

motu: Una dainai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Una na basine gini, bona anina basine vara;
english: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

motu: badina be Suria kwarana na Damasko, bona Damasko kwarana na Resini. (Laḡani tauratoi-ahui ima bae lao henia lalonai Efraim na baine makohirohoroho, bona basie gwauraia bese ta.)
english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.

motu: Bona Efraim kwarana na Samaria, bona Samaria kwarana na Remalia natuna. Bema basio kamonai, momokani umui na basio gini tutuka-tutuka. Emanuel
english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

motu: Iehova ese Ahasa ma e hereva henia, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, enai toa ta ba gwauraia; baine dobu, Mase Gabuna na heto, eiava baine dae, guba na heto.
english: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

motu: A Ahasa eto, Ḡau ta basina gwauraia bona Iehova basina dibaḡania.
english: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt Yahweh.”

motu: Bena Isaia eto, Benaini, David garana e, a kamonai! Taunimanima o hahekwarahidiamu na ḡau pipikina dainai egu Dirava danu o hahekwarahiamu a?
english: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada sibona ese toa ta baine henimu.
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel. + 7:14 “Immanuel” means “God with us”. *

motu: A itaia, haneulato ta baine rogorogo, natuna baine havaraia, mero ta; bena ladana baine hatoa Emanuel + 7:15 “Emanuel” anina be “Dirava na ita dekedekedai”. *. Dika idadaraina bona namo iabi-hidina baine diba negana ai, ia ese rata-hetarina bona bada-ranuna baine ani.
english: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

motu: Badina be una mero na dika idadaraina bona namo iabi-hidinado basine diba hekada hanai, hari o gari henidiamu pavapavadia raruosi edia tano na bae vahu.
english: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

motu: Iehova ese nega ta baine havaraia, oi bona emu bese audia bona tamamu ena iduhu latadiai; nega unuhetomana ta se vara, Efraim ese Iuda e rakatania negana amo ema bona hari. Asuria pavapavana bunai.
english: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.

motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Aigupto sinavaidia badidia laodia bona Asuria tanona labolabona loḡora baine hioga henidia.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

motu: Bena iboudiai bae roho mai, koura dobudobudia ai bona haga nadidia kohuadia ai bona au ḡiniḡini ona rei gabudia iboudiai lalodiai bae noho.
english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

motu: Una dina ai Ḡaubada ese vasiga ta Sinavai Badana unukahana amo baine vatua, Asuria pavapavana bunai; bena kwara bona ae baine naudia, bona auki-huina danu.
english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

motu: Una dina ai tau ta ese boromakau hahinena matamatana ta bona mamoe hahinedia rua baine ubudia;
english: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.

motu: bena rata momo herea bae heni dainai, ia ese rata-hetarina baine ania; badina be tano ai do bae noho taudia iboudiai ese rata-hetarina bona bada-ranuna bae ani.
english: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

motu: Gunaguna vine audia daha-ta, davadia silver * sekeledia daha-ta + 7:23 Silver sekeledia daha-ta = silver metauna 31 Ibs sisivana. * ḡaudia, e varava gabudia iboudiai na una dina ai ava ḡiniḡini bona au ḡiniḡini ese bae habubunidia.
english: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, + 7:23 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1000 shekels is about 10 kilograms or 22 pounds. * will be for briers and thorns.

motu: Taunimanima na mai pevadia bona mai dibadia ida unu gabu baela; badina be tano idoinai ava ḡiniḡini bona au ḡiniḡini ese bae habubunia.
english: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

motu: Ororo danu, gunaguna isiva amo avadia e rau; a unu basiola, ava ḡiniḡini bona au ḡiniḡini na garidia. A unu na boromakau heruhadia bona mamoe edia hemoimoilai gabudia ai baela.
english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Nadi palakana badana ta bavabia, bena taunimanima iboudiai dibadia revarevadia amo ba torea “Mahere-salala-hasa-basa ena”.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’; + 8:1 “Maher Shalal Hash Baz” means “quick to the plunder, swift to the prey”. *

motu: Bena ihamomokanina taudia namodia na abidia. Uria, hahelaḡa tauna, bona Sekaria, Ieberekia natuna, egu kara bae hamomokania totona.
english: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

motu: Bena peroveta hahinena dekenai na raka vareai, bena ia na e rogorogo, mero ta e havaraia. Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ladana ba hatoa “Mahere-salala-hasa-basa”; + 8:3 “Mahere-salala-hasa-basa” anina be “E dadi kohudia na e heaumu: darinu na e haragamu”. *
english: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

motu: badina be mero na “Mama” eiava “Ina” do basine boi diba negana ai, Damasko ena taḡa bona Samaria ai bae dadi kohudia na Asuria pavapavana vairanai bae hua lao.
english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

motu: Iehova ese ma e hereva henigu, eto,
english: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,

motu: Badina be ina bese ese Siloa ranudia, e aru metaira-metairamu ḡaudia, vada e dadaraidia, bona Resini bona Remalia natuna garidia ese e butudia taomu,
english: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

motu: una dainai Ḡaubada ese Sinavai Badana ranudia na idia ihadikadia totona e ha-arudia maimu. Unu ranu na goada herea bona momo, Asuria pavapavana mai hairaina idoinai ida; bena abata ese sinavai baine hahonudia, sinavai popotodia iboudiai baine utudia dae;
english: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

motu: ma baine aru lao ela bona Iuda tanona baine utua dae, ma bainela, baine dae ela bona aio ai baine kau. Emanuel e, hanina hetoi-rorodia ese emu tano lababana baine hahonua.
english: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.

motu: Bese idau-idau e, ba heḡiḡi rohoroho, ba gari dikadika! Gabu daudau e, ba hakala! Emui rami ba hekasilai, ba gari dikadika; emui rami ba hekasilai, ba gari dikadika.
english: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

motu: Ba henega bou, to ḡau ta basine vara; ba hereva, to emui hereva basine gini; badina be Dirava na ai dekedekemai ai. Iehova garina ba gari
english: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

motu: Badina be Iehova ese unu e hereva henigu toma; imana mai goadana na lau latagu ai e atoa kau, bona e sisiba henigu, ina bese ena dala ai basina raka. Eto,
english: For Yahweh spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

motu: Ina bese ese “dika henegadia” e gwauraimu ḡaudia iboudiai na umui ese “dika henegadia” basio gwauraidia, bona garidia e garimu ḡaudia na garidia basio gari, bona kudoumui basie hetaha.
english: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.

motu: A Iehova Sabaota hari ba gwauraia “helaḡa”; ia mo ba gari henia, bona ia dainai kudoumui bae hetaha.
english: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

motu: Ia na gabu helaḡana ai bainela, bona Israel oreadia ruaosi ediai hekwakwanai bona hetutuhi nadidia ai bainela, bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ediai rikiriki bona idoa ai bainela.
english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.

motu: Hutuma na ienai bae hetutuhi; bae moru bona bae hehuari; baine idoadia, bena baine abidia.
english: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

motu: Hahediba herevadia ba hunidia; egu hahediba taudia mo ba hadibadibalaidia.
english: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.

motu: Iehova baine naria; ia ese vairana na Iakob ena iduhu amo e huniamu; ia baina laroa.
english: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

motu: A itaia, lau bona natugu, Iehova ese vada e henigu memerodia, na toa bona gware Israel ai, Iehova Sabaota, Siona ororona ai e nohomu Diravana, ena amo.
english: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

motu: Bae hamaoromui, baeto “Rohe taudia bona mea taudia, e tanatanamu bona e hereva hemaunumu taudia, na ba nanadaidia” negana ai ba laloa, taunimanima ese edia Dirava basiema nanadaia a? Mase taudia bema nanadaidia mauri taudia dadiai a?
english: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

motu: Hahediba daladia bona hahediba herevadia ba badinadia. Momokani ina e gwauraiamu herevana na asi diarina.
english: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

motu: Tano bae rakaia hanai mai hisihisi badadia bona mai hitolodia ida; bena bae hitolo negana ai bae badu ḡaraḡara, bena edia pavapava bona edia Dirava bae uduguiraidia. Bae gaga dae,
english: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,

motu: bona tanobada bae raraia, a hisihisi bada bona dibura mo bae ita, hisihisi bada-hereavaburana; bena dibura masemase lalonai bae doridia vareai.
english: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

motu: A hisihisi ese e gugubaiava hahinena na vabura ai basinela. Nega gunana ai ia ese Sebulun bona Napatali tanodia na hedadarai gabudia ai e halaodia; a nega gabena ai ia ese davara dalana, loridane sinavaina unukahana tanona, bese idau-idau edia Galilea, baine hahairaia.
english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

motu: Dibura ai e rakava taudia ese diari badana vada e itaia; dibura masemase tanona ai e nohova taudia latadiai diari vada e tata dae roha.
english: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The|strong="H6440" * light has|strong="H1471" * shined on|strong="H6440" * those who|strong="H1471" * lived in|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * land|strong="H6440" * of|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * shadow of|strong="H6440" * death.

motu: Bese vada o hahutumaia, bona ena moale vada o habadaia; idia na oi vairamu ai e moalemu, taboro imoalelaina na heto, eiava vada e dadi kohudia e harimu taudia edia moale na heto.
english: You have multiplied the nation. You|strong="H3588" * have|strong="H3117" * increased their|strong="H3588" * joy. They|strong="H3588" * rejoice before|strong="H3117" * you|strong="H3588" * according to|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H3588" * joy in|strong="H3117" * harvest, as|strong="H3117" * men rejoice when|strong="H3588" * they|strong="H3588" * divide the|strong="H3588" * plunder.

motu: Badina be ena maduna metauna, bona ia paḡana auna, bona ia ihahisina tauna ena ikwadi auna, oi ese vada o hakwaidu Midian ena dina ai na heto.
english: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

motu: Badina be tuari herou-herouna ai e rakamu taudia edia tamaka iboudiai, bona rara ai vada e hekuikuilai dabuadia iboudiai, bae gabudia, lahi audia na heheto.
english: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

motu: Badina be meromero ta vada e vara, ita eda; mero ta vada e henida. Taunimanima ireḡudia na ia paḡana ai baine heato, bona ladana bae hatoa: Hahealo Tauna Herea-daena, Siahu-bada Diravana, Tamada hanaihanai, Maino Lohiana.
english: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

motu: Ena heregu ihabadana bona maino daladia na basie doko, David ena terono bona ena basileia latadiai, baine haginia bona baine ha-aukaia totona, mai hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva bona mai kara maoromaoro ida, hari ina nega ela hanaihanai. Ina na Iehova Sabaota ena ura-kwalimu ese baine karaia. Iehova ena badu Israel latanai
english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.

motu: Ḡaubada ese hereva ta vada e siaia, Iakob ihadikana; ia na Israel latanai baine kau.

english: Therefore Yahweh will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and|strong="H7218" * reed, in|strong="H6440" * one|strong="H1931" * day.

english: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and|strong="H7725" * those|strong="H3605" * who|strong="H3605" * are|strong="H3027" * led by|strong="H3027" * them|strong="H5921" * are|strong="H3027" * destroyed|strong="H1696" *.

motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada ese edia eregabe taudia se moalelaidiamu, bona edia ihareha bona edia vabu se bogadia hisimu; badina be iboudiai na Dirava asie matauraiamu, iboudiai na kara dika taudia, bona udu iboudiai na e hereva kava hereva kavamu. Ina idoinai vada e vara, to ena badu do se keru; ia imana na doini e hetoi roromu.
english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will|strong="H3293" * he|strong="H3588" * have|strong="H3588" * compassion on|strong="H3341" * their|strong="H3588" * fatherless and|strong="H8068" * widows; for|strong="H3588" * everyone is|strong="H3588" * profane and|strong="H8068" * an|strong="H3588" * evildoer, and|strong="H8068" * every|strong="H3588" * mouth speaks folly. For|strong="H3588" * all this|strong="H3588" * his|strong="H3588" * anger is|strong="H3588" * not|strong="H3588" * turned away|strong="H1197" *, but|strong="H3588" * his|strong="H3588" * hand is|strong="H3588" * stretched out still|strong="H3588" *.

english: For wickedness burns like a fire. It|strong="H1961" * devours the|strong="H3068" * briers and|strong="H3068" * thorns; yes, it|strong="H1961" * kindles in|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3068" * thickets of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3068" * forest, and|strong="H3068" * they|strong="H3068" * roll upward in|strong="H3068" * a|strong="H3068" * column of|strong="H3068" * smoke.

english: Through Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and|strong="H1320" * the|strong="H5921" * people|strong="H1320" * are|strong="H1320" * the|strong="H5921" * fuel for|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * fire. No|strong="H3808" * one|strong="H3808" * spares his|strong="H5921" * brother.

Everyone|strong="H3605" * will|strong="H3063" * eat the|strong="H3605" * flesh of|strong="H3027" * his|strong="H3605" * own|strong="H3027" * arm|strong="H3027" *:

motu: Manase ese Efraim e aniamu, bona Efraim ese Manase e aniamu, bona raruosi ese Iuda e hadikaiamu. Ina idoinai vada e vara, to ena badu do se keru, ia imana na doini e hetoi roromu.
english: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

motu: Hahedua herevadia dikadia e gwauraimu taudia madi ihabaidia; itorena taudia hahehisi herevadia e tore louloumu, madi ihabaidia!
english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees

motu: E dabumu taudia edia amo hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva e lao ahumu, bona ogoḡami taudia egu bese lalonai ahudia korikori e dadimu; edia dadidadi ḡaudia na vabu, bona damudia na ihareha.
english: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

motu: Dika davana iabina dinana ai dahaka ba karaia? Lai gubana dauha amo bainema negana ai dahaka ba karaia? Daika ba heau henia baine kahamu totona? Emu taḡa be edeseni ai ba rakatania?
english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

motu: Dala ta lasi, to e abidia mauri taudia bogaragidiai ba raki, eiava e aladia mase taudia bogaragidiai ba moru. Ina idoinai vada e vara, to ena badu do se keru, ia imana na doini e hetoi roromu. Asuria na Iehova ena gahi
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and|strong="H7725" * will|strong="H3027" * fall|strong="H5307" * under|strong="H8478" * the|strong="H3605" * slain|strong="H2026" *. For|strong="H8478" * all|strong="H3605" * this|strong="H2063" * his|strong="H3605" * anger is|strong="H3027" * not|strong="H3808" * turned|strong="H7725" * away|strong="H7725" *, but|strong="H3808" * his|strong="H3605" * hand|strong="H3027" * is|strong="H3027" * stretched|strong="H5186" * out|strong="H5186" * still|strong="H5750" *.

motu: A! Asuria na egu badu auna, egu badu-ḡaraḡara gahina.
english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

motu: Dirava se matauraiamu besena ihadikana totona na siaia laomu; na haganiamu, na badu henidiamu taudia na baine hadikadia. Baine dadidadi, kohu momo baine dadi; baine moimoilaidia, ariara kopukopuna na heto.
english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

motu: A unu se laloa tomamu, ena lalo-hadai na dia unuheto; a ena ura be hahebua-tari, bese diaḡau baine butudia tao.
english: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

motu: Badina be ia na e tomu: Egu tuari lohiadia iboudiai na dia papavapava a?
english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

motu: Kalano na Karakemisi ida vada e heḡereḡere, bona Hamat na Arapada ida vada e heḡereḡere, bona Samaria na Damasko ida vada e heḡereḡere, ani?
english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

motu: Imagu ese kaivakuku ibadinadia basileiadia vada e toi roro henidia, edia dirava laulaudia, e koro ḡaudia, na Ierusalem bona Samaria edia e hereadiava gabudia;
english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,

motu: matona, Samaria bona ena dirava laulaudia vada na kara henidia heḡereḡerena ai, Ierusalem mai ena kaivakuku ida basina kara henidia a?
english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

motu: Ḡaubada ese ena ḡaukara idoinai Siona Ororona bona Ierusalem latadiai baine ha-orea murinai, ia ese Asuria pavapavana ena hekokoroku herevadiabona ena heaḡi bada-herea daidiai baine hadikaia.
english: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.

motu: Badina be una taue tomamu: Lau imagu goadana amo vada na karaia, bona egu aonega amo danu; badina be lau na lalo-parara taugu. Bese idau-idau edia tano hetoadia vada na abidia oho, bona edia kohu namodia vada na dadi; bona terono ai e helaiva taudia vada na doridia dobi, boromakau maruanena ese bema doadia dobi heḡereḡerena.
english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

motu: Imagu ese bese idau-idau edia taḡa vada e davaridia, tau ta ese manu rumana bema davaria na heto; bona manu hahinena ese vada e rakatanidia gatoidia na taunimanima ese e haboudiamu heḡereḡerena ai, lau ese tanobada idoinai tagadia vada na haboudia; ta ese hanina se hamarereamu, eiava uduna se haḡaiamu, eiava se taimu.
english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

motu: Ira na sibona baine heaḡi, e utu-utulaiamu tauna baine dadaraia a? Eiava iri na sibona baine heimodai, e iri-irilaiamu tauna baine dadaraia a? Una na au ese e abia isimu tauna bema kwadi-kwadilaia, eiava gahi, au ḡauna, ese tau, dia au ḡauna, bema abia isi na heto.
english: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, ese taudia ihavaroda-varodadia gorerena na ena tuari taudia goada-hereadia bogaragidiai baine siaia; ia hairaina henunai hururu ta baine vara, lahi hururuna na heto.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

motu: Israel Diarina na lahi ai bainela; ena Helaḡa Diravana na lahi hururu-hururuna ai bainela; ena au ḡiniḡini bona ena ava ḡiniḡini baine aradia, dina tamona ai baine aradia ore.
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

motu: Ena uda bona ena tano namona hairaidia na Iehova ese baine habuadia tari, lauma ai bona tau-anina ai; gorere tauna e varoda-varodamu heḡereḡerena ai bainela.
english: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

motu: Ena uda audia oredia bae gadoi vaitani dainai, mero maraḡina ta ese baine hagaudia diba.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

motu: Una dina ai Israel kwabukwabudia bona Iakob iduhuna ena roho-mauri taudia ese idia e rahudia mase tauna enai basie tao lou, a Iehova, Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana, enai bae tao mai momokanidia ida.
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

motu: A kwabukwabudia na bae lou mai, Iakob iduhuna kwabukwabudia, Siahu Diravana bae lou henia.
english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

motu: Badina, ena be emu bese Israel na kone mirina na heto, to kwabukwabudia mo bae lou mai. Kara maoromaoro na e hepurai dobimu, una dainai hahebua-tari na vada e hahedualaia.
english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, ese baine haḡuḡurua vaitani, hahedua heḡereḡerena, tanobada idoinai bogaraginai.
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.

motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu bese taumui e, Siona ai o nohomu taumui e, Asuria taudia ese au amo bae rahumui mase bona edia gahi na ihadikamui totona bae abidia isi, Aigupto taudia e karaia heḡereḡerena, negana ai idia garidia basio gari.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

motu: Badina be asi vanahana egu lalo-siahu baine ore, bona egu badu eseidia ihabua-taridia baine matamaia.
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

motu: Bena Iehova Sabaota ese ikwadiva varona amo baine hadikadia, Midian na Oreb nadi-ginina badibadinai e rahua mase negana heḡereḡerena ai; bona ena itotohi na davara daenai baine he toi roro, bona baine abia isi, Aigupto ai e karaia heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

motu: Una dina ai ena maduna metauna na pagamui amo baine heabi oho, bona ena maduna auna na aiomui amo baine kwaidu oho. Ia na Rimon amo vada e dae lao,
english: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

motu: Aiata ai vada e kau; Migron vada e rakaia hanai, Mikmasa ai ena kohu e habouamu;
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

motu: Ororo makana amo vada e hanai, Geba ai e taruha rani; Rama na e heude-heudemu, Gibea, Saulo ena hanua, vada e heau.
english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

motu: Galimi hahinemu e, a tai badabada! Laisa e, a kamonai! Anatoto e, a haere henia!
english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

motu: Madamena na e heaumu; Gebimi inoholaina taudia na e heau maurimu.
english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

motu: Hari ina dina ai, ia na Nob ai baine gini, imana baine kahua kuboro-kuboro, Siona kekenina ena ororo baine kahu kuboro henia, Ierusalem ororona bunai.
english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

motu: A itaia, Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, ese au rigidia baine utu oho, mai siahu herea-daena ida; atai ḡaudia na baine utudia gari, atai-herea ḡaudia na henu ai bae heato diho.
english: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

motu: Ia ese uda audia hedoma-hedomadia na ira amo baine utudia, bona Lebanon mai ena au hereadia ida bae moru.
english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

motu: Iese badina amo tuhutuhu ta baine gara kau; bona ia ramuna amo rigi ta baine tubu.

motu: Basie hahehisi bona basie hahebua tari, egu ororo helaḡana idoinai ai; badina be tanobada na Iehova idiba-maorona ai baine honu, davara ena honuhonu-dae na heto.
