motu: Una dina ai Iese ramuna baine gini, taunimanima loḡora edia pepe; bese idau-idau ese ia bae tahua, bona ena noho gabudia bae herea dae. Kwabukwabudia bae lou mai
english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

motu: Una dina ai Ḡaubada ese nega iharuana imana baine toia roro, ena bese kwabukwabudia iabi-loudia totona: Asuria amo, Aigupto amo, Pataro amo, Etiopia amo, Elam amo, Sinara amo, Hamat amo, bona kone ahadia amo.
english: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

motu: Ia ese pepe ta baine duduia isi, bese idau-idau edia, bona Israel ena henege-daure taudia baine haboudia, bona Iuda ena karoho taudia baine gogodia tanobada daigunidia haniosi amo.
english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

motu: Efraim ena vagege baine heabi oho, bona Iuda ihahisina taudia bae henege daure; Efraim ese Iuda basine vagege henia, bona Iuda ese Efraim basine hahisia.
english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

motu: A Filistia taudia edia ororo gabaedia na bae hedai henidia lahara kahana ai; bona hebou tamona ai baela, laurabada kahana taudia edia kohu bae dadi. Imadia bae toi roro, Edom bona Moab ihadikadia totona; bona Amono taudia ese bae kamonai henidia.
english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Aigupto davara dogurana baine habuaia tari vaitani, bona Sinavai Badana daenai imana baine davea, mai ena lai siahuna ida; bena baine botaia parara, rege hitu ai baine aru, bona taunimanima na bae raka hanai diba, aedia basie paripari.
english: Yahweh will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

motu: Bena laolao dalana ta baine helailai Asuria amo, ena bese kwabukwabudia edia; Israel ena heḡereḡerena, Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi negana ai.
english: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

motu: Una dina ai baoto: Iehova e, lau baina hanamomu, badina ena be o badu henigu, to emu badu na egu amo o abia oho, bona taugu o haloa.
english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

motu: A itaia, Dirava na lau ihamaurigu; baina heabidadama, basina gari; badina be Iehova na egu goada bona egu ane, ia na ihamaurigu ai vada e hahelao.
english: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

motu: Mai moalemui ida ranu na hahemauri guridia amo ba utu.
english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

motu: Bona una dinai ai baoto: Iehova ba hanamoa, ia ladana ba hahanea; ena kara na bese idau-idau ba hadibalaidia, ba gwauraia hedinarai, ia ladana na herea-dae.
english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!

motu: Iehova ihanamolaina anedia avabi, badina be kara hereadia vada e kara, tanobada idoinai unu bae diba toma.
english: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

motu: Siona inoholaina taumui, a lolo, moale anedia avabi; badina be Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana na bada, umui bogaragimui ai.
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

motu: Maduna metauna Babulono latanai, Isaia Amoso ese e itaia ḡauna.
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

motu: Ororo gagaena ai toa ta ba duduia isi, ba boi lolo henidia; ba kalodia, bae raka vareai, lohia edia ikoukou lalodiai.
english: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

motu: Lau sibogu ese egu helaḡa taudia vada na haḡanidia, bona egu goada taudia, egu heaḡi herea taudia, vada na boiridia, egu badu karadia bae kara totona.
english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

motu: A hakala, heloḡo-heloḡo na ororo ai, hutuma bada reḡedia na heheto. A hakala, basileia idau-idau e heloḡo ahu-ahumu, e heboumu besedia na e heloḡo-heloḡomu. Iehova Sabaota ese tuari oreana ta e habouamu;
english: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Yahweh of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

motu: tano daudau amo e maimu, bona guba dokona amo, Iehova bona ena badu ḡaudia, tanobada idoinai ihabua-tarina totona.
english: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

motu: A tai lolololo, badina be Iehova ena dina eme kahikahi; ia na do baine kau, Siahu-idoinai Diravana ena hahebua-tari dinana ai bainela.
english: Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

motu: Taunabunai, ima iboudiai bae manoka-manoka; taunimanima iboudiai kudoudia bae hetaha,
english: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

motu: bona gari ese baine butudia tao. Hisihisi ese baine gugubadia, hisihisi badadia; idia na hisi bae ani, hahine ena hekamonai hisina na heto. Bae heita heheni mai gari badadia ida; vairadia bae kakakaka, lahi na heto.
english: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

motu: A itaia, Iehova ena dina e maimu, mai dagedagena bona mai baduna ida, mai badu ḡaraḡarana ida; tanobada na baine havahua, bona kara dika taudia na ia latana amo baine habuadia tari.
english: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

motu: Badina be guba hisiudia edia orea lalodiai na basie diari; daba ai dina na baine dibura, bona hua basine rara.
english: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

motu: Tanobada na ena dika davana baina henia, kara dika taudia na edia kara havara davadia baina heni; heaḡi taudia edia hekokoroku baina hadokoa, bona asi edia hebogahisi taudia edia heaḡi baina hamaraḡia.
english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

motu: Taunimanima baina hagadoidia: idia na bae gadoi, gold * namo-hereana baine momo; idia na bae gadoi, Ofiri gold-na baine momo.
english: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

motu: Taunabunai, guba baina haheude-heudea; bona Iehova Sabaota ena badu ese tanobada na ena gabu amo baine bibia oho, ena badu baine ḡaraḡara dinana ai.
english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.

motu: E labanaiamu diana na heto, eiava mamoe asi ireḡudia na heheto, taunimanima ta ta ese ena bese taudia ena bese taudia bae haḡeredia, bona taunimanima ta ta na ena tano korikori ena tano korikori bae lou lao.
english: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

motu: Bae davaria tauna na bae gwadaia uru, bona bae dabaia tao tauna na dare amo bae alaia mase;
english: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

motu: natudia karukarudia na vairadiai bae huaridia, edia ruma kohudia bae dadidia, bona adavadia bae hadikadia.
english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

motu: A itaia, lau ese Mede taudia lalodia baina hasiahudia, bae hadikadia totona; idia na silver * asie laloamu, bona gold * asie moalelaiamu.
english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

motu: Edia peva ese eregabe taudia bae aladia mase; hahine bogadia anidia na basie hamauridia; matadia ese memero bona kekeni na basie bogadia hisi.
english: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

motu: Babulono danu, basileia herea-daena, Kaldea taudia edia hairai bona edia heaḡi ḡauna, na Sodoma bona Gomora heḡereḡeredia ai bainela, Dirava ese e habuadia tari negana ai.
english: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

motu: Haida ese basie noho henia, bona basie noholaia ela bona uru iboudiai; Arabia tauna ta unuseni ai basine taruha, bona mamoe ireḡudia taudia haida ese edia seri basie hahekuredi: unuseni ai.
english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

motu: A uda boromadia na unuseni ai bae hekure, rumadia na e ḡoumu ḡaudia ai bae honu; unuseni ai kokokoko bae noho, bona huika-huika ḡaudia na unuseni ai bae mavaru.
english: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

motu: Tano ḡaḡaena sisiadia na kohorodia ai bae turo, bona uda sisiadia danu lohia rumadia lalodiai; ena nega vada eme kahikahi, bona ena dina na basie hoho.
english: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

motu: Iehova ese Iakob baine bogaia hisi bona Israel baine abia hidi lou; edia tano korikori ai baine atodia lou, bena idau bese taudia na idia ida bae tamona, Iakob besena enai bae tao.
english: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

motu: Bena unu bese taudia ese bae abidia, edia gabu korikori bae mailaidia; bena Israel taudia ese bae abidia, Iehova ena tano ai, edia hesiai taudia bona hahinedia ai bae halaodia; e abidia mauriva taudia na idia ese bae abidia mauri, bona e hahisidiava taudia na idia ese bae biagudia.
english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

motu: Iehova ese emui hisihisi bona emui hekwarahi bona emui hesiai-laoheniaukana amo laḡa-ani baine henimui negana ai,
english: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

motu: umui ese ina Babulono pavapavana iḡonaḡonalaina anena ba ladaia isi: A itaia! Hahehisi tauna vada e doko, heaḡi baduna vada e ore.
english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

motu: Iehova ese kara dika taudia edia itotohi vada e hakwaidua, bona pavapava edia dagi auna danu.
english: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

motu: Ia ese mai baduna ida bese idau-idau taudia e rahudia mase asi dokona; ia ese mai baduna ida basileia idau-idau taudia e biagudia, e hahisidia, se bogadia hisi.
english: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.

motu: Tanobada idoinai e laḡa animu, asi reḡereḡena; idia ese ane e ladaia isimu.
english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.

motu: Beroso + 14:8 “Beroso” na au ta ladana, Heberu gado ai. * audia na oi daimu ai e moalemu, bona Lebanon sida audia danu, e tomu, Oi o moru negana ema bona hari, au-utu tauna ta na ai ihadikamai se maimu.
english: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

motu: Mase Gabuna na e marere-mareremu henumai ai, oi ihedavari-henimu totona; mase laulaudia na e haodiamu, oi ihahenamo-henimu totona, tanobada ena hegunalai taudia laulaudia iboudiai; basileia idau-idau pavapavadia iboudiai na edia terono amo e hatoredia isimu.
english: Sheol + 14:9 Sheol is the place of the dead. * from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

motu: Iboudiai bae hereva, bae hamaoromu, baeto, Oi danu vada o manoka-manoka, ai bamomai; oi na ai heḡereḡeremai ai vada ola.
english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

motu: Oi hairaimu na Mase Gabuna ai vada e hadihoa, emu hatai-hatai ḡaudia reḡedia danu; uloulo na emu hekure gedana, bona biluga na emu hetaru.
english: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, + 14:11 Sheol is the place of the dead. * with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

motu: Daba hisiuna, daba-matana natuna, guba amo vada o moru! Basileia idau-idau o hamorudia taumu, tano ai vada e hamorumu!
english: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

motu: Lalomu ai oto: Guba ai baina dae, Dirava ena hisiu daediai, atai ai egu terono baina hadaia; hebou ororona ai baina helai, dauhai, mirigini kahana ai;
english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

motu: lau na atai oridia daediai baina dae, Herea Mikamika heḡereḡerena ai baina hahelao.
english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

motu: A oi na Mase Gabuna ai vada e hadihomu, mase gurina ena dobu gabudia ai.
english: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, + 14:15 Sheol is the place of the dead. * to the depths of the pit.

motu: Bae itamu taudia bae raraimu tao, bona bae haerolaimu, baeto: Ina na tanobada e haheude-heudea bona basileia idau-idau e hamareredia tauna a?
english: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,

motu: Ina be tanobada na tano ḡaḡaena ai e halaoa, bona ena hanua badadia e ḡiḡidia dobi, bona e ḡuidia taudia se kahudia nege tauna a?
english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

motu: Bese idau-idau pavapavadia iboudiai na hairai ai e hekuremu, ta ta ena gara ena gara ai;
english: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

motu: a oi na emu gara amo vada e negemu daudau, vara-dika merona, taunimanima ese e dadaraiamu ḡauna, na heto, dare ai e mase taudia na emu hetaru, Mase Gurina ena dobu gabudia nadidia ai mase tau-anina e moimoilaiamu na heto.
english: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

motu: Oi na idia ida basie gurimui hebou, badina be emu tano vada o havahua, bona emu bese taudia vada o aladia mase. Kara dika taudia vevedia ladadia na basie hato lou ela bona hanaihanai.
english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

motu: Natuna iala-masedia dalana ba lailaia, tamadia edia kerere daidiai, bae tore isi bena tanobada bae ḡaunaia bona tanobada kopina na hanua badadia amo bae hahonua na garina.
english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Lau na ihadikadia totona baina tore isi Iehova na e tomu, Lau ese ladana bona kwabukwabuna, natuna bona garana na Babulono amo baina negedia daure.
english: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Lau ese migu ena gabu bona gohugohu gabuna ai baina halaoa, bona hahebua-tari idarona amo baina daroa. Asuria baine darere
english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova Sabaota vada e gwau hamata, eto: Vada na laloa hata heḡereḡerena, unu baine vara toma; bona vada na lalo-hadailaia heḡereḡerena, unu baine gini toma.
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

motu: Lau ese Asuria tauna na egu tano ai baina huaria, bona egu tano ororodia ai baina moimoilaia; ena maduna na edia amo baine heabi oho, bona ena maduna metauna idia paḡadia amo danu.
english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

motu: Lalo-hadai binai vada e lalo-hadailaiamu, tanobada idoinai dainai; e toia roromu imana binai, basileia iboudiai daediai.
english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota ese vada e lalo-hadailaia, bena daika ese baine utua? Ia imana vada eme hetoi roro, bena daika ese baine haloua? Maduna metauna Filistia latanai
english: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

motu: King Ahasa ena mase laḡanina ai ina maduna metauna herevana e kau:
english: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.

motu: Filistia taumui iboumui ai, basio moale, e rahumui mase auna vada e kwaidu dainai; badina be gaigai ramuna amo duba ta baine vara, bona huahuana baine dobi, roho gaigaina ta.
english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

motu: Ogoḡami tauna natuna roboana baine aniani, bona e dabumu tauna baine hekure diho mai namona ida; a lau ese ramumu na doe amo baina hamasea, bona emu taunimanima kwabukwabudia baina aladia mase.
english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

motu: Ikoukou e, a tai! Hanua badana e, a tai lolololo; Filistia taumui iboumui ai, gari ese kudoumui baine hahetahadia! Badina be tuari kwalahuna na mirigini amo e lasi e maimu, bona tuari oreana ai tau ta se halahemu.
english: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

motu: Basileia ena gwaukau taudia na ede bae haere henidia toma? Iehova ese Siona vada e hadaia, bona ia lalonai ena hisihisi taudia ese mauri bae davaria.
english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

motu: Maduna metauna Moab latanai: Ara na hanuaboi tamona ai vada e havahua dainai, Moab na vada e baia; Kiri na hanuaboi tamona ai vada e havahua dainai, Moab na vada e baia.
english: The burden of Moab. For|strong="H3588" * in|strong="H3588" * a|strong="H3068" * night|strong="H3915" * Kir|strong="H7024" * of|strong="H4853" * Moab|strong="H4124" * is|strong="H4124" * laid waste|strong="H7703" *, and|strong="H3915" * brought to|strong="H3588" * nothing.

motu: Dibon natuna kekenina vada e dae lao, atai gabudia ai baine taitai totona; Nebo bona Medeba latadiai, Moab na e tai lolololomu. Kwara iboudiai vada e naudia, auki iboudiai huidia vada e abi;
english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

motu: ariara ai puse dabuadia e riomu; ruma guhidia ai bona hanua bogaragidiai danu taunimanima iboudiai na e tai lolololomu, bona taitaidia ai taudia e manokamu.
english: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

motu: Hesebon bona Eleale e lolomu, gadodia na e kamonaimu ela bona Iahasa; taunabunai, Moab ena tuari taudia na e tai badabadamu, laumadia na e dauremu.
english: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

motu: Moab dainai lalogu na e taimu, ena heau-mauri taudia na e heaumu ela bona Soara ela bona Eglata-selisia; badina be Luhiti dae-lao dalana ai, mai taitaidia ida e dae laomu; bona Horonaimi dalana ai, hahebua-tari dainai e taitaimu.
english: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

motu: Nimirimi ranu-gabudia vada e kororo, rei vada e marai, bona matamatadia se tubumu; tano ai e varamu ḡaudia iboudiai vada e ore.
english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

motu: Taunabunai edia taḡa idoinai bona vada e habou ḡaudia iboudiai e huadia hanaimu, Arabimi Sinavaina unukahana ai.
english: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

motu: Badina be Moab tanona hegegemadai ai, taitai na vada ela; taitai reḡedia na e laomu ela bona Eglaimi, e laomu ela bona Bere-elim.
english: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

motu: Badina be Dibon ranu gabudia na rara ai e honumu, ḡau tamona Dibon ena hisi ma baina habadaia; leona ta baina siaia Moab amo e roho maurimu taudia ediai, bona tano taudia kwabukwabudia ediai.
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

motu: Idia ese mamoe natudia vada e siaidia, tano lohiana dekenai, Sela amo, tano ḡaḡaena dalana ai, ela bona Siona natuna kekenina ena ororo.
english: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

motu: Manu e roho eva-evamu na heto, manu natudia e hakarohodiamu na heto, Moab hahinedia na unuheto, Aranon turu-hanai gabudia ai.
english: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

motu: Ba hahealo, hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva ba karaia; ikerukerumu na dina tubua ai ba ha-udunaia, hanuaboi diburana na heto. Vada e luludia lasi taudia ba hunidia, e heau maurimu tauna taona basio torea.
english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

motu: Moab amo e luludia lasi taudia na bogaragimui ai bavabidia dae; hahebua-tari tauna imana amo iharoho-mauridia gabuna ai baola. Negana bainema, hahehisi tauna baine boio, bona hahebua-tari baine doko, bona ae-hemoimoilai karadia e karamu tauna na tano amo baine puki;
english: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

motu: una negana ai terono ta na hebogahisi ai baine gini, ia latanai heabidadama tauna ta baine helai, David ena kalaga ai, hahemaoro e karaiamu bona hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva e tahuamu bona kara maoromaoro ikarana ai e haraḡamu tauna.
english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

motu: Moab ena heaḡi sivaraina vada ta kamonai, ena hekokoroku na dibada; e hekokorokumu, e heaḡimu, e gwau daḡemu, ena heaḡi herevadia na koikoi.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

motu: Taunabunai, Moab taudia bae tai lolololo, bona taunimanima iboudiai na Moab dainai bae tai. A tai, mai dara-dokomui ida, Kiri-haresete ena vine huahua kaukaudia manedia ba tailaidia.
english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

motu: Badina be Hesebon umadia na e maraimu, bona Sibma vinena danu; basileia idau-idau lohiadia ese ia rigina vada e bokodia; unu rigi na e laova ela bona Iasere, e loava ela bona tano ḡaḡaena; ia tuhutuhuna na e tubu rohorohova, davara e hanaiava.
english: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

motu: Taunabunai Iasere ida a taitaimu, Sibma vinena taina a taimu. Hesebon bona Eleale e, iruru-matagu amo na hapariparimuimu; badina be tuari honena vada e kau, emui huahua bona emui taboro latadiai.
english: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

motu: Moale bona lalo-namo na uma mai anina amo vada eme heabi oho; bona vine imeadia lalodiai ane asie abimu bona asie hisi daemu; vine itaolaidia gabudia ai tau ta ese vine se moimoilaimu, bona ta se hisi daemu.
english: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

motu: Taunabunai, Moab dainai lalogu e taimu, hatai-hatai ḡauna na heto, bona Kiri-herese danu dainai.
english: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

motu: Moab baine hedinarai, atai gabuna ai baine hekwarahi, ena gabu helaḡana ai baine ḡuriḡuri negana ai ḡau ta basine davaria.
english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

motu: Nega gunadia ai Iehova ese Moab na unu e herevalaia toma.
english: This is the word that Yahweh spoke concerning Moab in time past.

motu: A harihari Iehova na e tomu, Ena be Moab taudia na hutuma herea, to laḡani toi, ḡaukara tauna ena gwauhamata laḡanidia heḡereḡeredia, lalodiai Moab hairaina na heihi-ihirai ḡauna ai bainela; bopa bae mauri taudia na baegadoi bona taudia bae manoka.
english: But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

motu: Maduna metauna Damasko latanai: A itaia, Damasko hanuana baine vahu, nadi hesenudia ai bainela.
english: The burden of Damascus. “ Behold|strong="H2009" *, Damascus|strong="H1834" * is|strong="H2009" * taken|strong="H5493" * away|strong="H5493" * from|strong="H5493" * being|strong="H1961" * a|strong="H3068" * city|strong="H5892" *, and|strong="H5892" * it|strong="H1961" * will|strong="H1961" * be|strong="H1961" * a|strong="H3068" * ruinous|strong="H4654" * heap|strong="H4596" *.

motu: Hanuadia bae mia ḡaḡae ela bona hanaihanai, mamoe seridia edia gabu ai baela; mamoe na unuseni ai bae hekure, bona tau ta ese basine hagaridia.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.

motu: Efraim kohorona baine puki oho, bona Damasko basileiana danu; Suria taudia kwabukwabudia danu bae boio, Israel taudia hairaidia vada e boio heḡereḡerena. Iehova Sabaota unu e gwau tomamu. Israel ihahemaoro-henina
english: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Una dina ai, Iakob hairaina na baine maraḡi, bona tau-anina baine varoda-varoda;
english: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

motu: uit iutuna tauna ese e ginimu uitina e habouamu bena ia imana ese uit anidia e utumu na heto, eiava uit anidia momorudia Refaim kourana ai e gogomu na heto.
english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

motu: Momorudia do bae mia, olive auna e kwadiamu negana ai na heto; huahua rua eiava toi atai rigina dorina ai e miamu eiava hani eiava ima huahua auna rigina ai e miamu na heto. Iehova, Israel Diravana, unu e gwau tomamu.
english: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel.

motu: Una dina ai taunimanima ese Ikaradia Diravana na bae laloa, bona matadia ese Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana bae haḡerea;
english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

motu: ihaboulaina patadia, imadia amo e kara ḡaudia, na basie lalodia; bona ima-kwakikwakidia amoe kara ḡaudia, Asera ena au-tubua helaḡadia eiava muramura mai bonadiapatadia, na basie haḡeredia.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.

motu: Una dina ai edia goada hanuadia na Hivi taudia bona Amoro taudia edia hanua ahutudia, Israel taudia daidiai e rakatanidia gabudia, heḡereḡeredia ai baela, bona tano na baine vahu.
english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

motu: Badina be ihamaurimu Diravana vada o laloa boio, bona ihahemetaimu Nadi-ginina so laloa taomu; taunabunai, ena be herahera namodia bona dirava idauna ena uhe helaḡadia ba hado,
english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

motu: ena be ba hado dinana ai ba hatubudia bona ba hado dabana ai anidia ba havaradia, to anidia na bae puki, lalo-hisihisi bona asi ihanamona hisina dinana ai.
english: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

motu: Aha! Taunimanima hutuma reḡedia, davara hurehuredia gurudia na heheto. Aha! Basileia idau-idau reḡedia, e heloḡo-heloḡomu, ranu badadia gurudia na heheto.
english: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

motu: Basileia idau-idau taudia na e heloḡo-heloḡomu, ranu momo gurudia na heheto, a ia ese baine gwau henidia, bena dauha bae heau lao; lai ese momoru na ororo ai e hoda ohomu na heto, eiava lai-gubana ese ḡahu e hodaia isimu na heto.
english: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

motu: A itaia, adorahi ai gari bada-herea! Daba do se reremu, idia na lasihidia! Ina na eda ḡau e abi ohomu taudia ahudia; ina na eda kohu e dadi ohomu taudia davadia.
english: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.

motu: Aha! Manu hanidia gurudia tanona, Etiopia sinavaidia unukahadia ai;
english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

motu: ena gwaukau taudia na revareva vanagidia ai e siaidiamu, Nilo sinavaina amo. Gwaukau taumui mai haragamui e, aola, taudia lalata bona kopidia mamanada-mamanada besena dekediai, gabu kahikahidia bona gabu daudaudia ai e gari heniamu oreana dekenai; una bese na mai siahuna bona mai kwalimuna, ena tano na sinavai ese e hapararaiamu.
english: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”

motu: Tanobada inoholaina taumui iboumui ai, tanobada latanai o nohomu taumui e, toa ta ororo ai bae duduia isi negana ai, ba itaia! Kibi ta bae hiriria negana ai, ba kamonai!
english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

motu: Badina be Iehova ese ini e hereva henigu toma, eto: Egu noho gabuna amo baina roharoha, asi reḡereḡegu; dina e taramu siahuna na heto, ninoa taboro negana siahuna ai na heto.
english: For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

motu: Badina be taboro negana do basine kau ai, bure vada e marai bona vine huahuana e magemu negana ai, ia ese kwama-kwama kaiadia amo baine kwamadia, bona e hetoi lasimu rigidia baine lapa oho.
english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.

motu: Iboudiai bae mia, ororo manudia, damudia e tahumu ḡaudia, adia, bona tano boromadia adia. Siahu negana ai damudia e tahumu manudia ese bae anidia, bona keru negana ai tano boromadia iboudiai ese.
english: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.

motu: Una negana ai haida ese edia herahia ḡaudia bae mailai, Iehova Sabaota ena. Taudia lalata bona kopidia mamanada-mamanada oreana, gabu kahikahidia bona gabu daudaudia ai e gari heniamu oreana. bese mai siahuna bona mai kwalimuna, ena tano na sinavai ese e hapararaiamu besena, ese Siona ororona, Iehova Sabaota ladana e nemaiamu gabuna, bae maila.
english: In that time, a present will be brought to Yahweh of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Yahweh of Armies, Mount Zion.

motu: Maduna metauna Aigupto latanai: A itaia, Iehova na ori heiruna ai e guimu, Aigupto ai e kaumu. Aigupto kaivakukudia na ia vairanai bae heude-heude, Aigupto taudia na bae lalaḡa.
english: The burden of Egypt. “ Behold|strong="H2009" *, Yahweh|strong="H3068" * rides|strong="H7392" * on|strong="H5921" * a|strong="H3068" * swift|strong="H7031" * cloud|strong="H5645" *, and|strong="H3068" * comes|strong="H6440" * to|strong="H3068" * Egypt|strong="H4714" *. The|strong="H6440" * idols of|strong="H3068" * Egypt|strong="H4714" * will|strong="H3068" * tremble|strong="H5128" * at|strong="H5921" * his|strong="H3068" * presence|strong="H6440" *; and|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H6440" * heart|strong="H3824" * of|strong="H3068" * Egypt|strong="H4714" * will|strong="H3068" * melt|strong="H4549" * within|strong="H7130" * it|strong="H5921" *.

motu: Bena lau ese Aigupto taudia lalodia baina hasiahudia, bae hahedika heheni, bae heatu heheni, ta ta tadikakana tadikakana ida, ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna ida, hanua ta hanua ta ida, basileia ta basileia ta ida.
english: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

motu: Aigupto taudia laumadia bae daure; edia lalo-hata ḡaudia baina laodia ahu. Idia ese kaivakuku bona babalau taudia bae nanadaidia, bona rohe taudia bona mea taudia danu.
english: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

motu: Bena lau ese Aigupto taudia na biagu aukana ta imana ai baina atodia; bona pavapava ta mai dagedagena ese baine lohiadia. Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, unu e gwau tomamu.
english: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Nilo sinavaina ranudia bae kororo, sinavai baine kororo bona baine haurahaura;
english: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

motu: e gei dadairadia ranudia bae bodaga, bona Aigupto ena Sinavai Badana reḡedia bae kororo bona bae haurahaura, bona geda bona bota na bae pata rohoroho.
english: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

motu: Nilo sinavaina badibadina tanodia bae ḡaḡae, Nilo sinavaina isena tanodia; Nilo sinavaina isena ai e hadomu ḡaudia iboudiai na bae marai, lai ese baine hodadia oho, baine ha-oredia.
english: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

motu: Haoda taudia na bae taitai, bae hahane, Nilo sinavaina ai e kimaimu taudia iboudiai; bona reke e toremu taudia na lalodia bae hisihisi.
english: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

motu: Dabua aukadia e hatumu taudia daradia bae doko, bona dabua kurokurodia e hatumu taudia danu.
english: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

motu: Tano lohiadia na bae taodia tari, bona e gaukaramu mai davadia taudia na lalodia bae hisihisi.
english: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

motu: Soan lohiadia na kavakava herea; Farao ena aonega taudia ese hahealo kavakavadia e gwauraimu. Farao na ede ba hamaoroa toma, baoto “Lau na aonega tauna natuna, pavapava gunadia garadia”?
english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?

motu: Emu aonega taudia na edeseni ai? Bae hadibamu bona bae gwaurai hedinarai, Iehova Sabaota ese Aigupto ede baine kara henia toma.
english: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what Yahweh of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

motu: Soan lohiadia na kavakava taudia ai vada ela, Memefisi lohiadia na vada e hekoi; ena iduhu daiguni-nadidia ese Aigupto vada e hakaua kerere.
english: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

motu: Iehova ese daradara na ia bogaraginai vada e havaraia; Aigupto na vada e hararagaia ena kara iboudiai lalodiai, e kekeromu tauna na mumutana ai e raragamu na heto.
english: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

motu: Aigupto enai ḡau ta basine hekara, kwara eiava iu, reta eiava geda, ese bema karaia diba ḡauna.
english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

motu: Una dina ai, Aigupto taudia na hahine heḡereḡeredia ai baela; bona Iehova Sabaota ese imana na idia daediai baine davedavea negana ai, idia na ia vairanai bae heude-heude mai garidia ida.
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of Yahweh of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.

motu: Iuda tanona na gari ḡauna ai bainela Aigupto taudia ediai; bae herevalai henidia taudia iboudiai na bae gari, lalo-hadai, Iehova Sabaota ese idia ihadikadia e lalo-hadailaia, dainai.
english: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of Yahweh of Armies, which he determines against it.

motu: Una dina ai, Aigupto hanuadia badadia ima lalodiai Kanaan gadona ai bae hereva, bona edia gwauhamata na Iehova Sabaota bae henia. Ta ladana bae hatoa Dina Hanuana.
english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

motu: Una dina ai, Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana ta na Aigupto tanona bogaraginai baine mia, bona Iehova ena au-tubua ta na ena tano hetoana ai baine gini.
english: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

motu: Una na Iehova Sabaota toana ai bona ihahedinaraina ḡauna ai bainela, Aigupto tanona ai. Ihahisidia taudia daidiai idia ese Iehova bae tai henia negana ai, ia ese ihamauridia tauna ta na dekedia baine siaia lao; baine gimadia bona baine hamauridia.
english: It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Aigupto taudia baine hahedinarai henidia. Una dina ai, Aigupto taudia bae diba Iehova, bona bae toma henia diho mai kara helaḡadia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia ida, bona Iehova enai baegwau hamata, bena edia gwauhamata bae hamomokanidia.
english: Yahweh will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know Yahweh in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to Yahweh, and will perform it.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Aigupto taudia baine rahudia mase; baine rahudia mase ma baine hamauridia. Idia ese Iehova bae lou henia; bena ia ese edia noinoi baine kamonai, bona baine hamauridia.
english: Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

motu: Una dina ai, laolao dalana baine helailai, Aigupto amo ela bona Asuria. Asuria tauna na Aigupto bainela, bona Aigupto tauna na Asuria bainela; bona Aigupto taudia bona Asuria taudia bae toma diho hebou.
english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

motu: Una dina ai, Israel na Aigupto bona Asuria ida bae hebou, bena orea toiosi na hahenamo ḡauna ai baela, tanobada bogaraginai.
english: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;

motu: Iehova Sabaota ese vada e hanamodia, eto, Egu orea Aigupto, bona imagu amo na karaia ḡauna Asuria, bona dihigu Israel, na bae namo.
english: because Yahweh of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

motu: Tuari lohiana Saragono, Asuria pavapavana ese e siaia mai tauna, na Asdod ema, e tuari henia, bena e abia.
english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

motu: (Una negana ai, Iehova ese Isaia Amoso enai vada e hereva, eto, Aola, puse dabuana ba dokia oho, bona emu tamaka na aemu amo ba kokidia oho. Bena ia na unu e kara toma, asi dabuana bona aena asi tamakana vada e loaloava.)
english: at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

motu: Una laḡani lalonai Iehova eto, Egu hesiai tauna Isaia na laḡani toi lalodiai asi dabuana bona aena asi tamakana vada e loaloa, Aigupto bona Etiopia ihadikadia toana bona gwarena;
english: Yahweh said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

motu: una heḡereḡerena ai, Asuria pavapavana ese Aigupto taudia baine abidia mauri, baine hakaudia lao, bona Etiopia taudia na baine laohaidia, basie lou - eregabedia bona burukadia danu, asi dabuadia bona aedia asi tamakadia bona asi sihidia, Aigupto ihahemaraina.
english: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

motu: Bena bae dara doko bona bae baia, edia helaro ḡauna Etiopia bona edia heaḡi ḡauna Aigupto daidiai.
english: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

motu: Bena una dina ai ina kone tanona taudia baeto: A itaia, ina na vada e vara, ta helaro henidia, bona bae duruda, Asuria pavapavana ena amo bae hamaurida, totona ta heau henidia, taudia ediai. Matogana, ita na ede baita roho mauri toma?
english: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”

motu: Maduna metauna tano ḡaḡaena, davara kahana ḡauna, latanai; Koe-hirihiri na diho kahana amo e daro e maimu na heto, ia na tano ḡaḡaena amo e maimu, tano dika amo e maimu.
english: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As|strong="H4057" * whirlwinds|strong="H5492" * in|strong="H3220" * the|strong="H3372" * South|strong="H5045" * sweep|strong="H2498" * through|strong="H2498" *, it comes from the|strong="H3372" * wilderness|strong="H4057" *, from an awesome|strong="H3372" * land.

motu: Mata-hanai aukana vada e hahedinarai henigu: dadidadi tauna ese e dadidadimu, hahebua-tari tauna ese e hahebua tarimu. Elam e, a dae lao! Media e, a hahegegea ahu! Ḡanaḡana idoinai ia ese vada e havaraia na lau ese na hadokoamu.
english: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

motu: Taunabunai, koekoegu e hisihisi hereamu; hisi ese e gugubagumu, hahine ena hekamonai hisidia na heheto. Lau na e ha-igogu dihomu dainai asina kamonaimu; kudougu e hahetahaiamu dainai asina heitamu.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

motu: Daragu e dokomu, gari ese e butugu taomu; adorahi vaburana na hekise-hekise henia, to ia na egu heude-heude negana ai vada ela.
english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

motu: Pata e dabaraiamu, geda e tahomu; e anianimu bona e muinumu. Lohia taumui e, a tore isi; kesi na ba dehorodia.
english: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada ese ini e hamaorogu toma: Aola, gima tauna bavatoa; e itaiamu ḡauna na baine gwauraia hedinarai.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

motu: Gui taudia baine itadia, hosi-gui taudia rarua rarua amo, bona doniki-gui taudia bona kamelo-gui taudia danu; una negana ai baine hakala balaheni, baine hakala balaheni-balaheni.
english: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

motu: Bena e roharoha tauna na e boi lolo, eto: Ḡaubada e, gima kohorona ai na ginimu, dina idoinai; bona egu gima gabuna ai na hegimamu, hanuaboi idoidiai.
english: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

motu: A itaia, gui taudia na e maimu, hosi-gui taudia, rarua rarua amo. Bena ia na e haere, eto: Babulono vada e moru, vada e moru; ena dirava laulaudia iboudiai na ia ese vada e huaridia kohi tano ai.
english: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

motu: Bamogu e, e kwadimu bona e tapomu taumu e, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, ena amo vada na kamonai ḡauna na oi na hahedinarai henimumu. Maduna metauna Duma latanai
english: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

motu: Maduna metauna Duma latanai: Ta ese Seiri amo e boi henigumu, e tomu: Gima taumu, hanuaboi be edeheto? Gima taumu, hanuaboi be edeheto?
english: The burden of Dumah. One calls|strong="H7121" * to|strong="H8104" * me|strong="H7121" * out|strong="H4100" * of|strong="H4853" * Seir|strong="H8165" *, “ Watchman|strong="H8104" *, what|strong="H4100" * of|strong="H4853" * the|strong="H8104" * night|strong="H3915" *? Watchman|strong="H8104" *, what|strong="H4100" * of|strong="H4853" * the|strong="H8104" * night|strong="H3915" *?”

motu: Gima tauna e tomu: Daba na e maimu, a hanuaboi danu ma bainema; bema henanadai o uramu, vada ba henanadai, ma ba lou mai. Maduna metauna Arabia latanai
english: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

motu: Maduna metauna Arabia latanai: Dedan laolao hebou oreana taumui e, Arabia uda hedoma-hedomadia lalodiai ba taruha.
english: The burden on Arabia. You|strong="H6152" * will|strong="H3293" * lodge|strong="H3885" * in|strong="H3885" * the|strong="H3885" * thickets|strong="H3293" * in|strong="H3885" * Arabia|strong="H6152" *, you|strong="H6152" * caravans of|strong="H3293" * Dedanites|strong="H1720" *.

motu: Ranu ba mailaia, ranu-mase tauna ba henia; Tema tanona inoholaina taumui e, flaoa bavabia kau, heau-mauri tauna ba hedavarilai henia.
english: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

motu: Badina be dare amo vada e heau, e veria lasi darena amo, e marea pevana amo, bona tuari siahuna amo.
english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada ese ini e hamaorogu toma: Laḡani tamona lalonai, ḡaukara tauna ena gwauhamata laḡanina na heto, Kedara hairaina idoinai baine ore:
english: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

motu: bona Kedara garana bogaragidiai goada taudia edia peva taudia oredia bae gadoi; badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, vada e hereva.
english: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

motu: Maduna metauna mata-hanai kourana latanai:
english: The burden of the valley of vision. What|strong="H4100" * ails you|strong="H3588" * now|strong="H3588" *, that|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * have|strong="H3605" * all|strong="H3605" * gone|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" * to|strong="H5927" * the|strong="H3605" * housetops|strong="H1406" *?

motu: Heloḡo-heloḡo hanuana, moale hisidae hanuana, o lalo heboumu taumui e! Emui lalo-hadai be dahaka, bena vada o dae, iboumui ai ruma guhidia ai vada o dae kau? Emui mase taudia na dare amo asie aladia, eiava tuari ai asie mase.
english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

motu: Emui lohia iboudiai nega tamona vada e heau karoho; asi edia peva taudia ese e abidia mauri. E davarimui taumui, ena be haida e heau daudau, to iboumui ai e abimui mauri.
english: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

motu: Taunabunai lau nato: Basio haḡeregu, baina tai lalo dika; egu bese hane-ulatona vada e habuaia tari, taugu ihalona basio gugulaia.
english: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, na mai ena dina, heloḡo-heloḡo bona raka gurudia bona daradara dinana mata-hanai kourana lalonai, magu iḡiḡi-dobidia bona ororo ilolo-henidia dinana.
english: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

motu: Elam ese diba pauana e abia kau, bona Aram na hosi ai e gui, bona Kiri ese kesi e abia heḡaeḡae.
english: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

motu: Emu koura namo-hereadia na kariota ese e hahonudia, bona hosi-gui taudia na ikoukou ai e gini.
english: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

motu: Ia ese Iuda ena maḡu vada e abia oho. Una dina ai, tuari ḡaudia Uda Rumana lalonai o haḡeredia;
english: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

motu: bona David ena hanua maḡuna o itaia, gabu momo vada e heḡiḡi dobi; bona henu gohuna ranudia o haboudia;
english: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

motu: bona Ierusalem rumadia o duahidia, bena ruma na o haheḡiḡidia dobi, maḡu iha-aukana totona.
english: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

motu: Ranu ihabouna gabunana maḡu ruaosi padadiai o karaia, gohu gunana ranuna ihabouna. A ikarana tauna asio haḡerea, bona idau nega ai e laloa hata tauna na asio kamonai henia.
english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.

motu: Una dina ai Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, ese e boi henidia, bae taitai bona bae lalo hisihisi, kwaradia bae nau bona puse dabuadia bae rio.
english: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;

motu: To, a itaia, moale bona hisi-dae, boromakau bona mamoe ialadia, vamu ianina bona vine ranuna i'inuna. “Aita aniani bona aita inuinu, badina be kerukeru baita mase.”
english: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

motu: Iehova Sabaota ese vada e hahedinarai henigu, taiagu ai vada e hereva, eto: Ina emui kara havara na basine hegwau tao ela bona ba mase. Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, na unu e gwau tomamu. Eliakimi ese Sebna gabuna baine abia
english: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Ḡaubada. Iehova Sabaota, ini e gwau tomamu: Aoma, hari rum; ireguna tauna Sebna dekena baola, ba hamaoroa, baoto:
english: The Lord, Yahweh of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

motu: Gara na ata gabuna ai vada o ḡeiamu bona emu noho gabuna na haga-nadina ai o utuamu taumu e, iniseni ai dahaka o karamu, bona iniseni ai daika na dekemu a bena gara gabuna na iniseni ai vada o ḡeia sibomu emu a?
english: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

motu: Goada taumu e, a itaia, Iehova ese baine negemu daure mai dagedagena ida. Ia ese baine dabaimu tao,
english: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

motu: bena baine davemu heḡeḡe-heḡeḡe, bolo na heto, tano mai lababana lalonai; unuseni ai ba mase, bona unuseni ai emu kariota, ḡoeva-daedia bae mia, biagumu ena ruma ihahemaraina taumu e!
english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.

motu: Emu dagi amo baina dorimu lasi, emu ḡaukara gabuna amo ba henege dobi.
english: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

motu: Una dina ai, lau ese egu hesiai tauna Eliakim Hilkia baina boiria,
english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

motu: oiemu dabua amo baina hadabualaia, oiemu gaba ḡauna amo baina ḡeḡelaia, bona oiemu siahu na ia imana ai baina atoa. Bena ia na Ierusalem inoholaina taudia bona Iuda iduhuna taudia tamadia ai bainela.
english: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

motu: David ena ruma kina na ia paḡana ai baina atoa; ia ese baine kehoa, bena ta ese basine koua; ia ese baine koua, bena ta ese basine kehoa.
english: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

motu: Ikoko e kokoa kaumu na heto baina kokoa kau, gabu aukana ai; bena ia na hairai teronona ai bainela, tamana ena iduhu lalonai.
english: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

motu: Tamana ena iduhu metauna idoinai na ienai baine hetau dae, garana bona vevena idoinai, uda-uda ḡaudia maraḡidia iboudiai, kebere amo e dae ela bona bio iboudiai.
english: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Una dina ai gabu aukana ai e kokoa kau ikokona baine heraḡa; bena bae utua dobi, bena baine moru; bena ia latanai e miava madunana baine henege daure, badina be Iehova vada e hereva.
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”

motu: Maduna metauna Turo latanai: Tarasisi lagatoidia e, ba taitai; badina be Turo vada e havahua, asi rumana bona asi hetu gabuna. Kupro tanona amo vada e hahedinarai henidia.
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl|strong="H3213" *, you|strong="H3588" * ships of|strong="H1004" * Tarshish|strong="H8659" *! For|strong="H3588" * it|strong="H3588" * is|strong="H1004" * laid|strong="H1540" * waste|strong="H7703" *, so|strong="H3588" * that|strong="H3588" * there is|strong="H1004" * no house|strong="H1004" *, no entering in|strong="H1004" *. From|strong="H1540" * the|strong="H3588" * land of|strong="H1004" * Kittim|strong="H3794" * it|strong="H3588" * is|strong="H1004" * revealed|strong="H1540" * to|strong="H1004" * them|strong="H1540" *.

motu: Kone taumui e, eremui! Sidono hoihoi taumui e, eremui! Emui gwaukau taudia na gadobada e hanaia,
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.

motu: davara idau-idau momo ai e laolao; emui habou-habou ḡaudia na Sihoro uitina, bona Nilo tanona anianidia; umui na bese idau-idau edia hoihoi taudia.
english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

motu: Sidono e, ba hemarai; badina be davara vada e hereva, davara ena gabu aukana vada e hereva, eto: Asina hekamonai, bona asina mara; uhau asina ubudia bona ulato rami-heboudia asina regudia.
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

motu: Ina hari na Aigupto ai baine kau negana ai, lalodia bae hisihisi herea, Turo harina dainai.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

motu: Tarasisi enai ba hanai; kone taumui e, ba taitai!
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

motu: O moalelaia hisi dae hanuana, nega gunadia ai e hadaia hanuana, aena amo ela bona gabu daudau ai ma e noho hanuana binai a?
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

motu: Turo, havava ḡaudia ihenidia hanuana; ena kohu-hoi taudia na lolohia, ena hoihoi taudia na tanobada ese e heatolaidiamu; daika ese ia ihadikana na ini e lalo hadailaia tomamu?
english: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?

motu: Iehova Sabaota ese e lalo hadailaia, e heaḡilaiamu hairaina idoinai baine hamiroa totona, tanobada ai e matauraidiamu taudia iboudiai baine hahemaraidia totona.
english: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

motu: Tarasisi hahinemu e, emu tano ba da'ania, Nilo sinavaina na heto; asi ilao-ahumu dalana ta mia.
english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

motu: Ia ese imana vada e toia roro, davara daenai; basileia vada e haheude heudedia. Iehova vada e haheḡani Kanaan dainai, ena gabu aukadia bae habuadia tari.
english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

motu: Ia eto: Sidono hane-ulato rami-hebouna e, e hahisimumu kekenimu e, basio moale hisi dae lou. A tore isi, Kupro enai ba hanai, a unuseni ai danu basio laḡa ani diba.
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

motu: Kaldea tanona a itaia; besena bunai, dia Asuria. Turo na uda boromadia edia gabu ai bae halaoa eto. Idia ese tano na hanuana e lareba henia: ena lohia rumadia e haheḡiḡidia dobi, bona hanuana e habuaia tari.
english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

motu: Tarasisi lagatoidia e, a taitai; badina be emu gabu aukana vada e havahua.
english: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

motu: Una dina ai, Turo na bae laloa boio ela bona laḡani hitu-ahui bae? ore, hanua pavapavana ta ena nega heḡereḡerena. Bena laḡani hitu-ahui dokona ai, kara ta Turo enai baine vara, ariara hahinena anena lalonai na heto:
english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

motu: Ariara hahinemu e, vada e lalomu boio. Gitara avabia, hanua lalonai ba loa eva-eva; ba hataia gaiho-gaiho, ane momo bavabi, bae lalomu tao helaoreana.
english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

motu: Laḡani hitu-ahui dokona ai, Iehova ese Turo baine vadivadi heni? bena ena hehoi-nege karana baine lou henia, bona basileia iboudiai tanobada kopina ai ediai baine hehoi nege.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

motu: Ena hoihoi ḡaudia bona davana na baine hahelaḡadia, Iehova ena; basine haboudia bona basine gogosidia; a ena hoih? ḡaudia ese Iehova vairanai e nohomu taudia na bae ubudia bona bae hadabua-laidia aniani momo bona dabua namo-hereadia danu.
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

motu: A itaia, Iehova ese tanobada baine havahua, tano ḡaḡaena ai baine halaoa; ia ese tano kopina baine harigika-rigikaia, bona inoholaina taudia baine hakarohodia rohoroho.
english: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

motu: Hanua taudia ediai baine vara heḡereḡerena ai, hahelaḡa tauna enai danu; bona hesiai tauna enai heḡereḡerena ai, biaguna enai danu; bona hesiai kekenina enai heḡereḡerena ai, biaguna hahinena enai danu; bona kohu e hoiamu tauna enai heḡereḡerena ai, davana e abiamu tauna enai danu; bona heni-doa tauna enai heḡereḡerena ai, abi-doa tauna enai danu; bona heni-torehai tauna enai heḡereḡerena ai, abi-torehai tauna enai danu.
english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

motu: Tanobada na baine havahua vaitani bona baine habuaia tari ḡuḡuru, badina be Iehova ese ina hereva vada e gwauraia.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.

motu: Tanobada na e taitaimu bona e maraimu, tanobada na e hisihisimu bona e maraimu, guba bona tanobada na e hisihisi heboumu.
english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

motu: Tanobada na vada e miro, inoholaina taudia daidiai; badina be idia ese taravatu vada e tata utu, bona hahedua herevadia vada e hadikadia, bona mia-hanaihanai gwauhamatana vada e dadaraia.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

motu: Una dainai heuduguirai ese tanobada e hadonoamu, bona inohoiaina taudia na edia kara dika daidiai e hisihisimu; una dainai tanobada inoholaina taudia na lahi ese e aradiamu, bona kwabukwabudia mo e nohomu.
english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.

motu: Vine ranuna e taitaimu, vine auna e hisihisimu, lalodia e moaleva taudia na e ḡanaḡanamu.
english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

motu: Tareko reḡedia vada e ore, hisi-dae taudia eredia vada e doko, gitara moalena vada e ore.
english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

motu: Vine ranuna i'inuna ai ane asie abimu; kekero ḡauna vada e idita, i'inuna taudia ediai.
english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

motu: Hanua asi oromana na vada eme heḡiḡi dobi; ruma iboudiai vada eme hekou, tau ta basine raka vareai helaoreana.
english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

motu: Ariara ai e heloḡo-heloḡo, vine-ranuna lasi dainai; moale idoinai e vaburamu, tanobada moalena vada e puki oho.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

motu: Hanua na vada e habuaia tari; ikoukou na vada e hamakohidia rohoroho.
english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

motu: Badina be tanobada bogaraginai unu baine vara toma, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, olive auna e ureamu negana na heto, eiava vine anidia e habou vaitanimu bena momorudia e gogomu negana na heto.
english: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

motu: Ane e lada isimu, moale dainai ane e abimu; lahara kahana amo Iehova hairaina e heatolaiamu.
english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.

motu: Una dainai laurabada kahana ai Iehova ba imodaia, bona kone tanodia ai danu Iehova, Israel Diravana, ladana ba imodaia.
english: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

motu: Hahenamo anedia ta kamonaimu, tanobada dokodia amo e maimu, heimodai anedia, Kara Maoromaoro Diravana ena. A lau na tomamu “Daragu e doko e laomu, daragu e doko e laomu, madi, ihabaigu; badina be kara dibaka taudia na e kara dibakamu; oibe, kara dibaka taudia na e kara dika hereamu.”

english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

motu: Tanobada na e makohi rohorohomu, tanobada na e hedare pararamu, tanobada na e heude-heude dikadikamu.
english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

motu: Tanobada na e raragamu, kekero tauna na heto; e marere-mareremu, kalaga na heto. Ena kara dika na metau, ia latanai e miamu; ia na e morumu, basine tore isi lou.
english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

motu: Una dina ai, Iehova ese dika davana baine henidia, guba oreana guba ai, bona tanobada pavapavadia tanobada ai.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

english: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

english: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.

motu: Iehova e, oi na egu Dirava; baina imodaimu, oi ladamu baina hanamoa; badina be oi ese kara hereadia vada o kara, gunaguna o lalo hatalai karadia, heabidadama karadia bona kara momokanidia.
english: Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

english: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

english: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.

motu: Una dina ai, idia na baeto: A itaia, ina na eda Dirava; vada ta naria, baine hamaurida helaoreana. Ina na Iehova; vada ta naria; baita moale, ena hahenamo baita moalelaia.
