motu: Badina be, a itaia, Iehova na ena gabu amo e raka lasimu, tanobada inoholaina taudia edia dika davadia baine henidia totona; tanobada ese ia latanai vada e hebubu rarana na baine hahedinaraia, bona ena mase taudia basine ḡovadia ahu lou.
english: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The|strong="H5921" * earth also|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H3068" * disclose|strong="H1540" * her|strong="H1540" * blood|strong="H1818" *, and|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H3068" * no|strong="H3808" * longer|strong="H5750" * cover|strong="H3680" * her|strong="H1540" * slain|strong="H2026" *.

motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese ena dare aukana bona badana bona goadana amo Leviathan *, e rau laomu gaigaina, Leviathan *, e veromu gaigaina, davana baine henia; bona davara hualana na baine alaia mase.
english: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

motu: Una dina ai, vine imeana namo-hereana anena bavabia.
english: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

motu: Lau Iehova na ia ireḡuna, nega idoinai na dairiamu. Hanuaboi ai bona dina ai na gimaiamu, ta ese bema hadikaia na garina;
english: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

motu: lau na asi egu badu. Au ginigini bona ava ḡiniḡini bema mia, lau ese bama tuari henidia; ihadikadia totona bama tore isi, bama doudia ore.
english: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

motu: Eiava egu hegima lalonai bema vareai, lau ida baiama herohemaino, lau ida baiama herohemaino.
english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

motu: Dina gabedia ai, Iakob ramuna baine hekara, Israel baine gara kau, tuhutuhuna na bae tubu, huahuana na tanobada idoinai bae hahonua.
english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

motu: Vada e rahudia mase, irahu-masedia taudia e rahudia mase heḡereḡerena a? Eiava vada e aladia mase, iala-masedia taudia e aladia mase heḡereḡerena a?
english: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

motu: Taidia taidia amo dauhai iatodia ai o heai henidia; ena lai goadana amo e odadia oho, laurabada e toa dinana ai.
english: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

motu: Taunabunai, ini amo Iakob ese ena kerere baine davalaia, ena dika iabi-ohona anina momokanina binai: ia ese ihaboulaina patadia nadidia iboudiai na nadi maḡiḡidia, vada e makohi sisisisi ḡaudia, heḡereḡeredia ai baine halaodia; bona Asera ena au-tubua ta eiava muramura mai bonadia patana ta basine hamiaia.
english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.

motu: Badina be hanua mai maḡuna vada e ḡaḡae, ruma ahutuna, vada e rakatania ḡauna, na heto, eiava tano ḡaḡaena na heto. Boromakau natuna unuseni ai e anianimu, unuseni ai e hekuremu, rigi raudia e animu.
english: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

motu: Rigi e kaukaumu e kwaidumu negana ai, hahine na e maimu, edia au rakuraku ai e halaodiamu. Badina be ina bese taudia na asi edia lalo-parara, taunabunai ikaradia Diravana ese basine bogadia hisi, bona oromadia e henidia Diravana ese basine lalo namo henidia.
english: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

motu: Una dina ai, Iehova ese uit baine kwadia, Eufrate sinavaina amo ela bona Aigupto Dokana. Bona umui, Israel taumui e, umui na ta ta amo baine haboumui kau.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

motu: Una dina ai, kibi badana bae hiriria; bena Asuria tanona ai e boio taudia bona Aigupto tanona e luludia lao taudia na baema, Ierusalem ena ororo tubuana ai Iehova bae toma henia diho.
english: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

motu: Efraim ena kekero taudia kwaradia ihavavalaidia ḡaudia na hekokoroku; madi, ihabaidia! Vine ranuna e inu kekeromu taudia edia koura namona kwarakauna, ihahairaina ḡauna na e maraimu heraherana, madi, ihabaina!
english: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

motu: A itaia, Ḡaubada enai ta na mai siahuna bona mai goadana; medu-hetarina na heto, lai-gubana mai hahebua-tari na heto, sinavai abatana e aru goadagoadamu na heto; ia ese tano ai baine negea dobi mai daḡedaḡena ida.
english: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

motu: Efraim ena kekero taudia kwaradia ihavavalaidia heaḡina na aedia henudiai bae moia tao;
english: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

motu: Bona ia hairaina heraherana, koura namona kwarakauna ai e maraimu ḡauna, na suke huahuana ta, huahua negana do se kau ai e mage gunamu ḡauna, na heto; ta ta ese e itaiamu, bena imana ai e abiamu negana ai e ania haraḡamu.
english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

motu: Una dina ai, Iehova Sabaota na kwara-havava ḡauna mai hairaina ai bainela, bona herahera ḡauna herea-daena danu, ena bese taudia kwabukwabudia edia;
english: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,

motu: hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva laumana ai bainela, hahemaoro tauna enai, bona goada ai bainela, tuari na hanua ikoukouna amo e halouamu taudia ediai. Ierusalem isisiba-henina
english: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

motu: Ini danu vine ranuna dainai e laigo-laigomu, kekero ḡauna dainai e raragamu: hahelaḡa tauna bona peroveta tauna na kekero ḡauna dainai e laigolaigomu; vine ranuna dainai lalodia e heḡonumu, kekero ḡauna dainai e raragamu; matadia e madai-madaimu, hahemaoro ikarana ai e gwau rea gwau reamu.
english: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

motu: Badina be pata iboudiai na mumuta ai e honumu, bona asi mirona gabuna ta dia mia.
english: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

motu: Ia ese aonega na daika baine hadibalaia? Ia ese gwaukau herevana anina na daika baine hamaorolaia? Rata vada e dadaraia memerodia a? Sinadia kemedia amo vada e abidia oho memerodia a?
english: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

motu: Badina be taidia taidia amo bae hadibadia; sidia sidia taidia taidia amo, iniseni ai taina, unuseni ai taina.
english: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

motu: Lasi, idau mala taudia edia amo, bona idau gado taudia edia amo, Iehova ese ina bese baine hereva henia.
english: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,

motu: Ia ese vada e hamaorodia, eto “Ina na laḡa-ani, tau-boera taudia na laḡadia ba ha-ani; ina na doru-heu”. Ḡau tamona, idia na asie ura bae kamonai.
english: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ena hereva idia ediai na taidia taidia amo; sidia sidia taidia taidia amo, iniseni ai taina, unuseni ai taina. Idia na baela, bae hekidaera; bae hehuari, bae he-idoa, bena bae abidia.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

motu: Taunabunai, umui heḡonaḡonalai taumui, Ierusalem ai ina bese o lohiaiamu taumui, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

motu: Badina be umui oto: Ai na mase ida vada a gwauhamata heheni, bona Mase Gabuna ida vada a herohemaino; una dainai hahedika na abata na heto baine utu utu dae neganai, to ia na ai emai ai basine kau; badina be koikoi na emai roho-mauri gabuna ai vada a halaoa, bona koikoi herevadia ai vada a hemetaimu.
english: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. + 28:15 Sheol is the place of the dead. * When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, Siona ai badi ta na atoamu; nadi ta, e tohoa nadina, daiguni nadina ḡoeva-daena, badi nadina momokanina. Baine abia dae tauna basine haraḡa-haraḡa.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

motu: Hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva na hahetoho varona ai baina halaoa, bona kara maoromaoro na gini-maoro varona ai baina halaoa; bena koikoi ai o roho maurimu gabuna na medu-hetari ese baineha-arua oho, bona abata ese hemetai gabuna baine utua dae.
english: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

motu: Bena emui gwauhamata, mase ida, baine heḡiḡi rohoroho; bona emui herohemaino, Mase Gabuna ida, basine gini; bena hahedika na abata na heto baine utu utu dae negana ai, ia ese baine habubunimui.
english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol + 28:18 Sheol is the place of the dead. * shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

motu: Baine utu utu dae negadia iboudiai na baine abimui; badina be daba ta ta amo baine utu utu dae, dina ai bona hanuaboi ai danu, bena gwaukau herevana anina idavarina na mai gari-badana.
english: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

motu: Badina be mahuta ḡauna na kwadogi, hekure tauna basine hetoi roro; bona hetaru na iora, hetaru tauna basine hetaru namonamo.
english: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

motu: Badina be Iehova baine tore-isi, Perasimi ororona ai heḡereḡerena; bona baine badu, Gibeon kourana ai heḡereḡerena; ena kara ikarana totona (ena kara na idau), ena ḡaukara ikarana totona (ena ḡaukara na idau).
english: For Yahweh will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

motu: Taunabunai, basio ḡonaḡona, iḡuimui baine ha-aukadia na g=arina; badina be hahebua-tari e hahedualaia herevana vada na kamonai. Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, ena amo, tano idoinai latanai.
english: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, on the whole earth.

motu: Taiamui a hakiraradia, gadogu a kamonai; a hakala, egu hereva a kamonai.
english: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

motu: Hadohado totona tano e ruaiamu tauna ese e ruaia louloumu a? Ena tano e ruaia louloumu bona e gaua louloumu a?
english: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

motu: Tano kopina vada e hamanadaia negana ai, ia ese aniani avadia e hadomu; bona uit danu ere ta ta ai, bona bali ena gabu korikori ai, bona rae uma isedia ai, ani?
english: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

motu: Badina be vada e hadibaia maoromaoro; ena Dirava ese e hadibaiamu.
english: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.

motu: Aniani avadia na uit ikwadilaina auna amo asie kwadidiamu, eiava rerue ava-keikeina na idia latadiai asie keia hanaimu; a au maraḡina amo e kwadidiamu, au severa-severana amo e kwadidiamu.
english: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.

motu: Flaoa ikaralaina uitina e ririamu a? Lasi, se kwadia louloumu. Ena rerue ava-keikeina na hosi ese ia latanai e veria hanaimu, a se ririamu.
english: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

motu: Ina danu Iehova Sabaota ena amo e maimu; hahealo ai ia na namo herea, bona aonega ai ia na herea dae.
english: This also comes out from Yahweh of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

motu: Ariele + 29:1 “Ariele” na Ierusalem ladana ta. * e, Ariele e! David ese e noholaia hanuana e! Laḡani ta laḡani ta murina amo bainema, aria na edia nega ta ta ai bae hekara.
english: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

motu: A Ariele baina hahisihisia, bae ḡanaḡana, bae tai lolololo; ia na ihaboulaina patana rahurahuna heḡereḡerena ai bainela lauegu ai.
english: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth. + 29:2 or, Ariel *

motu: Lau ese baina hataruhamu heḡeḡe, kohoro amo baina hadaimu ahu, bona tano baina larebaia, oi ihadikamu.
english: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

motu: Bena tano lalona amo ba hereva, ḡahu lalona amo emu hereva bainema; oi gadomu na tano lalona amo bainema, laulau gadona na heto: oi eremu na ḡahu amo baine hemaunu.
english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

motu: Inaimu bae hutuma, tano ḡahuḡahuna na heto; bona asi edia hebogahisi taudia bae hutuma, uit momorudia lai ese e oda ohomu na heto. Bena davadavana ai
english: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

motu: Iehova Sabaota ese baine vadivadi henimu taku, guba-rahu bona tano-laga bona rege-bada ida, bona koe-hirihiri bona lai-gubana bona lahi siahuna hururu-hururunaida.
english: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

motu: Bena Ariele e tuari heniamu besedia loḡora iboudiai, ia bona ena gabu aukana e tuari henidiamu bona e hahisihisidiamu besedia iboudiai, na nihi eiava hanuaboi mata-hanaina heḡereḡerena ai baela.
english: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

motu: Hitolo tauna na heto, e nihimu bena ena nihi ai e anianimu, a mai hitolona ida e nogamu; eiava ranu-mase tauna na heto, e nihimu bena ena nihi ai ranu e inumu, a mai manorina bona mai ranu-masena ida e nogamu, Siona ororona e tuari heniamu besedia loḡora iboudiai na unu mo bae heto. Israel ena mata-kepulu bona ena koikoi
english: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

motu: Sibomui ba hahekavakava, bena mai kavakavamui ida ba noho; sibomui matamui ba hakepulu, bena mai mata-kepulumui ida banoho. Ba kekero, a dia vine-ranuna dainai; ba raraga, a dia kekero ḡauna dainai.
english: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

motu: Badina be Iehova ese mahuta-hedavauhe laumana na latamui ai vadae seia kau; peroveta taudia matadia vada e hakapudia, emui mata-hanai taudia kwaradia vada e ḡovadia ahu.
english: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

motu: Ina mata-hanai idoinai na vada e koua ahu bukana herevadia heḡereḡeredia ai vada ela, emui ai. Taunimanima ese duahia-duahi mai dibana tauna ta e heniamu, e tomu “Ina na a duahia”, negana ai, ia na e tomu “Basina duahia diba, badina be vada e hekou ahu”.
english: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”

motu: Bena buka na asi duahi-duahi dibana tauna ta e heniamu, e tomu “Ina na a duahia”, negana ai, ia na e tomu “Duahi-duahi asi dibagu”.
english: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”

motu: Bena Ḡaubada eto: Badina be ina bese taudia na mai udu-herevadia ida mo e rakahenigu kahimu, bona bibinadia amo mo e imodaigumu, a lalodia na dauhai; bona taunimanima edia haheḡani mo e abia dae kavamu dainai, idia ese lau garigu e garimu.
english: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese hoa karadia badadia ma baina kara lou ina bese enai; hoa karadia, hoa bada karadia; bona edia aonega taudia edia aonega baine ore vaitani, bona edia lalo-parara taudia edia lalo-parara baine hehuni.
english: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”

motu: Edia hahealo na Iehova ena amo e hunia balahenimu taudia, madi ihabaidia! Edia kara dika na dibura ai e karamu, e tomu, Daika ese e itadamu? Daika ese e dibadamu?
english: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”

motu: Umui ese ḡau o karuhi hebubumu! Uro ikarana tauna na raro bae gwauraia a? E karaia ḡauna ese ikarana tauna baine herevalaia, baineto “Ia ese asine karagu”, a? Eiava oromana e henia ḡauna ese oromana ihenina tauna baine herevalaia, baineto “Ia na asi ena lalo-parara”, a? Israel ihamaurina
english: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?

motu: Asi vanahana Lebanon na uma mai anina ai bainela; bona uma mai anina na imea bae gwauraia, ani?
english: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

motu: Una dina ai, taia-kudima taudia ese buka herevadia bae kamonaidia, bona vaburadia bona diburadia amo matakepulu taudia matadia ese ḡau bae ita.
english: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

motu: Manau taudia ese moale matamatana na Iehova enai bae abia; bona ogoḡami taudia ese Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana bae moalelaia bada.
english: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

motu: Badina be asi edia hebogahisi taudia na bae baia, bona ḡonaḡona taudia na bae doko; bona kara dika ikaradia daladia e tahumu taudia iboudiai na bae negedia daure.
english: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

motu: Idia ese hereva tamona amo tau ta na kerere tauna ai e halaoamu, bona hanua ikoukouna ai e hahemaoromu tauna na e idoaiamu, bona hereva asi anina amo kara maoromaoro tauna na e hakaua sirimu.
english: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

motu: Taunabunai, Abraham e hamauria Diravana ese Iakob ena iduhu na ini e herevalaia tomamu: Iakob na basine hemarai lou; ia vairana na basine ḡeḡeva lou.
english: Therefore Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

motu: Badina be natuna, lau imagu ese e karadia taudia, na bogaraginai baine itadia negana ai, idia ese lau ladagu bae hahelaḡaia; Iakob ena Helaḡa Diravana bae hahelaḡaia, Israel ena Dirava magigina bae magigi.
english: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

motu: Bena lalodia e kereremu taudia na lalodia do bae parara, bona e maumaumu taudia ese hahediba herevadia bae abi dae.
english: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Gwau-edeede memerodia madi ihabaidia! Idia edia lalo-hata karadia e karamu na dia lauegu; e henega boumu, to dia lau laumagu ai; unu amo kara dika na kara dika latanai e atoa kaumu.
english: “Woe to the rebellious children”, says Yahweh, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;

motu: Idia vada e tore isi, Aigupto baela e tomu, a lauegu hahealo asie tahua; Farao ena hegima lalonai bae roho mauri, bona Aigupto ikerukeruna ai edia hemetai gabuna bae tahua e tomu
english: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

motu: Taunabunai Farao ena hegima na ihahemaraimui ḡauna, bona Aigupto ikerukeruna hemetaina ese baine hahemaraimui bada.
english: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

motu: Badina be, ena be ena heitatao taudia na Soan ai, bona ena gwaukau taudia na Hane ai vada e kau,
english: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

motu: to iboudiai na hemarai ese e abidiamu, basine hadavalaidia diba besena dainai; una bese ese se kahadiamu bona se hadavalaidiamu, a hemarai bona hedadarai mo latadiai e hadihomu.
english: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

motu: Maduna metauna diho kahana boromadia latadiai: Hekwarahi bona hisihisi-bada tanona, leona hahinena bona leona maruanena edia tano, hekori gaigaina bona roho gaigaina edia tano amo, idia ese edia taḡa ḡaudia na doniki dorudia ai e laohaimu, bona dava-bada kohudia na kamelo dorudia ai, basine hadavalaidia lou diba besena taudia dekedia.
english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * land of|strong="H5971" * trouble|strong="H6869" * and|strong="H5971" * anguish|strong="H6869" *, of|strong="H5971" * the|strong="H5921" * lioness|strong="H3833" * and|strong="H5971" * the|strong="H5921" * lion|strong="H3833" *, the|strong="H5921" * viper and|strong="H5971" * fiery|strong="H8314" * flying|strong="H5774" * serpent|strong="H8314" *, they|strong="H1992" * carry|strong="H5375" * their|strong="H5375" * riches|strong="H2428" * on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * shoulders|strong="H3802" * of|strong="H5971" * young|strong="H3833" * donkeys|strong="H5895" *, and|strong="H5971" * their|strong="H5375" * treasures on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * humps|strong="H1707" * of|strong="H5971" * camels|strong="H1581" *, to|strong="H5921" * an|strong="H5375" * unprofitable people|strong="H5971" *.

motu: Badina be Aigupto ena hekaha na asi namona bona asi anina, una dainai ladana vada na hatoa; “Rahaba + 30:7 “Rahaba” na Heberu taudia edia gori ḡauna ta, gadobada ai e nohova ḡauna, ladana. * e helai kavamu”.
english: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.

motu: Aola, huro-nadina palaka-palakana ai ba torea, idia vairadiai, bona buka lalonai danu ba torea; bena nega vairai ia na ihamomokanina ḡauna ai bainela, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

motu: Badina be idia na gwau-edeede besena, koikoi memerodia, Iehova ena hahediba herevadia ikamonaidia asie uramu memerodia.
english: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;

motu: Idia ese mata-hanai taudia e hamaorodiamu, e tomu, Basio mata hanai; bona peroveta taudia e hamaorodiamu, e tomu, Hereva maoromaorodia basio perovetalai henimai; hereva gaihodia mo ba hamorolaimai, bona lalomai ikoidia herevadia ba perovetalai;
english: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

motu: dala ba rakatania, dala amo ba raka oho, Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana herevana basia kamonai lou.
english: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be ina hereva o dadaraiamu, bona hahehisi karadia bona kara gageva-gagevadia o abidadama henidiamu bona ediai o taomu;
english: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it,

motu: una dainai ina kara havara na emui ai baine vara, hara-lata maḡuna e heḡiḡi dobimu na heto; e pavamu ela bona heḡiḡi-dobina e kahira-kahiramu, bena negana e kaumu ai, nega tamona ai e heḡiḡi dobi takumu;
english: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

motu: eiava uro e makohimu na heto; e makohi rohorohomu, e makohi patapatamu, ela bona atagana ta se miamu, gida iudalaina heḡereḡerena, eiava ranu ikadolaina heḡereḡerena.
english: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova, Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana, ini e gwau tomamu: Emui lou ai bona emui laḡa-ani ai ba mauri; bona maino ai bona heabidadama ai goada ba davaria. A umui na asio ura,
english: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

motu: oto “Lasi, hosi ai baia heau”; taunabunai ba heau oho haraḡa; ma oto “Hosi mai heaudia latadiai baia gui”; taunabunai, ihahavamui taudia na bae heau haraḡa-haraḡa.
english: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

motu: Taunimanima daha-ta bae heau, tau tamona ese baine halalaḡadia dainai; bona tatau laima ese bae halalaḡamui dainai umui na ba heau; ela bona ba noho, au-tubua ta ororo dorina ai eiava pepe ta ororo ai na heto. Dirava ena gwauhamata ena bese taudia edia
english: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

motu: Taunabunai Iehova na e henarimu, baine hanamomui e tomamu; taunabunai ia na e tore isimu, baine bogamui hisi e tomamu. Badina be Iehova na hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva Diravana; ia e nariamu taudia iboudiai na nanamo.
english: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

motu: Oibe, Siona taumui, Ierusalem ai o nohomu taumui, umui na basio taitai lou. Momokani, emui taitai reḡena dainai ia ese baine hanamomui; baine kamonai negana ai baine haere henimui.
english: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

motu: Ena be Ḡaubada ese hahedika anianina bona hahehisi ranuna baine henimui, to emui Hahediba Tauna na basine komu lou, a matamui ese emui Hahediba Tauna bae itaia.
english: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;

motu: Bona idibamui kahana ai eiava laurimui kahana ai ba raka siri negana ai, taiamui na hereva ta murimui kahana amo bae kamonai, baineto, Dalana binai, ia lalonai ba raka.
english: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

motu: Bena emui kaivakuku, e korodia bena silver * amo e ḡovadia ḡaudia, bona e hahetaridia bena gold * amo e ḡovadia ḡaudia, na ba hamirodia. Ba ḡiḡidia rohoroho, ḡau mirodia na heheto. Ba hamaorodia, baoto, A siri.
english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

motu: Bena ia ese medu baine henimui, tano ai ba hado uhedia idairidia, bona uit danu, tano anidia, bae namo bona bae momo. Una dina ai emui boromakau na rei gabudia badadia ai bae aniani;
english: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

motu: bona boromakau mamaruanedia bona doniki, tano e ruaiamu ḡaudia, ese aniani mai damenana bae ania, gaga bona igau amo vada e hididia ḡaudia.
english: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

motu: Ororo badadia bona ororo latadia iboudiai latadiai sinavai maraḡidia bae aru diho, ala-alabadana dinana ai, kohoro bae heḡiḡi dobi negana ai.
english: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

motu: Ina danu, hua diarina na dina diarina heḡereḡerena ai bainela, bona dina diarina na baine habadaia hahitu, dina hitu diaridia heḡereḡeredia, Iehova ese ena bese taudia edia hisi gabudia baine kumidia bona ena hebota amo vada e havaradia berodia baine hanamodia dinana ai. Iehova ena hahemaoro Asuria latanai
english: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

motu: A itaia, Iehova ladana na dauha amo e maimu; ena badu e garagaramu, bona kwalahuna e dae badabadamu. Ia bibinana na badu ai e honumu, bona malana na e heara oremu lahina na heto;
english: Behold, Yahweh’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.

motu: ia lagana na sinavai abatana na heto, e utu daemu ela bona taunimanima aiodia. Basileia idau-idau na hahebua-tari amo baine hididia, bona bese idau-idau aukidia ai ihakau-kereredia ḡauna baine atoa.
english: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

motu: Ane ta bavabia, aria helaḡana e karaiamu hanuaboina ai na heto; bona lalomui bae moale mai ivilikou reḡena ida, Iehova ena ororo, Israel nadi-ginina, ilao-henina totona e tore isimu negana ai na heto.
english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to Yahweh’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

motu: BenaIehova ese ia gadona herea-daena baine hakamonaidia bona ia imana ehadihoamu hebotana baine haheitalaidia, mai badu-ḡaraḡarana bona heara-orelahina hururu-hururuna ida, bona mai medu-barokona bona lai-gubana bonamedu-hetarina ida.
english: Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.

motu: Asuria taudia na gari ese baine butudia tao, Iehovagadona dainai, ena au amo baine hebota negana ai.
english: For through Yahweh’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

motu: Iehova ena dava ihenina auna amo baine botadia negana ai, hebota ta ta ai tareko bona gitara reḡedia bae dae; ia na imana irubena amo baine tuari henidia.
english: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

motu: Badina be lahi gabuna na idau nega ai vada e heḡaeḡaelaia; oibe, vada e abia hata, hanua pavapavana ena; vada e hadobua bona lababana vada e habadaia, mai lahina bona au-rakurakuna momo herea ida. Iehova laḡana, heara nadidia e arumu na heto, ese e haraiamu.
english: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, it is prepared for the king. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

motu: Hekaha idavarina totona Aigupto e laomu bona hosi e abidadama henidiamu taudia, madi ihabaidia! Idia ese kariota e abidadama henidiamu, badina be momo; bona hosi-gui taudia danu, badina be gogoada heherea, a Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana asie heḡerea, bona Iehova ena hahealo asie hetahulaia.

english: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem. motu: Israel taumui e, vada o daḡedaḡe henia bada Diravana ma ba lou henia.
english: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

motu: Badina be una dina ai iboumui ai ese emui silver * kaivakukudia bona emui gold * kaivakukudia do ba negedia, hari imamui mai dikadia ese emui vada e kara ḡaudia.
english: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

motu: Bena Asuria tauna na dare ai baine mase, a dia taunimanima edia dare; dare, dia taunimanima ena, ese baine alaia mase; bena dare amo baine heau oho, bona ena eregabe taudia na hahedua ḡaukaradia ai bae haḡaukaradia.
english: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and|strong="H2719" * the|strong="H6440" * sword|strong="H2719" *, not|strong="H3808" * of|strong="H6440" * mankind, shall|strong="H2719" * devour him|strong="H6440" *. motu: King Hesekia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-hanina ai, Senakerib, Asuria pavapavana, ese luda hanuadia mai maḡudia iboudiai e tuari henidia bona e abidia.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

motu: Bena Asuria pavapavana ese Rabsake + 36:2 “Rabsake” na dia tau ta ladana, to ena dagi ladana. * bona tuari, oreana badana ta Lakisi amo e siaidia lao, King Hesekia dekenai, Ierusalem ai. Ia na atai gohuna dadairana badibadinai e gini, Dabua-huri Tauna Ena Tano lao dalana ai.
english: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

motu: Bena Eliakim Hilkia, hanua pavapavana ena ruma ireḡuna tauna, bona Sebna, toretore tauna, bona Ioa Asaf, e tore pepadia inaridia tau, tatoiosi na e raka lasi ia dekenai.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.

motu: Bena Rabsake ese e hereva henidia, eto, Hesekia na ba hamaoroa, baoto, Pavapava badana, Asuria pavapavana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Dahaka o halahalahamu dainai so daradaramu?
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

motu: Oi o laloamu hereva kavakavadia na tuari ihaerolaina bona igoadalaina a? Daika enai o helalo kaumu dainai vada o gwau edeede henigu?
english: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

motu: A itaia, oi na Aigupto enai o helalo kaumu, a ia be siriho kwaiduna tau ta ese hetao-kau ai imana baine gwadaia uru ḡauna na heto. Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, na unuheto, ienai e helalo kaumu taudia iboudiai ediai.
english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

motu: A boma hamaorogu “Ai na Iehova, emai Dirava, enai a helalo kaumu”; matona, iena atai gabudia bona ena ihaboulaina patadia na Hesekia ese vada e abi oho, bona Iuda taudia bona Ierusalem taudia vada e hamaorodia, eto “Ina ihaboulaina patana vairanai ba toma diho”, ani?
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”

motu: Be, biagugu Asuria pavapavana ida ba gwau hamata. Ia e tomu “Lau ese hosi daha-rua baina henimu, bema oi ese gui taudia na latadiai ba hahelaidia kau diba negana ai”.
english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

motu: Aigupto edia kariota bona edia hosi-gui taudia ediai o helalo kaumu negana ai, biagugu ena hesiai taudia bogaragidia amo tuari biaguna maraḡi-maraḡina tamona ma ede ba hadarerea toma?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

motu: Ina danu, oi o tomamu ina gabu ituari-henina bona ihabua-tarina vada nama lalonai Iehova na dia lau ida a? Lasi, Iehova ese e haḡanigu, eto, Ina tano ba tuari henia bona ba habuaia tari.
english: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

motu: Bena Eliakim bona Sebna bona Ioa ese Rabsake e hereva henia, eto, Mani emu kara emu hesiai taudia na Aram gadona ai ba hereva henimai, badina be ikamonaina mai dibamai, a Heberu gadona ai basio hereva henimai, maḡu latanai e helaimu taudia bae kamonai na garina.
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

motu: A Rabsake ese e hamaorodia, eto, Biagugu vada e siaigu, ina hereva na umui biagumui bona umui emui ai mo baina gwaurai totona, dia unu maḡu latanai e helaimu taudia, idia na umui ida vada e ahumui vaitani sibomui tagemui bavani bona meimui ba inu taudia, ediai a?
english: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

motu: Bena Rabsake na e tore isi, Heberu gadona ai e boi lolo, eto, Pavapava badana, Asuria pavapavana, ena hereva a kamonai.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

motu: Pavapava na ini e gwau tomamu: Hesekia ese basine koimui, badina be ia ese basine harohomui mauri diba.
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

motu: Bona Hesekia ese Iehova enai baine hahelalomui kau, baineto “Momokani Iehova ese baine hamaurida; ina hanua na Asuria pavapavana imana ai basine atoa kau”, na basio abia dae.
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

motu: Hesekia basio kamonai henia; badina be Asuria pavapavana na ini e gwau tomamu: umui na lau ida baita herohe maino; lau dekegu ba raka lasi mai. Bena iboumui ai na ta ta ena vine ena vine ena suke ena suke anidia baine ani, bona ena guri ena guri ranuna baine inu;
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;

motu: ela bona lau baina vasi, bena tano ta baina laohaimui, umui emui tano heḡereḡerena, uit bona vine-ranuna tanona, flaoa bona vine imeadia tanona.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, Hesekia ese baine koimui na garina, baineto “Iehova ese baine harohoda mauri”. Bese idau-idau diravadia ta ese nega ta ai ena tano na Asuria pavapavana imana amo vada e hamauria a?
english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

motu: Hamat bona Arapada diravadia be edeseni ai? Sefaravaimi diravana be edeseni ai? Samaria na imagu amo vada e hamauria a?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

motu: Ini tano idau-idau diravadia iboudiai bogaragidiai, daidia ese edia tano na lau imagu amo baine hamauria a? Matona, Iehova ese Ierusalem na lau imagu amo baine hamauria a?
english: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

motu: A taunimanima na asi reḡereḡedia e nohova, hereva ta asie haere henia; badina be hanua pavapavana ese vada e haḡanidia, eto, Basio haere henia.
english: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

motu: Bena Eliakim Hilkia, hanua pavapavana ena ruma ireḡuna tauna bona Sebna, toretore tauna, bona Ioa Asaf, e tore pepadia inaridia tau, na edia dabua e dare, bena Hesekia dekenai e raka vareai, Rabsake ena hereva e hamaorolaia.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

motu: King Hesekia ese hereva e kamonai, bena ena dabua e dare, puse dabuadia e hahedokilai; bena Iehova ena dubu ai e raka vareai.
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

motu: Bena ia ese Eliakim, ena ruma ireḡuna tauna, bona Sebna, toretore tauna, bona hahelaḡa taudia badadia, na e siaidia, puse dabuadia bae doki, bena peroveta tauna Isaia Amoso dekena baela.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

motu: Idia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Hesekia na ini e gwau tomamu: Hari dina na lalo-hisihisi bona gwau-gwaubona hemarai dinana; memero edia vara negana vada e kau, to ihavaradia ai goada na vada lasi.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.

motu: Reana Iehova, emu Dirava, ese Rabsake, biaguna Asuria pavapavana ese e siaia Mauri Diravana baine ḡonaḡonalaia tauna, ena hereva iboudiai vada e kamonai. Reana Iehova, emu Dirava, ese e kamonai herevadia baine gwaudia tubu. Taunabunai, taunimanima kwabu-kwabudia doini e nohomu daidiai ba ḡuriḡuri.
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

motu: King Hesekia ena hesiai taudia na Isaia dekenai e kau negana ai,
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

motu: Isaia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Baigumui ba hamaoroa, baoto “Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Basio gari, o kamonai herevadia, Asuria pavapavana ena hesiai taudia ese lau e ḡonaḡonalaigu herevadia, daidiai.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

motu: A itaia, lau ese lauma ta ia lalonai baina atoa, bena sivarai lahulahuna ta baine kamonai, bena ena tano korikori baine lou lao. Bena ena tano korikori ai lau ese ena mase dalana na dare amo baina havaraia”.
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

motu: Bena Rabsake e lou ela, Asuria pavapavana e davaria, ia ese Libna e tuari heniava; badina be vada e kamonai hanua pavapavana na Lakisi amo vada e raka oho.
english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Tirihaka, Etiopia pava pavana, harina e kamonai, haida eto “Ia na vada e tore isi, oi ituari-henimu e maimu”. Una hereva e kamonai negana ai, ia ese gwaukau taudia haida na Hesekia dekena e siaidia, eto,
english: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

motu: Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, ini ba hamaoroa toma, baoto: Emu Dirava, o abidadama heniamu Diravana, ese Ierusalem na Asuria pavapavana imana ai basine atoa gwauhamatana amo basine koilaimu.
english: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

motu: Vada o kamonai Asuria pavapavana ede vada e kara toma; tano iboudiai vada e habuadia tari vaitani. Bena umui na ba roho mauri a?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

motu: Bese idau-idau, senegu ese e habuadia tari besedia, Gosan, Haran, Resef, bona Eden taudia Tel-asara ai e nohova, na edia dirava ese vada e hamauridia a?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

motu: Hamat bona Arapada bona Sefaravaimi hanuana bona Hena bona Iva pavapavadia be edeseni ai?
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

motu: Hesekia ese revareva na gwaukau taudia imadia amo e abia, bena e duahia. Bena Hesekia na Iehova ena dubu ai e dae kau, bena revareva e kehoa Iehova vairanai.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

motu: Bena Hesekia ese Iehova e ḡuria, eto,
english: Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota e, Israel Diravana, oi na kerubi daediai o helaimu; oi mo sibomu tanobada basileiadia iboudiai edia Dirava; oi ese guba bona tanobada vada o karadia.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

motu: Iehova e, taiamu a hakala, bona ba kamonai. Iehova e, matamu a hapapa, ba roharoha. Senakerib ena hereva iboudiai, Mauri Diravana iḡonaḡonalaina totona e siaidia herevadia, na ba kamonai.
english: Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.

motu: Momokani, Iehova e, Asuria pavapavadia ese bese idau-idau iboudiai mai ediatano ida vada e habuadia tari,
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,

motu: bona edia dirava na lahi ai vada e tahodia kau; badina be idia na dia dirava korikoridia, a taunimanima imadia ese e kara ḡaudia, au bona nadi; una dainai vada e habuadia tari.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova emai Dirava e, ia imana amo ba hamaurimai, bena tanobada basileiadia iboudiai na bae diba, Iehova e, oi mo sibomu Dirava.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh, even you only.”

motu: Bena Isaia Amoso ese gwau-kau na Hesekia dekena e siaia lao, eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be vada o ḡurigu, Senakerib, Asuria pavapavana, herevadia vada o gwaurai, dainai,
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

motu: Iehova ese ini vada e herevalaia toma: Siona natuna hane-ulato rami-hebouna ese e dadaraimumu bona e ḡonaḡonalaimumu; Ierusalem natuna hahinena ese oi murimu ai kwarana e taiko-taikomu.
english: this is the word which Yahweh has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

motu: Daika vada o ḡonaḡonalaia, vada o ihi-ihiraia? Daika ihadikana ai gadomu vada o habadaia bona matamu o helari dae heniamu? Israel ena Helaḡa Diravana enai.
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

motu: Emu hesiai taudia ududia amo Iehova vada o ḡonaḡonalaia, oto, Egu kariota momo amo ororo doridia ai vada na dara dae, ela bona Lebanon ena gabu hehunidia. Ena sida audia lata-hereadia na hagaridia, bona ena beroso audia namo-hereadia danu. Ia doridorina ai na dara dae, bona ena uda ahu ai danu.
english: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.

motu: Guri na geidia, ranu na inu; aegu lalona amo Aigupto sinavaidia iboudiai na hakororodia.
english: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”

motu: Oi to kamonai a, lau ese idau nega ai na heḡaeḡaelaia? Harihari na havaramu karadia na idau nega ai na lalodia, nato, oi ese hanua mai maḡudia na nadi senudia ai ba halaodia;
english: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.

motu: bena edia goada baine ore dainai inoholaidia taudia na daradia bae doko bona bae baia; tano avadia eiava rei matamata heḡereḡeredia ai baela, eiava ruma guhidia ai rei e varamu na heto, do se huahua ai na e maraimu.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.

motu: A lau na emu helai diho dibagu, emu raka lasi bona emu raka vareai, bona emu heihi-ihirai egu ai danu.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

motu: Vada o ihi-ihiraigu dainai, bona emu hekokoroku herevadia vada na kamonai dainai, lau ese egu igau na udu-baubaumu ai baina atoa, bona egu udu-aurina danu udumu ai; bena ma baina haloumu, oi oma dalana amo.
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

motu: Toana emu ai binai: ina laḡani lalonai vara kava ḡauna bavania, bona laḡani iharuana ai ma iena amo baine vara ḡauna bavania; laḡani ihatoina ai ba hadohado bona ba taboro, vine imeadia ba hado, bona anidia bavani.
english: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

motu: Bona Iuda kwabukwabudia dounu mamauri na ramudia bae diho bona tuhutuhudia bae dae;
english: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

motu: badina be kwabukwabudia na Ierusalem amo bae raka lasi, bona Siona ororona amo roho-mauri taudia oreana na bainela. Iehova ena ura kwalimu ese ina na baine havaraia.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.’

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Asuria pavapavana na ini e herevalaia tomamu: Ia na ina hanua basinema, eiava diba ta basine kino henia, eiava mai kesina ida hanua vairanai basinema, eiava tano na hanua vairanai basine larebaia dae.
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

motu: Ema dalana amo ma baine lou; ina hanua lalonai basine raka vareai Iehova vada e hereva.
english: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

motu: Badina be ina hanua baina gimaia bona baina namauria, lau sibogu daigu ai bona egu hesiai tauna David dainai.
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru na e raka lasi, taunimanima domaga-ta gerebu-taurahani daha-ima + 37:36 Domaga-ta gerebu-taurahani daha-ima = 185,000. * Asuria taudia edia taruha ai e aladia mase. Daba e rere, haida e tore isi, e itadia, unu na iboudiai mase taudia mo.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

motu: Bena Senakerib, Asuria pavapavana, na e raka oho, e lou lao, Nineve ai e noho.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.

motu: Bena ena dirava, ladana Nisrok, ena dubu ai e ḡuriḡuriva negana ai, ia natuna Adram-melek bona Saresere ese dare amo e alaia mase, bena e heau mauri, Ararat tanona ela. Bena natuna ta, ladana Esarahadon, ese ia gabuna ai e lohia.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Hesekia na e gorerea, mokona e mase. Bena peroveta tauna Isaia Amoso na dekena ema, e hereva henia, eto, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Emu ḡau iboudiai bavatodia ḡoevaḡoeva, badina be oi na ba mase, emu gorere amo basio namo lou.
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”

motu: Bena Hesekia vairana na haba e henia, bona Iehova e ḡuria, eto,
english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,

motu: Iehova e, na noimumu ba laloa tao, lau na oi vairamu ai vada na raka mai heabidadamagu bona mai lalogu idoinai ida, bona oi vairamu ai vada na kara maoromaoro. Bena Hesekia na e tai dikadika.
english: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Isaia enai e kau, eto,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Isaiah, saying,
