motu: O loa kava loa kavamu, emu dala o ha-idaua louloumu; Aigupto ese baine hahemaraimu, Asuria ese e hahemaraimu na heto.
english: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You|strong="H4100" * will|strong="H1571" * be|strong="H1571" * ashamed of|strong="H1870" * Egypt|strong="H4714" * also|strong="H1571" *, as|strong="H1571" * you|strong="H4100" * were|strong="H4714" * ashamed of|strong="H1870" * Assyria.

motu: Ina danu, imamu na kwaramu ai heatona ai ba raka oho, badina be o abidadama henidiamu taudia na Iehova ese vada e dadaraidia, bona idia ese namomu basie habadaia.
english: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for|strong="H3588" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * has|strong="H3068" * rejected|strong="H3988" * those|strong="H5921" * in|strong="H5921" * whom|strong="H4009" * you|strong="H3588" * trust|strong="H4009" *, and|strong="H3068" * you|strong="H3588" * won’t prosper|strong="H6743" * with|strong="H3068" * them|strong="H5921" *.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Tau ta ese adavana bema hadihoa, bena una hahine ese bema rakatania bona tau ta ma bema adavaia, adavana gunana ese ma bema lou henia a? Una tano basinema miro bada a? Oi na vada o mata bodaga tatau momo ediai; bena lau dekegu ai ba lou mai a?
english: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says Yahweh.

motu: Ba gaga isi, ororo nemuka-nemukadia ba itadia! Edena gabu ai oi na tau ta ida asio eno bou? Dala isedia ai vada o helai, tatau vada o naridia, Arabia hahinena tano ḡaḡaena ai na heto. Emu mata-bodaga karadia amo tano vada o hamiroa.
english: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

motu: Taunabunai, batugu vada e helao ahu, bona hadohado negana ai medu se diho; ḡau tamona bagumu ita-itana na ariara hahinena baguna na heto, so uramu ba hemarai.
english: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.

motu: Ina harihari vada o boi henigu, ani, oto, Tamagu e! Kekenigu ai o hetura henigu.
english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?

motu: Baine badu ela bona hanaihanai, bona lalona baine siahu ela bona dokona a? A itaia, vada o hereva vaitani, to vada o kara dika mai goadamu idoinai. Iehova ese Israel bona Iuda e sisiba henidia
english: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”

motu: King Iosia ena nega ai, Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Una kara hebeatai besena, Israel, ena kara vada o itaia a? Ia na ororo badadia iboudiai e dara daeva, bona au mauridia iboudiai henudiai elava, urluseni ai lebulebu karadia e karava.
english: Moreover, Yahweh said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.

motu: Bena lau nato “Ina idoinai baine ha-orea murinai ia ese baine lou henigu”; a ia na se lou mai, tadikakana koikoina Iuda ese karana e itaia.
english: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

motu: Ia ese e itaia, una kara hebeatai besena Israel ena heuda-hanai karadia iboudiai daidiai lau ese na hadihoa bona hekoho revarevana na henia; ḡau tamona ia tadikakana koikoina Iuda na se gari, a ia danu ela, eha lebulebu.
english: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.

motu: lenai lebulebu na ḡau pipikina dainai, ia ese tano e hamiroa, nadi bona au ediai e lebulebu.
english: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ia tadikakana koikoina Iuda ese ina idoinai e itaia, to lau dekegu ai se lou mai mai lalona idoinai ida, a mai koikoina ida ema. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Kara hebeatai besena Israel ena kerere vada eme hedinarai na taina maraḡi, a koikoi besena Iuda ena kerere na bada.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

motu: Aola, ina hereva na mirigini kahana ba gwaurai henia, baoto: Iehova na e tomu: Kara hebeatai besena Israel e, a lou! Iehova na e tomu: Mai badugu ida basina haḡeremu, badina be lau na mai hebogahisigu; lau na basina badu hanaihanai.
english: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says Yahweh; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will not keep anger forever.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Emu kerere a gwaurai hedinarai mo; Iehova, emu Dirava, o daḡedaḡe henia, bona idau taudia ida o eno bou au mauridia iboudiai henudiai, bona lau gadogu so kamonai henia, vada ba gwaurai hedinarai.
english: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says Yahweh.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Kara hebeatai memeromui e, a lou; badina be biagumui na lau. Lau ese baina abimui, hanua ta amo ta, bona iduhu ta amo rarua, bena Siona ai baina hakaumui dae.
english: “Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

motu: Lau ese iregumui taudia baina henimui, na lalo namo henidiamu taudia; bena idia ese aonega bona lalo-parara amo bae ubumui.
english: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Tano ai ba vara rohoroho bona ba hutuma negana baine kau ai, unu dinadia ai idia ese Iehova ena taravatu mauana basie herevalaia lou. Basie laloa une, basie laloa tao, basie henanadailaia, bona ta ma basine hekara lou.
english: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says Yahweh, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of Yahweh’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.

motu: Una negana ai Ierusalem na bae gwauraia Iehova ena terono; bona bese iboudiai na ienai bae hebou Iehova vairanai, Ierusalem ai; bona sibodia edia lalo-hadai dikadia iḡavadia ai basie hetoahu.
english: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Iuda besena na Israel besena ida bae tami hebou, bona mirigini tanona amo baema bou, senemui na henidia tanona na ma bae mai henia.
english: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

motu: Lau na laloa natugu bogaragidiai baina atomu, bona tano namona baina henimu, tano mai hairaina, basileia iboudiai edia e hereadiamu tanona. Bona na laloa danu oi ese boma gwauraigu “Tamagu”, bona lau igavagu amo basioma raka siri.
english: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Israel besena e! Momokani, kara hebeatai hahinena ese adavana e dihotaniamu na heto, oi ese vada o kara hebeatai henigu.
english: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says Yahweh.

motu: Ororo nemuka-nemukadia ai gado ta e hekamonaimu, Israel garana edia taitai bona edia noinoi; badina be edia dala vada e hagagevaia, Iehova, edia Dirava, vada e laloa boio.
english: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Yahweh their God.

motu: Kara hebeatai memeromui, a lou mai; emui kara hebeatai amo baina hamaurimui. A itaia, ai na a vasimu, badina be oi na Iehova, emai Dirava.
english: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “ Behold|strong="H2005" *, we|strong="H3068" * have|strong="H3068" * come|strong="H7725" * to|strong="H7725" * you|strong="H3588" *; for|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * are|strong="H1121" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * our|strong="H3068" * God|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Momokani, ororo ese e koimaimu, bona lebulebu karadia ororo badadia ai ese e dibaḡanimaimu. Momokani, Israel ihamaurina be Iehova, emai Dirava, enai.
english: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.

motu: A eregabemai negadia amo hari hemarai ḡauna ese tamamai edia hekwarahi anidia iboudiai vada e hadonodia: edia mamoe seridia bona edia boromakau seridia, natudia mamaruanedia bona natudia hahinedia danu.
english: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

motu: Emai hemarai ai baia hekure; emai hemarai ese baine ḡovamai ahu; badina be ai ese Iehova, emai Dirava, vada a kara dika henia, ai bona tamamai danu, eregabemai negadia amo ema bona ina dina; bona Iehova, emai Dirava, gadona asia kamonai henia.
english: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice.”

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Israel e, oi na boma lou, lau dekegu ai ba lou mai. Emu ḡau dika-rohorohodia na vairagu amo boma abi oho, bona basioma daradara.
english: “If you will return, Israel,” says Yahweh, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;

motu: Momokani ai bona hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva ai bona kara maoromaoro ai boma gwau hamata, boma toma “Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena”, bena basileia idau-idau na sibodia bae hahenamo ia dainai, bona ia bae imodaia.
english: and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”

motu: Badina be Iehova ese Iuda taudia bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia na ini e hamaorodia tomamu: Emui vahu tanona ba ruaia, au ginigini gabudia ai basio hadohado.
english: For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

motu: Iuda taumui bona Ierusalem inoholaina taumui e, sibomui ba haheperitome Iehova enai, peritome ai lalomui ba hahelaḡadia, egu badu ḡaraḡara na lahi na heto baine lasi na garina, bena baine ara, asi tauna ta ese baine habodoa, emui kara vada e dika dainai. Iuda bae daea
english: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

motu: Iuda ai ba gwauraia, bona Ierusalem ai ba gwauraia hedinarai, baoto: Tano heḡeḡemadai ai kibi ba hiriria; ba boi lolo, baoto “A hegogo, baitala, hanua mai maḡudia lalodiai”.
english: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’

motu: Pepe ba duduia isi Siona enai, ba heau, mauri ba tahua, basio halahe. badina be hahedika na mirigini kahana amo na mailaimu, bona hahebua-tari badana danu.
english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”

motu: Leona na uda hedoma-hedomana vada e rakatania, basileia ihabua-taridia tauna vada e tore isi; ena gabu amo vada e raka lasi, emu tano ihavahuna totona; emu hanua na bae heḡiḡi dobi, asi inoholaidia bae mia.
english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

motu: Ina dainai puse dabuadia ba rio, ba tai, ba tai lolololo; badina be Iehova ena badu ḡaraḡara na ita eda amo se heabi oho.
english: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Una dina ai hanua pavapavana bona hanua lohiadia edia boga-auka baine ore; hahelaḡa taudia bae gari dikadika bona peroveta taudia bae hoa bada.
english: “It will happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”

motu: Bena lau nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi na ina bese bona Ierusalem hanuana vada o koidia vaitani, ani, oto “Vada ba namo”; ḡau tamona, dare ese be aladiamu.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”

motu: Una negana ai ta ese ina bese bona Ierusalem hanuana baine hamaorodia, baineto, Lai siahuna na tano ḡaḡaena ororodia nemuka-nemukadia amo e maimu, egu bese natuna hahinena e toa heniamu, dia itapona eiava ihaḡoevana totona.
english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.

motu: A lai badana na daigu ai e maimu. Harihari lau ese hahemaoro ai na hereva henidiamu.
english: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”

motu: A itaia, ia na duba na heheto e tubu e maimu, ena kariota na koe-hirihiri na heto; ena hosi na haraḡa herea, idia ese ugava e hereadiamu; madi ihabaida, vada ta dika vaitani.
english: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

motu: Ierusalem e, lalomu ena dika ba huri oho, ba mauri helaoreana; emu lalo-hadai dikadia na lalomu ai bae mia ela bona edena nega ai?
english: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?

motu: Badina be gado ta Dan amo e herevamu, bona Efraim ororona amo hahedika e gvauraiamu.
english: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:

motu: Bese idau-idau ba sisiba henidia, ia na e maimu; Ierusalem ba gwaurai henia, baoto: Hanua idaena taudia na tano daudau amo e maimu, Iuda hanuadia e hone henidiamu.
english: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

motu: Tano igimana taudia na heheto e ginia heḡeḡe, badina be ia ese vada e gwau edeede henigu. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says Yahweh.

motu: Emu dala bona emu kara ese ina kara na latamu ai vada e hadihoa. Ina na oi irevamu, vada eme idita; oi lalomu korikorina ai vada e vareai.
english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

motu: Lalogu e, lalogu e, hisihisi ese e gugubagumu! Kudougu e! Kudougu na e hetaha dikadikamu, udugu basina hakapua diba; badina be kibi reḡena na kamonaimu, bona tuari honena danu.
english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

motu: Dika ta dika ta latanai e kaumu, ela bona tano idoinai vada e vahu. Asi vanahana egu kalaga e hegiḡi rohorohomu; asi vanahana egu seseahu e heabi ohomu.
english: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.

motu: Pepe baina itaia ela bona edena nega ai? kibi reḡena baina kamonai ela bona edena nega ai?
english: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

motu: Badina be egu bese taudia na kakavakava, idia na asi dibadia lau; idia na lalo-duhu memerodia, asi edia lalo-parara. Kara dika ikaradia mai dibadia, a kara namo ikaradia na asi dibadia.
english: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”

motu: Tanobada na itaia, vada e vahu bona asi anina; guba na itaia, ia na asi diarina.
english: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.

motu: Ororo badadia na itadia, idia na e tabubu-tabubu, bona ororo maraḡidia e heude-heude.
english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.

motu: Na roha lao, tau ta asina itaia, bona atai manudia iboudiai vada e roho boio.
english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.

motu: Na roha lao, nomu tanona na itaia, vada e ḡaḡae, bona hanuana iboudiai vada e heḡiḡi dobi, Iehova vairanai, ena badu ḡaraḡara vairanai.
english: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh, before his fierce anger.

motu: Badina be Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Tano idoinai baine hahevahura; to basina havahuraia vaitani.
english: For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.

motu: Ina dainai tanobada baine taitai, bona atai ai guba baine dubaduba; badina be lau vada na hereva bona lalogu vada na hadaia, basina helalo kerehai bona lalogu basina haloua.
english: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”

motu: Hosi tauna bona peva tauna reḡedia dainai, hanua iboudiai taunimanimadia na e heau maurimu; uda hedoma-hedomadia ai e heau vareaimu, haga nadidia ai e dara daemu; hanua iboudiai e heautanidiamu, lalodiai tau ta se nohomu.
english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

motu: Oi, vada e negemu daure hahinemu e, emu lalo-hadai be dahaka bena dabua kakakakana o hahedokilaiamu; bona gold * heraheradia o heralaimu, bona matamu na umu amo o habadamu? Asi badina sibomu o hahairaimu; e ura henimuva taudia ese e dadaraimumu, idia ese emu mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu.
english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.

motu: Badina be taitai ta na kamonai, e hekamonaimu hahinena ena tai na heto, natuna roboana e havaraiamu hahinena ese hisi e animu na heto; Siona natuna hahinena ena tai, e laḡa dae laḡa daemu, bona imana e toi roromu, e tomu “Lau madi ihabaigu, roroma taudia vairadiai na mase reamu”.
english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”

motu: Ierusalem ariaradia ai ba heau lao ba heau mai, ba itaia bona ba haeroa. Ena ariara lalodiai ba ita hetahu-hetahu, tau ta ba davaria eiava lasi, e hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoevamu bona hereva momokanina e tahuamu tauna; unu amo ena dika bama gwau tao.
english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

motu: Ena be e tomamu “Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena”, to e gwau hamata koikoimu.
english: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”

motu: Iehova e, oi matamu ese kara momokanina e tahuamu, ani? Oi ese vada o harahudia mase, a lalodia asie hisihisi; oi ese vada o aladia ore, a mata-hakani asie ura. Idia ese vairadia e ha-aukadia, vairadia na nadi-aukadia na heheto, a idia na asie ura bae helalo kerehai.
english: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.

motu: Bena lau nato: Ini na ogoḡami taudia mo, lalodia na asie pararamu; badina be Iehova ena dala na asi dibadia, edia Dirava ena taravatu danu asi dibadia.
english: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.

motu: Lohia dekedia bainala, baina hereva henidia; badina be idia na Iehova ena dala dibadia, edia Dirava ena taravatu danu dibadia. A idia iboudiai ese danu maduna auna vada e hakwaidua, bona iḡuidia vada e hamotudia.
english: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

motu: Taunabunai, uda amo leona ta ese baine aladia mase; tano ḡaḡaena amo sisia daḡedaḡena ta ese baine habuadia tari. Taiga ta ese edia hanua e bani henidiamu, bae raka lasi taudia iboudiai na ia ese baine daredia patapata; badina be edia kara dika na momo, edia raka-muri na bada.
english: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.

motu: Emu dika na ede baina gwaua tao toma? Oi natumu ese vada e rakatanigu, dirava koikoidia ladadia ai vada e gwau hamata. Bogadia na hakunuva negadia ai, idia na e heuda hanaiva, ariara hahinedia edia ruma ai e didi vareaiva.
english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.

motu: Idia na hosi mamaruanedia, bogadia e kunumu bona taudia e lokalokamu, ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna adavadia e tubebe henidiamu.
english: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Unu ḡau daidiai davadia basina henidia a? Bese unuhetomana latanai dava basina atoa a?
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

motu: Ena vine imeana ba rakaia hanai, ba havahua, a basio havahuraia vaitani; ia rigina ba padadia oho, badina be idia na dia Iehova ena.
english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.

motu: Badina be Israel iduhuna bona Iuda iduhuna na egu ai vada e hebeatai vaitani. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says Yahweh.

motu: Idia ese Iehova e herevalaia koikoi, eto: Ḡau ta basine karaia; dika ta ita eda ai basine kau, dare bona doe basita mamidia.
english: They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.

motu: Peroveta taudia na lai kavakava ai bae hahelao, hereva momokanina na dia idia ediai. Unu bae halou henidia toma.
english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

motu: Taunabunai Dirava, Iehova Sabaota, na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hereva vada e gwauraia dainai, a itaia, egu hereva na lahi ai baina halaodia oi udumu ai, bona ina bese na au rakuraku ai baina halaoa, bena lahi ese baine aradia ore.
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

motu: Israel besena e, a itaia, bese ta na dauha amo baina mailaia umui latamui ai. Iehova na e herevamu. Una bese na e hesiriu hanaihanaimu besena, ia na bese gunana; ia na gadona asi dibamu besena, bae hereva negadia ai lalomu basine parara.
english: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.

motu: Edia diba pauana na gara hekehona na heto; idia iboudiai na goada-dikadika taudia.
english: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.

motu: Emu taboro bae ha-orea, bona emu aniani ḡaudia danu; natumu mamaruanedia bona hahinedia bae ha-oredia, bona emu mamoe seridia bona emu boromakau seridia danu; emu vine bae haoredia, bona emu suke audia danu; emu hanua aukadia, o abidadama henidiamu hanuadia, na dare ai bae habuadia tari.
english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

motu: Iehova na e tomamu: To unu dinadia ai lau ese basina ha-oremui vaitani.
english: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.

motu: Bena emu bese taudia baeto “Badina be dahaka Iehova, eda Dirava, ese ini kara iboudiai rla eda ai vada e kara?” negana ai, oi ese ba hamaorodia, baoto “Umui ese vada o rakatanigu, bona emui tano lalonai dirava idaudia isiaidia vada o lao heni heḡereḡerena, umui ese danu idau tano, dia emui tano, lalonai idau taudia isiaidia do ba lao heni”.
english: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has Yahweh our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’

motu: Iakob iduhuna ai ina hereva ba gwauraia, Iuda tanona ai ba gwauraia hedinarai, baoto:
english: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

motu: Asi lalomui bona asi daramui taumui e, a kamonai, mai matamui, to asio heitamu; mai taiamui, to asio kamonaimu.
english: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:

motu: Iehova na e tomamu: Asio gari henigumu a? Lau vairagu ai asio heude-heudemu a? Lau ese kone na atoa, davara hetoana, davara ilao-ahuna, baine mia hanaihanai ḡauna, davara ese basine hanaia diba ḡauna. Ena be hurehure na e heabi isimu, to basie kwalimu diba; ena be kone ai e poumu, to basie hanaia diba.
english: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’

motu: A ina bese taudia lalodia na a'auka, bona mai gwau-edeededia; idia na vada e raka siri, dauha vada ela.
english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.

motu: Lalodia ai idia na asie tomu: Iehova, eda Dirava, garina baita gari; ia ese medu e henidamu, negana korikori ai, lahara medudia bona guitau medudia; bona vada e duanaidia taboro puradia ai baela puradia na ia ese e badinadiamu, eda.
english: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’

motu: Ini na emui kara havara ese emui amo vada e abi oho, bona emui kara dika ese namo na emui amo vada e laoa ahu.
english: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

motu: Badina be kara dika taudia na egu orea taudia bogaragidiai e nohomu; bona idia na e komumu, manu ibani-henidia taudh na heheto. Idia ese rikiriki e atoamu, taunimanima e abidiamu.
english: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

motu: Edia ruma na kara dibaka ai e honumu, bosea na manu ai e honumu na heto; taunabunai idia na vada e lohia, vada e taḡa,
english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

motu: taudia vada e bada bona vada e raho namo. Edia kara dikadia na asie hamaragidiamu; asie hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoevamu; ihareha idurudia asie goadalaiamu, bona e dabumu taudia ahudia korikori asie gimadiamu.
english: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Ini ḡau daidiai matadia basina hakanidia a? Bese inihetomana latanai dava basina atoa a?
english: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

motu: Hoa bada bona gari bada ḡauna ta na tano ai vada e vara:
english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

motu: peroveta taudia na e peroveta koikoimu, bona edia hahedua heḡereḡeredia ai hahelaḡa taudia na e lohiamu; bona egu orea taudia na e uramu unu baine heto, a nega dokona baine kau ai be ede ba kara toma?
english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?

motu: Beniamina taumui e, Ierusalem bogaragina amo a heau mauri! Tekoa ai kibi ba hiriria, Bete-hakerereme ai pepe ba duduia isi! Badina be hahedika na mirigini kahana amo e hedinarai e maimu, bona hahebua-tari badana danu.
english: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.

motu: Hane namo, aboni-noho hahinena, baine alaia, Siona natuna hahinena baine alaia mase.
english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.

motu: Mamoe ireḡudia taudia mai edia seri ida na ia ivaira-henina baema, edia kalaga bae haginidia, bae ḡeḡea ahu, edia mamoe bae ubudia, ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai.
english: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”

motu: Tuari a haheḡaeḡaea, ia ihadikana; a tore isi, dina tubua ai baita daea. Madi ihabaida, ado e rahimu, dina na e kerekeremu.
english: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

motu: A tore isi, hanuaboi ai baita daea, ena lohia rumadia baita habuadia tari.
english: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Ena au ba hagaridia, tano ba larebaia dae, Ierusalem hevaira-henina ai. Ina hanua na matana bae hakania; ia lalonai na hahehisi karadia mo.
english: For Yahweh of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.

motu: Ranu gurina ese ranuna e hamatamataia na heto, ia ese ena kara havara unu e hamatamata tomamu; daḡedaḡe bona hahebua-tari karadia reḡedia na ia lalonai e hekamonaimu, gorere bona bero na vairagu ai nega idoinai.
english: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.

motu: Ierusalem e, nahuamu a tohoa, emu ai lalogu baine dika na garina, baina havahumu bona tano deḡedeḡena-rahu ai baina halaomu na garina.
english: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”

motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: vine huahuadia kwabudia e buruki oremu na heto, Israel kwabukwabudia ba burukidia ore; vine huahuadia igogodia tauna na heto, oi imamu ese rigina baine darahua lou.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”

motu: Daidia baina hereva henidia bona baina sisiba henidia, bae kamonai helaoreana? A itadia, taiadia na hehekou, idia na asi kamonai dibadia. A itadia, Iehova ena hereva na e ḡonaḡonalaiamu, asie moalelaiamu.
english: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, Yahweh’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.

motu: Taunabunai lau na Iehova ena badu ai na honumu, ihalahelaina ai na hesikumu. Taunabunai ariara ai memero kekeni latadiai ba bubua diho, bona eregabe taudia edia hegogo latadiai danu; tau mai adavana ida bae abidia hebou, taunimanima badadia bona burukadia danu.
english: Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “ Pour|strong="H8210" * it|strong="H5921" * out|strong="H8210" * on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * children|strong="H5768" * in|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * street|strong="H2351" *, and|strong="H3068" * on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * assembly|strong="H5475" * of|strong="H3068" * young|strong="H3117" * men|strong="H2205" * together|strong="H3162" *; for|strong="H3588" * even|strong="H1571" * the|strong="H5921" * husband with|strong="H5973" * the|strong="H5921" * wife will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3068" * taken|strong="H3920" *, the|strong="H5921" * aged|strong="H2205" * with|strong="H5973" * him|strong="H5921" * who|strong="H3068" * is|strong="H3068" * full|strong="H4392" * of|strong="H3068" * days|strong="H3117" *.

english: Their houses will be turned to others, their|strong="H3068" * fields|strong="H7704" * and|strong="H3068" * their|strong="H3068" * wives together|strong="H3162" *; for|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * stretch|strong="H5186" * out|strong="H5186" * my|strong="H3068" * hand|strong="H3027" * on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5002" * inhabitants|strong="H3427" * of|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H5002" * land|strong="H7704" *, says|strong="H5002" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.”

motu: Maraḡina ela bona badana, iboudiai ese mata-ḡaniḡani karadia e gugulaimu; bona peroveta tauna ela bona hahelaḡa tauna, iboudiai e kara koikoimu.
english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From|strong="H5704" * the|strong="H3605" * prophet|strong="H5030" * even|strong="H5704" * to|strong="H5704" * the|strong="H3605" * priest|strong="H3548" *, everyone|strong="H3605" * deals|strong="H6213" * falsely|strong="H8267" *.

motu: Egu orea taudia berodia vada e haḡoevadia lamai-lamai, eto “Maino, maino”, maino do lasi negana ai.
english: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘ Peace|strong="H7965" *, peace|strong="H7965" *!’ when|strong="H5921" * there|strong="H7965" * is|strong="H5971" * no peace|strong="H7965" *.

motu: Kara dika-rohorohona e karaia negana ai, idia na e hemarai a? Idia na asie hemarai, lasi ona lasi vaitani; hemarai mamina na asi dibadia. Taunabunai, e ketomu taudia bogaragidiai bae keto; matadia baina hakanidia negana ai idia na bae henege daure. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No|strong="H3808" *, they|strong="H3588" * were|strong="H6485" * not|strong="H3808" * at|strong="H3068" * all|strong="H3045" * ashamed|strong="H3637" *, neither|strong="H3808" * could|strong="H1571" * they|strong="H3588" * blush|strong="H3637" *. Therefore|strong="H3651" * they|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * fall|strong="H5307" * among|strong="H3808" * those|strong="H6213" * who|strong="H3068" * fall|strong="H5307" *. When|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * visit|strong="H6485" * them|strong="H6213" *, they|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3808" * cast|strong="H5307" * down|strong="H5307" *,” says Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Dala badidiai ba gini, ba roharoha; dala gunadia ba henanadailai; bena lao dalana namona ba davaria, ia lalonai ba raka, bona laumamui edia laḡa-ani ba davaria. A idia eto “Ai na ia lalonai basia raka”.
english: Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

motu: Gima taudia na duanaidia, umui igimamui; nato “Kibi reḡena ba hakala henia”. A idia eto “Ai na basia hakala”.
english: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’

motu: Bese idau-idau e, a kamonai! Hebou taumui e, ba diba dahaka na ediai baine vara.
english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

motu: Tanobada e, a kamonai! A itaia! Lau ese dika na havaraiamu ina bese taudia latadiai, idia sibodia edia lalo-hadai huahuadia; badina be egu hereva na asie hakala henidia, bona egu taravatu na vada e dadaraia.
english: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

motu: Anina be dahaka egu muramura mai bonana na Sieba amo e mailaiamu, eiava kane + 6:20 “Kane” na Heberu taudia edia muramura mai bonana ta. * namona tano daudauna amo? Emu ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia na asina abidia daemu, bona emu boubou karadia na asina moalelaidiamu.
english: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, hetutuhi ḡaudia na ina bese taudia vairadiai baina atodia, idia ihahetutuhidia. Tama bona natudia na bae hetutuhi hebou; ruma tauna mai turana ida bae mase hebou.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, bese ta na mirigini kahana amo e maimu; basileia badana ta na e tore isimu, tanobada kahadia daudau-hereadia ai.
english: Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

motu: Idia ese peva bona io na imadia ai e abimu, idia na e daḡedaḡemu, bona asie hebogahisimu; reḡedia na davara guruna na heto. Siona natuna hahinemu e, idia na hosi ai e guimu, e heḡaeḡaemu, tau ta na tuari dainai e heḡaeḡaemu na heto, oi ihadikamu totona.
english: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

motu: Ita ese harina vada ta kamonai, a imada na asi goadadia; hisihisi bada-hereana ese e gugubadamu, hahine ta ena hekamonai hisina na heto.
english: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

motu: Basio raka lasi tano paka ai, bona dala ai basio raka, badina be inai tauna na mai darena ida e loamu, bona gari bada ese e ḡeḡeda ahumu.
english: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.

motu: Egu bese natuna hahinemu e, puse dabuadia ba rio, kahu ai ba hekui-hekui; ba taitai, natuna vara-edeana e taitailaiamu na heto, herohe-ahu idita hereana; badina be hahebua-tari tauna ese baine hatakuda.
english: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.

motu: Lau ese hidi-hidi tauna bona hahetoho tauna ai vada na halaomu egu orea taudia bogaragidiai, edia dala ba dibadia bona ba hididia totona.
english: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.

motu: Idia iboudiai na e gwau ede-ede dikadikamu, hahebade koikoi herevadia e loalaidiamu; idia na auri bona auri labora-labora, iboudiai na e kara koikoimu.
english: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.

motu: Lahi ihiririlaina ḡauna ese lahi e hahururuamu, e vevemu aurina na lahi ai e veve ohomu; haheḡoeva ḡaukarana e karaiamu na asi anina, badina be kara dika taudia na asie heabi ohomu.
english: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.

motu: Silver * momorudia bae gwauraidia, badina be Iehova ese vada e dadaraidia.
english: Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”

motu: Ina hereva na Iehova ena amo Ieremia enai e kau:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

motu: Iehova ena dubu ikoukouna ai ba gini, unuseni ai hereva ba gwauraia, baoto, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai, umui Iuda taumui, Iehova itomadiho-henina totona ini ikoukou lalodiai o raka vareaimu taumui iboumui ai.
english: “Stand in the gate of Yahweh’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui dala bona emui kara ba hamaoromaorodia, bena ina gabu ai do baina hanohomui.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

motu: Ini hedibagani herevadia basio abidadama herlidia: “Ina na Iehova ena dubu, Iehova ena dubu, Iehova ena dubu”.
english: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, are these.’

motu: Badina be emui dala bona emui kara boma hamaoromaorodia vaitani, bona boma hahemaoro heheni mai maoromaoromui ida,
english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

motu: idau tauna eiava ihareha eiava vabu basioma hahisihisidia, eiava asi ena kerere tauna rarana basioma hahebubua irla gabu ai, bona dirava idaudia igavadia ai sibomui basioma hahehisi,
english: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,

motu: bena lau ese ina gabu ai do baina hanohomui, nega gunadia ai senemui na henidia vaitani tanona lalonai.
english: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.

motu: A itaia, umui ese hedibaḡani herevadia o abidadama henidiamu na asi anina.
english: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.

motu: Ba henao, ba roroma, ba heuda hanai, ba gwauhamata koikoi, muramura mai bonana ba gabua Baal enai, bona asio dibadia guna diravadia ba ḡavadia;
english: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,

motu: bena baoma, lau vairagu ai ba gini, ina lau ladagu e henemailaia dubuna lalonai, baoto “Ai na vada a roho mauri”; bena unu kara dika-rohorohodia ma ba kara lou a?
english: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?

motu: Ina lau ladagu e henemailaia dubuna na emui ita-ita ai dadidadi taudia edia kohua ai vada ela a? Iehova na e tomu, Lau sibogu ese vada na itaia.
english: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says Yahweh.

motu: Egu gabu Silo ai, lau ladagu na hamialaia guna gabuna, baola; ba itaia, ede na karaia toma, egu bese Israel taudia edia kara dika daidiai.
english: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

motu: Iehova ma e tomu Harihari, unu ḡau iboudiai vada o karadia, bona igwau-henimui di asina hesiku lo asio kamonai, bona na boirimui to asio haere, dainai
english: Now, because you have done all these works,” says Yahweh, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;

motu: lau ese ina dubu, lau ladagu vada e henemailaia bona o abidadama heniamu dubuna, bona ina gabu, umui bona senemui na henimui gabuna, baina kara henidia, Silo na kara henia heḡereḡerena.
english: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

motu: Bona lau vairagu amo baina negemui daure, varavaramui, Efraim garana, iboudiai na negedia daure heḡereḡerena. Iehova ena hereva Ieremia enai
english: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring + 7:15 or, seed * of Ephraim.

motu: Oi na ina bese taudia daidiai basio noinoi, eiava idia daidiai basio taitai eiava basio ḡuriḡuri eiava egu ai heraua basio tahua, badina be asina kamonai henimumu.
english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

motu: Iuda hanuadia ai bona Ierusalem ariaradia ai e karamu karadia na so itamu a?
english: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

motu: Memero bona kekeni ese au rakuraku e haboumu, tamadia ese lahi e ha-aramu, bona hahine ese flaoa e kuiamu, guba pavapavana hahinena ena ataga bae gabu totona; bona inuinu bouboudia e bubudiamu, dirava idaudia ediai. Unu amo e habadugumu.
english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Lau e haraivagumu eiava sibodia e haheraivamu bena hemarai na latadiai e kaumu a?
english: Do they provoke me to anger?” says Yahweh. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”

motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu badu, egu badu ḡaraḡara, na ina gabu latanai baina bubua dobi, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia, bona imea audia bona uma anidia danu, latadiai; ia na baine ara, basine bodo. Iuda ena gwau-edeede davana
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui kara helaḡadia ba kara negadia ai, emui ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia danu ba hahelaḡadia, bena vamudia bavani.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.

motu: Badina be Aigupto amo na hakaudia lasi dinana amo ema, lau ese senemui asina hereva henidia, bona asina haḡanidia idia ese ḡole-oho bouboudia bona kara helaḡadia bae kara.
english: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;

motu: To ina haheḡani na henidia, nato, Lau gadogu ba kamonai, bena lau na emui Dirava ai bainala, bona umui na egu bese ai baola; bona na haḡanilaimuimu dalana idoinai lalonai ba raka, bena ba namo.
english: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’

motu: A idia na asie kamonaiva, taiadia asie hakalava, to sibodia edia hahealo ai bona sibodia edia lalo-hadai dikadia bona aukadia lalodiai e rakava, e raka duava, asie raka vairava.
english: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

motu: Senemui na Aigupto tanona amo e raka lasi dinana amo ema bona ina dina, lau ese peroveta taudia, egu hesiai taudia, iboudiai na dina ta ta ai idia dekedia na siaidiava, asina hesiku;
english: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.

motu: ḡau tamona, idia na asie kamonai heniguva bona taiadia asie hakalava, a aiodia e ha-aukadiava. Edia kara dika ese tamadia edia kara dika e hereadiava.
english: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.

motu: Taunabunai, ini hereva iboudiai na ba hamaorolaidia, to basie kamonai henimu. Ba boi henidia, to basie haere henimu.
english: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.

motu: Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ina na Iehova, edia Dirava, gadona asie kamonai bona mata-hakani asie abia dae besena. Hereva momokani vada e boio vaitani, bona idia bibinadia amo vada e ore.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to Yahweh their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’

motu: Huimu ba utu nege, ororo nemuka-nemukadia ai ba rohe ahu; badina be Iehova ese e badu heniamu uruna na vada e dadaraia bona vada e rakatania.
english: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Yahweh has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Badina be Iuda taudia na lau vairagu ai vada e kara dika; edia ḡau dika-rohorohodia na lau ladagu vada e henemailaia dubuna lalonai vada e atodia, unu amo vada e hamiroa.
english: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says Yahweh. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

motu: Tofete ai, Hinom natuna ena koura ai, idia ese atai gabuna helaḡana ta vada e hadaia, natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na lahi ai bae haḡoledia oho helaoreana; lau ese unu asina haḡanidia toma, bona unu asina laloa toma.
english: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova na e tomu, negana vada be maimu “Tofete” bona “Hinom natuna ena koura” basie gwauraia, a ladana bae hatoa “Ala-ala Kourana”; mase taudia na Tofete ai bae guridia, badina be idau gabu ai na asi gabudia.
english: Therefore behold, the days come”, says Yahweh, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

motu: Bena ina bese taudia tau-anidia na atai manudia bona uda boromadia ese bae anidia; ta ese basine luludia oho.
english: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.

motu: Bena Iuda hanuadia bona Ierusalem ariaradia lalodiai lau ese kiri bona moale reḡedia baina hadokodia, bona headava matamata tauna bona hahinena gadodia danu; badina be tano na baine mia ḡaḡae.
english: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Una negana ai Iuda pavapavadia bona Iuda lohiadia turiadia, bona hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia turiadia, bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia turiadia, garadia amo bae lasilai;
english: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

english: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.

english: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova ini e gwau toma: Aola, uro ikarana tauna ena hoduhodu ta ba hoia, bena hanua taubadadia haida bona hahelaḡa taudia badadia haida na bavabidia;
english: Thus said Yahweh, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;

motu: bena ba raka lasi, Hinom natuna ena koura baola, Ataga Ikoukouna raka-vareaina ai. Unuseni ai na hamaorolaimunu herevadia ba gwaurai hedinarai.
english: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I will tell you.

motu: Baoto: Iuda pavapavana hahidaosi bona Ierusalem inoholaina taumui e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese dika badana ta ina gabu latanai baina havaraia; bena bae kamonai taudia iboudiai na taiadia bae hemai-hemai.
english: Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.

motu: Badina be taunimanima ese vada e rakatanigu, ina gabu vada e hamiroa, ia lalonai muramura mai bonadia vada e gabu, dirava idaudia, idia bona tamadia bona Iuda pavapavadia iboudiai na asi dibadia diravadia, ediai; bona, badina be ina gabu na asi edia kerere taudia raradia ai e hahonua,
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know—they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah—and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

motu: bona Baal ena atai gabudia vada e larebadia, natudia mamaruanedia na lahi ai bae haḡoledia, Baal ena gole oho boubou ḡaudia ai bae halaodia, totona; a lau ese una kara asina haheḡanilaia eiava asina hahedualaia, bona asina laloa davari.
english: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Taunabunai, ba itaia, nega na e maimu ina gabu ladana basie hatoa “Tofete” eiava “Hinom natuna ena koura”, a bae hatoa “Ala-ala Kourana”.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.

motu: Ina gabu ai lau ese Iuda bona Ierusalem edia lalo-hata ḡaudia na asi anidia ḡaudia ai baina halaodia, bona edia taunimanima na inaidia edia dare amo bona edia mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia imadia amo baina hamasedia. Bena lau ese tau-anidia masedia na atai manudia bona uda boromadia baina henidia, adia.
english: “‘“I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

motu: Ina hanua na gari ihavarana ḡauna ai baina halaoa, taunimanima ese bae silaia ḡauna; e rakaia hanaimu taudia iboudiai na bae gari bona bae si dagu, enai e varamu karadia dika-hereadia daidiai.
english: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

motu: Bena inaidia bona edia mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia ese bae koudia ahu bona bae hahisihisidia negana ai, lau ese natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia hidiodia baina ha-anidia, bona ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna hidiodia bae ani danu.
english: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”’

motu: Bena oi ese hari hoduhodu ba hamakohia, oi ida baola taudia vairadiai.
english: “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you,

motu: Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina bese bona ina hanua na unu baina hamakohidia toma, uro ikarana tauna ena hoduhodu e hamakohiamu, asi ibanina, na heto. Mase taudia na Tofete ai bae guridia, badina be asi iguridia gabuna idauna ta.
english: and shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Lau ese ina gabu mai inoholaina taudia ida na unu baina karadia toma; ina hanua na Tofete heḡereḡerena ai baina halaoa.
english: This is what I will do to this place,” says Yahweh, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.

motu: Bena Ierusalem taudia edia ruma bona Iuda pavapavana hahidaosi edia ruma, guhidia ai muramura mai bonadia e gabu, dina bona hua bona hisiu iboudiai ediai, bona inuinu bouboudia e bubu, dirava idaudia ediai, rumadia na bae hamirodia, gabu ladana Tofete heḡereḡerena.
english: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”

motu: Bena Ieremia na Iehova ese e siaia lao unuseni ai baine peroveta totona gabuna, Tofete, amo vada ema, Iehova ena dubu maguna lalonai e gini; bena ia ese taunimanima iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto,
english: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of Yahweh’s house, and said to all the people:

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, ina hanua badana latanai bona digina hanuadia iboudiai latadiai lau ese dika idoinai ia latanai vada na gwauraia na baina hadihoa; badina be idia ese aiodia vada e ha-aukadia, bona egu hereva ikamonaidia asie ura.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.’”

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna Pasahuru, Imere natuna, Iehova ena dubu itataona tauna badana, na e kamonai, Ieremia ese ini ḡau vada e perovetalai.
english: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in Yahweh’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

motu: Bena Pasahuru ese peroveta tauna Ieremia e dadabaia, bena hekahi-tao audia ai e atoa, Iehova ena dubu ikoukouna, ladana Beniamina Ikoukouna, atai ḡauna, enai.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house.

motu: Daba rerena ai, Pasahuru ese Ieremia na hekahi-tao audia amo e kahua nege. Bena Ieremia ese e hamaoroa, eto, Iehova ese ladamu se hatoamu “Pasahuru”, a e hatoamu “Hahegari heḡegemadai”.
english: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “Yahweh has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib. + 20:3 “Magormissabib” means “surrounded by terror” *

motu: Badina be Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese oi sibomu ihagarimu bona oi turamu iboudiai ihagaridia ḡauna ai baina halaomu. Idia na inaidia edia dare matadia ai bae mase, oi vairamu ai. Bena lau ese Iuda taudia iboudiai na Babulono pavapavana imana ai baina atodia; ia ese baine ḡuidia, Babulono baine laohaidia, dare amo baine aladia mase.
english: For Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.

motu: Ina danu, hanua badana ena taḡa idoinai, vada e habou ḡaudia bona e heaḡilaimu kohudia iboudiai, bona Iuda pavapavadia edia kohu namodia iboudiai, na inaidia imadia ai baina atodia; idia ese bae dadihaidia, bae dabaidia tao, bena Babulono bae laohaidia.
english: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.

motu: Bona oi Pasahuru, bona emu ruma inoholaina taudia iboudiai, na bae ḡuimui, oi bona turamu iboudiai, ediai vada o peroveta koikoi taudia, Babulono do baola, unuseni ai ba mase, unuseni ai bae gurimui. Ieremia ena herohe-ahu
english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”

english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

motu: Iehova ba nanadaia ai daimai ai, badina be Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e tuari henimaimu; reana Iehova ese ena hoa karadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ai baine kara henimai, bona ai emai amo baine haloua.
english: “Please inquire of Yahweh for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps Yahweh will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”

motu: Bena Ieremia ese e haere henidia, eto,
english: Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:

motu: Sedekia na ini ba hamaoroa toma, baoto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, tuari ḡaudia imamui ai mimia, Babulono pavapavana bona Kaldea taudia, emui hanua maguna murimurinai e gegemui ahumu taudia, o tuarilai henidiamu ḡaudia, na baina laodia ahu, bona inaimui na ina hanua bogaraginai baina haheboudia.
english: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.

motu: Lau sibogu ese baina tuari henumui mai imagu hetoi-rorona bona imagu goadana ida, badu ai bona daḡedaḡe ai bona badu-garagara bada-hereana ai.
english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.

motu: Bona ina hanua inoholaina taudia baina harahudia mase, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia danu; dai-hanai gorerena badana ta ese baine hamasedia.
english: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.

motu: Iehova ma e tomamu: Una murinai lau ese Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, bona ena hesiai taudia, bona ina hanua taudia hahidaosi dai-hanai gorerena bona dare bona doe amo bae roho mauri taudia, na Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, bona adia inai taudia, edia mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia, imadia ai baina atodia. Ia ese dare matana amo baine aladia mase; basine bogadia hisi, basine kahudia nege, basine bogalaidia.
english: Afterward,” says Yahweh, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’

english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, as good.

motu: Lau ese baina haḡeredia, ihanamodia totona, bona baina hakaudia lou mai ina tano lalonai. Lau ese baina haginidia, basina ḡiḡidia dobi; baina hadodia, basina raḡadia.
english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

motu: Lalodia na baina hapararadia, vada bae diba, lau na Iehova; bena idia na lauegu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala; badina be idia ese bae lou henigu, mai lalodia idoidiai ida.
english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.

motu: A Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hari suke dikadia, vada e dika herea dainai basie heani diba ḡaudia, heḡereḡeredia, Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, bona ena lohia taudia bona Ierusalem taudia kwabukwabudia, ina tano ai e nohomu bona Aigupto tanona ai e nohomu taudia, na unu baina kara henidia toma.
english: “‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely Yahweh says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.

motu: Lau ese hahegari ḡauna ai baina halaodia, tanobada basileiadia iboudiai ediai; idia na gvau-tora bona udu gwaurai-gwaurai bona hegonagonalai bona heuduguirai ḡaudia ai baela, baina luludia lao gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

motu: Lau ese dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena na latadiai baina siaidia, ela bona idia bona senedia na henidia tanoua lalona amo bae hebua tari vaitani.
english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.’”

motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina ai (una na Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana), hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, Iuda taudia iboudiai daidiai;
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

motu: bena Ieremia, peroveta tauna, ese una hereva na Iuda taudia iboudhi bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia, eto:
english: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

motu: Laḡani ruahui-toi lalodiai, Iosia Amon, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwautatoina amo ema bona ina dina, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai vada e kau, bona vada na hereva henimui havara-havara to umui na asio kamonai.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

motu: Asio kamonai, bona taiamui asio hakala, ena be Iehova ese ena peroveta hesiai taudia iboudiai na dekemui e siaidia havara-havara,
english: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),

motu: eto, Iboumui ai ba helalo kerehai, ta ta emui dala dikadia bona emui kara dikadia amo ba raka oho; bena Iehova ese umui bona senemui nega gunadia amo ela bona hanaihanai vada e henimui tanona ai do ba noho;
english: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.

motu: bona dirava idaudia vairadiai basiola, isiaidia basio lao heni bona basio toma henidia diho, bona imamui ḡaukaradia amo basio habadugu; bena lau ese basina hadikamui.
english: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”

motu: Ḡau tamona (Iehova na e tomu), umui ese asio kamonai henigu, imamui ḡaukaradia amo ba habadugu totona, sibomui ihadikalaimui.
english: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says Yahweh, “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu hereva asio abidia dae dainai,
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,

motu: a itaia, lau ese mirigini kahana besedia iboudiai baina boiridia (Iehova na e tomu), bona Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, egu hesiai tauna, danu baina boiria; ina tano mai inoholaina taudia ida, bona ini heḡeḡemadai besedia iboudiai danu, ihadikadia totona baina mailaidia; bena baina habuadia tari vaitani, hahegari bona si-dagu bona gwau-tora hanaihanai ḡaudia ai baina halaodia.
english: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says Yahweh, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

motu: Ina danu, kiri bona moale reḡedia na idia edia amo baina abi oho, bona headava matamata tauna bona hahinena eredia danu, bona uit e idia patapata reḡedia bona lamepa diarina danu.
english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

motu: Ina tano idoinai na e ḡiḡia dobi bona e havahua ḡauna ai bainela, bona ini bese ese Babulono pavapavana isiaina bae ho heni, laḡani hitu-ahui lalodiai.
english: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

motu: Bena laḡani hitu-ahui bae ore murinai, lau ese Babulono pavapavana bona una basileia, Kaldea tanona basileiana, na edia kara havara davana baina henidia, bona edia tano baina havahua ela bona hanaihanai. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says Yahweh, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.

motu: Una tano latanai vada na gwaurai herevadia iboudiai na anidia baina havara, ia ihadikana; ina buka ai e hetore, Ieremia ese basileia iboudiai ihadikadia e gwaurai guna ḡaudia iboudiai.
english: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

motu: Badina be basileia momo bona pavapava badadia ese idia bae ḡuidia, edia hesiai taudia ai bae halaodia; bona lau ese baina hadava henidia, edia kara bona imadia ḡaukaradia heḡereḡeredia. Badu keherena
english: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”

motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese ini e hereva henigu toma, eto: Ina kehere, badu vine-ranuna keherena, na lau imagu amo avabia, bena dekedia baina siaimu lao basileiadia iboudiai na ba ha-inulaidia.
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.

motu: Idia na bae inu, bena bae raraga bona bae kavadia, bogaragidiai na siaiamu darena dainai.
english: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese kehere na Iehova imana amo na abia, Iehova ese dekedia e siaigu lao basileiadia iboudiai na na ha-inulaidia;
english: Then I took the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:

motu: Ierusalem bona Iuda hanuadia, bona pavapavana bona lohiana iboudiai danu; idia na gabu ḡaḡaena bona e vahu gabuna ai bona si-dagu bona heuduguirai ḡauna ai baela, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena;
english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;

motu: Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, mai ena hesiai taudia bona ena lohia taudia bona ena orea taudia iboudiai ida danu;
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;

motu: bona idau bese taudia idia bogaragidiai e nohomu danu; bona Usu tanona pavapavana iboudiai, bona Filistia taudia edia tano pavapavana iboudiai (Askelono, Gasa, Ekron bona Asdod kwabukwabudia) danu;
english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

motu: bona Edom bona Moab bona Amono garana,
english: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;

motu: bona Turo pavapavana iboudiai bona Sidono pavapavana iboudiai bona davara unukahana konena pavapavadia danu;
english: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

motu: bona Dedan, Tema, Busu, bona bagudia huidia e naudiamu taudia iboudiai,
english: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

motu: bona Arabia pavapavadia iboudiai bona e headava hanai besedia tano ḡaḡaena ai e nohomu edia pavapava iboudiai danu;
english: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;

motu: bona Simiri, Elam, Media pavapavadia iboudiai,
english: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

motu: bona mirigini kahana pavapavadia iboudiai, gabu daudaudia bona kahikahidia, murina murina amo, bona tanobada basileiadia iboudiai tano kopina idoinai latanai danu. Idia muridiai, Babulono pavapavana ese baine inua.
english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.

motu: Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Ba inua, ba kekero, ba mumuta, ba keto, basio tore isi lou, bogaragimui ai na siaia vasimu darena dainai.
english: “You shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’

motu: Idia na basiema ura inuinu keherena na oi imamu amo bae abia, boma hamaorodia, boma toma, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Vada ba inua!
english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.

motu: Badina be lau ladagu e henemailaia hanuana lalonai dika ihavarana baina matamaia, bena dava iabina amo ba roho mauri a? Dava iabina amo basio roho mauri, badina be dare ta maina na gwauraiamu, tanobada inoholaina taudia iboudiai ihadikadia ḡauna. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.”’

motu: Taunabunai, idia latadiai ba peroveta, ini hereva iboudiai ba gwaurai, baoto: Iehova na atai amo baine ḡaba, ena noho gabuna helaḡana amo ia gadona baine habadaia. Baine ḡaba badabada, ena mamoe serina latanai; baine lolo, vine huahuadia e moimoilaimu taudia na heheto, tanobada inoholaina taudia iboudiai latadiai.
english: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘ Yahweh|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H3068" * roar|strong="H7580" * from|strong="H5921" * on|strong="H5921" * high|strong="H4791" *, and|strong="H3068" * utter|strong="H5414" * his|strong="H3605" * voice|strong="H6963" * from|strong="H5921" * his|strong="H3605" * holy|strong="H6944" * habitation|strong="H5116" *. He|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H3068" * mightily|strong="H7580" * roar|strong="H7580" * against|strong="H5921" * his|strong="H3605" * fold|strong="H5116" *. He|strong="H3068" * will|strong="H3068" * give|strong="H5414" * a|strong="H3068" * shout|strong="H6963" *, as|strong="H1697" * those|strong="H3605" * who|strong="H3605" * tread|strong="H1869" * grapes, against|strong="H5921" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * inhabitants|strong="H3427" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3605" * earth.

motu: Reḡe na baine reḡe dae ela bona tanobada dokodia, badina be Iehova na mai ena hahebade ta, basileia idau-idau latadiai; ia ese taunimanima iboudiai be hahemaoro henidiamu, bona kara dika taudia na dare amo baine aladia mase. Iehova na e herevamu.
