motu: Iehova Sabaota iui e gwau tomamu: A itaia, kara dika na e laomu, basileia ta amo ela bona ma basileia ta; lai gubana badana ta e toa matamamu, tanobada daudaudia kahadia amo.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “ Behold|strong="H2009" *, evil|strong="H7451" * will|strong="H3068" * go|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" * from|strong="H3318" * nation|strong="H1471" * to|strong="H3318" * nation|strong="H1471" *, and|strong="H3068" * a|strong="H3068" * great|strong="H1419" * storm|strong="H5591" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3068" * raised|strong="H5782" * up|strong="H5782" * from|strong="H3318" * the|strong="H3541" * uttermost parts|strong="H3411" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3541" * earth.”

motu: Una dina ai, Iehova ese baine aladia mase taudia na tanobada dokona amo ela bona ma tanobada dokona bae hesiriu. Ta ese basine rohedia ahu, ta ese basine haboudia, ta ese basine guridia; idia na boromakau taḡena heḡereḡerena ai baela, tano kopina ai.
english: The slain of Yahweh will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.

motu: Mamoe ireḡudia taudia, ba tai, ba tai lolololo! Mamoe seridia biagudia, kahu ai ba hekui-hekui! Badina be iala-masemui bona ihakarohomui dinadia vada e kau, bena ba keto, mamoe mamaruanedia namo-hereadia na heheto.
english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow|strong="H6428" * in|strong="H3117" * dust, you|strong="H3588" * leader of|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H3588" * flock|strong="H6629" *; for|strong="H3588" * the|strong="H3588" * days|strong="H3117" * of|strong="H3117" * your|strong="H3588" * slaughter|strong="H2873" * and|strong="H3117" * of|strong="H3117" * your|strong="H3588" * dispersions|strong="H8600" * have|strong="H3117" * fully|strong="H4390" * come|strong="H5307" *, and|strong="H3117" * you|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3117" * fall|strong="H5307" * like|strong="H5307" * fine pottery|strong="H3627" *.

motu: Mamoe ireḡudia taudia edia komu gabuna ta basine mia, mamoe seridia biagudia edia roho-mauri gabuna ta danu basine mia.
english: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The|strong="H4480" * leader of|strong="H4480" * the|strong="H4480" * flock|strong="H6629" * will|strong="H6629" * have|strong="H7462" * no|strong="H4480" * escape|strong="H6413" *.

motu: A hakala, mamoe ireḡudia taudia na e taimu, mamoe seridia biagudia na e tai lolomu; badina be Iehova ese edia rei gabudia e havahudiamu,
english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3588" * wailing|strong="H3215" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3588" * leader of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3588" * flock|strong="H6629" *, for|strong="H3588" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * destroys|strong="H7703" * their|strong="H3068" * pasture|strong="H4830" *.

motu: bona edia magu, edia maino gabudia, vada e habuadia tari, Iehova ena badu ḡaraḡara dainai.
english: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because|strong="H6440" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H6440" * fierce|strong="H2740" * anger|strong="H6440" * of|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Leona na heto ia na ena komu gabuna amo vada e raka lasi, badina be edia tano vada e vahu, e hahisihisidiamu tauna ena dare dainai, bona ena badu ḡaraḡara dainai.
english: He has left his covert, as the lion; for|strong="H3588" * their|strong="H6440" * land|strong="H6440" * has|strong="H1961" * become|strong="H1961" * an|strong="H1961" * astonishment|strong="H8047" * because|strong="H3588" * of|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * fierceness|strong="H2740" * of|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H6440" * oppression|strong="H3238" *, and|strong="H6440" * because|strong="H3588" * of|strong="H6440" * his|strong="H6440" * fierce|strong="H2740" * anger|strong="H6440" *.

motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, e lohia matama negana ai, ina hereva na Iehova ena amo ema.
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from Yahweh:

motu: Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Iehova ena dubu maguna ai ba gini, bona Iuda hanuadia iboudiai amo tomadiho totona Iehova ena dubu baema taudia na ba hereva henidia, na haganilaimumu herevadia iboudiai na ba hamaorolaidia; hereva ta basio hunia.
english: “Yahweh says: ‘Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship in Yahweh’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Don’t omit a word.

motu: Readia bae kamonai, bona iboudiai ese ta ta ena dala dikana ena dala dikana bae rakatani; bena unu amo lau baina helalo kerehai, bona ihadikadia karana, edia kara dikadia daidiai vada na laloa hata ḡauna, na basina karaia.
english: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”

motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova ini e gwvau tomamu: Bema basio kamonai henigu, egu taravatu, vairamui ai vada na atoa ḡauna, lalonai basio raka,
english: You shall tell them, “Yahweh says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,

motu: bona egu hesiai peroveta taudia, ena be asio hakala to dekemui na siaidia ḡava taudia, na basio hakala henidia;
english: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—

motu: bena ina dubu na Silo heḡereḡerena ai baina halaoa, bona ina hanua na heuduguirai ḡauna ai baina halaoa, tanobada besedia iboudiai ediai.
english: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’”

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai na e kamonai, Ieremia ese unu hereva e gwaurai, Iehova ena dubu lalonai.
english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in Yahweh’s house.

motu: Iehova ese e haganilaia taunimanima iboudiai baine hamaorolaidia herevadia na Ieremia ese e gwaurai ore; bena hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai ese e dabaia tao, eto, Oi na ba mase.
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!

motu: Ma eto, Badina be dahaka oi na Iehova ladana ai vada o peroveta, oto “Ina dubu na Silo heḡereḡerena ai bainela, bona ina hanua na baine vahu, asi inoholaina” a? Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese Ieremia e daia ahu, Iehova ena dubu ai.
english: Why have you prophesied in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in Yahweh’s house.

motu: Iuda lohiadia ese ini ḡau e kamonai, bena pavapava ena ruma amo e dae lao, Iehova ena dubu ela; bena Iehova ena dubu Ikoukouna Matamatana raka-vareaina ai e helai diho.
english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to Yahweh’s house; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia ese lohia taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Ina tau na baita revaia mase be namo, badina be ia ese ina hanua ihadikana vada e perovetalaia, umui sibomui taiamui ai vada o kamonai.
english: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”

motu: Bena Ieremia ese lohia taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai na e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova ese e siaigu, vada o kamonai herevadia iboudiai na ina dubu bona ina hanua latadiai baina gwaurai guna.
english: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “Yahweh sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

motu: Taunabunai, emui dala bona emui kara ba hanamodia, bona Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona ba kamonaia, bena Iehova na baine helalo kerehai, kara dika na umui latamui ai vada e gwauraia na basine karaia.
english: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey Yahweh your God’s voice; then Yahweh will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.

motu: A lau be umui imamui ai; emui lalohadai namona bona maorona heḡereḡerena ai ba kara henigu.
english: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.

motu: Ḡau tamona ba diba momokani, boma hamasegu, umui ese asi ena kerere tauna rarana na sibomui latamui ai bona ina hanua mai inoholaina taudia ida latadiai boma hadihoa; badina be momokani Iehova ese dekemui e siaigu, ini hereva na taiamui ai baina gwaurai halaoreana.
english: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on its inhabitants; for in truth Yahweh has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.”

motu: Bena hanua lohiadia bona taunimanima iboudiai ese hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia na e hamaorodia, eto, Asi badina ina tau baita revaia mase, badina be ia ese Iehova, eda Dirava, ladana ai vada e hereva henida.
english: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: “This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahweh our God.”

motu: Bena una tano tau-badadia haida na e tore isi, hebou taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto,
english: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

motu: Mika, tau Moresete, na Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai e perovetava; bena ia ese Iuda taudia iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Siona na bae ruaia, biru gabuna na heto, bona Ierusalem baine heḡiḡi dobi, bona dubu ororona na ororo mai udana ta ai bainela.
english: “Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “‘ Zion|strong="H6726" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H1961" * plowed|strong="H2790" * as|strong="H3117" * a|strong="H3068" * field|strong="H7704" *, and|strong="H3063" * Jerusalem|strong="H3389" * will|strong="H3068" * become|strong="H1961" * heaps|strong="H5856" *, and|strong="H3063" * the|strong="H3605" * mountain|strong="H2022" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H3605" * house|strong="H1004" * as|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H3605" * high|strong="H1116" * places|strong="H1116" * of|strong="H4428" * a|strong="H3068" * forest|strong="H3293" *.’

motu: Hesekia, Iuda pavapavana, bona Iuda idoinai ese e alaia mase a? Ia ese Iehova garina e gari bona Iehova e noia baine lalo namo henia, ani? Bena Iehova na e helalo kerehai, dika idia latadiai vada e gwauraia na se havaraia, ani? A ita ese dika badana na ita siboda latadai baita hadihoamu.
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”

motu: Ma lau ta danu Iehova ladana ai e perovetava, ladana na Uria Semaia, Kiriat-iearimi tauna. Ia ese peroveta herevadia na ina hanua bona ina tano latadiai e gwaurai; ena hereva na Ieremia ena heḡereḡeredia.
english: There was also a man who prophesied in Yahweh’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

motu: Bena King Iehoiakim, mai ena tuari taudia bona ena lohia taudia iboudiai ida, na iena hereva e kamonai negana ai, hanua pavapavana ese ia iala-masena dalana e tahua. A Uria e kamonai, bena e gari, e heau mauri, Aigupto ela.
english: When Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt.

motu: Bena King Iehoiakim ese tatau haida na Aigupto e siaidia lao; taudia be Elnatan Akaboro bona haida ia ida.
english: Then Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him into Egypt.

motu: Bena idia ese Uria na Aigupto amo e hakaua mai, King Iehoiakim dekenai; bena ia ese dare amo e alaia mase, bena tau-anina na hanua taudia edia gara gabuna ai e negea.
english: They fetched Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

motu: A Ahikama Safana imana ese Ieremia e rauaia, una dainai hanua audia imadia ai asie atoa, bena asie alaia mase.
english: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they didn’t give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

motu: Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, e lohia matama negana ai, ina hereva na Iehova ena amo ema, Ieremia enai e kau.
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

motu: Iehova ese ini e hamaorogu toma, eto: Boromakau kopidia varodia bona boromakau madunadia ba kara, sibomu aiomu ai bavato.
english: Yahweh says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.

motu: Hereva na ba siaia, Edom bona Moab pavapavadia, bona Amono taudia edia pavapava, bona Turo bona Sidono pavapavadia, dekediai; hari gwukau taudia, Ierusalem vada ema Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, dekenai, imadia amo ba siaia lao.
english: Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

motu: Ina gwaukau herevana ba henidia, biagudia edia, baoto, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Biagumui na ini ba hamaorodia toma, baoto,
english: Give them a command to their masters, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “You shall tell your masters:

motu: Lau ese egu siahu badana amo bona imagu hetoi-rorona amo tanobada vada na karaia, bona tanobada taudia bona tanobada boromadia danu, bena na lalohadailai maoromu taudia na henidiamu.
english: ‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me.

motu: Harihari ini tano iboudiai na egu hesiai tauna Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, imana ai vada na atodia, bona tanobada boromadia danu vada na henia, idia ese ia isiaina bae lao heni.
english: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.

motu: Bese iboudiai ese ia bona natuna bona tubuna isiaidia bae lao heni, ela bona iena tano korikori ena nega baine kau, bena bese momo bona pavapava badadia ese ia bae ḡuia, edia hesiai tauna ai bae halaoa.
english: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.

motu: A bese ta eiava basileia ta ese hari Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, isiaina basinema lao heni, bona aiona na Babulono pavapavana ena maduna henunai basinema atoa, bena lau ese una bese davana baina henia, dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena amo, ela bona hari pavapava imana amo baina ha-orea. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “‘“‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says Yahweh, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

motu: Una dainai, emui peroveta taudia eiava emui mari-abi taudia eiava emui nihi taudia eiava emui rohe taudia eiava emui mea taudia ese bema hamaoromui, bema toma “Babulono pavapavana isiaina basio lao heni”, umui ese basioma kamonai henidia.
english: But as for you, don’t listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, “You shall not serve the king of Babylon;”

motu: Badina be idia na emui ai e peroveta koikoimu, bena una dainai umui na emui tano amo ba heabi oho dauhai; lau ese baina lulumui lasi, bena ba mase.
english: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, so that I would drive you out, and you would perish.

motu: A edena bese ta ese aiona na Babulono pavapavana ena maduna henunai baine atoa, bona isiaina baine lao heni, lau ese ena tano korikori ai baina rakatania, bena bae birulaia bona bae noholaia. Iehova na e haevamu.
english: But the nation that brings their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, that nation I will let remain in their own land,’ says Yahweh; ‘and they will till it and dwell in it.’”’”

motu: Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, danu unu na hereva henia toma, nato, Aiomui na Babulono pavapavana ena maduna henunai bavato, ia bona ena bese taudia isiaidia ba lao heni, bena ba mauri.
english: I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

motu: Anina be dahaka oi bona emu bese taudia na dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena amo ba mase, Iehova ese Babulono pavapavana isiaina basine lao heni besena vada e herevalaia heḡereḡerena, a?
english: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

motu: Hari peroveta taudia, e tomu “Babulono pavapavana isiaina basio lao heni” taudia, na edia hereva basio kamonai; badina be idia ese koikoi herevana e perovetalai henimuimu.
english: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Lau ese asina siaidia, ḡau tamona idia na lau ladagu ai e peroveta koikoimu, una dainai lau ese baina lulumui lasi, bena ba mase, umui bona e peroveta henimuimu taudia danu.
english: For I have not sent them,” says Yahweh, “but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.”

motu: Bena lau ese hahelaḡa taudia bona ina bese idoinai na hereva henidia, nato, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Emui peroveta taudia na e perovetamu, e tomu “A itaia, Iehova ena dubu kohudia na asi vanahana Babulono amo bae loulai”, to edia hereva basio kamonai, badina be idia ese koikoi herevana e perovetalai henimuimu.
english: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, Yahweh says, “Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of Yahweh’s house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

motu: Basio kamonai henidia; Babulono pavapavana isiaina ba lao heni, bena ba mauri. Anina be dahaka ina hanua badana na baine vahu?
english: Don’t listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?

motu: Bema idia na peroveta taudia bona Iehova ena hereva bema idia dekediai, idia ese Iehova Sabaota bema noia, Iehova ena dubu ai bona Iuda pavapavana ena ruma ai bona Ierusalem ai doini mimia kohudia na Babulono basie laohai.
english: But if they are prophets, and if Yahweh’s word is with them, let them now make intercession to Yahweh of Armies, that the vessels which are left in Yahweh’s house, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota ese au-tubua bona nau bada-hereana bona rerue bona kohu orena ina hanua ai doini mimia ḡaudia,
english: For Yahweh of Armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the sea, concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,

motu: Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese Iekonia, Iuda pavapavana Iehoiakim natuna, bona Iuda bona Ierusalem lohiadia iboudiai, e abidia mauri, Ierusalem amo e laohaidia ela bona Babulono, negana ai se laohai ḡaudia, na ini e herevalaidia tomamu.
english: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, ese Iehova ena dubu ai bona Iuda pavapavana ena ruma ai bona Ierusalem ai doini mimia kohudia na ini e herevalaidia tomamu:
english: yes, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in Yahweh’s house, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:

motu: Babulono bae laohaidia, unuseni ai bae mia, ela bona iau ese baina helalolaidia; bena ma baina loulaidia, ina gabu ai ma baina atodia lou. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: ‘They will be carried to Babylon, and there they will be, until the day that I visit them,’ says Yahweh; ‘then I will bring them up, and restore them to this place.’”

motu: Una laḡani tamona ai, Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia negana matamana ai, laḡani ihahanina huana iha-imana ai, Hanania Asuru, peroveta tauna Gibeon amo, ese e hereva henigu, Iehova ena dubu ai, hahelaḡa taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, eto,
english: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in Yahweh’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Babulono pavapavana ese e atoa madunana vada na hakwaidua.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

motu: Laḡani rua do basie ore ai, Iehova ena dubu kohudia iboudiai, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese ina gabu amo e abi oho Babulono e laohai ḡaudia, na lau ese baina loulai ina gabu ai.
english: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of Yahweh’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.

motu: Bona Iekonia, Iuda pavapavana Iehoiakim natuna, bona Iuda amo Babulono e laohaidia taudia iboudiai danu, lau ese baina hakaudia lou mai ina gabu ai, badina be Babulono pavapavana ese e atoa madunana na baina hakwaidua. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”

motu: Bena peroveta tauna Ieremia ese peroveta tauna Hanania e hereva henia, hahelaḡa taudia bona Iehova ena dubu Ialonai e gini taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in Yahweh’s house,

motu: Peroveta tauna Ieremia eto, Amen! Iehova unu baine kara toma baine namo. Iehova ese oiemu peroveta herevadia baine hamomokanidia, Iehova ena dubu kohudia iboudiai bona abi-mauri taudia danu na Babulono amo baine loulaidia ema bona ina gabu, una na baine namo.
english: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May Yahweh do so. May Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Yahweh’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ina hereva oi vairamu ai bona taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai na gwauraiamu na ba kamonai.
english: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:

motu: Peroveta taudia, ita raruosi e gunalaida taudia, ese nega gunadia amo tuari bona doe bona dai-hanai goreredia na tano momo bona basileia badadia latadiai e per vetalai.
english: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence.

motu: A maino e perovetalaiamu tauna be una peroveta tauna ena hereva anina baine vara negana ai vada bae diba Momokani, Iehova ese una peroveta tauna vada e siaia.
english: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that Yahweh has truly sent him.”

motu: Bena peroveta tauna Hanania ese maduna audia na peroveta tauna Ieremia aiona amo e abidia, bena e hakwaidudia.
english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.

motu: Bena Hanania na taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai e hereva, eto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Laḡani rua do basie ore ai lau ese Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e atodia madunadia na bese iboudiai aiodia amo unu baine hakwaidudia toma. Bena peroveta tauna Ieremia na ena ura dalana amo ela.
english: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “Yahweh says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

motu: Peroveta tauna Hanania ese maduna audia na peroveta tauna Ieremia aiona amo e hakwaidudia murinai, nega taina vada ela, bena Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Aola, Hanania ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Oi ese au madunadia vada o hakwaidudia, a lau ese auri madunadia baina kara, idia ibolodia.
english: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese ini bese iboudiai aiodia ai auri madunadia vada na atodia, Nebukadnesara, Babulono pavapavana, isiaina ilao-henina ḡaudia; bona idia ese ia isiaina bae lao heni, badina be lau ese tanobada boromadia danu vada na henia.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field.”’”

motu: Bena peroveta tauna Ieremia ese peroveta tauna Hanania e hamaoroa, eto, Hanania e, a kamonai! Iehova ese se siaimu; bona oi ese ina bese taudia lalodia e ha-uradia bena koikoi herevana vada e abidadama henia.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! Yahweh has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese tanobada kopina amo baina abimu oho; hari ina laḡani lalonai vada ba mase, badina be Iehova igwau-edeede-henina herevadia vada o gwaurai.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.’”

motu: Una laḡani lalonai, hua ihahituna ai, peroveta tauna Hanarua na e mase.
english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

motu: Peroveta launa Ieremia ena revareva, Ierusalem amo e siaia lao, Nebukadnesara ese Ierusalem amo Babulono e laohaidia unuseni ai e hanohodia taudia edia tau-badadia bona hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia bona taunimanima iboudiai edia, revarevana herevadia bini.
english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,

motu: Ina be King Iekonia mai sinana bona mai ena hesiai taudia ida, bona Iuda bona Ierusalem lohiadia, bona ima karakara dibaka bona auri iḡaukaralaina taudia, ese Ierusalem e rakatania murinai.
english: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem),

motu: Ina revareva na Elasa Safana bona Gemaria Hilkia, Iuda pavapavana Sedekia ese Babulono e siaidia lao Babulono pavapavana Nebukadnesara dekenai taudia, imadia ai e siaia lao. Ini e torea toma:
english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, ese Ierusalem amo vada e siaidla lao bena Babulono ai vada e hanohodia taudia na ini e hamaorodia tomamu:
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

motu: Ruma ba hagini, bena ba noholai; uma ba kara, bena anidia bavani.
english: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.

motu: Hahine bavadavadia, natumui mamaruanedia bona hahinedia ba havaradia; hahine haida ma bavabidia, natumui mamaruanedia adavadia, bona natumui hahinedia na ba haheadavadia. Bena idia ese natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia ma bae havaradia eneseni ai; bena bae hutuma, basie gadoi.
english: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.

motu: A vada na siaimui lao eneseni ai ba noho hanuana ena namo ba tahua, bona Iehova ba ḡuria ia dainai; badina be iena namo ai emui namo ba davaria.
english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”

motu: Badirla be Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui peroveta taudia bona emui bagu-haoro taudia bogaragimui ai e nohomu ese basie koimui, bona edia nihi sivaraidia basio kamonai;
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

motu: badina be idia ese e hereva koikoi henimuimu lau ladagu ai; lau ese asina siaidia. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.

motu: Badina be Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Laḡani hitu-ahui bae ha-ore Babulono enai, bena baina vadivadi henimui, bona egu gwauhamata na emui ai baina hamomokania, bona baina hakaumui lou mai ina gabu ai.
english: For Yahweh says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Badina be egu lalo-hata ḡaudia emui ai na dibagu, ihanamomui ḡaudia, dia ihadikamui ḡaudia, nega vaira ḡaudia bona helaro ḡaudia.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

motu: Bena ba hahanegu bona igurigu baoma; bena lau ese baina kamonai henimui.

english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says Yahweh.

motu: A ina na Israel iduhuna enai baina karaia taravatuna, unu dina muridiai. Iehova na e tomu: Egu taravatu na ediai baina atoa, bona lalodia ai baina torea; bena lau na edia Dirava ai bainala, bona idia na lauegu bese taudia ai baela.
english: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says Yahweh: “ I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * put|strong="H5414" * my|strong="H5414" * law|strong="H8451" * in|strong="H5921" * their|strong="H3068" * inward|strong="H1004" * parts|strong="H7130" *, and|strong="H3478" * I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * write|strong="H3789" * it|strong="H5414" * in|strong="H5921" * their|strong="H3068" * heart|strong="H3820" *. I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H1961" * their|strong="H3068" * God|strong="H3068" *, and|strong="H3478" * they|strong="H1992" * shall|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H1961" * my|strong="H5414" * people|strong="H5971" *.

motu: Una murinai asi tauna ta ese dekena tauna eiava tadikakana baine hadibaia, baineto “Iehova na ba dibaia”; badina be iboudiai ese bae dibagu, maragina amo ela bona badana (Iehova na e herevamu); badina be edia kara havara baina gwaua tao bona edia kara dika basina laloa tao lou.
english: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and|strong="H3068" * every|strong="H3605" * man|strong="H1419" * teach|strong="H3925" * his|strong="H3605" * brother|strong="H7453" *, saying, ‘ Know|strong="H3045" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *;’ for|strong="H3588" * they|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * all|strong="H3605" * know|strong="H3045" * me|strong="H3925" *, from|strong="H5704" * their|strong="H3605" * least|strong="H6996" * to|strong="H5704" * their|strong="H3605" * greatest|strong="H1419" *,” says|strong="H5002" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, “ for|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * forgive|strong="H5545" * their|strong="H3605" * iniquity|strong="H5771" *, and|strong="H3068" * I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * remember|strong="H2142" * their|strong="H3605" * sin|strong="H2403" * no|strong="H3808" * more|strong="H5750" *.”

motu: Iehova, dina e henimu, diari ihavarana, bona hua bona hisiu edia dala korikori e henidiamu, hanuaboi diarina ai baela, Diravana na ini e gwau tomamu. Ia ese davara e haginiamu ela bona hurehure na mai gurudia ida e poumu; ia ladana na Iehova Sabaota.
english: Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H5414" * ordinances|strong="H2708" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H5414" * moon|strong="H3394" * and|strong="H3068" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H5414" * stars|strong="H3556" * for|strong="H2708" * a|strong="H3068" * light by|strong="H3068" * night|strong="H3915" *, who|strong="H3068" * stirs|strong="H7280" * up|strong="H5414" * the|strong="H5414" * sea|strong="H3220" *, so|strong="H3541" * that|strong="H3068" * its|strong="H5414" * waves|strong="H1530" * roar|strong="H1993" *— Yahweh|strong="H3068" * of|strong="H3068" * Armies|strong="H6635" * is|strong="H3068" * his|strong="H5414" * name|strong="H8034" *, says|strong="H3541" *:

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Ini edia dala korikori na vairagu amo bema heabi oho, bena Israel vevena na basie noho bese ta lau vairagu ai, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: “If these ordinances depart from before me,” says Yahweh, “ then|strong="H1961" * the|strong="H3605" * offspring|strong="H2233" * of|strong="H3068" * Israel|strong="H3478" * also|strong="H1571" * will|strong="H3068" * cease|strong="H7673" * from|strong="H6440" * being|strong="H1961" * a|strong="H3068" * nation|strong="H1471" * before|strong="H6440" * me|strong="H6440" * forever|strong="H3605" *.”

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Guba atai ai bema hahetohoa diba, bona tano badidia henu ai bema tahudia diba, bena Israel vevena iboudiai bama negedia daure, edia kara iboudiai daidiai. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Yahweh says: “If heaven above can be measured, and|strong="H3478" * the|strong="H3605" * foundations|strong="H4146" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3605" * earth|strong="H8064" * searched|strong="H2713" * out|strong="H2713" * beneath|strong="H4295" *, then|strong="H1571" * I|strong="H3541" * will|strong="H3068" * also|strong="H1571" * cast|strong="H3068" * off|strong="H5921" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * offspring|strong="H2233" * of|strong="H3068" * Israel|strong="H3478" * for|strong="H5921" * all|strong="H3605" * that|strong="H3605" * they|strong="H3068" * have|strong="H3068" * done|strong="H6213" *,” says|strong="H5002" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: A itaia, nega na e maimu, hanua na bae haginia lou, Iehova ena, Hananele kohorona amo ela bona Daiguni Ikoukouna.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the city will be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.

motu: Bena hahetoho varona na ma bae veria lao, maoromaoro bainela ela bona Gareb ororona, ma bae veria mageva ela bona Goa.
english: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.

motu: Mase tau-anidia bona kahu kourana idoinai bona rei gabudia iboudiai ela bona Kidron dokadokana, ela bona Hosi Ikoukouna daigunina, mairiveina kahana ai, idoinai baine helaḡa Iehova ena. Ia na nega ta ai basine heraga eiava basine heḡiḡi dobi ela bona hanaihanai.
english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be holy to Yahweh. It will not be plucked up or thrown down any more forever.”

motu: Ina hereva na Iehova ena amo Ieremia enai e kau, Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagvautana ai. Una na Nebukadresara ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahanina.
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

motu: Una negana ai Babulono pavapavana ena tuari oreana ese Ierusalem vada e daia heḡeḡe; bona peroveta tauna Ieremia na hegima taudia edia magu lalonai vada e hekou, Iuda pavapavana ena ruma ai.
english: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

motu: Badina be Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, ese vada e koua ahu, eto, Badina be dahaka o perovetamu, o tomu, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese ina hanua na Babulono pavapavana imana ai na atoamu, ia ese baine abia;
english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take it;

motu: bona Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, na Kaldea taudia imadia amo basine roho mauri diba, a ia na momokani Babulono pavapavana imana ai baine heato, ia ida hevaira-hehenidia ai bae hereva heheni bona bae heroha heheni.
english: and Zedekiah king of Judah won’t escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes;

motu: Bena ia ese Sedekia na Babulono baine laohaia, unuseni ai baine noho ela bona lau ese baina vadivadi henia; Iehova na e herevamu. Ena be Kaldea taudia ba tuari henidia to basio kwalimu.
english: and he will bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” says Yahweh, “though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not prosper”’?”

motu: Ieremia eto, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Jeremiah said, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: A itaia, Hanamele, tamamu lahaina Salumu natuna, na baine vasi, baineto “Egu tano Anatoto ai, Beniamina tanona ai, ba hoia, badina be iabi-taona siahuna na oiemu ai”.
english: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.”’”

motu: Bena tadikakagu Hanamele na dekegu ema, hegima taudia edia magu ai, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena ai, e hereva henigu, eto, Egu tano Anatoto ai, Beniamina tanona ai, ba hoia, badina be iabina mai siahuna tauna na oi; ba hoia emu. Bena na diba una na Iehova ena hereva.
english: “So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to Yahweh’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours. Buy it for yourself.’ “ Then|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * knew|strong="H3045" * that|strong="H3588" * this|strong="H1931" * was|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *’s word|strong="H1697" *.

motu: Bena una tano Anatoto ai na tadikakagu Hanamele ena amo na hoia, moni na hahetohoa, na henia, silver * sekeledia gwauta-hitu.
english: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels + 32:9 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * of silver.

motu: Ladagu na tano ibiaguna pepana ai na torea, na koua kunuka-kunuka, bena kara ihamomokanina taudia na abidia, bona moni na metau ihahetohona ḡauna ai na hahetohoa.
english: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.

motu: Bena hari tano ibiaguna pepana, e koua kunuka-kunuka ḡauna, bona ia ida-idana pepana ta, e hulala ḡauna, na abidia;
english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

motu: bena hari tano ibiaguna pepana na Baruku, Neria Mahaseia natuna, na henia, tadikakagu Hanamele vairanai, bona kara ihamomokanidia totona ladadia na una pepa ai e tore taudia vairadiai, bona Iuda taudia, hegima taudia edia maḡu ai e helaiva taudia, iboudiai vairadiai danu.
english: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

motu: Idia vairadiai Baruku na haḡania, nato,
english: “I commanded Baruch before them, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Ini tano ibiaguna pepadia, hari e koua kunuka-kunuka ḡauna, bona hari e hulala ḡauna danu, avabidia, hodu ta ai ba udadia, bae mia daudau helaoreana.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.’

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Ruma bona tano bona vine imeadia ma bae hoi lou ina tano ai.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Houses and fields and vineyards will yet again be bought in this land.’

motu: Hari tano ibiaguna pepana na Baruku Neria na henia murinai, lau ese Iehova na ḡuria, nato,
english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to Yahweh, saying,

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi ese guba bona tanobada na emu siahu badana bona imamu hetoi-rorona amo vada o kara. Ḡau ta na dia auka oiemu;
english: “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.

motu: oi na daha daha o bogadia hisimu, a tama edia kerere davadia na muridiai natudia o henidiamu. Dirava badana, Siahu Diravana e, oi ladamu na Iehova Sabaota;
english: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is your name:

motu: emu hahealo na bada, bona emu kara na mai siahudia; oi matamu e papamu, taunimanima edia kara iboudiai o itadiamu, ta ta ena dala ena dala bona ena kara anidia ena kara anidia heḡereḡeredia davadia o henidiamu.
english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;

motu: Oi ese toa bona hoa karadia na Aigupto tanona ai vada o hahedinarai, bona Israel ai bona taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidiai danu, ema bona ina dina; bona sibomu ladamu vada o hadaea ina dina ai.
english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;

motu: Oi ese emu bese Israel na Aigupto tanona amo o hakaudia lasi, mai toa bona hoa karadia, bona mai imamu goadana, mai imamu hetoi-rorona, bona mai hahegari badana ida.
english: and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

motu: Ina tano danu vada o henidia, senedia o gwau henidia hamata ba henidia oto tanona, rata bona bada ranuna e arumu tanona;
english: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

motu: bena e raka vareai, e ḡaunaia. A idia na oi eremu asie kamonai, bona oiemu taravatu ai asie raka; o haganilaidia karadia iboudiai na ta asie karaia. Una dainai ina dika idoinai na idia latadiai vada o hadihoa.
english: They came in and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice and didn’t walk in your law. They have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do. Therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them.

motu: A itaia, tano vada e senua, hanua badana iabina totona, bena dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena daidiai hanua na Kaldea taudia, e tuari heniamu taudia, imadia ai vada e atoa. O gwaurai herevadia anidia vada e vara, bena vada o itaia.
english: “Behold, siege ramps have been built against the city to take it. The city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, of the famine, and of the pestilence. What you have spoken has happened. Behold, you see it.

motu: A oi, Ḡaubada Iehova e, vada o hamaorogu, oto, Ena be hanua na Kaldea taudia imadia ai vada na atoa, to oi ese tano na moni amo ba hoia, kara ihamomokanina taudia danu bavabidia.
english: You have said to me, Lord Yahweh, ‘Buy the field for money, and call witnesses;’ whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, eto:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

motu: A itaia, lau na Iehova, mauri ḡaudia iboudiai edia Dirava. Kara ta na auka herea, bena basina karaia diba a?
english: “Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

motu: Taunabunai Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese ina hanua na Kaldea taudia imadia ai bona Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, imana ai baina atoa, bena ia ese baine abia.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

motu: Kaldea taudia, ina hanua e tuari heniamu taudia, na baema, ina hanua na bae daea, bae doua; guhidia ai muramura mai bonana na Baal e gabu henia bona inuinu bouboudia na dirava idaudia e bubu henidia bena unu amo e habadugu rumadia danu bae dou.
english: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

motu: Badina be Israel garana bona Iuda garana na kara dikadia mo vada e kara lau vairagu ai, merodia negadia amo, Israel garana imadia ḡaukaradia na lau ihabadugu karadia mo. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahweh.

motu: Ina hanua ese egu badu bona egu lalo-siahu vada e havaradia, e haginia dinana amo ema bona ina dina, una dainai lau ese vairagu amo baina abia oho,
english: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day, so that I should remove it from before my face,

motu: Israel garana bona Iuda garana edia kara dika iboudiai daidiai. Idia ese lau ihabadugu karadia e kara: edia pavapava bona edia lohia, edia hahelaḡa taudia bona edia peroveta taudia, Iuda taudia bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ese.
english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

motu: Idia ese vada e gini muri henigu, asie vaira henigu. Ena be na hadibadia havara-havara to idia ese hahediba herevadia na asie hakala henidia.
english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

motu: Edia ḡau dika-rohorohodia na e haginidia, lau ladagu e henemailaia dubuna lalonai, bae hamiroa totona.
english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

motu: Baal ena atai gabudia helagadia e larebadia, Hinom natuna ena koura ai, natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na boubou ḡaudia ai bae halaodia totona, Molek ena. A lau ese asina haḡanidia bona asina laloa idia ese una kara dika-rohorohona amo Iuda taudia bae hakaradia dika.
english: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech, which I didn’t command them. It didn’t even come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.”

motu: Taunabunai, ina hanua, umui ese o herevalaiamu, o tomu “Dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena amo Babulono pavapavana imana u vada e atoa”, hanuana na Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese ini e herevalaia tomamu:
english: Now therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, about which you say, “It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:”

motu: A itaia, egu badu bona egu lalo-siahu bona egu lalo-garagara bada-herea lalonai na luludia lao tanodia iboudiai amo ma baina haboudia lou; baina loulaidia ina gabu ai, bona baina hanohodia namonamo.
english: “Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place. I will cause them to dwell safely.

motu: Idia na lauegu bese ai baela bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala.
english: Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.

motu: Lalo tamona bona dala tamona baina henidia, bena lau bae gari henigu hanaihanai, idia bona muridhi natudia danu ihanamodia.
english: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.

motu: Lau ese egu gwauhamata baina henidia hanaihanai, bainato, idia ihanamodia karadia amo basina raka siri; bona lau garigu na lalodia ai baina atoa, egu amo basie raka siri helaoreana.
english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

motu: Idia ihanamodia karadia baina moalelaidia, bona heabidadama ai ina tano ai baina hadaidia, mai lalogu idoinai bona mai laumagu idoinai ida.
english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

motu: Badina be Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Ina dika badana idoinai na ina bese taudia latadiai vada na hadihoa heḡereḡerena, lau ese danu na gwauhamatalai henidiamu kara-namodh iboudiai ma baina hadiho.
english: For Yahweh says: “Just as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

motu: Ina tano, umui ese o herevalaiamu, o tomu “Ia na vada e vahu, asi tauna bona asi ubu-ubu ḡauna; Kaldea taudia imadia ai vada e atoa”, tanona lalonai inogo vada ba hoi;
english: Fields will be bought in this land, about which you say, ‘It is desolate, without man or animal. It is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’

motu: Inoḡo na moni amo ba hoi, bona tano ibiagudia pepadia ai ladamui ba tore, bena ba koudia kunuka-kunuka, bona kara ihamomokanina taudh ese bae hamomokanidia, Beniamina tanona ai, bona Ierusalem hetabirana ai, bona Iuda hanuadia ai, bona ororo kahadia hanuadia bona taora hanuadia bona diho kahana hanuadia ai; badina be edia noho ma baina hanamoa lou. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed,” says Yahweh.

motu: Nega iharuana Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, ia na dounu hegima taudia edia maḡu ai e hekou ahu negana ai.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,

motu: Iehova, tanobada e karaia bona baine gini tutuka-tutuka totona oromana e henia Diravana (ia ladana na Iehova) ini e gwau tomamu:
english: “Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it—Yahweh is his name, says:

motu: Ba boi henigu, bena baina haere henimu, bona ḡau badadia, hehuni ḡaudia, do asi dibamu ḡaudia, na baina hamaorolaimu.
english: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

motu: Badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese ina hanua rumadia bona Iuda pavapavadia edia ruma, e larebadia tanodia bona dare ilao-ahudia totona e ḡiḡidia dobi rumadia, na ini e herevalaidia tomamu:
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword:

motu: Kaldea taudia na e aru e maimu, bae tuari henidia, bona egu badu bona egu lalo-siahu ai baina rahudh mase taudia tau-anidia masedia amo bae hahonudia; badina be lau ese vairagu na ina hanua amo vada na hunia, edia kara dikadia iboudiai daidiai.
english: ‘While men come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city,

motu: A itaia, lau ese goada bona tauhalo baina henia; baina hanamodia, bona noho-namo bona noho-maino na baina hahedinarai henidia badabada.
english: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

motu: Iuda bona Israel edia noho-namo ma baina henidia lou, bona baina haginidia lou, e gini gunava heḡereḡerena.
english: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel, and will build them as at the first.

motu: E kara dika henigu dikana mirona idoinai amo baina haḡoevadia, bona edia kara dika bona edia gwau-edeede egu ai mirona idoinai na baina gwaua tao.
english: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against me. I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned against me and by which they have transgressed against me.

motu: Bena ina hanua na egu ai lada mai moalena, heimodai ḡauna bona hairai ḡauna ai bainela, tanobada besedia iboudiai vairadiai. Idia ese kara namo iboudiai, lau ese na kara henidiamu karadia, sivaraidia bae kamonai; idia na bae gari, taudia bae heude-heude, kara namo iboudiai bona noho-namo idoinai ina hanua baina karalai henia dainai.
english: This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will hear all the good that I do to them, and will fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I provide to it.’”

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Ina gabu, o herevalaiamu o tomu “Ia na vada e vahu, asi tauna ta eiava asi ubu-ubu ḡauna ta” gabuna ai, bona Iuda hanuadia ai bona Ierusalem ariaradia ai, idia danu vada e vahu, asi tauna ta eiava asi inoholaina ta eiava asi ubu-ubu ḡauna ta, unuseni ai
english: Yahweh says: “Yet again there will be heard in this place, about which you say, ‘It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,’

motu: kiri gadona bona moale gadona, headava matamata tauna gadona bona headava matamata hahinena gadona, bae kamonaidia lou; bona ane-abi taudia gadodia danu. Idia ese hahenamo boubouna ḡaudia na Iehova ena dubu ai bae mailaidia, baeto, Iehova Sabaota ba hanamoa, badina be Iehova na namo; badina be ena hebogahisi na e hesiriu hanaihanaimu. Badina be lau ese tano ena noho-namo gunana ma baina henia lou. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, ‘Give thanks to Yahweh of Armies, for Yahweh is good, for his loving kindness endures forever;’ who bring thanksgiving into Yahweh’s house. For I will cause the captivity of the land to be reversed as at the first,” says Yahweh.

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Ina gabu ḡaḡaena, asi tauna ta eiava asi ubu-ubu ḡauna ta gabuna, lalonai, bona hanuana iboudiai lalodiai, mamoe ireḡudia taudia, edia mamoe e halaḡa-anidiamu taudia, edia noho gabudia ma bae hekara lou.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Yet again there will be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

motu: Ororo kahadia hanuadia ai bona taora hanuadia ai bona diho kahana hanuadia ai, bona Beniamina tanona ai bona Ierusalem hetabirana gabudia ai, bona Iuda hanuadia ai, mamoe seridia na iduahidia tauna imana henudia amo bae raka hanai. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of him who counts them,” says Yahweh.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: A itaia, negana be maimu, lau ese Israel iduhuna bona Iuda iduhuna na henidia gwauhamatana baina hamomokania.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

motu: Unu dinadia ai bona una nega ai, lau ese Rigi ta, kara maoromaoro ḡauna, na baina hatubua, David ena; bena ia ese hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva bona kara maoromaoro baine kara ina tano ai.
english: “In those days and at that time, I|strong="H3117" * will|strong="H1931" * cause|strong="H4941" * a|strong="H3068" * Branch|strong="H6780" * of|strong="H3117" * righteousness|strong="H6666" * to|strong="H6213" * grow|strong="H6779" * up|strong="H6779" * to|strong="H6213" * David|strong="H1732" *. He|strong="H1931" * will|strong="H1931" * execute|strong="H6213" * justice|strong="H4941" * and|strong="H3117" * righteousness|strong="H6666" * in|strong="H6213" * the|strong="H6213" * land.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Iuda na baine mauri, bona Ierusalem baine noho namonamo. Bona ladana na ini bae hatoa toma: “Iehova na eda kara maoromaoro”.
english: In those days Judah will be saved, and|strong="H3063" * Jerusalem|strong="H3389" * will|strong="H3068" * dwell|strong="H7931" * safely. This|strong="H2088" * is|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3068" * name|strong="H7121" * by|strong="H3117" * which|strong="H3068" * she|strong="H7121" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3068" * called|strong="H7121" *: Yahweh|strong="H3068" * our|strong="H3068" * righteousness|strong="H6664" *.”

motu: Badina be Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: David iduhuna amo nega ta ai Israel ena bese teronona ihelai-kauna taudia ta ai basine dabu,
english: For Yahweh says: “David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.

motu: bona hahelaḡa taudia Levi oreana amo nega ta lau vairagu ai ḡole-oho bouboudia ihahelaḡadia bona flaoa bouboudia igabudia bona boubou karadia ikaradia taudia ta ai basie dabu, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: The Levitical priests won’t lack a man before me to offer burnt offerings, to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Egu haheḡani dina enai eiava hanuaboi enai boma utua diba, bena dina bona hanuaboi na edia nega korikoridia ai basiema hedinarai,
english: “Yahweh says: ‘If you can break my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, so that there will not be day and night in their time,

motu: bena egu gwauhamata egu hesiai tauna David enai danu ba utua diba, bena garana ta basine vara ena terono ihelai-kauna; bona egu gwauhamata hahelaḡa taudia Levi oreana amo, egu hesiai taudia, ediai danu ba utua diba.
english: then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won’t have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers.

motu: Guba hisiudia na asi iduahidia bona kone miridia na asi ihahetohodia na heto, egu hesiai tauna David garana bona hahelaḡa taudia Levi oreana amo garadia unu baina hahutumadia toma.
english: As the army of the sky can’t be counted, and the sand of the sea can’t be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai ma e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Ini taunimanima edia hereva so kamonai, eto “Iehova ese e abidia hidi iduhudia ruaosi vada e dadaraidia”, a? Unuheto, idia ese egu bese taudia vada e dadaraidia, bena harihari idia na dia bese ta idia vairadiai.
english: “Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.”

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Egu haheḡani dina bona hanuaboi ediai basinama haginia bona guba bona tanobada taravatudia danu,
english: Yahweh says: “If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,

motu: bena lau ese Iakob bona egu hesiai tauna David garadia baina dadaraidia, bona ia garana ta basina abia hidi, Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob vevedia ilohiadia. Badina be edia noho-namo baina havara henidia lou, bona baina bogadia hisi.
english: then I will also cast away the offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his offspring to be rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed and will have mercy on them.”

motu: A Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, bona ena tuari oreana idoinai, bona tanobada basileiadia iboudiai, iena siahu henunai e nohova oreadia, bona bese idau-idau iboudiai, ese Ierusalem mai ena hanua iboudiai ida e tuari henidiava negana ai, Iehova ena hereva ta na Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:

motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Aola, Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, ba hereva henia, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, ina hanua na Babulono pavapavana imana ai baina atoa; ia ese lahi amo baine doua.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire.

motu: Oi na ia imana amo basio roho mauri; momokani, haida ese bae abimu mauri, bena ia imana ai bae atomu. Oi na Babulono pavapavana ida ba heroha heheni, ba hevaira heheni, bona ba hereva heheni; bena Babulono baola.
english: You won’t escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.”’

motu: Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, e! Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Iehova ese ini e herevalaimu tomamu: Dare ai basio mase.
english: “Yet hear Yahweh’s word, O Zedekiah king of Judah. Yahweh says concerning you, ‘You won’t die by the sword.

motu: Maino ai ba mase. Senemu, pavapava dagina ai e gunalaimu taudia, daidiai muramura mai bonadia e gabu heḡereḡerena ai, taunimanima ese muramura mai bonadia bae gabu oi daimu ai, bona oi daimu ai bae rohe ahu, baeto “Ḡauka e, ihabaimu!” Iehova na e tomu: Vada na hereva.
english: You will die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will make a burning for you. They will lament you, saying, “Ah Lord!” for I have spoken the word,’ says Yahweh.”

motu: Bena peroveta tauna Ieremia ese ini hereva iboudiai na Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, e hamaorolaia, Ierusalem ai,
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

motu: Babulono pavapavana ena tuari oreana ese Ierusalem bona Iuda hanuadia oredia iboudiai, Lakisi bona Aseka, dounu e tuari henidiava negana ai. Badina be hanua mai maḡudia dounu Iuda ai e miava be unu ruaosi mo. Hesiai taudia iruhadia bona iḡui-loudia sivaraina
english: when the king of Babylon’s army was fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.

motu: King Sedekia ese Ierusalem taudia iboudiai taravadia e atu, hekahu-nege herevadia e gwaurai henidia, murinai Iehova ena hereva ta na Ieremia enai e kau.
english: The word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,

motu: E gwaurai henidia herevana binai: idia iboudiai ese edia hesiai taudia, Heberu taudia vada e ḡuidia bona isiaidia ilao-henidia taudia ai vada e halaodia taudia, tatau bona hahine, bae ruhadia nege; bena tau ta ese tadikakana Iuda tauna ta basine ḡuia, ena hesiai tauna ai basine halaoa.
english: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free, that no one should make bondservants of them, of a Jew his brother.

motu: Bena e kamonai, hanua lohiadia bona hanua taudia iboudiai ese taravatu vada e abia dae, iboudiai ese edia hesiai taudia, tatau eiava hahine, bae ruhadia nege, bena basie ḡuidia lou eto. Idia na e kamonai, e ruhadia nege.
english: All the princes and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant and everyone his female servant go free, that no one should make bondservants of them any more. They obeyed and let them go,

motu: A gabeamo idia na e kerehai, edia hesiai taudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia, vada e ruhadia nege taudia, na ma e abidia lou, e ḡuidia, hesiai taudia ai ma e halaodia.
english: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids whom they had let go free to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Iehova ena amo Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
english: Therefore Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Senemui na Aigupto tanona amo bona iḡui rumana amo na hakaudia lasi negana ai lau ese taravadia na atu, nato
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying:

motu: “Laḡani tauratoi dokodia ai, iboumui ai ese tadikakamui Heberu taudia vada o hoidia bena laḡani tauratoi lalodiai isiaimui vada e lao heni taudia, vada ba ruhadia nege; isiaimui ilao-henina amo ba ruhadia nege”. A senemui ese asie kamonai henigu bona asie hakala henigu.
english: At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years. You shall let him go free from you. But your fathers didn’t listen to me, and didn’t incline their ear.

motu: Vanegai mo umui na o helalo kerehai, bena kara maoromaorona na lau vairagu ai vada o karaia, hekahu-nege o gwaurai hedinarai, ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna ediai; bona lau vairagu ai o gwau hamata, lau ladagu e henemailaia dubuna lalonai.
english: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name;

motu: A ma o kerehai lou, lau ladagu o hamiroa; iboumui ai emui hesiai taudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia, edia ura heḡereḡerena ai vada o ruhadia nege taudia, ma o abidia lou, o ḡuidia, hesiai taudia ai ma o halaodia.
english: but you turned and profaned my name, and every man caused his servant and every man his handmaid, whom you had let go free at their pleasure, to return. You brought them into subjection, to be to you for servants and for handmaids.’”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Asio kamonai henigu, hekahu-nege igwauraina ai, ta ta tadikakana tadikakana ediai, bona ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna ediai; benaini, lau ese hekahu-nege na gwaurai henimuimu, dare bona dai-hanai gorerena bona doe na latamui ai na kahudia negemu, bona hahegari ḡauna ai baina halaomui tanobada basileiadia iboudiai ediai.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

motu: Bona egu taravatu e tataia utu bona edia gwauhamata, lau vairagu ai e gwauraia ḡauna, asie badinaia taudia na boromakau natuna, idia ese e utua parara bona kahana kahana padadia amo e rakaia hanai ḡauna, heḡereḡerena ai baina halaoa:
english: I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts:

motu: Iuda lohiadia, Ierusalem lohiadia, hesiai taudia, hahelaḡa taudia, bona hanua taudia, boromakau natuna kahana kahana padadia amo e raka hanai taudia iboudiai.
english: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf.

motu: Bena lau ese inaidia imadia ai bona edia mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia imadia ai baina atodia. Tau-anidia masedia na atai manudia bona tanobada boromadia ese bae ani.
english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

motu: Bona Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, bona ena lohia taudia, na lau ese inaidia imadia ai, bona edia mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia imadia ai, bona Babulono pavapavana ena tuari oreana, hari emui amo vada e raka oho oreana, imadia ai, baina atodia.
english: “I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hands of their enemies, into the hands of those who seek their life and into the hands of the king of Babylon’s army, who has gone away from you.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: A itaia, lau baina haheḡani, bena ma baina loulaidia mai, ina hanua ma baema; bena idia ese bae tuari henia, bae abia, lahi amo bae doua. Iuda hanuadia na baina havahudia, asi unoholaidia bae mia.
english: Behold, I will command,” says Yahweh, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, ena nega ai, Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

motu: Rekab taudia edia ruma baola, ba hereva henidia, bena ba hakaudia mai, Iehova ena dubu ai, daiutuna ta lalonai. Bena vine ranuna ba dudui henidia, bae inua totona.
english: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into Yahweh’s house, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iaasania, Ieremia Habasinia natuna, mai tadikakana bona natuna iboudiai ida, bona Rekab iduhuna idoinai, na abidia.
english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, with his brothers, all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

motu: Na hakaudia mai, Iehova ena dubu ai, Hanana Igdalia, Dirava ena tau, natuna edia daiutu lalonai. Una daiutu na lohia taudia edia daiutu badibadinai, bona Ma-aseia Salumu, dubu raka-vareaina igimana tauna, ena daiutu daenai.
english: and I brought them into Yahweh’s house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

motu: Bena hodu haida, vine ranuna ai e honu ḡaudia, bona kehere haida na idia vairadiai na ato; bena na hereva henidia, nato, Vine ranuna ba inua.
english: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!”

motu: A idia na e haere, eto, Ai na vine ranuna basia inua, badina be ai senemai Ionadab Rekab ese e haḡanimai, eto, Vine ranuna basio unua, umui bona garamui danu, ela bona hanaihanai;
english: But they said, “We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall drink no wine, neither you nor your children, forever.

motu: ruma auta basio haginia; basio hadohado; vine imeana ta basio hadoa eiava basio abia emui; a emui mauri dinadia iboudiai kalaga ai ba noho, o noholaiamu tanona ai emui mauri dinadia bae hoho helaoreana.
english: You shall not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, or have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that you may live many days in the land in which you live as nomads.’

motu: Ai ese senemai Ionadab Rekab gadona vada a badinaia, e haganilaimai karadia iboudiai lalodiai, emai mauri dinadia iboudiai vine ranuna asia inuamu, ai bona adavamai bona natumai mamaruanedia bona hahinedia danu;
english: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;

motu: bona ruma danu asia haginidia, asia noholaidia. Asi emai vine imeadia, asi emai uma, asi emai uhe;
english: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed;

motu: a kalaga ai vada a noho, bona senemai Ionadab ese e haganilaimai karadia iboudiai vada a badinadia bona a karadia.
english: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

motu: A Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, na tano idaena totona ema negana ai, ai ato “Aoma, Ierusalem aitala, Kaldea taudia bona Suria taudia edia tuari oreadia na garidia”. Taunabunai ai na Ierusalem ai a nohomu.
english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, ‘Come! Let’s go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we will dwell at Jerusalem.’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Aola, Iuda taudia bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova na e tomu: Hahediba herevadia basio abi dae bona egu hereva basio kamonai a?
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says Yahweh.

motu: Haheḡani, Ionadab Rekab ese garana e henidia ḡauna, vine ranuna basie inua, na vada e badinaia; idia na asie inuamu ema bona ina dina, badina be senedia ena haheḡani vada e badinaia. Lau ese vada na hereva henimui havara-havara, a umui ese asio kamonai henigu.
english: “The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father’s commandment; but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking, and you have not listened to me.

motu: Lau ese egu peroveta hesiai taudia iboudiai vada na siaidia vasi, na siaidia havara-havara, nato, Iboumui ai emui dala dikadia amo ba raka siri, bona emui kara ba haḡoevadia, bona dirava idaudia muridia amo basiola, isiaidia basio lao heni; bena umui na henimui bona senemui na henidia tanona ai do ba noho. A taiamui asio hakala bona asio kamonai henigu.
english: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them. Then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers;’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

motu: Ionadab Rekab garana ese senedia ena haheḡani vada e badinaia, a ina bese ese se kamonai henigu.
english: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.”’

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, hahedika Iuda bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia iboudiai latadiai vada na gwaurai ḡauna na ediai baina havaraia; badina be vada na hereva henidia to asie kamonai, vada na boi henidia to asie haere.
english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.’”

motu: A Rekab iduhuna taudia na Ieremia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be senemui Ionadab ena haheḡani vada o badinaia, bona ena hahediba herevadia iboudiai vada o badinadia, bona e haganilaimui karadia iboudiai vada o kara,
english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,’

motu: una dainai Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Ionadab Rekab iduhuna na nega ta ai lau vairagu ai iginina taudia ta ai basine dabu.
english: therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before me forever.’”

motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina ai, ina hereva Iehova ena amo na Ieremia enai e kau, eto:
english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

motu: Pepa ta avabia, Israel bona Iuda bona bese idau-idau iboudiai ihadikadia herevadia, vada na gwaurai henimu ḡaudia, na hereva henimu matama dinana amo, Iosia ena nega ai, ema bona ina dina, vada ba tore.
english: “Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.

motu: Readia Iuda iduhuna taudia na ihadikadia karadia iboudiai vada na lalo hata baina kara henidia nato herevadia bae kamonai, bena una dainai iboudiai ese edia dala dikadia bae rakatani, bena lau ese edia kara havara bona edia kara dika baina gwau tao.
