english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”

motu: Bena Ieremia ese Baruku Neria e boiria; bona Iehova ese vada e hamaorolaia herevadia iboudiai na Ieremia ese e gwaurai, bena Baruku ese pepa ta ai e tore.
english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all Yahweh’s words, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.

motu: Bena Ieremia ese Baruku e haduaia, eto, Vada e g vaugu tao, Iehova ena dubu ilao-henina ai;
english: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, “I am restricted. I can’t go into Yahweh’s house.

motu: una dainai oi hari baola, bena anivaga dinana ta ai Iehova ena hereva, lau ese vada na gwaurai bona oi ese pepa ai vada o tore ḡaudia, na Iehova ena dubu ai e heboumu taudia iboudiai vairadiai ba duahi. Iuda taudia, edia hanua amo vada e raka lasi taudia iboudiai, vairadiai danu ba duahi.
english: Therefore you go, and read from the scroll which you have written from my mouth, Yahweh’s words, in the ears of the people in Yahweh’s house on the fast day. Also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

motu: Readia edia noinoi na Iehova enai baine kau, bena iboudiai ese edia dala dikadia bae rakatanidia, badina be badu bona lalo-siahu Iehova ese ina bese latanai vada e gwaurai na bada herea.
english: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahweh, and will each return from his evil way; for Yahweh has pronounced great anger and wrath against this people.”

motu: Bena Baruku Neria ese peroveta tauna Ieremia ena hahedua idoinai heḡereḡerena ai e karaia, Iehova ena hereva na pepa amo e duahia, Iehova ena dubu ai.
english: Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book Yahweh’s words in Yahweh’s house.

motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, ena lohia laḡanina iha-imana huana ihataurahani-tana ai, Ierusalem taudia iboudiai bona Iuda hanuadia amo Ierusalem vada ema taudia iboudiai ese anivaga e gwauraia Iehova vairanai.
english: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before Yahweh.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai Baruku ese Ieremia ena hereva na pepa amo e duahia, Iehova ena dubu ai, toretore tauna Gemaria Safana ena daiutu lalonai. Una daiutu na alai maguna ai, Iehova ena dubu ikoukouna, ladana Ikoukou Matamatana, badibadinai.
english: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in Yahweh’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house, in the ears of all the people.

motu: Mikaia Gemaria Safana natuna, ese Iehova ena hereva iboudiai, pepa amo e duahi ḡaudia, na e kamonai negana ai,
english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all Yahweh’s words,

motu: ia na pavapava ena ruma e diho lao, toretore tauna ena daiutu ai e raka vareai. Lohia iboudiai unuseni ai e helaiva: toretore tauna Elisama, Semaia natuna Delaia, Akaboro natuna Elnatan, Safana natuna Gemaria, Hanania natuna Sedekia, bona lohia iboudiai.
english: he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room; and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

motu: Bena Mikaia ese e kamonai herevadia iboudiai, Baruku ese taunimanima vairadiai pepa amo e duahi herevadia, na e hamaorolaidia.
english: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

motu: Bena lohia iboudiai ese lehudi (ia na Netania natuna, Netania na Selemia natuna, Selemia na Kusi natuna) e siaia lao, Baruku baine hamaoroa, baineto, Hari taunimanima vairadiai o duahia pepana na imamu ai bavabia, vada baoma. Taunabunai, Baruku Neria ese pepa na imana ai e abia, bena dekedia ela.
english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So|strong="H3947" * Baruch|strong="H1263" * the|strong="H3605" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Neriah|strong="H5374" * took|strong="H3947" * the|strong="H3605" * scroll|strong="H4039" * in|strong="H3212" * his|strong="H3605" * hand|strong="H3027" *, and|strong="H1121" * came|strong="H3212" * to|strong="H3212" * them|strong="H7971" *.

motu: Idia ese e hamaoroa, eto, A helai diho, ba duahia. Taunabunai, Baruku ese e duahi henidia.
english: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.” So|strong="H7121" * Baruch|strong="H1263" * read|strong="H7121" * it|strong="H7121" * in|strong="H3427" * their|strong="H7121" * hearing.

motu: Unu hereva iboudiai e kamonai negana ai, idia na mai garidia ida e heroha heheni. Bena idia ese Baruku e hamaoroa, eto, Ini-hereva iboudiai na hanua pavapavana do baia hamaorolaia.
english: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”

motu: Bena idia ese Baruku e nanadaia, eto, A hamaoromai, ini hereva iboudiai ede o tore toma? Ia ese e gwaurai bena o tore a?
english: They asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how did you write all these words at his mouth?”

motu: Bena Baruku ese e haere henidia, eto, Ia ese ini hereva iboudiai e gwaurai henigu, bena lau ese ink amo na tore, pepa ai.
english: Then Baruch answered them, “He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.”

motu: Bena hari lohia ese Baruku e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, a komu, oi bona Ieremia danu, bona tau ta basine diba umui na edeseni ai.
english: Then the princes said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah go hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese pepa na toretore tauna Elisama ena daiutu ai e atoa, bena hanua pavapavana ena maḡu lalonai e raka vareai, unu hereva iboudiai na hanua pavapavana e hamaorolaia.
english: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Iehudi na pepa iabina totona e siaia lao; bena ia ese toretore tauna Elisama ena daiutu lalona amo.e abia. Bena Iehudi ese hanua parapavana bona hanua pavapavana badibadinai e giniva lohiadia e duahi henidia.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.

motu: Nega na hua ihataurahani-tana; hanua pavapavana na keru negana rumana ai e helaiva, bona lahi na rahurahu ai vada e ha-araia ia vairanai.
english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.

motu: Iehudi ese ere toi eiava hani e duahidia, bena hanua pavapavana ese kaia maragina amo e utudia oho, hari rahurahu ai e arava lahina lalonai e tahodia vareai. Unu mo e kara toma ela bona pepa Idoinai na una rahurahu ai e arava lahina ai e ara ore.
english: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ini hereva iboudiai e kamonai vaitani murinai, hanua pavapavana eiava ena hesiai taudia ta se gari, eiava edia dabua asie dare.
english: The king and his servants who heard all these words were not afraid, and didn’t tear their garments.

motu: Ena be Elnatan bona Delaia bona Gemaria ese hanua pavapavana e hereva henia goadagoada, pepa na basine doua, to ia ese se kamonai henidia.
english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ierahamele, hanua pavapavana natuna, bona Seraia, Asriel natuna, bona Selemia, Abdele natuna, na e haḡanidia, idia ese toretore tauna Baruku bona peroveta tauna leremia bae dabaidia tao. A Iehova ese e hunidia.
english: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.

motu: Ieremia ese e gwaurai bena Baruku ese e tore herevadia pepana na hanua pavapavana ese e doua murinai, Iehova ena hereva ta Ieremia enai e kau, eto,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Ma pepa ta bavabia, hereva gunadia, pepa gini-gunana, Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana, ese e doua ḡauna, ai e tore herevadia ma ba tore lou.
english: “Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

motu: Bona Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana, na ini ba herevalaia toma, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Ina pepa vada o doua, oto “Dahaka dainai ia lalonai vada o torea Babulono pavapavana na momokani bainema, ina tano baine habuaia tari bona taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia na ia lalona amo baine negedia daure?”
english: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘Yahweh says: “You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written therein, saying, “The king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will cause to cease from there man and animal”?’”

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova ese Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana, na ini e herevalaia tomamu: Ia garana ta ese David ena terono ai basine helai kau; bona ia tau-anina masena na murimuri ai bae negea lasi, dina garaḡarana ai bona hanuaboi parakana ai baine mia.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

motu: Lau ese ia bona natuna bona ena hesiai taudia na davadia baina henidia, edia kara havara daidiai. Idia latadiai, bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia bona Iuda taudia latadiai, dika idoinai, idia latadiai vada na gwauraia ḡauna, na baina hadihoa; a idia na asie ura bae kamonai.
english: I will punish him, his offspring, and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn’t listen.”’”

motu: Bena Ieremia ese pepa ta ma e abia, itorena tauna Baruku Neria e henia; bena Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana, ese lahi ai e doua pepana herevadia iboudiai na Ieremia ese ma e gwaurai bona Baruku ese ma e tore; bona hereva unuhetomadia momo na idia latadiai ma e tore kau.
english: Then Jeremiah took another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.

motu: Sedekia Iosia, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ese Iuda tanona pavapavana ai e halaoa tauna, na Iuda ai e lohiava, Konia Iehoiakim gabuna ai.
english: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

motu: A ia bona ena hesiai taudia bona tano taudia ese Iehova ena hereva, peroveta tauna Ieremia uduna amo e gwaurai ḡaudia, na asie kamonaidia.
english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to Yahweh’s words, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

motu: King Sedekia ese Iehukala Selemia bona hahelaḡa tauna Sefania Maaseia na peroveta tauna Ieremia dekena e siaidia lao, eto, Iehova, eda Dirava, na ai daimai ai ba ḡuria.
english: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to Yahweh our God for us.”

motu: Una negana ai Ieremia na dounu taunimanima bogaragidiai e raka vareaiva e raka lasiva; badina be dibura rumana ai do asie koua.
english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.

motu: Farao ena tuari oreana na Aigupto amo vada e raka lasi; bena Kaldea taudia, Ierusalem e daia heḡeḡe oreana, ese haridia e kamonai negana ai, idia na Ierusalem amo e raka oho.
english: Pharaoh’s army had come out of Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Ieremia dekenai e kau, eto,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Iuda pavapavana, dekegu ai e siaimu ba nanadaigu totona tauna, na ini ba hamaoroa toma, baoto, A itaia, Farao ena tuari oreana, oi idurumu totona ema ḡauna, na be lou laomu, edia tano korikori Aigupto ai.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, will return to Egypt into their own land.

motu: Bena Kaldea taudia ma bae lou mai, ina hanua bae tuari henia, bae abia, bena lahi amo bae doua.
english: The Chaldeans will come again, and fight against this city. They will take it and burn it with fire.”’

motu: Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Sibomui basio hekoi, basioto “Kaldea taudia na momokani dauhai bae noho”; badina be idia na dauhai basie noho.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.

motu: Badina be, ena be Kaldea taudia, e tuari henimuimu taudia, edia tuari oreana idoinai boma hadarerea, bona mai berodia taudia sibodia bema noho, ta ta ena kalaga ena kalaga ai, to idia na ben a tore isi, bena ina hanua na lahi ai bema doua.
english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.’”

motu: Kaldea taudia edia tuari oreana na Ierusalem amo vada e raka oho, Farao ena tuari oreana e raka kahira negana ai.
english: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

motu: Bena Ieremia na Ierusalem ai e tore isi, Beniamina tanona bainela, unuseni ai ahuna do baine abia, taunimanima bogaragidiai.
english: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people.

motu: Ia na Beniamina Ikoukouna ai, bena hegima tauna ta, ladana Iria, Selemia Hanania natuna, ese peroveta tauna Ieremia e dabaia tao, eto, Oi na Kaldea taudia ediai bo hanaimu.
english: When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are defecting to the Chaldeans!”

motu: Ieremia eto, Oi na o koikoimu; lau na Kaldea taudia ediai asina hanaimu. A Iria na se ura baine kamonai henia; bena ia ese Ieremia e dabaia tao, hanua lohiadia dekedia e laohaia.
english: Then Jeremiah said, “That is false! I am not defecting to the Chaldeans.” But|strong="H3808" * he|strong="H3808" * didn’t listen|strong="H8085" * to|strong="H5921" * him|strong="H5921" *; so|strong="H3808" * Irijah|strong="H3376" * seized|strong="H8610" * Jeremiah|strong="H3414" *, and|strong="H8085" * brought him|strong="H5921" * to|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * princes|strong="H8269" *.

motu: Hanua lohiadia ese Ieremia e badu henia lalo-dika; e dadabaia, bena toretore tauna Ionatan ena ruma ai e koua, badina be una ruma na dibura rumana ai vada e halaoa.
english: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.

motu: Ieremia na dibura rumana ai e koua, bena dina hoho unuseni ai e nohova.
english: When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,

motu: Una murinai King Sedekia ese e boiria, bena e abia dae. Hanua pavapavana ese e nanadaia hehuni ena ruma ai, eto, Hereva ta na Iehova ena amo vada ema a?
english: then Zedekiah the king sent and had him brought out. The king asked him secretly in his house, “Is there any word from Yahweh?” Jeremiah|strong="H3414" * said|strong="H1697" *, “ There|strong="H3426" * is|strong="H3068" *.” He|strong="H3068" * also|strong="H3068" * said|strong="H1697" *, “ You|strong="H5414" * will|strong="H3068" * be|strong="H3426" * delivered|strong="H5414" * into|strong="H3027" * the|strong="H5414" * hand|strong="H3027" * of|strong="H4428" * the|strong="H5414" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H4428" * Babylon.”

motu: Ieremia eto, Oibe. Ma eto, Babulono pavapavana imana ai bae atomu. Ieremia ese danu King Sedekia e hamaoroa, eto, Oi eiava emu hesiai taudia eiava ina bese taudia na ede vada na hadikamui toma dainai dibura rumana ai vada o kougu?
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

motu: Emu peroveta taudia, e peroveta henimu eto “Babulono pavapavana basinema, oi bona ina tano basine tuari henimui” taudia na edeseni ai?
english: Now where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you, nor against this land’?

motu: Pavapava e, egu lohia, mani emu kara a kamonai: egu noinoi, mai hematauraigu ida na gwauraiamu ḡauna, na emu ai baine kau; bena toretore tauna Ionatan ena ruma basio siaigu lao lou, unuseni ai baina mase na garina.
english: Now please hear, my lord the king: please let my supplication be presented before you, that you not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.”

motu: Taunabunai King Sedekia e hahedua, bena Ieremia na hegima taudia edia magu ai e koua; bena dina ta ta ai flaoa igabu ta ta e henia, flaoa igabuna taudia edia ariara amo, ela bona hanua flaoana idoinai vada e ore. Taunabunai Ieremia na hegima taudia edia maḡu ai e nohova.
english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

motu: Ieremia ese taunimanima iboudiai e hamaorolaidia herevadia na Sefatia Matan, Gedalia Pasahuru, Iukala Selemia, bona Pasahuru Malkia na e kamonai. Ia eto,
english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hanua ai baine noho tauna na dare eiava doe eiava dai-hanai gorerena amo baine mase; a Kaldea taudia dekedia baine raka lasi tauna na baine mauri; ena mauri na kwalimu ahuna ai bainela, bena baine mauri.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. He will escape with his life and he will live.’

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Momokani ina hanua na Babulono pavapavana imana ai bae atoa, bena baine abia.
english: Yahweh says, ‘This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.’”

motu: Bena hanua lohiadia ese hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto, Ina tau bae alaia mase be namo, badina be ia ese tuari taudia doini hanua ai e nohomu na imadia e hamanokadiamu, bona taunimanima iboudiai imadia danu, unu hereva e hamaorolaidiamu dainai. Badina be ina tau ese taunimanima ihanamodia se tahuamu a ihadikadia mo.
english: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death, because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them; for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but harm.”

motu: King Sedekia eto, A itaia, ia na umui imamui ai; badina be hanua pavapavana ese basine laomui ahu diba.
english: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese Ieremia e abia, Malkia, hanua pavapavana natuna, ena ranu gurina, hegima taudia edia magu ai, lalonai e tua dobi. Idia ese Ieremia na kwanau amo e tua dobi. Guri na asi ranuna, kopukopu mo; bena Ieremia na kopukopu ai e hepuni.
english: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard. They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

motu: Ebede-melek, tau Etiopia, hesiai tauna ta pavapava ena ruma ai, e kamonai idia ese Ieremia na guri lalonai vada e tua dobi. Hanua pavapavana na Beniamina Ikoukouna ai e helaiva,
english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king was then sitting in Benjamin’s gate),

motu: bena Ebede-melek na pavapava ena ruma amo ela, hanua pavapavana e hamaoroa, eto,
english: Ebedmelech went out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,

motu: Pavapava e, egu lohia, ini tatau na vada e kara dika, peroveta tauna Ieremia e kara henia karadia iboudiai lalodiai; idia ese ranu gurina lalonai vada e tua dobi, unuseni ai ia na baine hitolo mase, badina be flaoa taina dia mia hanua ai.
english: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”

motu: Bena hanua pavapavana ese Ebede-melek, tau Etiopia, e hagania, eto, Ini amo tatau tatoi avabidia, oi ida baola, peroveta tauna Ieremia do se masemu ai na guri amo ba veria dae.
english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ebede-melek ese unu tatau e abidia, bena pavapava ena ruma ela, habou-habou daiutuna ai maua ta lalona amo dabua seadia gunadia bona hahedoki, vada e dika ḡaudia, e abi; bena kwanau amo guri lalonai e tudia dobi, Ieremia enai.
english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

motu: Bena Ebede-melek, tau Etiopia, ese Ieremia e hamaoroa, eto, Dabua seadia bona hahedoki na kadidihamu bona kwanau padadiai bavatodia. Ieremia na unu e kara toma.
english: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords.” Jeremiah|strong="H3414" * did|strong="H6213" * so|strong="H3651" *.

motu: Bena idia ese Ieremia na kwanau amo e veria dae, guri amo e abia lasi. Bena Ieremia na hegima taudia edia magu ai e nohova.
english: So they lifted Jeremiah up with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

motu: King Sedekia ese peroveta tauna Ieremia e boiria, Iehova ena dubu iraka-vareaina ihatoina ai e abia dae. Hanua pavapavana ese Ieremia e hamaoroa, eto, Aina nanadaimu, ḡau ta egu ai basio hunia.
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to himself into the third entry that is in Yahweh’s house. Then the king said to Jeremiah, “I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.”

motu: Ieremia ese Sedekia e haere henia, eto, Bama hamaoromu bena boma alagu mase ani? Bona bama hahealo henimu bena basioma kamonai henigu.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.”

motu: Bena King Sedekia ese Ieremia e gwau henia hamata hehuni, eto, Iehova, laumada e karadia Diravana, na e maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau ese basina alamu mase eiava emu mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia imadia ai basina atomu.
english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, “As Yahweh lives, who made our souls, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.”

motu: Bena Ieremia ese Sedekia e hamaoroa, eto, Ḡaubada Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Babulono pavapavana ena lohia taudia ediai boma hahemanau, bena idia ese bae hamaurimu; ina hanua danu lahi amo basie doua, bona oi bona emu ruma taudia na ba mauri.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you will go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul will live, and this city will not be burned with fire. You will live, along with your house.

motu: A hari Babulono pavapavana ena lohia taudia ediai basioma hahemanau, bena ina hanua na Kaldea taudia imadia ai baine heato; bena idia ese lahi amo bae doua, bona oi na idia imadia amo basio roho mauri.
english: But if you will not go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then this city will be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they will burn it with fire, and you won’t escape out of their hand.’”

motu: King Sedekia ese Ieremia e hamaoroa, eto, Iuda taudia Kaldea taudia ediai vada e hanai na garidia na garimu, idia imadia ai bae atogu bena idia ese bae hadikagu na garina.
english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”

motu: Ieremia eto, Idia imadia ai basie atomu. Iehova gadona hari na hamaorolaimumu na ba badinaia, bena ba namo, emu mauri na basie abia oho.
english: But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, Yahweh’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will be well with you, and your soul will live.

motu: A hahemanau basioma ura, Iehova ese ina mata-hanai vada e henigu:
english: But if you refuse to go out, this is the word that Yahweh has shown me:

motu: A itaia, Iuda pavapavana ena ruma ai doini e nohomu hahinedia na e hakaudia lasimu, Babulono pavapavana ena lohia taudia dekediai; bena hahine na e tomu: Turamu, o abidadama henidia taudia, ese vada e koimu, bona vada e hadareremu; oi aemu na kopukopu ai vada e hepuni dainai, idia na emu amo e raka ohomu.
english: ‘Behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house will be brought out to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women will say, “ Your|strong="H3605" * familiar|strong="H7965" * friends have|strong="H3063" * turned|strong="H5472" * on|strong="H1004" * you|strong="H3605" *, and|strong="H3063" * have|strong="H3063" * prevailed|strong="H3201" * over|strong="H4428" * you|strong="H3605" *. Your|strong="H3605" * feet|strong="H7272" * are|strong="H1004" * sunk|strong="H2883" * in|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H3605" * mire|strong="H1206" *, they|strong="H2007" * have|strong="H3063" * turned|strong="H5472" * away|strong="H3318" * from|strong="H3318" * you|strong="H3605" *.”

motu: Adavamu bona natumu iboudiai na Kaldea taudia dekedia bae hakaudia lasi; bona oi danu idia imadia amo basio roho mauri, a Babulono pavapavana ese baine dabaimu tao; bena ina hanua na lahi amo bae doua.
english: They will bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans. You won’t escape out of their hand, but will be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon. You will cause this city to be burned with fire.’”

motu: Bena Sedekia ese Ieremia e hamaoroa, eto, Ini hereva na tau ta basio hadibalaia, bena basio mase.
english: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no man know of these words, and you won’t die.

motu: Hanua lohiadia bema kamonai lau na oi ida vada ta hereva-hereva, bena bae vasi, bae nanadaimu, baeto “A hamaoromai, hanua pavapavana ede o hamaoroa toma bona hanua pavapavana ese ede e hamaoromu toma; ḡau ta emai ai basio hunia, bena basia alamu mase”.
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’

motu: Bena oi ese ba haere henidia, baoto “Hanua pavapavana na noia mai manaugu ida, ia ese Ionatan ena ruma basine siaigu lao lou, unuseni ai baina mase na garina”.
english: then you shall tell them, ‘I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.’”

motu: Bena hanua lohiadia iboudiai na Ieremia dekena ela, e nanadaia; bena ia ese e haere henidia, hanua pavapavana ese vada e hagania heḡereḡerena. Taunabunai, idia ese ia ihereva-henina e hadokoa; badina be tau ta ese unu hereva asie kamonai.
english: Then all the princes came to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they stopped speaking with him, for the matter was not perceived.

motu: Bena Ieremia na hegima taudia edia maḡu ai e nohova, ela-bona Ierusalem e abia dinana.
english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.

motu: Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihataurahani-tana huana ihagvautana lalonai, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, bona ena tuari oreana idoinai ese Ierusalem e daea bona e koua heḡeḡe;
english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.

motu: bena Sedekia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-tana huana ihahanina dinana ihataurahani-tana ai, hanua maguna e gwadaia uru.
english: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.

motu: Ierusalem e abla negana ai, Babulono pavapavana ena lohia taudia iboudiai ema, bogaragi ikoukouna ai e helai: Neregala-saresere, Samagara-nebo, Sarasekimi (ena dagi be Rabsarisi), Neregalasaresere (ena dagi be Rabmaga), bona Babulono pavapavana ena tuari lohiadia oredia iboudiai.
english: All the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate: Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim the Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer the Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

motu: Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, bona tuari taudia iboudiai ese e itadia negana ai, idia na e heau; hanuaboi ai hanua e rakatania pavapava ena uma-uma bogaragina amo, bena magu ruaosi padadia ikoukouna amo e raka lasi, Araba dalana ai ela.
english: When Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

motu: A Kaldea tuari oreana ese e hahavadia; bena idia ese Sedekia e lasia tao Ieriko taoradia ai. E abia mauri, bena Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, dekena e laohaia, Ribla ai, Hamat tanona ai; bena ia ese ena kerere ahuna e gwauraia.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

motu: Bena Babulono pavapavana ese Sedekia natuna mamaruanedia na ia vairanai e aladia mase, Ribla ai; Babulono pavapavana ese danu Iuda lohiadia iboudiai e aladia mase.
english: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah.

motu: Bena ia ese Sedekia matana e hakepuludia, bona auri gadeadia ai e ḡuia, Babulono baine laohaia totona.
english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

motu: Kaldea taudia ese pavapava ena ruma e doua, bona taunimanima edia ruma danu e dou, bona Ierusalem maguna e ḡiḡia dobi.
english: The Chaldeans burned the king’s house and the people’s houses with fire and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

motu: Bena Nebusaradana, hegima oleana biaguna, ese taunimanima oredia dounu hanua ai nonoho na e laohaidia, Babulono ai e hanohodia, ienai e hanai taudia bona taunimanima oredia danu.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the rest of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the rest of the people who remained.

motu: Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese ogoḡami taudia haida, asi edia kohu taudia, na Iuda tanona ai e rakatanidia, bona una negana ai vine imeadia bona biru tanodia e henidia. Nebukadresara ese Ieremia e bogaia hisi
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

motu: Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, na Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ena amo e haheḡani, Ieremia dainai, eto,
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Avabia, ba naria namonamo, basio hadikaia, a ia ese baine hamaorolaimui heḡereḡerena ai ba kara henia.
english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”

motu: Taunabunai, Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, bona Nebusasabana, Rabsarisi tauna, bona Neregala-saresere, Rabmaga tauna, bona Babulono pavapavana ena tuari lohiadia badadia iboudiai na
english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon

motu: e hesiai, Ieremia na hegima taudia edia magu amo e abia. Idia ese Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, imana ai e atoa, iena ruma baine laohaia totona. Taunabunai ia na taunimanima bogaragidiai e nohova. Iehova ese Ebede-melek e hanamoa
english: sent and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should bring him home. So he lived among the people.

motu: Ieremia na hegima taudia edia magu ai e hekouva negana ai, Iehova ena hereva na ienai e kau, eto,
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

motu: Aola, Ebede-melek, tau Etiopia, ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu hereva baina hamomokanidia, ina hanua ihadikana ai, baina hadikaia, basina hanamoa. Una dina ai egu hereva anidia do bae vara oi vairamu ai.
english: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they will be accomplished before you in that day.

motu: A Iehova na e tomu: Una dina ai lau ese baina hamaurimu, o gari henidiamu taudia imadia ai basio heato.
english: But I will deliver you in that day,” says Yahweh; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

motu: Badina be momokani lau ese baina hamaurimu, dare ai basio mase; a emu mauri bavabia, kwalimu ahuna ai bainela, badina be lau vada o abidadama henigu. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says Yahweh.’”

motu: Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese Ieremia na auri gadeadia ai e ḡuia, Ierusalem ai bona Iuda ai e abidia mauri Babulono baine laohaidia totona taudia ida; bena Rama ai ma e ruhaia nege. Una murinai, ina hereva Iehova ena amo na Ieremia enai e kau.
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were carried away captive to Babylon.

motu: Hari hegima oreana biaguna ese Ieremia e abia, e hereva henia, eto, Iehova, emu Dirava, ese ina dika vada e gwauraia ina gabu latanai;
english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him, “Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;

motu: Iehova ese anina vada e havaraia, ena hereva heḡereḡerena ai vada e karaia. Badina be umui na vada o kerere Iehova enai, bona ia gadona asio kamonai, una dainai ina kara na latamui ai vada e kau.
english: and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

motu: A harihari, auri gadeadia na imamu amo na kokidia ohomu, na ruhamu nege, ina dina ai. Boma laloa lau ida Babulono baitala be namo, baitama lao, bena lau ese bama narimu namonamo. A boma laloa lau ida Babulono baitala na dia namo, basitama lao. A itaia, tano idoinai na vairamu ai; edena gabu ilao-henina o haeroamu namo bona maoro na unu baola.
english: Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t. Behold, all the land is before you. Where it seems good and right to you to go, go there.”

motu: Bema ba-noho, Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, Babulono pavapavana ese vada e duanaia Iuda hanuadia ikwaradia tauna ai bainela tauna, dekena ba lou lao, bena ia ida ba noho, taunimanima bogaragidiai; eiava, edena gabu ilao-henina o haeroamu namo na unu baola. Taunabunai, hegima oreana biaguna ese dala lakwana e henia, bona harihari ḡauna ta danu, bena e kahua nege.
english: Now while he had not yet gone back, “Go back then,” he said, “to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go.” So|strong="H7971" * the|strong="H3605" * captain|strong="H7227" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H3605" * guard|strong="H2876" * gave|strong="H5414" * him|strong="H5414" * food and|strong="H1121" * a|strong="H3068" * present|strong="H5414" *, and|strong="H1121" * let|strong="H7971" * him|strong="H5414" * go|strong="H3212" *.

motu: Bena Ieremia na Gedalia Ahikama dekena ela, Mispa ai, bena ia ida e nohova, una tano ai dounu nohodia taudia bogaragidiai.
english: Then Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

motu: Tano paka ai e nohova oreadia biagudia iboudiai bona edia orea taudia na e kamonai, Babulono pavapavana ese Gedalia Ahikama na tano ikwarana tauna ai vada e halaoa, bona tatau bona hahine mai natudia ida, una tano ogogami-herea taudia Babulono asie laohaidia, na iena hereḡu ai vada e atodia.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, women, children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon,

motu: Bena idia na Gedalia dekena ela, Mispa ai: Ismael Netania; Iohanan Karea; Seraia Tanahumete; Efai tau Netofa natuna mamaruanedia, bona Iesania, tau Maakata natuna maruanena; idia bona edia orea taudia danu.
english: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.

motu: Bena Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, ese idia bona edia orea taudia na e gwau henidia hamata, eto, Kaldea taudia isiaidia ilao-henina basio garilaia. Tano ai ba noho, Babulono pavapavana isiaina ba lao heni, bena vada ba namo.
english: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, “Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.

motu: Lau na Mispa ai baina noho, bena umui daimui ai Kaldea amo dekedai baema taudia vairadiai baina gini. A umui ese vine ranuna bona au-huahua bona dehoro ba habou, emui tohe ai ba baladia heni; bona vada o abi hanuadia ai ba noho.
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who will come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.”

motu: Una heḡereḡerena ai, Iuda taudia iboudiai Moab ai bona Amono taudia bogaragidiai bona Edom ai bona tano haida ai e nohova na e kamonai, Babulono pavapavana ese kwabukwabudia vada e rakatanidia Iuda ai, bona Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, vada e duanaia, idia ikwaradia tauna ai bainela;
english: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan,

motu: bena Iuda taudia iboudiai na vada e luludia lao gabudia iboudiai amo ma e lou mai, Iuda tanona ema, Gedalia dekenai, Mispa ai. Bena idia ese vine ranuna bona au-huahua momo herea e habou. Ismael ese Gedalia iala-masena dalana e tahua
english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.

motu: Una negana ai lohanan Karea bona tano paka ai e nohova oreadia biagudia na Gedalia dekena ela, Mispa ai,
english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

motu: e hereva henia, eto, Oi mai dibamu Baalisi, Amono pavapavana, ese Ismael Netania vada e siaia mai oi iala-masemu totona a? A Gedalia Ahikama ese edia hereva se abia dae.
english: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But|strong="H3588" * Gedaliah|strong="H1436" * the|strong="H3588" * son|strong="H1121" * of|strong="H1121" * Ahikam didn’t believe them|strong="H7971" *.

motu: Bena Iohanan Karea ese Gedalia e hereva henia hehuni Mispa ai, eto, Mani ainala, Ismael Netania baina alaia mase, bena tau ta basine diba. Anina be dahaka ia ese oi baine alamu mase, bena Iuda taudia oi dekemu ai vada e hebou na bae heau karoho, bena Iuda kwabukwabudia bae mase ore?
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”

motu: A Gedalia Ahikama ese Iohanan Karea e haere henia, eto, Una na basio karaia, badina be Ismael o herevalaia koikoimu.
english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, “You shall not do this thing, for you speak falsely of Ishmael.”

motu: Hua ihahituna ai, Ismael, Netania Elisama natuna, pavapava iduhuna tauna bona hanua pavapavana ena heitatao tauna badana ta, na tatau gwauta ida Gedalia Ahikama dekena ema, Mispa ai. Bena Mispa ai e aniani hebouva lalonai,
english: Now in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring and one of the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

motu: Ismael Netania bona hari tatau gwauta ia ida na e tore isi; bena idia ese Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, Babulono pavapavana ese tano ikwarana tauna ai e halaoa tauna, na dare amo e tutua gwada, e alaia mase.
english: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah arose, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

motu: Ismael ese Iuda taudia iboudiai Gedalia ida Mispa ai e nohova danu e aladia mase, bona Kaldea tuari taudia hahidaosi unuseni ai danu.
english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.

motu: Gedalia iroromana dinana murina dinana ai, tau ta ese sivaraina do se kamonai negana ai,
english: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

motu: tatau taurahani-ahui na Sekem bona Silo bona Samaria amo ema. Auki-huidia vada e abi, edia dabua vada e dare, bona kopidia vada e gasidia. Idia ese flaoa boubou ḡaudia bona muramura mai bonadia e mailaidia, Iehova ena dubu ai bae herahialai totona.
english: men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to Yahweh’s house.

motu: Bena Ismael Netania na Mispa amo e raka lasi mai taina ida, idia ihedavari-henidia totona. Idia ida e hedavari negana ai, ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Gedalia Ahikama dekenai ba raka vareai.
english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went, and as he met them, he said to them, “Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.”

motu: Bena hanua lalonai e raka vareai negana ai, Ismael Netania mai bamona ida ese e aladia mase, bena ranu habou gurina ta ai e tahodia dobi.
english: It was so, when they came into the middle of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, and cast them into the middle of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.

motu: A tatau gwauta idia bogaragidia amo-ese Ismaele hamaoroa, eto, Basio alamai mase, badina be ai na mai emai uit bona bali bona dehoro bona bada-ranuna, uma ai a huni. Taunabunai, ia ese kara e hadokoa, idia mai bamodia ida se aladia mase.
english: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey.” So|strong="H3808" * he|strong="H3588" * stopped|strong="H2308" *, and|strong="H8081" * didn’t kill|strong="H4191" * them|strong="H4672" * among|strong="H8432" * their|strong="H3588" * brothers.

motu: Hari ranu habou gurina, Ismael ese e aladia mase taudia tau-anidia na lalonai vada e tahodia dobi gurina, na guri badana, King Asa ese Baasa, Israel pavapavana, ena kwalimu ilao-ahuna totona e ḡeia ḡauna. Ismael Netania ese mase taudia tau-anidia amo e hahonua.
english: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (this was that which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

motu: Bena Ismael ese taunimanima oredia Mispa ai na e abidia mauri, hanua pavapavana natuna hahinedia bona Mispa ai e nohova taudia kwabukwabudia iboudiai, Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese Gedalia Ahikama ena heregu ai e atodia taudia iboudiai. Ismael Netania ese e abidia mauri, bena e tore isi, Amono taudia dekediai bae hanai eto.
english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all of the people who were left in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

motu: A Iohanan Karea bona orea biagudia iboudiai ia ida ese Ismael Netania ena kara dikadia iboudiai sivaraidia e kamorlai negana ai,
english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

motu: idia ese edia orea taudia iboudiai e abidia, Ismael Netania ituari-henina ela; bena gohu badana Gibeon ai badibadinai e lasia tao.
english: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

motu: Bena Ismael ida ela taudia iboudiai ese Iohanan Karea bona orea biagudia iboudiai ia ida, e itadia negana ai na e moale.
english: Now when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.

motu: Taunabunai, Ismael ese e abidia mauri Mispa amo e laohaidia taudia iboudiai na e raka lou, Iohanan Karea dekena e lou lao.
english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

motu: A Ismael Netania na Iohanan ena amo e roho mauri, tatau taurahani ida, bena Amono taudia dekedia ela.
english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

motu: Bena Ismael Netania ese Gedalia Ahikama e alaia mase murinai Mispa amo abi-mauridia ai e laohaidia taudia oredia iboudiai na Iohanan Karea bona orea biagudia iboudiai ia ida ese e abidia: tuari taudia, hahine, memero kekeni, bona hesiai taudia, lohanan ese Gibeon amo e hakaudia lou taudia.
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam—the men of war, with the women, the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.

motu: Idia na ela, Gerutu Kimuhamu ai e noho, Betelehem kahana ai. Edia lalo-hadai be Aigupto baela eto,
english: They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt

motu: Kaldea taudia daidiai; badina be e gari henidia, badina be Gedalia Ahikama, Babulono pavapavana ese tano ikwarana tauna ai e halaoa tauna, na Ismael Netania ese vada e alaia mase.
english: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.

motu: Tuari oreadia biagudia bona Iohanan Karea bona Asaria Hosaia, bona taunimanima iboudiai, asi dagidia bona mai dagi-badadia taudia, na e raka kahira,
english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,

motu: peroveta tauna Ieremia e hereva henia, eto, Emai noinoi bavabia dae; bona Iehova, emu Dirava, ba noia, ini kwabukwabumai daimai ai, badina be ai na orea badana taumai to, o itamaimu, gadoimai mo e rakatanimai.
english: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, “Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to Yahweh your God, even for all this remnant, for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes see us,

motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, ese baia rakalaia dalana bona baia karaia karana na baine hadibalaimai.
english: that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the things that we should do.”

motu: Peroveta tauna Ieremia ese e haere henidia, eto, Emui hereva vada na kamonai; a itaia, lau ese Iehova, emui Dirava, baina ḡuria, emui noinoi heḡereḡerena, bena Iehova na ede baine haere toma, una na baina hamaorolaimui; ḡau ta emui ai basina hunia.
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, “I have heard you. Behold, I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words; and it will happen that whatever thing Yahweh answers you, I will declare it to you. I will keep nothing back from you.”

motu: Bena idia ese Ieremia e hamaoroa, eto, Bema Iehova, emu Dirava, ese ai daimai ai baine henimu herevana idoinai heḡereḡerena ai basia karaia, Iehova ese baine habadelaimai mai maoromaorona bona mai momokanina ida.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May Yahweh be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which Yahweh your God sends you to tell us.

motu: Bema hereva namona eiava hereva dikana, to ai ese Iehova, eda Dirava, dekena a siaimumu Diravana, gadona baia badinaia, Iehova, eda Dirava, gadona ibadinana ai baia namo helaoreana.
english: Whether it is good, or whether it is bad, we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahweh our God.”

motu: Dina gwauta e ore ai Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau.
english: After ten days, Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah.

motu: Bena ia ese Iohanan Karea bona tuari oreadia biagudia iboudiai, ia ida e nohova taudia, bona taunimanima iboudiai, asi dagidia bona mai dagibadadia taudia, na e boiridia, e hereva henidia,
english: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

motu: eto, Iehova, Israel Diravana, dekena o siaigu, daimui ai baina noia totona, Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu:
english: and said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him, says:

motu: Ina tano ai boma noho, bena lau ese baina haginimui, basina gigimui dobi; baina hadomui, basina ragamui oho; badina be na hadikalaimui karana na helalo kerehailaiamu.
english: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

motu: Babulono pavapavana, o gari heniamu tauna, na garina basio gari. Iehova na e tomu, Basio gari henia, badina be lau na umui ida, baina hamaurimui bona ia imana amo baina harohomui mauri totona.
english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says Yahweh, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

motu: Lau ese baina bogamui hisi; unu amo ia ese danu baine bogamui hisi, bona emui tano korikori ai baine hanohomui.
english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

motu: A boma toma “Ina tano ai basia noho”; Iehova, emui Dirava, boma gwau edeede henia,
english: “‘But if you say, “We will not dwell in this land,” so that you don’t obey Yahweh your God’s voice,

motu: boma toma “Lasi, Aigupto tanona baiala, unuseni ai tuari basia itaia, bona kibi reḡena basia kamonai, bona basia hitolo, bena unuseni ai baia noho”;
english: saying, “No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we will see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there we will dwell;”’

motu: Iuda kwabukwabumui e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Lalomui boma ha-auka Aigupto ai boma raka vareai bona unuseni ai boma noho,
english: now therefore hear Yahweh’s word, O remnant of Judah! Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there,

motu: bena o garilaiamu darena ese unuseni ai, Aigupto tanona ai, baina lasimui tao, bona o garilaiamu doena ese baine gavamui havara-havara ela bona Aigupto; bena unuseni ai ba mase.
english: then it will happen that the sword, which you fear, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, will follow close behind you there in Egypt; and you will die there.

motu: Lalodia bae ha-auka Aigupto baela unuseni ai bae noho taudia iboudiai na dare eiava doe eiava dai-hanai gorerena amo bae mase; asi kwabukwabuna, asi tauna ta, na lau ese latadiai baina hadihoa dikana amo baine roho mauri.
english: So will it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there. They will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence. None of them will remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.’

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu badu bona egu badu-garagara na Ierusalem inoholaina taudia latadiai na bubu dobi heḡereḡerena ai, egu badu-garaḡara na umui latamui ai danu baina bubua dobi, Aigupto baola negana ai. Heihi-ihirai, hahegari, heuduguirai, hegonaḡonalai ḡaudia ai baola. Ina gabu na ma basio itaia lou.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and my wrath has been poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you, when you enter into Egypt; and you will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach; and you will see this place no more.’

motu: Iehova ese vada e hamaoromui, eto, Iuda kwabukwabumui e, Aigupto basiola. Ba diba momokani, hari ina dina ai vada na sisiba henimui,
english: “Yahweh has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, ‘Don’t go into Egypt!’ Know certainly that I have testified to you today.

motu: vada o raka siri davana na emui mauri. Badina be o siaigu, Iehova, emui Dirava, dekenai, oto “Iehova, eda Dirava, ba fiuria ai daimai ai, bena Iehova, eda Dirava, ede baine gwau toma na ba hamaoromai, bena baia karaia”.
english: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to Yahweh your God, saying, ‘Pray for us to Yahweh our God; and according to all that Yahweh our God says, so declare to us, and we will do it.’

motu: Bena hari dina ai vada na gwaurai henimui, to e siaigu baina hamaorolaimui ḡauna ta ai Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona asio badinaia.
english: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed Yahweh your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me to you.

motu: Taunabunai, ba diba momokani, ilao-henina bona inoholaina o uramu gabuna ai dare eiava doe eiava dai-hanai gorerena amo vada ba mase.
english: Now therefore know certainly that you will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence in the place where you desire to go to live.”

motu: Ieremia ese taunimanima iboudiai e hereva henidia vaitani, unu Iehova, edia Dirava, ena hereva iboudiai, Iehova, edia Dirava, ese vada e siailaia herevadia, e gwaurai ore murinai,
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

motu: Asaria Hosaia bona lohanan Karea bona asi edia hemataurai taudia iboudiai ese Ieremia na e hamaoroa, eto, Oi na o koikoimu. Iehova, eda Dirava, ese se siaimu, seto “Aigupto basiola, unuseni ai basio noho”,
english: then Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men spoke, saying to Jeremiah, “You speak falsely. Yahweh our God has not sent you to say, ‘You shall not go into Egypt to live there;’

motu: a Baruku Neria ese lalomu vada e hadikaia ai emai ai, Kaldea taudia imadia ai bavatomai totona, bena bae alamai mase, eiava Babulono bae laohaimai, unuseni ai bae hanohomai.
english: but Baruch the son of Neriah has turned you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death or carry us away captive to Babylon.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iohanan Karea bona tuari oreadia biagudia iboudiai bona taunimanima iboudiai ese Iehova ena hereva, Iuda tanona inoholaina herevana, na asie badinaia.
english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, to dwell in the land of Judah.

motu: A Iohanan Karea bona tuari oreadia biagudia iboudiai ese Iuda taudia kwabukwabudia iboudiai, bese idau-idau iboudiai bogaragidiai e luludia lao bena ma e lou, Iuda tanona ai ma e nohova, taudia, na e abidia:
english: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah, who had returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah—

motu: tatau, hahine, memero, kekeni, hanua pavapavana natuna hahinedia, bona Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese Gedalia, Ahikama Safana natuna, dekenai e rakatanidia taudia iboudiai; bona peroveta tauna Ieremia bona Baruku Neria danu.
english: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

motu: Bena Aigupto tanona ai e kau; badina be Iehova gadona asie badinaia. Bena Tapanese ai e kau.
english: They came into the land of Egypt, for they didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice; and they came to Tahpanhes.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Ieremia enai e kau, Tapanese ai, eto:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

motu: Nadi badadia haida imamu ai bavabi, Iuda taudia vairadiai raro-kaka ai ba hunidia, Farao ena ruma raka-vareaina ariarana ai, Tapanese ai.
english: “Take great stones in your hand and hide them in mortar in the brick work which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah.

motu: Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau na baina hesiai, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, egu hesiai tauna, baina abia; bena ia ese ena terono baine atoa, ini vada na hunidia nadidia latadiai, bona pavapava hahekerukeruna na idia daediai baine haginia.
english: Tell them, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden; and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.

motu: Ia na bainema, Aigupto tanona baine havahuraia, dai-hanai gorerena enai vada e revadia taudia na dai-hanai gorerena amo baine hamasedia, bona abi-mauri enai vada e revadia taudia na abi-mauri ai baine siaidia lao, bona dare enai vada e revadia taudia na dare amo baine aladia mase.
english: He will come, and will strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death will be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

motu: Ia ese lahi ta baine ha-araia, Aigupto diravadia edia dubu ai; baine doudia bona abi-mauri ai baine laohaidia. Ia ese Aigupto tanona baine haḡoevaia, mamoe ireḡudia tauna ese ena dabua mai darurana e hagoevaiamu na heto. Bena unu amo ma baine raka oho mai mainona ida.
english: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.

motu: Heliopolisi, Aigupto tanona hanuana ta, ena nadi-gini pupudia na baine hamakohidia; bona Aigupto diravadia edia dubu na lahi amo baine doudia.
english: He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.’”

motu: Ieremia enai e kau herevadia, Iuda taudia iboudiai Aigupto tanona ai e nohova herevadia, bini. Idia na Migdol ai bona Tapanese ai bona Memefisi ai bona Pataro tanona ai e nohova.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Dika idoinai Ierusalem latanai bona Iuda hanuadia iboudiai latadiai vada na hadihoa na vada o itaia. A itaia, ina nega ai idia na vada e vahu, asi tauna ta idia lalodiai e nohomu,
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah. Behold, today they are a desolation, and no man dwells in them,

motu: edia kara dikadia daidiai. Unu kara amo idia ese e habadugu; badina be idia na ela, muramura mai bonadia e gabu, bona dirava idaudia, idia asi dibadia, umui asi dibamui, bona senemui asi dibadia diravadia, isiaidia e lao heni.
english: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods that they didn’t know, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.

motu: Ḡau tamona, egu peroveta hesiai taudia na siaidia havara-havara dekemui ai, nato, Mani ina kara dika-rohorohona, na inai heniamu ḡauna, na basio karaia.
english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”

motu: A idia na asie kamonai, taiadia asie kirara, edia kara dika asie rakatania, bona muramura mai bonadia igabudia dirava idaudia ediai na asie hadokoa.
english: But they didn’t listen and didn’t incline their ear. They didn’t turn from their wickedness, to stop burning incense to other gods.

motu: Taunabunai egu badu-garagara bona egu badu na bubudia dobi, Iuda hanuadia ai bona Ierusalem ariaradia ai e ara; bena vada e ḡaḡae bona vada e vahu, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena.
english: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured out, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is today.’

motu: Harihari Ḡaubada Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Dahaka dainai ina dika badana o karaiamu, umui sibomui ihadikamui, bena tau bona hahine, mero karukaruna bona meromero, na emui amo eme henege daure, Iuda bogaragina amo, bona kwabukwabumui ta basine noho.
english: “Therefore now Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Why do you commit great evil against your own souls, to cut off from yourselves man and woman, infant and nursing child out of the middle of Judah, to leave yourselves no one remaining,

motu: Badina be dahaka imamui ḡaukaradia amo o habadugumu? Dahaka dainai muramura mai bonadia o gabudiamu dirava idaudia edia, ina Aigupto tanona, vada o mai henia bona o noholaiamu tanona, lalonai; bena unu amo vada ba henege daure, heuduguirai bona hegonagonalai ḡauna ai ba hahelao, tanobada besedia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
english: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to live, that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

motu: Senemui edia kara dika, Iuda pavapavadia mai adavadia ida edia kara dika, bona umui mai adavamui ida emui kara dika, Iuda tanona ai bona Ierusalem ariaradia ai e karava ḡaudia, vada o lalodia boio a?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah, the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

motu: Ema bona ina dina idia na asie hahemanau, bona asie gari, bona egu taravatu bona egu hiahedua herevadia, umui bona senemui vairamui ai na ato ḡaudia, lalodiai asie raka.
english: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.’

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, vairagu baina ha-aukaia emui ai, ihadikamui totona; Iuda idoinai baina negea daure.
english: “Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.

motu: Iuda taudia kwabukwabudia, vairadia vada e ha-aukadia Aigupto tanona baema bona bae noholaia taudia, na baina abidia, iboudiai baina ha-oredia; Aigupto tanona ai bae hekida diho, dare bona doe amo bae mase ore; asi dagidia bona mai dagibadadia taudia na dare bona doe ese bae hamasedia; idia na heihi ihirai bona hahegari bona heuduguirai bona heḡonaḡonalai ḡaudia ai baela.
english: I will take the remnant of Judah that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will all be consumed. They will fall in the land of Egypt. They will be consumed by the sword and by the famine. They will die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine. They will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach.

motu: Aigupto tanona ai e nohomu taudia na edia dika davana baina henidia, Ierusalem davana na henia heḡereḡerena, dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena amo;
english: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;

motu: taunabunai, Iuda taudia kwabukwabudia Aigupto tanona inoholaina totona; ema taudia, na ta basine heau mauri eiava basine roho mauri eiava Iuda tanona, harihari e uramu bae lou henia, na basine lou lao; badina be basie lou lao, a heau mauri taudia ta ta mo.
english: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will escape or be left to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there; for no one will return except those who will escape.’”

motu: Bena dibadia adavadia ese muramura mai bonadia na duava idaudia ediai vada e gabu taudia iboudiai, bona badibadidiai e giniva hahinedia iboudiai, hebou bada-hereana, Pataro ai, Aigupto tanona ai, e nohova taudia iboudiai, ese Ieremia e haere henia, eto,
english: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

motu: Hereva ta vada o hamaorolaimai Iehova ladana ai, to ai na basia kamonai henimu.
english: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.

motu: A vada a gwaurai hamata karadia iboudiai baia kara, muramura mai bonana baia gabua guba pavapavana hahinena ena, bona inuinu bouboudia baia bubu nege ia ena, a karaia guna heḡereḡerena, ai bona senemai, bona emai pavapava bona emai lohia, Iuda hanuadia ai bona Ierusalem ariaradia ai. Badina be una negana ai, amai aniani na momo, bona namomai na e bada e laova, dika ta asia itaia.
english: But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then we had plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

motu: A guba pavapavana hahinena ena muramura mai bonana igabuna bona ena inuinu bouboudia ibubudia a hadokoa murinai, ai na ḡau iboudiai vada e dabu bona dare bona doe ese vada e haoremai.
english: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.”

motu: Hahine ma eto, Ai na muramura mai bonana a gabua, guba pavapavana hahinena ena, bona inuinu bouboudia a bubu nege ia ena, negana ai, adavamai asie gwau maoro bena ai ese ena ataga a kara latadiai na mai ia laulauna bona inuinu bouboudia a bubu nege ia ena danu a?
english: The women said, “When we burned incense to the queen of the sky and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?”

motu: Bena Ieremia ese taunimanima iboudiai, tatau bona hahine, unu e haere henia toma taudia iboudiai, na e hereva henidia, eto,
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people—to the men and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,

motu: Hari muramura mai bonadia, Iuda hanuadia ai bona Ierusalem ariaradia ai o gabu ḡaudia, umui bona senemui, emui pavapava bona emui lohia, bona tano taudia, Iehova ese se laloa tao a? Ia ese se helalolaia une a?
english: “The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn’t Yahweh remember them, and didn’t it come into his mind?

motu: Iehova ena haheauka emui kara havara bona emui kara dika-rohorohodia ediai vada e ore; taunabunai emui tano na vada e ḡagae bona vada e vahu, heuduguirai ḡauna ai vada ela, asi inoholaina tauna ta, ina dina ai e miamu heḡereḡerena.
english: Thus Yahweh could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings and because of the abominations which you have committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation, an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is today.

motu: Muramura mai bonadia o gabu dainai, bona Iehova o kara dika henia bona Iehova gadona asio badinaia bona ena taravatu bona ena hahedua herevadia bona ena haheḡani lalodiai asio raka dainai, ina dika na latamui ai vada e kau, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena.
english: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is today.”

motu: Ieremia ese taunimanima iboudiai bona hahine iboudiai e hamaorodia, eto, Iuda taumui Aigupto tanona ai o nohomu iboumui ai, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear Yahweh’s word, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu: Umui bona adavamui ese udumui amo vada o gwauraia bona imamui amo vada o karadia, oto “Ai na momokani emai gwauhamata karadia baia kara, guba pavapavana hahinena ena muramura mai bonaula baia gabua bona inuinu bouboudia baia bubu nege”. Benaini, emui gwauhamata ba hamomokanidia bona karadia ba kara.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, “We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her.” “‘ Establish|strong="H6965" * then|strong="H6965" * your|strong="H3068" * vows|strong="H5088" *, and|strong="H6965" * perform|strong="H6213" * your|strong="H3068" * vows|strong="H5088" *.’

motu: Taunabunai, umui Iuda taumui Aigupto ai o nohomu iboumui ai, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Iehova na e tomu: A itaia, lau ladagu herea-daena bagunai vada na gwau hamata auka, Aigupto tanona idoinai Iuda tauna ta ese uduna amo lau ladagu basine hahanea, basineto “Ḡaubada Iehova e maurimu heḡereḡerena”.
english: “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by my great name,’ says Yahweh, ‘that my name will no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, “As the Lord Yahweh lives.”

motu: A itaia, lau ese na itadia taomu, dika ihavarana dainai, dia namo ihavarana dainai. Iuda taudia iboudiai Aigupto tanona ai na dare bona doe ese bae ha-oredia, ela bona bae ore vaitani.
english: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.

motu: Bena dare amo bae roho mauri taudia na Aigupto tanona amo bae lou lao, Iuda tanona baela, a gadoidia mo; bona Iuda taudia kwabukwabudia iboudiai, Aigupto tanona ema bena e noholaia taudia iboudiai, na bae diba daika ena hereva baine gini, lauegu eiava idia edia.
english: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Toana binai emui ai, emui dika davana baina henimui ina gabu ai, bena ba diba lauegu hereva na bae gini, umui ihadikamui totona.
english: “‘This will be the sign to you,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for evil.’

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese Farao Hofra, Aigupto pavapavana, na inaina imadia ai bona ena mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuamu taudia imadia ai baina atoa, Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, na Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ana inai tauna bona ena mauri iabi-ohona dalana e tahuava tauna, imana ai na atoa heḡereḡerena.
english: Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life.’”

motu: Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina lalonai, Ieremia ese ini hereva e gwaurai, bena Baruku Neria ese buka ta ai e toredia. Una negana ai peroveta tauna Ieremia ese Baruku Neria ini e hereva henia toma, eto,
english: The message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

motu: Baruku e, Iehova, Israel Diravana, ese ini e hereva henimu tomamu:
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

motu: Oi oto “Madi ihabaigu, badina be Iehova ese egu hisihisi latanai lalo-hisihisi ma vada e atoa kau; vada na ḡanaḡana ema bona name hesiku, bona laḡa-ani taina asiname davaria”.
english: ‘You said, “Woe is me now! For Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.”’

motu: Ini ba hereva henia toma, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, vada na haginia ḡauna na ḡiḡia dobimu, bona vada na hadoa ḡauna na ragaia ohomu: ḡauna be tano idoinai.
english: “You shall tell him, Yahweh says: ‘Behold, that which I have built, I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

motu: A oi ese ḡau hereadia o tahudiamu sibomu emu a? Iehova na e tomu: Basio tahudia; badina be lau ese dika na havaraiamu, taunimanima iboudiai latadiai; a emu mauri baina herumu, kwalimu ahuna ai bainela, ba lao heni gabudia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says Yahweh, ‘but I will let you escape with your life wherever you go.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Ieremia enai e kau, bese idauidau daidiai.
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

motu: Aigupto herevana, Farao Neko, Aigupto pavapavana, ena tuari oreana dainai; Karakemisi ai e taruhava, Eufrate sulavaina isena ai, bena Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ese e hadarerea, Iehoiakim, Iuda pavapavana Iosia natuna, ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina lalonai.
english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.
