motu: Ina na peroveta tauna Ieremia ena hereva, ia ese Seraia, Neria Mahaseia natuna, e haḡanilaia ḡauna, Sedekia, Iuda pavapavana, ida Babulono ela negana ai, hari Sedekia ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina lalonai. Seraia na kohu ireḡuna tauna.
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

motu: Ieremia ese dika idoinai Babulono latanai baine kau herevadia na buka ta ai e tore.
english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

motu: Bena Ieremia ese Seraia e hamaoroa, eto, Babulono ai ba kau negana ai, mi hereva iboudiai do ba duahidia;
english: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,

motu: ma baoto, Iehova e, oi na vada o hereva, ina gabu ba negea daure, bena ḡau ta ia lalonai basine noho, taunimanima ta eiava ubu-ubu ḡauna ta; ia na baine vahu hanaihanai.
english: and say, ‘Yahweh, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’

motu: Bena ina buka ba duahia vaitani murinai, nadi ta ai ba mataia kau, bena Eufrate sinavaina lalonai ba negea dobi.
english: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

motu: Bena baoto, Babulono na unu baine mutu toma, basine keni lou, dika na ia latanai ba hadihoamu dainai. Ieremia ena hereva dokona binai.
english: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus|strong="H3602" * far|strong="H5704" * are|strong="H1697" * the|strong="H6440" * words|strong="H1697" * of|strong="H1697" * Jeremiah|strong="H3414" *.

motu: Sedekia e lohia matama negana ai, ena mauri laḡanidia na ruahui-ta; ena lohia laḡanidia Ierusalem ai na gwauta-ta. Sinana ladana na Hamutala, Ieremia, tau Libna, natuna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

motu: Ia na Iehova vairanai e kara havara, Iehoiakim ena kara iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ma e kara.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

motu: Momokani, Iehova ena badu dainai Ierusalem bona Iuda edia dika na e bada e laova ela bona ia vairana amo e negedia daure. Bena Sedekia ese Babulono pavapavana e gwau edeede henia.
english: For through Yahweh’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah|strong="H6667" * rebelled|strong="H4775" * against|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H6440" * king|strong="H4428" * of|strong="H4428" * Babylon.

motu: Ena lohia laḡanina ihataurahani-tana ai, hua ihagwautana dinana ihagwautana lalonai, Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, na ena tuari oreana idoinai ida Ierusalem ihadikana ema, e koua hegeḡe bona tano e larebaia heḡeḡe.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

motu: Taunabunai, hanua e koua heḡeḡe ela bona King Sedekia ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-tana.
english: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

motu: Bena hua ihahanina dinana ihataurahani-tana ai, hanua lalonai doe vada e bada herea, bona tano idoinai taunimanima na asi adia.
english: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

motu: Una negana ai, hanua maguna e hamaurua. Ena be Kaldea taudia na hanua vada e koua heḡeḡe, to tuari taudia iboudiai na hanuaboi ai e heau, magu ruaosi padadia ikoukouna amo, hanua pavapavana ena uma-uma badibadinai; bena Araba kahana ela.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,

motu: A Kaldea taudia edia tuari oreana ese hanua pavapavana na e gavaia, ela bona Ieriko taorana ai Sedekia e lasia tao; bena ena tuari oreana idoinai na iena amo e karoho rohoroho.
english: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

motu: Bena idia ese hanua pavapavana e abia mauri, Babulono pavapavana dekena e laohaia, Ribla ai, Hamat tanona ai. Ia ese e revaia.
english: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

motu: Bena Sedekia natuna mamaruanedia na ia vairanai e aladia mase; bona Iuda lohiadia iboudiai danu Ribla ai e aladia mase.
english: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

motu: Ia ese danu Sedekia matana e hakepuludia, auri gadeadia amo e ḡuia. Bena Babulono pavapavana ese Babulono e laohaia, unuseni ai dibura rumana ai e koua ela bona ena mase dinana. luda e abia mauri
english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

motu: Hua iha-imana dinana ihahituna ai (una na King Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-taurahani-tana ai), Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, Babulono pavapavana ena hesiai tauna ta, na Ierusalem ai e raka vareai.
english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

motu: Bena ia ese Iehova ena dubu bona pavapava ena ruma bona Ierusalem rumadia iboudiai e doudia; ruma badadia iboudiai e doudia vaitani.
english: He burned Yahweh’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.

motu: Bena Kaldea tuari oreana taudia iboudiai, hegima oreana biaguna ida ema taudia, ese Ierusalem heḡeḡemadai maḡudia iboudiai e hahegigidia dobi.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

motu: Bena ogoḡami dikadika taudia haida, bona hanua taudia kwabukwabudia dounu hanua ai e nohova, bona Babulono pavapavana enai e heau hanai taudia, bona ima karakara dibaka taudia oredia, na Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese e ḡuidia, bena dauha e laohaidia.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

motu: A Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese ogoḡami dikadika taudia haida e rakatanidia, vine imeadia ireḡudia bona tano iruana taudia ai baela.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

motu: Auri labora-labora au-tubuadia Iehova ena dubu ai, bona rerue bona auri labora-labora nauna badana Iehova ena dubu ai, na Kaldea taudia ese e hamakohidia, bena auri labora-laborana idoinai na e laohaia Babulono.
english: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.

motu: Bona uro bona gaga bona lamepa ihaḡoevadia ḡaudia, bona nau, bona muramura mai bonadia urodia, bona auri labora-labora ḡaudia, kara helagadia ai e ḡaukaralaiva ḡaudia, na iboudiai e laohai;
english: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

motu: bona bia bona gida keberedia bona dihu bona uro, bona lamepa patadia, bona muramura mai bonadia urodia, bona udu-ahudia keheredia. Gold * ḡaudia bona silver * ḡaudia na hari hegima oreana biaguna ese e laohai.
english: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.

motu: Hari au-tubua ruaosi, bona nau badana, bona boromakau mamaruanedia laulaudia gwauta-ruaosi, auri labora-labora amo e kara bona nau badana henunai e ato ḡaudia, bona rerue, hanua pavapavana Solomon ese e kara Iehova ena dubu ena, auri labora-labora idia lalodiai metauna na asi ihahetohona.
english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

motu: Hari au-tubuadia ta ena lata na kiubit gwauta-taurahani; ena kuboro-heḡeḡe na kiubit gwauta-rua; kopina udunana na ima-kwakikwaki hani e haheboudia udunana heḡereḡerena; ia na auri kuborona lalona kohua.
english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; + 52:21 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

motu: Ia latanai na kwarana ikorona, auri labora-labora ḡauna; hari kwarana ikorona ta ena lata na kiubit ima; bona reke-hetomana bona rimono huahuadia laulaudia, iboudiai na auri laboralabora amo e kara, na auri au-tubua kwarana ikorona ḡauna e gegelaia. Au-tubua iharuana danu unuheto, mai ena rimono huahuadia laulaudia.
english: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, + 52:22 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.

motu: Rimono huahuadia laulaudia na taurahanita-ahui tauratoi ohena ohena ai; rimono huahuadia laulaudia reke-hetomana e geḡelaia iboudiai na sinahu-ta.
english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

motu: Bena hari hegima oreana biaguna ese hahelaḡa tauna badana Seraia, bona hahelaḡa tauna iharuana Sefania, bona dubu iduarana inaridia taudia tatoiosi, e abidia.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,

motu: Hanua amo danu tuari oreana biaguna ta bona hanua pavapavana ena kaunsil taudia hahitu hanua lalonai e davaridia na e abidia; bona tuari biaguna ena toretore tauna, ena ḡaukara be tano taudia ihagaudia, bona tano taudia tauratoi-ahui hanua lalonai e davaridia danu,
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

motu: Nebusaradana, hegima oreana biaguna, ese e abidia, Babulono pavapavana dekena e laohaidia Ribla ai.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

motu: Bena Babulono pavapavana ese e rahudia mamase, Ribla ai, Hamat tanona ai, e aladia mase. Taunabunai, Iuda taudia na e ḡuidia, edia tano amo e abidia oho, dauha e laohaidia.
english: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. motu: Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Israel taudia dekedia na siaimumu, daḡedaḡe besena, lau e daḡedaḡe henigumu taudia, dekediai; idia bona tamadia ese vada e kara dika henigu ema bona hari ina dina ai.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.

motu: Unu taunimanima danu asie matauraigumu, bona lalodia e ha-aukadiamu; dekedia na siaimumu, ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu”.
english: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord + 2:4 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * Yahweh says.’

motu: Bena bema kamonai eiava basiema kamonai (badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena), to vada bae diba peroveta tauna ta na idia bogaragidiai vada ema.
english: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

motu: Oi danu, taunimanima natuna e, idia garidia basio gari bona edia hereva basio garilaidia; ena be au ginigini bona ava ginigini na emu ai bona doadoa o helaidia taomu, to edia hereva garidia basio gari bona edia vaira-hua basio garilaia, badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
english: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

motu: Egu hereva ba hamaorolaidia, bena bae kamonai eiava kamonai basie ura; badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
english: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.

motu: A taunimanima natuna e, na hamaorolaimumu herevana ba kamonai: oi na basio daḡedaḡe, una daḡedaḡe besena na heto; udumu a hagaia, aina henimu ḡauna bavania.
english: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”

motu: Bena na roha lao, ima ta na itaia, e hetoi roro henigu, bona lalonai na pepa mai revarevana helokuna ta.
english: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.

motu: Bena ia ese lau vairagu ai e hulalaia: pepa kahana kahana na mai revarevadia, unu kaha ruaosi ai herohe-ahu bona taitai bona lalo-hisihisi herevadia vada e hetore.
english: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorugu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, na dudui henimu ḡauna na bavania; ina pepa helokuna bavania, bena baola, Israel taudia ba hereva henidia.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese udugu na hagaia; bena ia ese pepa na e henigu, baina ania.
english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.

motu: E hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ina na henimumu pepana bavania, bogamu ba hakunulaia. Bena na ania; udugu ai e gaiho, bada-ranuna na heto.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then|strong="H1961" * I|strong="H5414" * ate it|strong="H5414" *. It|strong="H5414" * was|strong="H1961" * as|strong="H1961" * sweet|strong="H4966" * as|strong="H1961" * honey|strong="H1706" * in|strong="H1121" * my|strong="H5414" * mouth|strong="H6310" *.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena dekena baola, egu hereva na ba hamaorolaidia.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

motu: Badina be idau gado aukana ta taudia dekedia asina siaimumu, a Israel besena enai;
english: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

motu: dia bese idau-idau momo, edia gado na i'idau bona a'auka besedia, ediai. Momokani, unuhetomadia ediai bama siaimu, idia ese bema kamonai henimu.
english: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

motu: A Israel besena ese basine kamonai henimu, badina be idia na asie uramu lau bae kamonai henigu. Badina be Israel taudia iboudiai na vairadia e huamu bona lalodia e ha-aukamu.
english: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate + 3:7 Literally, have a hard forehead * and hard-hearted.

motu: A itaia, oi vairamu vada na ha-aukaia, idia edia vaira-auka davana; bona oi vairamu vada na hahuakaia, idia edia vaira-hua davana.
english: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.

motu: Vairamu vada na ha-aukaia, nadi-vasiga ena auka e hereaiamu nadina na heto; idia garidia basio gari bona edia vaira-hua basio garilaia, badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
english: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, na herevalai henimumu herevadia iboudiai na lalomu ai bavabi dae, bona taiamu amo ba hakala henidia.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

motu: Aola, dauhai e hanohodia taudia, emu bese taudia, dekediai, bena ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu”; bena bae kamonai eiava kamonai basie ura.
english: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”

motu: Bena Lauma ese e abigu isi; bona Iehova hairaina na gabuna amo e tore isi negana ai tano-laga badana reḡena na murigu kahana ai na kamonai;
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory from his place.”

motu: una na mauri ḡaudia hanidia e hetomu heheni reḡedia bona idia badibadidiai e miava ava-keikeidia reḡedia, e hekara tano-laga reḡena na heto.
english: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

motu: Lauma ese e abigu isi, dauha e laohaigu; laumagu siahuna iditana ai nala, badina be Iehova imana na auka, lau latagu ai.
english: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was strong on me.

motu: Bena dauhai e hanohodia taudia dekediai na kau, Telabibi ai; idia na Kebara sinavaina isena ai e nohova. Bena unuseni ai na helai, idia bogaragidiai, laumagu na e daure ela bona dina hitu e ore. Israel igimana tauna
english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

motu: Dina hitu e ore ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, lau ese Israel besena igimana tauna ai vada na halaomu; lau udugu herevana ta ba kamonai negadia iboudiai na lau ladagu ai do ba sisiba henidia.
english: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

motu: Kara dika tauna bama hamaoroa, bama toma “Oi na vada ba mase”, bena oi basioma sisiba henia, una kara dika tauna na ena dala dikana amo ihakau-sirina bona ena mauri irauana herevadia basioma sisibalai henia, una kara dika tauna na ena dika ai baine mase; a ia rarana davana na oi imamu amo baina gwauraia.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

motu: A kara dika tauna boma sisiba henia, bena ia na ena kara dika amo eiava ena dala dikana amo basine raka siri, ia na ena dika ai baine mase; a oi ese sibomu emu mauri do ba rauaia.
english: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

motu: Ina danu, kara maoromaoro tauna ta na ena kara maoromaoIo amo bema raka siri, bena bema kara havara, bena lau ese hekwakwanai ḡauna ta ia vairanai bama atoa, ia na baine mase; oi ese to sisiba henia dainai ia na baine mase, ena kara dika bagunai, bona ena kara maoromaorodia, guna ia ese e kara ḡaudia, na basie lalodia tao; a ia rarana davana na oi imamu amo baina gwauraia.
english: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

motu: Ḡau tamona, oi ese kara maoromaoro tauna boma sisiba henia basinema kara dika, bena basine kara dika, ia na do baine mauri, badina be sisiba herevana na e abia dae; bena oi ese sibomu emu mauri do ba rauaia. Peroveta tauna e mu
english: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”

motu: Unuseni ai Iehova imana na lau latagu ai mia. Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A tore isi, ba raka lasi, taora baola; unuseni ai baina hereva henimu.
english: Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

motu: Taunabunai na tore isi, na raka lasi, taora nala; unuseni ai Iehova hairaina ginina ai na itaia, Kebara sinavaina isena ai na itaia hairaina heḡereḡerena. Bena na goru diho.
english: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.

motu: A Lauma ese e rohegu, bena ia ese e haginigu tore. Bena e hereva henigu, eto, Aola, sibomu emu ruma lalonai ba hekou ahu.
english: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a itaia, oi na varo amo bae ḡuimu, bena taunimanima dekediai basio raka lasi diba.
english: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

motu: Bena lau ese malamu na udumu atai maona ai baina hakapea dae; taunabunai vada ba mu, bena basio gwau henidia diba; badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
english: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.

motu: A baina hereva henimu negana ai, udumu do baina hahaḡaia, bena ba hereva henidia, baoto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamnu”. Kamonai e uramu tauna na baine kamonai; bona kamonai se uramu tauna na basine kamonai; badina be idia na daḡedaḡe besena.
english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, e tunua nadina ta bavabia, vairamu ai bavatoa diho; bena ia kopina ai Ierusalem hanuana laulauna ta ba torea:
english: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

motu: ituari-henina ḡaudia bona ikoulaina maguna bona tano senudia bona taruha bona vaḡoma danu laulaudia ba tore.
english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

motu: Bena auri palaka-palakana ta bavabia, auri maḡuna ai bainela, oi bona hanua padamui ai; bena ba raraia tao, ikou-ahuna bona ituari-henina ba ha-aukaia. Ina na toa ta, Israel besena enai.
english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

motu: Bena ohemu laurina ai ba eno dere; bena lau ese Israel besena ena dika davana na oi latamu ai baina atoa; dina edehohodia ai ba eno dere na edia dika davadia latamu ai bae mia.
english: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

motu: Badina be dina na gwaurai henimumu, dina sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui, idia ese edia dika davadia bae abi laḡanidia heḡereḡeredia; nega unudaudauna na Israel besena ena dika davana latamu ai baine mia.
english: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

motu: Unu dina ba haḡuḡurudia, bena nega iharuana ai ma ba eno dere, a ohemu idibana ai, bena Iuda iduhuna ena dika davana na latamu ai baine mia; dina hari-ahui na gwaurai henimumu, dina ta ta be laḡani ta a toadia.
english: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

motu: Bena Ierusalem ikou-ahuna ba raraia tao, mai imamu ḡaḡaena Ia; bena hanua ihadikana ba perovetalaia.
english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

motu: A itaia, lau ese varo ai baina guimu, bena basio eno hegiro diba, ela bona emu hanua ikou-ahuna dinadia ba haguḡurudia.
english: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

motu: Ina danu, oi ese uit, bali, bini, lentil *, millet *, bona rae na bavabidia, nau tamona ai ba udadia hebou, bena igabu ba kara. Bena ohemu ai ba eno dere dinadia hidaosi, dina sinahu-toi taurahanita-ahui lalodiai bavani.
english: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

motu: Bavania anianina metauna ba hahetohoa, sekele ruahui + 4:10 Sekele ruahui = 327 grams sisivana. * dina ta lalonai; dina ta ai nega tamona mo bavaniani.
english: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels + 4:10 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

motu: Ba inua ranuna danu ba hahetohoa, ranu hini ta ba karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa + 4:11 Hini ta bae karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa ta = 1 litre sisivana. * tamona ba inua; dina ta ai nega tamona mo ranu ba inu.
english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. + 4:11 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. * From time to time you shall drink.

motu: Bavania, bali atagana na heto, idia vairadiai ba gabua, taunimanima taḡedia kakorodia lahina latanai.
english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

motu: Bena Iehova na e tomu, Israel taudia adia aniani mirodia unu bae ani toma, ediai baina luludia lao besedia bogaragidiai.
english: Yahweh said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

motu: Bena lau nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, a itaia, lau na sibogu asina hahemiro; merogu negana amo ema bona hari ina nega sibona e mase kava ḡauna ta eiava uda boromadia ese e darea ḡauna ta asina ania, bona vamu bodagana taina na nega ta ai udugu ai se vareai.
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A itaia, na gwau maoromu, amu ataga na taunimanima taḡena kakorona lahina latanai basio gabua, a boromakau taḡena kakorona lahina latanai ba gabua.
english: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, a itaia, Ierusalem ai mauri anianina na baina abia oho; aniani metauna bae hahetohoa guna bena bae ania mai garidia ida; bona ranu na bae hahetohoa guna, bena bae inua mai kudou-hetahadia ida.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

motu: Unu baina kara toma, bena aniani ai bona ranu ai bae dabu, bae heroha heheni mai kudou-hetahadia ida, bona edia dika davadia daidiai taudia bae varoda.
english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, dare ganona ta bavabia, kwaramu inauna ḡauna ai ba halaoa, kwaramu ba naua bona aukimu huina bavabia; bena metau ihahetohona ḡauna bavabia, hui ba karoa, karoa toi.
english: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

motu: Bena karoa toiosi amo karoa ta na lahi ai ba gabua, hanua bogaraginai, hanua idai-ahuna baine ore negana ai; ma karoa ta bavabia, dare amo ba tara utu-utu, hanua heḡeḡemadai ai; ma karoa ta na lai ai ba giḡia oda-oda; bena unu muridiai lau ese dare na pauana lalona amo baina veria lasi.
english: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

motu: Bona unu amo danu hui haida bavabi, emu dabua gevena ai ba turidia.
english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

motu: Ma unu haida danu bavabi, lahi ai ba tahodia kau, ba gabudia; bena unu amo lahi ta baine lasi Israel besena idoinai enai.
english: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ierusalem binai, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai vada na atoa, tano idau-idau ese e ḡeḡea daemu.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

motu: A ia ese bese idau-idau vada e hereadia egu hahedua herevadia iutudia ai, bona heḡeḡemadai tanodia vada e hereadia egu taravatu itata-utudia ai; egu hahedua herevadia vada e dadaraidia, bona egu taravatu daladia ai asie raka.
english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be umui ese e gegemui ahumu besedia na o hereadiamu, heloḡo ahuahu ai, bona egu taravatu daladia ai asio raka bona egu hahedua herevadia asio badinadia, a e gegemui ahumu besedia edia hahedua herevadia, vada o badinadia;
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

motu: una dainai (Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu) a itaia, lau ese na inai henimuimu, bona hahemaoro karadia baina kara umui bogaragimui ai, bese idau-idau vairadiai.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

motu: Bona emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai lau ese nega gunana ta ai asina karaia bona nega gabena ta ai basina karaia lou karana ta baina kara henimui.
english: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

motu: Taunabunai, umui bogaragimui ai tama ese natudia bae anidia, bona memero ese tamadia bae anidia; bona lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui, bona hahidaosi ba roho mauri na lai kahadia iboudiai baina gigimui rohoroho.
english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Taunabunai na maurimu heḡereḡerena, umui ese egu gabu helaḡana na emui ḡau dika-hereadia bona emui kara dikarohorohodia amo vada o hamiroa dainai, momokani lau ese baina negemui daure; basina hageremui bona basina bogamui hisi.
english: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

motu: Emui orea lalona amo kaha ta be dai-hanai gorerena amo bae mase bona doe amo bae ore bogaragimui ai; ma kaha ta na dare amo bae mase emui orea hegegemadai ai; ma kaha ihatoina na lau ese lai kahadia iboudiai baina ḡiḡidia rohoroho; bona idia muridiai dare na pauana amo baina veria lasi.
english: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

motu: Unu amo egu badu baine ore; egu badu ḡaraḡarana amo baina kara henidia ela bona lalogu baine keru. Bena idia na bae diba lau Iehova na egu vageḡe ai vada na hereva, egu badu garagarana na latadiai baina ha-orea negana ai.
english: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

motu: Ina danu: lau ese baina hadoemui, bona hesivarai ḡauna ai baina halaomui, e ḡeḡemui ahumu besedia bogaragidiai bona raka-hanai taudia iboudiai vairadiai.
english: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

motu: Umui na hesivarai bona heḡonaḡonalai bona sisiba bona hahegari ḡauna ai baola, e ḡeḡemui ahumu besedia ediai, lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui mai badugu bona mai lalo-siahugu bona mai hedadaba aukadia ida negana ai. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
english: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, Yahweh, have spoken it—

motu: Una negana ai egu doe dibadia amo baina tarakimui mamase, hahebua-tari dibadia, umui ihabua-tarimui totona baina kinodia; doe na baina habadaia loulou emui ai, emui mauri anianina na baina abia oho.
english: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

motu: Lau ese doe bona uda boromadia baina siaidia vasi, umui ihadikamui totona; idia ese natumui na emui amo bae dadidia oho; dai-hanai gorerena bona rara ese bae daemui, bena dare na latamui ai baina siaia. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
english: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ororodia ba raraidia tao, latadiai ba peroveta,
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

motu: baoto, Israel ororodia e, Ḡaubada Iehova ena hereva a kamonai! Ḡaubada Iehova ese ororo badadia bona maraḡidia, koura dobudobudia bona koura-koura na ini e gwau henidia tomamu: A itaia, lau ese dare na latamui ai baina hadihoa, bona emui atai gabudia helaḡadia baina habuadia tari.
english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

motu: Emui ihaboulaina patadia bae vahu, emui muramura mai bonadia patadia bae heḡiḡi dobi, emui mase taudia na emui kaivakuku vairadiai baina tahodia dobi.
english: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

motu: Israel taudia na masedia ai baina hahekidadia diho, edia kaivakuku vairadiai; bona turiamui baina ḡiḡidia rohoroho, emui ihaboulaina patadia hegegemadai ai.
english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

motu: Emui noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai emui hanua bae vahu bona emui atai gabudia helaḡadia bae heḡiḡi dobi; emui ih-aboulaina paladia bae vahu bona bae heḡiḡi dobi; emui kaivakuku bae makohi bona bae hebua tari; emui muramura mai bonadia patadia bae heḡiḡi dobi bona emui ḡaukara anidia bae boio.
english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

motu: E aladiamu taudia na bogaragimui ai bae hekida diho; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: A umui haida na maurimui ai baina rakatanimui. Dare amo bae roho mauri taudia haida na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai bae noho, bona tano idau-idau ai ba karoho rohoroho negana ai,
english: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

motu: umui roho-mauri taumui hahidaosi ese lau ba lalogu tao, iguimui ai bae laohaimui besedia bogaragidiai. Bona mai lebulebudia ida vada e rakatanigu taudia na lalodia baina gugubadia, bona mai lebulebudia ida edia kaivakuku e gavadiamu taudia na matadia baina hakepuludia negana ai, idia na sibodia bae hedadarai, edia kara havara bona edia kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai.
english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

motu: Bena idia na bae diba lau na Iehova; ini baina karadia toma nato negana ai na asina hereva kava.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Imamui ba pata bona aemui ba pana dagu, baoto, Madi ihabaida! Israel besena ena kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai; badina be dare bona doe bona dai-hanai gorerena amo bae mase.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

motu: Gabu daudau ai e nohomu tauna na dai-hanai gorerena amo baine mase; bona gabu kahikahina ai e nohomu tauna na dare amo baine mase; bona do noho maurina tauna na doe amo baine mase. Unuhetomana egu badu-ḡaraḡara baina ha-orea idia latadiai.
english: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

motu: Bena edia mase taudia na edia kaivakuku bogaragidiai bae hekida diho, edia ihaboulaina patadia hegeḡemadai ai, bona ororo latalatadia iboudiai latadiai, bona ororo badadia iboudiai doridia ai, bona au mauridia iboudiai bona oak * audia urumo-urumodia iboudiai henudiai, muramura mai bonadia edia kaivakuku e gabu henidia gabudia iboudiai lalodiai; una negana ai ba diba, lau na Iehova.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

motu: Lau ese imagu baina toia roro, idia ihadikadia totona, tano baina habuaia tari bona baina havahua, edia noho gabudia iboudiai lalodiai, tano ḡaḡaena amo ela bona Ribla. Bena bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ḡaubada Iehova ese Israel tanona na ini e hamaorolaia tomamu: Dokona binai! Dokona vada e kau, tano daigunina haniosi latadiai.
english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

motu: Harihari dokona na oi latamu ai vada e kau, egu badu na oiemu ai baina hulalaia, bona emu kara heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henimu, emu kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai davadia do baina henimu.
english: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

motu: Lau ese basina hageremu bona basina bogamu hisi; a emu kara davadia baina henimu, emu kara dika-rohorohodia na doini bogaragimu ai mimia negana ai. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova.
english: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Dikadika ta murinai na dikadika ma ta! A itaia, ia na vada e maimu.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.

motu: Dokona vada e kau, dokona korikori vada e kau; anina na emu ai vada hedinarai. A itaia, ia na e maimu!
english: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.

motu: Tano inoholaina taumu e, emu ai baine kau ḡauna vada e kau; negana vada eme kau; heloḡo-ahuahu dinana vada eme kahikahi, dia moale lolodia dinana ororo latadiai.
english: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.

motu: Asi vanahana egu badu ḡaraḡara na latamu ai baina bubua, egu badu na emu ai baina ha-orea, bona emu kara heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henimu; bena emu kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai davadia baina henimu.
english: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

motu: Basina hageremu bona basina bogamu hisi; emu kara davadia baina henimu, emu kara dika-rohorohodia na doini bogaragimu ai mimia negana ai. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova, herahu-mase Diravana.
english: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.

motu: A itaia, dinana binai! A itaia, ia na e maimu! Emu ai baine kau ḡauna na vada e kau; kara gageva-gageva vada e papa, hekokoroku vada e gara kau;
english: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

motu: daḡedaḡe vada e tubu, kara dika vada e tubu kau. Idia ta basine noho; edia kohu-momo bona edia taḡa basie mia; bona idia bogaragidiai ta basine herea.
english: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

motu: Negana vada e kau, dinana vada eme kahikahi. E hoihoimu tauna basine moale, bona kohu e hoihoilaimu tauna lalona basine hisihisi, badina be badu ḡaraḡara na edia-hotuhotu iboudiai latadiai.
english: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

motu: Badina be kohu e hoihoilaimu tauna ese e hoilaia kohuna basine lou henia, edia mauri dinadia iboudiai. Badina be badu ḡaraḡara na edia hotuhotu iboudiai latadiai, bona basine heabi oho. Ena kara havara dainai tau ta ese sibona ena mauri basine rauaia diba.
english: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

motu: Kibi vada e hiriria, ḡau iboudiai vada e hegaegaelai; a ta na tuari se laomu, badina be egu badu na edia hotuhotu iboudiai latadiai.
english: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.

motu: Murimuri ai na dare; laloma ai na dai-hanai gorerena bona doe. Tano paka ai e nohomu tauna na dare ai e masemu; hanua ai e nohomu tauna na doe bona dai-hanai gorerena ese e hamaseamu.
english: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.

motu: Haida bema roho mauri, idia na ororo ai bema noho, koura punedia na heheto; iboudiai na bae ḡanaḡana, ta ta ena kara havara ena kara havara daidiai.
english: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.

motu: Ima iboudiai na e mamanomu; tui iboudiai na e heroḡe-herogemu, ranu na heto.
english: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.

motu: Puse dabuadia e riomu, gari ese e hahonudiamu; iboudiai vairadia e hemaraimu, iboudiai kwaradia e naudiamu.
english: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.

motu: Edia silver * na ariara ai e negeamu, bona edia gold * na ḡau mirona na heto. Iehova ena badu-ḡaraḡara dinana ai, edia silver * bona edia gold * ese basie hamauridia diba; edia hitolo basie ha-orelai diba, bona bogadia basie hakunulai diba. Badina be una na ihahekwakwanailaidia ḡauna edia kara havara ai.
english: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.

motu: Edia herahera mai hairaidia e heagilai, bona edia kaivakuku dika-rohorohodia bona edia ḡau dika-hereadia na unu amo e karadia; taunabunai lau ese ḡau mirona ai baina halaoa idia ediai.
english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

motu: Lau ese idau taudia imadia ai baina atoa, idia damudia ai bainela, bona tanobada ena taunimanima dikadia baina henidia, idia dinadia ai bainela; bena idia ese bae hamiroa.
english: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.

motu: Bena idia edia amo baina mede daudau, egu gabu ḡoeva-daena na bae hamiroa totona; dadidadi taudia ese ia lalonai bae raka vareai, bae hamiroa,
english: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.

motu: bona bae havahua. Badina be tano na rara-hebubu kara dikadia ai e honumu, bona hanua na ala-ala ai e honumu.
english: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

motu: Bese dika-hereadia baina mailaidia, edia ruma bae ḡaunaidia; edia goada, e heaḡilaiamu ḡauna, baina ha-orea; edia gabu helaḡadia bae hamirodia.
english: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.

motu: Lalo-hisihisi bada baine kau negana ai, idia ese maino bae tahua, to basie davaria.
english: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

motu: Dikadika na dikadika latanai e kaumu; hari lahulahuna ta na hari lahulahuna ta murinai e maimu. Mata-hanai na peroveta tauna enai e tahuamu; a taratvatu na hahelaḡa tauna enai e boiomu, bona hahealo na hanua tau-badadia ediai e oremu.
english: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

motu: Hanua pavapavana e taitaimu; hanua lohiana darana e dokomu; bona tano taudia imadia na e hedabarai, gari dainai. Idia edia kara heḡereḡerena ai baina kara henidia, bona idia edia hanemaoro herevadia heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henidia; bena bae diba, lau na Iehova.
english: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Laḡani ihatauratoina huana ihatauratoina dinana iha-imana lalonai, lau ese egu ruma ai na helaiva; bena Iuda tau-badadia na lau vairagu ai e helaiva ai na Ḡaubada Iehova ese imana na lau latagu ai e atoa kau.
english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Yahweh’s hand fell on me there.

motu: Bena na roha isi, ḡau ta na itaia, ita-itana taunimanima na heto; ia koekoena hetomana ḡauna henunai na lahi, bona koekoena daenai na diari-diari hetomana, auri laboralabora hurwu-hururuna na heto.
english: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

motu: Ima hetomana ḡauna ta e toia lasi, doboraḡigu ai e abigu; bena Lauma ese e abigu isi, tanobada bona guba padadiai, bena Dirava imata-hanailaina ai Ierusalem e laohaigu, ela bona laloma maguna ikoukouna raka-vareaina, mirigini kahana e vaira henia ḡauna; unuseni ai vaḡeḡe kaivakukuna, vaḡeḡe e havaraiamu ḡauna, ena gini gabuna e miava.
english: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

motu: Na itaia danu, Israel Diravana hairaina na unuseni ai, taora ai mata-hanai ai na itaia heḡereḡerena.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, a gaga isi, mirigini kahana ba roha henia. Bena na gaga isi, mirigini kahana na roha henia, na itaia, ihaboulaina patana ikoukouna mirigini kahana ai, raka-vareaina ai, hari vaḡeḡe kaivakukuna na mia.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So|strong="H5375" * I|strong="H2009" * lifted|strong="H5375" * up|strong="H5375" * my|strong="H5375" * eyes|strong="H5869" * the|strong="H5375" * way|strong="H1870" * toward|strong="H1870" * the|strong="H5375" * north|strong="H6828" *, and|strong="H1121" * saw|strong="H2009" *, northward|strong="H6828" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H5375" * gate|strong="H8179" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H5375" * altar|strong="H4196" * this|strong="H2088" * image|strong="H5566" * of|strong="H1121" * jealousy|strong="H7068" * in|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H5375" * entry.

motu: Bena ia ese ma e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, idia na ede e kara tomamu o itaiamu a? Kara dika-rohoroho bada-hereadia, Israel besena ese egu gabu helaḡana amo bae lulugu oho helaoreana ai e karamu ḡaudia, o itadiamu a? A kara dikarohorohodia haida, ini kara e hereadiamu ḡaudia, na do ba itadia.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

motu: Bena ma e laohaigu, maḡu ikoukouna badibadinai, bena na gaga isi, mauru ta magu ai na itaia.
english: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, maḡu ba hamaurua. Magu na hamaurua, bena iduara ta na itaia.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When|strong="H1121" * I|strong="H2009" * had|strong="H1121" * dug|strong="H2864" * in|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H2009" * wall|strong="H7023" *, I|strong="H2009" * saw|strong="H2009" * a|strong="H3068" * door|strong="H6607" *.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A raka vareai, kara dika-rohoroho badahereadia unuseni ai e karamu na ba itadia.
english: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

motu: Bena na raka vareai, na roharoha; unuseni ai e raumu ḡaudia idau-idau bona boroma dika-rohoroho-lia bona Israel taudia edia kaivakuku iboudiai laulaudia na haba ai vada e tore.
english: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

motu: Unu laulau vairadiai Israel tau-badadia hitu-ahui e gini, bona Iaasania Safana na bogaragidiai e gini. Idia ta ta mai edia gida keberedia imadia ai, bona muramura mai bonana, e gabua ḡauna, kwalahuna e daeva, ori na heto.
english: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Israel tau-badadia na dibura ai ede e kara tomamu, ta ta ena laulau daiutuna ena laulau daiutuna lalodiai, vada o itaia a? Badina be idia na e tomu “Iehova ese se itadamu; Iehova ese tano vada e rakatania”.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘Yahweh doesn’t see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land.’”

motu: Ia ese ma e hamaorogu, eto, Kara dika-rohorohodia haida, ini kara e hereadiamu ḡaudia, idia ese e karamu na do ba itadia.
english: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

motu: Bena ia ese Iehova ena dubu mirigini kahana ikoukouna raka-vareaina e laohaigu; unuseni ai hahine haida na itadia, e helaiva, Tamusu + 8:14 Tamusu na bese gunadia haida edia dirava; e laloa ia na laḡani ta ta amo keru negana ai e mase bena siahu negana ai ma e mauri lou, edia taitai bona edia ḡuriḡuri daidai. * taina e taiva.
english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Yahweh’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ina na vada o itaia a? Kara dika-rohorohodia haida, ini kara e hereadiamu ḡaudia, na do ba itadia.
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

motu: Bena ia ese Iehova ena dubu ena laloma maḡuna lalonai e laohaigu. Iehova ena dubu helaḡana vairanai, dehe toi-lasi rumana bona ihaboulaina patana padadiai, taunimanima ruahui-ima sisivana e gini; Iehova ena dubu helaḡana e muri henia bona mairiveina kahana e vaira henia, dina e toma henia dihova mairiveina italaina ai.
english: He brought me into the inner court of Yahweh’s house; and I saw at the door of Yahweh’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward Yahweh’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto Taunimanima natuna e, ina na vada o itaia a? Iuda besena taudia ese hari kara dika-rohorohodia iniseni ai e karamu na ḡau pipikina a, una dainai idia ese tano na daḡedaḡe amo e hahonuamu, bona e habadugu hereamu? A itaia, idia ese ududia mukurodia e kara.
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese badu ḡaraḡara karadia baina kara; basina haḡeredia bona basina bogadia hisi; ena be taiagu ai bae tai mai gao badadia ida, to basina kamonai henidia.
english: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

motu: Bena ia ese taiagu ai e lolo, mai gao badana ida, eto, Hanua ihabua-tarina taumui e, a raka kahira, ta ta mai emui ala-ala ḡaudia imamui ai.
english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

motu: Bena na itaia, tatau tauratoi na atai ikoukouna, mirigini kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna, kahana amo ema, ta ta mai edia ala-ala ḡaudia imadia ai. Ma tau ta danu idia ida ema; ia na dabua aukana e hahedokilaia, toretore ḡaudia vainana danu e daharaia. Bena idia na e raka vareai, ihaboulaina patana, auri labora-labora ḡauna, badibadinai e gini.
english: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

motu: Una negana ai Israel Diravana hairaina na kerubi daedia, vaia e miava gabuna, amo e dae, dubu raka-vareaina e lao henia; bena ia ese hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia bona toretore ḡaudia vainana e daharaia tauna na e boi henia.
english: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

motu: Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ierusalem hanuana ba rakaia hanai, kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai, hanua lalonai e karamu, na e taitailaidiamu bona e ḡanaḡanalaidiamu taudia bagudia ai toa ba kara.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

motu: Bena na kamonai, ia ese unu haida e hamaorodia, eto, Ia murinai hanua ba rakaia hanai, bavala-ala; basio haḡeredia bona basio bogadia hisi;
english: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

motu: iahu bavaladia mase, bona uhau, ulato, memero, kekeni, bona hahine danu; a baguna mai toana tauna ta basio daua toho. Egu gabu helaḡana amo ba matamaia. Taunabunai idia ese unu hanua tau-badadia dubu vairanai nohodia ediai e matamaia.
english: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then|strong="H2490" * they|strong="H5921" * began|strong="H2490" * at|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H3605" * old|strong="H2205" * men|strong="H2205" * who|strong="H3605" * were|strong="H1004" * before|strong="H6440" * the|strong="H3605" * house|strong="H1004" *.

motu: Bena ia ese ma e hamaorodia, eto, Dubu ba hamiroa, bona maḡudia na mase tau-anidia amo ba hahonudia. A raka lasi! Taunabunai, idia na e raka lasi, hanua na e daea.
english: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They|strong="H5221" * went|strong="H3318" * out|strong="H3318" *, and|strong="H1004" * struck|strong="H5221" * in|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H5221" * city|strong="H5892" *.

motu: Idia e daea negana ai, lau na sibogu na nohova, bena na goru diho, na tai, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, emu badu ḡaraḡara Ierusalem latanai iseina ai na Israel orena idoinai ba habuadia tari a?
english: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Israel bona Iuda besedia edia kerere na bada herea; tano na rara ai e honumu, bona hanua na hahemaoro karadia gageva-gagevadia ai e honumu. Badina be idia na e tomu “Iehova ese tano vada e rakatania; Iehova na se heitamu”.
english: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘Yahweh has forsaken the land, and Yahweh doesn’t see.’

motu: A lau be basina haḡeredia bona basina bogadia hisi, a edia kara heḡereḡeredia ai na tubuadia ai baina kara.
english: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

motu: Bena hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia bona toretore ḡaudia vainana e daharaia tauna ese hereva ma e loulaia, eto, O haḡanilaigu heḡereḡerena ai vada na karaia.
english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

motu: Bena na roha lao, na itaia, kerubi daediai, unu kerubi daedia gubana ai, ḡau ta e hedinarai, sapairo + 10:1 Sapairo na herahera nadina ta ladana. * nadina na heto, oromana na terono ta hetomana.
english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire + 10:1 or, lapis lazuli * stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

motu: Bena ia ese hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia tauna e hamaoroa, eto, Hari e hegiro-hegiromu ava-keikeidia bogaragidiai baola, kerubi henudiai, imamu ruaosi na gida hururu-hururudia amo ba hahonudia, kerubi bogaragidiai; bena hanua latanai ba petadia rohoroho. Bena ia na lau vairagu ai e raka vareai.
english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He|strong="H5921" * went|strong="H5892" * in|strong="H5921" * as|strong="H8478" * I|strong="H5921" * watched.

motu: Hari kerubi na dubu diho kahana ai e giniva, una tau e raka vareai negana ai; bona ori ta ese laloma maḡuna e hahonuava.
english: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na kerubi edia amo e dae lao, dubu raka-vareaina e lao henia; ori ese dubu e hahonua, bona Iehova hauaina diaridiarina ese maḡu e hahonua.
english: Yahweh’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Yahweh’s glory.

motu: Kerubi hanidia hudia na murimuri maḡuna ai e kamonai; unu hu na Siahu-idoinai Diravana gadona, e herevamu negadia ai, na heto.
english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

motu: Bena ia ese hari dabua aukana e hahedokilaia tauna e hagania eto “Lahi na e hegiro-hegiromu ava-keikeidia padadia amo bavabia, kerubi bogaragidiai” negana ai, ia na ela, ava-keikei ta badibadinai e gini.
english: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

motu: Bena kerubi ta ese imana e toia roro, hari kerubi bogaragidiai e arava lahina amo gida e abi, una dabua aukana e hahedokilaia tauna imana ai e ato; bena una tau ese e abi, e raka lasi.
english: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

motu: Hari kerubi hanidia henudiai na ḡau ta, ita-itana na taunimanima imana hetomana.
english: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

motu: Bena na roha lao, ava-keikei hani na itadia unu kerubi badibadidiai; ava-keikei ta ta kerubi ta ta badibadidiai. Hari ava-keikei ita-itadia na krusolito + 10:9 Krusolito na herahera nadina ta ladana. * nadidia kiama-hamadia na heheto.
english: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

motu: Haniosi ita-itadia na heḡereḡere; oromadia na tamona, ava-keikei ta ava-keikei ta lalonai na heto.
english: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

motu: E hekei laova negana ai, ena be asie hegiro to kaha haniosi ilao-henidia mai dibadia, a edena kaha ai vaira ava-keikeina ese e vaira henia, murina kahana ḡaudia na ia murinai ela, bona laodia ai asie hegiro.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

motu: Isedia auridia kuborodia bona ito'o-tao auridia bona ava-keikei na mata ai e honu, kerubi hahaniosi ava-keikeidia bunu.
english: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

motu: Na kamonai, unu ava-keikei na e gwauraidia “E hegiro-hegiromu ava-keikeidia”.
english: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.

motu: Idia ta ta vairadia na hani: vaira gini-gunana na kerubi vairana; vaira iharuana na tau vairana; vaira ihatoina na leona vairana, bona vaira ihahanina na ugava vairana.
english: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

motu: Hari kerubi na e dae ela; idia na unu mauri ḡaudia, Kebara sinavaina isena ai na itadia ḡaudia.
english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

motu: Bena kerubi e laova negadia ai na hari ava-keikei danu idia badibadidiai e laova; bena kerubi ese hanidia e idi roro, tano amo bae roho isi totona, negadia ai, hari ava-keikei na idia badibadidia amo asie hekei oho.
english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

motu: Idia na e gini negadia ai, unu danu e gini; bona idia na e dae negadia ai, unu danu e dae; badina be unu mauri ḡaudia laumadia na idia lalodiai.
english: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na dubu raka-vareaina amo e raka lasi, kerubi daediai e miava.
english: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

motu: Bena kerubi ese hanidia e idi roro bona raka lasidia ai tanobada amo e dae ela, lau vairagu ai; bona ava-keikeidia na idia badibadidiai. Bena idia na Iehova ena dubu mairiveina kahana ikoukouna iduarana enai e gini; bona Israel Diravana hairaina na idia daediai.
english: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

motu: Unu mauri ḡaudia Israel Diravana henunai na itadia ḡaudia, Kebara sinavaina isena ai; bena na diba idia na kerubi.
english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

motu: Idia ta ta vairadia na hani hani amo, bona hanidia danu na hani hani amo, bona hanidia henudiai na ḡau haida, ita-itadia na taunimanima imadia hetomadia.
english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

motu: Vairadia ita-itadia na Kebara sinavaina isena ai na itadia ḡaudia vairadia ita-itadia heḡereḡeredia. Idia na ta ta e lao vaira.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

motu: Bena Lauma ese e haheabigu isi, Iehova ena dubu mairiveina kahana ikoukouna, mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ḡauna, e laohaigu. Hari ikoukou iduarana ai tatau ruahui-ima na itadia, bona idia bogaragidiai laasania Asuru bona Pelatia Benaia, bese lohiadia, na itadia.
english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, kara havara e lalo hatamu, bena hahealo herevadia dikadia ina hanua lalonai taunimanima e hamaorolaidiamu taudia bini.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

motu: Idia na e tomu, Ruma ihaginidia negana na do se kahikahi; ina hanua na vamu inadulaina urona, bona vamu na ita.
english: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

motu: Taunabunai, idia latadiai ba peroveta; taunimanimanatuna e, ba peroveta.
english: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena Lauma ese e rohegu; bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, A hereva, agowa, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena e, umui na ene o laloa tomamu; badina be lalo-hadai dahaka dahaka lalomui ai e varamu na dibagu.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘Yahweh says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

motu: Emui mase taudia vada o hahutumadia ina hanua ai, bona ariarana na vada e aladia taudia ai vada o hahonudia.
english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui mase taudia, hanua bogaraginai vada o atodia, idia na vamu, bona ina hanua na inadulaidia urona; a umui na bogaragina amo bae hakaumui lasi.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Dare garina vada o gari; bena lau ese dare na latamui ai baine mailaia.
english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Ia bogaragina amo baina hakaumui lasi, bona idau taudia imadia ai baina atomui, bona hahemaoro karadia baina kara henimui.
english: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

motu: Dare ese baine alamui, bona lau ese Israel tanona hetoana ai baina hahemaoro henimui; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: Ina hanua na emui uro ai basinela, bona umui na vamu ai basiola ia lalonai. Israel tanona hetoana ai baina hahemaoro henimui,
english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

motu: bena ba diba lau na Iehova; badina be egu taravatu daladia ai asio raka, bona egu hahedua herevadia asio badinadia, a e ḡeḡemui dae besedia edia hahedua herevadia heḡereḡeredia ai vada o kara.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

motu: Bena lau na perovetava lalonai Pelatia Benaia e mase. Bena na goru diho, na lolo badabada, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, Israel kwabukwabudia ba ha-oredia vaitani a? Nega matamatana do bainema
english: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, tadikakamu, tadikakamu korikori, oi ida gabu daudau ai vada e hanohodia taudia, Israel besena idoinai, ena taunimanima iboudiai, na Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ese vada e herevalaidia, eto, Idia ese Iehova vada e rakatania, dauha vada ela; ina tano na ita vada e henida, baita ḡaunaia totona.
english: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from Yahweh. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

motu: Taunabunai oi na baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ena be dauha na laohaidia, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, ena be tano idau-idau lalodiai na hakarohodia rohoroho, to vada ela tanodia lalodiai lau na edia gabu helaḡana ina nega hekada hanai.
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

motu: Taunabunai baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia, amo baina hahegogomui, bona tano idau-idau, lalodiai vada e hakarohomui tanodia, amo baina haheboumui, Israel tanona na baina henimui.
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

motu: Bena unu baela negana ai, idia ese ḡau dika-hereadia iboudiai bona ena kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai na iena amo bae abidia oho.
english: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

motu: Bena lalodia na baina hatamonadia, bona lauma matamatana na idia lalodiai baina atoa; lalo-auka na idia lalodia amo baina abia oho, Ialo-manada baina henidia.
english: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

motu: Bena egu taravatu daladia ai bae raka bona egu hahedua herevadia bae badinadia bona karadia bae kara, idia na lauegu bese taudia ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala.
english: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

motu: A lalodia ese edia ḡau dika-hereadia bona edia kara dika-rohorohodia e ura henidiamu taudia be lau ese edia kara davadia na tubuadia ai baina haloudia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

motu: Bena kerubi ese hanidia e idi roro, mai ava-keikeidia idia badibadidiai, bona Israel Diravana hairaina na idia daediai.
english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na hanua bogaragina amo e dae, hanua mairiveina kahana ororona ai e miava.
english: Yahweh’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

motu: Bena Lauma ese e haheabigu isi, bona Dirava ena Lauma mata-hanaina lalonai Kaldea e laohaigu, unuseni ai vada e hanohodia taudia dekediai. Bena hari mata-hanai, na itaia ḡauna, ese e rakatanigu.
english: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So|strong="H5927" * the|strong="H5921" * vision|strong="H4758" * that|strong="H7200" * I|strong="H5921" * had|strong="H3778" * seen|strong="H7200" * went|strong="H5927" * up|strong="H5927" * from|strong="H5921" * me|strong="H7200" *.

motu: Bena Iehova ese vada e haheitalaigu ḡaudia iboudiai na lau ese unuseni ai vada e hanohodia taudia na hamaorolaidia.
english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese gwau-edeede besena bogaraginai o nohomu. Idia na mai matadia, ḡau bema ita, to ḡau ta asie itaiamu, bona mai taiadia, hereva bema kamonai, to hereva ta asie kamonaimu;
english: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

motu: badina be idia na gwauedeede besena. Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, dauhai bae hanohoa tauna ena laolao kohuna heḡereḡerena ai bavabia heḡaeḡae, bena dina ai dauhai bae hanohoa tauna heḡereḡerena ai ba raka lasi idia vairadiai; dauhai bae hanohoa launa na heto emu gabu amo baola, ela bona ma gabu ta, idia vairadiai. Ena be idia na gwau-edeede besena, to readia lalodia bae parara.
english: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

motu: Dina ai emu laolao kohuna ba lasilaia idia vairadiai, dauhai bae hanohoa tauna ena laolao kohuna na heto, bona adorahi ai idia vairadiai ba raka lasi, dauhai bae hanohodia taudia na heheto.
english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

motu: Idia vairadiai ruma habana ba hamaurua, bona mauruna amo ba rau lasi.
english: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

motu: Idia vairadiai laolao kohuna na bavabia isi paḡamu ai, bena dibura ai ba huaia lasi; vairamu ba ḡovaia, tano basio itaia helaoreana; badina be lau ese toa ta ai vada na halaomu, Israel besena enai.
