english: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

motu: Bena e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena ai na karaia. Dina ai egu laolao kohuna na lasilaia, dauhai bae hanohoa tauna ena kohu na heto; bona adorahi ai lau sibogu imagu amo ruma habana na hamaurua, dibura ai na rau lasi, egu laolao kohuna na paḡagu ai na huaia lao, idia vairadiai.
english: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

motu: Daba ai Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: In the morning, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena, gwau-edeede besena, e nanadaimu, eto “Dahaka o karamu?”, ani?
english: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hereva Inetauna na Ierusalem lohiana dainai, bona Israel besena taudia ia lalonai e nohomu iboudiai daidiai.
english: “Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

motu: Ma baoto, Lau na toa ta emui ai; lau vada na karaia heḡereḡerena ai, unu bae kara henidia toma; idia na dauhai bae hanohodia mai iḡuidia ida.
english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

motu: Bena lohia tauna idia bogaragidiai ese ena laolao kohuna na pagana ai baine abia isi, dibura lalonai, bena baine huaia lao. Ia ese ruma habana baine hamaurua, bena mauruna amo baine rau lasi; ia ese vairana baine ḡovaia, ia matana amo tano basine itaia helaoreana.
english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

motu: Egu huo baina otoa ia iabina, bona egu idoa ai baina idoaia; Babulono, Kaldea tanona ai, baina laohaia; ḡau tamona, ia ese basine itaia, ia na unuseni ai baine mase.
english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

motu: Ia bamona iboudiai, iduruna taudia bona ena tuari taudia iboudiai, na lau ese baina hakarohodia, lai kahadia iboudiai baela; bona dare na iudalaina ḡauna amo baina veria lasi, idia muridia amo.
english: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

motu: Bena bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina luludia lao, bona tano idau-idau lalodiai baina hakarohodia negana ai, idia na bae diba, lau na Iehova.
english: “‘They will know that I am Yahweh when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

motu: A idia kwabukwabudia haida na dare bona dai-hanai gorerena bona doe amo baina harohodia mauri, bena bae lao heni besedia bogaragidiai edia kara dikarohorohodia iboudiai na bae gwaurai hedinarai, bona bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto:
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, amu bavania mai kudou-hetahamu ida, bona ranu ba inua mai heudeheudemu bona mai garimu ida,
english: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

motu: bona tano taudia na ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ese Ierusalem inoholaina taudia Israel tanona lalonai na ini e herevalaidia tomamu: Adia bae ani mai garidia ida, bona ranu bae inu mai kudou-hetahadia ida, badina be edia tano anina idoinai baine heabi oho vaitani, e noholaiamu taudia iboudiai edia daḡedaḡe dainai.
english: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord Yahweh says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

motu: E noholaidiamu hanuadia na bae vahu, bona tano na tano ḡaḡaena ai baine hahelao; bena ba diba, lau na Iehova.
english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, emui hereva lada-isina be dahaka? Israel tanona o herevalaiamu, o tomu “Nega na e daudaumu bona mata-hanai iboudiai anidia asie varamu”, ani?
english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina hereva lada-isina na baina hadokoa; basie gwauraia lou Israel ai. A ba hamaorodia, baoto, Nega na vada e kahikahi, mata-hanai iboudiai anidia ihaḡuḡurudia danu vada e kahikahi.
english: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

motu: Badina be mata-hanai koikoidia bona bagu-haoro koikoidia na bae doko, Israel besena ai.
english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

motu: A lau Iehova ese baina gwauraia herevana vada baina gwauraia, bona karana baina karaia. Basine halahe, a oiemu nega ai, gwau-edeede besena e, hereva baina gwauraia bona karana baina karaia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: For I am Yahweh. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto:
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a itaia, Israel besena taudia na e tomu “Ena mata-hanai na dina momo vairai ḡauna, bona ena peroveta herevadia na nega daudau bainela herevadia”.
english: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu hereva iboudiai na ta basine halahe, a na gwauraiamu herevana anina do baine vara. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ena peroveta taudia latadiai ba peroveta; sibodia edia lalo-hadai e perovetalaimu taudia na ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word:

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Peroveta taudia kavakavadia, sibodia lalodia e badinamu a ḡau ta asie itaia taudia, madi ihabaidia!
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

motu: Israel e, emu peroveta taudia na uda sisiadia na heheto, e heḡiḡi dobi rumadia ai e nohomu.
english: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

motu: Magu vada e gwadadia mauru gabudia asio lao henidia, Israel besena maḡuna asio larebaia, Iehova ena dina ai tuari ai baine auka totona.
english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.

motu: Vada e hereva koikoi bona vada e bagu haoro koikoi. Iehova ese se siaidia negadia al, idia na eto “Iehova ini e gwau tomamu”, bena idia banava eto ia ese edia hereva baine hamomokania.
english: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but Yahweh has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

motu: Ena be lau asina hereva to umui oto “Iehova ini e gwau tomamu” negadia iboudiai na o mata hanai koikoi bona o bagu haoro koikoi ani?
english: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but I have not spoken?”

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hereva asi anidia vada o gwaurai bona mata-hanai koikoidia vada o ita dainai, Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, A itaia, lau ese na inai henimuimu.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: E mata hanai koikoimu bona e bagu haoro koikoimu peroveta taudia na lau imagu ese baine laodia ahu; egu orea taudia ida basie henega bou, bona Israel besena taudia ladadia itoredia ai idia ladadia basie hetore, bona Israel tanona ai basie raka vareai; bena umui na ba diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
english: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

motu: Oibe, badina be egu orea taudia vada e koidia, eto “Maino”, maino na lasi negadia ai; bona badina be taunimanima ese haba e haginiamu negadia ai, ini peroveta taudia ese ahu amo e dahuamu;
english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

motu: una dainai ahu amo haba e dahuamu taudia na ba hamaorodia, una haba na baine heḡiḡi dobi. Medu bada-herea baine diho, medu-hetari badadia bae moru, lai-gubana baine toa;
english: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

motu: bena haba baine heḡiḡi dobi negana ai, haida ese bae nanadaimu, baeto “O dahulaia ahuna be edeseni ai?” ani?
english: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

motu: Taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese egu badu ḡaraḡara ai lai-gubana baina hatoaia; bona egu badu ai medu bada-hereana baina hadihoa, bona medu-hetari badadia baina hamorudia, badu ḡaraḡara ai bae habuadia tari.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

motu: Umui ese ahu amo o dahua habana na lau ese baina ḡiḡia dobi tano ai, bena ia badina bae hedinarai. Baine heḡiḡi dobi negana ai, umui ese ia bogaraginai ba mase; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: Egu badu ḡaraḡara na unu baina bubua ore toma, haba latanai, bona ahu amo e dahua taudia latadiai; bena baina hamaoromu, bainato, Haba na lasihia, ahu amo e dahua taudia danu lasihidia;
english: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

motu: Israel ena peroveta taudia bunu, Ierusalem latanai e peroveta bona mata-hanai ai maino e itaia, maino na lasi negana ai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi danu vairamu ba ha-aukaia emu bese taudia natudia hahinedia, sibodia edia lalo-hadai e perovetalaimu hahinedia, ediai. Idia latadiai ba peroveta,
english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e g vau tomamu: Taunimanima laumadia idoadia totona mea ganadia na ima ganaganadia iboudiai ai e turidia, bona heḡova-ahu mukodia, taunimanima kikina-badana kwaradia igovalaidia, e karamu, hahinedia madi ihabaidia! gu orea taudia laumadia ba idoadia bona ma haida danu laumadia ba hamauridia, umui sibomui emui namo ihabadana a?
english: and say, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

motu: Egu orea taudia bogaragidiai lau ladagu vada o hamiroa, bali taidia bona flaoa atagadia iabidia ai, basiema mase taudia na o aladia masemu, bona basiema mauri taudia na o hamauridiamu, emui koikoi amo; egu orea taudia, koikoi e abi daemu taudia, na o koidia.
english: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, emui mea ganadia, taunimanima laumadia o idoalaidiamu ḡaudia, na na inai henidiamu; imamui amo baina daredia oho, bona o idoadiamu laumadia na baina kahudia nege, manu na heheto.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.

motu: Emui heḡova ahu mukodia danu baina daredia oho, bona egu bese taudia na imamui amo baina rauadia, bena egu orea taudia na imamui ai basie noho, umui damumui ai basiela. Bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: Badina be emui koikoi amo kara maoromaoro tauna lalona vada o hamanokaia, ena be lau ese lalona asina hamanokaia; bona kara dika tauna lalona vada o hagoadaia, ena dala dikana amo basine raka siri, ena mauri basine rauaia;
english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

motu: taunabunai, ina murinai umui na basio mata hanai koikoi lou, bona bagu haoro karadia basio kara lou; egu orea taudia na umui imamui amo baina harohodia mauri. Bena vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: A Bena Israel tau-badadia haida na dekegu ema, lau vairagu ai e helai.
english: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, ini tatau ese edia kaivakuku na lalodia ai vada e abidia dae, bona edia kara havara na hekwakwanai ḡauna ai vada e halaoa vairadiai; bae nanadailaigu herevadia baina kamonaidia eiava lasi?
english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

motu: Taunabunai ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena tauna ta ese kaivakuku na lalona ai baine abidia dae, bona ena kara havara na hekwakwanai ḡauna ai baine halaoa vairanai, bena peroveta tauna dekena bainema, lau Iehova sibogu ese baina haere henia, ena kaivakuku na momo dainai;
english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I Yahweh will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

motu: unu amo Israel besena taudia, edia kaivakuku daidiai vada e rakatanigu taudia, na lalodia baina abidia lou.
english: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

motu: Taunabunai Israel besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A helalo kerehai, emui kaivakuku bona emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai amo ba mede daudau.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

motu: Badina be Israel besena tauna ta, eiava idau tauna Israel ai e noho hedoamu ta, ese baine rakatanigu, ena kaivakuku na lalona ai baine abidia dae, bona ena kara havara na hekwakwanai ḡauna ai baine halaoa vairanai, bena peroveta tauna dekena bainema, peroveta tauna ese ia dainai baine nanadaigu totona, lau Iehova sibogu ese baina haere henia.
english: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I Yahweh will answer him by myself.

motu: Lau ese vairagu baina ha-aukaia una tau enai; toa bona udu gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai baina halaoa, bona egu bese taudia bogaragidia amo baina negea daure; bena umui na ba diba, lau na Iehova.
english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: A peroveta tauna lalona bema hekwakwanai bena hereva ta bema gwauraia, anina be lau Iehova ese vada na koia; bena lau ese imagu baina toia roro ia ihadikana, bona egu bese Israel bogaragina amo baina habuaia tari.
english: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, Yahweh, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

motu: Bena davadia bae hua; peroveta tauna davana bona henanadai tauna davana bae heḡereḡere;
english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

motu: unu amo Israel taudia na egu amo basie raka oho lou, bona edia kara havara iboudiai amo sibodia basie hahemiro lou, a egu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu. Dirava ena hahemaoro Ierusalem latanai
english: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, tano ta ese ena hebeatai karadia amo baine kara dika henigu, bena lau ese imagu na ia ihadikana totona baina toia roro bona ena mauri anianina baina abia oho, bona doe na ia latanai baina siaia, bona taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ia lalonai baina hamasedia, negana ai,
english: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

motu: ena be ini tatau tatoiosi, Noa bona Daniel bona Iobu, na ia lalonai bema noho, to edia kara maoromaoro amo idia sibodia mo edia mauri bema heraua. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Eiava uda boromadia na una tano ai bama harakadia hanai, bena idia ese bema havahua, ela bona tano ḡaḡaena ai bema hahelao, bena tau ta basinema rakaia hanai diba unu uda boromadia daidiai, negana ai,
english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

motu: ena be unu tatau tatoiosi na ia lalonai bema noho, to, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), idia tatoiosi ese natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia basiema hamauridia diba; idia tatoiosi sibodia mo edia mauri bema heraua, a tano na bema ḡaḡae.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

motu: Eiava dare na una tano latanai bama mailaia, bama toma “Dare na tano amo baine hanai”, bena taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ia lalonai bama hamasedia, negana ai,
english: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

motu: ena be unu tatau tatoiosi na ia lalonai bema noho, to, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), idia tatoiosi ese natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia basiema hamauridia diba, a idia tatoiosi sibodia mo bema heraua.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

motu: Eiava dai-hanai gorerena na una tano latanai bama siaia, bona egu badu ḡaraḡara na ia latanai bama bubua, rara ihahebubuna ai, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia ihamasedia totona, negana ai,
english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

motu: ena be Noa bona Daniel bona Iobu na ia lalonai bema noho, to, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), idia tatoiosi ese natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia basiema hamauridia diba, a idia tatoiosi sibodia mo edia mauri bema heraua, edia kara maoromaoro daidiai.
english: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Matona, Ierusalem baina hahemaoro henia, egu hahehisi karadia haniosi, dare bona doe bona uda boromadia dikadia bona dai-hanai goreredia, na ia latanai baina siaidia taunimanima bona mauri ḡaudia ihamasedia totona, negana ai, ia na ede baine heto!
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

motu: Ḡau tamona, ia lalonai haida na bema mauri, bena natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia bema hakaudia lasi, idia na dekemu ai bae raka lasi, bena edia dala bona edia kara ba ita negana ai taumu na baine lo, dika na Ierusalem latanai vada na mailaia dainai; oibe, kara iboudiai ia latanai vada na mailai daidiai.
english: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

motu: Idia ese taumu bae haloa, edia dala bona edia kara ba ita negana ai; bona ba diba Ierusalem lalonai na kara karadia iboudiai na dia asi badina asina karadia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, vine auna ese au haida ede e hereadia tomamu; vine rigina ese uda audia rigidia ede e hereadia tomamu?
english: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

motu: Ḡau ta ikaralaina auna na iena amo e abiamu a? Iena amo ikoko ta e karaiamu bena una ikoko ai ḡau ta e taua daemu a?
english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

motu: A itaia, lahi auna ai e halaoamu; bena lahi ese duduna duduna e aradia oremu bona bogaragina na gida ai e laomu murinai ia na mai ena ḡaukara a?
english: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?

motu: A itaia, au tutuana miana ai na asi ena ḡaukara; matona lahi ese vada e araia bona gida ai vada ela negana ai ena ḡaukara be dahaka?
english: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Uda audia bogaragidiai vine auna na lahi auna ai vada e halaoa heḡereḡerena ai, Ierusalem inoholaina taudia na unu baina kara henidia toma.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

motu: Lau ese vairagu na ediai baina ha-aukaia; ena be lahi amo bae roho mauri, to lahi ese do baine aradia ore; bena lau ese vairagu na ediai baina ha-aukaia negana ai na ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.

motu: Tano danu baina havahua, badina be e kara hebeatai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto,
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ierusalem na ena kara dika-rohorohodia ba hedaraunelai henia,
english: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ese Ierusalem na ini e hamaoroa tomamu: Senemu bona emu vara na Kanaan taudia edia tano ai, tamamu na Amoro tauna, sinamu na Hiti hahinena.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.

motu: Emu vara na iniheto: emu vara dinana ai hudomu varona asie utua, ranu ai asie hurimu, ba ḡoevaḡoeva totona, damena amo asie dahumu, dabua amo asie tarumu.
english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

motu: E itamu tauna ta ese se bogamu hisi, ini kara ta se kara henimu ena hebogahisi dainai; a tano paka ai e negemu; badina be o vara dinana ai e dadaraimu herea.
english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

motu: Bena na rakamu hanai negana ai na itamu, rara ai o hekure, bena rara ai hekuremu ai na hereva henimu, nato, Ba mauri,
english: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

motu: tano paka avana na heto ba tubu. Bena o bada oho bada oho, taumu e lata, hane-ulato ai ola; ratamu e hekara, huimu e lata; ḡau tamona gagaemu ai o nohova, asi dabuamu.
english: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

motu: Ma na rakamu hanai negana ai na itamu, oi na vada o ulato; bena egu dabua amo na tarumu, taumu na govalaia; oibe, maohenimu na karaia, bona oi ida ta hegwau hamata heheni, bena adavagu ai ola. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and you became mine.

motu: Bena ranu ai na hadigumu, raramu na huria oho, bona dehoro amo na dahumu.
english: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

motu: Dabua mai heraheradia amo na hahedokilaimu, bona boromakau kopina tamakadia na aemu ai na kara. Dabua aukana ḡoeva-daena amo na hariolaimu, bona dabua manoka-manokana amo na hahedokilaimu.
english: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.

motu: Herahera ḡaudia amo na haheralaimu; vagivagi na imamu ai na ato, bona ageva na ha-inulaimu.
english: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.

motu: Gadei ta na udu-baubaumu ai na atoa, bona haida danu taiamu ai; bona havava ḡauna ta mai hairaina na kwaramu na havavalaia.
english: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

motu: Gold * bona silver * amo unu na haheralaimu toma; emu dabua na dabua aukadia ḡoeva-daedia bona dabua manoka-manokadia bona dabua mai heraheradia; amu aniani na flaoa namo-hereana bona bada-ranuna bona dehoro. Hairaimu e bada e laova, ela bona oromamu na pavapava hahinena na heto.
english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

motu: Sivaraimu danu e hehari piu, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, hairaimu na bada herea dainai; badina be hairaimu na ḡoeva-dae, lau ese na hahairaimu dainai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: A oi ese hairaimu o abidadama henia, bena ariara hahinena ai ola harimu badana dainai, raka-hanai taudia ida o lebulebu.
english: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.

motu: Emu dabua haida o abi, pata helaḡadia o haheralai, bena latadiai ariara karadia o kara; kara unuhetomana na nega gunadia ta ai se vara, bona nega gabedia ta ai basine vara Iou.
english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

motu: Emu herahera ḡaudia danu, lauegu gold * bona silver * amo e kara bona lau ese na henimu ḡaudia, na o abidia, tatau laulaudia o karalai, bena o lebulebulai.
english: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.

motu: Emu dabua mai heraheradia danu o abidia, unu ḡau o govalaidia, bona egu dehoro bona egu muramura mai bonana na vairadiai o atodia.
english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

motu: Egu flaoa igabudia danu, na henimu ḡauna, (badina be lau ese flaoa namo-hereana bona dehoro bona bada-ranuna amo na ubumu) na idia vairadiai o atodia, bonadia bae moalelai totona. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Bena natumu mamaruanedia bona hahinedia, o havaradia egu, na o abidia, boubou ḡaudia ai o halaodia, idia adia. Emu ariara karadia na ḡau pipikidia a?
english: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,

motu: Una dainai lau natugu o aladia mase, bona ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai o halaodia, idia edia, a?
english: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?

motu: Emu kara dika-rohorohodia bona emu ariara karadia iboudiai lalodiai, maragimu negana, asi dabuamu ḡagaemu ai o nohova negana, rara ai o hekure, so laloa tao.
english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

motu: Bena emu kara dika iboudiai muridiai, (Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Madi, ihabaimu!),
english: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh—

motu: oi ese emu kalaga o haginidia bona emu pata helaḡadia o kara, ruma ariaradia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.

motu: Hanua ariarana iboudiai dokodia ai emu pata helaḡadia o haginidia; hairaimu vada o lebulebulaia, raka-hanai tataudia ediai sibomu o hehoihoilai, emu ariara karadia o habada.
english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

motu: Aigupto taudia, dekemu taudia mai edia mata-bodaga, ida danu vada o lebulebu, emu ariara karadia vada o habada, lau ihabadugu.
english: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.

motu: Taunabunai a itaia, lau imagu na toia roro oi ihadikamu, oi ahumu, e gwaurai henimu guna ḡauna, na hamaraḡia, oi inaimu Filistia hahinedia, mata-ganigani hahinedia, imadia ai na atomu; idia ese emu lebulebu karadia hemaraidia e hemaraiva.
english: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

motu: Asuria taudia ida danu ariara karadia o kara, badina be emu mata-bodaga na bada herea; oibe, idia ida ariara karadia o kara, a lalomu do se heḡereḡere.
english: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

motu: Emu ariara karadia o habada danu, Kaldea tanona ena hoihoi gabudia ai; a lalomu na dounu se heḡereḡere.
english: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Emu mata-bodaga na bada herea; una dainai ini kara iboudiai o kara, ariara hahinena se hemaraimu ena kara;
english: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;

motu: hanua ariaradia iboudiai dokodia ai emu kalaga o haginidia, bona ruma ariaradia iboudiai lalodiai emu pata helaḡadia o kara. Ḡau tamona oi na dia ariara hahinena heḡereḡerena, badina be henitaomu o dadaraiamu.
english: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.

motu: Oi na heuda-hanai hahinemu, idau taudia o abidia daemu adavamu gabuna ai.
english: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

motu: Tatau ese ariara hahinedia iboudiai na harihari ḡaudia e henidiamu; a oi ese emu harihari gsudia na e ura henimuva taudia iboudiai o henidiava, henitaodia o henidiava, kaha idau-idau iboudiai amo emu ariara karadia ikaradia bae vasi totona.
english: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

motu: Taunabunai, emu ariara karadia lalodiai oi na idau, dia hahine haida heḡereḡeredia. Ta se noimu ia ida ba eno bou; oi ese henitaona o henia, a haida ese henitaomu se henimu. Una dainai oi na idau.
english: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

motu: Taunabunai, ariara hahinemu e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: “Therefore, prostitute, hear Yahweh’s word:

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be e ura henimu taudia ida emu ariara karadia o kara lalodiai, oi ihahemaraimu na e hehulala bona gagaemu ai na o hedinarai dainai, bona emu kaivakuku iboudiai daidiai, bona natumu, idia o henidia memerodia, raradia daidiai,
english: ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;

motu: a itaia, e ura henimu taudia iboudiai, olebulebulaidia taudia, o ura henidia taudia bona o dadaraidia taudia iboudiai, na lau ese baina haboudia; oi ihadikamu totona kaha iboudiai amo baina haboudia, bena gagaemu ai baina haheitalaidia; taumu idoinai ḡaḡaena ai bae itaia.
english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

motu: Bena lau ese baina hahemaoro henimu, adavadia e dihotanidiamu bona rara e hahebubuamu hahinedia e hahemaoro henidiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

motu: E ura henimu taudia imadia ai baina atomu; bena idia ese emu kalaga bae ḡiḡia dobi, bona emu pata helaḡadia bae hamakohidia, emu dabua bae dokidia oho, emu herahera nadidia namo-hereadia na bae abidia, gagaemu ai asi dabuamu bae rakatanimu.
english: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

motu: Tuari oreana ta bae mailaia, oi ihadikamu; nadi amo bae hodomu, bona edia dare amo bae dapamu rohoroho.
english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

motu: Emu ruma bae doudia; hahemaoro karadia oi latamu ai bae kara, hahine momo vairadiai; emu ariara karadia ai baina hadokomu, bona henitao basio heni lou.
english: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

motu: Unu amo egu badu ḡaraḡara baina haḡuḡurua latamu ai, bona egu vaḡeḡe ese baine rakatanimu; lalogu na baine keru, basina badu lou.
english: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

motu: Badina be eregabemu negana so laloa taomu; to ini ḡau iboudiai amo vada o habadugu. Taunabunai, a itaia, emu kara davadia na tubuamu ai baina kara. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu. Emu kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai latadiai mata-bodaga karadia ma vada o ato kau, ani?
english: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

motu: A itaia, hereva lada-isidia e gwauraimu taudia iboudiai ese ina hereva lada-isina ai bae herevalaimu, baeto “Sinana hetomana, natuna hahinena danu unuheto”.
english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

motu: Sinamu ese adavana bona natuna e dadaraidia, bona oi na ia natuna hahinena; tadikakamu ese adavadia bona natudia e dadaraidia, bona oi na idia tadikakadia. Sinamu na Hiti hahinena; tamamu na Amoro tauna.
english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

motu: Kakamu na Samaria; ia na natuna hahinedia ida e nohova, oi miriginimu kahana ai; bona tadimu na Sodoma; ia na natuna hahinedia ida e nohova, oi dihomu kahana ai.
english: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

motu: Ḡau tamona, oi lalomu na se heḡereḡere idia edia dala ai ba raka, eiava idia edia kara dika-rohorohodia heḡereḡeredia ai ba kara; asi vanahana oiemu kara mirodia ese idia edia kara mirodia e hereadia, emu dala iboudiai lalodiai.
english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, tadimu Sodoma bona natuna hahinena edia kara na oi bona natumu hahinedia edia kara ida asie heḡereḡere.
english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

motu: A itaia, tadimu Sodoma ena kerere binai: ia mai natuna ida e hekokorokuva, e aniani boga-kunuva, e noho namonamova mai tagadia ida; a ogoḡami taudia bona e dabuva taudia na asie durudia.
english: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

motu: Idia na e hekokorokuva, kara dika-rohorohodia na lau vairagu ai e karava; taunabunai edia kara na itaia negana ai na na abidia oho.
english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

motu: Samaria ena kara dika na taina bada, a oiemu na bada herea; oiemu kara dika-rohorohodia ese idia edia vada e hereadia; oiemu kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai tadikakamu ita-itadia na kara maoromaoro hahinedia ita-itadia na heheto.
english: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

motu: Oi danu ihahemaraimu na ba huaia, badina be tadikakamu ihahemaorohenidia metauna vada o haragaia; badina be emu kara dika ai emu kara dika-rohorohodia ese idia edia e hereadia dainai, idia na taidia mamaoro, a oi na dika vaitani. Taunabunai, oi danu ba hemarai, ihahemaraimu ba huaia, badina be tadikakamu oromadia na kara maoromaoro hahinedia oromadia heḡereḡeredia ai vada o halaodia.
english: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

motu: Edia noho-namo baina henidia lou, Sodoma mai natuna hahinedia ida edia noho-namo bona Samaria mai natuna hahinedia ida edia noho-namo, bona oiemu noho-namo baina henimu lou idia bogaragidiai;
english: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

motu: bena ihahemaraimu ba huaia bona emu kara iboudiai daidiai ba hemarai, bena idia taudia ihalodia hahinemu ai baola.
english: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

motu: A tadimu Sodoma bona natuna hahinedia ese edia noho dalana Kunana bae lou henia; bona kakamu Samaria bona natuna hahinedia ese edia noho dalana gunana bae lou henia; bona oi bona natumu hahinedia ese emui noho dalana gunana ba lou henia.
english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

motu: Emu hekokoroku dinana ai oi tadimu Sodoma na udu gwaurai-gwawai herevana oi udumu ai, ani,
english: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

motu: emu kara dika do se hedinarai negana ai? Harihari oi na ia heḡereḡerena, duni-dae ḡauna ai vada ola Edom natuna hahinedia ediai, bona ia dekena hahinedia iboudiai ediai, bona Filistia taudia natudia hahinedia ediai, e ḡeḡemu daemu bona e dadaraimumu hahinedia iboudiai ediai.
english: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

motu: Emu lebulebu bona emu kara dika-rohorohodia davadia metauna o huaiamu. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.

motu: Oibe, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Oiemu kara heḡereḡerena ai baina kara henimu. Oi ese hereva helaḡana vada o dadaraia, gwauhamata itata-utuna;
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

motu: ḡau tamona, egu gwauhamata, eregabemu negana ai oi ida ta hegwau hamata heheni ḡauna, baina laloa toa, bona oi ida mia-hanaihanai gwauhamatana ta baita haginia tutuka-tutuka.
english: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

motu: Bena emu kara ba lalodia tao, bona emu hane-guna bona emu hane-muritai baina abidia, natumu ai baina halaodia, negana ai vada ba hemarai, a dia eda gwauhamata dainai.
english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

motu: Eda gwauhamata baina haginia tutuka-tutuka, bena ba diba lau na Iehova;
english: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;

motu: ba laloa tao, bena ba baia, bona udumu basio kehoa lou, emu hemarai dainai, lau ese emu kara iboudiai baina lalodia nege negana ai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, henanadai hepuina ba gwauraia, bona hereva heḡereḡerena ta na Israel besena ba gwaurai henia.
english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

motu: Baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ugava badana ta mai hanina badadia bona hape latadia, huina oromadia danu idau-idau, na Lebanon ema, sida auna ta dorina e bitua.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

motu: Ia ese dorina rigirigina e bitua kwaidu, hoihoi tanona e laohaia, hoihoi taudia edia hanua lalonai e hadoa.
english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

motu: Bena tano uhena e abia, tano namona ai e hadoa, ranu momo gabuna ai. E hadoa arabimi + 17:5 Arabimi na sinavai isena ai e varamu auna ta ladana. * rigirigina na heto,
english: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

motu: bena ia na e tubu, vine auna ai ela, e raga rohoroho; bena gavena na ia e tubu henia, a ramuna na ena gini gabuna ai e mia. Taunabunai, ia na vine auna ai ela, gavena e tubu bona rauna e urumo-urumo.
english: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

motu: A ugava ma ta ema; hanina na babada, bona huina na momo. A itaia, hari vine ramuna ese ia e hata hema bona gavena danu e tubu henia, baine hapariparidia totona. Bena e hadoa tanona amo
english: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

motu: ma e hadoa hanai, tano namona ai, ranu momo gabuna ai, gavena bae tubu bona hu huana bae dobi bona vine auna herea-daena ai bainela totona.
english: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

motu: Baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu; Baine tubu namonamo a? Ramuna basine raḡadia bona gavena basine utudia, rauna matamatadia iboudiai bae marai totona, a? Dia ima mai goadana mo, eiava taunimanima hutuma mo, bae heḡereḡere ramuna amo bae raḡaia, ani?
english: “Say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

motu: A itaia, bae hadoa hanai negana ai, baine tubu namonamo a? Laurabada baine toa henia negana ai, ia na basine marai a? E tubu gabuna ai baine marai ani?
english: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Harihari ene daḡedaḡe besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ini ḡau anidia na asi dibamui a? Bena ba hamaorodia, baoto, A itaia, Babulono pavapavana na Ierusalem ela, hanua pavapavana bona lohiana verina Babulono e hakaudia mai.
english: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

motu: Bena ia ese hanua pavapavana natuna maruanena ta e abia, ia taravana e atua, bona gwauhamata helaḡana henunai e hanohoa. (Tano lohiadia na ia ese vada e abidia oho,
english: He took one of the royal offspring, + 17:13 or, seed * and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,

motu: basileia na baine manau, basine hekokoroku, bona iena taravatu ibadinana ai baine gini helaorearia.)
english: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

motu: A ia ese e daḡedaḡe henia, gwaukau taudia na Aigupto e siaidia lao, idia ese hosi haida bona tuari oreana badana ta bae henia helaoreana. Baine kwalimu a? Kara unuhetomadia e karamu tauna na baine roho mauri diba a? Taravatu baine tataia utu, bena baine roho mauri diba a?
english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, momokani hanua pavapavana ta ese tau ta na pavapava tauna ai e halaoa, bena una pavapava ai e halaoa tauna ese dagi na e henia tauna ena gwauhamata helaḡana e dadaraia, bona e atua taravatuna e tataia utu; benaini, una tau na dagina e henia pavapavana ena noho gabuna ai baine mase, oibe, Babulono ai baine mase.
english: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

motu: Farao bona ena tuari oreana mai goadana bona ena orea badana idoinai ese basie durua tuari ai, hutuma iala-masedia totona tano bae larebaia bona hanua bae magua heḡeḡe negana ai.
english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

motu: Badina be gwauhamata helaḡana e dadaraia bona taravatu e tataia utu, bona imana e dudui heni to ini kara iboudiai e kara, dainai ia na basine roho mauri.
english: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, momokani egu gwauhamata helaḡana, e dadaraia ḡauna, bona egu taravatu, e tataia utu ḡauna, davadia na ia tubuana ai baina kara.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

motu: Egu huo baina otoa, ia iabina, bona egu idoa ai baina idoaia; bena Babulono baina laohaia, unuseni ai baina hahemaoro henia, ena koikoi karadia egu ai e kara na baina hahemaorolai.
english: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

motu: Ena abi-hidi tuari taudia na dare ai bae mase, bona roho-mauri taudia na lai kahadia iboudiai bae pere rohoroho; bena ba diba, lau Iehova vada na hereva. Hereva heḡereḡerena: Sida auna
english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau sibogu ese sida auna dorina amo rigirigi ta baina abia, bena baina hadoa; dorina rigirigidia ediai manoka-manokana ta baina gadaia oho, bena lau sibogu ese baina hadoa, ororo bada-hereana bona lata-hereana dorina ai.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

motu: Israel ororona dorina ai baina hadoa, rigina bae tubu bona huahuana bae dobi bona sida auna herea-daena ai bainela totona; bena ia henunai mauri ḡaudia idau-idau bae noho; bona ia rigina ikerukerudia ai manu idau-idau ese edia ruma bae kara.
english: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

motu: Bena tano paka audia iboudiai na bae diba lau Iehova ese au latana na hakwadogiamu bona au kwadogina na halataiamu, au maurina na hakakoroamu bona au masena na hatubuamu. Lau Iehova vada na hereva, bona karana baina karaia.
english: All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘ I|strong="H3588" *, Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, have|strong="H3068" * spoken|strong="H1696" * and|strong="H3068" * have|strong="H3068" * done|strong="H6213" * it|strong="H3588" *.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva egu ai ma e kau, eto:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

motu: Badina be dahaka ina hereva lada-isina o gwauraia louloumu, o tomu “Tama ese vine huahuadia kasiridia vada e ani, bona natudia isedia e urimu”?
english: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘ The|strong="H5921" * fathers have|strong="H1121" * eaten sour|strong="H1155" * grapes|strong="H1155" *, and|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H5921" * children|strong="H1121" *’s teeth|strong="H8127" * are|strong="H1121" * set|strong="H6949" * on|strong="H5921" * edge|strong="H6949" *’?

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, ina hereva lada-isina na basio gwauraia lou Israel ai.
english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

motu: A itaia, lauma iboudiai na lauegu, tama laumana bona natuna laumana danu; kara dika tauna laumana na baine mase.
english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

motu: Tau ta ena kara bema maoromaoro, taravatu ibadinana ai bona kara maoromaoro ikaradia ai bema noho,
english: “But if a man is just, and|strong="H4941" * does|strong="H6213" * that|strong="H3588" * which|strong="H3588" * is|strong="H6662" * lawful|strong="H4941" * and|strong="H4941" * right|strong="H4941" *,

english: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted|strong="H5375" * up|strong="H5375" * his|strong="H5375" * eyes|strong="H5869" * to|strong="H3478" * the|strong="H5375" * idols|strong="H1544" * of|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H5375" * house|strong="H1004" * of|strong="H1004" * Israel|strong="H3478" *, hasn’t defiled|strong="H2930" * his|strong="H5375" * neighbor|strong="H7453" *’s wife, hasn’t come|strong="H7126" * near|strong="H7126" * a|strong="H3068" * woman|strong="H5079" * in|strong="H3478" * her|strong="H5375" * impurity|strong="H5079" *,

english: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

He|strong="H1931" * shall|strong="H3027" * surely|strong="H4191" * live|strong="H2421" *.

motu: A tamana, badina be moni na gwaurai-lagau amo e abiva, bona tadikakana ena kohu e dadiva, bona ena bese taudia bogaragidiai kara dia nanamo e karava, ia na ena kara havara dainai do baine mase.
english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

motu: Ḡau tamona, umui na o tomu “Dahaka dainai natuna basine hisihisi tamana ena kara havara dainai?” Natuna na taravatu lalonai baine ḡaukara bona baine kara maoromaoro, bona egu taravatu iboudiai baine badinadia namonamo, negana ai, momokani ia na do baine mauri.
english: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.

motu: Kara dika tauna laumana na baine mase. Natuna basine hisihisi tamana ena kara havara dainai, bona tamana basine hisihisi natuna ena kara havara dainai; kara maoromaoro tauna ena kara maoromaoro na ia sibona latanai, bona kara dika tauna ena kara dika na ia sibona latanai. Dirava ena kara na maoromaoro
english: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

motu: A kara dika tauna na ena kara dika iboudiai amo bema raka oho, bona egu taravatu iboudiai bema badinadia, bona taravatu lalodiai bema ḡaukara bona bema kara maoromaoro, ia na momokani do baine mauri; ia na basine mase.
english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

motu: Kerere iboudiai, ia ese e kara ḡaudia, na ta basie laloa tao ia latanai; ena kara maoromaoro dainai ia na baine mauri.
english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Edena na moalelaiamu, kara dika tauna baine mase, eiava ena dala baine rakatania bena baine mauri, a?
english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

motu: A kara maoromaoro tauna ese ena kara maoromaoro e rakataniamu bona kara havara e karaiamu, bona kara dika-rohorohodia e karamu, kara dika tauna heḡereḡerena, negana ai, ia na baine mauri, a? Ena kara maoromaorodia ta basie Laloa tao; ena koikoi karadia bona ena kara dika daidiai, ia na baine mase.
english: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

motu: Ḡau tamona umui na o tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”. Israel besena e, a kamonai! Egu dala na dia maoro a? Lasi, umui emui dala hari dia mamaoro ani?
english: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna ese ena kara maoromaoro baine rakatania bena baine kara havara negana ai, ia na una kara havara dainai baine mase; ena kara havara dainai do baine mase.
english: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

motu: Ina danu, kara dika tauna ese ena kara dika baine rakatania bena taravatu lalonai baine ḡaukara bona baine kara maoromaoro, ia ese ena mauri baine rauaia.
english: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

motu: E helalo bena ena kara kerere iboudiai amo e raka oho dainai, ia na momokani do baine mauri; ia na basine mase.
english: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Israel besena na e tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”. Israel besena e, egu dala na dia maoro a? Lasi, umui emui dala hari dia mamaoro ani?
english: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Taunabunai, Israel besena e, lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui, ta ta ena dala ena dala heḡereḡeredia. Ba helalo kerehai, emui kerere iboudiai amo ba raka siri, kara havara ese baine hadikamui vaitani na garina.
english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

motu: Emui kerere iboudiai, lau o kara henigu karadia, na ba negedia daure, lalo matamatadia bona lauma matamatadia bavabi. Israel besena e, ba mase anina be dahaka?
english: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

motu: Badina be lau ese ta ena mase asina moalelaiamu; taunabunai, ba helalo kerehai, bena ba mauri. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
