motu: Laḡani ihahituna huana iha-imana dinana ihagwautana ai, Israel tau-badadia haida na ema, Iehova enai bae henanadai totona; bena idia na lau vairagu ai e helai.
english: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh, and sat before me.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel tau-badadia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau inanadaigu oma a? Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, umui ese lau basio nanadaigu.
english: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’

motu: Oi ese ba hahemaoro henidia a? Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese ba hahemaoro henidia a? Benaini, senedia edia kara dika-rohorohodia ba hadibalaidia,
english: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

motu: ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel na abia hidi dinana ai, Iakob vevena na gwau henidia hamata. Aigupto tanona ai na hahedinarai henidia, bena na gwau henidia hamata, nato, Lau na Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am Yahweh your God;’

motu: Una dina ai na gwau henidia hamata, nato, Aigupto tanona amo baina hakaudia lasi, idia daidiai vada na lalo davari tanona ta, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, tano herea-daena, tano iboudiai e hereadiamu ḡauna, lalonai baina hakaudia vareai.
english: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Ibouboumui ai, ḡau dika-rohorohodia, matamui ese e moalelaimu ḡaudia, na ba negedia daure, Aigupto kaivakukudia ediai basio hahemiro. Lau na Iehova, emui Dirava.
english: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’

motu: A idia ese e daḡedaḡe henigu, asie kamonai henigu; ḡau dika-rohorohodia, matadia ese e moalelaiva ḡaudia, na dia iboudiai ese asie negedia daure, bona Aigupto kaivakukudia asie rakatanidia. Bena na laloa, nato, egu badu ḡaraḡara na latadiai baina bubua dobi bona egu badu na idia ihadikadia ai baina ha-orea, Aigupto tanona ai.
english: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.

motu: A lau ladagu bagunai na ḡaukarava, bogaragidiai e nohova bona vairadiai Aigupto tanona amo ihakau-lasidia ai na hahedinarai henidia besedia vairadiai lau ladagu na basine miro totona.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese Aigupto tanona amo na hakaudia lasi, bena tano ḡaḡaena ai na hakaudia vareai.
english: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

motu: Egu taravatu na henidia, bona egu hahedua herevadia ibadinadia ai taunimanima bae mauri ḡaudia na na hamaorolaidia.
english: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

motu: Ina danu, egu dina helaḡadia na henidia, toa ai baela, lau bona Idia padamai ai, idia na bae diba lau Iehova ese na hahelagadiamu helaoreana.
english: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

motu: A Israel besena ese e daḡedaḡe henigu, tano ḡaḡaena ai; egu taravatu lalodiai asie raka, a egu hahedua herevadia, ibadinadia ai taunimanima bae mauri ḡaudia, na e dadaraidia, bona egu dina helaḡadia na e hamirodia herea. Bena na laloa, nato, egu badu ḡaraḡara na latadiai baina bubua dobi, tano ḡaḡaena ai, bona baina ha-orea vaitani.
english: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.

motu: A lau ladagu bagunai na ḡaukarava, vairadiai na hakaudia lasi besedia vairadiai lau ladagu basine miro helaoreana.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

motu: Ina danu, tano ḡaḡaena ai na gwau henidia hamata, baina henidia nato tanona, rata bona bada-ranuna e arumu tanona, tano herea-daena, tano iboudiai e hereadiamu ḡauna, lalonai basina hakaudia vareai;
english: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,

motu: badina be egu hahedua herevadia e dadaraidia, bona egu taravatu lalodiai asie raka, bona egu dina helaḡadia e hamirodia; badina be lalodia ese edia kaivakuku e lalo tao.
english: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

motu: Ḡau tamona, matagu ese e bogadia hisi; asina habuadia tari eiava asina ha-oredia vaitani, tano ḡaḡaena ai.
english: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.

motu: Bena tano ḡaḡaena ai idia natudia na hamaorodia, nato, Tamamui edia taravatu lalodiai basio raka, eiava edia hahedua herevadia basio badinadia, eiava edia kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia ai sibomui basio hahemiro.
english: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

motu: Lau Iehova na emui Dirava; lauegu taravatu lalodiai ba raka, bona egu hahedua herevadia ba badinadia namonamo;
english: I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.

motu: bona egu dina helaḡadia ba matauraidia, bena toa ai baela, lau bona umui padadai, bona ba diba lau Iehova na emui Dirava.
english: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’

motu: A idia natudia ese e daḡedaḡe henigu; egu taravatu lalodiai asie raka, bona egu hahedua herevadia; ibadinadia ai taunimanima bae mauri ḡaudia, asie badinadia namonamo, egu dina helaḡadia danu e hamirodia. Bena na laloa nato, egu badu ḡaraḡara na latadiai baina bubua dobi, bona egu badu na idia ihadikadia ai baina ha-orea, tano ḡaḡaena ai.
english: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

motu: A imagu na na rua, bona ladagu bagunai na ḡaukara, vairadiai na hakaudia lasi besedia vairadiai lau ladagu basine miro helaoreana.
english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

motu: Ina danu, tano ḡaḡaena ai na gwau henidia hamata, nato, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina hakarohodia bona tano idau-idau ai baina hakarohodia rohoroho;
english: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,

motu: badina be idia ese egu hahedua herevadia asie badinadia, bona egu taravatu e dadaraidia, bona egu dina helaḡadia e hamirodia, bona tamadia edia kaivakuku e haḡeredia.
english: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

motu: Ina danu, taravatu dikadia bona hahedua herevadia, ibadinadia ai mauri basie davaria ḡaudia, na henidia;
english: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.

motu: bona sibodia edia herahia ḡaudia amo na hamirodia; badina be na koidia, natudia roboadia iboudiai na ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai bae halaodia, baina hagaridia totona. Unu na kara toma, idia na bae diba lau na Iehova helaoreana.
english: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Yahweh.”’

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena taudia ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ina kara ai danu senemui ese e uduguiraigu, e kara koikoi henigu dainai.
english: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

motu: Badina be na gwau hamatalaia baina henidia nato tanona lalonai na hakaudia vareai negana ai, idia ese ororo latana ta eiava rauna urumona auna e itaia negadia iboudiai na edia boubou ḡaudia na unuseni ai e hahelaḡadia, bona edia herahia karadia amo danu e habadugu. Unuseni ai taunimanima lalodia ihanamodia bonadia e hadaedia, bona unuseni ai danu edia inuinu bouboudia ududia ahudia e bubu nege.
english: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.

motu: (Na hamaorodia, nato, Atai gabuna o lao heniamu be edena? Taunabunai, ia ladana e hatoamu Bama, + 20:29 “Bama” anina na “atai gabuna”. * ema bona ina dina.)
english: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah + 20:29 “Bamah” means “High Place”. * to this day.”’

motu: Taunabunai, Israel besena ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Senemui heḡereḡeredia ai ba hahemiro, bona edia ḡau dika-rohorohodia igavadia ai ba raka siri, a?
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?

motu: Emui herahia ḡaudia o henimu, bona natumui mamaruanedia na ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia ai o halaodiamu, negadia ai na umui na sibomui o hahemiromu, emui kaivakuku iboudiai ida, ema bona ina dina. Israel besena e, ba nanadaigu a? Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, umui na basio nanadaigu.
english: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I will not be inquired of by you!

motu: Emui lalo-hadai anina na nega ta ai basine vara; o laloamu, o tomu “Bese idau-idau, tano idau-idau besedia, heḡereḡeredia ai baia hahelao, au bona nadi baia toma henidia diho”.
english: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, momokani mai imagu goadana bona mai imagu itoi-rorona bona mai badu-hebubugu ida baina pavapavamui.
english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.

motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina hakaumui lasit bona lalodiai vada o karoho rohoroho tanodia amo baina gogomui, mai imagu goadana bona mai imagu itoi-rorona bona mai badu-hebubugu ida.
english: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.

motu: Bena bese idau-idau edia tano ḡaḡaena ai baina hakaumui vareai; unuseni ai hevaira-hehenida ai baina hahemaoro henimui.
english: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

motu: Aigupto tano-ḡaḡaena ai senemui na hahemaoro henidia heḡereḡerena ai umui danu baina hahemaoro henimui. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Itotohi henuna amo baina harakamui hanai, bona ta ta amo baina harakamui vareai.
english: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

motu: Daḡedaḡe taudia bona egu taravatu e tata utumu taudia na umui bogaragimui amo baina negedia daure, e noholaiamu tanona amo baina hakaud a lasi, a Israel tanona lalonai basie raka vareai. Bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

motu: A oi, Israel besena e, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Bema basio kamonai henigu, vada baola, ta ta ena kaivakuku ena kaivakuku isiaidia ba lao heni, harihati bona nega gabedia ai danu; a lau ladagu helaḡana na emui herahia ḡaudia eiava emui kaivakuku amo nega ta ai basio hamuoa lou.
english: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord Yahweh says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Badina be egu ororo helaḡana ai, Israel ororona dorina ai, unuseni ai Israel besena idoinai, ena taunimanima iboudiai, ese lau isiaigu bae lao heni una tano ai. Unuseni ai baina abidia dae; unuseni ai emui harihari ḡaudia bona emui herahia ḡaudia herea-daedia na emui ai baina gwaurai, bona emui boubou ḡaudia helaḡadia danu.
english: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina hakaumui lasi bona lalodiai o karoho rohoroho tanodia amo baina gogomui negana ai, lau ese baina abimui dae, bonana namo ḡauna na heto. Itelaḡagu na umui bogaragimui ai baina hahedinaraia, bese idau-idau vairadiai.
english: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.

motu: Bena Israel tanona, senemui na gwau henidia hamata baina henidia nato tanona, Ialonai baina hakaumui vareai negana ai, umui na ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.

motu: Unuseni ai emui dala bona sibomui o hahemirolai karadia iboudiai na ba lalodia une; bena sibomui ba hedadarai, emui kara dika iboudiai daidiai.
english: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.

motu: Bena lau ladagu bagunai baina kara henimui, dia emui dala dikadia eiava emui kara bodagadia heḡereḡeredia, negana ai umui ba diba lau na Iehova. Israel besena e, Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, talaimu na diho kahana ba henia, diho kahana latanai ba haroro, bona diho kahana uda-tanona latanai ba peroveta.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.

motu: Hari diho kahana udana ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, oi lalomu ai lahi ta baina ha-araia; bena una lahi ese au mauridia iboudiai bona au masedia iboudiai na baine aradia ore; ta ese lahi hururu-hururuna basine habodoa, bona vaira iboudiai, diho kahana amo ela bona mirigini kahana, na baine hodaridia.
english: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai na bae diba lau Iehova ese na ha-araia; bena ta ese basine habodoa.
english: All flesh will see that I, Yahweh, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.”’”

motu: Bena lau nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, idia ese e herevalaigumu, e tomu “Ia na sivarai heḡereḡeredia igwauraidia tauna ani?”
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, talaimu na Ierusalem ba henia, bona gabu helaḡadia latadiai ba haroro. Israel tanona latanai ba peroveta;
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

motu: Israel tanona ba hereva henia, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese oi na inai henimumu; egu dare na iudalaina pauana amo baina veria lasi, bena kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia na oiemu amo baina utudia oho.
english: Tell the land of Israel, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

motu: Badina be kara maoromaoro taudia bona kara dika taudia na oiemu amo baina utudia oho dainai, egu dare na iudalaina pauana amo baine lasi, taunimanima iboudiai, diho kahana amo ela bona mirigini kahana, ihadikadia totona.
english: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai bae diba, lau Iehova ese egu dare na iudalaina pauana amo vada na veria lasi; ḡauna na basine hetoi vareai lou.
english: All flesh will know that I, Yahweh, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, ba ganaḡana, mai dara-dokomu bona mai lalo-hisihisimu iditana ida ba ḡanaḡana, idia vairadiai.
english: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart + 21:6 literally, the breaking of your thighs * and with bitterness.

motu: Bena idia ese bae hereva henimu, baeto “Dahaka dainai o ḡanaḡanamu?” negana ai, baoto “Ini hari daidiai. Baine kau negana ai, dara iboudiai bae doko, bona ima iboudiai bae manoka, lauma iboudiai bae daure, bona tui iboudiai bae manoka-manoka ranu na heto. A ilaia, ia na e maimu, bona karana na baine ḡuḡuru”. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, a peroveta, baoto, Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Baoto Dare ta, dare ta vada e segea, vada e hakimore-kimorea danu;

Yes, it|strong="H5869" * is|strong="H1121" * polished to|strong="H1121" * give it|strong="H5869" * into the|strong="H5869" * hand of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H5869" * killer.”’

It|strong="H5921" * is|strong="H3820" * on|strong="H5921" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * princes of|strong="H3027" * Israel. They|strong="H3588" * are|strong="H3027" * delivered|strong="H3027" * over|strong="H5921" * to|strong="H3212" * the|strong="H3605" * sword|strong="H3027" * with|strong="H5921" * my|strong="H3605" * people|strong="H3820" *. Therefore|strong="H5921" * beat your|strong="H3605" * thigh.

motu: Badina be ia na dia hahetoho. Hekwadi auna boma dadaraia, ia ese dahaka bema havaraia diba? Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, ba peroveta; imamu ba pata dagu, bena dare na baine dapadapa nega harua, oibe nega hatoi, taunimanima iala-masedia darena, ia na heala-ala badana darena, e ḡeḡedia ahumu ḡauna.
english: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and|strong="H1121" * strike your|strong="H1571" * hands together|strong="H1571" *. Let the|strong="H3541" * sword|strong="H2719" * be|strong="H1121" * doubled the|strong="H3541" * third time, the|strong="H3541" * sword|strong="H2719" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H3541" * fatally wounded. It|strong="H2719" * is|strong="H1571" * the|strong="H3541" * sword|strong="H2719" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H3541" * great one|strong="H1121" * who|strong="H1121" * is|strong="H1571" * fatally wounded, which|strong="H2719" * enters into|strong="H2719" * their|strong="H1571" * rooms.

motu: Idibamu ai bona launmu ai ba lapalapa, emu dare isena e lapa henimu gabudia.
english: Gather yourselves together. Go|strong="H2719" * to|strong="H5414" * the|strong="H5414" * right. Set|strong="H5414" * yourselves|strong="H3027" * in|strong="H3027" * array. Go|strong="H2719" * to|strong="H5414" * the|strong="H5414" * left|strong="H5414" *, wherever your|strong="H5414" * face is|strong="H1931" * set|strong="H5414" *.

motu: Lau ese danu imagu baina pata dagu, egu badu ḡaraḡarana baina ha- orea. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
english: I will also strike my hands together, and|strong="H1121" * I|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H1961" * cause|strong="H3651" * my|strong="H3605" * wrath to|strong="H3478" * rest|strong="H1961" *. I|strong="H3588" *, Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, have|strong="H1961" * spoken it|strong="H1931" *.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

motu: Taunimanuna natuna e, Babulono pavapavana ena dare daladia rua toadia ba kara; ruaosi na tano tamona amo baema. Bona toa auna ba haginia, hanua dalana badi-tanona ai.
english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

motu: Dare ena mai dalana toana ba karaia; Raba, Amono taudia edia hanua, bona Iuda, bona Ierusalem, hanua mai maguna, baine mai henidia.
english: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

motu: Badina be Babulono pavapavana na dala katakata ai e ginimu, dala ruaosi badi-tanodia baine bagu haoro totona; diba e rubediamu, ena dirava laulaudia e nanadaidiamu, ase ai toa e tahudiamu.
english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. + 21:21 teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property. * He looked in the liver.

motu: Ia imana idibana ai Ierusalem hanua e hedinaraimu, lolo-dagu ihavarana, hanua iduaradia igwadadia vaḡomadia iato-hatadia, tano ilarebana, bona hanua iḡegelaina kohorodia ihaginidia.
english: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.

motu: A idia ese mamina bae abia, bagu-haoro koikoina na heto; idia ese gwauhamata helaḡadia vada e gwaurai; a ia ese edia kerere e hahelalolaidia une, bae heabi mauri totona.
english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be emui kerere ihelalolaidia na taunimanima lalodiai vada o havaraia, bona emui kara kerere vada o hulalalaidia, bena emui kara iboudiai lalodiai emui dika e hedinaraimu, bona badina be umui na sibomui o helalo unemu, una dainai emui kara dika lalodiai bae abimui.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.

motu: Oi danu, Israel pavapavana, tau dikana, o hahemiro taumu, emu dina vada e kau, davamu bavabia vaitani negana vada e kau.
english: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Kwara dabuana ba ruhaia oho, kwara ivavalaina ḡauna ba kokia oho; harihari e miamu ḡaudia na basie mia; henu ai e miamu ḡauna na ba hadaea, atai ai e miamu ḡauna na ba hadihoa.
english: the Lord Yahweh says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.

motu: Baina havahua, baina havahua, baina havahua; sisina taina basine mia, ela bona ia biaguna korikorina bainema; bena ia baina henia. Hahemaoro Amono taudia latadiai
english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, ba peroveta, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ese Amono taudia mai edia heḡonaḡonalai herevadia ida ini e herevalaidia tomamu. Baoto: Dare ta, dare ta vada e veria lasi, ala-ala totona. Vada e hakimorekimorea, baine hururu-hururu bona baine kevaru-kevaru.
english: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “ A|strong="H3068" * sword! A|strong="H3068" * sword is|strong="H1931" * drawn! It|strong="H1931" * is|strong="H1931" * polished for|strong="H5869" * the|strong="H2142" * slaughter, to|strong="H1961" * cause|strong="H1961" * it|strong="H1931" * to|strong="H1961" * devour, that|strong="H1931" * it|strong="H1931" * may|strong="H1961" * be|strong="H1961" * as|strong="H1961" * lightning;

I|strong="H3541" * will|strong="H3808" * blow on|strong="H3069" * you|strong="H3808" * with|strong="H7311" * the|strong="H3069" * fire of|strong="H3069" * my|strong="H5493" * wrath. motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Oi danu, taunimanima natuna, ba hahemaoro heni a? Ina hanua mai rarana ba hahemaoro henia a? Benaini, ena kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai ba gwaurai henia.
english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.

motu: Oi na baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hanuana binai, bogaraginai rara e hahebubuamu, ena nega baine kau helaoreana, bona kaivakuku e karamu, ia sibona ihamirolaina.
english: You shall say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!

motu: Oi na vada o kerere, vada o hahebubua rarana dainai; bona vada o miro, vada o kara kaivakukudia daidiai; emu nega vada o hakwadogia, vada e gwaurai henimu laḡanidia vada e ore. Taunabunai, hedunirai ḡauna ai vada na halaomu, bese idau-idau ediai, bona heḡonaḡonalai ḡauna, tano iboudiai ediai.
english: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

motu: Harimu dika-rohoroho ḡauna, heloḡo-ahuahu hanuana, e noho hetabiramu taudia bona daudaudia ai e nohomu taudia ese bae ḡonaḡonalaimu.
english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.

motu: A itaia, oi lalomu ai Israel lohiadia, ta ta ena siahu ena siahu heḡereḡeredia ai, lalodia na rara ihahebubuna vada e uralai bada.
english: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.

motu: Oi lalomu ai tama bona sina na e hahemataidiamu; oi bogaragimu ai noho hedoa tauna na gwaurai-lagau karadia amo e hahisiamu; oi lalomu ai ihareha bona vabu e kara dika henidiamu.
english: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. + 22:7 Literally, made light of father and mother. * Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.

motu: Egu ḡau helaḡadia vada o dadaraidia; egu dina helaḡadia vada o hamirodia.
english: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

motu: Oi lalomu ai haida ese e hahebademu, rara ihahebubuna totona; oi lalomu ai haida ese ororo ai e ani rahimu; oi bogaragimu ai haida ese lebulebu karadia e karamu.
english: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.

motu: Oi lalomu ai haida ese tamadia edia geda e hamirodiamu; oi lalomu ai hahine na edia rara-kara dinadia ai e hahemaraidiamu.
english: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.

motu: Ta na dekena tauna adavana ida e heuda hanaimu; ma ta na rava-maragi hahinena ida e eno boumu; ma ta oi lalomu ai na ia taihuna korikorina ida e eno boumu.
english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

motu: Oi lalomu ai haida ese dava e abimu, rara ihahebubuna totona; heatokau monidia o abimu, bona gvaurai-lagau karadia ai dekemu taudia o dadihaidia; vada o lalogu boio. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Taunabunai, a itaia, lau ese imagu ruaosi na tutu hekapumu, moni vada o abi koikoi bona rara na bogaragimu ai vada e hebubu daidiai.
english: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.

motu: Baina kara henimu dinadia ai na emu haheauka baine hesiriu eiava imamu bae goada a? Lau Iehova vada na hereva, bona karana do baina karaia.
english: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and will do it.

motu: Baina hakarohomui, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, bona tano idau-idau ai baina hakarohomui rohoroho; bona emu miro na bogaragimu amo baina ha-orea.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.

motu: Bena oi daimu ai lau ladagu baine miro bese idau-idau vairadiai; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena na momo ai vada ela lauegu ai; iboudiai na silver * bona auri labora-laborana bona auri hururu-hururuna bona auri bona auri metauna lahi lalonai na heheto. Momo ai vada ela.
english: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Umui iboumui ai na momo ai vada o hahelao dainai, taunabunai, a itaia, lau ese Ierusalem bogaraginai baina haboumui.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

motu: Taunimanima ese silver * bona auri labora-laborana bona auri bona auri metauna bona auri hururu-hururuna na lahi ai e haboumu, bena lahi e hahururuhururuamu idia ihavevedia totona, unuheto lau ese egu badu ai bona egu badu ḡaraḡara ai baina haboumui, lahi lalonai baina atomui vareai, baina havevemui.
english: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.

motu: Baina haboumui, egu badu ḡaraḡara lahina ai baina pururumui, bena ia bogaraginai ba veve oho.
english: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.

motu: Silver * na lahi ai e haveveamu na heto, lau ese egu badu ai baina havevemui; bena ba diba lau Iehova ese egu badu na latamui ai vada na bubua dobi.
english: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my wrath on you.’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, ba hamaoroa, baoto, Oi na asie haḡoevaia tanona, eiava latanai badu dinana ai medu se diho tanona.
english: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’

motu: Ia bogaraginai ena lohia verina na e goumu bona damuna e dareamu leonana na heto; idia ese taunimanima edia mauri vada e ha-oredia; kohu namo-hereadia bona dava bada ḡaudia vada e dadidia, hahine momo vada e havabudia ia bogaraginai.
english: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.

motu: Ena hahelaḡa taudia ese egu taravatu vada e tataia utu, bona egu ḡau helaḡadia vada e hamirodia; ḡau helaḡadia bona ḡau asi helaḡadia asie ha-idaudia, bona ḡau mirodia bona ḡau ḡoevaḡoevadia vada e hatamonadia; bona egu dina helaḡadia asie badinadia; unu amo idia ese lau ladagu vada e hamiroa.
english: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.

motu: Ena lohia verina ia bogaraginai na uda sisiadia na heheto; damudia e daremu, rara e hahebubuamu, bona taunimanima edia mauri e ha orediamu, unu amo kohu e ḡaunai.
english: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

motu: Ena peroveta taudia danu ahu ai e hedahu, vada e mata hanai koikoi bona vada e bagu haoro koikoi idia daidiai; vada eto “Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu”, a ḡau be Iehova se gwa.
english: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord Yahweh says,’ when Yahweh has not spoken.

motu: Tano taudia ese dava vada e gwaurai lagau, bona dadidadi karadia vada e kara; ogoḡami tauna bona e dabumu tauna vada e hahisidia, bona noho-hedoa tauna enai dava vada e gwaurai lagau, ena ḡau na asi iabi-louna dalana.
english: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.

motu: Bena idia bogaragidiai tau ta na tahua, maḡu baine haginia, bena e mauru gabuna ai lau vairagu ai baine gini, tano igimana totona baina habuaia tari na garina; a tau ta asina davaria.
english: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.

motu: Taunabunai, egu badu na idia latadiai vada na bubua dobi; egu badu-ḡaraḡara lahina ai vada na ha-aradia; edia kara davana vada na haloua, idia kwaradia ai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, hahine rarua e nohova, hahine tamona natuna.
english: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

motu: Idia ese ariara karadia e karava, Aigupto ai; ulatodia ai ariara karadia e karava. Unuseni ai tatau haida ese kemedia e rosidia; bona ulato rami-heboudia ai ratadia e ḡiḡidia.
english: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.

motu: Hane guna ladana na Ohola; ia tadina ladana na Oholiba. Lau ese na adavadia; bena idia ese natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia e havaradia. Ladadia anidia na iniheto: Ohola na Samaria, bona Oholiba na Ierusalem.
english: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

motu: Ohola na lau adavagu negana ai, ia ese ariara karadia e karava; e ura heniava taudia, Asuria taudia, na e mata dika henidiava.
english: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

motu: Idia na tuari taudia, dabua kakakakadia e hahedokilaiva; idia na hekwara taudia bona tuari lohiadia; iboudiai na eregabe taudia namo-hereadia, hosi ai e guiva taudia.
english: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.

motu: Ia ese e kara lebulebu henidia; iboudiai na Asuria taudia ḡoeva-daedia; bona e mata dika henidia taudia iboudiai edia kaivakuku iboudiai ediai e hahemiro.
english: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.

motu: Ena ariara karadia, Aigupto ai e nohova dinadia amo vada e kara, na se hadokodia; badina be ulatona ai tatau na ia ida e eno bou, bona ulato rami-hebouna ai idia ese ratana e ḡiḡidia; bona e kara lebulebu henia.
english: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.

motu: Taunabunai, e ura heniava taudia, hari Asuria taudia, ia ese e mata dika henidia taudia, imadia ai na atoa.
english: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.

motu: Idia ese ena geda e hamiroa; ia natuna mamaruanedia bona hahinedia na e dabaidia tao, a ia be dare amo e alaia mase; hahemaoro na ia latanai vada e haḡuḡurua negana ai, ia na gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai ela hahine bogaragidiai.
english: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.

motu: Ina kara na ia tadina Oholiba ese e itaia, ḡau tamona ia ese kakana e hereaia, ena mata dika ai bona ena ariara karadia ai; unu kara ai kakana na dika, a ia be dika herea.
english: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.

motu: Ia ese Asuria taudia e mata dika henidia; hekwara taudia bona tuari lohiadia, edia auri dabuadia e hahedokilaiva taudia, edia hosi ai e guiva taudia, iboudiai na eregabe taudia namo-hereadia.
english: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.

motu: Bena na itaia, vada e miro vaitani; idia raruosi na dala tamona ai vada e raka.
english: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.

motu: A ia ese ena ariara karadia ma e habada; ia ese tatau laulaudia haba ai e raraidia, Kaldea taudia laulaudia, muramura kakakakana amo vada e tore ḡaudia,
english: “She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red,

motu: mai edia gaba ḡaudia koekoedia ai bona edia kwara dabuadia kwaradia ai, iboudiai ita-itadia na lohia taudia, Kaldea taudia, Babulono tanona ai e nohomu taudia, laulaudia.
english: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.

motu: E itadia negana ai na e mata dika henidia; bena gwaukau taudia na dekedia e siaidia lao Kaldea ai.
english: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

motu: Bena Babulono taudia na ia dekena ela, ia ida e eno bou, ela bona edia lebulebu karadia amo e hamiroa. E hamiroa murinai, ia ese e rakatanidia mai hedadaraina ida.
english: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

motu: Ena ariara karadia e kara hedinarai bona tau-anina e heaḡilaia negana ai na na rakatania mai hedadaraigu ida, kakana na rakatania heḡereḡerena.
english: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.

motu: To, ia ese ena ariara karadia e habada, hane-ulatona negana e laloa tao; una negana ai ia ese ariara karadia e karava Aigupto tanona ai;
english: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.

motu: unuseni ai ia e ura heniava taudia, taudia reḡedia na doniki reḡedia na heheto bona natudia na hosi natudia na heheto taudia, na ia ese e mata dika henidia.
english: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

motu: Unuheto hane-ulato ai Aigupto taudia ese kememu e rosia bona ratamu e ḡiḡi negana ai lebulebu karadia o karava na oi ese o lalodia tao, mai lalo-hekisehekisemu ida.
english: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.

motu: Taunabunai, Oholiba e, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, e ura henimumu taudia, mai hedadaraimu ida o rakatanidia taudia, na baina hatoredia isi, kaha iboudiai amo baina haboudia, oi ihadikamu totona:
english: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:

motu: Babulono taudia bona Kaldea taudia iboudiai, Pekodo bona Soa bona Koa taudia, bona Asuria taudia iboudiai idia ida, iboudiai na eregabe taudia namo-hereadia bona hekwara taudia bona tuari biagudia, lohia taudia bona tuari taudia, iboudiai danu hosi gui taudia.
english: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.

motu: Idia na oi ihadikamu totona mirigini kahana amo baema, mai edia kariota bona edia rerue bona edia orea taudia hutuma ida. Idia ese bae koumu heḡeḡe, mai edia keme auridia bona edia kesi bona edia kwara ḡaudia, bona siahu baina henidia bae hanemaoro, bena edia hahemaoro herevadia amo bae hahemaoro henimu.
english: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.

motu: Bena egu badu na baina siai henimu, edia badu ḡaraḡara ai bae kara henimu totona. Idia ese udu-baubaumu bona taiamu bae utudia oho, bona emu roho-mauri taudia na dare ai bae mase. Idia ese natumu mamaruanedia bona hahinedia bae dabaidia tao, bona emu roho mauri taudia na lahi ese baine aradia ore.
english: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.

motu: Idia ese danu emu dabua bae hadokidia oho, bona emu herahera nadidia namo-hereadia bae abidia oho.
english: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

motu: Unuhetomana lau ese emu lebulebu bona emu ariara karadia, Aigupto amo o mailai, na baina hadokodia; una dainai, Aigupto taudia na basio gaga dae henidia lou, bona basio lalodia tao lou.
english: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese o inai henidiamu taudia, mai hedadaraimu ida o rakatanidia taudia, imadia ai baina atomu;
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.

motu: bena daḡedaḡe ai bae kara henimu, emu hekwarahi anina idoinai bae abia oho, gagaemu ai bae rakatanimu, bena emu ariara karadia anidia korikori bae hedinarai. Emu lebulebu bona emu ariara karadia ese
english: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.

motu: ina kara na latamu ai vada e hadihoa, badina be bese idau-idau ida ariara karadia o kara, bona edia kaivakuku ediai o hahemiro.
english: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.

motu: Kakamu ena dala ai vada o raka; taunabunai iena kehere na oi imamu ai baina atoa.
english: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Kakamu ena kehere amo ba inu, ia na bada bona dobu; bae kirikirilaimu, bae ḡonaḡonalaimu, badina be anina na bada;
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘ You|strong="H1961" * will|strong="H1961" * drink|strong="H8354" * of|strong="H3069" * your|strong="H1961" * sister’s cup|strong="H3563" *, which|strong="H3069" * is|strong="H1961" * deep|strong="H6013" * and|strong="H8354" * large|strong="H7342" *. english: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with|strong="H4390" * the|strong="H4390" * cup|strong="H3563" * of|strong="H4390" * astonishment|strong="H8047" * and|strong="H8111" * desolation|strong="H8077" *, with|strong="H4390" * the|strong="H4390" * cup|strong="H3563" * of|strong="H4390" * your|strong="H4390" * sister Samaria|strong="H8111" *.

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be vada o lalogu boio bona murimu ai vada o negegu, una dainai emu lebulebu bona emu ariara karadia davadia bavabi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”

motu: Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Ohola bona Oholiba ba hahemaoro henidia a? Benaini, edia kara dika-rohorohodia ba gwaurai henidia.
english: Yahweh said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

motu: Badina be idia na vada e heuda hanai, bona rara na imadia ai; edia kaivakuku ida vada e heuda hanai; bona natudia mamaruanedia, lauegu amo e abidia memerodia, na boubou karana ai idia e henidia, adia.
english: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.

motu: Ina danu vada e kara henigu: dina tamona ai egu gabu helaḡana bona egu dina helaḡadia vada e hamirodia.
english: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

motu: Badina be natudia e aladia mase, edia kaivakuku iboulaidia ḡaudia ai e halaodia, dinana lalonai idia ese egu gabu helaḡana lalonai e didi vareai, bae hamiroa totona. A itaia, egu dubu ai unu e kara toma.
english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.

motu: Idia ese danu gwaukau tauna ta e siaia lao, dauha amo tatau haida baema; bena vada ema. Idia daidiai o digu, matamu o ouda, bona taumu o haheraia;
english: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,

motu: ege-diho patana namo-hereana ai o helai; ia vairanai pata ta o atoa, bona egu muramura mai bonana bona egu dehoro na pata latanai o atodia.
english: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.

motu: Hutuma edia moale reḡedia na taiana ai; bona gunika taudia na tano ḡaḡaena amo e hakaudia mai, kekero taudia; bena vaḡivaḡi na hahine imadia ai e atodia, bona havava ḡaudia mai hairaidia na kwaradia e havavalaidia.
english: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.

motu: Bena lau nato, Tatau na ia ida e eno boumu negadia ai, idia na asie heuda hanaimu a?
english: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’

motu: Badina be idia na ia dekenai vada e raka vareai, haida ese ariara hahinena dekenai e raka vareaimu na heto. Ohola bona Oholiba dekediai unu e raka vareai toma, bae kara lebulebu totona.
english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.

motu: A ka a maoromaoro taudia ese bae hahemaoro henidia, heuda-hanai hahinedia bona rara ihahebubuna hahinedia davadia bae henidia; badina be idia na heudahanai hahinedia, bona rara na imadia ai.
english: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Tuari oreana ba hakaua mai, gari ihavarana ḡauna ai bona dadidadi ḡauna ai ba halaodia.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.

motu: Bena hari tuari oreana taudia ese nadi amo bae hododia bona edia date amo bae aladia mase; natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia danu bae aladia mase, bona edia ruma bae doudia.
english: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

motu: Unu amo lebulebu karadia na tano ai baina hadokodia, hahine ese nahuadia bae toho totona, bena lebulebu karadia basie kara, umui vada o kara heḡereḡeredia.
english: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.

motu: Bena emui lebulebu davana do bavabia, bona emui kara dika ai kaivakuku o toma henidia diho na davadia bavabi; bena vada ba diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
english: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Laḡani ihataurahani-tana huana ihagwautana dinana ihagwautana lalonai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ina dina, hari ina dina, ladana ba torea; Babulono pavapavana ese Ierusalem vada e koua heḡeḡe, hari ina dina ai.
english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.

motu: Hereva heḡereḡerena na ina gwau-edeede besena ba gwaurai henia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Uro ba laia kau, ba laia kau; ranu na ia lalonai ba seia danu.
english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “ Put|strong="H8239" * the|strong="H3069" * cauldron on|strong="H1004" * the|strong="H3069" * fire. Put|strong="H8239" * it|strong="H4325" * on|strong="H1004" *, and|strong="H1004" * also|strong="H1571" * pour|strong="H3332" * water|strong="H4325" * into|strong="H3332" * it|strong="H4325" *.

She|strong="H3588" * set|strong="H7760" * it|strong="H7760" * on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H5921" * bare|strong="H6706" * rock|strong="H5553" *. motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hanua mai rarana madi ihabaina! Lau ese danu senu baina habadaia.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to|strong="H5892" * the|strong="H3069" * bloody|strong="H1818" * city|strong="H5892" *! I|strong="H3541" * also|strong="H1571" * will|strong="H1571" * make|strong="H1431" * the|strong="H3069" * pile|strong="H4071" * great|strong="H1431" *.

Make|strong="H8552" * the|strong="H7235" * broth thick, and|strong="H6086" * let the|strong="H7235" * bones|strong="H6106" * be|strong="H6086" * burned|strong="H2787" *.

english: Then set it empty on its coals, that|strong="H4616" * it|strong="H5921" * may|strong="H5178" * be hot|strong="H3179" *, and|strong="H5975" * its|strong="H5921" * bronze|strong="H5178" * may|strong="H5178" * burn|strong="H2787" *, and|strong="H5975" * that|strong="H4616" * its|strong="H5921" * filthiness|strong="H2932" * may|strong="H5178" * be molten|strong="H5413" * in|strong="H5921" * it|strong="H5921" *, that|strong="H4616" * its|strong="H5921" * rust|strong="H2457" * may|strong="H5178" * be consumed|strong="H8552" *.

motu: Vada na hekwarahi kava; ia deḡideḡina udunanana lahi ai se oremu.
english: She is weary with toil; yet|strong="H3808" * her|strong="H3318" * great|strong="H7227" * rust|strong="H2457" *, rust|strong="H2457" * by|strong="H3318" * fire, doesn’t leave|strong="H3318" * her|strong="H3318" *.

motu: Deḡideḡina na oiemu lebulebu miro-hereana. Badina be bama haḡoevamu, to emu miro badana amo asio goeva; basio ḡoevaḡoeva lou ela bona egu badu na baina hagugurua latamu ai.
english: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.

motu: Lau Iehova vada na hereva; ina na baine vara, lau ese baina karaia; lau na basina helalo lou, basina hebogahisi, basina helalo kerehai. Emu dala bona emu kara heḡereḡeredia ai baina hahemaoro henimu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu. Esekiel adavana e mase
english: “‘“I, Yahweh, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai ma e kau, eto,
english: Also Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, mata-kunumai tamona ai oi matamu ihamoalena baina abia oho, ḡau tamona lalomu basine hisihisi bona basio tai, bona iruru-matamu basie diho.
english: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.

motu: Ba hahodi, to basio ḡanaḡana; mase taina basio tai. Dabua na kwaramu ba kumilaia, bona tamaka na aemu ai ba kara; udumu basio ḡovaia, bona basio ani helaḡa.
english: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

motu: Taunabunai, daba ai lau ese taunimanima na hereva henidia, bena adorahi ai adavagu na e mase. Bena daba rerena ai, e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena ai na kara.
english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.

motu: Bena taunimanima ese e nanadaigu, eto, Ini ḡau anidia emai ai, bona ini o kara karadia anidia, basio hamaoromai a?
english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”

motu: Bena na haere henidia, nato, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Then I said to them, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Israel besena ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu gabu helaḡana baina hamiroa, emui siahu iheaḡilaina toana, matamui ese e moalelaiamu ḡauna, laumamui ese e uralaiamu ḡauna; bena natumui mamaruanedia bona hahinedia unuseni ai o rakatanidia na dare amo bae mase.
english: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

motu: Bena-lauegu kara heḡereḡerena ai do ba kara; udumui basio ḡovadia bona basio ani helaḡa.
english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.

motu: Kwaramui dabuadia na kwaramui ai bae mia, bona emui tamaka na aemui ai bae mia; lalomui basie hisihisi bona basio taitai, a emui kara havara ai ba varoda-varoda, bona ba heḡanaḡana heheni.
english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

motu: Unuhetomana, Esekiel na toa ta ai bainela emui ai, ia ese e kara karadia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia, umui ese ba kara. Ina na baine kau negana ai, ba diba lau na Ḡaubada Iehova.
english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”’”

motu: iBona oi, taunimanima natuna e, edia gabu aukana, edia moale bona edia hairai, matadia ese e moalelaiamu bona lalodia ese e uralaiamu ḡauna, bona natudia mamaruanedia bona hahinedia danu, na edia amo baina abidia oho dinana ai,
english: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—

motu: una dina ai heau tauna ta na dekemu bainema, hari baine hamaorolaimu.
english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

motu: Una dina ai, udumu baine hekeho una heau tauna enai; vada ba hereva, basio mu lou. Unu amo oi na toa ta ai baola, idia ediai; bena bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, talaimu na Amono taudia ba henidia, bona idia latadiai ba peroveta.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

motu: Amono taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai. Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be umui oto “Aha” egu gabu helaḡana latanai, bona Israel tanona latanai, e havahua negana ai, bona Iuda besena latanai, dauhai e hanohoa negana ai;
english: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,

motu: una dainai lau ese mairiveina kahana taudia imadia ai na atomuimu, idia ese edia ai bae halaomui, bona bogaragimui ai bae taruha bona bae noho; idia ese emui au-huahua bae ani bona emui rata bae inu.
english: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.

motu: Raba na kamelo edia rei gabuna ai baina halaoa, bona Amono taudia edia hanua na mamoe seridia edia maḡu ai baina halaodia. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova.
english: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be imamui vada o tutu bona aemui vada o pana, bona emui badu lalonai Israel tanona ihadikana o moalelaia,
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,

motu: una dainai, a itaia, imagu na vada na toia roro, umui ihadikamui, bona bese idau-idau imadia ai baina atomui, edia ai bae halaomui; bena bese idau-idau edia amo baina negemui daure, bona tano idau-idau lalodia amo baina hamasemui, baina habuamui tari. Bena ba diba, lau na Iehova. Peroveta herevana Moab latanai
english: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be Moab eto “A itaia, Iuda besena na bese idau-idau iboudiai heḡereḡeredia”,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’

motu: una dainai lau ese Moab igimana na kaha ta amo baina abia oho, ena tano hetoana hanuadia amo baina abia oho; unu na tano hairaina, Bet-iesimoto, Baal-meono, Kiriataimi.
english: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

motu: Una tano, Amono taudia ida, na mairiveina kahana taudia baina henidia, edia ai bae halaoa, bena bese idau-idau bogaragidiai ta ese basine laloa tao lou;
english: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

motu: bona Moab na baina hahemaoro henia. Bena idia na bae diba lau na Iehova. Peroveta herevana Edom latanai
english: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be Edom ese Iuda besena taudia edia daḡedaḡe e hadava henidia, bona e kerere dikadika idia ihadava-henidia ai,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”

motu: una dainai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau ese imagu na baina toia roro, Edom ihadikana, taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia na iena amo baina negedia daure. Baina havahua; bena Teman amo ela bona Dedan idia na dare ai bae mase.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

motu: Egu hahedava-heni na Edom latanai baina atoa kau, egu bese Israel taudia imadia ai; Edom ai bae ḡaukara, egu badu bona egu badu-ḡaraḡara heḡereḡeredia ai; bona egu hahedava-heni bae diba. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu. Peroveta herevana Filistia taudia latadiai
english: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be Filistia taudia na e hahedava heni, bona edia badu ai hahedava-heni karadia e kara, miahanaihanai heinai-hehenina ai bae hahebua tari totona;
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”

motu: una dinai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese imagu na baina toia roro Filistia taudia ihadikadia, bona Kerete taudia baina negedia daure, bona kone kahana orena na baina habuaia tari.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

motu: Lau ese hahedava-heni badana baina karaia idia latadiai; mai badugu ida davadia baina henidia. Bena egu hahedava-heni na latadiai baina atoa negana ai, idia na bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”

motu: Laḡani ihagwauta-tana lalonai, hua dinana gini-gunana ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, badina be Turo ese Ierusalem e herevalaia, eto “Aha, taunimanima edia ikoukou vada e makohi, egu ai vada e hekeho; ia vada e vahu dainai lau baina namo lou”;
english: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’

motu: una dainai Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Turo e, a itaia, lau ese na inai henimumu. Bese momo baina mailaidia oi ihadikamu, davara ese hurehurena na e mailaidiamu na heto.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

motu: Idia ese Turo maḡudia bae ḡiḡidia dobi, bena kohorodia bae haheḡiḡidia tari, bena lau ese tanona baina tahia oho, nadina mo baine kikiri.
english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

motu: Ia na davara bogaraginai baine mia, reke itoredia gabuna ai bainela. Lau, Ḡaubada Iehova, vada na hereva. Bena ia na bese idau-idau damudia ai bainela;
english: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

motu: bona ia natuna hahinedia tanobada ai na dare ese baine aladia mase. Bena bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, mirigini kahana amo Nebukadresara, Babulono pavapavana, pavapava edia pavapava, mai ena hosi bona ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia bona ena tuari taudia hutuma herea ida, baina mailaidia, Turo latanai.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

motu: Ia ese natumu hahinedia tanobada ai na dare amo baine aladia mase. Ia ese maḡu ta amo baine koumu heḡeḡe, bona tano baine larebaia bona kesi momo bae duduidia isi oi ihadikamu.
english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

motu: Ena vaḡoma amo maḡumu baine hamakohidia, bona ena ira amo kohoromu baine hagaridia.
english: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.

motu: Ena hosi bae hutuma herea dainai, aedia kahudia ese bae govamu. Ia na ikoukoumu amo baine raka vareai, ta ese maḡuna e hamaurua hanuana ai bema raka vareai heḡereḡerena; una negana ai hosi-gui taudia bona rerue bona kariota reḡedia ese maḡumu bae haheude-heudedia.
english: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

motu: Ena hosi aedia amo ia ese ariaramu iboudiai baine moimoilaidia; emu taunimanima iboudiai ia ese baine aladia mase, emu au-tubua auka-hereadia na tano ai bae moru.
english: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

motu: Idia ese emui taḡa na bae dadidia oho, bona emui hoihoi kohudia na damudia ai bae halaodia; maḡumu bae gigi dobi, bona emui ruma namo-hereadia bae habuadia tari; emui nadi bona emui au bona emui uma tanodia na davara lalonai bae negedia dobi.
english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

motu: Emui ane reḡedia baina hadoko; emui gitara reḡedia na basie hekamonai lou.
english: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

motu: Nadi kikiri ai baina halaomu; reke itoredia gabuna ai ba hahelao; nega ta ai basie haginimu lou; badina be lau Iehova vada na hereva. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova ese Turo na ini e hereva henia tomamu: Ba moru negana ai na bae bero taudia bae ganaḡana, bona ala-ala na baine bada bogaragimu ai; una negana ai kone tanodia na basie heude-heude a?
english: “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

motu: Bena davara lohiadia iboudiai na edia terono amo bae diho, edia hahedoki badadia bae atodia tabe bona edia hahedoki mai heraheradia bae dokidia oho. Mai heude-heudedia ida edia dabua bae hahedokilai; tano ai bae helai; nega idoinai bae heude-heude bona oi daimu ai bae gari.
english: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a|strong="H3068" * land destitute|strong="H8074" * of|strong="H3068" * that|strong="H3588" * of|strong="H3068" * which|strong="H3068" * it|strong="H5414" * was|strong="H3068" * full|strong="H4393" *, when|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * strike|strong="H5221" * all|strong="H3605" * those|strong="H3605" * who|strong="H3605" * dwell|strong="H3427" * therein|strong="H4393" *, then|strong="H5414" * they|strong="H3588" * will|strong="H3068" * know|strong="H3045" * that|strong="H3588" * I|strong="H3588" * am|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.

motu: Unu bae rohe ahu toma; bese idau-idau hahinedia ese bae rohe ahu; Aigupto latanai bona ena taunimanima hutuma latadiai bae rohe ahu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Laḡani ihagwauta-ruana huana gini-gunana dinana ihagwauta-imana ai, Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto:
english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Aigupto ena orea taudia hutuma taidia ba tai, bona ba siaidia diho, idia bona bese herea-daedia hahinedia danu, mase gabuna ai bae diho, guri ai vada e diho taudia dekediai.
english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.

motu: Daika na hairai ai o hereaiamu? A diho lao, asie peritomedia taudia ida bae hahekuremu.
english: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.

motu: Idia na dare ese e aladia mase taudia bogaragidiai bae hekida diho, bona ena orea taudia hutuma iboudiai na ia ida bae hekure.
english: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.

motu: Lohia herea-daedia ese idia bona idurudia taudia na mase gabuna bogaragina amo bae herevalaidia, baeto “Asie peritomedia taudia na vada e diho, e hekuremu, asie marere-mareremu; dare ese vada e aladia mase”.
english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol + 32:21 Sheol is the place of the dead. * with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.

motu: Asuria na unuseni ai, ena orea idoinai danu; edia gara ese e geḡea daemu, iboudiai na dare ai e mase taudia mo.
english: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,

motu: Edia gara na guri dobu-masemasena ai e miamu, bona ena orea ese ena gara e ḡeḡea daemu; iboudiai, gunaguna mauri taudia edia tano ai hahegari karadia e karava taudia, na dare ai vada e mase.
english: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

motu: Elam na unuseni ai, bona ena orea taudia hutuma iboudiai ese iena gara e ḡeḡea daemu. Iboudiai na dare ai e mase; do se heperitome ai idia na mase gabuna ela. Gunaguna idia ese mauri taudia edia tano ai hahegari karadia e karava; harihari guri ai e dihomu taudia ida e hemarai heboumu.
english: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

motu: Idia ese ena hekure gabuna vada e lailaia, e aladia mase taudia bogaragidiai, ia mai ena orea taudia hutuma iboudiai ida; edia gara ese e ḡeḡea daemu, iboudiai na do se heperitome taudia, dare ai e mase taudia mo. Badina be idia igari-henidia vada e hepiu rohoroho, mauri taudia edia tano ai; idia na guri ai e dihomu taudia ida e hemarai heboumu, e aladia mase taudia ida e atodiamu.
english: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.

motu: Mesek bona Tubal na unuseni ai, mai edia orea taudia hutuma ida; edia gara ese e ḡeḡedia daemu. Iboudiai na do se heperitome taudia, dare ai e mase taudia mo. Badina be idia ese mauri taudia edia tano ai hahegari e havaraia rohoroho.
english: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

motu: Idia na sene edia goada-herea taudia ida asie hekure heboumu. Unu na mai edia tuari ḡaudia ida mase gabuna ai e diho, edia dare ai e haheKwinadia bona edia kesi na turiadia latadiai heheato; badina be goada-herea taudia edia hahegari na mauri taudia edia tano ai e miava.
english: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

motu: Taunabunai ba makohi, dare ese e aladia mase taudia ida ba hekida diho, do se haheperitome taudia bogaragidiai.
english: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.

motu: Edom na unuseni ai, ena pavapava bona ena lohia iboudiai. Idia na goada dikadika, to dare ai e mase taudia ida vada e hahekuredia. Idia na se haheperitome taudia, guri ai e dihomu taudia, ida e hekuremu.
english: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.

motu: Mirigini kahana lohiadia iboudiai na unuseni ai, bona Sidono taudia iboudiai danu. Idia na e aladia mase taudia ida nda e hemarai heboumu, edia goada ese e havaraia hahegarina idoinai dainai. Idia na do se haheperitome ai e hekuremu, dare ai e mase taudia ida; idia na guri ai e dihomu taudia ida e hemarai heboumu.
english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Farao ese baine itadia negana ai, ia na sibona tauhalo baine davaria, ena orea taudia hutuma daidiai; oibe, Farao mai ena tuari oreana idoinai, dare ai e mase taudia, daidiai.
english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Badina be ia ese hahegari e piua rohoroho, mauri taudia edia tano ai; una dainai ia na do se haheperitome taudia bogaragidiai bae hahekurea, dare ai e mase taudia, Farao mai ena orea taudia hutuma iboudiai, ida. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, emu bese taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Dare na tano ta latanai bama mailaia, bena una tano taudia ese tau ta idia bogaragidia amo bema abia hidi, edia gima tauna ai bema halaoa;
english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,

motu: bena una tau ese dare na tano latanai e kaumu ai bema itaia negana ai, kibi bema hiriria, taunimanima ihadibadia:
english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,
