motu: una negana ai ta ese kibi reḡena bema kamonai to bema noho hedavauhe, bena dare na bema mai, ena maun bema abia oho; ia rarana na ia sibona kwarana ai baine mia.
english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

motu: Kibi reḡena e kamonai, to e noho hedavauhe; ia rarana na ia sibona latanai. A bema hedaraunelaia, bena ena mauri bema rauaia.
english: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.

motu: A gima tauna ese dare ena mai bema itaia, to kibi basinema hiriria, bena taunimanima na basiema diba, bena dare na bema mai, idia ta bema alaia; una tau na ena dika ai baine mase, a ia rarana davana na gima tauna enai baina gwauraia.
english: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, lau ese Israel besena igimana tauna ai vada na halaomu; lau udugu herevana ta ba kamonai negadia iboudiai na lau ladagu ai do ba sisibalai henidia.
english: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.

motu: Kara dika tauna bama hamaoroa, bama toma “Kara dika taumu e, oi na vada ba mase,” bena oi ese basioma hereva henia, basioma sisiba henia, ena dala amo baine raka siri totona; bena una kara dika tauna na ena dika ai baine mase, a ia rarana davana na oiemu ai baina gwauraia.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.

motu: A kara dika tauna boma sisiba henia, ena dala amo baine raka siri totona, bena ia na ena dala amo basinema raka oho, ia na ena dika ai baine mase, a oi na emu mauri do ba rauaia. Dirava ena dala na maoromaoro
english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese Israel besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Umui vada oto “Emai kerere bona emai kara dika na latamai ai, bena unu daidiai taumai e varoda-varodamu; ede baia mauri toma?”
english: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’

motu: Ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu, e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, lau ese dika tauna ena mase asina moalelaiamu, a dika tauna na ena dala amo baine raka siri bena baine mauri, una na na moalelaiamu. A lou, emui dala dikadia amo a lou! Israel besena e, anina be dahaka ba mase?
english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, oi ese emu bese taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Kara maoromaoro tauna ena kara maoromaoro ese basine hamauria, baine kerere negana ai; bona kara dika tauna ena kara dika ese basine haketoa, ena kara dika amo baine raka siri negana ai. Kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kara maoromaoro dainai basine mauri, baine kara dika negana ai.
english: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.

motu: Ena be kara maoromaoro tauna na hamaoroamu ia na do baine mauri, to ena kara maoromaoro bema abidadama henia bena bema kara havara, bena ena kara maoromaorodia ta basine helalo tao, a ia na ena kara havara ai baine mase.
english: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.

motu: Ina danu, ena be kara dika tauna na hamaoroamu, na tomu “Oi na do ba mase”, to ena kara dika amo bema raka oho, taravatu henunai bema noho bona kara maoromaorodia bema kara;
english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

motu: bema kara dika tauna ese gwauhamata davana ma bema haloua bona vada e dadi ḡaudia bema heni lou, bona mauri haheganidia ai bema raka bona basinema kara havara, bena ia na do baine mauri; ia na basine mase.
english: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.

motu: Ena kara dikadia ta basine helalo tao, ia ihadikana; ia na taravatu henunai vada e kara maoromaoro, ia na do baine mauri.
english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

motu: Ḡau tamona, emu bese taudia na e tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”; a ḡau be idia sibodia edia dala na dia maoro.
english: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kara maoromaoro amo baine raka oho, bena baine kara havara, ia na una kara dainai baine mase.
english: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

motu: Bona kara dika tauna na ena kara dika amo baine raka oho bona taravatu henunai baine kara maoromaoro, ia na una kara dainai baine mauri.
english: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

motu: Ḡau tamona umui na o tomu “Ḡaubada ena dala na dia maoro”. Israel besena taumui e, lau ese baina hahemaoro henimui, ta ta ena kara ena kara heḡereḡeredia ai. Ierusalem e darere harina
english: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”

motu: Emai noho-hedoa laḡanina ihagwauta-ruana huana ihagwautana dinana iha-imana lalonai, Ierusalem amo e heau mauri tauna ta na dekegu ema, eto, Hanua na vada e darere.
english: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”

motu: Heau mauri tauna na do se gini dae ai, adorahi ai Iehova imana na latagu ai e kau; bena daba ai, hari tau na dekegu ai e kau negana ai, Iehova ese udugu vada e kehoa guna; taunabunai, udugu vada e hekeho, egu mu negana vada e ore.
english: Now Yahweh’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, gabu ḡaḡaedia e noholaimu taudia Israel tanona lalonai na e hereva louloumu, e tomu, Abraham na tau tamona, to ia ese tano e ḡaunaia; a ai na hutuma, matona, tano na bae henimai, vada baia ḡaunaia.
english: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’

motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hidio na mai rarana ida o aniamu, bona emui kaivakuku o gaga dae henidiamu, bona rara o hahebubuamu, matona, tano ba ḡaunaia a?
english: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?

motu: Dare amo o ala-alamu, kara dika-rohorohodia o karamu, bona umui iboumui ai na ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna adavadia ida o heuda hanaimu; matona, tano ba ḡaunaia a?
english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’

motu: Ini ba hamaorodia toma, baoto, Ḡaubada. Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, gabu ḡagaedia ai e nohomu taudia na dare ai do bae mase; bona tano paka ai e nohomu tauna na uda boromadia baina henidia, idia ese bae ania; bona gabu aukadia ai bona kohua lalodiai e nohomu taudia na dai-hanai gorerena ese baine hamasedia.
english: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.

motu: Tano na baina havahua, tano ḡaḡaena ai bainela; ena siahu, e heaḡilaiamu ḡauna, na baine ore; Israel ororodia bae ḡaḡae vaitani dainai ta ese basine rakadia hanai.
english: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.

motu: Bena edia kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai daidiai lau ese tano na baina havahua, tano ḡaḡaena ai baina halaoa, negana ai idiu na bae diba, lau na Iehova.
english: Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’

motu: A, taunimanima natuna e, oiemu bese taudia ese ruma habadia badibadidiai bona ruma iduaradia ai oi e hereva heboulaimumu, e hereva hehenimu, ta ta ese tadikakana tadikakana e hamaorodiamu, e tomu, Aoma, Iehova ena amo e maimu herevana be dahaka vada ba kamonai.
english: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from Yahweh.’

motu: Idia na e vasimu, taunimanima na e hegogomu na heheto, bena oi vairamu ai e helaimu, lauegu orea na heto; bena oiemu hereva na e kamonaimu, to karana basie karaia; badina be ududia bibinadia amo lalokau herevadia momo e gwauraimu, to lalodia ai idia sibodia edia taḡa ihabadana daladia e haeromu.
english: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

motu: A itaia, idia ediai oi na lalokau anedia e abimu tauna na heto, gadona na namo-herea, bona gitara e hataia ḡoevaḡoevamu; badina be emu hereva bae kamonai, to karana basie karaia.
english: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.

motu: Ina na bainema negana ai, (bona ia na momokani bainema), bena idia na bae diba peroveta tauna ta na bogaragidiai vada ema.
english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ireḡuna taudia latadiai ba peroveta. Ba peroveta, ireḡuna taudia ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel ireḡuna taumui e, sibomui o heubumu taumui! Mamoe ireḡudia taudia na mamoe basie ubudia a?
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?

motu: Umui ese digara o animu, bona mamoe huidia dabuadia o hahedokilaimu, bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia o aladiamu; a mamoe na asio ubudiamu.
english: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.

motu: Manoka taudia asio hagoadadia, gorere taudia asio hanamodia, ae-hedairike taudia aedia asio kumidia, e raka oho taudia asio hakaudia lou, e boio taudia asio tahudia, a mai siahumui bona mai dagedagemui ida vada o biagudia.
english: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.

motu: Taunabunai idia na e karoho rohoroho, badina be asi ireḡudia ta; bona uda boromadia iboudiai ediai e hahelao.
english: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

motu: Egu mamoe na e karoho rohoroho, oIoro badadia gabaedia ai bona ororo maraḡidia doridia ai e loa eva-eva; egu mamoe na tanobada kopina idoinai latanai e karoho rohoroho, bona ta ese se tahudia davari.
english: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”

motu: Taunabunai, mamoe ireḡudia taumui e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word:

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena, badina be egu mamoe na uda boromadia iboudiai adia ai vada e hahelao, asi ireḡudia dainai; bona badina be egu mamoe ireḡudia taudia ese egu mamoe asie tahudia, a mamoe ireḡudia taudia na sibodia e heubu, egu mamoe asie ubudia;
english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,

motu: una dainai, mamoe ireḡudia taumui e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word!”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese mamoe ireḡudia taudia na inai henidiamu; egu mamoe na ediai baina gwaurai; mamoe iubudia ai baina hadokodia; mamoe ireḡudia taudia na sibodia basie heubu lou. Egu mamoe na ududia amo baina rauadia, adia aniani ai basie halaodia.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau sibogu ese egu mamoe baina tahudia ela bona baina davaridia.
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

motu: Mamoe ireḡudia tauna ese ena mamoe serina baine tahua davari, ena mamoe haida vada e karoho rohoroho negana ai, una heḡereḡerena ai lau ese egu mamoe baina tahudia davari; bona dagadaga bona dibura masemase dinana ai e karoho rohoroho gabudia iboudiai amo baina rauadia.
english: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina hakaudia lasi, bona tano idau-idau lalodia amo baina gogodia, edia tano korikori lalonai baina hakaudia vareai. Bena Israel ororodia ai baina ubudia, ranu-lohilohi gabudia badibadidiai, bona taunimanima ese tano ai e noholaimu gabudia iboudiai lalodiai danu.
english: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

motu: Rei namona gabudia ai baina ubudia; Israel ororodia doridia ai rei bae ani; unuseni ai rei namona gabudia ai bae hekure, bona rei namo-hereana bae ania, Israel ororodia ai.
english: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: Lau sibogu ese egu mamoe baina reḡudia bona baina hahekuredia.
english: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Boio ḡaudia na baina tahudia davari, bona e raka eva-evamu ḡaudia baina hakaudia lou, bona ae-hedairike ḡaudia aedia baina kumidia; manoka ḡaudia baina hagoadadia, bona mai digaradia bona mai goadadia ḡaudia na baina gimadia, hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva ai baina ubudia.
english: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu: egu seri e, a itaia, lau na mamoe padadiai na hahemaoromu, bona mamoe mamaruanedia bona nani mamaruanedia padadiai.
english: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

motu: Rei namona o aniamu na dia heḡereḡere, una dainai emui rei orena na aemui amo o moia taomu a? Ranu negari-negarina o inuamu na dia heḡereḡere, bena orena na aemui amo o haduhuamu a?
english: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?

motu: Lauegu mamoe ese aemui amo o moia tao reina bae ania bona aemui amo o haduhua ranuna bae inua a?
english: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau henidia tomamu: A itaia, lau sibogu na mamoe mai digaradia bona mamoe varodadia padadiai baina hahemaoro.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

motu: Badina be ohemui bona paḡamui amo o hebibimu, bona manoka ḡaudia iboudiai na doamui amo o bibidia ohomu, ela bona o hakarohodia rohorohomu;
english: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,

motu: una dainai egu mamoe serina baina hamauria. Idia na damu ai basie hahelao lou; lau ese mamoe ta bona mamoe ta padadiai baina hahemaoro.
english: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.

motu: Lau ese mamoe ireḡudia tauna tamona, egu hesiai tauna David, na idia ireḡudia tauna ai baina halaoa; ia ese baine ubudia bona baine reḡudia.
english: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.

motu: A lau Iehova na edia Dirava ai bainala, bona egu hesiai tauna David ese baine lohiadia. Lau Iehova vada na hereva.
english: I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.

motu: Lau idia ida baia herohemaino; uda boromadia na tano amo baina luludia lasi, bena tano ḡaḡaena ai bae noho namonamo bona uda ai bae mahuta.
english: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

motu: Bena egu ororo badi-tanodia ai baina hanohodia; bona medu batugudia baina hadihodia, negadia korikoridia ai; idia na hahenamo medudia ai baela.
english: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.

motu: Huahua audia huahuadia na bae dobi, tano anidia na bae habada, bona tano taudia na edia tano ai bae noho namonamo, bena edia gadea baina hamotudia bona e ḡuidia taudia imadia amo baina hamauridia negana ai, idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.

motu: Idia na bese idau-idau damudia ai basie hahelao lou, bona uda boromadia ese basie anidia lou; idia bae noho namonamo, bona tau ta ese basine hagaridia.
english: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.

motu: Lau ese imea namodia baina henidia, bena basie hitolodia lou edia tano ai, bona bese idau-idau ese basie ḡonaḡonalaidia lou.
english: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.

motu: Bena idia na bae diba, lau Iehova, edia Dirava, na idia ida bona idia, Israel besena taudia, na lauegu orea taudia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: They will know that I, Yahweh, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Umui na lauegu mamoe, egu rei mamoedia, bona lau na emui Dirava. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, vairamu ba huaia Seiri ororona enai; bena ia latanai ba peroveta,
english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Seiri ororona e, a itaia, lau ese na inai henimumu. Lau imagu baina toia roro, oi ihadikamu totona; baina habuamu tari bona baina havahumu.
english: and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

motu: Emu hanua na baina habuadia tari; oi na gabu ḡaḡaena ai ba hahelao; bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: Badina be o daḡedaḡe hanaihanaiva, bona Israel taudia na dare ena siahu ai o atodia kauva, edia hisi-ani negana ai, edia dava-abi orena ai;
english: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

motu: una dainai, (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu), lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena ai lau ese baina haheḡaeḡaemu rara ena, bona rara ese baine hahavamu; badina be rara vada o hahebubua, una dainai rara ese baine hahavamu.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.

motu: Seiri ororona na baina havahua bona baina habuaia tari; bona lao mai taudia iboudiai na iena amo baina hadokodia dae.
english: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

motu: Emu ororo iboudiai na e aladia mase taudia ai baina hahonudia; dare amo bae aladia mase taudia na emu ororo ai bona emu koura ai bona emu koura dobudobudia iboudiai lalodiai bae hekida diho.
english: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

motu: Baina habuamu tari hanaihanai, bona emu hanua na haida ese basie noholaidia. Bena vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: Badina be oi oto “Ini bese ruaosi bona ini tano ruaosi na lau ese baina abidia, bena ai ese baia ḡaunaidia”, (gau tamona Iehova na unuseni ai);
english: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although Yahweh was there,

motu: una dainai (Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu) lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena ai, oi ese o inai henidia dainai badu bona vaḡeḡe karadia o karalai henidia heḡereḡeredia ai lau ese baina kara henimu; bona bogaragimu ai baina hedinarai, baina hahemaoro henidia negana ai.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

motu: Bena ba diba, lau Iehova ese emu hereva, Israel ororodia o gonaḡonalaidia herevadia, iboudiai vada na kamonai; oto “Idia na vada e habuadia tari; vada e henimai, baia ha-oredia”.
english: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

motu: Sibomu emu heaḡi vada o habadaia, lau ihadikagu herevadia vada o gwaurai; bona emu hereva vada o hahohodia, lau ihadikagu; lau vada na kamonai.
english: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Tanobada idoinai ihamoalena totona lau ese baina habuamu tari.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

motu: Israel ahuna latanai o moaleva, vada e hebua tari dainai, heḡereḡerena ai lau ese baina kara henimu; oi danu ba hebua tari, Seiri ororona bona Edom idoinai, oibe, idoinai. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel ororodia ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Israel ororodia e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh’s word.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be inaimui ese e herevalaimui, eto ‘Aha”, bona “Ororo gunadia doridia vada a ḡaunaidia,”
english: The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’

motu: una dainai ba peroveta, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Oibe, badina be idia ese e habuamui tari, bona kaha iboudiai amo e taomui tari, bena bese oredia ese e ḡaunaimui, bona taunimanima ese e herevalaimui bona e hesivarailaimui.
english: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”

motu: Taunabunai, Israel ororodia e, Ḡaubada Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai; ororo badadia bona maraḡidia, bona koura dobudobudia bona koura iboudiai, bona gabu gagaedia bona hanua ahutudia, bese oredia hegegemadai ai ese damudia ai vada e halaodia bona vada e kirikirilaidiamu ḡaudia na Ḡaubada Iehova ese ini e hereva henidia tomamu.
english: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu vaḡeḡe bada lalonai lau ese bese oredia bona Edom idoinai danu na gwau dika henidiamu; idia ese egu tano e ḡaunaia mai moale badana bona mai hedadarai bada-hereana ida, bae abia bona lalonai bae dadidadi totona.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’

motu: Taunabunai, Israel tanona ba perovetalaia, ororo badadia bona maraḡidia, bona koura dobudobudia bona koura iboudiai, ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu vaḡeḡe baduna ai na herevamu; badina be bese idau-idau edia hedunirai herevadia na umui latamui ai.
english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Lau na gwau hamatamu, na tomu, e gegemui dae besedia latadiai hedunirai herevadia na bae kau.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

motu: A umui, Israel ororodia e, emui au rigidia bae gara kau, bona emui au huahuadia bae dobi, egu bese Israel adia; badina be asi vanahana edia gabu korikori bae lou henia.
english: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

motu: Badina be, a itaia, lau na umui ida; lau ese baina hageremui, bena bae ruamui bena uhemui bae hado.
english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.

motu: Bena lau ese taunimanima baina hahutumadia latamui ai, Israel besena idoinai, oibe, idoinai; hanua bae noholaidia, bona e heḡiḡi dobi hanuadia ma bae haginidia lou.
english: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

motu: Taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia na baina hahohodia umui latamui ai; bae hutuma, bae vara rohoroho. Bae noholaimui taudia baina hahutumadia, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia, bona baina hanamomui badabada. Bena vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: Oibe, baina gwau maoro, bena egu bese, Israel taudia, na latamui ai bae loaloa; bae ḡaunaimui, ahudia ai bae halaomui; bona natudia na mase ai basio abidia oho lou.
english: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Badina be taunimanima ese e gwau henimuimu, e tomu “Umui ese taunimanima o ha-orediamu bona emui bese taudia natudia na mase ai o abidia ohomu”,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

motu: una dainai umui ese taunimanina basio ha-oredia lou, bona emui bese taudia natudia na mase ai basio abidia oho lou. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Bena lau ese bese idau-idau baina gwaudia tubu, basie lodu henimui lou, bona taunimanima hemaraidia na basio hua lou, bona emui bese na basio hahekwakwanaia lou. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Israel besena taudia na edia tano korikori ai e nohova negana ai, idia ese edia dala bona edia kara amo e hamiroa; edia kara lau vairagu ai na mimiro, hahine ta ena rara-kara mirona na heto.
english: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

motu: Taunabunai egu badu na latadiai na bubua, idia ese rara na tano ai vada e hahebubua bona tano na kaivakuku amo e hamiroa davana.
english: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

motu: Bese idau-idau bogaragidiai na hakarohodia, bena tano idau-idau lalodiai e karoho rohoroho; edia noho bona edia kara heḡereḡeredia ai na hahemaoro henidia.
english: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.

motu: A bese idau-idau ediai e kau, bena e kau gabudia iboudiai lalodiai idia ese lau ladagu helaḡana e hamiroa; badina be taunimanima ese e herevalaidia, eto, Ina na Iehova ena orea taudia, ḡau tamona iena tano amo e harakadia lasi.
english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are Yahweh’s people, and have left his land.’

motu: A lau ladagu helaḡana, Israel taudia ese ediai e kau besedia bogaragididi e hamiroa ḡauna, na lau ese na helalolaia bada.
english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

motu: Taunabunai, Israel besena taudia ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena e, lau ba ḡaukaramu na dia umui daimui ai, to lau ladagu helaḡana, ediai o kau besedia bogaragidiai o hamiroa ḡauna, dainai.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

motu: Lau ladagu hereana ena helaḡa, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai vada e miro badina be umui ese vada o hamiroa ḡauna, na lau ese baina gwauraia maoro; bena umui emui amo egu helaḡa na idia vairadiai baina gwauraia maoro negana ai, bese idau-idau bae diba lau na Iehova. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh,” says the Lord Yahweh, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.

motu: Badina be bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo baina abimui, bona tano iboudiai lalodia amo baina gogomui, bena emui tano korikori ai baina hakamui vareai.
english: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

motu: Lau ese ranu negarinegarina amo baina sisirimui, bena emui miro idoinai amo ba ḡoeva; bona emui kaivakuku iboudiai edia amo baina haḡoevamui.
english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

motu: Lalo matamatana baina henimui, bona lauma matamatana na lalomui ai baina atoa; Ialo-auka na umui lalomui amo baina abia oho, Ialo-manada baina henimui.
english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

motu: Egu lauma na lalomui ai baina atoa; egu taravatu lalodiai baina harakamui; bona egu hahemaoro herevadia ibadinadia ai baina hamanadamui.
english: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.

motu: Senemui na henidia tanona ai ba noho; egu bese ai baola, lau danu emui Dirava ai bainala.
english: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

motu: Emui miro iboudiai amo baina haḡoevamui; bona uma ḡaudia baina haḡanidia, bae vara momo; basina hahitolomui.
english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

motu: Au huahuadia bona uma anianidia baina hahohodia; bena bese idau-idau bogaragidiai basio hemarai lou, hitolo dainai.
english: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

motu: Bena emui dala dikadia bona emui kara dia nanamo ba lalodia tao, bena sibomui ba hedadarai, emui kara havara bona emui kara dika-rohorohodia daidiai.
english: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, Baina ḡaukara, to dia umui daimui ai; una na ba diba. Israel besena taumui e, emui dala daidiai ba hemarai bona ba baia.
english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Emui kara havara iboudiai amo baina haḡoevamui dinana ai, lau ese taunimanima na hanua lalodiai baina hanohodia, bona e heḡiḡi dobi hanuadia na bae haginidia lou.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

motu: E vahu tanona na bae biru henia, bena raka-hanai taudia iboudiai ese vahuna ai basie itaia lou.
english: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.

motu: Bena idia na baeto, Hari e vahu tanona na Ede imeana heḡereḡerena ai vada ela; bona e havahudia, e habuadia tari, e ḡiḡidia dobi hanuadia na haida ese e noholaidiamubona e maḡudiamu.
english: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

motu: Bena doene e ḡeḡemui daemu besedia na bae diba lau Iehova ese e heḡiḡi dobi hanuadia vada na haginidia lou, bona e vahu tanodia ai vada na hadohado lou. Lau Iehova vada na hereva; bona karana do baina karaia.
english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, Yahweh, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena taudia baina ha-uradia dainai, ina danu egu ai bae noia; edia taunimanima na baina hahutumadia, mamoe serina na heto.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

motu: Boubou mamoedia serina na heto, e gwaurai hata negadia ariadia ai Ierusalem ai e habouamu serina na heto, vada e vahu hanuadia na taunimanima seridia ai bae honu. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova imana na latagu ai, bena ia ese Iehova ena Lauma amo e abigu, e laohaigu, koura ta ai e atogu diho; una koura na turia ai e honu.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

motu: Bena bogaragidiai e hakaugu eva-eva; na itadia, idia na momo herea una koura ai, bona idia na kakakoro.
english: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.

motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ini turia na bae mauri diba a? Lau na haere, nato, Ḡaubada Iehova e, oi hari mai dibamu.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I|strong="H3045" * answered, “ Lord|strong="H3069" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, you|strong="H3045" * know|strong="H3045" *.”

motu: Ma e hereva henigu, eto, Ini turia na ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Turia kakorodia e, Iehova ena hereva ba kamonai.
english: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova ese ini turia na ini e hereva henidiatomamu: A itaia, baina hahoho henimui, bena ba mauri.
english: The Lord Yahweh says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

motu: Varovaro na latamui ai baina atodia, bona hidiomui baina hadudu, bona kopi amo baina govamui; bena baina hahoho henimui, bena ba mauri. Bena ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

motu: Taunabunai, lau na peroveta, vada e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena; bena na perovetava lalonai hesede-hesede reḡena e reḡedagu; bena turia na e hahebou, turia ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai e hemudu-hemudu kau.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

motu: Na itadia negana ai, idia na mai varovarodia, bona hidio ese e hadududia ahu, bona kopi ese e ḡovadia, a dounu asi laḡadia.
english: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, laḡa ba peroveta henia, laḡa ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Laḡa e, lai haniosi kahadia amo baoma, ini vada e aladia mase taudia na ba hahoho henidia, bena bae mauri.
english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”

motu: Taunabunai, lau na peroveta, e haḡanigu heḡereḡerena, bena laḡa na idia lalodiai e vareai; bena e mauri, e tore isi, hutuma bada herea.
english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ini turia na Israel besena idoinai. A itaia, idia na e tomu, Turiamai vada e kakoro, emai helaro vada e boio; vada e negemai daure.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

motu: Taunabunai ba peroveta henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu bese e, a itaia, emui guri baina kehodia, emui guri amo baina hatoremui isi, bena baina hakaumui lou, Israel tanona ai.
english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

motu: Egu bese e, emui guri baina kehodia bona emui guri amo baina hatoremui isi negana ai, vada ba diba lau na Iehova.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

motu: Bena egu Lauma na lalomui ai baina atoa, bena ba mauri; bena emui tano korikori ai ma baina hanohomui. Bena ba diba, lau Iehova vada na hereva bona karana vada na karaia. Iehova na e herevamu. Iuda bona Israel bae tamona
english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, au ta bavabia bona ia latanai ba torea: “Iuda, bona Israel taudia ia ida e heboumu, edia”. Bena au ma ta bavabia bona ia latanai ba torea: “Iosef (Efraim auna), bona Israel besena idoinai ia ida e heboumu, edia”.
english: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’

motu: Bena au ruaosi ba hahesiriudia, au tamona ai baela oi imamu ai.
english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

motu: Bena emu orea taudia ese bae nanadaimu, baeto “Ina kara anina basioma hamaorolaimai a?” negana ai
english: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’

motu: ba haere henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, Iosef bona Israel iduhudia ia ida e heboumu edia au (Efraim imana ai e miamu ḡauna) aina abia, Iuda ena au ida baina hahesiriudia, au tamona ai baina halaodia lau imagu ai.
english: tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

motu: Hari latadiai revareva vada o tore audia na idia vairadiai ui imamu ai bae mia negana ai,
english: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’

motu: ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, lau ese Israel taudia na bogaragidiai vada ela besedia edia amo ma baina abidia, kaha iboudiai amo baina haboudia, edia tano korikori lalonai baina hakaudia vareai.
english: Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.

motu: Bena bese tamona ai baina halaodia una tano ai, Israel ororodia ai; pavapava tamona ese iboudiai baine pavapavadia. Idia na bese rua ai basie hahelao lou, bona basileia rua ai basie haheparara lou.
english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

motu: Edia kaivakuku eiava edia ḡau dika-rohorohodia eiava edia kerere amo sibodia basie hahemiro lou; a edia raka muri ai e kara dika karadia iboudiai amo baina hamauridia bona baina haḡoevadia. Idia na lauegu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala.
english: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

motu: Egu hesiai tauna David ese baine pavapavadia; iboudiai na ireḡudia tauna tamona ese baine regudia. Egu hahemaoro herevadia na bae gavadia, bona egu taravatu na bae badinadia namonamo.
english: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.

motu: Senemui ese e noholaia tanona, egu hesiai tauna Iakob na henia tanona, lalonai bae noho; idia bona natudia bona garadia na unuseni ai bae noho, ela bona hanaihanai; bona egu hesiai tauna David ese baine pavapavadia hanaihanai.
english: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.

motu: Lau na idia ida baia herohemaino; emai herohemaino baine hesiriu hanaihanai. Lau ese baina hanamodia bona baina hahutumadia; egu gabu helaḡana na idia bogaragidiai baina atoa, unuseni ai baine mia hanaihanai.
english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.

motu: Idia ida baina noho; edia Dirava ai bainala, egu bese ai baela.
english: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

motu: Bena egu gabu helaḡana na idia bogaragidiai e miamu ma baine mia hanaihanai dainai, bese idau-idau na bae diba lau Iehova ese Israel na hahelagaiamu.
english: The nations will know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Gog, Magog tanona tauna, Mesek bona Tubal lohiadia badana, ba vaira henia bona latanai ba peroveta,
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

motu: baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Gog e, Mesek bona Tubal lohiadia badana e, lau ese oi na inai henimumu;
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

motu: baina haginimu kerehai, igau na aukimu ai baina ḡau, bena baina verimu lasi; bona emu tuari oreana idoinai danu, hosi bona hosi-gui taudia, iboudiai na mai edia tuari dabuadia, tau-anidia iḡovalai-ḡuḡurudia ḡaudia, orea bada-hereana, iboudiai na mai edia keme auridia bona kesi, bona mai edia dare imadia ai.
english: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;

motu: Parasa bona Kusu bona Put taudia na idia ida; iboudiai na mai edia kesi bona auri kwara-gaudia;
english: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

motu: Gomere mai ena hutuma idoinai ida; Bete-togarama danu mirigini kahana gabu daudaudia amo, mai ena hutuma idoinai ida; bese momo na oi ida.
english: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.

motu: A hegaegae, bona ba heḡaeḡae noho, oi bona emu ai e heboumu oreadia badadia iboudiai, bona ba gimadia.
english: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.

motu: Dina hoho muridiai bae haheboumui; bena laḡani gabedia ai tuari ena hahedika amo vada e hanamoa lou tanona, bese loḡora bogaragidia amo taunimanima na Israel ororodia ai vada e haboudia tanona, vada e vahu loulou tanona, na umui ese do ba tuari henia. Ena taunimanima na bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo e hakaudia lasi, bona harihari idia iboudiai na e noho namonamomu.
english: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.

motu: A ba orea isi, baola, lai gubana na heto, dagadaga ese tano bema ḡovaia ahu na heto, oi bona emu hutuma idoinai bona bese momo oi ida.
english: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Una dina ai lalo-hadai haida na lalomu ai bae vara, bena kara dikana ta ba laloa hata,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

motu: baoto, Lau ese asi maḡudia hanuadia tanona baina tuari henia; unu asi reḡereḡedia e noho namonamomu, edia ruma na asi maḡudia, asi auridia, asi ikoukoudia, taudia na baina daedia;
english: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

motu: edia kohu baina dadi, bona baina dadi ḡaudia na baina laohai; gunaguna e vahu a harihari taunimanima ese e noholaimu gabudia baina tuari henidia; bona bese idau-idau bogaragidia amo vada e hahebou edia boromakau bona edia kohu vada e habou taudia, tano bogaraginai e nohomu taudia, danu baina tuari henidia.
english: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’

motu: Sieba bona Dedan, bona Tarasisi ena hoihoi taudia bona hanuana iboudiai, ese bae nanadaimu, baeto, Oi na kohu idadidia totona vada oma a? Emu hutuma vada o haheboudia, ba dadi kohudia bae hua lao, silver * bona gold * bae huadia lao bona boromakau bona kohu bae laohaidia, ḡau momo herea bae dadi totona a?
english: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima natuna e, ba peroveta, Gog ba hamaoroa, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Una dina ai egu bese Israel e noho namonamomu negana ai, oi na ba tore isi,
english: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?

motu: emu gabu, mirigini kahana gabu daudaudia, amo baoma, oi bona bese momo oi ida, iboudiai na hosi ai bae gui, hutuma bada-herea, tuari oreana mai goadana.
english: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.

motu: Baoma, egu bese Israel taudia ba daedia, dagadaga ese tano e ḡovaia ahumu na heto. Dina gabedia ai, lau ese baina hakaumu mai, egu tano ituari-henina totona; bena oiemu amo, Gog e, egu helaḡa na bese idau-idau vairadiai baina hamomokania, unu amo idia ese bae dibagu.
english: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you, Gog, before their eyes.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Nega gunadia ai egu hesiai taudia, Israel ena peroveta taudia, ududia amo na herevalaia tauna na oi a? Idia na laḡani gunadia lalodiai e perovetava oi baina mailaimu idia ituarihenidia totona.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova ma e tomu, A una dina ai, Gog ese Israel tanona ituari-henina bainema dinana ai, egu badu baine vara.
english: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.

motu: Badina be egu vaḡeḡe ai bona egu badu ḡaraḡara ai na gwaumu, Una dina ai Israel tanona baine heude-heude bada;
english: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken. Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel,

motu: davara gwarumedia, atai manudia, uda boromadia, tano ai e raumu ḡaudia iboudiai, bona tanobada latanai e nohomu taudia iboudiai danu, bae heude-heude lau vairagu ai; ororo danu bae heḡiḡi dobi bona haga nadidia bae moru, bona maḡu iboudiai na tano ai bae heḡiḡi dobi.
english: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e lomu, Hahegari karadia idau-idau iboudiai baina havaradia, Gog ihadikana; taunimanima iboudiai na tadikakadia ida bae heala-ala heheni, edia dare amu.
english: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.

motu: Dai-hanai gorerena bona rara ihahebubuna amo baina hahemaoro henia, bona medu bada-hereadia bona medu-hetaridia, lahi bona teio na ia bona ena hutuma bona baine bamoa besedia loḡora latadiai baina hadiho. + 38:22 Teio; Nadi ta ladana, Helene gado ai. E aramu bena bonana dika-hereana e daemu, taunimanima e hamasediamu. Ladana English gado ai na “sulphur”. *
english: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.

motu: Unu amo egu herea-dae bona egu helaḡa baina hahedinaraidia, bona bese momo vairadiai sibogu baina hahedinarai. Bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”’

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Gog latanai ba peroveta, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Gog e, Mesek bona Tubal lohiadia badana, lau ese na inai henimumu;
english: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

motu: lau ese baina haginimu kerehai bona baina lulumu lao, mirigini kahana gabu daudaudia amo baina mailaimu, baina hakaumu, Israel ororodia ituari-henidia ai;
english: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.

motu: bena emu peva na imamu laurina amo baina pataia oho, bona emu diba na imamu idibana amo baina hamorudia.
english: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.

motu: Bena Israel ororodia ba hekida diho, oi bona emu hutuma idoinai bona e bamomumu besedia; bena lau ese baina abimui, kasiri-ani manudia idau-idau bona uda bolomadia adia ai baina halaomui;
english: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.

motu: tano paka ai do ba hekida diho, badina be lau, Ḡaubada Iehova, vada na hereva.
english: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Lau ese lahi baina siaia lao, Magog latanai, bona kone tanodia ai e noho namonamomu taudia latadiai; bena idia bae diba lau na Iehova.
english: “I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

motu: Bena lau ladagu helaḡana baina hahedibalaia, egu bese Israel bogaraginai; baina gwaudia tao, lau ladagu helaḡana basie hamiroa lou; bena bese idau-idau na bae diba, lau na Iehova, Helaḡa Diravana Israel ai.
english: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh, the Holy One in Israel.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na e tomu, A itaia, ia na e maimu, vada be kaumu. Lau ese vada na herevalaia dinana bunai.
english: Behold, it comes, and it will be done,” says the Lord Yahweh. “This is the day about which I have spoken.

motu: Bena Israel hanuadia e noholaidiamu taudia na bae raka lasi, tuari ḡaudia na Iahi ai bae haboudia, bae doudia; kesi bona keme auridia, peva bona diba, kareva bona io. Lahi audia ai bae halaodia ela bona laḡani hitu bae ore;
english: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;

motu: taunabunai idia ese au na tano paka ai basie abi eiava uda ai basie utu, badina be edia lahi na unu tuari ḡaudia amo bae raku; edia ḡau e dadi taudia ediai ḡau ma bae dadi, bona edia kohu e abi oho taudia ediai kohu ma bae abi oho. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Una dina ai lau ese Gog na gara gabuna ta baina henia Israel ai, koura ta ladana na “Laolao taudia edia Koura”, Tadi Gohuna mairiveina kahana ai. Laolao taudia edia dala na baine helao ahu, badina be unuseni ai Gog bona ena hutuma idoinai na bae guridia; ladana bae hatoa Hamono-gog Kourana.
english: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.

motu: Hua hitu lalodiai Israel besena taudia ese bae guridia, tano ihaḡoevana totona.
english: “‘“The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.

motu: Tano taudia iboudiai ese bae guridia; bena idia haridia bae namo, lau ese hairaigu baina hahedinaraia dinana ai. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Tatau haida bae gwauraidia hidi, idia ese tano bae rakaia hanai loulou bona tano kopina ai miadia taudia bae guridia totona; unu amo tano bae haḡoevaia. Hua hitu bae ore ai do bae hetahu.
english: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.

motu: Bena tano iraka-hanaina ai idia ta ese tau ta turiana baine davaria negana ai, ia ese toa ta baine holoa una turia badibadinai, ela bona mase iguridia taudia ese Hamono-gog Kourana ai bae ḡuria.
english: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.

motu: (Hanua ta ladana Hamona na unuseni ai danu.) Tano na unu bae haḡoevaia toma.
english: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’

motu: Taunimanima natuna e, Ḡaubada Iehova ese ini e hereva henimu tomamu: Manu idau-idau bona uda boromadia iboudiai na ba hereva henidia, baoto, Ba hegogo bena baoma; kaha iboudiai amo ba hebou, boubou ariana lau ese na hegaegaelaiamu amui na bavania, boubou ariana badana Israel ororodia ai; vamu bame ani bona rara bame inu.
english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.

motu: Goada-herea taudia hidiodia bavani, bona tanobada lohiadia raradia ba inu; mamoe mamaruanedia bona mamoe natudia bona nani bona boromakau mamaruanedia danu, iboudiai na Basan ubu-ubu boromadia.
english: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

motu: Digara bavania, ela bona bogamui bae kunuka-kunuka, bona rara ba inua, ela bona ba kekero, hari boubou ariana, amui na heḡaeḡaelaiamu ḡauna, lalonai.
english: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

motu: Egu dabara ai, hosi bona hosi-gui taudia amo, goada-herea taudia bona tuari taudia idau-idau amo, bogamui do bae kunu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord Yahweh.’

motu: Lau hairaigu na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina hahedinaraia; bena bese iboudiai ese egu hahemaoro karana bona imagu, latadiai na atoa ḡauna, bae itadia.
english: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.

motu: Israel besena na una dina amo bae diba, lau na Iehova, edia Dirava.
english: So the house of Israel will know that I am Yahweh their God, from that day and forward.

motu: Bena bese idau-idau na bae diba, Israel besena na iḡui gabuna ai ela, edia kara havara dainai; badina be edia kara amo e koigu dikadika dainai lau ese vairagu na edia amo na hunia, bona adia inai taudia imadia ai na atodia, bena iboudiai na dare ai e mase.
english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.

motu: Edia miro bona edia kerere heḡereḡeredia ai na kara henidia, bona vairagu na edia amo na hunia.
english: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomaunu: Harihari Iakob ena noho-namo baina havaraia lou, bona Israel besena idoinai baina bogaia hisi; bona lau ladagu helaḡana vageḡena baina vageḡe.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.

motu: Bena bese idauidau bogaragidia amo baina loulaidia, bona inaidia edia tano hidaosi amo baina haboudia, bona idia edia amo egu helaḡa na bese momo vairadiai baina hamomokania negana ai, idia ese edia hemarai bae laloa boio, bona edia kara koikoi, lau e koilaigu karadia, edia tano ai e noho namonamova bona haida ese asie hagaridiava negadia ai e karava karadia, danu bae lalo boio.
english: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid
when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.

motu: Bena idia bae diba, lau na Iehova, edia Dirava; badina be gabu daudau ai na hanohodia, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, bena ma na gogodia lou, edia tano korikori ai. Lau ese idia ta na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai basina rakataia lou;
english: They will know that I am Yahweh their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.

motu: bona vairagu na edia amo basina hunia lou; egu Lauma ese Israel besena baine rohea. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

motu: Dauhai e hanohomai laḡanina iharuahui-imana matamana ai, hua dinana ihagwautana ai, hanua badana e hadarerea murinai laḡani gwauta-hani vada e lao bubuni ai, una dina lalonai Iehova imana na vada latagu ai;
english: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.

motu: bena Dirava ese e henigu mata-hanaidia ai Israel tanona e laohaigu, ororo badana ta dorina ai e haginigu diho, ḡau ta, ita-itana na hanua badana ta na heto, hevaira-hehenina ai.
english: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.

motu: Unuseni ai e haginigu diho negana ai, tau ta na itaia, ita-itana na auri labora-labora na heto, mai ena hahetoho varona bona ena hahetoho sirihona imana ai. Ia na ikoukou ai e gini.
english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

motu: Bena una tau ese e hereva henigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, lau ese baina haheitalaimu ḡaudia iboudiai na matamu amo ba itadia, bona taiamu amo ba kamonai bona lalomu amo ba haerodia, badina be ini ḡau baina haheitalaimu totona e mailaimu iniseni ai. Ba ita ḡaudia iboudiai na Israel besena taudia ba hamaorolaidia.
english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

motu: Bena na itaia, maḡu ta ese dubu tanona e ḡeḡea dae. Hari hahetoho sirihona una tau imana ai latana na kiubit badadia tauratoi. + 40:5 Kiubit hadadia tauratoi = 3 metres sisivana. * (Unu kiubit badadia ta anina be kiubit idoinai ta bona ima-palapala lababana ta). Bena ia ese maḡu udunana e hahetohoa, hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena; harana latana danu hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena.
english: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits + 40:5 A normal cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. A handbreadth is about 4.3 inches or 11 centimeters, so the long cubit described here would be about 22.3 inches or 57 centimeters long. Thus, a 6 long cubit measuring reed would have been about 3 yards 26.6 inches or about 3.42 meters long. * long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

motu: Bena mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna idae-lao-henina ai, vadavadana amo e dae; bena ikoukou raka-vareaina e hahetohoa, lababana na hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena.
english: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.

motu: Ohe daiutudia danu latadiai na hahetoho sirihona auta, bona lababadia danu hahetoho sirihona auta. Daiutu padadia na kiubit ima. Ikoukou raka-vareaina, ikoukou dehena laloma kahana ai, na hahetoho sirihona auta heḡereḡerena.
english: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

motu: Bena ia ese ikoukou dehena e hahetohoa: ia na kiubit taurahani;
english: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

motu: bona ena ihua-ihua danu, idia na kiubit rua. Hari ikoukou dehena na laloma kahana ai.
english: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

motu: Mairiveina kahana ikoukouna ohena kahana kahana na daiutu toi toi amo; toiosi edia bada na heḡereḡere; bona ohe kahana kahana ihua-ihuadia edia bada danu heḡereḡere.
english: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

motu: Bena ia ese ikoukou raka-lasina e hahetohoa, kiubit gwauta; bona ikoukou idoinai lababana, kiubit gwauta-toi.
english: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

motu: Ohe kahana kahana daiutudia na mai seaseadia lababadia kiubit tamona, bona hari daiutu na kiubit tauratoi, ohe kahana kahana ai.
english: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

motu: Bena ikoukou na e hahetohoa, ohena ta daiutuna durana iduarana amo ela bona ma ohena ta daiutuna durana iduarana, lababa idoinai na kiubit ruahui-ima, iduara amo ela bona iduara.
english: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.

motu: Dehe danu e hahetohoa, kiubit ruahui; maḡu ta ese ikoukou dehena e ḡeḡea dae.
english: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.

motu: Ikoukou vaira-kahana raka-vareaina ela bona ikoukou lalona kahana dehena na kiubit imahui.
english: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

motu: Ikoukou heḡeḡemadai ai na gaba-mauru haida; ihua-ihua padadia na hahaga murimuri kahadia ai bona i'iora laloma kahadia at; bona dehe danu mai gaba-mauruna laloma kahana hegegemadai ai. Ihua-ihua ai be pamu audia laulaudia.
english: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.

motu: Bena ia ese murimuri kahana maḡuna lalonai e hakaugu vareai; unuseni ai daiutu haida bona nadi ariarana ta na itadia, maḡu e ḡegea dae; daiutu toi-ahui ese hari nadi ariarana e vaira henia.
english: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.

motu: Hari nadi ariarana na ikoukou badibadidiai ela; lababana na hari ikoukou lababadia heḡereḡeredia. Una nadi ariarana na henu ariarana.
english: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

motu: Bena ia ese hari henu ikoukouna ena laloma kahana bona laloma maḡuna ena murimuri kahana padadia e hahetohoa; padadia na kiubit sinahu-ta. Bena ia na lau vairagu ai ela, mirigini kahana ala;
english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

motu: unuseni ai ikoukou ta ese mirigini kahana e vaira henia; una na murimuri kahana maḡuna ikoukouna. Ia ese latana bona lababana e hahetohodia.
english: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.

motu: Ena ohe daiutudia, toi kahana ai toi kahana ai, bona ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe edia bada na ikoukou gini-gunana ena heḡereḡeredia; latana na kiubit imahui bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
english: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

motu: Ena gaba-mauru, ena dehe bona ena pamu audia laulaudia edia bada na hari mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna ena heḡereḡeredia. Vadavada moi-kaudia auhitu amo e dae henia; bona dehena na ena laloma kahana ai.
english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.

motu: Hari mirigini kahana ikoukouna hevaira-hehenina ai na laloma maḡuna ikoukouna ta, mairiveina kahana ḡauna heḡereḡerena; bena ia ese padadia e hahetohoa, ikoukou ta ela bona ikoukou ta padadia na kiubit sinahu-ta.
english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.

motu: Bena ia ese diho kahana ma e hakaugu lao; bena ikoukou ma ta na itaia diho kahana ai. Ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe e hahetohodia; edia bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

motu: Gaba-mauru ese ia bona ia dehena e haheḡeḡedia dae, unu haida edia gaba-mauru heḡereḡeredia; ia latana na kiubit imahui bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
english: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

motu: Vadavada moi-kaudia auhitu amo e dae henia, bona dehena na ena laloma kahana ai; ena ihua-ihua ai na pamu audia laulaudia, ta ohena ta ai, ma ta ohena ta ai.
english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

motu: Laloma maḡuna ena diho kahana na mai ikoukouna. Bena ia ese padadia e hahetohoa, ikoukou ta amo ela bona ikoukou ta, diho kahana ai; padadia na kiubit sinahu-ta.
english: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.

motu: Bena ia ese laloma maḡuna lalonai e hakaugu vareai, diho kahana ikoukouna amo. Bena ia ese diho kahana ikoukouna e hahetohoa; ena bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
english: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;

motu: Ena ohe kahana kahana daiutudia, ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe na unu haida heḡereḡeredia; gaba-mauru ese ia bona ia dehena e haheḡeḡedia dae; ia latana na kiubit imahui bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

motu: Dehe haida ma e ḡegea dae, latadia na kiubit ruahui-ima bona lababadia na kiubit ima.
english: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

motu: Dehena na murimuri kahana maḡuna e vaira henia; ena ihua-ihua ai na pamu audia laulaudia; vadavada moi-kaudia taurahani amo e dae henia.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.

motu: Bena ia ese laloma kahana maḡuna ai e hakaugu vareai, mairiveina kahana ai. Ia ese ikoukou e hahetohoa; ena bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
english: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;

motu: Ena ohe kahana kahana daiutudia, ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe edia bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia. Gaba-mauru ese e haheḡeḡea dae. Ia latana na kiubit imahui, bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

motu: Ia dehena ese murimuri kahana maḡuna e vaira henia. Ena ihua-ihua ai na pamu audia laulaudia, ta ohena ta ai, ma ta ohena ta ai. Vadavada moi-kaudia taurahani amo e dae henia.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

motu: Bena ia ese ma e hakaugu lao, mirigini kahana ikoukouna ala. Bena e hahetohoa; ena bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia.
english: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—

motu: Ena ohe kahana kahana daiutudia, ena ihua-ihua bona ena dehe edia bada na unu haida edia heḡereḡeredia. Gaba-mauru ese e haheḡeḡea dae. Ia latana na kiubit imahui, bona lababana na kiubit ruahui-ima.
english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

motu: Ia dehena ese murimuri kahana ikoukouna e vaira henia. Ena ihua-ihua ai na pamu audia laulaudia, ta ohena ta ai, ma ta ohena ta ai. Vadavada moi-kaudia taurahani amo e dae henia.
english: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

motu: Daiutu ta iduarana na ikoukou dehena ai; unuseni ai ḡole-oho boubouna na bae huria.
