english: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.

motu: Ikoukou dehena ai danu na pata rua, ohe kahana kahana ai; idia latadiai ḡole-oho bona kara dika bona kerere boubou ḡaudia bae aladia mase.
english: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

motu: Dehe murimurina kahana ai, mirigini kahana ikoukouna raka-vareaina ai, na pata rua; hona ikoukou dehena kahanadanu pata rua.
english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.

motu: Pata hani na laloma kahana ai bona pata hani na murimuri kahana ai, ikoukou raka-vareaina ai; pata taurahaniosi latadiai boubou ḡaudia na bae aladia mase.
english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

motu: E utu hata nadidia patadia hani danu mimia, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia patadia. Latadia na kiubit ta mai kahana, lababadia danu kiubit ta mai kahana, bona haradia latadia be kiubit tamona. Ḡole-oho bouboudia bona boubou haida ialalaidia ḡaudia na unu pata latadiai bae heato.
english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

motu: Igau haida danu, edia lata na ima-palapala ta lababana heḡereḡerena, na lalonai e hetau dae heḡeḡe. Unu pata latadiai na boubou ḡaudia hidiodia bae atodia.
english: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.

motu: Bena ia ese murimuri kahana amo e hakaugu vareai, laloma maḡuna lalonai; unuseni ai daiutu rua na itadia, laloma maḡuna lalonai. Ta be mirigini kahana ikoukouna badibadinai, diho kahana e vaira henia. Ma ta be diho kahana ikoukouna badibadinai, mirigini kahana e vaira henia.
english: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.

motu: Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina diho kahana e vaira heniamu daiutuna na hahelaḡa taudia, dubu e biaguamu taudia, edia;
english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

motu: bona mirigini kahana e vaira heniamu daiutuna na hahelaḡa taudia, ihaboulaina patana e biaguamu taudia, edia. Unu na Sadok garana; Levi garana iboudiai bogaragidiai amo idia sibodia ese Iehova bae raka henia kahi, isiaina ilao-henina totona.
english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.”

motu: Bena ia ese maḡu e hahetohoa: ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta bona ena lababa na kiubit sinahu-ta; kahana haniosi na heḡereḡere. Ihaboulaina patana na dubu vairanai.
english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lao, dubu dehena ala. Ia ese dehe ihua-ihuana e hahetohodia; idia na kiubit ima, ohe kahana kahana ai. Ikoukou lababana na kiubit gwauta-hani; bona ikoukou ohena habadia na kiubit toi, ohe kahana kahana ai.
english: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

motu: Dehe ena lata na kiubit ruahui, bona ena lababa na kiubit gwauta-rua. Vadavada moi-kaudia gwauta amo e dae henia; bona ihua-ihua badibadidiai na au-tubua, ohe kahana kahana ai.
english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

motu: Bena ia ese dubu ai e hakaugu vareai; bena ihua-ihua e hahetohodia. Ohe kahana kahana ai ihua-ihua padadia na kiubit tauratoi.
english: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

motu: Rakavareaina lababana na kiubit gwauta; bona raka-vareaina ohena habadia na kiubit ima, ohe kahana kahana ai. Dubu laloma kahana e hahetohoa; ena lata na kiubit hari-ahui bona ena lababa na kiubit ruahui.
english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, + 41:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

motu: Bena ia ese laloma daiutuna ai e raka vareai, raka-vareaina ihua-ihuana e hahetohodia, kiubit rua; bona raka-vareaina lababana, kiubit tauratoi; bona raka-vareaina ohena habadia, kiubit hitu.
english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

motu: Daiutu e hahetohoa, ena lata bona ena lababa na kiubit ruahui, dubu durana kahana ai. Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na gabu helaḡa-hereana.
english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

motu: Bena ia ese dubu habana e hahetohoa, udunana na kiubit tauratoi. Ohena daiutudia lababadia na kiubit hani, idia ese dubu e haheḡeḡea dae.
english: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

motu: Hari ohe daiutudia na ere toi, latana latana ai. Daiutu na toi-ahui toi-ahui amo, ere Ia ta ai. Dubu heḡeḡemadai ai to-tao ḡaudia e kara, dubu habana ai, bena daiutu lavadia na unu ḡau latadiai e heato kau, unu lava na dubu habana lalonai basie hetoi vareai helaoreana.
english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

motu: Hari ohe kahana kahanil daiutudia lababadia na e bada e laova, henu erena amo ela bona atai erena, to-tao ḡaudia na henu erena amo ela bona atai erena e bada e laova heḡereḡerena, dubu heḡeḡemadai ai. Dubu ohena ai vadavada ta e daeva, unu amo taunimanima na henu erena amo e dara daeva ela bona bogaragi erena, bona bogaragi erena amo e dara daeva ela bona atai erena.
english: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

motu: Na itaia danu, dubu heḡeḡemadai ai na patapata ta. Hari ohe kahana kahana daiutudia badidia na e hahetohodia, idia na hahetoho sirihona idoi ta, kiubit badadia tauratoi heḡereḡerena.
english: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

motu: Ohe kahana kahana daiutudia murimuridia kahadia habadia lababadia na kiubit ima; patapata mia-ḡaḡaena kahana lababana na kiubit ima. Hari dubu patapatana
english: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

motu: bona maḡu daiutudia padadia na kiubit ruahui, dubu hegegemadai idoinai.
english: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

motu: Hari ohe kahana kahana daiutudia iduaradia na patapata mia-ḡaḡaena kahana ai e hekeho, iduara ta na mirigini kahana e vaira henia, bona iduara ta na diho kahana e vaira henia. Una patapata mia-ḡaḡaena kahana lababana na kiubit ima, dubu heḡeḡemadai ai.
english: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

motu: Lahara kahana ai dubu maḡuna e vaira henia rumana ena lababa nil kiubit hitu-ahui. Ruma habana udunana na kiubit ima, ruma heḡeḡemadai ai; bona ena lata na kiubit taurahanita-ahui.
english: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

motu: Bena ia ese dubu e hahetohoa, ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta; bona maḡu mai rumana ida edia lata na kiubit sinahu-ta;
english: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

motu: bona dubu mai maḡuna ida, mairiveina kahana ai, labahadia na kiubit sinahu-ta.
english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

motu: Bena ia ese maḡu e vaira henia rumana, lahara kahana ai, mai ohe kahana kahana habadia ida, e hahetohodia, latadia na kiubit sinahu-ta. Dubu laloma kahana hona laloma daiutuna bona murimuri kahana dehena habadia
english: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

motu: na mai iḡovalaidia reireidia, bona toiosi heḡeḡemadai ai na gaba-mauru; unu gaba-maurudia ioradia na au rotonadia amo e kara. Rakavareaina hevaira-hehenina habana heḡeḡemadai ai na mai iḡovalaina reireidia, ruma reireina amo ela bona gaba-mauru, (hari gaba-mauru na mai ikoulaidia ḡaudia),
english: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

motu: ma ela bona iduara daena, ma ela bona laloma daiutuna, bona murimuri ai danu. Bona haba iboudiai heḡeḡemadai ai, laloma daiutuna ai bona dubu ai, na laulau e koro:
english: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

motu: kerubi laulaudia bona pamu audia laulaudia; kerubi padadia amo na pamu audia ta ta. Kerubi ta ta vairadia na rua rua:
english: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

motu: vaira ta, taunimanima vairana na heto, ese pamu auna ta e vaira henia ohena ta ai; bona vaira ta, leona natuna vairana na heto, ese pamu auna ta e vaira henia, ohena ma ta ai. Idia na dubu idoinai heḡeḡemadai ai e hekoro;
english: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

motu: dubu reireina amo ela bona iduara daena, kerubi bona pamu audia laulaudia na haba ai e hekoro.
english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

motu: Dubu iduarana ihua-ihuadia na kaha haniosi heḡereḡere audia. Gabu helaḡana vairanai na ḡau ta,
english: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

motu: ita-itana na pata helaḡana, au amo e karaia ḡauna; harana latana na kiubit toi, bona latana bona lababana na kiubit rua. Daigunina bona badina bona habahabana na au amo e kara. Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na Iehova vairanai e miamu patana.
english: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before Yahweh.”

motu: Dubu bona gabu helaḡana ruaosi iduaradia na kaha rua rua amo.
english: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

motu: Iduara ta ta mai kahadia rua rua, bona kaha ruaosi e helokuva bona e hulalava, iduara ta ta ai.
english: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

motu: Dubu iduaradia kopidia ai kerubi bona pamu audia laulaudia na e hekoro, haba ai e hekoro na heto. Bona murimuri ai dehe na mai guhina, au-reireidia amo e karaia.
english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

motu: Ohe kahana kahana ai, dehe ohena habadia ai, na gaba-mauru, ioradia na au rotonadia amo e kara ḡaudia; bona pamu audia laulaudia danu.
english: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lao, laloma maḡuna lalonai, mirigini kahana ai, ela bona dubu maḡuna bona mirigini kahana rumana e vaira henidia daiutudia.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

motu: Hari mirigini kahana rumana ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta bona ena lalaba na kiubit imahui.
english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits + 42:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

motu: Laloma kahana maḡuna ena kiubit ruahui badibadidiai bona murimuri kahana maḡuna nadi-ariarana vairanai na dehe haida e hevaira heheniva, ere toiosi ai.
english: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

motu: Daiutu vairadiai, raka-hanai gabuna ta ese laloma kahana e lao heniava, ena lababa na kiubit gwauta bona ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ta; daiutu iduaradia na mirigini kahana ai.
english: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

motu: Atai daiutudia na taidia i'iora, badina be idia dehedia lababadia na taidia babada a henu bona bogaragi eredia dehedia lababadia na taidia mamaraḡi.
english: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

motu: Badina be idia na ere toi ai bona asi edia au-tubua, murimuri kahana maḡuna ena au-tubua heḡereḡeredia, una dainai atai daiutudia na taidia mamaraḡi a henu bona bogaragi eredia daiutudia na taidia babada.
english: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

motu: Murimuri ai na hehari maḡuna ta, ia bona hari daiutu padadia idoinai na heḡereḡere. Ia na murimuri kahana maḡuna e lao heniava, bona daiutu e vaira henidiava. Ena lata na kiubit imahui.
english: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

motu: Badina be murimuri kahana maḡuna daiutudia edia lata na kiubit imahui, a dubu e vaira heniava daiutudia edia lata na kiubit sinahu-ta.
english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

motu: Ini daiutu henudiai na raka-vareai gabuna ta, mairiveina kahana ai, murimuri kahana maḡuna amo daiutu lalodiai e raka vareaiva gabuna ai.
english: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

motu: Murimuri kahana maḡuna na unu amo e hematama. Diho kahana ai danu, maḡu bona ruma hegaga-henina ai na daiutu haida,
english: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

motu: bona raka-hanai gabuna ta na idia vairadiai. Idia na mirigini kahana daiutudia heḡereḡeredia, edia lata bona edia lababa na unu idia ida heheḡereḡere; edia raka lasi gabudia bona ihaginidia daladia bona iduara danu na unu idia ida heheḡereḡere.
english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

motu: Hari diho kahana daiutudia henudiai na raka-vareai gabuna ta, mairiveina kahana ai, unuseni ai raka-hanai gabuna ai e raka vareaimu. Idia vairadiai be hehari maḡuna ta.
english: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Mirigini bona diho kahadia daiutudia, maḡu hevaira-hehenina ai, na daiutu helagadia; hahelaḡa taudia ese Iehova bae raka henia kahi negadia ai, herahia anianidia helaḡa-hereadia na unuseni ai bae ani; unuseni ai herahia anianidia helaḡa-hereadia bae atodia - naoa boubouna, bona kara dika bona kerere iabi-ohodia bouboudia ḡaudia; badina be una gabu na helaḡa.
english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia na gabu helaḡana ai bae raka vareai negadia ai, idia na unu amo basie raka lasi murimuri kahana maḡuna ai ela bona kara helaḡadia ikaradia totona e hahedokilai dabuadia na unuseni ai bae dokidia oho bona bae atodia guna, badina be unu dabua na hehelaga. Idia ese dabua idaudia bae dokilaidia guna, bena hanua taudia edia gabu bae raka henia kahi.
english: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

motu: Ia ese dubu maḡuna laloma kahana e hahetohoa vaitani, bena mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna amo e hakaugu lasi, bena dubu maḡuna murimurina kahana e hahetohoa heḡeḡe.
english: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

motu: Mairiveina kahana na hahetoho sirihona amo e hahetohoa; ia na kiubit sinahu-ima, hahetoho sirihona ai.
english: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

motu: Bena kahana ma ela, mirigini kahana e hahetohoa, kiubit sinahu-ima hahetoho sirihona ai.
english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

motu: Ma kahana ela, diho kahana e hahetohoa, kiubit sinahu-ima hahetoho sirihona ai.
english: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

motu: Ma kahana ela, lahara kahana e hahetohoa, kiubit sinahu-ima hahetoho sirihona ai.
english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

motu: Ia ese kaha haniosi e hahetohodia. Magu ta ese e ḡegea ahu, ena lata na kiubit sinahu-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit sinahu-ima; una maḡu ese tano helaḡana bona tano uhuḡaina e kaharuadiava.
english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

motu: Una murinai ia ese e hakaugu lao, mairiveina kahana e vaira henia ikoukouna ai.
english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.

motu: Bena Israel Diravana hairaina na itaia, mairiveina kahana amo ema. Ena mai reḡena na sinavai momo reḡedia na heheto; bena ia hairaina ese tanobada na e hakiama-kiamaia.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

motu: Egu mata-hanai na hanua ihabua-tarina totona ema negana ai na mata hanailaia ḡauna bona Kebara sinavaina badibadinai na mata hanailaia ḡauna heḡereḡeredia. Bena tano ai na goru diho.
english: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

motu: Bena Iehova hairaina na mairiveina kahana e vaira heniava ikoukouna amo dubu ai e vareai negana ai,
english: Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.

motu: Lauma ese e abigu isi, laloma kahana maḡuna lalonai e laohaigu; bena na itaia, Iehova hairaina ese dubu vada e hahonua.
english: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.

motu: Una tau na badibadigu ai ginina ai, lau ese gado ta na kamonai, dubu lalona amo e hereva henigu;
english: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.

motu: e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Egu terono bona ae-palapalagu imoina gabuna binai; iniseni ai baina noho hanaihanai, Israel taudia bogaragidiai. Israel besena taudia ese lau ladagu helaḡana basie hamiroa lou, idia bona edia pavapava edia ariara karadia amo, eiava edia pavapava tau-anidia masedia amo,
english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;

motu: eiava edia raka-vareaina na lauegu raka-vareaina bona edia iduara ihua-ihuadia na lauegu iduara ihua-ihuadia badibadidiai bae alodia, bena lau bona idia padamai ai na hehari maḡuna mo baine mia dainai. Edia kara dika-rohorohodia vada e kara dainai lau ladagu helaḡana vada e hamiroa, taunabunai lau ese egu badu garaḡarana ai vada na ha-oredia.
english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

motu: Harihari edia kaivakuku itomadihohenidia bona edia pavapava tau-anidia masedia na bae negedia daure, bena lau na idia bogaragidiai baina noho hanaihanai. Dubu bona Ihaboulaina Patana Taravatudia
english: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.

motu: Taunimanima nahma e, dubu ita-itana bona ilalo-hatana na Israel besena taudia ba hamaorolaidia, edia kara havara hemaraidia bae hemarai helaoreana.
english: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

motu: Bena edia kara iboudiai hemaraidia bema hemarai, bena dubu bona ihaero-hatana, raka-lasina bona raka-vareaina, bona oromana idoinai, ba haheitalaidia, bona ena hahedua herevadia bona ena taravatu iboudiai ba hadibalaidia; idia vairadiai ba torea, bena idia ese ena taravatu bona ena hahedua herevadia iboudiai na bae badinadia bona karadia bae kara.
english: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, its fashion, its exits, its entrances, its structure, all its ordinances, all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.

motu: Dubu taravatuna binai ororo dorina tanona hegeḡemadai idoinai baine helaḡa herea. A itaia, dubu taravatuna bunai.
english: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana ihahetohona, kiubit amo e hahetohoa, binai. (Ini kiubit na kiubit ta bona ima-palapala lababana ta). Ia badina hara-latana na kiubit ta, bona lababana na kiubit ta; ia na mai isena, ohena idoinai e ḡeḡea ahu ḡauna, isena lababana na ima-kwakikwaki daḡana ta heḡereḡerena. Ihaboulaina patana harana latana na ini baine heto:
english: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit + 43:13 A normal cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. A hand width is about 4.3 inches or 11 cm. * is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; + 43:13 A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.) * and this shall be the base of the altar.

motu: badina, tano ai, amo ela bona henu digina, kiubit rua, bona lababana na kiubit tamona; bona digi maraḡina amo ela bona digi badana, kiubit hani, bona lababana na kiubit tamona.
english: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.

motu: Ihaboulaina patana rahurahuna na kiubit hani; bona ihaboulaina patana rahurahuna amo doa hani e hagini, edia lata na kiubit tamona.
english: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.

motu: Hari rahurahu ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, lalana kiubit gwauta-rua bona lababana danu kiubit gwauta-rua.
english: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.

motu: Digina danu ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, latana kiubit gwauta-hani bona lababana kiubit gwauta-hani; isena danu baine geḡea ahu, ia lababana na kiubit duduna. Bona ia badina heḡeḡemadai ai na kiubit tamona. Ihaboulaina patana vadavadana na mairiveina kahana baine vaira henia.
english: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hahedua herevadia, ihaboulaina patana ena, bini. Ḡole-oho bouboudia na latanai bae hahelaḡadia bona rara bae nevarilaia totona bae haginia dinana ai,
english: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.

motu: Levi hahelaḡa taudia, Sadok ena iduhu taudia, kara helaḡadia ikaradia totona e raka henigu kahimu taudia, na boromakau maruanena ta ba henidia, kara dika iabi-ohona boubou ḡauna ai bainela. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.

motu: Bena rarana kuri ta bavabia, ihaboulaina patana ena doa haniosi ba dahulaidia, bona digi daigunina haniosi danu, bona isena heḡeḡemadai ai; unu amo ihaboulaina patana ba haḡoevaia bona kara dika na iena amo bavabia oho.
english: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.

motu: Bena una boromakau maruanena, kara dika iabi-ohona ḡauna, na bavabia, vada e gwauraia hidi gabuna ai ba haḡolea oho, dubu tanona ai, to helaḡa gabuna murimurinai.
english: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.

motu: Bena dina iharuana ai, nani maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta ba hahelaḡaia, kara dika iabi-ohona ḡauna ai bainela. Unu amo ihaboulaina patana ma ba haḡoevaia, boromakau maruanena amo o haḡoevaia heḡereḡerena.
english: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.

motu: Ba haḡoevaia ḡuḡuru, bena boromakau maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta bona seri mamoe maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta ba hahelaḡadia.
english: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.

motu: Iehova vairanai ba heni, bena hahelaḡa taudia ese damena na latadiai bae ḡiḡi, bena bae haḡoledia oho, Iehova ena.
english: You shall bring them near to Yahweh, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

motu: Dina hitu lalodiai, dina ta ta ai nani maruanena ta ba heni, kara dika iabi-ohona ḡauna ai bainela; bona boromakau maruanena ta bona seri mamoe maruanena ta asi bebekabebekadia, danu ba heni.
english: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.

motu: Dina hitu lalodiai boubou karadia bae kara, dika na ihaboulaina patana amo iabi-ohona bona ihaḡoevana totona; unu amo ba hahelaḡaia.
english: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.

motu: Unu dina bae haḡuḡurudia, bona dina ihataurahanina amo hahelaḡa taudia ese emui ḡole-oho bouboudia bona emui maino bouboudia ḡaudia na bae hahelaḡadia, ihaboulaina patana latanai; bena lau ese baina abimui dae. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lou lao, gabu helaḡana murimurina kahana ikoukouna ala, mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna. Ḡauna na vada e hekou.
english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina ikoukou na hekouna ai do baine mia; ta ese basine kehoa, bona ta na iena amo basine raka vareai; badina be Iehova, Israel Diravana, na iena amo vada e raka vareai, una dainai ia na hekouna ai do baine mia.
english: Yahweh said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.

motu: Hanua pavapavana sibona na ia lalonai baine helai, Iehova vairanai baine aniani totona. Ia na ikoukou dehena amo baine raka vareai, bona unu amo ma baine raka lasi.
english: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before Yahweh. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”

motu: Bena ia ese mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo e hakaugu lao, ela bona dubu vairanai a kau. Bena na roha lao, na itaia, Iehova hairaina ese Iehova ena dubu vada e hahonua; bena tano ai na goru diho.
english: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house; so I fell on my face.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hereva henigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, a laloa namonamo; baina hamaorolaimu ḡaudia iboudiai ba itadia bona herevadia ba kamonai, Iehova ena dubu herevadia, hahedua herevadia bona taravatuna iboudiai danu. Ba laloa namonamo danu, daika daika na dubu ai bae raka vareai diba, bona daika daika na gabu helaḡana lalonai basie raka vareai diba.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of Yahweh’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.

motu: Bona gwau-edeede besena, Israel besena, na ba hamaorodia, baoto, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel besena e, emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai ba hadoko.
english: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,

motu: Idau bese taudia, lalodia asie hahelaḡadia bona tauanidia asie peritomedia taudia, na egu gabu helaḡana lalonai o harakadia vareai, bona gabu o hamiroa, agu aniani, digara bona rara, na egu ai o hahelagadiamu negadia ai. Emui kara dika-rohorohodia iboudiai latadiai danu egu taravatu itata-utuna vada o atva kau.
english: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.

motu: Egu ḡau helaḡadia danu asio baladia heni, a idau bese taudia vada o duanaidia, egu ḡau bae baladia heni, egu gabu helaḡana lalonai.
english: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Idau bese tauna ta, lalona se hahelaḡaia bona tau-anina asie peritomea tauna, idau bese taudia iboudiai Israel besena taudia padadiai e nohomu taudia ta, na egu gabu helaḡana lalonai basine raka vareai.
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.

motu: A Levi taudia ese edia dika davadia bae hua, egu amo idauhai e raka kerere dainai; idia ese lau e rakatanigu bona edia kaivakuku muridiai ela, Israel besena e raka kerere negana ai.
english: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.

motu: Idia ese egu gabu helaḡana ḡaukaradia bae kara, bona dubu ikoukoudia bae itadia tao, bona dubu ai kara helaḡadia bae kara. Idia ese ḡole-oho boubou ḡauna bona taunimanima edia boubou ḡaudia na bae aladia mase; taunimanima bae naridia bona isiaidia bae lao heni.
english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

motu: Badina be idia ese kara helaḡadia e kara, edia kaivakuku vairadiai, bona kara dika-rohorohodia amo Israel besena ihahekwakwanaina ḡauna ai ela; taunabunai Ḡaubada Iehova na e gwaumu: Lau na idia latadiai vada na gwau hamata, edia dika davadia do bae hua.
english: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and they will bear their iniquity.

motu: Idia ese basie raka henigu kahi, hahelaḡa karadia ai isiaigu basie lao heni; egu ḡau helaḡadia bona egu ḡau helaḡa-hereadia basie raka henidia kahi, a hemaraidia bae hemarai, kara dika-rohorohodia vada e kara daidiai.
english: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

motu: Ḡau tan-ona lau ese baina duanaidia, dubu bae naria; bona toma-diho karadia iboudiai bona ḡaukara iboudiai ia lalonai e karamu na idia ese bae kara.
english: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.

motu: A Levi taudia haida, Sadok vevena, hahelaḡa dagina e abia bena egu gabu helaḡana e nariava, Israel besena taudia ese e rakatanigu negana ai, ese bae raka henigu lialu, bona isiaigu bae lao heni; idia na lau vairagu baema, digara bona rara bae hahelaḡadia egu. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “‘“But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Idia danu egu gabu helaḡana lalonai bae raka vareai, bona egu pata bae raka henia kahi, isiaigu bae lao heni bona egu hahedua bae badinadia totona.
english: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.

motu: Laloma maḡuna ikoukoudia lalodiai bae raka vareai negana ai, idia ese dabua auka hahedokidia bae dokilai; Inamoe huidia dabuadia basie hahedohlai, laloma maḡuna ikoukoudia ai bona maḡu lalonai kara helaḡadia bae kara negadia ai.
english: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

motu: Kwaradia na dabua aukadia amo bae havavalaidia, bona koekoedia ai dabua auka piriboudia bae kara; varahu ihavarana ḡauna ta basie dokilaia.
english: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

motu: Bena murimuri maḡuna ai taununanima dekediai bae raka lasi negana ai, idia ese unu dabua, kara helaḡadia e karalai ḡaudia, na bae doki oho, daiutu helaḡadia ai bae atodia, bena dabua idaudia bae dokilai, edia dabua amo unu taunimanima na helaḡa siahuna bae henidia hanai na garina.
english: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

motu: Kwaradia basie naudia, bona huidia basie halata; kwaradia huidia bae utu kwadogi mo.
english: “‘“They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ta ese vine ranuna basine inua, laloma maḡuna ai e raka vareaimu negana ai.
english: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

motu: Idia ese vabu ta eiava e diho hahinena ta na basie adavaia, a rami-hebou ulatona ta, Israel besena amo, eiava hahelaḡa tauna ta vabuna.
english: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.

motu: Idia ese egu orea taudia na bae hadibadia, ḡau helaḡadia bona ḡau uhugaidia ede e idau tomamu; bona ḡau dia gogoeva bona ḡau ḡoevaḡoevadia edia idau ede bae diba toma.
english: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

motu: Heai lalodiai idia na hahemaoro taudia ai baela; bona lauegu hahemaoro daladia amo bae hahemaoro. Egu taravatu bona egu hahedua herevadia bae badinadia, vada na gwauraidia ariadia iboudiai lalodiai; bona egu dina helaḡadia bae hahelaḡadia.
english: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.

motu: Mase tauna iraka-kahi-henina ai sibodia basie hahemiro; ḡau tamona tamadia eiava sinadia eiava natudia mamaruanedia eiava hahinedia, eiava tadikakadia eiava taihudia ulatodia daidiai sibodia bae hahemiro diba.
english: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

motu: Ta baine hahemiro murinai, ia sibona ese dina hitu baine hagaudia, bena ia na baine ḡoeva.
english: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.

motu: A gabu helaḡana, laloma maḡuna ai, lalonai baine raka vareai, gabu helaḡana ai kara helaḡadia baine kara totona, una dina ai ia ese ena kara dika iabi-ohona boubouna ḡauna na baine hahelaḡaia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Ahudia ta basie abia, badina be ahudia na lau; bona kohu ta Israel ai basio henidia, badina be edia kohu na lau.
english: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.

motu: Flaoa boubouna bona kara dika bona kerere iabi-ohodia bouboudia ḡaudia na bae ani; bona ḡau helaḡadia iboudiai Israel ai na idia edia.
english: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

motu: Uma ḡaudia roboadia idau-idau iboudiai bona emui herahia ḡaudia idau-idau iboudiai, na hahelaḡa taudia ese bae abidia edia; bona emui igabu roboadia danu hahelaḡa taudia ba henidia, hahenamo na emui ruma latadiai baine mia helaoreana.
english: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.

motu: E mase kava ḡauna ta eiava ḡau ta ese e haberoa ḡauna ta, roho manuna eiava timo kopina ai e nohomu ḡauna, na hahelaḡa taudia ese basie ania.
english: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

motu: Tano ba haria negana ai, tano kahana ba gwauraia hidi Iehova ena, kaha helaḡana ai bainela. Ena lata na kiubit gerebu rua daha ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu rua; ia na baine helaḡa ela bona hetoana idoinai.
english: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to Yahweh, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.

motu: Ia lalonai gabu ta baine mia, dubu helaḡana gabuna, ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, kiubit sinahu-ima; bona hegeḡemadai ai tano taina baine mia ḡagae, ia lababana na kiubit imahui.
english: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits + 45:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * for its pasture lands all around.

motu: Hari kaha helaḡana lalonai, tano ta ba hahetohoa, ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta; ia lalonai dubu helaḡana, helaḡa herea gabuna, na baine gini.
english: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

motu: Una tano na tano helaḡana ai bainela; ia na hahelaḡa taudia, dubu helaḡana ai kara helaḡadia e karamu bona Iehova isiaina ilaohenina totona e raka henia kahimu taudia edia; edia ruma gabudia tanona, bona dubu helaḡana tanona helaḡana ai bainela.
english: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to Yahweh. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

motu: Ma kaha ta, ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta na Levi taudia, dubu lalonai kara helaḡadia e karamu taudia, edia; bae ḡaunaia, bae noholaidia hanuadia unuseni ai bae hadai.
english: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

motu: Vada o gwauraia hidi, kaha helaḡana ai o halaoa, tanona badibadinai, hanua tanona ba duanaia, ena lababa na kiubit daha-ima bona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima; ia na Israel besena idoinai ese baine ḡaunaia.
english: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

motu: Bena kaha helaḡana ohena ohena tanodia bona hanua ena kaha ohena ohena tanodia, lahara kahana ai bona laurabada kahana ai, na hanua pavapavana ese baine ḡaunaia, ena lata na iduhu ta ahuna ena lata heḡereḡerena, lahara kahana hetoana ela bona laurabada kahana hetoana.
english: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

motu: Una na ia ahuna korikorina Israel ai. Bena pavapava ai baina halaodia taudia ese egu orea taudia na basie hahisihisidia lou; a tano na Israel besena taudia bae henidia, edia iduhu ta ta ai.
english: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Israel pavapavadia e, vadaeni! Daḡedaḡe bona hahehisi karadia ba negedia; hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva bona kara maoromaoro ba kara; egu orea taudia ilulu-lasidia ba hadokoa. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Enough, you princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Hahetoho ḡaudia momokanidia bavabi, bona efa momokanina bona bata momokanina danu.
english: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, + 45:10 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * and a just bath.

motu: Efa bona bata anidia bae heḡereḡere; bata gwauta na homere ta heḡereḡerena, bona efa gwauta na homere ta heḡereḡerena. Hahetoho ḡaudia iboudiai ibadidia na homere.
english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, + 45:11 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels * and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.

motu: Sekele na gera ruahui heḡereḡeredia; sekele ima be sekele anidia korikoridia inta ba heni, bona sekele gwauta be sekele anidia korikoridia gwauta ba heni. Emui mina lalonai sekele bae imahui. Boubou bona Aria
english: The shekel + 45:12 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces. * shall be twenty gerahs. + 45:12 a gerah is about 0.5 grams or about 7.7 grains * Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina. + 45:12 A mina is about 600 grams or 1.3 U. S. pounds. *

motu: Boubou ḡaudia na ini ba heni toma: uit homere ta lalona amo efa ta ba karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa ta ba heni; bona bali homere ta lalona amo efa ta ba karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa ta ba heni;
english: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,

motu: bona dehoro ahuna na koro ta ta lalodia amo bata ta ba karoaia, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ba heni. (Hari koro lalonai na bata gwauta, homere heḡereḡerena).
english: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer), + 45:14 1 cor is the same as 1 homer in volume, and is about 211 liters, 55.9 gallons, or 6 bushels. 1 bath is about 21.1 liters, 5.59 gallons, or 2.4 pecks. *

motu: Bona mamoe sinahu-rua sinahu-rua amo mamoe ta ta ba heni; Israel iduhudia iboudiai ese unu bae heni toma. Boubou ḡaudia bunu, flaoa bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia, edia dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu. + 45:15 Efa; bata; homere; sekele; gera; mina; koro. Ini na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡaudia haida ladadia. *
english: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Tano taudia iboudiai ese ini boubou ḡaudia na Israel pavapavana bae henia.
english: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara korikori be ḡole-oho bouboudia bona flaoa bouboudia bona inuinu bouboudia ḡaudia baine heni, aria negadia ai bona hua matamatadia negadia ai bona dina helaḡadia ai, Israel besena ena aria korikoridia iboudiai negadia ai. Ia ese kara dika bouboudia bona flaoa bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona maino bouboudia ḡaudia baine heni, Israel besena ena kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia.
english: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Hua gini-gunana dinana gini-gunana ai, boromakau natuna maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta bavabia, bena gabu helaḡana ba haḡoevaia.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna ese kara dika iabi-ohona boubou ḡauna rarana kuri ta baine abia, dubu iduaradia ihua-ihuadia bona ihaboulaina patana isena daigunina haniosi bona laloma maḡuna ikoukouna audia baine dahulaidia.
english: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.

motu: Hua dinana ihahituna ai danu unu ba kara toma, kara-rea eiava mata-lahui dainai vada e kara dika tauna bagunai; unu amo dubu ba haḡoevaia.
english: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.

motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana ihag vauta-hanina ai, lagau-hanai ariana ba karaia; dina hitu lalodiai asie hatubua flaoana bae ania.
english: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

motu: Una dina ai, hanua pavapavana ese boromakau natuna maruanena ta baine heni, dika iabi-ohona boubouna ḡauna, ia bona tano taudia iboudiai daidiai.
english: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.

motu: Bona aria dinadia hituosi lalodiai ia ese boromakau natudia mamaruanedia hitu bona mamoe mamaruanedia asi bebeka-bebekadia hitu baine heni, Iehova ena, unu dina ta ta ai, ḡole-oho boubou ḡaudia; bona nani maruanena ta, unu dina ta ta ai, dika iabi-ohona boubouna ḡaudia.
english: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to Yahweh, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.

motu: Ia ese danu flaoa boubouna baine heni, efa ta ta boromakau mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona efa ta ta mamoe mamaruanedia ta ta edia, bona dehoro hini + 45:24 “Efa” bona “hini” na Heberu taudia edia hahetoho ḡaudia ladadia. * ta ta efa ta ta ida.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah + 45:24 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin + 45:24 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. * of oil to an ephah.

motu: Hua ihahituna dinana ihagwauta-imana ai, bona aria dinadia hituosi lalodiai, ia ese unu heḡereḡeredia ma baine heni, dika iabi-ohona bouboudia bona ḡole-oho bouboudia bona naoa bouboudia ḡaudia, bona dehoro danu.
english: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Laloma maḡuna ikoukouna, mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna, na baine hekou, ḡaukara dinadia tauratoiosi lalodiai; a dina helaḡa ai bona hua matamatana dinana ai vada bae kehoa.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

motu: Hanua pavapavana na murimuri kahana amo baine raka vareai, ikoukou dehena ai; bena ikoukou auna badibadinai baine gini. Bena hahelaḡa taudia ese ena ḡole-oho boubouna bona ena maino bouboudia ḡaudia na bae hahelaḡadia; bena ia na ikoukou raka-vareaina ai baine toma diho. Bena ia na baine raka lasi, a ikoukou na basie koua ela bona dina baine diho.
english: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

motu: Tano taudia na Iehova vairanai bae toma diho, una ikoukou raka-vareaina ai dina helaḡadia ai bona hua matamata dinadia ai.
english: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

motu: Ḡole-oho boubouna, hanua pavapavana ese dina helaḡa ai Iehova baine henia ḡauna, na mamoe natudia asi bebeka-bebekadia tauratoi, bona mamoe maruanena asi bebekabebekana ta.
english: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to Yahweh shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;

motu: Flaoa boubouna mamoe maruanena ida baine heni ḡauna na efa ta, bona flaoa boubouna ḡaudia mamoe natudia ida na ena goada heḡereḡerena ai baine heni; flaoa efadia ta ta ida dehoro hini ta ta baine heni danu.
english: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin + 46:5 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. * of oil to an ephah. + 46:5 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel *

motu: Hua matamata dinana ai, ia ese boromakau natuna maruanena asi bebeka-bebekana ta, bona mamoe natudia tauratoi bona mamoe maruanena ta, asi bebeka-bebekadia, na baine heni.
english: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.

motu: Ena ilaoa bouboudia na boromakau maruanena ida efa ta bona mamoe maruanena ida efa ta, bona mamoe natudia ida ena goada heḡereḡerena ai baine heni; flaoa efadia ta ta ida dehoro hini ta ta baine heni.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

motu: Hanua pavapavana baine raka vareai negana ai, ia na ikoukou dehena amo baine raka vareai, bona unu amo ma baine raka lasi.
english: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.

motu: E gwaurai ariadia daidiai tano taudia na Iehova vairanai baema negadia ai, mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo toma-diho totona baine raka vareai tauna na diho kahana ikoukouna amo baine raka lasi; bona diho kahana ikoukouna amo baine raka vareai tauna na mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo baine raka lasi; asi tauna ta ese e raka vareai ikoukouna amo ma baine raka lasi; a ta ta na bae raka vairai, bena bae raka lasi.
english: “‘“But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

motu: Bae raka vareai negana ai, hanua pavapavana na idia ida baine raka vareai; bona bae raka lasi negana ai, ia danu baine raka lasi.
english: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

motu: Aria negadia ai bona e gwaurai negadia ai, flaoa boubouna boromakau natuna maruanena ida bae heni ḡauna na efa ta; bona mamoe maruanena ta ida danu efa ta; a mamoe natudia ida ihenina tauna ena goada heḡereḡerena ai baine heni. Eta ta ta ida dehoro hini ta ta bae heni.
english: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah + 46:11 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

motu: tlanua pavapavana ese ena ura-kwalimu ai boubou ḡauna bema heni, ḡole-oho boubouna eiava maino bouboudia, ena ura-kwalimu ḡauna Iehova ena; bena baine heni negana ai mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ikoukouna na bae kehoa iena. Bena ia ese ena ḡole-oho boubouna eiava ena maino bouboudia ḡaudia baine heni, dina helaḡa ai heḡereḡerena. Bena ia na baine raka lasi; bena baine raka lasi murinai ikoukou na bae koua.
english: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to Yahweh, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.

motu: Dina ta ta amo ia ese mamoe natuna ta, laḡani tamona ḡauna asi bebeka-bebekana, baine heni, ḡole-oho boubouna ai bainela, Iehova ena; daba daba iboudiai ia ese baine heni.
english: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to Yahweh daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.

motu: Daba ta ta amo danu ia ese flaoa boubouna baine heni; efa ta baine karoaia, karoa tauratoi, bena karoa ta baine heni, bona dehoro hini ta baine karoaia, karoa toi, bena karoa ta baine heni, flaoa ikuilaina; una na flaoa boubouna ai bainela, Iehova ena. Ḡole-oho bouhouna, bae heni loulou ḡauna, haheḡanina bunai.
english: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, + 46:14 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to Yahweh continually by a perpetual ordinance.

motu: Taunabunai, mamoe natuna bona flaoa boubouna bona dehoro na daba daba iboudiai bae heni, ḡole-oho boubouna, bae heni loulou ḡauna, ai bainela.
english: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Bema hanua pavapavana ese harihari ḡauna na ia ahuna amo natuna haida baine henidia, unu natuna ese bae abia, bae ḡaunaia, ahudia korikoridia ai baela.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.

motu: A bema ia ese harihari ḡauna na ia ahuna amo ena hesiai taudia ta baine henia, una tau ese baine abia, ela bona heruha-nege laḡanina; una negana ai hanua pavapavana ese baine abia lou. Ia natuna mo sibodia ese harihari ḡauna ta ia ahuna amo na bae dogoa tao diba.
english: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese ena orea taudia ahudia taina basine abia diba, ahudia amo basine luludia lasi; ia ese natuna ahudia baine henidia, ia sibona ahuna amo, taunabunai egu orea taudia ta ena ḡau basine heabi oho.
english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”

motu: Bena ia ese ikoukou badina iduarana amo e hakaugu hanai, ela bona hahelaḡa taudia edia daiutu helaḡadia mirigini kahana erena; bena una ere dokodokona ai, lahara kahana ai, gabu ta na itaia.
english: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Gabuna binai hahelaḡa taudia ese kerere bona kara dika iabi-ohodia bouboudia ḡaudia na bae nadudia, bona flaoa bouboudia ḡaudia na bae gabudia; murimuri kahana maḡuna ai basie lasilaidia, taunimanima na helaḡa siahuna bae henidia hanai na garina.
english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”

motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lasi, murimuri kahana maḡuna ala, bena e hakaugu lao, maḡu daigunina haniosi a lao heni; maḡu daigunina ta ta na mai maḡumaḡudia.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

motu: Maḡu daigunina haniosi na mai maḡumaḡudia, edia lata na kiubit hari-ahui bona edia lababa na kiubit toi-ahui; haniosi edia bada na heḡereḡere.
english: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits + 46:22 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

motu: Laloma kahadia ai, hari maḡumaḡu haniosi hegegemadai ai, na nadi palakadia ere ta, bona unu ere henudiai na rahurahu.
english: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Nanadu gabudia bini, kara helaḡadia dubu ai e karamu taudia ese taunimanima edia boubou ḡaudia na iniseni ai bae nadu.
english: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”

motu: Bena ia ese e hakaugu lou, dubu iduarana ai; bena na itaia, ranu na dubu raka-vareaina henuna amo e lasiva, mairiveina kahana ai, (badina be dubu na mairiveina kahana e vaira henia); bona dubu raka-vareaina diho kahana henuna amo danu ranu e lasiva, ihaboulaina patana diho kahana ai.
english: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.

motu: Bena ia ese mirigini kahana ikoukouna amo e hakaugu lasi, murimuri kahana ai e hakaugu heḡeḡe ela bona murimuri kahana ikoukouna, mairiveina kahana e vaira heniamu ḡauna; ranu na diho kahana amo e lasiva.
english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

motu: Mairiveina kahana ma ala; ia na mai ena hahetoho varona imana ai, bena kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu amo e hakaugu hanai; aemai ganaganadia ai e raro.
english: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, + 47:3 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

motu: Ma kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu amo ma e hakaugu hanai; tuimai ai e raro. Ma kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu amo ma e hakaugu hanai; koekoemai ai e raro.
english: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.

motu: Ma kiubit daha-ta e hahetohodia, bena ranu na vada sinavai ta; asi turu-hanai dibagu, badina be ranu vada e dae; vada e dobu, nahu heḡereḡerena, ta basinema turu hanai diba.
english: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ina na vada o itaia a? Bena e hakaugu riri lou, sinavai isena amo.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then|strong="H7725" * he|strong="H7725" * brought|strong="H7725" * me|strong="H7725" * and|strong="H1121" * caused me|strong="H7725" * to|strong="H7725" * return|strong="H7725" * to|strong="H7725" * the|strong="H7200" * bank|strong="H8193" * of|strong="H1121" * the|strong="H7200" * river|strong="H5158" *.

motu: Lougu ai, au momo herea na itadia sinavai isena kahana kahana ai.
english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina ranu na mairiveina kahana e aru e laomu, Araba kourana ai e dihomu; bena gohu ai e aru lasimu negana ai, gohu na e negarimu.
english: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

motu: Bena sinavai na e aru e laomu gabudia iboudiai, mauri ḡaudia na bae vara heḡiḡi oda-oda, bona gwarume danu seridia seridia. Badina be ina ranu na e aru e laomu, gohu baine hanegaria; taunabunai sinavai na e aru e laomu gabudia ai, ḡau iboudiai na bae mauri daehai daehai.
english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

motu: Haoda taudia na gohu badinai bae gini; En-gedi amo ela bona En-eglaimi edia reke bae tore; gwarumena bae idau-idau, Davara Badana gwarumedia heḡereḡeredia.
english: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

motu: A gohugohuna bona laguta-lagutana na basie negari; bae mia, damena gabudia.
english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

motu: Sinavai isena kahana kahana ai huahua audia idau-idau iboudiai bae vara. Idia raudia basie marai, bona huahuadia basie hehuhu, a hua ta ta amo huahuadia bae dobi, badina be ihapariparidia ranudia na gabu helaḡana amo e aru e laomu. Huahuadia na aniani ḡaudia bona raudia na hahemauri ḡaudia ai baela. Tano Hetoadia
english: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Tano hetoadia bini: tano na ba haria, Israel iduhudia gwauta-ruaosi ese ahudia bae abi, a Iosef na ahu rua baine abi.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

motu: Ba haria, ahu iboudiai bae heḡereḡere; na gwau hamata senemui baina henidia nato; ina tano na ahumui korikori ai bainela.
english: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.

motu: Tano hetoana binai: mirigini kahana ai, Davara Badana amo baine hematama, bena Hetelono amo bainela ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina, bena Sedad
english: “This shall be the border of the land: “ On|strong="H1870" * the|strong="H4480" * north|strong="H6828" * side|strong="H6285" *, from|strong="H4480" * the|strong="H4480" * great|strong="H1419" * sea|strong="H3220" *, by|strong="H1870" * the|strong="H4480" * way|strong="H1870" * of|strong="H1366" * Hethlon|strong="H2855" *, to|strong="H1870" * the|strong="H4480" * entrance of|strong="H1366" * Zedad|strong="H6657" *;

motu: bona Berota bona Sibiraimi amo (una Sibiraimi na Damasko bona Hamat hetoadia ai) ela bona Hasere-hatikono, Haurana hetoana ai.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

motu: Unu amo hetoa na davara amo bainela ela bona Hasara-enono, Damasko mirigini kahana hetoana ai. Hamat hetoana danu na ia miriginina kahana ai. Mirigini kahana hetoana bunai.
english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

motu: Laurabada kahana ai, hetoa na Hasara-enono amo baine hematama, Haurana bona Damasko padadia amo bainela; bena Ioridane sinavaina amo bainela, Gilead bona Israel tanodia padadia amo, ela bona laurabada kahana davarana, ela bona Tamara. Laurabada kahana hetoana bunai.
english: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

motu: Diho kahana ai, hetoa na Tamara amo baine hematama, bainela ela bona Meribata-kade ranu gabudia, bena Aigupto Dokana amo bainela, ela bona Davara Badana. Diho kahana hetoana bunai.
english: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

motu: Lahara kahana ai, hetoa na Davara Badana, ela bona Hamat rakavareaina hevaira-hehenina. Lahara kahana hetoana bunai.
english: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

motu: Ina tano na unu ba haria toma, Israel iduhudia heḡereḡeredia.
english: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

motu: Ahumui ba duanaidia, umul emui bona idau taudia, bogaragimui ai e nohomu bona natudia na bogaragimui ai vada e havaradia taudia. Idia na Israel memerodia korikoridia heḡereḡeredia ai baela umui emui ai; umui ida ahumui ba duanaidia Israel iduhudia bogaragidiai.
english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

motu: Edena iduhu ai idau tauna na e nohomu, unuseni ai ia ahuna ba henia. Ḡaubada Iehova na e herevamu.
english: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

motu: Iduhu ladadia bini. Mirigini kahana hetoana na davara amo baine hematama, Hetelono amo bainela ela bona Hamat raka-vareaina, ela bona Hasara-enono (una na Damasko mirigini kahana hetoana, Hamat hevaira-hehenina ai), laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana: una na Dan ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

motu: Dan ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Asere ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

motu: Asere ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Napatali ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.

motu: Napatali ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Manase ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

motu: Manase ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Efraim ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.

motu: Efraim ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Ruben ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.

motu: Ruben ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, Iuda ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

motu: Iuda ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana, tano ta ba gwauraia hidi. Ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, ena lata na unu iduhu ahudia ta heḡereḡerena, laurabada kahana ela bona lahara kahana; ia bogaraginai na gabu helaḡana.
english: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

motu: Iehova ena ba gwauraia hidi tanona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-rua.
english: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

motu: Tano helaḡana inogodia bini: hahelaḡa taudia edia inogo ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima murigini kahana ai, ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta lahara kahana ai bona kiubit gerebu-ta laurabada kahana ai, bona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima diho kahana ai. Iehova en: gabu helaḡana na ia bogaraginai.
english: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the middle of it.

motu: Una na vada e hahelaḡadia taudia, Sadok vevena, edia; idia ese egu hahedua e badinadiava, bona Israel taudia e raka siri negana ai idia na asie raka siri, hari Levi taudia e raka siri na heto.
english: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

motu: Idia ahudia korikorina ai bainela, tano helaḡana lalonai, gabu helaḡa-hereana ai bainela, Levi taudia edia tano ohena ai.
english: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia edia tano ohena ai, Levi taudia ese edia inogo bae abia; ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima bona ena lababa na kiubit gerebu-ta. Latana idoinai na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, bona lababana idoinai na kiubit gerebu-rua.
english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

motu: Taina basie hoia, eiava basie hebodohilaia. Ina ahu namohereana tanona na haida basie henidia, badina be ia na helaḡa, Iehova ena.
english: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to Yahweh.

motu: Orena miana, ena lababa na kiubit daha-ima bona ena lata na kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima, na hanua ena, ruma bona gabiruma tanodia. Ilanua badana na bogaraginai baine gini.
english: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

motu: Ena bada be iniheto: mirigini kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima; diho kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima; laurabada kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima, bona lahara kahana, kiubit daha-hani sinahu-ima.
english: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

motu: Hanua ena gabiruma tanona danu baine mia: mirigini kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui; diho kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui; laurabada kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui; bona lahara kahana ai, kiubit sinahu-rua imahui.
english: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

motu: Orena miana ena lata tano helaḡana ohena ai na kiubit gerebu-ta laurabada kahana ai bona kiubit gerebu-ta lahara kahana ai, tano helaḡana ohena ai. Una tano huahuana na hanua ena ḡaukara taudia adia aniani.
english: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.

motu: Hanua ena ḡaukara taudia, Israel iduhudia iboudiai amo, ese bae biru henia.
english: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

motu: Ba gwauraia hidi, tano idoinai ena lata bona ena lababa bae heḡereḡere, kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima; una na tano helaḡana bona hanua tanona.
english: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

motu: Tano orena, tano helaḡana bona hanua tanona ohena ohena ai, na hanua pavapavana ena. Tano helaḡana ena kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima amo ela bona laurabada kahana hetoana, bona lahara kahana ai hari kiubit gerebu-rua daha-ima amo ela bona lahara kahana hetoana, na hanua pavapavana ena tano. Una tano bona iduhu ta ta ahudia padadia na basie maraḡi bona basie bada edia lata idoinai. Tano helaḡana bona dubu helaḡana ia bogaraginai danu,
english: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

motu: bona Levi taudia edia tano bona hanua tanona, na hanua pavapavana ena tano bogaraginai bae mia. Hanua pavapavana ahuna na Iuda ena tano bona Beniamina ena tano padadiai baine mia.
english: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

motu: Iduhu oredia na iniheto: laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana, Beniamina ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

motu: Beniamina ena tano ohena ai, laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana, Simeon ahuna, ahu ta.
english: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.
