english: He delivers and rescues. He|strong="H1768" * works signs and|strong="H4437" * wonders in|strong="H4437" * heaven and|strong="H4437" * in|strong="H4437" * earth, who|strong="H1768" * has|strong="H1768" * delivered Daniel|strong="H1841" * from|strong="H4481" * the|strong="H3606" * power of|strong="H4481" * the|strong="H3606" * lions.”

motu: Bena hari Daniel ena namo e badava, Darauese ena lohia negana ai, bona Kurese, tau Parasa, ena lohia negana ai.
english: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

motu: Belesasara, Babulono pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai, Daniel na e nihi, bona mata-hanai ḡaudia haida na kwarana lalonai e hedinarai, ena mahuta patana ai e hekureva negana ai. Bena ia ese nihi sivaraina e torea, bona anina e hahedinaraia.
english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head while on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.

motu: Daniel eto, Hanuaboi ai na mata hanai bena na itaia, guba laina haniosi ese gadobada e hahurehurea.
english: Daniel spoke and said, “I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke out on the great sea.

motu: Bena mauri ḡaudia badadia hani na davara lalona amo e dae, ita-itadia na idau-idau.
english: Four great animals came up from the sea, different from one another.

motu: Gini-gunana na leona na heto, a mai hanina, ugava hanina na heheto. Bena na itaiava ai na hanina e butudia oho, bena tano ai e haginia tore, aena ruaosi ai e haginia, taunimanima na heto, bona taunimanima darana e henia.
english: “The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings. I watched until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on two feet as a man. A man’s heart was given to it.

motu: Bena mauri ḡauna ta ma na itaia, iharuana, bea na heto. E haginia tore, gini-gunana ohena ai, bona uduna ai na rudu turiadia autoi, isena padadiai. Ta ese e hamaoroa, eto, A tore isi, vamu momo bavani.
english: “Behold, there was another animal, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth. They said this to it: ‘Arise! Devour much flesh!’

motu: Una murinai na roha lao, ta ma na itaia, taiga na heto, a manu hanidia hani na doruna ai; bona una mauri ḡauna na mai kwarana hani danu; bena lohia siahuna na e henia.
english: “After this I saw, and behold, another, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird. The animal also had four heads; and dominion was given to it.

motu: Una murinai, hanuaboi mata-hanaidia ai, mauri ḡauna ihahanina na itaia, mai garina bona mai kudou-hetahana; ia na goada dikadika danu. Isena na auri gaudia, bona bada herea; bena ia ese ḡau e aniva, e dare patapatava, bona momoruna na aena amo e moia patapatava. Ia na idau, dia e gunalaia ḡaudia heḡereḡeredia; ia doana na gwauta.
english: “After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, there was a fourth animal, awesome, powerful, and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth. It devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet. It was different from all the animals that were before it. It had ten horns.

motu: Doana na haerodia, bena na itaia, doa ma ta idia bogaragidiai e tubu, maraḡi-muaḡina; bena ia vairanai unu doa gunadia toi e heraga oho. Na itaia danu, una doa na mai matana, tau matana na heto; bona mai uduna, hereva badadia e gwaurai.
english: “I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking arrogantly.

motu: Na itaiava ai na terono haida na hehelai, bena ḡauka ta na e helai diho; ena dabua na kuroka-kuroka, snow * na heto, bona kwarana huina na mamoe huina ḡoeva-daena na heto; ena terono na lahi hururu-hururudia, ava-keikeina na e aramu lahina.
english: “I watched until thrones were placed, and|strong="H1934" * one who|strong="H1768" * was|strong="H1934" * Ancient|strong="H6268" * of|strong="H6268" * Days|strong="H3118" * sat|strong="H3488" *. motu: Bena hereva badadia, hari doa ese e gwaurai gaudia, daidiai na roha lao. Bena na roho laova ai, hari mauri ḡauna na e alaia mase, tau-anina na e habuaia tari, e heni, Iahi ese baine ḡolea oho.
english: “I watched at that time because of the voice of the arrogant words which the horn spoke. I watched even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

motu: Hari mauri ḡaudia oredia na edia lohia siahuna na e abia oho, a edia mauri na nega taina e hadaudaua ela bona nega ta.
english: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

motu: Bena hanuaboi mata-hanaidia ai na itaia, ta na guba oridia ai ema, ia na taunimanima natuna na heto; ia na Gauka dekena ema, bena vairanai e hakaua lao.
english: “I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him.

motu: Bena lohia siahuna e henia, bona hairai bona basileia danu, bese idau-idau bona basileia idau-idau bona gado idau- idau iboudiai ese ia isiaina bae lao heni helaoreana; iena lohia siahuna na mia-hanaihanai siahuna, basine puki oho ḡauna, bona ena basileia danu ta ese basine habuaia tari.
english: Dominion was given him, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which will not pass away, and his kingdom one that will not be destroyed.

motu: A lau Daniel na laumagu e daure, bona kwaragu mata-hanaidia ese e hagarigu.
english: “As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

motu: Bena unuseni ai e giniva taudia ta na raka henia kahi, na nanadaia, ina idoinai anina korikori be dahaka. Taunabunai ia ese e hamaorogu, bona unu ḡau anidia e hadibalaigu, eto,
english: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. “ So|strong="H4481" * he told me|strong="H5922" *, and|strong="H7127" * made|strong="H3046" * me|strong="H5922" * know|strong="H3046" * the|strong="H3606" * interpretation|strong="H6591" * of|strong="H4481" * the|strong="H3606" * things|strong="H4406" *.

motu: Ini mauri ḡaudia badadia haniosi na pavapava hahani, tanobada ai bae tore isi.
english: ‘These great animals, which are four, are four kings, who will arise out of the earth.

motu: A Herea Mikamika Diravana ena helaḡa taudia ese basileia bae abia, basileia na bae ḡaunaia hanaihanai, oibe, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’

motu: Bena na ura baina diba, hari mauri ḡauna ihahanina herevana korikorina be dahaka. Ia na idau, dia oredia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia. Ia na mai gari-badana; isena na auri bona kahauna na auri labora-labora. Ia ese ḡau e aniva, e dare patapatava, bona momoruna na aena amo e moi patapatava.
english: “Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was different from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of bronze; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;

motu: Bona doa gwauta kwarana ai herevadia danu, bona una doa ta, e tubu bena ia vairanai doa toi e moru ḡauna, mai matana bona mai uduna bena hereva badadi e gwaurai bona ita-itana ese bamona ita-itadia na e hereadiava gauna, herevana.
english: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes and a mouth that spoke arrogantly, whose look was more stout than its fellows.

motu: Lau na roha laova ai, una doa ese helaḡa taudia e tuari henidia bona e hadareredia,
english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them,

motu: ela bona Ḡauka na ema, bena ia ese hahemaoro e karaia, Herea Mikamika Diravana ena helaḡa taudia maorodia e gwaurai; bena negana e gini dae helaḡa taudia ese basileia e abia.
english: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

motu: Taunabunai ia eto, Mauri ḡauna ihahanina na iniheto: Basileia ihahanina na tanobada latanai baine vara; ia na baine idau, dia basileia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia; ia ese tanobada idoinai baine hadonoa, baine moia tao, baine hamakohia patapata.
english: “So he said, ‘The fourth animal will be a fourth kingdom on earth, which will be different from all the kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth, and will tread it down and break it in pieces.

motu: Unu doa gwauta be pavapava gwauta, una basileia lalona amo bae tore isi; bona idia muridiai ma ta baine tore isi. Ia baine idau, dia unu gunadia heḡereḡeredia, ia ese pavapava tatoi baine hadareredia.
english: As for the ten horns, ten kings will arise out of this kingdom. Another will arise after them; and he will be different from the former, and he will put down three kings.

motu: Ia ese Herea Mikamika Diravana baine gonagonalaia, bona Herea Mikamika Diravana ena helaḡa taudia edia goada baine ha-orea; ia ese nega bona taravatu iha-idaudia daladia baine lalo hata, bena ia imana ai bae heni, laḡani ta bona laḡani rua bona laḡani kahana ai.
english: He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

motu: A hahemaoro tauna ese hahemaoro baine karaia, bena iena lohia siahuna bae abia oho, bae ha-orea bona bae habuaia tari ela bona dokona.
english: “‘But the judgment will be set, and they will take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.

motu: Bena basileia bona lohia siahuna, bona guba idoinai henunai e miamu basileiadia siahudia danu na Herea Mikamika Diravana ena helaḡa taudia bae henidia; edia basileia na mia-hanaihanai basileiana ai bainela, bona orea mai siahudia iboudiai ese isiaidia bae lao heni bona bae kamonai henidia.
english: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, will be given to the people of the saints of the Most High. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions will serve and obey him.’

motu: Hereva dokona binai. A lau Daniel egu lalo-hadai ese e hagarigu bona na labora ḡuḡuru; a ina hereva na lalogu ai na dogoa tao.
english: “Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.”

motu: King Belesasara ena lohia laḡanina ihatoina lalonai, lau Daniel na mata hanai lou, nega gunana ai egu ai e kau ḡauna e hedinarai murinai.
english: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

motu: Egu mata-hanai ai ḡau haida na itadia; na itadia negana ai lau na hanua badana Susa ai, Elam tanona ai; bena mata-hanaigu ai na itaia, lau na Ulai sinavaina isena ai.
english: I saw the vision. Now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.

motu: Lau na roha isi, bena mamoe maruanena ta sinavai isena ai ginina ai na itaia. Ia doana na rua; ruaosi lalata, a ta ese ma ta e hereaia, bona lata-hereana na gabe ai e tubu ḡauna.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a ram which had two horns stood before the river. The two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

motu: Bena na itaia, hari mamoe maruanena na mai daḡedaḡena ida e heau taiko-taiko, lahara kahana ai bona mirigini kahana ai bona diho kahana ai; mauri ḡauna ta se heḡereḡere ia vairanai baine gini, bona ta se heḡereḡere iena siahu amo baine heraua. Ia ese sibona ena ura e karava, bona sibona e heimodaiva.
english: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could deliver out of his hand, but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.

motu: Na haeroava ai, nani maruanena ta na itaia, lahara kahana amo ema, tanobada idoinai e hanaia, tano ai se moi kauva; ia na mai doana ta, hedinarai mataka-mataka ḡauna, matana ruaosi padadiai.
english: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground. The goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

motu: Ia na ema, hari mamoe maruanena mai doana rua, sinavai isena ai na itaia ḡauna, dekenai; bena mai badu ḡaraḡarana ida e heau henia.
english: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.

motu: Lau na itaia, ia ese hari mamoe maruanena e heau henia kahi, bena e badu henia lalo-dika, e nuaia, doana ruaosi e hakwaidudia. Hari mamoe maruanena na asi goadana ia vairanai baine gini; una ḡau ese e nuaia keto tano ai, bena e moia patapata; asi tauna ta ese una mamoe maruanena na ia siahuna amo baine hamauria diba.
english: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns. There was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground and trampled on him. There was no one who could deliver the ram out of his hand.

motu: Bena hari nani maruanena na sibona e heaḡi dikadika; a ena goada negana ai hari doana badana e kwaidu, bena ia gabuna ai doa hani, hedinarai mataka-mataka ḡaudia, e vara, guba laidia haniosi kahadia e tubu henidia.
english: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.

motu: Idia ta ena amo doa maragina ta e vara, bena e tubu badabada, diho kahana bona mairiveina kahana bona mai hairaina tanona e tubu henidia.
english: Out of one of them came out a little horn which grew exceedingly great—toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.

motu: E tubu badabada ela bona guba oreana; bena hisiu haida na tano ai e tahodia dobi, bena e moidia patapata.
english: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and it cast down some of the army and of the stars to the ground and trampled on them.

motu: Sibona e heagi, guba oreana lohiana e dae henia; bena ḡole-oho boubouna, e heni louloumu ḡauna, na iena amo e abia oho, bona ena gabu helaḡana na e ḡiḡia dobi.
english: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

motu: Bena orea na ia imana ai e heato, bona gole oho boubouna, e heni louloumu ḡauna, danu, kara havara dainai; hereva momokani na tano ai e henege dobi, bona hari doa e gaukarava bona ena namo e habadaiava.
english: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience. It cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.

motu: Bena helaḡa tauna ta gadona na kamonai; bena helaḡa tauna ma ta ese e hereva guna tauna na e nanadaia, eto, Ini mata-hanai ḡaudia, ḡole-oho boubouna, e heni louloumu ḡauna, bona kara havara, gabu e havahuamu gauna, bona gabu helaḡana bona orea na ae-moimoilai ḡaudia ai e halaodiamu na bae hesiriu ela bona edena nega ai?
english: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, “How long will the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot be?”

motu: Bena ia ese e haere henia, eto, Ela bona adorahi daha-rua sinahu-toi bona daba daha-rua sinahu-toi; bena gabu helaḡana na bae hanamoa lou, oromana korikorina baine abia lou.
english: He said to me, “To two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary will be cleansed.”

motu: Lau Daniel ese una mata-hanai na itaia vaitani, bena anina na tahua; bena ta na lau vairagu ai e gini, ita-itana na taunimanima na heto.
english: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. Then behold, there stood before me someone with the appearance of a man.

motu: Bena tau ta gadona na kamonai, Ulai sinavaina isena padadia amo e boiboi, eto, Gabriel e, ina tau na mata-hanai anina ba hadibalaia.
english: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia ese egu gini gabuna e raka henia kahi; bena ia ema negana ai na gari, bena na goru diho. A ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Taunimanima natuna e, ba diba, una mata-hanai na nega dokona e hahedinaIaiamu.
english: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand, son of man, for the vision belongs to the time of the end.”

motu: Ia dounu e herevava ai, lau na goru-dihogu ai na mahuta hedavauhe; a ia ese e daugu toho, bena e haginigu tore.
english: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me and set me upright.

motu: Ia eto, A itaia, baina hadibamu, badu negana dokona ai dahaka baine vara; badina be nega dokona vada e duanaia negana herevana binai.
english: He said, “Behold, I will make you know what will be in the latter time of the indignation, for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.

motu: Hari mamoe maruanena o itaia mai doana rua, unu na Media bona Parasa pavapavadia.
english: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

motu: Hari nani maruanena na Helene tanona pavapavana; doa badana ia matana ruaosi padadiai na pavapava gini-gunana.
english: The rough male goat is the king of Greece. The great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

motu: Doa ta e kwaidu, bena ia gabuna ai doa hani e tubu anina be basileia hani na iena bese amo bae vara, a iena siahu basie haheḡereḡerea.
english: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms will stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.

motu: Edia lohia negana dokona ai, kara havara taudia bae goada ḡuḡuru negana ai, pavapava ta, vaira-auka bona hereva hehunidia anidia mai dibana tauna, baine tore isi.
english: “In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding riddles, will stand up.

motu: Ena siahu baine bada; ia ese hahebua-tari badana baine havaraia, ena ḡaukara ai baine kwalimu, goada tauna bona orea helaḡana taudia na baine habuadia tari.
english: His power will be mighty, but not by his own power. He will destroy awesomely, and will prosper in what he does. He will destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.

motu: Ena dibaka ai, kara koikoi anidia baine habadadia, ia unana henunai, bona lalona ai sibona baine heaḡi. Ia ese hutuma baine habuadia tari taku; lohia edia Lohia danu baine tuari henia, bena baine darere, a dia taunimanima ta imana amo.
english: Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes, but he will be broken without human hands.

motu: Hari adorahi bona daba sivaraidia mata-hanaina na momokani; a una mata-hanai ba hunia, badina be una na dina hoho vairai herevana.
english: “The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many days to come.”

motu: Bena lau Daniel taugu na e manori, dina haida na hekure noho, mai goreregu ida. Bena na tore isi, hanua pavapavana ena ḡaukara na karaia; a una mata-hanai dainai lalogu e hekwarahi; bona asina dibaia namonamo.
english: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick for some days. Then I rose up and did the king’s business. I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.

motu: Darauese Ahasuero, tau Mede, ese Kaldea basileiana e pavapavaia laḡanina gini-gunana ai,
english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—

motu: ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana lalonai lau Daniel buka lalodia amo na diba laḡani hida baela ela bona Ierusalem ihavahuna baine guguru, Iehova ena hereva peroveta tauna Ieremia enai e kau heḡereḡerena; unu laḡanidia be hitu-ahui.
english: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which Yahweh’s + 9:2 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

motu: Bena Ḡaubada Dirava na haḡerea, ḡuriḡuri ai bona noinoi ai na tahua, mai anivagagu bona mai puse-dabuagu bona mai kahugu ida.
english: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

motu: Iehova, egu Dirava, na guria, egu dika na gwaurai hedinarai, nato: Ḡaubada e, Dirava badana bona mai garina, oi ese emu gwauhamata bona emu hebogahisi o hahesiriudiamu, e ura henimumu bona emu haheḡani e badinadiamu taudia ediai.
english: I prayed to Yahweh my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord|strong="H3068" *, the|strong="H8104" * great|strong="H1419" * and|strong="H3068" * dreadful|strong="H3372" * God|strong="H3068" *, who|strong="H3068" * keeps|strong="H8104" * covenant|strong="H1285" * and|strong="H3068" * loving kindness|strong="H2617" * with|strong="H3068" * those who|strong="H3068" * love|strong="H2617" * him|strong="H8104" * and|strong="H3068" * keep|strong="H8104" * his|strong="H8104" * commandments|strong="H4687" *,

motu: Ai na vada a kara dika, vada a kara kerere, kara havara bona daḡedaḡe karadia vada a kara, emu haheḡani bona emu taravatu daladia amo vada a raka siri;
english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.

motu: emu hesiai taudia, peroveta taudia, oi ladamu ai emai pavapava, emai lohia, senemai bona tano taudia iboudiai e hereva henidia taudia na asia kamonai henidia.
english: We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

motu: Ḡaubada e, kara maoromaoro na oiemu ai, a ai emai ai na hemarai, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena, Iuda taudia ediai, bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ediai, bona Israel idoinai enai, gabu kahikahi taudia bona gabu daudau taudia, vada o luludia lao tanodia iboudiai lalodiai; badina be idia ese oi ihadikamu karadia vada e kara.
english: “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

motu: Ḡaubada e, hemarai na ai emai ai, bona emai pavapava bona emai lohia bona senemai ediai, badina be ai ese vada a kara dika henimu.
english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

motu: Ḡaubada, emai Dirava, na mal hebogahisina bona mai dika igwau-taona; badina be ai ese vada a daḡedaḡe henia
english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.

motu: bona Iehova, emai Dirava, gadona asia kamonai henia, ena taravatu, ena hesiai peroveta taudla eaia amo vairamai ai e atodia taravatudia, asia badinadia.
english: We haven’t obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

motu: Israel idoinai ese emu taravatu vada e tataia utu; vada a raka siri, oi eremu ikamonaina asia ura. Heuduguirai bona gwauhamata helaḡana Dirava ena hesiai tauna Mose ena taravatu ai e hetore gaudia, na ai latamai ai vada eme hebubu dobi, badina be ai ese vada a kara dika henia.
english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice. “ Therefore|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H3605" * curse|strong="H7621" * and|strong="H4872" * the|strong="H3605" * oath|strong="H7621" * written|strong="H3789" * in|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H3605" * law|strong="H8451" * of|strong="H6963" * Moses|strong="H4872" * the|strong="H3605" * servant|strong="H5650" * of|strong="H6963" * God has|strong="H3478" * been|strong="H5674" * poured|strong="H5413" * out|strong="H5413" * on|strong="H5921" * us|strong="H5921" *, for|strong="H3588" * we|strong="H3068" * have|strong="H5650" * sinned|strong="H2398" * against|strong="H5921" * him|strong="H5921" *.

motu: Ia ese ena hereva vada e hamomokanidia. ai latamai ai bona ikwaramai taudia latadiai e gwaurai gaudia, hahehisi karana badana na ai latamai ai vada e mailaia; badina be guba idoinai henunai kara ta nega ta ai se karaia, Ierusalem vada e kara henia heḡereḡerena.
english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

motu: Mose ena taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena ai, ina hahehisi karana idoinai na ai latamai ai vada e kau, ḡau tamona Iehova, emai Dirava, asia noi henimu ba lalo namo henimai, emai kara havara amo ba mede kerehai bona emu hereva momokanidia nahuadia baia toho helaoreana.
english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of Yahweh our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.

motu: Taunabunai Iehova ese hahehisi karana vada e haheḡaeḡaea bona latamai ai vada e mailaia; badina be Iehova, emai Dirava, na maoromaoro, vada e kara karadia iboudiai lalodiai, bona ai ese ia erena asia kamonaia.
english: Therefore Yahweh has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

motu: Ḡaubada e, emai Dirava e, oi ese emu bese taudia na Aigupto tanona amo o hakaudia Lasi, mai imamu goadana ida, bona ladamu vada o habadaia, ina dina ai heḡereḡerena; a harihari ai ese vada a kara dika, vada a kara havara.
english: “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.

motu: Ḡaubada e, emu kara maoromaorodia iboudiai heḡereḡeredia ai, emu badu bona emu lalo-dika na emu hanua Ierusalem, emu ororo helaḡana, amo baine siri; badina be emai kara dika bona senemai edia kara havara daidiai, Ierusalem bona oiemu bese na gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai vada e hahelao, e ḡeḡemai dae taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

motu: Taunabunai, emai Dirava e, emu hesiai tauna ena ḡuriḡuri bona ena noinoi ba hakala henidia, bona oi sibomu daimu ai, Ḡaubada e, oi vairamu ese emu gabu helaḡana, vada eme vahu gabuna, baine hadiaria.
english: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

motu: Egu Dirava e, laiamu a hakala, a kamonai, matamu a hapapa, ḡaḡaemai ai ba itamai, bona oi ladamu e nemailaia hanuana ba itaia. Badina be emai noinoi na oi vairamu ai e daemu, dia ai emai kara maoromaoro daidiai, a oiemu hebogahisi badana dainai.
english: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

motu: Ḡaubada e, a kamonai; Ḡaubada e, emai dika ba gwau tao; Ḡaubada e, ba lalomai, ba kara; egu Dirava e, basio halahe, oi sibomu daimu ai, badina be emu hanua bona emu bese na oi ladamu e hahenemailaia. Peroveta herevadia
english: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

motu: Egu hereva bona egu ḡuriḡuri lalodiai egu kara dika bona egu bese Israel edia kara dika na gwaurai hedinaraiva, bona Iehova, egu Dirava, na noinoi heniava, egu Dirava ena ororo helaḡana dainai;
english: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before Yahweh my God for the holy mountain of my God—

motu: bena, ḡuriḡuri dounu na gwauraiava ai, hari tau Gabriel, mata-hanai ai na itaia guna tauna, na dekegu e roho mai haraga, adorahi boubouna negana ai.
english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

motu: Ia na ema, e hereva henigu, eto, Daniel e, aonega bona lalo-parara batna henimu totona vada na hedinaraimu.
english: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.

motu: Emu noinoi matamana ai hereva ta e lasi, bena ihamaorolaimu totona vada nama, badina be oi na e lalokau henimu badamu; taunabunai, hereva ba haeroa, bona mata-hanai anina ba diba.
english: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision.

motu: Laḡani hitu nega hahitu-ahui be vada e gwauraidia, emu bese bona emu hanua helaḡana latadiai, kerere iha-orena, kara dika ihadokona, kara havara irohodia, baine mia hanaihanai kara-maoromaorona imailaina, matahanai bona peroveta tauna ihamomokanina bona helaga-herea gabuna ihorona totodia.
english: “Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

motu: Taunabunai ba diba, lalomu danu baine parara, Ierusalem ihanamo-louna bona ihaginina herevana baine hedinarai negana ela bona lohia ta, e horoa tauna, bainema na pura hitu. Bena pura tauratoi-ahui rua lalodiai bae haginia lou, mai ariarana bona mai iḡeḡe-ahuna koupana, a hekwakwanai momo negana ai.
english: “Know therefore and discern that from the going out of the commandment to restore and build Jerusalem to the Anointed One, + 9:25 “Anointed One” can also be translated “Messiah” (same as “Christ”). * the prince, will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be built again, with street and moat, even in troubled times.

motu: Bena unu pura tauratoi-ahui rua muridiai, e horoa tauna na bae negea daure, ḡau ta ienai basine mia; bona bainen-a lohiana ena orea taudia ese hanua bona gabu helaḡana bae habuadia tari. Utu-utu ese baine ha-orea, bona tuari do baine hesiriu ela bona dokona. Hahevahu karadia vada e gwaurai hata.
english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One + 9:26 “Anointed One” can also be translated “Messiah” (same as “Christ”). * will be cut off, and will have nothing. The people of the prince who come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood, and war will be even to the end. Desolations are determined.

motu: Bena ia ese hutuma ida bae hegwau hamata heheni, gwauhamata aukana ta, ela bona pura ta baine ore. Pura kahana ai ia ese boubou bona herahia karadia baine hadokodia, bona ḡau dika-rohorohona hanina latadiai hahevahu tauna ta bainema, ela bona vada e gwauraia hata dokona negana na hahevahu tauna latanai baine hebubu dobi.
english: He will make a firm covenant with many for one week. In the middle of the week he will cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease. On the wing of abominations will come one who makes desolate; and even to the decreed full end, wrath will be poured out on the desolate.”

motu: Kurese, Parasa pavapavana, ena lohia laḡanina ihatoina ai, hereva ta e hedinarai Daniel (ladana ta na Beletesasara) enai. Hereva na momokani, tuari badana herevana. Hereva anina vada e dibaia, bona matahanai anina danu.
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the message was true, even a great warfare. He understood the message, and had understanding of the vision.

motu: Unu dinadia ai, lau, Daniel, Ialogu e hisihisiva pura toi lalodiai.
english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

motu: Aniani gaihodia asina ani, vamu eiava vine ranuna na udugu ai asie vareai, bona dehoro ai asina hedahu, ela bona unu pura ḡuḡurudia toi.
english: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

motu: Hua gini-gunana dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, sinavai badana, ladana Tigris, isena ai na giniva negana ai,
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel, + 10:4 or, Tigris River *

motu: lau na roha isi, tau ta na itaia, ena hahedoki na dabua aukana ḡaua bona ena gaba ḡauna na Ufasa gold *-na.
english: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.

motu: Tau-anina na berulio nadina na heto; vairana ita-itana na kevaru; matana na kede hururu-hururudia na heheto, imana bona aena na auri labora-labora hmorena na heto, bona erena na hutuma eredia na heto. + 10:6 Berulio na herahera nadina ta ladana. *
english: His body also was like beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.

motu: Lau, Daniel, sibogu ese mata-hanai na itaia, badina be bamogu ese asie itaia, to gari ese e butudia tao, bena e heau, bae komu totona.
english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision, but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

motu: Taunabunai, hu na sibogu na noho, una mata-hanai badana na itaia, bena goadagu vada e ore; vairagu hairaina e idau herea, bona goadagu taina dia mia.
english: So I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.

motu: Bena erena na kamonai. Erena na kamonai negana ai, lau na goru parapara tano ai, na mahuta hedavauhe.
english: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

motu: Bena ima ta ese e daugu toho, bena na hetao isi, tuigu ai bona imagu ai, mai heude-heudegu ida.
english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

motu: Ia ese e hereva henigu, eto, Daniel e, e lalokau henimu badamu taumu, na hamaorolaimumu herevadia nahuadia ba toho, ba gini tore, badina be ina harihari oi dekemu vada e siaigu mai. Ina hereva e hamaorolaigu lalonai, na gini tore mai heude-heudegu ida.
english: He said to me, “Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have been sent to you, now.” When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

motu: Bena ia ese ma e hamaorogu, eto, Daniel e, basio gari, badina be lalo-parara o tahua matama bona emu Dirava vairanai sibomu o hahemanau dinana amo, emu hereva na vada e kamonai, bena emu hereva daidiai vada nama.
english: Then he said to me, “Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come for your words’ sake.

motu: Parasa basileia lohiana ese dina ruahui-ta e ginigu shu; bena Mikael, lohia badana ta, na ikahagu totona ema, taunabunai unuseni ai na rakatania, Parasa basileia lohiana ida.
english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia.

motu: Bena nama, dina gabedia ai dahaka dahaka baine vara emu bese taudia ediai baina hadibamu totona. Badina be mata-hanai na nega vaira ḡauna.
english: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision is yet for many days.”

motu: Ini hereva e hamaorolaigu negana ai, tano na igo henia, asi reḡereḡegu na noho.
english: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and was mute.

motu: Bena ta, ita-itana na taunimanima natudia ta na heto, ese bibinagu e daudia toho. Bena udugu na kehoa, na hereva. Vairagu ai e giniva tauna na hamaoroa, nato, Egu lohia e, na mata hanai dainai, hisihisi na egu ai vada e kau, bona egu goada vada e ore.
english: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, “My lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me, and I retain no strength.

motu: Egu lohia emu hesiai tauna na egu lohia ida ede baita hereva-hereva toma? Badina be harihari goadagu taina na dia mia, bona laḡagu taina danu dia mia.
english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”

motu: Una murinai ta, ita-itana na taunimanima na heto, ese e daugu toho, e hagoadagu.
english: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me.

motu: Ia eto, E lalokau henimu badamu taumu e, basio gari, maino na emu ai baine mia; ba goada, ba haheauka. E hereva henigu negana ai na goada, bena nato, Egu lohia e, a hereva, badina be vada ome hagoadagu.
english: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When|strong="H3588" * he|strong="H3588" * spoke|strong="H1696" * to|strong="H1696" * me|strong="H1696" *, I|strong="H3588" * was|strong="H1696" * strengthened|strong="H2388" *, and|strong="H2388" * said|strong="H1696" *, “Let my|strong="H1696" * lord speak|strong="H1696" *, for|strong="H3588" * you|strong="H3588" * have|strong="H7965" * strengthened|strong="H2388" * me|strong="H1696" *.”

motu: Bena ia eto, Oi dibamu dahaka dainai dekemu vada nama a? A harihari baina lou lao, Parasa lohiana baina tuari henia; baina hadarerea, bena Helene lohiana bainema.
english: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.

motu: A baina hamaoromu, hereva momokanina bukana ai ede e hetore tomamu; asi tauna ta ohegu kahana ai e tuarimu, emu lohia Mikael mo sibona.
english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince.

motu: A lau be Darauese, tau Mede, ena lohia laḡanina gini-gunana ai na tore isi, baina hamomokania bona baina hagoadaia totona. Mirigini kahana pavapavana bona diho kahana pavapavana
english: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.

motu: Harihari lau ese hereva momokanina baina hahedinarai henimu. A itaia, pavapava tatoi ma bae tore isi Parasa ai, bona ihahanina ena taḡa ese idia tatoiosi edia taḡa baine hereadia; bena ena taḡa dainai baine goada negana ai, ia ese taunimanima iboudiai lalodia baine ani, Helene basikiana bae hadikaia.
english: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia. The fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.

motu: Bena pavapava mai siahuna ta baine tore isi; ia baine lohia mai siahu-badana ida, bona ena ura heḡereḡerena ai baine karaia.
english: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

motu: Baine tore isi murinai, ena basileia baine heḡiḡi rohoroho bona baine hehari, guba laidia haniosi ediai; ia garana basie abia, bona ta ese basine lohiaia mai siahuna ida, iena lohia siahuna heḡereḡerena; badina be ena basileia baine heraḡa oho, idaudia haida ese bae abia, dia idia:
english: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.

motu: Bena diho kahana pavapavana baine goada, a iena lohia tauna ta ese goada ai baine hereaia, bena ena lohia siahuna na baine herea.
english: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.

motu: Laḡani haida baela, bena bae herohemaino; bena diho kahana pavapavana natuna hahinena na mirigini kahana pavapavana dekena bainela, maino ihavarana totona; a una hahine imana siahuna na basine mia, bona una tau mai natuna ida basie noho daudau; bena una hahine na baine heabi mauri, ia bona ena hesiai hahinedia bona natuna bona adavana.
english: At the end of years they will join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement, but she will not retain the strength of her arm. He will also not stand, nor will his arm; but she will be given up, with those who brought her, and he who became the father of her, and he who strengthened her in those times.

motu: Unu negadia ai, una hahine ramuna amo e tubu rigidia ta na una tau gabuna ai baine tore isi, bena ia ese tuari oreana baine tuari henia, mirigini kahana pavapavana ena ruma aukana ai baine dae kau, baine ala-ala henidia, bena baine kwalimu.
english: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them and will prevail.

motu: Edia dirava bona edia kaivakuku, e hahetaridia ḡaudia, bona edia sdver bona gold * ḡaudia, ḡau namo-hereadia, danu baine abidia, Aigupto baine laohaidia; bena laḡani haida lalodiai ia ese mirigini kahana pavapavana basine tuari henia.
english: He will also carry their gods with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, captive into Egypt. He will refrain some years from the king of the north.

motu: Bena hari mirigini kahana pavapavana na diho kahana pavapavana ena tano lalonai baine raka vareai, a ma baine lou, ena tano korikori bainela.
english: He will come into the realm of the king of the south, but he will return into his own land.

motu: Bena ia natuna mamaruanedia bae tuari, tuari oreadia badadia momo bae haboudia, bena bae aru lao, bae utua dae, bae hanai, tuari ma bae laohaia ela bona ena ruma aukana.
english: His sons will wage war, and will assemble a multitude of great forces which will come on, and overflow, and pass through. They will return and wage war, even to his fortress.

motu: Bena diho kahana pavapavana na mai baduna ida baine raka lasi, mirigini kahana pavapavana baine tuari henia; orea bada-hereana baine haboua, a una orea na ia imana ai baine heato.
english: “The king of the south will be moved with anger and will come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. He will send out a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.

motu: Bena hari orea bada-hereana baine darere negana ai, ia lalona baine heagi, bena gerebu gerebu baine hadareredia, to basine kwalimu.
english: The multitude will be carried off, and his heart will be exalted. He will cast down tens of thousands, but he won’t prevail.

motu: Badina be hari mirigini kahana pavapavana ese hutuma ma baine haboudia, ina hutuma ese e haboua guna oreana na baine hereaia; bena laḡani haida baela murinai ia na ma baine tore isi, mai ena tuari oreana badana bona ena kohu momo herea ida.
english: The king of the north will return, and will send out a multitude greater than the former. He will come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with abundant supplies.

motu: Unu negadia ai hutuma ese diho kahana pavapavana bae tuari henia, bona emu bese korikorina bogaragina amo daḡedaḡe taudia haida bae tore isi, mata-hanai anina ihavarana totona; to basie kwalimu.
english: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision, but they will fall.

motu: Bena mirigini kahana pavapavana na bainema, tano baine larebaia heḡeḡe, bena hanua auka-hereana ta na baine abia. Bena diho kahana tuari oreadia na basie gini tutuka, oibe, ena tuari diba-herea taudia na basie gini tutuka, badina be edia goada basine heḡereḡere.
english: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.

motu: A baine tuari henia tauna ese sibona ena ura heḡereḡerena baine karaia; tau ta ia vairanai basine gini diba. Ia na tano herea-daena ai baine gini; idoinai na ia siahuna lalonai baine mia.
english: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.

motu: Ia vairana baine ha-aukaia, ena basileia goadana idoinai ida bainema, herohemaino herevadia baine mailai, bona karadia baine kara. Hahine herea-daena baine henia, basileia ihabua-tarina helaoreana; a anina basine vara bona basine durua.
english: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won’t be for him.

motu: Gabeamo ia talaina na kone tanodia baine henidia, bena momo herea baine abidia. A tuari lohiana ta ese ena hekokoroku baine laoa ahu; momokani, ma baine haloua ia latanai.
english: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.

motu: Bena talaina na ena tano korikori gabudia aukadia ma baine heni; a baine hetutuhi, baine hekida diho, bena ta ese basine davaria.
english: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.

motu: Bena tau ta baine tore isi, ia gabuna ai baine gini; una tau ese heaiva monina igwauraina tauna ta baine siaia lao, ena basileia kahadia herea-daedia iboudiai lalodiai; a dina hida hona baela, bena haida ese bae alaia, dia badu ai bona dia tuari ai.
english: “Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place; but within few days he shall be destroyed, not in anger, and not in battle.

motu: Ia gabuna ai bonegita tauna ta e tore isi, pavapava dagina asie henia tauna; ia na baine gini lasi kava, boga-alaga herevadia amo basileia na baine abia.
english: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

motu: Tuari oreadia na ia vairanai bae hedaro oho, bae karoho rohoroho, bona herohemaino lohiana danu.
english: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.

motu: Ia ida bae herohemaino negana amo, ia na baine kara koikoi; bena orea maragina ida baine goada.
english: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.

motu: Tano ena taḡa-herea gabudia ai baine hedinarai kava, bena tamana bona tubuna asie kara karadia baine kara, dadidadi bona henao kohudia bona ḡau idau-idau na bogaragidiai baine ḡiḡidia rohoroho. Gabu aukadia ihabua-taridia daladia baine lalo hata, a basine maivalo.
english: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and wealth. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.

motu: Bena tuari oreana badana amo ena siahu bona ena haheauka baine habadadia, diho kahana pavapavana ihadikana totona; bona diho kahana pavapavana danu tuari oreana bada-hereana bona goada-hereana amo baine tuari; a basine gini tutuka, badina be haida ese ia ihadikana totona bae henega bou.
english: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

motu: Ena aniani gaiho-lia bae ani taudia ese danu bae hahekwakwanaia; ena tuari oreana baine hedaro oho, bona hutuma na ala-ala ai bae hekida diho.
english: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.

motu: A hari pavapava raruosi be kara dika bae uralai bada; pata tamona ai koikoi herevadia bae gwaurai, a anidia basie vara; badina be dokona be dohore, vada e gwauraia guna negana ai mo.
english: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.

motu: Bena ena tano korikori baine lou henia, mai taḡana ida; a lalona ese herohemaino helaḡana baine dadaraia. Ena ura baine karaia, bena ena tano korikori baine lou henia.
english: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.

motu: E gwauraia guna negana ai ia ma baine lou lao, diho kahana; a ina negana ai nega gunana heḡereḡerena ai basine vara lou.
english: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.

motu: Badina be Kitim lagatoidia na ia ihadikana totona bae mai henia; bena ia na baine gari, baine raka oho, mai baduna ida baine lou lao, herohemaino helaḡana ihadikana karadia baine kara. Baine lou lao, herohemaino helaḡana e rakataniamu taudia baine kamonai henidia.
english: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

motu: lena tuari oreadia haida bae hedinarai, dubu bona ruma aukana bae hamirodia, bona ḡole-oho boubouna, e heni louloumu ḡauna, bae abia oho, bona ḡau dika-rohorohona, hahevahu ḡauna, bae haginia.
english: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.

motu: Herohemaino e hadikaiamu taudia na boga-alaga herevadia amo baine dibaganidia; a edia Dirava dibadia taudia na bae gini tutuka-tutuka, bona edia kara bae kara.
english: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.

motu: Aonega taudia hahidaosi taunimanima bogaragidiai e nohomu ese hutuma na bae hadibadibadia; ḡau tamona idia na dare bona lahi hururu-hururuna bona abi-mauri bona dadidadi amo bae dika, dina haida lalodiai.
english: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.

motu: Bae dika negana ai, idia ese hekaha taina bae davaria. Hutuma na ediai bae tao, mai edia boga-alaga herevadia ida;
english: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.

motu: aonega taudia haida bae hekida diho, ihanamodia bona ihaḡoevadia bona ihakurokurodia totona, ela bona nega dokona, badina be vada e gwauraia guna negana na do se kau.
english: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed.

motu: Hanua pavapavana ese ena ura heḡereḡerena baine karaia; sibona baine heimodai, sibona baine heaḡi, dirava iboudiai daediai, bona hoa herevadia baine gwaurai, dirava edia Dirava latanai. Namona baine hesiriu, ela bona badu baine guguru; badina be vada e gwawaia hata karana do baine hekara.
english: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.

motu: Senena edia dirava eiava hahine e lalokau heniamu diravana na basine kamonai henidia; bona dirava idauna ta basine kamonai henia, badina be sibona baine heimodai, dirava iboudiai daediai.
english: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.

motu: Idia gabudia ai ia ese gabu aukadia diravana baine imodaia; senena asi dibadia diravana na goW bona silver *, dava-bada nadidia bona davabada herahia gaudia, amo baine imodaia.
english: But in their place, he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.

motu: Gabu auka-hereadia baine hadareredia, dirava idauna ta ena hekaha dainai; bae abiabiraia taudia na ia ese baine imodaidia bada. Ia ese hut uma ilohiadia ai baine halaodia, bona dava bagunai tano baine haria.
english: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.

motu: Nega dokona ai, diho kahana pavapavana ese baine tuari henia; a mirigini kahana pavapavana ese baine heau henia, koe-hirihiri na heto, mai ena kariota bona ena hosi-gui taudia bona ena lagatoi momo ida; tano haida baine lao henidia, baine ha-utudia dae, ma baine hanai.
english: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.

motu: Tano herea-daena lalonai baine kau. Gerebu gerebu bae hekida diho, a ini na id imana amo bae roho mauri: Edom bona Moab bona Amono besena kahana badana.
english: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

motu: Tano idau-idau ihadikadlia totona ia ese imana baine toia roro; Aigupto tanona danu basine roho mauri.
english: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won’t escape.

motu: Aigupto ena dava-bada ḡaudia, gold * bona silver * ḡaudia bona ḡau namo-hereadia iboudiai, biagudia ai bainela; bena Libia bona Etiopia taudia ese ia bae ḡavaia.
english: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps.

motu: A sivarai haida mairiveina kahana bona mirigini kahana amo baema, bae hagaria; bena ia na mai badu-ḡaraḡarana ida baine raka lasi, hutuma baine aladia ore bona baine habuadia tari helaoreana.
english: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.

motu: Ena kalaga herea-daedia na davara bona ororo helaḡana mai hairaina padadiai baine haginidia; ḡau tamona ena doko negana baine kau, una negana ai ta ese basine kahaia.
english: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

motu: Una negana ai Mikael, emu bese ireḡuna lohiana badana, baine tore isi. Hekwakwanai negana ta baine vara; unuhetomana na nega glmadia ta ai se vara, basileia e hematama negana amo ema bona hari ela bona una nega baine kau. A una negana ai emu bese taudia na bae rauadia, buka ai ladadia vada e hetore taudia iboudiai.
english: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.

motu: Tano gahuna ai e mahutamu taudia hutuma na bae noga, haida mauri hanaihanai enai, ma haida hemarai bona hedadarai hanaihanai enai.
english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

motu: Bena aonega taudia na bae diari, guba kiama-kiamana na heto, bona hutuma kara maoromaoro dalana lalonai bae hakaudia vareai taudia na bae diari, hisiu na heheto, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

motu: A oi, Daniel, hereva ba hunidia, bona buka ba koua kunuka-kunuka, ela bona dokona negana. Hutuma na bae heau lao heau mai, bona lalo-parara bae habadaia.
english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and knowledge will be increased.”

motu: Bena lau, Daniel, na roha lao, tatau rarua ginidia ai na itadia, ta sinavai inikahana ai bona ta sinavai unukahana ai.
english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

motu: Bena dabua aukana e hahedokilaia bona sinavai ranudia daediai nohona tauna na nanadaia, nato, Nega ede daudauna bainela ela bona ini hoa karadia dokodia.
english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”

motu: Bena dabua aukana e hahedokilaia bona sinavai ranudia daediai nohona tauna ese imana idibana bona laurina amo guba e dudui henia; bena na kamonai, ia na e noho hanaihanaimu Diravana ladana ai e gwau hamata, laḡani ta bona laḡani rua bona laḡani kahana baela, bena bese helaḡana ena siahu igigi-rohorohona baine ore negana ai, ini ḡau iboudiai anidia bae vara.
english: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have finished breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things will be finished.

motu: Hereva vada na kamonai, to lalogu se parara. Bena lau nato, Egu lohia e, ini ḡau amo dahaka baine vara?
english: I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”

motu: Ia eto, Daniel e, emu dala ai a raka lao; badina be hereva vada hehehuni, vada e hekou kunuka-kunuka, ela bona dokona negana.
english: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

motu: Hutuma na bae haheḡoeva, bae hahekurokuro, bae ḡoeva dae; a kara dika taudia do bae kara dika. Kara dika taudia ta lalona basine parara, a aonega taudia lalodia bae parara.
english: Many will purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined, but the wicked will do wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.

motu: Bena ḡole-oho boubouna, e heni louloumu gauna, baine heabi oho, bona ḡau dika-rohorohona, e hahevahumu ḡauna, bae haginia, negana amo dina daha-ta sinahu-rua taurahanita-ahui do baela.
english: “From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.

motu: Baine henari noho ela bona dina daha-ta sinahu-toi toi-ahui ima bae ore tauna na namo.
english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

motu: A emu dala ai ba raka ela bona dokona, bena oi na do ba laḡa ani, bona doko dinadia ai na vada e gwaurai henimu gabuna ai do ba gini.
english: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”

motu: Ina na Iehova ena hereva, Hosea Be-eri enai e kau herevana, Iuda pavapavadia Usia bona Iotam bona Ahasa bona Hesekia bona Israel pavapavana Ieroboam Ioasa edia nega ai.
english: Yahweh’s + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

motu: Iehova ese Hosea uduna amo e hereva matama negana ai, Iehova ese Hosea e hamaoroa, eto, Aola, ariara hahinena ta bavadavaia, bona ariara memerodia ba havaradia, badina be ina tano taudia e lebulebu hereamu, Iehova irakatanina ai.
english: When Yahweh spoke at first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking Yahweh.”

motu: Taunabunai ia na ela, Gomere, Diblaimi natuna hahinena, e abia; bena hahine na e rogorogo, natuna maruanena ta e abia.
english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

motu: Iehova ese e hamaoroa, eto, Ladana ba nemaia Iesrele; badina be asi vanahana lau ese Iehu iduhuna davana baina henia, Iesrele rarana dainai, bona Israel iduhuna basileiana baine ha-orea.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

motu: Una dina ai Israel ena peva baina hakwaidua, Iesrele kourana ai.
english: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

motu: Hahine na e rogorogo lou, natuna kekenina ta e abia. Iehova ese Hosea e hamaoroa, eto, Ladana ba nemaia “Se bogaia hisimu”; badina be ina murinai lau ese Israel iduhuna taudia basina bogadia hisi, bona edia dika basina gwau tao, lasi ona lasi vaitani.
english: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. english: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

english: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi, + 1:9 Lo-Ammi means “not my people”. * for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Israel taudia na bae hutuma, kone mirina na heto, basie hahetohodia bona basie duahidia diba ḡauna. E hamaorodia “Umui na dia lauegu bese” gabuna ai, bae hamaorodia, baeto “Mauri Diravana natuna verina”.
english: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

motu: Bena Iuda taudia bona Israel taudia na bae hahebou, ikwaradia tauna tamona bae gwauraia hidi. Bena tano amo bae dae lao, badina be Iesrele ena dina baine bada.
english: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.

motu: Tadikamamui ba hamaorodia, baoto “Egu bese”, bona taihumui ba hamaorodia, baoto “Hebogahisi vada e davaria”.

english: I will show wonders in the heavens and in the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.

english: It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as Yahweh|strong="H3068" * has said, and among the remnant, those whom Yahweh|strong="H3068" * calls.

motu: Ḡaubada na itaia, ihaboulaina patana badibadinai e gini, e hereva, eto: Au-tubua kwaradia ikorodla ba botadia, ela bona badidia bae heude-heude; ba huaridia patapata, bena taunimanima iboudiai kwaradia ai bae heḡiḡi kau. Bena oredia na dare amo baina aladia mase, ta basine heau oho, ta basine roho mauri.
english: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake. Break them in pieces on the head of all of them. I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them will flee away. Not one of them will escape.

motu: Ena be guri bae ḡei ela bona Mase Gabuna, to unu amo lau imagu ese baine abidia; ena be guba ai bae dara dae, to unu amo baina veridia dobi.
english: Though they dig into Sheol, + 9:2 Sheol is the place of the dead. * there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.

motu: Ena be Karamele ororona dorina ai bae komu, to unuseni ai baina tahudia ela bona baina abidia; ena be davara ena dobu gabudia ai lau vairagu amo bae komu, to unuseni ai dagwala baina haganidia, bena baine koridia.
english: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.

motu: Ena be inaidia ese bae guidia, bena bae doridia lao, to unuseni ai dare baina hagania, bena baine aladia mase. Baina raraidia tao, dia ihanamodia to ihadikadia totona.
english: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.

motu: Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, ese tanobada e daua tohomu, bena e veve ohomu, bona inoholaina taudia na e taitaimu; idoinai e daemu, Nilo sinavaina na heto, ma e dihomu, Nilo, Aigupto sinavaina, na heto.
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, is he who touches the land and it melts, and all who dwell in it will mourn; and it will rise up wholly like the River, and will sink again, like the River of Egypt.

motu: Ia ese ena atai daiutudia e hadaidiamu guba ai, bona ena henu daiutudia tanobada ai; ia ese davara ranudia e boilaidiamu, bona tanobada kopina ai e bubudia dobimu; ia ladana na Iehova.
english: It is he who builds his rooms in the heavens, and has founded his vault on the earth; he who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth—Yahweh is his name.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Israel taumui e, umui na dia Etiopia taudia heḡereḡeredia lauegu ai a? Israel taudia na Aigupto tanona amo asina hakaudia lasi a? Filistia taudia na Kaftoro amo bona Suria taudia na Kiri amo asina mailaidia a?
english: Are you not like the children of the Ethiopians to me, children of Israel?” says Yahweh. “Haven’t I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

motu: A itaia, Ḡaubada Iehova ese kara dika basileiana na e raraia taomu. Iehova na e tomu: tano kopina amo baina habuaia tari; ḡau tamona, Iakob ena iduhu basina habuaia tari vaitani. Israel baine namo lou
english: Behold, the eyes of the Lord Yahweh are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” says Yahweh.

motu: A itaia, lau na baina haheḡani, Israel besena baina haruiruia, basileia iboudiai bogaragidiai, ruirui ḡauna amo bama ruiruia na heto, a nadinadi ta na tano ai basine moru.
english: “For behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet not the least kernel will fall on the earth.

motu: Kara dika taudia egu bese bogaraginai iboudiai, e tomu “Dika ese basine lasida tao eiava basine hedavari henida” taudia, na dare ai bae mase.
english: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, who say, ‘Evil won’t overtake nor meet us.’

motu: Una dina ai David ena kalaga, e heḡiḡi dobi ḡauna, lau ese ma baina haginia lou; e mauru gabudia baina banidia, e heḡiḡi dobi gabudia baina haginidia, baina haginia lou, nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia ai!
english: In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old,

motu: Edom orena bae ḡaunaia helaoreana, bona lau ladagu e henemailai besedia iboudiai danu. Iehova, ini kara e karamu Diravana, na e herevamu.
english: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations who are called by my name,” says Yahweh who does this.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: A itaia, nega na e maimu, ruarua tauna ese uit iutuna tauna baine lasia tao, bona vine huahuadia imoimoilaidia tauna ese hadohado tauna baine lasia tao; ororo amo vine ranuna gaihona baine hetuturu, bona ororo komutadia amo baine aru.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “ that|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * plowman|strong="H2790" * shall|strong="H3068" * overtake|strong="H5066" * the|strong="H3605" * reaper|strong="H7114" *, and|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H3605" * one|strong="H3605" * treading|strong="H1869" * grapes|strong="H6025" * him|strong="H3605" * who|strong="H3605" * sows|strong="H4900" * seed|strong="H2233" *; and|strong="H3068" * sweet|strong="H6071" * wine|strong="H6071" * will|strong="H3068" * drip|strong="H5197" * from|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H3605" * mountains|strong="H2022" *, and|strong="H3068" * flow from|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H3605" * hills|strong="H1389" *.

english: I will bring my people Israel back from captivity, and|strong="H3478" * they|strong="H6213" * will|strong="H5971" * rebuild|strong="H1129" * the|strong="H6213" * ruined|strong="H8074" * cities|strong="H5892" *, and|strong="H3478" * inhabit|strong="H3427" * them|strong="H7725" *; and|strong="H3478" * they|strong="H6213" * will|strong="H5971" * plant|strong="H5193" * vineyards|strong="H3754" *, and|strong="H3478" * drink|strong="H8354" * wine|strong="H3196" * from|strong="H7725" * them|strong="H7725" *.
