motu: Obadia ena mata-hanai binai. Ḡaubada Iehova ese Edom na ini e herevalaia tomamu: Hari na Iehova ena amo vada a kamonai. bona gwaukau tauna na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai vada e siaia, eto: A tore isi, baita tuari henia.
english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord + 1:1 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * Yahweh + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

motu: A itaia, lau ese bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina hamaraḡimu, idia ese bae dadaraimu vaitani.
english: Behold, + 1:2 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

motu: Lalomu hekokorokuna ese vada e dibaḡanimu, hagahaga kohuadia ai o nohomu taumu; emu noho gabuna na atai ai, bona lalomu ai o tomu “Daika ese baine verigu dobi tano ai?”
english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

motu: Ena be atai ai o rohomu ugava na heto, ena be emu ruma na hisiu bogaragidiai e miamu. to unu amo baina verimu dobi. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

motu: Henao taudia bema vasi, eiava dadidadi taudia hanuaboi ai bema kau, daka hahebua-tarina! To edia dabu heḡereḡerena mo bema henao ani? Vine huahuadia igogodia taudia bema vasi, to vine momorudia bema rakatani ani?
english: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

motu: Esau madi vada e dadihaia, ena taḡa vada e dadia.
english: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

motu: Idurumu taudia iboudiai ese vada e koimu, vada e lulumu lao ela bona tano hetoana; bamomu ese vada e hadareremu, turamu, o abidadama henidia taudia, ese vada e idoamu; tau ta ese basine lalo-pararalaia diba.
english: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Una dina ai aonega taudia Edom lalona amo baina habuadia tari, bona lalo-parara na Esau ororona amo danu, ani?
english: “Won’t I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?

motu: Teman e, emu goada taudia kudoudia bae hetaha, Bena Esau ororona amo baema taudia iboudiai na bae aladia ore.
english: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

motu: Tadimu Iakob o daḡedaḡe henia dainai, hemarai ese baine ḡovamu ahu, bona ba henege daure hanaihanai.
english: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

motu: Oi o gini edea dinana ai, idau taudia ese ena taḡa e huaia lao bona idau gabu taudia ese ia iduarana ai e raka vareai bona Ierusalem iabilaina maridia e kara dinana ai, oi na idia heḡereḡeredia ta.
english: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

motu: A tadimu ena dina, ena hisihisi dinana, basioma kirikirilaia; bona Iuda taudia na e hebua tari dinana basioma moalelaia; hahehisi dinana ai basioma hekokoroku.
english: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

motu: Egu bese ena ikoukou ai basioma raka vareai, hahehisi na ienai e kau dinana ai; ia ihadikana basioma kirikirilaia, hahehisi na ienai e kau dinana ai; ena kohu basioma dadia, hahehisi na ienai e kau dinana ai.
english: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.

motu: Dala katakata ai basioma gini, ena heau taudia iala-masedia totona; ena roho-mauri taudia na inaidia imadia ai basioma atodia, hisihisi dinana ai.
english: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

motu: Badina be Iehova ena dina vada eme kahikahi, bese idau-idau iboudiai latadiai. Vada o kara heḡereḡerena ai bae kara henimu; emu kara na oi sibomu kwaramu ai ma baine kau.
english: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

motu: Badina be egu ororo helaḡana ai vada o inuinu heḡereḡerena ai e noho hetabiramu besedia iboudiai na bae inuinu; bae inuinu, bae raraga, bena basiema mauri heḡereḡerena ai baela. Israel iabi-daena
english: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

motu: A Siona ororona ai haida do bae roho mauri, bena ororo na baine helaga; bona Iakob ena iduhu taudia ese sibodia edia kohu bae abidia.
english: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

motu: Iakob iduhuna na lahi ai bainela, bona Iosef iduhuna na lahi hururu-hururuna ai bainela, bona Esau iduhuna na rei kakoro ai bainela; bena bae aradia, bae aradia ore, Esau iduhuna lalona amo tau ta basine roho mauri; badina be Iehova vada e hereva.
english: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, Yahweh has spoken.

motu: Diho kahana taudia ese Esau ororona bae abia, bona Sefela taudia ese Filistia taudia edia tano bae abia; Efraim tanona bona Samaria tanona bae abidia, bona Beniamina ese Gilead baine abia.
english: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.

motu: Hala ai e hanohodia taudia hahidaosi Israel besena amo ese Foenikia bae abia ela bona Sarefata; bona Ierusalem amo e abidia oho, Sefarad ai e hanohodia, taudia ese diho kahana hanuadia bae abidia.
english: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.

motu: Hahemauri taudia na Siona ororona ai bae dara dae, Esau ororona ilohiana totona; bona basileia na Iehova ena basileia ai bainela.
english: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.

motu: Iehova ena hereva na Iona Amitai enai e kau, eto,
english: Now Yahweh’s + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

motu: A tore isi, hanua badana ladana Nineve baola, ba gwau henia; badina be edia kara dika na lau vairagu ai vada eme hedinarai.
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”

motu: A Iona e tore isi, Tarasisi baine heau lao, Iehova vairana amo baine heau oho eto. Ia na e diho, Iopa ai, Tarasisi bainela lagatoina ta e davaria; dava e heni, bena e gui, idia ida Tarasisi baela, Iehova ena amo baine heau oho eto.
english: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese lai gubana e hatoaia, davara latanai; hurehure vada e bada herea, lagatoi na mokona e heroḡi rohoroho.
english: But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.

motu: Bena lagatoi taudia na e gari, ta ta ena dirava ena dirava e hahanedia; bena e negenege, lagatoi ihaharaḡana totona. A Iona na vada e diho, lagatoi tuana ai, unuseni ai vada e hekure, vada e mahuta.
english: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.

motu: Taunabunai lagatoi biaguna ema, e hamaoroa, eto, Mahuta taumu e, edeheto? A tore isi, emu dirava ba hahanea; reana una dirava ese baine laloda, bena basita mase.
english: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! + 1:6 or, gods * Maybe your God + 1:6 or, gods * will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”

motu: Bena idia na e hereva heheni, eto, Aoma, mari aita abi; bena baita diba daika bagunai ina dika na ita latadai vada e kau. Taunabunai idia ese mari e abi, bena mari ese Iona e duanaia.
english: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

motu: Bena idia ese e nanadaia, eto, A hamaoromai, daika bagunai ina dika na latadai vada e kau? Oiemu ḡaukara be dahaka? Ede amo oma? Emu tano be edena? Oi na edena bese tauna?
english: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”

motu: Bena ia ese e haere henidia, eto, Lau na Heberu tauna; Iehova, guba Diravana, davara bona tano kaukauna e karadia Diravana garina na garimu.
english: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God + 1:9 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”

motu: Bena unu tatau na e gari dikadika, e hamaoroa, eto, Ede vada o kara toma? Badina be unu tatau vada e diba ia na Iehova vairana amo vada e heau oho, badina be ia ese vada e hamaorodia.
english: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Yahweh, because he had told them.

motu: Bena idia ese ma e nanadaia, eto, Ede baia karamu toma bena davara baine gaima emai ai? Badina be hurehure vada e bada e laova.
english: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.

motu: Ia ese e hamaorodia, eto, Bavabigu, davara ai ba tahogu dobi; bena davara baine gaima emui ai; badina be lau dibagu, ina guba badana na lau daigu ai emui ai vada e kau.
english: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”

motu: Ḡau tamona, hari tatau na e bara hekwarahi, lagatoi na kone ai bae baraia diho totona; to asie heḡereḡere, badina be hurehure na vada e bada herea e laova idia vairadiai.
english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese Iehova e tai henia, eto, Iehova, e, ai ese a noimumu, ina tau ena mauri bagunai basia mase, bona asi kererena tauna rarana na ai latamai ai basio atoa kau; badina be, Iehova e, emu ura heḡereḡerena ai vada o karaia.
english: Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, Yahweh, have done as it pleased you.”

motu: Taunabunai idia ese Iona e abia, davara ai e tahoa dobi; bena davara na vada e gaima.
english: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

motu: Bena unu tatau ese Iehova e gari henia lalo-dika; idia ese boubou karadia e kara, Iehova ena, bona e gwau hamata danu.
english: Then the men feared Yahweh exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.

motu: Bena Iehova ese gwarume badana ta e saia, ia ese Iona baine hadonoa; bena Iona na dina toi boi toi una gwarume bogana ai e nohova.
english: Yahweh prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

motu: Bena Iona ese gwarume bogana amo Iehova, ena Dirava, e ḡuria,
english: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

motu: eto Egu dara-doko ai Iehova na hahanea, bena ia ese e haere henigu; Mase gabuna lalona amo na tai, bena oi ese lau gadogu o kamonai.

You|strong="H6419" * heard my|strong="H3068" * voice.

english: For you threw me into the depths, in|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H8085" * heart|strong="H8085" * of|strong="H3068" * the|strong="H8085" * seas. motu: Bena lau nato “Oi vairamu amo vada o negegu daure, emu dubu helaḡana ede baina itaia lou toma?”
english: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet|strong="H3605" * I|strong="H5921" * will|strong="H3824" * look again|strong="H5674" * toward|strong="H5921" * your|strong="H3605" * holy temple.’

english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The|strong="H5704" * earth barred me|strong="H5315" * in|strong="H5315" * forever|strong="H5704" *; yet|strong="H5704" * you|strong="H5704" * have|strong="H8415" * brought|strong="H5437" * my|strong="H5704" * life|strong="H5315" * up|strong="H2280" * from|strong="H5315" * the|strong="H5704" * pit, Yahweh|strong="H3068" * my|strong="H5704" * God.

motu: Laumagu e daure negana ai lau ese Iehova na laloa tao; egu ḡuriḡuri na e dae vasi, emu dubu helaḡana ai.
english: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My|strong="H3068" * prayer came|strong="H5927" * in|strong="H3068" * to|strong="H3381" * you|strong="H3381" *, into|strong="H3381" * your|strong="H3068" * holy temple.

motu: Kaivakuku asi anidia e matauraidiamu taudia ese edia heabidadama ḡauna korikorina e rakataniamu.
english: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

motu: A lau ese oi baina boumu, mai egu hahenamo herevadia ida, egu gwauhamata baina hamomokanidia. Hahemauri na Iehova enai.
english: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will|strong="H2617" * pay|strong="H8104" * that|strong="H7723" * which|strong="H2617" * I have|strong="H8104" * vowed. Salvation belongs to|strong="H8104" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese una gwarume e hereva henia; bena una gwarume ese Iona e kakaia lasi, tano kaukauna ai.
english: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na Iona enai ma e kau, nega iharuana, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,

motu: A tore isi, hanua badana Nineve baola, lau ese baina henimu herevana ba gwaurai henia.
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”

motu: Taunabunai, Iona e tore isi, Nineve ela, Iehova ena hereva heḡereḡerena. Hari Nineve na hauna bada-hereana, ena lababa na dina toi laolaona na heto.
english: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.

motu: Iona ese hanua lalonai e raka vareai matama, dina ta laolaona heḡereḡerena ela. Bena e haroro, eto, Dina hari-ahui bae ore, bena Nineve baine heḡiḡi dobi.
english: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”

motu: Bena Nineve taudia ese Dirava e abiabiraia; idia na e anivaga e gwauraia bona puse dabuadia e hahedokilai, badana ela bona maraḡina.
english: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.

motu: Nineve pavapavana ese harina e kamonai, bena ia na ena terono amo e tore isi, ena hahedoki e dokia oho, puse dabuana e hahedokilaia, bena rahurahu ai e helai diho.
english: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

motu: Bena ena hahedua herevana e gwauraia hedinarai bona e siaia lao, Nineve tanona idoinai, eto, Hanua pavapavana bona ena lohia taudia edia haheḡani binai: Taunimanima eiava ubu-ubu ḡauna, boromakau serina eiava mamoe serina, ese ḡau ta basie ania; basie aniani bona ranu basie inu;
english: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;

motu: a taunimanima bona ubu-ubu ḡauna ese puse dabuadia bae hahedokilai, bena bae tai lolo-lolo, Dirava bae tai henia; oibe, iboudiai ese edia kara dika amo bae raka oho bona imadia edia daḡedaḡe karadia amo danu.
english: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.

motu: Daika dibana, reana Dirava na baine helalo kerehai, bona ena badu-ḡaraḡara amo baine raka oho, bena ita na basita mase.
english: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”

motu: Dirava ese edia kara e itaia, edia dala dikana amo ede e raka oho toma; bena Dirava ese baine hadikalaidia eto karana amo e helalo kerehai; bena se karaia.
english: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.

motu: Una kara ese Iona lalona se hamoalea; ia na e badu.
english: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

motu: Bena ia ese Iehova e ḡuria, eto, Iehova e, na noimumu, lau na dounu egu tano ai na nohova negana ai ini asina hereva toma a? Una dainai na ḡava, Tarasisi baina heau lao nato. Badina be lau vada na diba, oi na harihari-bada bona hebogahisi Diravana, badu ai o halahemu bona hebogahisi ai o honu honu daemu, bona kara dika amo o helalo kerehaimu.
english: He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.

motu: Taunabunai, Iehova e, lau na noimumu, egu mauri avabia oho, badina be baina mase be namo, baina mauri na dika.
english: Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”

motu: Bena Iehova eto, O badumu be namo a?
english: Yahweh said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”

motu: Bena Iona na hanua amo e raka lasi, hanua mairiveina kahana ai e helai, unuseni ai ena kalaga auta e karaia. Bena ikerukeruna ai e helai, dahaka baine vara hanua badana enai baine itaia totona.
english: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.

motu: Bena Dirava Iehova ese au ta e abia, e hatubua, ela bona Iona daenai e mia, kwarana ihakerukeruna bona ena hisihisi ilao-ahuna totona. Taunabunai, Iona na e moale bada, una au dainai.
english: Yahweh God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.

motu: Kerukeru, daba e rere, bena Dirava ese bubu ta e siaia lao, bena una bubu ese au e budua; bena hari au e marai.
english: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.

motu: Dina e dae, bena Dirava ese lai siahuna ta mairiveina kahana amo e siaia lao, bona dina ese Iona kwarana e raraia ela bona tauna e manori. Bena mase e noinoilaia, eto, Baina mase be namo; baina mauri na dika.
english: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”

motu: A Dirava ese Iona e nanadaia, eto Au dainai o badamu be namo eiava? Ia eto, Na badamu be namo, baina badu ela bona mase danu namo.
english: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He|strong="H5704" * said, “ I|strong="H5704" * am right to|strong="H5704" * be angry|strong="H2734" *, even|strong="H5704" * to|strong="H5704" * death|strong="H4194" *.”

motu: Bena Iehova eto, Hari au, oi so hekwarahilaia bona so hatubua ḡauna, hanuaboi ta ai e tubu ma hanuaboi ta ai e marai ḡauna, o bogaia hisimu.
english: Yahweh said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.

motu: Matona, lau ese hanua badana Nineve, lalonai imadia idibadia be ededia bona lauridia be ededia asi dibadia taudia domaga-ta gerebu-rua + 4:11 Domaga-ta gerebu-rua = 120,000. * bona boromakau momo herea danu e nohomu hanuana, basina bogaia hisi a?
english: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”

motu: Iehova ena hereva, Mika, tau Moresete, enai e kau, Iuda pavapavadia Iotam bona Ahasa bona Hesekia edia nega ai, Samaria bona Ierusalem herevadia.

english: You will give truth to Jacob, and|strong="H3117" * mercy|strong="H2617" * to|strong="H5414" * Abraham, as|strong="H3117" * you|strong="H5414" * have|strong="H3117" * sworn|strong="H7650" * to|strong="H5414" * our|strong="H5414" * fathers from|strong="H3117" * the|strong="H5414" * days|strong="H3117" * of|strong="H3117" * old|strong="H6924" *.

motu: Maduna metauna Nineve latanai; Nahumu, tau Elkoso, ena mata-hanai bukana.
english: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

motu: Iehova na vaḡeḡe bona hadava Diravana, Iehova na dava e hadavamu mai baduna ida. Iehova ese ana inai taudia e hadava henidiamu; ia inaina e badu henidiamu.
english: Yahweh + 1:2 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * is a jealous God + 1:2 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

motu: Iehova ena badu na se vara haraḡamu, ena goada na herea; Iehova ese kerere taudia maorodia basine gwaurai, lasi ona lasi vaitani. lena dala na koe-hirihiri ai bona lai gubana ai, ori na ia aena ḡahuna.
english: Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

motu: Ia ese davara e gwau heniamu, e hakororoamu, sinavai iboudiai e hakororodiamu; Basan bona Karamele e geaka-geakamu, Lebanon burena e maraimu.
english: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

motu: Ia vairanai ororo e heude-heudemu, bona ororo komutadia e vevemu; ia vairanai tano na e vahumu, tanobada mai inoholaina taudia iboudiai ida danu.
english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

motu: lena badu vairanai daika baine gini? Ena badu garaḡarana ai daika baine haheauka? Ena badu na e seia dobimu lahi na heto; haga nadidia ia ese e hapararadiamu.
english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

motu: Iehova na namo, ia na gabu aukana hekwakwanai dinana ai; enai e roho maurimu taudia na e dibadiamu.
english: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

motu: A utu-utu badana amo ia ese ana inai taudia bame ha-uredia vaitani, bona inaina na baine hahavadia ela bona dibura lalonai.
english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

motu: Dahaka o lalo hatalaiamu, Iehova ihadikana? Ia ese inaina baine habuadia tari vaitani. Ia ese ia inaina basine hadava henidia nega harua.
english: What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

motu: Au giniginidia heromedia na heheto e aradia oremu, eiava rei kakoro na heto.
english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

motu: Iehova ihadikana dalana e lalo hatalaia bona kara dika e hahealolaia tauna ta oiemu amo se lasi a?
english: One has gone out of you who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Ena be idia na gogoada bona huhutuma, to bae henege daure bona bae puki oho. Ena be vada na hahisihisimu, to basina hahisihisimu lou.
english: Yahweh says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

motu: Harihari iena madluna oi paḡamu ai na baina hakwaidua, bona iḡuimu varodia baina hamotudia.
english: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

motu: Iehova ese oi vada e haḡanilaimu, e tomu: Ini amo oi ladamu basine hesiriu; emu dirava edia dubu lalona amo e koroa bona e hahelaria kaivakukudia baina negedia daure; oiemu guri baina ḡeia, badina be oi na dika rohoroho.
english: Yahweh has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

motu: A itaia, hari namodia e mailaidiamu tauna, maino e harorolaiamu tauna, aena na ororo ai. Iuda e, emu aria ba kara, emu gwauhamata anidia ba kara, badina be kara dika tauna ese nega ta ai basine tuari henimu lou, ia na vada e henege daure vaitani.
english: Behold, + 1:15 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

motu: Ihamakohimu tauna ese vada e tuari henimumu, maḡu ba gimadia, dala ba itaia tao; emu rami ba hekasilaia, goadamu idoinai ba heḡaeḡaelaia.
english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

motu: (Badina be Iehova ese Iakob siahuna e havaraia loumu, Israel siahuna heḡereḡerena; badina be dadidadi taudia ese vada e dadihaidia, bona rigidia na vada e hadihakia vaitani.)
english: For Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.

motu: Iena goada taudia edia kesi na kakakaka, ena tuari taudia ese dabua kakakakadia vada e hahedokilai. Kariota e haboudia hegaeḡaemu negana ai idia na e hwuru-hururumu, lahi na heto; hosi na e hare loamu.
english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

motu: Kariota na ariara ai e heau lalo-dikamu, hanua ariaradia ai e heau laomu e heau maimu; e kiama-kiamamu kede na heheto, e kinoa laomu kevaru na heto.
english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.

motu: Tuari biagudia na e boiridiamu, laodia ai e hetutuhimu; maḡu e heau heniamu, vaḡoma vada e haheḡaeḡaea.
english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.

motu: Sinavai ihadai-ahudia vada e kehodia, pavapava ena ruma ai kudoudia e hetahamu;
english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

motu: pavapava hahinena na ena dabua vada e hahedokidia oho, vada e laohaia, ena hesiai kekenidia na e rohe ahumu, e taimu pune na heheto, e tai hevalemu.
english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

motu: Nineve na ranuna e aru ohomu gohuna na heto; e boi lolomu, e tomu “A gini, a gini”, a ta se gini kerehaimu.
english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.

motu: Silver * ba dadia! Gold * ba dadia! Kohu namodia na asi dokodia, ḡau herea-daedia na momo herea.
english: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.

motu: Hahevahu! Haheḡagae! Hahebua-tari! Kudou e hetahamu; tui e tabubu-tabubumu; koekoe iboudia e hisihisimu; vaira iboudiai e laboramu.
english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

motu: Leona ena guri na edeseni ai? leona natuna edia kohua na edeseni ai? leona ese damuna e vareailaia gabuna, natuna e noholaiamu bena ta ese se hamarerediamu gabuna, be edeseni ai?
english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?

motu: Leona ese vamu e darea sisisisi, natuna adia, bona damuna gadona e koria, advana adia; ena kohua na damuna amo bona ena guri na vamu amo e hahonudia.
english: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled prey for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill and his dens with prey.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: A itaia, lau ese na tuari henimumu; emu kariota na baina doudia, kwalahu ai baela; dare ese emu leona natudia baine ha-oredia; oi damumu na tanobada amo baina negea daure, bona emu gwaukau taudia eredia na basie hekamonai lou.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

motu: Rara hebubu hanuana, madi ihabaina! Koikoi bona dadidadi ḡaudia ai e honu honu daemu; dadidadi karadia na asi dokodia.
english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery—no end to the prey.

motu: Hekwadi varona bona ava-keikei reḡedia e daemu; hosi bona kariota e heau lalo-dikamu.
english: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

motu: Hosi gui taudia e tata laomu, dare e hururu-hururumu, io e kiama-kiamamu; hutuma bada e masemu, mase tau-anidia na e hasenudiamu, mase tau-anidia na asi dokodia, ediai e hetutuhimu.
english: the horseman charging, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies

motu: Ini na ariara hahinena ena ariara karadia momo-herea daidiai, mai hairaina bona mai ena mea dikadia, ena ariara karadia amo basileia idau-idau e dibaḡanidiamu, bona ena mea karadia amo bese ulau-idau e hahekwakwanaidiamu.
english: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: A itaia, lau ese na inai henimumu, bona vairamu na ramimu amo baina ḡovaia ahu. Bese idau-idau baina haheitalaidia, oi na gagaemu mo, basileia idau-idau emu hemarai baina haheitalaidia.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

motu: Lau ese miro amo baina hodomu, baina dadaraimu, bona hamue ḡauna ai baina halaomu.
english: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.

motu: Bae itamu taudia iboudiai na bae lagagalaimu, baeto, Nineve vada e vahu; daika ese baine tailaia? Ia tauna ihalona taudia na edeseni ai baina tahudia?
english: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”

motu: Oi ese Tebe o hereaia a? Ia na Nilo sinavaina isena ai e daia, ranu ese e ḡeḡea ahuva, ia inaina ilao-ahudia ḡauna na davara, bona ena maḡu na ranu.
english: Are you better than No-Amon, + 3:8 or, Thebes * who was situated among the rivers, + 3:8 or, Nile * who had the waters around her, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

motu: Etiopia na ena goada, bona Aigupto danu, asi hetoana; Put bona Libia taudia ese e kahaia.
english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

motu: Ḡau tamona, vada e abia oho, mai iḡuina ida e laohaia; ena memero maraḡidia na e huaridia patapata, ariara iboudiai doridia ai; ena taunimanima namodia, e matauraidia taudia, na mari amo e abidia, bona ena lohia badadia na auri gadeadia amo e ḡuidia.
english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

motu: Oi danu ba kekero, matamu bae madai-madai; roho-mauri gabuna do ba tahua, inaimu amo ba roho mauri totona.
english: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.

motu: Emu kohoro iboudiai na suke audia na heheto, huahuadia e dobi matama negana ai; bema haheude-heudedia, idia na ianidia taudia ududia ai bema moru.
english: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs. If they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

motu: A itaia, emu tuari oreadia na hahine na heheto, oi bogaragimu ai. Emu tano ikoukoudia na e hekeho vaitani, oi inaimu vairadiai; emu kahitao audia na lahi ese vada e aradia ore.
english: Behold, your troops among you are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.

motu: Ranu ba utua, ba hekou ahu negana ranuna, emu maḡu ba ha-aukadia; raro gabuna baola, raro ba kuia, raro mauana bavabia.
english: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.

motu: Unuseni ai lahi ese baine hamasemu, dare ese baine gwadamu mase, baine animu ore kwadi na heto. Ba hutuma, kwadi na heto; ba hutuma, rei kwadidla na heheto.
english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

motu: Emu hoihoi taudia o hahohodia, idia ese guba hisiudia e hereadia; kwadi ese hanina e toi roromu, e roho laomu.
english: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips and flees away.

motu: Emu hanua lohiadia na rei kwadidia na heheto, emu toretore taudia na kwadi tabatabadia na heheto; era ai e helaimu, keru dinana ai, a dina e daemu negana ai e roho laomu, tau ta asi dibana idia na edeseni ai.
english: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

motu: Asuria pavapavana e, emu mamoe ireḡudia taudia na e mahutamu, emu lohia taudia na e mahuta hedavauhemu, emu taunimanima na ororo ai e karoho rohorohomu, asi ihaheboudia tauna ta.
english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.

motu: Emu hisihisi na asi ihanamona dalana, beromu na dika herea; oi harimu e kamonaimu taudia iboudiai ese imadia na e patapata henimumu. Badina be oiemu hahedika karadia asi dokodia be daika ese se mamia toho a?
english: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?

motu: Dirava ena hereva metauna, peroveta tauna Habakuku ese e matahanailaia.
english: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

motu: Iehova e, baina boi henimu, ba durugu totona; bena basio kamonai ela bona edena nega ai? Eiava baina tai henimu, bainato “Daḡedaḡe”, bena basio hamaurigu a, ela bona edena nega ai?
english: Yahweh, + 1:2 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

motu: Badina be dahaka kara kereredia o haheitalaigumu? Dahaka dainai hekwakwanai ḡaudia o hahedinarai henigumu? Hahebua-tari bona daḡedaḡe na vairagu ai, heatu bona heiri-heiri na e varamu.
english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

motu: Taunabunai, taravatu e manokamu, bona hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva na se hedinaraimu. Badina be kara dika taudia ese kara maoromaoro taudia na e ḡeḡedia daemu, bona hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva na e gageva-gagevamu. Kaldea taudia ese Iuda bae habuaia tari
english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

motu: Bese bogaragidiai ba roharoha, ba itaia; ba hoa, ba hoa dikadika. Badina be emui nega ai kara ta na karaiamu; ena be bama hamaorolaimui, to basioma kamonai.
english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

motu: Badina be, a itaia, Kaldea taudia na hatoredia isimu, una kara idita bona kara heau-heau besena. Idia ese tanobada lababana e rakaia hanaimu, noho gabudia dia idia edia na idia ese e dadimu.
english: For, behold, + 1:6 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

motu: Idia ese gari bona kudou-hetaha e havaradiamu, edia hahemaoro bona edia siahu na sibodia edia amo e varamu.
english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

motu: Edia hosi ese taiga e hereadiamu edia heau ai, bona tano-ḡaḡaena uda-sisiadia e hereadiamu edia daḡedaḡe ai; edia hosi-gui taudia na e heaumu mai heaḡidia ida. Oibe, edia hosi-gui taudia na dauha amo e maimu, ugava na heto e rohomu, ala-ala totona.
english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

motu: Iboudiai na kara daḡedaḡe totona e maimu; igari-henidia na vairadiai e laomu, e ḡuidiamu taudia na miri na heto.
english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

motu: Hanua pavapavadia na e ihi-ihiraidiamu, bona hanua lohiadia na e kirikirilaidiamu. Kohoro iboudiai e kirikirilaidiamu, badina be tano na e larebamu, bena-e abidiamu.
english: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

motu: Lai na heto e heau hanaimu e laomu, kerere laudia, sibodia edia goada na edia dirava ai e halaoamu. Habakuku ese Iehova e ḡanaḡana heniamu
english: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

motu: Iehova e, egu Dirava, egu Helaḡa Diravana, oi na o noho hanaihanaimu ani? Ai na basia mase. Iehova e, oi ese vada o gwauraidia, ai ihahemaoro-henimai taudia ai baela. Nadi-gini e, oi ese vada o haginidia, ai matamai ihakanidia totona.
english: Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, + 1:12 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

motu: Oi matamu na ḡoeva-dae dainai, kara dika basio itaia, bona kara kerere basio raraia diba. Dahaka dainai asi edia heabidadama taudia na o haḡerediamu? Badina be dahaka oi na asi regeregemu, kara dika tauna ese kara maoromaoro ai ia e hereaiamu tauna e hadonoamu negana ai?
english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

motu: Badina be oi ese taunimanima na o karadiamu, davara gwarumedia na heheto, eiava tano ai e raumu ḡaudia na heheto, asi biagudia.
english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

motu: Ia ese kimai ai e veridiamu, ena reke ai e veridia lasimu, ena ole ai e haboudiamu, bena e moalemu bona e heaḡimu.
english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

motu: Taunabunai ia ese ena reke e bouamu, bona muramura mai bonana na ena ole e gabu heniamu; badina be idia daidiai ia ese digara e animu, bena ana aniani na mai gaihona.
english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

motu: Matona, ia ese ena reke anina baine bubua loulou a? Bese idau-idau baine habuadia tari hanaihanai a?
english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

motu: Lau na baina gini, baina gima, kohoro ai baina gini, baina roha lao, baina itaia, ia ese ede baine hereva henigu toma, bona ede baina haere toma, egu maumau dainai.
english: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e haere henigu, eto: Mata-hanai herevana ba torea, nadi palakadia ai ba hahedinaraia, bena iduahina tauna na baine heau.
english: Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

motu: Badina be mata-hanai na doini ena nega e nariamu, dokona e heau heniamu, basine koikoi. Ena be boma toma ia na metaira-metaira, to do ba naria; momokani, ia na bainema, basine halahe.
english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

motu: A itaia, lalona na dia maoro tauna na baine moru, a kara maoromaoro tauna na ena heabidadama dainai baine mauri.
english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

motu: Ina danu, vine ranuna na mai ena hekoi, bona hekokoroku tauna na basine noho daudau. Ena mata-ganigani na mai lababana, Mase Gabuna na heto, mase na heto, ia na se honumu. Basileia iboudiai na e gogodiamu, ena; bona bese iboudiai na e haboudiamu, ia sibona ena. Kara dika taudia iḡonaḡonalaidia
english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; + 2:5 Sheol is the place of the dead. * he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

motu: Ini iboudiai ese ia bae ḡonaḡonalaia, ani; bae ihi-ihiraia mai kiridia ida, baeto: Ḡau e senumu, dia iena ḡau, tauna, madi ihabaina! Baine noho ela bona edena nega ai? Abitorehai toadia e gogodiamu tauna danu, madi ihabaina!
english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

motu: Emu ai e abi torehai taudia na basie tore isi taku a? Oi kudoumu ihahetahana taudia na basie noga a? Ena negana ai idia ese bae dadihaimu.
english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

motu: Badina be oi ese basileia momo vada o dadihaidia, una dainai bese kwabukwabudia iboudiai ese bae dadihaimu; taunimanima raradia bona kara daḡedaḡe daidiai, kara daḡedaḡe tano enai bona hanua mai inoholaidia taudia ediai.
english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

motu: Ena ruma na dala dikadia amo e hanamoamu tauna, madi ihabaina! Ena ruma na atai ai e atoamu, manu rumana na heto, dika na ienai basine kau helaoreana.
english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

motu: Emu ruma ihahemaraina dalana vada o laloa hata; bese momo vada o negedia daure, sibomu vada o hetao tore.
english: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

motu: Badina be nadi na maḡu amo baine lolo, bona mukuro na ruma amo baine haere.
english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

motu: Rara amo hanua e haginiamu bona kara havara amo hanua badana e hadaiamu tauna, madi, ihabaina!
english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

motu: A itaia, ina na Iehova Sabaota ena amo, ani? Bese idau-idau e ḡaukaramu, lahi mo iabina, bona basileia idau-idau e hekwarahimu, asi davana.
english: Behold, isn’t it from Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

motu: Badina be tanobada na Iehova hairaina idiba-maorona amo baine honu, davara na ranu ai e honumu na heto.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

motu: Dekena taudia na ena badu keherena amo e ha-inudiamu ela bona e kekeromu, edia hemarai baine raraia helaoreana, tauna na madi, ihabaina!
english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

motu: Dia hairai amo to hedadarai amo do ba honu; ba inuinu, ba raraga. Iehova imana idibana ai e miamu keherena na emu ai baine kau, bona hemarai ese hairaimu baine habubunia.
english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

motu: Lebanon idagedaḡe henina ese baine habubunimu, uda ḡaudia ihabua-taridia ese baine hagarimu bada, taunimanima raradia bona kara daḡedaḡe daidiai, kara daḡedaḡe tano enai bona hanua mai inoholaidia taudia ediai.
english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

motu: Kaivakuku anina namona be dahaka, ikarana tauna ese vada e karaia negana ai? Ia na auri laulauna mo, koikoi ihahedibalaina ḡau. Badina be ima karakara tauna ese sibona e karaia ḡauna na e abidadama heniamu, asi hereva dibadia kaivakukudia e karadiamu negana ai.
english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

motu: Au ḡauna e haḡaniamu, e tomu “A noga”, eiava asi hereva dibana nadina e hamaoroamu, e tomu “A tore isi”, tauna na madi, ihabaina! Ina ḡau ese lalo-diari baine havaraia a? A itaia, gold * bona silver * ese e ḡovaiamu, bona ia na asi laḡana.
english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

motu: A Iehova na ena dubu helaḡa lalonai e nohomu; tanobada taudia iboudiai ia vairanai bae noho, asi reḡereḡedia.
english: But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

motu: Peroveta tauna Habakuku ena ḡuriḡuri anena; ane gadona ladana be Shigionoth.
english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

motu: Iehova e, oi harimu vada na kamonai; Iehova e, oiemu ḡaukara na garilaiamu. Laḡani bogaragidiai ba hamatamaia, laḡani bogaragidiai ba hahedinaraia; badu lalonai hebogahisi ba laloa tao.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Ḡau iboudiai baina darodia oho vaitani tanobada kopina amo.
english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

motu: Taunimanima bona uda ḡaudia baina darodia oho, bona atai manudia bona davara gwarumedia danu. Iehova na e tomu: Kara dika taudia na baina tahodia dobi, taunimanima iboudiai baina negedia daure, tanobada kopina amo.
english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

motu: Lau ese imagu baina toia roro, Iuda ihadikana totona, bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia iboudiai ihadikadia totona. Ina gabu amo Baal oreana kwabukwabudia baina negedia daure, bona kaivakuku edia hahelaḡa taudia ladadia baina rohodia:
english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,
