english: those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.

motu: Ḡaubada Iehova vairanai asi reḡereḡemui ba noho; badina be Iehova ena dina vada eme kahikahi. Iehova ese boubou ḡauna vada e hahegaegaea, bona e vavea taudia na vada e hahelaḡadia.
english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord + 1:7 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand. For Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.

motu: Iehova ese ena boubou ḡauna baine hahelaḡaia dinana ai, lau ese heitatao taudia bona hanua pavapavana natuna mamaruanedia baina hadava henidia, bona idau bese dabuadia e hahedokilaimu taudia iboudiai danu.
english: It will happen in the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

motu: Una dina ai ruma raka-vareaina e rohoa hanaimu taudia iboudiai, bona biagudia edia ruma na daḡedaḡe bona koikoi karadia ai e hahonudiamu taudia iboudiai, baina hadava henidia.
english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Una dina ai taitai na Gwarume Ikoukouna amo baine dae, bona tai lolololo na Hanua Matamatana amo, bona rege badana na ororo amo.
english: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

motu: Raro-kaka kourana inoholaina taumui e, a tai lolololo! Badina be hoihoi taudia iboudiai na lasihidia; silver * e hahetohoamu taudia iboudiai vada eme henege daure.
english: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.

motu: Una negana ai lau ese lamepa baina abi kau, Ierusalem ai baina hetahu; bena noho-herekwa taudia, lalodia ai e tomu “Iehova basine hahenamo bona basine hahedika” taudia, baina hadava henidia.
english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “Yahweh will not do good, neither will he do evil.”

motu: Edia kohu na haida ese bae dadi oho, edia ruma na haida ese bae ḡiḡi dobi. Ena be ruma bae haginidia, to basie noholaidia; ena be vine imeadia bae hadodia, to anidia ranudia basie inu.
english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.

motu: Iehova ena dina badana vada eme kahikahi, e kahira-kahiramu, e mai haraḡamu; Iehova ena dina reḡena mamina na idita, una dina ai goada-herea tauna baine tai lolololo.
english: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.

motu: Una dina na badu dinana, hisihisi bona lalo-hekwarahi dinana, hahevahu bona hahebua-tari dinana, dibura bona ḡabora dinana, dagadaga bona dibura masemase dinana,
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

motu: kibi reḡena bona hone dinana, hanua mai maḡudia bona kohoro ḡaulatalatadia ihadikadia dinana.
english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.

motu: Lau ese hisihisi baina mailaia taunimanima latadiai, bena bae raka, mata-kepulu taudia na heheto, badina be Iehova vada e kara dika henia. Raradia bae hebubu nege ḡahu na heto, bona hidiodia boromakau taḡena na heto.
english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against Yahweh. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

motu: Edia silver * eiava edia gold * ese basie hamauridia diba, Iehova ena badu dinana ai. Ena badu ḡaraḡarana lahina ai, tanobada idoinai baine ara oho; badina be ia ese tanobada inoholaina taudia iboudiai baine ha-oredia taku, baine ha-oredia vaitani
english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.

motu: Asi hemarai dibana besena e! A hegogo, emui hebou ta bavabia,
english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

motu: do basie odamui oho lai ese uit momona e odaia ohomu na heto bona Iehova ena badu ḡaraḡarana na latamui ai do basine diho negana ai, Iehova ena badu dinana na emui ai do basine kau negana ai.
english: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahweh comes on you, before the day of Yahweh’s anger comes on you.

motu: Umui tano taumui mai manaumui ida, ena haheḡani o badinadiamu taumui, Iehova ba tahua! Kara maoromaoro ba tahua, Ialo-manau ba tahua; bena reana ba hehuni diba, Iehova ena badu dinana ai.
english: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of Yahweh’s anger.

motu: Badina be Gasa baine ḡaḡae, bona Askelono baine vahu; Asdod taudia na dina tubua ai bae luludia lasi, bona Ekron baine heraḡa oho.
english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

motu: Kone taumui e, Kerete besena e, madi, ihabaimui! Kanaan e, Filistia tanona e, Iehova ena hereva na latamu ai; lau ese do baina habuamu tari, ela bona inoholaimu tauna ta basine noho.
english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! Yahweh’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

motu: Oi danu, kone tanona e, rei gabudia ai do ba hahelao: mamoe ireḡudia taudia edia rei gabudia, bona mamoe seridia edia maḡu.
english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

motu: Kone tanona na Iuda besena kwabukwabudia ese bae ḡaunaia, unuseni ai edia mamoe bae ubudia. Hanuaboi bae hekure, Askelono rumadia ai. Badina be Iehova, edia Dirava, ese baine lalodia, bona baine hanamodia lou.
english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for Yahweh, their God, + 2:7 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * will visit them and restore them.

motu: Moab taudia edia hegonaḡonalai bona Amono taudia edia heihi-ihirai vada na kamonai. Idia ese egu bese taudia vada e gonagonalaidia, bona edia tano iabi-ohona vada e herevalaia mai hekokorokudia ida.
english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

motu: Iehova Sabaota, Israel Diravana, na e tomu: Taunabunai, lau na maurimu heḡereḡerena Moab na Sodoma heḡereḡerena ai bainela, bona Amono taudia na Gomora heḡereḡerena ai bae hahelao, ava ḡiniḡini bona laguta tanodia ai baela, bae vahu ela bona hanaihanai. Egu orea taudia kwabukwabudia ese bae dadihaidia; egu bese taudia kwabukwabudia ese bae ḡaunaidia.
english: Therefore, as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

motu: Ahudia unu bae heto, edia hekokoroku davana; badina be idia ese Iehova Sabaota ena orea taudia na e kirikirilaidiava bona latadiai e heaḡiva.
english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova ese baine daḡedaḡe henidia; oibe, ia ese tanobada diravadia iboudiai baine hahitolodia; bena bese idau-idau edia basileia iboudiai ese ia bae toma henia diho, ta ta ena gabu ena gabu ai.
english: Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.

motu: Etiopia taumui e, umui danu; egu dare ese baine alamui mamase.
english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.

motu: Bena ia ese imana na mirigini kahana baine toi roro henia, Asuria baine habuaia tari; Nineve danu baine havahua, gabu kaukauna ai baine halaoa, tano ḡaḡaena na heto.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

motu: Nani seridia na ia bogaraginai bae hekure, bona uda boromadia idau-idau iboudiai danu; bogibada bona migu na ena au-tubua lalodiai bae noho; baimumu na ena gaba-mauru ai baine mu, bona mukou danu ena raka-vareaina ai; badina be ena sida audia igovalaidia bae hekoki oho.
english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

motu: Hekokoroku hanuana binai, e nohova mai namona ida; sibona e tomava “Lau o ina, idauna ta na lasi”. Madi, vada e vahu vaitani, uda boromadia edia gabu ai vada e hahelao. E rakaia hanaimu taudia iboudiai ese e si heniamu bona imadia e kahu kuboro-kuboro heniamu.
english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.

motu: Gwau-edeede hanuana, vada e miro hanuana, daḡedaḡe hanuana, madi ihabaina!
english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

motu: Gado ta se kamonaimu, sisiba ta se abia daemu, Iehova se abidadama heniamu, ena Dirava se raka henia kahimu.
english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.

motu: Ena heitatao taudia ia lalonai na e ḡoumu leonadia na heheto; ena hahemaoro taudia na tano-ḡaḡaena uda-sisiadia, ḡau ta basine mia rani.
english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

motu: Ena peroveta taudia na e gwau edeedemu, idia na asi edia heabidadama; ena hahelaḡa taudia ese helaḡa ḡaudia e hamirodiamu, idia ese taravatu e daḡedaḡe heniamu.
english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

motu: Ia lalonai Iehova na e kara maoromaoromu, kara kerere ta ia ese se karaiamu. Daba iboudiai ia ese ena hehamaoro ḡoevaḡoeva e hahedinaraiamu, daba matadia ta ta ai ia na se helalo reamu; a kara gageva-gageva tauna na asi hemarai dibana.
english: Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

motu: Bese idau-idau vada na negedia daure, edia maḡu vada eme heḡiḡi dobi; edia ariara vada na havahudia, bena ta ese se raka-rakalaidiamu; edia hanua iboudiai vada e hahevahu, asi tauna ta lalodiai; ta ese se noholaidiamu.
english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

motu: Lau nato “Momokani, ia ese baine gari henigu, sisiba baine abia dae; lau ese vada na hadibadibalaidia ḡaudia iboudiai na ia ese basine lalodia nege”; a idia na lalodia e ura dikadikamu lebulebu karadia mo bae kara e tomu.
english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Taunabunai, lau ba narigu; lau baina tore isi, baina hereva hedinarai, dinana ba nana. badina be lalogu vada na hadaia, bese idau-idau baina gogodia, basileia idau-idau danu baina haboudia, egu badu na idia latadiai baina bubua dobi totona, egu badu ḡaraḡarana idoinai. Badina be egu vaḡeḡe baduna lahina ai tanobada idoinai baine heara oho.
english: “Therefore wait for me”, says Yahweh, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

motu: Oibe, una negana ai bese idau-idau gadodia baina ha-idaudia, gado ḡoeva-daena ai baina halaodia; bena idia iboudiai ese Iehova ladana bae hahanea, bona ia isiaina bae lao heni mai lalodia tamona ida.
english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

motu: Etiopia sinavaidia unukahadia amo, ela bona gabu daudaudia mirigini kahana ai, idia ese herahia ḡaudia na lauegu bae mailai.
english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

motu: Una dina ai ta ese basine hahemaraimu, o daḡedaḡe henigu karadia daidiai; badina be una negana ai emu hetataro taudia na bogaragimu amo baina abidia oho. Bena oi na basio hekokoroku lou, egu ororo helaḡana ai.
english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

motu: Badina be bogaragimu ai bese ta baina hanohoa, lalo-manau bona lalo-manada besena. Idia ese edia roho-mauri gabuna bae tahua, Iehova ladana ai.
english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.

motu: Unu na Israel kwabukwabudia: kara dikana ta basie karaia, hereva koikoina ta basie gwauraia; bona ududia amo hereva koikoi basie lasi. Badina be idia na bae aniani, bae hekure nege, bona ta ese basine hagaridia.
english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

motu: Siona kekenimu e, ane avabia badabada! Israel e, a lolo! Ierusalem kekenimu e, ba moale, ba heimodai, mai lalomu idoinai!
english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

motu: Iehova ese ena hahemaoro herevadia na oi latamu amo vada e abia oho; ia ese oi inaimu vada e tahodia lasi. Iehova, Israel pavapavana, na bogaragimu ai; dika garina basio gari lou.
english: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

motu: Una dina ai Ierusalem bae hereva henia, baeto: Siona e, basio gari; imamu ba ha-aukadia, basio manoka.
english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

motu: Iehova, emu Dirava, na bogaragimu ai, ia na tuari lohiana, kwalimu e henimu; ia ese baine moalelaimu mai moale-badana ida, ena lalokau ai ia ese baine hamatamatamu; ia ese baine heaḡilaimu mai ane lolona ida,
english: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

motu: aria dinana ai na heto. Hahedika na oiemu amo baina abia oho, una hahedika gwauna basio huaia helaoreana.
english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

motu: A itaia, una negana ai e daḡedaḡe henimumu taudia iboudiai na lau ese davadia baina henidia. Ae-hedairike taudia na baina hamauridia, bona e hakarohodia taudia na ma baina haboudia; edia hemarai na heimodai ai bona hari namo ai baina halaoa, tanobada idoinai latanai.
english: Behold, + 3:19 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

motu: Una negana ai lau ese emui gabu korikori ai baina hakaumui vareai, emui noho ihanamo-louna na matamui amo ba itaia negana ai. Oibe, harimui baina habadaia, bona i'imodaimui danu, tanobada besedia iboudiai bogaragidiai, emui noho ma baina hanamoa lou negana ai. Iehova na unu e gwau tomamu.
english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.

motu: King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihatauratoina dinana gini-gunana ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai ena amo e hedinarai, Serubabele Sealtiele, Iuda lohiana, bona Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, ediai e kau, eto,
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * word came by Haggai the prophet, to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Ini taunimanima na e tomu Iehova ena dubu ihagini-louna negana na do se kau.
english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for Yahweh’s house to be built.’”

motu: Bena Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai ena amo e kau, eto,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

motu: Ina na emui ruma hairaidia lalodiai o nohomu negana a? A ina dubu be heḡiḡi-dobina ai mia.
english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

motu: Taunabunai Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Dahaka dahaka emui ai vada e vara na ba haeroa.
english: Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

motu: Emui hadohado na bada, to emui taboro anina na maragi; o anianimu, to bogamui asie kunumu; ranu o inumu, to gadomui asie doromu; dabua o hahedokilaimu, to ta tauna se lomu. Moni ḡaukaradia e karamu tauna ese ena ḡaukara davana e abiamu, bena puse mai matumatuna lalonai e udaiamu.
english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm; and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.’

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Dahaka dahaka emui ai vada e vara na ba haeroa.
english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

motu: Ororo ai ba dara dae, au ba mailai, dubu ba haginia, baina moalelaia bona mai hairaigu ida baina hedinarai helaoreana. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says Yahweh.

motu: Ḡau momo o tahu, matogana, sisina mo o davaria; bena o mailaia negana ai lau ese na hiriria oho. Iehova Sabaota na e henanadaimu, e tomu, Dahaka dainai? Badina be egu dubu na e heḡiḡi dobimu, a umui ese ta ta ena ruma ena ruma o ḡaukaralaidiamu.
english: “You looked for much, and, behold, + 1:9 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Yahweh of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

motu: Una dainai guba daemui ai ese hunu vada e rua, bona tano ese anina vada e rua.
english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

motu: Lau ese doe vada na gwauraia, taora bona ororo latadiai, bona uit bona vine ranuna bona dehoro bona tano anidia iboudiai latadiai, bona taunimanima bona boromakau bona edia hekwarahi idoinai latadiai.
english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground produces, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

motu: Bena Serubabele Sealtiele bona hahelaḡa tauna badana, Iosua Iehosadak, bona taunimanima kwabukwabudia iboudiai ese Iehova, edia Dirava, gadona bona peroveta tauna Hagai, Iehova, edia Dirava, ese e siaia tauna, ena hereva danue kamonai; bena taunimanima na Iehova vairanai e gari.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed Yahweh their God’s + 1:12 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * voice, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahweh their God had sent him; and the people feared Yahweh.

motu: Bena Hagai, Iehova ena gwaukau tauna, ese Iehova ena gwaukau herevana na taunimanima e hamaorolaidia, eto, Iehova na e tomu: Lau na umui ida.
english: Then Haggai, Yahweh’s messenger, spoke Yahweh’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says Yahweh.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Serubabele Sealtiele, Iuda lohiana, bona Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, bona taunimanima kwabukwabudia iboudiai na lalodia e hasiahudia; bena idia na ela, Iehova Sabaota, edia Dirava, ena dubu e ḡaukaralaia,
english: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of Yahweh of Armies, their God,

motu: hua ihatauratoina dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai.
english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

motu: Hua ihahituna dinana iharuahui-tana ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai enai e kau, eto:
english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

motu: Serubabele Sealtiele, Iuda lohiana, bona Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, bona taunimanima kwabukwabudia iboudiai ba hereva henidia, baoto,
english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

motu: Daika daika doini nonoho umui bogaragimui ai ese ina dubu na ena hairai gunana ai e itaia? Harihari be ede o itaia tomamu? Umui vairamui ai ina na dia ḡau ta ani?
english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Ḡau tamona, Serubabele e, harihari a boga auka! Hahelaḡa tauna badana, Iosua lehosadak e, a boga auka! Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, A gaukara, badina be lau na umui ida,
english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Aigupto amo o raka lasi negana ai na henimui gwauhamatana heḡereḡerena. Egu Lauma na bogaragimui ai e nohomu; basio gari.
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Asi vanahana guba bona tanobada bona davara bona tano kaukauna baina haheude-heudedia lou;
english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once more, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

motu: bona bese iboudiai baina haheude-heudedia, bena bese iboudiai edia taḡa na bae siaidia mai, bena ina dubu na baina hahairaia ḡuḡuru. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Silver * na lauegu, bona gold * na lauegu.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Ina dubu hairaina gabena ese hailaina gunana baine hereaia, bena ina gabu ena noho-namo baina habadaia. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu. Sisiba herevadia
english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

motu: Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihataurahani-tana dinana iharuahui-hanina ai Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Hagai enai e kau, eto,
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Hahelaḡa taudia ba nanadaidia, bena bae hereva maoro. Baoto,
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

motu: Tau ta ese vamu helaḡana na ena dabua gevena ai baine abia kau, bena ena dabua na ilaoa eiava vasiahu eiava vine ranuna eiava dehoro eiava aniani ḡauna ta enai baine kau, una ḡau baine helaḡa a? Hahelaḡa taudia eto, Lasi.
english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The|strong="H3605" * priests|strong="H3548" * answered|strong="H6030" *, “ No|strong="H3808" *.”

motu: Hagai ma eto, Tau ta bema miro, tau-ani masena ta e daua toho dainai, bena una tau ese unu aniani ḡaudia ta bema daua toho; una ḡau baine miro a? Hahelaḡa taudia eto, Baine miro.
english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The|strong="H3605" * priests|strong="H3548" * answered|strong="H6030" *, “ It|strong="H2930" * will|strong="H5315" * be|strong="H5315" * unclean|strong="H2931" *.”

motu: Bena Hagai eto, Iehova na e tomu: Ina bese bona ina basileia na unuheto lau vairagu ai; bona imadia ḡaukaradia iboudiai danu unuheto; bona unuseni ai e henimu herahiana na mai mirona.
english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

motu: Mani emui kara ba haeroa, hari ina dina amo bainela dahaka baine vara. Iehova ena dubu ai nadi ta na nadi ta latanai do se heato kau negana ai,
english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.

motu: emui noho na edeheto? Ta ese irau ruahui isenudia e lao henia negana ai, gwauta hona mo mimia; ta ese vine ranuna e haboua gabuna ela, hodu imahui baine utu eto, a ruahui hona mimia.
english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Umui na rahumui mase, bona emui ḡaukara anidia na hogohogo bona valavala bona medu-hetarina amo na hadikadia, ḡau tamona umui na asio lou henigu.
english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.

motu: Ina dina, hua ihataurahani-tana dinana iharuahui-hanina, amo bainela, do ba haeroa. Iehova ena dubu badidia nadidia na gabudia ai e atodia ema bona hari danu ba haeroa.
english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.

motu: Uhe na roge ai doini mimia eiava? Vine bona suke bona rimono bona olive audia na do asi huahuadia a? Hari ina dina amo bainela, lau ese baina hanamomui. Iehova ena gwauhamata
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From today I will bless you.’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na nega iharuana Hagai enai ma e kau, hua dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

motu: Serubabele, Iuda lohiana, ba hereva henia, baoto: Lau ese guba bona tanobada ba haheude-heudeamu,
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

motu: bona basileia teronodia danu ba tahodia dobimu; bese idau-idau basileiadia edia goada ba ha-oreamu, bona kariota mai taudia ida ba hahebubudiamu; hosi bona hosi-gui taudia na bae mase, ta ta bamona bamona edia dare ai.
english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Serubabele e, egu hesiai tauna, Sealtiele natuna, una dina ai lau ese baina abimu. Iehova na e tomu, Lau ese ima-kwakikwaki vagivagina, toa ḡauna, heḡereḡerena ai baina halaomu, badina be vada na abimu hidi. Iehova Sabaota unu e gwau tomamu.
english: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

motu: Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihataurahanina ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Sekaria Berekia, Ido tubuna, dekenai e kau, eto,
english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

motu: Iehova ese tamamui e badu henidia dikadika.
english: “Yahweh was very displeased with your fathers.

motu: Taunabunai ba hamaorodia, baoto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Lau dekegu ai ba lou mai, Iehova Sabaota e tomu, bena lau ese umui baina lou henimui. Iehova Sabaota unu e gwau tomamu:
english: Therefore tell them, Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Tamamui heḡereḡeredia ai basiola. Peroveta gunadia ese idia e boi henidia, eto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Emui dala dikadia bona emui kara dikadia amo ba raka kerehai. Iehova na e tomu, To idia na asae kamonai, egu hereva asie abia dae.
english: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says Yahweh.

motu: Tamamui na edeseni ai? Bona peroveta taudia danu, idia na e mauri hanaihanaimu a?
english: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

motu: A egu hereva bona egu taravatu, egu hesiai peroveta taudia na haḡanilaidia gaudia, ese tamamui e lasidia tao ani? Una dainai idia na e helalo kerehai, eto, Iehova Sabaota ese e laloa hata eda dala bona eda kara heḡereḡeredia ai baine kara henida; bena unu vada e kara henida toma. Peroveta tauna ena matu-hanai gini-gunana
english: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “ Then|strong="H3651" * they|strong="H3651" * repented|strong="H7725" * and|strong="H3068" * said|strong="H1697" *, ‘ Just|strong="H1697" * as|strong="H1697" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" * of|strong="H3068" * Armies|strong="H6635" * determined to|strong="H7725" * do|strong="H6213" * to|strong="H7725" * us|strong="H7725" *, according to|strong="H7725" * our|strong="H3068" * ways|strong="H1870" * and|strong="H3068" * according to|strong="H7725" * our|strong="H3068" * practices|strong="H6213" *, so|strong="H3651" * he|strong="H3651" * has|strong="H3068" * dealt|strong="H6213" * with|strong="H3068" * us|strong="H7725" *.’”

motu: Darauese ena lohia laḡanina iharuana lalonai, hua ihagwauta-tana, ladana Sebata, dinana iharuahui-hanina ai, Iehova ena hereva na peroveta tauna Sekaria Berekia, Ido tubuna, enai e kau. Sekaria eto,
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

motu: Hanuaboi ai tau ta na itaia, hosi kakakakana ai e gui. Ia na koura ai e gini, keroro audia bogaragidiai; ia murinai na hosi haida, kakakakadia bona mai toutoudia bona kurokurodia.
english: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, + 1:8 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

motu: Bena lau nato, Egu lohia e, ini na dahaka? Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ese e hamaorogu, eto, Baina haheitalaimu, unu na dahaka.
english: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The|strong="H7200" * angel|strong="H4397" * who|strong="H1992" * talked|strong="H1696" * with|strong="H1696" * me|strong="H7200" * said|strong="H1696" * to|strong="H1696" * me|strong="H7200" *, “ I|strong="H7200" * will|strong="H4100" * show|strong="H7200" * you|strong="H4100" * what|strong="H4100" * these|strong="H1992" * are|strong="H1992" *.”

motu: Taunabunai keroro audia bogaragidiai e giniva tauna na e haere, eto, Ini be Iehova ese tanobada i'itataona totona e siaidia ḡaudia.
english: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones Yahweh has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

motu: Bena idia ese Iehova ena aneru, keroro audia bogaragidiai e giniva aneruna, e haere henia, eto, Tanobada vada a itaia tao; vada a itaia, tanobada idoinai e noho mainomu.
english: They reported to Yahweh’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru eto, Iehova Sabaota e, Ierusalem bona Iuda hanuadia na laḡani hitu-ahui lalodiai vada o badu henidia; ma basio bogadia hisi ela bona edena nega ai?
english: Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

motu: Bena Iehova ese lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na hahenamo bona hahealo herevadia e gwaurai henia.
english: Yahweh answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

motu: Taunabunai, lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ese e hamaorogu, eto, A boi lolo, baoto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Ierusalem bona Siona daidiai lalogu na e hekwarahi badamu.
english: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

motu: Bena lau ese e noho namonamomu besedia na badu henidia dikadikamu; badina be sisina mo na badu negana ai, idia ese dika ma e habadaia.
english: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

motu: Taunabunai Iehova na ini e gwau tomamu: Ierusalem vada name lou henia, mai hebogahisigu ida. Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Egu dubu na ia lalonai bae haginia, bona hahetoho varona na Ierusalem daenai baine heveri roro.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

motu: Ma ba boi lolo, baoto, Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Egu hanua badadia na noho-namo ai ma bae honu honu dae, bona Iehova ese Siona ma baine hahealo henia lou, bona Ierusalem ma baine abia hidi lou. Peroveto tauna ena mata-hanai iharuana
english: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and Yahweh will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

motu: Bena na gaga isi, doa hani na itadia.
english: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na nanadaia, nato, mi be dahaka? Bena ia ese e haere henigu, eto, Ini na Iuda bona Israel bona Ierusalem vada e hakaroho rohoroho doadia.
english: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

motu: Bena Iehova ese auri iḡaukaralaina taudia hahani na e haheitalaigu.
english: Yahweh showed me four craftsmen.

motu: Bena lau nato, Ini na dahaka ikarana totona vada e maimu? Ia ese e haere, eto, Unu na Iuda e hakarohoa rohoroho doadia, bena tau ta se gaga isi; a ini na ihagaridia totona vada ema, hari Iuda tanona iḡiḡi-rohorohona totona doadia e abidia isi besedia na ini hahaniosi ese bae tahodia dobi.
english: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”

motu: Bena na gaga isi, tau ta na itaia, mai ena hahetoho varona imana ai.
english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

motu: Bena na nanadaia, nato, Ede bo laomu? Ia ese e haere henigu, eto, Ierusalem ihahetohona totona na laomu, baina itaia ena lababa na ede badana bona ena lata na ede badana.
english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He|strong="H3389" * said|strong="H1696" * to|strong="H1696" * me|strong="H1696" *, “ To|strong="H1696" * measure Jerusalem|strong="H3389" *, to|strong="H1696" * see what|strong="H4100" * is|strong="H4100" * its|strong="H7161" * width and|strong="H3063" * what|strong="H4100" * is|strong="H4100" * its|strong="H7161" * length.”

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na itaia, ia na e raka lasi, bona aneru ma ta e raka kahi mai, ia ihedavari-henina totona,
english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

motu: e hamaoroa, eto, A heau, una eregabe tauna ba hamaoroa, baoto “Ierusalem bae noholaia, asi maḡudia hanuadia e noholaidiamu na heto, badina be taunimanima bona boromakau bae momo ia lalonai.
english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

motu: Badina be lahi maḡuna heḡereḡerena ai bainala, heḡeḡemadai gabudia iboudiai, bona hairai ai bainala ia lalonai. Iehova na e herevamu.” Dauhai e hanohodia taudia iboiridia
english: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, He, he, mirigini kahana tanona ba heautania; badina be lau ese vada na hakarohomui rohoroho, guba laidia haniosi na heheto. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.

motu: He, Babulono natuna hahinena ida o nohomu taumu, a roho mauri, Siona a heau lao.
english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

motu: Badina be Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau toma, ia hairaina ese e dadimui besedia dekediai e siaigu murinai, badina be umui e daumui tohomu tauna ese ia matana nadinadina e daua tohomu;
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

motu: ia eto: A itaia, lau ese imagu baina davedavea idia daediai, bena edia hesiai taudia ese bae dadidia. Bena ba diba Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu.
english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.

motu: Siona natuna hahinena e, ane avabia, a moale; badina be, a itaia, lau na vasimu, umui bogaragimui ai baina noho. Iehova na e herevamu.
english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.

motu: Una dina ai bese momo na Iehova enai bae tao, egu bese ai baela; bena lau ese umui bogaragimui ai baina noho, bona umui na ba diba Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu vasi.
english: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Iuda baine abia, ia ahuna ai baine halaoa, tano helaḡana lalonai; bona Ierusalem ma baine abia hidi lou.
english: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

motu: Taunimanima iboumui ai, asi reḡereḡemui ba noho, Iehova vairanai; badina be ia na vada e tore isi, ena noho gabuna helaḡana amo vada e raka lasi.
english: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”

motu: Bena ia ese hahelaḡa tauna badana Iosua e haheitalaigu, Iehova ena aneru vairanai e gini, bona Satana na ia idibana kahana ai e gini, ihabadelaina totona.
english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

motu: Bena Iehova ese Satana e hereva henia, eto, Satana e, Iehova ese aine lodu henimu! Iehova, Ierusalem e abia hidi Diravana, ese aine lodu henimu! Ina na dia lahi amo e veria lasi tutuna a?
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

motu: Hari Iosua na aneru vairanai e gini, mai hahedokina miroka-mirokadia ida.
english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

motu: Bena hari aneru ese ia vairanai ginidia taudia na e hamaorodia, eto, Hari hahedoki miroka-mirokadia na iena amo ba hadokidia oho. Bena ia ese Iosua e hereva henia, eto, A itaia, emu kara havara na emu amo vada na abia oho, dabua mai hairaidia na do baina hahedokilaimu.
english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

motu: Bena lau nato, Dabua ḡoevaḡoevana na kwarana bae ḡeḡelaia. Taunabunai idia ese dabua ḡoevaḡoevana na kwarana e ḡegelaia, bona hahedoki na e hahedokilaia; Iehova ena aneru na una gabu ai e gini.
english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So|strong="H5975" * they|strong="H3068" * set|strong="H7760" * a|strong="H3068" * clean|strong="H2889" * turban|strong="H6797" * on|strong="H5921" * his|strong="H7760" * head|strong="H7218" *, and|strong="H3068" * clothed|strong="H3847" * him|strong="H5921" *; and|strong="H3068" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *’s angel|strong="H4397" * was|strong="H3068" * standing|strong="H5975" * by|strong="H5921" *.

motu: Bena Iehova ena aneru ese Iosua e sisiba henia, eto,
english: Yahweh’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Egu dala ai boma raka bona egu hahedua boma badinaia, bena egu ruma do ba biagua bona egu maḡu do ba reḡudia; bona baina gwau maoro henimu, do ba raka vareai diba, iniseni ai ginidia taudia bogaragidiai.
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana Iosua e, harihari a kamonai, oi bona turamu hahidaosi vairamu ai helaidia, badina be idia na haridia nanamo taudia; a itaia, egu hesiai tauna, Rigi, baina mailaia.
english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

motu: Badina be, a itaia, Iosua vairanai vada na atoa nadina tamona kahana hituosi ai lau ese revarevana baina ḡasia, bona dina tamona lalonai ina tano ena kerere baina abia oho. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

motu: Iehova Sabaota ma e tomu, Una dina ai umui iboumui ai ese ta ta dekena tauna dekena tauna ba vavedia mai, emui vine audia bona emui suke audia henudiai.
english: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ma ema, e haogu, mahuta tauna bema haoa na heto.
english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Dahaka o itaiamu? Lau nato, Lamepa patana ta, gold * ḡauna, na itaiamu, dorina ai na dihu ta, bona ia latanai lamepa hitu, bona dorina lamepadia ta ta na mai ududia hitu.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I|strong="H2009" * said, “ I|strong="H2009" * have|strong="H7200" * seen|strong="H7200" *, and|strong="H2091" * behold|strong="H2009" *, a|strong="H3068" * lamp|strong="H5216" * stand all|strong="H3605" * of|strong="H7218" * gold|strong="H2091" *, with|strong="H5921" * its|strong="H3605" * bowl|strong="H1543" * on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H3605" * top|strong="H7218" * of|strong="H7218" * it|strong="H5921" *, and|strong="H2091" * its|strong="H3605" * seven|strong="H7651" * lamps|strong="H5216" * on|strong="H5921" * it|strong="H5921" *; there|strong="H2009" * are|strong="H4100" * seven|strong="H7651" * pipes|strong="H4166" * to|strong="H5921" * each|strong="H3605" * of|strong="H7218" * the|strong="H3605" * lamps|strong="H5216" * which|strong="H4100" * are|strong="H4100" * on|strong="H5921" * the|strong="H3605" * top|strong="H7218" * of|strong="H7218" * it|strong="H5921" *;

motu: Ia badibadinai na olive audia rua, ta dihu idibana kahana ai, ma ta laurina kahana ai.
english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na nanadaia, nato, Ḡauka e, ini na dahaka?
english: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna ese e haere henigu, eto, Oi na asi dibamu ini na dahaka a? Lau nato, Ḡauka e, lasi.
english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I|strong="H3045" * said|strong="H1696" *, “ No|strong="H3808" *, my|strong="H3045" * lord.”

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na Iehova ena hereva Serubabele enai. Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Dia goada amo eiava dia siahu amo, a Laumagu amo.
english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Ororo badana e, oi na dahaka? Serubabele vairanai oi na taora ai ba hahelao, bena ia ese atai nadina baine mailaia, bona taunimanima na bae lolo, baeto, Harihari-bada, harihari-bada ienai baine mia.
english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva ma ta danu egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Serubabele imana ese ina dubu badina vada e atoa, bona ia ese baine haḡuḡurua danu. Bena vada ba diba, Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu mai dekemu ai.
english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

motu: Badina be ḡau maraḡidia dinana vada e dadaraia tauna na baine moale, bona gini-maoro varona baine itaia Serubabele imana ai. Ini hituosi na Iehova matana, tanobada idoinai e neneamu.
english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

motu: Bena na nanadaia, nato, Ini olive audia ruaosi, lamepa patana idibana kahana ai bona laurina kahana ai be dahaka?
english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

motu: Nega iharuana ma na nanadaia, nato, Hari olive audia rigidia ruaosi, gold * baubaudia, dehoro e seilaia ḡaudia, badibadidiai e miamu be dahaka?
english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

motu: Ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Oi asi dibamu ini na dahaka a? Lau nato, Ḡauka e, lasi.
english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I|strong="H3045" * said, “ No|strong="H3808" *, my|strong="H3045" * lord.”

motu: Bena ia eto, Ini na e horodia taudia raruosi tanobada idoinai Lohiana badibadinai e ginimu taudia.
english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord + 4:14 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * of the whole earth.”

motu: Bena na gaga isi lou, na roha lao, buka helokuna ta na itaia, e rohova.
english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

motu: Ia ese e nanadaigu, eto, Dahaka o itaiamu a? Lau na haere, nato, Buka helokuna ta rohona ai na itaiamu; ena lata na kiubit ruahui bona ena lababa na hubit gwauta.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I|strong="H7200" * answered, “ I|strong="H7200" * see|strong="H7200" * a|strong="H3068" * flying|strong="H5774" * scroll|strong="H4039" *; its length is|strong="H4100" * twenty|strong="H6242" * cubits, + 5:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. * and|strong="H6242" * its width|strong="H7341" * ten|strong="H6235" * cubits.”

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Ina na heuduguirai ḡauna, tano idoinai daenai e laomu; badina be ina murinai henao taudia iboudiai na bae henege daure, ia lalonai e hedinaraimu heḡereḡerena bona ia murinai e gwau hamata koikoimu taudia iboudiai na bae henege daure, ia lalonai e hedinaraimu heḡereḡerena.
english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Lau ese baina siaia lao, henao tauna ena ruma lalonai baine vareai bona lau ladagu ai e gwau hamata koikoimu tauna ena ruma lalonai danu; bena ena ruma ai baine mia ela bona baine ha-olea, au bona nadi danu baine ha-oredia. Peroveta tauna ena mata-hanai ihahituna
english: I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna e raka kahi mai, e hereva henigu, eto, A gaga isi, e lasimu ḡauna na ba itaia.
english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

motu: Bena lau nato, Una na dahaka? Ia eto, Una na tohe ta e laomu. Ma eto, Ina na edia kara havara, tano idoinai lalonai.
english: I said, “What is it?” He|strong="H1931" * said|strong="H3318" *, “ This|strong="H2063" * is|strong="H1931" * the|strong="H3605" * ephah + 5:6 An ephah is a measure of volume of about 22 liters, 5.8 U. S. gallons, or about 2/3 of a bushel. * basket that|strong="H3605" * is|strong="H1931" * appearing.” He|strong="H1931" * said|strong="H3318" * moreover, “ This|strong="H2063" * is|strong="H1931" * their|strong="H3605" * appearance|strong="H5869" * in|strong="H5869" * all|strong="H3605" * the|strong="H3605" * land—

motu: Bena na itaia, auri-metauna ikaruhina na e heabi isi, bena tohe lalonai hahine ta e helaiva.
english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent + 5:7 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds. * was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah + 5:7 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel * basket.”

motu: Bena ia eto, Ina na Kara Dika. Bena ma e doria dobi tohe lalonai, bona auri-metauna ikaruhina amo e karuhia ahu.
english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

motu: Bena na gaga dae, hahine rarua na itadia, e maiva. Lai ese hanidia e ha-evadia; hanidia na boḡe hanidia na heheto. Bena idia ese hari tohe e abia isi, tanobada bona guba padadiai.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na na nanadaia, nato, tlari tohe na ede e laohaiamu?
english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

motu: Ia ese e hamaorogu, eto, Sinara tanona; unuseni ai dubuna bae haginia; baine gini vaitani bena tohe na ilahana latanai bae laia kau.
english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

motu: Bena na gaga isi lou, kariota hani na itadia, ororo rua padadia amo e maiva. Hari ororo na auri-laboralabora ororodia.
english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

motu: Kariota gini-gunana mai hosi kakakakadia; iharuana na mai hosi koremadia;
english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

motu: ihatoina na mai hosi kurokurodia; bona kariota ihahanina na mai hosi mia-koremadia mai toutoudia.
english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

motu: Bena lau ida a hereva-hereva aneruna na nanadaia, nato, Ḡauka e, ini be dahaka?
english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

motu: Hari aneru ese e haere henigu, eto, Ini na tanobada idoinai Lohiana vairanai bae hedinarai guna, bena guba laina haniosi ediai baela.
english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

motu: Kariota mai hosi koremadia na mirigini kahana tanona be lao heniamu; kurokurodia na lahara kahana be lao heniamu; bona mai toutoudia ḡaudia na diho kahana be lao heniamu.
english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

motu: Hari hosi na e heau lasi negana ai, idia na e ḡava, baela, tanobada bae itaia tao eto. Bena ia eto, Aola, tanobada ba itaia tao. Taunabunai, idia na tanobada i'ita-taona ela.
english: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

motu: Bena ia ese e boi henigu, eto, A itaia, mirigini kahana vada e lao heniamu taudia ese Laumagu vada e halagaia ani, una mirigini kahana tanona ai. Iosua kwarana ihavavalaina
english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

motu: Dauhai e hanohodia taudia bogaragidia amo, Heledai bona Tobia bona Iedaia bavabidia; idia na Babulono amo vada ema. Bena una dina tamona ai Iosia Sefania ena ruma baola.
english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

motu: Idia ediai silver * bona gold * bavabi, havava ḡauna ta ba karaia, bena Iosua Iehosadak, hahelaḡa tauna badana, kwarana ba havavalaia.
english: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

motu: Bena ba hamaoroa, baoto, Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Tau ladana Rigi a itaia; badina be ia na ena gabu ai baine tubu, bena ia ese Iehova ena dubu baine haginia.
english: and speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build Yahweh’s temple.

motu: Ia ese Iehova ena dubu baine haginia, bena bae matauraia, pavapava na heto; bena ena terono ai baine helai, baine lohia. Ena terono badibadinai hahelaḡa tauna ta baine gini; bena raruosi lalodia bae tamona, mai mainodia ida.
english: He will build Yahweh’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

motu: Bena hari havava ḡauna na Iehova ena dubu ai baine mia, Heledai, Tobia, Iedaia bona Iosia Sefania ihahelalo-unedia totona.
english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.

motu: Dauhai e nohomu taudia na baema, Iehova ena dubu ihaginina ai bae heduru; bena vada ba diba, Iehova Sabaota ese vada e siaigu dekemu ai. Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, gadona ba badinaia namonamo, ini ḡau do bae vara.
english: Those who are far off shall come and build in Yahweh’s temple; and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey Yahweh your God’s voice.”’” + 6:15 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). *

motu: King Darauese ena lohia laḡanina ihahanina ai, huana ihataurahani-tana, ladana Kisleve, dinana ihahanina lalonai, Iehova ena hereva na Sekaria enai e kau.
english: In the fourth year of King Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

motu: Una negana ai Betele taudia ese Saresere bona Regeme-melek, mai edia orea taudia ida, e siaidia lao, Iehova bae noia, ena hahenamo na latadiai baine kau.
english: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat Yahweh’s favor,

motu: Bona Iehova Sabaota ena dubu ai hahelaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia na bae nanadaidia baeto, Hua iha-imana ai baina taitai bona baina anivaga, laḡani gunadia momo lalodiai vada na karaia heḡereḡerena eiava?
english: and to speak to the priests of the house of Yahweh of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

motu: Bena Iehova Sabaota ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: Then the word of Yahweh of Armies came to me, saying,

motu: Tano taudia iboudiai bona hahelaḡa taudia danu ba hamaorodia, baoto: Ene laḡani hitu-ahuiosi lalodiai, hua iha-imana ai bona hua ihahituna ai o taitaiva bona o anivagava negadia ai na lau daigu ai o anivagava a?
english: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

motu: Bona o anianimu o inuinumu negadia ai, umui sibomui daimui ai o anianimu bona o inuinumu, ani?
english: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

motu: Ierusalem bona ena hetabira hanuadia na e noholaidiava mai namodia ida, bona diho kahana bona taora kahadia danue noholaidiava, negana ai ini hereva na Iehova ese peroveta taudia gunadia ududia amo e gwaurai, ani? Gwau-edeede davana
english: Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

motu: Iehova ena hereva na Sekaria enai e kau, eto,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Ba hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva; ta ta tadikakana tadikakana bae kara namo henidia bona bae bogadia hisi.
english: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

motu: Vabu, ihareha, noho-hedoa tauna, ogoḡami tauna basio hahisidia; bona ta ese tadikakana ihadikana dalana ta basine lalo hatalaia.
english: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

motu: A idia na asie ura bae kamonai; bena e helai muri henia bona taiadia e kodobedia, basie kamonai helaoreana.
english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

motu: Lalodia na e ha-aukadia masemase, Iehova Sabaota ena Lauma ese peroveta taudia gunadia edia amo e siaidia taravatudia bona herevadia bae kamonai na garina. Taunabunai badu ḡaraḡara bada-herea na Iehova Sabaota ena amo e kau.
english: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which Yahweh of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Lau na boiboi bena idia asie kamonai heḡereḡerena ai idia e boiboi bena lau asina kamonai;
english: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said Yahweh of Armies;

motu: bena koe-hirihiri amo na hakarohodia rohoroho, asi dibadia besedia iboudiai bogaragidiai. Taunabunai, e rakatania tanona na vada e vahu, asi lao mai tauna ta; tano namona vada e havahua vaitani.
english: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”

motu: Bena Iehova Sabaota ena hereva na egu ai e kau, eto,
english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na ini e gwau tomamu: Siona dainai lalogu na e hekwarahimu, mai lalo-hekwarahigu badana ida bona mai badu-garagaragu ida.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”

motu: Iehova ini e gwau tomamu: Siona baina lou henia, Ierusalem bogaraginai baina noho; bena Ierusalem na bae gwauraia “Heabidadama Hanuana”, bona Iehova Sabaota ena ororo na bae gwauraia “Ororo Helaḡana”.
english: Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Yahweh of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Tatau burukadia bona hahine burukadia na Ierusalem hanuana ariaradia ai ma bae helai, ta ta mai edia itotohi, vada e buruka herea dainai.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

motu: Bona una hanua ariaradia na memero bona kekeni ese bae hahonudia, ariara lalodiai bae gadara.
english: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Reana ina nega ai ina bese kwabukwabuna ese una kara na bema hoalaia dainai umui na o tomamu lau ese danu baina hoalaia a! Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova Sabaota ma ini e gwau tomamu: A itaia, egu bese taudia baina hamauridia, laurabada kahana tanodia amo bona lahara kahana tanodia amo;
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.

motu: bena baina hakaudia mai, Ierusalem bogaraginai baina hanohodia. Idia na lauegu bese ai baela, bona lau na edia Dirava ai bainala, heabidadama ai bona kara maoromaoro ai.
english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Umui, ina negana ai ini hereva o hakala henimu, dubu helaḡana baine gini totona Iehova Sabaota ena dubu badina e atoa dinana amo peroveta taudia ududia amo e lasi herevadia o kamonaimu taumui e, imamui ba ha-aukadia.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahweh of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

motu: Badina be unu dina do asie kau ai, taunimanima ena ḡaukara na asi davana bona boromakau maruanena ena ḡaukara na asi davana, bona e raka lasi eiava e raka vareai tauna na asi ena dala ana inai tauna imana amo baine roho mauri; badina be lau ese taunimanima iboudiai na bamodia ida na haheinaidia heheni.
english: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.

motu: A harihari lau ese ina bese kwabukwabuna basina kara henidia nega gunadia heḡereḡeredia. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Badina be maino baine hehado; vine na baine huahua, bona tano anina baine vara, bona guba hununa baine diho; bona ini ḡau iboudiai na ina bese kwabukwabuna baina henidia, bae ḡaunaidia.
english: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.

motu: Iuda taumui bona Israel taumui e, umui na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai heuduguirai gwaurai-gwaurai herevana ai vada ola heḡereḡerena ai, lau ese do baina hamaurimui, bena hahenamo taumui ai baola. Basio gari, a imamui ba ha-aukadia.
english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

motu: Iehova, egu Dirava, ini e gwau toma: Ialadia vada e gwaurai hata mamoedia iboudiai ireḡudia tauna ai baola.
english: Yahweh my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.

motu: E hoidia taudia ese e aladia masemu, bona ta ese matadia se hakanidiamu; e hoihoilaidiamu taudia na e tomu “Iehova aita hanamoa, lau vada na taḡa”; bona ireḡudia taudia korikoridia ese asie bogadia hisimu.
english: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Badina be ina tano inoholaina taudia basina bogadia hisi lou. A itaia, lau ese taunimanima na ta ta ireguna tauna ireḡuna tauna imadia ai, bona ta ta ena pavapava ena pavapava imadia ai, baina atodia kau; bena idia ese tanobada bae hadarerea, bona lau ese tau ta na idia imadia amo basina harohodia mauri.
english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says Yahweh; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”

motu: Taunabunai, lau na mamoe ihoihoilaidia taudia daidiai ialadia vada e gwaurai hata mamoedia ireḡudia tauna ai nala. Bena itotohi rua na abidia: ta ladana na hatoa Harihari-bada, ma ta ladana na hatoa Hahetamona. Bena mamoe na reḡudia.
english: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.

motu: Hua tamona lalonai lau ese mamoe ireḡudia taudia tatoiosi na aladia mase. A egu haheauka e ore, mamoe ediai, bona idia ese e inai henigu.
english: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

motu: Taunabunai lau nato, Lau ese basina regumui. Dahaka baine mase, vada baine mase; bona dahaka bae habuaia tari, vada bae habuaia tari; bena kwabukwabudia ese bae heani heheni.
english: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”

motu: Bena egu itotohi ladana Harihari-bada na abia, na hakwaidua; unu amo egu gwauhamata, bese iboudiai na gwau hamalalai henidia ḡauna, na na utua.
english: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

motu: Taunabunai, una dina ai e heutu, bona mamoe e hoihoilaidia taudia ese e itagu tao, bena lalodia vada e parara una na Iehova ena hereva.
english: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was Yahweh’s word.

motu: Bena na hamaorodia, nato, Bema lalomui baeto maoro, egu ḡaukara davana boma henigu, a bema lasi, boma rua. Bena idia ese egu ḡaukara davana e hahetohoa, silver * sekeledia toi-ahui.
english: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Moni mauana ai ba udaia dobi. (Una na dava herea-daena idia ese egu ḡaukara e davalaia ḡauna). Taunabunai, lau ese hari silver * sekeledia toi-ahui na abidia, moni mauana ai na uda dobi, Iehova ena dubu ai.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh’s house.

motu: Bena egu itotohi iharuana, ladana Hahetamona, na hakwaidua, unu amo Iuda bona Israel edia hetadikaka na utua.
english: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

motu: Bena Iehova ese e hamaorogu, eto, Mamoe ireḡudia tauna asi namona ena ḡaukara ḡaudia ma bavabidia lou.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

motu: Badina be, a itaia, lau ese mamoe ireḡudia tauna ta ina tano ai na haginiamu; ia ese be masemu taudia na se naridiamu, eiava raka-boioboio taudia na se tahudiamu, eiava mai berodia taudia na se hamauridiamu, eiava goada taudia na se ubudiamu, a ubu-ubu ḡaudia hidiodia e animu, aedia kahaudia danu e raḡadia ohomu.
english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

motu: Egu mamoe ireḡudia tauna asi namona, madi ihabaina! Ia ese ena mamoe serina e rakataniamu. Dare ese ia imana baine dapaia, bona matana idibana danu baine taraia, una na baine namo. Imana do baine heveri, bona matana idibana baine kepulu vaitani, una na baine namo.
english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”

motu: Maduna metauna herevana Iehova ena amo, Israel dainai. Iehova, guba vada e idia roro bona tanobada vada e karaia bona taunimanima laumana na ia lalonai vada e havaraia Diravana, na ini e gwau tomamu:
english: A revelation of Yahweh’s word concerning Israel: Yahweh, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

motu: A itaia, lau ese Ierusalem na hahekekero keherena ai baina halaoa, hegegemadai besedia iboudiai ediai; Iuda ihadikana ḡauna ai bainela danu, Ierusalem bae koua heḡeḡe negana ai.
english: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

motu: Una dina ai lau ese Ierusalem na nadi metauna ta ai baina halaoa, bese iboudiai edia; bae abia isi taudia iboudiai na sibodia bae hahehisi herea. Bena tanobada basileiadia iboudiai na bae hahebou, ia ihadikana.
english: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.

motu: Iehova na e tomu: Una dina ai, hosi iboudiai kudoudia baina hahetahadia, bona hosi-gui taudia iboudiai na baina hakavakavadia. A Iuda iduhuna taudia na matagu baina hapapa henidia, bese idau-idau taudia edia hosi iboudiai matadia baina hakepuludia negana ai.
english: In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

motu: Bena Iuda iduhudia taudia na bae hereva heheni, baeto “Ierusalem inoholaina taudia ese goada e abiamu, Iehova Sabaota, edia Dirava, dainai”.
english: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in Yahweh of Armies their God.’

motu: Una dina ai, Iuda iduhudia na gida keberena au bogaragidiai na heto, eiava kede hururu-hururuna rei kakoro bogaraginai na heto; heḡeḡemadai besedia iboudiai, idiba kahana ai bona lauri kahana ai, na idia ese bae aradia ore, a Ierusalem na gabuna ai baine mia, mai inoholaina taudia ida.
english: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.

motu: Iehova ese kwalimu na Iuda kalagadia baine henidia guna, David iduhuna hairaina bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia hairaidia ese Iuda hairaina basie hereaia helaoreana.
english: Yahweh also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.

motu: Una dina ai Iehova ese Ierusalem inoholaina taudia na kesi amo baine koudia heḡeḡe; una dainai manokamanoka-herea tauna idia bogaragidiai na una dina ai David ida bae heḡereḡere; bona David iduhuna na Dirava ida, Iehova ena aneru ida, bae heḡereḡere, idia ikwaradia ai.
english: In that day Yahweh will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like Yahweh’s angel before them.

motu: Una dina ai danu lau ese Ierusalem e tuari heniamu basileiadia iboudiai ihabua-taridia dalana baina tahua.
english: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

motu: Bena David iduhuna bona Ierusalem inoholaina taudia latadiai hebogahisi bona noinoi laumana baina seia dobi; taunabunai vada e gwadaia uru tauna bae raraia negana ai, idia na ia taina bae tai, ta ese natuna vara edeana bema tailaia na heto, bona bae tai ḡadeḡadelaia, ta ese natuna roboana bema taitailaia na heto.
english: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me + 12:10 After “me”, the Hebrew has the two letters “Aleph Tav” (the first and last letters of the Hebrew alphabet), not as a word, but as a grammatical marker. * whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

motu: Una dina ai taitai na baine bada herea Ierusalem ai, Megido taorana ai, Hadadarimon taina e taiva na heto.
english: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

motu: Tano taudia na bae taitai, edia iduhu ta ta ai: David iduhuna tataudia na sibodia bona adavadia danu sibodia; Natan iduhuna tataudia na sibodia bona adavadia danu sibodia;

english: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Una dina ai danu kaivakuku ladadia na tano amo baina negedia daure; bena tau ta ese basine lalodia tao lou; bona peroveta taudia bona lauma mai mirona danu na tano amo baina abidia oho.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

motu: Bema ta ma baine hedinarai, baineto ia na peroveta tauna, bena ia e havaraia tauna bona hahinena ese bae hamaoroa, baeto “Emu mauri na basine mia badina be hereva koikoidia na Iehova ladana ai o gwauraimu”; bena baine peroveta negana ai, e havaraia tauna bona hahinena ese bae gwadaia uru.
english: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Yahweh’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.

motu: Una dina ai peroveta taudia iboudiai na edia mata-hanai daidiai bae hemarai, bae peroveta negadia ai; idia na hahedoki huika-huikadia basie hahedokilai, taunimanima ikoidia totona.
english: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,

motu: A idia baeto, Ai na dia peroveta taudia, ai na biru taudia; badina be ina tano na emai tano korikori, tauhaumai negana amo.
english: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’

motu: Bena ta ese bema nanadaidia, bema toma “Ene dorumui berodia be dahaka?”, idia baeto “Ini bero na turamai edia ruma ai a davari”. Iehova ena mamoe ireḡudia tauna irahu-masena
english: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’
