motu: A itaia, Iehova ena dina na e maimu; una dina ai emui amo e dadi oho kohudia na bogaragimui ai ma bae heharilai.
english: Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

motu: Badina be basileia iboudiai baina haboudia, Ierusalem bae tuari henia totona; bena hanua na bae abia, ruma kohudia na bae dadi, bona hahine na bae hadikadia; a taunimanima oredia na hanua amo basie henege daure.
english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

motu: Bena Iehova baine raka lasi, unu basileia na baine tuari henidia, tuari dinana ai e tuarimu na heto.
english: Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

motu: Una dina ai, ia aena na Olive ororona, Ierusalem vairanai, mairiveina kahana ai e miamu ḡauna, latanai bae hahedai; bona Olive ororona baine hepola parara, laurabada kahana amo ela bona lahara kahana; koura mai lababana ta baine hekara. Taunabunai Ororo kahana ta na mirigini kahana bainela, bona kahana ta na diho kahana bainela.
english: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

motu: Egu ororo kourana na baine hekou ahu; badina be ororo kourana ese ia ohena ai baine hetomu kau. Bena umui na ba heau oho, Usia, Iuda pavapavana, ena nega ai tano laḡa o heautania na heto. Bena Iehova, emui Dirava, bainema bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai danu ia ida.
english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Yahweh my God will come, and all the holy ones with you. + 14:5 Septuagint reads “him” instead of “you”. *

motu: Una dina ai keru eiava paraka mavamavana basie vara.
english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

motu: Bena diari na baine hesiriu hanaihanai (Iehova na mai dibana), dia dina bona dia hanuaboi; ena be dina baine diho to diari na baine mia.
english: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

motu: Una dina ai, mauri ranudia na Ierusalem lalona amo bae aru lasi, kahana na laurabada kahana davarana ai bae aru lasi, ma kahana na lahara kahana davarana ai; bae aru hanaihanai, siahu negana ai bona keru negana ai danu.
english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

motu: Bena Iehova ese tanobada idoinai baine pavapavaia; una dina ai Iehova na baine tamona bona ia ladana danu baine tamona.
english: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

motu: Tano idoinai na taora ai baine hahelao, Geba amo ela bona Rimon, Ierusalem diho-kahana ai. A Ierusalem na atai ai baine mia, gabana korikorina ai, Beniamina Ikoukouna amo ela ikoukou gunana, ela bona Daiguni Ikoukouna, bona Hananele Kohorona ela bona pavapava ena vine itaolaidia gabudia.
english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

motu: Bona haida ese bae noholaia, badina be hevadari basine mia; Ierusalem taudia na bae noho namonamo, asi garidia.
english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

motu: Bena Ierusalem bae tuari henia besedia iboudiai na Iehova ese ina dai-hanai gorerena amo baine hahisidia: ginidia ai hidiodia bae pata, bona kwaradia ai matadia bae pata, bona ududia ai maladia bae pata.
english: This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

motu: Una dina ai gari bada-hereana Iehova ena amo na idia latadiai baine kau, bena ta ta ese bamona bamona imadia bae abi, bona ta ta ese imadia bae abi isi, bamodia ihadikadia totona;
english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from Yahweh will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

motu: Iuda ese danu Ierusalem baine tuari henia. Bena heḡeḡemadai besedia iboudiai edia taḡa na bae haboudia, gold * bona silver * bona dabua momo herea.
english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

motu: Bena dai-hanai gorerena ta, hari gorere heḡereḡerena na hosi bona doniki badadia bona kamelo bona doniki maraḡidia, bona ubu-ubu ḡaudia dahaka dahaka unu taruha lalodiai bae mia, latadiai baine kau.
english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

motu: Bena roho-mauri taudia iboudiai, unu Ierusalem vada e tuari henia besedia idau-idau iboudiai amo, na laḡani ta ta ai Ierusalem bae dara dae, Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, itomadiho-henina bona kalaga ariana ibadinana totona.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

motu: A tanobada iduhudia haida na Ḡaubada, Iehova Sabaota, itomadiho-henina totona Ierusalem basiema dara dae, medu na idia latadiai basie diho.
english: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

motu: Bona Aigupto taudia danu basiema dara dae, unuseni ai basiema hedinarai, bena Iehova ese kalaga ariana ibadinana totona asie dara daemu besedia e hahisilaidiamu gorerena na idia danu latadiai baine kau.
english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

motu: Aigupto davana bona kalaga ariana ibadinana totona asie dara daemu besedia iboudiai davadia na unu bae abi toma.
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

motu: Una dina ai hosi aiodia gabagabadia ai ina revareva bae torea: “Helaḡa, Iehova ena”. Bona Iehova ena dubu ai bae mia urodia na ihaboulaina patana vairanai e miamu naudia heḡereḡeredia ai baela.
english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO YAHWEH”; and the pots in Yahweh’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

motu: Uro iboudiai Ierusalem ai bona Iuda ai na bae helaḡa, Iehova Sabaota enai; taunabunai edia boubou ḡaudia bae hahelaḡadia taudia iboudiai na baema diba, bae abidia, edia boubou ḡaudia hidiodia na idia lalodiai bae nadudia. Bona hoihoi tauna ta na Iehova Sabaota ena dubu ai basine noho lou una dina ai.
english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite + 14:21 or, merchant * in the house of Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Maduna metauna herevana Iehova ena amo, Israel latanai, Malaki ese e gwauraia.
english: A revelation, Yahweh’s + 1:1 “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. * word to Israel by Malachi.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Lau ese vada na lalokau henimui. A umui o tomamu, Ede vada o lalokau henimai toma? Iehova ma e tomu, Esau na dia Iakob kakana a? Ḡau tamona Iakob vada na lalokau henia,
english: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. Yet|strong="H3068" * you|strong="H3808" * say, “ How|strong="H4100" * have|strong="H3068" * you|strong="H3808" * loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau|strong="H6215" * Jacob|strong="H3290" *’s brother?” says|strong="H5002" * Yahweh|strong="H3068" *, “ Yet|strong="H3068" * I|strong="H3808" * loved Jacob|strong="H3290" *;

motu: a Esau vada na inai henia. Ena ororo tanona vada na havahua, bona ia ahuna na tano-ḡaḡaena sisiadia vada na henidia.
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

motu: Edom bema toma “Vada e taomai tari, to vada eme heḡiḡi dobi gabudia ma baia haginidia lou”, bena Iehova Sabaota bema toma “Readia bae haginidia, to lau ese ma baina ḡiḡidia dobi, ela bona vada bae gwauraidia kara-dika tanona bona Iehova ese e badu henia hanaihanaimu besena”.
english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” Yahweh of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”

motu: Sibomui matamui amo ba itaia, bena baoto, Iehova na herea, Israel tanona murimurinai. Iehova ese hahelaḡa taudia e gwau henidiamu
english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

motu: Mero ese tamana e matauraiamu, bona hesiai tauna ese biaguna e matauraiamu. Bena bema lau na tama, imatauraigu be edeseni ai? Eiava bema lau na biagu, igari-henigu be edeseni ai? Hahelaḡa taumui e, lau ladagu o dadaraiamu taumui e, lau, Iehova Sabaota, na hereva henimuimu. Umui na o tomu, Oi ladamu ede a dadaraia toma?
english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says Yahweh of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

motu: Iniheto: aniani ḡaudia mirodia na egu ihaboulaina patana ai vada o ato. Ma o tomu, Ede a h uniroa toma? Iniheto: umui na o laloa Iehova ena pata baine hedadarai diba.
english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is contemptible.’

motu: Ubu-ubu ḡaudia mata-kepuludia na boubou ḡaudia ai o halaodiamu negadia ai, una na dia dika a? Eiava ae-hedairike ḡaudia eiava gorere ḡaudia na boubou ḡaudia ai o halaodiamu negadia ai, una na dia dika a? Unuhetomana ta na emui hanua lohiana boma henia, ia ese bema moalelaimui eiava bema lalo namo henimui a? Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Harihari Dirava ba noia, ia ese baine lalo namo henida bona baine bogada hisi a? Matogana, herahia ḡaudia unuhetomadia imamui amo baine abi negana ai, ia ese umui ta baine lalo namo henia a? Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, + 1:9 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “” (Elohim). * that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Umui bogaragimui amo ta ese iduara bema koudia, bena lahi na egu ihaboulaina patana latanai basioma ha-araia kava, una na bema namo. Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Lau ese asina moalelaimuimu, bona boubou ḡaudia na umui imamui amo basioa abi.
english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

motu: Badina be daba e reremu ela bona dina e dihomu ai, lau ladagu na herea, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai, bona gabu iboudiai lalodiai muramura mai bonadia e gabudiamu lau ladagu ai, bona boubou ḡaudia ḡoevaḡoevadia danu e henimu; badina be lau ladagu na herea, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: A umui na O tomu Iehova ena pata vada e hamiroa bena anianina bae dadaraia negana ai, umui ese una pata na o hamiroamu.
english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu: Umui o tomamu “Ina daka hekwarahi”, bona o hamue henigumu. Dadidadi ḡauna eiava ae-hedairike ḡauna eiava gorere ḡauna o mailaiamu, emui boubou ḡauna ai ba halaoa o tomamu. Iehova na e tomu, Be, una na imamui amo baina abia a?
english: You say also, ‘Behold, + 1:13 “Behold”, from “”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.

motu: Koikoi tauna na mai ena mamoe maruanena ta ena mamoe serina ai, bena e gwau hamatalaiamu; to mai dikana ḡauna ta na e hahelaḡaiamu, Ḡaubada ena; ia na bae uduguiraia. Badina be lau na Pavapava badana, bona lau ladagu na e gari heniamu, bese idau-idau bogaragidiai. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord + 1:14 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” * a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

motu: Hahelaḡa taumui e, harihari ina haheḡani na umui latamui ai.
english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Basioma kamonai, bona lau ladagu i'imodaina basioma laloa bada, bena lau ese heuduguirai na latamui ai baina siaia, bona emui hahenamo herevadia na baina uduguiraidia; momokani, vada na uduguiraidia vaitani, badina be umui na asio laloa badamu.
english: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.

motu: A itaia, lau ese natumui baina gwau henidia, bona boromakau bona mamoe taḡedia na vairamui baina dahulaidia, hari emui boubou ḡaudia taḡedia; bena lau vairagu amo baina atomui lasi murimuri ai.
english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, + 2:3 or, seed * and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Unu amo ba diba, ina haheḡani na lau ese vada na siaia vasi, egu gwauhamata Levi enai baine momokani helaoreana.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Egu gwauhamata ienai na mauri bona maino gwauhamatana, bena unu na na henia, baine gari helaoreana. Bena e gari henigu, bona ladagu e matauraia.
english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

motu: Hahediba herevadia momokanidia na ia uduna ai e miava, bona ia bibinana ai kerere ta se miava. Ia na lau ida a raka hebouva, maino ai bona kara maoromaoro ai, bona hutuma na ia ese kara havara amo e hakaudia siri.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

motu: A hahelaḡa tauna bibinana ese aonega baine gimaia, bona taunimanima ese hahediba herevadia na ia uduna amo bae tahua, una na namo; badina be ia na Iehova Sabaota ena gwaukau tauna.
english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, A umui na dala amo vada o raka siri, bona emu hahediba herevadia amo hutuma vada o hahekwakwanaidia; umui ese Levi ena gwauhamata vada o hadikaia.
english: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Taunabunai, lau ese baina hahemaraimui bona baina ha-igomui diho, taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, egu dala asio badinadia bona emui hahediba ai kaha ta enai o tao dainai. Iehova ese Israel e gwau henia
english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.

motu: Ita iboudai tamada na tamona, ani? Dirava tamona ese vada e karada, ani? Benaini, dahaka dainai ita na ta hekoi hehenimu, bena seneda edia gwauhamata ta hadikaiamu?
english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

motu: Iuda vada e koikoi; bona Israel ai bona Ierusalem ai kara dika-rohorohodia vada e kara; badina be Iuda ese Iehova ena gabu helaḡana, e lalokau heniamu gabuna, vada e hadikaia; bona dirava idauna natuna kekenina vada e adavaia.
english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

motu: Ini e kara tomamu tauna iduruna lotona bema hereva eiava bema haere eiava boubou ḡauna Iehova Sabaota enai bema mailaia tauna na Iehova ese Iakob ena kalaga amo baine negea daure, una be namo.
english: Yahweh will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Ina danu o karaiamu. Iehova ena ihaboulaina patana na iruru-matamui amo o hada'ania ḡuḡurumu, mai taitaimui bona mai ḡanaḡanamui ida, badina be ia ese boubou ḡauna ihaḡerena vada e hadokoa, bona imamui amo asie abia daemu mai lalo-namona ida.
english: “This again you do: you cover Yahweh’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

motu: Umui na o henanadaimu, o tomu, Dahaka dainai se abia daemu? Badina korikori be Iehova na mai dibana oi bona adavamu na eregabemui ai o hegwau hamata heheni, a, ena be ia na oi bamomu bona adavamu, gwauhamata dainai, to ienai so tao.
english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.

motu: Dirava tamona ese mauri laumana vada e karaia bona vada e hahesiriua ita eda, ani? Bona iena ura be dahaka? Ena ura be ita ese ia bae matauraia memerodia na baita havaradia. Taunabunai, sibomui ba henahua toho, bona ta ese eregabena ai e adavaia hahinena na basine rakatania.
english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

motu: Iehova, Israel Diravana, na e tomu, Badina be hahekoho na na inai heniamu, bona daḡedaḡe karadia ai dabuana e hamiroamu tauna danu na inai heniamu. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu. Taunabunai, sibomui ba henahua toho, bona adavamui basio hadihodia.
english: One who hates and divorces”, says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.

motu: Emui hereva amo Iehova vada o hahekwarahia ema bona vada e hesiku. Ḡau tamona, umui na o tomu, Ede a hahekwarahia toma? Iniheto: umui oto, Kara dika taudia iboudiai nanamo, Iehova vairanai, bona ia ese e moalelaidiamu. Eiava o henanadai, oto, Hahemaoro ḡoevaḡoeva Diravana be edeseni ai?
english: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in Yahweh’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, A itaia, egu gwaukau tauna na siaiamu, vairagu dalana baine lailaia totona; bona Iehova, o tahuamu Diravana, ese ena dubu helaḡana baine mai henia taku.
english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: A itaia, gwauhamata gwaukauna tauna, o moalelaiamu tauna, na e maimu. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu. A ena mai dinana ai, daika baine haheauka diba? Bona baine hedinarai negana ai, daika baine gini diba? Badina be ia na gold * ihaḡoevana tauna ena lahi bona dabua-huri tauna ena sopu na heto.
english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;

motu: Ia na baine helai, silver * ihamanada-manadana bona ihaḡoevaḡoevana tauna na heto; ia ese Levi vevena baine hagoevadia, bona baine hamanadadia, gold * bona silver * na heheto, ela bona idia ese boubou ḡaudia maorodia na Iehova bae henia.
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to Yahweh offerings in righteousness.

motu: Bena Iuda bona Ierusalem edia boubou ḡauna na Iehova ese baine moalelaia, dina gunadia ai bona laḡani gunadia ai heḡereḡeredia.
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh as in the days of old and as in ancient years.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Una negana ai lau na hahemaoro totona baina vasi. Lau ese babalau taudia, heuda-hanai taudia, gwauhamata koikoi taudia, ḡaukara taudia davadia ihenidia ai e koidiamu bona vabu bona ihareha e hahisidiamu taudia, bona noho-hedoa tauna e doria ohomu bona lau garigu asie garimu taudia na baina habadelaidia haraḡa. Herahia monidia
english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Badina be lau Iehova na asina idaumu. Una dainai, Iakob garana e, umui na asio mase ore.
english: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

motu: Senemui edia nega amo umui na egu taravatu vada o rakatanidia bona asio badinadia. Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, A lou henigu, bena lau ese baina lou henimui. A umui na o tomamu, Ede baia lou toma?
english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

motu: Be, taunimanima ese Dirava bae dadihaia a? Mato, umui ese o dadihaigumu. A umui o tomamu, Ede a dadihaimu tomamu? Iniheto: emui ḡau ikaroadia ai bona emui herahia ḡaudia ihenidia ai.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

motu: Heuduguirai na latamui ai vada e kau, badina be umui na mai besemui idoinai ida ese o dadihaigumu.
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Ḡau ikaroadia korikoridia ba mailaidia, roge ai bavatodia, aniani na rumagu ai baine mia helaoreana. Unu amo ba tohogu, guba gaba-maurudia baina kehodia emui, bona hahenamo na latamui ai baina seia dobi ela bona baine hepurai dobi, eiava.
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.

motu: Iehova Sabaota ini e gwau tomamu: Kwadi baina gwaua tao, emui tano anidia basine ha-oredia totona; bona imea ai emui vine na huahua ai basie dabu.
english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Bena bese iboudiai ese bae imodaimui; badina be moale tanona ai baola. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu. Kara dika taudia bona kara namo taudia
english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Iehova na e tomu, Emui hereva vada e auka, lau latagu ai, A umui o tomamu, Ede a hadikamu toma emai hereva ai?
english: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

motu: Iniheto: vada oto, Dirava isiaina ilao-henula na asi anina; anina be dahaka ena hahedua baita badinaia eiava Iehova Sabaota vairanai baita raka, taitai taudia na heheto?
english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?

motu: Ina negana amo, hekokoroku taudia na namodia baita gwaurai; kara dika taudia na e taḡamu; a dia una mo, Dirava e dibaganiamu negadia ai danu idia na e roho niaurimu.
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

motu: Bena Iehova garina e gariva taudia na e hereva heheniva; Iehova ese e hakala henidia, bona edia hereva e kamonai, bena Iehova garina e gariva bona ia ladana e helalolaiava taudia ilalo-taodia bukana vada e torea ia vairanai.
english: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared Yahweh and who honored his name.

motu: Iehova Sabaota eto, Idia na lauegu taunimanima korikoridia, kara baina karaia dinana ai, bona baina hamauridia, tau ta ese natuna, ia isiaina e lao heniamu merona, e hamauriamu na heto.
english: They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

motu: Bena emui haero-haero ai kara namo taudia bona kara dika taudia ma ba hididia lou, Dirava isiaina e lao heniamu tauna bona isiaina se lao heniamu tauna danu ba hididia.
english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

motu: Iehova Sabaota na e tomu, Badina be, a itaia, dina na e maimu; e siahumu amu siahuna na heto. Una dina ai hekokoroku taudia iboudiai bona kara dika taudia iboudiai na rei kakoro heḡereḡerena ai baela; hari bainema dinana ese baine aradia ore, bena idia ediai ramu ta eiava rigi ta basine mia.
english: “For behold, the day comes, burning like a furnace, when all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble. The day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

motu: A umui, lau ladagu o gari heniamu taumui, emui ai kara maoromaoro dinana baine dae, mai hahemaurina ia hanina ai. Do ba raka lasi mai rohomui ida, boromakau natudia na edia aniani gabuna amo e roho lasimu na heto.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

motu: Bena lau ese karana baina karaia dinana ai, kara dika taudia na ba moimoilaidia, badina be idia na kahu ai baela, aemui palapaladia henudiai. Iehova Sabaota na e herevamu.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

motu: Egu hesiai tauna Mose ena taravatu ba badinaia, ena taravatu bona ena hahemaoro herevadia lau ese Horeb ai na haganilai heniava, Israel idoinai ese bae badina ḡaudia.
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

motu: A itaia, Iehova ena dina badana mai garina ida do basinema negana ai, lau ese peroveta tauna Elia do baina siaia vasi.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

motu: Bena ia ese tama lalodia na baine haloudia natudia ediai, bona natu lalodia na baine haloudia tamadia ediai, lau baina vasi bena tano na heuduguirai amo baina habuaia tari na garina.
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

motu: Iesu Keriso ena vara revarevana binai: ia na David natuna, Abraham natuna.
english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 Messiah (Hebrew) and Christ (Greek) both mean “Anointed One” * the son of David, the son of Abraham.

motu: Abraham ese Isaak e havaraia; Isaak ese Iakob e havaraia; Iakob ese Iuda mai tadina ida e havaradia;
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

motu: Iuda ese Perese bona Sera e havaradia, Tamara bogana ai; Perese ese Hesrom e havaraia; Hesrom ese Ram e havaraia;
english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

motu: Ram ese Aminadab e havaraia; Aminadab ese Nason e havaraia; Nason ese Salmon e havaraia;
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

motu: Salmon ese Boa e havaraia, Rahaba bogana ai; Boa ese Obed e havaraia, Ruta bogana ai; Obed ese Iese e havaraia;
english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

motu: Iese ese David, hanua pavapavana, e havaraia. David ese Solomon e havaraia, Uria adavana bogana ai;
english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king + 1:6 NU omits “the king”. * became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

motu: Solomon ese Rehoboam e havaraia; Rehoboam ese Abia e havaraia; Abia ese Asa e havaraia;
english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

motu: Asa ese Iehosafat e havaraia; Iehosafat ese Ioram e havaraia; Ioram ese Usia e havaraia;
english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

motu: Usia ese Iotam e havaraia; Iotam ese Ahasa e havaraia; Ahasa ese Hesekia e havaraia;
english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

motu: Hesekia ese Manase e havaraia; Manase ese Amon e havaraia; Amon ese Iosia e havaraia;
english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

motu: Iosia ese Iekonia mai tadina ida e havaradia, Babulono e laohaidia negana ai.
english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

motu: Babulono e laohaidia murinai, Iekonia ese Sealtiele e havaraia; Sealtiele ese Serubabele e havaraia;
english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

motu: Serubabele ese Abiud e havaraia; Abiud ese Eliakim e havaraia; Eliakim ese Asoro e havaraia;
english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

motu: Asoro ese Sadok e havaraia; Sadok ese Akim e havaraia; Akim ese Eliud e havaraia;
english: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

motu: Eliud ese Eleasara e havaraia; Eleasara ese Matan e havaraia; Matan ese Iakob e havaraia;
english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

motu: Iakob ese Iosef, Maria adavana, e havaraia; Maria ena amo Iesu, e gwauraia Keriso, e vara.
english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, + 1:16 “Jesus” means “Salvation”. * who is called Christ.

motu: Taunabunai uru iboudiai Abraham ena amo ema bona David be uru gwauta-hani; bona David ena amo ema bona Babulono e laohaidia negana be uru gwauta-hani; bona Babulono e laohaidia negana amo ema bona Keriso be uru gwauta-hani. Iesu e vara
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

motu: Iesu Keriso na ini e vara toma: ia sinana Maria na Iosef maohenina, to raruosi do asie geda bou, Lauma Helaga ese mero e henia.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

motu: Adavana Iosef na kara maoromaoro tauna, bona hahine ihahemaraina se ura, taunabunai baine hahekohoa hehuni-hehuni eto.
english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

motu: Lalona unu e hadaia tomava ai, Lohiabada ena aneru ta ese nihi ai e hahedinarai henia, eto, Iosef David e, adavamu Maria iabidaena garina basio gari, badina be Lauma Helaḡa ese mero vada e henia.
english: But when he thought about these things, behold, + 1:20 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

motu: Ia ese mero do baine abia; ladana ba hatoa IESU; badina be ia ese cna bese taudia edia kara dikadia amo baine hamauridia.
english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, + 1:21 “Jesus” means “Salvation”. * for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

motu: Ini ḡau iboudiai e vara, Lohiabada ese peroveta tauna uduna amo e gwauraia herevana ihamomokanuna; eto,
english: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

motu: A itaia, haneulato ta baine rogorogo, Natuna baine havaraia, mero ta; Ia ladana bae hatoa Emanuel. (Emanuel anina be: Dirava na ita dekedekedai).
english: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and|strong="G2532" * shall|strong="G2532" * give|strong="G5088" * birth|strong="G5088" * to|strong="G2532" * a|strong="G2192" * son|strong="G5207" *. They|strong="G2532" * shall|strong="G2532" * call|strong="G2564" * his|strong="G1722" * name|strong="G3686" * Immanuel|strong="G1694" *,” which|strong="G3739" * is|strong="G1510" *, being|strong="G1510" * interpreted|strong="G3177" *, “ God|strong="G2316" * with|strong="G3326" * us|strong="G2249" *.” + 1:23 Isaiah 7:14 *

motu: Iosef na mahuta amo e noga, bena Lohiabada ena aneru ese e haduaia heḡereḡerena e karaia. Adavana e abia dae:
english: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

motu: to ia ida asie geda bou, ela bona natuna e abia. Bena mero ladana e hatoa IESU.
english: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

motu: Iesu na Betelehem Iudea ai e vara, King Herod ese Iudea e lohiaia negana ai, aonega taudia be dina dae kahana amo Ierusalem ai e lasi.
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men + 2:1 The word for “wise men” (magoi) can also mean teachers, scientists, physicians, astrologers, seers, interpreters of dreams, or sorcerers. * from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

motu: Idia na e henanadai, eto, Iuda taudia edia pavapava harihari eme vara be edeseni ai? Badina be ena hisiu mairiveina kahana ai a itaia, bona itomadiho-henina ama.
english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

motu: King Herod ese una hereva e kamonai negana ai, kudouna e hetaha; Ierusalem taudia iboudiai danu.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

motu: Bena ia ese hahelaḡa taudia iboudiai bona itorena taudia e haboudia, e nanadaidia, eto, Keriso be edeseni ai baine vara e tomamu?
english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

motu: Bena idia na e haere henia, eto, Betelehem Iudea ai; badina be peroveta tauna ini e torea toma:
english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

motu: Oi danu Betelehem e, Iuda tanona ai, Iuda lohiadia bogaragidiai oi na dia gabe tauna, Badina be hahekau tauna na oiemu amo bainema, Ia ese egu bese Israel baine reḡua.
english: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are|strong="G1510" * in|strong="G1722" * no|strong="G2532" * way|strong="G1722" * least|strong="G1646" * among|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * princes|strong="G2232" * of|strong="G1537" * Judah|strong="G2455" *; for|strong="G1063" * out|strong="G1831" * of|strong="G1537" * you|strong="G4771" * shall|strong="G2532" * come|strong="G1831" * a|strong="G2532" * governor|strong="G2232" * who|strong="G3588" * shall|strong="G2532" * shepherd|strong="G4165" * my|strong="G1722" * people|strong="G2992" *, Israel|strong="G2474" *.’” + 2:6 Micah 5:2 *

motu: Bena Herod ese aonega taudia e boiridia hehuni, hisiu ena hedinarai negana e nanadailaia ḡoevaḡoeva.
english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

motu: Bena e siaidia lao, Betelehem baela; eto, Aola, mero maraḡina ba ha tahua goadagoada, bona ba davaria negana ai bame hadibagu, bena lau danu baina vasi toma diho.
english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

motu: Idia na hanua pavapavana erena e kamonaia, bena vada ela. Hari hisiu, mairiveina kahana ai e itaia ḡauna, ese e gunalaidia, ela bona mero maraḡina ena noho gabuna daenai e mia.
english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

motu: Idia na hisiu e itaiava ai na e moale hisi dae.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

motu: Bena ruma ai e raka vareai, mero maraḡina sinana Maria ida e itadia, bena e goru goru diho, e toma henia diho. Bena edia kohu e hulala, herahia e henia, gold bona muramura mai bonana bona dahudahu muramurana.
english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

motu: Bena Dirava ese nihi ai e hamaorodia, eto, Herod dekena basio lou lao. Taunabunai idau dala amo edia hanua e lou henia. Iesu e heaulaia, Aigupto ela
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

motu: Idia e lou murinai, Lohiabada ena aneru ese nihi ai Iosef ma e hahedinarai henia, eto, A tore isi, mero maraḡina sinana ida avabidia, Aigupto ba healulaidia lao, unuseni ai ba ha noho, ela bona lau mil b.lJnl hereva henimu lou; badina be Herod ese mero maraḡina e tahuamu, baine alaia mase e tomu.
english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

motu: Bena Iosef e noga, mero maraḡina sinana ida hanuaboi ai e abidia, Aigupto ela.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

motu: Unuseni ai eha noho ela bona Herod e mase, Lohiabada ese peroveta tauna uduna amo e gwauraia herevana ihamomokanina; eto, Aigupto amo natugu na boiria.
english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.” + 2:15 Hosea 11:1 *

motu: Una negana ai Herod na dibana aonega taudia ese vada e koia, bena e badu dikadika. Bena e hesiai, laḡanidia rua bona gabeai e vara memerodia iboudiai na Betelehem ai bona badina tanodia ai e aladia mase, aonega taudia e nanadailaidia negana heḡereḡerena.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

motu: Una negana ai Ieremia, peroveta tauna, ena hereva vada e momokani; eto,
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

motu: Gado ta Rama ai e kamonai, Tai lolololo bona tai ḡadeḡade bada, Rahela be natuna taidia e taimu, Tauhalo e dadaraia, badina be idia na lasihidia. Nasaret e lou henia
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping|strong="G2799" * and|strong="G2532" * great|strong="G4183" * mourning|strong="G3602" *, Rachel|strong="G4478" * weeping|strong="G2799" * for|strong="G3754" * her|strong="G3754" * children|strong="G5043" *; she|strong="G2532" * wouldn’ t|strong="G3588" * be|strong="G1510" * comforted|strong="G3870" *, because|strong="G3754" * they|strong="G2532" * are|strong="G1510" * no|strong="G3756" * more|strong="G4183" *.” + 2:18 Jeremiah 31:15 *

motu: Herod e mase murinai, Lohiabada ena aneru ese nihi ai Iosef ma e hahedinarai henia lou, Aigupto ai.
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

motu: Eto, A tore isi, mero maraḡina sinana ida avabidia, Israel tanona baola, badina be mero maraḡina iala-masena e tahuava taudia na vada e mase.
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

motu: Bena e tore isi, mero maraḡina bona sinana e abidia, Israel tanona ela.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

motu: To sivarai e kamonai Akelao ese Iudea e lohiaia, tamana Herod gabunai, bena unu lao garina e gariva. A nihi amo Dirava ese e hadibaia dainai e raka hanai, Galilea kahana ela,
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

motu: hanua ta ai, ladana Nasaret, eha noho. Taunabunai peroveta taudia edia hereva vada e momokani; eto, Ia na Nasaret tauna bae gwauraia.
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Ioane Bapatiso e hedinaraiva, Iudea tano ḡaḡaena ai e harorova; eto,
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

motu: A helalo kerehai, badina be guba basileiana vada eme kahira-kahira.
english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

motu: Badina be ia na peroveta tauna Isaia ese e herevalaia guna, eto, Gado ta tano ḡaḡaena ai e boi lolomu, e tomu, Lohiabada ena dala ba lailaia, Ena laolao dalana ba hamaoromaoroa.
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “ The|strong="G1722" * voice|strong="G5456" * of|strong="G1223" * one|strong="G3588" * crying in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * wilderness|strong="G2048" *, make|strong="G4160" * the|strong="G1722" * way|strong="G3598" * of|strong="G1223" * the|strong="G1722" * Lord|strong="G2962" * ready|strong="G2090" *! Make|strong="G4160" * his|strong="G1223" * paths|strong="G5147" * straight|strong="G2117" *!” + 3:3 Isaiah 40:3 *

motu: Ioane ena dabua na kamelo huina, ena gaba ḡauna be boromakau kopina, ana aniani na kwadi bona bada ranuna.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

motu: Ierusalem bona Iudea taudia iboudiai, bona Ioridane kourana hanuadia idoidiai, ia dekena ela,
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

motu: edia dika e gwaurai hedinaraiva. Bena ia ese Ioridane sinavaina ai e bapalisodiava.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

motu: A Farisea taudia bona Sadukea taudia diaḡau bapatiso totona ela e itadia, bena e gwau henidia, eto, Gaigai natudia e, daika ese e hamaoromui do baine vara baduna na ba heautania?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

motu: Helalo-kerehai anina ba hahedinaraia.
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “\+w Before|strong="G4250"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* rooster \+w crows|strong="G5455"\+w*, \+w you|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w deny|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w three|strong="G5151"\+w* \+w times|strong="G5151"\+w*.” * Then he went out and wept bitterly.

motu: Daba e rere, hahelaḡa taudia iboudiai bona hanua tau-badadia e henega bou, Iesu ialana totona;
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

motu: bena e ḡuia, e hakaua lao, Pilato, gavana tauna, e henia.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

motu: Iuda, tao-tore tauna, ese Iesu e itaia, ia ese vada e revaia; bena e helalo, hari silver monidia toi-ahui-osi e loulai, hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua tau-badadia e henidia lou,
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

motu: eto, Vada na kara dika, badina be asi ena kerere tauna taona vada na torea. Idia eto, Ai ese a? Oi sibomu.
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But|strong="G1161" * they|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ What|strong="G5101" * is|strong="G3588" * that|strong="G3588" * to|strong="G4314" * us|strong="G3004" *? You|strong="G4771" * see|strong="G3708" * to|strong="G4314" * it|strong="G1161" *.”

motu: Ia ese silver monidia Dubu Helaḡa lalonai e taho vareai, bena e raka oho, ela, sibona eha hemata.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia ese hari silver monidia e abi, eto, Dia namo boubou mauana ai baita uda, badina be ina na rara davana.
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

motu: E henegalaia, bena uro ikarana tauna ena tano e hoilaia, idau bese taudia iguridia gabuna ai vada e halaoa.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

motu: Una dainai, una tano ladana e hatoa “Rara Tanona” ema bona hari.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

motu: Unu amo Ieremia, peroveta tauna, ena hereva vada e momokani, eto, Silver monidia toi-ahui na abi, Israel taudia ese davana e gwauraia tauna davana,
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah + 27:9 some manuscripts omit “Jeremiah” * the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “ They|strong="G2532" * took|strong="G2983" * the|strong="G2532" * thirty|strong="G5144" * pieces of|strong="G5207" * silver, the|strong="G2532" * price|strong="G5092" * of|strong="G5207" * him|strong="G3588" * upon|strong="G3588" * whom|strong="G3739" * a|strong="G2532" * price|strong="G5092" * had|strong="G2532" * been|strong="G2532" * set|strong="G2532" *, whom|strong="G3739" * some|strong="G3739" * of|strong="G5207" * the|strong="G2532" * children|strong="G5207" * of|strong="G5207" * Israel|strong="G2474" * priced,

motu: uro ikarana tauna ena tano na hoilaia, Lohiabada ese e haduagu heḡereḡerena. Iesu Pilato vairanai
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" * commanded|strong="G4929" * me|strong="G1325" *.” + 27:10 Zechariah 11:12-13; Jeremiah 19:1-13; 32:6-9 *

motu: Iesu na gavana vairanai e gini: bena gavana ese e nanadaia, eto, Oi na Iuda taudia edia pavapava eiava? Iesu eto, O ena vada o gwaumu.
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus|strong="G2424" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G2532" * him|strong="G3588" *, “\+w So|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w say|strong="G3004"\+w*.” *

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua tau-badadia ese ma e habadelaia, to ia na se haere.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

motu: Bena Pilato eto, Hahebade herevadia momo e habadelaimumu na to kamonaimu a?
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

motu: To Iesu na se haere, hereva ta se gwauraia. Taunabunai gavana na e hoa.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

motu: Una aria negana ai, gavana na vaia ena kara dibura rumana ai e nohomu tauna ta, hutuma ese bae gwauraia tauna, baine ruhaia nege.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

motu: Una negana ai, tau ta dibura rumana ai e nohova, ladana na Baraba; una tau harina na bada.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

motu: Taunabunai, idia na e hebou vaitani negana ai, Pilato ese e nanadaidia, eto, Daika o ura heniamu baina ruhaia nege, Baraba eiava Iesu, e nemaia Keriso.
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

motu: Badina be Pilato dibana idia na vaḡeḡe dainai taona e torea.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

motu: Pilato na hahemaoro gabuna ai, ena helai ḡauna latanai helaina ai, adavana ese ena gwaukau e siaia lao dekena ai, eto, Una kara maoromaoro tauna enai ḡau ta basio karaia, badina be hari dina ai vada na nihi, egu nihi ai hisi badana ese e hadikagu ia dainai.
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

motu: A hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua tau-badadia ese aru taudia lalodia e ani, Baraba iruhana bona Iesu iala-masena bae gwaurai.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

motu: Bena gavana ese ma e nanadaidia, eto, Idia raruosi daika baina ruhaia umui emui? ldia eto, Baraba.
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" *, “Barabbas!”

motu: Bena Pilato ma e nanadaidia, eto, O Iesu, Keriso e nemaia, na ede baina tomaia? Idia iboudiai e haere bou, eto, Ba hasatauroa.
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They|strong="G3588" * all|strong="G3956" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G3004" * him|strong="G3588" *, “ Let|strong="G3767" * him|strong="G3588" * be|strong="G3956" * crucified|strong="G4717" *!”

motu: Pilato eto, Be, ena dika be dahaka? A idia na e lolo lalo-dika, eto, Ba hasatauroa.
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But|strong="G1161" * they|strong="G1161" * cried|strong="G2896" * out|strong="G2896" * exceedingly|strong="G4057" *, saying|strong="G3004" *, “ Let|strong="G1161" * him|strong="G3588" * be|strong="G3588" * crucified|strong="G4717" *!”

motu: Taunabunai Pilato lalona e parara, ena hereva na basine goada, bona edia heloḡo-heloḡo eha badava; bena ia ese ranu e abia, aru taudia vairadiai imana e huri, eto, Ina kara maoromaoro tauna rarana na dia lau latagu ai; umui sibomui.
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

motu: Idia iboudiai e haere, eto, Ia rarana be ai latamai ai bona natumai latadiai.
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

motu: Bena ia ese Baraba e ruhaia nege, a Iesu e dadabaia, bena e henidia, bae hasatauroa. Iesu e ḡonaḡonalaia
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

motu: Bena gavana ena tuari taudia ese Iesu e hakaua lao, edia gima rumana lalonai, bena edia orea taudia iboudiai e gogodia ia dekenai.
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

motu: Idia ese ena dabua e kokia oho, dabua kakakakana e hakaralaia;
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

motu: bona havava ḡauna ḡiniḡini a e hatua, ia kwarana ai e atoa kau; siriho auta danu imana idibana ai e hakahulaia. Bena tuidia e hadai, e toma henia diho koikoi, eto, Iuda pavapavana e! Ba mauri!
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

motu: Bena e kanudia, bona hari siriho e abihaia, kwarana e botalaia.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

motu: E ḡonaḡonalaia vaitani, bena dabua kakakana e kokia oho, ena dabua korikorina ma e hakaralaia. Bena e hakaua lao, bae hasatauroa. Iesu e hasatauroa
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

motu: E raka lasiva ai, Kurene tauna ta e davaria, ladana na Simona, bena e haduaia, Iesu ena satauro baine huaia.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

motu: Gabu ta ai e lasi, ladana na Golgota; anina be “kwara koukouna tanona”.
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

motu: Unuseni ai vine ranuna muramura ida e buloa na e henia, baine inua; to e demaia toho, inuna se ura.
english: they gave him sour wine + 27:34 or, vinegar * to drink mixed with gall. + 27:34 Gall is a bitter-tasting, dark green oil from a wormwood plant that is alcoholic in its effect. * When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

motu: Bena e hasatauroa; bona mari amo ena dabua e hari.
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots, + 27:35 TR adds “that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet: ‘They divided my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots;’” [see Psalms 22:18 and John 19:24] *

motu: Bena e helai diho, e gima.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

motu: Ia kwarana daenai idia ese hahebade herevana e kapaia, ini e torea toma: INA NA IESU, IUDA PAVAPAVANA.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

motu: Ia ida nega tamona dadidadi taudia rarua e hasataurodia, ta idibana kahana ai, ta laurina kahana ai.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

motu: E raka hanai taudia ese e hereva dika henia, kwaradia e taiko-taiko,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

motu: eto, I! Dubu Helaḡa ba rohoa ma dina toi ai ba larebaia lou taumu, sibomu ba hahemauri. Oi Dirava Natuna o tomamu, satauro amo boma dada dobi.
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona itorena taudia bona hanua tau-badadia ese danu e ḡonaḡonalaia, eto,
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, + 27:41 TR omits “the Pharisees” * and the elders, said,

motu: Ia na idau taudia e hamauridiava, matona sibona se hahemauri. Ia na Israel pavapavana, harihari satauro amo aine dada dobi, bena baita abidadama henia.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

motu: Ia ese Dirava e abidadama heniava; Dirava ese bena lalokau henia, bema hamauria: badina be ia eto “Lau na Dirava Natuna”.
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

motu: Dadidadi taudia raruosi danu, ia ida e hasataurodia taudia, ese unu e ḡonaḡonalaia toma.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

motu: Dina tubua amo dibura ese tanobada idoinai e gorua ahu, ela bona dina e ḡelo.
english: Now from the sixth hour + 27:45 noon * there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour. + 27:45 3:00 p.m. *

motu: Bena dina ḡelona sisivana Iesu e lolo, eto, Eloi, eloi lama sabaktani; anina be Egu Dirava e, egu Dirava e, dahaka lau ome rakatanigu.
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “\+w Eli|strong="G2241"\+w*, \+w Eli|strong="G2241"\+w*, lima * + 27:46 TR reads “lama” instead of “lima” * \+w sabachthani|strong="G4518"\+w*?” * That is, “\+w My|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*, \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*, \+w why|strong="G2444"\+w* \+w have|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w forsaken|strong="G1459"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*?” * + 27:46 Psalms 22:1 *

motu: Unuseni ai e gini taudia haida na e kamonai, bena eto, Ia na Elia e boiriamu.
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

motu: Bena ta e heau lao, puta ta eha abia, vine ranuna iditana ai e urua diho, siriho ai e gwadaia kau, bena e duduia dae, baine topoa eto.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

motu: A haida be eto, Mani do: aita itaia, Elia bainema baine hamauria eiava.
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

motu: A Iesu ma e lolo dagu, bena e mase.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

motu: Una negana ai Dubu Helaḡa seseahuna e hedare parara, atai amo ema bona henu. Tano danu e laga, papapapa e parara;
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

motu: bona mase garadia e hekeho, helaḡa taudia hutuma na e tore isi.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

motu: Bena ena tore-isi-lou murinai idia na gara amo e raka lasi, hanua helaḡana ela, unuseni ai hutuma ese e itadia.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

motu: Tuari biaguna mai bamona ida, Iesu e gimaia taudia, ese tano-laga bona e vara ḡaudia e ita, bena e gari bada, eto, Momokani, ina na Dirava Natuna.
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

motu: Herarai hahinedia diaḡau danu dauhai e gini; Galilea amo Iesu murinai e rakava bona isiaina e lao heniva hahinedia bunu.
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

motu: Haida bini: Maria, hane Magdala; bona Maria, Iakobo bona Iosef sinadia; bona Sebedeo natuna sinadia. Iesu e guria
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

motu: Adorahi ai, taḡa tauna ta, ladama Iosef, Arimatea amo e kau; ia danu Iesu ena hahediba ta.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

motu: Ia na Pilato dekena ela, e noia, Iesu tau-anina baine abia eto, bena Pilato na e hahedua bae henia.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

motu: Taunabunai, Iosef ese tau-anina e abia dobi, dabua ḡoevaḡoevana ai e kumia,
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

motu: nadi hagana ai e ḡeia kohuana matamatana ta, ia sibona ena, lalonai e atoa; nadi badana amo kohua iduarana e kurea ahu, bena e raka oho.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

motu: A hahine rarua, Maria, hane Magdala, bona Maria ta, be kohua vairanai e helaiva.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

motu: Daba ai, haheḡoeva dinana murina dinana ai, hahelaḡa taudia bona Farisea taudia Pilato vairanai e hebou,
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

motu: eto, Ḡaubada e, ai na ame helalo une, una koikoi tauna be maurina ai e hereva, eto “Dina toi bae ore, bena lau ma baina tore isi lou”.
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

motu: Taunabunai, mani ba hahedua, gara bae gimaia namonamo ela bona dina ihatoina; ena hahediba baela, tau-anina bae henaoa, bena taunimanina bae koidia, baeto “Ia na mase amo vada e tore isi lou”, na garina. Unu bema heto, koikoi gabena ese koikoi gunana bema hereaia.
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

motu: Pilato eto, Be, umui na mai emui hegima taudia; vada aola, gara ba ha koua, emui goada heḡereḡerena.
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

motu: Bena idia na ela, gara eha koua kunuka-kunuka, toa ta nadi ai e atoa, bena kito taudia e habadinalaidia. Iesu e tore isi lou
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

motu: Dina Helaḡa e ore murinai, daba matana ai, pura dinana gini-gunana ai, Maria, hane Magdala, Maria ta ida, gara itana ela.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

motu: Una negana ai tano vada e laga bada; badina be Lohiabada ena aneru na guba amo e diho, nadi e kurea oho, bena latanai e halai kau.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

motu: Ia vairana e diari-diari, kevaru na heto; ena dabua danu kuroka-kuroka, snow na heto.
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

motu: Ia garina e gari dainai hegima taudia na e heude-heude, mase taudia heḡereḡeredia ai ela.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

motu: A aneru ese hahine e hereva henidia, eto, Asio gari; dibagu umui na Iesu, e hasatauroa tauna, o tahuamu.
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

motu: Ia na dia iniseni ai; vada e tore isi, e hamaoromui heḡereḡerena. Vada aoma; e atoa gabuna mani a itaia.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

motu: Bena baola haraḡa-haraḡa, ena hahediba ba hamaorodia, ia na mase amo vada e tore isi, bona baine gunalaimui Galilea ai; inuseni ai ba itaia.
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

motu: Bena raruosi ese gara e rakatania haraḡa-haraḡa, mai garidia bona mai moaledia ida, ena hahediba ihadibadia totona e heau ela.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

motu: A dala ai Iesu na idia ida e hedavari, e hereva henidia, eto, Ba mauri! Bena raruosi e raka kahira, aena ai e rosia tao, e toma henia diho.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “\+w Rejoice|strong="G5463"\+w*!” * They|strong="G2532" * came|strong="G4334" * and|strong="G2532" * took|strong="G2902" * hold|strong="G2902" * of|strong="G2532" * his|strong="G3708" * feet|strong="G4228" *, and|strong="G2532" * worshiped|strong="G4352" * him|strong="G3588" *.

motu: Bena Iesu eto, Asio gari; vadi aola, varavaragu ba hamaorodia, idia na Galilea baela, unuseni ai bae itagu.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w afraid|strong="G5399"\+w*. \+w Go|strong="G5217"\+w* \+w tell|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w my|strong="G3708"\+w* brothers * + 28:10 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w should|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w go|strong="G5217"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w Galilee|strong="G1056"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w there|strong="G1563"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w see|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*.” *

motu: Raruosi na e laova ai, hegima taudia haida danu hanua ela, e vara ḡaudia iboudiai na hahelaḡa taudia e hamaorolaidia.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

motu: Bena idia na hanua tau-badadia ida e henega bou, hegima taudia moni diaḡau e henidia,
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

motu: eto, Baoto “Ena hahediba na hanuaboi ema, mahutamai ai eme henaoa”.
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

motu: A ina sivarai gavana ese baine kamonaia, ai ese lalona baia hamarumarua, bena basine hadikamui.
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese moni e abia, bena e hadibadibadia heḡereḡerena e hereva. Ina sivarai be Iuda taudia ese vada e hapiua ema bona harihari danu.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

motu: Lau ese ranu amo na bapatisomuimu, a ia ese Lauma Helaḡa arno baine bapatisomui. Iesu e bapatisoa

english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

motu: Una negana ai Lauma ese tano ḡaḡaena e siaia lao.

english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

motu: Bena ia ela, imana e abia, e hahelaia tore; bena ena gorere e doko, e tore isi, idia isiaidia e lao heni.

english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

motu: A ireḡudia taudia na e heau, hanua lalonai bona uma gabudia ai harina e piua. Bena taunimanima e aru ela, e vara ḡauna bae itaia eto.

english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

motu: A Iesu ese una hereva e dadaraia, bona dubu biaguna e hereva henia, eto, Asio gari, bavabidadama henigu.

english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

motu: Dubu biaguna ena ruma ai e kau, taunimanima e itadia, e helogoheloḡova, e tai lolova.
english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

motu: Bena ia ese etamanudia, sivarai basie piua eto. Bona e hamaorodia, kekeni ana bae henia.
english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

motu: Unu amo e tore isi, ena hahediba ida ena hanua korikori ela.
english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

motu: Dina Helaḡa ai ia ese dubu ai ma e hadibadia matama; bena e kamonai taudia iboudiai e hoa, eto, Ina tau na ini ḡau ede amo e abi? Ena aonega danu daika ese e henia? Bona ini siahu karadia ia imana amo e karamu na edeheto?
english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

motu: Ia na dia kamuta tauna natuna a? Ia na dia Maria natuna, lakobo bona losef bona Iuda bona Simona kakadia a? Ia taihuna danu padadai dia nonoho a? Bena lalodia na e hekwakwanai ia dainai.
english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

motu: Ia na e hoa bada, badina be idia na asi edia abidadama. Gabeamo ia ese hanua maraḡidia ai e loaloava, e hahedibava. Iesu ese ena aposetolo e siaidia
