motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna badana ese sibona ena dabua e darea, e lolo, eto, Dahaka hahebadena ta tahuamu a?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

motu: Dirava ihadikana herevana vada ome kamonai. Dahaka o tomamu? Idia iboudiai e revaia, eto, Aine mase.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

motu: Bena haida ese e kanudia, ma haida ese matana e kou ahu bona e tutua, eto, Daika ese? Edia hesiai taudia ese danu imadia amo e pataia. Petro hatoi e heḡore
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

motu: Petro be tano ai, maḡu lalonai: bena hahelaḡa tauna badana ena hesiai hahinena ta ela,
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

motu: Petro lahi ai e heganava ai e itaia; bena e raraia, eto, Oi danu Iesu, Nasaret tauna, o bamoava.
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

motu: To ia na e heḡore, eto, Lau na asi dibagu; emu hereva na lalogu seme parara. E raka oho, ikoukou badibadinai, bena kokoroku e tai.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

motu: Hari hahine ese ma e itaia lou, bena dekedekena taudia e hamaorodia, eto, O ta be ena ia.
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

motu: Ia na ma e heḡore lou. Asi vanahana, Petro badibadinai e gini taudia ese ma e habadea, eto, Oi danu idia ta, badina be oi danu tau Galilea.
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

motu: Bena ia na e ere dika, e gwau tora, eto, Umui o gwauraiamu tauna na lau asi dibagu.
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

motu: Bena kokoroku ma e tai lou. Bena Petro ese Iesu ena hereva e helalolaia une, eto “Kokoroku do basine tai harua, oi hatoi ba ḡoregu”. Bena e tai dikadika.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “\+w Before|strong="G4250"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* rooster \+w crows|strong="G5455"\+w* \+w twice|strong="G1364"\+w*, \+w you|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w deny|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w three|strong="G5151"\+w* \+w times|strong="G5151"\+w*.” * When he thought about that, he wept.

motu: Daba vaburana ai, hahelaḡa taudia ese hanua tau-badadia bona itorena taudia ida e henega, bena idia, kaunsil taudia iboudiai ida, Iesu e ḡuia, e hakaua lao, Pilato e henia.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

motu: Bena Pilato ese e nanadaia, eto, Oi na Iuda taudia edia pavapava a? Iesu eto, O ena vada o gwaumu.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He|strong="G2532" * answered|strong="G3004" *, “\+w So|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w say|strong="G3004"\+w*.” *

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia ese hereva diaḡau e habadelaia.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

motu: Pilato ese ma e nanadaia lou, eto, Oi na to haeremu a? Oi dibamu hereva idau-idau amo e habadelaimumu.
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

motu: To Iesu se haere; taunabunai Pilato e hoa.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

motu: Pilato vaia ena kara una aria negana ai, dibura rumana ai e nohova tauna ta, idia ese bae gwauraia tauna, baine ruhaia nege.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

motu: Una negana ai tau ta dibura rumana ai e nohova, ladana na Baraba; ia na haida ida e heatu, bena una heatu lalonai haida e aladia mase.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

motu: Bena aru taudia ese Pilato e noia, vaia ena kara ma baine karaia.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

motu: Pilato ese e nanadaidia, eto, O uramu Iuda taumui emui pavapava baina ruhaia nege a?
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

motu: Badina be ia dibana hahelaḡa taudia ese e vaḡeḡe hellia dainai taona e torea.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

motu: A hahelaḡa taudia ese aru taudia lalodia e ani, eto, Aogwa “Lasi, Baraba hari ba ruhaia nege”.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

motu: Bena Pilato ese ma e nanadaidia, eto, O, ina Iuda taumui emui pavapava o tomamu na ede baina tomaia?
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

motu: Idia na e lolo, eto, Ba hasatauroa.
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

motu: Pilato eto, Be, ena dika be dahaka? A idia ma e lolo lalo-dika, eto, Ba hasatauroa.
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But|strong="G1161" * they|strong="G1161" * cried|strong="G2896" * out|strong="G2896" * exceedingly|strong="G4057" *, “ Crucify|strong="G4717" * him|strong="G3588" *!”

motu: Taunabunai, Pilato na aru taudia ihamarumarudia urana e urava dainai, ia ese Baraba e ruhaia nege, a Iesu na e dadabaia, bena e henidia, bae hasatauroa. Iesu e ḡonaḡonalaia
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

motu: Tuari taudia ese e hakaua lao, edia gima rumana ikoukouna ai, bena edia orea taudia iboudiai e gogodia.
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

motu: Dabua kakakakana e hakaralaia, bena havava ḡauna ginigini a e hatua, ia kwarana ai e atoa kau.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

motu: Bena e hanamoa matama, eto, Iuda pavapavana e! Ba mauri!
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

motu: Bena siriho amo kwarana e botaia, e kanudia; bona tuidia e hadai, e toma henia diho koikoi.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

motu: E ḡonaḡonalaia vaitani, bena dabua kakakakana e kokia oho, ena dabua korikorina ma e hakaralaia, e hakaua lasi, bae hasatauroa. Iesu e hasatauroa
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

motu: Kurene tauna ta, ladana Simona, Alesana bona Rufo tamadia, gunika amo e lasi; bena idia ese e haduaia, Iesu ena satauro baine huaia.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

motu: Bena e hakaua lao, gabu ta ladana Golgota; anina be “kwara koukouna tanona”.
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

motu: Idia ese vine ranuna hisi ihamaraḡina muramurana ida e bulo hebou, e henia, to se inua.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

motu: Bena e hasatauroa; bona ena dabua e hari, mari ai ta ta ahudia e abi.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

motu: Dina e taolara sisivana e hasatauroa.
english: It was the third hour + 15:25 9:00 a.m. * when they crucified him.

motu: Hahebade herevana ia daellai ini e torea toma: IUDA TAUDIA EDIA PAVAPAVA.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

motu: Ia ida nega tamona dadidadi taudia rarua e hasataurodia, ta idibana kahana ai, ma ta laurina kahana ai.
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

motu: Unu amo gunaguna e torea herevana vada e momokani, eto, Kara havara-havara taudia ida e duahia hebou.
english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.” + 15:28 NU omits verse 28. *

motu: E raka hanai taudia ese e hereva dika henia, kwaradia e taiko-taiko, eto, I! Dubu Helaḡa ba rohoa ma dina toi ai ba larebaia lou oto taumu,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

motu: satauro amo a dada dobi, sibomu ba hahemauri.
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona itorena taudia ese danu ma e ḡonaḡonalaia, e hereva heheni, eto, Ia ese idau taudia e hamauridiava, matona sibona se hahemauri.
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

motu: Hari Keriso, Israel pavapavana, mani satauro amo aine dada dobi; baita itaia, bena baita abidadama henia. Ia ida e hasataurodia hebou taudia raruosi danu ia e ḡonaḡonalaia.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” + 15:32 TR omits “him” * Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

motu: Dina tubua ela bona dina ḡelona tanobada na dibura ese e goru ahu.
english: When the sixth hour + 15:33 or, noon * had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour. + 15:33 3:00 p.m. *

motu: Dina ḡelona ai Iesu e lolo, eto, Eloi, eloi, lama sabaktani; anina be Egu Dirava e, egu Dirava e, dahaka dainai vada o rakatanigu.
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “\+w Eloi|strong="G1682"\+w*, \+w Eloi|strong="G1682"\+w*, \+w lama|strong="G2982"\+w* \+w sabachthani|strong="G4518"\+w*?” * which is, being interpreted, “\+w My|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*, \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*, \+w why|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w forsaken|strong="G1459"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*?” * + 15:34 Psalms 22:1 *

motu: Badibadinai e gini taudia haida e kamonai, eto, Ia na Elia e boiriamu.
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

motu: Bena tau ta e heau, puta ta vine ranuna iditana ai e urua diho, siriho ai e gwadaia kau, bena e duduia dae, baine topoa eiava. Eto, Mani do: aita itaia, Elia bainema baine abia dobi eiava.
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

motu: A Iesu ma e lolo dagu, bena vada e mase.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

motu: Una negana ai Dubu Helaḡa seseahuna e hedare parara, atai amo ema bona henu.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

motu: Tuari biaguna ta badibadinai e gini, e itaia unu e mase toma, bena eto, Momokani, ina na Dirava Natuna.
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

motu: Herarai hahinedia haida danu dauhai e gini. Haida bini: Maria, hane Magdala; bona Maria, Iakobo maraḡina bona Iosef sinadia; bona Salome.
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

motu: Idia iboudiai Galilea ai ia murinai e rakava bona isiaina e lao heniva. Bona ia ida Ierusalem e dara dae hahinedia haida danu. Iesu e ḡuria
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

motu: Adorahi ai, badina be haheḡoeva dinana bunai, kerukeru be Dina Helaḡa,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

motu: Iosef, Arimatea tauna, kaunsil tauna ta mai harina namona bona Dirava ena basileia e nariava tauna, na Pilato dekena ela, e noia goadagoada, Iesu tau-anina baine abia eto.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

motu: Pilato e hoa dikadika, badina be Iesu vada e mase haraḡa; bena tuari biaguna e boiria, Iesu ena mase negana e nanadailaia.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

motu: Tuari biaguna ese e hamaoroa ḡoeva, bena tau-anina Iosef e henia.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

motu: Iosef ese dabua aukana e hoia; bena Iesu e abia dobi, dabua ai e kumia, nadi hagana ai e ḡeia kohuana lalonai e atoa vareai; bena nadi badana amo iduara e kurea ahu.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

motu: Maria, hane Magdala, bona Maria, Iosef sinana, raruosi ese e atoa gabuna e itaia kau.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

motu: Dina Helaḡa e ore ai, Maria, hane Magdala, bona Maria, Iakobo sinana, bona Salome, tatoiosi muramura mai bonadia e hoi, ia idahulaina.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

motu: Pura dinana gini-gunana ai, daba galuma-galumana ai, idia na gara ela.
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

motu: Sibodia e hereva heheni, eto, Daika ese gara ikoulaina nadina baine kurea oho?
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

motu: Bena e roha isi, nadi na dauhai heatona ai e itaia. Una nadi na bada herea.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

motu: Idia na gara lalonai e raka vareai, bena eregabe ta e itaia, idiba kahana ai e helai, ena dabua na kurokuro bona ḡaulatalata. Hahine na vada e gari.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

motu: A ia ese a hamaorodia, eto, Asio gari: umui na Iesu, Nasaret tauna, e hasatauroa tauna, o tahuamu. Ia na vada e tore isi: ia na dia iniseni ai. E atoa gabuna mani a itaia.
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

motu: Vada aola, ena hahediba bona Petro ba hamaorodia, baoto “Ia ese baine gunalaimui Galilea ai; unuseni ai ba itaia, e hamaoromui heḡereḡerena”.
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

motu: Bena idia na e raka lasi, gara e heautania, badina be taudia e heude-heude bona laumadia e daure. Bena hereva na tau ta asie hamaoroa, badina be e gari.
english: They went out, + 16:8 TR adds “quickly” * and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid. + 16:8 One isolated manuscript omits verses 9-20 but adds this “short ending of Mark” to the end of verse 8: They told all that had been commanded them briefly to those around Peter. After that, Jesus himself sent them out, from east to west, with the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation. *

motu: Pura dinana gini-gunana ai, daba matana ai, Iesu e tore isi; bena Maria, hane Magdala, enai e hedinarai guna. Una na lauma dikadia hahitu ena amo e halasidia hahinena.
english: + 16:9 NU includes the text of verses 9-20, but mentions in a footnote that a few manuscripts omitted it. The translators of the World English Bible regard Mark 16:9-20 as reliable based on an overwhelming majority of textual evidence, including not only the authoritative Greek Majority Text New Testament, but also the TR and many of the manuscripts cited in the NU text. *Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

motu: Ia na vada ela, Iesu bamona edia kudouhetaha bona edia taitai lalonai e hamaorodia.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

motu: Idia na e kamonai, vada e mauri bona Maria ese vada e itaia, to ena hereva asie abia dae.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

motu: Gabeamo idia rarua gunika ela, bena idia vairadiai e hedinarai, to oromana na e idau.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

motu: Bena raruosi ela, bamodia e hamaorodia, to edia hereva asie abia dae.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

motu: Ma nega ta gwauta-taosi anianidia ai ediai e hedinarai; bena e gwau henidia, edia gwau-edeede bona edia lalo-duhu daidiai; badina be ena tore-isi ai e itaia taudia asie kamonai henidia.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

motu: E hamaorodia, eto, Baola, tanobada idoinai sivarai namo taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai ba harorolaia.
english: He said to them, “\+w Go|strong="G4198"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w all|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w world|strong="G2889"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w preach|strong="G2784"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Good|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w News|strong="G2098"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w whole|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w creation|strong="G2937"\+w*. *

motu: Baine kamonai, bona ba bapatisoa tauna na do baine mauri; a basine kamonai tauna na do bae revaia.
english: \+w He|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w believes|strong="G4100"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* baptized \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w saved|strong="G4982"\+w*; \+w but|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* disbelieves \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w condemned|strong="G2632"\+w*. *

motu: Bae kamonai taudia na ini toa bae kara: lauma dikadia lau ladagu ai bae luludia lasi; gado matamatadia ai bae hereva;
english: \+w These|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w signs|strong="G4592"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w accompany|strong="G3877"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w believe|strong="G4100"\+w*: \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w* \+w they|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w cast|strong="G1544"\+w* \+w out|strong="G1544"\+w* \+w demons|strong="G1140"\+w*; \+w they|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w speak|strong="G2980"\+w* \+w with|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w new|strong="G2537"\+w* \+w languages|strong="G1100"\+w*; *

motu: gaigai dikadia bae abi isi; mase muramurana bae inua to basie mase; imadia na gorere taudia latadiai bae dau kau, bena bae mauri.
english: \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w take|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w up|strong="G3361"\+w* \+w serpents|strong="G3789"\+w*; \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w if|strong="G2579"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w drink|strong="G4095"\+w* \+w any|strong="G5100"\+w* \+w deadly|strong="G2286"\+w* \+w thing|strong="G5100"\+w*, \+w it|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w no|strong="G3756"\+w* \+w way|strong="G5100"\+w* hurt \+w them|strong="G1438"\+w*; \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w lay|strong="G2007"\+w* \+w hands|strong="G5495"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* sick, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w recover|strong="G2192"\+w*.” *

motu: Lohiabada Iesu ese e hereva hellidia vaitani, bena guba ai vada e heabi dae, Dirava idibana kahana ai e helai diho.
english: So then the Lord, + 16:19 NU adds “Jesus” * after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

motu: A idia na vada ela, tanobada heḡege-madai e harorova; Lohiabada danu idia ida e gaukara hebouva, bona hoa karadia amo edia hereva e hamomokaniva.
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

motu: Lohia taumu Teofilo e: hutuma ese ta abi dae herevadia vada e tore,
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

motu: matadia amo e ita bona matamana amo e harorolai taudia ese e henidava heḡereḡerena;
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

motu: taunabunai lau danu hereva iboudiai vada na tahu ḡoevaḡoeva, matamana amo, bena na tomamu namona binai, lau ma baina tore lou oiemu.
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

motu: Vada ba diba, e hadibamuiva herevadia be momomo-kakani. Sakaria bona Elisabeta
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

motu: Herod ese Iudea e lohiaiava negana ai, hahelaḡa tauna ta e nohova, ladana na Sakaria, Abia ena orea tauna. Adavana be Aaron ena iduhu hahinena, ladana na Elisabeta.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

motu: Idia raruosi na kara maoromaoro taudia Dirava vairanai, Lohiabada ena taravatu bona ena haheḡani iboudiai e badinava, asi toutoudia.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

motu: A raruosi na asi natudia, Elisabeta e gabani dainai, bona raruosi vada e buruka.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

motu: Sakaria ese hahelaḡa karadia e karava Dirava vairanai, ena orea taudia edia nega ai.
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

motu: Bena edia kara heḡereḡerena ai ia vada e abia hidi, gabu helaḡana lalonai muramura mai bonana baine gabua; taunabunai ia na e raka vareai muramura igabuna totona,
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

motu: a taunimanima iboudiai na murimuri ai e noho, e ḡuriḡuri.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

motu: Una negana ai, ia ese Lohiabada ena aneru ta e itaia, muramura mai bonana patana idibana kahana ai e gini.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

motu: Sakaria ese e itaia, bena kudouna e hetaha, bona gari ese e butua tao.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

motu: A aneru ese e hereva henia, eto, Sakaria, asio gari, badina be emu ḡuriḡuri vada e kamonai, adavamu Elisabeta ese natumu ta do baine abia, ladana ba hatoa IOANE.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

motu: Ba moale, ba moale hisi dae, hutuma danu ia baine vara dainai bae moale.
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

motu: Badina be Lohiabada vairanai ia na baine herea; ia ese vine ranuna bona kekero muramuradia basine inu, bona dounu sinana bogana ai na Lauma Helaga ese baine rohea.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

motu: Ia ese Israel memerodia hutuma baine hakerehaidia, Lohiabada, edia Dirava, bae lou henia;
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

motu: bona Lohiabada vairanai baine raka, Elia ena kara bona ena siahu heḡereḡerena. Tamadia lalodia natudia laloda ida baine hatamonadia; gwau-edeede taudia aonega baine henidia, kara maoromaoro taudia ai baela; bona bese ta baine abia heḡaeḡae, Lohiabada ena.
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ + 1:17 Malachi 4:6 * and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

motu: Sakaria ese hari aneru e hamaoroa, eto, Ina na ede baina diba toma? Lau na iahu; adavagu danu vada e buruka.
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

motu: Aneru e helada hato, eto, Lau na Gabriel, Dirava vairanai na gini; ihereva-henimu bona ina harina namona ihamaorolaimu totona e siaigu.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

motu: Benaini, vada ba mu, basio hereva diba, ela bona ina hereva anina baine vara dinana, badina be egu hereva na tome abia dae; to, ena nega korikori ai do baine momokani.
english: Behold, + 1:20 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

motu: Taunimanima ese Sakaria e naria mase, bena e hoa, badina be gabu helaḡana ai e halahe.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

motu: Bena e raka lasi ai na asi hereva dibana. Bena lalodia e parara, ia na gabu helaḡana ai vada e mata hanai. Bena ia ese toa amo e hadibadia, vada e mu.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

motu: Ena ḡaukara dinadia e haḡuḡuru, bena ena ruma korikori ela.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

motu: Gabeamo, ia adavana Elisabeta vada e rogorogo, bena hua ima e noho hehuni;
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

motu: eto, Lohiabada ese ini vada e karagu toma, ena ura negana vada eme haḡeregu, egu hemarai taunimanima vairadiai vada eme abia oho. Maria
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

motu: Hua ihatauratoina, Dirava ese aneru ladana Gabriel e siaia, Galilea hanuana ta ladana Nasaret ela.
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

motu: Haneulato ta be unuseni ai, ia na David ena iduhu tauna ta, ladana losef, maohenina; haneulato ladana be Maria.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

motu: Aneru na ia dekenai e raka vareai, eto, Ba mauri, e lalokau henimumu hahinemu! Lohiabada ese baine bamomu.
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

motu: Una hereva dainai ia na kudouna e hetaha, bona lalona e haguhi, una hahenamo anina be dahaka.
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

motu: A aneru ese e hamaoroa, eto, Maria e, asio gari, badina be Dirava ena harihari ome abia.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

motu: Oi na do ba rogorogo, mero ta bavabia, ladana ba hatoa IESU.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

motu: Ia na baine herea dae, Herea Mikamika Natuna bae gwauraia; Lohiabada Dirava ese tamana David ena terono na baine henia;
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

motu: Iakob ena iduhu baine halohiaia hanaihanai; ena basileia na basine doko.
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

motu: Maria ese aneru e hamaoroa, eto, Lau na tau asi dibagu, ina be ede baine vara toma?
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

motu: Bena aneru na e haere, eto, Lauma Helaḡa na latamu ai baine diho, bona Herea Mikamika ena siahu ese baine hakerukerumu; bena oiemu amo baine vara merona helaḡana na Dirava Natuna bae gwauraia.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

motu: Ba diba danu, oi varavaramu Elisabeta na burukana ai vada e rogorogo; gabani e gwauraia, to ena hua ihatauratoina binai.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

motu: Badina be Dirava na ḡau iboudiai ikaradia mai dibana.
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.” + 1:37 or, “For everything spoken by God is possible.” *

motu: Maria eto, Lau na Lohiabada ena hesiai hahinegu; emu hereva heḡereḡerena ai egu ai baine vara. Bena aneru na iena amo e raka oho. Maria Elisabeta ida
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * angel departed from|strong="G2532" * her|strong="G3708" *.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Maria e tore isi, e raka haraḡa Iuda ororodia hanuana ta ela,
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

motu: Sakaria ena ruma ai e dae Elisabeta e hanamoa.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

motu: Elisabeta ese Maria ena hahenamo herevana e kamonai negana ai na natuna na bogana ai vada e marere; bona Elisabeta na Lauma Helaḡa ese a rohea.
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

motu: Bena e hereva badabada, eto, Hahine iboudiai bogaragidiai oi mo sibomu namo herea, bona bogamu anina danu namo herea.
english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

motu: Egu namo be dahaka bena egu Lohiabada sinana dekegu vada ema?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

motu: Badina be emu hahenamo mamina na taiagu ai e vareai negana ai na natugu na bogagu ai e marere, moale dainai.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

motu: Abidadama hahinemu, vada o namo; badina be Lohiabada ena amo o kamonai herevadia do bae momokani. Maria ena moale anena
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

motu: Bena Maria eto, Lau lalogu ese Lohiabada eme imodaia,
english: Mary said, “ My|strong="G1473" * soul|strong="G5590" * magnifies the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *.

motu: Bona laumagu ese danu ihamaurigu Diravana eme moalelaia;
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

motu: Badina be ia ese ena hesiai hahinena ogoḡamina e haḡerea, Taunabunai ini amo uru iboudiai ese bae hanamogu;
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For|strong="G1063" * behold|strong="G2400" *, from|strong="G3588" * now|strong="G3568" * on|strong="G1909" *, all|strong="G3956" * generations|strong="G1074" * will|strong="G1473" * call|strong="G3106" * me|strong="G1473" * blessed|strong="G3106" *.

motu: Badina be Siahu Diravana ese hoa karadia egu ai eme havara; Ia Iadana na Helaḡa.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is|strong="G3588" * his|strong="G4160" * name|strong="G3686" *.

motu: Ena hebogahisi na uru uru idoidiai Ia garina e garimu taudia latadiai.
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

motu: Ia imana ese ena goada vada e hahedinaraia: Lalodia e hekokoroku taudia ia ese e hakarohodia,
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He|strong="G4160" * has scattered|strong="G1287" * the|strong="G1722" * proud|strong="G5244" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * imagination|strong="G1271" * of|strong="G1722" * their|strong="G1722" * hearts|strong="G2588" *.

motu: Bona Iohia na edia helai ḡaudia amo ia ese vada e dolidia dobi, A ogoḡami taudia ia ese vada e abidia isi;
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and|strong="G2532" * has|strong="G2532" * exalted|strong="G5312" * the|strong="G2532" * lowly|strong="G5011" *.

motu: Hitolo taudia ia ese ḡau namodia amo bogadia vada e hakunu, A taḡa taudia ia ese ima kavakavadia e haloudia.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He|strong="G2532" * has|strong="G2532" * sent|strong="G1821" * the|strong="G2532" * rich|strong="G4147" * away|strong="G1821" * empty|strong="G2756" *.

motu: Ena hesiai besena Israel ia ese vada e kahaia, Ena hebogahisi vada e helalolaia une,
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

motu: Seneda e gwau henidia hamata heḡereḡerena, Abraham mai garana ida do baine bogadia hisi hanaihanai eto.
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to|strong="G1519" * Abraham and|strong="G2532" * his|strong="G1519" * offspring + 1:55 or, seed * forever|strong="G1519" *.”

motu: Bena Maria na Elisabeta ida e nohova hua toi, gabeamo ena ruma e lou henia. Elisabeta e mara
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

motu: Elisabeta ena mara neganla e gini dae, mero ta vada e abia.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

motu: Bena dekena taudia bona varavarana ese Lohiabada ena harihari-bada ienai vada e vara harina e kamonai, idia na ia ida e moale hebou.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, idia na mero iperitomena totona e hebou, bena ladana bae hatoa Sakaria, tamana baine nemaia eto.
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

motu: To sinana e haere, eto, Lasi, ia ladana na Ioane.
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

motu: Idia eto, Be, una na emu iduhu tauna ta ladana a?
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

motu: Bena idia ese tamana matadia ai e kunumaia, mero ladana ede bae hatoa toma.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

motu: Ia ese toretore ḡauna ta e gwauraia, bena ini e torea toma: ia ladana be Ioane.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They|strong="G2532" * all|strong="G3956" * marveled|strong="G2296" *.

motu: Una negana ai uduna e haḡaia, malana danu e maoro, bena e hereva, Dirava e imodaia.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

motu: Taunabunai, dekedia taudia iboudiai na gari ese e butudia tao; bona unu kara haridia na Iudea ororodia hanuadia iboudiai lalodiai vada e piua.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

motu: Bena e kamonai taudia iboudiai e lalo tao; eto, Ina mero na ede baine heto? Badina be Lohiabada imana na ia latanai. Sakaria ena moale anena
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

motu: Lauma Helaḡa ese mero tamana Sakaria e rohea, bena e haroro, eto,
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

motu: Lohiabada, Israel ena Dirava, aita hanamoa, Badina be ia ese ena bese taudia vada e vadivadidia bona vada e hamauridia.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for|strong="G3754" * he|strong="G2532" * has|strong="G2316" * visited|strong="G1980" * and|strong="G2532" * redeemed|strong="G3085" * his|strong="G4160" * people|strong="G2992" *;

motu: Hahemauri badina ia ese vada e havaraia ita eda, Ena hesiai tauna David ena iduhu amo,
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

motu: Ena peroveta taudia helaḡadia ududia amo e gwaurai herevadia na heto, Tanobada matamana amo ema hari;
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

motu: Inaida bona e badu henidamu taudia imadia amo Ia ese baine hamaurida.
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

motu: Tubuda tamada e bogadia hisi; Ena gwauhamata helaḡana e laloa tao;
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to|strong="G2532" * remember|strong="G3403" * his|strong="G4160" * holy covenant|strong="G1242" *,

motu: Ita seneda Abraham e gwau henia hamata,
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

motu: Ita inaida amo baine hamaurida eto, Bena isiaina baita lao henia, asi eda gari,
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve|strong="G3000" * him|strong="G3000" * without|strong="G1537" * fear,

motu: Mai helaḡada bona mai maoromaoroda ida ia vairanai baita raka, Eda mauri dinadia iboudiai.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

motu: Natugu e, oi danu Herea Mikamika ena peroveta tauna bae gwauraimu, Badina be oi na Lohiabada vairanai do ba raka, Ena dala ba lailaia.
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for|strong="G1063" * you|strong="G4771" * will|strong="G2532" * go|strong="G4313" * before|strong="G1799" * the|strong="G2532" * face|strong="G4383" * of|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" * to|strong="G2532" * prepare|strong="G2090" * his|strong="G2532" * ways|strong="G3598" *,

motu: Mauri dalana oi ese ena bese ba hadibalaidia, Edia dika igwau-taodia,
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

motu: Iseda Dirava ena hebogahisi dainai, Daba e rotoa na heto, atai amo bainema, baine igoda ita;
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by|strong="G1223" * which|strong="G3739" * the|strong="G1722" * dawn from|strong="G1537" * on|strong="G1722" * high|strong="G5311" * will|strong="G2316" * visit|strong="G1980" * us|strong="G2249" *,

motu: Dibura ai bona mase laulauna ai e nohomu taudia baine hadiaridia, Bona ita aeda maino dalana ai baine hakaudia.
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to|strong="G1519" * guide|strong="G2720" * our|strong="G2532" * feet|strong="G4228" * into|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G1722" * way|strong="G3598" * of|strong="G2532" * peace|strong="G1515" *.”

motu: Bena hari mero na e bada oho bada oho, bona lalona e goada; bona tano ḡaḡaena ai e nohova ema bona Israel ediai e hedinarai dinana.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

motu: Unu dinadia ai Kaisara Augusto ese ena haheḡani herevana ta e siaia lao, tanobada taudia iboudiai ladadia bae tore:
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

motu: lada itoredia gini-gunana binai, Kurenio ese Suria e lohiaia negana ai.
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

motu: Taunabunai, taunimanima iboudiai ese ladadia itoredia totona ena hanua ena hanua e lou heni.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

motu: Iosef danu Nasaret, Galilea kahana hanuana ta, amo ela, David ena hanua ladana Betelehem, Iudea kahana ai, e lasi, badina be ia na David ena iduhu tauna;
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

motu: unuseni ai ladana baine torea. Ia maohenina danu, Maria, ia ida ela; ia na vada e rogorogo.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

motu: Bena raruosi unuseni ai e nohova ai na ena mara dinana e kau.
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

motu: Ia na e mara, mero roboana e abia, dabua amo e tarua, bena boromakau edia aniani patana ai e kurea, badina be henitao rumana lalonai asi gabuna.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

motu: Mamoe ireḡudia taudia haida vahu ai e nohova, hanuaboi ai edia seri e gimadiava.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

motu: Bena Lohiabada ena aneru ta ela, dekedekediai e gini, bona Lohiabada diaridiarina ese e hadiaridia heḡeḡe; bena gari bada ese e butudia tao.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

motu: To aneru ese e hamaorodia, eto, Asio gari; hereva namona lau ese vada na mailaia, taunimanima iboudiai ihamoaledia.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

motu: Badina be ina harihari, David ena hanua ai, emui Hahemauri Tauna vada e vara, Keriso Lohiabada bunai.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ + 2:11 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * the Lord.

motu: Toana binai: mero karukaruna ba ha davaria, boromakau edia ruma patana ai hekure, dabua ai e tarua.
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

motu: Bena guba anerudia hutuma bada hari aneru ida e hedinarai taku, Dirava e hanamoa, eto,
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

motu: Atai doriva-dorivana ai Dirava bae imodaia, Bona tanobada ai na maino, ena lalo-namo taudia ese bae abia.
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on|strong="G1909" * earth|strong="G1093" * peace|strong="G1515" *, good|strong="G2107" * will|strong="G2316" * toward|strong="G1909" * men|strong="G1722" *.”

motu: Aneru loḡora ese e rakatanidia, guba e lou henia, muridiai mamoe ireḡudia taudia e hereva heheni, eto, Ita na Betelehem aitala, Lohiabada ese vada e hadibada ḡauna baita itaia.
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

motu: Bena e raka haraḡa, ela, Maria bona Iosef e davaridia, bona mero karukaruna, boromakau edia aniani patana ai hekure.
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

motu: Mero e itaia, bena e kamonai herevana e gwauraia hedinarai.
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

motu: Bena e kamonai taudia iboudiai ese mamoe ireḡudia taudia edia hereva e hoalaia.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

motu: A Maria na unu hereva iboudiai e haero bona e lalo tao.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

motu: Bena mamoe ireḡudia taudia e lou, Dirava e heatolaia, e imodaia, badina be e kamonai bona e ita ḡaudia na vada e hadibadia heḡereḡerena.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

motu: Dina ihataurahanina ai, mero iperitomena negana ai, idia ese ladana e hatoa IESU, sinana do se rurua negana ai aneru ese e hatoa ladana. Iesu Ierusalem e laohaia
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

motu: Idia ihaḡoevadia dinadia, Mose ena taravatu heḡereḡerena, e ore, bena idia ese Ierusalem e laohaia, Lohiabada vairanai bae hahedinaraia totona;
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

motu: Lohiabada ena taravatu ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Roboa mamaruanedia iboudiai na hehelaḡa, Lohiabada ena.
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”), + 2:23 Exodus 13:2,12 *

motu: Bona boubou ḡauna bae henia eto, Lohiabada ena taravatu heḡereḡerena, kerea rua eiava pune natuna rua.
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.” + 2:24 Leviticus 12:8 *

motu: Tau ta Ierusalem ai, ladana na Simeon; ia na kara maoromaoro tauna bona Dirava garina e gariva tauna; ia ese Israel edia tauhalo tauna e nariava, bona Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohea.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

motu: Lauma Helaḡa ese danu e hamaoroa, ia na basine mase ela bona Lohiabada ena Keriso do baine itaia.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ. + 2:26 “Christ” (Greek) and “Messiah” (Hebrew) both mean “Anointed One” *

motu: Lauma ese Dubu Helaḡa lalonai e hakaua vareai, bena mero maraḡina Iesu na tamana sinana ese e rakalaia vareai, taravatu karana ibadinana totona.
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

motu: Bena ia ese e abia, e rosia, Dirava e hanamoa, eto,
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

motu: Lohiabada e, emu hesiai tauna harihari ome kahugu nege, Mai mainogu ida bainala, emu gwau-hamata heḡereḡerena;
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according|strong="G2596" * to|strong="G2596" * your|strong="G1722" * word|strong="G4487" *, in|strong="G1722" * peace|strong="G1515" *;

motu: Badina be matagu ese emu Hahemauri vada eme itaia,
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

motu: Oi ese vada o seua taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai.
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

motu: Diari na binai, bese idauidau ihadiarilaidia. Bona oiemu bese Israel iheatolaidia.
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * glory|strong="G1391" * of|strong="G2532" * your|strong="G2532" * people|strong="G2992" * Israel|strong="G2474" *.”

motu: Mero tamana sinana ese unu hereva e kamonai, e hoa.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

motu: Bena Simeon ese raruosi e hanamodia; bona sinana Maria e hamaoroa, eto, Ina mero na Israel taudia hutuma ihaketodia bona ihatore-isidia ai bainela; bona ia na toa ta taunimanima ese bae gwaua heiri.
english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

motu: Hutuma edia lalo-hadai hehunidia bae hedinarai; a oi lalomu dare ese baine daia uru.
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

motu: Peroveta hahinena ta danu, ladana na Ana, Fanuel natuna, Asere ena iduhu hahinena: ia na hane badana, e headava, laḡani hitu adavana ida e noho bou,
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

motu: murinai laḡani taurahaniahui hani vabuna ai e nohova. Ia ese Dubu Helaḡa se rakataniava, Dirava e toma henia dihova, e ḡuriḡuriva, e anivagava.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

motu: Una hora ai ia danu e kau, bena Dirava e hanamoa, bona Israel ihamaurina e nariava taudia Ierusalem ai mero herevana e hamaorolaidia. Iesu Nasaret ai e bada oho bada oho
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

motu: Lohiabada ena taravatu karadia iboudiai raruosi ese e haḡuḡuru vaitani, bena Galilea e lou henia, edia hanua korikori Nasaret ela.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

motu: Bena mero na e bada, mai goadana bona mai aonegana ida, bona Dirava ena hariharibada na ia latanai. Mero Iesu na Ierusalem ela
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

motu: Laḡani iboudiai tamana bona sinana Ierusalem e laova, Lagau-hanai Ariana negadia.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

motu: Bena Iesu laḡanina ihagwauta-ruana ai, tatoiosi na una Aria ikarana totona Ierusalem ma e dara dae.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

motu: Aria dinadia e ore, bena idia vada e lou, to Iesu na Ierusalem ai e noho. Tamana sinana na asi dibadia;
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

motu: idia banava ia na laolao taudia bogaragidiai eto. Bena dina ta e raka, murinai varavaradia bona turadia dekediai e tahua.
english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

motu: Asie davaria, taunabunai Ierusalem e lou henia, ma e tahua.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai, idia ese Dubu Helaḡa lalonai e davaria, hahediba taudia bogaragidiai e helai, edia hereva e kamonai bona e nanadaidia danu;
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

motu: erena e kamonai taudia iboudiai na ena lalo-parara bona ena haere e hoalai.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

motu: Raruosi e itaia, e hoa, bena sinana ese e hereva henia, eto, Natugu e, dahaka dainai ini o karamai toma? Lau tamamu ida vada a tahumu lai tahumu taimu.
english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

motu: A ia eto, Dahaka dainai o tahugu? Asi dibamui Tamagu ena ruma be egu noho rumana?
english: He said to them, “\+w Why|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w were|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w looking|strong="G2212"\+w* \+w for|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*? Didn’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w know|strong="G1492"\+w* \+w that|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w must|strong="G1163"\+w* \+w be|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Father|strong="G3962"\+w*’s house?” *

motu: Ena hereva e kamonai, to lalodia asie parara.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

motu: Ia na idia ida Nasaret ela, bona e kamonai henidia; a sinana ese ini hereva iboudiai e lalo tao.
english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

motu: Bena Iesu e bada-oho bada oho mai aonegana ida; Dirava bona taunimanima ese e ura heniava.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

motu: Tiberio Kaisara ena lohia laḡanina ihagwauta-imana ai, Pontio Pilato be Iudea edia gavana, bona Herod be Galilea lohiana, bona tadina Filipo be Iturea bona Trakonito lohiadia, bona Lusania be Abilene lohiana,
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

motu: bona Ana bona Kaiafa be hahelaḡa taudia badadia, una negana ai Dirava ese Ioane Sakaria e hereva henia, tano ḡaḡaena ai.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

motu: Bena Ioane ese Ioridane sinavaina badina tanona idoinai e loa heniava, helalo bapatisona, dika igwau-taona, e harorolaiava.
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

motu: Isaia, peroveta tauna, ena buka ai e torea na heto; eto, Gado ta tano ḡaḡaena ai e boi lolomu, e tomu, Lohiabada ena dala ba lailaia,
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “ The|strong="G1722" * voice|strong="G5456" * of|strong="G3056" * one|strong="G3588" * crying in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * wilderness|strong="G2048" *, ‘ Make|strong="G4160" * ready|strong="G2090" * the|strong="G1722" * way|strong="G3598" * of|strong="G3056" * the|strong="G1722" * Lord|strong="G2962" *. Make|strong="G4160" * his|strong="G1722" * paths|strong="G5147" * straight|strong="G2117" *.

motu: Koura iboudiai bae hahonu, Ororo badadia bona ororo maraḡidia iboudiai bae hataora Gabu gageva-gagevadia bae hamaoromaoro, Rigika-rigikadia danu bae hamanada;
english: Every valley will be filled. Every|strong="G3956" * mountain|strong="G3735" * and|strong="G2532" * hill|strong="G3735" * will|strong="G1510" * be|strong="G1510" * brought|strong="G2532" * low|strong="G5013" *. The|strong="G2532" * crooked|strong="G4646" * will|strong="G1510" * become|strong="G1510" * straight|strong="G2117" *, and|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * rough|strong="G5138" * ways|strong="G3598" * smooth|strong="G3006" *.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai ese Dirava ena Hahemauri bae itaia.
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’” + 3:6 Isaiah 40:3-5 *

motu: Hutuma ia dekena ela, baine bapatisodia totona; bena ia ese e gwau henidia, eto, Gaigai natudia e, daika ese e hamaoromui do baine vara baduna ba heautania?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

motu: Helalo anina ba hahedinaraia. Bona basioto “Ai tamamai na Abraham”; badina be na hamaoromuimu, Dirava na mai siahuna ini nadi amo natuna bema havaradia Abraham ena.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

motu: Harihari ira na au badidiai e atoamu; taunabunai huahua namodia asie dobimu audia iboudiai na be utumu, lahi ai he taho kaumu.
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

motu: Aru taudia ese e nanadaia, eto, Ede baia kara toma?
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

motu: Ia ese e haere henidia, eto, Mai ena hahedoki rua tauna na ta dabu tauna baine henia; mai ana tauna danu unu baine kara toma.
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

motu: Tax gogo taudia danu bapatiso iabina totona ela, eto, Hahediba taumu e, ai na ede baia kara toma?
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

motu: Ia e haere, eto, Taravatu e gwauraimu ḡauna mo bavabia, basio habadaia.
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

motu: Tuari taudia danu e nanadaia, eto, Ai danu ede baia kara toma? Ia eto, Taunimanima basio daḡedaḡe henidia bona basio habadelaidia koikoi, bona davamui korikori mo bavabi mai lalo-namomui ida.
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G4314" * them|strong="G3588" *, “Extort from|strong="G2532" * no|strong="G3367" * one|strong="G3367" * by|strong="G4314" * violence, neither|strong="G3366" * accuse|strong="G4811" * anyone|strong="G3367" * wrongfully. Be|strong="G2532" * content|strong="G4160" * with|strong="G4314" * your|strong="G2532" * wages|strong="G3800" *.”

motu: Taunimanima na e daradarava bona e haeroava, Ioane na Keriso eiava.
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

motu: Bena ia ese iboudiai e hereva henidia, eto, Lau na ranu amo na bapatisomuimu, a ta be maimu, iena siahu ese lauegu e hereaiamu, lau na dia namo ena tamaka varona baina ruhaia; ia ese Lauma Helaḡa bona lahi amo baine bapatisomui.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

motu: Ena itapo na imana ai: ena uit ikwadina gabuna baine tapoa ḡoevaḡoeva, uit na ena roge ai baine haboua, a momona be basine bodo lahina ai baine doua vaitani.
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

motu: Iena hereva bunu: ma sisiba herevadia diaḡau ia ese taunimanima e harorolai henidia.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

motu: Ia ese Herod Ḡaubada danu e sisiba henia, Herodia, ia kakana Filipo adavana, dainai, bona ena kara havara daidiai.
english: but Herod the tetrarch, + 3:19 a tetrarch is one of four governors of a province * being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s + 3:19 TR reads “brother Philip’s” instead of “brother’s” * wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

motu: A Herod ese unu dika iboudiai latadiai ta ma e atoa kau: ia ese Ioane na dibura rumana ai e koua. Iesu e bapatisoa
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai e bapatisodia negana ai, Iesu danu e bapatisoa. Bena e ḡuriḡuriva ai guba vada e parara,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

motu: bona Lauma Helaḡa e diho, pune na heto, ia tubuana ai e kau. Bona gado ta guba amo e boi dobi, eto, “Oi na lau Natugu, egu lalokau; lau oi na lalo namo henimumu”.
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

motu: Una negana ai Iesu ena vara laḡanidia na toi-ahui sisivana. Taunimanima e tomava ia na Iosef natuna. Besedia bini: Heli,
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

motu: Matat, Levi, Melki, Ianai, Iosef,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

motu: Iesu Ioridane sinavaina amo e lou ai, Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohea. Bena Lauma ese tano ḡaḡaena e hakaua lao;
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

motu: unuseni ai dina hari-ahui Diabolo ese e dibaḡaniava. Unu dinadia iboudiai ia na se anianiva, dokona ai e hitoloa.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

motu: Bena Diabolo ese e hereva henia, eto, Bema oi na Dirava Natuna, ina nadi boma haḡania, aniani ḡauna ai bema lao.
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

motu: Diabolo eto, Lau na ini siahudia bona hairaidia iboudiai baina henimu, badina be lau mo e henigu, bona na ura heniamu tauna do baina henia;
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

motu: Bena ia eto, Iesu e, emu basileia bavabia negana ai, ba lalogu.

english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

motu: Bena ia na ela, Pilato dekenai, Iesu tau-anina e noia.

motu: Una dainai e daradara. Bena tatau rarua dekediai e gini, mai dabua hururu-hururudia ida.

motu: Hahine e gari, tano ai e goru diho. A raruosi ese e hereva henidia, eto, Dahaka dainai mauri tauna mase gabuna ai o tahuamu?

english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

motu: Ioane danu Aenon ai, Salim kahana ai, e bapatisova, badina be ranu na bada unuseni ai. Taunimanima na unu e laova, bena e bapatisodiava.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

motu: Una na Ioane dibura rumana ai do asie koua ahu negana ai.
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

motu: Ioane e haere, eto, Guba amo basinema henia tauna na ḡau ta basinema abia diba.

motu: Umui danu dibamui lau nato “Lau na dia Keriso, a ia igunalaina vada e siaigu”.
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

motu: Hahine matamatana e abiamu tauna, headava matamata tauna bunai. A headava matamata tauna turana danu e ginimu, erena e kamonaimu, bona headava matamata tauna gadona e moalelaiamu. Taunabunai, lauegu moale vada eme ḡuḡuru.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

motu: Ia be baine bada; lau be baina maraḡi.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

motu: Atai amo ema tauna na ḡau iboudiai daediai; tano amo ema tauna na tano tauna, bona tano herevadia e gwauraimu. Guba amo ema tauna na ḡau iboudiai daediai;
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

motu: ia ese e ita bona e kamonai ḡaudia na e gwaurai hedinaraimu, a tau ta ese ena hereva se abi daemu.

motu: A ena hereva e abi daemu tauna ese Dirava e gwauraiamu, Dirava na momokani.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese e siaia tauna ese Dirava ena hereva e gvauraimu; bona Dirava ese Lauma e henimu neganai dia taidia taidia se henimu.

motu: Tamana ese Natuna e lalokau heniamu, bona ḡau idoidiai ia imana ai vada e ato.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

motu: Natuna e abidadama heniamu tauna ese mauri hanaihanai baine abia; Natuna e gwau edeede heniamu tauna ese mauri basine itaia, a Dirava ena badu na ia latanai e miamu.

motu: Lohiabada vada e diba Farisea taudia vada e kamonai Iesu ese hutuma e abidia, ena hahediba ai e halaodia bona e bapatisodia, a Ioane be gadoidia mo e abidia.

motu: Simona Petro ese Iesu e ḡavaia, hahediba ta danu ia ida. Una hahediba na hahelaḡa tauna badana turana, bena ia na Iesu ida hahelaḡa tauna badana ena ruma maḡuna lalonai e raka vareai.
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

motu: A Petro be murimuri ai gini. Bena hari hahediba, hahelaḡa tauna badana ida e hetura tauna, e raka lasi, ikoukou igimana kekenina e hereva henia, bena Petro e hakaua vareai.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

motu: Bena ikoukou igimana kekenina ese Petro e nanadaia, eto, Oi na una tau ena hahediba ta ani? Ia e haere, eto, Lau na lasi.
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ I|strong="G2532" * am|strong="G1510" * not|strong="G3756" *.”

english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna badana ese Iesu e nanadaia, ena hahediba bona ena hahediba herevadia e nanadailaiava.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

motu: Iesu ese e haere henia, eto, Taunimanima iboudiai na hereva henidia hedinaraiva. Vaia dubu lalodiai bona Dubu Helaḡa ai na hahedibava, Iuda taudia iboudiai e hebouva gabudiai. Asina hereva hehuni.

english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

motu: Iesu na e haere, eto, Bama hereva kerere, egu kerere na boma gwauraia hedinarai; a bama hereva maoro, dahaka dainai o patagu?

motu: Simona Petro na dounu lahi badinai e giniva, e heganava. Bena idia ese e nanadaia, eto, Oi na iena hahediba ta ani? Ia ma e heḡore, eto, Lau na lasi.
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He|strong="G2532" * denied it|strong="G2532" * and|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ I|strong="G2532" * am|strong="G1510" * not|strong="G3756" *.”

english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

motu: Petro ma e heḡore lou. Bena kokoroku vada e tai. Iesu Pilatv vairanai
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

motu: Idia ese Kaiafa ena amo ma e hakaua lao, gavana ena ruma e laohaia. Daba vada e rere. Iuda taudia na gavana ena ruma ralonai asie raka vareai, badina be idia na hehelaḡa, Lagau-hanai Ariana bae ania dainai.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

motu: Taunabunai, Pilato na e raka lasi dekediai; bena eto, Dahaka dainai ina tau o habadelaiamu?

motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Bema asi ena kara dika, ai ese basiama mailaia.
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

motu: Bena Pilato ese ma e hamaorodia, eto, Umui sibomui avabia, ba hahemaoro henia emui taravatu heḡereḡerena. Iuda taudia eto, Ai na asi siahumai tau ta baia alaia mase.
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore|strong="G3767" * the|strong="G2532" * Jews|strong="G2453" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G2532" * him|strong="G3588" *, “ It|strong="G2532" * is|strong="G3588" * illegal for|strong="G2532" * us|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G2532" * put|strong="G2532" * anyone|strong="G3762" * to|strong="G2532" * death,”

english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

motu: Bena Pilato na ruma ai ma e raka vareai lou, Iesu e boiria, e nanadaia, eto, Oi na Iuda taudia edia pavapava a?
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

motu: Iesu ma e haere, eto, Egu hasileia na dia ina tanobada ḡauna. Egu basileia bema ina tanobada ḡauna, egu hesiai taudia na bema tuari, Iuda taudia imadia amo bema hamaurigu. Ḡau tamona, egu basileia na dia iniseni ai.

english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

motu: Bena e raka henia kahi, eto, Iuda taudia edia pavapava e, ba mauri! Bena imadia amo e pataia.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

motu: Bena Pilato ma e raka lasi, eto, A itaia, vairamui ai name hakaua lasi; ba diba, ena kerere ta asiname davaria.
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

motu: Bena Iesu na e raka lasi; havava ḡauna ḡiniḡini a e hatua be kwarana ai, dabua kakakakana danu tauna ai. Bena Pilato eto, Tau na a itaia.
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia bona edia hesiai taudia ese e itaia, bena e lolo, eto, Ba hasatauroa, ba hasatauroa! Pilato eto, Umui sibomui avabia, ba hasatauroa; badina be lau ese ena kerere ta asiname davaria.

english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

motu: Pilato na una hereva e kamonai negana ai na e gari dikadika;
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

motu: gavana ena ruma ai ma e raka vareai lou, Iesu e nanadaia, eto, Ede amo oma? A Iesu na se haere.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

motu: Unu amo Pilato ese ia iruha-negena dalana e tahua tohova. A Iuda taudia na e lolo, eto, Ena tau bo ruhaia negemu, oi na dia Kaisara turana. Bema tau ta e gwaumu ia sibona na hanua ta pavapavana, ia ese Kaisara e inai heniamu.
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

motu: Pilato ese una hereva e kamonai, bena ia ese Iesu ma e hakaua lasi. Bena ia na hahemaoro gabuna ai e helai diho: una gabu ladana be “Nadi dehena”; Heberu gadodia ai ladana be “Gabata”.
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

motu: Una na Lagau-hanai Ariana e abia heḡaeḡae dinana; negana be dina tubua. Pilato ese Iuda taudia e hereva henidia, eto, A itaia, emui pavapava binai.
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. + 19:14 “the sixth hour” would have been 6:00 a.m. according to the Roman timekeeping system, or noon for the Jewish timekeeping system in use, then. * He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

motu: Bena idia na e lolo, eto, Avabia oho! Avabia oho! Ba hasatauroa! Pilato ese e nanadaidia, eto, Emui pavapava baina hasatauroa a? Hahelaḡa taudia na eto, Asi emai pavapava ta, Kaisara mo sibona.
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate|strong="G4091" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G3004" * them|strong="G3588" *, “ Shall|strong="G3361" * I|strong="G1487" * crucify|strong="G4717" * your|strong="G2192" * King|strong="G3588" *?” The|strong="G3588" * chief priests answered|strong="G3004" *, “ We|strong="G1487" * have|strong="G2192" * no|strong="G3756" * king|strong="G3588" * but|strong="G1487" * Caesar|strong="G2541" *!”

english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

motu: Iesu ese ena satauro e huaia lao, ḡabu ta ela, ladana na “Kwara koukouna gabuna”; Heberu gadodia ai ladana na “Kwara koukouna gabuna”, Heberu gadodia ai ladana na “Golgota”.
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

motu: Bena Pilato ese revareva e torea, satauro dorina ai e kapaia kau. E torea revarevana binai: IESU, TAU NASARET; IUDA TAUDIA EDIA PAVAPAVA.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

motu: Iuda taudia hutuma ex una revareva e duahia, badina be Iesu e hasatauroa gabuna bona hanua badana padadia na dia daudau; bona una revareva na Heberu gadodia ai bona Roma gadodia ai bona Helene gadodia ai e torea.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

motu: Bena Iuda taudia edia hahelaḡa taudia badadia ese Pilato e hamaoroa, eto, Basio torea “Iuda taudia edia pavapava”; ini hari ba torea toma, “Ia eto, Lau na Iuda taudia edia pavapava”.
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

motu: Pilato eto, Na torea ḡauna be vada na torea vaitani.
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

motu: Bena tuari taudia, hari Iesu e hasatauroa taudia, ese ena dabua e abi, e dare siri hani, bena hahaniosi ta ta ese ahudia e abi. A ena hahedoki na se turia ḡauna, idoinai vada e hatua.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

motu: Taunabunai, sibodia e hereva heheni, eto, Basita darea, a mari hari baita karaia, bena baita diba daika ese baine abia. Unu amo Buka Helaḡa ai e torea herevana vada e momokalli; eto, Idia ese egu dabua e hari, Egu hahedoki na mari amo e abia. Hari tuari taudia na unu e kara toma.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “ They|strong="G2532" * parted|strong="G1266" * my|strong="G1473" * garments|strong="G2440" * among|strong="G4314" * them|strong="G3588" *.
