motu: Una dainai, Lohiabada Iesu ida a vareai a lasi negadia iboudiai e bamomai tauna ta,
english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

motu: Lohiabada Iesu ese Ioane enai bapatiso e abia ema bona ena heabi-isi ai e rakatanimai negana ai e bamomai tauna, baita abia hidi, Iesu ena tore-isi-lou igwaurai-hedinaraina ai ma baine bamomai.
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese tatau rarua e abidia, Iosef, e nemaia Barasaba, ladana ta danu Iusto, bona Matia.
english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

motu: Bena e ḡuriḡuri, eto, Lohiabada e, taunimanima iboudiai lalodia dibamu, ini raruosi na edena bavabia,
english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

motu: hesiai ahuna bona aposetolo dagina baine abia; badina be Iuda ese ena kara dika dainai vada e morutania, bena ena gabu korikori vada ela.
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

motu: Bena mari e karaia, Matia e duanaia; bena aposetolo gwauta-taosi ida e duahidia bou.
english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

motu: Pentekoste dinana ai idia iboudiai gabu tamona ai e hebou.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

motu: Bena guba amo reḡe ta e reḡe dagu, lai badana huna na heto, e helai bou rumana e hahonua.
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

motu: Bona lahi maladia na heheto e heita, idia ta ta tubuadia ai e hururu.
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

motu: Bena Lauma Helaḡa ese e hahonudia, bona idau gado idau gado ai e hereva, Lauma ese e henidia heḡereḡerena.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

motu: Una negana ai Iuda taudia Ierusalem ai e nohova, Dirava garina e gariva taudia, tanobada tanodia loḡora amo ema.
english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

motu: Una rege e kamonai ai, hutuma e hebou, bena laumadia e daure, badina be ta ta ena gado ena gado e kamonai.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

motu: Iboudiai e daradara bona e hoa, eto, Ini e herevamu taudia na dia Galilea taudia a?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

motu: O edeheto ita iboudai ta ta ena gado ena gado korikori ai edia hereva ta kamonaimu?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

motu: Patia amo, Media amo, Elam amo, Mesopotamia amo, Iudea amo, Kapadokia amo, Ponto amo, Asia amo,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

motu: Frugia amo, Pamfulia amo, Aigupto amo, bona Kurene amo (una na Afrika kahana ta). Haida be vadivadi taudia Roma amo; haida be Iuda taumai; haida be Iuda ai e halaodia taudia;
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

motu: haida danu Krete taudia bona Arabia taudia. Tatau bini Dirava ena hoa ḡaudia e herevalai henidamu, eda gado korikori ai.
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

motu: Iboudiai e hoa, bona e daradara, e hereva heheni, eto, Ina na dahaka?
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

motu: A haida ese e kirikuilaidia, eto, Idia na vine ranuna matamatana e inua, e kekeromu. Petro ena haroro
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

motu: A Petro na gwauta-taosi ida e gini tore, erena e habadaia, e haroro henidia, eto, Iudea taumui bona Ierusalem ai o nohomu taumui e, ina na ba haeroa, bona egu hereva ba kamonai.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

motu: Ini na dia kekekero, umui o laloamu heḡereḡerena, badina be ina na doini daba.
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day. + 2:15 about 9:00 a.m. *

motu: A ina na Ioel, peroveta tauna, ese e gwauraia guna herevana; eto,
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

motu: Dirava eto, Tanobada dokona dinadia ai Lau laumagu baina seia dobi, taunimanima iboudiai latadiai; Bena natumui mamaruanedia bona hahinedia do bae peroveta, Bona emui eregabe bae mata hanai, Bona emui iahu bae nihi.

Your|strong="G2532" * old|strong="G4245" * men|strong="G3956" * will|strong="G2316" * dream|strong="G1797" * dreams|strong="G1798" *.

motu: Oibe, unu dinadia ai egu hesiai taudia bona hahinedia latadiai Laumagu do baina seia dobi, bena bae peroveta.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G2532" * pour|strong="G1632" * out|strong="G1632" * my|strong="G1722" * Spirit|strong="G4151" *, and|strong="G2532" * they|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * prophesy|strong="G4395" *.

motu: Bena hoa ḡaudia na guba ai baina hahedinarai, Bona toa ḡaudia tanobada ai; Rara bona lahi bona kwalahu.
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and|strong="G2532" * signs|strong="G4592" * on|strong="G1909" * the|strong="G1722" * earth|strong="G1093" * beneath|strong="G2736" *: blood, and|strong="G2532" * fire|strong="G4442" *, and|strong="G2532" * billows of|strong="G2532" * smoke|strong="G2586" *.

motu: Dina do baine dibura, Hua na rara ai bainela, Lohiabada ena dina badana bona herea-daena baine kahira-kahira negana ai.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * moon|strong="G4582" * into|strong="G1519" * blood, before|strong="G4250" * the|strong="G2532" * great|strong="G3173" * and|strong="G2532" * glorious|strong="G2016" * day|strong="G2250" * of|strong="G2250" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" * comes|strong="G2064" *.

motu: A Lohiabada ladana bae hatoa taudia na bae mauri.
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’ + 2:21 Joel 2:28-32 *

motu: Israel taumui e, ina hereva ba kamonai: Iesu, tau Nasaret, Dirava ese dekemui e siaia vasi, bona siahu karadia bona hoa karadia bona toa na bogaragimui ai e hahedinarai, Dirava ese ia imana amo e karava; umui danu dibamui.
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

motu: Ia hari, Dirava ena lalo-hadai bona ena diba ese e henimui tauna, umui ese murimuri taudia imadia amo vada o hasatauroa.
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

motu: A Dirava ese e hatorea isi lou, mase ena iḡui e ruha; badina be mase na ia idogo-taona asi dibana.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

motu: David danu ia herevana e gwauraia; eto, Lohiabada na nega idoinai vairagu ai na itaia, Badina be ia na idibagu kahana ai, Basina marere helaoreana.
english: For David says concerning him, ‘ I|strong="G1473" * saw|strong="G4308" * the|strong="G1519" * Lord|strong="G2962" * always|strong="G3956" * before|strong="G1799" * my|strong="G3956" * face, for|strong="G1063" * he|strong="G3754" * is|strong="G1510" * on|strong="G1519" * my|strong="G3956" * right|strong="G1188" * hand|strong="G1188" *, that|strong="G3754" * I|strong="G1473" * should|strong="G3588" * not|strong="G3361" * be|strong="G1510" * moved|strong="G3361" *.

motu: Taunabunai lalogu eme hisi dae, Malagu eme moale bada, Hidiogu na helaro ai baine taruha;
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover|strong="G1161" * my|strong="G1473" * flesh|strong="G4561" * also|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * dwell|strong="G1909" * in|strong="G1909" * hope|strong="G1680" *,

motu: Badina be laumagu na mase taudia edia gabu ai basio rakatania, Bona emu Helaḡa Tauna na basine pata.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, + 2:27 or, Hell * neither|strong="G3761" * will|strong="G1473" * you|strong="G4771" * allow|strong="G1325" * your|strong="G3708" * Holy|strong="G3741" * One|strong="G3588" * to|strong="G1519" * see|strong="G3708" * decay|strong="G1312" *.

motu: Mauri daladia vada o hadibagu; Oi vairamu itana ai egu moale baine ḡuḡuru.
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You|strong="G4771" * will|strong="G1473" * make|strong="G1107" * me|strong="G1473" * full|strong="G4137" * of|strong="G3598" * gladness|strong="G2167" * with|strong="G3326" * your|strong="G3588" * presence|strong="G4383" *.’ + 2:28 Psalms 16:8-11 *

motu: Varavaragu e, seneda David herevana na hamaoromui momokanimu: ia na e mase, e guria, bona gara na doini mia ita dekeda ai.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

motu: To ia be peroveta tauna; dibana danu Dirava vada e gwau henia hamata, ia besena ta ese ena terono ai baine helai kau eto.
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ + 2:30 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * to sit on his throne,

motu: Una dainai e diba guna herevana e gwauraia, Keriso ena tore-isi-lou herevana, ia na mase taudia edia gabu ai basine noho, bona tau-anina basine pata.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, + 2:31 or, Hell * and his flesh didn’t see decay.

motu: Hari Iesu na Dirava ese e hatorea isi; ai iboumai ai danu dibamai.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

motu: Bona Dirava ese imana idibana amo e abia isi; bena ia ese Tamana e gwauraia hamata Laumana Helaḡana vada e abia, bona vada e seia dobi; umui ese harihari o itaiamu bona o kamomaiamu.
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

motu: Badina be David na guba ai se dae kau, a ia hari eto, Lohiabada ese egu Lohia e hamaoroa, eto, Lau idibagu kahana ai ba helai,
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘ The|strong="G1519" * Lord|strong="G2962" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G1519" * my|strong="G1473" * Lord|strong="G2962" *, “ Sit|strong="G2521" * by|strong="G1537" * my|strong="G1473" * right|strong="G1188" * hand|strong="G1188" *

motu: Ela bona oi inaimu na Aemu ihadaidia ḡauna ai baina halaodia.
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’ + 2:35 Psalms 110:1 *

motu: Taunabunai, Israel besedia iboudiai na bae diba vaitani, hari Iesu, umui ese o hasatauroa tauna, Dirava ese Lohiabada bona Keriso ai vada e halaoa. Ekalesia oreana e gini
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

motu: Ini hereva daidiai, idia kudoudia e hetaha. Bena idia ese Petro aposetolo orena ida e nanadaidia, eto, Varavaragu e, ede baia kara toma?
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

motu: Petro ese e haere henidia, eto, Ba helalo kerehai: iboumui ai bapatiso bavabia, Iesu Keriso ladana ai, emui dika igwau-taona toana; bena Lauma Helaḡa hariharina do bavabia.
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

motu: Badina be gwau-hamata be umui emui ai, bona natumui ediai, bona dauhai nohodia taudia ediai, oibe, Lohiabada eda Dirava ese baine boiridia taudia iboudiai ediai.
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

motu: Hereva diaḡau amo ma e sisiba henidia; bona e haduadia, eto, Ina uru gageva-gagevana amo ba roho mauri.
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

motu: Bena erena e abia dae taudia na bapatiso e abia; una dina tamona ai taunimanima daha toi sisivana na edia orea ai e vareai.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

motu: Bena idia na aposetolo edia hahediba heboudia ai e noho taritariva; aniani danu e bitu hebouva, bona e ḡuriḡuri hebouva danu.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

motu: Gari ese iboudiai e butudia tao; bona hoa karadia bona toa diaḡau aposetolo ese e kara.
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

motu: Bena abidadama taudia e noho hebou, bona ḡau iboudiai e abi hebou.
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

motu: Edia kohu bona edia tano danu eha hoi, davadia e hari hagau-hagau, ta ta ena dabu ena dabu heḡereḡeredia.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

motu: Dina iboudiai mai lalodia tamona e hebou, Dubu Helaḡa lalonai; bona edia ruma ai e aniani hebou mai moaledia ida bona mai lalodia tamona ida,
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

motu: Dirava e imodaia danu. Taunimanima ese e lalo namo henida; bona Lohiabada ese e hamauridia taudia na dina iboudiai dekedia ai e haboudia.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

motu: Nega ta, dina ḡelona ḡuriḡurina negana, Petro Ioane ida Dubu Helaḡa ai e dae kau.
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour. + 3:1 3:00 p.m. *

motu: Unuseni ai tau ta, ae hedairikena ai e vara, dina iboudiai e huaia laova, Dubu Helaḡa iduarana ladana “Herea-dae” badinai e hahelaiava, bena Dubu Helaḡa ai e daeva taudia ediai e noi hegameva.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

motu: Ia ese Petro bona Ioane e itadia, Dubu Helaḡa ai e dae kau negana ai, bena ediai ma e noinoi.
english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

motu: A Petro Ioane ida ese e raraia tao, eto, Ba raraimai.l
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

motu: Ia ese una hereva e kamonai, Ia banava eto idia ese ḡau ta bae henia.
english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

motu: A Petro eto, Silver bona gold na asi-egu, a dekegu ai e miamu ḡauna hari na henimumu: Iesu Keriso, tau Nasaret, ladana ai a raka.
english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

motu: Imana idibana amo e veria tore, bena aena bona aena komukomuna vada e hedai kunu.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

motu: Bena e roho isi, e gini tore, e raka matama. Bena idia ida Dubu Helaḡa lalonai e raka vareai, e raka roho isi roho isi, Dirava e heatolaia.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

motu: Hutuma ese e itaia, e raka bona Dirava e heatolaia;
english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

motu: bona dibadia ia na vaia Dubu Helaḡa iduarana ladana “Herea-dae” badibadinai e helaiva bona e noi hegameva tauna; bena e hoa dikadika bona e daradara bada, ienai e vara ḡauna dainai. Petro ma e haroro
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

motu: Aena vada e namo tauna ese Petro bona Ioane e dogodia taova ai, taunimanima hutuma ese e heau henidia hebou, dehe ta ai, ladana na “Solomon ena dehe”. Laumadia na e daure.
english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

motu: Petro ese e itadia, bena hutuma e hereva henidia, eto, Israel taumui e, dahaka dainai ina ḡau o hoalaiamu? Bona badina be dahaka o raraimai taomu? O laloamu ai na sibomai emai siahu eiava emai namo daidiai ina tau a hamauria a?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

motu: Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob edia Dirava, bona tamada edia Dirava, ese ia Natuna Iesu e heatolaia, to umui ese Pilato o henia, bona Pilato urana e urava baine kahua nege negana ai na umui ese o dadaraia.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

motu: Helaḡa bona Kara Maoromaoro Tauna umui ese o dadaraia, a ala-ala tauna be o noia baine hamauria oto.
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

motu: Mauri Biaguna be umui ese o alaia mase, to Dirava ese mase amo ma e hatorea isi; ini ai be dibamai taumai.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

motu: Bena ina ia ladana e abidadama henia tauna, o itaiamu bona umui dibamui tauna, ia ladana ese vada e hagoadaia; oibe, ia iabidadamahenina ese ina tau vada e hamauria umui iboumui ai vairamui ai.
english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

motu: Varavaragu e, dibagu umui na mai emui lohia ida unu o kara toma na lalomui asie parara dainai.
english: “Now, brothers, + 3:17 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

motu: A Dirava ese peroveta taudia iboudiai ududia amo Keriso na hisi baine ani herevadia e gwaurai; unu hereva vada e hamomokani vaitani.
english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

motu: Taunabunai ba helalo lou, ba helalo kerehai; bena emui dika bae hcabi oho, bona hahemauri negadia na Lohiabada ena amo baema.
english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

motu: Bona ia ese Keriso ma baine siaia, gunaguna vada e gwauraia hidi emui; Iesu bunai.
english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

motu: A guba ai baine heabi dae guna, ela bona ḡau iboudiai ihamataunatadia negadia, Dirava ese nega gunadia amo enaperoveta taudia helaḡadia ududia ai vada e gwauraia heḡereḡerena.
english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

motu: Mose ese seneda e hamaorodia, eto, Lohiabada emui Dirava ese peroveta tauna ta do baine haginia umui emui, varavaramui edia amo, lau bamogu. Ia ese baine gwaurai henimui herevadia iboudiai na ba kamonai.
english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

motu: Bona una peroveta tauna basie kamonai henia taudia iboudiai na taununanima padadia amo bae mase ore.
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’ + 3:23 Deuteronomy 18:15,18-19 *

motu: Oibe; bona peroveta taudia iboudiai danu, Samuel ena amo ema bona hari, ini dina vada e gwauraiva.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

motu: Umui na peroveta taudia natudia; bona Dirava ese umui senemui e gwau henidia hamata, Abraham e hamaorolaia, eto, Oi garamu edia amo tanobada besedia iboudiai do bae namo.
english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’ + 3:25 or, seed * + 3:25 Genesis 22:18; 26:4 *

motu: Dirava ese Natuna vada e haginia, bena e siaia guna emui ai, ihanamomui bona emui dika amo ihaloumui totona.
english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

motu: A Petro bona Ioane ese hanua taudia e hereva henidiava ai, hahelaḡa taudia bona Dubu Helaḡa biaguna bona Sadukea taudia na raruosi dekedia ela,
english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

motu: e badu henidia; badina be raruosi ese taunimanima e hadibadia, bona mase taudia edia tore-isi-lou, Iesu e tore isi lou bagunai, e harorolaia.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

motu: Bena idia ese e dabaidia tao, dibura rumana ai e koudia ahu, unuseni ai bae noho rani, badina be ado vada e rahi.
english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

motu: A edia hereva e kamonai bona e abi dae taudia iboudiai be daha ima sisivana.
english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

motu: Daba ai, hanua lohiadia bona hanua tau-badadia bona itorena taudia na Ierusalem ai vada e hebou.
english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

motu: Ana, hahelaḡa tauna badana, bona Kaiafa, bona loane, bona Alesana, bona hahelaḡa tauna badana ena iduhu taudia iboudiai danu unuseni ai.
english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

motu: Bena raruosi na bogaragidiai e haginidia, e nanadaidia, eto, Edena siahu ai bona daika ladana ai ina ḡau o karaia?
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

motu: Una negana ai Petro na Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohea, bena ia ese e haere henidia, eto, Hanua lohiamui bona heitatao taumui e,
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

motu: harihari o nanadaimaimu ina ae-hedairike tauna ai ese a kara namo henia na ede e namo toma?
english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

motu: Vada ba diba, Israel taudia iboudiai danu bae diba, Iesu Keriso, tau Nasaret, umui ese o hasatauroa a Dirava ese mase amo e hatorea isi tauna, ia ladana dainai ina tau na umui vairamui ai eme gini mai goadana ida.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

motu: Ia be Ruma ikarana taumui ese o dadaraia nadina na Daiguni nadina ai vada ela.
english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’ + 4:11 Psalms 118:22 *

motu: Hahemauri be idau tauna ta lalonai dia mia; badina be ihamaurida ladana idauna ta guba henunai se henida, lasi vaitani.
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

motu: Idia ese Petro bona Ioane e itadia, asi edia gari; dibadia danu idia na hahediba gabuna ta asiela bona asi aonegadia taudia; bena e hoa, bona lalodia e parara idia na Iesu bamona.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

motu: Bena idia raruosi bona e hamauria tauna tatoiosi gini-boudia ai e itadia, bena asi edia dala ma bae hereva henidia.
english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

motu: Taunabunai e haduadia, eto una hebou amo bae raka oho. Bena e raka lasi muridiai sibodia e henanadai heheni, eto,
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

motu: Idia raruosi ede baita karadia tomamu a? Badina be unu Ierusalem ai nohodia taudia iboudiai bae diba idia raruosi ese hoa karana ta vada e karaia, bona ita ese basita ḡorea diba.
english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

motu: A taunimanima ese bae piua badabada na garina, raruosi baita hagaridia, bona baita taravadia, una lada na tau ta ma basie herevalai henia lou.
english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

motu: Bena e boiridia, e tamanudia, Iesu ladana ai basie haroro bona basie hahediba, lasi vaitani.
english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

motu: A Petro Ioane ida e haere, eto, Mani ba laloa, umui baia kamonai henimui, Dirava basia kamonai henia, una na Dirava vairanai maoro eiava lasi?
english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

motu: Badina be a itava bona a kamonaiva ḡaudia na basia herevalai na dia heḡereḡere.
english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

motu: Ma e hagaridia lou, bena e kahudia nege. Ihadikadia dalana ta asie davaria, badina be taunimanima iboudiai ese Dirava e heatolaia, hari hoa karana dainai.
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

motu: Badina be una hoa karana ese e hamauria tauna ena vara laḡanidia na hari-ahui mai dikoana. Ekalesia e ḡurḡuri
english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

motu: E kahudia nege murinai, raruosi na turadia dekedia ela, hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua tau-badadia edia hereva iboudiai e hamaorolaidia.
english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

motu: Idia na e kamonai, bena lalodia e hatamonaia, Dirava e guria, eto, Ḡaubada e, guba, tanobada, davara, bona lalodiai e miamu ḡaudia iboudiai, ikaradia na Oi.
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

motu: Oi danu Lauma Helaḡa ena amo ai senemai David uduna ai o hereva, eto, Bese idau-idau dahaka baduna e badumu, Bona dahaka dainai taunimanima ese ḡau asi anidia e lalo hadailai?
english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘ Why|strong="G1223" * do|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * nations|strong="G1484" * rage|strong="G5433" *, and|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * peoples|strong="G2992" * plot|strong="G3191" * a|strong="G2532" * vain|strong="G2756" * thing|strong="G3004" *?

motu: Hanua pavapavadia e gini tore, Bona hanua lohiadia e hebou, Lohiabada ena Keriso ida ilao-ahudia.
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * rulers plot together|strong="G4863" *, against|strong="G2596" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *, and|strong="G2532" * against|strong="G2596" * his|strong="G1909" * Christ|strong="G5547" *.’ + 4:26 Christ (Greek) and Messiah (Hebrew) both mean Anointed One. * + 4:26 Psalms 2:1-2 *

motu: Momokani, ina hanua lalonai idia na e hebou, emui hesiai tauna helaḡana Iesu, oi ese o horoa tauna, ihadikana totona. Pontio Pilato bona idau bese taudia bona Israel besena taudia e hebou,
english: “For truly, + 4:27 nu adds “in this city,” * both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

motu: oi imamu ese e torea guna, oiemu aonega ese e haeroa guna, karana e karaia.
english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

motu: Taunabenai, Lohiabada e, edia hahegari herevadia ame kamonai; emu hesiai taumai goada bame henimai, emu hereva baia gwaurai mai goadamai ida.
english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

motu: Imamu danu ba toia roro, gorere taudia ba hamauridia, toa bona hoa karadia ba kara, Iesu, emu hesiai tauna helaḡana, ladana ai.
english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

motu: E ḡuriḡuri vaitani, bena edia hebou rumana vada e heude-heude. Lauma Helaḡa ese iboudiai e rohedia, bena idia ese Dirava ena hereva e harorolaia mai goadadia ida. Ekalesia taudia edia noho
english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

motu: Kamonai taudia iboudiai mai lalodia tamona bona mai daradia tamona ida e nohova; ta ena kohu sibona ena se gwauraiava, a edia ḡau iboudiai e abi bouva.
english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

motu: Aposetolo taudia ese danu Lohiabada Iesu ena tore-isi-lou e harorolaiava mai siahudia ida. Dirava ena harihari-bada danu idia iboudiai latadiai e miava.
english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

motu: Idia dekediai tau ta se dabu. Badina be mai edia tano eiava edia ruma taudia iboudiai ese edia ḡau eha hoi, davadia e laohai,
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

motu: aposetolo vairadiai e ato diho. Bena iboudiai e henidia hagau-hagau, ta ta ena dabu ena dabu heḡereḡeredia.
english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

motu: Tau ta, ladana na Iosef, aposelolo ese ladana e hatoa Banaba (anina be “Tauhalo Tauna”), ia na Levi iduhuna tauna, Kupro ai e vara:
english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

motu: ena tano vada e hoia, bena davana e laohaia, aposetolo vairadiai e atoa diho.
english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

motu: A tau ta, ladana be Anania, adavana Sapira ida, edia tano ta e hoia;
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

motu: to una tano davana kahana e moia tao. Adavana danu dibana. Kahana mo e laohaia, aposetolo vairadiai e atoa diho.
english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

motu: Bena Petro ese e gwau henia, eto, Anania e, edeheto Satana ese e bolomu, bena Lauma Helaḡa o koia, tano davana kahana o moia tao?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

motu: Do asio hoia negana ai, tano na oiemu ani? Bona o hoia negana ai, davana na oiemu ani? Hari ina kara be ede o lalo hadailaia toma? Oi ese taunimanima some koidia; a Dirava ome koia.
english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

motu: Anania ese una hereva e kamonai, bena e hekida diho, e mase vailani. Bena harina e kamonai taudia iboudiai e gari dikadika.
english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

motu: Bena eregabe e tore isi, tau-anina dabua ai e hiria, e huaia lasi, e ḡuria.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

motu: Hora toi sisivana vada ela, hahine ma e raka vareai; to hari adavana enai e vara ḡauna asi dibana.
english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

motu: Bena Petro ese e nanadaia, eto, A hamaorogu, umui raruosi ese tano o hoia davana gaunabinai a? Ia e haere, eto, Oibe, davana ḡaunabenai.
english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ Yes|strong="G3483" *, for|strong="G4314" * so|strong="G1161" * much|strong="G5118" *.”

motu: Bena Petro ese e gwau henia, eto, Umui raluosi dahaka dainai lalomui o hatanlonaia, Lohiabada ena Lauma ba dibaḡania oto? Adavamu igurina memerodia o itadiamu, iduara ai gigini; oi danu ma bae huamu lasi.
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

motu: Bena ia Petro ae-badinai ma e hekida diho, vada e mase.
english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

motu: Una negana ai ekelesia idoinai bona harina e kamonai taudia iboudiai na gari bada ese e butudia tao. Toa diaḡau
english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

motu: Toa bona hoa karadia diaḡau aposetolo ese hanua taudia vairadiai e karava; iboudiai danu mai lalodia tamona ida Solomon ena dehe ai eha hebouva.
english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

motu: A taunimanima oredia na e gariva, una dainai dekediai asie hebouva. Ḡau tamona, hanua taudia ese e imodaidiava;
english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

motu: bona Lohiabada e abidadama henia taudia hutuma bada, tatau bona hahine, na edia orea ai e hebouva.
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

motu: Gorere taudia danu e huadia lasiva, edia geda ai ariara ai e kurediava, Petro baine raka hanai negana ai ia laulauna ese haida baine hakerukerudia helaoreana.
english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

motu: Ierusalem badina hanuadia taudia hutuma bada danu e hebouva, gorere taudia bona lauma dikadia ese e bolodia taudia danu e laohaidia, bena idia ese ibouboudiai e hamauridia. Aneru ese dibura rumana e kehoa
english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna badana mai bamona ida (Sadukea taudia edia orea bunai) e vaḡeḡe bada,
english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

motu: aposetolo taudia e dabaidia tao, dibura rumana ai e koudia.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

motu: A hanuaboi ai Lohiabada ena aneru ta ese dibura rumana iduarana e keho, e hakaudia lasi, eto,
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

motu: Vada aola, Dubu Helaḡa ai ba gini, ina mauri herevana idoinai hanua taudia ba herevalai henidia.
english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

motu: Una hahedua e kamonai, bena daba matana ai idia na Dubu Helaḡa ai e dae kau, e hahediba matama. A hahelaḡa tauna badana mai bamona ida ela, kaunsil taudia bona Israel tau-badadia iboudiai e haboudia; bena ena hesiai taudia dibura rumana e siaidia lao, aposetolo taudia bae hakaudia mai eto.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

motu: Hari hesiai taudia na ela, to dibura rumana ai asie davaridia. Bena e lou ela, eto,
english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

motu: A gini dae negana ai, dibura rumana vada e hekou kunuka-kunuka, hegima taudia danu iduara badibadidiai gigini; to iduara e keho negana ai, ruma lalona na asi tauna.
english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

motu: Dubu Helaḡa biaguna bona hahelaḡa taudia ese una hereva e kamonai, bena e daradara bada, asi dibadia unu kara anidia be dahaka. Aposetolo e hahemaoro henidia
english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

motu: Bena tau ta dekediai e kau, e hamaorodia, eto, Dibura rumana ai o koudia taudia na Dubu Helaḡa ai gigini, hanua taudia e hadibadiamu.
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

motu: Bena Dubu Helaḡa biaguna ena hesiai taudia ida ela, aposetolo e hakaudia; to asie daḡedaḡe henidia, hanua taudia ese nadi amo bae hododia na garina.
english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

motu: E hakaudia vareai, kaunsil taudia vairadiai e haginidia. Bena hahelaḡa tauna badana ese e nanadaidia, eto,
english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

motu: Ai ese a haduamui, ato “Una tau ladana ai basio hahediba”. A harihari emui hahediba herevadia ese Ierusalem vada eme hahonua; bona o habadelaimaimu, una tau ena mase dainai.
english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

motu: Bena Petro, aposetolo oredia ida, e haere, eto, Dirava ikamonai-henina be namo; taunimanima ikamonai-henidia be dika.
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

motu: Hari Iesu, umui ese satauro ai o taua dae, o alaia mase, tauna na tamada edia Dirava ese vada e hatorea isi lou.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

motu: Bona Dirava ese danu vada e abia dae ia imana idibana ai, Lohiabada bona Hahemauri Tauna ai vada e halaoa, Israel taudia baine hahelalodia kerehai bona edia dika baine gwau tao.
english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

motu: Ai na ini ḡau a gwauraimu, Lauma Helaḡa danu e gwauraimu: Laumana bunai Dirava ese ia ikamonai-henina taudia vada e henidia.
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

motu: Unu hereva e kamonai ai, e badu dikadika, aposetolo bae aladia mase eto.
english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

motu: A Farisea tauna ta, ladana be Gamaliel, e tore isi; ia be taravatu ihahedibalaina tauna; taunimanima iboudiai ese ia e matauraiava. Ia e hahedua, aposetolo na bae raka lasi, nega taina murimuri ai do bae noho.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

motu: Bena ia eto, Israel taumui e, nahuamui ba toho ini tatau ede ba karadia toma.
english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

motu: Idau nega ai Teuda na e gini tore, eto ia na herea tauna, bena taunimanima sinahu-tlani sisivana ienai e tao; to e alaia mase, bona ena orea taudia e hakarohodia bona e ha-oredia.
english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

motu: Ia murinai luda, tau Galilea, be taunimanima ladadia itoredia negana ai e gini tore, bona taunimanima haida ienai e tao; to ia danu e alaia mase, bona ena orea taudia danu e hakarohodia.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

motu: Taunabunai na hamaoromuimu, ini lalau asio dogodia tao. Ba kahudia nege. Badina be ini hereva bona ini kara bema taunimanima edia amo, anidia na basiema vara;
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

motu: to, bema Dirava ena amo, umui na basioma ha-oredia diba. Nahuamui ba toho, Dirava ba tuari henia na garina.
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

motu: Idia ese ia e kamonai henia. Bena aposetolo e boiridia, e dadabadia; bona tarava e atu henidia, Iesu ladana ai basie hahediba lou eto. Bena e kahudia nege.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

motu: Taunabunai, aposetolo ese kaunsil e rakatania mai moaledia ida, badina be Iesu ladana bagunai hisi e ani.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

motu: Bena dina iboudiai, Dubu Helaḡa ai bona ruma lalodiai, taunimanima e hadibadia, bona Iesu Keriso sivaraina namona iharorolaina asie hadokoa.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

motu: Unu dinadia ai, Iesu ibadinana taudia e hahutumava, bena Helene gado ai e herevava taudia ese Heberu gado ai e herevava taudia na e maumauraidia matama, badina be edia hahine vadodia na dina iboudiai aniani iharina ai e dabu loulouva.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists + 6:1 The Hellenists used Greek language and culture, even though they were also of Hebrew descent. * against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

motu: Bena aposetolo ese Iesu ibadinana taudia hutuma e haboudia, eto, Ai ese Dirava ena hereva iharorolaina baia hadokoa aniani iharina totona na dia namo.
english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaramai e, umui na taumui hahitu avabidia hidi, haridia namodia taudia, Lauma bona aonega ai e honumu taudia; bena ina ḡaukara baia henidia.
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

motu: A ai ese nega idoinai ḡuriḡuri bona haroro baia goadalai.
english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

motu: Ina hereva na iboudiai ese e abia dae, bena haida e gwauraidia hidi: Stefano, abidadama bada bona Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohea tauna; bona Filipo; bona Prokoro; bona Nikanoro; bona Timona; bona Pamena; bona Nikolao, ia na tau Antioka, Iuda tauna ai e halaoa.
english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

motu: Unu hahituosi na idia ese aposetolo vairadiai e haginidia. Bena aposetolo na e ḡuriḡuri guna, bena imadia latadiai e ato kau.
english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

motu: Bena Dirava ena hereva e piua rohorohova, bona Iesu ibadinana taudia Ierusalem ai e hahutumadiava; bona hahelaḡa taudia hutuma ese danu e abiabiraia. Stefano e dabaia tao
english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

motu: Stefano na harihari-bada ai bona siahu ai e honu, bena ia ese hoa karadia bona toa badadia taunimanima vairadiai e karava.
english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

motu: Bena e ruhadia nege oreana edia dubu taudia haida, bona Kurene bona Alesandrea bona Kilikia bona Asia taudia haida, ese Stefano ida e hepapahuahu.
english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

motu: To idia na asi siahudia bae gwaua tubu, badina be ena hereva na aonega ai bona Lauma ai e hahonua.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

motu: Una dainai idia ese haida lalodia e ani, baeto “Ai na ena hereva dikadia a kamonai, Mose bona Dirava e hadikalaidia”.
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

motu: Unu amo idia ese hanua taudia bona heitatao taudia bona itorena taudia e haherou-heroudia; bena ia dekena e heau lao, vada e dabaia tao, kaunsil taudia vairadiai e laohaia.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

motu: Bena idia ese hahebade koikoi taudia e haginidia tore. Idia eto, Ina tau ese ina gabu helaḡana bona taravatu ihadikalaidia herevadia na se hadokomu.
english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

motu: Ai ese danu ena hereva a kamonai, eto “Iesu, tau Nasaret, ese ina gabu baine rohoa, bona Mose ese e henida karadia danu baine ha-idau”.
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

motu: Bena kaunsil gabuna ai e helaiva taudia iboudiai ese e raraia tao, vairana e itaia, aneru ta vairana na heto.
english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana eto, Edia hereva na momokani a?
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

motu: Stefano e haere, eto, Varavaragu bona tamagu loḡora e, egu hereva a kamonai. Hairai Diravana ese seneda Abraham enai e hedinarai Mesopotamia ai, Haran ai do se nohova negana ai;
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

motu: eto, Emu tano bona varavaramu ba rakatanidia, baina hadibamu tanona baola.
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’ + 7:3 Genesis 12:1 *

motu: Bena ia ese Kaldea taudia edia tano e rakatania, Haran ai eha noho. Bena tamana e mase murinai Dirava ese unu amo ma e hakaua, ema bona harihari o noho heniamu tanona ai eme lasi.
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

motu: A tano sisina taina se henia; oibe, aena ihadaina gabuna taina asine henia. Ḡau tamona, e gwau henia hamata do baine henia, bona ia murinai garana danu baine henidia. Una negana ai Abraham na asi natuna.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

motu: Dirava ese ma e hamaoroa eto, garana loḡora idau tano ai bae ha noho, bena una tano taudia ese isiaidia ilao-henidia taudia ai bae halaodia, bona bae hahisidia laḡani sinahu-hani.
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

motu: Dirava ma eto, Hesiai taudia ai baine halaodia besena na lau ese baina hahemaoro henia; gabeamo idia na bae raka lasi, iniseni ai bae toma henigu diho.
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’ + 7:7 Genesis 15:13-14 *

motu: Peritome taravatuna danu e henia. Taunabunai, Abraham ese Isaak e havaraia, bona dina ihataurahanina ai e peritomea. Isaak ese danu Iakob e havaraia; bona Iakob ese eda iduhu ikwaradia taudia gwauta-raruosi e havaradia.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

motu: Hari iduhu ikwaradia taudia ese Iosef e vaḡeḡe henia, Aigupto taudia ediai e hoia. A Dirava ese e bamoa,
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

motu: bona ena hisihisi iboudiai amo e hamauria; hahenamo bona aonega danu e henia, Farao, Aigupto pavapavana, vairanai; bena Farao ese siahu e henia, Aigupto tanona bona iena ruma taudia baine lohiadia.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

motu: A doe be Aigupto idoinai bona Kanaan ai e vara, hisi ani bada danu; bena seneda e hitolodia maseva.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

motu: Iakob e kamaonai Aigupto na mai uitina, bena ia ese seneda e siaidia lao, nega gini-gunana.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

motu: Nega iharuana ai Iosef sibona ese kakana e hahedinarai henidia; bona Iosef besena haridia Farao danu e kamonai.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

motu: Bena Iosef ese gwau-kau e siaia, tamana Iakob bona varavarana iboudiai danu e vavedia, taunimanima hitu-ahui laima.
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

motu: Bena Iakob na Aigupto ela; unuseni ai e mase; bona seneda danu unuseni ai e mase.
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

motu: Bena Sekem e huadia lao, gara lalonai e atodia; una gara na Abraham ese Hamoro natuna edia amo silver monidia ai e hoia.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

motu: Dirava ena gwauhamata Abraham enai ihamomokanina negana e kahirakahira ai, taunimanima Aigupto ai vada e vara rohorohova bona e hutumava;
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

motu: ema bona pavapava idauna ta Aigupto vada e lohiaia; ia na asi dibana Iosef.
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

motu: Ia ese seneda e dibaḡanidia bona e hahisidia; bona e haduadia, natudia karukarudia bae negedia, bena bae mase.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

motu: Una negana ai Mose vara, raho-namo merona bena hua toi tamana ena ruma ai e ubua.
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

motu: Bena e negea; to Farao natuna kekenina ese e abia, natuna ai e haloa.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

motu: Taunabunai, Aigupto taudia edia aonega idoinai na Mose e hadibmaia; bena ena hereva bona ena ḡaukara na mai siahudia.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

motu: Ena laḡani e hari-ahui negana ai lalona vada e hadaia, varavarana Israel taudia baine igodia ita eto.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, + 7:23 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * the children of Israel.

motu: Tau ta e itaia, Aigupto tauna ese e hadikaia, bena e durua, Aigupto tauna e alaia mase.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

motu: Ia banava eto varavarana lalodia bae parara, Dirava ese ia imana amo baine hamauridia, to asi dibadia.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

motu: Kerukeru tatau rarua e heatuva ai dekediai e kau, bena ia ese e hamarumarudia toho, eto “Tatau e, umui raruosi na varavara; dahaka dainai o hahedika hehenimu?”
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

motu: A varavarana e hadikaiava tauna ese e doria oho, eto “Oi be daika ese emai lohia bona emai hahemaoro tauna ai vada e halaomu”?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

motu: O uramu bavalagu a, varani Aigupto tauna o alaia na heto?”
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’ + 7:28 Exodus 2:14 *

motu: Mose ese una hereva e kamonai, bena e heau ela, Midian tanona ai eha noho, unuseni ai natuna mamaruanedia rarua e havaradia.
english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

motu: Laḡani hari-ahui e ore, bena aneru ta ese tano ḡaḡaena ai, ororo ladana Sinai ai, e hahedinarai henia, au ḡiniḡini e arava hururuna lalonai.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

motu: Mose ese e itaia, bena e hoa. Itana totona e raka kahiva ai Lohiabada gadona ese e hereva henia, eto,
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

motu: Lau na tubumu tamamu edia Dirava; Abraham bona Isaak bona Iakob edia Dirava. Mose na e heude-heudle, au iraraitaona vada e gari.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ + 7:32 Exodus 3:6 * Moses trembled and dared not look.

motu: bena Lohiabada ese e hamaoloa, eto, Emu tamaka a daki oho, badina be o ginimu gabuna na tano helaḡana.
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

motu: Momokani, egu taunimanima Aigupto ai edia hisihisi vada na itaia, edia ḡanaḡana danu vada na kamonai, bena ihamauridia totona vada na diho nama. Harihari baina siaimu, Aigupto baola.
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’ + 7:34 Exodus 3:5,7-8,10 *

motu: Hari Mose na idia ese e ihi-ihiraia, eto “Daika ese emai lohia bona emai hahemaoro tauna ai vada e halaomu?”: Mose na bunai Dirava ese e siaia, edia lohia bona edia hahemaoro tauna ai vada e halaoa; bona au ginigini lalonai e itaia aneruna ese e durua.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

motu: Una tau ese e hakaudia lasi, hoa karadia bona toa danu e karava Aigupto ai bona Davara Kakakakana ai bona tano ḡaḡaena ai, laḡani hariahui lalodiai.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

motu: Una Mose ese danu Israel taudia e hamaorodia, eto, Dirava ese peroveta tauna ta do baine haginia umui emui ai, varavaramui edia amo, lau bamogu.
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’ + 7:37 TR adds “You shall listen to him.” * + 7:37 Deuteronomy 18:15 *

motu: Una tau danu tano ḡaḡaena ai hegogo lalonai, bona Sinai ororona dorina ai ia ida e hereva-hereva aneruna ida, bona ita seneda ida, e nohova. Ia ese mauri herevadia e abi, ita ma baine henida helaoreana.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

motu: A seneda na ia ikamonai-henina asie urava; e dadaraia, bona lalodia ai Aigupto ma e ura henia louva.
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

motu: Bona idia ese Aaron e hereva henia, eto “Dirava haida a karadia ita eda, ita vairadai bae raka; badina be asi dibada hari Mose, Aigupto amo e hakauda lasi tauna, na ede eha heto”.
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’ + 7:40 Exodus 32:1 *

motu: Una negana ai idia ese boromakau natuna laulauna ta e karaia, bena boubou ḡauna danu una kaivakuku vairanai e atoa; imadia ai e kara ḡaudia na e moalelaiva.
english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

motu: Bena Dirava na edia amo e raka oho, sibodia guba ḡaudia bae toma heni diho, peroveta taudia edia buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Israel taumui e, laḡani hari-ahui tano ḡaḡaena ai o alava boromakaudia bona boubou ḡaudia na vairagu ai o ato a?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, + 7:42 This idiom could also be translated “host of heaven”, or “angelic beings”, or “heavenly bodies.” * as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘ Did|strong="G2532" * you|strong="G1722" * offer|strong="G4374" * to|strong="G2532" * me|strong="G1473" * slain animals and|strong="G2532" * sacrifices|strong="G2378" * forty|strong="G5062" * years|strong="G2094" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * wilderness|strong="G2048" *, O house|strong="G3624" * of|strong="G2316" * Israel|strong="G2474" *?

motu: Lasi, Molok ena dabua dubuna, bona dirava ta ladana Refan ena hisiu, o loalaiva, laulaudia bunu o karava, ba toma henidia diho helaoreana. Babulon unukahana do baina laohaimui.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the|strong="G2532" * star of|strong="G2316" * your|strong="G2532" * god|strong="G2316" * Rephan|strong="G4481" *, the|strong="G2532" * figures|strong="G5179" * which|strong="G3739" * you|strong="G5210" * made|strong="G4160" * to|strong="G2532" * worship|strong="G4352" *, so|strong="G2532" * I|strong="G3739" * will|strong="G2316" * carry|strong="G3351" * you|strong="G5210" * away|strong="G3351" * + 7:43 Amos 5:25-27 * beyond|strong="G1900" * Babylon.’

motu: Dabua dubuna, taravatu ihahedinaraina ḡauna, na seneda ese tano ḡaḡaena ai e abia; e karaia Dirava ese Mose e haduaia bona Mose ese oromana e itaia heḡereḡerena.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

motu: Bona seneda haida, gabeai e vara taudia, ese ma e abia, Iosua negana ai e huaia mai, idau bese taudia edia tano iabina negana ai; unu idau bese taudia na Dirava ese seneda vairadia amo e luludia ohova, ema bona David negana.
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

motu: David ese Dirava ena hahenamo e abia, bona e noinoi, Iakob ena Dirava ena dubu baine karaia eto.
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

motu: To ena dubu ihaginina be Solomon.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Herea Mikamika na taunimanima imadia ese e karava rumadia ai se nohomu; peroveta tauna ena hereva heḡereḡerena eto,
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

motu: Lohiabada na e tomu, Guba be egu helai gabuna, Tanobada be aegu ihadaidia ḡauna, Ruma edehetomana ba karaia lauegu? Egu laḡa-ani gabuna be edena?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and|strong="G1161" * the|strong="G1161" * earth|strong="G1093" * a|strong="G2228" * footstool|strong="G5286" * for|strong="G1161" * my|strong="G1473" * feet|strong="G4228" *. What|strong="G5101" * kind|strong="G4169" * of|strong="G3624" * house|strong="G3624" * will|strong="G5101" * you|strong="G3004" * build|strong="G3618" * me|strong="G1473" *?’ says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G1161" * Lord|strong="G2962" *. ‘ Or|strong="G2228" * what|strong="G5101" * is|strong="G3588" * the|strong="G1161" * place|strong="G5117" * of|strong="G3624" * my|strong="G1473" * rest|strong="G2663" *?

motu: Ini ḡau iboudiai na imagu amo asina kara a?
english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’ + 7:50 Isaiah 66:1-2 *

motu: Aio auka taumui e, lalomui bona taiamui e kara asie peritomedia taudia na heheto, umui ese nega idoinai Lauma Helaḡa o laoa ahumu. Tamamui edia kara na umui ese danu doini o badinamu.
english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

motu: Peroveta tauna be daika umui senemui ese asie daḡedaḡe henia? Kara Maoromaoro Tauna maina e gwauraia gunava taudia na idia ese e aladia mase; harihari umui ese ia taona vada o torea, bona vada o alaia mase.
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

motu: Umui na aneru ese e heni taravatuna vada o abia, to asio badinaia. Stefano e hodoa mase
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

motu: Idia ese unu hereva e kamonai ai, e badu dikadika, gadigadidia danu e haheḡiri henia.
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

motu: A Stefano na Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohea; bena guba ai e gaga dae, Dirava hairaina e itaia, bona Iesu danu, Dirava idibana kahana ai gini.
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

motu: Bena ia eto, Guba na itaiamu, e hekehomu, Taunimanima Natuna danu na itaiamu, Dirava idibana kahana ai gini.
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

motu: Bena idia na e lolo badabada, bona taiadia e kodobe. Bena dekena e heau lao, e abia,
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

motu: hanua murimurinai e veria lasi, nadi amo e hodoa. Herarai taudia ese edia dabua na eregabe tauna ta, ladana Saulo, aena badibadinai e ato.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

motu: E hodoa negana ai Stefano e ḡuriḡuri, eto, Lohiabada Iesu e, lau laumagu na avabia dae.
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

motu: Bena e hetuitui, e lolo, eto, Lohiabada e, ina kara dika na davana-basio henidia. Unu e hereva toma, bena e mahuta.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

motu: Saulo ese Stefano iala-masena na e hanamoa. Una negana ai daḡedaḡe bada e vara, ekalesia oreana Ierusalem lalonai e daḡedaḡe henia, bona ekalesia taudia iboudiai e hakarohodia rohoroho, Iudea bona Samaria tanodia idoidiai; aposetolo mo sibodia e nohova.
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

motu: Dirava garina e gariva taudia haida ese Stefano e guria, bona taina e tai.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

motu: A Saulo ese ekalesia oreana e hadikaia rohoroho, ruma iboudiai lalodiai e raka vareai, tatau bona hahine e dabuidia lasi, dibura rumadia ai e koudia. Filipo Samaria ai e haroro
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

motu: E hakarohodia taudia na gabu idau-idau ela, sivarai namo e harorolaia.
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

motu: Filipo e diho ela, Samaria hanuana ta ai e lasi; bena ia ese hanua taudia na Keriso e harorolai henidia.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

motu: Hutuma ese Filipo e hakala henia, mai lalodia tamona; bona toa e kara danu e ita.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

motu: Badina be lauma dikadia ese e bolodia taudia edia amo lauma dikadia e lasi mai lolodia ida; pada taudia bona ae-hedairike taudia hutuma danu ia ese e hamauridia.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

motu: Bena una hanua lalonai moale bada e vara.
english: There was great joy in that city.

motu: A tau ta ladana be Simona; gunaguna una hanua lalonai babalau karadia e karava, hanua taudia e hahoadiava, e tomava ia sibona herea-mikamika tauna.
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai kikina badana ese e kamonai heniava; bona e tomava, Ina tau na Dirava ena Siahu Badana.
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

motu: Una dainai e kamonai heniava, badina be nega daudau ia ese ena babalau karadia e hahoalaidiava.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

motu: A Filipo ese Dirava ena basileia sivaraina namona bona Iesu Keriso ladana e harorolai matama, bena idia ese e abiabiraia. Bena ia ese e bapatisodia, tatau bona hahine.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

motu: Simona, babalau tauna, ese danu e abiabiraia; bena vada e bapatisoa; murinai Filipo vada e bamoa, iena toa bona hoa karadia e ita, bona e hoalai. Petro Ioane ida Samaria ela
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

motu: Aposetolo Ierusalem ai na Samaria taudia ese Dirava ena hereva e abia dae harina e kamonai; bena Petro bona Ioane e siaidia, Samaria baela.
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

motu: Raruosi e diho ela, bena e guriḡuri, Samaria taudia ese Lauma Helaḡa bae abia;
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

motu: badina be una negana ai Lauma Helaḡa idia ta latanai do se diho, bapatiso mo vada e henidia Lohiabada Iesu ladana ai.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

motu: Bena raruosi ese imadia na idia latadiai e ato kau; bena Lauma Helaḡa e abia.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

motu: Hari Simona ese aposetolo e itadia, imadia e ato kau, Lauma Helaḡa e heni; bena ia ese moni e dudui henidia, eto,
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

motu: Ina siahu ame henigu, bena latanai imagu baina ato kau tauna danu Lauma Helaḡa do baine abia.
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

motu: Bena Petro eto, Emu moni na oi ida ba dika hebou, badina be lalomu e tomu Dirava ena harihari ḡauna na moni amo ba hoia diba.
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

motu: Ina ḡaukara ai oi na asi ahumu, badina be lalomu na dia maoro Dirava vairanai.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

motu: Emu dika amo ba helalo kerehai, bona Lohiabada ba noia, bena reana emu lalo-hadai kererena baine gwaua tao.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

motu: Badina be vada na itamu, oi na auduna idita bona kara dika iḡuina ai noho.
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

motu: Bena Simona, babalau tauna, e haere, eto, Lohiabada na daigu ai ba noia, hari ome gwaurai ḡaudia ta egu ai basine kau.
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia raruosi ese Lohiabada ena hereva e gwaurai hedinarai bona e harorolai vaitani; bena Ierusalem e lou henia negana ai idia ese Samaria hanua maraḡidia momo lalodiai sivarai namo e harorolaia e laova. Afrika tauna bapatiso e abia
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

motu: Lohiabada ena aneru ta es Filipo e haduaia, eto, A tore isi, diho kahana aola, ela bona Ierusalem amo Gasa e laomu dalana, tano ḡaḡaena dalana.
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

motu: Bena e tore isi, vada ela. Afrika tauna ta, eunuko tauna bona dagi badana tauna, Etiopia pavapavana hahinena ena kohu ireḡuna tauna, Ierusalem ela, toma-diho totona.
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

motu: Ena hanua ilou-henina ai, ena kariota ai helaina ai Isaia peroveta tauna ena buka e duahiava.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

motu: Bena Lauma ese Filipo e haduaia, eto, Aola, una kariota ai ba gui.
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

motu: Bena Filipo e heau lao, e kamonai, Isaia peroveta tauna ena buka e duahiava. Bena eto, O duahiamu ḡauna anina mai dibamu a?
english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

motu: Ia e haere, eto, Be, ede baina diba toma? Lau na asi ihakaugu. Bena ia es Filipo e noia, baine gui, dekenai baine helai.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

motu: E duahia karoana lalonai ini e torea toma: Mamoe na heto e hakaua lao, e alaia mase; Bena mamoe natuna huina iabina tauna vairanai e mumu na heto ia na asi reḡereḡena;
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “ He|strong="G2532" * was|strong="G1510" * led as|strong="G5613" * a|strong="G5613" * sheep|strong="G4263" * to|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * slaughter|strong="G4967" *. As|strong="G5613" * a|strong="G5613" * lamb before|strong="G1909" * his|strong="G1909" * shearer|strong="G2751" * is|strong="G1510" * silent, so|strong="G3779" * he|strong="G2532" * doesn’ t|strong="G3588" * open his|strong="G1909" * mouth|strong="G4750" *.

motu: E hahemanau dainai hahemaoro danu ena amo e abia oho. Ena uru daika es baine gwauraia? Badina be ena mauri na tanobada amo vada e abia oho.
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who|strong="G5101" * will|strong="G5101" * declare|strong="G1334" * His|strong="G1722" * generation|strong="G1074" *? For|strong="G3754" * his|strong="G1722" * life|strong="G2222" * is|strong="G3588" * taken from|strong="G3588" * the|strong="G1722" * earth|strong="G1093" *.” + 8:33 Isaiah 53:7,8 *

motu: Eunuko tauna es Filipo e nanadaia, eto, Mani emu kara a hamaorogu: peroveta tauna ese daika unu e herevalaia toma? Ia sibona eiava idau tauna e herevalaia a?
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

motu: Bena Filipo es una karoa amo e haroro henia matama, Iesu sivaraina namona e hadibalaia.
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

motu: Raruosi dala amo ela bona ranu gabuna ta ai e kau. Bena eunuko tauna eto, A itaia, ranu binai. Dahaka es ibapatisogu e laoa ahumu?
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

motu: Filipo eto, Boma kamonai mai lalomu idoinai, ibapatisomu hari namo. Bena ia na e haere, eto, Name kamonai lava dae Iesu Keriso be Dirava Natuna.
english: + 8:37 TR adds Philip said, “If you believe with all your heart, you may.” He answered, “I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.” *

motu: Bena e hamaoroa, kariota baine haginia. Bena raruosi ranu ai e diho; Filipo ese eunuko tauna vada e bapatisoa.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

motu: Raruosi ua ranu amo e dae kau ai Lohiabada Laumana ese Filipo vada e abia olio; eunuko tauna ese se itaia lou, a dala amo e laova mai moalena ida.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

motu: A Filipo na Asoto ai eha kau. Bena ena laolao ai e raka vareaiva hanuadia iboudiai lalodiai sivarai namo e harololaiava, ela bona Kaisarea ai eha kau.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

motu: Saulo ena ḡosi idoinai Lohiabada ibadinana taudia ihagaridia bona ialadia. Bena ela, hahelaḡa tauna badana dekenai,
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

motu: e noia, revareva baine henia, Damasko dubudia edia; bena Iesu ibadinana taudia haida unuseni ai bema ha davaridia, tatau eiava hahine, bema ḡuidia, bena mai iḡuidia ida bema loulaidia Ierusalem ai.
english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

motu: Bena laona ai vada ela bona Damasko e kahira-kahira, diari ta guba amo e tara dagu, e ḡeḡea ahu.
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

motu: Bena ia na tano ai e hekida diho, gado ta e kamonai, eto, Saulo e, Saulo e, dahaka dainai o daḡedaḡe henigumu?
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “\+w Saul|strong="G4549"\+w*, \+w Saul|strong="G4549"\+w*, \+w why|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w do|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w persecute|strong="G1377"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*?” *

motu: Ia e haere, eto, Lohiabada e, oi na daika? Ia eto, Lau na Iesu, o daḡedaḡe henigumu.
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The|strong="G1161" * Lord|strong="G2962" * said|strong="G3004" *, “\+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w Jesus|strong="G2424"\+w*, \+w whom|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w persecuting|strong="G1377"\+w*. * + 9:5 TR adds “It’s hard for you to kick against the cattle prods.” *

motu: A tore isi, hanua ai ba raka vareai; bena baina hamaoromui ede ba kara toma.
english: \+w But|strong="G2532"\+w* * + 9:6 TR omits “But” * \+w rise|strong="G1163"\+w* \+w up|strong="G1210"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w enter|strong="G1525"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w city|strong="G4172"\+w*, \+w then|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w will|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w told|strong="G2980"\+w* \+w what|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w must|strong="G1163"\+w* \+w do|strong="G4160"\+w*.” *

motu: E bamoa taudia iboudiai e gini, asi regeregedia; badina be gado ta e kamonai, to tau ta asie itaia.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

motu: Bena Saulo na tano amo e tore isi, matana e noga, a ḡau ta se itaia. Bena idia ese imana ai e abi, Damasko e hakaua lao.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

motu: Bena unuseni ai boi toi e noho, matana asie papava, aniani se aniva, ranu se inuva.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

motu: Iesu ibadinana tauna ta Damasko ai, ladana na Anania. Mata hanai ai Lohiabada ese e hereva henia, eto, Anania e! Ia e haere, eto, Lohiabada e, lau o ina.
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” * He|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ Behold|strong="G2400" *, it|strong="G2532" *’ s|strong="G2962" * me|strong="G1473" *, Lord|strong="G2962" *.”
