motu: Bena Lohiabada ese e haduaia, eto, A tore isi, ariara ladana “Maoro” aola, Iuda ena ruma lalonai Taso tauna ta ladana na Saulo ba ha tahua; badina be ia na e ḡuriḡurimu.
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w go|strong="G4198"\+w* \+w to|strong="G4314"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w street|strong="G4505"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w called|strong="G2564"\+w* \+w Straight|strong="G2117"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w inquire|strong="G2212"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w house|strong="G3614"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Judah|strong="G2455"\+w* * + 9:11 or, Judas * \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w one|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w named|strong="G3686"\+w* \+w Saul|strong="G4569"\+w*, \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* man \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Tarsus|strong="G5018"\+w*. \+w For|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w praying|strong="G4336"\+w*, *

motu: Ia be mata hanaina ai tau ta ladana Anania vada e itaia, e raka vareai, imana ia latanai e ato kau, matana baine hapapa helaoreana.
english: \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w vision|strong="G3705"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w has|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w seen|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* man \+w named|strong="G3686"\+w* Ananias \+w coming|strong="G1525"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w laying|strong="G2007"\+w* \+w his|strong="G2007"\+w* \+w hands|strong="G5495"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3708"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G3704"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w might|strong="G2532"\+w* receive \+w his|strong="G2007"\+w* \+w sight|strong="G3705"\+w*.” *

motu: Anania e haere, eto, Lohiabada e, una tau harina vada na kamonai, taunimanima hutuma ese e piua, emu helaḡa taudia Ierusalem ai vada e hadikadia bada.
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

motu: Iniseni ai danu, hahelaḡa taudia ese siahu vada e henia, e hahanemumu taudia iboudiai baine ḡuidia.
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

motu: Bena Lohiabada eto, Vada aola; badina be lau ese vada name abia hidi, bese idau-idau taudia bona hanua pavapavadia bona Israel taudia vairadiai lau ladagu baine gwauraia.
english: But the Lord said to him, “\+w Go|strong="G4198"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2962"\+w* \+w way|strong="G4198"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w chosen|strong="G1589"\+w* \+w vessel|strong="G4632"\+w* \+w to|strong="G4314"\+w* \+w bear|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w* \+w before|strong="G1799"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w nations|strong="G1484"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w kings|strong="G3588"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w children|strong="G5207"\+w* \+w of|strong="G5207"\+w* \+w Israel|strong="G2474"\+w*. *

motu: Badina be do baina hadibaia, ia ese lau ladagu dainai hisi diaḡau do baine ani.
english: \+w For|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w show|strong="G5263"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w how|strong="G3745"\+w* \+w many|strong="G3745"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w he|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w must|strong="G1163"\+w* \+w suffer|strong="G3958"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w name|strong="G3686"\+w*’s \+w sake|strong="G5228"\+w*.” *

motu: Bena Anania ela, ruma lalonai eha raka vareai, imana ruaosi Saulo latanai e ato kau, eto, Tadigu Saulo e, Lohiabada Iesu, dala ai emu ai e hedinarai tauna, ese e siaigu, malamu bae papa bona Lauma Helaḡa bavabia totona.
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

motu: Bena ḡau haida, una-una na heheto, matana amo e moru, bona matana e papa. Bena e tore isi, bapatiso e abia.
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

motu: Bena e aniani, tauna e goada lou. Dina haida Damasko ai e nohova, Iesu ibadinana taudia dekediai.
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several|strong="G5100" * days|strong="G2250" * with|strong="G3326" * the|strong="G1722" * disciples|strong="G3101" * who|strong="G3588" * were|strong="G3588" * at|strong="G1722" * Damascus|strong="G1154" *.

motu: Asi vanahana, dubu lalodiai Iesu e harorolaiava, e tomava ia na Dirava Natuna.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

motu: E kamonai taudia iboudiai vada e hoa; eto, Ina na Iesu ladana ihatona taudia Ierusalem ai e hadikadiava tauna ani? Bona iniseni ai danu ma baine guidia, hahelaḡa taudia dekedia baine laohaidia, totona ema ani?
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

motu: A Saulo na ena siahu e bada e laova, bona Iesu e harorolaiava, ia na momokani Keriso. Una negana ai Iuda taudia Damasko ai e nohova na asi edia haere dalana. Saulo na Damasko e heautania
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

motu: Nega taina vada e daudau; bena Iuda taudia e henega, Saulo ialamasena dalana e herevalaia.
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

motu: To Saulo be edia henega dibana. Idia na hanua ikoukoudia iboudiai e bani heni boiva e bani heni raniva, ia ialamasena totona.
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

motu: To Iesu ibadinana taudia ese hanuaboi ai e abia, bosea ai e udaia, maḡu gaba-matuna amo e tua dobi. Saulo Ierusalem ai
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

motu: Ia na Ierusalem ai e gini dae, Iesu ibadinana taudia ida bae hebou eto; to iboudiai ese e gari heniava, lalodia asie parara ia ese danu Iesu vada e abiabiraia.
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

motu: To Banaba ese e durua, aposetolo dekedia e hakaua lao; e hamaorodia, eto, Ia ese dala ai Lohiabada e itaia, bona Lohiabada ese e hereva henia, bena Damasko ai ia ese Iesu ladana e halorolaia goadagoada.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

motu: Bena Saulo na idia ida e nohova Ierusalem ai; e raka vareaiva, e raka lasiva, bona Lohiabada ladana ai e haroro goadagoadava.
english: He was with them entering into + 9:28 TR and NU add “and going out” * Jerusalem,

motu: Bona Helene gado ai e herevava taudia ida e hereva-herevava bona e hapapahuahuva; a idia ese ia iala-masena dalana e tahuava.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. + 9:29 TR and NU omit “Jesus” and reverse the order of verses 28 & 29. * He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, + 9:29 The Hellenists were Hebrews who used Greek language and culture. * but they were seeking to kill him.

motu: Varavara e diba; bena idia ese e hakaua lasi, Kaisarea ela; unua amo Taso e siaia lao. Ekalesia oreadia e tubu
english: When the brothers + 9:30 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

motu: Una negana ai Iudea tanona idoinai, bona Galilea bona Samaria ai danu, ekalesia oreadia ese maino vada e abia, bona e goada e laova; Lohiabada garina e gariva bona Lauma Helaḡa ese taudia e halodia, e hahutumadiava danu. Petro eha laolao
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

motu: Petro na hanua hanua e rakadia hanai ela bona Luda ai e kau, helaḡa taudia dekediai e nohova.
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

motu: Unuseni ai pada tauna ta e davaria, ladana Aenea; ia na laḡani taurahani vada e hekureva.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

motu: Bena Petro ese e hereva henia, eto, Aenea e, Iesu Keriso ese e hamaurimumu; emu geda a lokua. Bena vada e tore isi.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

motu: Luda bona Saron taudia iboudiai ese e itaia; bena Lohiabada e haḡerea.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

motu: Iopa ai Iesu ibadinana hahinena ta e nohova, ladana na Tabita (ladana ihaheḡereḡerena Helene gado ai be “Doreka”). Ia ese kara namodia bona hebogahisi karadia e goadalaiva dina idoidiai.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. + 9:36 “Dorcas” is Greek for “Gazelle.” * This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

motu: A una negana ai ia na e gorerea, bona e mase. Idia ese tauna e huria, bena atai daiutuna ta ai e atoa.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

motu: Luda bona lopa padadia na dia daudau; taunabunai Iesu ibadinana taudia e kamonai Petro na Luda ai noho, idia ese tatau rarua e siaidia ia dekenai, bae noia, baeto “Ai dekemai aoma, basio halahe”.
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men + 9:38 Reading from NU, TR; MT omits “two men” * to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

motu: Petro na e tore isi, idia ida ela. E gini dae, bena idia ese atai daiutuna ai e hakaua dae. Hahine vadodia iboudiai na unuseni ai mai taidia ida gigini. Bena hahedoki bona hetaru dabuadia iboudiai Doreka ese maurina ai e turiva na e haheitalaia.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

motu: Bena Petro ese iboudiai e doridia lasi. Bena e hetuitui, e ḡuriḡuri. Bena ia ese mase hahinena e haḡerea, eto, Tabita e, a tore isi. Bena matana e noga, Petro e itaia, e helai tore.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

motu: Bena Petro ese imana ai e abi, e haginia tore. Bena helaḡa taudia bona vado hahinedia e boiridia, mai maurina ida e henidia.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

motu: Una kara harina na Iopa idoinai e piua, bena hutuma ese Lohiabada e abiabiraia.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

motu: Petro na nega taina daudau Iopa ai e nohova, boromakau kopidia iseudia tauna ta, ladana Simona, dekena ai.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

motu: Tau ta ladana na Korenelio, Kaisarea ai e nohova, Italia taudia edia tuari oreana biaguna.
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

motu: Ia na Dirava ibadinana tauna; ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida Dirava garina e gariva. Ia danu ogoḡami taudia e harihari henidia badabadava; bona nega iboudiai Dirava e ḡuriava.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

motu: Dina gelona ta ai vada e mata hanai, Dirava ena aneru ta e itaia, ienai e kau, ladana e hatoa, eto, Korenelio e!
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, + 10:3 3:00 p.m. * he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

motu: Bena ia ese aneru e raraia tao mai garina ida, eto, Lohiabada e, dahaka? Aneru ma eto, Emu ḡuriḡuri bona emu harihari ḡaudia danu Dirava vairanai vada e dae, bona ia ese e lalo taomu.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G1519" * him|strong="G3588" *, “ Your|strong="G2962" * prayers|strong="G4335" * and|strong="G2532" * your|strong="G2962" * gifts|strong="G1654" * to|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G2532" * needy have|strong="G2532" * gone up|strong="G1519" * for|strong="G1519" * a|strong="G1096" * memorial|strong="G3422" * before|strong="G1715" * God|strong="G2316" *.

motu: Harihari memero haida lopa ba siaidia lao, Simona, ladana ta be Petro, bae ha vavea.
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

motu: Ia na Simona, boromakau kopidia iseudia tauna, dekena ai e nohomu; ena ruma na kone ai.
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside. + 10:6 TR adds “This one will tell you what it is necessary for you to do.” *

motu: E hereva henia aneruna ese e rakatania; bena ia ese ena hesiai memerodia rarua e boiridia, bona tuari tauna ta danu, Dirava ibadinana bona nega idoinai Korenelio isiaina e lao heniva tauna.
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

motu: Hereva idoidiai ia ese e hamaorolaidia, bena e siaidia, lopa ela.
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

motu: Kerukeru, idia na dounu dala ai, hanua vada e kahikahi. Dina tubua ai, Petro be ruma guhina ai e dae kau, ḡuriḡuri totona.
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

motu: Bena e hitoloa; baine aniani eto. To idia e nanaduva ai, ia vada e mata hanai;
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

motu: guba e itaia, e parara, bona ḡau ta, dabua bada-hereana na heto, daigunina hani vada e tua dobi;
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

motu: Ialonai be mauri ḡaudia loḡora iboudiai, e rakamu gaudia, e raumu ḡaudia, bona atai ai e rohomu manudia, iboudiai e uda.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

motu: Bena ere ta ienai e kau; eto, Petro e, a tore isi, avaladia, bavani.
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, \+w Peter|strong="G4074"\+w*, \+w kill|strong="G2380"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w eat|strong="G2068"\+w*!” *

motu: Petro e haere, eto, Lohiabada e, lasi vaitani; ḡau dikadia bona mai helaḡadia na asina animu ema bona hari.
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

motu: Ere ma e kau, eto, Dirava ese vada e haḡoevadia ḡaudia na basioto didika.
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “\+w What|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w cleansed|strong="G2511"\+w*, \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w must|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w not|strong="G3361"\+w* \+w call|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w unclean|strong="G2840"\+w*.” *

motu: Hatoi unu e kara toma, bena ḡauna na guba ai e abia dae lou.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

motu: Petro ese mata hanaina ai e itaia ḡauna anina e daradaralaiava ai, Korenelio ena hesiai taudia e kau, Simona ena ruma e tahua, ema bona iduara ai e gini.
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

motu: E boiboi, eto, Simona, e nemaia Petro, na iniseni ai e nohomu eiava?
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

motu: Petro na mata hanaina ai e itaia ḡauna dounu e laloava ai, Lauma ese e hamaoroa, eto, Tatau tatoi e tahumumu;
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three + 10:19 Reading from TR and NU. MT omits “three” * men seek you.

motu: a tore isi, a diho, idia ida baola, basio daradara; badina be lau ese vada na siaidia.
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

motu: Bena Petro vada e diho, tatau tatoiosi dekediai; bena eto, O tahuamu tauna na lau; dahaka dainai umui oma?
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

motu: Idia e haere, eto, Korenelio, tuari oreana ta biaguna, kara maoromaoro bona Dirava garina e garimu tauna, bona harina danu namo Iuda taudia bogaragidiai tauna, aneru helaḡana ese Dirava ena hahedua e henia, eto, baine vavemu, ena ruma baola, emu hereva baine kamonai.
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

motu: Bena Petro ese e abidia dae, ruma ai e mahuta. Daba ai e tore isi, idia ida e raka, bona ia bamona haida lopa amo ia ida ela.
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. motu: Kerukeru idia na Kaisarea ai e kau. Korenelio ese e naridiava, bena ia ese varavarana bona turana e vavedia, bae hebou.
english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

motu: Petro e dae kau; bena Korenelio na ia ida e hedavari, aena badinai e goru diho, e toma henia diho.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

motu: Petro ese e veria tore, eto, A gini tore; lau danu taunimanima mo.
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

motu: Bena e raka vareai, ia ida e hereva-hereva, bona e hebou taudia hutuma e davaridia.
english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

motu: Bena ia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Dibamui Iuda tauna na idau bese tauna ida bae noho hebou eiava baine igoa ita na mai taravatuna. To Dirava ese vada e hadibagu tau ta basina gwauraia dika eiava helaḡa.
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

motu: Badina bunai o vavegu negana ai na nama, asina gwau edeede. Taunabunai na henanadaimu, dahaka dainai o vavegu?
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

motu: Korenelio e haere, eto, Dina hani vada ela, lau na egu ruma ai na ḡuriguri, dina ḡelona ai. Bena tau ta dabuana na hururu-hururu vairagu ai e gini,
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, + 10:30 3:00 p.m. * I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

motu: eto “Korenelio e, Dirava ese emu ḡuriḡuri vada e kamonai, bona emu harihari karadia danu e lalo taomu;
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

motu: taunabunai gwaukau lopa ba siaia lao, Simona, e nemaia Petro, ba vavea; ia na Simona, boromakau kopidia iseudia tauna ena ruma ai e nohomu, kone ai”.
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

motu: Bena gwaukau dekemu na siaia vasi haraḡa-haraḡa; vada oma dainai na hanamomumu. Ai iboumai ai iniseni ai Dirava vairanai vada ame hebou, Lohiabada ese vada e haḡanilaimu herevadia baia kamonai a tomu.
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

motu: Bena Petro vada e hereva matama, eto, Vada name diba momokani Dirava ese taunimanima oromadia se lalomu,
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

motu: a bese iboudiai lalodiai ia garina e garimu bona kara maoromaoro e karamu tauna na ia ese e lalo namo heniamu.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

motu: Ena hereva vada dibamui: herevana ia ese e siaia Israel taudia dekedia ai, maino sivaraina namona Iesu Keriso, taunimanima iboudiai edia Lohiabada, bagunai e gwauraia.
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

motu: Dibamui danu una hereva na Galilea ai e gwauraia matama, Ioane ese e harorolaiava bapatisona murinai, ema bona Iudea kahana idoinai e gwauraia.
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

motu: Hereva na Iesu, tau Nasaret, herevana: Dirava ese Lauma Helaḡa bona siahu e horolaia; bena ia na eha loava, kara namodia e karava, Diabolo ese e hadikadiava taudia iboudiai e hamauridiava; badina be Dirava ese e bamoava.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

motu: Ḡau idoidiai ia ese Iuda tanona ai bona Ierusalem ai e karava, ai danu dibamai. Idia ese au dorina ai e taua dae, e alaia mase.
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also + 10:39 TR omits “also” * killed, hanging him on a tree.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai Dirava ese e hatorea isi bona e hahedinaraia;
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

motu: dia taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, to Dirava ese e abimai hidi guna, baia gwauraia hedinarai helaoreana, taumai vairamai ai. Taumai bini, e tore isi lou murinai ia ida a anianiva, a inuinuva.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

motu: Ia ese danu e haduamai, taunimanima vairadiai baia harorolaia bona baia gwauraia hedinarai, Dirava ese vada e abia hidi, mauri taudia bona mase taudia ihahemaorohenidia tauna ai vada e halaoa.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

motu: Peroveta taudia iboudiai ese danu vada e gwauraia hedinaraiva, e tomava bae abidadama henia taudia iboudiai edia kara dika bae hegwau tao, ia ladana dainai.
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

motu: Petro na dounu e herevava ai, Lauma Helaḡa ese hereva e kamonai taudia iboudiai latadiai e diho.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

motu: Bena Iuda taudia, Iesu e badinaia bona Petro e bamoa taudia, na e hoa, badina be Lauma Helaḡa na idau bese taudia latadiai vada e seia dobi.
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

motu: Badina be e kamonai, idia na gado idau-idau ai e hereva, bona Dirava e imodaia. Bena Petro eto,

english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

motu: Bena ia na e hahedua, Iesu Keriso ladana ai bae bapatisodia. Bena idia ese e noia, dina haida idia dekediai baine noho.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

motu: Aposetolo bona varavara Iudea ai e kamonai idau bese taudia ese Dirava ena hereva e abia daeva.
english: Now the apostles and the brothers + 11:1 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

motu: Taunabunai, Petro na Ierusalem ai e dara dae negana ai na peritome ibadinana taudia ese e hepapahuahu henia,

motu: Bena Petro ese sivarai idoinai e hamaorolaidia, matamana amo ela bona dokona.

english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

motu: A ere na nega iharuana guba amo ema, eto “Dirava ese vada e haḡoevadia ḡaudia na basioto didika”.
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘\+w What|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w has|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w cleansed|strong="G2511"\+w*, don’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w call|strong="G2840"\+w* \+w unclean|strong="G2840"\+w*.’ *

motu: Hatoi unu e kara toma, bena unu ḡau idoidiai guba ai ma e veri dae lou.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

motu: Una negana ai tatau tatoi vada e gini dae, ai a noho heniava rumana ai; Kaisarea amo tau ta ese dekegu e siaidia mai.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

motu: Bena Lauma ese e haduagu, lau na idia ida baiala, basina daradara. Varavarada tauratoiosi bini lau e bamogu, ala, hari tau ena ruma ai a raka vareai.
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

motu: Bena ia ese e hamaoromai eto ia ese anelu ta e itaia, ena ruma lalonai e gini, bena eto “Gwaukau Iopa ba siaia lao, Simona, a nemaia Petro, bae ha vavea;
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

motu: ia ese hereva momokanidia baine gwaurai, oi bona emu rwna taudia ihamaurilaimui”.
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

motu: Egu heleva na matamaia, bena Lauma Helaḡa na idia latadiai vada e diho, gunaguna ita latadai e diho heḡereḡerena.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

motu: Bena Lohiabada ena hereva na helalolaia une, eto “Ioane ese ranu e bapatisolaimui, a lau ese Lauma Helaḡa do baina bapatisolaimui”.
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘\+w John|strong="G2491"\+w* \+w indeed|strong="G3303"\+w* baptized \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w water|strong="G5204"\+w*, \+w but|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2962"\+w* \+w be|strong="G3588"\+w* baptized \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w Holy|strong="G4151"\+w* \+w Spirit|strong="G4151"\+w*.’ *

english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

motu: Idia ese unu hereva e kamonai, vada asi reḡereḡedia e noho. Bena Dirava e imodaia, eto, Benaini, idau bese taudia danu Dirava ese vada e hahelalodia kerehai, mauri baine henidia helaoreana. Ekalesia oreana e vara Antioka ai
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

motu: Stefano ena mase negana daḡedaḡena ese e hakarohodia taudia na Foenikia bona Kupro bona Antioka vada ela, Iuda taudia mo sivarai namo e harorolai henidia.
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

motu: A idia haida be Kupro bona Kurene taudia; bena Antioka ai e kau negana ai idia ese Helene taudia danu e hereva henidia, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso sivaraina namona e harorolai henidia.

english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

motu: Banaba e gini dae Antioka ai, Dirava ena harihari-bada e itaia, bena e moale bada, bona iboudiai e sisiba henidia, Lohiabada na bae badinaia mai lalodia idoidiai ida.
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

motu: Badina be ia na tau namona, Lauma Helaḡa ai bona abidadama ai e honuhonu dae. Una negana ai Lohiabada ibadinana taudia vada e hutuma e laova.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

motu: Bena Banaba e tore isi, Taso ela, Saulo itahuna;
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

motu: e davaria, bena Antioka e hakaua lao. Unuseni ai idia raruosi na laḡani ta ekalesia ida e hebouva, bona hutuma e hadibadiava. Una negana ai Iesu ibadinana taudia e nemaidia “Christian”; una hereva na Antioka ai e vara.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

motu: Una negana ai peroveta taudia haida Ierusalem amo ela Antioka.
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

motu: Ta ladana be Agabo. Lauma ese e hadibaia dainai ia ese doe badana harina e piua guna, tanobada idoinai baine vara eto. Doe na Klaudio negana ai e vara.
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

motu: Taunabunai, Iesu ibadinana taudia iboudiai e lalo hadai, eto idia ta ta ena kohu ena kohu e abi heḡereḡeredia, edia harihari ḡauna bae siaia lao, varavara Iudea ai e nohova edia.
english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

motu: Unu e kara toma, bena Banaba bona Saulo e siailaidia, ekalesia oreana itataona taudia bae henidia.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

motu: Una negana ai King Herod ese ekalesia taudia haida e dabaidia tao, baine hadikadia eto.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

motu: Iakobo, Ioane kakana, na ia ese dare amo e alaia mase.
english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

motu: Bena ia ese Iuda taudia e itadia, idia ese una kara e moalelaia; bena Petro danu ma e dabaia tao. Una na Flaoa-asie-hatubua Ariana dinadia ai.
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

motu: E dabaia tao, dibura rumana ai e koua; bona tuari taudia gwauta-tauratoi e gwauraidia hidi, hahani hahani amo bae gimaia. Ena lalo-hadai be Lagau-hanai Ariana murinai hanua taudia vairadiai baine hakaua lasi eto.
english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

motu: Taunabunai, Petro be dibura rumana ai e gimaiava; a ekalesia taudia ese Dirava e noia goadagoada Petro ena. Aneru ese Petro e hamauria
english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

motu: Herod ese baine hakaua lasi eto; bena una hanuaboi ai Petro na tuari taudia rarua ihuadiai e mahutava, mai iḡuina gadeadia danu rua. Hegima taudia danu dibura rumana iduarana vairanai e gima.
english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

motu: Bena Lohiabada ena aneru ta badibadinai e gini, diari ese danu daiutu e hadiaria. Aneru ese Petro ohena e pataia, e haoa, eto, A tore isi haraḡa-haraḡa. Bena gadea na imana ruaosi amo e moru.
english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

motu: Hari aneru ese ma e haduaia, eto, Emu rami a rioa, emu tamaka a ḡui. Bena unu e kara toma. Aneru ma eto, Emu dabua a hetarulaia, murigu ai ba raka.
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

motu: Petro e raka lasi, hari aneru e ḡavaia; to e daradara, hari aneru ena kara na momokani eiava; ia banava e mata hanai eto.
english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

motu: Hegima taudia gini-gunana bona iharuana raruosi ese vada e rakadia hanai, bena auri ikoukouna amo e lasi, hanua ilasi-henina ikoukouna. Hari ikoukou na sibona idia vairadiai vada e hekeho hata, bona raruosi e raka lasi, ariara ta amo e raka hanai. Bena hari aneru ese e rakatania.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

motu: Bena Petro lalona e parara, eto, Harihari name diba momokani, Lohiabada ese ena aneru vada e siaia, Herod imana amo bona Iuda taudia e larova karadia iboudiai amo vada eme hamaurigu.
english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

motu: Lalona e hadaia, bena Maria ena ruma ela: una Maria na Ioane Mareko sinana. Unuseni ai taunimanima hutuma e hebouva, e ḡuriḡuriva.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

motu: Bena Petro na iduara ai vada e pidipidi. Bena kekeni ta, ladana Roda, na ikehona ela;
english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

motu: a Petro gadona dibana, bena ena moale bada dainai iduara se kehoa, to e heau vareai, e hamaorodia, Petro na iduara murinai gini.
english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

motu: Idia ese ia e gwau henia, eto, Oi na e kavamu a? A ia na e hereva goadagoada, eto, Lasi, na gwau momokanimu. Idia eto, Una na readia ia laulauna.
english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

motu: A Petro na e pidipidi loulou, ela bona idia ese iduara e kehoa, e itaia, vada e hoa bou.
english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

motu: Bena ia ese imana amo e taodia ahu, asi reḡerḡedia bae noho; bena Lohiabada ese dibura rumana amo e hakaua lasi sivaraina e hamaorolaidia. Bena ma eto, Iakobo bona varavarada na ba hamaorodia. Bena e rakatanidia, idau gabu ela.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

motu: Daba e rere, heloḡo-heloḡo dia maraḡi tuari taudia bogaragidiai e vara, Petro na ede ela heloḡo-heloḡona.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

motu: Herod ese e tahua, to se davaria. Bena hegima taudia e nanadaidia murinai e gwau isi, bae hakaudia lasi, bae aladia mase. Bena Iudea e rakatania, e diho, Kaisarea ela, unuseni ai eha noho. Herod e mase
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

motu: Herod ese Turo mai Sidono taudia e badu henidia dikadika; una dainai idia iboudiai lalodia e hatamonaia, bena dekena ela. Idia ese Ḡaubada ena mahuta daiutuna ita-taona tauna, ladana Blasto, e hamarumarua guna; murinai herohemaino e gwauraia, badina be Ḡaubada ena tano amo edia tano taudia ese aniani e abiva.
english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

motu: Bena e gwauraia hidi dinana ai, Herod ese pavapava dabuadia e doki, hahemaoro teronona ai e helai kau, e haroro henidia matama.
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

motu: Bena hanua taudia e lolo, eto, Ena na dirava ta gadona, dia taunimanima gadona.
english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

motu: Una negana ai Lohiabada ena aneru ta ese e huaria, badina be ia ese Dirava se heatolaia. Bena gaigai-gaigai ese tau-anina e ania, vada e mase vaitani.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

motu: A Dirava ena hereva vada e tubu badabada.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

motu: Bena Banaba bona Saulo ese edia ḡaukara e ha-orea, bena Ierusalem e rakatania, e lou ela; Ioane Mareko danu e hakaua lao, idia ida vada ela.
english: Barnabas and Saul returned to + 12:25 TR reads “from” instead of “to” * Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

motu: Ekalesia oreana Antioka lalonai be mai edia peroveta bona hahediba taudia haida. Ladadia bini: Banaba; Simeon Nigera; Lukio, tau Kurene; Manaen (ia na Herod Ḡaubada ida e ubua hebou tauna); bona Saulo.
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

motu: Idia ese Lohiabada e toma henia dihova bona e anivagava negana ai, Lauma Helaḡa ese e haduadia, eto, Banaba Saulo ida a hahelaḡadia lauegu, badina be ḡaukara ta ikarana vada na abidia hidi.
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia na e anivaga bona e ḡuriḡuri, bena imadia na raruosi latadiai e ato kau, bena e kahudia nege.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

motu: Lauma Helaḡa ese unu e siaidia toma dainai raruosi ela bona kone amo e lasi, Seleukia ai, unua amo Kupro e heau lao.
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

motu: Salami ai eha heau kau, unuseni ai Dirava ena hereva Iuda taudia edia dubu lalodiai vada e harorolaia matama. Ioane danu idia raruosi e durudia. Banaba bona Saulo Kupro ai
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

motu: Idia ese una motumotu e rakaia hanai ela bona Pafo. Unuseni ai babalau bona peroveta koikoi tauna ta e davaria, Iuda tauna, ladana na Bariesu;
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

motu: ia na gavana launa, Seregio Paulo, dekenai e nohova. Una gavana be lalo-parara tauna: ia ese Banaba bona Saulo e boiridia, e ura henidia, Dirava ena hereva bae hamaorolaia.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

motu: A hari babalau tauna, Eluma (ia ladana ihaheḡereḡerena bunai), ese raruosi e gwaudia tubu; ena ura be gavana ese edia hereva basine abi dae.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

motu: A Saulo (ia ladana ta danu Paulo) na Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohea, bena ia ese Eluma e raraia tao, eto,
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

motu: Oi na koikoi bona dika idoinai ese e hahonumumu, diabolo natuna, kara maoromaoro iboudiai o inai henimumu; Lohiabada ena dala maoromaorodia ihagagevadia basio hadokoa a?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

motu: A kamonai: Lohiabada ese imana na oi latamu ai be atoamu ina harihari; bena matamu bae kepulu, dina basio itaia ela bona nega ta. Una negana ai ḡahu bona dibura ese e hakepulua; benal e loa eva-eva, taunimanima e noidia, ia imana ai bae abi, bae hakaua.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately|strong="G3916" * a|strong="G2532" * mist and|strong="G2532" * darkness|strong="G4655" * fell|strong="G4098" * on|strong="G1909" * him|strong="G3588" *. He|strong="G2532" * went|strong="G2532" * around|strong="G1909" * seeking|strong="G2212" * someone to|strong="G2532" * lead|strong="G1510" * him|strong="G3588" * by|strong="G1909" * the|strong="G2532" * hand|strong="G5495" *.

motu: E vara ḡauna na gavana ese e itaia, bena Lohiabada ena hahediba herevadia e abi dae bona e hoalai. Paulo mai bamona ida Asia ai
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

motu: Paulo mai bamona ida ese Pafo e heautania, Peregaai e diho: una na Pamfulia tanona ai. Unuseni ai Ioane ese e rakatanidia, Ierusalem e lou henia.
english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

motu: A raruosi na Perega amo e vareai, gunika kahana ela bona Antioka ai e kau. Una Antioka na Pisidia tanona ai. Dina Helaḡa ai idia na dubu ai e raka vareai, e helai diho.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

motu: Taravatu bona peroveta bukadia e duahi murinai, dubu biagudia ese gwaukau na raruosi dekedia e siaia lao, eto, Varavaramai e, bema mai emui hahealo herevadia taunimanima edia, mani a gwaurai.
english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

motu: Bena Paulo na e tore isi, imana ai e taodia ahu, eto, Israel taumui bona Dirava garina o garimu taumui e, a kamonai.
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

motu: Ina bese Israel ena Dirava ese seneda e abidia hidi, bona eda bese taudia na Aigupto tanona ai e nohova negana ai vada e hahutumadia, bona ia imana ese e hakaudia lasi.
english: The God of this people + 13:17 TR, NU add “Israel” * chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

motu: Laḡani hari-ahui sisivana tano ḡaḡaena ai e haheauka henidia.
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

motu: Kanaan tanona besena hitu e habuadia tari; bena tano na Israel taudia e henidia, edia tano korikori ai e halaoa. Unuseni ai laḡani sinahu-hani imahui sisivana e nohova.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai hahemaoro taudia e henidiava, ema bona Samuel peroveta tauna negana.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

motu: Gabeamo idia na e noinoi, pavapava ta bae abia eto; bena Dirava ese Saulo Kisa, Beniamina ena iduhu tauna, e henidia, laḡani hari-ahui ia ese e pavapavadia.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

motu: Saulo e abia oho murinai, Dirava ese David ma e haginia, edia pavapava ai e halaoa; e herevalaia hedinarai, eto, David Iese vada name davaria, egu lalokau tauna, egu ura karadia iboudiai do baine kara.
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

motu: Ia garana amo Dirava ese Israel edia Hahemauri Tauna Iesu e havaraia, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena.
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation + 13:23 TR, NU read “a Savior, Jesus” instead of “salvation” * to Israel according to his promise,

motu: Ia na do sema negana ai Ioane ese helalo bapatisona Israel taudia iboudiai vairadiai vada e harorolaia.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel. + 13:24 TR, NU read “to all the people of Israel” instead of “to Israel” *

motu: A Ioane ena ḡaukara dokona ai eto “Umui na dahaka o tomamu, lau be daika? Lau na dia ia: tau ta murigu ai be maimu; lau na dia namo ena tamaka varona baina ruhaia”.
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

motu: Varavaragu e, Abraham garana loḡora e, bona Dirava garina o garimu taumui e, ina hahemauri herevana na ita dekeda vada e siaia mai.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

motu: Badina be Ierusalem taudia bona lohiadia na asi dibadia ia; bona peroveta taudia edia hereva Dina Helaḡa iboudiai e duahi to lalodia asie parara; una dainai e revaia mase, bona unu amo peroveta taudia edia hereva e hamomokani.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

motu: Ena be ihamasena badina ta asie davaria, to idia ese Pilato e noia, baine alaia mase.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

motu: Ia herevana iboudiai, vada e tore guna herevadia, na idia ese e hamomokani; bena au dorina amo e abia dobi, gara lalonai e atoa.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

motu: A Dirava ese mase amo ma e hatorea isi.
english: But God raised him from the dead,

motu: Ia ida Galilea amo Ierusalem ela taudia ese dina diaḡau lalodiai e itaia loulou; bena harihari idia ese taunimanima vairadiai e gwauraia hedinaraaimu.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

motu: Taunabunai, seneda e henidia gwauhamatana sivaraina namona binai ai ese a harorolai henimuimu:
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

motu: gwauhamatana bunai Dirava ese Iesu ihatore-isina ai vada e hamomokania, natuda ediai. Salamo iharuana lalonai e torea na heto; eto, Oi na lau Natugu, Hari dina ai vada na abimu.
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘ You|strong="G4771" * are|strong="G1510" * my|strong="G1722" * Son|strong="G5207" *. Today|strong="G4594" * I|strong="G1473" * have|strong="G2532" * become|strong="G1510" * your|strong="G2532" * father|strong="G1080" *.’ + 13:33 Psalms 2:7 *

motu: Mase amo vada e hatorea isi bona basine pata lou herevana na ini e gwauraia toma: David na henia gwauhamatadia helaḡadia bona momokanidia do baina henimui.
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’ + 13:34 Isaiah 55:3 *

motu: Bona salamo ta lalonai ma eto: Emu Helaḡa Tauna basio kahua nege, basine pata.
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’ + 13:35 Psalms 16:10 *

motu: Badina be David ese ena uru ai Dirava isiaina e lao heniva, Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena ai, bena vada e mase, senena loḡora ida vada eha hebou; tau-anina be e pata.
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

motu: A Dirava ese e hatorea isi tauna na pata asi dibana.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, ia bagunai dika igwau-taodia a harorolai henimuimu.
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, + 13:38 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

motu: Ia bagunai danu kamonai taudia iboudiai edia dika loḡora amo eme heruha; ena be Mose ena taravatu ai basio heruha diba, to ia bagunai do ba heruha.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

motu: Taunabunai, nahuamui ba toho, peroveta taudia ese e gwaurai ḡaudia na umui emui ai bae momokani na garina; eto,
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

motu: Heihi-ihirai taumui e, a itaia, ba hoa, ba mase ore; Badina be kara ta emui mauri dinadia ai na karaia, Kara na, ena be ta ese bema hamaoromui, to basioma abia dae.
english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder|strong="G2296" * and|strong="G2532" * perish, for|strong="G3754" * I|strong="G1473" * work|strong="G2041" * a|strong="G2532" * work|strong="G2041" * in|strong="G1722" * your|strong="G1437" * days|strong="G2250" *, a|strong="G2532" * work|strong="G2041" * which|strong="G3739" * you|strong="G5210" * will|strong="G2532" * in|strong="G1722" * no|strong="G3756" * way|strong="G1722" * believe|strong="G4100" *, if|strong="G1437" * one|strong="G5100" * declares it|strong="G2532" * to|strong="G2532" * you|strong="G5210" *.’” + 13:41 Habakkuk 1:5 *

motu: Paulo bona Banaba e raka lasi ai taunimanima ese e noidia, eto, Dina Helaḡa vairai unu hereva ma bae gwaurai lou idia vairadiai.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

motu: Hebou e karoho, bena Iuda taudia hutuma, bona Dirava garina e gariva taudia Iuda taudia ai vada e halaodia haida danu, ese Paulo bona Banaba e bamodia. Raruosi ese e hereva henidia bona e halodia, eto Dirava ena harihari-bada bae badinaia tarika-tarika.
english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

motu: Dina Helaḡa iharuana ai, hanua taudia hutuma bada Dirava ena hereva ikamonaina totona vada e hebou.
english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

motu: A Iuda taudia ese aru taudia e itadia, bena raruosi e vaḡeḡe henidia, Paulo ena hereva e gwau tubu mai ere dikadia ida.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

motu: Bena Paulo bona Banaba e hereva goadagoada, eto, Dirava ena hereva a harorolai henimui guna na mai badina; to o dadaraiamu, bona sibomui o hahemaoromu, mauri hanaihanai basio abia o tomu. Benaini, idau bese taudia baia haḡeredia;
english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

motu: badina be Lohiabada ese vada e haduada, eto, Lau ese vada na atomui, idau bese taudia edia diari ai baola; Bona hahemauri ai baola, ela bona tanobada dokodia idoidiai.
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘ I|strong="G1473" * have|strong="G1473" * set|strong="G5087" * you|strong="G4771" * as|strong="G1519" * a|strong="G1519" * light|strong="G5457" * for|strong="G1063" * the|strong="G1519" * Gentiles|strong="G1484" *, that|strong="G3588" * you|strong="G4771" * should|strong="G3588" * bring|strong="G1519" * salvation|strong="G4991" * to|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G1519" * uttermost parts of|strong="G2962" * the|strong="G1519" * earth|strong="G1093" *.’” + 13:47 Isaiah 49:6 *

motu: Idau bese taudia ese una hereva e kamonai mai moaledia ida, bona Dirava ena hereva e imodaia. Bena e abidia hidi mauri hanaihanai bae abia audia iboudiai ese e abiabiraia.
english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

motu: Lohiabada ena hereva na una tano idoinai vada eha piua rohoroho.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

motu: A Iuda taudia ese lohia hahinedia haida, Dirava garina e gariva hahinedia, bona hanua tau-badadia, lalodia e ani, Paulo bona Banaba bae daḡedaḡe henidia eto. Bena edia tano amo e luludia lasi.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

motu: Bena raruosi ese aedia palapaladia ḡahudia e davedave oho, idia ihabadelaidia karana; bena Ikonio ela.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

motu: Iesu ibadinana taudia na e moale badava, bona Lauma Helaḡa ese e rohediava.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

motu: Ikonio ai Paulo bona Banaba na Iuda taudia edia dubu ai e dae kau, e haroro; bena Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia hutuma ese sivarai namo e abia dae.
english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

motu: To Iuda taudia haida ese asie abia dae, bena idia ese idau bese taudia lalodia e ani, kamonai taudia bae daḡedaḡe henidia.
english: But the disbelieving + 14:2 or, disobedient * Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

motu: Raruosi na nega taina daudau unuseni ai e noho. E haroro goadagoadava Lohiabada bagunai; bona Lohiabada ese ena harihari-bada herevana na ini e hamomokania tomava, siahu na raruosi e henidia, bena idia ese toa bona hoa karadia e karava.
english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

motu: Bena hanua taudia na e hahepararava; haida na Iuda audia ediai e taova, a haida be aposetolo ediai e taova.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

motu: Bena idau bese taudia bona Iuda taudia haida edia hanua lohiadia ida e henega hebou, raruosi bae taodia tari, nadi amo bae hododia eto.
english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

motu: To raruosi vada e diba, bena e heau, Lukaonia tanona ela, Lustera bona Derebe hanuadia ai bona una tano idoinai
english: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

motu: sivarai namo e harorolaia. Paulo bona Banaba Lustera ai
english: There they preached the Good News.

motu: Lustera ai ae-hedairike tauna ta e helaiva; ia na boga amo e vara isi asi raka dibana.
english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

motu: Ia ese Paulo ena haroro e kamonai; bena Paulo ese e raraia tao, dibana danu ena abidadama ese baine hamauria diba, bena e hereva badabada, eto,
english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

motu: A tore isi, a gini maoromaoro. Bena ia na e roho isi, e raka.
english: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

motu: Aru taudia na Paulo ena kara e itaia, bena Lukaonia gadodiai e lolo, eto, Dirava be taunimanima heida-idadiai vada eme diho ita dekedai.
english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

motu: Bena edia dirava ladadia e nemaidia: Banaba e nemaia Deo, bona Paulo e nemaia Hereme, badina be ia na hereva herea tauna.
english: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

motu: Deo ena dubu be hanua vairanai; bena ena hahelaḡa taudia hanua ikoukoudia ela, boromakau mamaruanedia bona herahera ḡaudia e laohai, aru taudia ida bae boubou eto.
english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

motu: Aposetolo raruosi, Paulo bona Banaba, e kamonai, bena edia dabua e dare, e heau lasi ela, hutuma bogaragidiai e lolo, eto,
english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

motu: Henamo e, dahaka dainai ini o kara tomamu? Ai danu taunimanima mo; daramai danu umui daraunui heḡereḡeredia. Ai na sivarai namo dekemui a mailai, umui ese mi ḡau asi anidia ba rakatani bona Mauri Diravana ba haḡerea helaoreana. Ia ese guba bona tanobada bona davara bona lalodiai e miamu ḡaudia idoidiai e kara.
english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

motu: Uru gunadia edia nega ai bese idau-idau iboudiai e kahudia nege, sibodia edia ura daladia ai bae raka;
english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

motu: ḡau tamona, sibona ihahedinaraina toadia mo se nege, a hahenamo karadia e karamu, medu guba amo bona madinamo negadia e henimuimu, bogamui e hakunudiamu, bona lalomui e hamoalediamu.
english: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you + 14:17 TR reads “us” instead of “you” * rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

motu: Raruosi na unu e hereva toma, aru taudia bae rudia eto; to aru taudia ese boubou ḡaudia na raruosi vairadiai mokona e ato.
english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

motu: A Iuda taudia haida na Antioka maraḡina bona Ikonio amo ema, aru taudia lalodia e ani; bena idia ese Paulo na nadi amo e hodoa, hanua amo e veria lasi, banava eto vada e mase.
english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

motu: A Iesu ibadinana taudia ese e ginia heḡeḡe, bena ia na e tore isi, hanua e lou henia. Daba ai, ia na Banaba ida Derebe ela. Aposetolo na Derebe amo e lou, Antioka e lou henia
english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

motu: Raruosi ese Derebe ai sivarai namo e harorolaia, bona Iesu ibadinana taudia hutuma e abidia. Bena Lustera bona Ikonio bona Antioka maraḡina e lou heni,
english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

motu: Iesu ibadinana taudia lalodia e hagoadadia, e halodia, Iesu bae abiabiraia tarika-tarika; bona e hamaorodia, eto, Hisihisi momo lalodia amo Dirava ena basileia ai do baita raka vareai.
english: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

motu: Bona una negana ai ekalesia oreadia iboudiai lalodiai heitatao taudia vada e abidia hidi, ḡuriḡuridia ai bona anivagadia ai e hahelaḡadia, e abiabiraia Lohiabadana ena.
english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

motu: Raruosi na Pisidia tanona amo e raka hanai, Pamfulia tanona amo e lasi.
english: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

motu: Perega hanuana ai Lohiabada ena hereva e harorolaia; bena kone ai e lasi Atalia hanuana ai.
english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

motu: Unu amo lagatoi auta ai e gui, Antioka badana ela; hari vada e ha-orea ḡaukarana dainai Dirava ena harihari-bada lalonai e hahelaḡadia guna gabuna ai e kau.
english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

motu: E gini dae, bena ekalesia taudia e haboudia, Diraya ida e kara bouva ḡaudia idoidiai sivaraidia, bona Iesu iabiabiraina iduarana idau bese taudia ediai e kehoa herevadia, e gwaurai.
english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

motu: Bena raruosi na nega taina daudau unuseni ai e noho, Iesu ibadinana taudia dekediai.
english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

motu: Taunimanima haida na Iudea amo e diho ela, varavara e hadibadia, eto, Basie peritomemui, Mose ena taravatu heḡereḡerena umui ese hahemauri basio abia diba.
english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, + 15:1 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

motu: Paulo bona Banaba idia ida vada e heai bona e hapapahuahu badabada dainai, idia na e hahedua, Paulo bona Banaba, varavara haida ida, Ierusalem baela, aposetolo bona heitatao taudia dekedia, una hereva bae nanadailaidia.
english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

motu: Ekalesia taudia ese edia dala matamana ai e bamodia. Bena Foenikia bona Samaria tanodia e rakadia hanai, bese idau-idau taudia ese e helalo kerehai sivaraina e gwauraia; bena varavara iboudiai e moale bada.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

motu: Idia na Ierusalem ai e gini dae ai, ekalesia taudia bona aposetolo taudia bona heitatao taudia ese e abidia dae; bena idia ese Dirava ida e kara bouva ḡaudia idoidiai e hamaorolaidia.
english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

motu: A Farisea oreana amo Iesu vada e abiabiraia taudia haida na e tore isi, eto, Maorona binai, idau bese taudia danu bae peritomedia, bona bae haduadia danu Mose ena taravatu bae badinaia.
english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

motu: Bena aposetolo bona ekalesia ita-taona taudia e hebou, una hereva e haeroa.
english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

motu: Bena e hepapahuahu nega daudau, murinai Petro e tore isi, eto, Varavaragu e, dibamui Dirava ese umui bogaragimui amo e abigu hidi, lau udugu amo bese idau-idau taudia ese sivarai namo bae kamonai bona bae abia dae.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

motu: Bona taunimanima lalodia mai dibana Diravana ese idia ediai e hedinarai, bona Lauma Helaḡa e henidia, ita e henida heḡereḡerena;
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

motu: ita bona idia se ha-idauda. Badina be edia abidadama ese lalodia vada e haḡoevadia.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

motu: Benaini, badina be dahaka Dirava o dibaiamu taumui ese Iesu ibadinana taudia paḡadia ai maduna metauna o atoa kaumu, seneda bona ita danu ihuana asita heḡereḡere madunana?
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

motu: Ita ta abia daemu Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada dainai baita mauri; idia danu unuheto.
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, + 15:11 TR adds “Christ” * just as they are.”

motu: Hebou taudia iboudiai asi reḡereḡedia. Bena Banaba bona Paulo edia hereva mo e hakala henia; Dirava ese bese idau-idau taudia bogaragidiai toa bona hoa karadia idia imadia amo e karava sivaraidia raruosi ese e gwaurai.
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

motu: Edia hereva e hadokoa, bena Iakobo na e sisiba, eto, Varavaragu e, a kamonai henigu.
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

motu: Simona ese vada e hamaoroda, Dirava ese gunaguna bese idau-idau e haḡeredia, edia amo bese ta baine abia hidi, ia ladana baine nemailaia.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

motu: Una na peroveta taudia edia hereva ida eme heḡereḡere; e torea, eto,
english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai lau do baina lou mai, David ena dabua rumana vada e kohu, ma baina haginia lou, Vada e heḡiḡi rohoroho, ma baina hadaia lou, Bona baina haginia vaitani.
english: ‘After these things I will return. motu: Bena taunimanima gabedia ese Lohiabada bae tahua; Oibe, bese idau-idau lau ladagu vada e nemailaidia na bae tahua.
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all|strong="G3956" * the|strong="G2532" * Gentiles|strong="G1484" * who|strong="G3739" * are|strong="G3588" * called|strong="G3004" * by|strong="G1909" * my|strong="G3956" * name|strong="G3686" *, says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *, who|strong="G3739" * does|strong="G4160" * all|strong="G3956" * these|strong="G3778" * things|strong="G3956" *.’ + 15:17 Amos 9:11-12 *

motu: Lohiabada na unu e gwau tomamu: Ia ese ini ḡau vada e gwaurai hedinaraiva tanobada matamana amo ema harihari.
english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

motu: Taunabunai, lau na tomamu bese idau-idau taudia ese Dirava e haḡereamu be ita ese basita haraivadia.
english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

motu: A baita tore henidia, baita haduadia, kaivakuku ihaboulaidia ḡaudia na basie ani, bona basie heuda-hanai, bona aiodia e gigi ḡaudia hidiodia bona rara na basie ani.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

motu: Badina be sene negadia ema bona harihari Mose na mai ena haroro taudia hanua iboudiai lalodiai, bona Dina Helaḡa iboudiai ena taravatu na dubu lalodiai e duahiamu.
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

motu: Bena aposetolo bona heitatao taudia, ekalesia taudia iboudiai ida, lalodia e hadai, edia orea amo haida bae abidia hidi, Paulo bona Banaba ida baela Antioka. Taudia be ini; luda, e nemaia Barasaba, bona Sila; idia raruosi na varavara ikwaradia taudia.
english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers. + 15:22 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” *

motu: Ina revareva idia ese e laohaia: Aposetolo taumai bona ekalesia ita-taodia taumai a tomamu bese idauidau taumui, Antioka ai bona Suria ai bona Kilikia ai o nohomu, iboumui ai ba namo ba mauri.
english: They wrote these things by their hand: “ The|strong="G2532" * apostles, the|strong="G2532" * elders|strong="G4245" *, and|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * brothers, to|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * brothers who|strong="G3588" * are|strong="G3588" * of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G2532" * Gentiles|strong="G1484" * in|strong="G2596" * Antioch, Syria|strong="G4947" *, and|strong="G2532" * Cilicia|strong="G2791" *: greetings|strong="G5463" *.

motu: Ai na vada ame kamonai, haida emai amo vada e vasi, edia hereva amo vada e haraivamui bona e hadaradaramui; to ai ese unu asia haduadia toma.
english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

motu: Taunabunai, ai iboumai ai emai lalo-hadai tamona binai, tatau haida baia abidia hidi, baia siaidia, emai lalokau taudia Banaba bona Paulo ida bae vasi.
english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

motu: Taudia raruosi bene edia mauri vada e nege daure, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana dainai.
english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Badina bunai Iuda bona Sila vada a siaidiamu, ini hereva heḡereḡeredia mo ududia amo ma bae gwaurai.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

motu: Badina be Lauma Helaḡa bona ai a tomamu ula na baine namo: maduna metaudia na paḡamui ai basia ato kau; a ini mai badidia ḡaudia mo baia ato kau,
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

motu: kaivakuku ihaboulaidia ḡaudia bona rara bona aiodia e gigi ḡaudia hidiodia na basio ani, bona basio heuda-hanai. Unu ḡau idoidiai na basio abi dae, vada ba namo. Ba mahuta.
english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

motu: Taunabunai, e siaidia taudia na Antioka ela, kamonai taudia unuseni ai e haboudia, bena revareva e henidia.
english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

motu: Idia ese e duahia, bona unu hahealo herevadia e moalelai.
english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

motu: Iuda bona Sila na peroveta taudia; taunabunai raruosi ese hereva diaḡau amo e hadibalaidia bona e hagoadalaidia.
english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

motu: Idia na unuseni ai dina hoho e noho; bena varavara ese e tudia, mai mainodia ida ela, e siaidia taudia dekedia.
english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

motu: A Sila na ena ura dainai dounu e halaheva. PauIo ese ena laolao iharuana e matamaia
english: + 15:34 Some manuscripts add: But it seemed good to Silas to stay there. *

motu: Paulo Banaba ida be Antioka lalonai e nohova, e hahedibava, bona Lohiabada ena hereva e harorolaiava, hutuma ida.
english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

motu: Dina haida vada ela, bena Paulo ese Banaba e hereva henia, eto, Aitala, Lohiabada ena hereva ta harorolai henidia hanuadia iboudiai baita lou henidia, varavarada baita ha itadia, ede e hetomu.
english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

motu: Bena Banaba e urava Ioane Mareko na idia ida ma baela.
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

motu: A Paulo ena lalo-hadai be ia bae laohaia na dia namo, badina be Pamfulia ai e rakatanidia, edia ḡaukara ai se bamodia.
english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

motu: Una gwauna raruosi e heai, bena e haheparara. Banaba ese Mareko e abia, lagatoi auta ai e gui, Kupro ela.
english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

motu: A Paulo ese Sila e abia hidi. Varavara ese Dirava ena harihari-bada ai e hahelaḡadia; bena e tore isi,
english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

motu: Suria bona Kilikia tanodia e rakadia hanai, ekalesia oreadia e hagoadadia.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

motu: Ia na Derebe bona Lustera ai e lasi: Lustera ai Iesu ibadinana tauna ta e nohova, ladana na Timoteo: sinana he Iuda hahinena, sivarai namo vada e abiabiraia, a tamana be Helene tauna.
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

motu: Varavara Lustera bona Ikonio taudia ese e gwauraiava tau namona.
english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

motu: Paulo ese e ura henia, ia ida baela; bena e abia, e peritomea, Iuda taudia unu gabu ai e nohova daidiai; badina be iboudiai dibadia tamana na tau Helene.
english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

motu: Hanua hanua e rakadia hanai ai, aposetolo bona Ierusalem ekalesiana ita-taona taudia edia haheḡani e henidia, bae badina helaoreana.
english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

motu: Taunabunai, ekalesia oreadia iboudiai edia abidadama e goada e laova, bona dina iboudiai ekalesia taudia na e hutuma e laova. Paulo Troa ai e lasi
english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

motu: Bena Paulo mai bamona ida Frugia bona Galatia tanodia e rakadia hanai; badina be Lauma Helaḡa ese vada e gwaudia ahu, Asia tanona ai sivarai namo basie harorolaia eto.
english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

motu: Idia na Musia hetoana ai e kau, Bitunia baela eto; to Iesu ena Lauma ese e rudia.
english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

motu: Taunabunai, Musia murimurina amo e raka hanai, kone ai e lasi, Troa hanuana ai.
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

motu: Hanuaboina ai Paulo vada e nihi. Ena nihi ai Makedonia tauna ta e itaia, ia vairanai e gini, e noia, eto, Makedonia aoma, ame kahamai. Paulo mai bamona ida e heau hanai Makedonia ela
english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

motu: Una mata-hanai dainai, ai ese Makedonia ai baia heau hanai dalana a tahua haraḡa-haraḡa, ato sivarai namo baia henidia helaoreana Dirava ese vada e boirimai.
english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

motu: Taunabunai, Troa ai lara a kidaia isi, bena a heau maoromaoro, Samotrake ala. Daba ai ma a heau, Neapoli ai a ha kau.
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

motu: Unu amo Filipi ala: una na Makedonia hanuana bada-hereana; Roma tuari oreana ta ese e noholaiava danu. Paulo bona Sila Filipi ai
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

motu: Dina Helaḡa ai hanua ikoukouna amo a raka lasi, sinavai isena ala; badina be vada a diba ḡuriḡuri gabuna be unuseni ai. A helai diho, unuseni ai e hebouva hahinedia a hereva henidia.
english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

motu: Hahine ta unuseni ai ladana Ludia, dabua kakakakadia e hoiva hahinena; ena hanua be Tuatira. Ia ese Dirava e toma henia dihova. Emai hereva e kamonai, bona Lohiabada ese lalona e hapararia, bena ia ese Paulo e hakala henia.
english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

motu: Ia mai ena ruma taudia ida bapatiso e abia; bena ia ese e noimai, eto, Lalomui bema toma lau na Lohiabada iabiabiraina hahinegu, egu ruma baitama lao, unuseni ai boma noho. Ia ese lalomai e ani, bena vada ala.
english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

motu: Nega ta ḡuriḡuri gabuna a laova ai, babalau laumana ese e boloava kekenina ta be vairamai ema. Una kekeni biaguna ese kohu momo iena babalau karadia amo e abiva.
english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

motu: Ia na Paulo murinai e raka, e lolo, eto, Ini raruosi na Herea Mikamika Diravana ena hesiai taudia, hahemauri dalana e hamaorolaimuimu.
english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

motu: Dina hoho unu mo e kara toma. Bena Paulo lalona e hesiku, e gini kerehai, hari lauma e gwau henia, eto, Iesu Keriso ladana ai na haduamumu, ena amo a raka lasi. Bena una hora lalonai e raka lasi.
english: She was doing this for many days.
