But|strong="G1161" * Paul|strong="G3972" *, becoming greatly|strong="G4183" * annoyed|strong="G1278" *, turned|strong="G1994" * and|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G1722" * spirit|strong="G4151" *, “ I|strong="G2532" * command|strong="G3853" * you|strong="G4771" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * name|strong="G3686" * of|strong="G4151" * Jesus|strong="G2424" * Christ|strong="G5547" * to|strong="G2532" * come|strong="G1831" * out|strong="G1831" * of|strong="G4151" * her|strong="G4160" *!” It|strong="G2532" * came|strong="G1831" * out|strong="G1831" * that|strong="G3588" * very|strong="G4183" * hour|strong="G5610" *.

motu: A biaguna ese e itaia, edia kohu iabilaidia karana vada e doko; bena idia ese Paulo bona Sila e dabaidia tao, hoihoi gabuna e dabuidia lao, hanua lohiadia vairadiai.
english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

motu: Hahemaoro taudia vairadiai e hakaudia lao, eto, Ini raruosi na Iuda taudia, eda hanua e haturiaiamu,
english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

motu: bona kara haida, iabi-daedia bona ibadinadia na mai taravatuna ita Roma tauda edai, karadia danu e gwaurai hedinaraimu.
english: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

motu: Aru taudia ese danu e ḡonaḡonalaidia. Bena hahemaoro taudia e hahedua, edia dabua bae dare oho, au amo bae dadabadia.
english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

motu: E dadabadia dikadika, bena dibura rumana igimana tauna e haduaia, baine gimadia namonamo.
english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

motu: Unu e haduaia toma dainai, ia ese raruosi laloma daiutuna ta ai e koudia, aedia danu au matudia ai e kapu tao kunuka-kunuka.
english: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

motu: Malokihi ai, Paulo bona Sila e guriguriva bona Dirava ihanamolaina anedia e abiva; dibura taudia ese danu e hakala henidiava.
english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

motu: Bena tano e laḡa dagu, dibura rumana e heude-heude, iduara iboudiai sibodia e hekeho, bona edia iḡui iboudiai e heruha.
english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

motu: Dibura rumana igimana tauna na mahuta amo e noga, iduara e ita, iboudiai hehekeho; bena ia ese ena dare e veria lasi, sibona baine heala mase eto, badina be ia banava dibura taudia vada e heau lasi eto.
english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

motu: A Paulo na e lolo badabada, eto, Sibomu asio heala, badina be ai iboumai ai iniseni ai.
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

motu: Dibura rumana igimana tauna e boiboi, kede bae mailai; bena e heau vareai, Paulo bona Sila vairadiai e goru diho mai heude-heudena ida.
english: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

motu: Bena ia ese e hakaudia lasi, eto, Lohiamui e, ede baina kara toma bena mauri baina abia?
english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

motu: Raruosi e haere, eto, Lohiabada Iesu bavabiabiraia, bena ba mauri, oi bona emu ruma taudia.
english: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

motu: Bena raruosi ese Lohiabada ena hereva na ia bona ena ruma taudia iboudiai e hamaorolaidia.
english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

motu: Bena hanuaboi lalonai ia ese raruosi e laohaidia, berodia e dairi; bena ia bona ena ruma taudia iboudiai bapatiso vada e abia.
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

motu: Bena ena ruma ai e hakaudia dae, adia e dabaraia, e aniani. Bena ia mai ena ruma taudia ida e moale bada, Dirava e abidadama henia dainai.
english: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

motu: Daba ai, hahemaoro taudia ese edia hesiai taudia e siaidia, eto, Ene tatau ba ruhadia nege.
english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

motu: Dibura rumana igimana tauna ese PauIo e hamaoroa, eto, Hahemaoro taudia edia gwaukau e siaia, baina ruhamui nege e tomu. Taunabunai, a raka lasi, mai mainomui ida aola.
english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

motu: A Paulo eto, Ai na Roma ena basileia taumai, asie hahemaoro henimai guna, a taunimanima vairadiai vada e dadabamai kava bona dibura rumana ai e koumai, bena harihari vada bae kahumai nege hehuni a? Lasi vaitani. Idia sibodia baema, bae hakaumai lasi.
english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

motu: Bena hesiai taudia ela, unu hereva na hahemaoro taudia e hamaorolaidia. Idia na e kamonai raruosi na Roma ena basileia taudia, bena e gari.
english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

motu: Bena ela, raruosi e hamarumarudia; bena e hakaudia lasi, e noidia danu una hanua na bae rakatania eto.
english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

motu: Raruosi na dibura rumana amo e raka lasi, Ludia ena ruma ela. Unuseni ai idia na varavara ida e hedavari, bona hahealo herevadia amo e hagoadadia. Bena Filipi e rakatania.
english: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

motu: Idia raruosi ese Amfipoli bona Apolonia e rakadia hanai, Tesalonika ai e lasi. Iuda taudia edia dubu ta be unuseni ai.
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

motu: Paulo na dubu ai e dae kau, vaia ena kara heḡereḡerena bena Dina Helaḡa toi ai Buka Helaḡa na idia ida e hereva-herevalai.
english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

motu: E hadibalaidia ḡoevaḡoeva, Keriso ena hisi-ani bona ena tore-isi-lou na mai badidia. Bona e hamaorodia, eto, Ina Iesu na harorolai henimuimu, ia na Keriso.
english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

motu: Idia haida be e kamonai, bena Paulo bona Sila ida e hebouva; bona Helene taudia Dirava garina e gariva hutuma bona lohia hahinedia dia gadoi danu idia ida e hebouva.
english: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

motu: Una dainai Iuda taudia oredia vada e vaḡ=ege, bena hoihoi gabuna ai e noho kavava taudia dikadia haida e abidia, bona hanua taudia hutuma e haboudia, heloḡo-heloḡo badana e havaraia. Bena Iason ena ruma e darea, Paulo bona Sila e tahudia, hanua taudia vairadiai bae veridia lasi eto.
english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along + 17:5 TR reads “And the Jews who were unpersuaded, becoming envious and taking along” instead of “But the unpersuaded Jews took along” * some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

motu: A asie davaridia; bena idia ese Iason, varavara haida ida, e dabuidia dobi, hahemaoro taudia vairadiai e veridia lao, e lolo, eto, Tanobada idoinai vada e uhea hebubumu taudia iniseni ai danu vada eme gini dae,
english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers + 17:6 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

motu: bona Iason ese vada e abidia dae ena ruma ai. Idia ese Kaisara ena taravatu e tata utumu, pavapava ta ma e gwauraiamu, ladana Iesu.
english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

motu: Aru taudia bona hahemaoro taudia ese una hereva e kamonai negana ai na kudoudia e hetaha.
english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

motu: Idia ese Iason mai bamona ida tarava e atu henidia, bena e ruhadia nege. Berea ai
english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

motu: Varavara ese Paulo bona Sila na hanuaboi ai e siaidia haraḡa-haraḡa ela Berea. Raruosi e kau, bena Iuda taudia edia dubu ai ma e dae kau.
english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

motu: Ini na taiḡa-namo taudia, dia Tesalonika taudia heḡereḡeredia; badina be idia cse hereva e hakala henia mai lalo-haragadia ida, bona dina iboudiai Buka Helaḡa lalodiai e hetahu, ini ḡau na momokani eiava lasi.
english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

motu: Taunabunai, hutuma ese edia hereva e abi dae, bona Helene lohiadia danu, tatau bona hahine, dia gadoi.
english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

motu: A Iuda taudia Tesalonika ai harina e kamonai Paulo ese Dirava ena hereva na Berea ai e harorolaiava, bena unu ela, hanua taudia lalodia e haraivadia bona e hagaridia.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

motu: Bena varavara ese Paulo e siaia lasi haraḡa kone ai; a Sila bona Timoteo be unuseni ai e noho.
english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

motu: A Paulo inarina taudia ese e hakaua lao, Atena ai e rakatania, bona ena hahedua e loulaia, Sila bona Timoteo edia, raruosi na ia dekena baela haraḡa eto. Atena ai
english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

motu: Paulo ese Atena ai raruosi e naridiava negana ai lalona e hekwarahiva, badina be una hanua na e itaia, kaivakuku ai e honuhonu dae.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

motu: Taunabunai ia na dubu ai Iuda taudia bona Dirava e toma henia diho taudia ida e herevaherevava, bona hoihoi gabuna ai danu, daba daba idoidiai unuseni ai e davaridia taudia ida.
english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

motu: Bona Epikuro ena orea bona Stoa oreana taudia haida Paulo ida e hepapahuahuva. Haida eto, Ina hereva kava tauna be dahaka e gwauraiamu? Haida ma eto, Ia na dirava idaudia e gwauraidiamu dahaka. Idia na unu e gwau toma badina be ia ese Iesu bona ena tore-isi-lou sivaraina namona e harorolaiava.
english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also + 17:18 TR omits “also” * were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others|strong="G3588" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ He|strong="G2532" * seems|strong="G1380" * to|strong="G2532" * be|strong="G1510" * advocating foreign deities|strong="G1140" *,” because|strong="G3754" * he|strong="G2532" * preached|strong="G2097" * Jesus|strong="G2424" * and|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * resurrection.

motu: Bena idia ese Areo Ororona e hakaua lao; bena eto, Emu hahediba matamatana na anina mani boma hadibalaimai,
english: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

motu: badina be emu hereva mamidia na idau a tomamu, taunabunai a uramu anidia korikori baia diba.
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

motu: Badina be Atena taudia iboudiai bona idau hanua taudia unuseni ai e nohova danu edia kara tamona be dina iboudiai hereva matamatadia e gwauraiva bona e kamonaiva.
english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

motu: Bena Paulo na Areo Ororona bogaraginai e gini, e haroro, eto, Atena taumui e, name itamui umui ese emui dirava o matauraidia hereamu.
english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

motu: Badina be na raka hanaiva ai, o toma heni dihomu ḡaudia na itava negana ai boubou patana ta na davaria, latanai revareva ini e torea toma: ASI DIBADA DIRAVANA ENA. Taunabunai, asi dibamui Diravana o toma henia dihomu na lau ese aina hadibalaimui.
english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

motu: Tanobada bona lalonai e miamu ḡaudia idoidiai ikaradia Diravana ese guba bona tanobada na e lohiadiamu; ia na taunimanima imadia ai e karava dubudia lalodiai se nohomu.
english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

motu: Taunimanima imadia ese danu ia isiaina asie lao henimu, ḡau ta bema dabu na heto; badina be ia ese mauri bona laḡa bona ḡau idoidiai danu taunimanima iboudiai e henidiamu.
english: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

motu: Rara tamona ai ia ese taunimanima besedia iboudiai vada e karadia, tanobada kopina idoinai bae noho henia, edia nega bona edia tano hetoadia vada e gwaurai,
english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

motu: Dirava bae tahua totona; bena bae darahua bonal bae davaria readia. Ḡau tamona, ia bona ita ta ta padada na dia daudau;
english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

motu: badina be ia lalonai ta maurimul, bona ta marere-mareremu, bona ta nohomu, emui ane isisibadia taudia haida ese vada e gwauraia heḡereḡerena, eto, Badina be ita danu ia natuna.
english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

motu: Benaini, ita na ia natuna; taunabunai dia maoro laloda ai baitato Dirava na gold eiava silver eiava nadi, kwara-herea bona aonega taudia ese e korova ḡaudia, na heto.
english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

motu: Dirava ese unu mata-lahui negadia na se lalo taomu; a harihari ia ese taunimanima iboudiai gabu idoidiai e haduadiamu, bae helalo kerehai.
english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

motu: Badina be ia ese dina ta vada e gwauraia hidi, una dina ai ena abi-hidi tauna ese tanobada idoinai baine hahemaoro henia mai maoromaorona ida; bona ihamomokanina toana taunimanima iboudiai vada e henidia, toana binai, mase amo e hatorea isi.
english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

motu: Mase ihatore-isi-louna herevana e kamonai negana ai haida ese e kirikirilaia. Ma haida eto, Ina hereva na emu ai ma baia kamonai lou.
english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

motu: Bena Paulo ese e rakatanidia.
english: Thus Paul went out from among them.

motu: A haida na ienai e taova, bona ena hereva e abi dae: ta be Dionusio, Areo Ororona tauna ta; bona hahine ta ladana be Damari; bena ma haida danu idia ida.
english: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

motu: Unu ḡau muridiai, ia ese Atena e rakatania, Korinto ela.
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

motu: Unuseni ai ia ese Iuda tauna ta e davaria, Ponto besena tauna, ladana na Akula; ia na vanegai mo adavana Priskila ida Italia amo ema, Klaudio ena hahedua, eto Iuda taudia iboudiai Roma bae rakatania, una dainai. Bena Paulo na idia raruosi dekedia ela;
english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

motu: bena, ia bona idia edia moni idavarina ḡaukarana be tamona dainai, ia na idia ida e nohova bona e ḡaukara hebouva. Edia ḡaukara na dabua rumadia ituridia.
english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

motu: A Dina Helaḡa iboudiai ia na dubu ai e harorova, bona Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia lalodia e ani tohova. Sila bona Timoteo e kau
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

motu: Sila bona Timoteo na Makedonia amo e kau. Una negaula ai Paulo e haroro goadagoadava, Iuda taudia e hadibadia ḡoevaḡoeva, Iesu na Keriso.
english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

motu: A idia ese e gwaua tubu mai ere dikadia ida, bena ia ese ena dabua e odaraia, eto, Raramui na sibomui kwaramui ai baine mia; dia lauegu kerere; harihari ela, lau na idau bese taudia dekedia bainala.
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

motu: Bena ia ese una gabu e rakatania, ela, tau ta ladana Titio lusto ena ruma ai e nohova una tau ese Dirava e toma henia dihova; iena ruma danu dubu ida e gini hetabira.
english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

motu: Krispo, dubu biaguna, ese danu Lohiabada e abiabiraia, ena ruma taudia iboudiai ida. Korinto taudia hutuma danu Paulo ena haroro e kamonaia, e abia dae, bona bapatiso e abia.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

motu: Bena Lohiabada ese hanuaboi ai Paulo na nihi ai e hereva henia, eto, Asio gari, ba hereva, udumu basio daia kapu;
english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w afraid|strong="G5399"\+w*, \+w but|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w speak|strong="G2980"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* don’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w be|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w silent|strong="G4623"\+w*; *

motu: badina be lau na oi dekemu ai na nohomu; tau ta ese basine guru henimu, basine hadikamu, badina be lauegu taunimanima na hutuma ina hanua lalonai.
english: \+w for|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w with|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w no|strong="G3762"\+w* \+w one|strong="G3762"\+w* \+w will|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w attack|strong="G2007"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w harm|strong="G2559"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w many|strong="G4183"\+w* \+w people|strong="G2992"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w city|strong="G4172"\+w*.” *

motu: Taunabunai Paulo na laḡani ta hua tauratoi unuseni ai e noho, Dirava ena hereva e hadibalaidiava. Paulo na Korinto ai e hahemaoro
english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

motu: Galio be Akaia tanona e lohiaia matama negana ai, Iuda taudia ese Paulo e daḡedaḡe henia mai lalodia tamona, bena hahemaoro gabuna e hakaua lao;
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

motu: eto, Ina tau ese taunimanima lalodia e animu, taravaiu e tataia utumu dalalla amo Dirava bae toma henia diho e tomu.
english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

motu: Paulo baine hereva eto; to Galio ese Iuda taudia e hamarodia, eto, Iuda taumui e, kara dika ta eiava kerere badana ta ai boma habadelaia, bama kamonai henimui bema namo.
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

motu: To ene hereva bona lada bona emui taravatu henana-laidia na sibomui ba tahu; lau ese ene ḡau basina hahemaorolai.
english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

motu: Bena ia ese hahemaoro gabuna amo e luludia lasi.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

motu: Bena idia iboudiai ese dubu biaguna, Sostene, e dabaia tao, hahemaoro gabuna vairanai e dadabaia. A Galio na una kara se haerolaia. Paulo ena laolao iharuana e ha-orea, e lou lao Antioka
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

motu: Paulo na dina hoho dounu e nohova, bena ia ese varavara loḡora e hatonidia, lagatoi ai e gui, Suria bainela. Priskila bona Akula ese e bamoa. Kenkrea ai huina vada e utua, badina be mai ena gwauhamata.
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, + 18:18 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

motu: Tatoiosi Efeso ai e heau kau; unuseni ai ia ese raruosi e rakatanidia. Ia sibona dubu ai e dae kau, Iuda taudia ida e hereva-hereva.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

motu: Bena idia ese e noia, baine noho taritari; to ia ese edia noinoi se abia dae.
english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

motu: E hatonidia, eto, Dirava baine ura, ma baina lou mai dekemui ai. Bena Efeso e heautania.
english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

motu: Kaisarea ai e diho, bena Ierusalem ai eha dara dae, ekalesia oreana e hahenamo henia. Bena Antioka ela. Paulo ese ena laolao ihatoina e matamaia
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

motu: Nega taina unuseni ai e noho, bena ma eha laolao, Galatia bona Frugia tanodia ela, ekalesia oreadia e igodia ita, Iesu ibadinana taudia iboudiai e hagoadadia.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

motu: Una negana ai Iuda tauna ta, ladana Apolo, na Efeso ela. Ia na Alesandria tauna, mai aonegana, Buka Helaḡa dibana herea tauna.
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

motu: Ina tau na ta ese Lohiabada ena dala vada e hadibalaia; bena ia ese Iesu sivaraina e gwauraia mai siahuna ida, bona e hahedibalaia ḡoevaḡoeva. Ḡau tamona, bapatiso na Ioale ena bapatiso mo dibana.
english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

motu: Ia na dubu lalonai e haroro matama mai haheaukana ida. Unuseni ai Priskila bona Akula ese hereva e kamonai, bena edia ruma e hakaua lao; bena raruosi ese Dirava ena dala e hadibalaia maoromaoro.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

motu: Ena ura be baine heau hanai, Akaia bainela; taunabunai varavara ese Iesu ibadinana taudia unuseni ai e tore henidia, e noidia bae abia dae. Ia na unuseni ai e kau, bena Dirava ena harihari-bada dainai vada e kamonai taudia na ia ese e durudia badava.
english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

motu: Badina be ia ese taunimanima vairadiai Iuda tauddia e gwaudia tubu vaitani, Buka Helaḡa amo vada e hahedinaraia, Iesu na Keriso.
english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

motu: Apolo na Korinto ai e nohova negana ai, Paulo gunika kahana amo e lasi, Efeso ai e kau; Iesu ibadinana taudia haida unuseni ai ma e davaridia.
english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

motu: Bena ia ese e nanadaidia, eto, Iesu o abiabiraia negana ai Lauma Helaḡa danu o abia a? Idia e haere, eto, Lasi, Lauma Helaḡa herevana na do asia kamonai.
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G4314" * him|strong="G3588" *, “ No|strong="G3761" *, we|strong="G1161" * haven’ t|strong="G3588" * even|strong="G3761" * heard that|strong="G3588" * there|strong="G1161" * is|strong="G1510" * a|strong="G2983" * Holy|strong="G4151" * Spirit|strong="G4151" *.”

motu: Ma e nanadaidia lou, eto, Dahaka bapatisona o abia? Idia eto, Ioane ena bapatiso.
english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ Into|strong="G1519" * John|strong="G2491" *’s baptism.”

motu: Paulo eto, Ioane ese helalo-kerehai bapatisona mo taunimanima e henidia; bona e hamaorodia danu ia murina amo bainema tauna na bae abiabiraia, Iesu bunai.
english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.” + 19:4 NU omits Christ. *

motu: Una hereva e kamonai, bena Lohiabada Iesu ladana ai bapatiso ma e abia.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

motu: Bena Paulo ese imana na idia latadiai e ato kau negana ai, Lauma Helaḡa na idia latadiai vada e diho. Bena idia na gado idau-idau ai e hereva, bona e peroveta danu.
english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

motu: Taudia iboudiai gwauta-rarua sisivana.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

motu: Paulo na dubu ai e dae kau loulouva, hua toi davana e haroro loulouva mai haheaukana ida, Dirava ena basileia herevadia e hahedibalaiva, taunimanima lalodia e aniva.
english: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

motu: A haida ese lalodia e ha-aukadia, e gwau edeede, bona dala matamatana e ḡonaḡonalaia hutuma vairadiai. Taunabunai Paulo ese e rakatanidia, Iesu ibadinana taudia danu e hakaudia oho; bena dina iboudiai Turano ena hahediba rumana ai e hahedibava.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

motu: Laḡani rua unu e kara tomava; taunabunai Asia tanona ai e nohova taudia, Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia, iboudiai ese Lohiabada ena hereva e kamonaiva.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

motu: Siahu karadia hereadia danu Dirava ese Paulo imana amo e karava;
english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

motu: taunabunai muko bona rami Paulo tauna ena amo e laohai, gorere taudia dekediai, bena edia gorere vada e doko bona lauma dikadia ese e rakatanidia.
english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

motu: A Iuda taudia haida, vaia lauma dikadia ilulu-ohodia karadia e loalaiva taudia, ese Iesu ladana e hatoa matama, lauma dikadia ese e bolodia taudia latadiai, eto, Paulo ese e harorolaia tauna Iesu ladana ai a haḡanimuimu.
english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

motu: Skeva, Iuda tauna bona hahelaḡa tauna ta, natuna mamaruanedia hahituosi unu e kara tomava.
english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

motu: Bena lauma dikana ese e haere henidia, eto, Iesu na mai dibagu, Paulo danu dibagu, a umui be daidia?
english: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

motu: Bena hari lauma dikana ese e boloa tauna na idia latadiai e roho kau, e hadareredia bona e dadabadia, ela bona idia na una ruma amo e heau lasi, asi dabuadia bona mai berodia ida.
english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

motu: Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia Efeso ai e nohova ese harina e kamonai, bena gari ese iboudiai e butudia tao. Iboudiai ese danu Lohiabada Iesu ladana e imodaia.
english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

motu: Bona kamonai taudia hutuma danu ema, edia kara e gwaurai hedinarai;
english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

motu: bona babalau taudia dia gagadoi edia buka e habou, taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai e gabu. Buka davadia e hagau, davadia silver monidia gerebu ima.
english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver. + 19:19 The 50,000 pieces of silver here probably referred to 50,000 drachmas. If so, the value of the burned books was equivalent to about 160 man-years of wages for agricultural laborers *

motu: Taunabunai, Lohiabada ena hereva vada e vara rohorohova bona e kwalimuva.
english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

motu: Una murinai Paulo lalona e hadaia, Makedonia bona Akaia tanodia amo baine raka hanai, bena Ierusalem bainela. Eto, Unu bainala guna, gabeamo Roma baina ha itaia.
english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

motu: Bena ia ese iduruna taudia rarua, Timoteo bona Erasto, Makedonia e siaidia lao; a ia sibona Asia kahana ai e nohova.
english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

motu: Una neg ma ai heloḡo-heloḡo dia maraḡi e vara, Iesu ena dala dainai.
english: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

motu: Badina binai: tau ta ladana be Demetrio, silver igaukaralaina tau, dirava hahinena ladana Diana ena silver dubudubudia e karava; unu amo ena ḡaukara oreana taudia ese moni diaḡau e abiva.
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

motu: Ia ese idia bona ḡaukara heḡereḡeredia e karava taudia e haboudia, eto, Tatau e, dibamui ina ḡaukara amo eda moni ta abimu;
english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

motu: bona o itaiamu bona o kamonaimu danu, ina tau Paulo ese taunimanima hutuma bada lalodia e animu, bona e hakaudia sirimu, dia Efeso ai mo, a Asia tanona idoinai; danu, e tomamu taunimanima imadia ese e kara diravadia na dia dirava korikori.
english: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

motu: Ina na ita e hadikadamu. Eda moni idavarina ḡaukarana taunimanima ese bae dadaraia. Bona dia una mo: dirava hahinena, Diana, ena dubu danu bae dadaraia; oibe, Asia idoinai bona tanobada taudia ibouboudiai e toma henia dihomu diravana dagina herea-daena baine heabi oho.
english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

motu: Idia ese una hereva e kamonai negana ai e badu dikadika, e lolo loulou, eto, Efeso diravana, Diana, na herea mikamika.
english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

motu: Hanua idoinai heloḡo-heloḡo vada e bada. Bena idia iboudiai e heau ela herarai rumana, mai lalodia tamona; Makedonia taudia rarua danu, Gaio bona Aristako, Paulo ena laolao ai e bamoava taudia, vada e dabaidia tao, e dabuidia lao.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

motu: Bena Paulo ena ura be baine raka vareai hanua taudia dekediai, to Iesu ibadinana taudia ese e rua.
english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

motu: Asia lohiadia haida be Paulo turana; idia ese danu gwaukau e siaia, e noia, herarai rumana ai basine raka vareai eto.
english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

motu: Haida ese hereva ta e lololaiava, ma haida hereva ta; bena hebou na e heloḡo ahuahuva dainai hutuma na hebou badina asi dibadia.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

motu: Bena haida na lalodia eto hebou badina be Alesana, badina be Iuda taudia ese taunimanima vairadiai e doria laova. Taunabunai, Alesana ese imana ai e taodia ahu, taunimanima baine haere henidia eto.
english: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

motu: To idia ese e itaia, ia na Iuda tauna, bena iboudiai hereva tamona e lololaia loulouva ela bona hora rua sisivana; eto, Efeso diravana, Diana, na herea mikamika.
english: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

motu: Bena hanua ena toretore tauna ese hutuma e hatuidia, eto, Efeso taumui e, daika tanobada ai asi dibana Efeso na Diana badana ena dubu igimana, bona Deo ena amo e moru ḡauna danu igimana.
english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

motu: Ini hereva be asi igwau-tubudia, taunabunai ba noho namonamo, basio kara havarahavara, una be namo.
english: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

motu: Badina be ini o hakaudia mai taudia na dia dubu ai asie dadidadi; eda dirava hahinena danu asie hadikaia.
english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

motu: Taunabunai, Demetrio mai ena ḡaukara taudia ida lalodia baeto tau ta ese vada e hadikadia, hahemaoro rumadia vada eme hekeho, gavana danu noho: benaini, bae hahebade heheni.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

motu: A bema idau hereva ta mia, hebou korikori ai bae herevalaia.
english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

motu: A hari dina ena heloḡo-heloḡo dainai bae habadelaida be baita kerere; badina be ina heloḡo-heloḡo na asi anina, bona ina hebou badina na basita gwauraia diba.
english: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”

motu: Ia e hereva vaitani, bena e haḡanidia bae karoho.
english: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

motu: Helogo-helogo e doko murinai, Paulo ese Iesu ibadinana taudia e haboudia, e hahealo henidia, e hatonidia; bena e rakatanidia, Makedonia ela.
english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

motu: Unu gabu e rakadia hanai, hereva hoho ai e hahealo henidia; bena Akaia ela,
english: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

motu: hua toi unuseni ai e nohova. Lagatoi ai baine ḡui Suria bainela eto, to Iuda taudia ese ihadikana karana e henegalaia dainai ia ese lalona e hadaia Makedonia amo baine lou.
english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

motu: E bamoa ela bona Asia taudia bini: Sopatera Puro, tau Berea; Aristako bona Sekundo, Tesalonika taudia; Gaio, tau Derebe; Tukiko bona Trofimo, Asia taudia.
english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

motu: Idia ese e gunalaimai, Troa ai e narimai.
english: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

motu: A ai na Flaoa-asie-hatubua Ariana dinadia e ore murinai Filipi a heautania, daba ima Troa ai a heau kau, idia dekediai a kau. Dina hitu unuseni ai a nohova. Troa ai
english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

motu: Pura dinana gini-gunana anibou ianina a hebou negana ai, Paulo ese e haroro henidia, badina be daba ai baine heau eto. Ena haroro e hadaudaua ela bona malokihi.
english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

motu: Atai daiutuna ai a hebou; una daiutu ai lamepa na momo.
english: There were many lights in the upper room where we + 20:8 TR reads “they” instead of “we” * were gathered together.

motu: Eregabe tauna ta, ladana Eutuko, gaba-matuna ai e helaiva; bena mahuta ese e hametaua matama, Paulo ese ena haroro e hadaudaua dainai. E mahuta hedavauhe, bena ruma atai kahana amo e moru dobi; e abia isi negana ai ia na vada e mase.
english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

motu: A Paulo na e diho, latanai e goru, e rosia; eto, Asio heloḡo-heloḡo, ia na doini e maurimu.
english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

motu: Ma e dae kau, flaoa alagana e bakia, e aniani; bena idia ida e hereva-hereva ela bona daba e rere. Bena e raka oho.
english: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

motu: A hebou taudia ese eregabe tauna e hakaua Iao mai maurina ida; edia lalo-namo na dia maraḡi. Paulo ese Efeso taudia hatonidia
english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

motu: Ai na vada a ḡui guna, lara a kidaia, Aso ai baia heau kau, unuseni ai Paulo baine ḡui kau eto; badina be ia na unu e hahedua toma. A ia na tano amo bainela eto.
english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

motu: Taunabunai ai na ia ida Aso ai a hedavari, e ḡui kau, bena Mitulene ai a heau kau.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

motu: Unu amo ma a heau lao, bena kerukeru Kioso daenai a hetu, vanegai Samo ai a heau kau, vainanegai Mileto ai a heau kau.
english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

motu: Badina be Paulo lalona eto Efeso baine heaua hanai be namo, nega daudau Asia ai baine halahe na garina. Badina be ia na e ḡava, bema mai dalana Pentekoste dinana ai Ierusalem ai baine noho eto.
english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

motu: Bena Mileto amo ia ese gwaukau Efeso e siaia lao, ekalesia oreana ita-taona taudia ia dekena baela.
english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

motu: Bena idia na dekenai e kau negana ai, ia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Asia tanona ai aegu na hadaia guna dinana ema harihari, ede na noho tomava umui bogaragimui ai vada dibamui.
english: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

motu: Lohiabada isiaina na lao heniava mai manaugu ida; iruru-matagu e dihova bona hisihisi ese e butugu taova, Iuda taudia edia henega dikadia daidiai.
english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

motu: Ihanamolaimui herevadia iboudiai na hamaorolai henimuiva, ta asina hunia; bona na hadibamuiva taunimanima vairadiai bona emui ruma ai danu.
english: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

motu: Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia danu na haroro henidiava, Dirava enai bae helalo kerehai, bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bae abidadama henia.
english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus. + 20:21 TR adds “Christ” *

motu: Harihari Ierusalem bainala, Lauma ese vada e ḡuigu dainai, a dahaka ese unuseni ai baine butugu tao na asi dibagu;
english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

motu: ḡau tamona, hanua hanua lalodiai Lauma Helaḡa ese vada e hamaorogu, iḡui bona hisihisi momo vairagu ai eme hure.
english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

motu: A egu mauli na herevana, asina lalokau heniamu: egu heau baina ha-orea, hesiai ilaohenina Lohiabada Iesu ese vada e henigu, Dirava ena harihari-bada sivaraina namona baina gwauraia hedinarai, vada baina haḡuḡurua.
english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

motu: Harihari lau na dibagu, emui ai na loaloa bona Basileia na harorolai henimui taumui iboumui ai ese vairagu basio itaia lou.
english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

motu: Badina binai na hamaoromuimu, lau na taunimanima iboudiai raradia amo name ḡoeva.
english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura idoinai vada na hamaorolaimui; sina taina asina moia tao.
english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

motu: Sibomui nahuamui ba toho, mamoe serina nahuana danu; serina bunai Lauma Helaḡa ese ita-taona taumui ai vada e halaomui, Dirava ena ekalesia ia rarana e davalaia ḡauna, ba ubua helaoreana.
english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and + 20:28 TR, NU omit “the Lord and” * God which he purchased with his own blood.

motu: Dibagu lau baina raka oho murinai uda sisiadia karakaradia be. bogaragimui ai do bae raka vareai, seri na bae hadikaia;
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

motu: bona umui sibomui emui amo tatau haida do bae gini tore, hereva gageva-gagevadia bae gwaurai, kamonai taudia bae hakaudia kerere.
english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

motu: Taunabunai, ba gima, ina danu ha laloa tao laḡani toi vaitani umui ta ta isisiba-henimui asina hadokoa; na sisiba henimui boiva na sisiba henimui raniva mai irurumatagu ida.
english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

motu: Harihari Dirava imana ai bona ena harihari-bada herevana ai na atomui taomu; ia na mai goadana baine haginunui maoro, bona ahumui baine heni ena helaḡa taudia iboudiai bogaragidiai.
english: Now, brothers, + 20:32 The word for “brothers” here and where the context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

motu: Tau ta ena silver eiava ena gold eiava ena dabua asina hekisehekise heniava.
english: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

motu: Umui dibamui, egu dabu ḡaudia, bona bamogu edia, na ini imagu ruaosi ḡaukaradia amo na abiva.
english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai lalodiai dala namona na hahedinarai henimui; ba gaukara, lau bamogu, manoka-manoka taudia ba kahadia; bona Lohiabada Iesu ena hereva ba laloa tao, eto “Ḡau ihenina be namo bada, ḡau iabina be namo maraḡi”.
english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘\+w It|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w more|strong="G3123"\+w* \+w blessed|strong="G3107"\+w* \+w to|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w than|strong="G2228"\+w* \+w to|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w receive|strong="G2983"\+w*.’ * ”

motu: Unu e gwau toma, bena tuina e hadai, idia iboudiai ida e ḡuriḡuri.
english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

motu: Idia iboudiai na e tai dikadika, aiona ai e hagagiu dae, e harahua.
english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

motu: Lalodia e hisihisi bada ena hereva dainai, ia vairana basie itaia lou eto. Bena dala ai e bamoa ela lagatoi.
english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

motu: Taunabunai, ai ese a hatonidia mai lalo-metaumai ida, bena lara a kidaia, a heau maoromaoro, Koso ai a heau kau; kerukeru Rodo ai a heau kau; unu amo a heau ala Patara.
english: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

motu: Unuseni ai Foenikia bainela lagatoina ta a davaria, bena a ḡui kau, a heau.
english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

motu: Kupro a itaia, bena laurina kahana ai a heautania, Suria ai a heau kau, Turo ai a diho; badina be lagatoi kohuna unuseni ai bae vaia eto.
english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

motu: Iesu ibadinana taudia a davaridia, bena unuseni ai boi hitu a nohova; Lauma ena amo idia ese Paulo e hamaoroa loulou, Ierusalem basinela.
english: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

motu: Unu dinadia e ore, bena emai laolao ala; idia iboudiai mai adavadia mai natudia ida dala ai e bamomai ela bona hanua a rakatania. Kone ai a hetuitui, a ḡuriḡuri,
english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

motu: bena a hatonidia, lagatoi ai a ḡui kau. Idia ese edia ruma e lou heni.
english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

motu: Turo amo a heau, Tolemaia ai a heau kau: emai heau dokona bunai. Unuseni ai varavara a hahenamo henidia, dina tamona idia ida a noho.
english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

motu: Daba ai, Tolemaia a rakatania, Kaisarea ala, Filipo, sivarai namo iharorolaina tauna, ena ruma ai a dae kau; ia na hahituosi taudia ta. Bena ia ida a nohova.
english: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We|strong="G2532" * entered|strong="G1525" * into|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G2532" * house|strong="G3624" * of|strong="G1537" * Philip|strong="G5376" * the|strong="G2532" * evangelist|strong="G2099" *, who|strong="G3588" * was|strong="G1510" * one|strong="G3588" * of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G2532" * seven|strong="G2033" *, and|strong="G2532" * stayed|strong="G3306" * with|strong="G3844" * him|strong="G3588" *.

motu: Ia na mai natuna ulatodia hahani; hahaniosi ese e perovetava.
english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

motu: Dina hoho unuseni ai nohomai ai, peroveta tauna ta, ladana Agabo, Iudea amo e diho ema,
english: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

motu: dekemai ai e gini dae. Bena ia ese Paulo ena dabua e abia, sibona aena bona imana e ḡuilai, eto, Lauma Helaḡa be ini e gwau tomamu: ina dabua biaguna na Iuda taudia ese Ierusalem ai ini bae ḡuia toma, bena idau bese taudia bae henidia.
english: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

motu: Una hereva a kamonai negana ai na ai bona una gabu taudia danu a noia loulou, Ierusalem basine ha dara dae.
english: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

motu: Bena Paulo e haere, eto, Ini o tai tomamu bona lalogu ini o hamanokaia tomamu anina be dahaka? Lau be vada name heḡaeḡae, bae ḡuigu; oibe, dia una mo, baina mase danu Ierusalem ai, Lohiabada Iesu ladana bagunai.
english: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

motu: Bena lalona ianina ai asia heḡereḡere dainai emai noinoi a hadokoa, ato, Lohiabada ena ura mo baine karaia.
english: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

motu: Unu dina muridiai, emai laolao ḡaudia a abi heḡaeḡae, bena Ierusalem ai a ha dara dae.
english: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

motu: Iesu ibadinana taudia haida Kaisarea amo e bamomai; Nason, tau Kupro, danu a hakaua lao; ia na Iesu ibadinana tauna gunana ta, ena ruma ai baine abimai dae eto. Paulo Ierusalem ai
english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

motu: Ierusalem ai a kau negana ai na varavara ese e abimai dae mai moaledia ida.
english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

motu: Kerukeru, Paulo na ai ida ala, Iakobo dekenai a raka vareai; ekalesia oreana ita-taona taudia iboudiai danu e hebou.
english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

motu: Paulo ese e hahenamo henidia, bena Dirava ese bese idau-idau taudia bogaragidiai iena hesiai amo e karava kal-adia iboudiai sivaraidia e gwaurai.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

motu: Idia na e kamonai, bena Dirava e heatolaia. Bena idia ese ia e hereva henia, eto, Varavalamai e, oi dibamu Iuda taudia daha daha ese Iesu vada e badinaiamu; iboudiai danu taravatu e badinaia tarika-tarikamu.
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

motu: Idia na vada e kamonai, oi ese Iuda taudia bese idau-idau bogaragidiai e nohomu na o hadibadiamu, Mose bae rakatania, bona natudia basie peritomedia, bona sene karadia basie kara.
english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

motu: Taunabenai, ede ba kara toma? Momokani, idia na bae kamonai oi vada oma.
english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

motu: Una dainai, ina kara aia hamaorolaimu na ba karaia. Tatau hahani bini hehelaḡa, edia gwauhamata dainai.
english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

motu: Oi ese ba bamodia, idia ida ba hallego(:va, bae laohai kohudia danu ba davanalai, bena huidia bae utu. Unu am-taunimanima iboudiai bae diba oi harimu e kamonaiva na asi anina; bae diba danu o kara maoromaoromu, bona taravatu o badinaiamu.
english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

motu: A bese idau-idau taudia na emai lalo-hadai vada a tore henidia, ato, Kaivakuku ihahoulaidia ḡaudia bona rara bona aiodia e gigi ḡaudia hidiodia na basie ani, bona basieheuda-hanai.
english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

motu: Taunabunai, Paulo ese hari tatau e bamodia; kerukeru, idia ida e hahegoeva, bona Dubu Helaḡa lalonai e raka vareai, haheḡoeva dinadia bae ore bona boubou ḡaudia idia ta ta daidiai baine ato dinana e gwauraia hedinarai. Ierusalem taudia ese Paulo e dabaia tao
english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

motu: Haheḡoeva dinadia hituosi kahira-kahira e ore ai na Iuda taudia haida Asia amo ese Paulo e itaia, Dubu Helaḡa lalonai, bena idia ese aru taudia lalodia e ani. Bena e dabaia tao,
english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

motu: e lolo, eto, Israel taumui e, a kahamai. Ina tau ese taunimanima iboudiai gabu idoidiai e hadibadiamu, ita beseda bona taravatu bona ina gabu bae inai henidia; ina danu, ia ese Helene taudia na Dubu Helaḡa lalonai vada e hakaudia vareai, ina gabu helaḡana vada e hadikaia.
english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

motu: Badina be idia ese Trofimo, tau Efeso, hanua lalonai Paulo ida e itadia guna, bena banava eto Paulo ese Dubu Helaḡa lalonai vada e hakaua vareai.
english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

motu: Hanua idoinai e haraivaia; bena hanua taudia e aru ela, Paulo e dabaia tao, Dubu Helaḡa amo e veria lasi, bena iduara iboudiai e kou. Roma taudia ese Paulo e hamauria
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

motu: Idia ese bae alaia mase eto. To Ierusalem idoinai e heloḡo-heloḡova harina na tuari biaguna badana e kamonai;
english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

motu: bena ia ese tuari taudia mai biagudia ida e hakaudia haraḡa-haraḡa, dekedia e heau diho. Aru taudia ese tuari biaguna badana mai ena orea taudia ida e itadia, bena Paulo idadabana e hadokoa.
english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

motu: Bena tuari biaguna badana e raka kahira, e abia, ena orea taudia e haduadia gadea rua amo bae ḡuia. Bena e henanadai, ia be daika bona ena kara be dahaka.
english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

motu: A hutuma bogaragidia amo haida hereva ta ma haida hereva ta e lololai; bena heloḡo-heloḡo dainai ia na hereva maorona idavarina asi dibana. Taunabunai e hahedua, Paulo na tuari kohorona lalonai bae hakaua vareai.
english: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

motu: Vadavada ai e kau ai, tuari taudia ese e huaia dae, badina be aru taudia na mai edia daḡedaḡe.
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

motu: Badina be hanua taudia ibouboudiai ese e ḡavaia, e lolo, eto, Aine mase. Paulo ese Ierusalem taudia e haroro henidia
english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

motu: Kohoro lalonai bae hakaua vareai eto; bena Paulo ese tuan biaguna badana e noia, eto, Mani bama hereva henimu. Tuari biaguna badana eto, Helene gadodia mai dibamu a?
english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ Do|strong="G3004" * you|strong="G4771" * know|strong="G1097" * Greek|strong="G1676" *?

motu: Oi na dia hari Aigupto tauna, gunaguna ala-ala e havaraia bona ala-ala taudia daha hani tano ḡaḡaena e hakaudia lao, a?
english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

motu: Paulo eto, Lau na Iuda taugu; egu hanua na Taso, Kilikia tanona ai, harina dia maraḡi hanuana. Na noimumu, mani emu kara, taunimanima aina hereva henidia.
english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

motu: E gwau maoro; bena Paulo na vadavada ai e gini, imana ai taunimanima e taodia ahu. Idia na asi reḡereḡedia; bena ia ese Heberu gadodia ai e hereva henidia, eto,
english: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

motu: Tadikakagu bona tamagu logora e, sivaraigu aina hamaorolaimui mani a kamonai.
english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

motu: Idia ese e kamonai ia na Heberu gadodia ai e hereva henidia, bena asi reḡereḡedia e hakala henia.
english: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G5346" *,

motu: Bena ia ma eto, Lau na Iuda taugu, Kilikia tanona ai na vara, Taso hanuana ai; to ina hanua lalonai na bada oho bada oho. Gamaliel ese e hadibaguva negana ai, ia ese seneda edia taravatu kaladia metaudia e hadibalaiguva. Bena Dirava ena ḡaukara na goadalaiava, harihari umui ese o goadalaiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

motu: Ina dala matamatana danu na daḡedaḡe heniava, tatau bona hahine na ḡuidiava, dibura rumadia ai na koudiava, bae mase na tomava.
english: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

motu: Una na hahelaḡa tauna badana bona hanua tau-badadia bae hamomokania diba. Idia ese revareva e henigu, varavarada Damasko ai edia; bena nala, unuseni ai e nohova taudia ma baina ḡuidia, Ierusalem baina hakaudia mai, matadia ihakanidia totona.
english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

motu: To na laova ai, Damasko e kahira-kahira, dina tubua sisivana diari badana ta guba amo e tara dagu, e ḡeḡegu ahu.
english: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

motu: Tano ai na hekida diho, bena gado ta na kamonai, eto “Saulo e, Saulo e, dahaka dainai o daḡedaḡe henigumu?”
english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘\+w Saul|strong="G4549"\+w*, \+w Saul|strong="G4549"\+w*, \+w why|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w are|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w you|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w persecuting|strong="G1377"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*?’ *

motu: Bena na haere, nato “Lohiabada e, oi na daika?” Ia e helada hato, eto “Lau na Iesu, tau Nasaret, o daḡedaḡe henigumu”.
english: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘\+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w Jesus|strong="G2424"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2962"\+w* \+w Nazareth|strong="G3480"\+w*, \+w whom|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w persecute|strong="G1377"\+w*.’ *

motu: Bamogu danu diari e itaia, to e hereva henigu gadona na asie kamonai.
english: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

motu: Bena na henanadai, nato “Lohiabada e, ede baina kara toma?”, Lohiabada e haere, eto “A tore isi, Damasko ai ba raka vareai, unuseni ai ta ese baine hamaoromu ede ba kara toma”.
english: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, \+w and|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w go|strong="G4198"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w Damascus|strong="G1154"\+w*. \+w There|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w will|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w be|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w told|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w about|strong="G4012"\+w* \+w all|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w are|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w appointed|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w do|strong="G4160"\+w*.’ *

motu: Una diari badana ese matagu e paia, ḡau ta asina itaia; bena bamogu ese imagu ai e abi, e hakaugu lao bona Damasko ai.
english: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

motu: Unuseni ai tau ta na dekegu ema, ladana na Anania; ia be Dirava garina e gariva bona taravatu e badinaiava tauna; Iuda taudia danu iboudiai unuseni ai e nohova ese ia e imodaiava.
english: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

motu: Ia na badibadigu ai e gini, eto “Tadigu Saulo e, matamu bae papa”. Una negana ai matagu vada e papa, na itaia.
english: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

motu: Bena ia eto “Seneda edia Dirava ese vada e abimu hidi, ena ura vada ba diba, Kara Maoromaoro Tauna do ba itaia bona uduna herevadia danu ba kamonai.
english: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

motu: Badina be iena amo vada o ita bona o kamonai ḡaudia na do ba gwaurai hedinarai, iena taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai.
english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

motu: Dahaka o halahemu? A tore isi; bapatiso avabia, emu dika ihuri-ohodia; bona ia ladana ba hahanea”.
english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

motu: Bena Ierusalem na lou henia, Dubu Helaḡa lalonai na ḡuriḡuriva ai na mata hanai,
english: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

motu: Iesu na itaia. E hereva henigu, eto “A kara haraḡa, Ierusalem a rakatania haraḡa-haraḡa; badina be sivaraigu na bo gwauraimu basie abi daemu”.
english: and saw him saying to me, ‘\+w Hurry|strong="G4692"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w get|strong="G1831"\+w* \+w out|strong="G1831"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w Jerusalem|strong="G2419"\+w* \+w quickly|strong="G5034"\+w*, \+w because|strong="G1360"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w not|strong="G3756"\+w* \+w receive|strong="G3858"\+w* \+w testimony|strong="G3141"\+w* \+w concerning|strong="G4012"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w from|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*.’ *

motu: Lau na haere, nato “Lohiabada e, idia dibadia, lau ese oi ibadinamu taudia na dubu iboudiai amo na abidia, dibura rumadia ai na koudia, na dadabadia danu.
english: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

motu: Igwauraimu tauna Stefano danu rarana e hahebubua negana ai lau danu idia dekediai gini, ia iala-masena taudia edia kara na hanamoa, bona edia dabua na nari”.
english: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’

motu: A Iesu ese e hereva henigu, eto “Vada aola; bainda be gabu daudau bdina siaimu lao, bese idau-idau dekedia baola”.
english: “He said to me, ‘\+w Depart|strong="G4198"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w send|strong="G1821"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w out|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w far|strong="G3112"\+w* \+w from|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w here|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Gentiles|strong="G1484"\+w*.’ * ”

motu: Idia ese e hakala henia ela bona ia na unu e gwau toma, bena e lolo, eto, Ina tau na tanobada amo baine heabi oho; baine mauri na dia namo.
english: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

motu: E lolova ai edia dabua danu e taho nege, bona ḡahu e taho dae taho dae. Paulo Roma taudia imadia ai
english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

motu: Una dainai tuari biaguna badana ese ena orea taudia e haduadia, Paulo na kohoro lalonai bae hakaua vareai, unuseni ai bae dadabaia, bona bae nanadaia, unu e lolo henia tomava anina be dahaka.
english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

motu: Idia ese boromakau kopina varodia amo e mataia, bena ia ese tuari biaguna, ia badibadinai e gini tauna, e nanadaia, eto, Roma tauna na do basie hahemaoro henia a vada bae dadabaia guna na maoro a?
english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

motu: Tuari biaguna una hereva e kamonai, bena ela, tuari biaguna badana e hamaoroa, eto, Ede bo kara tomamu? Badina be hari tau na Roma tauna.
english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

motu: Bena tuari biaguna badana na Paulo dekena ela, eto, A hamaorogu, oi na Roma taumu a? Ia eto, Oibe.
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" *, “ Yes|strong="G3483" *.”

motu: Tuari biaguna badana eto, Una dagi be moni badana amo na hoia. Paulo eto, A lau be una dagi ai na vara.
english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul|strong="G3972" * said|strong="G5346" *, “ But|strong="G1161" * I|strong="G1473" * was|strong="G3588" * born|strong="G1080" * a|strong="G2532" * Roman.”

motu: Bena bae dadabaia eto taudia ese e rakatania haraḡa-haraḡa; tuari biaguna badana danu kudouna e hetaha, badina be ia dibana Roma tauna vada e ḡuia kava.
english: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

motu: Kerukeru, tuari biaguna badana e urava Iuda taudia ese Paulo e habadelaia badina baine diba. Una dainai ia ese e ruhaia, bena hahelaḡa taudia bona kaunsil taudia iboudiai e haduadia, bae hebou eto. Bena ia ese Paulo e hakaua diho, idia vairadiai e haginia.
english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

motu: Bena Paulo ese kaunsil taudia e raraidia tao; bena eto, Varavaragu e, lau na mai lalo-ḡoevaḡoevagu ida vada na nohova Dirava vairanai, ema bona harihari.
english: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

motu: Bena hahelaḡa tauna badana, Anania, ese badibadinai e gini taudia e haduadia, uduna bae huaria.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

motu: Bena Paulo ese e gwau henia, eto, Dirava ese oi do baine huarimu; oi na e hakurokuroa habana na heto. Oi na taravatu ai ba hahemaoro henigu totona o helaimu ani? Matona, taravatu o tataia utumu, o haduadiamu bae huarigu.
english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

motu: Badibadinai e gini taudia eto, Dirava ena hahelaḡa tauna badana o ḡonaḡonalaiamu a?
english: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

motu: Paulo e haere, eto, Varavaragu e, asi dibagu ia na hahelaḡa tauna badana; a dibagu vada e torea, Emu bese lohiana na basio ere dika henia.
english: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’” + 23:5 Exodus 22:28 *

motu: Paulo ese kaunsil taudia e itadia, haida be Sadukea taudia, ma haida be Farisea taudia; bena bogaragidiai e lolo, eto, Varavaragu e, lau na Farisea taugu, bona Farisea tauna natuna. Mase taudia edia tore-isi-lou name laroa dainai o hahemaoro henigumu a?
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

motu: Ia na unu e gwau toma; bena Farisea taudia bona Sadukea taudia e hepapahuahu, edia hebou e haheparara;
english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

motu: badina be Sadukea taudia e tomamu tore-isi-lou na lasi, aneru lasi, lauma danu lasi, a Farisea taudia ese iboudiai e gwauraidiamu.
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

motu: Bena heloḡoheloḡo vada e badava; itorena taudia haida Farisea oreana amo e gini tore, e hereva goada-goada, eto, ina tau enai kara dika ta asiame davaria; lauma ta eiava aneru ta ese vada e hereva henia dahaka.
english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

motu: Hepapahuahu na e habadaia; bena tuari biaguna badana e gari, idia ese Paulo bae darea na garina. Taunabunai, ia ese ena orea taudia e haduadia, bae diho, bogaragidia amo bae hakaua oho, kohoro lalonai ma bae hakaua vareai.
english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

motu: Hanuaboi ai Lohiabada na Paulo badibadinai e gini, eto, Ba goada balaheni, badina be Ierusalem ai vada o gwauraigu heḡereḡerena ai Roma ai danu ma ba gwauraigu. Iuda taudia ese Paulo iala-masena dalana e tahua
english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer \+w up|strong="G1210"\+w*, \+w Paul|strong="G3588"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w as|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w testified|strong="G3140"\+w* \+w about|strong="G4012"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w at|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w Jerusalem|strong="G2419"\+w*, \+w so|strong="G3779"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w must|strong="G1163"\+w* \+w testify|strong="G3140"\+w* \+w also|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w at|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w Rome|strong="G4516"\+w*.” *

motu: Daba ai, Iuda taudia haida e henega, e gwau hamata mai hereva metaudia ida, basie aniani bona ranu basie inua ela bona Paulo bae alaia mase.
english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

motu: Unu e gwau hamata toma taudia na hari-ahui mai dikoana.
english: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

motu: Idia na hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua tau-badadia dekedia ela, eto, Ai na vada ame gwau hamata mai hereva metaudia ida, basia aniani ela bona Paulo baia alaia mase.
english: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

motu: Taunabinai, umui na kaunsil taudia ida tuari biaguna ba noia, ia ese Paulo ma baine hakaua diho dekemui ai, boma ura ia herevana boma tahua ḡoevaḡoeva na heto. A ai na baia heḡaeḡae noho, bena dekemui ai do basine raka kahi mai, vada baia alaia mase.
english: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

motu: A Paulo vavana ese edia bani-tao herevana e kamonai, bena tuari taudia edia kohoro ai e raka vareai, Paulo e hamaorolaia.
english: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

motu: Bena Paulo ese tuari biaguna maraḡina ta e boiria, eto, Ina tauhau na tuari biaguna badana dekena a hakaua lao, badina be ia na hereva ta baine hamaorolaia e tomu.
english: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

motu: Taunabunai, ia ese e hakaua lao, tuari biaguna badana dekena, eto, Hari mai iḡuina tauna, Paulo, ese e boirigu, e noigu, ina tauhau na oi dekemu baina hakaua mai eto, badina be ia na hereva ta aine hamaorolaimu e tomu.
english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

motu: Bena tuari biaguna badana ese ia imana e abia, e hakaua siri, e nanadaia hehuni; eto, Dahaka ba hamaorogu o tomu?
english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

motu: Ia na e haere, eto, Iuda taudia vada e henega bou, bae noimu, kerukeru Paulo ba hakaua diho, kaunsil taudia dekediai, bae nanadaia ḡoevaḡoeva totona.
english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

motu: To basio kamonai henidia, badina tatau hari-ahui mai dikoana na Paulo e bani heniamu, bona vada e gwau hamata, eto aniani basie ani bona ranu basie inu ela bona bae alaia mase. Idia na harihari e heḡaeḡae nohomu, badina be lalodia e tomamu oi ese edia noinoi bavabia dae.
english: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

motu: Taunabunai, tuari biaguna badana ese tauhau na e tua, e tamanua, eto, Tau ta basio hamaoroa oi ese unu ḡau vada o hadibalaigu. Roma taudia ese Paulo e hakaua lao Kaisarea ai
english: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

motu: Bena ia ese tuari biagudia rarua e boiridia, eto, Tuari taudia sinahu-rua bona hosi ai e guimu taudia hitu-ahui bona io taudia sinahu-rua ba haboudia heḡaeḡae, hari hanuaboi hora taurahani-ta Kaisarea baela.
english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.” + 23:23 about 9:00 p.m. *

motu: Hosi ta danu ba henidia, Paulo ena gui ḡauna. Bena Gavana Feliki dekena ba laohaia mai maurina ida.
