english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

motu: Revareva danu e torea, ini e torea toma:
english: He wrote a letter like this:

motu: Lau Klaudio Lusia ese oi Feliki, gavana taumu namo-hereana, na hahenamo henimumu.
english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

motu: Ina tau be Iuda taudia ese e dabaia tao, bae alaia mase eto; bena lau na tuari oreana ida ala, a hamauria, badina be na diba ia na Roma tauna.
english: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

motu: kau na ura e habadelaiava badina baina diba, taunabunai na hakaua diho edia hegogo badana lalonai.
english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

motu: Unuseni ai na davaria idia ese edia taravatu herevadia ai e habadelaiava, a ihamasena eiava iḡuina badina ta asie gwauraia.
english: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

motu: A vada eme hamaorogu, haida na bae bani tao bena bae alaia mase; taunabunai na siaia vasi haraḡa-haraḡa dekemu ai; bona ihabadelaina taudia danu vada na haduadia bae vasi, oi vairamu ai bae habadelaia.
english: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

motu: Taunabunai, e haduadia heḡereḡerena ai, tuari taudia ese Paulo e abia, hanuaboi ai Antipatri e hakaua lao.
english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

motu: Kerukeru, idia na edia kohoro e lou lao; a hosi ai e ḡui taudia be Paulo ida ela.
english: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

motu: Kaisarea ai e lasi; bena hari revareva na gavana e henia, Paulo danu e hakaua vareai ia vairanai.
english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

motu: Feliki ese hari revareva e duahia vaitani, bena e henanadai, eto, Ia be edena gabu tauna? Vada e kamonai ia na Kilikia kahana tauna.
english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

motu: Bena eto, E habadelaimumu taudia do baema, bena vairadiai emu hereva idoinai baina kamonai. Bena e haduadia, Herod ena hahemaoro rumana ai do bae gimaia.
english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

motu: A Dina ima e ore ai, Anania, hahelaḡa tauna badana, e gini dae, hanua tau-badadia haida ida, bona haroro mai dibana tauna ta, ladana Teretulo. Bena idia ese gavana e hereva henia, Paulo e habadelaia.
english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

motu: Taunabunai Paulo e boiria. Bena Teretulo ese e habadelaia matama; eto, Namo-herea taumu Feliki e, oi daimu ai maino ai a nohomu; bona emu aonega dainai ina bese ena dala vada eme maoromaoro;
english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

motu: taunabunai ai ese nega idoidiai bona gabu iboudiai emu hereva a abi daemu bona a hanamomumu.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

motu: A baina haturiamu na garina na noimumu, mani ame bogamai hisi, emai hereva kwadogina na ba kamonai.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

motu: Badina binai: ai ese ina tau a davaria, ia na dika ihavarana tauna, Iuda taudia iboudiai tanobada kahadia idoidiai ia ese e haheloḡo-heloḡodiamu; ia danu Nasaret oreana ihakauna tauna ta.
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

motu: Ia ese Dubu Helaḡa e hadikaia toho, to ai ese a dabaia tao, baia hahemaoro henia emai taravatu heḡereḡerena ato.
english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him. + 24:6 TR adds “We wanted to judge him according to our law,” *

motu: A Lusia, tuari biaguna badana, ema, imamai amo e abia oho mai daḡedaḡena ida;
english: + 24:7 TR adds “but the commanding officer, Lysias, came by and with great violence took him out of our hands,” *

motu: bona e habadelaia taudia e haganidia, oi dekemu baema. Mani oi ese ba nanadaia, bena hari kara idoidiai a habadelaiamu herevadia sibomu ba diba.
english: + 24:8 TR adds “commanding his accusers to come to you.” *By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

motu: Bena Iuda taudia ese ena hereva e durua, eto, Unu hereva iboudiai na momomo-kakani.
english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

motu: Gavana ese Paulo e lodu henia; bena Paulo ese haere. Eto, Lau dibagu oi ese laḡani hoho ina bese vada o hahemaoro henia, una dainai sibogu herevagu aina gwaurai mai moalegu ida.
english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

motu: Badina boma tahua boma diba, dina gwauta-rua vada ela, lau na toma-diho tolona Ierusalem ai na lla dara dae.
english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

motu: Dubu Helaḡa ai lau tau ta ida hepapahuahumai ai asie davarigu; bona dubu maraḡidia ai eiava hanua ariaradia ai heloḡo-heloḡo ta asina havaraia.
english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

motu: Idia danu harihari e habadelaigumu herevadia na oi vairamu ai basie hamomokani diba.
english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

motu: A ina na na gwauraia hedinaraimu: idia ese kererena e gwauraiamu dalana ai lau ese senemai edia Dirava na toma henia dihomu; ḡau tamona, ḡau iboudiai taravatu ai bona peroveta bukadia ai e tore na na abi daemu danu.
english: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

motu: Mai egu helaro danu Dirava enai, ini hahebade taudia heḡereḡeredia. Emai helaro binai: mase taudia do bae tore isi lou, kara maoromaoro taudia bona asi edia kara maoromaoro taudia danu.
english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

motu: Ina danu na goadalaiamu, lalogu na basine kerere helaoreana. Dirava vairanai bona taunimanima vairadiai.
english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

motu: Laḡani haida vada e lao bubuni; bena nala, harihari ḡaudia bona boubou ḡaudia egu hanua baina laohai nato.
english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

motu: Unu na kara toma, bena na haheḡoeva negana ai na Dubu Helaḡa ai e davarigu; aru taudia na lasi, heloḡo-heloḡo danu lasi.
english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

motu: A Iuda taudia haida Asia amo be unuseni ai; idia na egu kara dika ta bema diba, oi vairamu ai bema mai, bema habadelaigu, una na bema maoro.
english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

motu: Eiava ini vada ema taudia ese bema hamaorogu, egu kara dika be edena, kaunsil taudia vairadiai na gini negana ai e davaria.
english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

motu: A ina hereva tamona idia bogaragidiai ginigu ai na gwauraia badabada, nato “Mase taudia edia tore-isi-lou herevana dainai hari dina ai o hahemaoro henigumu”.
english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

motu: Hari “dala” herevana vada e diba maoromaoro dainai, Feliki ese idia e gwaudia tubu, eto, Lusia, tuari biaguna badana, bainema negana ai na emui hereva baina tahua namonamo.
english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

motu: Bena tuari biaguna e haduaia, Paulo baine gimaia, to basine koua kunuka-kunuka; turana haida ese danu bae igoa ita, basine gwaudia tao.
english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

motu: Dina Haida muridiai, Feliki na adavana Drusila, Iuda hahinena, ida ema; bena Paulo e boiria, Keriso Iesu iabiabiraina herevana na iena amo e kamonai.
english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

motu: A Paulo ese kara maoromaoro bona boga auka bona bainema hahemaorona danu e herevalai; bena Feliki e gari bada, eto, Harihari aola; nega baine namo ma baina boirimu lou.
english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

motu: Ia danu mai ena helaro, Paulo ese moni baine henia, ia iruhana davana; una dainai ia ese e boiria loulouva, ia ida e hereva-herevava.
english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

motu: A laḡani rua vada e lao bubuni, bena Porokio Festo ese Feliki e boloa. Bena Feliki na Iuda taudia lalodia ihanamodia urana e urava dainai, ia ese Paulo na iḡuina ai e rakatania.
english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

motu: Festo na baine lohiaia tanona ai e diho, dina toi e nohova, bena Kaisarea amo Ierusalem eha dara dae.
english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

motu: Bena hahelaḡa taudia bona Iuda ikwaradia taudia ese Paulo herevana e hadibalaia;
english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

motu: bena e noia, ia ihadikana ai baine durudia, hesiai taudia baine siaidia lao, Ierusalem bae hakaua mai. Badina be idia ese dala ai bae bani henia, bae alaia mase eto.
english: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

motu: A Festo e haere, eto, Paulo bae gimaia Kaisarea ai, asi vanahana lau danu unu bainala.
english: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

motu: Ma eto, Umui bogaragimui amo mai siahudia taudia na lau ida baiala, bena hari tau bema mai ena kerere, idia ese bae habadelaia.
english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

motu: Ia na idia dekediai e nohova dina taurahani eiava gwauta dahaka, bena Kaisarea ela. Kerukeru, ia na hahemaoro gabuna ai e helai; bena e gwau isi, Paulo bae hakaua vareai.
english: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

motu: Ia e gini dae, bena Ierusalem amo e diho taudia ese e ginia heḡeḡe, hereva metaudia momo e habadelaia, to asie hamomokani diba.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

motu: Bena Paulo e haere, eto, Iuda taudia edia taravatu asina tataia utu, Dubu Helaḡa asina hadikaia, bona Kaisara enai asina kerere.
english: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

motu: To Festo e urava Iuda taudia lalodia baine hamoaledia dainai, ia ese Paulo e hamaoroa, eto, O uramu Ierusalem ba ha dara dae, unuseni ai baina hahemaoro henimu ini hereva daidiai a?
english: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

motu: Paulo eto, Lau na Kaisara ena hahemaoro gabuna vairanai na ginimu; ia ese baine hahemaoro henigu. Lau be Iuda taudia asina hadikadia; oi danu dibamu.
english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

motu: Bama kerere, eiava mase karana ta bama karaia, vada bama mase, basinama gwau edeede. A edia hahebade bema asi anina, tau ta ese idia imadia ai basinema atogu kau diba. Kaisara ladana name hatoa; ia vairanai baina hahemaoro.
english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

motu: Unu amo Festo kaunsil taudia ida vada e hereva-hereva; bena ia ese Paulo e haere henia, eto, Kaisara ladana ome hatoa; Kaisara dekena do baola. Agripa e gini dae
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

motu: Dina haida vada ela, bena King Agripa mai Berenike ida Festo ihanamona totona Kaisarea ela.
english: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

motu: Idia na dina hoho unuseni ai e nohova, bena Festo ese Paulo herevana na gaubada e hamaorolaia, eto, Tau ta be iniseni ai, Feliki ese dibura rumana ai e rakatania.
english: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

motu: Lau Ierusalem nala negana ai hahelaḡa taudia bona hanua tau-badadia ese ia herevana e hamaorolaigu, bona e noigu danu baina hahemaoro henia.
english: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

motu: Bena na haere henidia, nato, Roma taumai na unu asia kara tomamu; e habadeamu tauna na ihabadelaina taudia ida do asie hegaga heheni bona do se haere henidia negima ai asia hahemaoro heniamu.
english: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

motu: Taunabunai, idia na iniseni ai e hebou negana ai, lau na asina halahe, a kerukeru hahemaoro gabuna ai na helai, na gwau isi, hari tau bae hakaua mai.
english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

motu: A ihabadelaina taudia e gini tore negana ai, lau banava kara dikadia bae habadelaia nato, to asie gwaurai;
english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

motu: edia toma-diho karadia mo e herevalai. Bona tau ta, ladana Iesu, herevana danu, ia na vada e mase, a Paulo ese e herevalaia goadagoadava, eto vada eme mauri.
english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

motu: Bena ini hereva itahudia dalana na daradaralaia dainai, na nanadaia, Ierusalem bainela, unuseni ai baine hahemaoro, eiava.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

motu: A Paulo ese e noigu, eto ihahemaoro-henina baine mia ela bona Augusto ese baine karaia; taunabunai na hahedua, bae gimaia ela bona Kaisara dekena baina siaia lao.
english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

motu: Bena Agripa ese Festo e hamaoroa, eto, Lau danu na uramu hari tau ena hereva baina kamonai. Festo eto, Kerukeru do ba kamonai. Paulo Agripa vairanai
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G5346" *, “ you|strong="G2532" * shall|strong="G2532" * hear him|strong="G3588" *.”

motu: Kerukeru Agripa bona Berenike na mai hairaidia ida ela, hahemaoro rumana ai e raka vareai, tuari biagudia bona hanua tau-badadia ida. Bena Festo e gwau isi, Paulo bae hakaua vareai.
english: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

motu: Bena Festo eto, King Agripa e, bona dekemai ai vada ome hebou taumui iboumui ai, ina tau o itaiamu, Iuda taudia iboudiai Ierusalem ai bona iniseni ai danu e noigu, e lolo, baine mauri na dia namo eto.
english: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

motu: To mase karana ta ienai asina davaria. Bena ia ese Augusto ladana vada e hatoa, ia vairanai baine hahemaoro e tomu; taunabunai na tomamu baina siaia lao.
english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

motu: A ia herevana biagugu baina tore henia na asina diba ḡoeva; taunabunai vada name hakaua mai umui vairamui ai, bona oi vairamu ai danu, King Agripa e; baita nanadaia ḡoeva-ḡoeva, bena ia herevana ta baina davaria, baina torea.
english: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

motu: Badina be lau na tomamu dia maoro mai iḡuina tauna baina siaia lao, a ihabadelaina herevadia na basina tore hedinarai.
english: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

motu: Bena Agripa ese Paulo e hamaoroa, eto, Mani sibomu a hereva. Bena Paulo ese imana ai e taodia ahu, e haere matama, eto,
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then|strong="G5119" * Paul|strong="G3972" * stretched|strong="G1614" * out|strong="G1614" * his|strong="G4012" * hand|strong="G5495" *, and|strong="G1161" * made|strong="G1161" * his|strong="G4012" * defense.

motu: King Agripa e, na moalemu badina be Iuda taudia ese e habadelaigumu ḡaudia iboudiai na oi vairamu ai hari dina ai aina haerelai.
english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am accused by the Jews,

motu: Badina be Iuda taumai emai kara bona emai hepapahuahu iboudiai vada o diba bada, taunabenai na noimumu mani emu kara a haheauka, egu hereva ba kamonai.
english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

motu: Egu kara, tauhaugu negana ema harihari, egu bese taudia bogaragidiai bona Ierusalem ai danu, Iuda taudia iboudiai vada dibadia.
english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

motu: Matamana amo idia na dibadia lau, bona bema ura bema gwauraigu lau na Farisea taugu, toma-diho oreana bunai ena kara metaudia idoidiai na badinava.
english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

motu: Harihari ina hahemaoro gabuna ai name gini, badina be Dirava ena gwauhamata na laroamu, senemai e henidia gwauhamatana.
english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

motu: Iduhu gwautaruaosi ese una gwau-hamata ihamomokanina e laroamu dainai idia ese Dirava e toma henia diho boi toma henia diho ranimu mai goadadia ida. Ḡaubada e, una helaro dainai Iuda taudia ese e habadelaigumu.
english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

motu: Badina be dahaka umui na o tomamu Dirava ese mase taudia e hatoredia isi herevana na basita abia dae diba?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

motu: Lau danu lalogu na hadaia, nato Iesu tau Nasaret ladana ihadikana karadia momo bama kara bema namo.
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

motu: Unu na kara toma Ierusalem ai. Hahelaḡa taudia ese siahu e henigu, bena helaḡa taudia hutuma be dibura rumadia ai na koudia; bona e revadia mase negadia ai, lau danu nato bae mase.
english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

motu: Dubu iboudiai lalodiai danu lau ese na dadabadia loulou; na hahisidia, bae ere dika totona. Na badu henidia dikadika dainai, na ḡavadia ela bona hanua idaudia ai ma na daḡedaḡe henidia.
english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

motu: Taunabunai, Ḡaubada e, una ḡaukara dainai Damasko dalana ai na raka lao. Siahu bona hahedua na hahelaḡa taudia ese vada e henigu.
english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

motu: Bena dala ai, dina tubua negana ai, diari ta guba amo e tara dagu na itaia, dina hururu-hururuna e hereaia, lau mai bamogu ida e ḡeḡemai ahu.
english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

motu: Ai iboumai ai tano ai a hekida diho; bena lau mo gado ta na kamonai, Heberu gadodiai e hereva henigu, eto “Saulo e, Saulo e, dahaka dainai o daḡedaḡe henigumu? Ikodo e lahamu bena o hisihisimu”.
english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘\+w Saul|strong="G4549"\+w*, \+w Saul|strong="G4549"\+w*, \+w why|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w are|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w persecuting|strong="G1377"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*? \+w It|strong="G5101"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w hard|strong="G4642"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w kick|strong="G2979"\+w* \+w against|strong="G4314"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w goads|strong="G2759"\+w*.’ *

motu: Lau nato “Lohiabada e, oi na daika?” Ia eto “Lau na Iesu, o daḡedaḡe henigumu.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “ He|strong="G1161" * said|strong="G3004" *, ‘\+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w Jesus|strong="G2424"\+w*, \+w whom|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w persecuting|strong="G1377"\+w*. *

motu: A tore isi, badina be emu ai vada name hedinarai badina binai: egu hesiai tauna ai baina halaomu, vada o ita ḡaudia bona do baina hahedinarai henimu ḡaudia danu ba gwaurai hedinarai.
english: \+w But|strong="G2532"\+w* arise, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w stand|strong="G2476"\+w* \+w on|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w your|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w feet|strong="G4228"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w appeared|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w purpose|strong="G3739"\+w*: \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w appoint|strong="G4400"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w servant|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w a|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w witness|strong="G3144"\+w* \+w both|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w seen|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* reveal \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*; *

motu: Heberu taudia bona idau bese taudia imadia amo baina hamaurimu. Idia dekedia baina siaimu lao,
english: \+w delivering|strong="G1807"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w* \+w from|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w people|strong="G2992"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w from|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Gentiles|strong="G1484"\+w*, \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w whom|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* send \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*, *

motu: matadia bae papa; bena dibura bae rakatania, diari bae haḡerea. Bona Satana ena siahu bae rakatania, Dirava bae haḡerea; unu amo edia dika bae hegwau tao, bona ahudia do bae abi, lau iabiabiraigu ese vada e hahelaḡadia taudia bogaragidiai”.
english: \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* open \+w their|strong="G1438"\+w* \+w eyes|strong="G3788"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w turn|strong="G1994"\+w* \+w from|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w darkness|strong="G4655"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w light|strong="G5457"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w from|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w power|strong="G1849"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w Satan|strong="G4567"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*, \+w that|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w receive|strong="G2983"\+w* remission \+w of|strong="G2316"\+w* sins \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w an|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w inheritance|strong="G2819"\+w* \+w among|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w are|strong="G3588"\+w* sanctified \+w by|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w faith|strong="G4102"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*.’ *

motu: Taunabunai, King Agripa e, guba amo e hahedinarai henigu ḡauna na asina gwau edeede henia;
english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

motu: a Damasko taudia na haroro henidia guna, gabeamo Ierusalem taudia bona Iudea kahana taudia iboudiai bona bese idau-idau taudia danu na haroro henidia, bae helalo kerehai, bona Dirava bae haḡerea, bona helalo karadia danu bae kara.
english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

motu: Badina binai Iuda taudia ese Dubu Helaḡa lalonai e dabaigu tao, bae alagu mase eto.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

motu: A hekaha be Dirava ena amo vada na davaria, una negana ema bona harihari; vada na gini tutuka-tutuka, kikina badana vada na haroro henidia. A idau ḡau asina gwauraia, peroveta taudia bona Mose ese e gwaurai guna ḡaudia mo na gwaurai.
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

motu: Ḡaudia bini: Keriso na baine hisihisi guna, bena mase amo baine tore isi lou, bena diari ese Heberu taudia bona bese idauidau taudia baine hadiarilaidia.
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

motu: Ia na unu e haere toma, bena Festo e lolo, eto, Paulo e, oi na o kavamu; emu aonega badana ese lalomu vada e hakavaia.
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

motu: A Paulo na e haere, eto, Namo-herea taumu Festo e, lau na dia kava; momokani bona lalo-parara herevadia na gwauraimu.
english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

motu: Badina be Ḡaubada danu ini mai goadagu ida na gwaurai heniamu ḡaudia na dibana. Vada name diba ini ḡau ta ienai se hehunimu, badina be ina ḡau na dia daiguni ai asie karaia.
english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

motu: King Agripa e, peroveta taudia edia hereva o abi daemu a? Vada dibagu o abi daemu.
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

motu: Bena Agripa ese Paulo e hamaoroa, eto, Lalogu o aniamu, mokona Keriso ibadinana tauna ai o halaogumu.
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

motu: Paulo eto, Dirava vairanai egu ura binai: dia mokona lalomu basinama ania to bama ania momokani; bona dia oi mo, to hari dina ai e hakala henigumu taudia iboudiai; lau ihaḡoigu ai boma lao, a dia iḡui ai.
english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

motu: Bena hari Ḡaubada bona Gavana bona Berenike, bona idia ida e helaiva taudia iboudiai, e tore isi,
english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

motu: e raka lasi, e hereva heheni, eto, Ina tau be mase karana ta eiava iḡuina karana ta se karaia.
english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

motu: Agripa danu Festo e hamaoroa, eto, Kaisara ladana basinema hatoa, baitama ruhaia nege.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

motu: Lalodia e hadai, ai na lagatoi ai baia gui, Italia baiala; bena Paulo bona e ḡuidia taudia haida danu tuari biaguna e henia. Ia ladana be lulio; Augusto ena orea tauna ta.
english: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

motu: Ai na Adramutio lagatoina ta ai a ḡui kau, Asia konena hanuadia baine heau henidia ḡauna. Makedonia tauna ta, Tesalonika amo, ladana na Aristako, ese e bamomai.
english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

motu: Kerukeru Sidono ai a heau kau. Unuseni ai Iulio ese Paulo e kara namo henia, e kahua nege, turana dekedia bainela bona dekediai baine laḡa ani.
english: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

motu: Una gabu a heautania, Kupro enoenona kahana ai a hanai, badina be lai na vairamai amo ema.
english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

motu: Kilikia bona Pamfulia daedia amo a heau hanai, bena Mura ai, Lukia tanona ai, a heau kau.
english: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

motu: Unuseni ai tuari biaguna ese Alesandria lagatoina ta e davaria, Italia bainela; una dainai e haguimai hanai una lagatoi ai.
english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

motu: Dina hoho a heau metaira-metaira ela bona Kenido daenai a heau kau mai hekwarahimai ida. Unuseni ai lai ese e laomai ahu; bena Krete enoenona kahana ai a heau, Salmone idukana daenai.
english: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

motu: Bena badibadina amo a heau, mai hekwarahimai ida, ela bona gabu ta ai a heau kau, ladana be Ao Namodia; una gabu bona Lasea hanuana padadia na dia daudau.
english: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

motu: Nega daudau vada e lao bubuni, bona una nega heauna be mai garina, badina be Anivaga negana vada e ore; taunabunai Paulo ese e sisiba henidia,
english: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

motu: eto, Tatau e, vada name diba eda laolao na do baine dika, ḡau momo bae boio, bona dia kohu mo a lagatoi danu; ita danu baita mase dahaka.
english: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

motu: A tuari biaguna ese lagatoi itarina tauna bona lagatoi biaguna e kamonai henidia, Paulo ena hereva se abia dae.
english: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

motu: Una hetu gabuna na dia namo lahara negana ai; taunabunai hutuma na e tomava baia dobitania, Foenikia ai baia heau kau toho, unuseni ai baia noho lahara negana ai. Una Foenikia na Krete aona ta, mai matuna, ta be lasirai matuna, a ta be laurabada matuna. Guba dikana
english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

motu: Lahu diho e toa, bena idia banava eto nega namona vada e davaria; taunabunai idia ese dogo e veria, bena Krete badibadina amo a heau.
english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

motu: Asi vanahana guba bada-hereana miriguni kahana amo e kau,
english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon. + 27:14 Or, “a northeaster”. *

motu: lagatoi e hohoa. Baia heau dae baia heau diho ato, to se heḡereḡere, bena a haḡoḡoa.
english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

motu: Bena motumotu maraḡina ta, ladana Kauda, metaina ai a heau kau, unuseni ai dingi ihamaurina ai a hekwarahi.
english: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

motu: Idia ese dingi e veria dae; bena pae-tao kwanauna e abia, lagatoi gabenana ai kwanau e mataia, bena e veria tao. Lagatoi boe ai baine hure kau garina idia ese lara e veria dobi; bena a hagogoa.
english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

motu: Hari guba sinaiana ese lagatoi e hahegure-hegurea dikadika dainai, daba e rere ai kohu nege e matamaia.
english: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

motu: Dina ihatoina ai, lagatoi ḡaudia danu ma e nege dobi.
english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

motu: Dina hoho, dina bona hisiu asie hedinaraiva, guba danu se dokova, e odamaiva; bena baiama mauri helarona e heabi oho vai tani.
english: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

motu: Idia na nega daudau asie anianiva, bena Paul ) na bogaragidiai e gini tore, eto, Tatau e, boma kamonai henigu, Krete basitama dobitania, bena ina hahedika bona kohu iha-oredia na emui ai basiema vara.
english: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

motu: A harihari na hamaoromuimu, na tomu, ba goada balahelli; badina be umui ta ena mauri basine boio, lagatoi mo sibona baine boio.
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

motu: Badina be lau na Dirava ena tau, ia isiaina na lao henimu; b-na boi hanuaboi iena aneru ta na badibadigu ai e gini,
english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

motu: eto “Paulo e, basio gari, Kaisara vairanai do ba gini; bona taunimanima iboudiai oi ida o laolaomu edia mauri na Dirava ese vada e henimumu”.
english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

motu: Taunabunai, tatau e, ba goada balaheni; badina be Dirava na abidadama heniamu, na tomamu ḡau idoidiai bae vara, vada e hamaorogu heḡereḡerena.
english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

motu: A motumotu ta ai do baita hure kau. Lagatoi e hure kau
english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

motu: Boi gwauta-hani vaitani Adria gadobadana ai a hure eva-eva. Bena ihagwauta-hanina ai, malokihi ai, lagatoi memerodia eto tano ta vada e kahira-kahira.
english: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

motu: Idia ese davara ena dobu e hahetohoa, roha ruahui e abia; asi vanahana ma e hahetohoa lou, roha gwauta-ima e abia.
english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. + 27:28 20 fathoms = 120 feet = 36.6 meters * After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms. + 27:28 15 fathoms = 90 feet = 27.4 meters *

motu: Bena lagatoi na nadi ai baine tata kau garina ai, idia ese dogo auhani lagatoi gabenana amo e nege dobi; bena daba e naria mai kudou-hetahadia ida.
english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

motu: Lagatoi memerodia ese lagatoi bae pautania eto; bena dingi davara ai e tua dobi, e kara hedibaḡani, lagatoi idamana ai dogo haida inege-dobidia laona urana na heto.
english: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

motu: Bena Paulo ese tuari biaguna mai ena orea taudia ida e hamaorodia, eto, Idia na lagatoi ai basie noho, umui na basio mauri diba.
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

motu: Bena tuari taudia ese dingi kwanaudia e rahu utu; bena dingi na davara ai vada e moru.
english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

motu: Daba e kinia, bena Paulo ese iboudiai e noidia, aniani taina bae ania. Ia eto, Dina ihagwauta-hanina binai umui na o vagamu, aniani taidia asio animu;
english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

motu: taunabunai, na noimuimu, aniani taidia mani avani, mauri helaoreana; badina be kwaramui huidia autamona basine boio, lasi vaitani.
english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

motu: Unu e gwau toma, bena aniani e abia, Dirava e hanamoa idia iboudiai vairadiai; bena e baki sisi, e ani.
english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

motu: Bena iboudiai lalodia vada e namo, e aniani danu.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

motu: Lagatoi ai a nohova taumai iboumai ai na sinahu-rua hitu-ahui tauratoi.
english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

motu: E aniani vaitani, bena lagatoi ihaharaḡana totona uit na davara ai vada e nege dobi.
english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

motu: Daba e rere ai, idia na tano toana asi dibadia; a tabero ta hari e itaia, mai konena, bena lalodia e hadai, eto bema mai dalana lagatoi na una kone ai bae hatataia kau lao eto.
english: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese dogo kwanaudia e rahu utu, dogo na davara ai e rakatanidia; tari iḡuidia kwanaudia e ruha, bona idama larana na lai hoho-hohona ai e kidaia; bena lagatoi e taria diho.
english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

motu: A aru e toibolo gabuna ta ai e heau kau, bena lagatoi na moemoe ai e hatataia kau. Lagatoi idamana e tataia kunukakunuka; a gabenana be hurehure ese vada e hamakohia matama.
english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

motu: Tuari taudia edia lalo-hadai be mai iḡuidia taudia bae aladia mase eto, haida bae nahu vareai kone ai bena vada bae heau na garina.
english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

motu: A tuari biaguna ena ura be Paulo baine hamauria, taunabunai ia ese e gwaudia tao. A nahu mai dibadia taudia be e haduadia, bae pau dobi guna, tano ai bae nahu vareai;
english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

motu: muridiai taunimanima oredia bae diho, haida reirei latadiai ma haida lagatoi ḡaudia latadiai. Unu e kara toma, bena iboudiai tano ai e kau mai mauridia ida.
english: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

motu: Ai na vada a roho mauri, bena a diba una motumotu ladana na Melita.
english: When we had escaped, then they + 28:1 NU reads “we” * learned that the island was called Malta.

motu: Motumotu taudia ese heabi-dae karana dia maraḡi e hanamolaimai; idia ese lahi e haraia bona e abimai dae, badina be medu bona keru ese e alamaiva.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

motu: Paulo ese au haida e gogo, lahi ai e ato kau ai, gaigai ta siahu amo e vero lasi, imana ai e hetau dae.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

motu: Motumotu taudia ese hari gaigai na imana ai e itaia, bena e hereva heheni, eto, Momokani, ina tau na ala-ala tauna; ena be gadobada amo vada e roho mauri, to Kara Maoromaoro na se uramu baine mauri.
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

motu: A ia ese gaigai e davea dobi lahi lalonai, dika se davaria.
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

motu: Idia ese e itaia tao, tauna baine gudu eiava baine hekida diho, baine mase taku readia. A nega daudau e itaia tao, ienai dika ta se vara; bena lalodia e ha-idau, eto ia na dirava ta readia.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

motu: Una gabu amo padana dia daudau be motumotu lohiabadana ta, ladana Publio, ena tano. Ia ese e abimai dae, dina toi ena vadivadi ai e halaomai, mai gaiho-namona ida.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

motu: Hari Publio tamana na e hekure; ia na mai ena gorere, tauna e siahu bona rara e kukuva. A Paulo ese e igoa ita, e ḡuriḡuri, bena imana na ia latanai e ato kau, e hamauria.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

motu: Gabeai gorere taudia haida una motumotu ai ma ema, bena ia ese e hamauridia.
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

motu: Bena idia ese e hanamomai badabada, bona a ḡui kau negana ai lakwamai na lagatoi ai e uda.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

motu: Hua loi vada ela, bena Alesandria lagatoina ta ai a ḡui kau: una lagatoi toana be Hekapa Memerodia. Ia be lahara negana ai una motumotu ai e nohova.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

motu: Surakuse ai a heau kau, dina toi unuseni ai a noho.
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

motu: Unu amo badibadina amo a heau, Regio ai a heau kau, dina ta unuseni ai, bena diho e toa, dina iharuana ai Puteoli ai a heau kau.
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

motu: Unuseni ai varavara haida ida a hedavari; bena idia ese e dogomai tao, dina hitu idia ida a noho. Unu amo ai na a raka lao, Roma ai a kau.
english: where we found brothers, + 28:14 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

motu: Varavara unuseni ai ese harimai e kamonai, bena vada ema, hanua maraḡidia ai, ladadia Apio Foro bona Taverono Toi, ai ida a hedavari. Paulo ese e itadia, bena Dirava e hanamoa; bona lalona vada e goada. Paulo Roma ai
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

motu: Roma ai a kau, bena idia ese Paulo e kahua nege, sibona baine noho, a tuari tauna ta ese baine gimaia.
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

motu: Dina toi vada ela, ia ese Iuda ikwaradia taudia e boiridia, ia ida bae hedavari. Idia na e hebou, bena ia ese e hereva henidia, eto, Varavaragu e, ena be taunimanima asina hadikadia bona seneda edia kara danu asina hadika, to Ierusalem ai e ḡuigu, Roma taudia imadia ai e atogu kau.
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

motu: Idia ese e nanadaigu, bena e urava bae ruhagu nege, badina be mase badina ta egu ai asie davaria.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

motu: A Iuda taudia e gwau-gwau; taunabunai lau ese Kaisara ladana na hatoa, ia vairanai baina gini nato; ḡau tamona, lau na asi egu hahebade ta, egu bese taudia basina habadelaidia.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

motu: Badina binai na boirimui; baina itamui bona baina hereva henimui nato; badina be Israel ena helaro dainai ini e ḡuigu toma.
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

motu: Idia ese e haere henia, eto, Oi herevamu revarevadia Iudea amo asia davari; varavaramai ta danu sema, emu kara dika eiava sivaraimu dikana ta se gwauraia.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

motu: A ai na a uramu oiemu lalo-hadai baia kamonai, badina be dibamai ina orea na gabu idoidiai e gwaua tubu.
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

motu: Taunabunai, idia ese dina ta e gwauraia hidi; bena una dina ai hutuma bada na ena ruma ai e hebou. Bena daba ai ela bona adorahi ai ia ese Dirava ena basileia e harorolaia, bona Iesu herevana Mose ena taravatu bona peroveta taudia edia buka amo e gwauraia hedinarai.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

motu: Bena haida ese ena hereva e abia dae, a haida ese e dadaraia;
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

motu: lalodia na dia tamona. Bena e karoho. A karohodia ai Paulo ese ina hereva tamona ma e hamaorolaidia, eto, Hereva momokani na Lauma Helaḡa ese Isaia, peroveta tauna, ena amo seneda e gwaurai henidia,
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

motu: eto, Aola, ina bese taudia dekedia, baoto, Kamonai be ba kamonai, to lalomui basie parara, Ita be ba ita to basio diba;
english: saying, ‘ Go|strong="G4198" * to|strong="G4314" * this|strong="G3778" * people|strong="G2992" * and|strong="G2532" * say|strong="G3004" *, in|strong="G2532" * hearing, you|strong="G3004" * will|strong="G2532" * hear, but|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * in|strong="G2532" * no|strong="G3756" * way|strong="G4198" * understand|strong="G4920" *. In|strong="G2532" * seeing|strong="G3708" *, you|strong="G3004" * will|strong="G2532" * see|strong="G3708" *, but|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * in|strong="G2532" * no|strong="G3756" * way|strong="G4198" * perceive|strong="G3708" *.

motu: Badina be ina bese taudia lalodia na duduhu, Taiadia na kukudima, Matadia vada e hakapu; Matadia amo bae ita na garina, Taiadia amo bae kamonai na garina, Lalodia bae parara na garina, Bae helalo kerehai, bena baina hamauridia, na garina.
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their|strong="G1438" * ears|strong="G3775" * are|strong="G3588" * dull|strong="G3975" * of|strong="G2532" * hearing|strong="G3775" *. Their|strong="G1438" * eyes|strong="G3788" * they|strong="G2532" * have|strong="G2532" * closed|strong="G2576" *. Lest|strong="G3379" * they|strong="G2532" * should|strong="G3588" * see|strong="G3708" * with|strong="G2532" * their|strong="G1438" * eyes|strong="G3788" *, hear with|strong="G2532" * their|strong="G1438" * ears|strong="G3775" *, understand|strong="G4920" * with|strong="G2532" * their|strong="G1438" * heart|strong="G2588" *, and|strong="G2532" * would|strong="G2532" * turn|strong="G1994" * again|strong="G1994" *, then|strong="G2532" * I|strong="G2532" * would|strong="G2532" * heal|strong="G2390" * them|strong="G3588" *.’ + 28:27 Isaiah 6:9-10 *

motu: Taunabunai, do ba diba, Dirava ena haahemauri na bese idau-idau taudia dekedia vada e siaia lao; idia na do bae kamonai.
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

motu: Ia na unu e gwau toma, bena Iuda taudia na dauha ela, ena hereva e helalolai-badava.
english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves. + 28:29 NU omits verse 29. *

motu: Laḡani rua ia sibona davana e heni rumana ai e nohova, ia dekena ela taudia iboudiai e abidia dae,
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

motu: Dirava ena basileia herevana e harorolai henidiava, bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso sivaraina e hadibalaidiava, mai goadana ida. Bona tau ta ese se gwaua tubu.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

motu: Lau Paulo, Iesu Keriso ena hesiai taugu, e boirigu ena aposetolo tauna ai bainala, bona e hahelagagu Dirava ena sivarai namo baina harorolaia.
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

motu: Sivarai namo bunai ia ese ena peroveta taudia ududia amo e gwauraia hamata, Buka Helaḡa lalonai:
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

motu: ia Natuna herevana, tau-anina ai David garana amo e vara,
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring + 1:3 or, seed * of David according to the flesh,

motu: a Lauma Helaḡa ese mase amo e hatorea isi negana ai e gwauraia hedinarai mai siahuna ida, ia na Dirava Natuna; eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bunai.
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

motu: lena amo harihari-bada, bona aposetolo dagina, ai ese vada a abi, bena ia ladana dainai bese iboudiai baia hahelalodia kerehai, abidadama korikori bae abia;
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

motu: bona umui danu, Iesu Keriso ese e boirimuimu taumui.
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

motu: Dirava ese e ura henimuimu taumui Roma ai o nohomu, helaḡa taumui e gwauraimuimu, ba namo; Tamada Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia anlo harihari-bada bona maino bavabi. Hahenamo herevadia
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Egu hereva gini-gunana binai: egu Dirava na hanamoamu Iesu Keriso ladana ai, umui iboumui ai daimui ai; badina be emui abidadama harina e piuamu ina tanobada heḡege-madai lalonai.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

motu: Natuna ena sivarai namo isiaina laumagu ai na laohenimu Diravana na mai dibana, lauegu ḡuriḡuri na asi dokona umui daimui ai,
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

motu: bona egu ḡuriḡuri ai na noinoi louloumu, Dirava baine ura nega ta baina vasi itamui.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

motu: Badina be na ura lalo-dikamu baina itamui, bona Lauma ena harihari ḡauna baina henimui, bena ba gini tutuka-tutuka.
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

motu: Bona na tomanm umui bona lau eda heabidadama dainai baita hahealo heheni.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

motu: Varavaragu e, lau na uramu ba diba, nega hoho baina vasi nato, to e laogu ahumu ema bona harihari; egu ura be huahuamui baina davaria, bese idau-idau ediai vada na abi heḡereḡerena.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

motu: Lau na Helene taudia bona bese idau-idau taudia, aonega taudia bona kavakava taudia, ediai na abi torehai,
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

motu: taunabunai lau na uramu umui Roma ai o nohomu taumui vairamui ai sivarai namo do baina harorolaia.
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

motu: Badina be sivarai namo asina hemarailaiamu; ia na Dirava ena siahu, abidadama taudia e hamaurilaidiamu, guna Iuda taudia, gabe amo Helene taudia.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

motu: Badina be ia lalonai Dirava ena kara maoromaoro eme hedinarai, abidadama ihabadana totona; buka ai e torea na heto, eto, Kara maoromaoro tauna na ena abidadama dainai baine mauri. Hahemaoro bese idau-idau latadiai
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.” + 1:17 Habakkuk 2:4 *

motu: Dirava ena badu guba amo e hedinaraimu, taunimanima edia kara gageva-gagevadia bona Dirava asie matauraiamu karadia latadiai: idia ese edia kara gagevadia daidiai hereva momokani e tao tarimu.
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

motu: Dirava herevana dibadia, badina be Dirava ese lalodia ai vada e hahedinaraia;
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

motu: tanobada matamana amo e hehuni ḡaudia, ena siahu bona ena kara, vada eme hedinarai, e kara ḡaudia ese vada e hahedinaraimu. Taunabunai, idia na asi edia hahekora herevadia.
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

motu: Badina be Dirava na dibadia, to edia Dirava ai asie halaoa, asie heatolaia, bona asie hanamoa; edia lalo-hadai vada e kavakava, bona lalo-duhu ese lalodia vada e hadiburadia.
english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

motu: Sibodia e tomava mai aonegadia, a ḡau be kavakava taudia ai ela;
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

motu: noho hanaihanai Diravana hairaina e rakataniava, taunimanima laulaudia, bona manu, boroma, bona e raumu ḡaudia laulaudia, e toma henidia dihova.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

motu: Taunabunai, Dirava ese e kahudia nege, edia heḡahusi bodagadia bae ḡava, bena sibodia bae hahedika.
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

motu: Badina be Dirava ena hereva momokani na idia ese koikoi ḡauna ai e boloava, e kara ḡaudia e toma heni dihova, bona isiaidia e lao heniva, a ikaradia Diravana na e dadaraiava. Hahenamo be iena ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

motu: Una dainai Dirava ese vada e kahudia nege, heḡahusi bodagadia bae badina; edia hahine ese hahine karana korikorina vada e ha-idaua, sibodia e heḡahusi hehenimu;
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

motu: tatau danu, hahine vada e rakatanidia, sibodia e heḡahusi hehenimu; bena edia kara havara davana na tau-anidia ai e abiamu.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

motu: Idia ese Dirava ilalo-hadailaina asie urava, taunabunai Dirava ese vada e kahudia nege, edia lalo-hadai kavakavadia bae ḡava bona kara dikadia bae kara;
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

motu: ema bona dika iboudiai ese vada e hahonudia: kara gagevagageva, kara dika, mata ḡaniḡani, vaḡeḡe, hebore, roroma, hepapahuahu, dibaka, daḡedaḡe.
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

motu: Idia na hesivarai taudia, ere dika taudia, Dirava ese e dadaraidiamu taudia, ere daḡedaḡe taudia, hekokoroku taudia, heaḡi taudia, dika ihavarana taudia, tamadia sinadia e dadaraidiamu taudia,
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

motu: asi aonegadia taudia, gwauhamata itata-utuna taudia, asi edia heuraheni taudia, asi edia hebogahisi taudia.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

motu: Ena be dibadia Dirava e gwau hamata, eto, “Unu bae kara toma taudia bae mase”, to idia ese e karamu, bona e karamu taudia danu e imodaidiamu.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

motu: Benaini, oi haida o hahemaoro henidiamu taumu, oi na asi emu hahekora herevadia; emu hahemaoro na sibomu o hahedikalaimu, badina be oi hahemaoro taumu na unu o kara tomamu.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

motu: Dibada danu, unu e kara tomamu taudia na Dirava ese davadia baine henidia mai maoromaorona ida.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

motu: Bena unu e kara tomamu taudia o hahemaoro henidiamu, ma sibomu danu unu o kara tomamu; o lalomu o tomamu Dirava ena hahemaoro amo ba roho mauri a?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

motu: Eiava, ena harihari-bada, ena haheauka bona ena hebogahisi o dadaraimu, matona asi dibamu Dirava ena harihari-bada ese e hakaumumu helalo dalana ai a?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

motu: Emu lalo-duhu dainai badu latamu ai o habouamu; bena Dirava ena hahemaoro dinana ai una badu anina baine hedinarai.
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

motu: Ia ese taunimanima iboudiai edia kara heḡereḡerena davadia do baine henidia hagau-hagau:
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:” + 2:6 Psalms 62:12; Proverbs 24:12 *

motu: kara namodia e kara tarika-tarikamu bona hairai bona hahenamo bona basine pata maurina danu e tahumu taudia na mauri hanaihanai bae abia;
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

motu: a e heiri-heirimu bona hereva momokani e dadaraiamu bona kara gageva-gageva e badinamu taudia na badu bona hisihisi bae abi.
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

motu: Kara dika taudia ese lalo-hisihisi bona kudou-hetaha bae davari, guna Iuda taudia, gabe amo Helene taudia;
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

motu: a kara namo taudia ese hairai bona hemataurai bona maino bae davari, guna Iuda taudia, gabe amo Helene taudia.
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese taunimanima iboudiai e itadiamu, heḡereḡere mo.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

motu: Taravatu murimurinai e kara dika taudia na taravatu murimurinai davadia bae abi, a taravatu lalonai e kara dika taudia na taravatu lalonai bae hahemaoro henidia.
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

motu: Dirava vairanai bae maoromaoro taudia na dia taravatu e kamonaimu taudia, to taravatu e badinamu taudia hari.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

motu: Bese idau-idau taudia na taravatu asi dibadia, to lalodia ai taravatu e badinamu; taravatu be asi dibadia, to sibodia edia taravatu e haginimu.
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

motu: Idia ese lalodia ai e torea tal-avatuna karadia e hahedinaraimu, bena lalodia ese taravatu e hamomokanimu; bona lalodia ese e hahemaoro henidiamu, bena e habadelaidiamu, eiava maorodia e gwauraimu.
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

motu: Egu sivarai namo hegereḡerena, dinana baine kau ai Dirava ese taunimanima edia hehuni karadia baine hahemloro henidia, Iesu Keriso bagunai.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

motu: Taunabinai oi, Iuda taumu o tomamu, taravatu o abidadama heniamu taumu, Dirava o heatolaiamu
english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

motu: bona ena ura mai dibamu taumu, herea-dae ḡaudia toadia dibamu bona taravatu vada o diba vaitani o tomamu taumu:
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

motu: oi na mata-kepulu taudia o hakaudiamu, bona dibura ai e nohomu taudia edia diari ai o laomu,
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

motu: bona kavakava taudia o sisiba henidiamu, bona memero o hadibadiamu; badina be aonega bona hereva momokani oromadia na taravatu lalonai o davarimu.
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

motu: Matona, bamomu o hadibadiamu, to sibomu to hahedibamu a? O haroromu, o tomamu taunimanima basie henao, a ḡau be oi o heuda hanaimu a?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

motu: O tomamu taunimanima basie heuda hanai, a ḡau be oi o heuda hanaimu a? Kaivakuku o ihi-ihiraidiamu, a ḡau be dubu ḡaudia o henaomu a?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

motu: Taravatu o heagilaiamu, a ḡau be taravatu itata-utuna ai Dirava o hadikaiamu a?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

motu: Benaini, buka ai ini e torea toma, ani: Dirava ladana na bese idau-idau bogaragidiai e ihiihiraiamu umui daimui ai.
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” + 2:24 Isaiah 52:5; Ezekiel 36:22 * just as it is written.

motu: Momokani, taravatu ba badinaia negana ai peritome ese baine hanamomu; a taravatu ba tataia utu negana ai emu peritome na asi anina.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

motu: A asie peritomea tauna na taravatu baine badinaia, ia na e peritomea tauna heḡereḡerena ai bainela ani?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

motu: Bona, asie peritomea to taravatu e badinaiamu tauna ese oi, taravatu ai o vara bona peritome o abia to taravatu o tataia utumu taumu, na baine hahemaoro henimu ani?
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

motu: Badina be Iuda oromana na dia Iuda korikori, bona peritome oromana na dia peritome korikori;
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

motu: a Iuda korikori na lalona ḡauna, bona peritome korikori na lalona ḡauna, dia tau-anina ai to lauma ai. Tau unuhetomana na taunimanima readia basie heatolaia, to Dirava ese baine heatolaia.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

motu: Tau Iuda ena namo be dahaka? Peritome ena namo be dahaka?
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

motu: Diaḡau. Gini-gunana binai: Dirava ese ena hereva Iuda taudia dekediai e atova.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

motu: Haida be asie kamonai readia. Matona, edia kamonai na lasi dainai Dirava ena momokani danu lasi a?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

motu: Dia unuheto. Dirava be momokani, a taunimanima iboudiai na e koikoimu; buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Oi emu hereva iboudiai bae momokani, Bena bae hahemaoro henimu negana ai ba kwalimu.
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “ that|strong="G3588" * you|strong="G4771" * might|strong="G2532" * be|strong="G1096" * justified|strong="G1344" * in|strong="G1722" * your|strong="G2532" * words|strong="G3056" *, and|strong="G2532" * might|strong="G2532" * prevail|strong="G3528" * when|strong="G1161" * you|strong="G4771" * come|strong="G1096" * into|strong="G1722" * judgment|strong="G2919" *.” + 3:4 Psalms 51:4 *

motu: A iseda kara dika ese Dirava ena kara maoromaoro baine hahedinaraia negana ai, ede baita gwau toma? Dirava ese baine badu henida, ia na baine kerere a? Lau ese taunimanima edia hereva kava mo na gwauraiamu.
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

motu: Lasi, dia unuheto. Unu bema heto, Dirava ese tanobada ede bema hahemaoro henia toma?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

motu: Badina be lauegu koikoi ese Dirava ena momokani bona ena hairai bema habada, dahaka dainai egu kara dika davana bema henigu?
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

motu: Ai na asiato “Dika baita kara, namo ihavarana helaoreana”. Haida ese e habadelaimai koikoimu, e tomamu ai na unu a gwau toma; edia koikoi davana bae abia hari namo.
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

motu: O edeheto? Ai Iuda taumai be heherea a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani. Badina be Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia vada e habadelaidia, hahebade tamona: iboudiai na mai edia kara dika.
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Ta dia maoro, lasi ona lasi vaitani;
english: As it is written, “ There|strong="G3754" * is|strong="G1510" * no|strong="G3756" * one|strong="G1520" * righteous|strong="G1342" *; no|strong="G3756" *, not|strong="G3756" * one|strong="G1520" *.

motu: Lalo-parara tauna ta lasi, Dirava itahuna tauna ta lasi;
english: There is no one who understands. There|strong="G1510" * is|strong="G1510" * no|strong="G3756" * one|strong="G3588" * who|strong="G3588" * seeks|strong="G1567" * after|strong="G1567" * God|strong="G2316" *.

motu: Iboudiai vada e raka oho, vada e dika bou; Kara namo tauna ta danu lasi vaitani.
english: They have all turned away. They|strong="G3588" * have|strong="G1510" * together become|strong="G1510" * unprofitable. There|strong="G1510" * is|strong="G1510" * no|strong="G3756" * one|strong="G1520" * who|strong="G3588" * does|strong="G4160" * good|strong="G3956" *, no|strong="G3756" *, not|strong="G3756" * so|strong="G4160" * much as|strong="G2193" * one|strong="G1520" *.” + 3:12 Psalms 14:1-3; 53:1-3; Ecclesiastes 7:20 *

motu: Gadodia na gara e hekehomu na heto, Maladia ese koikoi mo e gwauraimu, Bibinadia na hekori gaigaidia ese mase muramurana e loalaimu na heheto,
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With|strong="G5259" * their|strong="G3588" * tongues|strong="G1100" * they|strong="G3588" * have|strong="G3588" * used deceit|strong="G1387" *.” + 3:13 Psalms 5:9 * “ The|strong="G3588" * poison|strong="G2447" * of|strong="G5259" * vipers is|strong="G3588" * under|strong="G5259" * their|strong="G3588" * lips|strong="G5491" *.” + 3:13 Psalms 140:3 *

motu: Ududia na heuduguirai bona ere daḡedaḡe ai e honumu.
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.” + 3:14 Psalms 10:7 *

motu: Aedia e heaumu, rara ihahebubuna totona;
english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

motu: Hahebua-tari bona hisihisi na edia dala ai mimia,
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

motu: Bona maino dalana na asi dibadia.
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.” + 3:17 Isaiah 59:7-8 *

motu: Dirava garina asie garimu, lasi vaitani.
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.” + 3:18 Psalms 36:1 *

motu: Dibada taravatu ese e gwauraimu herevadia iboudiai ese taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia e gwaurai henidiamu, taunabunai udu ihoudiai bae hekou, bena tanobada idoinai na Dirava ese baine hahemaoro henia.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

motu: Taunabunai, tau ta basine maoro taravatu ibadinana dainai; badina be taravatu ena amo taunimanima na kara dika mai dibadia. Mauri dalana na tamona
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

motu: Harihari Dirava ena kara maoromaoro vada eme hedinarai, dia taravatu amo, a taravatu bona peroveta bukadia ese vada e hamomokania dalana amo;
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

motu: Dirava ena kara maoromaoro na Iesu Keriso e abidadama heniamu taudia iboudiai ese bae davaria. Ta dia idau;
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

motu: badina be iboudiai vada e kara dika, bona iboudiai ese Dirava hairaina vada e reaia;
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

motu: to ena harihari-bada dainai maorodia e gwauraimu, Keriso Iesu ena hahemauri bagunai.
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

motu: Ia na Dirava ese e abia hidi, herohemaino ḡauna ai e halaoa, rarana bae abidadama henia taudia edia. Unu amo ena kara maoromaoro vada eme hedinarai, badina be kara dika gunadia vada eme hegwau tao, Dirava ena haheauka dainai.
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice + 3:25 or, a propitiation * through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

motu: Oibe, ena kara maoromaoro na ina negana ai vada eme hedinarai: sibona vada eme maoromaoro, bona Iesu e abidadama heniamu tauna maorona e gwauraiamu.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

motu: Bena heaḡi na edeseni? Vada eme hegwau tao. Edena taravatu bona edena kara ese e gwaua tao? Lasi. Abidadama ese e gwaua taomu.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

motu: Taunabunai ita ta tomamu tau ta maorona e gwauraiamu be dia taravatu ibadinana dainai, a abidadama dainai.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

motu: Dirava na Iuda taudia mo edia Dirava a? Ia na dia bese idau-idau edia Dirava a? Lasi, ia na bese idauidau edia Dirava danu.
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

motu: Benaini, Dirava na tamona; e peritomedia taudia na ia ese abidadama dainai maorodia baine gwaurai, bona asie peritomedia taudia danu abidadama dainai maorodia baine gwaurai.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

motu: O, abidadama dainai taravatu ta negeamu a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani. Ita ese taravatu ta haginia tutuka-tutukamu.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

motu: Seneda Abraham na ede baita herevalaia toma? Ia ese dahaka ḡau e davaria?
english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

motu: Abraham na ena kara daidiai maorona bema gwauraia, ia na mai badina bema heaḡi; to dia Dirava vairanai basinema heaḡi.
english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

motu: Buka Helaḡa na dahaka e tomamu? Abraham ese Dirava e abidadama henia dainai maorona e gwauraia.
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.” + 4:3 Genesis 15:6 *

motu: Ḡaukara tauna ese ahuna e abiamu, dia harihari ḡauna, a davana korikori.
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

motu: A se ḡaukaramu to kara dika taudia na kara maoromaoro taudia ai e halaodiamu Diravana e abidadama heniamu tauna, ia be ena abidadama dainai maorona e gwauraiamu.
english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

motu: Dirava ese ena kara se laloamu to maorona e gwauraiamu tauna na David ese danu vada e hanamoa,
english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

motu: eto, Edia kara rea e gwau taomu bona edia dika e herome ahumu taudia na nanamo;
english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose|strong="G3739" * sins are|strong="G3588" * covered|strong="G1943" *.

motu: Lohiabada ese dikana se gwauraiamu tauna hari namo.
english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.” + 4:8 Psalms 32:1-2 *

motu: ma hahenamo na peritome taudia mo sibodia ese bae abia a? Eiava asie peritomedia taudia danu? Ita ta tomamu “Abraham ese Dirava e abidadama henia dainai maorona e gwauraia”.
english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

motu: Edena nega ai? E peritomea murinai, eiava do se peritomea negana ai? Dia peritome lalonai, a do se peritomea negana ai, ani?
