english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

motu: Do se peritomea negana ai ena abidadama na maoromaoro; gabeamo e peritomea, ena abidadama maoromaorona toana. Taunabunai, ia na asie peritomedia to mai edia abidadama taudia tamadia: maorodia e gwauraimu.
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

motu: Bona e peritomedia to peritome asie abidadama heniamu, edia abidadama na seneda Abraham ena abidadama, do se peritomea negana ai, e tohotohoamu taudia: ia na idia tamadia danu.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

motu: Gwauhamata na Abraham e henia, ia garana ida tanobada idounai bae abia; taravatu dainai se henia, to ena abidadama amo e varava karamaoromaorodia daidiai e henia.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

motu: Badina be taravatu ibadinana taudia na dihi ai bema halaodia, abidadama taudia edia abidadama bema asi anina, gwauhamata danu asi anina.
english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

motu: Taravatu ese badu e havaraiamu; badina be taravatu bema lasi, itata-utuna danu bema lasi.
english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

motu: Benaini, abidadama dainai e abiamu, harihari ḡauna na heto; dia taravatu ibadinana taudia mo, a Abraham ena abidadama e tohotohoamu taudia iboudiai danu. Ia na ita iboudai tamada;
english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

motu: buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Bese loḡora tamadia ai baina halaomu. Mase taudia e hamauridiamu bona do asie vara ḡaudia e havaradiamu Diravana na Abraham ese e abidadama henia.
english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” + 4:17 Genesis 17:5 * This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

motu: Ena helaro na e kara asi badina na heto, to abidadama dainai e helarova; taunabunai ia na bese loḡora tamadia ai ela, gwauhamata herevana heḡereḡerena eto, Garamu na unu bae hoho toma.
english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.” + 4:18 Genesis 15:5 *

motu: Ena abidadama na se manokava. Ena be tau-anina e haeroava mase tauna na heto (laḡanina na sinahu-ta sisivana) bona Sara danu mase hahinena na heto,
english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

motu: to Dirava ena gwauhamata e laloa taova, bona e abidadama henia tutuka-tutukava, bona e heatolaiava;
english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

motu: badina be dibana ena gwauhamata baine hamomokania.
english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

motu: Una dainai maorona e gwauraia.
english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.” + 4:22 Genesis 15:6 *

motu: Dia ia mo sibona herevana unu se torea toma;
english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

motu: a ita danu, Iesu, eda Lohiabada, mase amo e hatorea isi Diravana ta abidadama heniamu tauda, maoroda e gwaurai.
english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

motu: Ia taona e torea, iseda kara dika daidiai; ma mase amo e tore isi, maoroda baine gwaurai helaoreana.
english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

motu: Taunabunai, iseda abidadama dainai ita maoroda vada e gwaurai, bena Dirava ena maino tame abia, Iesu Keriso iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

motu: Ia bagunai danu ita ese ta noholaiamu hariharina vada tame davaria, eda abidadama dainai; Dirava hairaina danu ta laroamu mai moaleda ida.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

motu: Dia una mo: a dikadika negadia ai ta moalemu; badina be dibada hisihisi ese haheauka e havaraiamu,
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

motu: bona haheauka ese manada e havaraiamu, bona manada ese helaro e havaraiamu.
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

motu: Helaro danu basine doko; badina be Lauma Helaḡa vada tame abia, bena ia ese Dirava ena uraheni na laloda ai vada eme vedaia.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

motu: Badina be nega korikori ai, ita ta manokava negana ai, Keriso e mase, Dirava e ihi-ihiraiava taudia daidiai.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna dainai daika baine mase? Readia ta ta mo unu bae kara toma.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

motu: A Dirava ese ena uraheni ini e hahedinaraia toma; ita na dounu kara dikadia ta karava negadia ai Keriso na ita daidai e mase.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

motu: Iesu rarana dainai ita na maoroda e gwauraimu, taunabunai ia ese Dirava ena badu amo baine hamaurida.
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

motu: Gunaguna, ta inai heniava negana ai, Dirava ida ta herohemaino ia Natuna bagunai; harihari, vada ta herohemaino vaitani negana ai, mauri baita abia iena mauri bagunai.
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

motu: A dia una mo: Dirava ta moalelaiamu iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso dainai; badina be ia bagunai herohemaino vada tame abia. Adam bona Keriso
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

motu: Taunabunai, tau ta dainai dika tanobada ai e vareai, bona dika ese mase e vareailaia; bena mase ese taunimanima iboudiai e butudia tao, badina be iboudiai na mai edia kara dika.
english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

motu: Badina be kara dika vada e vara guna tanobada ai, taravatu be gabeamo; asi taravatu negana ai kara dika asie hahemaoro heniava.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

motu: Mase vada e kwalimuva, Adam negana ema bona Mose negana ai; ena be haida ese Adam ena kara dika asie tohotohoa, to e mase. Adam ese bainema tauna e hahedinaraia guna.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

motu: A kara dika na idau, harihari-bada danu idau. Badina be tau ta ena kara dika dainai hutuma e mase; a harihari, Dirava ena harihari-bada dainai, bona ena harihari-bada ese e havaraia herahiana, Iesu Keriso, dainai, hutuma eme mauri.
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

motu: Tau tamona ena kara dika be idau, harihari-bada be idau; badina be tau tamona dainai hahemaoro ese hahedika e gwauraia, a harihari-bada ese kara dika taudia hutuma maorodia eme gwaurai.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

motu: Tau tamona ena kara dika dainai mase vada e kwalimu; unuhetomana, harihari-bada bona kara maoromaoro e abimu taudia na bae kwalimu bona bae mauri, tau tamona, Iesu Keriso, dainai.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

motu: Bona tau tamona ena kara dika dainai hahemaoro ese iboudiai e hadikadia; unuhetomana, tau tamona ena kara maoromaoro dainai taunimanima iboudiai maorodia e gwauraunu, vada bae mauri.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

motu: Bona tau tamona ena gwau-edeede daimai hutuma na dika taudia ai e halaodiava; unuhetomana, tau tamona ena kamonai dainai hutuma na kara maoromaoro taudia ai e halaodiamu.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

motu: Taravatu e gini, bena hekwakwanai vada e vara badabada. A kara dika e badamu gabudia ai, harihari-bada na e honuhonu daemu.
english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

motu: Kara dika e kwalimuva, mase e havaraiava; unuhetomana kara maoromaoro dainai harihari-bada e kwalimumu, mauri hanaihanai e havaraiamu, Iesu Keriso iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

motu: O edeheto: kara dikadia ma baita kara loulou, harihari-bada ihabadana helaoreana a?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

motu: Lasi vaitani. Ita ese kara dika na vada ta masetania, be ede baita lou henia toma?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

motu: Asi dibamui a, Keriso Iesu ladana ai e bapatisoda tauda na ena mase ai vada e bapatisoda?
english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

motu: Taunabunai, bapatiso ai ita na ia ida ta mase bona ia ida e gurida; bena Keriso na mase amo Tamana hairaina ai e tore isi lou heḡereḡerena ita danu mauri matamatana lalonai baita raka.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

motu: Badina be ia ida tama mase bou, ia ida danu tama tore isi lou.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

motu: Dibada ita tauda gunadia na ia ida satauro ai e mase, kara dika iha-orena; taunabunai, ita na kara dika isiaina basita lao heni lou.
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

motu: Mase tauna na kara dika ena amo vada e roho mauri.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

motu: Benaini, ita na Keriso ida tama mase hebou, dibada ia ida danu tama mauri hebou.
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

motu: Bona dibada Keriso na mase amo vada e tore isi dainai ia na basine mase lou; mase na asi siahuna ienai.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

motu: Badina be e mase negana ai, ia na kara dika enai e mase vaitani, a e maurimu be Dirava enai e maurimu.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

motu: Unuhetomana, umui danu sibomui unu na ba helalolai: kara dika enai vada o mase, Dirava enai vada o mauri, Keriso Iesu iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

motu: Kara dika ese tau-animui basine lohiadia; ena hekise-hekise basio kamonai henia.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

motu: Bona taumui reḡedia na kara dika basio henia, isiaina basie lao heni; a taumui na Dirava ba henia, mase amo e roho mauri taudia na heheto, bona taumui reḡedia danu ia ba henia, kara maoromaoro ikarana ḡaudia ai baela.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

motu: Kara dika ese basine lohiamui, badina be taravatu henunai asio nohomu, a harihari-bada henunai o nohomu.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

motu: Edeheto? Taravatu henunai asita nohomu a harihari-bada henunai ta nohomu dainai baita kara dika a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani.
english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

motu: Asi dibamui a, erena o kamonaimu tauna ena hesiai ai baola, o kamonai heniamu dainai? Kara dika isiaina ba lao heni, mase bavabia; eiava kamonai korikori isiaina ba lao heni, kara maoromaoro bavabia.
english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

motu: Dirava baita hanamoa, badina be gunaguna umui na kara dika isiaina o lao heniva, a harihari a hadibamuiva herevana vada o kamonai henia mai daramui ida.
english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

motu: Kara dika amo e ruhamui nege; kara maoromaoro enai vada e ḡuimui kau.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

motu: Taunimanima edia hereva kava heḡereḡeredia ai na gwauraimu, tau-animui edia manokamanoka dainai. Badina be gunaguna taumui reḡedia ese kara dika bona lebulebu isiaidia e lao heniva heḡereḡerena, harihari taumui reḡedia ba heni, kara maoromaoro isiaina ilao-henina ai bae helaḡa.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

motu: Kara dika isiaina o lao heniva negana ai, umui na kara maoromaoro enai o heruha negeva.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

motu: Ḡau tamona, harihari o hemarailaimu karadia o karava negana ai anidia be dahaka emui ai? Unu ḡau dokodia na mase.
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

motu: A harihari, kara dika amo vada o heruha nege, Dirava ena hesiai ai vada ola, anina emui ai be vada o helaḡa, bona dokona be mauri hanaihanai.
english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

motu: Badina be kara dika davana be mase; a Dirava ena harihari ḡauna na mauri hanaihanai, Keriso Iesu iseda Lohiabada bagunai.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

motu: Varavaragu e, taravatu mai dibamui taumui, na tore henimuimu. Asi dibamui taravatu ese taunimanima e lohiadiamu edia mauri dunadia iboudiai a?
english: Or don’t you know, brothers + 7:1 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

motu: Taravatu dainai hahine ta adavana enai baine tao ena mauri dinadia idoidiai; a adavana baine mase, ia na asi taravatuna.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

motu: Taunabunai, adavana maurina ai tau ta ma bema abia, ia na heuda-hanai hahinena; a adavana baine mase, ia na asi taravatuna, tau ta ma baine adavaia, una na dia heuda-hanai.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

motu: Unuhetomana, varavaragu e, umui danu Keriso tau-anina bagunai taravatu enai vada o mase; bena mase amo e tore isi tauna ese baine abimui, huahuada Dirava enai bae dobi helaoreana.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

motu: Badina be ita ese tau-anina ta badinaiava negana ai, kara dika ena laloani taravatu ena amo e varava bona tauda reḡedia lalodiai e vareaiva, bena huahuada mase enai e dobiva.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

motu: A harihari taravatu ese vada e kahuda nege, e dogoda taova ḡauna enai vada ta mase na heto; taunabunai harihari eda hesiai ilao-henina na lauma dainai, dia nega gunadia ai e tore herevadia daidiai. Taravatu ena namo be dahaka?
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

motu: Bena dahaka baitato? Taravatu na dika a? Lasi vaitani. Taravatu basinema hadibagu, lalogu basinema parara kara dika be dahaka. Bona taravatu basinema haduagu “Basio hekise-hekise”, lalogu na basinema parara hekise-hekise be dahaka.
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.” + 7:7 Exodus 20:17; Deuteronomy 5:21 *

motu: A taravatu ena hahedua dainai dika ese hekisehekise idau-idau lalogu ai e havara; badina be taravatu bema lasi, dika bema mase.
english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

motu: Gunaguna lau na taravatu murimurinai na mauriva; a haheḡani egu ai e kau, bena kara dika e vara lou, a lau na na mase.
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

motu: Taravatu na mauri ḡauna e tomamu, a lauegu ai ia na mase ḡauna ai ela;
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

motu: badina be dika ese haheḡani amo e koigu bona e alagu mase.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

motu: Taunabunai, taravatu na helaḡa, haheḡani danu helaḡa bona maoromaoro bona namo.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

motu: Matogana, ḡau namona na mase ḡauna ai egu ai e laomu a? Lasi vaitani. A kara dika ena dika baine hedinarai totona, ḡau namona na mase ḡauna ai egu ai e halaoa; bena haheḡani ena amo kara dika toana baine hedinarai, ia na dika vaitani.
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

motu: Dibada taravatu be lauma ena; a lau be tau-anina ena, kara dika ese vada e hoigu, ena hesiai ai vada e halaogu.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

motu: Lau na karamu karadia na asi dibagu: badina be na ura henimu karadia na asina karamu, bona na inai henimu karadia na karamu.
english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

motu: A asina ura heniamu karana na karaiamu negana ai, lau ese taravatu na maorona na gwauraiamu.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

motu: Ḡau tamopna, kiarana na dia lau, a dika lalogu ai e nohomu hari.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

motu: Lau dibagu lau na asi egu namo tau-anigu ai, badina be lalogu ese kara namo e ura henimu, to ikarana asina heḡereḡere.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

motu: Na ura heniamu karana namona na asina karaiamu, a asina ura heniamu karana dikana be na karaiamu.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

motu: Taunabunai, asina ura heniamu karana na karaiamu, to ikarana na dia lau, a dika lalogu ai e nohomu hari.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

motu: Taunabunai, taravatu ta vada na lalo davari: kara namo baina karaia na tomu, to dika na egu ai e miamu.
english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

motu: Badina be lalogu ese Dirava ena taravatu e moalelaiamu;
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

motu: a tau-anigu ai taravatu idauna na itaiamu, ia be lalogu ena taravatu e tuari heniamu, bena e ḡuigumu, kara dika taravatuna ena, tau-anigu ai e nohomu ḡauna bunai.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

motu: Lau madi, ihabaigu! Daika ese ina tau-anigu masena amo baine hamaurigu?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

motu: Dirava na imodaiamu, Iesu Keriso bagunai. Benaini, lalogu ese Dirava ena taravatu e badinaiamu; a tau-anigu ese kara dika taravatuna e badinaiamu.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

motu: Harihari Keriso Iesu e badinaiamu taudia na dikadia basie gwaurai.
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit. + 8:1 NU omits “who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit” *

motu: Badina be Keriso Iesu bagunai Mauri Laumana ese kara dika taravatuna bona mase taravatuna edia amo vada e ruhagu nege.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

motu: Tau-anina ena manoka dainai taravatu na asi siahuna, taunabunai Dirava ese Natu-adorana e siaia, dika tau-anina e abia, dika kwarana ai ela, tau-anina ai dika e hadarerea.
english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

motu: Taunabunai, ita, tau-anina ena kara asita karamu a lauma ena kara ta karamu tauda, edai taravatu ena kara maoromaoro baine ḡuḡuru.
english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

motu: Badina be tau-anina ena kara e karamu taudia ese tau-anina ena ḡau mo e lalomu, a lauma ena kara e karamu taudia ese lauma ena ḡau mo e lalomu.
english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

motu: Tauanina ilalona be mase; a lauma ilalona be mauri bona maino.
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

motu: Tau-anina ilalona ese Dirava e inai heniamu, badina be Dirava ena taravatu se badinaiamu bona ibadinana asi dibana.
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

motu: Tau-anina ilalona ai e nohomu taudia na Dirava ihamoalena asi dibadia.
english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

motu: Dirava ena Lauma lalomui ai bema noho, umui na tau-anina ilalona ai basioma noho, a lauma ilalona ai boma noho. A Keriso ena Lauma se abiamu tauna na dia Keriso ena.
english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

motu: Keriso bema lalomui ai, tau-anina bema mase, kara dika dainai, a lauma bema mauri, kara maoromaoro dainai.
english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

motu: Iesu mase amo e hatorea isi Laumana na lalomui ai bema noho, Keriso Iesu mase amo e hatorea isi Diravana ese umui taumui bema hamauridia, ena Lauma lalomui ai bema noho dainai.
english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, asi eda ima-doa tau-anina enai, bona tau-anina ena ura basita kara.
english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

motu: Badina be tau-anina ena ura ba kara, vada ba mase; a lauma ena amo tau-anina ena kara ba hamase, ba mauri.
english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena Lauma ese e hakaudiamu taudia iboudiai na Dirava natuna.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

motu: Umui be hesiai laumana mai garina ida asio abia lou, a heabi-dae laumana vada o abia; taunabunai ta boiboimu, ta tomu “Aba e, Tamamai e!”
english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! + 8:15 Abba is an Aramaic word for “Father” or “Daddy”, which can be used affectionately and respectfully in prayer to our Father in heaven. * Father!”

motu: Lauma ese ita laumada ida e gwau boumu, e gwauraidamu, ita na Dirava natuna.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

motu: Ita na ia natuna, taunabunai ita na ia dihina danu. Ita na Dirava dihina, Keriso ida, taunabunai ia ida baita hisihisi hebou, bena ia ida hairaida baita abi hebou.
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

motu: Lau na tomamu ina nega hisihisina na ḡau pipikina, gabeamo isedai baine hedinarai hairaina baine bada herea.
english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

motu: Badina be e kara ḡaudia iboudiai edia helaro be Dirava natuna bae hedinarai; una mo e nariamu.
english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

motu: E kara ḡaudia iboudiai na mase henunai e atodia, dia sibodia edia ura dainai, a e atodia tauna ena ura dainai;
english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

motu: ena helaro be e kara ḡaudia na mase ena iḡui amo bae heruha nege, bona Dirava natuna edia ura-kwalimu herea-daena bae abia.
english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

motu: Taunabunai, e kara ḡaudia iboudiai na e ḡanaḡana boumu, e hisihisi boumu, hekamonai hisina na heto, ema bona harihari;
english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

motu: bona dia idia mo: ita danu, Lauma natuna roboadia, laloda ai ta ḡanaḡanamu, baine abida dae bona tau-anida baine hamauridia negana ta nariamu.
english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

motu: Ihamaurida ḡauna be helaro. Ta laroamu ḡauna baitama itaia, una na dia helaro: daika ese e itaiamu ḡauna baine laroa?
english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

motu: A helaro be asita itaiamu ḡauna baita naria mai haheaukada ida.
english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

motu: Unuhetomana danu Lauma ese eda manoka-manoka ai e kahadamu; badina be ita na ḡuriḡuri maoromaorodia asi dibada, a Lauma ese ita daidai e ḡuriḡurimu mai ḡanaḡana badana ida.
english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

motu: Bona taunimanima lalodia e tahudiamu Diravana na Lauma ena ura dibana, badina be Lauma ese helaḡa taudia daidiai e noinoimu, Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena.
english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

motu: Ita dibada ḡau iboudiai e ḡaukara boumu, Dirava e ura heniamu bona Dirava ese e abidia hidi taudia ihanamodia.
english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

motu: Ia e dibadia guna taudia e gwauraidia hidi, Natuna oromana bae abia, ia tadina ai baela, ia na tau roboana ai bainela.
english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers. + 8:29 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” *

motu: E gvauraidia hidi taudia ia ese e boiridia; e boiridia taudia ia ese maorodia e gwaurai; maorodia e gwaurai taudia ia ese e hanamodia.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

motu: Ini ḡau ede baita herevalai toma? Dirava ese bema beiada, daika ese bema tuari henida?
english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

motu: Ia ese Natuna vara-edeana se rua, a ita iboudai daidai e kahua nege; benaini, ḡau iboudiai ia ida basine henida a?
english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

motu: Daika ese Dirava ena abihidi taudia baine habadelaidia? Bona Dirava ese maorodia e gwauraimu taudia daika ese dikadia baine gwaurai?
english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

motu: Keriso Iesu e mase, ma e tore isi lou; ia na Dirava idibana kahana ai e nohomu, ita daidai e noinoimu.
english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

motu: Daika ese Keriso ena uraheni amo baine bibida oho? Nega dikadika ese a? Eiava lalo-hisihisi ese a? Eiava daḡedaḡe ese? Eiava doe ese? Eiava ogoḡami ese? Eiava mase ese? Eiava dare ese?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

motu: Buka ai a torea heḡeregerena, eto, Ai na oi daimu ai dina iboudiai e alamaimu, E duahimaimu, bae aladia mamoedia na heheto.
english: Even as it is written, “ For|strong="G3754" * your|strong="G3650" * sake|strong="G1752" * we|strong="G3754" * are|strong="G3588" * killed|strong="G2289" * all|strong="G3650" * day|strong="G2250" * long|strong="G2250" *. We|strong="G3754" * were|strong="G3588" * accounted|strong="G3049" * as|strong="G5613" * sheep|strong="G4263" * for|strong="G3754" * the|strong="G3588" * slaughter|strong="G4967" *.” + 8:36 Psalms 44:22 *

motu: A ini ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ta kwalimu vaitani, e lalokau henidamu tauna bagunai.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

motu: Badina be lau vada na diba vaitani, ḡau ta asi goadana, mase eiava mauri, eiava aneru, eiava lohia hereadia, eiava siahu ḡaudia, eiava harihari e miamu ḡaudia, eiava gabeai bae vara gaudia,
english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

motu: eiava atai ḡaudia, eiava dobu ḡaudia, eiava e kara ḡaudia, ta ese Dirava ena uraheni, Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada ese vada e hahedinaraia ḡauna, amo basine bibida oho diba.
english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

motu: Lau na Keriso ladana ai na hereva momokanimu, asina koikoimu, Lauma Helaḡa danu dibana; lalogu na e tomamu
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

motu: egu lalo-hisihisi na bada herea, daragu danu e dokomu dina iboudiai;
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

motu: lau na uramu dikagu bema gwauraia, Keriso ena amo bema bibigu oho, tadikakagu bona egu bese taudia daidiai.
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

motu: Idia na Israel taudia: abi-hidi bona hairai bona hero-hemaino bona taravatu bona toma-diho bona gwauhamata na idia mo edia.
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

motu: Tubu tama danu idia mo edia. Idia bogaragidiai Keriso na tau-anina ai e vara: ia mo sibona herea dae, Dirava ese vada e hanamoa hanaihanai. Amen.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

motu: Basitato Dirava ena hereva na asi anina. Basitato Israel ena amo e vara taudia iboudiai na Israel korikori.
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

motu: Basitato Abraham ena amo e vara taudia iboudiai na ia natuna. A buka e tomamu, Isaak ena amo oi garamu do bae vara.
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.” + 9:7 Genesis 21:12 *

motu: Anina binai: tau-anina amo e vara memerodia na dia Dirava natuna, a e gwauraidia hamata memerodia mo ia garana ai baine halaodia.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

motu: Badina be gwauhamata na binai: Laḡani vairai, nega inihetomana ai, lau na bainama, bena Sara ese mero ta baine abia.
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.” + 9:9 Genesis 18:10,14 *

motu: Dia una mo. Rebeka danu, seneda Isaak adavana, e rogorogo,
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

motu: hekapa memerodia e abi. Do asie vara negana ai, kara namo bona kara dika asie kara negana ai, Dirava ena ura e gini; dia kara ikarana dainai, a e boiboi Diravana ena heabi-hidi dainai.
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls, + 9:11 NU puts the phrase “not of works, but of him who calls” at the beginning of verse 12 instead of the end of verse 11. *

motu: Bena ia ese Rebeka e hamaoroa, eto, Tau roboana ese tau muritai isiaina baine lao heni;
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.” + 9:12 Genesis 25:23 *

motu: e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Iakob na lalokau heniamu; Esau na inai heniamu.
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.” + 9:13 Malachi 1:2-3 *

motu: Dahaka baitato? Dirava mai ena kara rea a? Lasi vaitani.
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

motu: Ia ese Mose e hamaoroa, eto, Na bogalaidia taudia na baina bogalaidia; na bogadia hisi taudia na baina bogadia hisi.
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.” + 9:15 Exodus 33:19 *

motu: Taunabunai, tau ta ena ura na herevana, tau ta ena heau na herevana; Dirava ena hebogahisi mo mai badina.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

motu: Badina be buka ai Farao e hamaoroa, eto, Ina mo dainai na haginimu, egu siahu ba hahedinaraia, bona tanobada idoinai lau ladagu harina bae ha piua.
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.” + 9:17 Exodus 9:16 *

motu: Taunabunai, ena ura heḡereḡerena haida e bogadia hisi, ma haida lalodia e ha-aukadia.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

motu: Readia ba hereva henigu, baoto “Be, dahaka dainai e gwaugwaumu? Daika ese ena ura e laoa ahu?”
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

motu: E tau e, oi be daika, Dirava ena hereva o gwau tubumu? E karaia ḡauna ese ikarana tauna baine nanadaia, baineto “Dahaka dainai ini o karagu toma”, a?
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?” + 9:20 Isaiah 29:16; 45:9 *

motu: Uro ikarana tauna asi siahuna a, raro taba tamona ai uro namona bona uro dikana baine kara?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

motu: Readia Dirava ena ura be ena badu bona ena siahu baine hahedinarai, bena ia ese badu ḡaudia e haheauka henidia ela bona e hebua tari.
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

motu: A hairai badana baine hahedinaraia, hebogahisi ḡaudia ediai: ḡaudia be ia ese e abi heḡaeḡae, hairai baine henidia eto.
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

motu: Gaudia be ita, e boiridia tauda, dia Iuda laumai mo, a bese idau-idau taumui danu.
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

motu: Hosea ese e torea hegereḡerena, eto, Idia na dia egu bese korikori, to baina gwauraidia “egu bese”; Dia egu lalokau korikori, to baina gwauraidia “egu lalokau”;
english: As he says also in Hosea, “ I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G2532" * call|strong="G2564" * them|strong="G3588" * ‘ my|strong="G1722" * people|strong="G2992" *,’ which|strong="G3588" * were|strong="G3588" * not|strong="G3756" * my|strong="G1722" * people|strong="G2992" *; and|strong="G2532" * her|strong="G3588" * ‘beloved,’ who|strong="G3588" * was|strong="G3588" * not|strong="G3756" * beloved.” + 9:25 Hosea 2:23 *

motu: E gwau henidia, eto “Umui na dia lauegu bese taumui”, gabuna ai, Mauri Diravana natuna bae gwauraidia.
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there|strong="G1563" * they|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2316" * be|strong="G1510" * called|strong="G2564" * ‘ children|strong="G5207" * of|strong="G5207" * the|strong="G1722" * living|strong="G2198" * God|strong="G2316" *.’” + 9:26 Hosea 1:10 *

motu: Isaia ese danu Israel e hahanea, eto, Ena be Israel garana bae hutuma, kone mirina na heto, to kwabu-kwabudia mo bae mauri;

english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

motu: Ḡau tamona, idia edia keto dainai tanobada bema taḡa, bona idia edia dabu dainai bese idau-idau bema boga kunu, o edia honuhonu-dae amo dahaka namona bema vara?
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

motu: Readia baoto “Rigi e dabai kwaidu lau bae hirigu kau helaoreana”.
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

motu: Benaini, asi edia abidadama dainai e dabai kwaidu, a oi hari emu abidadama dainai o ginimu. Asio hekokoroku: ba gari.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

motu: Badina be Dirava ese rigi korikori se bogadia hisi, bona oi danu basine bogamu hisi.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

motu: Dirava ena hebogahisi bona ena lalo-auka ba haero: e keto taudia ediai lalona e aukamu; a oi na e bogamu hisi, ena hebogahisi o badinaiamu negana ai. A basio badinaia, ia na baine utumu oho.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

motu: A idia be edia hedadarai bae rakatania, bae hehiri kau lou; badina be Dirava na mai siahuna baine hiridia kau lou.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

motu: Benaini, oi na vara-kava olivena ena amo e utumu oho, uma olivena enai e hirimu kau, idia be rigi korikori, edia olive korikorina ai basie hiri kau a? Vada bae hiri kau.
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

motu: Varavaragu e, lau na uramu ina hereva hehunina ba diba, sibomui emui aonega ba heaḡilaia na garina. Israel taudia haida lalodia do bae duhu, ela bona bese idau-idau taudia bae didi vareai guna.

english: and so all Israel will be saved. english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada bona ena abi-hidi na se idaumu.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

motu: Gunaguna umui ese Dirava o gwau edeede heniava; harihari hebogahisi vada o davaria, idia edia gwau-edeede dainai.
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese ita iboudai gwau-edeede ai vada e kouda ahu, baine bogada hisi helaoreana.
english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

motu: Dirava ena aonega bona ena lalo-arara na daka dobu! Ena hahemaoro na daika ese baine tahua diba? Ena dala na daika ese baine davaria diba?
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, Dirava ena hebogahisi dainai na noimuimu, tau-animui idoidiai ia ba henia, boubou ḡaudia mauridia bona helaḡadia ai baela, Dirava ese baine moalelai: emui hesiai karana korikorina bunai.
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

motu: Ina tanobada oromana na basio tohotohoa; a lalomui ba hamatamata, bae idau vaitani, bena Dirava ena ura, mai namona bona mai hairaina bona mai hereadaena ida, vada ba diba.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

motu: E henigu hariharina dainai umui ta ta na haduamuimu, basio hekokoroku, a lalomui bae manau, Dirava ese heabidadama ahuna ta ta e henimui hagauhagau heḡereḡerena.
english: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

motu: Ita heḡereḡereda, tau ta reḡena na momo, a edia ḡaukara na idau-idau;
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

motu: unuhetomana, ita na hoho, a tau-anina tamona Keriso enai, reḡe idau-idau ta ḡaukara heboumu.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

motu: Harihari-bada ese herahia ḡaudia vada e henida: bema peroveta, baita peroveta eda kamonai heḡereḡerena;
english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

motu: bema hesiai lao-heni, hesiai baita lao heni; hahediba tauna baine hahediba;
english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

motu: haroro tauna baine haroro; ihenina tauna baine henia mai moalena ida; ireḡuna tauna baine hereḡu mai goadana ida; hebogahisi tauna baine hebogahisi mai lalo-namona ida.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

motu: Emui uraheni baine momokani. Dika ba lalo nege; namo enai ba tao.
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

motu: Ta ta ba heura heheni, varavara na heheto; ba hemataurai heheni danu.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

motu: Ḡaukara lalonai basio lahedo. Lauma na lalomui ai baine hururu. Lohiabada isiaina ba lao heni.
english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

motu: Helaro ai ba moale. Dika negadia ai ba haheauka. Guriḡuri ba goadalaia nega idoidiai.
english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

motu: Helaḡa taudia edia dabu ai ba kahadia. Heabi-dae karadia ba kara.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

motu: E daḡedaḡe henimuimu taudia ba hanamodia; basio uduguiraidia.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

motu: E moalemu taudia ida ba moale; e taitaimu taudia ida ba tai.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

motu: Iboumui ai lalomui bae tamona. Herea ḡaudia basio lalodia, a manau taudia ida ba noho hebou. Sibomui emui aonega basio heaḡilaia.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

motu: Tau ta basio kara dika henia, iena dika davana; a taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai kara namo mo ba kara.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

motu: Bema mai dalana, taunimanima iboudiai ida ba noho mai mainomui ida.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, dika basio hadavaia; badu baine mia. Badina be vada e torea, Lohiabada eto “Dava be lau imagu ai, lau ese baina karaia”.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” + 12:19 Deuteronomy 32:35 *

motu: Taunabunai, inaimu bema hitolo, ana boma henia; bema ranu mase, ranu boma henia; unu ba kara toma, e kara lahi gidadia kwarana tubuana ai ba giḡi kau na heto.
english: Therefore “ If|strong="G1437" * your|strong="G1437" * enemy|strong="G2190" * is|strong="G3588" * hungry|strong="G3983" *, feed|strong="G5595" * him|strong="G3588" *. If|strong="G1437" * he|strong="G3778" * is|strong="G3588" * thirsty|strong="G1372" *, give|strong="G4160" * him|strong="G3588" * a|strong="G1437" * drink|strong="G4222" *; for|strong="G1063" * in|strong="G1909" * doing|strong="G4160" * so|strong="G1063" *, you|strong="G4771" * will|strong="G3778" * heap|strong="G4987" * coals of|strong="G1909" * fire|strong="G4442" * on|strong="G1909" * his|strong="G1909" * head|strong="G2776" *.” + 12:20 Proverbs 25:21-22 *

motu: Dika ese basine hadarelemui, a emui kara namo amo dika ba hadarerea.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai ese lohia bae matauraidia. Badina be siahu idoinai na Dirava ena amo e maimu; bona lohia iboudiai Dirava ese vada e haginidia.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

motu: Taunabunai, lohia e laoa ahumu tauna ese Dirava ena haheḡani e gwaua tubumu; bona e gwaua tubumu taudia ese davadia do bae abi.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

motu: Badina be kara namo tauna na lohia garina se garimu, a kara dika tauna hari. Oi o uramu lohia garina basio gari a? Kara namo ba kara, bena ia ese haine hanamomu;
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

motu: ia na Dirava ena hesiai tauna, taunabunai baine hanamomu. A kara dika boma kara be ia garina boma gari; badina be ia ese dare se abia kavamu. Ia na Dirava ena hesiai tauna; kara dika tauna davana baine henia.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

motu: Taunabunai, ba matauraia: dia badu garina, a helalo dainai.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

motu: Una dainai umui ese tax monidia o henidiamu; badina be idia na Dirava ena hesiai taudia, nega idoinai ina ḡaukara e karaiamu.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

motu: Iboudiai na ena ḡau ena ḡau ba henidia: tax gogo tauna tax ba henia; heni-tao inarina tauna heni-tao ba henia; garina e garimu tauna ba gari henia; e matauraiamu tauna ba matauria.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

motu: Tau ta enai basio ima doa. Ba heura heheni; badina be bamona e ura heniamu tauna ese taravatu idoinai vada e badinaiamu.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

motu: “Basio heuda hanai” bona “basio ala ala” bona “basio henao” bona “basio hekisehekise” bona taravatu oredia iboudiai na ina haheḡani tamona lalonai vada e hebou: “Dekemu tauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu na heto”.
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” + 13:9 TR adds “You shall not give false testimony,” * “You shall not covet,” + 13:9 Exodus 20:13-15,17; Deuteronomy 5:17-19,21 * and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” + 13:9 Leviticus 19:18 *

motu: Lalokau ese dekemu tauna se hadikaiamu; taunabunai lalokau na taravatu ihaḡuḡuruna.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

motu: Nega be dibamui: mahuta amo ba noga horana vada be kaumu. Badina be ta kamonai matama negana ai eda hahemauri na dauhai, a harihari ia na vada kahikahi.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

motu: Hanuaboi vada e ore, daba vada eme kahikahi; taunabunai dibura karadia baita nege, diari baita abia, eda kesi ai baita halaoa.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

motu: Eda kara nahuadia baita toho; eda raka na dina ai ta rakamu. Basita lebulebu; basita kekero; basita heuda hanai; basita mata dika; basita heai; basita vaḡeḡe.
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ba hadokilaia, bona tau-animui edia ura dikadia basio abi dae.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

motu: Ena abidadama e manoka-manokamu tauna na bavabia dae, to basio hepapahuahu.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

motu: Ta be mai ena abidadama, bena ḡau iboudiai e animu; ma ta lalona e manokamu, bena uma ḡaudia mo e animu.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

motu: E animu tauna ese se animu tauna basine dadaraia; bona se animu tauna ese e animu tauna basine hahemaoro henia: badina be Dirava ese vada e abia dae.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

motu: Oi be daika, tau ta ena hesiai tauna o hahemaoro heniamu? Biaguna vairanai baine gini, eiava baine keto. Ia na baine gini, badina be Lohiabada na mai siahuna baine haginia.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

motu: Tau ta e tomamu dina ta be herea; ma tau ta e tomamu dina iboudiai be heḡereḡere. Ta ta ese lalodia bae hadai ḡoevaḡoeva.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

motu: Dina e laloamu tauna na Lohiabada enai e laloamu. E anianimu tauna na Lohiabada enai e anianimu, badina be ia ese Dirava e hanamoamu; bona se anianimu tauna na Lohiabada enai se anianimu, bona ia ese danu Dirava e hanamoamu.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

motu: Asi tauna ta sibona enai e maurimu, bona asi tauna ta sibona enai e masemu.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

motu: Ta maurimu be Lohiabada enai ta maurimu; bona baita mase, Lohiabada enai baita mase. Taunabunai, ta maurimu eiava baita mase, ita na Lohiabada ena.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

motu: Ina dainai Keriso e mase bona e mauri lou, mase taudia bona mauri taudia biagudia ai bainela totona.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

motu: A oi, dahaka dainai varavaramu o hahemaoro heniamu? Dahaka dainai o dadaraiamu? Badina be ita iboudai Dirava ena hahemaoro gabuna vairanai baita gini.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Lohiabada eto “Egu mauri dainai tui iboudiai lau vairagu ai bae hadai, bona mala iboudiai ese Dirava bae imodaia”.
english: For it is written, “‘ As|strong="G2532" * I|strong="G1473" * live|strong="G2198" *,’ says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *, ‘ to|strong="G2532" * me|strong="G1473" * every|strong="G3956" * knee|strong="G1119" * will|strong="G2316" * bow|strong="G2578" *. Every|strong="G3956" * tongue|strong="G1100" * will|strong="G2316" * confess|strong="G1843" * to|strong="G2532" * God|strong="G2316" *.’” + 14:11 Isaiah 45:23 *

motu: Taunabunai, ita iboudai ta ta ena kara ena kara Dirava vairanai baita hahedinarai.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

motu: Taunabunai, basita hahemaoro heheni, a laloda ini baita hadai toma: varavarada ena dala ai hekwakwanai ḡauna eiava idoa basita atoa.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

motu: Lohiabada Iesu ese vada e hamaorogu dainai lau na dibagu ḡau ta dikana basina gwauraia. A ta ese ḡau ta dikana baine gwauraia, una ḡau na dika ienai.
english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

motu: Bena amu aniani ḡauna dainai varavaramu lalona e hekwakwanaimu, oi na uraheni dalana ai to rakamu. Keriso ese ia dainai e mase; oi ese amu aniani dainai basio hamasea.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

motu: Oi ese namona o laloamu ḡauna dikana basie gwauraia.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

motu: Badina be Dirava ena basileia na dia aniani ḡauna eiava inuinu ḡauna; a kara maoromaoro bona maino bona moale, Lauma Helaḡa bagunai.
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

motu: Badina be ini ḡau amo Keriso isiaina e lao henimu tauna na Dirava ese e lalo namo heniamu, bona taunimanima ese e hanamoamu.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

motu: Benaini, maino daladia baita tahu, bona baita hahegoada heheni.
english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

motu: Dirava ena ḡaukara basio hadikaia, aniani ḡauna dainai. Momokani, ḡau iboudiai na goḡoeva-gogoeva; to mai daradarana baine aniani tauna ana aniani na dika ienai.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

motu: Vamu basita ania, vine ranuna basita inua, bona varavarada ihahekwakwanaina karana ta basita karaia, unu hari namo.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

motu: Oi na mai emu abidadama, ani? Dirava bavabidadama henia. Sibona dikana se gwauraiamu ena kara dainai, una tau na namo.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

motu: A daradara tauna baine aniani, sibona baine hahedika, badina be asi ena abidadama; bona abidadama ese se havara ḡaudia iboudiai na didika.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,
but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;
to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen. + 14:26 TR places verses 24-26 after Romans 16:24 as verses 25-27. *

motu: Ita goada tauda na manoka taudia edia manoka baita huahai, dia ita siboda eda moale basita tahua.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

motu: Iboudai ta ta dekeda taudia baita hamoaledia, edia namo bona edia goada ihavaradia.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

motu: Badina be Keriso danu sibona se hahemoale; Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Gwaugwau herevadia oi e gwau henilaimu na lau latagu ai vada eme kau.
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.” + 15:3 Psalms 69:9 *

motu: E tore guna ḡaudia na ita ihadibalaida totona e tore, bena Buka Helaḡa ese haheauka bona tauhalo bae havara, ela bona helaro baita davaria.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

motu: Bena haheauka bona tauhalo Diravana ese lalomui baine hatamonadia, Keriso Iesu bagunai;
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

motu: bena mai lalomui tamona bona mai eremui tamona ida Dirava, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, ba imodaia.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Taunabunai ba heabi-dae heheni, Keriso ese umui e abimui dae heḡereḡerena, Dirava iheatolaina.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, + 15:7 TR reads “us” instead of “you” * to the glory of God.

motu: Na tomu Keriso na Israel edia hesiai tauna ai e halaoa, Dirava ena hereva momokani dainai, seneda e gwau henidia hamata herevadia ihamomokanidia;
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

motu: bona bese idau-idau ese danu Dirava bae imodaia, ena hebogahisi dainai; buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Ina dainai bese idau-idau bogaragidiai baina imodaimu; Oi ladamu na egu ane ai baina hanamoa.
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “ Therefore|strong="G1223" * I|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2316" * give|strong="G1843" * praise|strong="G1843" * to|strong="G2532" * you|strong="G4771" * among|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * Gentiles|strong="G1484" * and|strong="G2532" * sing|strong="G5567" * to|strong="G2532" * your|strong="G1223" * name|strong="G3686" *.” + 15:9 2 Samuel 22:50; Psalms 18:49 *

english: Again he says, “ Rejoice|strong="G2165" *, you|strong="G3004" * Gentiles|strong="G1484" *, with|strong="G3326" * his|strong="G2532" * people|strong="G2992" *.” + 15:10 Deuteronomy 32:43 *
