Let|strong="G2532" * all|strong="G3956" * the|strong="G2532" * peoples|strong="G2992" * praise|strong="G1867" * him|strong="G3588" *.” + 15:11 Psalms 117:1 *

motu: Ma Isaia eto, Iese ramuna amo ta baine gara kau, Bese idau-idau lohiadia ai bainela; Bese idau-idau taudia ese ia bae abidadama henia.
english: Again, Isaiah says, “ There|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G1510" * be|strong="G1510" * the|strong="G2532" * root|strong="G4491" * of|strong="G2532" * Jesse|strong="G2421" *, he|strong="G2532" * who|strong="G3588" * arises to|strong="G2532" * rule over|strong="G1909" * the|strong="G2532" * Gentiles|strong="G1484" *; in|strong="G1909" * him|strong="G3588" * the|strong="G2532" * Gentiles|strong="G1484" * will|strong="G1510" * hope|strong="G1679" *.” + 15:12 Isaiah 11:10 *

motu: Helaro Diravana ese emui abidadama dainai moale bona maino idoinai baine hahonulaimui, Lauma Helaḡa siahuna amo baine habadaia. Egu ḡaukara bona egu laolao
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

motu: Varavaragu e, lau dibagu umui na kara namo ai o honumu, diari ai o honuhonu daemu, hesisiba heheni na mai dibamui.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, + 15:14 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

motu: Taunabunai, mai goadagu ida na tore henimuimu, ihahelalolaimui totona, Dirava ese e henigu hariharina dainai.
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

motu: Lau be Keriso Iesu ena hesiai taugu, bese idau-idau ediai; Dirava ena sivarai namo na harorolaiamu, bena Lauma Helaḡa ena hahelaḡa dainai bese idau-idau na boubou ḡaudia namodia ai baela.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

motu: Dirava ena ḡaukara na karaiamu bona na heaḡilaiamu, Iesu Keriso bagunai.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

motu: Keriso ena ḡaukara idaudia haida basina herevalai; a lau daigu ai bese idau-idau taudia vada e kamonai, bona edia kamonai amo hereva bona kara vada e vara, una mo na herevalaiamu.
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

motu: Toa bona hoa karadia danu vada eme hedinarai, Dirava ena Lauma ena siahu dainai; taunabunai Ierusalem amo ela bona Iluriko, Keriso ena sivarai namo vada na harorolaia ḡuḡuru.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

motu: Egu lalo-hadai tamona binai: sivarai namo baina harorolaia, Keriso ladana do asie hatoamu gabudia ai. Asina uramu ta ena du latadiai egu ruma baina haginia.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Asie hadibalaidia taudia na bae ita, Bona sivaraina asie kamonai taudia na bae diba.
english: But, as it is written, “ They|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * see|strong="G3708" *, to|strong="G2532" * whom|strong="G3739" * no|strong="G3756" * news of|strong="G4012" * him|strong="G3739" * came|strong="G2532" *. They|strong="G2532" * who|strong="G3739" * haven’t heard will|strong="G2532" * understand|strong="G4920" *.” + 15:21 Isaiah 52:15 *

motu: Una dainai vada name helao ahu, asina vasi itamui ema bona hari.
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

motu: A harihari lau na asi egu ḡaukara inikaha ai; bona laḡani hoho vada na ura bada baina vasi.
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

motu: Taunabunai, Spania baina lao henia negana ai baina vasi; badina be na uramu egu laolao ai baina itamui, umui ida baita noho nega taina, bena dala ai ba hakaugu.
english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

motu: A ina harihari lau na Ierusalem ba laomu, helaḡa taudia ikahadia totona.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

motu: Badina be Makedonia bona Akaia taudia ese edia harihari ḡaudia vada e habou ogoḡami taudia Ierusalem ekalesiana ai edia.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

motu: Idia na unu e kara toma mai moaledia ida; e haeroa, idia na ima-doa taudia na heheto. Badina be lauma ḡaudia vada e abi; bena tau-ani ḡaudia ma bae heni lao eto.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

motu: Ina ḡaukara baina karaia vaitani, ina huahua baina henidia vaitani, bena baina vasi itamui, ma Spania bainala.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

motu: Lau dibagu danu, baina vasi negana ai Keriso ena hahenamo idoinai baina vasilaia.
english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

motu: Varavaragu e, na noimuimu, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai bona Lauma ena uraheni bagunai, Dirava ba ḡuria goadagoada lau daigu ai, sibogu daigu ai na ḡuriḡurimu heḡereḡerena;
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

motu: gwau-edeede taudia Iudea ai imadia amo baine hamaurigu, bona egu ḡaukara Ierusalem ai helaḡa taudia ese bae abia dae mai lalo-namodia ida.
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

motu: Bena Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena ai, lau baina vasi mai moalegu ida, bena baita hahealo heheni.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

motu: Maino Diravana ese aine bamomui. Amen.
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

motu: Ita taihuda Foibe e vasimu; ia na Kenkrea diakono hahinena ta.
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant + 16:1 or, deacon * of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

motu: Lohiabada bagunai bavabia dae, ani, helaḡa taudia o abidia daemu na heto; bona ena ḡaukara ai ba durua. Badina be ia ese hutuma vada e durudia; bona lau danu eme durugu.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

motu: Priskila bona Akula, Keriso Iesu bagunai lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva taudia, ba hanamodia.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

motu: Idia na lau daigu ai mokona e mase. Lau ese na hanamodiamu; a dia lau mo, bese idau-idau edia ekalesia oreadia iboudiai danu.
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

motu: Bona edia ruma ai e heboumu oreana danu ba hanamodia. Na lalokau heniamu tauna, Epaineto, danu ba hanamoa; ia na anina roboana Keriso ena, Asia ai.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

motu: Maria danu ba hanamoa; ia na umui daimui ai vada e hekwarahi bada.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

motu: Varavaragu Androniko bona Iunia danu ba hanamodia; idia be lau ida dibura rumana ai e koumai bou. Haridia na bada aposetolo taudia bogaragidiai. Idia danu Keriso ena orea lalonai e vareai guna, lau be gabe ai.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

motu: Amplia, Lohiabada bagunai na lalokau heniamu tauna,
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

motu: bona Urebano, lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva tauna, bona Staku, egu lalokau tauna,
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

motu: bona Apele, Keriso enai e gini tutukatutukamu tauna, iboudiai ba hanamodia. Aristobulo ena ruma taudia ba hanamodia.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

motu: Varavaragu Herodion ba hanamoa. Narakiso ena ruma taudia ba hanamodia; idia na Lohiabada ena orea taudia.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

motu: Trufena bona Trufosa ba hanamodia; idia na Lohiabada ena orea hahinedia; Peresi, lalokau hahinena, ba hanamoa; ia na Lohiabada ena ḡaukara vada e heckwarahilaia.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

motu: Rufo, Lohiabada ese e abia hidi tauna, ba hanamoa; ia sinana danu, natuna ai e halaogu hahinena, ba hanamoa.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

motu: Asunukrito bona Flegon bona Hereme bona Patroba bona Herema, mai bamodia ida, ba hanamodia.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers + 16:14 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * who are with them.

motu: Filologo, bona Iulia, bona Nerea, mai taihuna ida, bona Olumupa, bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai idia ida e nohomu, ba hanamodia.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

motu: Ba hahenamo heheni; ba haherahu heheni. Keriso ena ekalesia oreadia iboudiai ese e hanamomuimu.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

motu: Varavaragu e, heai taudia bona hekwakwanai ihavaradia taudia nahuada ba toho. Hahediba herevadia vada a henimui na idia ese e tata utumu; edia amo ba raka ohu.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

motu: Taunimanima unuhetomadia na Keriso iseda Lohiabada isiaina asie lao henimu, a bogadia mo e lalomu; bona idia ese danu hereva manau bona ere namo amo asi dibadia taudia na e koidiamu.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

motu: A umui emui haheauka harina na taunimanima iboudiai ese vada e kamonai; taunabunai, lau na umui daimui ai na moalemu. To lau na uramu umui na ḡau namodia ai ba aunega, ḡau dikadia ai ba kavakava.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

motu: Asi vanahana Maino Diravana ese Satana baine moia patapata umui aemui henudiai. Iseda Lohiabada Iesu ena harihari-bada ese baine bamomui.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The|strong="G1722" * grace|strong="G5485" * of|strong="G5259" * our|strong="G2316" * Lord|strong="G2962" * Jesus|strong="G2424" * Christ|strong="G5547" * be|strong="G2316" * with|strong="G3326" * you|strong="G5210" *.

motu: Timoteo, lau ida a ḡaukara heboumu tauna, bona varavaragu Luka bona Iason bona Sosipatro, hahaniosi ese e hanamomuimu.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

motu: Lau Teretio ese imagu amo ina revareva name torea: Lohiabada ladana ai na hanamomuimu.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

motu: Gaio, lauegu badiholo tauna bona ekalesia taudia iboudiai edia badiholo tauna, ese e hanamomuimu. Erasto, hanua monina inarina tauna, bona Koato, ekalesia tauna ta, ese danu e hanamomuimu.
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

motu: Eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na iboumui ai emui ai baine mia. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

motu: Dirava aita hanamua, ia na mai goadana baine haginimui tutuka-tutuka, egu sivarai namo bona Iesu Keriso ena haroro herevadia heḡereḡeredia. Hereva hehunidia ihahedinaraidia heḡereḡerena danu, nega gunadia amo e hehuni,
english: + 16:25 TR places Romans 14:24-26 at the end of Romans instead of at the end of chapter 14, and numbers these verses 16:25-27. *

motu: a harihari vada eme hedinarai; noho hanaihanai Diravana ena hahegani dainai, peroveeta taudia edia buka ese bese loḡora ibuudiai vada e hadibalaidia, edia abidadama ihavarana.
Aonega Diravana tamona aita imodaia, Iesu Keriso bagunai; ia hairaina baine mia hanaihanai. Amen.
Lau Paulo, Dirava ena ura dainai vada e boirigu, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu ai vada e halaogu, varavarada Sostene ida,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

motu: raruosi Dirava ena ekalesia Korinto ai o nohomu taumui a hahenamo henimuimu. Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e hahelaḡamui, helaḡa taumui vada e gwauraimui. Umui, bona Iesu Keriso, edia Lohiabada bona eda Lohiabada, ladana e hahaneamu taudia iboudiai,
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

motu: harihari-bada bona maino bavabi, ita Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo. Hahenamo herevadia
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Nega idoinai Dirava na hanamoamu umui daimui ai, badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada na Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e henimui.
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

motu: Taunabunai, ḡau iboudiai ia lalonai vada e hataḡalaimui, hereva ai bona lalo-parara ai danu,
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

motu: Keriso idibana umui lalomui ai vada e hamomokania heḡereḡerena.
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

motu: Taunabunai umui na harihari ḡauna ta ai asio dabumu, hari iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ihahedinaraina o nariamu negana ai.
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

motu: Ia ese baine haginimui tutuka-tutuka ela bona dokona; bena Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena mai dinana ai ta ese basine habadelaimui.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Dirava na momokani; bona ia ese vada e boirimui, ia Natuna Iesu Keriso ida ba hetura.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

motu: Varavaragu e, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai na noimuimu, iboumui ai hereva tamona ba gwauraia; heiri-heiri na bogaragimui ai basie vara, a lalo tamona ai bona lalo-hadai danu tamona ai ba hedaro boubou.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, + 1:10 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

motu: Badina be, varavaragu e, Kloe varavarana ese sivaraimui vada e hamaorolaigu, e tomu umui na o noho heai-heaimu.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

motu: Readia umui ta ta o tomamu “Lau na Paulo ena”, “Lau na Apolo ena”, “Lau na Kefa ena”, “Lau na Keriso ena”.
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

motu: Be, Keriso na vada e haheparara a? Paulo e hasatauroa umui daimui ai a? Eiava Paulo ladana ai e bapatisomui a?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

motu: Lau ese Dirava na hanamoamu, badina be umui ta asina bapatisoa, Krispo bona Gaio mo;
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

motu: ta bema toma lau na sibogu ladagu ai na bapatisomui na garina.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

motu: Stefana ena ruma taudia danu na bapatisodia; asina diba ḡoeva ta danu na bapatisoa eiava.
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

motu: Badina be Keriso ese e siaigu dia taunimanima ibapatisodia totona, a sivarai namo iharorolaina; bona dia aonega herevadia amo basina haroro, Keriso ena satauro na asi siahuna baine mia na garina. Satauro herevana
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

motu: Badina be satauro herevana na kavakava, mase dalana ai e rakamu taudia ediai; a mauri dalana ai ta rakamu tauda edai ia na Dirava ena siahu.
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Aonega taudia edia aonega baina ha-orea, lalo-parara taudia edia lalo-parara danu baina dadaraia.
english: For it is written, “ I|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * destroy the|strong="G2532" * wisdom|strong="G4678" * of|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * wise|strong="G4680" *. I|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * bring|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * discernment of|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * discerning to|strong="G2532" * nothing.” + 1:19 Isaiah 29:14 *

motu: Aonega tauna be edeseni ai? Itorena tauna be edeseni ai? Ina tanobada ai hereva e hedavelaimu tauna be edeseni ai? Dirava ese tanobada ena aonega na kavakava ḡauna ai vada e halaoa, ani?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

motu: Badina be Dirava ena aonega binai: tanobada na aonega amo Dirava se dibava negana ai iena ura vada e hedinarai, haroro kavakavana amo e abidadama heniamu taudia na do bae mauri.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

motu: Taunabunai, Iuda taudia ese toa e noiamu, Helene taudia ese danu aonega e tahuamu;
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

motu: to ai ese Keriso vada e hasatauroa na a harorolaiamu. Una na hekwakwanai ḡauna Iuda taudia ediai, bona kavakava ḡauna Helene taudia ediai;
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

motu: to e boiridia taudia, Iuda bona Helene danu, ediai Dirava ena siahu bona ena aonega.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

motu: Badina be Dirava ena kavakava ese taunimanima edia aonega e hereaiamu; bona Dirava ena manoka-manoka ese taunimanuma edia goada e hereaiamu.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

motu: Varavaragu e, Dirava ese e boirimui na ba laloa; dia hoho mai emui aonega, tau-anina aonegana; bona dia hoho mai emui siahu, tanobada siahuna; bona lohia danu dia hoho.
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

motu: A tanobada ena kavakava ḡaudia Dirava ese vada e abi hidi, aonega taudia ihahemaraidia; bona tanobada ena manokamanoka ḡaudia danu Dirava ese vada e abi hidi, goada ḡaudia ihahemaraidia;
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

motu: bona tanobada ena ḡau pipikidia bona ena hedadarai ḡaudia bona lasihidia ḡaudia danu Dirava ese vada e abi hidi, ia ese miadia ḡaudia baine ha-oredia totona.
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

motu: Taunabunai, tau ta Dirava vairanai basine heaḡi.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

motu: Dirava na Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e hamaurimui; bona Keriso Iesu ena amo aonega bona kara maoromaoro bona hahelaḡa bona hahemauri vada eme henida;
english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Heaḡi tauna ese Lohiabada baine heaḡilaia.
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.” + 1:31 Jeremiah 9:24 *

motu: Varavaragu e, lau na vasi bona Dirava ihahedinaraina herevadia na harorolai henimuiva negana ai, hereva namo-hereadia eiava aonega hereana asina vasilai.
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

motu: Badina be lalogu na hadaia, umui dekemui ai ḡau ta basina diba, Iesu Keriso mai ena satauro ida mo vadaeni.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

motu: Lau na manoka-manoka ai bona gari ai bona heude-heude badana ai umui bogaragimui ai na nohova;
english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

motu: bona egu hereva bona egu haroro na dia aonega herevadia eiava lalo-ani herevadia, to Lauma ena siahu na hahedinaraia,
english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

motu: emui abidadama na dia taunimanima edia aonega ai basine gini to Dirava ena siahu ai baine gini helaoreana.
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

motu: Aonega herevadia a gwauraimu, tatau badadia bogaragidiai, ḡau tamona dia ina tanobada aonegana bona dia ina tanobada lohiadia edia aonega; idia na e lao bubunimu.
english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

motu: A ai ese Dirava ena aonega hehunina a gwauraiamu; aonega hehunina bunai Dirava ese e lalo-hadailaia guna, tanobada do se karaia negana ai, ita ihanamoda.
english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

motu: Aonegana bunai ina tanobada lohiadia ta asi dibana; badina be idia bema diba, Hairai Lohiana basiema hasatauroa.
english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

motu: Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡerḡerena, eto, Mata ta se ita bona taia ta se kamonai ḡaudia, Tau ta lalona ese se lalo-hadailai ḡaudia, Dirava ese vada e abi hegaeḡae, E lalokau heniamu taudia edia.
english: But as it is written, “ Things|strong="G3588" * which|strong="G3739" * an|strong="G2532" * eye|strong="G3788" * didn’ t|strong="G3588" * see|strong="G3708" *, and|strong="G2532" * an|strong="G2532" * ear|strong="G3775" * didn’ t|strong="G3588" * hear, which|strong="G3739" * didn’ t|strong="G3588" * enter|strong="G3756" * into|strong="G1909" * the|strong="G2532" * heart|strong="G2588" * of|strong="G2316" * man|strong="G2588" *, these|strong="G3739" * God|strong="G2316" * has|strong="G2316" * prepared|strong="G2090" * for|strong="G1909" * those|strong="G3588" * who|strong="G3739" * love him|strong="G3588" *.” + 2:9 Isaiah 64:4 *

motu: A Dirava ese ia Laumana ena amo ini ḡau vada e hahedinarai henida; badina be Lauma ese ḡau iboudiai e tahumu; oibe, Dirava ena dobu ḡaudia e tahumu.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

motu: Badina be taunimanima edia ḡau be taunimanima laumana mo mai dibana, ani? Unuhetomana, Dirava ena ḡau be ta asi dibana, Dirava Laumana sibona mai dibana.
english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

motu: Ita ese tanobada laumana asita abia, a Dirava ena amo e maimu laumana tame abia, Dirava ese e henida dudu kaumu ḡaudia baita diba helaoreana.
english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

motu: Una na a gwauraimu, dia taunimanima edia aonega herevadia amo, a Lauma ese e hadibalaimu herevadia amo; taunabunai, lauma ḡaudia na Lauma ese e hahedibalaimu.
english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

motu: Tau-anina iabidadama-henina tauna ese Dirava Laumana ḡaudia se abi daemu, badina be idia na kakavakava ienai; lalona se pararamu, badina be lalo-parara na Lauma ena amo.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

motu: A lauma iabidadama-henina tauna ese ḡau iboudiai e dibamu, a tau ta ese ia se dibaiamu.
english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

motu: Badina be daika ese Lohiabada darana dibana, bena baine hadibaia? Ḡau tamona, ita ese Keriso darana vada ta abia.
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” + 2:16 Isaiah 40:13 * But we have Christ’s mind.

motu: Varavaragu e, lau na asina hereva henimuiva lauma iabidadama-henina taudia hegereḡeredia, a tau-anina iabidadama-henina taudia heḡereḡeredia ai na hereva henimuiva, e kara memero karukarudia Iesu Keriso lalonai na heheto.
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

motu: Rata na ubulaimuiva, dia aniani aukadia, badina be do asio goadava; harihari danu asio goadamu.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

motu: Badina be umui na doene tauanina o abidadama heniamu; vaḡeḡe bona heai umui bogaragimui ai doene e miamu. Benaini, umui na tau-anina iabidadama-henina taumui ani? Umui na taunimanima heḡereḡeredia o rakamu ani?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

motu: Badina be ta e tomu “Lau na Paulo ena”, ma ta e tomu “Lau na Apolo ena”; benaini, umui na tau-anina iabidadama-henina taumui, ani?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

motu: Apolo be daika? Paulo be daika? Hesiai taudia mo, sivarai namo e henimui, Lohiabada ese idia e henidia heḡereḡerena.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

motu: Lau ese na hadoa; Apolo ese e dairia; a Dirava ese anina e havaraia.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

motu: Benaini, ihadona tauna bona idairina tauna be herevadia; Dirava sibona ese anina e havaraiamu.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

motu: Ihadona tauna bona idairina tauna be heḡereḡere; to ta ta davadia bae abi, edia hekwarahi heḡereḡeredia.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

motu: Badina be ai na Dirava ida a ḡaukara heboumu; umui na Dirava ena uma bona Dirava ena ruma.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

motu: Dirava ese e henigu hariharina heḡereḡerena ruma iseuna dibana tauna na heto, ruma badina vada na atoa; a idau tauna ta ese ia daenai ruma ta ma e hadaiamu. A ta ta nahuadia bae toho, ede bae hadaia toma;
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

motu: badina be ruma badina idauna na tau ta ese basine atoa diba, vada e atoa kau ḡauna mo, Iesu Keriso bunai.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

motu: Una ruma badina latanai tau ta ese gold eiava silver eiava nadi nan namo-hereadia eiava au eiava kurukuru eiava biri baine hadai;
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

motu: ḡau tamona, taunimanima ta ta edia ḡaukara bae hedinarai. Badina be Keriso ena dina ese baine hahedinarai; oibe, lahi ese baine hahedinarai. Bena taunimanima ta ta edia ḡaukara be edeheto, lahi ese baine diba.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

motu: Tau ta ese e hadaia ḡauna na baine gini, una tau ese davana do baine abia.
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

motu: A tau ta ese e hadaia ḡauna na lahi ese baine araia, una tau do baine dabu; to ia na lahi lalona amo do baine roho mauri.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

motu: Asi dibamui a, umui na Dirava ena ruma helaḡana; Dirava Laumana danu umui lalomui ai e nohomu?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

motu: Tau ta ese Dirava ena ruma helaḡana baine hadikaia, Dirava ese ia do baine hadikaia. Badina be Dirava ena ruma na helaḡa; bona una ruma na umui.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

motu: Tau ta sibona basine hekoi. Tau ta umui bogaragimui ai lalona baineto ia na ina tanobada aonegana vada e davaria, ia na kavakava tauna ai do bainela, bena aonega korikori baine abia.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

motu: Badina be ina tanobada aonegana na kavakava, Dirava vairanai. Buka Helaḡa ai vada e torea, eto, Ia ese aonega taudia e idoadia, edia dibaka karadia ai.
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.” + 3:19 Job 5:13 *

motu: Ma e torea, eto, Lohiabada na aonega taudia edia lalo-hadai dibana, idia na asi anidia.
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.” + 3:20 Psalms 94:11 *

motu: Taunabunai, ta ese taunimanima basine heaḡilaidia. Badina be ḡau iboudiai na umui emui:
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

motu: Paulo eiava Apolo eiava Kefa eiava tanobada eiava mauri eiava mase eiava harihari e miamu ḡaudia eiava do bae vara ḡaudia. Ibouboudiai na umui emui;
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

motu: umui danu Keriso ena; Keriso danu Dirava ena.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

motu: Taunimanima ese ini bae lalolmai toma: ai na Keriso ena hesiai taumai bona Dirava ena hereva hehuni iregudia taumai.
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

motu: Matona, ireḡudia taudia namodia be kara momokani taudia.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

motu: Lauegu lalo-hadai binai: umui ese ba hahemaoro henigu, eiava taunimanima haida ese, una na ḡau pipikina mo. Lau danu sibogu asina hahemaoro heni,
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

motu: badina be egu kerere ta asina lalo davari. To una dainai maoromaorogu basie gwaurai; ihahemaoro-henigu tauna na Lohiabada.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

motu: Taunabunai, ḡau ta basio hahemaoro henia, negana be dounu; ela bona Lohiabada bainema. Ia ese dibura ai e hehunimu ḡaudia na diari ai baine veri lasi; taunimanima edia lalo-hadai danu baine hahedinarai. Bena taunimanima ta ta Dirava ese baine hanamodia.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

motu: Varavaragu e, umui daimui ai ini ḡau vada na gwaurai, lau bona Apolo latamai ai; bena ai emai amo vada ba diba, Buka Helaḡa ai e tore herevadia ba badinadia, ta bavabia dae una ta ba dadaraia na garina.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

motu: Be, daika ese oi mo e ha-idaumu? Bona dahaka ḡau oi dekemu ai, a tau ta ese se henimu? A bema ta ese e henimu, dahaka dainai o heaḡilaiamu, ta basinema henimu na heto?
english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

motu: Umui na ina harihari vada o boga kunumu; umui na ina harihari taḡa taumui; umui na lohia o tomamu, a ai be lasi. Boma lohia momokani bema namo, bena ai be umui ida baitama lohia hebou.
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

motu: Badina be lau na tomamu Dirava ese ai aposetolo taumai na gabe taumai ai vada e halaomai, vada e revamai mase; badina be tanobada bona aneru bona taunimanima bae raraia hebou ḡauna ai vada e halaomai.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

motu: Ai na kakavakava Keriso dainai, a umui na Keriso lalonai o aonegamu. Ai na mamanoka-mamanoka, a umui na gogoada. Umui na e heatolaimuimu, a ai na e ihi-ihiraimaimu.
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

motu: Dina iboudiai ema bona harihari e hitolomaimu, a ranu masemu, asi emai dabua, e tutumaimu, asi emai noho gabuna.
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

motu: A hekwarahimu, imamai amo a ḡaukaramu. E uduguiraimaimu, to a hanamodiamu; e daḡedaḡe henimaimu, to a haheaukamu;
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

motu: ladamai e hadikamu, to a hamarumarudiamu. Tanobada taḡena ai bona ḡau iboudiai momodia ai vada e halaomaimu ema bona harihari. Do baina igomui ita
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

motu: Ini hereva asina toremu umui ihahemaraimui totona; a natugu, egu lalokau, bama sisiba henidia heḡereḡerena ai umui na sisiba henimuimu.
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

motu: Ena be ihadibamui taudia Keriso ai bema gerebu ta, to tamamui basiema hoho; badina be Keriso Iesu bagunai lau ese sivarai namo ai na havaramui.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

motu: Taunabunai lau na noimuimu, lau ba haḡoigu.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

motu: Badina bunai Timoteo vada na siaia vasi dekemui ai; ia na egu lalokau merona mai momokanina ida, Lohiabada alonai. Ia ese egu ḡaukara Keriso Iesu lalonai baine hahelalolaimui, gabu idoidiai ekalesia iboudiai na hadibalaidia heḡereḡerena.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

motu: Haida na vada e hekokorokumu, badina be idia banava lau na basina vasimu e tomu.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

motu: A Lohiabada baine ura, lau na asi vanahana baina vasi; bena hekokoroku taudia baina dibadia; edia hereva basina diba, edia siahu mo baina diba.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena basileia na dia hereva ai, to siahuna ai e miamu.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

motu: Dahaka o uramu? Kwadi-kwadi auna baina vasilaia, eiava lalokau bona manilu ai baina vasi.
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

motu: Sivarai vada e piua, umui bogaragimui ai lebulebu karana ta mia; kara unuhetomana bese idau-idau taudia na asi dibadia. Karana binai: tau ta tamana adavana ida e heuda hanai.
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

motu: A umui be o hekokorokumu, asio taimu, asio tomu unu e kara toma tauna na bogaragimui amo bema heabi oho bema namo.
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

motu: Benaini, ena be taugu na idau gabu ai to laumagu na dekemui ai; taunabunai, lau ese una kara e karaia tauna vada na hahemaoro henia vaitani, dekemui ai bama noho na heto.
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai na haḡanimuimu: lau laumagu ida ba hebou Lohiabada Iesu Keriso siahuna ai,
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

motu: bena una kara e karaia tauna na Satana ba henia, Iauanina ihamasena totona; bena laumana do baine mauri Lohiabada ena mai dinana ai.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

motu: Emui hekokoroku na dia namo. Asi dibamui a, hatubu ḡauna sisina ese taba idoinai e hatubuamu?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

motu: Hatubu ḡauna gunana ba negea, taba matamatana ai baola, se hatubua ḡauna. Badina be Keriso vada e alaia mase, iseda Lagau-hanai mamoena ai ela.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

motu: Taunabunai, aria baita karaia, dia hatubu ḡauna gunana ai, bona dia lalo-hadai dikadia bona kara dikadia edia hatubu ḡauna ai, a se hatubua anianina ai: una na lalo ḡoeva bona hereva momokani.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

motu: Egu revareva ta lalonai na tore henimui, nato heuda-hanai taudia basio bamodia.
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

motu: To asinato nega idoinai ina tanobada ena heuda-hanai taudia, eiava mata-ḡaniḡani taudia, eiava dadidadi taudia, eiava kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia taudia, ida basio hebou; unu asina gwau toma. Boma ura unu boma kara toma, dala tamona be tanobada boma rakatania vaitani.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

motu: A harihari na tore henimuimu, na tomu, ita varavarada ta bema heudahanai tauna, eiava mata-ḡaniḡani tauna, eiava kaivakuku itomadiho-henina tauna, eiava ere dika tauna, eiava kekero muramurana inuna tauna, eiava dadidadi tauna, umui na ia ida basio hetura bona ia ida basio aniani hebou.
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

motu: Badina be murimuri tauna baina hahemaoro henia na dia lauegu ḡaukara; a umui emui ḡaukara be ekalesia lalonai e nohomu taudia na ba hahemaoro henidia, ani?
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

motu: Dirava ese murimuri taudia e hahemaoro henidiamu. Umui hari kara dika tauna murimuri ai bavatoa lasi.
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.” + 5:13 Deuteronomy 17:7; 19:19; 21:21; 22:21; 24:7 *

motu: Edeheto umui ta ese bamona baine habadelaia e tomu, bena kara kerere taudia vairadiai e hahemaoro heniamu, dia helaḡa taudia vairadiai se hahemaoro heniamu?
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

motu: Asi dibamui a, helaḡa taudia ese tanobada bae hahemaoro henia? Matona, asio heḡereḡere ḡau pipikidia ba hahemaorolai.
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

motu: Asi dibamui a, ita ese aneru do baita hahemaoro henidia? Ina mauri ena ḡau basita hahemaorolai a?
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

motu: Benaini, ina mauri ena ḡau o hahemaorolaimu negadia ai, edeheto ekalesia lalonai asi haridia taudia vairadiai o hahemaoro hehenimu?
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

motu: Ini na gwau tomamu, umui ihahemaraimui. Be! Bogaragimui ai aonega tauna ta lasi a, varavarana baine hahemaoro henidia diba?
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

motu: A ekalesia tauna ese bamona e habadelaiamu bona e hahemaoro heniamu, asi edia abidadama taudia vairadia ai.
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

motu: Taunabunai, umui o hahemaoro hehenimu na vada o kerere vaitani. E hadikamui negadia ai na hisi basio ani a? Emui kohu e abi havaramu negadia ai na basio haheauka a?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

motu: A umui ese bamomui ma o hadikadiamu, bona edia kohu ma o abi havaramu.
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

motu: Asi dibamui a, kara dika taudia na asi ahudia Dirava ena basileia lalonai? Basio hekoi. Lebulebu taudia, bona kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia taudia, bona heuda-hanai taudia, bona hahine ai e laomu taudia, bona sibodia e hahedika hehenimu taudia,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

motu: bona henao taudia, bona mata ganigani taudia, bona muramura ese e hakekerodiamu taudia, bona ere dika taudia, bona dadidadi taudia, ini iboudiai na asi ahudia, Dirava ena basileia lalonai.
english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

motu: Umui haida danu gunaguna unuheto; to vada e hurimui, vada e hahelaḡamui, bena maoromui vada e gwaurai, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai bona iseda Dirava Laumana ai. Basio lebulebu
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

motu: Kara iboudiai na asi taravatudia lauegu ai; to dia kara iboudiai na nanamo. Kara iboudiai na asi taravatudia lauegu ai; to ta ese basine biagugu.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

motu: Aniani ḡaudia na boga ena, bona boga na aniani ḡaudia edia; to Dirava ese ruaosi baine ha-ore. Tau-anina na dia lebulebu ena, a Lohiabada ena; Lohiabada danu tau-anina ena.
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

motu: Dirava ese Lohiabada vada e hatorea isi, bona ita danu baine hatoreda isi, ia sibona ena siahu amo.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

motu: Asi dibamui a, tau-animui na Keriso reḡena? Bena Keriso reḡena baina abi, ariara hahinena reḡena ai baina halao a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani.
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

motu: Asi dibamui a, ariara hahinena ida e heboumu tauna na ia ida tau-anina tamona? Badina be vada e torea, Raruosi na tau-anina tamona ai baela.
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.” + 6:16 Genesis 2:24 *

motu: A Lohiabada ida e heboumu tauna na ia ida lauma tamona.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

motu: Heuda-hanai ba heautania. Kara dika iboudiai taunimanima ese e karamu na tau-anina murimurinai; to e heuda hanaimu tauna ese sibona tau-anina e kara dika heniamu.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

motu: Asi dibamui a, tau-animui na Lauma Helaḡa ena ruma; ia na lalomui ai, Dirava ese vada e henimui? Umui na dia sibomui emui;
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

motu: badina be vada e hoimui, mai davamui. Taunabunai, tau-animui ai Dirava ba imodaia.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

motu: Vada o tore henigu herevadia davadia bini. Tatau basiema headava bema namo;
english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

motu: to lebulebu garina tatau ese adavadia ta ta bae abidia, hahine ese danu adavadia korikori mo bae abidia.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

motu: Tau ese adavana ena headava karana baine henia; hahine danu adavana ena headava karana baine henia.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, + 7:3 NU and TR have “what is owed her” instead of “the affection owed her”. * and likewise also the wife her husband.

motu: Hahine ese sibona tau-anina se biaguamu, a tau ese e biaguamu; tau danu sibona tau-anina se biaguamu, a hahine ese e biaguamu.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

motu: Boma hedadarai heheni, ḡuriḡuri igoadalaina totona, negana basinema daudau; bena boma eno bou lou, emui haheauka basinema heḡereḡere bena Satana ese bema dibaḡanimui na garina.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

motu: Ina na egu hahealo; dia haheḡani.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

motu: Lau na uramu taunimanima iboudiai ese lau bae haḡoigu; to ta ta mai edia harihari ḡaudia Dirava ena amo, ta be iniheto, ma ta be unuheto.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

motu: Asie headava taudia bona vabu na hamaorodiamu, na tomu bae noho lau heḡereḡeregu, una baine namo.
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

motu: To basiema haheauka, bema headava; badina be bae headava na namo, mata-dika ena lahi ai bae ara na dika.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

motu: A headava hahinedia na haganidiamu, hahine ese tau basine dihotania. Ina na dia lauegu haheḡani, to Lohiabada ena.
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

motu: A bema dihotania, ia na vadona ai bema noho, eiava adavana enai ma bema daro dae lou. Tau ese danu adavana basine hadihoa.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

motu: A taunimanima oredia ediai lauegu hereva (dia Lohiabada ena) binai: varavarada ta bema mai adavana, dia ekalesia hahinena, bona una hahine bema ura ia ida do bemaa noho; basinema hadihoa.
english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

motu: Bona hahine ta danu bema mai adavana, dia ekalesia tauna, bona una tau bema ura ia ida do bema noho; basinema dihotania.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

motu: Badina be ekalesia hahinena ese adavana murimuri tauna na e hahelaḡaiamu; bona ekalesia tauna ese adavana murimuri hahinena na e hahelaḡaiamu. Bema lasi, natumui basiema helaḡa; ḡau tamona, idia na harihari hehelaḡa.
english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

motu: A murimuri tauna eiava hahinena baine raka oho, basio rua; bena una headava ese tadikakada eiava taihuda basine ḡuia. Dirava ese vada e boirimui, maino ai ba noho.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

motu: Hahine e, ede o diba tomamu adavamu ba hamauria eiava? Tau e, ede o diba tomamu adavamu ba hamauria eiava?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

motu: Lohiabada ese taunimanima ta Ia vada e harihari henidia heḡereḡerena, bona Dirava ese taunimanima ta ta vada e boiridia heḡereḡerena, unu bae raka toma. Ekalesia oreadia iboudiai lalodiai unu na haḡanidia tomamu.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

motu: E peritomea tauna vada e boiria a? Ena peritome basine ḡorea. Asie peritomea tauna vada e boiria a? Basie peritomea.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

motu: E peritomea bona asie peritomea be asi anina; Dirava ena haheḡani ibadinadia mo mai anina.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

motu: Ta ta e boiridia negadia ai e nohova heḡereḡerena ai do bae noho.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

motu: E boirimu negana ai oi na hesiai taumu a? Lalomu basine hekwarahi. A iruha-negemu dalana ba davaria, vada bavabia dae; una be namo herea.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

motu: Badina be hesiai tauna Lohiabada lalonai vada e boiria, Lohiabada ese vada e ruhaia nege; a e heruha nege tauna vada e boiria, ia na Lohiabada ena hesiai tauna.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

motu: Vada e hoimui, mai davamui: taunimanima edia hesiai taudia ai basiola.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

motu: Taunimanima ta ta e boiridia negadia ai e nohova heḡereḡerena do bae noho, Dirava ida.
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

motu: Uhau bona ulato ediai lau na asi egu haheḡani Lohiabada ena amo; to lau sibogu, Lohiabada ese vada e bogagu hisi dainai bavabidadama henigu diba taugu, egu lalohadai aina henimui.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

motu: Lau na tomamu hari ini nega dikadia daidiai, taunimanima na harihari e nohomu heḡereḡeredia ai mo do bae noho, una be namo.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

motu: Mai adavamu a? Basio hadihoa. Asi adavamu a? Ta basio tahua.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

motu: Boma headava, ena na dia kara dikana; bona haneulato bema headava, una danu dia kara dika. Ḡau tamona, unu bae kara toma taudia na hisi do bae ani. A na uramu basinia hametaumui.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

motu: A varavaragu e, ini na gwau tomamu: nega na kwadogi. Harihari ela, mai adavadia tataudia na bae noho asi adavadia na heto baine namo;
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

motu: bona taitai taudia na bae noho asie taimu na heto; bona moale taudia na bae noho asie moalemu na heto; bona hoihoi taudia na bae noho asi edia kohu na heto;
english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

motu: bona tanobada ena ḡau namodia e abimu taudia na basie abi badabada, badina be tanobada oromana vada e lao bubunimu.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

motu: Lau na uramu lalomui na basie hekwarahi. Se headava tauna ese Lohiabada ena ḡau e lalo haguhilaimu, Lohiabada ede baine hamoalea toma.
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

motu: A headava tauna ese tanobada ḡaudia e lalo haguhilaimu, adavana ede baine hamoalea toma;
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

motu: taunabunai lalona be rua. Se headava hahinena eiava hane-ulato na Lohiabada ena ḡau e lalo haguhilaimu; bena tau-anina ai bona laumana ai baine helaḡa. A headava hahinena ese tanobada ḡaudia e lalo haguhilaimu, adavana ede baine hamoalea toma.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

motu: Unu na gwau tomamu na emui namo ihavarana, dia idoa vairamui ai asina atoamu; a na uramu hemataurai karadia ba kara, bona Lohiabada isiaina ba lao heni, asi daradaramui.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

motu: Tau ta na lalona ai bema diba ia ese maohenina asine kara maoromaoro henia, a hegahusi dainai ena ura ienai vada e abia, bena ena ura heḡereḡerena ai baine karaia, vada bae headava; una na asi kererena.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

motu: A ta ese sibona lalona bema hadaia basine headava e tomamu, bona lalona bema ha-aukaia bona bema hadaia momokani ede baine kara toma, bena basine headava be namo.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

motu: Taunabunai, maohenina baine adavaia tauna baine kara namo, a basine adavaia tauna baine kara namo herea.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

motu: Hahine ese adavana baine badinaia ela bona ena mauri dokona. A tau na baine mase, hahine na baine heruha nege, baine ura henia tauna na baine adavaia; to Lohiabada lalonai mo baine adavaia.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

motu: A lau na tomamu vadona ai baine noho, ena lalo-namo baine herea; lau na tomamu danu Dirava Laumana na lalogu ai.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

motu: Kaivakuku ihaboulaidia vamudia herevadia bini: ita dibada iboudai mai eda lalo-parara; to lalo-parara ese hekokoroku e havaraiamu, a lalokau ese goada e havaraiamu.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

motu: Tau ta lalona baineto mai ena aonega, ia na aonega korikori do asi dibana;
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

motu: a tau ta ese Dirava baine lalokau henia, Dirava ese ia baine dibaia.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

motu: Taunabunai, kaivakuku ihaboulaidia vamudia herevadia bini: ita dibada kaivakuku iboudiai tanobada ai na asi anidia; Dirava danu tamona mo.
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

motu: Ena be “dirava” e gwauraidiamu ḡaudia na guba ai bona tanobada ai nonoho, dirava hutuma bona lohia hutuma,
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

motu: to ita na mai eda Dirava tamona, ia na Tamada; ḡau iboudiai na iena amo e varamu, ita danu iena. Ita na mai eda Lohiabada tamona danu, Iesu Keriso bunai, ia dainai ḡau iboudiai e varamu, ita danu ia dainai vada ta vara.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

motu: Ḡau tamona, taunimanima iboudiai lalodia unu asie parara tomamu. Haida be kaivakuku karadia vada e manadalai ema bona harihari; una dainai lalodia ai e abia daemu e aniamu vamuna na helaḡa ḡauna, bena lalodia e manoka-manokamu dainai e hekwakwanaimu.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

motu: A aniani basine hanamoda Dirava vairanai; basita ania, basita dika; baita ania, basita namo.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

motu: To nahuamui ba toho, ina emui siahu na manoka taudia ihahekwakwanaidia ḡauna ai bainela na garina.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

motu: Badina be tau ta ese oi lalo-parara taumu baine itamu, kaivakuku ena dubu ai o ege dihomu, ia lalo-manoka tauna baineto ia danu kaivakuku ihaboulaina vamuna baine ania ani?
english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

motu: Bena lalo-manoka tauna, ena be oi varavaramu, ia dainai Keriso vada e mase, to oiemu lalo-parara dainai ia baine mase.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

motu: Taunabunai, varavarada o kara dika henidiamu, bona edia lalo-manoka o habadaiamu, unu amo Keriso danu o hadikaiamu.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

motu: Benaini, vamu ese varavaragu baine hahekwakwanaia, lau ese vamu basina ania ela bona hanaihanai, varavaragu baina hahekwakwanaia na garina.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

motu: Lau na ura-kwalimu taugu ani? Lau na aposetolo taugu ani? Eda Lohiabada Iesu na itaia ani? Umui na lauegu ḡaukara anina Lohiabada lalonai ani?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

motu: Idau taudia ediai readia lau na dia aposetolo tauna, a umui emui ai lau be aposetolo tauna momokani; badina be egu aposetolo dagina toana Lohiabada lalonai be umui.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

motu: E nanadaigumu taudia na ini na haere henidia tomamu;
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

motu: asi siahumai baia aniani bona baia inuinu a?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

motu: Asi siahumai ekalesia hahinedia edia amo adavamai baia abidia, bena baia hakaudia eva-eva, aposetolo oredia bona Lohiabada tadina bona Kefa heḡereḡeredia a?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

motu: Lau Banaba ida asi siahumai imamai ḡaukaradia baia ato diho a?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

motu: Daika baine ha tuari, bena ena tuari dokona ai sibona davana baine kara? Daika vine baine hado, bena ena hadohado anina basine ani? Daika ese mamoe baine naridia, bena rata na basine inua?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

motu: Lau na herevamu kavakava tauna na heto a? Taravatu unu se gwau tomamu a?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

motu: Badina be Mose ena taravatu ai vada e torea, eto, Uit e moimoilaiamu boromakauna na uduna basio ḡuia. O, Dirava ese boromakau e lalodiamu,
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” + 9:9 Deuteronomy 25:4 * Is it for the oxen that God cares,

motu: eiava ita daidai unu e gwau tomamu, a? Readia ita daidai vada e torea: badina be ruarua tauna na baine ruarua mai helarona ida, bona uit e kwadiamu tauna danu ahuna iabina baine laroa.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

motu: Ai ese lauma ḡaudia baiama hado umui emui, tanobada ḡaudia emui ai baiama abi na ḡau metauna a?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

motu: Haida ese bema biagumui, ai ese basiama biagumui badabada a? To asia biagumui. Ḡau idoidiai a haheaukalai, Keriso ena sivarai namo baia laoa ahu na garina.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? motu: Asi dibamui a, hahelaḡa ḡaukaradia e karamu taudia ese Dubu Helaḡa ḡaudia e animu; bona boubou patana e nariamu taudia ese boubou patana amo ahudia e abimu?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

motu: Unuhetomana, Lohiabada na vada e hahedua, sivarai namo e harorolaiamu taudia na sivarai namo amo adia bae abi.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

motu: A lau ese ḡau ta asina abia. Ini hereva asina tore umui ese unu ba karagu toma helaoreana. Bama mase bema namo; tau ta ese egu heaḡi badina bema abia oho bema dika.
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

motu: Ḡau tamona, sivarai namo na harorolaiamu be asina heaḡilaiamu, badina be vada e haduagu unu baina kara toma: sivarai namo basinama harorolaia madi ihabaigu.
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

motu: Badina be sibogu egu ura dainai bama karaia, ahugu bama abia; to dia sibogu egu ura dainai, hahedua dainai na karaia.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

motu: Benaini, ahugu be dahaka? Ahugu binai: sivarai namo iharorolaina ai hari sivarai namo baina heni asi davana; egu siahu sivarai namo lalonai basina ḡaukaralaia kava.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

motu: Ena be lau na ura kwalimu taugu taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, to iboudiai edia hesiai tauna ai nala, hutuma baina veridia mauri helaoreana.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

motu: Iuda taudia ediai Iuda tauna ai nala, Iuda taudia baina veridia mauri totona. Ena be lau na dia taravatu henunai, to taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia ediai taravatu henuna tauna ai nala, taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia baina veridia mauri totona.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, + 9:20 NU adds: though I myself am not under the law * that I might gain those who are under the law;

motu: Ena be lau ese Dirava ena taravatu asina tataia utu a Keriso ena taravatu na badinaia, to, asi taravatudia taudia ediai asi taravatuna tauna ai nala, asi taravatudia taudia baina veridia mauri totona.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

motu: Lalo-manoka taudia ediai lalo-manoka tauna ai nala, lalo-manoka taudia baina veridia mauri totona. Taunimanima idau-idau iboudiai edia ḡau idau-idau iboudiai nala, dala idau-idau iboudiai amo haida baina veridia mauri totona.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai na sivarai namo dainai na karamu, ia lalonai ahugu baina abia helaoreana.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

motu: Dibamui, ani, heau-helulu ai heau taudia iboudiai e heaumu, a tau tamona ese davana e abiamu. Unu ba heau toma, bena davamui bavabia.
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

motu: Gadara-helulu taudia na e boga aukamu, kwara iḡeḡena e maraimu ḡauna iabina totona. Ita danu ta boga aukamu, kwara iḡeḡena baine mia hanaihanai ḡauna iabina.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

motu: Unu na heau tomamu; asina daradaramu. Unu na tuari tomamu; dia hodahoda asina tutuamu,
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

motu: to sibogu tau-anigu na tutuamu, na ḡuiamu; haida baina haroro henidia to sibogu mauri baina reaia na garina.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

motu: Varavaragu e, na uramu ba diba, seneda iboudiai na ori henunai e nohova, bena unu amo ma iboudiai davara lalona amo e raka raka hanai.
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

motu: Iboudiai Mose enai bapatiso e abia, ori bona davara amo.
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

motu: Iboudiai danu lauma anianina tamona e aniava,
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

motu: bona iboudiai lauma ranuna tamona e inuava; badina be e ḡavadia nadina ranuna tamona e inua loulouva, nadina be Keriso.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

motu: To Dirava ese idia hutuma bada se lalo namo henidia dainai, tano ḡaḡaena ai eha mase.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

motu: Unu ḡau na toa, ita eda; kara dikadia basita ura heni, idia ese e ura heni na heto.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

motu: Kaivakuku danu basio toma henidia diho, idia haida heḡereḡeredia; Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena eto, Taunimanima na e ege diho, e aniani, e inuinu; bena e tore isi, e mavaru.
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.” + 10:7 Exodus 32:6 *

motu: Ita na basita lebulebu, idia haida e lebulebu na heto, bena dina tamona ai gerebu-rua daha-toi vada e mase.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

motu: Lohiabada danu basita dibagania, idia haida ese e dibaḡania na heto, bena gaigai ese e koridia mamase.
english: Let’s not test Christ, + 10:9 NU reads “the Lord” instead of “Christ”. * as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

motu: Bona basio maumau, idia haida e maumau na heto, bena ala-ala aneruna ese e aladia mamase.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

motu: Unu ḡau be idia ediai e vara, toa ai baela totona; sivaraidia danu vada e tore henida, ina tanobada dokona tauda isisibalai-henida.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

motu: Taunabunai, lalona e tomamu e gini tutuka-tutukamu tauna ese nahuana baine tohoa, baine keto na garina.
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

motu: Vada e butumui laomu hedibaganidia na taunimanima iboudiai ese e haheaukalai hedibaḡanidia heḡereḡeredia. Bona Dirava na momokani; ia ese baine narimui, emui goada e hereaiamu hedibaḡanina ta ese baine butumui tao na garina; hedihaḡani negana ai ia ese emui roho mauri dalana baine henimui, bena ba haheaukalaqia diba.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

motu: Taunabunai, egu lalokau e, kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia na ba heautani.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

motu: Lalo-parara taumui na hereva henimuimu; egu hereva ba haeroa.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

motu: Hahenamo keherena ta hanamoamu na hetura, Keriso rarana ai, ani? Ataga ta bakiamu na hetura, Keriso tau-anina ai, ani?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

motu: Badina be ataga be tamona, ita danu ena be hutuma to tau-ani tamona, taunabunai ita iboudai ataga tamona ta ania heboumu.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

motu: Israel ena kara ba itaia: boubou vamudia e animu taudia na boubou patana ai asie heturamu a?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

motu: Bena dahaka bainato? Kaivakuku ihaboulaina ḡauna na mai anina a? Bona kaivakuku danu mai anina a?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

motu: Lasi. Bese idau-idau ese e hahelaḡa ḡaudia na e aladiamu lauma dikadia ihaboulaidia, dia Dirava ena ihaboulaina. Asina uramu lauma dikadia ida ba hetura.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

motu: Lohiabada ena kehere bona lauma dikadia edia kehere ruaosi basio inu diba; Lohiabada ena pata anianina bona lauma dikadia edia pata anianidia ruaosi hasio ani diba.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

motu: Lohiabada ena vaḡege baita havaraia, a? Be, eda goada ese iena e hereaiamu a?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

motu: Ḡau iboudiai na asi taravatudia ita edai; to basitato ḡau iboudiai na nanamo. Ḡau iboudiai na asi taravatudia ita edai; to dia ḡau iboudiai ese basie hagoadada.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

motu: Ta sibona ena namo basine tahua, a dekena tauna ena namo danu baine tahua.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

motu: Hoihoi gabuna ai e hoimu vamudia iboudiai na bavani, basio henanadailai, lalomui bae hekwakwanai na garina.
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

motu: Badina be tanobada mai anidia iboudiai ida Lohiabada ena.
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.” + 10:26 Psalms 24:1 *

motu: Murimuri tauna ese baine boirimui, bena ba ura baola, vada baola, vairamui ai bae dabara ḡaudia iboudiai bavani, basio henanadailai, lalomui bae hekwakwanai na garina.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

motu: A tau ta ese baine hamaoromui, baineto “Inana na boubou vamuna”, basio ania, ia dainai bona lalo-hekwakwanai garina;
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

motu: dia oi lalomu asina gwauraiamu, to ia lalona. Be! Dahaka dainai lauegu ura-kwalimu na idau tauna lalona ese baine laoa ahu?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

motu: Dirava bama hanamoa, bena bama aniani. Dahaka dainai mai ihanamona ida na ania ḡauna dainai baine gwau henigu?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

motu: Benaini, bavaniani eiava ba inuinu eiava dahaka dahaka ba kara, ḡau iboudiai ba kara Dirava iheatolaina ai.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

motu: Iuda taudia bona Helene taudia, bona Dirava ena ekalesia taudia danu, basio hahekwakwanaidia;
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

motu: lau heḡereḡeregu, taunimanima iboudiai ḡau idoidiai na hamoalelaidia tohomu, sibogu egu namo asina tahuamu, a taunimanima loḡora edia namo na tahuamu, ihamauridia helaoreana.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

motu: Lau ba haḡoigu, lau ese Keriso na haḡoiamu heḡereḡerena. Eda toma diho
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

motu: Lau na hanamomuimu badina be ḡau iboudiai o lalolaigu, hahediba herevadia na abi bena na henimui ḡaudia o badinamu.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

motu: To na uramu ba diba, tatau iboudiai kwaradia na Keriso; hahine kwarana na tau; Keriso kwarana be Dirava.
english: But I would have you know that the head + 11:3 or, origin * of every man is Christ, and the head + 11:3 or, origin * of the woman is man, and the head + 11:3 or, origin * of Christ is God.

motu: Tau e ḡuriḡurimu eiava e perovetamu negadia ai kwarana e kumiamu, una na kwarana e hadikaiamu.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

motu: A hahine e guriḡurimu eiava e perovetamu negadia ai kwarana se kumiamu, ia danu kwarana e hadikaiamu; ia na kwarana e nauamu hahinena heḡereḡerena.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

motu: Badina be hahine ta ese kwarana basine kumia, ia huina do bae utua; a huina iutuna eiava kwarana inauna bema mai hemaraina, hahine ese kwarana bema kumia.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

motu: A tau ese kwarana baine mukoa na dia namo, badina be ia na Dirava ihaḡoina tauna bona Dirava hairaina. A hahine be tau hairaina.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

motu: Badina be tau na hahine ena amo se vara, a hahine hari, tau ena amo e vara;
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

motu: bona tau na se karaia hahine ena, a hahine hari e karaia tau ena.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

motu: Una dainai hahine ena siahu toana kwarana ai baine mia, aneru daidiai.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

motu: Ḡau tamona, hahine na dia sibona, a tau ida, bona tau na dia sibona, a hahine ida, Lohiabada lalonai.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
