motu: Badina be hahine na tau dainai vada e vara, a tau be hahine ena amo e varamu. A ḡau iboudiai na Dirava dainai e varamu.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

motu: Sibomui ba haeroa. Hahine be kwarana asi ikumilaina Dirava baine ḡuria namo eiava?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

motu: Lalomui asie pararamu a, tau huina baine lata na hemarai ḡauna ienai,
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

motu: a hahine huina baine lata na hairai ḡauna ienai? Badina be huina latana amo kwarana baine kumia.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

motu: A ta ese ina hereva baine gwaua tubu, egu haere binai: ai na kara idauna ta asi dibamai, bona Dirava ena ekalesia oreadia danu asi dibadia. Anibou Helaḡa
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

motu: Egu hahedua binai na henimuimu, asina hanamomuimu; badina be emui hebou amo namo ta se varamu, a dika mo e varamu.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

motu: Hereva gini-gunana binai: lau na name kamonai emui ekalesia heboudia lalodiai heiri-heiri e varamu bogaragimui ai. Una sivarai kahana na abia daemu.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

motu: Badina be lalo-hadai idau-idau bogaragimui ai bae vara; bena mai edia lalo-hadai namodia taudia emui at bae hedinarai.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

motu: Emui hebou negadia ai, Lohiabada ena anibou asio ania momokanimu.
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

motu: Badina be tau ana tau ana o animu, una dainai haida e hitolomu, ma haida e kekeromu.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

motu: Be! Asi emui ruma a? Unuseni ai boma aniani bona boma inuinu. Dirava ena ekalesia i'ihi-ihiraina bona ogoḡami taudia ihahemaraidia o uramu a? Ede baina hereva henimui toma a? Baina hanamomui a? Lasi vaitani.
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

motu: Badina be Lohiabada ena amo na abia bena umui na hamaorolaimui dalana binai: taona e torea hanuaboina ai, Lohiabada Iesu ese naoa atagana ta e abia;
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

motu: e hanamoa, bena e bitua, eto “Lau taugu binai, umui daimui ai baine makohi; ini ba kara toma, lau ba lalogu”.
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “\+w Take|strong="G2532"\+w*, eat. \+w This|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1699"\+w* \+w body|strong="G4983"\+w*, \+w which|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w broken|strong="G2806"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w*. \+w Do|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1519"\+w* memory \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*.” *

motu: Unuhetomana danu, e aniani vaitani murinai ia ese kehere e abia, bena ma eto “Ina kehere na herohemaino matamatana, lau raragu ai; ba inua negadia ai ini ba kara toma, lau ba lalogu”.
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “\+w This|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w cup|strong="G4221"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w new|strong="G2537"\+w* \+w covenant|strong="G1242"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1699"\+w* blood. \+w Do|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w*, \+w as|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w often|strong="G3740"\+w* \+w as|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w you|strong="G1437"\+w* \+w drink|strong="G4095"\+w*, \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* memory \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w me|strong="G3004"\+w*.” *

motu: Taunabunai, ina flaoa atagana bavania bona ina kehere ba inua negadia iboudiai na umui ese Lohiabada ena mase ba hahedinaraia, ela bona ia do bainema.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

motu: Benaini, tau ta ese ina flaoa atagana baine ania bona ina kehere baine inua kerere, ia ese Lohiabada tau-anina bona rarana baine hadika.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

motu: Tau ta lalona baine tahua guna; bena ataga baine ania bona kehere baine inua.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

motu: Badina be e ania kavamu bona e inua kavamu, se laloamu una na Lohiabada tau-anina, tauna ese ia sibona ihahemaoro-henina e aniamu bona e inuamu.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

motu: Badina bunai hutuma umui bogaragimui ai e manoka-manokamu bona e gorerediamu, haida danu e masemu.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

motu: A ita siboda laloda baitama tahu, hahemaoro na edai basinema kau.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

motu: Ḡau tamona Lohiabada ese e hahemaoro henidamu, matada ihakanidia, ita bona tanobada baita dika bou na garina.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, anibou dainai ba hebou negadia ai, ba henari heheni.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

motu: Ta ben-a hitolo, ia na ena ruma ai bema aniani, hahemaoro ai ba dika bou na garina. Hereva oredia do bae mia ela bona baina vasi, bena baina hamaoromaoro.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

motu: Varavaragu e, lau na uramu lauma ena herahia ba diba.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

motu: Badina be umui dibamui, dibura ai o nohova negana ai, e hakaumui negadia iboudiai kaivakuku, asie herevamu diravadia, ediai e hakaumui oho.
english: You know that when you were heathen, + 12:2 or Gentiles * you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

motu: Badina bunai na hadibamuimu, Dirava Laumana ai e herevamu tauna ese Iesu basine uduguiraia diba; bona tau ta basineto “Iesu na Lohiabada”, Lauma Helaḡa ai e herevamu tauna mo sibona.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

motu: Herahia be idau-idau, a Lauma be tamona.
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

motu: Hesiai daladia na idau-idau, a Lohiabada be tamona.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

motu: Ḡaukara danu idau-idau, a Dirava be tamona; ia ese ḡau idoidiai taunimanima iboudiai lalodiai e karamu.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

motu: A Lauma ese taunimanuma vada e hahedinarai henidia hagau-hagau, namo ihavarana totona.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

motu: Badina be Lauma tamona ena amo, ta aonega igwauraina e heniamu, ma ta lalo-parara igwauraina e heniamu,
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

motu: ma ta abidadama e heniamu, ma ta gorere ihanamolaidia siahuna e heniamu,
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

motu: ma ta hoa karadia ikaralaidia siahuna e heniamu, ma ta peroveta siahuna e heniamu, ma ta lauma idibadia e heniamu, ma ta gado idaudia e heniamu, ma ta gado anidia ihahedinaraidia e heniamu.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

motu: Unu ḡau iboudiai Lauma tamona ese taunimanima e henidia hagau-hagaumu, ena ura heḡereḡerena.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

motu: Badina be tau-anina be tamona, to reḡena na momo; bona rege, ena be momo, to iboudiai tau-anina tamona reḡena. Keriso danu unuheto.
english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

motu: Badina be ita iboudai Lauma tamona lalonai e bapatisoda, tau-anina tamona ai e halaoda, Iuda tauda eiava Helene tauda, hesiai tauda eiava urakwalimu tauda; ita iboudai danu Lauma tamona e ha-inulaida.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

motu: Badina be tau-anina na dia reḡe tamona, a reḡe diaḡau.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

motu: Ae-palapala bema toma “Lau na dia ima-palapala dainai lau na dia tau-anina ena”; una dainai ia na dia tau-anina ena a?
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

motu: Bona taia bema toma “Lau na dia mata dainai lau na dia tau-anina ena”; una dainai ia na dia tau-anina ena a?
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

motu: Tauanina idoinai bema mata mo, kamonai vada edena? Eiava idoinai bema kamonai mo, bonabona vada edena?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

motu: A Dirava ese reḡe ta ta tau-anina lalonai vada e ato, ena ura heḡereḡerena.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

motu: Iboudiai bema reḡe tamona, tau-anina be vada edena?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

motu: A reḡe be idau-idau; tau-anina na tamona.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

motu: Benaini, mata ese ima-palapala na basine hereva henia, basineto “Asi emu ḡaukara egu ai”, kwara danu aepalapaladia basine hereva henidia, basineto “Asi emui ḡaukara egu ai”,
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

motu: Lasi; manoka-manoka ta gwauraimu reḡedia na mai edia ḡaukara badahereadia;
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

motu: bona imatauraidia mamaraḡi ta tomamu reḡedia na ta matauraidia badamu; bona asi hairaidia reḡedia ta hanamo badamu;
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

motu: a tau-anida reḡedia mai hairaidia na ḡau ta ai asie dabumu. Dirava ese reḡe iboudiai vada eme habou, tau-anina tamona ai baela; e dabu reḡena danu hemataurai bada vada eme henia,
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

motu: tau-anina ai reḡe iboudiai bae hedaro boubou bona bae henari heheni helaoreana.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

motu: Bena reḡe ta baine hisihisi, reḡe iboudiai na ia ida bae hisihisi hebou; eiava reḡe ta bae hanamoa, reḡe iboudiai na ia ida bae moale hebou.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

motu: Benaini, umui na Keriso tau-anina; umui ta ta be ia reḡena.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

motu: Dirava ese haida ekalesia lalonai vada e atodia: gini-gunadia be aposetolo; iharuadia be peroveta taudia; ihatoidia be hahediba taudia; idia muridiai hoa karadia ikaradia taudia; ma idia muridiai gorere ihamauridia mai dibadia taudia bona hekaha taudia bona hahekau taudia bona gado idau-idau taudia.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

motu: Iboudiai be aposetolo a? Iboudiai na peroveta taudia a? Iboudiai na hahediba taudia a? Iboudiai na hoa karadia e karamu a?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

motu: Iboudiai na gorere ihamauridia mai dibadia a? Iboudiai na gado idaudia ai e herevamu a? Iboudiai na gado anidia e hahedinaraimu a?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

motu: Herahia hereadia ba hekisehekise heni. A dala herea-daena be harihari aina hahedinarai henimui.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

motu: Taunimanima gadodia ai bona aneru gadodia ai bama hereva, to asi egu lalokau, lau na auri e botaiamu eiava gaba e touamu na heto.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

motu: Peroveta siahuna bama abia, bona hehuni ḡaudia bona aonega ḡaudia iboudiai bama diba, bona egu abidadama amo ororo bama raga oho, to asi egu lalokau, lau na ḡau asi anina na heto.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

motu: Egu kohu idoinai ogoḡami taudia bama ubulaidia, bona tau-anigu bama heni, lahi ai bema ara ore, to asi egu lalokau, unu ese basie hanamogu.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

motu: Lalokau na e haheauka taritarimu; lalokau na mai ena heabi-dae; asi ena hebore; se heaḡimu; se hekokorokumu;
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

motu: se kara havaramu; sibona ena ḡau se tahun u; se badll haraḡamu; ihadikal; lina karadia se lalo taomu;
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

motu: kara gageva-gageva se moalelaimu, a hereva momokani e moalelaimu;
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

motu: ḡaukara iboudiai e goadalaimu; ḡau iboudiai e abi daemu; iboudiai e laromu, dika iboudiai e haheauka henimu.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

motu: Lalokau na se dokomu. Peroveta herevadia hari bae ore; gado idaudia bae doko; aonega danu baine boio.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

motu: Badina be sisidia mo dibada, taidia taidia mo ta perovetamu;
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

motu: a ḡoeva-daena bainema negana ai, sidia taidia ta diba ḡaudia na bae bubuni.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

motu: Merogu negana ai na herevava mero na heto, lalogu e urava mero na heto, egu lalo-hadai be mero ena lalo-hadai. A taugu e lo negana ai, mero ena kara vada na nege.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

motu: Badina be harihari hevarivari ai ta ita valahu-valahumu, a una negana ai baita ita heida-ida. Harihari sisina mo dibagu, a una negana ai do baina diba ḡoevaḡoeva, vada e dibagumu heḡereḡerena.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

motu: Taunabunai, ini ḡau toiosi mo mimia: abidadama, bona helaro, bona lalokau. A herea-daena be lalokau mo.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

motu: A Lalokau na ba ḡavaia goadagoada, lauma herahiadia danu ba tahu, ba peroveta helaoreana.
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

motu: Badina be gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna na dia taunimanima se hereva henidiamu, a Dirava hari, badina be taunimanima ta na ena hereva anina asi dibana; ia ese lauma ai hereva hehunidia e gwauraimu.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

motu: A e perovetamu tauna ese hahealo bona hahegoada bona tauhalo na taunimanima e herevalai henidiamu.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

motu: Gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna na sibona lalona e hapararaiamu, a e perovetamu tauna ese ekalesia taudia lalodia e hapararadiamu.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

motu: Lau na uramu umui iboumui ai gado idaudia ai ba hereva, to na ura badamu ba peroveta. E perovetamu tauna ese gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna e hereaiamu, ena gado idaudia anidia ekalesia taudia lalodia ihapararadia totona se haheḡeregere negadia ai.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

motu: Varavaragu e, harihari umui dekemui bama vasi gado idaudia ai bama hereva, a gado anidia eiava lalo-diari eiava peroveta eiava hahediba herevadia basinama gwaurai, ede bama hanamomui toma?
english: But now, brothers, + 14:6 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

motu: Heḡereḡerena binai: ḡau haida be dia mamauri to mai reḡedia; ivilikou bona gitara reḡedia basiema idau-idau, dahaka e hiririmu bona dahaka e hataimu ede baitama diba toma?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

motu: Ina danu, tuari kibina basiema hiriria ḡoevaḡoeva, daika ese ena tuari ḡaudia bema heḡaeḡaelai?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

motu: Unuhetomana umui danu, emui hereva anidia basie hedinarai, daika ese mamidia baine abi? E kara hodahoda ba hereva henia na heto.
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

motu: Readia gado idau-ldau be diaḡau tanobada ai, a iboudiai be mai anidia.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

motu: To, gado anina basinama diba, e herevamu tauna vairanai lau na idau taugu na heto, ia danu lau vairagu ai idau tauna na heto.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

motu: Taunabunai, lauma herahiadia o hekise-hekise henimu dainai, ekalesia ilareba-daena daladia ba tahu goadagoada.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

motu: Badina bunai, gado idaudia ai e herevamu tauna na baine noinoi, gado anidia danu baine haheḡereḡere diba.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

motu: Badina be gado idaudia ai baina ḡuriḡuri be laumagu mo e ḡuriḡurimu to lalogu na se pararamu.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

motu: Matona: laumagu ai baina ḡuriḡuri, ma lalogu ai danu baina ḡuriḡuri; laumagu ai ane baina abi, ma lalogu ai danu ane baina abi; una be namo.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

motu: Bema lasi, lauma ai mo Dirava ba hanamoa negana ai, lalona se pararamu tauna ese “amen” ede baine gwauraia toma? Badina be emu hereva anina na asi dibana.
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

motu: Oi ese Dirava ihanamona herevana o gwauraia ḡoevaḡoevamu, to bamomu lalona se pararamu.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

motu: Dirava na hanamoamu, lau na umui iboumui ai name hereamui, gado idaudia igwauraidia ai.
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

motu: A ekalesia hebouna ai hereva ima baina gwaurai mai daragu ida, haida baina hadibalaidia, una be namo; a hereva gerebu gado idaudia ai baina gwaurai, una be dika.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

motu: Varavaragu e, daramui ai basio garuḡaru. Lalo-dika ai ba ḡaruḡaru, a daramui na taudia e lo taudia daradia heḡereḡeredia ai baela.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

motu: Taravatu ai vada e torea: Lohiabada na e tomu “Idau gado idau gado taudia edia amo bona bese idau-idau taudia bibinadia amo lau ese ina bese taudia baina hereva henidia; to basie kamonai henigu”.
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.” + 14:21 Isaiah 28:11-12 *

motu: Taunabunai, gado idaudia na toa, dia kamonai taudia edia, to asi edia kamonai taudia edia. A peroveta herevadia na dia asi edia kamonai taudia edia, to kamonai taudia edia.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

motu: Benaini, ekalesia idoinai gabu tamona ai bae hebou, bona hebou taudia iboudiai gado idaudia ai bae hereva; bena asi dibadia taudia eiava asi edia kamonai taudia bae raka vareai, bena baeto “Umui na readia e kavamui”.
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

motu: A iboudiai bae peroveta, bena asi ena kamonai tauna eiava asi dibana tauna baine raka vareai negana ai iboudiai ese bae sisiba henia, bae hahemaoro henia,
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

motu: bona ena lalo-hadai hehunidia do bae hahedinarai; bena baine goru diho, Dirava baine toma henia diho, baineto “Momokani, Dirava na umui bogaragimui ai”. Ekalesia heboudia
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

motu: Bena edeheto, varavaragu e? Ba hebou negadia ai, umui ta ta mai emui ane, mai emui hahediba, mai emui hereva hehuni ihahedinaraidia, mai emui gado idaudia, mai emui gado idauna anina ihahegeregerena. Ḡau idoidiai ba kara taunimanima lalodia ihapararalaidia.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

motu: Gado idaudia ai bae hereva, rarua eiava tatoi mo bae hereva hedava, bena ta ese anidia baine haheḡereḡere.
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

motu: A bema asi gado ihaheḡereḡerena tauna, gado idauna ai e herevamu tauna na ekalesia hebouna ai basine hereva; a ia lalona ai sibona baine hereva, bona Dirava baine hereva henia.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

motu: Peroveta taudia danu rarua eiava tatoi bae hereva, bena bamodia ese edia hereva bae haero.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

motu: A helai tauna ta lalona ai hereva hehunina ta baine hedinarai e herevamu tauna na ena hereva baine hadokoa.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

motu: Iboumui ai ba peroveta diba, to ta ta ba peroveta hedava, bena hebou taudia iboudiai na aonega bona hahegoada bae davari.
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

motu: Peroveta laumadia ese peroveta taudia e kamonai henidiamu;
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

motu: badina be Dirava na dia heiri-heiri Diravana, a maino Diravana. Helaḡa taudia edia ekalesia heboudia iboudiai lalodiai heḡereḡerena,
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

motu: emui hahine na hebou lalodiai bae mu noho; bae hereva na taravatu. Bae hemataurai noho, taravatu ese e gwauraiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says, + 14:34 Deuteronomy 27:9 *

motu: Bae ura ḡau ta bae diba, ruma ai adavadia bae nanadaidia; badina be hahine na hebou lalonai baine hereva na mai hemaraina.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

motu: Be, Dirava ena hereva na umui emui amo ema, eiava umui mo emui ai vada e kau, a?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

motu: Tau ta lalona baineto ia na peroveta tauna, eiava Lauma ese vada e roheamu, ia ese na tore henimuimu herevadia baine abi dae, baine diba Dirava ena haheḡani bini.
english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

motu: A bema ta basine diba, bena basio abia dae.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, peroveta siahuna ba hekise-hekise henia, bona gado itlaudia ig vauraidia basio gwau tao.
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

motu: Ḡau idoidiai ba kara namonamo, ba kara ḡoevaḡoeva.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

motu: Varavaragu e, sivarai namo na harorolai henimuiva, o abi daeva, bona lalonai o gini tutuka-tutukamu, ma na hadibalaimuimu.
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

motu: Unu amo danu mauri vada o abia; ḡau tamona sivarai namo na harorolai henimuiva boma laloa tao, basioma abia dae kava.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

motu: Badina be na davaria herevana na henimui gunava: Keriso na eda kara dika daidiai e mase, Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena;
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

motu: vada e ḡuria danu; dina ihatoina ai e hatorea isi, Buka Helaḡa ai e torea heḡereḡerena;
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

motu: Kefa + 15:5 “Kefa” be Petro ladana ta. * enai e hedinarai, bona gwautararuosi ediai danu;
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

motu: gabeamo nega tamona ai varavarada sinahu-ima mai dikoana ediai e hedinarai. Idia hutuma vada e nohomu ema harihari; a haida na vada e mahuta.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

motu: Muridiai Iakobo enai e hedinarai; bona aposetolo iboudiai ediai danu.
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

motu: Ibouboudiai muridiai, e vara dika merona ta na heto, lau ese vada na itaia.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

motu: Badina be aposetolo iboudiai ese lau e hereagumu; lau na dia namo aposetolo bae gwauraigu, badina be Dirava ena ekalesia oreana na daḡedaḡe heniava.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

motu: To Dirava ena harihari-bada dainai lau ini name heto; bona e henigu hariharina danu se henigu kava, badina be ḡaukara lalonai idia iboudiai vada na hereadia; a dia lau mo, to Dirava ena harihari-bada lau ida.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

motu: Taunabunai, lau na haroro, eiava idia e haroro, herevana be tamona mo, a harorolaiamu bona o abia daemu ḡauna mo.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

motu: A bema Keriso na mase amo e hatorea isi a harorolaiamu, edeheto umui haida na o tomamu mase taudia na basie tore isi lou?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

motu: Mase taudia na basiema tore isi lou, Keriso danu basinema hatorea isi;
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

motu: bona Keriso basinema hatorea isi, emai haroro bema asi anina, umui emui abidadama danu bema asi anina.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

motu: Oibe, ai danu Dirava idiba-koikoina taumai bema gwauraimai, badina be Dirava ese Keriso e hatorea isi sivaraina a harorolaia; a ḡau be mase taudia basinema hatoredia isi negana ai Keriso danu basinema hatorea isi.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

motu: Momokani; mase taudia basinema hatoredia isi, Keriso danu basinema hatorea isi.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

motu: Bena Keriso na basinema hatorea isi, umui danu boma abidadama kava, bena emui kara dikadia lalodiai doene boma noho;
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

motu: bona Keriso lalonai vada e mahutamu tauda na bema baia.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

motu: Eda helaro Keriso lalonai bema ina mauri mo, taunimanima iboudiai bogaragidiai ita mo madi ihabaida.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

motu: Momokani, Keriso na mase amo vada e tore isi, mahuta taudia edia tore-isi-lou roboana.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

motu: Badina be taunimanima ena amo mase vada e vara; ma taunimanima ena amo mase taudia ihatore-isidia vada e vara.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

motu: Badina be taunimanima iboudiai Adam bagunai vada e mase na heto, Keriso bagunai iboudiai do bae mauri.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

motu: A ta ta ena nega ena nega ai mauri bae abia; guna Keriso, tore-isi-lou roboana; murinai, iena lou mai negana ai, Keriso ibadinana taudia.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

motu: Bena dokona baine kau: una negana ai ia ese basileia na Tamana Dirava baine henia; una negana ai danu gaubada iboudiai bona lohia iboudiai bona siahu taudia iboudiai na ia ese baine haoredia.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

motu: Badina be ia na do baine lohia, ela bona ana inai iboudiai na ia aena henudiai do baine atodia.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

motu: Ana inai gini-gabena be mase: ia danu baine ha-orea.
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

motu: Badina be ia ese ḡau iboudiai aena henudiai vada e ato. A hereva e tomu “ḡau iboudiai ia henunai vada e ato”, dibada anina be dia ḡau iboudiai, badina be ia henunai vada e atodia Diravana na unu se heato toma.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” + 15:27 Psalms 8:6 * But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

motu: A ḡau iboudiai ia henunai bae heato vaitani negana ai, Natuna danu ḡau iboudiai ia henunai vada e atodia Diravana henunai bainela; taunabunai Dirava baine herea, baine herea dae.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

motu: Unu basinema heto, mase daidiai vada e bapatisodia taudia na ede bema heto? Mase taudia basiema tore isi lou, badina be dahaka idia daidiai e bapatisodiamu?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

motu: Bona badina be dahaka lau na nega idoidiai hahedika bogaragidiai na nohomu?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

motu: Varavaragu e, Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada lalonai na heaḡilaimuimu dainai, na hamaoromui momokanimu, lau na daba daba iboudiai na masemu.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

motu: Taunimanima edia kara heḡereḡerena Efeso ai uda boromadia ida na heatu, namona be dahaka egu ai? Mase taudia basiema tore isi lou, baitama aniani baitama inuinu hari namo, badina be kerukeru vada baita mase.
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.” + 15:32 Isaiah 22:13 *

motu: Basio hekoi: kara dika taudia edia hebamo ese kara namo taudia e hahekwakwanaidiamu.
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

motu: Kara namo enai ba noga; basio kara dika; badina be haida na Dirava asi dibadia. Unu na gwau tomamu, umui ihahemaraimui totona.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

motu: A tau ta baineto “Mase taudia na ede bae tore isi toma? Tau-anidia edehetomadia ma bae torelai?”
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

motu: Kava taumu e, o hadoamu ḡauna na basinema mase guna, ia na basinema mauri.
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

motu: O hadoamu ḡauna na dia gabeai baine vara anina, to uhe mo, readia uit uhena eiava idau uhe ta.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

motu: A Dirava ese anina e heniamu, ena ura heḡereḡerena uhe ta ta anidia korikori e henidiamu.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

motu: Hidio danu iboudiai na dia heḡereḡere: ta be taunimanina hidiodia; ma ta be boroma hidiodia; ma ta be manu hidiodia; ma ta be gwarume hidiodia.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

motu: Guba tau-anidia bona tanobada tau-anidia danu mimia; a guba ḡaudia hairaidia be ta, tanobada ḡaudia hairaidia be ma idau.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

motu: Dina hairaina be ta, hua hairaina be ma ta, hisiu hairaidia danu idau; bona hisiu ta ta hairaidia be idau-idau.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

motu: Mase taudia edia tore-isi-lou na unuheto. Mase ai e hadoamu; mauri hanaihanai ai e hatorea isimu.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

motu: Hemarai ai e hadoamu; hairai ai e hatorea isimu. Manoka-manoka ai e hadoamu; goada ai e hatorea isimu.
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

motu: E hadoamu, tau-anina; e hatorea isimu, lauma-anina ai. Badina be tau-anina e miamu, bona lauma-anina danu e miamu.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

motu: Buka Helaḡa ai ini e torea toma: Tau gini gunana Adam na lauma maurina ai e halaoa. A Adam gini-gabena be hahemauri laumana ai vada e halaoa.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” + 15:45 Genesis 2:7 * The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

motu: Lauma-anina na se guna; tau-anina e gunava, gabe amo lauma-anina.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

motu: Tau gini-gunana na tano amo ema, ḡahu ai e karaia; tau iharuana na guba amo ema.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

motu: Tanobada taudia be tano amo ema tauna heḡereḡerena; guba taudia be guba amo ema tauna heḡereḡerena.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

motu: Tano amo ema tauna oromana vada ta abia na heto, guba amo ema tauna oromana do baita abia.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s + 15:49 NU, TR read “we will” instead of “let’s” * also bear the image of the heavenly.

motu: To, varavaragu e, lau na tomamu hidio bona rara ese Dirava ena basileia basie abia diba; mase tauna ese danu se masemu ḡauna ahuna basine abia diba.
english: Now I say this, brothers, + 15:50 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

motu: A kamonai; hereva hehuni aina hamaorolaimui. Ita iboudai basita mahuta; to iboudai do baine ha-idauda;
english: Behold, + 15:51 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

motu: asi kaimana, mata-hekunumai tamona ai, kibi gabena bae hiriria negana ai. Badina be kibi do bae hiriria, bena mase taudia baine hatoredia isi, basie mase lou; bona ita na do baine ha-idauda.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

motu: Badina be ina baine pata ḡauna ese basine pata ḡauna haine hadokilaia, bona ina baine mase ḡauna ese basine mase ḡauna baine hadokilaia.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

motu: Taunabunai, baine pata ḡauna na basine pata ḡauna baine hadokilaia bona baine mase ḡauna na basine mase ḡauna baine hadokilaia negana ai, e torea herevana baine momokani, eto, Kwalimu ese mase vada e hadonoa.
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.” + 15:54 Isaiah 25:8 *

motu: Mase e, emu kwalimu be edeseni ai? Mase e, emu hekori be edeseni ai?
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, + 15:55 or, Hell * where|strong="G4226" * is|strong="G3588" * your|strong="G3588" * victory|strong="G3534" *?” + 15:55 See Hosea 13:14 *

motu: Mase ena hekori na kara dika; bona kara dika ena siahu na taravatu.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

motu: A Dirava aita hanamoa: ia ese vada e hakwalimuda, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai.
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, egu lalokau, ba gini tutuka-tutuka, basio marere. Lohiabada ena ḡaukara lalonai ba goada balaheni nega idoinai; badina be dibamui emui hekwarahi Lohiabada lalonai na asio hekwarahilaia kavamu.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

motu: Boubou, helaḡa taudia idurulaidia, na ekalesia Galatia ai na haḡanilaidia heḡereḡerena umui danu ba karaia.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

motu: Pura dinana gini-gunana umui ta ta ese taidia taidia bavato tabe, emui ḡaukara anidia vada e tubu heḡereḡerena; bena baina vasi negana ai boubou ḡaukarana be baine mia.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

motu: Bena dekemui ai baina kau negana ai, ba gwauraidia hidi taudia na revareva ba henidia, baina siaidia, emui herahia ḡaudia Ierusalem bae laohai.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

motu: A boma ura, lau danu idia ida bama lao. Hahetoni herevadia
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

motu: Makedonia baina rakaia hanai, bena baina vasi. Badina be egu lalohadai be Makedonia do baina rakaia hanai guna,
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

motu: bena dekemui ai baina noho taritari, reana ela bona keru negana baine doko. Bena una negana ai umui ese ba durugu egu laolao idoinai.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

motu: Badina be asina uramu harihari rakagu ai baina itamui, to Lohiabada baine ura, lau na dekemui ai baina noho taritari na tomamu.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

motu: A Efeso ai baina noho ela bona Pentekoste negana;
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

motu: badina be iduara badana vada eme hekeho, egu ḡaukara baine ḡoeva, to inaida na hutuma.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

motu: Timoteo baine vasi negana ai, nahuamui ba toho, bavabia dae, dekemui ai baine noho; badina be ia ese Lohiabada ena ḡaukara e karaiamu, lau hegereḡeregu.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

motu: Taunabunai, tau ta ese basine dadaraia; a maino ai ba durua, dekegu bainema. Badina be ia, mai varavarada haida ida, na naridiamu.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

motu: A varavarada Apolo vada na noia goadagoada, varavarada haida ida bae vasi nato; to ia na se ura, harihari basine vasi e tomu, a nega namona baine davaria bena baine vasi.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

motu: Ba gima. Abidadama ai ba gini tutuka-tutuka. Ba haheauka. Ba goada.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

motu: Emui ḡaukara idoidiai na lalokau ai ba kara.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

motu: Varavaragu e, na hahealo henimuimu, Stefana mai ena ruma taudia na dibamui, idia na helalo-kerehai taudia gini-gunadia Akaia ai; idia danu sibodia e hegwaurai, helaḡa taudia isiaidia bae lao heni.
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

motu: Taunabunai, unuhetomadia, bona ai ida a ḡaukara heboumu bona a hekwarahi heboumu taudia iboudiai, ba kamonai henidia.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

motu: Lau na moalemu badina be Stefana bona Forotunato bonaAkaiko vada e gini dae dainai; badina be umui na dia iniseni ai, to idia daidiai egu ai e heḡereḡere.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

motu: Badina be idia ese lau lalogu vada e hamauria, bona umui lalomui danu. Unu e kara tomamu taudia na bavabidia dae.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

motu: Ekalesia oreadia Asia ai ese e hanamomuimu. Akula bona Priskila, ekalesia oreana edia ruma ai e heboumu taudia ida, ese e hanamomui badabadamu Lohiabada ladana ai.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

motu: Varavara iboudiai ese e hanamomuimu. Ba hahenamo heheni, mai haherahu helaḡana ida.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

motu: Lau Paulo egu hahenamo herevana binai, imagu ai name torea.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

motu: Tau ta ese Lohiabada basinema ura henia, bema uduguiraia. Emai Lohiabada e, aoma!
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. + 16:22 Greek: anathema. * Come, Lord! + 16:22 Aramaic: Maranatha! *

motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada emui ai baine mia.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

motu: Egu lalokau be umui iboumui ai emui ai, Keriso Iesu lalonai. Amen.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu Dirava ena ura dainai, varavarada Timoteo ida, Dirava ena ekalesia taumui Korinto ai, bona helaḡa taumui iboumui ai Akaia tanona idoinai, a tore henimuimu:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

motu: Tamada Dirava ena amo, bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, harihari-bada bona maino bavabi. Hereva matadia
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Dirava aita imodaia; ia na iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, Tama hebogahisina, tauhalo Diravana.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

motu: Emai hisihisi iboudiai lalodiai ia ese taumai e halodiamu, taunabunai ai ese hisi e animu taudia na taudia ihalodia dibamai; Dirava ena tauhalo e henimaimu ai ese ma a henidiamu.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

motu: Badina be Keriso e ani hisidia emai ai e badamu heḡereḡerena tauhalo danu emai ai e badamu, Keriso dainai.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

motu: Taunabunai, hisi baiama ani, una na taumui ihalodia bona ihamaurimui totodia; a tauhalo baiama abia, una danu taumui ihalodia totona, ai a animu hisidia umui danu o animu mai haheaukamui ida tauhalona.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

motu: Ai a abidadama henimuimu danu; dibamai ai ida hisihisi ahuna o abiamu, ma ai ida tauhalo ahuna bavabia.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

motu: Varavaramai e, a uramu Asia ai a aniva hisidia ba diba: e gugubamai maseva, emai goada e oreva, banava baia mase ato.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, + 1:8 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

motu: A sibomai lalomai ai ato baia mase, taunabunai sibomai asia heabidadama, a mase taudia e hatoredia isimu Diravana a abidadama heniava.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

motu: Ia ese mase badana amo e hamaurimaiva bona e hamaurimaimu; a abidadama heniamu danu ia ese do baine hamaurimai.
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

motu: Umui danu ba kahamai emui ḡuriḡuri ai; bena ḡuriḡuri momo amo baia davaria hariharina dainai hutuma ese Dirava bae hanamoa. Emai heaḡi badina
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

motu: Emai heaḡi badina binai, lalomai ese e hamomokaniamu: emai kara tanobada ai bona umui emui ai a karamu na mai helaḡadia bona mai momokanidia ida; dia tanobada aonegana amo a Dirava ena harihari-bada amo.
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

motu: Badina be ai ese hereva hehunidia asia tore henimuimu, a ba duahidia diba bona anidia ba lalo-davari herevadia mo. Egu helaro be harihari do asio dibadia ḡoevaḡoeva ḡaudia na anidia ba diba vaitani. Bena umui ese ba heaḡilaimai, ai ese baia heaḡilaimui heḡereḡerena ai, eda Lohiabada Iesu ena dina ai. Egu vasi herevadia
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—
as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

motu: Una na dibagu dainai, egu lalo-hadai gunana be dekemui ai baina vasi nato, harihari-bada iharuana ma baina henimui totona;
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

motu: bena umui emui amo Makedonia bainala, ma Makedonia amo baina lou dekemui ai; bena umui ese Iudea bainala dalana ba lailaia nato.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

motu: Lalogu unu na hadaia toma daradara tauna na heto a? Eiava egu lalo-hadai be tanobada tauna ena lalo-hadai na heto, nega ta be “oibe” ma una nega tamona ai be “Lasi” danu a?
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

motu: Dirava be momokani bena emai hereva na dia “oibe” bona “lasi”.
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

motu: Badina be lau bona Siluano bona Timoteo ese Iesu Keriso, Dirava Natuna, a harorolai henimuiva na dia “oibe” bona “lasi”, to “oibe” mo.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

motu: Badina be ia lalonai Dirava ena gwauhamata iboudiai na “oibe”; una dainai ia lalonai Dirava i'imodaina na “amen” amo ta hamomokaniamu.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

motu: Ai bona umui na Keriso enai e haginida tutuka-tutukamu bona vada e horoda tauna na Dirava.
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

motu: Ia toana danu ita latadai vada e atoa, bona ena Lauma toana ita lalodai vada e henida, toana bunai.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

motu: Dirava hari lalogu dibana, lau na Korinto asina vasi badina korikori be na bogamui hisi dainai.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

motu: Ai ese emui abidadama asia biaguamu, to ai na emui moale ikahana taumai; badina be abidadama dainai o ginimu.
english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

motu: Lalogu na hadaia nato basina vasi lou, lalo-hisihisi baine vara na garina.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

motu: Badina be lau ese bama hahisimui, daika ese bema hamoalegu? Umui, na hahisimuimu taumui mo.
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

motu: Bena egu revareva ta na torea, baina vasi negana ai ihamoalegu taudia ese bae hahisigu na garina. Na abidadama henimuimu, lauegu moale ai umui danu ba moale. Egu revareva gunana badina
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

motu: Badina be na tore henimui negana ai na lalogu e hisihisiva bona e metauva; mai taigu ida na tore henimui, dia ihahisimui totona, to egu uraheni badana emui ai ba diba totona.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

motu: A hisihisi e havaraia tauna ese dia lau mo se hahisigu, a umui danu taina (herevana basina ha-aukaia) e hahisimui.
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

motu: Una tau ena dika davana umui hutuma ese vada o gwauraia vada e heḡereḡere;
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

motu: harihari ena dika ba gwau tao bona tauna ba haloa, dara-doko ese baine gugubaia mase na garina.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

motu: Taunabunai na noimuimu, emui iura-henina lalonai bavabia lou.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

motu: Una dainai na tore henimui: toamui baina diba, hereva iboudiai o badina eiava lasi.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

motu: Umui ese tau ta ena dika ba gwau tao, lau danu ena dika baina gwau tao. Badina be tau ta ena dika bama gwau tao una na umui daimui ai bona Keriso vairanai bama gwau tao,
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

motu: Satana ese bema hadarereda garina; badina be iena dibaka karadia na dibada. Egu laolao sivaraina
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

motu: Lau be Troa nala, Keriso ena sivalai namo iharorolaina, bena Lohiabada ese iduara ta e kehoa egu;
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

motu: to asina noho namonamova, badina be tadigu Tito asina davaria. Taunabunai na hatonidia, Makedonia nala.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

motu: A Dirava aita hanamoa, ia ese Keriso ena kwalimu ai nega idoinai e hakaumaimu, bona ia sivaraina bonana namona na gabu iboudiai ai emai amo e hahedinaraiamu.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

motu: Badina be, ai na Keriso bonana namona Dirava vairanai, e hamauridiamu taudia ediai bona bae mase taudia ediai;
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are saved and in those who perish:

motu: ini idia ediai mase bonana, mase ihavarana, a unu idia ediai mauri bonana, mauri ihavarana. Ini ḡaukara ai daika baine heḡereḡere?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

motu: Ḡau tamona, ai na dia haida na heheto, Dirava ena hereva asia hoihoilaiamu, to mai momokanimai ida Dirava ese Keriso lalonai e henimaimu heḡereḡerena Dirava vairanai a herevamu.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

motu: Sibomai a hahenamo loumu o tomu a? Eiava, ai na haida heḡereḡeredia, hahenamo revarevadia emui ai eiava emui amo baia abi a?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

motu: Emai revareva na umui, lalomai ai e torea, taunimanima iboudiai dibadia bona e duahiamu.
english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

motu: Eme hedinarai vaitani umui na Keriso ena revareva, ai ese a reḡuamu; dia ink amo se torea, a Mauri Diravana ena Lauma amo e torea; dia nadi ai se torea, a taunimanima lalodia ai e torea.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

motu: Ai ese Dirava unu a abidadama henia tomamu, Keriso bagunai.
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

motu: Ai na asi aonegamai ḡau ta sibomai baia laloa ḡoeva: aonegamai na Dirava ena amo.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

motu: Ia ese e ha-aonegamai, herohemaino matamatana isiaina ilaohenina taumai ai e halaomai; dia buka ai ta duahiamu ḡauna a Lauma ese e hadibildamu ḡauna. Badina be buka ḡauna be hahemase ḡauna, a Lauma ḡauna be hahemauri ḡauna.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

motu: Hahemase isiaina ilao-henina herevadia nadi ai e tore na mai hururuhururuna ida ema; bena Israel taudia Mose vairana asie raraia diba, hururuhururuna dainai. Ḡau tamona, una hururu-hururu se mia daudau.
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

motu: Benaini, Lauma isiaina ilao-henina hururu-hururuna ese ia basine hereaia a?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

motu: Badina be taunimanima iḡuidia bema mai hururu-hururuna, taunimanima iruhanegedia hururu-hururuna vada herea.
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

motu: Momokani, gunaguna e hururuhururuva ḡauna harihari se hururu-hururumu, badina be ina hururu-hururu matamatana vada herea.
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

motu: Bena se vanaha ḡauna bema mai hururu-hururuna, e miamu ḡauna hururu-hururuna vada herea.
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

motu: Taunabunai, unu a helaro tomamu dainai a hereva goadamu;
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

motu: dia Mose na heto, vairana muko ai e koua, Israel taudia ese se miamu ḡauna basie raraia tao helaoreana.
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

motu: A lalodia e duhuva; una dainai taravatu gunana e duahiamu negadia ai una muko na dounu mia ema bona harihari; Keriso mo lalonai i vada eme heabi oho.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

motu: Oibe, Mose ena buka e duahiamu negadia ai muko ese lalodia e koumu ema bona harihari;
english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

motu: a lohiabada bae haḡerea negana ai hari muko baine heabi oho.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

motu: Lohiabada na Lauma; bona Lohiabada Laumana e nohomu gabudia ai ura kwalimu danu e nohomu.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

motu: Ita iboudai vairada asi mukodia na heto Lohiabada hururu-hururuna ta hahedinaraiamu; hevarivari na heto; bena e haidaudamu, ia heida-ida ai, hairai ta amo ela bona ma hairai la, Lohiabada Laumana dainai.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

motu: Iena hebogahisi dainai ina hesiai ḡaukarana vada a abia; taunabunai ai na asia hesikumu.
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

motu: Ai na hemarai karadia hehunidia vada a nege; dibaka karadia asia loalaimu; Dirava ena hereva asia hagagevaiamu. A hereva momokanidia a gwaurai hedinaraimu Dirava vairanai; unu amo taunimanima lalodia a hanamodiamu emai ai.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

motu: Emai sivarai namo bema hehuni, ia na mase e lao heniamu taudia mo ediai bema hehuni.
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

motu: Ina tanobada diravana ese asi edia abidadama taudia lalodia vada e hadiburadia, Keriso namona, Dirava ihagoina tauna, ena sivarai namo diarina ediai baine tata dae roha na garina.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

motu: Badina be emai haroro badina na dia ai sibomai, to Keriso Iesu, ia na Lohiabada, bona ai, umui isiaimui ilao-henina taumai Iesu dainai.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

motu: Badina be Dirava eto “Dibura amo diari baine tara”; Diravana bunai ai lalomai ai e taramu, Dirava hairaina Iesu Keriso vairana ai baia itaia helaoreana.
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” + 4:6 Genesis 1:3 * who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

motu: A ina kohu namona na e kara hodu lalodiai a abiamu na heto; taunabunai siahu herea-daena na Dirava ena amo bainema, dia ai emai amo.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

motu: Ini amo unu amo hahedika e aru maimu, to asia dareremu; a daradaramu, to daramai asie dokomu;
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

motu: e daḡedaḡe henimaimu, to bamomai asie rakatanimaimu; e haketomaimu, to asia masemu.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

motu: Nega idoinai tau-animai ai Iesu ena mase a loalaiamu, Iesu ena mauri danu tau-animai ai baine hedinarai helaoreana.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

motu: Badina be dina idoidiai, ai mauri taumai taomai e tore Iesu dainai, Iesu ena mauri ai hidiomai ai baine hedinarai helaoreana.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

motu: Benaini, ai lalomai ai mase e gaukaramu, a umui lalomui ai mauri e ḡaukaramu.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

motu: Emai kamonai be e torea herevana heḡereḡerena, eto, Lau na kamonai, bena na hereva; ai danu a kamonaimu, bena a herevamu.
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” + 4:13 Psalms 116:10 * We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

motu: Ai dibamai Lohiabada Iesu e hatorea isi Diravana ese ai danu Iesu ida baine hatoremai isi, bena ai bona umui ia vairanai baita gini.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.

motu: Badina be ini ḡau iboudiai na umui daimui ai; hutuma ese harihari-bada bae abia bena Dirava bae imodaia badabada helaoreana.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

motu: Taunabunai, ai na asia hesikumu. Tau-animai e manokamu, a daba daba idoinai lalomai e hamatamatamu.
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

motu: Badina be emai hisihisi taina, asi metauna bona asi vanahana ḡauna, ese emai namo bada-hereana ta e havaraiamu, mai metauna bona mia-hanaihanai ḡauna.
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

motu: A itamu ḡaudia na asia raraidi mu, to mata-tuna ḡaudia a raraidiamu; badina be a itamu ḡaudia na mai negadia, to mata-tuna ḡaudia na bae mia hanaihanai.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

motu: Dibamai emai kalaga binai tanobada ai baine heroho, guba ai ruma ta Dirava ena amo baia abia, dia ima karakara ḡauna to mia-hanaihanai ḡauna.
english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

motu: Momokani, iniseni ai a ḡanaḡanamu, a ura badamu emai guba rumana baia hadokilaia;
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

motu: bena baia hadokilaia negana ai basie davarimai kopi kavakava.
english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

motu: Ina kalaga ai a nohomu taumai emai maduna daidiai a ḡanaḡanamu; asia uramu baia dokia oho, to a uramu matamatana baia dokilaia; bena mauri ese mase baine hadonoa.
english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

motu: E karamai heḡaeḡae tauna na Dirava, bena ihamomokanina Laumana vada e henimai.
english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

motu: Benaini, ai na lalomai e goadamu nega idoidiai. Dibamai tau-animai ai a nohomu negana ai, ai na dia Lohiabada enai;
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

motu: badina be abidadama dainai a rakamu, dia ita-itana dainai.
english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

motu: Lalomai e goadamu, a uramu tauanina ena amo baia raka oho, Lohiabada enai baia noho.
english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

motu: Taunabunai, emai lalo-hadai tamona binai: iniseni ai eiava unuseni ai ia mo baia hamoalea.
english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

motu: Badina be ita iboudai Keriso ena hahemaoro gabuna ai baita gini, bena tau-anida ai ta karamu karadia davadia baita abi, namo eiava dika. Herohemaino
english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

motu: Taunabunai, Lohiabada garina dibamai dainai, ai ese taunimanima lalodia a animu. Dirava vairanai lalomai e hedinaraimu; lau na uramu umui lalomui ai danu lalomai bae hedinarai.
english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

motu: Sibomai asia hahenamo loumu; to heaḡi badina a henimuimu, ai daimai ai ba heaḡi; bena taunimanima lalodia asie heagilaimu a oromadia mo e heaḡilaimu taudia ba haere henidia diba.
english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

motu: Ai baiama kava, una na Dirava dainai; a baiama aonega, una na umui daimui ai.
english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

motu: Badina be Keriso ena uraheni ese e haduamaimu: a tomamu, ta ese iboudiai daidiai e mase, taunabunai iboudiai vada e mase;
english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

motu: bona iboudiai daidiai e mase, taunabunai e maurimu taudia na sibodia ediai basie mauri, to idia daidiai e mase ma e tore isi lou tauna enai bae mauri.
english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

motu: Taunabunai, ina murinai tau ta na oromana mo amo basia haeroa; ena be gunaguna Keriso na oromana amo a haeroa, to harihari unu asia haeroa toma.
english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

motu: Taunabunai, tau ta bema Keriso lalonai, ia na e kara tau matamatana na heto; ḡau gunadia vada e lao bubuni, ḡau iboudiai vada matamata.
english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, + 5:17 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * all things have become new.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai danu Dirava ena amo; ia ese Keriso bagunai ia ida vada e haheroheda maino; bona herohemaino isiaina ilao-henina taumai ai vada e halaomai.
english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

motu: Herevana binai: Dirava be Keriso lalonai, tanobada taudia ia ida e haheroheda maino, eda kara dika asine lalo tao. Herohemaino herevana binai ai e henimai. Ai na Keriso ena gwaukau taumai
english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

motu: Taunabunai, ai na Keriso ena gwaukau taumai: Dirava ese ai udumai amo e noimuimu, Keriso bagunai Dirava ida ba herohemaino.
english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

motu: Ia na kara dika asi dibana, to tau dikana ai e halaoa ita daidai, ita na ia bagunai Dirava ena maoromaoro ai baitala helaoreana.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

motu: Ai danu, ia ida a ḡaukara heboumu taumai, a noimuimu, Dirava ena harihari-bada basio abia kava.
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

motu: Badina be ia na e tomu, Nega namona ai na kamonai henimu, Hahemauri dinana ai na kahamu. Benaini, nega namona binai, hahemauri dinana binai.

Behold|strong="G2400" *, now|strong="G3568" * is|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G1722" * day|strong="G2250" * of|strong="G2250" * salvation|strong="G4991" *.

motu: Tau ta asia hahekwakwanaia, emai hesiai ilao-henina baine dika na garina.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

motu: A emai kara iboudiai daidiai taunimanima bae diba, ai na Dirava ena hesiai taumai: haheauka dainai, hisihisi daidiai, ogoḡami dainai, lalohisihisi daidiai,
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

motu: hekwadi daidiai, dibura rumana nohona dainai, heloḡoheloḡo daidiai, hekwarahi dainai, hegima daidiai, hitolo dainai,
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

motu: laloḡoevaḡoeva dainai, aonega dainai, lalo-manada dainai, hebogahisi dainai, Lauma Helaḡa dainai, lalokau korikori dainai,
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

motu: hereva momokani dainai, Dirava ena siahu dainai, kara maoromaoro ena tuari ḡaudia imamai idibadia ai bona lauridia ai daidiai.
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

motu: E heatolaimai bona e hahemaraimai. Namomai e gwaurai bona dikamai e gwaurai. Koikoimai e gwaurai, ḡau tamona ai na momokani.
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

motu: Asi harimai eto, ḡau tamona mai harimai. Mase taumai eto, ḡau tamona a maurimu. E dadabamai, to asie alamai mase.
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

motu: Daramai e doko, to nega idoidiai a moalemu. Ogoḡami taumai, to hutuma a hataḡadiamu. Asi emai ḡau ta, to ḡau iboudiai na ai emai.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

motu: Korinto taumui e, hereva momo a hamaorolaimui; lalomai anidia eme hedinarai emui ai.
english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

motu: Emai lalokau emui ai na dia maraḡi; a emui hari eme maraḡi.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

motu: Na hereva henimuimu, natugu na heheto; na tomu davana ba henimai, emui lalokau na ba habadaia emai ai. Lalo rua
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

motu: Asie kamonaimu taudia ida basio hebamo. Badina be kara maoromaoro bona kara havara ede bae hetura toma? Eiava diari bona dibura ede bae hebou toma?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

motu: Keriso bona Beliara ede bae herohemaino toma? Kamonai tauna ahuna be dahaka, asi ena kamonai tauna enai?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

motu: Dirava ena dubu bona kaivakuku ede bae hatamonadia toma? Badina be ita na Mauri Diravana ena dubu; Dirava ena hereva heḡereḡerena eto, Lau na bogaragidiai baina noho bona baina loa eva-eva; Lau na edia Dirava ai bainala, bona idia be egu bese ai baina halaodia.
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.” + 6:16 Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 32:38; Ezekiel 37:27 *

motu: Lohiabada ma eto, Edia amo ba raka oho, dauhai ba noho; Miro ḡauna enai basio dau kau, bena baina abimui dae;
english: Therefore “‘ Come|strong="G1831" * out|strong="G1831" * from|strong="G1537" * among|strong="G1537" * them|strong="G3004" *, and|strong="G2532" * be|strong="G2532" * separate,’ says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *. ‘Touch no|strong="G3361" * unclean thing|strong="G3004" *. I|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * receive|strong="G1352" * you|strong="G5210" *. + 6:17 Isaiah 52:11; Ezekiel 20:34,41 *

motu: Lau na Tamamui ai bainala, bona umui be natugu mamaruanemui bona hahinemui ai baina halaomui. Lohiabada siahu-hereadaena unu e gwau toma.
english: I will be to you a Father. motu: Taunabunai, egu lalokau e, ini gwauhamata herevadia tame abi dainai, tau-anina bona lauma ihadikadia karadia iboudiai baita huri oho, helaḡa karadia baita haḡuḡuru, Dirava imatauraina ai.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

motu: Bavabimai dae: tau ta asia hadikaia, ta asia ha-ogoḡamia, ta ena kohu asia abia koikoi.
english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

motu: Bona asina gwau henimuimu: vada na hereva guna heḡereḡerena, a lalokau henimuimu; umui ida baita mase hebou, baita mauri hebou.
english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

motu: Lau na abidadama henimuimu, na heaḡilaimuimu. Emai hisihisi iboudiai lalodiai taugu eme lo, bona na moale badamu. Tito ena heigo-ita
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

motu: Makedonia ai a kau negana ai, tau-animai asie laḡa ani, hekwarahi ese e ḡeḡemai dae; murimai ai be heatu, Ialomai ai be gari.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

motu: A dara-doko ihakeruna Diravana ese Tito ena gini-dae amo lalomai e hakerudia;
english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

motu: dia ena gini-dae mo dainai, a umui ese o abia dae sivaraina dainai danu. Badina be emui uraheni bona emui taitai bona emui helalo egu ai na e hamaoromai, bena na moale bada.
english: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

motu: Egu revareva dainai lalomui e hisihisiva, bena na daradarava. To harihari asina daradaramu, badina be dibagu una revareva ese nega sina mo lalomui e hahisiva.
