english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

motu: Harihari na moalemu, dia lalomui e hisihisiva dainai, to emui lalo-hisihisi ese helalo-kerehai e havaraia dainai. Badina be emui lalo-hisihisi na Dirava ena amo, taunabunai dika ta emai amo asio davaria.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena amo lalo-hisihisina ese helalokerehai e havaraiamu, bona helalo-kerehai ese hahemauri e havaraiamu; basita daradaralaia. A tanobada ena amo lalo-hisihisina ese mase e havaraiamu.
english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

motu: Mani ba laloa: ina Dirava ena amo lalo-hisihisina dainai nahuamui o toho ani? lalomui o hamaoromaoro ani? lalomui e hekwarahi ani? o gari ani? o helaro ani? o haheauka ani? dika davana o heni ani? Kara iboudiai lalodiai kerere vada o hamaoromaoro.
english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

motu: Una dainai na tore henimui, dia kerere e havaraia tauna dainai, eiava e hadikaia tauna dainai, to emui lalokau korikori emai ai Dirava vairanai baine hedinarai totona.
english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

motu: Unu amo taumai e lo; bona a moale danu, Tito ena moale dainai, badina be umui ese ia tauna o haloa.
english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

motu: Ia vairana na heaḡilaimuiva, bena asio hahemaraigu: a herevalai henimui herevadia vada momokani, bona Tito vairanai a heaḡilaimui herevadia danu vada momokani.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

motu: Tito ese umui e ura henimui lalo-dikamu, badina be iboumui ai emui kamonai karadia ia ese e lalo unemu; mai garimui bona mai hematauraimui ida o abia dae danu e laloa unemu.
english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

motu: Lau na moalemu badina be na abidadama henimui momokanimu.
english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

motu: Varavaragu e, Dirava ena harihari-bada, ekalesia oreadia Makedonia ai e harihari henidia, aia hadibalaimui.
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

motu: Ena be edia hisihisi na bada, to edia moale na bada herea; ena be edia ogoḡami na bada, to edia heduru na bada herea.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

motu: Na gwauraia hedinaraimu, idia na edia goada heḡereḡerena e heni, ma edia goada e hereaia danu;
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

motu: bona e noimai lalo-dika, edia harihari ḡaudia baia abi, helaḡa taudia idurulaidia, eto.
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

motu: Dia ai emai helaro mo asie haheḡereḡerea. A, guna idia sibodia lalodia Lohiabada e henia, bona ai e henimai, Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

motu: Una dainai Tito a noia, ina herahia ḡaukarana ia ese e matamaia, bena ia ese emui ai do baine haḡuḡurua ato.
english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

motu: Benaini, ḡau iboudiai emui ai na babada: abidadama, bona hereva, bona lalo-parara, bona haheauka, bona iura-henimai; ina herahia karana danu emui ai baine bada.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

motu: Asina haḡanimuimu; to idia haida edia haheauka amo umui emui uraheni na dibaiamu, ia na momokani eiava lasi.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

motu: Badina be iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada vada dibamui: ia na taḡa tauna, to umui daimui ai ogoḡami tauna ai ela, ena ogoḡami amo umui baine hataḡamui totona.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

motu: Egu lalo-hadai binai: ba karaia baine namo. Badina be laḡani muridai vada o haeroa bona o matamaia;
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

motu: bena harihari ba haḡuḡurua. Ihaerona ai o haraḡa heḡereḡerena, ihaḡuḡuruna ai danu ba haraḡa.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

motu: Badina be tau ta lalona baine haraḡa, iabi-daena be enai e miamu ḡauna heḡereḡerena, dia e dabumu ḡauna heḡereḡerena.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

motu: Lau asina tomamu haida ese laḡadia bae ani, a umui be ba hekwarahi mase.
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

motu: Lasi, iboumui ai ba heḡereḡere. Harihari umui na mai emui ḡau, a idia be e ogoḡamimu; taunabunai, ba kahadia. Kerukeru vanegai umui ba ogoḡami, bena idia ese bae kahamui; bena vada ba heḡereḡere.
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, Mana momo e gogo tauna ana bahu se mia, A e gogo gadoi tauna ana be vada e davana.
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.” + 8:15 Exodus 16:18 *

motu: Dirava baita hanamoa badina be ia ese Tito lalona ai umui iura-henimui vada e havaraia;
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

motu: bena emai hahealo e abia dae, bona sibona ena ura dainai danu vada e vasi.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

motu: Varavarada ta danu ia ida vada a siaia vasi; ia na mai harina namo, sivarai namo ihapiuna ai, ekalesia oreadia iboudiai lalodiai.
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

motu: Dia una mo, a ekalesia oreadia ese vada e abia hidi, ina herahia ḡaukarana iloalaina ai baine bamomai, Lohiabada iheatolaina bona ai lalomai ihaharagadia totona.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

motu: Badina be emai gari tamona be tau ta ese baine habadelaimai, ina herahia badana a ḡaukaralaiamu dainai;
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

motu: bona emai ura tamona be baia ḡaukara maoromaoro, Dirava vairanai bona taunimanima vairadiai.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

motu: Ma varavarada ta idia ida vada a siaia vasi; ena goada be nega momo vada a dibaia loulou, a harihari e goada hereamu, umui e abidadama henimuimu dainai.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

motu: Haida ese Tito henanadaina bema henanadai, ia na lau bamogu, raruosi a ḡaukara heboumu umui daimui ai. Eiava hari varavarada henanadaidia bema henanadai, idia na ekalesia oreadia edia hesiai ilao-henina taudia, Keriso iheatolaina.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

motu: Taunabunai, emui lalokau toana bona ai ese a heaḡilaimuimu badina ba hahedinarai, ekalesia oreadia vairadiai.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

motu: Badina be emui lalo-haraḡa na dibagu bona Makedonia taudia vairadiai na heaḡilaimui.
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

motu: nato “Akaia na laḡani gunana ai e heḡaeḡae”. Bena emui goada ese idia e hagoadadia.
english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

motu: A varavarada vada na siaidia vasi, a heaḡilaimui kava na garina, bena umui ba heḡaeḡae, na herevalaimui heḡereḡerena ai.
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

motu: Bena Makedonia taudia haida ese bema bamogu, baiama vasi davarimui, a do asio hegaegae, bena emai heaḡi kava dainai baiama hemarai, umui danu boma hemarai.
english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

motu: Taunabunai na laloa varavarada aina noidia hari namo, idia bae vasi guna, o gwauraia hamata ḡauna bae haboua heḡaeḡae; bena ia na herahia ḡauna korikori ai bainela, dia ai ese emui ai baiama dadihaia ḡauna na heto.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

motu: Ba laloa: baine hado gadoi tauna ese baine ḡei gadoi; baine hado hoho tauna ese baine ḡei hoho.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

motu: Ta ta ena lalo-hadai ena lalo-hadai ai bae heni; basie heni maumau, bona dia hahedua dainai basie heni. Badina be mai moalena ida e henimu tauna Dirava ese e lalokau heniamu.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

motu: Dirava na mai siahuna herahia ḡaudia iboudiai emui ai baine habada; taunabunai, nega idoidiai ḡau bavabi hoho, bona emui kara namodia iboudiai ba habada.
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

motu: Buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto, E ḡiḡi rohoroho, ogoḡami taudia e henidia; Ena kara maoromaoro bae mia hanaihanai.
english: As it is written, “ He|strong="G3588" * has|strong="G1519" * scattered|strong="G4650" * abroad|strong="G4650" *. He|strong="G3588" * has|strong="G1519" * given|strong="G1325" * to|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G1519" * poor|strong="G3993" *. His|strong="G1519" * righteousness|strong="G1343" * remains|strong="G3306" * forever|strong="G1519" *.” + 9:9 Psalms 112:9 *

motu: Uhe bona aniani e henimu Dirava ese uhe baine henimui bona baine hatubu; emui kara maoromaoro huahuadia danu baine hahoho.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

motu: Ia ese baine harihari henimui, bena umui danu ba harihari; bena ai daimai ai Dirava ihanamolaina baine bada.
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

motu: Badina be ina herahia ena heduru ese helaḡa taudia edia dabu ḡaudia e henidia ḡuḡurumu; bona Dirava ihanamona danu e habadaiamu.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

motu: Umui ese Dirava ba hanamoa, badina be ina heduru karana ese e hamomokanimuimu, umui na Iesu Keriso ena sivarai namo iabi-daena taumui korikori; e hanamoamu danu, emui harihari-bada idia ediai bona taunimanima iboudiai ediai daidiai.
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

motu: Idia ese e lalokau henimuimu, bona Dirava e noiamu daimui ai, badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada na umui emui ai.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

motu: Dirava aita imodaia, ena harihari-bada herea-daena, igwauraina asi dibadia ḡauna, dainai.
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso ena manau bona ena manada daidiai, na noimuimu. Lau binai, dekemui ai na nohova mai manaugu ida, a dauhai na nohomu ai na gwau henimuimu.
english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

motu: Lau na noimuimu, dekemui ai baina noho negadia ai gwaugwau badina ta basine hedinarai. Ḡau tamona, lau na tomamu haida, e gwauraimaimu tau-anina ena dala ai a rakamu e tomu taudia, baina gwau henidia dikadika.
english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

motu: Ena be tau-anina ena dala ai a rakamu, to emai tuari na dia tau-anina tuarina.
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

motu: Badina be emai tuari ḡaudia na dia tau-anina ena, a Dirava ena amo e maimu siahuna, kohoro irohodia.
english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

motu: Hepapahuahu bona Dirava idibana e laoa ahumu ḡaudia iboudiai a haketodiamu; bona lalo-hadai iboudiai a ḡuidiamu, Keriso ikamonaihenina ai;
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

motu: bona umui ba kamonai ḡuḡuru negana ai, gwau-edeede iboudiai davadia baia heni.
english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

motu: Hedinarai ḡaudia ba itadia. Tau ta baineto ia na Keriso ena, ia na baine haeroa lou, ai danu Keriso ena, ia heḡereḡerena.
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

motu: Lau na emai siahu, Lohiabada ese e henimai dia ikure-dobimui totona a ilarebamui helaoreana, bainama heaḡilaia, lau na basinama hemarai.
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

motu: Basioto egu revareva na ihagarimui totona na tore henimuimu.
english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

motu: Badina be haida e tomu “Ena revareva na mai metaudia bona mai siahudia, to tau-anina na manoka-manoka bona uduna herevadia danu asi mamidia”.
english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

motu: Unu e laloa tomamu tauna baine haeroa, dauha amo emai hereva e vasimu heḡereḡerena dekemui ai emai kara unu baia kara toma.
english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

motu: Ai na asia tomamu ai na sibodia e hahenamomu taudia heḡereḡeredia. Idia na sibodia e hahetohomu, bona sibodia e haheḡereḡeremu: madi, asi edia aonega.
english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

motu: Ai na basia heaḡi kava, a Dirava ese e henimai hahetohona ai baia heaḡi: hahetohona benai emui ai vada e kau.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

motu: Emai siahu asia halataiamu, hetoana asia hanaiamu, umui iabi-vareaimui; badina be Keriso ena sivarai namo a vasilaia.
english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

motu: Haida edia ḡaukara, ai emai hetoa murimurinai, asia heaḡilaiamu; to ai na a helaromu emui kamonai do baine tubu badabada, bena umui emui amo emai hetoa do baine daudau.
english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

motu: Bena unukahamui tanodia ai sivarai namo do baia harorolaia; a idauna ta ena ḡaukara basia heaḡilaia.
english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

motu: A ta baine heaḡi, ia ese Lohiabada baine heaḡilaia.
english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.” + 10:17 Jeremiah 9:24 *

motu: Badina be sibona e hahenamomu tauna na namona basine gvauraia, a Lohiabada ese e hanamoamu tauna hari.
english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

motu: Lau na uramu egu kavakava sina ba haheaukalaia. Mani emui kara ba haheauka henigu.
english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena vaḡeḡe heḡereḡerena ai daimui na vaḡeḡemu; e kara Keriso enai maohenimui vada na kara, haneulato rami-hebouna na heto.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

motu: To lau na garimu, gaigai ese Heva e koia heḡereḡerena ai, helalo idau-idau ese bae koimui, bena emui lalokau momokanina bona ḡoeva-daena Keriso enai na ba rakatania.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

motu: Ta ese Iesu idauna bema harorolaia, dia ai ese a harorolaiava heḡereḡerena eiava Lauma idauna boma abia dae, dia o abia dae guna laumana heḡereḡerena eiava sivarai namo idauna boma kamonai, dia o kamonai guna ḡauna heḡereḡerena o abi dae haraḡamu ani?
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

motu: Lau na tomamu, ene aposetolo hereadia na ḡau ta ai asie hereagumu.
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

motu: Ena be hereva igwauraidia ai lau na dia heḡereḡere, to lalogu ena diari na dia unuheto: ḡau iboudiai emui ai vada a hahedinaraiva.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

motu: Sibogu na hahemanau, umui bae imodaimui totona; Dirava sivaraina namona na harorolai henimuiva asi davagu. Na kerere a?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

motu: Ekalesia oreadia idaudia edia kohu na henao na heto, davagu ai na halao, umui isiaimui ilao-henina totona.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

motu: Dekemui ai na nohova negana ai nega haida na dabuva, to umui asina hahekwarahimuiva; badina varavarada, Makedonia amo ema taudia, ese egu gabu ḡaudia e heniguva. Ḡau ta ai asina hahekwarahimuiva, bona basina hahekwarahimui.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

motu: Keriso ena hereva momokani lalogu ai e miamu dainai, tau ta ese ina egu heaḡi badina na egu amo basine abia oho, Akaia kahana idoinai.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

motu: Badina be dahaka? Asina Ialokau henimuimu a! Dirava dibana na lalokau henimuimu.
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

motu: A na karamu karadia do baina kara; bena edia dala e tahuamu bae heaḡi, baeto ḡaukara ai idia na ai heḡereḡeremai, taudia na dala ta basie davaria.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

motu: Badina be idia na aposetolo koikoidia, ḡaukara koikoi taudia, sibodia Keriso ena aposetolo ai e hahelao.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

motu: Unu na basita hoalaidia. Badina be Satana sibona diari aneruna ai e hahelao;
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

motu: unuhetomana ena hesiai taudia ese kara maoromaoro taudia ai e hahelaomu; a dokodia ai be edia kara ihaheḡereḡeredia bae abi.
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

motu: Na gwau loumu, ta basineto lau na kavakava. A unu boma laloa toma, boma haheauka henigu, kavakava tauna boma haheauka henia na heto; bena taina bama heaḡi.
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

motu: Hari na hamaorolaimuimu herevadia na dia Lohiabada ena amo, to sibogu na hereva kavamu, na heaḡi kavamu.
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

motu: Hutuma ese tau-anina ḡaudia e heaḡilaimu; benaini, lau danu unu baina kara toma.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

motu: Badina be umui, aonega taumui, na kavakava taudia ihaheaukahenidia mai dibamui.
english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

motu: Hesiai ai e ḡuimuimu tauna o haheauka heniamu; amui e ani oremu tauna o haheauka heniamu; e hahekwarahimuimu tauna o haheauka heniamu; e dadaraimuimu tauna o haheauka heniamu; vairamui e huaridiamu tauna o haheauka heniamu.
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

motu: Ai na a hemaraimu, badina ai na mamanoka-mamanoka. A ta baine heaḡi, lau danu baina heaḡi. Na hereva kavamu, ani?
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

motu: Idia na Heberu taudia a? Lau danu. ldia na Israel besena a? Lau danu. Idia na Abraham garana a? Lau danu.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring + 11:22 or, seed * of Abraham? So am I.

motu: Idia na Keriso ena hesiai taudia a? Lau ese na hereadiamu. Na hereva kavamu, ani? Na hekwarahi bada; dibura rumadia ai e kougu loulou; e dadabagu dikadikava; nega hoho masegu danu e kahira-kahirava.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

motu: Nega ima Iuda taudia ese hekwadi toi-ahui taurahani-ta amo e kwadigu.
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

motu: Nega toi au amo e dadabagu. Nega ta nadi amo e hodogu. Nega toi na ḡui kau lagatoidia e hure kau; hanuaboi ta dina ta gadobada ai na hure.
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

motu: Egu laolao na momo: sinavai ai na hekwarahi; dadidadi taudia imadia ai na hekwarahi; egu bese taudia imadia ai na hekwarahi; idau bese taudia imadia ai na hekwarahi; hanua lalodiai na hekwarahi; tano ḡaḡaedia ai na hekwarahi; gadobada ai na hekwarahi, varavara koikoi imadia ai na hekwarahi.
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

motu: Na hekwarahimu; taugu e boeramu; na noga rani louloumu; e hitologumu, na ranu masemu, asi agu; keru ese e hamasegumu; dabua ai na dabumu.
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

motu: Dia ini tau-anina ḡaudia mo; to lalogu danu dina iboudiai e hekwarahimu, ekalesia oreadia ireḡudia ai.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

motu: Daika e manokamu, bena lau asina manokamu? Daika e hekwakwanaimu, bena lau lalogu se siahumu?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

motu: Lau bama heaḡi, bena egu manoka-manoka baina heaḡilaia.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

motu: Dirava, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, bae imodaia hanaihanai Diravana, ia hari dibana lau na asina koikoimu.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

motu: Damasko ai, Areta Ḡaubada ena gavana tauna ese Damasko hanuana e gimaia, lau idabai-taogu totuna.
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

motu: To bosea lalonai e udagu, maḡu gaba-mauruna amo e tugu dobi; bena na heau mauri, ia imana lalona amo.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

motu: Heaḡi na dia namo, to ma baina heaḡi: mata-hanai bona Lohiabada ihahedinaraina herevadia baina gwaurai.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

motu: Keriso lalonai tau Ia dibagu, laḡani gwauta-hani muridai e heabi isi guba ihatoina ai; a tau-anina lalonai eiava tau-anina murimurinai e heabi isi na asi dibagu, Dirava hari dibana.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

motu: Una tau be dibagu, a tau-anina lalonai eiava tau-anina murimurinai e heabi isi na asi dibagu, Dirava dibana; to dibagu ia na Paradiso ai e heabi isi,
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

motu: hehuni herevadia e kamonai, taunimanima basie gwaurai diba herevadia.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

motu: Una tau hari baina heaḡilaia, a sibogu basina heaḡi. Eiava, sibogu egu manoka-manoka mo baina heaḡilaia.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

motu: Heaḡi bama ura, to basinama heaḡi kava; hereva momokani bama gwaurai hari. A asina heaḡimu, tau ta ese baine lalogu, lau na herea, dia egu ai e itamu bona e kamonaimu heḡereḡerena, na garina.
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

motu: E hahedinarai henigu ḡaudia babada heherea daidiai, ḡiniḡini ta, amo e gwadagu, baina hekokoroku garina; una na Satana ena hesiai tauna na heto, itutulaigu ḡauna ai ela, baina hekokoroku herea na garina.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

motu: Una ḡau dainai nega hatoi Lohiabada na noia, baine abia oho.
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

motu: To ia ese e hamaorogu eto “Egu harihari-bada na oiemu ai baine davana, badina be manoka-manoka ai lauegu siahu na herea”. Taunabunai egu manoka baina heaḡilaia mai moalegu ida, bena Keriso ena siahu egu ai baine kau.
english: He has said to me, “\+w My|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w grace|strong="G5485"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* sufficient \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w you|strong="G4771"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G1063"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w power|strong="G1411"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w made|strong="G3004"\+w* perfect \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* weakness.” * Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

motu: Una dainai, manoka-manoka bona badu herevadia bona ogoḡami bona daḡedaḡe karadia bona hahehisi ḡaudia be Keriso dainai na moalelaimu; badina be na manokamu negadia ai na goadamu.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

motu: Vada na heaḡi kava, to umui emui kerere; umui ese boma hanamogu bema namo. Badina be ene aposetolo hereadia ese lau asie hereagumu; ḡau tamona, lau na dia ḡau ta.
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

motu: Momokani, aposetolo toadia na umui bogaragimui ai na karava mai haheaukagu ida: toa bona hoa karadia bona siahu karadia.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

motu: Edena ḡau ekalesia oreadia idaudia ese e abia a umuiasio abia a? Ina tamona mo: asina hahekwarahimui. Mani ina egu dika tamona ba laloa nege. Egu heigo-ita ihatoina
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

motu: Nega ihatoina binai vada name heḡaeḡae, baina vasi na tomu; bona basina hahekwarahimui. Lau na dia emui kohu asina tahuamu, a umui hari na tahumuimu; badina be memero ese kohu basie habou tamadia sinadia edia, a tamadia sinadia ese kohu bae habou natudia edia.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

motu: Lau na mai moalegu ida egu kohu baina ha-ore bona tau-anigu danu baina ha-orea, umui laumamui daidiai. Lau ese na ura henimui badamu dainai umui ese o ura henigu maraḡimu a!
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

motu: Benaini, asina hahekwarahimui. A readia dibaka karana ta amo na koimui o tomu, bena na abimui.
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

motu: Be; dekemui na siaidia vasi taudia edia amo na koimui a?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

motu: Tito na noia; bena varavarada ta ia ida na siaidia vasi. Be; Tito ese e koimui a? Ai raruosi na lauma tamona ena kara asia karamu a? Dala tamona ai asia rakamu a?
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

motu: Reana umui na nega daudau vada o laloa ai na emai kara a hekoramu. Ai na Dirava vairanai a herevamu, Keriso lalonai. Egu lalokau e, ḡau iboudiai a karamu umui ihagoadamui.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

motu: Lau na na garimu, baina vasi negana ai baina davarimui, umui na dia lauegu ura heḡereḡerena; umui danu lau ba davarigu, dia umui emui ura heḡereḡerena; bena heai, vaḡeḡe, badu, ani-gunita, hahebade, maumau, hekokoroku, heloḡo-heloḡo, bae vara.
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

motu: Na garimu danu, baina vasi negana ai egu Dirava ese baine hahemaraigu umui bogaragimui ai; bona kara dika taudia hutuma taidia baina tai, badina be edia mata-bodaga, edia heuda-hanai, edia lebulebu karadia amo, asie helalo kerehaimu daidiai.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

motu: Nega ihatoina binai baina vasi. Rarua eiava tatoi edia hereva daidiai hereva iboudiai bae hamomokani.
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.” + 13:1 Deuteronomy 19:15 *

motu: O kerere guna taumui bona harihari o kereremu taumui, nega gunana ai na sisiba henimui bona harihari dauha amo ma na tore henimuimu: nega iharuana na vasi heḡereḡerena, baina vasi negana ai basina bogamui hisi.
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

motu: Toana bunai umui o tahuamu ḡauna, Keriso lauegu amo e herevamu toana. Ia na emui ai se manokamu, a lalomui ai e siahumu.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

motu: Badina be ia na manoka-manoka ai e hasatauroa, to Dirava ena siahu dainai vada e maurimu. Ai danu mamanoka ia lalonai, to eda hebamo lalonai ai na Dirava ena siahu amo ia ida baia mauri.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

motu: Sibomui ba hetahu bona sibomui ba hediba, umui na abidadama taumui eiava lasi. Lalomui asie pararamu Iesu Keriso na lalomui ai a? Bema lasi, umui na dia heḡereḡere.
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

motu: Lau na uramu umui ba diba, ai na heḡereḡere.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

motu: Dirava a noiamu, umui na basio kara dika; dia ai maoromai bae gwaurai, a, ena be ai kereremai bae gwaurai to umui ba kara maoromaoro, helaoreana.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

motu: Badina be hereva momokani igwau-tubuna na asi dibamai; ikahana mo dibamai.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

motu: Badina be ai a manokamu umui o goadamu negadia ai a moalemu; emai noinoi tamona binai, umui ba namo ḡuḡuru.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

motu: Taunabunai, lau na dauha amo na tore henimuimu; bena baina vasi negana ai Lohiabada ese vada e henigu siahuna, una na taunimanima ihaginidia dia ihaketodia ḡauna, na basina ḡaukaralaia daḡedaḡe. Hahetoni herevadia
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

motu: Varavaragu e, na hahetonimuimu; ba namo ḡuḡuru, egu hereva ba kamonai; lalomui bae tamona; maino ai ba noho. Bena uraheni bona maino Diravana ese baine bamomui.
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

motu: Haherahu helaḡana amo ba hahenamo heheni.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

motu: Helaḡa taudia iboudiai ese e hahenamo henimuimu.
english: All the saints greet you.

motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada bona Dirava ena uraheni bona Lauma Helaḡa ena hetura ese iboumui ai bae bamomui.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, aposetolo taugu, (dagi na dia taunimanima edia amo eiava tau ta dainai asina abia, to Keriso dainai, bona Tamada, Iesu mase amo e hatorea isi Diravana, dainai na abia),
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

motu: bona e bamogu taudia iboudiai, Galatia ekalesia oreadia taumui a tore henimuimu, atomu,
english: and all the brothers + 1:2 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

motu: harihari-bada bona maino Tamada Dirava ena amo bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo avabi.
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

motu: Ia ese sibona e heni, eda kara dika daidiai, ina tanobada ena dika amo baine hamaurida helaoreana, Tamada Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena.
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

motu: Ia baita imodaia hanaihanai. Amen. Egu hoa
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

motu: Lau na hoamu, badina be umui ese Keriso ena harihari-bada lalonai na boirimui taugu vada o rakatanigu haraga, sivarai idauna o lao heniamu.
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

motu: Ḡau tamona dia sivarai idauna, a haida ese e haturiamuimu, bona e uramu danu Keriso ena sivarai namo bae hagagevaia.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

motu: A ai ese, eiava guba aneruna ese, sivarai idauna baiama harorolaia, dia a harorolaia gunava ḡauna heḡereḡerena ai baiama baia.
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

motu: Hata vada na gwauraia, harihari ma na gwauraia loumu, Ḡau ta ese sivarai idauna baine harorolai henimui, dia o abia dae gunava heḡereḡerena, ia na baine baia. Egu haroro na ede amo?
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

motu: Lau ese taunimanima ihamoaledia na tahuamu eiava Dirava ihamoalena na tahuamu a? Taunimanima lalodia ihanamodia na tahuamu a? Lau ese taunimanima bama hamoaledia, Keriso isiaina basinama lao heni.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

motu: Varavaragu e, na hamaoromuimu, sivarai namo na harorolaiamu na dia taunimanima edia.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

motu: Taunimanima edia amo asina abia; idia ese asie hadibagu; a Iesu Keriso ese lalogu ai e hahedinaraia.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

motu: Gunaguna na karava karadia sivaraidia vada o kamonai, Iuda taudia edia orea ai na nohova ai na Durava ena ekalesia oreana na daḡedaḡe heniava, na hadikaiava.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

motu: Iuda taudia edia ḡuriḡuri karadia ai egu uru taudia bona egu bese taudia na hereadiava; sene karadia na goadalai dikadikava.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

motu: A sinagu bogana amo e hahelagagu bona ena harihari-bada ai e boirigu Diravana ese ena ura negana ai
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

motu: ia Natuna lau lalogu ai e hahedinaraia, idau bese taudia bogaragidiai ia baina harorolaia helaoreana: una negana ai lau na tau ta ida asia henega.
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

motu: Bona aposetolo-gunadia Ierusalem ai danu dekedia asinala, a Arabia nala, bena Damasko na lou henia.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

motu: Laḡani toi e ore, bena Petro itana Ierusalem nala, boi gwauta-ima ia ida a nohova.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

motu: Aposetolo idaudia haida asina itadia, lakobo, Lohiabada tadina, mo sibona.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

motu: Dirava hari dibana ini na tore henimuimu herevadia na dia koikoi.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, + 1:20 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * before God, I’m not lying.

motu: Unu amo Suna bona Kilikia kahadia nala.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

motu: A Keriso ena ekalesia taudia Iudea ai na vairagu asi dibadia,
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

motu: harigu mo e kamonai, eto “Gunaguna e daḡedaḡe henidava tauna ese sivarai namo e harorolaiamu; eda abidadama baine ha-orea e tomava, a harihari e harorolaiamu”.
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

motu: Bena lau daigu ai idia ese Dirava e hanamoa.
english: So they glorified God in me.

motu: Laḡani gwauta-hani e ore murinai Ierusalem nala; Banaba bona Tito ese e bamogu.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

motu: Lalogu ai e hedinarai herevana dainai nala. Haridia namodia taudia ida sibomai a hebouva, bena lau ese sivarai namo bese idau-idau taudia bogaragidiai na harorolaiamu herevana na hamaorolaidia, egu ḡaukara na karaiava bona na karaiamu bema asi anina na garina.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

motu: Bamogu ta, Tito, na Helene tauna, to iperitomena asie haḡanilaia.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

motu: Varavara koikoidia haida e vareai hehuni, emai ura-kwalimu Keriso Iesu ena amo bae hasinadoa, bena bae ḡuimai lou eto.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

motu: To ai na asia manoka, bona hora ta ai asia kamonai henidia, lasi ona lasi vaitani; sivarai namo ena hereva momokani dekemui ai bae mia helaoreana.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

motu: A haridia namodia taudia (edia dagi na herevana, asina laloamu; Dirava ese taunimanima toadia se lalomu) ḡau matamatana ta asie henigu.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

motu: A sivarai namo Petro e henia, e peritomedia taudia baine harorolai henidia, heḡereḡerena sivarai namo lau e henigu, asie peritomedia taudia baina harorolai henidia.
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

motu: Badina be Petro na peritome taudia edia aposetolo ai e halaoa Tauna ese lau danu bese idau-idau taudia edia aposetolo ai e halaogu.
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

motu: Taunabunai, Iakobo bona Petro bona Ioane (idia be ekalesia duna e gwauraidiava taudia) vada dibadia harihari-bada lau danu vada e henigu. Bena idia ese lau bona Banaba imamai e abi, hetura toana; ai raruosi bese idau-idau taudia dekedia baiala eto, a idia be peritome taudia dekedia baela;
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

motu: ḡau tamona, ogoḡami taudia baia lalodia eto. Karana bina vada na goadalaiamu.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

motu: A Pelro na Antioka ela negana ai, lau ese na gwau henia, badina be ia na e kerere.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

motu: Badina be haida Iakobo ena amo do asiela negana ai, ia na idau bese taudia ida e aniani hebouva; a idia ela negana ai, ia e raka muri, idau bese taudia edia amo e raka oho, peritome taudia garidia.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

motu: Iuda taudia oredia danu ia ida unu e koikoi tomava; bona Banaba danu edia koikoi ese e hahekwakwanaia.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

motu: A lau ese na itadia, idia na asie raka maoromaoro, bona sivarai namo ena hereva asie badinaia, bena Petro na gwau henia, idia iboudiai vairadiai, nato “Oi na tau luda, a idau bese taudia heḡereḡeredia o nohomu, dia Iuda taudia heḡereḡeredia; matona, idau bese taudia o haḡanidiamu, Iuda taudia heḡereḡeredia bae noho o tomu”.
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

motu: Ai be Iuda taumai korikori, dia kara dika taudia idau bese amo;
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

motu: a ai dibamai tau ta taravatu ibadinana dainai maorona basie gwauraia, a Iesu Keriso ikamonai-henina mo dainai. Taunabunai, ita ese Keriso Iesu ta kamonai henia, bena maoroda bae gwaurai, Keriso ikamonai-henina dainai, dia taravatu ibadinana dainai; badina be taravatu ibadinana dainai tau ta maorona basie gwauraia.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

motu: A ita na Keriso dainai maoroda igwauraidia ta tahuamu negana ai ta kara dikamu, unu amo Keriso na kara dika ikahalaina tauna ai e laomu a? Lasi ona lasi vaitani.
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

motu: Badina be na kurea dobi ḡauna bama haginia lou, lau na kara havara taugu ai bama lao.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

motu: Badina be taravatu dainai vada na mase taravatu enai, Dirava enai baina mauri helaoreana.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

motu: Lau na Keriso ida vada e hasataurogu; ḡau tamona, na maurimu, a dia lau, to Keriso hari lau lalogu ai e maurimu. Bona egu mauri, tau-anigu ai na maurimu, na Dirava Natuna na abidadama heniamu dainai na maurimu. Ia ese e ura henigu bona sibona e heni, lau daigu ai.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

motu: Dirava ena harihari-bada na asina dadaraiamu; badina be kara maoromaoro na taravatu amo bema vara, Keriso ena mase bema asi anina.
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

motu: Galatia taumui e, kavakava taumui, daika ese ena mea amo e koimuimu? Umui vairamui ai vada eme hedinarai: Iesu Keriso e hasatauroa
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

motu: Ina mo ba hamaorolaigu: taravatu ibadinana dainai eiava sivarai namo iabi-daena dainai Lauma o abia?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

motu: Umui na kakava a? Lauma enai o matamaia, a tau-anina enai o haḡuḡuruamu a?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

motu: Hisi diaḡau o aniva na asi anidia a? Reana mai anina.
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

motu: Lauma e henimuimu bona bogaragimui ai hoa karadia e karamu Diravana ese taravatu ibadinana dainai eiava sivarai namo iabi-daena dainai e karamu a?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

motu: Abraham heḡereḡerena: ia ese Dirava e abidadama henia, bena maorona e gwauraia.
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.” + 3:6 Genesis 15:6 *

motu: Benaini, vada na diba, kamonai taudia na Abraham natuna ai baela.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

motu: Buka Helaḡa danu vada e gwauraia guna, Dirava ese bese idau-idau taudia kamonai dainai maorodia baine gwaurai; bena sivarai namo Abraham e henia guna, eto, Tanobada besedia iboudiai na oi daimu ai bae namo.
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.” + 3:8 Genesis 12:3; 18:18; 22:18 *

motu: Taunabunai, kamonai taudia na Abraham, kamonai tauna, ida bae namo bou.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

motu: Taravatu ibadinana e abidadama heniamu taudia iboudiai na heuduguirai henunai e nohomu, badina be ini e torea toma: Taravatu bukana ai e tore herevadia iboudiai basie badina taudia na bae uduguiraidia.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.” + 3:10 Deuteronomy 27:26 *

motu: Bona tau ta taravatu dainai maorona basie gwauraia Dirava vairanai; ina na eme hedinarai, badina be kamonai dainai kara maoromaoro tauna baine mauri.
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.” + 3:11 Habakkuk 2:4 *

motu: Bona taravatu na kamonai amo se varamu, a ikarana tauna hari ena kara dainai baine mauri.
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.” + 3:12 Leviticus 18:5 *

motu: Taravatu ena hahedika amo Keriso ese vada e hamaurida; ia be dika tauna ai ela, ita iboloda. Badina be Buka Helaḡa ai vada e torea, eto, Au ai e taudia dae taudia iboudiai vada e dika.
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” + 3:13 Deuteronomy 21:23 *

motu: Taunabunai, Abraham e hanamolaia hahenamona na bese idau-idau taudia ese Keriso Iesu dainai do bae davaria; bona ita ese kamonai dainai e gwauraia hamata Laumana baita abia.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

motu: Varavaragu e, taunimanima edia kara na gwauraimu: tau ta baine gwauhamata, bena ena gwauhamata baine hamomokania; basine taoa tari, bona basine ha-idaua.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

motu: Benaini, gwauhamata na Abraham mai garana ida edia. Asineto “Garamu loḡora ida”. Hutuma se gwauraidia; a tamona mo e gwauraia, eto “Garamu idat”. Una na Keriso.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. + 3:16 or, seed * He doesn’t say, “To descendants + 3:16 or, seeds *”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, + 3:16 Genesis 12:7; 13:15; 24:7 * which is Christ.

motu: Egu lalo-hadai binai: Dirava ena gwauhamata gunana na laḡani sinahu-hani toi-ahui muridiai e vara taravatuna ese se taoa tari, asi anina ḡauna ai se halaoa.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

motu: Ahu iabina bema taravatu dainai, gwauhamata bema herevana; a Dirava ese gwauhamata amo Abraham e henia.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

motu: Benaini, taravatu be dahaka? Kara havara dainai e haginia, baine mia ela bona e gwauraia hamata garana baine vara; aneru ese e gwauraia, herohemaino tauna ese e mailaia.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

motu: Herohemaino na dia kaha tamona basine herohemaino; a Dirava be tamona.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

motu: O, taravatu ese Dirava ena gwauhamata e laoa ahumu a? Lasi vaitani. Badina be taravatu bema mai siahuna mauri ihavarana, kara maoromaoro na taravatu amo bema vara.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

motu: A Buka Helaḡa ese taunimanima iboudiai kara dika ai vada e koudia, Iesu Keriso iabiabiraina gwauhamatana na kamonai taudia ese bae abia helaoreana?
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

motu: A Iesu iabiabiraina do sema negana ai, taravatu ese e dogoda tao, e kouda ahu, ema bona do baine hedinarai abidadamana e kau.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

motu: Taunabunai, taravatu na hereḡu tauna na heto, ema bona Keriso eme kau, kamonai dainai maoroda bae gwaurai helaoreana.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

motu: A harihari kamonai vada eme kau, taunabunai ita na dia tau ta ena hereḡu ai.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

motu: Badina be umui iboumui ai be Dirava natuna, Keriso Iesu o abiabiraiamu dainai.
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

motu: Badina be Keriso ladana ai e bapatisomui taumui iboumui ai ese Keriso vada o hahedokilaia.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

motu: Badina be umui na dia Iuda taumui, dia Helene taumui, dia hesiai taumui, dia ura-kwalimu taumui, dia mamaruane, dia hahine; a ibouboumui ai tamona mo, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

motu: Umui Keriso ena dainai, umui danu Abraham garana bona gwauhamata dihina.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

motu: Lau na tomamu tau ta dihina, ena be ia na ḡau iboudiai biagudia, to merona negana ai ia be hesiai merona na heto;
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

motu: ia na hahediba taudia bona heregu taudia henudiai, ela bona tamana ese e gwauraia guna negana baine kau.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

motu: Ita danu unuheto: maraḡida negadia ai tanobada ena ḡaruḡaru herevadia ese hesiai iḡuidia ai e dogoda taova;
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

motu: a nega vada e ḡuḡuru, Dirava ese ia Natuna e siaia, hahine bogana ai e vara, taravatu henunai danu e vara,
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

motu: taravatu henunai e nohomu taudia baine hamauridia bona ita na ia natuna ai baitala totona.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

motu: Bona umui na ia natuna dainai, Dirava ese Natuna ena Lauma ita laloda ai vada eme siaia; bena e lolomu, e tomu, “Aba e, Tamamai e”.
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, + 4:6 Abba is a Greek spelling for the Aramaic word for “Father” or “Daddy” used in a familiar, respectful, and loving way. * Father!”

motu: Taunabunai, Dirava dainai oi na dia hesiai tauna, to natuna; bona dia natuna mo, to dihina danu.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

motu: Gunaguna, Dirava asi dibamui negana ai, umui ese dirava koikoidia isiaidia o lao heniva.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

motu: A harihari umui na Dirava dibamui, Dirava danu dibana umui. Matona, tanobada ena ḡaruḡaru herevadia mamoka-manokadia bona kavakavadia ma o lou henidiamu, bae dogomui tao luo o tomu a?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

motu: Dina bona hua bona aria negadia bona laḡani o badinamu.
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

motu: Lau na umui daimui ai na garimu, vada na hekwarahilaimui kava na garina.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

motu: Varavaragu e, na nolmuimu, umui lau ida baita heḡereḡere, badina be lau na umui ida vada na heḡereḡere. Umui ese asio hadikagu.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

motu: Dibamui lau na nega gunana ai gorere dainai sivarai namo na harorolai henimui.
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

motu: Ḡau tamona asio dadaraigu bona asio ihi-ihiraigu egu gorere daimai: o abigu dae, Dirava ena aneru na heto, eiava Keriso Iesu na heto.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

motu: Emui hahenamo be edeseni ai? Lau dibagu una negana ai, bema mai dalana, umui ese matamui boma vai lasi, boma henigu.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

motu: Be, hereva momokani na hamaoromuimu dainai, inaimui ai vada nala a?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

motu: Idia ese e ura henimuimu, to lalodia na dia mamaoro; e uramu ai emai amo bae laimui oho, bena umui ese idia ba ura henidia.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

motu: Kara namo iura-henina dainai ba ura henigu na nega idoidiai namo, dia dekemui ai na nohomu negadia ai mo.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

motu: Natugu e, hisi na animu, hekamonai hisidia na heto, ela bona Keriso na lalomui ai baine vara.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

motu: Harihari umui dekemui ai bama noho, ere idauna ai bama hereva, bema namo; badina be lalogu na e hekwarahimu umui daimui ai.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

motu: Umui taravatu henunai ba noho o tomu taumui, ba hamaorogu, taravatu asio kamonai heniamu a?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

motu: Buka Helaḡa ai ini e torea loma: Abraham natuna na rarua; ta be hesiai hahinena natuna, a ta be ura-kwalimu hahinena natuna.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

motu: Hesiai hahinena natuna na tau-anina ena kara ai e vara, a ura-kwalimu hahinena natuna na gwau-hamata dainai e vara.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

motu: Una na hereva heḡereḡerena: unu hahine raruosi na herohemaino ruaosi heḡereḡeredia. Ta be Sinai ororona amo ema, hesiai memerodia e havaradia: una na Hagara.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

motu: Hari Hagara be Sinai ororona ladana ta, Arabia tanona ai: ia na ina harihari e miamu Ierusalemana heḡereḡerena; mai natuna ida hesiai iḡuidia ai e nohomu.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

motu: A atai ai e miamu Ierusalemana na urakwalimu hanuana; ita sinada bunai.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

motu: Vada e torea, Gabami hahinemu e, ba moale; Hekamonai hisidia asi dibamu hahinemu e, ba hisi dae; Badina be vado hahinena natuna na hutuma, A e headava hahinena natunal na dia hoho.
english: For it is written, “ Rejoice|strong="G2165" *, you|strong="G3754" * barren|strong="G4723" * who|strong="G3588" * don’ t|strong="G3588" * bear|strong="G5088" *. Break|strong="G4486" * out|strong="G2532" * and|strong="G2532" * shout, you|strong="G3754" * who|strong="G3588" * don’ t|strong="G3588" * travail. For|strong="G1063" * the|strong="G2532" * desolate|strong="G2048" * women have|strong="G2192" * more|strong="G3123" * children|strong="G5043" * than|strong="G2228" * her|strong="G3754" * who|strong="G3588" * has|strong="G2192" * a|strong="G2192" * husband.” + 4:27 Isaiah 54:1 *

motu: Varavaragu e, umui na gwauhamata memeromui, Isaak heḡereḡerena.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

motu: A unu dinadia ai heḡereḡerena tau-anina ena kara ai e vara merona ese Lauma ena amo e vara merona e daḡedaḡe heniava, harihari danu unu mo heto.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

motu: Buka Helaḡa ai ede e torea toma? Hesiai hahinena mai natuna ida ba luludia oho; Badina be hesiai hahinena natuna na dihi ai basinela, Ura-kwalimu hahinena natuna ida ahuna basine abia.
english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.” + 4:30 Genesis 21:10 *

motu: Benaini, varavaragu e, ita na dia hesiai hahinena natuna; ita be urakwalimu hahinena natuna.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

motu: Keriso ese vada e ruhada nege, ura-kwalimu tauda ai baitala: ba gini tutuka-tutuka, bae ḡuimui lou na garina.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

motu: Ba Ialoa: lau Paulo ese na hamaoromuimu, na tomu, peritome boma abia, ahumui bema lasi Keriso enai.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

motu: Momokani, na hamaoromui loumu, na tomu, peritome bae abia taudia ese taravatu karadia iboudiai bae badina.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

motu: Taravatu ibadinana dainai maoromui bae gwaurai o tomu taumui na asi ahumui Keriso enai; Dirava ena harihari-bada vada o morutania.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

motu: A ai ese kara maoromaoro helarona a nariamu, Lauma ikamonai-henina dainai.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

motu: Badina be Iesu Keriso enai peritome bona asi peritome ruaosi na asi anidia, a abidadama mo, uraheni ai e ḡaukaramu.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

motu: Umui na gunaguna o heau namonamova. Daika ese e laomui ahu, bena hereva momokani asio badinaia a?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

motu: Lalo-ani herevadia na dia e boirimui tauna ena amo se vasi.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

motu: Hatubu muramurana sina taina ese taba idoinai e hatubuamu.
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

motu: Lau na Lohiabada ladana ai na abidadama henimuimu, lalomui basio hadai idau; a e haraivamuimu tauna ese gwauna do baine huaia.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

motu: Varavaragu e, peritome doini bama harorolaia, doini e daḡedaḡe henigumu badina be dahaka? Unu bema heto, satauro ena hekwakwanai bema lasi.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

motu: Lau na uramu e haraivamuimu taudia na sibodia bema heutu oho.
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

motu: Varavaragu e, vada e boirimui, ura-kwalimu taudia ai baola. Ḡau tamona, emui ura-kwalimu na tau-aninlui ihamoaledia ḡauna ai basio halaoa; a lalokau dainai ta ta isiaimui ba helao heheni.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

motu: Badina be taravatu idoinai na hereva tamona ai e haboua. Herevana binai: Dekemu tauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena.
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” + 5:14 Leviticus 19:18 *

motu: A ba hekori heheni bona ba heani heheni nahuamui ba loho, sibomui ba haheore na garina.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

motu: A lau na tomamu, Lauma ena dala ai ba raka, bena tau-anina ena ura basio karaia.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

motu: Tau-anina ese laumal baine laoa ahu e tomamu, bonalauma ese tau-anina baine laoa ahu e tomamu; badina be ruaosi e heinai hehenimu. Una dainai emui ura karadia asio karamu.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

motu: A lauma ese baine hakaumui negana ai, umui na dia taravatu henunai.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

motu: Tau-anina ena kara na hehedinararai. Gaudia bini: heuda-hanai, kara mirodia, mata-bodaga,
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

motu: kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia, babalau, heai, heatu, mama, badu, gogosi, heiri-heiri, hahediba koikoi herevadia,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

motu: heḡahusi, kekero, lebulebu; bona kara unuhetomadia iboudiai. Na hamaoromuiva, bona harihari ma na hamaoromui loumu, unu e kara tomamu taudia ese Dirava ena basileia basie abia.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

motu: A Lauma huahuana binai: lalokau, moale, maino, haheauka, hebogahisi, kara maoromaoro, hereva ibadinana,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, + 5:22 or, faithfulness *

motu: manau boga-auka; kara unuhetomadia na asi taravatudia.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

motu: Keriso Iesu ena orea taudia ese tau-anidia, mai edia hekise-hekise bona edia ura dikadia ida, vada e hasataurodia.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

motu: Lauma dainai ta maurimu; taunabunai, Lauma dainai baita raka.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

motu: Basita hekokoroku; basita heai heheni; basita heḡahusi heheni.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

motu: Varavaragu e, tau ta kerere ese baine butua tao, umui lauma ikamonaina taumui ese ba hakaua lou, mai manaumui ida. Nahuamu danu ba tohoa, hedibaḡani ese oi danu baine butumu tao na garina.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

motu: Umui ta ta emui maduna ba hehua heheni; unu amo Keriso ena haheḡani ba badinaia.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

motu: Badina be ta sibona baineto “Lau na namo”, a ḡau be dia namo, sibona e hekoimu.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

motu: Ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara bae diba, a bamona ena basine diba, unu amo sibona ena ḡaukara baine heaḡilaia.
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

motu: Badina be ta ta ena maduna ena maduna bae hua.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

motu: E hadibadia taudia ese edia ḡau namodia ai hahediba tauna bae ahulaia.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

motu: Basio laloa kerere: Dirava na basita koia diba. Taunimanima e hadomu ḡaudia heḡereḡeredia mo bae abi.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

motu: Tau-anina ena e hadoamu tauna ese tau-anina ena mase baine abia. Lauma ena e hadoamu tauna ese Lauma ena mauri hanaihanai baine abia.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

motu: Kara namo ikarana basita hesikulaia; badina be bema ita basita manoka, bena nega namona ai huahuada baita abi.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

motu: Taunabunai, dala baita davaria negadia ai, taunimanima iboudiai baita kara namo henidia; a ekalesia taudia na baita hanamodia herea. Hahetoni herevadia
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

motu: Mani egu revareva ba itaia, vada na torea badabada.
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

motu: Ina tanobadl ena hahenamo bae abia urana e uramu taudia ese e haḡanimuimu, peritome bavabia e tomu, badina korikori be Keriso ena satauro dainai taunimanima ese bae daḡedaḡe henidia na garina.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

motu: Idia ese peritome e abiamu, ḡau tamona taravatu asie badinaiamu; to e uramu umui hari peritome bavabia, taumui bae heaḡilai helaoreana.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

motu: A lau ese ḡau ta basina heaḡilaia, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena satauro mo sibona; ia bagunai tanobada vada e hasatauroa egu ai, bona lau vada e hasataurogu tanobada enai.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

motu: Badina be peritome bona asi peritome na asi anidia; a vara matamata hari.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

motu: Ini e raka tomamu taudia latadiai bona Dirava ena Israel latanai maino bona hebogahisi bae mia.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

motu: Ina murinai, tau ta ese basine hamareregu, badina be biagugu Iesu ena kipara na kopigu ai e miamu.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

motu: Varavaragu e, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada lalomui ai baine mia. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu, Dirava ena ura dainai, helaḡa taumui Efeso ai, Keriso Iesu o abidadama heniamu taumui, na tore henimuimu:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

motu: harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, bavabi. Ihamaurimui dalana
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Dirava, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, aita hanamoa: ia ese Keriso lalonai Lauma ena hahenamo iboudiai guba ai e miamu ḡaudia na vada e hanamolaida.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

motu: Tanobada do se karaia negana ai, Dirava ese Keriso lalonai e abida hidi, ia vairanai helaḡa tauda ai bona asi bebeka-bebekada tauda ai baitala helaoreana. Ena lalokau dainai
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

motu: ia ese lalona e hadaia guna, ia natuna ai baine halaoda Iesu Keriso dainai. Ina na ena ura namona heḡereḡerena.
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

motu: Ena harihari-bada ḡoeva-daena, ina na ena lalokau tauna ai vada e hataḡalaida hariharina, dainai baita imodaia.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

motu: Ia lalonai hahemauri vada ta abiamu, ia rarana dainai, bona eda dika vada eme hegwau tao. Ina na ena harihari-bada ḡoeva-daena
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

motu: vada e habada iseda ai.
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

motu: Badina be ena aonega ai bona ena lalo-parara ai, Dirava ese ena lalohadai hehunidia vada e hadibada, ena ura namona Keriso lalonai e rataia heḡereḡerena,
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

motu: negadia bae ḡuḡuru ai na ḡau iboudiai, guba ḡaudia bona tanobada ḡaudia, Keriso ai baine haboudia helaoreana.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese ḡau iboudiai na ena lalohadai heḡereḡerena e karamu. Bona matamana negana ai Dirava ese e gwauraimai hidi, ena ura ihaḡuḡuruna.
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

motu: Taunabunai ai Keriso a laroa gunava taumai ese ia hairaina baia heatolaia.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

motu: Ia lalonai danu umui ese hereva momokanina, emui hahemauri sivaraina namona, o abia dae. Umui ese danu Keriso o abidadama henia bona Dirava ese ia toana e tlenimui, Lauma Helaḡa, e gwaurai hamata Laumana, bunai.
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

motu: Toana bunai, ita ese ahuda baita abia Dirava ena gwauhamata hegereḡerena, bona ia ese ena taunimanima baine hamauridia. Ia hairaina baita heatolaia hebou. Dirava na ḡuriamu daimui ai
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

motu: Badina bunai, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso o abidadama heniamu bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai o lalokau henidiamu sivaraina na kamonai dainai,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

motu: egu Dirava ihanamona na asi dokona daimui ai. Bona daimui ai na ḡuriḡurimu,
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

motu: eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena Dirava, Tamada herea-daena, ese aonega bona lalo-parara laumana baine henimui, bena ienai ba manada.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,
