motu: Lalomui matadia danu baine hapapa, bena ena boiboi helarona bona ahuna herea-daena, davana bada ḡauna helaḡa taudia edia, vada ba diba.
english: having the eyes of your hearts + 1:18 TR reads “understanding” instead of “hearts” * enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

motu: Iena siahu badana bona ena goada hereadaena ita kamonai tauda edai danu ba diba.
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

motu: Siahuna bunai Keriso enai e hedinarai: ia ese mase amo e hatorea isi, guba ai vada e abia dae, ia idibana kahana ai e hahelaia.
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

motu: Keriso na ḡaubada iboudiai daediai, gavana iboudiai daediai, siahu taudia iboudiai daediai, lohia iboudiai daediai; ia ladaula danu lada iboudiai, ina mauri ai bona mauri gabena ai, e hereadiamu.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

motu: Dirava ese ḡau iboudiai ia aena palapaladia henudiai e ato, bona ḡau iboudiai ikwaradia ai vada e halaoa, ekalesia lalonai.
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

motu: Ekalesia na Keriso tau-anina; ḡau iboudiai e haḡuḡurumu Tauna ihaḡuḡuruna.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

motu: Umui ese kara havara bona kara dika lalodiai o maseva;
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

motu: gunaguna ina tanobada ena kara o karava, guba padana siahuna lohiana o badinaiava, laumana bunai gwau-edeede memerodia lalodia ai e ḡaukaramu.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

motu: Ai iboumai ai danu, gunaguna idia ida a nohova, tau-anina ena ura a karava; tau-animai edia ura bona lalomai edia ura a badinava, bena ahumai korikorina na badu, taunimanima oredia heḡereḡeredia.
english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

motu: A hebogahisi-bada Diravana ese, e ura henimai lalo-dika dainai,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

motu: kara havara ai a mase taumai na Keriso ida e hamaurimai. Umui danu harihari-bada ese e hamaurimuimu.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

motu: Ia ida vada e hatoreda isi, ia ida danu guba ai vada e hahelaida, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

motu: Vairada negadia ai danu ena harihari-bada bona ena gado namo ita edai baine hedinarai, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

motu: Badina be harihari-bada ese vada e hamaurimui, abidadama dainai; dia sibomui ese, a Dirava ena harihari-bada ese;
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

motu: bona dia ḡaukara daidiai, tau ta baine heaḡi na garina.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

motu: Badina be ita na ia imana ai e karada tauda, Keriso Iesu lalonai vada e havarada, ḡaukara namodia ikaradia totona: ḡaukara namodia bunu Dirava ese vada e heḡaeḡaelai, ita ese baita kara.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

motu: Taunabunai, ba helalo: umui na gunaguna idau bese taumui; peritome taudia na tau-anidia vada e ivadia dainai “asi peritome taumui” e gwauraimuiva.
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

motu: Una negana ai umui bona Keriso na mai padamui; umui bona Israel besena danu mai padamui; herohemaino gwauhamatadia na asi dibamui; asi emui helaro bona asi emui Dirava tanobada ai.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

motu: A gunaguna dauhai o nohova taumui na harihari Keriso Iesu lalonai vada o kahikahimu; Keriso rarana ese vada e harakamui kahi.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

motu: Badina be ia na eda maino; ia ese bese ruaosi vada e hatamonada; e hapararada maḡuna vada e raḡaia.
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

motu: Ia tau-anina ai ia ese taravatu ena hahedua iboudiai vada e ha-ore, beseda ruaosi amo matamatana ta baine havaraia, bona maillo baine haginia,
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

motu: bona ena satauro dainai ruaosi Dirava enai baine hatamonada, helaoreana. Eda heinai-heheni ia ese satauro dorina ai e ha-orea.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

motu: Benaini, ia ema, maino e harorolaia, umui dauhai o nohomu taumui emui, bona gabu kahikahidia ai e nohomu taudia edia.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

motu: Ia dainai umui bona ai na Tamada dekenai baita raka vareai diba, Lauma tamona lalonai.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

motu: Taunabunai, umui na harihari dia idau bese taumui, dia noho-hedoahedoa taumui; umui na helaḡa taudia ida hanua tamona taumui; umui na Dirava ena ruma taumui.
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

motu: Aposetolo taudia bona peroveta taudia latadiai vada e hadaimui, ruma na heto; ruma daigunina nadina na Iesu Keriso sibona.
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

motu: Ia latanai ruma idoinai e larebaia daemu, dubu helaḡana ai bainela, Lohiabada lalonai.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

motu: Ia latanai danu umui e larebamui heboumu, Dirava ena ruma ai baola, Lauma lalonai.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

motu: Badina bunai lau Paulo na Keriso Iesu ese e ḡuigu, idau bese taumui daimui ai.
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

motu: Reana vada o kamonai, ena harihari-bada dainai Dirava ese ḡaukara e henigu, umui daimui ai;
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

motu: hereva hehunina, vada na torea kwadoḡi ḡauna, ia ese e hahedinarai henigu.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

motu: Iduahina ai do ba diba, lau na Keriso sivaraina hehunina na mai dibagu.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

motu: Uru gunadia ediai se hedinarai; a harihari ena aposetolo taudia helaḡadia bona peroveta taudia na Lauma ese vada e hahedinarai henidia.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

motu: Herevana binai: idau bese taudia bona Iuda taudia na ahudia be tamona, bona tau-anidia be tamona; gwauhamata tamona danu e abia heboumu Iesu Keriso lalonai, sivarai namo dainai.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

motu: Dirava ena harihari-bada dainai ena siahu ese egu ai vada e ḡaukara, sivarai namo isiaina ilaohenina taugu ai vada e halaogu.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

motu: Helaḡa taudia iboudiai lau mo sibogu maraḡi-maraḡi herea; to ia esevada e harihari henigu, bese idau-idau vairadiai Keriso ena taḡa, iduahina ta asi dibana taḡana, baina harorolaia,
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

motu: bona ḡau iboudiai ikaradia Diravana ese sene negadia ema harihari vada e hunia herevana anina baina hahedinaraia taunimanima iboudiai ediai.
english: and to make all men see what is the administration + 3:9 TR reads “fellowship” instead of “administration” * of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

motu: Harihari, ekalesia ena amo, lohia hereadia bona siahu taudia, guba ai e nohomu, ese Dirava ena aonega idau-idau bae diba,
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

motu: nega hanaihanai e lalo-hadailaia heḡereḡerena ai, Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada lalonai e hamomokania.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

motu: Ia lalonai ita na mai boga-aukada bona mai goadada baita raka henia kahi, ta abidadama heniamu dainai.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

motu: Taunabunai na noimuimu, daramui basie doko umui bagumui ai na hisihisimu; lauegu hisihisi na umui ihahairaimui ḡauna. Egu ḡuriḡuri daimui ai
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

motu: Una dainai lau na Tamada vairanai na hetuituimu.
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

motu: Bese iboudiai guba ai bona tanobada ai be ia nemaina.
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

motu: Na noiamu, ia hairaina taḡadia amo ia Laumana ese siahu baine henimui, bena lalomui idoidiai do bae goada,
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

motu: bona emui abidadama dainai Keriso na umui lalomui ai baine noho. Bena lalokau ai ba gini tutuka-tutuka bona ba badinaia tarika-tarika dainai, ba goada momokani;
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

motu: bena helaḡa taudia iboudiai ida Keriso ena lalokau lababana bona rohana bona harana-latana bona dobuna
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

motu: vadaba diba, bona basita diba ḡuḡuru lalokauna, Keriso ena, danu. Unu amo Dirava ena honuhonu-dae ese baine hahonumui.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

motu: Ita laloda ai mai siahuna ida e ḡaukaramu Diravana do baine ḡaukara, ela bona eda noinoi bona eda lalo-hadai idoidiai baine hereadia;
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

motu: ia hairaina be ekalesia lalonai bona Keriso Iesu lalonai baine mia, ela bona uru iboudiai ela hanaihanai. Amen.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

motu: Badina bunai lau, Lohiabada ese e ḡuigu taugu, na hahealo henimuimu: ba raka, e boirimui rakana heḡereḡerena.
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

motu: Lalomui bae manau, bae manada, bae haheauka. Lalokau ai ba haheauka heheni.
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

motu: Lauma ena lalo-tamona ba kahua tao, maino ena iḡui ai.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

motu: Tau-anina be tamona; Lauma danu tamona; e boirimui negadia ai boiboi helarona na tamona;
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

motu: Lohiabada na tamona; abidadama na tamona; bapatiso na tamona.
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

motu: Dirava danu tamona, ia na taunimanima iboudiai Tamadia; ia ese iboudiai e hereadiamu, iboudiai e rohediamu, iboudiai lalodiai e nohomu.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

motu: Ita ta ta harihari-bada vada eme henida, Keriso ese ena herahia e hahetohoamu hegereḡerena.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

motu: Una dainai ini e torea toma: Ia e dae atai ai, Ena abi-mauri taudia mai iḡuidia ida e hakaudia lao; Ena herahia na taunimanima e henidia.
english: Therefore he says, “ When|strong="G3004" * he|strong="G3588" * ascended|strong="G3588" * on|strong="G1519" * high|strong="G5311" *, he|strong="G3588" * led captivity captive, and|strong="G3588" * gave|strong="G1325" * gifts|strong="G1390" * to|strong="G1519" * people|strong="G3004" *.” + 4:8 Psalms 68:18 *

motu: Ina hereva “la e dae” anina be dahaka? Anina binai: e diho guna ela bona tanobada henuna kahana, ani?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

motu: E diho tauna danu e dae, guba doriva-dorivana ela, ḡau iboudiai baine hahonu helaoreana.
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

motu: Ena herahia be haida e heni, aposetolo taudia ai baela; ma haida e heni, peroveta taudia ai baela; ma haida sivarai namo iharorolaina; ma haida hereḡu taudia bona hahediba taudia ai baela.
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds + 4:11 or, pastors * and teachers;

motu: Ini e kara toma, ia ese Dirava ena helaḡa taudia iboudiai baine reḡudia, bena idia ese Keriso isiaina bae lao heni, bena Keriso tau-anina bae larebaia dae;
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

motu: ela bona ita iboudai eda abidadama baine tamona bona eda diba danu baine tamona, Dirava Natuna; ela bona tauda bae lo, Keriso tauna e lo hahetohona heḡereḡerena.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

motu: Bena memero karukarudia heḡereḡeredia basita noho; hahediba herevadia lai na heto basie hureda dae hureda diho; taunimanima edia kara gagevagagevadia bona koikoidia basiehakauda kerere.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

motu: A hereva momokani na lalokau ai baita gwaurai; bena unu kara ai baita bada oho bada oho, ela bona Keriso enai baita kau; ia na eda orea ikwarana.
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

motu: Ia enai garugaru iboudiai e ḡaukara heboumu, bena tau-anina idoinai vada e hesiriu kaumu bona e hekamo boumu, bona rege ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara e karamu; unu amo tau-anina e bada oho bada ohomu, bona lalokau ai e tubumu. Mauri matamatana ena kara
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

motu: Taunabunai, Lohiabada lalonai na halomuimu, na tomu, harihari ela basio raka dibura taudia heḡereḡeredia; idia na edia lalo-hadai kavakavadia ai e rakamu
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

motu: Lalodia na didibura; Dirava ena mauri ai idia na asi ahudia, edia mata-lahui bona edia lalo-duhu daidiai.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

motu: Mami namodia asie abimu; a lebulebu daladia ai e rakamu, bona mata-dika karadia e ura heni lalodikamu.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

motu: A Keriso enai vada o diba dalana na dia unuheto.
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

motu: Ia gadona vada o kamonai, ia lalonai vada o hahediba, hereva momokanina Iesu ena amo vada o abia.
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

motu: Bena tau gunana mai ena kara ida ba doki oho; ia na dika, badina be koikoi e ura heniamu.
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

motu: Daramui ba hamatamata,
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

motu: tau matamatana ba hahedokilaia, Dirava heida-idana, kara maoromaoro ai bona hereva momokani helaḡana ai vada e karaia.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

motu: Taunabunai, hereva koikoidia ba nege daure, dekemui taudia ida hereva momokani mo ba gwaurai; badina be ita bona idia na tau-anina tamona regedia.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

motu: Ba badu, to basio kara dika; dina do basine diho ai emu badu baine doko.
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” + 4:26 Psalms 4:4 * Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

motu: Lalomui iduaradia basio keho diabolo ena.
english: and don’t give place + 4:27 or, opportunity * to the devil.

motu: Henao tauna na basine henao lou; ḡaukara namona ta imana amo baine karaia, bena e dabumu tauna na baine durua diba.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

motu: Hereva mirodia udumui amo basie lasi; hereva namodia ba gwaurai, taunimanima lalodia ba hapararalai, bena bae kamonai taudia ese harihari-bada bae abia.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

motu: Dirava ena Lauma Helaḡa basio turia riki henia; ia ese vada e abumui hidi, ia toana emui ai baine mia ela bona hahemauri dinana.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

motu: Heiri-heiri, daḡedaḡe, badu, heloḡo-heloḡo, hereva mirodia, hahebade, iboudiai ba nege daure.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

motu: Ba hekaha heheni; ba hebogahisi heheni; emui dika ba hegwau tao heheni, Dirava ese Keriso lalonai emui dika vada e gwau tao na heto.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

motu: Taunabunai, umui, Dirava natuna, ena lalokau, Dirava ba haḡoia.
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

motu: Lalokau ai ba raka, Keriso ese e lalokau henida heḡereḡerena; ia sibona e heni, ita daidai, herahia ḡauna bona boubou ḡauna mai bonana namona, Dirava ena.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

motu: Heuda-hanai bona mata-dika bona mata-ḡaniḡani na bogaragimui ai basio herevalai; helaḡa taudia edia dala bunai.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

motu: Lebulebu, kavakava, hevaseha herevadia danu dia nanamo; a hahenamo herevadia hari namo.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

motu: Dibamui, auli, heuda-hanai tauna bona mata-dika tauna bona mata-ḡaniḡani tauna na asi ahudia, Keriso bona Dirava edia basileia lalonai; idia be kaivakuku itomadiho-henidia taudia na heheto.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

motu: Tau ta ese hereva kavakavadia basine koilaimui; badina be unu ḡau daidiai Dirava ena badu na gwau-edeede taudia latadiai e kaumu.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

motu: Badina bunai, idia ida basio hetura.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

motu: Badina be gunaguna umui na didibura, a harihari umui vada ome diari, Lohiabada lalonai: ba raka, diari memerodia heḡereḡeredia.
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

motu: Badina be diari huahuadia na lalohadai namodia ai bona kara maoromaorodia ai bona hereva momokanidia ai e hedinaraimu.
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

motu: Lohiabada ihamoalena karana na ba tahua.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

motu: Dibura karadia asi huahuadia na basio hetura henidia, a ba hahedinaraidia;
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

motu: badina be edia kara hehunidia igwaurai-hedinaraidia na mai hemaraina.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

motu: A e hahedinaraidia ḡaudia iboudiai na diari ese e hahedinaraimu; badina be e hahedinaraimu ḡaudia iboudiai na didiari.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

motu: Badina bunai hereva na e tomu, Mahuta taumu e, a noga; Mase taudia bogaragidia amo ba tore isi; Keriso ese diari baine henimu.
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

motu: Taunabunai, emui raka nahuana ba tohoa; aonega taudia heḡereḡeredia ai ba raka, dia kavakava taudia na heheto.
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

motu: E henimui negana ba ḡaukaralaia namonamo, badina be ina na nega dikana.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

motu: Benaini, basio kavakava; Lohiabada ena ura ba diba ḡoeva.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

motu: Vine ranuna basio inua momo, kekero garina; a Lauma ese baine hahonumui.
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

motu: Ba hereva heheni, salamo ai bona ane ai bona lauma anedia ai. Ane bavabi, bona Lohiabada ba hanamoa lalomui ai.
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

motu: Nega idoinai Tamada Dirava ba hanamoa, ḡau iboudiai daidiai, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

motu: Ba hemataurai heheni, Keriso o matauraiamu heḡereḡerena. Hahealo herevadia
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

motu: Hahine e, adavamui ba kamonai henidia, Lohiabada boma kamonai henia heḡereḡerena.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

motu: Badina be tau na adavana kwarana, Keriso na ekalesia kwarana na heto; ekalesia na ia tau-anina, ia danu ekalesia ihamaurina.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

motu: A ekalesia ese Keriso e kamonai heniamu heḡereḡerena, hahine ese ḡau iboudiai lalodiai adavadia unu bae kamonai henidia toma.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

motu: Tatau e, adavamui ba lalokau henidia, Keriso ese ekalesia e lalokau henia na heto. Ia dainai sibona e heni,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

motu: ena hereva amo ranu ai e huria, baine hahelaḡaia,
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

motu: ma baine abia iena; ekalesia mai hairaina, asi toutouna, asi makukuna, asi berona; baine helaḡa asi bebeka-bebekana helaoreana.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

motu: Unuhetomana tatau ese adavadia bae lalokau henidia, sibodia tau-anidia e lalokau henimu heḡereḡerena. Adavana e lalokau heniamu tauna ese sibona e helalokaumu.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

motu: Badina be tau ta ese sibona tau-anina se inai heniamu, to e ubuamu bona e dosiamu, Keriso ese ekalesia e ubuamu bona e dosiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

motu: Badina be ita na ia tau-anina regena.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

motu: “Badina binai tau ese tamana sinana baine rakatanidia, adavana mo enai baine tao, bena raruosi vada tau-anina tamona na heto.”
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.” + 5:31 Genesis 2:24 *

motu: Ina hereva hehunina anina na bada; to lau ese Keriso bona ekalesia na gwauraidiamu.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

motu: Benaini, umui tatau ta ta adavamui ba lalokau henidia, sibomui o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena. Hahine danu adavana baine matauraia.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

motu: Memero kekeni e, tamamui sinamui ba kamonai henidia, Lohiabada lalonai, badina be ena na maoro.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

motu: “Tamamu sinamu ba matauraidia,” (ina na haheḡani mai gwauhamatana gini-gunana),
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

motu: “bena ba namo, ba mauri daudau tanobada ai.”
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.” + 6:3 Deuteronomy 5:16 *

motu: Tama e, natumui basio habadudia, a Lohiabada ena hahediba herevadia bona ena sisiba herevadia ba ubulaidia.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

motu: Hesiai memeromui e, biagumui tanobada ai ba kamonai henidia mai heude-heudemui ida bona mai lalomui tamona ida, Keriso boma kamonai henia heḡereḡerena.
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

motu: Isiaidia ba lao heni, dia vairadiai mo, taunimanima ihamoaledia e uramu taudia na heheto, a Keriso ena hesiai taudia ese Dirava ena ura e karamu mai lalodia ida na heto.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

motu: Emui hesiai ilao-henina ba karaia mai lalo-manaumui ida, Lohiabada enai boma karaia na heto.
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

motu: Umui dibamui ita ta ta baita kara namo negadia ai na davada baita abi, Lohiabada ena amo; iḡui tauna eiava ura-kwalimu tauna, dava tamona.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

motu: Biagu e, kara heḡereḡeredia ba kara henidia; ihagarilaidia herevadia na ba hadoko. Umui dibamui umui bona idia Biagumui be tamona guba ai; ia ese taunimanima toadia se lalomu.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

motu: Hereva dokona binai: Lohiabada siahuna ai ba siahu, bona goadana ai ba goada.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

motu: Dirava ena tuari dabuadia iboudiai ba hahedokilai; bena ba goada, diabolo ena kara dibaka ba laoa ahu.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

motu: Badina be ita eda tuari na dia taunimanima ida, a ḡaubada hereadia bona siahu taudia bona tanobada diburana lohiadia bona lauma dikadia guba gabudia ai ida ta tuarimu.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

motu: Una dainai Dirava ena tuari dabuadia iboudiai ba hahedokilai, bena dika dinana ai ba laodia ahu diba; ḡau iboudiai ba kara ḡuḡuru, bena ba gini.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

motu: Benaini, ba gini: koekoemui ai hereva momokani ba ḡeḡea; kememui ai kara maoromaoro ba hadabualai;
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

motu: aemui palapaladia sivarai namo mainona iseuna ba kumilai.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

motu: Nega idoinai abidadama kesina bavabia kau, unu amo Tau Dikana ena diba lahidia ba habodo diba.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

motu: Hahemauri bavabia, emui kwara ḡauna; bona Lauma ena dare, Dirava ena hereva bunai.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word + 6:17 from the Greek “ῥῆμα” (rhema), which means “spoken word” * of God;

motu: Ḡuriḡuri bona noinoi iboudiai Lauma lalonai ba gwaurai, nega idoinai. Ba gima malaka-malaka; helaḡa taudia daidiai ba noinoi,
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

motu: lau daigu ai danu ba noinoi, baina haroro negadia ai sivarai namo ena hereva hehunidia baina hahedinarai ḡoevaḡoeva.
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

motu: Badina bunai lau na hesiai taugu mai iḡuigu ida na nohomu. Lau daigu ai ba noinoi, baina hereva goadagoada, vada e haduagu heḡereḡerena.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

motu: Paulo bona Timoteo, ai Iesu Keriso ena hesiai taumai, ese umui Keriso Iesu ena helaḡa taumui iboumui ai Filipi ai o nohomu, bona heitatao taumui bona diakono taumui, a tore henimuimu:
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers + 1:1 or, superintendents, or bishops * and servants: + 1:1 Or, deacons *

motu: harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, bavabi. Hahenamo herevadia
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Na lalomuimu negadia iboudiai egu Dirava na hanamoamu;
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

motu: bona umui daimui ai na noinoimu negadia iboudiai, na ḡuriḡurimu mai moalegu ida;
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

motu: badina be lalomui ai o matamaia dinana ema bona hari, sivarai namo ḡaukarana ai o kahagu dainai.
english: for your partnership + 1:5 The word translated “partnership” (κοινωνίᾳ) also means “fellowship” and “sharing”. * in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

motu: Badina be dibagu kara namo lalomui ai e matamaia Diravana ese baine haḡuḡurua, ela bona Iesu Keriso ena dina.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

motu: Umui iboumui ai ini na lalomui tomamu na maoro, badina be lalogu ai na lalomui taomu; dibura rumana ai na nohomu ai bona sivarai namo na gwauraiamu ma na hamomokaniamu ai, umui bona lau harihari-bada tame abia hebou.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

motu: Dirava hari dibana, Keriso Iesu ena hebogahisi ai umui iboumui ai na ura henimui lalo-dikamu.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

motu: Egu noinoi binai: emui uraheni baine vara badabada mai diarina bona mai aonegana ida;
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

motu: bena ḡau namodia toadia ba diba, bona ba noho mai ḡoevamui, asi bebeka-bebekamui, ela bona Keriso ena dina.
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

motu: Kara maoromaoro huahuadia ai ba honu; idia na Iesu Keriso ena amo e maimu, Dirava iheatolaina bona ihanamona totona. Egu noho
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

motu: Varavaragu e, na uramu ba diba, egu ai e vara ḡaudia na sivarai namo ihapere-rohorohona ḡaudia ai vada ela.
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, + 1:12 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

motu: Ḡaubada ena hegima oreana idoinai bona taunimanima iboudiai gabu idau-idau ai danu dibadia lau na Keriso dainai dibura rumana ai na nohomu;
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace + 1:13 or, praetorian * guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

motu: bona varavaragu na gwauraidiamu taudia na lau iḡuigu dainai lalodia eme goada Lohiabada lalonai, bena Dirava ena hereva e gwauraiamu mai goadadia ida, asie garimu.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

motu: Momokani, haida ese Keriso na vaḡeḡe ai bona heai ai e harorolaiamu; a haida be lalo-namo ai e harorolaiamu.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

motu: Ini idia na uraheni dainai e haroromu; dibadia lau na sivarai namo ihamomokanina dainai na ginimu.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

motu: Unu idia na heiri-heiri dainai e haroromu, dia lalodia amo; dibura rumana ai na nohomu ai egu hisihisi bae habadaia e tomamu.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

motu: Herevana! Dibaka ai eiava momokani ai Keriso e harorolaiamu; una dainai na moalemu.
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

motu: Oibe, bona baina moale. Badina be lau dibagu ini amo hahemauri baina abia, emui noinoi daidiai, bona Iesu Keriso ena Lauma ena hekaha dainai.
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

motu: Egu ura bada bona egu helaro bini: ḡau ta ai basina hemarai, a nega idoidiai heḡereḡeredia harihari danu baina goada mo; bona maurigu ai eiava masegu ai lau taugu ese Iesu baine imodaia.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

motu: Badina be lauegu ai mauri be Keriso, a mase amo ḡau namo-hereana baina davaria.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

motu: A taugu ai bama mauri noho, egu ḡaukara anina bama itaia; una dainai asi dibagu edena baina abia hidi.
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

motu: Egu ura na rua; na daradaramu. Na ura badamu Keriso dekena bainala; una bema namo herea.
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

motu: To umui daimui ai taugu ai baina noho baine namo.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

motu: Una na dibagu; bena na laloamu do baina noho, umui ida baita noho hebou, emui abidadama bona emui moale ihabadana.
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

motu: Taunabunai, Keriso Iesu lalonai emui heaḡi baine bada, badina be lau na umui dekemui ai dainai. Emui noho
english: that your boasting + 1:26 or, rejoicing * may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Keriso ena sivarai namo ihaheḡereḡerena karadia mo ba kara; bena baina vasi itamui eiava dauhai mo harimui baina kamonai, lau baina diba umui na lalo tamona ai o gini tutuka-tutukamu, bona ura tamona ai sivarai namo ikamonai-henina o goadalaiamu.
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

motu: E inai henimuimu taudia na garidia basio gari; una na idia edia mase toana, a umui emui ai Dirava ena hahemauri toana.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

motu: Vada e henimui hariharina binai: dia Keriso iabiabiraina mo, a hisi ianina danu ia dainai.
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

motu: Emui tuari be o itaguva na goadalaiava bona o kamonaimu doini na goadalaiamu tuarina.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

motu: Taunabunai, Keriso ena lalo-hakeru bema mia, uraheni ena tauhalo bema mia, Lauma ena hetura-heheni bema mia, hebogahisi bona hekaha bema mia,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

motu: umui ese egu moale boma haḡuḡurua, lalomui boma hatamona, emui ura heni boma hatamona, emui lalo-hadai boma hatamona.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

motu: Ḡau ta basio karaia heiri-heiri dainai eiava hekokoroku dainai; a ta ta sibomui ba hahemanau, bamomui ba imodaidia.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

motu: Bona ta ta ena namo ena namo basio tahu, a bamomui edia namo ba tahu.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

motu: Keriso Iesu lalonai e miava darana umui lalomui ai danu baine mia.
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

motu: Ia hari, ena be Dirava anitarana e abia, ena be ia Dirava ida vada e heḡereḡere, to se haeroa una na baine Dogoa tao ḡauna.
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

motu: Ia ese sibona e hekaruhia hebubu, hesiai merona anitarana e abia, taunimanima oromana ai e vara,
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

motu: ita-itana na taunimanima na heto. Bena sibona e hahemanau, Dirava e kamonai henia ela bona mase, oibe, satauro ena mase.
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

motu: Una dainai Dirava ese e imodaia, lada ta e henia, lada iboudiai e hereadia ladana;
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

motu: bena Iesu ladana dainai guba ḡaudia bona tanobada ḡaudia bona tanobada henuna ḡaudia iboudiai tuidia bae hadai;
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

motu: bona mala iboudiai ese Keriso na “Lohiabada” bae gwauraia, Tamada Dirava iheatolaina.
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, nega idoidiai lau vairagu ai o kamonai henigu; harihari, lau murigu ai, emui kamonai ba habadaia, mai garimui bona mai heude-heudemui ida ihamaurimui ba tahua.
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese ena ura namodia iura-henidia bona ikaradia na lalomui ai e havaramu.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai asi emui maumau asi emui hepapahuahu ba kara;
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

motu: unu amo Dirava natuna ai baola, asi toutoumui, asi bebeka-bebekamui, bona asi emui kerere, uru gageva-gagevana mai gwau-edeedena bogaraginai. Idia padadiai ba hedinarai, tanobada ena diari na heto.
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

motu: Mauri herevana ba hahedinaraia, bena Keriso ena dina ai lau na do baina moale, bainato “Asina heau kava, asina hekwarahi kava”.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

motu: Ena be lau raragu baine hebubu, emui abidadama karadia ihahelaḡadia, to baina moale, bona baita moale hebou;
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

motu: umui danu ba moale bona baita moale hebou. Timoteo baina siaia vasi
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

motu: Lohiabada Iesu lalonai na laloamu asi vanahana Timoteo baina siaia vasi, bena harimui baina kamonai, lalogu baine keru.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

motu: Badina be dekegu ai ta lasi ia heḡereḡerena; ta lasi umui baine reḡumui ia baine reḡumui heḡereḡerena.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

motu: Badina be iboudiai na sibodia edia ḡau e tahumu, a Iesu Keriso ena ḡau asie tahumu.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

motu: A ia toana be dibamui: mero ese tamana isiaina e lao henimu na heto, ia ese lau isiaigu vada e lao heni, sivarai namo dainai.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

motu: Taunabunai egu helaro be asi vanahana ia baina siaia vasi, lau ede baina heto baina diba negana ai.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

motu: A Lohiabada na abidadama heniamu, nega basine daudau lau danu baina vasi. Epafrodito be vasimu
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

motu: Lau na tomamu tadigu Epafrodito, ḡaukara ai bona tuari ai e bamogumu tauna, o siaia egu dabu ai baine kahagu tauna, ma aina siaia vasi.
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

motu: Badina be e lalomui badamu, bona lalona e hekwarahimu, ena gorere harina o kamonai dainai.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

motu: Momokani e gorerea, mokona e mase, to Dirava ese e bogaia hisi, bona dia ia mo a lau danu e bogagu hisi, egu lalo-hisihisi baine bada herea na garina.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

motu: Una dainai aina siaia vasi na tomamu. Ba itaia lou, bena ba moale; lau danu egu daradara baine maraḡi.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

motu: Benaini, Lohiabada lalonai bavabia dae mai moalemui ida; bona kara unuhetomadia e karamu na taudia danu iboudiai ba matauraidia.
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

motu: Badina be Keriso ena ḡaukara dainai mokona e mase; ena mauri e dadaraia, emui hebogahisi egu ai baine haḡuḡurua totona.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

motu: Benaini, varavaragu e, Lohiabada lalonai ba moale. Hereva tamona na torea louloumu, asina hesikumu; badina be ia ese umui baine hamaurimui.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

motu: Sisia nahuadia ba toho; dika ikarana taudia nahuadia ba toho; heiva kava taudia nahuadia ba toho.
english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

motu: Badina be peritome korikori be ita: ita, lauma ai Dirava ta toma henia dihomu, bona Keriso Iesu ta heaḡilaiamu, bona tau-anina asita abidadama heniamu, tauda.
english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

motu: Lau ese tau-anina bama abidadama henia diba; ena be tau ta ese tau-anina bema abidadama henia, to lau ese bama hereaia.
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

motu: Na vara, dina ihataurahanina ai e peritomegu. Lau na Israel besena taugu, Beniamina ena iduhu taugu. Senegu danu Heberu taudia. Taravatu ibadinana ai lau be Farisea taugu.
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

motu: Egu goada na hahedinaraiava, ekalesia oreana na daḡedaḡe heniava. Taravatu ena kara maoromaoro ibadinana ai lau na asi bebeka-bebekagu.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

motu: A gunaguna e hanamolaigu ḡaudia iboudiai harihari Keriso dainai dikadia na gwauraimu.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

motu: Oibe, ḡau iboudiai na dadaraimu, a ḡau herea-daena, Keriso egu Lohiabada baina dibaia ḡoevaḡoeva, na helaorealaiamu; ia dainai ḡau iboudiai vada na haboiodia, negenege ḡaudia ai vada na halaodia, Keriso baina abia tarika-tarika helaoreana.
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

motu: Bena ia lalonai bae davarigu, dia taravatu ai na kara maoromaoro dainai, to Keriso ibadinana ai na kara maoromaoro dainai; Dirava ese eda abidadama dainai e henidamu kara maoromaorona bunai.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

motu: Bena ia bona ena toreisi-lou siahuna baina diba; bona ia e ani hisidia lau danu baina ani, ena mase dalana ai danu baina mase.
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

motu: Unu amo mase amo toreisi-louna baina ḡavaia.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

motu: Lau asina tomamu vada na abia, eiava vada na ḡoeva dae. Doini na ḡavaiamu, baina abia na tomamu, Keriso Iesu ese lau e abigu na heto.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

motu: Varavaragu e, asina tomamu vada na abia; a kara tamona na goadalaiamu, murigu ḡaudia name lalo boio, vairagu ḡaudia na ḡavamu;
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

motu: dokona na heau heniamu, davana baina abia na tomamu; una dava be Keriso Iesu lalonai Dirava ese e boirida dae.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

motu: Benaini, mai darada tauda iboudai unu baita kara toma; a umui haida lalomui bema idau, Dirava ese lalomui baine hadiaridia.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

motu: Ḡau tamona, vada ta davari ḡaudia heḡereḡeredia ai baita raka.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

motu: Varavaragu e, lau ba ḡavagu hebou, bona ai e haḡoimaimu taudia na ba haerodia.
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

motu: Badina be vada na hamaoromui gunava, bona mai taigu ida na hamaoromui loumu, haida na e raka kereremu, Keriso ena satauro e inai heniamu.
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

motu: Dokodia na mase; edia dirava na bogadia; edia heaḡi na edia hemarai karadia; edia helalo na tanobada ḡaudia.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

motu: A ita eda hanua konkori na guba ai; eda helaro be Ihamaurida Tauna, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso, unu amo bainema.
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

motu: Ia ese ini tau-anida manokadia baine hamatamata, ia tau-anina ḡoeva-daena heida-idana ai baine halao; badina be ia siahuna vada e heḡereḡere ḡau iboudiai baine hamanada.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

motu: Taunabinai, varavaragu e, egu lalokau taumui, na ura henimuimu taumui, egu moale badina, egu dagi toana: lalokau e, Lohiabada lalonai ba gini tutuka-tutuka.
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

motu: Euodia bona Sunutuke na noidiamu, lalodia bae tamona Lohiabada lalonai.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

motu: Oi danu, o kahagumu taumu e, ene hahine ba kahadia, badina be idia na lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva, sivarai namo ena; Klemento bona lau ida a ḡaukara hebouva taudia oredia danu. Idia ladadia na mauri bukana ai vada e tore.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

motu: Nega idoidiai Lohiabada lalonai ba moale. Ma na gwau loumu: ba moale.
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

motu: Emui lalo-manau na taunimanima iboudiai bae diba. Lohiabada vada eme kahikahi.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

motu: Ḡau ta basio lalo haguhilaia; a ḡau iboudiai ḡuriḡuri ai, noinoi ai, heimodai ai, emui ura na Dirava ba hamaorolaia.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

motu: Bena Dirava ena maino, eda diba idoinai e hereaiamu mainona, ese lalomui bona daramui baine gima, Keriso Iesu lalonai.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

motu: Varavaragu e, orena binai: momokani ḡaudia iboudiai, hemataurai ḡaudia iboudiai, maoromaoro ḡaudia iboudiai, ḡoevaḡoeva ḡaudia iboudiai, lalokau ḡaudia iboudiai, haridia namodia ḡaudia iboudiai, ba haero. Ena namo taina mia ḡauna, eiava ena heimodai taina mia ḡauna, ba haeroa.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

motu: O davariva ḡaudia, o abi daeva ḡaudia, egu ai o kamonaiva o itava ḡaudia, unu mo ba kara; bena Maino Diravana ese baine bamomui.
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

motu: Lohiabada lalonai na moale badamu, vada o lalolaigu loumu dainai. Dibagu o lalolaigu gunava, to asi emui dala ta.
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

motu: Egu ogoḡami na asina herevalaiamu; badina be vada na manada, egu ai e miamu ḡaudia baina moalelai.
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

motu: Ogoḡami dibagu; taḡa danu dibagu. Ḡabu iboudiai, ḡau iboudiai, bogakunu bona hitolo, taḡa bona ogoḡami, vada na manadalai.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

motu: Goada e henigumu Diravana dainai lau na ḡau iboudiai ikaradia ai na goadamu.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

motu: Ḡau tamona, egu hisihisi lalonai o kahagumu be namo.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

motu: Filipi taumui e, umui dibamui, sivarai namo iloalaina na matamaia negana ai, Makedonia na rakatania murinai, ekalesia oreana ta ese ikahalaigu ḡaudia ihenidia bona iabidia herevadia se gwaurai, umui mo sibomui.
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

motu: Badina be Tesalonika ai na nohova ai, umui ese egu ogoḡami ikahalaina ḡaudia o siai loulouva.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

motu: Dia herahia ḡauna asina tahuamu, a huahua hari na tahumu, ihanamolaimui ḡaudia ai baela huahuadia.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

motu: Lau na vada na abi vaitani; egu ḡau na momo. Badina be Epafrodito ese emui amo e mailai ḡaudia vada na abi; bonadia nanamo ḡaudia, boubou ḡaudia, Dirava ese e abi daemu mai moalena ida.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

motu: Egu Dirava ese o dabumu ḡaudia baine henimui ḡuḡuru, ena kohu herea-daedia, Keriso Iesu lalonai baine henimui.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

motu: Tamada Dirava baita imodaia hanaihanai. Amen.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

motu: Keriso Iesu ena helaḡa taudia iboudiai ba hahenamo henidia. Varavarada dekegu ai e nohomu ese e hahenamo henimumu.
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

motu: Helaḡa taudia iniseni ai, haida danu Kaisara ena ruma ai e nohomu, iboudiai ese e hahenamo henimuimu.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na laumamui ai baine mia.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo taugu, Dirava ena ura dainai, bona varavarada Timoteo,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

motu: ai raruosi ese umui helaḡa taumui Kolose ai, Keriso iabidadama-henina taumui, a tore henimuimu: harihari-bada bona maino Tamada Dirava ena amo bavabi. Hahenamo herevadia
english: to the saints and faithful brothers + 1:2 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Dirava, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, a hanamoamu, umui daimui ai a noiamu negadia iboudiai;
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

motu: badina be ai na vada a kamonai Keriso Iesu o abidadama heniamu, bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai o ura henidiamu.
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

motu: Badina be emui helaro na guba ai, sivarai namo ena hereva momokani ai o kamonai guna helarona.
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

motu: Ina na umui emui ai vada e kau, tanobada idoinai vada eha kau heḡereḡerena: bona tanobada idoinai huahuana e dobimu, umui bogaragimui ai e dobimu heḡereḡerena; dia ina harihari mo, to Dirava ena harihari-bada sivaraina o kamonai bona o diba momokani dinana amo.
english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

motu: Ai bamomai, emai lalokau Epafra, ese e hadibamui; ia na Keriso ena hesiai tauna korikori emui ai.
english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your + 1:7 NU reads our * behalf,

motu: Ia ese danu emui uraheni, Lauma lalonai, vada e hamaorolaimai. Emai guriguri daimui ai
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

motu: Una dainai, ai a kamonai dinana amo ema bona harihari, ḡuriḡuri asia hadokoa umui daimui ai; a noinoimu, iena ura ba diba vaitani mai aonegamui idoinai, laumamui danu bae diari;
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

motu: bena Lohiabada imatauraina ai ba raka, kara iboudiai ia ba hamoalea, kara namodia iboudiai anidia ba havara, bona emui diba Dirava enai baine tubu.
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

motu: Ai a noinoimu danu, siahu idoinai ese baine hagoadamui, ia siahuna herea-daena heḡereḡerena; bena ba haheauka bona ba boga auka mai moalemui ida.
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

motu: Ita Tamada baita imodaia. ia ese vada e haḡoevada, diari ai helaḡa taudia ida ahuda baita abia;
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

motu: ia danu dibura siahuna amo vada e hamaurida, ia Natuna, ena lalokau, ena basileia lalonai vada e abida vareai;
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

motu: ia lalonai ita na mai eda hahemauri bona mai eda dika igwau-taodia. Keriso ena ḡaukara
english: in whom we have our redemption, + 1:14 TR adds “through his blood,” * the forgiveness of our sins.

motu: Ia na asita itaiamu Diravana heida-idana, e vara ḡaudia iboudiai roboadia.
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

motu: Badina be ḡau iboudiai guba ai bona tanobada ai ia ese e kara, ta itamu ḡaudia bona asita itamu ḡaudia, guba pavapavadia, lohia badadia, ḡaubada hereadia, siahu taudia: iboudiai ia ese e karadia, iena ḡau.
english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

motu: Ia e noho guna, a ḡau iboudiai be gabeamo, bona ḡau iboudiai ia lalonai e hekamo boumu.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

motu: Ia na ekalesia kwarana; ekalesia na ia tau-anina. Ia na mase amo toreisi-lou roboana, taunabunai ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ia na herea.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

motu: Badina be Diravana ena ura dainai, ena honuhonu-dae na ienai e miava;
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

motu: bona iena amo ḡau iboudiai, tanobada ḡaudia bona guba ḡaudia, ienai baine hadarodia dae, ia idia ida bae herohemaino, iena satauro rarana dainai.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

motu: Umui danu, gunaguna ia bona umui na mai padamui; lalomui ai o inai heniava emui kara dika daidiai.
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

motu: A harihari ia ese ienai vada eme hadaromui dae, ia tau-anina ena mase dainai; bena ia vairanai baine haginimui mai helaḡamui ida, asi bebeka-bebekamui, asi emui kara havara.
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

motu: Ḡau tamona, kamonai ai ba noho, ba badinaia tarika-tarika, ba gini tutukatutuka; sivarai namo ena helaro amo basie daromui daudau. Sivarai namo bunai vada o kamonai; sivarai namo bunai taunimanima iboudiai guba henunai vada e harorolai henidia; sivarai namo bunai lau Paulo na hesiai tauna ai vada eme halaogu. Lauegu ḡaukara daimui ai
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

motu: Harihari egu hisihisi umui daimui ai na moalelaimu; bona Keriso ena hisihisi orena lau taugu ai na haḡuḡuruamu, ekalesia, ia tau-anina, dainai.
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

motu: Ena hesiai taugu ai nala, bena Dirava ese dagi e henigu umui emui ai, Dirava ena hereva baina harorolaia ḡuḡuru helaoreana.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

motu: Ena hereva hehunina na sene eregunadia bona uru iboudiai edia amo e hunia, ema harihari; a harihari ena helaḡa taudia ediai vada e hahedinaraia,
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

motu: bena idia ediai, Dirava ena ura dainai, ina hereva hehunina hairaina herea-daena na bese idau-idau taudia bogaragidiai baine hedinarai. Herevana binai: Keriso na umui lalomui ai, emui hairai helarona.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

motu: Ai ese ia a harorolaiamu; taunimanima iboudiai a sisiba henidiamu, launimanima iboudiai a hadibadiamu, aonega iboudiai lalodiai; taunimanima iboudiai danu baia haginidia, bae namo ḡuḡuru Keriso lalonai.
english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

motu: Una totona na hekwarahimu bona na goada tohomu; iena ḡaukara heḡereḡerena lau lalogu ai e ḡaukaramu, mai siahuna ida.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

motu: Badina be na uramu ba diba, lau na hekwarahi hereamu umui daimui ai, bona Laodikea taudia daidiai, bona vairagu do asie itaia taudia iboudiai daidiai.
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

motu: Na uramu lalodia bae hagoadadia, bona lalokau ai bae hedaro boubou; na uramu danu lalo-parara idoinai ese baine hataḡadia, ela bona Dirava ena hereva hehunina, Keriso bunai, bae diba.
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

motu: Ia lalonai aonega bona lalo-parara kohudia iboudiai na vada e hehunimu. Sisiba herevadia
english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

motu: Ini na gwau tomamu, tau ta ese lalo-ani herevadia baine koilaimui na garina.
english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

motu: Ena be tau-anigu na dia dekemui ai, to laumagu na dekemui ai; bena na moalemu, badina be emui hereḡu namona na itaiamu, bona Keriso o abidadama henia tarika-tarikamu danu na itaiamu.
english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

motu: Taunabunai, Keriso Iesu vada o abia lava dae heḡereḡerena, ienai ba raka.
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

motu: Ia lalonai ba haheholo kau; ia latanai ba hahedai kau; ia iabiabiraina ai ba hahegoada, vada e hadibamui heḡereḡerena; ia ihanamona ai ba herea dae.
english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, tau ta ese ena dadidadi damuna ai baine halaomui na garina, taunimanima edia aonega kavakavadia eiava edia lalo-hadai koikoidia eiava sene taudia edia toma-diho karadia ai baine koimui na garina; Keriso ena dala na dia unu-heto.
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena mauri ḡoeva-daena na Keriso tau-anina ai vada e noho.
english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

motu: Ia lalonai umui vada o namo ḡuḡuru. Ia na lohia hereadia bona siahu taudia iboudiai kwaradia.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

motu: Ia lalonai peritome vada o abia, dia taunimanima imadia amo, a tau dikana idokiohona ḡauna, Keriso ena amo.
english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

motu: Emui bapatiso ai ia ida e gurimui hebou bona ia ida o tore isi hebou, Dirava o abidadama heniamu, ia siahuna ese Keriso e hatorea isi lou, dainai.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

motu: Umui na asie peritomemui taumui, emui kara dika ai o maseva; to Dirava ese ia ida vada e hamaurimui, bona iseda kara dika iboudiai vada e gwau tao.
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

motu: E laoda ahu herevadia taravatu ai e hetore na ia ese vada e roho, vada e abi oho, ena satauro ai vada e koko kau.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

motu: Lohia hereadia bona siahu taudia ia ese vada e haketodia, taunimanima vairadiai vada e hahemaraidia, ia murina amo vada e hakaudia.
english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

motu: Taunabunai, tau ta ese basine hahemaoro henimui aniani dainai, eiava inuinu dainai, eiava aria daidiai, eiava hua matamatadia daidiai, eiava dina helaḡadia daidiai.
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

motu: Unu na gabeai bae vara ḡaudia laulaudia mo, a anina korikori be Keriso ena.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

motu: Ena mata-hanai e heaḡilaiamu bona lalonai e hahemanau koikoimu bona aneru e toma henidia dihomu tauna ese basine hahemaoro henimui. Ia na tau-anina ena lalo-hadai kavakavadia e heagilaimu, a una na asi anina.
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

motu: Ia danu Keriso, ia na Kwara, enai se kahua taomu. Keriso ena amo tau-anina idoinai ese goada e abiamu, bena garugaru bona varovaro ese e hatamonaiamu, bena e bada oho bada ohomu, Dirava ena heubu dainai.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

motu: Benaini, Keriso ida tanobada laumadia edia lohia badadia edia amo vada o roho mauri, a dahaka dainai ene taravatu o badinamu, emui mauri na tanobada ai na heto, a?
english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

motu: O tomu “Basio dogoa tao” bona “Basio mamia toho” bona “Basio daua toho”;
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

motu: a ene ḡau iboudiai na iabidia ai bae ore; idia na taunimanima edia hahedua bona edia hahediba herevadia mo.
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

motu: Tomadiho momo ai, bona hahemanau ai, bona tau-ani ihadikadia ai, oromadia na aonega herevadia, to idia na asi anidia, badina be taunimanima ena ura dikadia asie hadareremu.
english: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

motu: Taunabunai, Keriso ida vada o tore isi dainai, atai ḡaudia ba haero; gabuna bunai Keriso na Dirava idibana kahana ai e helaimu.
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

motu: Atai ḡaudia ba haero; tanobada ḡaudia basio haero.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

motu: Badina be vada o mase; emui mauri na Keriso ida Dirava lalonai vada e hehunimu.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

motu: Keriso, eda mauri badina, baine hedinarai negana ai, umui danu ia ida hairai ai ba hedinarai.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

motu: Taunabunai, tau-animui edia ura dikadia ba hamase: heuda-hanai, kara dika, mata-dika, lalo-heḡani, mata-ḡaniḡani. Ena na kaivakuku itomadiho-henina na heto.
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

motu: Ene ḡau daidiai Dirava ena badu e kaumu, gwau-edeede taudia latadiai.
english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

motu: Gunaguna umui danu ene dala ai o rakava, idia bogaragidiai o nohova negana ai.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

motu: A harihari ini ḡau iboudiai ba nege: badu, daḡedaḡe, lalo-dika, ere-dika, udumui herevadia dikadia.
english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

motu: Basio hekoi heheni. Badina be tau gunana mai ena dika vada o dokia oho,
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

motu: tau matamatana vada o hahedokilaia; ia na aonega ai e hamatamataia, ikarana Diravana heida-idana.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

motu: Tau matamatana lalonai asi Helene tauna, asi Iuda tauna, e peritomea tauna na lasi, bona se peritomea tauna danu lasi, idau tauna ta lasi, asi Skute tauna, asi hesiai tauna, bona asi ura-kwalimu tauna, a Keriso mo sibona, taunimanima bona ḡau iboudiai lalodiai.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

motu: Dirava ena abi-hidi taumui, ena helaḡa taumui, ena lalokau taumui e, ini na ba hahedokilai: hebogahisi, gado namo, manau, manada, haheauka.
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

motu: Ba haheauka heheni. Ta ese bamona baine habadelaia negana ai, emui dika ba hegwau tao heheni; Lohiabada ese emui dika vada e gwau tao; umui danu unu ba kara toma.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

motu: A unu ḡau iboudiai latadiai, lalokau ba hahedokilaia; ia na ihatamonada ḡauna herea-daena.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

motu: Keriso ena maino danu lalomui baine biagudia; e boirimui, tau-anina tamona ai e haboumui, badina bunai. Dirava ba hanamoa.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

motu: Keriso ena hereva be lalomui ai bae mia, nega idoinai bae hataḡamui. Salamo ai, ane ai, lauma anedia ai, ba hahediba heheni bona ba hahealo heheni. Dirava ihanamolaina anedia bavabi mai lalomui ida.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

motu: Emui hereva ai bona emui ḡaukara ai, ḡau iboudiai Lohiabada Iesu ladana ai ba kara; bona Dirava ba hanamoa ia bagunai. Hahealo herevadia
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

motu: Hahine e, adavamui ba kamonai henidia; una na maoro, Lohiabada lalonai.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

motu: Tatau e, adavamui ba lalokau henidia, basio lalo dika henidia.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

motu: Memero kekeni e, ḡau iboudiai lalodiai tamamui sinamui eredia ba kamonai, bena Lohiabada ese baine lalo namo henimui.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

motu: Tama e, natumui basio turia riki henidia, lalodia bae hesiku na garina.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

motu: Hesiai memeromui e, ḡau iboudiai lalodiai biagumui ina tanobada ai ba kamonai henidia, dia vairadiai mo, taunimanima ihamoaledia karana, a mai lalomui idoidiai, Lohiabada imatauraina karana.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

motu: Emui kara iboudiai na ba kara balaheni, Lohiabada vairanai, dia taunimanima mo vairadiai;
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

motu: ba diba, ahumui na Lohiabada ena amo bavabi, badina be umui na Lohiabada Keriso ena hesiai taumui.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

motu: A kara dika tauna ese ena kara dika davana do baine abia; eda Lohiabada na taunimanima toadia se lalomu.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

motu: Biagu e, kara maoromaoro ai bona kara namo ai emui hesiai memerodia ba kara henidia; ba diba, umui danu mai Biagumui guba ai.
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

motu: Ba ḡuriḡuri goada, basio hadokoa; ba ḡuriḡuri dudukau, Dirava ba hanamoa.
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

motu: Dirava ba noia emai ai, ia ese iduara ta baine kehoa emai, Keriso herevana hehunina baia harorolaia. Ina iḡui ai na nohomu badina bunai.
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

motu: Taunabunai do baina gwauraia hedinarai; e henigu ḡaukarana binai.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

motu: Murimuri taudia vairadiai ba raka mai aonegamui ida; nega emui ai mia na ba ḡaukaralaia namonamo.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

motu: Nega idoinai ba hereva mai gadonamomui ida; emui hereva na damena ai ba damenaia. Bena taunimanima ta ta ba haere henidia mai dibamui ida. Hahetoni herevadia
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

motu: Sivaraigu idoinai Tukiko ese baine hamaorolaimui. Ia na varavaragu, egu lalokau; ia danu hesiai tauna namona ta, ai raruosi ese Lohiabada isiaina a lao heni heboumu.
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
