motu: Na siaia vasimu badina binai: ai sivaraimai baine hamaorolaimui, bena lalomui baine hakeru.
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

motu: Onesimo danu ia ida na siaidia vasimu; ia danu varavarada namona ta, ai emai lalokau bona umui bamomui. Idia ese iniseni ai e varamu karadia iboudiai bae hadibalaimui.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

motu: Aristako, lau bamogu dibura rumana ai, bona Banaba tadina Mareko, raruosi ese e hahenamo henimuimu. Mareko dainai hahedua vada o abia: bema vasi, boma abia dae.
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

motu: Iesu, ladana ta be Iusto, ese danu e hahenamo henimuimu. Peritome taudia na idia tatoiosi mo sibodia lau ida a ḡaukara heboumu, Dirava ena basileia iharorolaina ai; idia ese danu lalogu vada eme hakerua.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

motu: Bamomui Epafra, Keriso Iesu ena hesiai tauna, ese e hahenamo henimuimu. Nega idoinai umui daimui ai e ḡuriḡurimu, e noinoimu, ba gini tutuka-tutuka, ba namo ḡuḡuru, bona Dirava ena ura ba diba ḡoeva.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

motu: Na hamaoromui momokanimu, ia na e hekwarahi bada, umui daimui ai, bona Laodikea taudia daidiai, bona Hieropoli taudia daidiai.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

motu: Egu lalokau Luka, muramura tauna, bona Dema, raruosi ese e hahenamo henimuimu.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

motu: Varavarada Laodikea ai ba hanamodia. Numufa, bona ekalesia oreana iena ruma ai e heboumu, danu ba hanamodia.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

motu: Ina revareva na bogaragimui ai ba duahia murinai Laodikea hebouna ai danu bae duahia. Bona Laodikea taudia edia revareva na umui danu ba duahia.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

motu: Akipo ba hamaoroa, ia ese hesiai ḡaukarana, Lohiabada enai e abia, na nahuana baine tohoa, karana baine karaia ḡuḡuru.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

motu: Ina hahenamo na lau Paulo imagu amo na toreamu. Ba laloa tao, lau na iḡui ai na nohomu. Harihari-bada na dekemui ai baine mia.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

motu: Ai taloiosi, Paulo bona Siluano bona Timoteo, ese Tamada Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia ekalesia oreana Tesalonika ai a tore henimuimu: harihari-bada bona maimo bavabi. Emai moale na daimui ai
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Ai na nega iboudiai Dirava a hanamoamu umui daimui ai, bona emai ḡuriḡuri ai umui ladamui a hato louloumu.
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

motu: Emui kamonai karadia, bona emui uraheni ḡaukaradia, bona emui helaro Lohiabada Iesu Keriso enai e aukamu, ini ḡau nega idoidiai Tamada Dirava vairanai, a lalo taomu.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

motu: Dibamai danu, varavaramai e, Dirava ese umui, ena lalokau taumui, vada e abimui hidi.
english: We know, brothers + 1:4 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * loved by God, that you are chosen,

motu: Badina be emai sivarai namo emui ai e kau, dia hereva ai mo, a siahu ai bona Lauma Helaḡa ai, bena emui ai e momokani vaitani; bona emai kara daimui ai vairamui ai e hedinarai be dibamui.
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

motu: Bena ai o haḡoimai, Lohiabada danu o haḡoia, hereva o abia daeva mai hisihisimui ida, to mai moalemui ida danu, Lauma Helaḡa moalena.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

motu: Bena kamonai taudia iboudiai Makedonia ai bona Akaia ai edia ihaḡoina ḡauna ai ola.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

motu: Badina be umui emui amo Lohiabada ena hereva vada e piua rohoroho, Makedonia ai bona Akaia ai; bona dia una mo, a gabu iboudiai emui abidadama Dirava enai vada e diba. Taunabunai, ai baia hereva na asi badina.
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.

motu: Badina be idia sibodia harida e hapiuamu, ede o abimai dae toma, bona kaivakuku ede o rakatanidia toma, bona Dirava Mauri, Dirava Momokani, ede o haḡerea toma, isiaina ede o lao heni tomamu,
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

motu: bona ia Natuna guba amo ede o naria tomamu: Iesu bunai, ia na mase amo e tore isi, bainema baduna amo e hamauridamu.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

motu: Varavaramai e, dibamui a vasi negana ai na emai heigo-ita na mai anina.
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

motu: Dibamui a hisihisi gunava, Filipi ai e daḡedaḡe henimaiva; a Dirava ladana ai a haheauka, daḡedaḡe bogaraginai Dirava ena sivarai namo a hadibalaimuiva, asia gariva.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

motu: Badina be emai hahealo herevadia na dia lalo-hadai kerere amo, dia lalo-hadai mirodia amo, dia koikoi amo, asie vara;
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

motu: a Dirava ese vada e abimai hidi bona sivarai namo vada e henimai heḡereḡerena mo a gwauraiamu; dia taunimanima ihamoaledia, a laloda e dibamu Diravana ihamoalena.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

motu: Umui dibamui ai na nega ta asia gwaumui lalo-aniva; bona Dirava dibana ai na kohu asia ḡaima hehuniva.
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

motu: Ena be ai na Keriso ena aposetolo dainai baiama hametaumui diba, to nega ta heimodai asia tahuava, umui emui ai eiava haida ediai.
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

motu: Ai na bogaragimui ai a manauva, natuna e ubudia hahinena na heto.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

motu: Unu a ura henimui tomava dainai, lalomai e urava dia Dirava ena sivarai namo mo baiama henimui, a laumamai danu; badina be a lalokau henimuiva.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

motu: Varavaramai e, emai hekwarahi bona emai hisihisi o lalo taomu ani? Dina hanuaboi a ḡaukarava, baia hahekwarahimui na garina; bena Dirava ena sivarai namo a harorolai henimuiva.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

motu: Umui dibamui, Dirava danu dibana, umui kamonai taumui bogaragimui ai a nohova mai helaḡamai bona mai maoromaoromai ida, asi bebeka-bebekamai.
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

motu: Tama ese natuna e kara henidiamu heḡereḡerena, a hahealo henimuiva, taumui a halova, a haḡanimuiva,
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

motu: Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena ai ba raka helaoreana. Ia ese vada e boirimui, ena basileia bona hairaina baine henimui.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

motu: Una dainai ai ese Dirava ihanamona asia hadokoamu, badina be emai ai o kamonai herevana na o abia dae, dia taunimanima mo emai hereva, a Dirava ena hereva. Una be momokani, bona una hereva be umui kamonai taumui lalomui ai e ḡaukaramu.
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

motu: Varavaramai e, Dirava ena ekalesia oreadia Iudea ai ida vada o heḡereḡere, Keriso Iesu lalonai; badina be Iuda taudia ese idia e hahisidia heḡereḡerena umui emui bese taudia ese vada e hahisimui.
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

motu: Idia ese Lohiabada Iesu e alaia, edia peroveta taudia danu e aladia, bona ai e lulumai. Idia ese Dirava e habaduamu, bona taunimanima e inai henidiamu;
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

motu: ai danu e gwaumai taomu, idau bese taudia mauri herevadia basia harorolai henidia e tomamu. Edia kara dika e haḡuḡurumu; Dirava ena badu na latadiai vada e kau, baine habuadia tari. Lalomai e hekwarahimu daimui ai
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

motu: Varavaramai e, ina nega sisina ai vairamui asia itamu; tau-anida na mai padadia, to laumada na asi padadia; taunabunai ai na a ura lalo-dika vairamui baiama ita lou ato.
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

motu: Bena baia vasi ato; momokani, lau Paulo dala na tahu loulouva baina vasi nato. To Satana ese e laomai ahu.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

motu: Badina be eda Lohiabada Iesu baine lou mai negana ai emai helaro, emai moale, emai heaḡi toana, ia vairanai be dahaka? Umui, ani!
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus + 2:19 TR adds “Christ” * at his coming?

motu: Emai heaḡi bona emai moale badidia na umui.
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

motu: Emai haheauka e ore, bena ato ai raruosi mo Atena ai baia noho,
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

motu: a tadimai Timoteo, Dirava ena hesiai tauna Keriso ena sivarai namo lalonai, a siaia vasi, emui abidadama ai lalomui baine hagoadadia bona taumui baine halodia totona,
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

motu: ini hisihisi lalodiai ta basine marere-marere helaoreana. Badina be dibamui hisi-ani e ahulaida;
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

motu: ta noho hebouva negana ai a hamaoromui heḡaeḡaeva hisi bae vara; benaini, vada e vara, ani!
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

motu: Badina binai, egu haheauka e ore negana ai na siaia vasi, emui abidadama sivaraina baina diba, hedibaḡani tauna ese bema dibaḡanimui bena emai hekwarahi anina bema boio na garina.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

motu: A harihari Timoteo na emui amo vada e lou mai, emui abidadama bona emui lalokau haridia vada e mailai; e tomu, umui ese nega idoinai o lalomaimu mai moalemui ida, bona o uramu ha itamai, ai a uramu baia itamui heḡereḡerena.
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

motu: Varavaramai e, emui abidadama dainai taumai vada eme lo, emai hisihisi bona emai daradoko lalodiai.
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

motu: Umui Lohiabada enai bo gini tutuka-tutukamu dainai ai baia maurimu.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

motu: Dirava ede baia hanamoa toma, emai Dirava vairanai umui a moalelaimuimu moalena idoinai dainai?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

motu: Dina bona hanuaboi a ḡuriḡuri goadagoadamu, vairamui do baia ita a tomu, bena abidadama ai o dabumu ḡaudia baia henimui ḡuḡuru.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

motu: Benaini, Tamada Dirava bona eda Lohiabada Iesu ese do bae hakaumai vasi.
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

motu: Lohiabada ese emui heura-heheni baine havaraia bona baine habadaia; bona baine durumui, taunimanima iboudiai ba lalokau henidia, ai ese umui a lalokau henimuimu heḡereḡerena;
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

motu: bona lalomui baine hagoadadia, bena eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso mai ena helaḡa taudia loḡora ida baema negana ai, Tamada Dirava vairanai ba helaḡa, asi bebeka-bebekamui.
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

motu: Varavaramai e, orena binai: Lohiabada Iesu ladana ai a noimuimu, bona a haḡanimuimu, emui raka dalana bona Dirava ihamoalena dalana, emai ai o abia, ba goadalaia.
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

motu: Badina be haheḡani, Lohiabada Iesu ena amo a abi a henimui, na dibamui.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura binai: ba helaḡa, mata-bodaga kaladia basio kara;
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

motu: bona iboumui ai ba diba, ta ta adavamui bavabidia mai helaḡamui bona mai hematauraimui ida,
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body + 4:4 literally, possess his own vessel * in sanctification and honor,

motu: dia mata-dika ena ura bodagadia daidiai basio abidia, Dirava asi dibadia besedia na heheto.
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

motu: Bona ta ese varavarana basine koia bona basine hurea hanai; badina be ini kara iboudiai davadia ihenina tauna na Lohiabada, ai ese a hamaoromui gunava bona vada a gwauraia hedinaraiva heḡereḡerena.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese vada e boirida, dia mata-dika enai, to helaḡa enai.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

motu: Taunabunai, e dadaraiamu tauna ese dia taunimanima se dadaraidiamu, a ena Lauma Helaḡa e henimuimu Diravana e dadaraiamu.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

motu: Varavara iura-henidia herevadia na basina tore henimui, badina be Dirava ese vada e hadibamui umui ta ta ba heura heheni.
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

motu: Momokani, umui ese varavara iboudiai Makedonia ai o lalokau henidiamu; to, varavaramai e, a noimuimu, una kara ba habadaia.
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

motu: Mai manaumui ida ba noho, sibomui emui ḡaukara ba kara, imamui amo ba ḡaukara, a haḡanimuiva heḡereḡerena.
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

motu: Unu amo murimuri taudia vairadiai ba raka bena idia ese bae matauraimui, bona ḡau ta ai basio dabu. Mase taudia
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

motu: Varavaramai e, a uramu umui na basio daradara mase taudia daidiai; bona daramui basie doko, asi edia helaro taudia na heheto.
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

motu: Ta abia daemu herevana binai: Iesu e mase, ma e tore isi lou. Benaini, Iesu enai e masemu taudia na Dirava ese ia ida baine hakaudia vareai mauri ai.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

motu: Badina be Lohiabada ena hereva a henimuimu, a tomu, Lohiabada ena mai dinana ai tanobada ai ta nohomu tauda ese mase taudia basita laidia oho.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

motu: Badina be Lohiabada na guba amo mai lolona ida baine diho; bona aneru badana danu mai gadona ida bona mai kibi be Dirava ena. Bena Iesu enai e mase taudia na hae tore isi guna;
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

motu: gabeamo, doini tanobada ai ta maurimmu tauda baine abida isi, ori latadiai Lohiabada ida baita hedavari, guba padanai. Bena Lohiabada ida baita noho hebou hanaihanai.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

motu: Benaini, ini hereva daidiai ba hahegoada heheni.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

motu: Varavaramai e, nega bona laḡani herevadia na basia torelai henimui;
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

motu: badina be umui dibamui Lohiabada ena dina na bainema, henao tauna hanuaboi ai e maimu na heto.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

motu: Idia baeto “Maino” bona “Namo” negana ai, hebuatari ese baine lasidia tao, hekamonai ese rogorogo hahinena e lasia taomu na heto; bena basie roho mauri diba.
english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

motu: To, varavaramai e, umui na dia dibura taumui; una dina ese basine lasimui tao, henao tauna na heto.
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

motu: Umui iboumui ai diari memeromui, dina memeromui: ita na dia hanuaboi ena, dia dibura ena.
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

motu: Benaini, basita mahuta, haida e mahutamu na heto; a matada baita hapapa nega iboudiai, baita haheauka.
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

motu: Mahuta taudia be hanuaboi ai e mahutamu, bona kekero taudia be hanuaboi ai e kekeromu.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

motu: A ita, dina tauda, baita haheauka; kemeda ai kamonai bona lalokau baita hadabualai, bona hahemauri helarona na kwarada ḡauna ai baita halaoa.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura ita edai na dia badu; ena ura be hahemauri baita abia, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

motu: Ia na ita daidai e mase, bena nogada ai eiava mahutada ai ia ida baita noho hebou.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

motu: Taunabunai, ba hahealo heheni, ba hahegoada heheni, ina harihari o karamu heḡereḡerena. Sisiba herevadia
english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

motu: Varavaramai e, a noimuimu, bogaragimui ai e ḡaukaramu bona Lohiabada ladana ai e reḡumuimu bona e sisiba henimuimu taudia na ba hakala henidia.
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

motu: Bona edia ḡaukara dainai emui lalokau ai bavabidia dae. Ba hedaro boubou.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be|strong="G2532" * at|strong="G1722" * peace|strong="G1514" * among|strong="G1722" * yourselves|strong="G1438" *.

motu: Varavaramai e, a haḡanimuimu: noho kava taudia ba sisiba henidia, lalo-hesiku taudia ba hagoadadia, manoka taudia ba imudadia, taunimanima iboudiai ba haheauka henidia.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

motu: Ta ese dika na dika basine davalaia. Namo ba gavaia, bamomui edia bona taunimanima iboudiai edia.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

motu: Nega idoinai ba moale.
english: Always rejoice.

motu: Ḡuriguri basio hadokoa.
english: Pray without ceasing.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai daidiai Dirava ba hanamoa; badina be una na Dirava ena ura emui, Keriso Iesu bagunai.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

motu: Lauma na basio habodoa.
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

motu: Peroveta herevadia basio dadarai.
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai ba diba toho: ḡau namona ba kahua tarika-tarika;
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

motu: ḡau dikana ena amo ba raka oho. Hahetoni herevadia
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

motu: Maino Diravilla ese idoimui ai baine hahelaḡamui ḡuḡuru. Lalomui bona laumamui bona taumui ia ese baine dogodia tao, asi bebeka-bebekamui ba noho, ela bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bainema
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: E boirimuimu Tauna na momokani; ia ese baine karaia.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

motu: Varavaramai e, ai daimai ai ba ḡuriḡuri.
english: Brothers, pray for us.

motu: Varavara iboudiai na haherahu helaḡana amo ba hanamodia.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

motu: Lohiabada ladana ai na haḡanimuimu, ina revareva na varavara iboudiai vairadiai ba duahia.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

motu: Eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na emui ai baine mia.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

motu: Ai tatoiosi, Paulo bona Siluano bona Timoteo, ese Tamada Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia ekalesia oreana Tesalonika ai a tore henimuimu:
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

motu: harihari-bada bona maino Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo bavabi. Emai moale na daimui ai
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Varavaramai e, ai na nega idoidiai Dirava a hanamoamu umui daimui ai. Una na maoro, badina be emui abidadama e badamu, bona emui heura-heheni danu bada.
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, + 1:3 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

motu: Taunabunai, ai ese Dirava ena ekalesia oreadia vairadiai a heaḡilaimuimu, badina be e butumui taomu daḡedaḡedia bona hisihisidia lalodiai emui haheauka bona emui abidadama o hahedinaraimu.
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

motu: Ina na Dirava ena hanemaoro namona toana: ena basileia, bagunai o hisihisimu basileiana, lalonai do ba heḡereḡere.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena kara maoromaoro binai, e hahisihisimui taudia davadia hisihisi baine henidia.
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

motu: A umui ai ida hisi ta animu tauda laḡada baita ani, Lohiabada Iesu mai ena aneru siahudia ida guba amo baema negana ai, Iahi hururu-hururuna ai bainema.
english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

motu: Dirava asi dibadia taudia bona Lohiabada Iesu ena sivarai namo asie abia daemu taudia davadia do baine henidia.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

motu: Davadia binai: Lohiabada vairana amo bona ena siahu hairaina amo mase hanaihanai bae abia,
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

motu: ena helaḡa taudia ida heimodai iabma bainema negana ai. Una dina ai abidadama taudia iboudiai bae hoa, badina be emai haroro o abia dae.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

motu: Taunabunai, nega idoidiai a ḡuriḡurimu umui daimui ai, Dirava ese baine haeromui ena boiboi ikamonaina ba heḡereḡere, bona ena siahu amo emui ura namodia iboudiai bona emui kamonai karadia baine haḡuḡuru
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

motu: Bena eda Lohiabada Iesu ladana bae imodaia umui daimui ai, bona umui bae imodaimui ia dainai, iseda Dirava bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso edia harihari-bada heḡereḡerena.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus + 1:12 TR adds “Christ” * may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Varavaramai e, ai a noimuimu, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ma bainema bena ia ida baita hebou dainai
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

motu: lalomui na basie haraḡa-haraḡa; bona, ena be lauma ta eiava hereva ta eiava revareva ta, ai emai na heto, baineto “Lohiabada ena dina vada be gini daemu”, to kudoumui na basie hetaha.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

motu: Ta ese ḡau ta ai basine koimui; badina be una dina na basine gini dae ela bona raka-muri baine vara, bona dika tauna, hahemase natuna, baine hedinarai guna.
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion + 2:3 or, falling away , or, defection * comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

motu: Ia ese dirava ai e halaodiamu bona e toma heni dihomu ḡaudia iboudiai e inai henidiamu, bona e hereadiamu e tomu; Dirava ena helai gabuna helaḡana ai e helaimu, sibona Dirava ai e hahelaomu.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

motu: Asio helalo unemu a, ta noho hebouva negadia ai ini ḡau na hamaorolaimuiva?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

motu: Harihari ia iruna tauna dibamui; baine rua ela bona ena nega korikori ai baine hedinarai.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

motu: Badina be dika na e ḡaukara hehunimu; basine hedinarai ela bona iruna tauna baine heabi oho.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

motu: Una negana ai hari dika tauna baine hedinarai; bena Lohiabada ese baine hahoho henia, baine alaia mase; ia maina diaridiarina ese baine ha-orea.
english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

motu: Hari dika tauna na Satana ena siahu ai bainema, mai siahu koikoidia, mai toa koikoidia mai hoa karadia koikoidia ida.
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

motu: Bona ia ese ena kara gagevagagevadia amo mase dalana ai e rakamu taudia baine koidia; badina be hereva momokani iura-henina ese bema hamauridia, to asie ura henia.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

motu: Badina binai Dirava ese lalodia baine haduhu, hereva koikoi bae abia dae helaoreana.
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

motu: Bena hereva momokani asie abia dae a kara dika e moalelai taudia na baine hahemaoro henidia. Ba gini tutuka-tutuka
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

motu: Varavaramai e, Lohiabada ena lalokau taumui e, ai ese nega idoidiai Dirava a hanamoamu umui daimui ai. Badina be Dirava ese matamana amo e abimui hidi, Lauma ena hahelaḡa bona hereva momokani iabi-daena daidiai mauri bavabia.
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

motu: Una dainai emai sivarai namo amo e boirimui, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso hairaina bavabia helaoreana.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaramai e, ba gini tutuka-tutuka; udumai amo eiava emai revareva ai a hadibamui herevadia na ba kahu tao tarika-tarika.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

motu: Eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bona Tamada Dirava, e lalokau henidamu bona ena harihari-bada ai mia-hanaihanai tauhalona bona helaro-namona vada e henida Diravana, ese
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

motu: lalomui bae hakeru, bona kara namodia bona hereva namodia iboudiai lalodiai bae hagoadamui.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

motu: Varavaramai e, orena binai: ai daimai ai ba ḡuriḡuri, bena Lohiabada ena hereva na baine pere rohoroho, bena hutuma ese bae imodaia, umui ese o imodaiamu heḡereḡerena;
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

motu: bona ura kerere bona ura dika taudia imadia amo baine hamaurimai. Badina be haida mo mai edia abidadama.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

motu: A Lohiabada na vada momokani; bena ia ese baine haginimui tutuka-tutuka, dika amo baine hamaurimui.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

motu: Ai ese Lohiabada lalonai a abidadama henimuimu, a halḡanimui karadia o karamu bona ba kara.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

motu: Lohiabada ese lalomui baine hakaudia, Dirava ena uraheni ai bona Keriso ena haheauka ai.
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

motu: Varavaramai e, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai a haḡanimuimu, e raka havara-havaramu taudia bona emai hahediba herevadia asie badinamu taudia edia amo ba raka oho.
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

motu: Umui dibamui ai ba haḡoimai hari namo; badina be ai na padamui ai asia kara havara-havarava,
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

motu: bona tau ta ana aniani asia ani kavava; dina hanuaboi a ḡaukarava, a hekwarahiva, umui baia hametaumui na garina.
english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

motu: Unu a kara tomava, badina he dia asi emai siahudainai, a umui ese ba haḡoimai helaoreana.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

motu: Dekemui ai a nohova negana ai danu ina haheḡani a henimui, ato “Ta basine ḡaukara, ia na basine aniani”.
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

motu: Haida haridia ame kamonai, bogaragimui ai e raka havara-havaramu, asie ḡaukaramu; unu na gado-dae gado-dae taudia.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

motu: Unu e kara tomamu taudia na Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ladana ai a haḡanidiamu bona a sisiba henidiamu, bae ḡaukara manaumanau, sibodia adia malamala bae ani.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

motu: Varavaramai e, kara namo ikarana ai basio hesiku.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

motu: Tau ta ese ina revareva ai a tore herevadia basine abi dae, ia toana ba itaia, bona bavatoa tabe, bena kopina baine hemarai.
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

motu: To basio inai henia; ba sisiba henia, tadimui na heto.
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

motu: Bena Maino Lohiana ese ena maino baine henimui, nega idoidiai bona gabu iboudiai. Lohiabada ese iboumui ai baine bamomui.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

motu: Ina hahenamo herevana na lau, Paulo, sibogu imagu amo na toreamu. Egu revareva iboudiai toadia na ini na tore tomamu.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

motu: Iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na iboumui ai emui ai baine mia.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu, Ihamaurida Diravana bona Keriso Iesu eda Helaro edia haheḡani daidiai,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ + 1:1 NU reads Christ Jesus and omits the Lord. * our hope,

motu: natugu korikori Iesu ibadinana ai, Timoteo, na tore henimumu: harihari-bada bona hebogahisi bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada ena amo, bavabi. Emu ḡaukara
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

motu: Makedonia nala negana ai, na noimu Efeso ai ba noho taritari nato, haida ba sisiba henidia, hahediba herevadia idaudia basie gwaurai
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

motu: bona gori bona uru ihagaudia basie lalo-hadailai, helaoreana. Badina be unu na hepapahuahu e havaramu, a Dirava ena gaukara, una na abidadama amo e varamu, na asie duruamu.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

motu: Egu hahedua anina korikori be lalokau, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva amo bona lalo hadai maoromaorodia amo bona abidadama korikori amo e varamu.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

motu: Haida ese unu amo vada e raka siri, edia dala vada e reaia, hereva kavakavadia e gwauraimu,
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

motu: sibodia taravatu ihadibalaidia taudia ai baela e tomu. Ḡau tamona, edia hereva anidia bona e gwaurai goadagoadamu ḡaudia na asi dibadia.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

motu: Taravatu be namo, tau ta ese baine ḡaukaralaia maoromaoro negana ai.
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

motu: A baita diba, taravatu vada e haginia, dia kara maoromaoro tauna ena, a kara-havara taudia edia bona gwau-edeede taudia edia, Dirava garina asie garimu taudia edia bona kara dika taudia edia, tamadia sinadia e aladiamu taudia edia bona roroma taudia edia,
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

motu: heuda-hanai taudia edia bona mata-bodaga taudia edia, taunimanima e henaodiamu taudia edia bona koikoi taudia edia, gwau-hamata koikoi taudia edia bona hahediba herevadi momokanidia e inai henimu taudia edia.
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

motu: Unu hahediba herevadia momokanidia be Herea-dae bona Hairai Diravana ena sivarai namo; bona ia ese ena sivarai namo ireḡuna tauna ai vada e halaogu.
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

motu: Siahu e henigu tauna, eda Lohiabada Keriso Iesu, na hanamoamu, badina be e haerogu vada na momokani, bona e abigu hidi ena hesiai taugu.
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

motu: Ena be gunaguna na ere dikava, na daḡedaḡe heniava, ladana na hadikaiava, to e bogagu hisi; badina be mata-lahui ai na karava, asi egu kamonai dainai
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

motu: Bona eda Lohiabada ena harihari-bada vada e bada herea egu ai, abidadama bona lalokau na davaria Keriso Iesu lalonai.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

motu: Ina hereva na momokani, iabi-daena danu namo: Keriso Iesu na kara dika taudia ihamauridia totona tanobada ema. A dika hereana be lau.
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

motu: Badina binai e bogagu hisi: Iesu Keriso ese haheauka idoinai lauegu ai baine hahedinaraia guna, gabeamo bae abidadama henia ela bona mauri hanaihanai bae abia taudia ese lau bae haḡoigu.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

motu: Uru iboudiai edia Pavapava, mase asi dibana, asi ita-itana, sibona mo Dirava, aita matauraia bona aita imodaia, harihari ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

motu: Natugu Timoteo e, ina hahegani na henimumu e gwauraimu gunava herevadia heḡereḡeredia; unu amo tuari namona ba tuarilaia,
english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

motu: abidadama bona lalo-hadai namodia ba kahu tao tarika-tarika. Haida ese vada e kahu nege, e kara edia abidadama vada eha tata kohi na heto.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

motu: Ta be Humenaio, ma ta Alesana; raruosi be Satana vada na henia, bae mata kani, Dirava ladana basie hadikaia lou.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

motu: Taunabunai, egu hahealo gini-gunana binai: noinoi bona ḡuriḡuri be Dirava igamena bona ihanamolaina ba kara, taunimanima daidiai,
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

motu: bona hanua pavapavadia bona lohiadia danu daidiai. Unu amo Dirava ibadinana bona imatauraina lalodiai baita noho namonamo mai mainoda ida.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

motu: Una be namo, Ihamaurida Diravana ihamoalena;
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

motu: badina be ia na e uramu taunimanima iboudiai bae mauri bona hereva momokani bae diba.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

motu: Badina be Dirava na tamona; bona herohemaino tauna danu tamona, Dirava bona taunimanima padadiai, tauna be Keriso Iesu.
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

motu: Ia sibona ena mauri e heni, taunimanima iboudiai idavalaidia, ihamomokanina na nega korikori ai e hedinarai.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

motu: Una dainai haroro tauna bona aposetolo tauna e gwauraigu; na hereva momokanimu, asina koikoimu. Bona idau bese taudia edia hahediba tauna ai e halaogu, kamonai ai bona hereva momokani ai baina hadibadia.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

motu: Taunabunai, lau na uramu gabu iboudiai tatau bae ḡuriḡuri, ima helaḡadia bae dudui isi; basie badu bona basie hepapahuahu.
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

motu: Hahine danu dava maraḡi dabuadia bae hahedokilai, mai manaudia bona mai hematauraidia ida. Huidia basie pani, goldeiava aḡeva mai hairaidia basie heralai, dava bada dabuadia danu basie doki.
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not + 2:9 The word for “not” is the negative particle “μη” which denies an expected idea, as opposed to the usual word for “not” (ου) which denies a fact. Thus “μη” in this context is denying an expected idea (that women can be properly dressed without good works). * with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

motu: A kara namo mo bae heralai: una na maoro, Dirava imatauraina e gwaurai hamatamu hahinedia ediai.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

motu: Hahine na lalo-parara baine tahua, asi reḡereḡena, mai lalo-manauna ida.
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

motu: Hahine na na gwaua tubumu, basine hahediba, bona tau basine gunalaia; ia na asi reḡereḡena baine noho.
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

motu: Badina be Adam e karaia guna, Heva be gabeai.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

motu: Adam danu se koia; hahine hari e koia, bena kara havara ese e butua tao.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

motu: A natuna iabina ai mauri baine davaria, kamonai bona lalokau bona kara helaḡa baine badina mai lalo-pararana ida negana ai.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

motu: Ina hereva na momokani: tau ta ese heitatao dagina baine tahua, ia na dagi namona baine ura henia.
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer + 3:1 or, superintendent, or bishop * desires a good work.

motu: Taunabunai, heitatao tauna na basie habadelaia diba baine namo; ia danu hahine tamona adavana, boga-auka tauna, aonega tauna, kara manada tauna, heabi-dae tauna, hahediba mai dibana tauna.
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

motu: Vine ranuna basine inu momo; basine heatu; baine ḡaukara mai manauna ida; basine heai; moni basine mata ḡaniḡani heni.
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

motu: Iena ruma baine reḡua namonamo, natuna danu baine reḡudia, bae kamonai henia bona bae matauraia;
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

motu: badina be tau ta ese ena ruma korikori taudia basinema reḡudia diba, Dirava ena ekalesia oreana ede bema reḡua toma?
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

motu: Ekalesia tauna matamatana ese ina dagi do basine abia, baine hekokoroku bena diabolo ena hedibaḡani ese baine butua tao na garina.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

motu: Ia harina baine namo murimuri taudia ediai, haida ese bae habadelaia bena diabolo ena idoa ai baine keto na garina.
english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

motu: Diakono danu unu bae heto: bae matau; basie udu mauri; vine ranuna basie inu momo; moni basie mata ḡaniḡani heni;
english: Servants, + 3:8 or, Deacons. * in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

motu: Iesu ibadinana herevadia bae badina mai lalodia ḡoevadia ida.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

motu: Bae dibadia guna; bena ta basinema habadelaidia, diakono karana bema kara.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve + 3:10 or, serve as deacons * if they are blameless.

motu: Adavadia danu bae matau, basie ere dika, bae boga auka, ḡau iboudiai bae heabidadama.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

motu: Diakono na basie hodara; natudia bona edia ruma taudia bae reḡudia namonamo.
english: Let servants + 3:12 or, deacons * be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

motu: Badina be diakono ḡaukarana e karaia namonamomu taudia na taunimanima ese bae matauraidia, bona Keriso Iesu ikamonaina ai bae goada balaheni.
english: For those who have served well + 3:13 or, served well as deacons * gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

motu: Ini hereva na tore henimumu; ḡau tamona na helaromu baina vasi haraḡa na tomu.
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

motu: A bama halahe, ini amo boma diba taunimanima na ede bae kara toma Dirava ena orea lalonai; Mauri Diravana ena ekalesia bunai, hereva momokani duna bona badina.
english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

motu: Momokani, eda Dirava ibadinana herevana hehunina na bada: Tau anina ai e hedinarai; Lauma ese maorona e gwauraia; Aneru ese e itaia; Bese idau-idau bogaradiai e harorolaia; Tanobada ai e kamonai henia; Hairai ai e abia dae.
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God|strong="G2532" * + 3:16 NU replaces “God” with “who” * was|strong="G1510" * revealed|strong="G5319" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * flesh|strong="G4561" *, justified|strong="G1344" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * spirit|strong="G4151" *, seen|strong="G3708" * by|strong="G1722" * angels, preached|strong="G2784" * among|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * nations|strong="G1484" *, believed|strong="G4100" * on|strong="G1722" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * world|strong="G2889" *, and|strong="G2532" * received up|strong="G2532" * in|strong="G1722" * glory|strong="G1391" *.

motu: Lauma ese vada e gwauraia hedinarai, nega gabedia ai haida ese Iesu ibadinana bae rakatania, dibaka laumadia bae kamonai henidia, bona lauma dikadia edia hahediba herevadia bae abi dae.
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

motu: Hari hahediba koikoidia na dibaka taudia haida edia amo. Idia be e kara lalodia na auri siahuna amo e gabu na heto.
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

motu: Idia ese taunimanima e gwaudia taomu, basie headava e tomu, bona aniani haida basie ani. A unu aniani na Dirava ese e kara ḡaudia; kamonai taudia bona hereva momokani dibadia taudia ese Dirava bae hanamoa guna ḡuriḡuri ai, bena bae ani.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese e kara ḡaudia iboudiai nanamo, bona asi taravatudia danu; taunimanima ese Dirava bae hanamoa, bena bae abi.
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena hereva bona taunimanima edia ḡuriḡuri ese eme hahelaḡadia.
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

motu: Ini hereva oi ese varavarada ba hadibalaidia; bena Keriso Iesu ena hesiai tauna namona ai baola, Iesu ibadinana bona hahediba herevadia namodia, vada o badina guna ḡaudia, ese do bae ubumu.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

motu: A taunimanima mo edia gori kavakavadia ba dadarai; Dirava ibadinana mo ba goadalaia.
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

motu: Badina be tau-anina ihagoadana na taina namo, a Dirava ibadinana ese ḡau iboudiai e hanamodiamu; ia hari mai gwauhamatana, ina mauri ena bona mauri gabena ena.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

motu: Ina na hereva momokani; baita abia dae hari namo.
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

motu: Badina bunai ta hekwarahimu bona ta hisihisimu, badina be Mauri Diravana ta abidadama heniamu. Ia na taunimanima iboudiai ihamauridia, to kamonai taudia ediai anina na bada. Ekalesia oreana ireḡuna
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

motu: Ini hereva ba hahedualai, ba hahedibalai.
english: Command and teach these things.

motu: Ta basine dadaraimu oi na eregabe mo dainai. A hereva ai, kara ai, lalokau ai, abidadama ai, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva ai, kamonai taudia edia ihaḡoina tauna ai baola.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

motu: Buka Helaḡa iduahina, haroro, hahediba, ba goadalai ela bona lau baina vasi.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

motu: E henimu herahiana iḡaukaralaina ai basio manoka; peroveta edia hereva heḡereḡeredia ai e henimu, heitatao taudia ese imadia na oi tubuamu ai e ato kau negana ai.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

motu: Ini ḡau ba manadalai, lalomu idoinai ba henidia, bena emu goada na taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai baine hedinarai.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

motu: Sibomu nahuamu ba tohoa, bona emu hahediba herevadia nahuadia ba toho; ba badina tarika-tarika. Unu ba kara toma, bena sibomu ba hahemauri, bona bae kamonai henimu taudia danu ba hamauridia.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

motu: Tau badana ta basio gwau henia; ba hahealo henia tamamu na heto. Eregabe taudia ba hereva henidia tadikakamu na heheto.
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

motu: Hahine badadia ba herwa henidia sinamu na heto. Eregabe hahinedia ba hereva henidia taihumu na heheto, mai lalomu ḡoevaḡoevana ida.
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

motu: Vabu ba matauraidia, bema vabu korikori.
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

motu: To vabu ta bema mai natuna eiava mai tubuna, idia na bae diba, Dirava ibadinana na edia ruma korikori ai bae haḡuḡurua guna, natudia ese tamadia sinadia bae ubudia; badina una be kara namona Dirava vairanai.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is + 5:4 TR adds “good and” * acceptable in the sight of God.

motu: A vabu korikori, asi varavarana, ese Dirava e abidadama heniamu, e noinoi hanaihanaimu, e ḡuriḡuri boimu e ḡuriḡuri ranimu.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

motu: A tau-anina ena moale e tahuamu vabuna, ena be e maurimu, to vada e mase.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

motu: Unu ba hahedua toma, bena asi bebeka-bebekadia bae noho.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

motu: Varavarana se naridiamu bona ena ruma taudia se ubudiamu tauna ese Iesu ibadinana e ḡoreamu; ena dika ese murimuri tauna ena dika e hereaiamu.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

motu: Vabu ladana basio torea ela bona ena vara laḡanidia tauratoi-ahui bae ore. Tau tamona e adavaia hahinena,
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

motu: ena kara namo daidiai e imodaiamu hahinena, natuna e ubudiava hahinena, laolao taudia e abidia daeva hahinena, helaḡa taudia aedia e huriva hahinena, hisihisi taudia e durudiava bona kara namodia iboudial e goadalaiva hahinena, ia hari ladana ba torea.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

motu: A vabu eregabedia ladadia basio tore; badina be edia ura dikadia daidiai Keriso bae dadaraia, bae headava lou.
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

motu: Bena hahemaoro bae abia, badina be edia gwauhamata gunana vada e negea.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

motu: Bona lahedo karadia e manadalaimu, idau ruma idau ruma e dae kau dae kaumu; dia lahedo mo, a udu mauri danu, e gado kau gado kaumu, e ere dikamu.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

motu: Taunabunai, lau na uramu vabu eregabedia na bae headava, natudia bae havaradia, edia ruma taudia bae regudia; bena e inai henidamu tauna na basine habadelaida diba.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

motu: Badina be haida vada e raka oho vaitani, Satana vada e ḡavaia.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

motu: Iesu ibadinana hahinena ta varavarana haida bema vabu, ia ese bema naridia, ekalesia oreana basinema hametaua. Unu amo ekalesia ese vabu korikori baine naridia diba.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

motu: Heitatao taudia ese taunimanima e hakaudia namonamomu na ba matauraidia, bona heitatao taudia haroro bona hahediba e goadalaimu na ba matauraidia bada.
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

motu: Badina be Buka Helaḡa na e gwaumu: Boromakau ese uit e moimoilaiamu negana ai na uduna basio ḡuia. Ma e gwaumu: Ḡaukara tauna ese davana baine abia, una na baine namo.
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” + 5:18 Deuteronomy 25:4 * And, “\+w The|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w laborer|strong="G2040"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* worthy \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w his|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w wages|strong="G3408"\+w*.” * + 5:18 Luke 10:7; Leviticus 19:13 *

motu: Haida ese heitatao tauna bae habadelaia, edia hahebade basio abia dae, ela bona dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi ese bae gwauraia hedinarai.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

motu: Kara dika e manadalai taudia ba gwau henidia, taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai, bena oredia vada bae gari.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

motu: Dirava bona Keriso Iesu bona e gwauraidia hidi anerudia vairadiai na haḡanimumu, ini hahedua herevadia na ba badina; lalomu basio hadaia kava, bona emu hahemaoro basio hagagevaia.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

motu: Imamu na tau ta tubuana ai basio ato kau haraḡa; haida edia kara dikadia basio durudia; sibomu nahuamu ba tohoa, ba ḡoevaḡoeva.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

motu: Ranu kavakava basio inua, a vine ranuna kuri ta ta mo ba inu, bogamu ihanamona, badina be o gorere louloumu.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

motu: Taunimanima haida edia dika vada eme hedinarai, e kara e gunalaidiamu na heto, ela bona hahemaoro gabuna; a haida edia dika e kara e ḡavadiamu na heto.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

motu: Unuhetomana danu kara namodia haida vada e hedinaraimu, a asie hedinaraimu ḡaudia na basie hehuni daudau.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

motu: Maduna henunai hesiai taudia iboudiai na lalodia bae hadai maoro, biagudia bae matauraidia, Dirava ladana bona iseda hahediba herevadia bae hadika na garina.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

motu: Haida biagudia be Iesu ibadinana taudia; to imatauraidia basie hamaraḡia idia na varavara dainai. A isiaidia bae lao heni mai goadadia ida, badina be edia kara namo ese e hanamodiamu taudia na Iesu ibadinana taudia bona edia lalokau. Unu ba hadibadia toma bona unu ba hagoadadia toma.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

motu: A baine hahediba kerere, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena hereva maoromaorodia bona Dirava ibadinana herevadia heḡereḡeredia basine gwaurai,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

motu: tauna na hekokoroku tauna. Ia na ḡau ta asi dibana; henanadai bona hepapahuahu mo e ura heni kavamu. To unu amo e varamu ḡaudia bini: vaḡege, heai, ere-dika, lalo-hadai dikadia,
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

motu: bona lalodia e kereremu bena hereva momokani vada e rakatanimu taudia edia hepapahuahu asi anidia. Idia banava e tomu Dirava ibadinana na kohu idavarina dala.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such. + 6:5 NU omits “Withdraw yourself from such.” *

motu: Momokani, Dirava ibadinana mai lalo-uamona be kohu badana ta.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

motu: Badina be ḡau ta tanobada ai asita mailaia, ḡau ta danu basita laohaia.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

motu: Taunabunai, malamala bona hahedoki baita davari, unu hari laloda ese bae moalelai na namo.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

motu: A taḡa e ura heniamu taudia na hedibaḡani ese e butudia taomu, bona ura kavakavadia bona ura dikadia, idoa na heheto, ese e abidiamu. Taunimanima ihabua-taridia ḡaudia bunu, mase hanaihanai ai e hadonodia masemu.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

motu: Badina be moni iura-henina na dika idoinai ramuna; bona e ura henia bada taudia haida ese Iesu ibadinana vada e rakatania, bona hisihisi momo amo sibodia vada e hedai uru. Hahedua herevadia
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

motu: A oi, Dirava ena hesiai taumu e, unu ḡau iboudiai ba heautani; kara maoromaoro, Dirava ibadinana, kamonai, lalokau, haheauka, lalo-manau, ba ḡava.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

motu: Kamonai ena tuari namona ba tuarilaia. Mauri hanaihanai iabina totona vada e boirimu, bona mauri hanaihanai harina namona vada o gwauraia hedinarai, dibadia taudia hutuma vairadiai; benaini, vada bavabia tao.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai edia mauri e henidiamu Diravana vairanai, bona Keriso Iesu, hereva namona Pontio Pilato vairanai e gwauraia Tauna, vairanai, na haduamumu:
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

motu: ina haheḡani ba badinaia, asi toutouna bona asi ihabadelaina, ela bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso baine hedinarai.
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

motu: Nega namona ai Ḡaubada namo-hereana ese baine hahedinaraia; ia mo sibona Ḡaubada; pavapava edia Pavapava; lohia edia Lohia;
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

motu: ia sibona e noho hanaihanaimu, asi iraka-kahikahina diarina ai e nohomu; ta ese asine itaia, bona ta ese basine itaia diba. Hemataurai bona siahu ienai bae mia hanaihanai. Amen. Hahetoni herevadia
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

motu: Taḡa taudia ina tanobada ai ba haduadia, basie hekokoroku, asie mia daudaumu kohudia na basie laro, a Mauri Diravana mo bae laroa. Ia ese ihamoaleda ḡaudia iboudiai e henida dudukaumu.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

motu: Ba haduadia danu, kara namodia bae kara, edia taḡa ḡaudia bunu. Edia kohu bae hariharilai, heabi-dae taudia ai baela.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

motu: Unu amo edia badi namona bae abia heḡaeḡae, vairada dinadia ena, bena mauri korikori bae abia tao.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

motu: Timoteo e, vada e henimu ḡauna ba gimaia; hereva dikadia bona kavakava herevadia bona aonega koikoidia hepapahuahudia amo ba raka oho.
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

motu: Unu na haida ese vada e abi dae, bena Iesu ibadinana vada e reaia. Harihari-bada emu ai baine mia.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace|strong="G5485" * be|strong="G3588" * with|strong="G3326" * you|strong="G5210" *. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu ena aposetolo taugu, Dirava ena ura dainai, Keriso Iesu lalonai mauri gwauhamatana e miamu heḡereḡerena
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

motu: natugu Timoteo, egu lalokau, na tore henimumu: harihari-bada bona hebogahisi bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo, bona Keriso Iesu eda Lohiabada ena amo bavabi.
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

motu: Dirava na hanamoamu; senegu ese isiaina e lao heniva heḡereḡerena ai, lau ese danu na lao heniamu mai lalogu ḡoevaḡoevana ida. Hanuaboi ai, dina ai, egu ḡuriḡuri ai na hanamoamu bona oi ilalomu asina hadokoamu.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

motu: Emu tai na helalo unelaiamu, bona na ura badamu baina itamu, baina moale bada helaoreana.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

motu: Emu kamonai korikori danu na helalo unelaiamu; una kamonai na gunaguna tubumu hahinena Loi bona sinamu Eunike lalodia ai e miava; lau na tomamu harihari oi lalomu ai e miamu danu. Emu ḡaukara
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

motu: Una dainai na halomumu, Dirava ena herahia ḡauna be imagu tubuamu ai na ato kau negana ai o abia, herahiana ba hahururu-hururua.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese gari laumana se henida, a siahu bona lalokau bona boga-auka laumana e henida.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

motu: Taunabunai, eda Lohiabada igwauraina ai basio hemarai, bona lau e ḡuigu hemaraina basio hemarai. Dika iboudiai lalodiai ba haheauka, sivarai namo dainai, Dirava ese goada baine henimu heḡereḡerena.
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

motu: Ia ese vada e hamaurida, bona boiboi helaḡana amo vada e boirida, dia ila eda kara heḡereḡeredia, a ia sibona ena lalo-hadai bona ena harihari-bada heḡereḡeredia. Una harihari-bada be Keriso Iesu lalonai e henida, seneda do asie vara negana ai,
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

motu: a harihari vada eme hahedinaraia, Keriso Iesu, iseda Hahemauri Tauna, ihahedinaraina ai. Ia ese mase vada e ha-orea; ia ese sivarai namo amo ina mauri bona mauri hanaihanai vada e hadiaridia.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

motu: Una sivarai namo iharorolaina bona iloalaina bona ihahedibalaina tauna ai vada e halaogu.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

motu: Una dainai lau ini na hisihisi tomamu; to asina hemaraimu. Badina be egu abidadama vada dibagu, bona lalogu na hadaiamu, na tomu ia na mai goadana egu ai vada e atoa ḡauna baine gimaia diba, ela bona una dina baine kau.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet|strong="G2532" * I|strong="G1473" * am|strong="G1510" * not|strong="G3756" * ashamed|strong="G1870" *, for|strong="G1063" * I|strong="G1473" * know|strong="G1492" * him|strong="G3588" * whom|strong="G3739" * I|strong="G1473" * have|strong="G2532" * believed|strong="G4100" *, and|strong="G2532" * I|strong="G1473" * am|strong="G1510" * persuaded|strong="G3982" * that|strong="G3754" * he|strong="G2532" * is|strong="G1510" * able|strong="G1415" * to|strong="G1519" * guard|strong="G5442" * that|strong="G3754" * which|strong="G3739" * I|strong="G1473" * have|strong="G2532" * committed|strong="G3866" * to|strong="G1519" * him|strong="G3588" * against|strong="G1519" * that|strong="G3754" * day|strong="G2250" *.

motu: Hereva momokanidia lauegu amo o kamonaiva ba badinadia tarikatarika, Keriso Iesu iabi-daena ai bona irua-henina ai.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

motu: E henimu ḡauna namona ba gimaia, Lauma Helaga, ita laloda e noho henimu Laumana, dainai.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

motu: Dibamu Asia ai e nohomu taudia iboudiai na egu amo e raka oho, Fugelo bona Heremogene danu.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

motu: Onesiforo mai ena ruma taudia ida Lohiabada ese baine bogadia hisi; badina be nega momo ia ese lalogu vada e hamatamataia, bona egu gadea hemaraina se hemarai;
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

motu: a Roma ai e kau negana ai e tahugu goadagoada ema bona e davarigu.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

motu: Lohiabada ena hebogahisi do baine davaria, una dina ai. Isiaigu ede e lao heni tomava Efeso ai vada dibamu.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, Keriso Iesu ena harihari-bada lalonai ba goada.
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

motu: Dibadia taudia hutuma vairadiai vada na hamaorolaimu herevadia na kamonai taudia ba hamaorolaidia; bena idia ese haida ma bae hadibadia.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

motu: Hisihisi lalodiai ba haheauka, Keriso Iesu ena tuari tauna namona na heto.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

motu: Tuari tauna ese ina mauri ḡaudia basine haturialai; unu amo tuari oreana lalonai e abia vareai tauna baine hamoalea.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

motu: Tau ta danu gadara gabuna ai baine goada helulu, a gadara taravatuna basine badinaia, ia ese kwalimu toana basine abia.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

motu: Biru tauna ena hekwarahi davana be uma anina baine abi guna.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

motu: Egu hereva anidia ba haero; badina be Lohiabada ese ḡau iboudiai lalodiai aonega baine henimu.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

motu: Iesu Keriso ba laloa tao: ia na David garana; ia danu mase amo e tore isi. Egu sivarai namo bunai;
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring + 2:8 or, seed * of David, according to my Good News,

motu: bona ia dainai hisi na animu egu iḡui ai, kara dika tauna na heto; ḡau tamona, Dirava ena hereva asie ḡuia.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

motu: Badina binai hisihisi iboudiai na haheaukalaimu, vada e abidia hidi taudia daidiai, Keriso Iesu ena hahemauri bona mia-hanaihanai hairaina bae abi helaoreana.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

motu: Ina hereva be momokani: ia ida tama mase, ia ida danu tama mauri;
english: This saying is trustworthy: “ For|strong="G1063" * if|strong="G1487" * we|strong="G1063" * died|strong="G4880" * with|strong="G2532" * him|strong="G3588" *, we|strong="G1063" * will|strong="G2532" * also|strong="G2532" * live|strong="G4800" * with|strong="G2532" * him|strong="G3588" *.

motu: baita haheauka, ia ida lohia ai baitala; a baita ḡorea, ia ese baine ḡoreda.
english: If we endure, we|strong="G2249" * will|strong="G2532" * also|strong="G2532" * reign|strong="G4821" * with|strong="G2532" * him|strong="G2532" *. If|strong="G1487" * we|strong="G2249" * deny him|strong="G2532" *, he|strong="G2532" * also|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * deny us|strong="G2249" *.

motu: Ena be ita ese basita badinaia, to ia ese ita baine badinada, nega iboudiai; badina be sibona basine heḡore.
english: If we are faithless, he|strong="G1565" * remains|strong="G3306" * faithful|strong="G4103" *; for|strong="G1063" * he|strong="G1565" * can|strong="G1410" *’t deny himself|strong="G1438" *.”

motu: Ini ḡau na ba hahelalolaidia; bona Lohiabada vairanai danu ma ba sisiba henidia, hereva idau-idau basie hepapahuahulaidia, badina be una na asi anina, bona unu amo ikamonaina taudia lalodia bae hadai kerere.
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

motu: Ba goada; Dirava vairanai namomu baine hedinarai, ḡaukara taumu asi emu hemarai, hereva momokani igwaurai-ḡoevana taumu ai baola.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

motu: A hereva dikadia bona kavakava herevadia amo ba raka oho, badina be idia ese dika bae habadaia.
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

motu: Hereva unuhetomadia na e kara toto dikana e ara moru ara morumu na heto. Humenaio bona Fileto na unuheto;
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

motu: raruosi ese hereva momokani vada e reaia, e tomu tore-isi-lou vada e ore vaitani, bena haida edia kamonai vada e uhea hebubu.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

motu: Ḡau tamona, Dirava ena badi aukana vada e ginimu; toana bini, Lohiabada na ena taunimanima iboudiai vada dibana, bona, Lohiabada ladana e hatoamu taudia iboudiai ese kara dika bae heautania.
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” + 2:19 Numbers 16:5 * and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord + 2:19 TR reads “Christ” instead of “the Lord” * depart from unrighteousness.”

motu: Ruma badana lalonai kebere na dia gold bona silver ḡaudia mo, a au bona raro keberedia danu mimia; unu be e matauraimu, a ini be asie matauraimu.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

motu: Tau ta na hari ḡau dikadia amo sibona baine haheḡoeva, ia na e matauraiamu keberena ai bainela, baine helaḡa, biaguna isiaina ilaohenina baine heḡereḡere, ḡaukara namodia iboudiai ikaradia ai baine heḡereḡere.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

motu: Uhau edia lebulebu karadia ba heautani. Ini na ba ḡava: kara maoromaoro, abidadama, lalokau, maino. Lalodia ḡoevadia ai Lohiabada ladana e hahaneamu taudia ida ba hebamo heheni.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

motu: Henanadai kavakavadia bona mata-lahuidia ihedorilaidia ba dadarai; dibamu idia ese heai e havaramu.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

motu: Lohiabada ena hesiai tauna na basine heai, a taunimanima iboudiai baine gado namo henidia, baine hahediba ḡoevaḡoeva, baine haheauka.
