english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

motu: E gwaua tubumu taudia baine sisiba henidia mai manauna ida; readia Dirava ese baine hahelalodia kerehai, bena hereva momokani bae diba.
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

motu: Bena, ena be diabolo ese vada e abidia mauri ena ura ikarana, to bae noga, ena idoa amo bae roho mauri.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

motu: Ina danu ba diba, dina gabedia ai nega dikadia do bae vara.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

motu: Badina be taunimanima na sibodia bae heura heni; moni bae mata ḡaniḡani henia; bae heaḡi; bae hekokoroku; bae ere dika; tamadia sinadia bae gwau edeede henidia; basie hahenamo; basie helaḡa;
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

motu: lalokau basie diba; bae tudaga; bae habade koikoi; bae lebulebu; bae daḡedaḡe; kara namo basie ura heni;
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

motu: bae tao tore; bae kara kava; bae hereva kava; lebulebu karadia bae ura heni bada, Dirava bae ura henia maraḡi;
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

motu: Dirava ibadinana na koukouna mo bae abia, a anina bae dadaraia. Ini iboudiai edia amo ba raka oho.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

motu: Idia haida na ruma lalodiai e rau vareaimu, hahine kavakavadia e ḡuidiamu; unu hahine na edia kara dika ese e hametaudiamu, bona edia ura dikadia ese e hakaudia kereremu,
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

motu: nega idoinai e hahediba tohomu, a hereva momokani asie diba kaumu.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

motu: Iane bona lambre ese Mose e laoa ahu na heto, idia ese hereva momokani e laoa ahumu; lalodia eme dika bona edia kamonai na koikoi.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

motu: A basie raka daudau, badina be edia kavakava na taunimanima iboudiai vairadiai baine hedinarai, unu raruosi heḡereḡeredia.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

motu: A oi ese egu hahediba herevadia vada o diba vaitani; egu kara, egu ura, egu abidadama, egu hebogahisi, egu lalokau, egu haheauka, vada dibamu.
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

motu: Dibamu danu daḡedaḡe bona hisihisi ese e butugu tao, Antioka ai bona Ikonio ai bona Lustra ai. Daḡedaḡe idau-idau na hisihisilaiva; to idoidiai lalodia amo Lohiabada ese e harologu mauri.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

motu: Oibe, Keriso Iesu lalonai Dirava ibadinana bae ura taudia iboudiai na daḡedaḡe do bae hisihisilai.
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

motu: Bona kara dika taudia bona koikoi taudia ese edia kara dika bona edia koikoi bae habada; idia ese haida bae koidia bona haida ese idia bae koidia.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

motu: A oi ese vada o diba bona vada o abi dae herevadia na ba kahu tarikatarika; daidia ese e hadibalaimu vada dibamu.
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

motu: Maraḡimu negana ema, revareva helaḡadia vada o manadalai; idia ese bae ha-aonegamu ela bona hahemauri ba davaria, Keriso Iesu ikamonai-henina lalonai.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

motu: Revareva helaḡadia iboudiai na Dirava ena heuda-roha dainai e tore; idia na mai siahudia taunimanima ihadibadia, bona ihahelalo-kerehaidia, bona isisiba-henidia, bona kara maoromaoro ai ihakaulaidia.
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and + 3:16 or, Every writing inspired by God is * profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

motu: Unu amo Dirava ena tau baine ḡoeva dae, bona kara namo iboudiai ikaradia ai baine kwalimu.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

motu: Dirava vairanai na haduamumu, bona Keriso Iesu vairanai danu; ia ese mauri taudia bona mase taudia be hahemaoro henidiamu. Ena mai bona ena basileia daidiai danu na haduamumu:
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

motu: hereva iharorolaina ai ba goada balaheni, nega namodia ai bona nega dikadia ai; taunimanima ba hahelalodia kerehai, ba sisiba henidia, ba halodia, ba hadibadia mai haheaukamu ida.
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

motu: Badina be negana do baine gini dae, hahediba herevadia maoromaorodia basie abi dae; edia ura kavakavadia daidiai haroro taudia hutuma bae abidia; taiadia do bae hemaihemai.
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

motu: Taiadia ese hereva momokani enai bae kudima, a gori bae hakala henidia.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

motu: A oi na ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ba boga auka, hisihisi ba haheaukalai, sivarai namo iharorolaina tauna ena kara ba karaia, emu hesiai karana ba haḡuḡurua.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

motu: Badina be lau raragu na ina harihari be hebubumu; egu raka-oho negana vada be kaumu.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

motu: Tuari namona vada na tuarilaia; egu heau-helulu vada e ore; kamonai karana vada na haḡuḡurua.
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

motu: Harihari egu kara maoromaoro ena kwara-havava ḡauna vada e heḡaeḡae; una dina ai Lohiabada ese baine henigu; badina be ia na Hahemaoro Tauna, mai ena kara maoromaoro. Bona dia lau mo, to ena mai e laroamu taudia iboudiai danu baine henidia. Hahetoni herevadia
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

motu: Ba goada. Dekegu baoma haraḡa.
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

motu: Badina be Dema ese vada eme rakatanigu, ina tanobada eme ura henia dainai, Tesalonika vada ela. Kreske be Galatia vada ela. Tito be Dalamatia vada ela.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

motu: Luka mo sibona dekegu ai. Mareko bavabia, raruosi baoma, badina be ia na egu ḡaukara ai baine heduru diba.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

motu: Tukiko vada na siaia, Efeso ela.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

motu: Egu hetaru Troa ai na rakatania, Kapo dekenai, o maimu negana ai bavabia kau; buka danu; a hereana be kopi, toretore ḡaudia.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

motu: Alesana, auri labora-labora iḡaukaralaina tauna, ese eme hadikagu herea; Lohiabada ese ena kara davana do baine henia.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

motu: Nahuana ba tohoa, badina be eda hahediba herevadia vada e gwau lubu hereamu.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

motu: Egu kota gini-gunana ai, ta ese se kahagu; iboudiai ese e rakatanigu. Madi, hahebade latadiai basine kau baine namo.
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

motu: A Lohiabada ese e kahagu bona e hagoadagu, lau daigu ai sivarai namo baine hedinarai ḡoevaḡoeva bona bese iboudiai bae kamonaia helaoreana. Leona ududia amo vada e hamaurigu.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

motu: Lohiabada ese dika iboudiai amo baine harohogu mauri, guba ai. Heimodai baita henia hanaihanai. Amen.
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

motu: Priska bona Akula bona Onesitoro ena ruma taudia ba hahenamo henidia.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

motu: Erasto na dounu Korinto ai e nohomu; a Trofimo na Mileto ai na rakatania, mai ena gorere.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

motu: A kara haraḡa, keru negana do basine kau ai baoma. Eubulo bona Pude bona Lino bona Klaudia bona varavarada iboudiai ese e hahenamo henimumu.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

motu: Lohiabada ese laumamu baine bamoa. Harihari-bada emu ai baine mia.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, Dirava ena hesiai tauna bona Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo, Dirava ena abi-hidi taudia edia abidadama idurulaina bona Dirava ibadinana herevadia momokanidia ihadibalaidia totodia e siaigu,
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

motu: mauri hanaihanai bae laroa helaoreana. Seneda do asie vara negana ai, koikoi asi dibana Diravana ese una mauri hanaihanai e gwauraia hamata,
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

motu: ema bona ena nega korikori ai ena gwauhamata anina vada e hahedinaraia, ihamaurida Diravana ena hahedua dainai na harorolaiamu sivaraina namona lalonai.
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

motu: Tito, natugu korikori eda abidadama tamona lalonai, na tore henimumu: harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Keriso Iesu eda Hahemauri Tauna ena amo, bavabi. Ekalesia ireḡuna
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

motu: Krete ai na rakatanimu badina binai: do asie maoro ḡaudia na ba hamaoromaoro, bona heitatao taudia danu hanua hanua lalodiai ba gwauraidia hidi, egu hahedua heḡereḡerena.
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

motu: Asi edia kara dika taudia, adavadia tamodia taudia, natudia be Iesu ibadinana memerodia, asi edia lebulebu bona asi edia gwau-edeede, bavabidia hidi.
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

motu: Badina be heitatao tauna na basie habadelaia diba baine namo; ia na Dirava ena hesiai tauna. Ia na basine daḡedaḡe; basine badu haraḡa; kekero muramuradia basine inu momo; basine heatu; moni basine mata ḡaniḡani henia.
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

motu: A idau taudia baine abidia dae; kara namo baine ura henia; sibona baine hegwahi baine kara maoromaoro; baine helaḡa; baine boga auka.
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

motu: Hereva momokani baine abi tarika-tarika, vada e hadibalaia heḡereḡerena; unu amo baine heḡereḡere, hahediba herevadia maoromaorodia amo taunimanima lalodia baine hagoadadia bona hereva momokani e laoahumu taudia baine nanaudia. Hahediba koikoi
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

motu: Hutuma na e gwau edeedemu, e hereva kava hereva kavamu, taunimanina e koidiamu. Peritome taudia na una kara ai e hereamu.
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

motu: Ba gwaudia tubu, ududia bae hakapu; badina be iduhu haida vada e hahekwakwanaidia, hahediba herevadia koikoidia vada e hadibalaidia, moni idavarina totona.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

motu: Idia sibodia edia peroveta tauna ta ini e gwau toma: Krete taudia na nega idoinai koikoi taudia, uda boromadia dikadia na heheto, boga mase taudia.
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

motu: Una hereva na momokani. Taunabunai ba gwau henidia goadagoada, sivarai namo bae abia dae maoromaoro;
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

motu: a Iuda taudia edia gori bona hereva momokani vada e rakatania taudia edia haheḡani basie abi dae.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai be ḡoḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva, lalo-ḡoevaḡoeva taudia ediai. A lalo-miro taudia ediai bona asi edia kamonai taudia ediai ḡau ta dia ḡoeva; idia daradia bona lalodia na mimiro.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

motu: Idia na Dirava dibadia e tomamu, a ḡau be edia kara ese e ḡoreamu; idia na lalomase taudia, gwau-edeede taudia, kara namodia iboudiai lalodiai idia na asi goadadia.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

motu: A oi na hahediba herevadia maoromaorodia ba hahedibalai.
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

motu: Tatau badadia ba hadibadia, bae boga auka, bae matau, Ialodia bae hadai maoromaoro, kamonai ai bona lalokau ai bona haheauka ai bae gini tutukatutuka.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

motu: Hahine badadia danu ba hadibadia, bae noho helaḡa taudia heḡereḡeredia, basie hahebade koikoi, vine ranuna basie inu momo, kara namo bae hahedibalai.
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

motu: Bena idia edia amo eregabe hahinedia ese adavadia bona natudia bae lalokau henidia;
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

motu: lalodia bae hadai maoromaoro; basie mata dika; ruma ai bae ḡaukara; bae hebogahisi; adavadia eredia bae kamonai. Unuhetomana ta ese Dirava ena hereva basine hadikaia.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

motu: Eregabe taudia danu ba haduadia, bae boga auka.
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

motu: Bona oi sibomu kara namodia ba hahedinarai, bae haḡoimu helaoreana. Emu hahediba herevadia bae maoromaoro; bona bae matau.
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

motu: Bena emu hereva bae maoromaoro dainai ta ese basine habadelaimu diba; bona heiri-heiri tauna baine hemarai, badina be dikada basine gwaurai diba.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

motu: Hesiai taudia na biagudia bae kamonai henidia, ḡau iboudiai lalodiai bae hamoaledia. Basie heiri-heiri henidia;
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

motu: edia ḡau basie henao; kamonai karadia bae hahedinarai. Unu amo ḡau iboudiai lalodiai Ihamaurida Diravana ena hahediba herevadia anidia bae hahedinarai.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena harihari-bada vada eme hedinarai, taunimanima iboudiai ihamauridia;
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

motu: bona vada e hadibadamu, e tomu Dirava idadaraina karadia bona tanobada ena lebulebu karadia baita rakatani, ina tanobada ai baita noho migomigo, baita kara maoromaoro, Dirava baita badinaia.
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

motu: Helaro namona baita naria: Dirava badana bona Ihamaurida Tauna Iesu Keriso hairaidia ihahedinaraidia bunai.
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

motu: Ia na sibona vada e heni, ita daidai, kara dika iboudiai edia amo baine ruhada nege, orea ta baine haḡoevaia sibona ena, kara namo baine goadalai oreana.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

motu: Ini ḡau ba herevalai; taunimanima ba haduadia bona ba sisiba henidia mai siahumu ida. Tau ta ese basine dadaraimu.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

motu: Ba hahelalodia une, hahemaoro taudia bona siahu taudia bae kamonai henidia, bona edia haheḡani bae badina. Bae noho haḡaeḡae, kara namo iboudiai ikaradia.
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

motu: Tau ta dikana basie gwauraia; basie heai; bae manau; taunimanima iboudiai bae kara namo henidia.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

motu: Badina be ita danu gunaguna mai eda kavakava bona mai eda gwau-edeede bona e hakauda kerere; ura dikadia bona moale idau-idau ta badinava; lalo-dika ai bona vaḡeḡe ai ta nohova; haida ese ita e inai henida, bona ita ese idia ta inai henidia.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

motu: A Ihamaurida Diravana ena gado-namo bona ena uraheni taunimanima edai e hedinarai negana ai,
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

motu: ia ese e hamaurida, dia ita eda kara maoromaoro daidiai, to iena hebogahisi dainai, vara lou ena hehuri ai bona Lauma Helaḡa ena hahematamata ai.
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

motu: Una hahemauri na ia ese latadai vada e seia dobi, Ihamaurida Tauna Iesu Keriso bagunai.
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

motu: Taunabunai, iena harihari-bada ese maoroda baine gwaurai, bona ia dihina ai baine halaoda, mauri hanaihanai helarona heḡereḡerena.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

motu: Una na hereva momokani; bena na uramu unu hereva ba gwaurai goadagoada, bena Dirava vada e abidadama heniamu taudia na nahuadia bae toho, kara namodia bae badina. Ini ḡau be nanamo bona mai anidia, taunimanima ediai.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

motu: A henanadai kavakavadia iherevalaidia, bona uru ihagaudia, bona heai, bona taravatu hepapahuahudia, amo ba gini siri; badina be idia na asi anidia bona kavakava.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

motu: Heiri-heiri tauna be nega gini-gunana bona nega iharuana ba sisiba henia, murinai ba dadaraia.
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

motu: Dibamu una tau na mai ena kerere bona mai ena dika; ia sibona ese ena dika vada e hahedinaraiamu. Hahetoni herevadia
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

motu: Aretema eiava Tukiko baina siaia vasi negana ai, dekegu baoma haraḡa Nikapoli ai; badina be keru negana ai unuseni ai baina noho na tomamu.
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

motu: Sena, taravatu tauna, bona Apolo, na edia laolao dalana ba lailaia, ḡau ta ai basie dabu.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

motu: Varavarada danu ḡaukara namodia bae manadalai, dabu taudia bae hanamodia, asi huahuadia bae noho na garina.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

motu: Bamogu iboudiai iniseni ai ese e hahenamo henimumu. Iesu ibadinana ai e lalokau henimaimu taudia ba hahenamo henidia. Harihari-bada be umui iboumui ai emui ai baine mia.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace|strong="G5485" * be|strong="G3956" * with|strong="G3326" * you|strong="G5210" * all|strong="G3956" *. Amen.

motu: Lau Paulo, Keriso Iesu dainai abi-mauri tauna, varavarada Timoteo ida, raruosi ese emai lalokau Filemona, ai ida ta ḡaukara heboumu taumu, a tore henimumu.
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

motu: Oi bona taihumai Apia, bona bamomai Arekipo, ia ida a tuari heboumu, bona ekalesia oreana emu ruma ai e heboumu, a tore henimuimu, a tomu:
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

motu: Harihari-bada bona maino, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena amo, bavabi.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Na ḡuriḡurimu negadia iboudiai oi na lalomumu, bona Dirava na hanamoamu;
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

motu: badina be na kamonaimu oi ese Lohiabada Iesu o lalokau heniamu bona o abidadama heniamu, helaḡa taudia danu o lalokau henidiamu bona o abidadama henidiamu.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

motu: Taunabunai egu ḡuriḡuri be oiemu abidadama huahuana baine dobi idia ediai, Keriso lalonai ita edai e miamu ḡaudia namodia iboudiai bae diba.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

motu: Una dainai, tadigu e, name moale bada bona taugu danu eme lo, emu lalokau dainai, badina be helaḡa taudia lalodia vada o hakeru.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

motu: Taunabunai, Keriso ladana ai bama haḡanimu diba, ede boma kara toma,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

motu: to lalokau dainai asina haḡanimumu, na noimumu hari. Oibe, lau Paulo, tau badana bona Keriso Iesu ena abi mauri tauna,
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

motu: na nounumu natugu Onesimo, iḡui ai na nohomu ai tamana ai na hahelao merona, dainai.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains, + 1:10 Onesimus means “useful”. *

motu: Gunaguna ena hesiai ilao-henina na dika oiemu ai, a harihari ena hesiai ilao-henina na namo, oiemu ai bona lauegu ai.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

motu: Na siaia loumu, be vasimu, bona lalogu idoinai danu ia ida.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

motu: Bena egu ura be bama dogoa tao, sivarai namo ena iḡui ai isiaigu bema lao heni, oi ibolomu.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

motu: To asina uramu kara ta baina karaia, oi do so gwau maoro negana ai; egu ura be emu kara namo na dia lauegu hahedua dainai a oiemu ura dainai bema vara.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

motu: Badina bunai, readia, una nega sina oiemu amo e heabi oho, bavabia hanaihanai helaoreana:
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

motu: dia hesiai tauna, a hesiai e hereaiamu tauna, varavara bona lalokau, lauegu bona oiemu, tau-anina ai bona Lohiabada lalonai.
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

motu: Lau be oi turamu o tomamu; benaini, ia bavabia dae, lau boma abigu dae heḡereḡerena.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

motu: A ia ese e hadikamu eiava emu ai e abi torehai readia: benaini, ena abi-torehai egu ai ba gwauraia.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

motu: Lau Paulo sibogu imagu ai na toreamu: davana idoinai do baina henimu. Asina tomu oi ese laumamu egu ai o abia doa;
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

motu: ḡau tamona, tadigu e, mani ba hamoalegu Lohiabada lalonai, lalogu ba hakerua Keriso lalonai.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

motu: Lalogu na e tomamu ba kamonai henigu dainai na tore henimumu; dibagu na gwauraimu karadia ba hereadia.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

motu: Vadivadi daiutuna ta bavabia heḡaeḡae lauegu; badina be name helaro emu ḡuriḡuri daidiai egu vasi dalana baine helailai.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

motu: Bamogu Epafra, Keriso Iesu dainai lau ida iḡui ai a nohomu, ese e hahenamo henimumu.
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

motu: Mareko bona Aristako bona Dema bona Luka, lau ida a ḡaukara heboumu, ese danu e hahenamo henimumu.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada laumamu ai baine mia.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

motu: Hereva taidia taidia amo, idau dala idau dala ai, Dirava, ese idau nega ai peroveta taudia ududia amo seneda e hereva henidiava;
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

motu: a ini dina dokodia ai ia Natuna ena amo ita vada e hereva henida. Natuna bunai ḡau iboudiai vada e henia, ia ahuna; iena amo danu tanobada idoinai vada e kara.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

motu: Ia bunai Dirava hairaina diari-diarina bona anitarana ihaheḡereḡerena; ia bunai ḡau iboudiai e abi isimu, ena siahu herevadia amo; ia sibona ese eda kara dika e haḡoeva vaitani, bena Herea Mikamika idibana kahana ai vada e helai, guba ai. Iesu ese aneru e hereadiamu
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

motu: Ia ese aneru vada e hereadia, vada e henia ladana ese idia ladadia e hereadiamu heḡereḡerena.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

motu: Edena nega ai Dirava ese aneru ta e hereva henia, eto, Oi na lau natugu; Hari dina ai vada na abimu. Eiava Lau na ia tamana ai bainala; Ia danu lau natugu ai bainela.

motu: Ḡau tamona, idia iboudiai na hesiai laumadia, ani? Mauri bae abia taudia isiaidia ilaohenidia totona e siaidiamu.
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

motu: Una dainai, ta kamonai herevadia nahuadia baita toho, nega ta baita huretani garina.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

motu: Badina be aneru ese e gwaurai herevadia bema momokani, bona kara havara iboudiai bona gwau-edeede iboudiai bema mai davadia korikoridia,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

motu: ita na ede baitama roho mauri toma, hahemauri unu-badana baitama dadaraia negana ai? Hahemauri bunai Lohiabada ese e gwauraia guna; bena iena amo e kamonai taudia ese vada e hamomokania ita eda.
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

motu: Bona Dirava danu vada e hahedinaraia, toa ai, hoa karadia ai, siahu karadia idau-idau ai, bona Lauma Helaḡa ena herahia ai, ena ura heḡereḡerena.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

motu: Badina be mauri gabena, ai ese a herevalaiamu, na dia aneru se henidia bae biagua.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

motu: Buka itorena tauna ta vada e hereva, eto, Taunimanima be dahaka oi ese ia o laloamu? Taunimanima natuna be daika oi ese ia o dosiamu?
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “ What|strong="G5101" * is|strong="G1510" * man|strong="G5100" *, that|strong="G3754" * you|strong="G3754" * think|strong="G5100" * of|strong="G5207" * him|strong="G1980" *? Or|strong="G2228" * the|strong="G1161" * son|strong="G5207" * of|strong="G5207" * man|strong="G5100" *, that|strong="G3754" * you|strong="G3754" * care for|strong="G3754" * him|strong="G1980" *?

motu: Oi ese o karaia, aneru ese sisina mo ia e hereaiamu; Hairai mai hemataurai ida oi ese kwarana o havavalaia. Oi imamu ai o kara ḡaudia iboudiai vada o henia, baine biagudia;
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You|strong="G2532" * crowned|strong="G4737" * him|strong="G2532" * with|strong="G3844" * glory|strong="G1391" * and|strong="G2532" * honor|strong="G5092" *. + 2:7 TR adds “and set him over the works of your hands” *

But|strong="G1161" * now|strong="G1161" * we|strong="G1063" * don’ t|strong="G3588" * yet|strong="G1161" * see|strong="G3708" * all|strong="G3956" * things|strong="G3956" * subjected|strong="G5293" * to|strong="G1722" * him|strong="G3588" *.

motu: A nega sisina mo aneru ese e hereaia tauna, Iesu, harihari ta itaiamu, mase hisihisina dainai hairai mai hemataurai ida kwarana vada e havavalaia; Dirava ena harihari-bada ai mase mamina e abia, taunimanima iboudiai daidiai.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

motu: Ina na diaḡau namona, ena, bona ena amo, ḡau iboudiai e havaramu Diravana na, ia natuna loḡora hairai ai bema hakaudia vareai totona ese, edia Hahemauri Tauna na hisihisi amo bema hahereaia dae.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

motu: Badina be hahelaḡa tauna bona e hahelaḡadia taudia na iduhu tamona; una dainai ia na asi ena hemarai ia tadina baine gwauraidia.
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers, + 2:11 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” *

motu: Eto, Oi ladamu baina gwauraia, tadigu vairadiai; Hebou lalonai baina hanamomu egu ane ai.
english: saying, “ I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G1473" * declare your|strong="G1722" * name|strong="G3686" * to|strong="G3004" * my|strong="G1722" * brothers. Among|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * congregation|strong="G1577" * I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G1473" * sing|strong="G5214" * your|strong="G1722" * praise|strong="G5214" *.” + 2:12 Psalms 22:22 *

motu: Ma eto, Baina abidadama henia. Ma eto, Lau o ina, Bona natugu, Dirava ese vada e henigu, bini.
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.” + 2:13 Isaiah 8:18 *

motu: Benaini, natuna be mai hidiodia bona mai raradia dainai ia ese danu tau-anina e abia idia heḡereḡeredia; mase amo ia ese mase biaguna, una na diabolo, baine hadarerea,
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

motu: bona edia mauri dinadia iboudiai mase garina ese e ḡuidiamu taudia baine ruhadia nege helaoreana.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

motu: Momokani, ia na dia aneru se kahadia, a Abrahamgarana hari.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring + 2:16 or, seed * of Abraham.

motu: Una dainai ia na ḡau iboudiai lalodiai tadina ida e heḡereḡere, hahelaḡa tauna badana ai bainela, mai ena hebogahisi bona mai ena kara maoromaoro Dirava ena ḡaukara lalonai, taunimanima edia dika iabi-ohona.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

motu: Ia na hedibaḡani e mamiamu taudia idurudia mai dibana, badina be ia sibona ese hisihisi bona hedibaḡani mamidia e abi dainai.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu helaḡamui e, umui danu Dirava ena boiboi ai e lalomui kau taumui, Iesu ba haeroa. Eda kamonai ai, ia na Dirava ese e siaia, eda hahelaḡa tauna badana.
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

motu: E siaia Diravana na ia ese e kamonai henia, Mose ese Dirava ena bese lalonai e kamonai henia heḡereḡerena.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

motu: A ia ese hairai badana vada e abia, Mose ese hairai maraḡina e abia. Una danu namo; heḡereḡerena be ruma ikarana tauna e matauraia badamu, a e karaia rumana e matauraia maraḡimu.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

motu: Badina be ruma iboudiai na mai ikaradia taudia, a ḡau iboudiai ikaradia be Dirava.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

motu: Mose ese Dirava ena bese idoinai lalonai hesiai ḡaukarana e karaia ḡoevaḡoeva mai kamonaina ida, do bae gwaurai ḡaudia ihahedinaraidia.
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

motu: A Keriso ese Dirava ena bese e biagua mai kamonaina ida, badina be ia na natuna dainai. lta na iena bese, eda haheauka bona eda helaro moaledia ta badinamu dainai.
english: but Christ + 3:6 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

motu: Badina bunai Lauma Helaḡa na e tomu, Hari dina ai gadona boma kamonai,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “ Today|strong="G4594" * if|strong="G1437" * you|strong="G1437" * will|strong="G3004" * hear|strong="G5456" * his|strong="G3588" * voice|strong="G5456" *,

motu: Lalomui basio ha-auka, Dirava o dadaraia negana ai na heto, Hedibagani dinana ai tano ḡaḡaena ai na heto;
english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * day|strong="G2250" * of|strong="G2250" * the|strong="G1722" * trial|strong="G3986" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * wilderness|strong="G2048" *,

motu: Una negana ai senemui ese e tohoguva, Bona laḡani hari-ahui lalodiai egu kara e itava.
english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and|strong="G2532" * saw|strong="G3708" * my|strong="G3708" * deeds|strong="G2041" * for|strong="G1722" * forty|strong="G5062" * years|strong="G2094" *.

motu: Badina bunai, una uru na badu heniava, Nato “Vaevae laJodia e kereremu, Egu dala danu asi dibadia.”
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" *, ‘ They|strong="G2532" * always err|strong="G4105" * in|strong="G2532" * their|strong="G2532" * heart|strong="G2588" *, but|strong="G1161" * they|strong="G2532" * didn’ t|strong="G3588" * know|strong="G1097" * my|strong="G1473" * ways|strong="G3598" *.’

motu: Bena egu badu ai na gwau hamata, Nato “Egu laḡa-ani ai basie raka vareai”.
english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘ They|strong="G3588" * will|strong="G1473" * not|strong="G1487" * enter|strong="G1525" * into|strong="G1519" * my|strong="G1722" * rest|strong="G2663" *.’” + 3:11 Psalms 95:7-11 *

motu: Varavaragu e, nahuamui ba toho, ta ese lalona baine hadaia kerere, asi ena kamonai, bena Mauri Diravana baine rakatania na garina.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

motu: A daba daba idoidiai ba hahealo heheni, doini “Hari dina” ta gwauraiamu negana ai, kara dika ena koikoi ese lalomui baine ha-auka na garina.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

motu: Badina be ita na Keriso bamona, una dainai eda heabidadama baita badinaia tarikatarika, matamana amo ela bona dokona.
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

motu: Vada e hereva heḡereḡerena eto, Hari dina ai gadona boma kamonai Lalomui basio ha-auka, Dirava o dadaraia negana ai na heto.
english: while it is said, “ Today|strong="G4594" * if|strong="G1437" * you|strong="G5210" * will|strong="G3004" * hear|strong="G5456" * his|strong="G1722" * voice|strong="G5456" *, don’ t|strong="G3588" * harden|strong="G4645" * your|strong="G1437" * hearts|strong="G2588" *, as|strong="G5613" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * rebellion.” + 3:15 Psalms 95:7-8 *

motu: Daidia gadona e kamonai, to ena badu e havaraia? Mose ese Aigupto amo e hakaudia lasi taudia iboudiai, ani?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

motu: Bona laḡani hari-ahui e badu henidiava taudia be daidia? Kara dika taudia, tano ḡaḡaena ai e mase ore, ani.
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

motu: Ma daidia ia ese e gwau henidia hamata, ena laḡa-ani ai basie raka vareai eto? Cwau-edeede taudia, ani?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

motu: Taunabunai vada tame diba, asi edia kamonai dainai asie raka vareai.
english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

motu: Ena gwauhamata na doini mia, ena laḡa-ani ai baita raka vareai eto; to eda gari na umui haida bae itamu o ḡava tuna.
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

motu: Badina be sivarai namo vada e harorolai henida, idia heḡereḡeredia; to e kamonai herevadia ese asie hanamodia, badina be e kamonai taudia ese asie abi dae.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

motu: Badina be ita kamonai tauda na ena laḡa-ani ai ta raka vareaimu; ena hereva heḡereḡerena, eto, Egu badu ai na gwau hamata, Nato “Egu laḡa-ani ai basie raka vareai”. Ḡau tamona, iena ḡaukara be tanobada ikarana negana ai e kara ḡuḡuru.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” + 4:3 Psalms 95:11 * although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

motu: Badina be buka ta ai dina ihahituna e herevalaia, eto, Dirava na dina ihahituna ai ena ḡaukara iboudiai amo e laḡa ani.
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;” + 4:4 Genesis 2:2 *

motu: Ma ina gabu ai eto, Egu laḡaani ai basie raka vareai.
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.” + 4:5 Psalms 95:11 *

motu: Benaini, haida do bae raka vareai; to sivarai namo e harorolai henidia guna taudia na edia gwau-edeede dainai asie raka vareai.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

motu: Una dainai ia ese dina ta ma e abia hidi, “Hari dina” e gwauraia; bena nega daudau vada e lao bubuni David ese ena hereva ma e gwauraia loumu, e tomu, Hari dina ai gadona boma kamonai, Lalomui na basio ha-auka.
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “ Today|strong="G4594" * if|strong="G1437" * you|strong="G5210" * will|strong="G5100" * hear|strong="G5456" * his|strong="G1722" * voice|strong="G5456" *, don’ t|strong="G3588" * harden|strong="G4645" * your|strong="G1437" * hearts|strong="G2588" *.” + 4:7 Psalms 95:7-8 *

motu: Badina be Iosua ese laḡa-ani bema henidia, Dirava ese nega daudau murinai dina ta ma basinema herevalaia.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

motu: Taunabunai, dina helaḡa ena laḡa-ani na doini mia, Dirava ena orea taudia edia.
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

motu: Badina be ena laḡa-ani ai e raka vareaimu tauna ese ena ḡaukara amo e laḡa animu, Dirava ese iena ḡaukara amo e laga aniva na helo.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

motu: Una dainai, una laḡa-ani ai baita raka vareai toho mai goadada ida, tau ta ese gwau-deede taudia baine haḡoidia bena baine keto na garina.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

motu: Badina na Dirava ena hereva na e maurimu, bona mai siahuna; ia ganona ese isena rua mai ganodia darena e hereaiamu. E hegwadamu ela bona dara bona Iauma e hapararadiamu, bona garugaru bona turia haradia danu e hapararadiamu. Eda lalo-hadai bona eda ura ia na dibana herea.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

motu: Mauri ḡauna ta ia vairana amo basine hehuni diba; ḡau iboudiai na ia, e hahemaoro henidamu Diravana, vairanai hehedinararai. Keriso, eda hahelaḡa tauna badana
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

motu: Ita na mai eda hahelaḡa tauna badana, guba ai vada e raka hanai; ia na Iesu, Dirava Natuna. Taunabunai, ia iabi-daena baita kahua tao.
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

motu: Badina be eda hahelaḡa tauna badana na dia eda manoka-manoka mamina iabina asi dibana tauna. Ḡau iboudiai ese ia e dibaḡaniava, ita e dibaḡanidamu heḡereḡerena; to ia na asi ena kara dika.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

motu: Benaini, hebogahisi teronona baita raka henia kahi, asi eda gari; bena baine bogada hisi, bona harihari-bada, eda dabu negadia ai baine kahada hariharina, baita abia.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia badadia iboudiai na taunimanima bogaragidia amo e abidia hidimu, taunimanima daidiai Dirava bae boua, herahia ḡaudia bona boubou ḡaudia bae hahelaḡa, dika iabi-ohodia.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana ese lalo-duhu taudia bona kerere taudia e bogadia hisimu, badina be ia danu manoka-manoka ese e butua taomu;
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

motu: una dainai, ia ese boubou ḡaudia baine hahelaḡa, dia taunimanima mo edia kerere daidiai, a ia sib-ona ena kerere daidiai danu.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

motu: Bona tau ta ese ina dagi namona sibona se abiamu; a Dirava ese e boiriamu, Aaron e boiria heḡereḡerena.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

motu: Unuhetomana danu, Keriso na sibona se heimodai, hahelaḡa tauna badana dagina se abia, to dagi e henia Diravana eto, Oi na lau Natugu; Hari dina ai vada na havaramu.
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “ You|strong="G4771" * are|strong="G1510" * my|strong="G1473" * Son|strong="G5207" *. Today|strong="G4594" * I|strong="G1473" * have|strong="G2532" * become|strong="G1096" * your|strong="G2532" * father|strong="G1080" *.” + 5:5 Psalms 2:7 *

motu: Ia danu ma e hereva, eto, Oi na hahelaḡa tauna, o noho hanaihanaimu; Melkisedek ena orea taumu.
english: As he says also in another place, “ You|strong="G4771" * are|strong="G3588" * a|strong="G2532" * priest|strong="G2409" * forever|strong="G1519" *, after|strong="G2596" * the|strong="G1722" * order|strong="G5010" * of|strong="G2532" * Melchizedek|strong="G3198" *.” + 5:6 Psalms 110:4 *

motu: Ia tanobada ai e nohova dinadia ai, Iesu ese mase amo baine hamauria diba Diravana na e ḡuriava bona e noiava, mai taina bona mai irurumatana ida; bena Dirava garina e gariva dainai ena noinoi ḡauna e abia.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

motu: Ena be ia na Dirava Natuna to hisihisi ese Dirava ikamonai-henina e hadibaiava,
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

motu: ela bona e namo ḡuḡuru; bena ia ikamonai-henina taudia iboudiai edia mauri hanaihanai ihavarana tauna ai ela.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

motu: Badina be Dirava ese e gwauraia, hahelaḡa tauna badana, Melkisedek ena orea ai.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

motu: Emai hereva momo mimia, ia herevana; ḡau tamona anidia igwauraidia na metau, badina be umui taiamui vada e kudima.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

motu: Nega vada eme gini dae, umui na hahediba taumui ai boma lao, to doini o dabumu; ta ese Dirava ena hereva badidia bema hadibalaimui lou bema namo. Umui na doini rata inu memerodia na heheto; aniani korikori ianidia na asi goadamui.
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

motu: Rata inu merona na kara maoromaoro herevana asi dibana, badina be ia na karukaru.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

motu: A aniani korikori be taudia vada e lo taudia adia; idia na lalodia vada eme manada, namo bona dika toadia na mai dibadia.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

motu: Badina bunai, Keriso ena hereva badidia baita rakatani, huahuadia baita ḡava. Badidia bini basita hagini loulou: kara asi anidia ihelalolai-kerehaidia; Dirava ibadinana;
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

motu: bapatiso herevadia; ima tubua ai ato kau herevadia; mase ihatore-isidia herevadia; mia hanaihanai hahemaorona herevadia.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

motu: Dirava baine ura, ini na bae mia.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

motu: Gunaguna lalodia e diariva, bona guba hariharina e mamia tohova, bona Lauma Helaḡa enai ahudia e abiva,
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

motu: bona Dirava ena hereva namona bona mauri gabena siahuna e mami tohova,
english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

motu: taudia na bema keto, idia na basiema helalo kerehai lou diba; badina be idia sibodia ese Dirava Natuna vada e hasatauroa lou bona taunimanima vairadiai vada e hahemaraia.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

motu: Badina be e diho louloumu medudia e inumu, bona aniani ḡaudia namodia e havaramu uma taudia edia, tanona ese Dirava ena hahenamo e abiamu.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

motu: A au ginigini bona ava ḡiniḡini e havaramu tanona ese hedadarai bona heuduguirai e abimu; dokona ai lahi ese baine ara ore.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

motu: A lalokau e, ena be ini a hereva tomamu, to lalomai e tomamu hahemauri badina ḡaudia namodia na lalomui ai vada mimia.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

motu: Badina be Dirava na asi ena kara gageva-gageva; emui ḡaukara bona emui lalokau ia ladana dainai vada o hahedinarai, helaḡa taudia o durudiava bona o durudiamu, ia ese basine lato boio.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

motu: A ai na a ura badamu umui iboumui ai ene ba goada toma, ela bona dokona ai emui helaro ba hagugurua.
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

motu: Basio hesiku; a edia abidadama bona edia habeauka daidiai ahudia vada e abi taudia do ba haḡoidia.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese Abraham e gwau hamata henia negana ai, ta ese ia se hereaia dainai ia sibona ladana ai e gwau hamata,
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

motu: eto, Momokani baina hanamomu, garamu danu baina hahutumadia.
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.” + 6:14 Genesis 22:17 *

motu: Bena Abraham e haheauka taritariva ela bona gwauhamata anina e davaria.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

motu: Badina be taunimanima ese herea tauna ladana ai e gwau hamatamu; bena hereva ihamomokanilaina gwauhamatana ese edia hepapahuahu idoinai e hadokoamu.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

motu: Unuhetomana, Dirava na e urava gwauhamata dihina taudia bae diba ḡoevaḡoeva iena Ialo-hadai basine idau; una negana ai ia ese hereva helaḡana amo e gwau hamata henidia.
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

motu: Unu ḡau ruaosi na basie idau, bona unu ḡau ruaosi ai danu Dirava ese basine koida diba. Taunabunai ita na hahedika vada ta heautania, bona goada vada davaria, ita ese vairadai enle hure helarona baita kahua tao.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

motu: Una helaro na laumada dogona na heto, se idaumu bona se mareremu, seseahu unukahanai e vareaimu;
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

motu: unuseni ai e gunalaida tauna, Iesu, vada e raka vareai guna ita daidai, hahelaḡa tauna badana Melkisedek ena orea ai vada e hahelao, ela bona hanaihanai.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

motu: Hari Melkisedek na Salem pavapavana bona Herea Mikamika Diravana ena hahelaḡa tauna. Ia na Abraham ida e hedavari, Abraham ese hanua pavapavadia iala-masedia amo e lou negana ai, bena e hanamoa.
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

motu: Abraham ese danu kohu e karoa, karoa gwauta, bena karoa ta ia e henia. Ia ladana gunana anina be Kara Maoromaoro Lohiana. Ma ladana ta Salema Pavapavana, anina be Maino Lohiana.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

motu: Ia na asi tamana, asi sinana, asi iduhuna, asi ena vara dinana, asi ena mauri dokona; a Dirava Natuna ihaḡoina ai vada e halaoa, hahelaḡa tauna, e noho hanaihanaimu.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

motu: Una tau ba haeroa, ede e herea tomava. Seneda Abraham ese tuari ai e abi kohudia e karoadia, karoa ihagwautana e henia.
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

motu: Momokani, Levi natuna haida ese danu hahelaḡa dagina e abia, bena mai siahudia ida taunimanima edia kohu e karoadia, karoa ihagwautadia bae abi, taravatu heḡereḡerena. Ena be varavaradia, Abraham besena taudia, to e abi.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

motu: A ia, ena be dia idia edia iduhu tauna, to Abraham ena kohu karoana ihagwautana e abia, bona Dirava ese e gwau hamata henia tauna na ia ese e hahenamo henia.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

motu: A dibada vaitani, dagi maraḡina tauna na dagi badana tauna ese e hahenamo heniamu.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

motu: Harihari, bae mase taudia ese kohu e karoadiamu, karoa ihagwautadia e abimu; a una negana ai, sivaraina e piuamu doini e maurimu e tomamu tauna ese e abiva.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

motu: Bona e kara Levi, karoa ihagwautadia iabidia tauna, ese danu ena kohu karoana ihagwautana e henia na heto, Abraham dainai;
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

motu: badina be ia na tamana tau-anina ai, Melkisedek na tamana ida e hedavari negana ai.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

motu: Eda bese taudia ese Levi iduhuna hahelaḡa taudia edia amo taravatu e abia; ḡau tamona hahenamo ḡoeva-daena na idia edia amo bema vara, hahelaḡa tauna idauna ta, dia Aaron ena iduhu tauna a Melkisedek ena orea tauna, bema gini anina be dahaka?
english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

motu: Badina be hahelaḡa taudia bae idau, taravatu danu baine idau.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

motu: Badina be ini e herevalaia tomamu tauna na ena iduhu na idau; bona iena iduhu tauna ta ese pata helaḡana gaukaradia do se kara.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

motu: Badina be tame diba eda Lohiabada be Iuda iduhuna amo e vara, a Mose ese hahelaḡa taudia haida una iduhu ai se gwauraidia.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

motu: Ina na tame diba ḡoevaḡoeva, badina be hahelaḡa tauna idauna ta vada e vara, Melkisedek ihaḡoina;
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

motu: ena dagi danu vada e henia, dia tau-anina taravatuna ibadinana totona, a mauri hanaihanai siahuna ai.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

motu: Badina be ini e gwauraia tomamu: Oi na hahelaḡa tauna, o noho hanaihanaimu, Melkisedek ena orea taumu.
english: for it is testified, “ You|strong="G4771" * are|strong="G3588" * a|strong="G1519" * priest|strong="G2409" * forever|strong="G1519" *, according|strong="G2596" * to|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G1519" * order|strong="G5010" * of|strong="G2596" * Melchizedek|strong="G3198" *.” + 7:17 Psalms 110:4 *

motu: Benaini, taravatu gunana vada eme heabi oho, badina be ia na manokamanoka bona asi anina,
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

motu: bona ḡau ta se haḡuḡurua. A helaro matamatana bona namo-hereana ese ia gabuna vada eme abia: unu amo Dirava ta raka henia kahimu.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

motu: Bona ina na mai gwauhamata helaḡana.
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

motu: Idia na hahelaḡa taudia ai e halaodiava na asi edia gwauhamata, a ia na mai gwauhamatana ida hahelaḡa tauna ai e halaoa. E gwau hamata Diravana ese e hereva henia, eto, Lohiabada na vada e gwau hamata vaitani, Lalona danu basine ha-idaua; E tomu “Oi na hahelaḡa tauna, O noho hanaihanaimu”.
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “ The|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" * swore|strong="G3660" * and|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * not|strong="G3756" * change|strong="G3338" * his|strong="G1223" * mind|strong="G3338" *, ‘ You|strong="G4771" * are|strong="G3588" * a|strong="G2532" * priest|strong="G2409" * forever|strong="G1519" *, according|strong="G3756" * to|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G2532" * order|strong="G4314" * of|strong="G1223" * Melchizedek.’” + 7:21 Psalms 110:4 *

motu: Taunabunai, Iesu na herohemaino matamatana ihamomokanina.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

motu: Ina danu: unu hahelaḡa taudia na hutuma, badina be mase ese e butudia taova, edia dagi ai basie noho hanaihanai;
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

motu: a ina hahelaḡa tauna na e noho hanaihanaimu, asi ibolona.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

motu: Badina bunai ia na mai goadana, ia bagunai Diravana e raka henia kahimu taudia baine hamauridia ḡuḡuru, badina be e noho hanaihanaimu, bona ita daidai e noinoi hanaihanaimu.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

motu: Hahelaḡa tauna badana unuhetomana vada e namo ita eda: helaḡa tauna, asi ena dika, asi bebeka-bebekana, asi ahuna kara dika taudia ediai, guba doriva-dorivana ai vada e dae.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

motu: Ia na dia unu hahelaḡa taudia badadia na heheto: idia ese daba iboudiai boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadiava, guna idia sibodia edia dika irohodia, gabe amo hanua taudia edia dika irohodia. A ia ese nega tamona boubou ḡauna e hahelaḡaia vaitani, ia sibona boubou ḡauna ai e hahelao negana ai.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

motu: Badina be taravatu ese manoka-manoka taudia na hahelaḡa taudia ai e halaodiava; a gwauhamata herevana, taravatu e gabelaia ḡauna, ese Natuna na hahelaḡa tauna badana ai vada e halaoa. Ia eme ḡoeva dae ela bona hanaihanai.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

motu: Ai ese vada ame gwaurai herevadia anidia bini: ita na mai eda hahelaḡa tauna badana, Herea Mikamika Diravana ena terono idibana kahana ai vada e helaimu, guba ai.
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

motu: Ia na helaḡa ḡaudia bona ḡuriḡuri kalagana korikori ireḡudia tauna: una kalaga na taunimanima ese asie taruhaia, a Lohiabada ese e taruhaia.
english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia badadia iboudiai vada e duanaidia, herahia ḡaudia bona boubou ḡaudia bae boudia; taunabunai, ina hahelaḡa tauna badana danu mai ena herahia ḡauna.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

motu: Tanobada ai bema noho, ia na hahelaḡa tauna ai basinema lao; badina be hahelaḡa taudia haida nonoho, idia ese boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡamu, taravatu heḡereḡerena.
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

motu: Idia edia ḡaukara na guba ai e karamu ḡaukarana ihaheḡereḡerena bona laulauna mo. Dirava ese Mose e tamanua na heto, ḡuriḡuri kalagana baine karaia negana ai; eto, Nahuamu ba tohoa, ḡau iboudiai ba kara, ororo ai na haheitalaimu ḡaudia oromadia heḡereḡedia.
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.” + 8:5 Exodus 25:40 *

motu: A harihari Keriso ese hereḡu dagina hereana vada e abia, dagi gunadia e hereadiamu; ina na iena herohemaino ese taravatu gunana e hereaiamu heḡereḡerena, badina be gwauhamata hereadia latadiai e hadaia dainai.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

motu: Badina be taravatu gunana bema asi kererena, iharuana bema asi badina.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

motu: A Dirava ese kereredia e gwaurai, eto, Lohiabada na e gwaumu, dina vada be maimu, Taravatu matamatana do baina karaia, Israel besena ida Bona Iuda besena ida;
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “ Behold|strong="G2400" *, + 8:8 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * the|strong="G2532" * days|strong="G2250" * are|strong="G3588" * coming|strong="G2064" *”, says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *, “ that|strong="G3588" * I|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * make|strong="G2532" * a|strong="G2532" * new|strong="G2537" * covenant|strong="G1242" * with|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * house|strong="G3624" * of|strong="G2250" * Israel|strong="G2474" * and|strong="G2532" * with|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * house|strong="G3624" * of|strong="G2250" * Judah|strong="G2455" *;

motu: Dia senedia ida na karaia taravatuna heḡereḡerena, Imadia na abi dinana ai, Aigupto tanona amo baina hakaudia lasi nato; Badina be egu taravatu asie badinaiava, Taunabunai na dadaraidiava; Lohiabada na unu e gwau tomamu.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * day|strong="G2250" * that|strong="G3754" * I|strong="G1473" * took|strong="G1949" * them|strong="G3588" * by|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * hand|strong="G5495" * to|strong="G2596" * lead|strong="G1806" * them|strong="G3588" * out|strong="G1537" * of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1722" * land|strong="G1093" * of|strong="G1537" * Egypt; for|strong="G3754" * they|strong="G3588" * didn’ t|strong="G3588" * continue|strong="G1696" * in|strong="G1722" * my|strong="G1722" * covenant|strong="G1242" *, and|strong="G3962" * I|strong="G1473" * disregarded them|strong="G3588" *,” says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G1722" * Lord|strong="G2962" *.

motu: Lohiabada ma e gwaumu: unu dina muridiai, Ina tarava baina atua, Israel besena ida; Egu haheḡani na lalodia ai baina ato, Kudoudia ai baina tore; Edia Dirava ai bainala, Idia danu besegu ai baela.
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after|strong="G3326" * those|strong="G3588" * days|strong="G2250" *,” says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *: “ I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G2316" * put|strong="G1325" * my|strong="G1325" * laws|strong="G3551" * into|strong="G1519" * their|strong="G1438" * mind|strong="G1271" *; I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G2316" * also|strong="G2532" * write|strong="G1924" * them|strong="G3588" * on|strong="G1909" * their|strong="G1438" * heart|strong="G2588" *. I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G2316" * be|strong="G1510" * their|strong="G1438" * God|strong="G2316" *, and|strong="G2532" * they|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2316" * be|strong="G1510" * my|strong="G1325" * people|strong="G2992" *.

motu: Basie hahediba heheni danu, basieto “Lohiabada ba dibaia”, Badina be kikina-badana iboudiai ese lau bae dibagu.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen + 8:11 TR reads “neighbor” instead of “fellow citizen” * and|strong="G2532" * every|strong="G3956" * man|strong="G1538" * his|strong="G3956" * brother, saying|strong="G3004" *, ‘ Know|strong="G1492" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *,’ for|strong="G3754" * all|strong="G3956" * will|strong="G2532" * know|strong="G1492" * me|strong="G1473" *, from|strong="G2532" * their|strong="G2532" * least|strong="G3398" * to|strong="G2532" * their|strong="G2532" * greatest|strong="G3173" *.

motu: Badina be edia kara dikadia lalodiai baina bogadia hisi, Bona edia kara havara basina lalo tao.
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G1510" * remember|strong="G3403" * their|strong="G2532" * sins and|strong="G2532" * lawless deeds no|strong="G3756" * more|strong="G2089" *.” + 8:12 Jeremiah 31:31-34 *

motu: Taravatu matamatana iherevalaina ai, ia ese gunana na vada e ore ḡauna ai e halaoa. Bona siahuna e ore ḡauna, ḡau gunana, vada be pukimu.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

motu: Taravatu gunana na mai ena toma-diho haheḡanidia bona mai ena dubu tanobada ai.
english: Now indeed even the first + 9:1 TR adds “tabernacle” * covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

motu: Badina be ḡuriḡuri kalagana e karaia, murimuri daiutuna ai be lamepa iato-kauna ḡau bona pata bona Dirava vairanai e atoa flaoana; una na gabu helaḡana e gwauraia.
english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

motu: Seseahu iharuana lalonai be Helaḡa Herea daiutuna ta e gwauraia hidi.
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

motu: Ia lalonai pata helaḡana ta gold ai e karaia, muramura mai bonana patana bunai; bona taravatu mauana ta danu gold ai e havavaia heḡeḡe; bona maua lalonai be gold kibona auta, anina be mana; bona Aaron ena itotohi, e gara kau ḡauna; bona taravatu nadidia danu una maua lalonai.
english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

motu: Maua daenai hairai kerubidia ese hebogahisi teronona e hakerukeruava. To unu ḡau harihari basia herevalai hagau-hagau diba.
english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

motu: Unu ḡau be unu e seu toma; bena hahelaḡa taudia na murimuri daiutuna lalonai e raka vareai loulou, boubou ḡaudia e hahelaḡadia.
english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

motu: A laloma daiutuna be hahelaḡa tauna badana mo sibona laḡani ta lalonai nega tamona e raka vareai, rara e vareailaia, e hahelaḡaia, ia sibona dainai, bona bese taudia edia kara kerere-kerere daidiai.
english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

motu: Ini amo Lauma Helaḡa ese e hadibadiamu: Helaḡa Herea gabuna iraka-vareaina dalana do se hekeho, murimuri daiutuna dounu gini negana ai.
english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

motu: Una na hereva heḡereḡerena, ina nega ena. Herahia ḡaudia bona boubou ḡaudia vada e hahelagamu, ḡau tamona idia na asi siahudia toma-diho tauna lalona ihaḡoevana.
english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

motu: Badina be edia siahu badidia be ini mo; aniani gaudia, inuinu ḡaudia, digu karadia haida, tau-anina taravatudia; e hagini, taunimanima ese bae badina ela bona hahematamata negana.
english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

motu: A Keriso ema, vada e vara ḡaudia namodia edia hahelaḡa tauna badana. Bena ḡuriḡuri kalagana bada-hereana bona namo-hereana amo e raka hanai, dia taunimamima imadia e karaia ḡauna bona dia ina tanobada gauna.
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

motu: E raka hanai, Helaḡa Herea gabuna ai e raka vareai vaitani, nega tamona mo; dia nani bona boromakau natudia raradia a ia sibona rarana e vareailaia, hahemauri hanaihanai e havaraia.
english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

motu: Badina be nani raradia bona boromakau maruanedia raradia bona boromakau natudia lahi ese e ḡole oho kahudia amo na dika taudia bema ḡiḡidia tao, bena tau-anidia bema ḡoevaḡoeva;
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

motu: o Keriso rarana, Noho-hanaihanai Laumana dainai sibona Dirava e henia tauna rarana, asi bebeka-bebekana tauna rarana, siahuna basinema herea a, umui lalomui mase karadia amo bema haḡoeva, bona Mauri Diravana ena hesiai taudia ai bema halaomui ani?
english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

motu: Taunabunai, ia na taravatu matamatana ena herohemaino tauna; taravatu gunana vada e tataia utu taudia na mase ta ai e hamauridiamu, bona e boiridia taudia na mia-hanaihanai ahudia e henidiamu, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

motu: Badina be tau ta dihina ese ahudia basie abi ela bona una tau baine mase momokani;
english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

motu: ena kohu iharidia herevadia na mai siahudia ena mase dainai, a ena mauri negana ai idia na asi siahudia.
english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

motu: Unuhetomana, taravatu gunana danu rara ese e hamomokania.
english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

motu: Badina be Mose ese taravatu ena haheḡani iboudiai na bese taudia iboudiai e herevalai henidiava; bena boromakau natudia raradia bona nani raradia bona ranu e abi, mamoe huina kakakakana bona husopo danu e abi, bena buka bona bese taudia iboudiai e nevarilaidia,
english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

motu: eto “Ina na Dirava ese vada e haḡanilaimui taravatuna rarana”.
english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.” + 9:20 Exodus 24:8 *

motu: Unuhetomana danu ia ese ḡuriḡuri kalagana bona helaḡa ḡaudia iboudiai rara ai e nevaridia.
english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

motu: Oibe; taravatu henuna ḡaudia momo herea rara ese e haḡoevadiamu; bona rara basinema hebubu, dika igwau-taodia bema lasi.
english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

motu: Benaini, guba ḡaudia ihaheḡereḡeredia ḡaudia na ini helaḡa karadia amo e haḡoeva, a guba ḡaudia korikori na boubou namodia amo bae haḡoeva.
english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

motu: Badina be Keriso vada e raka vareai dubuna na dia taunimanima imadia amo e karaia ḡauna dubu korikorina ihaheḡereḡerena, a guba ai vada e raka vareai, Dirava vairanai e hedinaraimu ita daidai.
english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

motu: Bona ia na se raka vareai sibona boubou ḡauna ai bainela loulou, hahelaḡa tauna badana na heto, ia ese laḡani ta ta amo Helaḡa Herea gabuna lalonai e raka vareai, rara e vareailaia, to dia ia rarana.
english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

motu: Unu bema heto, Keriso na nega diaḡau bema hisihisi, tanobada matamana ema bona harihari. A ia be nega tamona, ina nega dokona ai, vada eme hedinarai, sibona boubou ḡauna ai vada ela, dika iabiohona.
english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

motu: Taunimanima edia mase na tamona, murinai hahemaoro bae abia;
english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

motu: unuhetomana Keriso danu nega tamona boubou ḡauna ai vada e halaoa, hutuma edia kara dika ihuadia. Ma baine hedinarai lou, dia kara dika ihamaoromaorona totona, a mai helarodia ida e nariamu taudia ihamauridia.
english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

motu: Taravatu na ḡau namodia bae vara laulaudia mo, dia ḡau korikoridia. Idia ese hari boubou ḡaudia laḡani laḡani e hahelaḡamu. To taravatu na asi goadana ia ese e raka kahi maimu taudia baine hanamodia ḡuḡuru.
english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

motu: Bema mai goadana, boubou ḡaudia ihahelaḡadia na bema doko, ani? Badina be toma-diho taudia bema ḡoeva vaitani, idia na kara dika basiema lalo lou.
english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

motu: A unu boubou lalodiai idia ese laḡani ta ta amo edia kara dika e helalolai loulou.
english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
