motu: Badina be boromakau mamaruanedia raradia bona nani raradia ese kara dika basie abi oho diba.
english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

motu: Taunabunai, Keriso na tanobada ema, eto, Helaḡa karadia bona boubou ḡaudia so uramu, A tau-anina ta vada o abia heḡaeḡae lauegu;
english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “ You|strong="G3004" * didn’ t|strong="G3588" * desire|strong="G2309" * sacrifice|strong="G2378" * and|strong="G2532" * offering|strong="G4376" *, but|strong="G1161" * you|strong="G3004" * prepared|strong="G2675" * a|strong="G2532" * body|strong="G4983" * for|strong="G1519" * me|strong="G1473" *.

motu: Lahi ese e gole oho ḡaudia bona kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia so moalelaimu.
english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

motu: Bena nato “Lau o ina, Taravatu bukana ai e torelaigu heḡereḡerena Dirava e, emu ura ikarana totona nama”.
english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to|strong="G3004" * do|strong="G4160" * your|strong="G3708" * will|strong="G2307" *, O God|strong="G2316" *.’” + 10:7 Psalms 40:6-8 *

motu: Ena hereva gini-gunana eto, Helaḡa karadia bona boubou ḡaudia bona lahi ese e ḡole oho ḡaudia bona kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia so uramu bona so moalelaimu. Ḡau tamona idia ese taravatu heḡereḡerena ai vada e hahelaḡamu.
english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

motu: Ma eto, Lau o ina, emu ura ikarana nama. Gini-gunana e abia ohomu, iharuana baine haginia helaoreana.
english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

motu: Una ura ese vada e hahelaḡada, Iesu Keriso tau-anina nega tamona mo boubou ḡauna ai vada e halaoa dainai.
english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

motu: Hahelaḡa taudia iboudiai dina ta ta amo e ginimu, helaḡa karadia e karamu, boubou ḡaudia tamodia e hahelaḡa louloumu. Ḡau tamona, unu helaḡa ḡaudia ese kara dika basie abi oho diba.
english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

motu: A Keriso ese boubou ḡauna tamona vada e hahelaḡaia, kara dika iabi-ohodia; bena Dirava idibana kahana ai vada e helai diho.
english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

motu: Una negana ema vada e henarimu, ela bona ia inaina na aena ihadaidia ḡaudia ai baine halaodia.
english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

motu: Badina be boubou ḡauna tamona amo ia ese e hahelaḡadiamu taudia na vada e haḡoevadia ḡuḡuru ela hanaihanai.
english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

motu: Lauma Helaḡa danu vada e hadibalaida; badina be ia eto,
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

motu: Lohiabada na e gwaumu: Unu dina muridiai, Ina tarava idia ida baina atua; Egu haheḡani na kudoudia ai baina ato, Lalodia ai baina tore.
english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after|strong="G3326" * those|strong="G3588" * days|strong="G2250" *,” says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *, “ I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G2532" * put|strong="G1325" * my|strong="G1325" * laws|strong="G3551" * on|strong="G1909" * their|strong="G1438" * heart|strong="G2588" *, I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G2532" * also|strong="G2532" * write|strong="G1924" * them|strong="G3588" * on|strong="G1909" * their|strong="G1438" * mind|strong="G1271" *;” + 10:16 Jeremiah 31:33 * then|strong="G2532" * he|strong="G2532" * says|strong="G3004" *,

motu: Ma eto, Edia kara dika bona edia kara havara basina lalo tao.
english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.” + 10:17 Jeremiah 31:34 *

motu: A unu kara bae gwaudia tao, kara dika iabi-ohodia ḡaudia bae hahelaḡa na asi badina.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, asi eda daradara Helaḡa Herea gabuna lalonai baita raka vareai, Iesu rarana dainai.
english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

motu: Ia ese dala matamatana, mauri dalana, vada e kehoa ita eda; seseahu e hanaiamu, ia tau-anina bunai.
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

motu: Ita na mai eda hahelaḡa tauna badana, Dirava ena ruma ita-taona.
english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

motu: Taunabunai, baita raka kahira mai laloda momokanidia ida bona mai kamonai lava-daena ida. Laloda na vada eme nevari; lalo-hadai dikadia vada eme heabi oho, tau-anida danu ranu negari-negari ai vada eme hehuri ḡoevaḡoeva.
english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

motu: Eda helaro herevadia baita kahu tarika-tarika, basita raivaraiva, badina be e gwaurai hamata tauna ena gwauhamata na momokani.
english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

motu: Baita helalolai heheni, bena baita hahealo heheni, Ialokau bona kara namodia baita havara.
english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

motu: Eda hegogo karadia danu basita nege, haida ese e nege heḡereḡerena, a baita hahealo heheni; oibe, ina kara baita habadaia, badina be, o itaiamu, dina badana eme kahikahi.
english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

motu: Badina be hereva momokani vada ta diba vaitani murinai ma baita kara havara, boubou ḡauna ta dia mia eda kara dika iabi-ohodia;
english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

motu: a hahemaoro inarina mo mia, mai gari-badana ida, bona lahi danu mia, Dirava inaina baine aradia ore.
english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

motu: Tau ta ese Mose ena taravatu e tataia utumu, bena dibadia taudia rarua eiava tatoi ese e gwauraia hedinaraimu, una tau na baine mase, basie bogaia hisi.
english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

motu: Ede o laloa tomamu? Dirava Natuna vada e moia tao; bona herohemaino rarana, e hahelaḡaia ḡauna, na asi ena helaḡa ḡauna ai vada e halaoa; bona Harihari-bada Laumana vada e taoa tari tauna, na davana ede baine bada toma?
english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

motu: Badina be ita dibada daika eto “Dava ikarana be lau; lau ese dava baina heni”. Ma eto “Lohiabada ese ena bese taudia baine hahemaoro henidia”.
english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. + 10:30 Deuteronomy 32:35 * Again, “The Lord will judge his people.” + 10:30 Deuteronomy 32:36; Psalms 135:14 *

motu: Mauri Diravana imana ese baine butuda tao na mai garina.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

motu: Nega gunadia ba helalolai: Ialomui e diariva murinai hisihisi momo ese e butumui taova, a o haheaukava.
english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

motu: Nega haida e lodu henimui bona e daḡedaḡe henimui; ma nega haida unu e karadia toma taudia na o bamodia.
english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

motu: Badina be e ḡuidia taudia o bogadia hisi, bona emui kohu e dadi negadia ai edia kara o abi dae mai moalemui ida; badina be dibamui emui kohu namo-hereana na mia hanaihanai.
english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

motu: Taunabunai, emui boga auka basio negea; ia davana baine bada.
english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

motu: Badina be emui haheauka badina binai: Dirava ena ura ba karaia ḡuḡuru, bena gwauhamata anina do bavabia.
english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

motu: Badina be asi vanahana Bainema tauna do bainema, basine halahe;
english: “In a very little while, he|strong="G2532" * who|strong="G3588" * comes|strong="G2064" * will|strong="G2532" * come|strong="G2064" * and|strong="G2532" * will|strong="G2532" * not|strong="G3756" * wait.

motu: A kara maoromaoro tauna na ena kamonai dainai do baine mauri; To baine raka kerehai tauna na laumagu ese basine moalelaia.
english: But the righteous one will live by faith. If|strong="G1437" * he|strong="G2532" * shrinks|strong="G5288" * back|strong="G5288" *, my|strong="G1722" * soul|strong="G5590" * has|strong="G4102" * no|strong="G3756" * pleasure|strong="G2106" * in|strong="G1722" * him|strong="G3588" *.” + 10:38 Habakkuk 2:3-4 *

motu: A ita na dia raka-kerehai tauda, dia boio tauda; ita na kamonai tauda, laumada na do bae mauri.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

motu: Abidadama na ta laromu ḡaudia ihamomokanidia; bona abidadama dainai, asita daradaramu asita itadia ḡaudia ediai.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

motu: Badina be edia abidadama daulai Dirava ese sene taudia e hanamodiava.
english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

motu: Abidadama dainai ita dibada Dirava ena hereva ese tanobada e karaia, bena ta itamu ḡaudia be asita itamu ḡaudia amo vada e vara.
english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

motu: Abidadama dainai, Abel ese boubou ḡauna namona e hahelaḡaia, Kain ena e hereaia; bena Dirava ese ena herahia ḡauna e abia dae bona kara maoromaoro tauna e gwauraia. E mase, to ena abidadama dainai ia na doini e herevamu.
english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

motu: Abidadama dainai, Enok na tanobada amo e heabi oho, mase asi dibana; asie davaria, badina be Dirava ese e abia oho. A do se heabi oho negana ai vada e gwauraia, Dirava ihamoalena tauna.
english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

motu: A asi ena abidadama tauna na Dirava ihamoalena asi dibana. Badina be Dirava iraka-heni-kahina e uramu tauna ese baine abia dae guna Dirava na e maurimu, bona ia e tahuamu taudia davadia namodia baine henidia.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

motu: Abidadama dainai Noa ese do se ita ḡaudia Dirava ese e sisibalai henia guna, bena Noa ese Dirava e kamonai henia, lagatoi auta e karaia. ena ruma taudia ihamauridia helaoreana. Unu amo ia ese tanobada e hahemaoro henia, bona abidadama amo e varamu kara maoromaorona na ia ahuna korikori ai e halaoa.
english: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, + 11:7 or, reverence * prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

motu: Abidadama dainai, Abraham ese boiboi e hakala henia, e boiria ena hanua baine rakatania, gabu ta bainela, baine abia ia ahuna, negana ai. Bena e raka lasi; ede bainela na asi dibana.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

motu: Abidadama dainai gwauhamata tanona ai e noho hedoa-hedoava, Isaak bona Iakob ida kalaga ai e nohova; idia raruosi danu ia ida gwauhamata dihina taudia.
english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

motu: Badina be baine gini tutuka-tutuka hanuana na ia ese e tahuava: iseuna bona ikarana na Dirava.
english: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

motu: Abidadama dainai Sara, ena be hane badana, to goada e davaria baine rogorogo; badina be e gwau henia hamata Diravana na ia ese e abidadama henia.
english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

motu: Taunabunai tau ta, mase tauna na heto, ena amo bese badana vada e vara; una bese taudia na guba hisiudia heḡereḡeredia eiava kone rariana na heto, diaḡau duahi-duahi.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

motu: Idia iboudiai abidadama ai e mase; gwauhamata anina asie abia, a dauha amo e itaia bona e abia dae; sibodia danu e hegwaurai, idia na idau taudia bona noho-hedoahedoa taudia ina tanobada ai.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen + 11:13 TR adds “and being convinced of” * them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

motu: Unu e hereva tomamu taudia na edia hereva anina eme hedinarai: idia ese edia tano korikori e tahuamu.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

motu: Badina be e rakatania tanona bema laloa, reana edia lou dalana bema davaria.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

motu: To idia ese tano namo-hereana e hekisehekise heniamu; ia na guba ai. Taunabunai, Dirava na se hemaraimu edia Dirava bae gwauraia; badina be hanua ta ia ese vada e abia heḡaeḡae idia edia.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

motu: Abidadama dainai, hedibaḡani negana ai, Abraham ese Isaak e abia, boubou ḡauna ai e halaoa. Oibe, hari gwauhamata e abia daeva tauna ese natuna vara-edeana na boubou ḡauna ai baine halaoa eto.
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born + 11:17 The phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”. * son,

motu: Merona bunai vada e herevalaia, eto, Isaak ena amo oi garamu do bae vara.
english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,” + 11:18 Genesis 21:12 *

motu: Badina be ia na e haeroa, Dirava na mai siahuna mase amo baine hatorea isi eto. Bena e abia lou, mase amo bema abia lou na heto.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

motu: Abidadama dainai Isaak ese Iakob bona Esau e hanamodia, gabeai bae vara ḡaudia e gwaurai.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

motu: Abidadama dainai, Iakob ena mase vada e kahira-kahira, bena ia ese Iosef natuna raruosi e hanamodia; e loma diho danu, ena itotohi kwarana ai e goru kau.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

motu: Abidadama dainai Iosef danu, ena mauri dokona ai, Israel besena edia raka lasi e gwauraia guna, bona ia turiana e hahedualai.
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

motu: Abidadama dainai, Mose e vara negana ai na tamana sinana ese hua toi e huniava, badina be e itaiava ia na raho-namo merona; hanua pavapavana ena haheḡani danu garina asie gariva.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

motu: Abidadama dainai Mose, tauna e lo ai, Farao natuna hahinena dihina bae gwauraia na e dadaraia;
english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

motu: ia na Dirava ena bese taudia ida bae dika bou e ura bada, kara dika moaledia, asie mia daudau ḡaudia, e ura maraḡi.
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

motu: Ia na e haeroa, Keriso dainai bae lodu henia na ḡau badana, Aigupto taudia edia taḡa e hereaia eto; badina be davana mo e haḡerea.
english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

motu: Abidadama dainai, ia ese Aigupto e rakatania, hanua pavapavana ena badu garina se gariva; badina be ia na e haheauka, asita itaiamu Diravana vada e itaia na heto.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

motu: Abidadama dainai ia ese Lagau Hanai karana e badinaia, rara danu e nevari, ala-ala aneruna ese memero roboadia basine aladia mase helaoreana.
english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

motu: Abidadama dainai, eda bese taudia ese Davara Kakakakana e rakaia hanai, tano kaukauna ai bema raka na heto; a Aigupto taudia na unu bae kara toma eto negana ai e dono mamase.
english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

motu: Abidadama dainai, Ieriko maḡuna na dina hitu e rakaia heḡeḡe, bena e keto.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

motu: Abidadama dainai, Rahaba, mata-bodaga hahinena, na gwau-edeede taudia ida se mase, hasinadoa taudia maino ai e abidia dae dainai.
english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

motu: Ma dahaka aina gwauraia? Badina be asi egu nega Gideon bona Barak bona Samson bona Iefeta bona David bona Samuel bona peroveta taudia baina herevalaidia.
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

motu: Idia ese abidadama dainai tanobada basileiadia e hadarerediava; kara maoromaoro e karava; gwauhamata e abiva; leona ududia e kouva;
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, + 11:33 Daniel 6:22-23 *

motu: Iahi siahuna e habodoava; dare matana amo e roho mauriva; manoka-manoka e negeava, goada e abiava; tuari ai e kwalimuva, inai taudia edia tuari oreadia e hahavadia.
english: quenched the power of fire, + 11:34 Daniel 3:1-30 * escaped the edge of the sword, + 11:34 1 Kings 19:1-3; 2 Kings 6:31—7:20 * from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

motu: Hahine ese danu edia mase taudia e davaridia lou, e tore isi lou dainai. Haida na e dadabadia maseva; a mauri e dadaraia, tore-isi-lou namo-hereana bae abia helaoreana.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. + 11:35 1 Kings 17:17-23; 2 Kings 4:32-37 * Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

motu: Ma haida e ḡonaḡonalaidiava, e kwadidiava, e ḡuidiava, dibura rumadia ai e koudiava.
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

motu: Nadi ai e hododia maseva, e iridia utuva, dare ai e aladia maseva. Mamoe kopidia bona nani kopidia e riova, e loava; e ogoḡamiva; e hisihisiva; taunimanima ese e hadikadiava.
english: They were stoned. + 11:37 2 Chronicles 24:20-21 * They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. + 11:37 Jeremiah 26:20-23; 1 Kings 19:10 * They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

motu: Tanobada na asi ena namo, idia na latanai bae noho. Tano ḡaḡaedia ai bona ororo ai e loava; kohua ai bona guri ai e nohova.
english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

motu: Ini iboudiai, ena be edia abidadama ese vada e hamomokanidia, to gwauhamata anidia asie abiva;
english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

motu: badina be Dirava ese ḡau namo-hereana vada e seua, idia sibodia ese basie abia, a idia ita ida ese baita abia hebou, baine hanamoda ḡuḡuru.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

motu: Taunabunai, herarai taudia hutuma bada ese e ḡeḡeda ahumu dainai, e hametaudamu ḡaudia idoidiai bona e kahuda taomu karadia dikadia baita ato tabe, bena heau-helulu vairadai e hure na baita heau mai haheaukada ida.
english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

motu: Iesu baita raraia tao; ia ese eda abidadama e havaraiamu bona e haḡuḡuruamu; ia danu vairanai e hure moalena dainai satauro e haheaukalaia, hemaraina se laloa, bena Dirava ena terono idibana kahana ai vada e helaimu.
english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

motu: Kara dika taudia ese e inai henia, a ia ese e haheauka henidia. Una na ba haeroa, lalomui bae hesiku na garina, laumamui bae manori na garina.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

motu: Umui na kara dika ilao-ahuna o goada-laiamu; to do asio laoa ahu ela bona raramui e hebubu.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

motu: Hahealo herevadia vada o lalo boio a, tamana ese natuna e sisiba henidiamu na heto e sisiba henimuimu, e tomu, Natugu e, Lohiabada ena mata hakani basio dadaraia E sisiba henimumu negadia ai danu lalomu basine manoka.
english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “ My|strong="G1473" * son|strong="G5207" *, don’ t|strong="G3588" * take|strong="G2532" * lightly|strong="G3643" * the|strong="G2532" * chastening|strong="G3809" * of|strong="G5207" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" *, nor|strong="G3366" * faint|strong="G1590" * when|strong="G5613" * you|strong="G5210" * are|strong="G3588" * reproved|strong="G1651" * by|strong="G5259" * him|strong="G3588" *;

motu: Badina be Lohiabada ese e ura heniamu tauna matana e hakanimu, Bona natuna ai e halaodiamu taudia iboudiai e dadabadiamu.
english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and|strong="G1161" * chastises|strong="G3146" * every|strong="G3956" * son|strong="G5207" * whom|strong="G3739" * he|strong="G1161" * receives|strong="G3858" *.” + 12:6 Proverbs 3:11-12 *

motu: Benaini, mata hakani ai ba haheauka; Dirava ese e karamui natu-adora heḡereḡeredia. Badina be edena mero na tamana ese matana se hakaniamu?
english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

motu: Natu iboudiai matadia e hakanimu: bema oi na lasi, oi na ariara merona, dia natu-adora.
english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

motu: Ina danu: tamada ina tanobada ai ese matada e hakanimu, bena ta matauraidiamu; matona, laumada Tamadia na basita matauraia a, bena baita mauri?
english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

motu: Badina be idia ese dina dia hoho ai matadia e hakaniva, edia ura heḡereḡerena; a ia ese matada e hakanimu ita ihanamoda, ia ida baita helaḡa hebou helaoreana.
english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

motu: Ina harihari mata hakani na asi ena moale bona mai ena hisihisi; a gabeamo vada e hamanadadia taudia ediai huahuana do baine dobi, kara maoromaoro ena maino.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

motu: Taunabunai, imamui eme heveri ba toi roro, bona aemui eme pada ba hahedai.
english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees, + 12:12 Isaiah 35:3 *

motu: Aemui edia dala maoromaorodia ba kara, bena ae-hedairike na basine heride, a baine namo.
english: and make straight paths for your feet, + 12:13 Proverbs 4:26 * so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

motu: Maino ba ḡavaia, taunimanima iboudiai ida; kara helaḡa danu, badina be basine abia tauna na Lohiabada basine itaia.
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, ta ese Dirava ena harihari-bada baine reaia na garina; eiava ramu iditana ta baine kobo na garina, bena baine haturiamui, bona hutuma baine hadikadia;
english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

motu: eiava bogaragimui ai tau ta baine heuda hanai na garina; eiava Dirava basine matauraia, Esau heḡereḡerena, ia ese Dirava se matauraia a ena roboa ahuna na nau tamona e hoilaia.
english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

motu: Badina be umui na dibamui, ia na gabeai hahenamo iabina e urava, to vada e dadaraia; ena be mai iruru-matana ida helalo-kerehai dalana e tahua, to se davaria.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

motu: Umui vada o raka henia kahi gabuna na dia ba daua toho ḡauna, dia lahi hururu-hururuna, dia dibura bona dagadaga bona lahi badana,
english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

motu: dia kibi reḡena bona gado. Una gado erena e kamonai taudia e noinoi, basine hereva henidia lou eto,
english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

motu: badina be asi edia haheauka una hahedua bae badinaia, eto, Mauri ḡauna ta ororo ai baine kau, nadi ai ba hodoa mase.
english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”. + 12:20 TR adds “or shot with an arrow” * + 12:20 Exodus 19:12-13 *

motu: Bona ita-itana na mai garina dainai Mose eto, Name gari, name heudeheude.
english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.” + 12:21 Deuteronomy 9:19 *

motu: A umui vada o raka henia kahi gabuna be Siona ororona, Mauri Diravana ena hanua, guba Ierusalemana; aneru diaḡau duahi-duahi e heboumu gabuna;
english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

motu: hegogo badana, natu roboadia, ladadia guba ai e hetore taudia edia ekalesia e moale heboumu gabuna, taunimanima iboudiai edia Hahemaoro Diravana dekenai, kara maoromaoro ai vada e ḡoeva-dae taudia laumadia dekediai;
english: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

motu: bona Iesu dekenai, ia na taravatu matamatana ena herohemaino tauna; bona vada e nevarilaia rarana enai, ena hahenamo ese Abel rarana ena e hereaiamu.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, + 12:24 Jeremiah 31:31 * and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, e hereva henimuimu tauna ba dadaraia na garina. Badina be tanobada ai e sisiba henidia tauna e dadaraia taudia na asi edia roho mauri dalana; benaini, ita na guba amo e sisiba henidamu tauna baita dadaraia, ede baita roho mauri tonma?
english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

motu: Una negana ai ia gadona ese tanobada e haheude-heudea; a harihari eme gwau hamata, e tomu, Nega gabena ai dia tanobada mo to guba danu baina haheude-heudea.
english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.” + 12:26 Haggai 2:6 *

motu: Una hereva “nega gabena” anina binai: haine haheude-heude ḡaudia baine abi oho, e kara ḡaudia bunu; a basie heude-heude ḡaudia na do bae mia.
english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

motu: Taunabunai, se heude-heudemu basaeiana na tame abia dainai, Dirava baita hanamoa, bona baita toma henia diho mai hematauraida ida bona mai garida ida, ia ihamoalena.
english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

motu: Badina be ita eda Dirava na lahi ḡaraka-ḡaraka.
english: for our God is a consuming fire. + 12:29 Deuteronomy 4:24 *

motu: Heura-heheni na bogaragimui ai baine hesiriu.
english: Let brotherly love continue.

motu: Idau taudia iabi-daedia basio lalo boio; badina be una kara dainai haida ese aneru vada e abidia dae, a asi dibadia unu be aneru.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

motu: Dibura rumadia ai e hekoumu taudia ba lalodia, umui danu idia idla bema koumui hebou na heto. E hahisidiamu taudia danu ba lalodia, badina be umui danu mai tau-animui.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai es headava bae matauraia, mahuta gedana basie hadikaia; badina be Dirava ese herahe-dadi taudia bona heudahanai taudia do baine hahemaoro henidia.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

motu: Lalomui ai moni basio hekisehekise henia, a dekemui ai mimia ḡaudia na bavabi, asi karikarimui; badina be Dirava eto, Lau na basina negemu bona basina rakatanimu, lasi ona lasi vaitani.
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” + 13:5 Deuteronomy 31:6 *

motu: Taunabunai, mai goadada ida baitato, Lohiabada be egu hekaha, Lau na hasina gari; Taunimanima ese ede bae hadikagu toma?
english: So that with good courage we say, “ The|strong="G3004" * Lord|strong="G2962" * is|strong="G5101" * my|strong="G1473" * helper. I|strong="G1473" * will|strong="G5101" * not|strong="G3756" * fear|strong="G5399" *. What|strong="G5101" * can|strong="G3004" * man|strong="G3756" * do|strong="G4160" * to|strong="G3004" * me|strong="G1473" *?” + 13:6 Psalms 118:6-7 *

motu: Ihakaumui taudia, Dirava ena hereva vada e hadibalaimui taudia, na ba lalodia; edia kara anina ba haeroa, bena edia abidadama ba haḡoia.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

motu: Iesu Keriso na varani bona harihari dia idau, bona basine idau ela bona hanaihanai.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

motu: Hahediba herevadia idau-idau basie hakaumui kerere; badina be ina na namo, Dirava ena harihari-bada ese laloda baine ba-auka, dia aniani ḡaudia ese; unu ḡau ese e badinava taudia asie hanamodiava.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

motu: Ita na mai eda pata helaḡana, a ḡuriḡuri kalagana ena hahelaḡa taudia na unu amo basie aniani diba.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

motu: Badina be mauri ḡaudia raradia na hahelaḡa tauna badana ese Helaḡa Herea gabuna ai e vareailaia, kara dika iabi-ohodia, a tau-anidia na taruha murimurinai e ḡole oho.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp. + 13:11 Leviticus 16:27 *

motu: Unuhetomana Iesu danu ikoukou murimurinai e mase, ia sibona rarana amo bese taudia baine hahelaḡadia helaoreana.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

motu: Taunabunai, ita na ia dekena baitala, taruha murimurinai, ia hemaraina danu baita huaia.
english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

motu: Badina be iniseni ai ita na asi eda mia-hanaihanai hanuana, a mia-hanaihanai hanuana, gabeai baine hedinarai ḡauna, ta tahuamu.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

motu: Taunabunai, ia dainai daba daba idoidiai Dirava iheatolaina na eda boubou ḡauna ai baita haloa; ududa bibinadia ese ia ladana bae imodaia.
english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God + 13:15 Psalms 50:23 * continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

motu: Kara namo bona kohu iharina na basio rea, badina be Dirava ese helaḡa karadia enehetomadia e moalelaimu.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

motu: Ihakaumui taudia ba kamonai henidia bona ba matauraidia. Badina be idia ese umui laumamui e gimadiamu, edia kara anidia bae gwaurai hedinarai taudia na heheto. Unu bae kara toma mai moaledia ida baine namo; a mai ḡanaḡanana ida bae karaia negana ai na emui ai anina taina basine vara.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

motu: Ba ḡuriḡuri ai emai; badina be ai a tomamu lalomai be ḡoḡoeva-ḡoḡoeva, bona a uramu ḡau idoidiai baia kara maoromaoro.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

motu: Lau na noinoi henimuimu, unu ba kara toma, bena ma baina vasi haraḡa-haraḡa.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

motu: Maino Diravana, mamoe ireḡudia tauna badana, Iesu Keriso, miahanaihanai herohemainona rarana dainai mase amo e hatorea isi lou Diravana, ese
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

motu: ḡau namodia idoidiai baine hanamolaimui ḡuḡuru; bena umui ese iena ura ba kara, bona ia ese e moalelaimu ḡaudia na umui lalomui ai baine havara, Iesu Keriso dainai. Ia baita imodaia hanaihanai. Amen.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

motu: Varavaragu e, lau na noimuimu, egu hahealo herevadia bavabi dae, badina be hereva dia hoho vada name tore henimui.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

motu: Ba diba, varavarada Timoteo vada e ruhaia nege. Ia bema mai haraḡa, raruosi baiama vasi itamui.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

motu: Ihakaumui taudia iboudiai bona helaḡa taudia iboudiai ba hanamodia. Italia taudia ese e hanamomuimu.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

motu: Harihari-bada be iboumui ai emui ai baine mia. Amen.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

motu: Lau Iakobo, Dirava ena hesiai tauna bona Iesu Keriso ena danu, veve gwauta-rarua taumui, idau tano idau tano ai o noho hedoa-hedoamu, na hahenamo henimuimu. Haheauka
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

motu: Varavaragu e, hedibaḡani ese bae butumui tao negadia ai na lalomui baeto ene na moale mo.
english: Count it all joy, my brothers, + 1:2 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * when you fall into various temptations,

motu: Dibamui, emui abidadama itohona ese haheauka e havaraiamu.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

motu: A haheauka ese ena ḡaukara baine haḡuḡurua baine namo, bena ba ḡoeva dae bona ba namo ḡuḡuru, ḡau ta ai basio dabu.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

motu: Umui ta aonega ai bema dabu, ia ese taunimanima iboudiai e henidia dudu kaumu bona se gwaugwaumu Diravana na baine noia, bena do baine henia.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

motu: To abidadama ai baine noinoi, basine daradara; badina be daradara tauna na davara hurehurena na heto, lai ese e hohoamu bona e haginiamu.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

motu: Una tau basine laloa ḡau ta Lohiabada ena amo baine abia;
english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

motu: badina be lalo rua tauna na ena kara iboudiai asie gini tutuka-tutukamu. Ogoḡami bona Taḡa
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

motu: Ekalesia tauna ogoḡamina baine moale, Dirava ese baine abia isi negana ai.
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

motu: Bona taḡa tauna danu baine moale, Dirava ese baine hamorua negana ai; badina be rei huahuana na heto ia na baine lao bubuni.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

motu: Badina be dina e tata dae rohamu, e ḡaraḡaramu, rei e hamaraiamu; bena huahuana e hehuhumu, bona ita-itana namona e oremu. Taḡa tauna danu unu baine lao bubuni toma. Dirava na se dibaḡanidamu
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

motu: Hedibaḡani ai e haheaukamu tauna be namo, badina be baine kwalimu negana ai ia ese mauri ena kwara-havava ḡauna baine abia, Dirava ese vada e gwauraia hamata ḡauna, ia bae ura henia taudia ese bae abia e tomamu.
english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

motu: Hedibaḡani ai ta basineto “Dirava ese e dibaḡanigumu”; badina be dika na Dirava idibaḡanina asi dibana, bona Dirava ese danu tau ta se dibaḡaniamu.
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

motu: A taunimanima ta sibona ena ura dikadia ese lalona e aniamu bona e koiamu.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

motu: Bena ura dikadia na e rogorogomu, kara dikadia e havaramu, bona kara dikadia na e lomu, mase e abiamu.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

motu: Varavaragu e, egu lalokau, sibomui basio hekoi;
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

motu: harihari ḡaudia namodia iboudiai bona herahia ḡaudia ḡoeva-daedia iboudiai na atai amo e maimu, diari idoidiai ihavaradia Diravana ena amo e dihomu; iena diari na se idaumu bona se kerekeremu.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

motu: Sibona ena ura dainai ia ese ena hereva momokani amo e havarada, e havaradia ḡaudia anidia roboadia na heheto. Eda diba heḡereḡerena baita kara
english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

motu: Varavaragu e, egu lalokau, ina na dibamui. A ta ta hereva ikamonaina ai baine haraḡa, hereva igwauraina ai baine halahe, badu ai danu baine halahe.
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

motu: Badina be taunimanima edia badu ese Dirava ena kara maoromaoro se havaraiamu.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

motu: Taunabunai, miro idoinai bona lalohadai dikadia lalomui ai e tubumu ba nege daure; bona lalonlui ai vada e hadoa herevana, laumamui baine hamauridia diba ḡauna, bavaabia dae, mai manaumui ida.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls. + 1:21 or, preserve your life. *

motu: Hereva ibadinana taumui ai baola; bema hereva ikamonaina taumui mo, una be sibomui o hekoimu.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

motu: Badina be tau ta hereva baine kamonai to basine badinaia, ia na hevarivari ai sibona vairana heida-idana e itaiamu tauna na heto;
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

motu: e itaiamu, bena e raka ohomu, asi kaimana e helalo boiomu ia be edeheto.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

motu: A tau ta taravatu ḡoeva-daena, ura kwalimu taravatuna, baine itaia tao bona henunai baine noho, basine kamonai mo a karana danu baine karaia, una tau be hahenamo baine abia ena ḡaukara ai.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

motu: Tau ta lalona ai baineto ia na Dirava ibadinana tauna, to malana se dogoa taomu a sibona lalona e hekoimu, una tau ena Dirava ibadinana na asi anina.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

motu: Dirava ibadinana ḡoevaḡoevana bona asi bebeka-bebekana Tamada Dirava vairanai be iniheto: ihareha bona vabu baita igodia ita edia hisihisi ai, bona siboda baita hegima, tanobada mirona ese basine hamiroda.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

motu: Varavaragu e, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso, hairai Lohiana, o abiabiraiamu; benaini, taunimanima oromadia basio lalo.
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

motu: Badina be tau ta emui dubu ai bema dae kau, imana kwakikwakidia vaḡivagidia na gold bona ena dabua danu hereadae, ma ogoḡami tauna ta danu ena dabua dikana ida bema dae kau,
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, + 2:2 or, meeting * and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

motu: bena dabua namodia e karamu tauna boma abia dae, boma toma “Mani ina gabu namona ai a helai”, a ogoḡami tauna boma hamaoroa, boma toma “Oi na unuseni ai a gini” eiava “Aegu badibadinai a helai”,
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

motu: umui ese taunimanima basioma ha-idaudia a? Basioma hahemaoro kerere a?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

motu: Varavaragu e, egu lalokau, a kamonai. Dirava ese tanobada ai e ogoḡamimu taudia vada e abidia hidimu ani? Edia taḡa na edia abidadama; bona ahudia na vada e gwauraia hamata basileiana, e ura heniamu taudia na baine henidia e tomamu, ani?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

motu: To umui ese ogoḡami tauna vada o hahemaraia. Taḡa taudia ese e daḡedaḡe henimuimu ani? Hahemaoro gabudia ai e dabuimui vareaimu ani?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

motu: Lada namona vada e nemailaimui na idia ese e ere dika heniamu ani?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

motu: Benaini, haheḡani herea-daena ba badinaia, buka ai e torea heḡereḡerena, eto “Dekemu tauna ba lalokau henia, sibomu o helalokaumu heḡereḡerena”. Unu ba kara toma, vada ba namo.
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” + 2:8 Leviticus 19:18 * you do well.

motu: A taunimanima oromadia ba lalo, vada ba kara dika, taravatu enai ba kerere.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

motu: Badina be taravatu idoinai e badinaiamu a kara tamona ai e hekwakwanaimu tauna ese taravatu idoinai e tataia utumu.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

motu: Badina be “Basio heuda hanai” eto tauna na ma e hereva, eto “Basio ala-ala”. Benaini, oi na basioma heuda hanai, a tau ta boma alaia, oi na taravatu boma tataia utu.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” + 2:11 Exodus 20:14; Deuteronomy 5:18 * also said, “Do not commit murder.” + 2:11 Exodus 20:13; Deuteronomy 5:17 * Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

motu: Ba hereva bona ba kara, ura kwalimu taravatuna ese baine hahemaoro henidia taudia na heheto.
english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

motu: Badina be asi ena hebogahisi tauna enai hahemaoro na asi ena hebogahisi. A hebogahisi ese hahemaoro e hereaiamu. Kamonai bona kara
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

motu: Varavaragu e, tau ta baineto ia be kamonai tauna, to asi ena kara, anina be dahaka? Kamonai ese baine hamauria diba a?
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

motu: Tadikaka-ta ta eiava taihuda ta bema asi ena dabua, eiava bema hitoloa mase;
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

motu: bena umui ta ese boma hamaoroa, boma toma “Mai mainomu ida aola, ba hegana, ba boga kunu”, a tau-anidia ai e dabumu ḡaudia na basioma henidia, anina be dahaka?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

motu: Unuhetomana, kamonai asi ena kara vada e mase, badina be sibona.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

motu: A tau ta baineto “Oi na mai emu kamonai, a lau be mai egu kara”. Emu kamonai asi karana ba hamaorolaigu, a lau be egu kamonai na egu kara amo baine haheitalaimu.
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

motu: Oi na o abi daemu Dirava korikori be tamona. Una na namo. To lauma dikadia danu unu e abi dae tomamu, bona deradia e talamu.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

motu: Asi lalomu taumu e, asi dibamu kamonai asi ena kara na asi anina a?
english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

motu: Tamada Abraham ese natuna Isaak pata helaḡana ai e atoa kau negana ai, maorona e gwauraia ani, ena kara daidiai.
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

motu: O itaiamu: ena kamonai bona ena kara e ḡaukara hebouva; bena ena kara ese ena kamonai e haḡuḡuruava, ani?
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

motu: Bena buka ai e torea herevana vada e momokani; eto, Abraham ese Dirava e abiabiraia, bena kara maoromaoro tauna e gwauraiava. Bena e gwauraia, Dirava turana.
english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” + 2:23 Genesis 15:6 * and he was called the friend of God.

motu: Benaini, kara daidiai taunimanima be maorodia bae gwauraidia, dia kamonai mo dainai.
english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

motu: Unuhetomana danu, Rahaba, ariara hahinena, na ena kara daidiai maorona e gwauraia ani; badina be ia ese hasinadoa taudia e abidia dae, bona idau dala amo e siaidia lao.
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

motu: Badina be tau-anina asi laumana be vada e mase; unuhetomana kamonai asi ena kara be vada e mase.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

motu: Varavaragu e, umui hutuma hahediba ai basiola, badina be ai hahediba taumai ihahemaoro-henimai baine auka.
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

motu: Badina be ita iboudai ta hekwakwanai louloumu; tau ta ena hereva ai se hekwakwanaimu, ia na ḡoeva-dae tauna, tau-anina ireḡuna na mai dibana.
english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

motu: Hosi ududia ai idogotaodia auridia ta atomu, bae kamonai henida helaoreana; bena taudia idoidiai ta hatatadia kerehaimu.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

motu: Lagatoi danu ba ita, idia na babada, bona lai badadia ese e odamu, to tari maraḡi-maraḡina ese e tarimu, tari tauna ena ura gabuna baela.
english: Behold, + 3:4 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

motu: Unuhetomana, mala be ḡau maragina, to e heaḡi badamu. Lahi danu ba haeroa, ia na maraḡi to uda badana e araiamu.
english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

motu: Benaini, mala be lahi. Ia na kara dika idoinai e haboumu, tauda reḡedia bogaragidiai, bena tau-anida idoidiai e hadikamu. Ia na mauri idoinai iaralaina; ena lahi danu Gehena amo e abiamu.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna. + 3:6 or, Hell *

motu: Badina be mauri ḡaudia iboudiai, e rakamu ḡaudia bona e rohomu ḡaudia bona e raumu ḡaudia bona davara gaudia, taunimanima na ihamanadadia mai dibadia, bona vada e hamanadadia.
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

motu: A mala ihamanadana na tau ta asi dibana; e raivaraivamu mai dikana ida, mase muramurana amo e honumu.
english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

motu: Iena amo Lohiabada, ita Tamada, ta hanamoamu; iena amo danu Dirava heida-idaua ai e karadiamu taudia ta uduguiraidiamu.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

motu: Udu tamona amo hahenamo bona heuduguirai e lasimu. Varavaragu e, una na dia namo.
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

motu: Guri tamona amo ranu gaihona bona ranu iditana e lohi lohi daemu a?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

motu: Varavaragu e, suke auna ai olive huahuadia bae dobi a? Eiava vine auna ai suke huahuadia bae dobi a? Tadi danu ranu gaihona se havaraiamu.
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

motu: Daika na bogaragimui ai e aonegamu bona lalona e pararamu? Ia ese ena mauri namona na ena kara ai baine hahedinaraia, aonega korikori manauna ai.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

motu: A vaḡeḡe dikadia bona heiri-heiri na lalomui ai bema mia, basioma heaḡi bona hereva momokani basioma hagagevaia.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

motu: Una na dia atai amo e maimu aonegana, a tanobada ḡauna, tau-anina ena, lauma dikadia edia.
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

motu: Badina be vaḡeḡe bona heiri-heiri e miamu gabuna ai, heloḡo-heloḡo bona kara dika idoinai e miamu.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

motu: A atai amo e maimu aonegana toana gini-gunana be ḡoevaḡoeva, murinai maino, gado-namo, lalomanada. Ia na hebogahisi bona huahua namodia amo e honumu. Ia na asi ena daradara bona asi ena dibaka.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

motu: Kara maoromaoro anina be maino ai e hadoamu, herohemaino taudia ediai.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

motu: Tuari bona heatu bogaragimui ai be ede amo e varamu? Ini amo e varamu: emui ura dikadia na taumui reḡedia ai e tuarimu, ani?
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

motu: O ura lalo-dikamu, to asio abimu, bena o ala-alamu. O hekise-hekisemu, to asio davarimu, bena o heatumu bona o tuarimu. Asio abimu, badina be asio noinoimu.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

motu: Eiava o noinoimu, to asio abimu, badina be o noinoi kereremu; emui lalo-hadai be bavabi ḡaudia na emui ura dikadia ai ba petapetalai.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

motu: Heuda-hanai taumui e! Heuda-hanai hahinemui e! Asi dibamui tanobada iura-henina na Dirava i'inai-henina a? Taunabunai, tanobada e hetura heniamu tauna na Dirava inaina.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

motu: Eiava lalomui ai o tomamu revareva helaḡana na e gwau kavamu a? E tomamu, Laloda ai e hanohoa laumana ese e ura henida lalo-dikamu.
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

motu: A ia ese ena harihari-bada e heni louloumu. Una dainai ma e tomamu, Dirava ese hekokoroku taudia e laodia ahumu, a manau taudia na e harihari henidiamu.
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” + 4:6 Proverbs 3:34 *

motu: Taunabunai, Dirava isiaina ba lao heni. Diabolo ba ginia ahu, bena ia ese baine heautanimui.
english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

motu: Dirava ba raka henia kahi, bena ia ese danu baine raka henimui kahi. Kara dika taumui e, imamui ba huri. Lalo rua taumui e, lalomui ba haḡoevadia.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

motu: Ba dara doko, ba lalo hisihisi, ba taitai. Emui kiri na lalo-hisihisi ai bainela; emui moale na dara-doko ai bainela.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

motu: Lohiabada vairanai ba hahemanau, bena ia ese baine abimui dae. Ba hahemanau
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

motu: Varavaragu e, basio ere dika heheni. Tau ta ese varavarana e ere dika heniamu eiava e hahemaoro heniamu, ia ese taravatu danu e ere dika heniamu bona e hahemaoro heniamu. A oi ese taravatu ba hahemaoro henia, oi na dia taravatu ibadinana tauna, a hahemaaro tauna.
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

motu: Tarava iatuna tauna bona hahemaoro tauna be tamona mo: ia na mai siahuna baine hahemauri bona baine hahemase. A oi be daika, dekemu tauna na o hahemaoro heniamu?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

motu: Umui haida o gwaumu “Hari dina eiava kerukeru una hanua baitala, unuseni ai laḡani ta baita noho, baita hoihoi, eda moni baita habou”.
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

motu: A asi dibamui kerukeru dahaka baine vara. Badina be emui mauri be dahaka? Ranu varahuna mo, nega sisina mo e hedinaraimu, ma e boiomu.
english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

motu: Matona, boma toma “Lohiabada baine ura, ita na baita mauri, ini unu baita kara toma”.
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

motu: A harihari emui hekokoroku o heaḡi-laiamu; heaḡi unuhetomana idoinai be dika.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

motu: Taunabunai, kara namo ikarana mai dibana to se karaiamu tauna na kara dika tauna.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

motu: Taḡa taumui e, a taitai, a tai lolo-lolo, dara-doko emui ai be kaumu dainai.
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

motu: Emui kohu na vada e houka-houkamu, bona emui dabua na pitopito ese vada e animu.
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

motu: Emui gold bona emui silver vada e hogohogomu; edia hogohogo ese baine hahemaoro henimui, hidiomui baine ani, lahi na heto. Emui kohu vada o haboumu, dina gabedia ḡaudia.
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

motu: A kamonai: emui uma anidia e utu taudia davadia o abihaidia na e lolomu; bona iutudia taudia edia taitai na Iehova Sabaota taiana ai vada e vareai.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies. + 5:4 Greek: Sabaoth (or Hebrew: Tze’va’ot) *

motu: Umui na tanobada ai o mauri nohomu mai namomui ida, bona o kara lebulebumu; bona bogamui vada e kunumu ala-ala dinana ai.
english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

motu: Kara maoromaoro tauna vada o revaia, bena vada o alaia mase; ia ese se laomui ahu. Ekalesia taumui, ba haheauka
english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, ba haheauka, ela bona Lohiabada na baine gini dae. A laloa: biru tauna ese ena biru anina e nariamu mai haheaukana ida, ela hona medu gunana bona medu gabena bae hapariparia.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

motu: Umui danu ba haheauka; lalomui na bae goada balaheni, badina be Lohiabada maina be kahira-kahira.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

motu: Varavaragu e, basio hemaumau heheni, hahemaoro tauna ese baine hahemaoro henimui na garina; a itaia, ia na iduara vairanai vada e ginimu.
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

motu: Varavaragu e, peroveta taudia, Lohiabada ladana ai e herevava taudia, edia hisi-ani bona edia haheauka ba haḡoidia.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

motu: Ta tomamu haheauka taudia na nanamo, ani? Iobu ena haheauka harina vada o kamonai, bona Lohiabada ena kara vada o itaia, ena hegbogahisi bona ena hariharibada vada e bada herea.
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

motu: A varavaragu e, herea-daena binai: hereva metaudia amo basio gwau hamata; guba eiava tanobada eiava idau ḡau ta ladana ai basio gwau hamata; guba eoiaba tanpobada eioava idau ḡau ta ladana ai basio gwau hamata. A emui “oibe” baine oibe, bona emui “lasi” baine lasi, baine hahemaoro henimui na garina.
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy. + 5:12 TR reads “under judgment” instead of “into hypocrisy” *

motu: Bogaragimui ai ta hisi e animu a? Baine ḡuriḡuri. Ta e moalemu a? Ane baine abi.
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

motu: Bogaragimui ai ta e gorereamu a? Ekalesia ita-taona taudia baine boiridia, bena idia ese ia dainai bae ḡuriguri, bona dehoro bae horolaia, Lohiabada ladana ai.
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

motu: Bena abidadama ḡuriḡurina dainai gorere tauna do baine mauri; Lohiabada ese baine hatorea isi, bona ena kara dika baine gwau tao.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

motu: Taunabunai, emui kara dika ba hahedinarai heheni, bona ta ta bamomui daidiai ba ḡuriḡuri; bena ba mauri. Kara maoromaoro tauna ena ḡuriḡuri ese anina e havaraiamu mai siahuna Ida.
english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

motu: Elia na taunimanima mo, ila bamoda; to ia na e ḡuriḡuri goadagoadava medu basine diho, bena medu na tanobada latanai se dihova, laḡani toi hua tauratoi lalodiai.
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

motu: Ma e ḡuriḡuri louva, bena medu na guba amo e dihova, bona tano ese anina e havaraiava.
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

motu: Varavaragu e, ta umui bogaragimui ai hereva momokani dalana amo baine raka siri, bena ta ese baine haloua,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

motu: ba diba ḡoevaḡoeva, kara dika tauna ena dala kererekererena amo baine haloua tauna ese laumana na mase amo baine harohoa mauri bona kara dika momo danu baine tahuni.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

motu: Lau Petro, Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo taugu, ese e abimui hidi taumui, Ponto ai bona Galatia ai bona Kapadokia ai bona Asia ai bona Bitunia ai o noho hedoa-hedoamu, na tore henimuimu.
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

motu: Ita Tamada Dirava ese e abimui hidi guna, bena Lauma Helaḡa ese e hahelaḡamui, Iesu Keriso ba kamonai henia bena ia rarana ese baine nevarimui helaoreana. Hariharibada bona maino emui ai bae bada. Heimodai
english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

motu: Dirava, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso Tamana, aita imodaia. Iena hebogahisi na bada herea dainai, ia ese vada e havarada lou, mauri helarona ai, Iesu Keriso mase amo e tore isi lou dainai.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

motu: Ahumui do bavabia, baine mia hanaihanai, asi bebeka-bebekana, basine marai, guba ai vada e atoa heḡaeḡae umui emui.
english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

motu: Abidadama dainai Dirava ena siahu ese e gimamuimu, ela bona vada e seua hahemaurina, nega gabena ai baine hedinarai ḡauna, bavabia.
english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

motu: Una dainai, ena be ina nega sina ai hedibaḡani momodaidiai daramui e dokomu, to ba moale.
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

motu: Emui abidadama e tohoamu, gold lahi ai e tohoamu na heto. Ena namo ese gold ena namo e hereaiamu; ia na ihanamolaimui bona iheatolaimui bona imatauraimui ḡauna ai bainela, Iesu Keriso baine hedinarai dinana ai.
english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

motu: Ena be nega ta asio itaia, to o ura heniamu; ena be asio itaiamu, to o abidadama heniamu bona o moalelaiamu; emui moale na asi igwauraina dalana, o moale hisi daemu.
english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

motu: Emui abidadama huahuana do bavabia, laumamui ihamauridia benai.
english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

motu: Peroveta taudia, Dirava ena harihari-bada emui ai baine kau e gwauraia guna taudia, ese hari hahemauri e henanadailaia bona e tahua malaka-malaka.
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

motu: Keriso ena lauma lalodia ai e nohova; Keriso baine ani hisidia bona murinai baine abi hairaidia e hadibalaidiava; bena idia ese negana bona toana e tahuva.
english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

motu: E hadibadia danu, unu ḡau e ḡaukaralaidia na dia idia edia, to umui emui; bona harihari sivarai namo e harorolai henimui taudia ese vada e gwaurai, Lauma Helaḡa guba amo vada e siaia diho dainai. Unu ḡau aneru ese itana urana e uramu e tomamu. Ba helaḡa
english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

motu: Lalomui ba haḡoeva, ba haheauka. Iesu Keriso baine hedinarai negana ai emui ai baine kau hariharina ba laroa mai lalomui idoidiai.
english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. + 1:13 literally, “gird up the waist of your mind” or “put on the belt of the waist of your mind” * Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

motu: Kamonai memeromui ai baola. O diburava negadia ai o ḡahusiva ḡaudia na basio haḡoidia;
english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

motu: a e boirimui Tauna vada e helaḡa heḡereḡerena, umui danu ba helaḡa, emui kara idoidiai lalodiai.
english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

motu: Badina be vada e torea, Umui na ba helaḡa, badina be lau name helaḡa.
english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.” + 1:16 Leviticus 11:44-45 *

motu: Taunimanima e hahemaoro henidiamu negadia ai na oromadia se lalomu, a ta ta ena ḡaukara ena ḡaukara daidiai e hahemaoro henidiamu, Diravana o hahaneamu, Tamamui o gwauraiamu; benaini, ina emui noho-hedoa negana ai ba noho mai garimui ida.
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

motu: Bona ba diba, senemui edia kara asi anidia amo e hamaurimui davana na dia baine pata ḡauna ta, dia silver, dia gold,
english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

motu: a rara herea-daena, mamoe natuna asi bebeka-bebekana bona asi toutouna rarana na heto, Keriso rarana benai.
english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

motu: Tanobada do se havaraia negana ai e abia heḡaeḡae, a ini dina gabedia ai vada eme hedinarai, umui daimui ai.
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

motu: Ia bagunai Dirava o abidadama heniamu; Dirava ese mase amo e hatorea isi bona hairaina e henia; taunabunai emui abidadama bona emui helaro na Dirava enai mimia.
english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

motu: Hereva momokani vada o kamonai dainai laumamui vada o haḡoevadia bona varavarada o lalokau henidia momokanimu; benaini, ba heura heheni mai lalomui idoidiai.
english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

motu: Vada o vara matamata, dia baine pata ḡauna ena amo, a Mauri bona Noho-hanaihanai Diravana ena hereva dainai.
english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

motu: Badina be Taunimanima iboudiai na rei na heto, Idia hairaidia na rei huahuadia na heheto; Rei e maraimu, bona huahuana e hehuhumu,
english: For, “ All|strong="G3956" * flesh|strong="G4561" * is|strong="G3588" * like|strong="G5613" * grass|strong="G5528" *, and|strong="G2532" * all|strong="G3956" * of|strong="G2532" * man|strong="G3956" *’s glory|strong="G1391" * like|strong="G5613" * the|strong="G2532" * flower in|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * grass|strong="G5528" *. The|strong="G2532" * grass|strong="G5528" * withers|strong="G3583" *, and|strong="G2532" * its|strong="G3956" * flower falls|strong="G1601" *;

motu: A Lohiabada ena hereva do baine hesiriu hanaihanai. Sivarai namo vada e harorolai henimui herevana benai.
english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” + 1:25 Isaiah 40:6-8 * This|strong="G3778" * is|strong="G1510" * the|strong="G1519" * word|strong="G4487" * of|strong="G2962" * Good|strong="G2097" * News|strong="G2097" * which|strong="G3588" * was|strong="G1510" * preached|strong="G2097" * to|strong="G1519" * you|strong="G5210" *.

motu: Taunabunai, lalo-hadai dikadia iboudiai bona koikoi iboudiai bona dibaka karadia bona ere dikadia iboudiai ba nege daure.
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

motu: Lauma ena rata ḡoevaḡoevana ba ura henia, memero karukarudia na heheto; unu amo ba bada oho bada oho, ela bona hahemauri bavabia.
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

motu: Badina be Lohiabada ena harihari-bada vada o mamia toho.
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

motu: Ia dekena aoma; ia na nadi maurina, taunimanima ese e dadaraia, a Dirava ese vada e abia hidi, davana bada nadina ai vada e hataoa.
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

motu: Umui danu bae larebamui dae, mauri nadidia na heheto, lauma ena dubu ai baola, hahelaḡa taumui ai baola, lauma ena boubou ḡaudia ba hahelaḡa, Iesu Keriso dainai Dirava ese baine abi dae ḡaudia.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

motu: Badina be buka ai ini e torea toma, A itaia, daiguni nadina namo-hereana vada na abia hidi, Siona ai vada na atoa. Baine abidadama henia tauna na basine hemarai.
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “ Behold|strong="G2400" *, + 2:6 “Behold”, from “” or “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at.
