He|strong="G2532" * who|strong="G3588" * believes|strong="G4100" * in|strong="G1722" * him|strong="G3588" * will|strong="G2532" * not|strong="G3756" * be|strong="G2532" * disappointed|strong="G2617" *.” + 2:6 Isaiah 28:16 *

motu: Taunabunai, o abiabiraiamu taumui emui ai ia na herea dae; a gwau-edeede taudia ediai, Ruma ilarebana taudia ese e dadaraia nadina na Daiguni nadina ai vada ela;
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “ The|strong="G2532" * stone|strong="G3037" * which|strong="G3739" * the|strong="G2532" * builders|strong="G3618" * rejected has|strong="G3739" * become|strong="G1096" * the|strong="G2532" * chief|strong="G2776" * cornerstone|strong="G2776" *,” + 2:7 Psalms 118:22 *

motu: bona Hekwakwanai nadina, hetutuhi papapapana. Edia gwau-edeede dainai hereva ai e hekwakwanaimu; ahudia korikori bunai.
english: and, “ a|strong="G2532" * stumbling|strong="G4625" * stone|strong="G3037" * and|strong="G2532" * a|strong="G2532" * rock|strong="G4073" * of|strong="G3056" * offense|strong="G4625" *.” + 2:8 Isaiah 8:14 * For|strong="G1519" * they|strong="G2532" * stumble|strong="G4350" * at|strong="G1519" * the|strong="G2532" * word|strong="G3056" *, being|strong="G2532" * disobedient, to|strong="G1519" * which|strong="G3739" * also|strong="G2532" * they|strong="G2532" * were|strong="G3588" * appointed|strong="G5087" *.

motu: A umui na e abia hidi besena, hahelaḡa taudia herea-daedia, hanua helaḡana, Dirava ena orea. E abimui hidi, dibura amo e boirimui bona ena diari herea-daena ai e hakaumui lasi tauna ena kara namodia ba gwaurai hedinarai helaoreana.
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

motu: Gunaguna umui na asi besemui, a harihari umui na Dirava ena bese. Gunaguna ta ese se bogamui hisi, a harihari hebogahisi vada o davaria. Hahealo herevadia
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, na noimuimu, umui na noho-hedoa taumui bona laolao taumui na heheto dainai, tau-anina ena heḡahusi karadia basio kara; idia ese lauma e tuari heniamu.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

motu: A bese idau-idau taudia vairadiai emui kara bae ḡoeva; bena, ena be bae habadelaimui, kara dika taumui bae gwauraimui, to emui kara namo do bae ita dainai idia ese Dirava bae imodaia, iena vadivadi dinana ai.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

motu: Taunimanima edia taravatu iboudiai ba badina, Lohiabada dainai. Hanua pavapavana ba kamonai henia, badina be ia na herea.
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

motu: Bona gavana taudia, ia ese kara dika taudia ihadikadia bona kara namo taudia ihanamodia totona e siaidia, ba kamonai henidia.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena ura be emui kara namo amo kavakava taudia edia hereva kava ba tuidia.
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

motu: Umui na ura kwalimu taumui, to emui ura kwalimu na kara dika dalana ikehona ḡauna ai basio halaoa; Dirava isiaina ba lao heni.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

motu: Taunimanima iboudiai ba matauraidia. Iseda orea taudia ba lalokau henidia. Dirava garina ba gari. Hanua pavapavana ba matauraia.
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

motu: Hesiai taumui e, biagumui ba kamonai henidia bona ba matauraidia; dia kara namo bona gado namo taudia mo, a daḡedaḡe taudia danu.
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

motu: Badina be ina na mai hahenamona: asi ena kerere tauna ese Dirava ibadinana dainai hisi baine ani.
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

motu: Umui na ba kara dika, bena bae dadabamui negana ai ba haheauka, namona be dahaka? A ba kara namo, bena hisi bavani negana ai ba haheauka, una na mai hahenamona Dirava ena amo.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

motu: Una dainai e boirimui. Badina be Keriso umui daimui ai e hisihisiva, emui raka dalana e henimui, ia aena gabudia ai ba raka helaoreana.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you + 2:21 TR reads “us” instead of “you” * an example, that you should follow his steps,

motu: Ia ese kara dikana ta se karaia, bona ia uduna amo hereva koikoina ta se lasi.
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.” + 2:22 Isaiah 53:9 *

motu: E ere dika henia, to se hedava. Hisi e ani, to se daḡedaḡe. A Hahemaoro Diravana maoromaorona e abidadama henia.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

motu: Ia tau-anina ai eda dika e hua, au dorina ai, kara dika enai baita mase bona kara maoromaoro enai baita mauri helaoreana. Ia berona ese vada e hamaurida.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds. + 2:24 or, stripes *

motu: Badina be umui na o dobiva, mamoe na heheto; a harihari, laumamui ireḡudia bona ita-taodia Tauna vada o lou henia.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer + 2:25 “Overseer” is from the Greek ἐπίσκοπον, which can mean overseer, curator, guardian, or superintendent. * of your souls.

motu: Hahine e, umui danu adavamui ba kamonai henidia, bena idia haida, ena be hereva asie abia daemu, to umui emui kara daidiai do bae helalo kerehai,
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

motu: emui igo-diho bona hemataurai karadia bae ita negadia ai.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

motu: Heramui namodia na dia kopimui heradia, dia hui ipanina, eiava gold heraheradia, eiava dabua namo-hereadia idokilaidia;
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

motu: a lalomui heraheradia, basie pata ḡaudia, lalo-manau asi daḡedaḡena: una na kohu herea-daena Dirava vairanai.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

motu: Sene hahinedia helaḡadia, Dirava e abidadama heniava hahinedia, unu e hera tomava, bona adavadia e kamonai henidiava.
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

motu: Sara na heto, Abraham e kamonai heniava, “lohia” e gwauraiava. Umui na ia natuna, o kara maoromaoromu bona ḡau ta garina asio garinlu negadia ai.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

motu: Tatau e, umui danu, adavamui ida o noho heboumu dalana ba haeroa. Hahine ba matauraidia, badina be idia edia goada bona umui emui goada na dia heheḡereḡere, to mauri hariharina na idia mai ahudia, umui mai ahumui; unu ba noho toma, bena emui ḡuriḡuri na asi ilao-ahuna.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

motu: Hereva orena binai: iboumui ai lalomui bae tamona; ba hekaha heheni, ba heura heheni, tadikaka na heheto. Ba hebogahisi heheni; ba manau.
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

motu: Kara dika bona ere dika basio hadava, a e hadikamuimu taudia ba hanamodia. Badina be una totona vada e boirimui, bona una dainai baine hanamomui.
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

motu: Badina be Mauri e uramu Bona dina namodia itadia e uramu tauna ese Malana baine naria, basine ere dika, Uduna bibinadia danu koikoi herevadia basie gwaurai;
english: For, “ He|strong="G2532" * who|strong="G3588" * would|strong="G2309" * love|strong="G2309" * life|strong="G2222" * and|strong="G2532" * see|strong="G3708" * good|strong="G3588" * days|strong="G2250" *, let|strong="G1063" * him|strong="G3588" * keep|strong="G3361" * his|strong="G3708" * tongue|strong="G1100" * from|strong="G2532" * evil|strong="G2556" * and|strong="G2532" * his|strong="G3708" * lips|strong="G5491" * from|strong="G2532" * speaking|strong="G2980" * deceit|strong="G1388" *.

motu: Dika baine rakatania, kara namo baine kara; Maino baine tahua, baine ḡavaia.
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let|strong="G1161" * him|strong="G4160" * seek|strong="G2212" * peace|strong="G1515" * and|strong="G2532" * pursue|strong="G1377" * it|strong="G2532" *.

motu: Badina be Lohiabada ese kara maoromaoro taudia e haḡerediamu, Edia noinoi danu e kamonaimu; A kara dika taudia na Lohiabada ese e laodia ahumu. Daḡedaḡe lalodiai ba haheauka
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and|strong="G2532" * his|strong="G1519" * ears|strong="G3775" * open to|strong="G1519" * their|strong="G2532" * prayer|strong="G1162" *; but|strong="G1161" * the|strong="G2532" * face|strong="G4383" * of|strong="G2532" * the|strong="G2532" * Lord|strong="G2962" * is|strong="G2962" * against|strong="G1909" * those|strong="G1161" * who|strong="G3748" * do|strong="G4160" * evil|strong="G2556" *.” + 3:12 Psalms 34:12-16 *

motu: Kara namo ba lalokau henia, bena daika ese baine hadikamui?
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

motu: A bema hisi bavani, kara maoromaoro dainai, ba namo. Edia hahegari herevadia na garidia basio gari; kudoumui danu basie hetaha.
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.” + 3:14 Isaiah 8:12 *

motu: A Keriso na lalomui ai ba hahelaḡaia, emui Lohiabada. Ba heḡaegae, emui helaro badina bae nanadailaimui taudia na ba haere henidia, to, ba haere mai manaumui bona mai hematauraimui ida.
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

motu: Lalomui bae ḡoevaḡoeva; bena bae maumauraimui, dikamui bae gwaurai, taudia na emui kara namo Keriso lalonai o karamu ese do bae hahemaraidia.
english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

motu: Badina be Dirava baine ura emui kara namo daidiai ba hisihisi, una na namo; a dia namo emui kara dika daidiai ba hisihisi.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

motu: Badina be Keriso nega tamona mo e mase, dika iabio-hodia; kara maoromaoro tauna ese kara gageva-gageva tauda e hebodohilaida, baine hakauda lou Dirava enai helaoreana. Tau-anina e alaia, a laumana e hamauria;
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

motu: bena ia na ela, e koudia laumadia e haroro henidia.
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

motu: Idia na gunaguna e gwau ede-edeva, Noa lagatoi e karaia negana ai, bena Dirava ese e naridiava mai haheaukana ida; a una lagatoi ai taunimanima dia hoho, taurahani hona, ranu amo e hamauridia.
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

motu: Una heḡereḡerena be bapatiso, harihari umui eme hamaurimui, dia tau-anina mirona ihuri-ohona, a lalomui ihaḡoevadia Dirava vairanai, Iesu Keriso mase amo e tore isi lou dainai.
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

motu: Ia na guba ai vada e vareai, Dirava idibana kahana ai e helaimu; aneru bona lohia bona siahu taudia iboudiai na ia henunai e nohomu.
english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

motu: Keriso na tau-anina ai e hisihisiva dainai, umui ese emui lalo-hadai na iena ida ba haheḡereḡere, lalomui iha-aukadia; badina be tau-anina e hisihisimu tauna ese kara dika e rakatania.
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

motu: Taunabunai, emui mauri orena tau-animui ai, taunimanima edia heḡahusi ḡaudia basio badina, a Dirava ena ura hari ba badinaia.
english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

motu: Badina be gunaguna umui na bese idauidau taudia heḡereḡeredia ai o nohova, mata-dika bona heḡahusi karadia o karava, vine ranuna o inu momova, o lebulebuva, o kekerova, kaivakuku dikadia o toma heni dihova.
english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

motu: Harihari idia na e hoamu, badina be umui na asio bamodiamu, idia ida asio lebulebu heboumu; taunabunai dikamui e gwauraimu.
english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

motu: A idia na mauri taudia bona mase taudia e hahemaoro henidiamu Diravana vairanai do bae gini.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

motu: Badina bunai sivarai namo na mase taudia e harorolai henidia, bena, ena be tau-anidia e hahemaoro henidia, taunimanima iboudiai heḡereḡeredia, to laumadia na do bae mauri, Dirava maurina ai.
english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

motu: Ḡau iboudiai dokodia vada be kaumu; ba boga auka, ba gima, ba ḡuriḡuri.
english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

motu: A herea-daena binai: ba heura heheni mai lalomui idoidiai, badina be uraheni ese kara dika momo e tahunimu.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

motu: Ba heabi dae heheni, basio maumau.
english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

motu: E ahulaimui ḡaudia na ba hariharilai, Dirava ena harihari-bada ireḡuna taudia ai baola.
english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

motu: Ta baine haroro, ia na Dirava ena hereva baine gwaurai. Ma ta baine hekaha, ia na Dirava ese e heniamu goadana amo baine hekaha. Unu amo ḡau iboudiai lalodiai Dirava ba imodaia Iesu Keriso bagunai: hairai bona siahu na iena, ela bona hanaihanai. Amen. Ina hahedika negana
english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, hisihisi lahi na heto emui ai e kaumu na basio daradaralaia, basioto ḡau idauna ta emui ai e varamu: lasi, ena na itoholaimui ḡauna mo.
english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

motu: A Keriso ida o hisihisi heboumu dainai ba moale; gabeai ia hairaina baine hedinarai negana ai ba moale hisi dae.
english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

motu: Keriso ladana dainai bae gwau dika henimui, do ba namo; badina be Dirava ena Lauma, hairai Laumana, na emui ai baine kau.
english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

motu: Dia namo umui ta baine hisihisi ala-ala dainai, eiava henao dainai, eiava kara dika dainai, eiava hesivarai dainai;
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

motu: a ta ese Keriso ibadinana dainai baine hisihisi, ia na basine hemarai, a Dirava baine imodaia.
english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

motu: Badina be hahemaoro negana vada eme kau, Dirava ena orea ai aine hematama; a ita baine guna henida, Dirava ena sivarai namo e dadaraiamu taudia na ede bae heto?
english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

motu: Bona kara maoromaoro tauna na mauri iabina baine hekwarahi, Dirava se badinaiamu tauna eiava kara dika tauna na ede baine gini toma?
english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?” + 4:18 Proverbs 11:31 *

motu: Taunabunai, Dirava ena ura dainai hisi e animu taudia ese kara namodia mo bae kara, bona laumadia na e karadia Diravana imana nuanai bae atodia.
english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

motu: Umui hahidaosi ekalesia ita-taona taumui aina hahealo henimui. Lau danu heitatao taugu. Keriso e hisihisiva lau danu na itaia, bona baine hedinarai hairaina ai lau danu mai ahugu.
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

motu: Dirava ena mamoe serina ba reḡudia. Ba itadia tao, Dirava ena ura heḡereḡerena; dia gwaugwau amo, a lalodia iha-uradia amo; dia kohu idavarina totona, a lalomui e uramu dainai;
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

motu: dia lohia taumui ai baola totona, a mamoe serina bae haḡoimui totona.
english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

motu: Bena mamoe ireḡudia Tauna badana baine hedinarai negana ai, kwara-havava ḡauna mai hairaina, se maraimu ḡauna, do bavabia.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

motu: Eregabe taumui e, umui ese heitatao taudia ba kamonai henidia. Iboumui ai, lalo-manau ba hahedokilaia; badina be Dirava ese hekokoroku taudia e laodia ahumu, a manau taudia e harihari henidiamu.
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” + 5:5 Proverbs 3:34 *

motu: Taunabunai, Dirava imana siahuna henunai ba hahemanau, bena negana baine gini dae ia ese do baine abimui isi.
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

motu: Emui lalo-haguhi na ia enai ba tahoa kau, badina be ia ese e lalomuimu.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

motu: Ba boga auka, ba gima; inaimui diabolo na e loamu mai ḡouna ida, leona na heto, baine anidia ore taudia na e tahudiamu.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

motu: Ba laoa ahu, abidadama ai ba gini tutuka-tutuka; ba diba, o animu hmisidia heḡereḡeredia varavaramui tanobada heḡeḡe-madai ai danu e animu.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

motu: Umui na nega sina mo ba hisihisi; bena harihari-bada idoinai Diravana, Keriso dainai ena mia-hanaihanai hairaina iabina vada e boirimui Diravana, ese baine hanamomui ḡuḡuru, baine haginimui tutukatutuka, baine hakwalimumui.
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

motu: Siahu na ia ena, ela bona hanaihanai. Amen. Hahetoni
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

motu: Ina revareva sina na Siluano imana amo vada na torea heau heau. Lau na tomamu ia na varavara korikori. Na haduamuimu, Dirava ena harihari-bada korikorina binai; ia lalonai ba gini tutuka-tutuka.
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

motu: Ekalesia oreana Babulono ai, umui bamomui e abidia hidi taudia, ese e hahenamo henimuimu. Natugu Mareko ese danu e hahenamo henimuimu.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

motu: Lalokau haherahuna amo ba hahenamo heheni. Keriso lalonai o nohomu taumui iboumui ai, maino emui ai baine mia.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace|strong="G1515" * be|strong="G3956" * to|strong="G1722" * all|strong="G3956" * of|strong="G1722" * you|strong="G5210" * who|strong="G3588" * are|strong="G3588" * in|strong="G1722" * Christ|strong="G5547" * Jesus. Amen.

motu: Lau, Simona Petro, Iesu Keriso isiaina ilao-henina bona ena aposetolo taugu, umui ai ida eda abidadama tamona iseda Dirava bona Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso ena kara maoromaoro enai e miamu taumui na tore henimuimu:
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

motu: harihari-bada bona maino emui ai bae bada, emui laloparara danu Dirava enai bona eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso enai baine bada. Laumamui ihagoadadia
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

motu: Dirava ena siahu ese eda mauri bona ia ibadinana ḡaudia iboudiai vada e henida, hairaina bona ḡoeva-daena amo vada e boirida Tauna tame diba dainai.
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

motu: Unu amo ena gwauhamata badadia bona hereadia vada e henida; unu gwauhamata ese tanobada ena heḡahusi bodagadia amo bae harohomui mauri, bena Dirava lalona korikorina bavabia.
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

motu: Badina bunai, ba goada balaheni. Emui kamonai enai, kara namo bavatoa kau; kara namo enai lalo-parara bavatoa kau;
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

motu: lalo-parara enai haheauka bavaloa kau; haheauka enai boga-auka bavatoa kau; boga-auka enai Dirava ibadinana bavatoa kau;
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

motu: Dirava ibadinana enai tadikakamui irua-henidia bavatoa kau; bona tadikakamui iura-henidia enai lalokau bavatoa kau.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

motu: Badina be bema ini ḡau lalomui ai bae mia bona bae bada, umui na lahedo taumui bona asi damumui taumui ai basiola, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso mai dibamui dainai.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: A ini ḡau ai e dabumu tauna, ia na matakepulu tauna; matana e tunamu dainai e helalo boiomu ena kara dika gunadia vada e huri oho vaitani.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

motu: Taunabunai, varavaragu e, ba goada balaheni, e boirimui bona e abimui hidi vada ba hamomokania, badina be unu ba kara toma negana ai umui na basio keto.
english: Therefore, brothers, + 1:10 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

motu: Bona unu amo emui dala baine lailai ḡoevaḡoeva, eda Lohiabada bona eda Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso ena mia-hanaihanai basileiana lalonai ba raka vareai. Ina revareva badina
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

motu: Badina bunai lau na tomamu ini hereva baina hamaorolaimui loulou. Ena be mai dibamui bona hereva momokani ai o gini tutuka-tutukamu,
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

motu: to lau na tomamu, ina taruha doini na noho heniamu ai, baina haomui bona ini ḡau baina hahelalolaimui une.
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

motu: Badina be lau dibagu egu taruha iraḡana negana vada eme kahira-kahira; iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso unu vada e hadibagu toma.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

motu: A baina goada toho, bena egu mase murinai ini ḡau ba helalolai une, nega iboudiai. Keriso hairaina na itaia
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

motu: Badina be eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena siahu bona ena mai herevadia a hamaorolaimuiva negadia ai, ai na dia gori herevadia asia sivaraiva, a ia hairaina na matamai amo a itaia.
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

motu: Badina be Tamada Dirava ena amo hemataurai bona hairai e abi negana ai, ere ta Diari-diari Herea-daena lalona amo e kamonai, eto, “Ina na Natugu, egu lalokau; lau ia na lalo namo heniamu”.
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.” + 1:17 Matthew 17:5; Mark 9:7; Luke 9:35 *

motu: Ina ere ai ese a kamonai, ia ida ororo helaḡana ai a nohova negana ai. Peroveta herevadia na Dirava ena amo
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

motu: Unu amo peroveta herevadia vada e momokani vaitani, ai emai ai. Umui danu ba badinadia baine namo; idia na lamepa gabu diburana ai e diarimu na heto, ela bona daba baine rere, bona hisiu bada na lalomui ai baine dae.
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

motu: A ina na ba diba guna: ta ese sibona ena lalo-hadai heḡereḡerena ai peroveta bukadia anidia basine gwaurai.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

motu: Badina be peroveta herevadia na taunimanima edia ura kava amo asie vara, a Lauma Helaḡa ese Dirava ena helaḡa taudia e haduadia heḡereḡerena e herevava.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

motu: Peroveta taudia koikoidia na taunimanima bogaragidiai e nohova; bona umui bogaragimui ai danu hahediba koikoi taudia do bae gini tore. Idia na hahediba herevadia koikoidia bae hadibalai hehuni, bona Biagudia, e hoidia Tauna, bae ḡorea. Bae mase haraga, sibodia edia hahedika ai.
english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

motu: A hutuma ese edia dala dikadia ai bae ḡavadia; idia daidiai hereva momokani dalana na dikana bae gwauraia.
english: Many will follow their immoral + 2:2 TR reads “destructive” instead of “immoral” * ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

motu: Edia mata-ḡaniḡani dainai, koikoi herevadia amo lalomui bae ani, ela bona bae abimui; a ihahemaorohenidia na se halahemu, bona ihamasedia na se mahutamu. Sisiba herevadia
english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

motu: Dirava ese e kara havara anerudia na se bogadia hisi, a dibura masemase gabuna ai e tahodia dobi, unuseni ai e ḡuidia ela bona hahemaoro negana.
english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, + 2:4 Tartarus is another name for Hell * and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

motu: Bona bese gunana danu se bogaia hisi; Noa mo, kara maoromaoro iharorolaina tauna, mai bamona hahituosi ida, e hamauridia, a ia garina asie gariva taudia be utu-utu ese e habuadia.
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

motu: Sodoma bona Gomora danu e habuadia tari, kahu ai e halaodia, gabeai ia garina basie gari taudia matadia ihakanidia;
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

motu: a Lot mo, kara maoromaoro tauna, e hamauria. Una Lot be lalona e hesiku, kara dika taudia edia lebulebu karadia daidiai;
english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

motu: ia na kara maoromaoro tauna, a idia padadiai e nohova dinadia iboudiai edia kara havara e itava e kamonaiva dainai ia lalona e hisihisiva.
english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

motu: Benaini, Lohiabada ese ia ibadinana taudia hedibaḡani amo baine hamauridia diba, a kara dika taudia baine ḡuidia diba ela bona hahemaoro dinana.
english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

motu: Dika hereadia bini: tauanina ena ura bodagadia e ḡava taudia, bona gwau-maoro taudia e dadaraidia taudia. E hekokorokumu, sibodia edia ura e karamu, atai taudia i'ihiihiraidia asie garimu;
english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

motu: a aneru, ena be edia goada bona edia siahu na herea, to unu atai taudia asie habadelaidia Lohiabada vairanai.
english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

motu: Ini na boroma na heheto, asi daradia; unu e vara toma, ma unu bae dika toma. Asi dibadia ḡaudia e ḡonaḡonalaimu; edia dika lalonai bae mase vaitani,
english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

motu: edia kara dika davadia do bae abi. Lebulebu karadia dina ai e moalelaimu; idia na toutou eiava bero na heto; umui ida o aniani heboumu negadia ai danu e aniani lalo-dikamu.
english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

motu: Matadia e bodagamu; kara dika ai asie hesikumu; lalo-manoka taudia e idoadiamu; mata-ḡaniḡani karadia ai vada e manada. Uru dikana!
english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

motu: Idia na dala maoromaorona vada e rakatania, vada e raka kerere, Balaam, Beoro natuna, ena dala vada e rakalaia. Ia na kara dika davana iabina urana e urava tauna;
english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

motu: a ena kerere dainai e sisiba henia, doniki, hereva asi dibana ḡauna, ese taunimanima gadodia ai una peroveta tauna e hereva henia, ena kara kava e gwaua tubu.
english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

motu: Idia na ranu guridia kororodia na heheto, eiava ḡahu lai ese e hodaia isi na heto; dibura masemase gabuna vada e seua, idia edia.
english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

motu: E hereva kavamu; e heaḡi kavamu; kara kerere-kerere taudia bogaragidia amo e roho maurimu taudia e idoadiamu tau-anina ena heḡahusi bona ena mata-dika amo.
english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

motu: Ura kwalimu bae henidia e tomamu, to idia sibodia na mase ena iḡui taudia; badina be darere tauna na kwalimu tauna ena hesiai ai bainela.
english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

motu: Badina be eda Lohiabada bona eda Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso dibadia murinai tanobada ena miro ḡaudia amo vada e roho mauri taudia na unu miro ḡaudia ese ma bae idoadia lou bona bae hadareredia, madi, edia dika gunana na maraḡi, edia dika gabena na baine bada.
english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

motu: Idia na dala maoromaorona basiema diba bema namo; a dibadia bena e henidia haheḡanina helaḡana amo e raka oho na dika.
english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

motu: Hereva heḡereḡerena na idia ediai vada eme momokani, eto, Sisia be ena mumuta e lou heniamu; bona boroma be bae huria to kopukopu ai baine hekui-hekui lou.
english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” + 2:22 Proverbs 26:11 * and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, revareva iharuana binai na tore henimuimu. Ruaosi badidia be lalomui ihaodia, mai lalomui ḡoevaḡoevadia ida ba helalo une.
english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

motu: Peroveta taudia ese idau nega ai e gwauraiva herevadia, bona Lohiabada eda Hahemauri Tauna ena haheḡani, ena aposetolo ese vada e henimui ḡaudia, ba helalolai.
english: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

motu: Ina na ba diba guna: nega dokona ai ḡonaḡona taudia baema, sibodia edia heḡahusi daladia ai bae raka,
english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

motu: baeto “Ena lou mai gwauhamatana na edeheto? Badina be tubuda tamada e mahutava negadia ema harihari, ḡau iboudiai vada eme hesiriu, tanobada e karaia negana heḡereḡerena”.
english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

motu: Unu e laloa tomamu badina be ina na vada e laloa boio: gunaguna guba e miava, bena Dirava ena hereva dainai tanobada na gadobada lalona amo e dae bona gadobada bogaraginai e miava.
english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

motu: A una tanobada na gadobada ese e habubunia, bena vada e ore.
english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

motu: A ina harihari e miamu gubana bona tanobadana na iena hereva ese e seudiamu, lahi ese baine ha-ore, hahemaoro bona Dirava asie badinaiamu taudia ihabuadia dinana ai.
english: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, ina hereva tamona basio laloa boio, Lohiabada enai dina tamona na laḡani daha na heto, bona laḡani daha na dina tamona na heto.
english: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

motu: Lohiabada na ena gwauhamata ihamomokanina ai se halahemu, haida e laloamu na heto; to, e haheauka henimuimu, badina be ia na se uramu ta baine mase; e uramu iboumui ai ba helalo kerehai.
english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

motu: A Lohiabada ena dina baine kau, henao tauna na heto; una dina ai guba baine puki mai rege-badana ida, ḡau iboudiai na siahu badana ese baine havevedia, tanobada danu, mai anina idoinai ida, lahi ese baine araia ore. Ba noho migomigo
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

motu: Benaini, ini ḡau iboudiai unu bema ore toma, umui ede boma kara toma? Emui kara iboudiai bema helaḡa; Dirava boma badinaia.
english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

motu: Dirava ena dina ena mai ba nari bona ba kahaia; una dina ai lahi ese guba baine araia ore, bona siahu-badana ese ḡau iboudiai baine havevedia.
english: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

motu: Ita na guba matamatana bona tanobada matamatana, ena gwauhamata heḡereḡerena, ta narimu; kara maoromaoro taudia ese bae noholaia.
english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

motu: Taunabunai, egu lalokau taumui e, ini ḡau o narimu dainai ba goada balaheni, hedaro-bouboumui ai baine davarimui, asi toutoumui bona asi kereremui ia vairanai.
english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

motu: Lohiabada ena haheauka ba haeroa, una na hahemauri ḡauna; varavara-dosida Paulo ese e henia aonegana amo e tore henimui heḡereḡerena.
english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

motu: Ena revareva iboudiai lalodiai ini ḡau na unu e torelai toma. E tore herevadia haida anidia idavaridia na auka, bena mala-lahui bona daradara tauna ese e hagagevamu, revareva helaḡadia haida e hagagevamu heḡereḡerena sibodia ihadikadia ḡaudia ai e halaomu.
english: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, vada o diba guna, taunabunai nahuamui ba toho, kara havara taudia edia kerere ese baine hakaumui siri na garina, emui gini tutuka-tutuka amo ba keto na garina.
english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

motu: A eda Lohiabada bona eda Hahemauri Tauna Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada bona ena lalo-diari ai ba tubu daga dae. Hairai na iena, harihari ela hanaihanai. Amen.
english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

motu: Matamana amo e mia ḡauna, taiamai amo a kamonai, matamai amo a itaia, a raraia tao, imamai amo a daua toho ḡauna, mauri herevana, a hamaorolaimuimu.
english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

motu: Una mauri vada e hedinarai; ai ese a itaia bona a gwauraia hedinaraimu, mauri hanaihanai, Tamada enai e miamu bona ai emai ai e hedinarai, a hamaorolaimuimu.
english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

motu: Ai ese a itaia bona a kamonai ḡauna na a hamaorolaimuimu, umui ai ida orea tamona ai baitala helaoreana; ai danu Tamada bona ia Natuna Iesu Keriso ida orea tamona ai vada ala.
english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ. + 1:3 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. *

motu: Ini a tore henimui tomamu na eda moale baine ḡuḡuru totona. Dirava
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

motu: Iena amo a kamonai bena umui a hamaorolaimuimu herevana binai: Dirava na diari, bona dibura sisina taina ienai dia mia.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

motu: Ita baitato ita na iena orea tauda, a dibura lalonai baita loa, be baita koikoi, hereva momokani basita badinaia.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

motu: A diari lalonai baita raka, ia heḡereḡerena ita na orea tamona tauda, bona ia Natuna Iesu rarana ese eda dika iboudiai baine huri oho.
english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

motu: Ita baitato ita na asi eda kara dika, be siboda baita hekoi, bona hereva momokani na ita laloda ai basine mia.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

motu: A eda kara dika baita gwaurai hedinarai, ia na maoromaoro bona momokani, edia kara dika iboudiai baine gwau tao, bona eda kara gageva-gageva baine huri oho.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

motu: Ḡau tamona, ita baitato asi eda kara dika, ita ese koikoi tauna ai baita halaoa, bona iena hereva na ita laloda ai basine mia.
english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

motu: Natugu e, ini name tore henimui toma na basio kara dika totona; a ta bema kara dika, ita na mai ikahada tauna Tamada vairanai, Iesu Keriso, kara maoromaoro tauna, bunai.
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor + 2:1 Greek παρακλητον: Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, and Comforter. * with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

motu: Ia na iseda dika kwarana ai ela, bona dia ita mo eda, a tanobada besedia-idoidiai edia.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice + 2:2 “atoning sacrifice” is from the Greek “ιλασμος”, an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation—the sacrifice that turns away God’s wrath because of our sin. * for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

motu: Ena haheḡani baita badina; unu amo baita diba momokani ita dibada ia.
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

motu: Ta baineto “Lau na dibagu ia”, a ena haheḡani basine badina, ia na koikoi tauna, hereva momokani na ia lalona ai se miamu.
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

motu: A ena hereva e badinaiamu tauna lalona ai Dirava ena uraheni vada eme ḡuḡuru.
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

motu: Ia lalonai e nohomu e tomamu tauna ese iena raka heḡereḡerena ai do baine raka. Dibura bona diari
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, lau na haheḡani matamatana ta asina tore henimuimu, a haheḡani gunana, matamana ai vada o abia ḡauna. Ina haheḡani gunana be vada o kamonai herevana.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

motu: Ḡau tamona, haheḡani matamatana na tore henimuimu, ienai bona umui emui ai vada e momokani; badina be dibura vada e lao bubunimu, bona diari korikori vada e taramu.
english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

motu: Ta e tomamu ia na diari lalonai, a tadikakana e badu heniamu, ia na doini dibura ai e nohomu.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

motu: Tadikakana e ura heniamu tauna na diari ai e nohomu; ienai hekwakwanai badina ta dia mia.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

motu: A tadikakana e badu heniamu tauna na dibura ai e nohomu bona dibura ai e rakamu, e lao heniamu gabuna na asi dibana, badina be dibura ese matana vada e hakepulu. Hahealo herevadia
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

motu: Natugu e, na tore henimuimu, badina be emui kara dika na ia ladana dainai vada eme gwau tao.
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

motu: Sihi guna taumui e, na tore henimuimu, badina be matamana amo e nohomu Tauna na dibamui. Eregabe taumui e, na tore henimuimu, badina be dika tauna vada o hadarerea. Memero e, na tore henimuimu, badina be Tamada na dibamui.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning.
