motu: Tanobada na basio ura henia, bona tanobada ḡaudia danu basio ura heni. Tanobada e ura heniamu tauna lalonai ai Tamada iura-henina na se miamu.
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

motu: Badina be tanobada ḡaudia iboudiai, tau-anina ena heḡahusi, mata-dika, mauri ena heaḡi kava, iri na dia Tamada ena amo, a tanobada ena amo e maimu.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

motu: Tanobada na baine lao bubuni, mai ena heḡahusi ida, a Ddirava ena ura e karaiamu tauna na baine noho hanaihanai. Hereva koikoi bona hereva momokani
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

motu: Natugu e, hora dokona binai. Vada o kamonai, Keriso Inaina be maimu. A Keriso inaina hutuma vada ema; taunabunai ita dibada ina na hora dokona.
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

motu: Idia na iseda amo e raka oho, a idia na dia ita bamoda; badina be bema ita bamoda, idia na dekedai bema noho. A e raka oho, baine hedinarai idia iboudiai na dia ita bamoda helaoreana.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

motu: A umui na Helaḡa Tauna ese vada e horomui, bena ḡau iboudiai vada dibamui.
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge. + 2:20 Or, “know what is true”, or, “know all things” *

motu: Lau na tore henimuimu, dia hereva momokani asi dibamui dainai, a badina be dibamui, bona dibamui danu koikoi na hereva momokani enai se taomu.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

motu: Koikoi tauna be daika? Iesu na dia Keriso e tomamu tauna, ani. Keriso inaina binai: Tamana bona Natuna e ḡorediamu tauna.
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

motu: Natuna e ḡoreamu tauna na asi ahuna Tamana enai; a Natuna e abiabiraiamu tauna na mai ahuna Tamana enai.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also. + 2:23 MT omits: He who confesses the Son has the Father also. *

motu: Matamana ai o kamonai herevana na lalomui ai baine mia. Bema matamana ai o kamonai herevana na lalomui ai baine mia, umui danu Natuna lalonai bona Tamana lalonai ba noho.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

motu: E gwaurai henida hamata ḡauna bunai, mauri hanaihanai.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

motu: Ini vada na tore henimui tomamu, bae hakaumui kerere taudia daidiai.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

motu: A ia ese e horolaimui siahuna na doene lalomui ai e miamu; taunabunai ta ese baine hadibamui na herevana. A e horolaimui siahuna ese ḡau iboudiai e hadibalaimuimu, bona ena hahediba na momokani, dia koikoi; taunabunai, e hadibalaimui heḡereḡerena ia lalonai ba noho.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

motu: Taunabunai, natugu e, ia lalonai ba noho, bena ia bainema negana ai laloda basie daradara, bona ia vairanai basita hemarai.
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

motu: Dibamui ia na maoromaoro, taunabunai dibamui danu kara maoromaoro taudia iboudiai na iena amo vada e vara.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

motu: Mani a laloa, Tamada ese iura-henina bada herea vada e henida, Dirava natuna e gwauraidamu. Momokani, ita na ia natuna. Una dainai tanobada na asi dibana ita, badina be asi dibana ia.
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, harihari ita na Dirava natuna, a gabe amo ede baita heto do se hedinarai. Ina mo dibada, ia bainema negana ai, ita na ia ida-idana baitala, badina be ia anitarana korikori baita itaia.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

motu: Ini e laroa tomamu taudia iboudiai ese sibodia e haheḡoevamu, ia eme ḡoevaḡoeva heḡereḡerena.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

motu: Kara dika tauna ese taravatu e tata utumu, badina be kara dika na taravatu itata-utuna ḡau.
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

motu: A umui dibamui, ia na kara dika iabi-ohodia totona ema; ia lalonai dika ta se miamu.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

motu: Ia lalonai e nohomu tauna ese kara dika se karamu; kara dika e karamu tauna ese ia se itaia, bona asi dibana ia.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

motu: Natugu e, ta ese basine koimui. Kara maoromaoro e karamu tauna na maoromaoro; Dirava heḡereḡerena ia danu maoromaoro.
english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

motu: A kara dika e karamu tauna na diabolo ena, badina be matamana negana amo diabolo na e kara dika. Dirava Natuna e hedinarai badina binai: diabolo ena kara dika baine ha-ore.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

motu: Dirava ena amo e vara tauna ese kara dika se karamu, badina be Dirava ena mauri na ia lalonai e miamu; taunabunai, ia na dika ikarana asi dibana, badina be Dirava ena amo e vara.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

motu: Unu amo Dirava natuna bona diabolo natuna bae hedinarai. Kara maoromaoro se karamu tauna bona tadikakana se lalokau heniamu tauna na dia Dirava ena.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

motu: Badina be matamana amo o kamonai herevana binai: baita heura heheni.
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

motu: Kain ida basio heḡereḡere; ia be dika tauna natuna, bena ia ese tadina e alaia mase. Dahaka dainai e alaia? Badina be iena kara na dika, a tadina ena kara na maoromaoro. Ita na tadikaka, Keriso lalonai
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

motu: Varavaragu e, tanobada ese e inai henimuimu na basio hoalaia.
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

motu: Ita dibada, mase amo mauri enai vada ta hanai, tadikakada ta lalokau henidiamu dainai. Tadikakana se lalokau heniamu tauna na dounu mase lalonai e nohomu.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

motu: Bona tadikakana e badu heniamu tauna na ala-ala tauna; dibamui mauri hanaihanai na ala-ala tauna lalonai se miamu.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

motu: Ini amo lalokau vada ta diba: ia ese ita daidai ena mauri e atoa diho. Una dainai ita ese tadikakada daidiai eda mauri baita atoa diho hari namo.
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

motu: Tau ta bema mai ena kohu, bena tadikakana bema itaia mai ena ogoḡami, a basinema bogaia hisi, Dirava iura-henina na ia lalona ai ede bema mia toma?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

motu: Natugu e, eda lalokau na dia hereva amo, dia mala amo, a kara ai bona momokani ai baita hahedinaraia.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

motu: Unu amo baita diba ita na momokani, bona ia vairanai laloda baita hagoadadia.
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

motu: Badina be laloda ese bae habadelaida reana; a Dirava ese ita laloda e hereadiamu, bona ia na ḡau iboudiai dibana.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, laloda ese basie habadelaida negana ai, ita na Dirava baita raka henia kahi, asi eda gari.
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

motu: Bena baita noia ḡaudia iboudiai ia ese baine henida; badina be iena haheḡani ta badinamu bona ia ihamoalena karadia ta karamu dainai.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

motu: Ena haheḡani binai: ia Natuna Iesu Keriso ladana baita abiabiraia, bona baita heura heheni, ia ese e haḡanida heḡereḡerena.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

motu: Ena haheḡani e hadinamu tauna na Dirava lalonai e nohomu, Dirava danu ia lalona ai e nohomu. Bena vada e henida Laumana dainai ita dibada ia na laloda ai e nohomu.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, lauma iboudiai basio kamonai henidia, a lauma ba dibadia guna, idia na Dirava ena amo eiava. Badina be peroveta koikoi taudia hutuma na tanobada ai vada e hedinarai.
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

motu: Dirava ena Lauma ini ba diba toma: lauma iboudiai ese Iesu Keriso e gwauraiamu, ia na tauanina ai ema, idia na Dirava ena;
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

motu: a Iesu asie gwauraiamu laumadia iboudiai na dia Dirava ena. Keriso Inaina laumana binai; vada o kamonai, ia na bainema; bona ia na harihari tanobada ai e nohomu.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

motu: Natugu e, umui na Dirava ena, bena vada o hadareredia; badina be lalomui ai e nohomu laumana ese tanobada ai e nohomu laumana e hereaiamu.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

motu: Idia na tanobada ena; taunabunai tanobada herevadia e gwauraimu, bona tanobada ese e kamonai henidiamu.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

motu: Ai na Dirava ena; Dirava mai dibana tauna ese e kamonai henimaimu, a Dirava asi dibana tauna ese se kamonai henimaimu. Hereva momokani laumana bona kerere laumana unu ta dibadia tomamu. Dirava na lalokau
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, baita heura heheni. Badina be lalokau na Dirava ena amo, bona mai ena lalokau tauna na Dirava ena amo e vara, bona ia dibana Dirava.
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

motu: A asi ena lalokau tauna na asi dibana Dirava, badina be Dirava na lalokau.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

motu: Dirava ena lalokau na ini e hahedinarai henida toma: Dirava ese ia Natuna vara-edeana tanobada ai e siaia, ia bagunai baita mauri helaoreana.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born + 4:9 The phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”. * Son into the world that we might live through him.

motu: Lalokau anina binai: dia ita ese Dirava ta ura henia, to ia ese ita e ura henida, bona ia Natuna e siaia, iseda dika kwarana ai ela.
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice + 4:10 “atoning sacrifice” is from the Greek “ιλασμος”, an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation—the sacrifice that turns away God’s wrath because of our sin. * for our sins.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, Dirava ese unu e ura henida toma dainai, ita danu baita heura heheni ani?
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

motu: Taunimanima ta ese Dirava asine itaia; a ta heura hehenimu negadia ai, Dirava na ita laloda ai noho, bona ena lalokau na ita laloda ai eme ḡuḡuru.
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

motu: Ini ta diba tomamu ita na ia lalonai ta nohomu bona ia danu ita laloda ai e nohomu: ia ese ena Lauma vada e henida.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

motu: Ai danu vada a itaia, bona dibamai, Tamada ese Natuna tanobada e siaia mai, tanobada ihamaurina totona.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

motu: Iesu na Dirava Natuna e gwauraiamu tauna na Dirava be ia lalona ai e nohomu, ia danu Dirava lalonai e nohomu.
english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

motu: Dirava ese e ura henidamu vada dibada, bona ta abia daemu. Dirava na lalokau. Lalokau ai e nohomu tauna na Dirava lalonai e nohomu; Dirava danu ia lalona ai e nohomu.
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

motu: Eda lalokau ihaḡuḡuruna binai: hahemaoro dinana ai ita na basita gari, badina be ina tanobada ai ita na ia ida heḡereḡere.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

motu: Lalokau ai gari sisina taina dia mia; lalokau momokani ese gari e lulua ohomu. Badina be gari na mai ena hisihisi; taunabunai gari tauna na lalokau ai do se ḡuḡuru.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

motu: Ita na mai eda lalokau, badina be ia ese e lalokau henida guna.
english: We love him, + 4:19 NU omits “him”. * because he first loved us.

motu: Ta baineto “Lau ese Dirava na ura heniamu”, a tadikakana e inai heniamu, ia na koikoi tauna. Badina be tadikakana, e itaiamu tauna, na basinema ura henia, se itaiamu Diravana ede bema ura henia toma?
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

motu: lena amo ta abiamu haheḡanina binai: Dirava e ura heniamu tauna ese tadikakana danu baine ura henia.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

motu: Iesu e abia daemu, ia na Keriso e tomu, tauna na Dirava ena amo e vara; bona tamana e ura heniamu tauna ese natuna danu e ura heniamu.
english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

motu: Ini ta diba tomamu ita ese Dirava natuna ta ura henidiamu: Dirava ta ura heniamu bona ena haheḡani ta badinamu.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

motu: Badina be Dirava iurahenina anina binai: ena haheḡani baita badina. Ena haheḡani danu dia memetau.
english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

motu: Badina be Dirava ena amo e vara tauna ese tanobada e hadarereamu; bona tanobada ihadarerena ḡauna na iseda abidadama.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

motu: Tanobada e hadarereamu tauna be daika? Iesu e abia daemu, Dirava Natuna e gwauraiamu, tauna.
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

motu: Ranu bona rara amo ema tauna binai, Iesu Keriso; dia ranu amo mo, a ranu bona rara amo.
english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

motu: Lauma ese e hahedinaraiamu, badina be Lauma na momokani.
english: For there are three who testify: + 5:7 Only a few recent manuscripts add “in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one. And there are three that testify on earth:” *

motu: Ihahedinaraina be toi: Lauma bona ranu bona rara; toiosi edia hereva be tamona.
english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

motu: Ita ese taunimanima edia hereva ta abi daemu, a Dirava ena hereva na herea-dae; badina be Dirava ena hereva be Natuna igwaurai-hedinaraina herevana.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

motu: Una hereva be Dirava Natuna e abiabiraiamu tauna lalona ai e miamu; a Dirava se abiabiraiamu tauna ese Dirava na koikoi ai e halaoamu, badina be Dirava ena hereva, Natuna igwaurai-hedinaraina herevana, ia ese e dadaraiamu.
english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

motu: Herevana binai: Dirava ese mauri hanaihanai vada e henida, bona una mauri na ia Natuna lalonai.
english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

motu: Natuna e abia daemu tauna ese mauri e abiamu, a Dirava Natuna se abia daemu tauna ese mauri se abiamu. Hahetoni herevadia
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

motu: Umui Dirava Natuna o abiabiraiamu taumui na tore henimuimu, vada ba diba, umui na mauri hanaihanai vada o abia.
english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

motu: Ia ta abidadama heniamu dainai, dibada ḡau ta iena ura heḡereḡerena ai baita noia, ia ese baine hakala henida.
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

motu: Bona dibada eda noinoi iboudiai e kamonaimu dainai, ita dibada danu ta noiamu ḡaudia baita abi.
english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

motu: Tau ta ese tadikakana baine itaia, kara dikana e karaiamu, to dia mase karana, bena baine noinoi ia ena; bena Dirava ese mauri baine henia, e kara dikamu to mase karana asie karaiamu taudia edia. A kara dikana ta be mase karana; asina tomamu una kara dainai baine noinoi.
english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

motu: Kara gageva-gagevadia iboudiai na didika; a kara dika haida na dia mase karadia.
english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

motu: Dibada Dirava ena amo e vara taudia iboudiai na asie kara dikamu, badina be Dirava Natuna ese e gimadiamu, bena dika tauna ese se abidiamu.
english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

motu: Dibada danu ita na Dirava ena amo ta vara, a tanobada idoinai na dika tauna imana ai.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

motu: Ma dibada danu Dirava Natuna vada ema, laloda vada e hapararadia, Dirava Korikori baita diba helaoreana. Ita na ia lalonai, bona ia Natuna Iesu Keriso lalonai, ta nohomu. Ia bunai Dirava Korikori; ia bunai Mauri Hanaihanai.
english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

motu: Natugu e, nahuamui ba toho dirava koikoidia na garidia.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

motu: Lau heitatao taugu ese e abimu hidi hahinemu mai natumu ida na tore henimuimu. Lau na hereva momokani ai na lalokau henimuimu; bona dia lau mo, a hereva momokani dibadia taudia iboudiai danu,
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

motu: hereva momokani laloda ai e miamu bona dekedai do baine mia hanaihanai dainai.
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

motu: Hariharibada bona hebogahisl bona maino dekedai bae mia, Tamada Dirava ena amo bona Tamada Natuna, Iesu Keriso, ena amo, hereva momokani ai bona lalokau ai.
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, + 1:3 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

motu: Lau na moale bada, badina be natumu haida na davaridia, hereva momokani dalana ai e rakamu, Tamada ese e henida haheḡanina heḡereḡerena.
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

motu: Hane lohia e, na noimumu, baita heura heheni; dia haheḡani matamatana ta asina tore henimumu, a matamana amo ta abia ḡauna.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

motu: Lalokau binai: iena haheḡani dalana ai baita raka. Una haheḡani na matamana amo o kamonai, ba badinaia totona e henimui.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

motu: Badina be koikoi taudia hutuma na tanobada ai e loamu, Iesu Keriso tau-anina ai ema na asie gwauraiamu; idia na koikoi taudia, Keriso inaina.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

motu: Nahuamui ba toho, o tahumu ḡaudia ba rea na garina; davamui do bavabi ḡuḡuru.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

motu: E raka hanaimu, Keriso ena hahediba herevadia se badinamu, tauna na Dirava enai se taomu; a hahediba herevadia e badinamu tauna na Tamada enai e taomu, bona Natuna danu enai e taomu.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

motu: A ta baine vasi, ini hahediba herevadia basine vasilai, tauna na basio abia dae emu ruma ai, bona basio hanamoa.
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

motu: Badina be baine hanamoa tauna ese ena kara dika baine durua.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

motu: Hereva hoho aina tore henimui na tomu, to pepa bona ink amo basina tore. A lau na uramu baina vasi itamui, bena baita hereva heheni, eda moale danu baine ḡuḡuru.
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

motu: Tadimu, e abia hidi hahinena, natuna ese e hahenamo henimumu.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

motu: Lau heitatao taugu ese egu lalokau Gaio na tore henimumu. Hereva momokani ai na lalokau henimumu.
english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, na ura lalo-dikamu oi na ḡau iboudiai lalodiai ba namo, bona tau-animu danu baine namo, laumamu e namomu heḡereḡerena.
english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

motu: Varavarada haida ema, e hamaorogu oi na kara momokani taumu eto, bena na moale bada, hereva momokani dalana ai o rakamu dainai.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

motu: Moale bada-herea egu ai badina binai: natugu haridia na kamonaimu, idia be hereva momokani dalana ai e rakamu.
english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, varavarada bona laolao taudia o abidia dae na heabidadama ḡaukarana namona.
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

motu: Idia ese ekalesia oreana vairadiai oiemu heabi-dae karadia vada e gwaurai hedinarai. Edia laolao ai ba kahadia baine namo herea, Dirava ibadinana karana.
english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

motu: Badina be ia ladana dainai e raka lasi, bese idau-idau taudia edia amo ḡau ta asie abia.
english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

motu: Taunabunai, ita ese baita abidia dae baine namo; unu amo hereva momokani ikahalaina tauda ai baitala.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

motu: Ekalesia oreana na tore henidia, a Diotrefe, sibona e heimodaimu tauna, ese e dadaraimaimu.
english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

motu: Una dainai, baina vasi negana ai, ena kara baina lalo tao. Ia ese hereva dikadia amo e maumauraimaimu; a dia una mo, varavarada danu se abidia daemu, bona iabi-daedia e uramu taudia ia ese e gwaudia tubumu bona ekalesia oreana amo e atodia tabemu.
english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

motu: Egu lalokau taumu e, dika basio haḡoia, a namo hari. Kara namo e karamu tauna na Dirava ena; a kara dika e karamu tauna ese Dirava se itaia.
english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

motu: Demetrio be harina namo tauna, taunimanima iboudiai bona hereva momokani ese namona e gwauraiamu. Ai danu unu a gwauraia tomamu, bona umui dibamui ai emai hereva na momokani.
english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

motu: Hereva hoho aina tore henimu na tomu, to ink bona pen amo basina tore.
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

motu: Asi vanahana baina vasi itamu na tomamu, bona baita hereva heheni.
english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be|strong="G2532" * to|strong="G4314" * you|strong="G4771" *. The|strong="G2532" * friends greet you|strong="G4771" *. Greet the|strong="G2532" * friends by|strong="G4314" * name.

motu: Maino emu ai baine mia. Turamu iniseni ai e hahenamo henimumu. Turagu eneseni ai ta ta ladadia ba hato, ladagu ai ba hahenamo henidia.
Lau luda, Iesu Keriso ena hesiai taugu, Iakobo tadina, e abimui hidi taumui, Tamada Dirava ese e lalokau henimuimu bona Iesu Keriso ese e gimamuimu taumui, na tore henimuimu:
english: Jude, + 1:1 or, Judah * a servant of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

motu: hebogahisi bona maino bona lalokau emui ai bae bada. Egu revareva badina
english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, iseda hahemauri herevana baina tore henimui nato, to, kara ta dainai na tore henimuimu. Na haduamuimu, ta abia daemu herevana, helaḡa taudia e heni-dia vaitani herevana, ba gimaia goadagoada.
english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

motu: Badina be haida ese dekemui ai vada e rau vareai hehuni, idau nega ai davadia e gwaurai guna taudia, Dirava asie badinaiamu taudia; idia ese iena harihari-bada na lebulebu ḡauna ai e halaoamu, bona biaguda tamona, Lohiabada Iesu Keriso, e ḡoreamu. Nahuamui ba toho, koikoi garina
english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

motu: Lau na uramu gunaguna o dibava ḡaudia baina hahelalolaimui une. Lohiabada ese bese ta Aigupto tanona amo e hamauridia, a gabeamo asie kamonai henia taudia na e habuadia.
english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

motu: Aneru haida danu, edia dagi korikori asie laloa tao, bona edia gabu korikori e rakatania; bena ia ese dibura gabuna ai e atodia, mia-hanaihanai gadeadia ai e ḡuidia, unuseni ai bae noho ela bona dina badana hahemaorona negana.
english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

motu: Sodoma bona Gomora bona dekedia hanuadia danu unuheto: heuda-hanai bona kara bodagadia e karava mai lalodia idoidiai, davadia na mia-hanaihanai lahina ai e abi, ita matada ihakanidia.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

motu: Ini nihi taudia ese danu tau-anidia unu e hadikadia tomamu, siahu taudia e dadaraidiamu, bona hairai anerudia e ḡonaḡonalaidiamu.
english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

motu: A Mikael, aneru ikwaradia, diabolo ida e hepapahuahu, Mose tau-anina e hepapahuahulaia, negana ai na se ere dika henia, a e hereva henia, eto “Lohiabada ese baine gwau henimu”.
english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”

motu: A ini na herevalaidiamu taudia ese asi dibadia ḡaudia e ḡonaḡonalaimu, bona boroma edia diba heḡereḡeredia dibadia ḡaudia na sibodia ihadikadia ḡaudia ai e halao.
english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.

motu: Madi, ihabaidia! Kain ena dala ai vada e raka. Balaam ena kerere vada e heau henia, kohu iabina totona. Kora ena gwau-hemuri ai do bae mase.
english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

motu: Idia na umui ida o anibou negadia ai, emui anibou e hadikamu, e anianimu, bogadia e hakunumu, asie garimu. Idia na dagadaga asi medudia, lai ese e odadia lao odadia maimu, na heheto. Idia na au na heheto, raudia e hehuhumu, huahuadia na lasi, vada e mase vaitani, mai ramudia ida e ragadiamu.
english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

motu: Idia na davara hurehuredia na heheto, edia hemarai e hedinaraimu gwaragwara na heheto. Idia na e morumu hisiudia na heheto, mia-hanaihanai diburana ai bae bodo.
english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

motu: Adam ena amo uru ihahituna tauna, Enok, ese idia e gwauraidia guna, eto “A itaia, Lohiabada vada ema, mai ena helaḡa taudia gerebu gerebu ida;
english: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, + 1:14 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

motu: taunimanima iboudiai baine hahemaoro henidia, bona Dirava asie badinaiamu taudia baine dunidia dae, Dirava idadaraina karadia e kara daidiai bona Dirava ihadikalaina herevadia aukadia e gwaurai daidiai”.
english: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

motu: Idia na ḡonaḡona bona maumau taudia; edia heḡahusi karadia mo e karamu. Ududia amo heaḡi herevadia e lasimu; taḡa taudia danu e imodaidiamu, kohu iabina totona. Ba goada
english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

motu: Egu lalokau taumui e, iseda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena aposetolo taudia ese e hamaorolaimuiva herevadia na ba lalo tao.
english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

motu: Idia ese e hamaoromui, eto “Nega dokona ai ḡonaḡona taudia bae hedinarai, sibodia edia heḡahusi karadia bae kara”.
english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

motu: Heiri-heiri ihavaradia taudia bunu, tau-anidia e lalomu taudia, Lauma na asie abia.
english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

motu: A umui, egu lalokau taumui e, emui abidadama helaḡana latanai emui mauri ba hadaia. Lauma Helaḡa ai ba ḡuriḡuri.
english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

motu: Dirava ena lalokau ai ba noho. Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena hebogahisi ba laroa; ia ese mauri hanaihanai dalana ai baine hakaumui.
english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

motu: Daradara taudia ba bogadia hisi.
english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

motu: Haida lahi lalona amo ba veridia oho, ba hamauridia. Ma haida ba bogadia hisi, to mai garimui ida; tau-anina ese e hamiroamu dabuana na ba inai henia. Heimodai
english: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

motu: Mai siahuna ida baine gimamui bena basio keto Diravana, asi bebekabebekamui ia hairaina vairanai baine atomui mai moalemui ida Diravana,
english: Now to him who is able to keep them + 1:24 TR and NU read “you” * from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

motu: Dirava tamona, eda Lohiabada Iesu Keriso bagunai e hamauridamu Diravana: hairai bona dagi bona goada bona siahu baine abi, harihari ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

motu: Iesu Keriso ihahedinaraina herevana Dirava ese e henia, asi vanahana bae vara ḡaudia na ena hesiai taudia baine hamaorolaidia; bena ena aneru e siaia, ena hesiai tauna Ioane e haheitalaia.
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, + 1:1 “Christ” means “Anointed One”. * which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel + 1:1 or, messenger (here and wherever angel is mentioned) * to his servant, John,

motu: Bena ia ese Dirava ena hereva bona Iesu Keriso ena hereva bona e ita ḡaudia iboudiai e gwaurai hedinarai.
english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

motu: Ini peroveta herevadia baine duahi tauna baine namo, bona bae kamonai taudia danu bae namo, bona ina buka ai e tore herevadia bae badina taudia bae namo; badina be ini ḡau iboudiai be varamu negana vada eme kahikahi. Ekalesia oreadia hituosi Asia ai
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

motu: Lau Ioane, ekalesia oreadia hituosi Asia ai na tore henimuimu: hariharibada bona maino bavabi, e nohomu, e nohova bona baine noho Diravana ena amo, bona ena terono vairanai e ginimu laumadia hahituosi edia amo,
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

motu: bona Iesu Keriso ena amo: ia na gwau maoro tauna namona, bona toreisi-lou roboana mase amo, bona tanobada pavapavadia biagudia. Eura henidamu bena eda kara na rarana amo e huri oho Tauna,
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

motu: basileia ta ai e habouda bona Tamana Dirava ena hahelaḡa tauda ai e halaoda Tauna, enai hairai bona siahu bae mia ela bona hanaihanai. Amen.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests + 1:6 Exodus 19:6; Isaiah 61:6 * to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

motu: A itaia, ia na ori amo be maimu; mataa iboudiai ese bae itaia; e gwadaia taudia danu bae itaia; tanobada besedia iboudiai ese ia dainai bae tai. Momokani. Amen.
english: Behold, + 1:7 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. * he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

motu: Lohiabada Dirava na e tomu “Lau na Matamana bona Dokona”. Ia na e nohomu, e nohova bona do baine noho, Siahu-idoinai Diravana.

english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

motu: Bena Lohiabada ena dina ai Lauma ese e rohegu, bena murigu ai gado badana ta, kibi reḡena na heto, na kamonai;
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

motu: lamepa bogaragidiai ta e gini, e kara taunimanima natuna na heto, ena dabua na lata, ela bona aena, kemena na gold torana e ḡeḡea.
english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, + 1:13 Daniel 7:13 * clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

motu: Kwarana bona huina na kuroka-kuroka, mamoe huina na heto, eiava snow na heto. Matana na lahi na heto.
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

motu: Aena na auri labora-labora e kimore-kimore na heto, lahi ai e havevea negana ai. Gadona na sinavai momo reḡedia na heto.
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

motu: Imana idibana ai hisiu hitu e abi. Dare ta, kahana kahana mai ganodia ḡauna, uduna amo e lasi. Vairana na dina e tara na heto.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

motu: Ia na itaia, bena aena badinai na goru diho, e kara na mase na heto. A ia ese imana idibana taugu ai e dau kau, eto, Asio gari; lau na gini-gunana bona gini-gabena;
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. motu: Ini ḡau muridiai na roha lao, guba ai iduara ta e hekeho na itaia, bona ere, na kamonai guna ḡauna, kibi reḡena na heto, ese e hereval henigu, eto, A dae aoma, gabeai bae vara ḡaudia baina haheitalaimu.
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

motu: Lauma ese e rohegu, bena guba ai terono ta na itaia, bona ta latanai e helai kau.
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

motu: E helai kau tauna ita-itana na iaspi + 4:3 Iaspi: Sadio: Samarago. Ini na nadi hururu-hururudia haida, asi ladadia Motu gado ai dainai Helene gado ai vada e tore. * bona sadio nadidia na heheto; bona kevau ese terono e ḡeḡea dae, ita-itana na samarago nadina na heto.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

motu: Terono ruahui-hani ese terono badana e laia heḡeḡe, bona heitatao taudia ruahuihani unu terono latadiai e helai; kwaradia na mai havava ḡaudia, gold ḡaudia.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

motu: Terono amo kevaru bona ere bona guba-rahu e lasi; bona terono vairanai lamepa auhitu e ara mai hururu-hururudia, Dirava ena lauma hahituosi bunu.
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

motu: Bona terono vairanai danu davara, hevarivari na heto, e mia. Bona terono lalonai bona heḡeḡenai mauri ḡaudia hani mimia, vairadia kahadia ai bona muridia kahadia ai matadia na momo.
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

motu: Mauri ḡauna gini-gunana na leona na heto; iharuana na boromakau natuna na heto; ihatoina vairana na taunimanima vairana na heto; ihahanina na ugava e rohomu na heto.
english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

motu: ldia haniosi hanidia na tauratoi tauratoi amo. Murimuridia ai bona lalodia ai matadia na momo. Idia na dina hanuaboi laḡadia asie animu; e herevamu, e tomu, Helaḡa, Helaḡa, Helaḡa; Lohiabada na Siahu Idoinai Diravana; E nohova, e nohomu, bona baine noho.
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy + 4:8 Hodges/Farstad MT reads “holy” 9 times instead of 3. * is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

motu: Bena hari mauri ḡaudia ese Mauri Hanaihanai Diravana terono ai e helaimu na e imodaiamu bona e heatolaiamu bona e hanamoamu negadia ai,
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

motu: heitatao taudia ruahui-haniosi ese terono ai e helaimu Diravana vairanai e goru dihomu, Mauri Hanaihanai Diravana e toma henia dihomu, edia havava ḡaudia na terono vairanai e nege dobimu, e tomu,
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

motu: Emai Lohiabdda, emai Dirava e, Namona binai: Hairai bona hemataurai bona siahu bavabi. Badina be oi ese ḡau iboudiai o havara, E; mu ura dainai o karadia bona e miamu.
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, + 4:11 TR omits “and God, the Holy One,” * to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

motu: Bena na itaia, terono ai e helai Tauna imana idibana ai be buka ta, lalonai bona murimuri kahana ai danu revareva e hetore; buka na e hekou kunuka-kunuka, ikouna toadia na hitu.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

motu: Bena aneru goadana ta na itaia, e hereva badabada, eto, Daika na heḡereḡere ina buka baine kehoa, bona ikouna toadia baine hamotu?
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

motu: A guba ai bona tanobada ai bona tanobada henunai ta asi goadana buka baine kehoa bona lalona baine itaia.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

motu: Bena na tai dikadika, badina be ta asi goadana buka bame kehoa bona lalona baine itaia.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

motu: Bena heitatao tauna ta ese e hereva henigu, eto, Asiotai; Iuda iduhuna ena leona, David ramuna, vada e kwalimu; ia ese buka baine kehoa bona ikouna toadia hituosi baine hamotu.
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

motu: Bena terono bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi padadia ai, heitatao taudia bogaragidiai, Mamoe Natuna ginina ai na itaia, e kara vada e alaia mase na heto. Doana na hitu, matana danu hilu, Dirava ena lauma hituosi, tanobada heḡeḡe-madai e siaidia lao ḡaudia, bunu.
english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

motu: Ia na ema, terono ai e helai Tauna imana idibana amo buka e abia.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

motu: Buka e abia; bena mauri ḡaudia haniosi bona heitatao taudia ruahui-haniosi na Mamoe Natuna vairanai e goru diho. Idia ta ta mai edia gitara bona mai edia gold urodia: unu uro be e gabumu bena bonadia e daemu muramuradia ai e honuhonu dae, helaḡa taudia edia ḡuriḡuri bunu.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

motu: Bena ane matamatana e abia, eto, Oi na heḡereḡere buka bavabia, Bona ikouna toadia ba hamotu; Badina be e alamu mase, Raramu na taunimanima o hoilaidia, Dirava ena, Iduhu iboudiai, gado iboudiai, hanua iboudiai, bese iboudiai amo;

motu: Bena na roha lao, bona aneru hutuma gadodia na kamonai, idia ese terono bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi bona heitatao taudia e ginidia hegeḡe, daha daha, gerebu gerebu.
english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

motu: Idia na e lolo badabada, eto “Mamoe Natuna e alaia mase, ia hari namo; siahu bona taḡa bona aonega bona goada bona hemataurai bona hairai bona hahenamo baine abi”.
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

motu: Bena e kara ḡaudia iboudiai, guba ai bona tanobada ai bona tanobada henunai bona davara ai, bona lalodia ḡaudia iboudiai, eredia na kamonai, eto “Terono ai e helaimu Diravana bona Mamoe Natuna na hahenamo bona hemataurai bona hairai bona siahu bae abi, harihari ela bona hanaihanai”.
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!” + 5:13 TR omits “Amen!” *

motu: Bena mauri ḡaudia haniosi eto “Amen”. Bona heitatao taudia e goru diho, e toma henia diho.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the + 5:14 TR adds “twenty-four” * elders fell down and worshiped. + 5:14 TR adds “the one living forever and ever” *

motu: Bena Mamoe Natuna na itaia, ia ese ikouna toana ta e hamotua, bena mauri ḡauna ta erena na kamonai, e kara guba e rahua na heto, eto “Aoma”.
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

motu: Bena hosi kurokurona ta na itaia; e ḡui kau tauna na mai ena peva. Kwarana ivavalaina ḡauna e henia, bena mai siahuna ida ela, baine kwalimu totona.
english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

motu: Ikouna toana iharuana e hamotua, bena mauri ḡauna iharuana erena na kamonai, eto “Aoma”.
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

motu: Bena hosi kakakakana ta e lasi; e ḡui kau tauna na siahu e henia, maino tanobada amo baine abia oho, taunimanima bae heala-ala heheni helaoreana. Bena dare badana e henia.
english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

motu: Ikouna toana ihatoina e hamolua, bena mauri ḡauna ihatoina erena na kamonai, eto “Aoma”. Bena hosi korema-koremana ta na itaia; e ḡui kau tauna na metau ihahetohona ḡauna e abia kau imana ai.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

motu: Bena ere ta mauri ḡaudia haniosi bogaragidia amo na kamonai, eto “Uit irau ta davana na silver monina ta, bona bali irau toi davadia na silver monina ta; bona nahuamu ba tohoa, dehoro bona vine ranuna ba hadika na garina”.
english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix + 6:6 A choenix is a dry volume measure that is a little more than a liter (a little more than a quart). * of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

motu: Ikouna toana ihahanina e hamotua, bena mauri ḡauna ihahanina erena na kamonai, eto “Aoma”.
english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

motu: Bena hosi mia kurona ta na itaia; e ḡui kau tauna ladana na Mase, bona Mase Lohiana na ia murina amo ema. Siahu na raruosi e henidia, tanobada ena inogo haniosi ai inogo ta bae biagua, dare bona doe bona dai-hanai goreredia bona tanobada ena hekori boromadia amo taunimanima bae aladia mase.
english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades + 6:8 or, Hell * followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

motu: Ikouna toana iha-imana e hamotua, bena pata helaḡana henunai Dirava ena hereva dainai bona ena hereva igwauraina dainai e aladia mase taudia laumadia na itadia.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

motu: Idia na e lolo badabada, eto “Biagumai e, Helaḡa bona Momokani, edena nega ai tanobada taudia ba hahemaoro henidia, davadia ba henidia, ai raramai dainai”.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

motu: Bena dabua kurokurodia ta ta e henidia, bona e haduadia, nega taina laḡadia do bae ani, ela bona bamodia bona tadihakadia hahidaosi iala-masedia, idia e aladia mase heḡereḡerena do baine ḡuḡuru.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, + 6:11 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” * who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

motu: Ikouna toana ihatauratoina e hamotua, bena na roha lao, tano e laḡa bada, dina danu e dibura, dabua koremana na heto, bona hua na rara na heto.
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

motu: Bona hisiu na guba amo e moru, lai gubana ese suke huahuadia kasiridia e hahehuhumu na heto.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

motu: Guba danu e puki, kopi mai revarevana e lokuamu na heto; ororo bona motumotu iboudiai danu gabudia amo e heraḡa oho.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

motu: Bena tanobada pavapavadia bona lohiadia, bona tuari biagudia, bona taḡa taudia, bona goada taudia, bona hesiai taudia, bona ura kwalimu taudia, iboudiai na kohua lalodiai bona ororo nadi-hagadia henudiai e komu;
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

motu: bena ororo bona hagahaga e noidia, eto, Ame karuhimai tao, terono ai e helaimu Diravana vairana amo bona Mamoe Natuna ena badu amo ba hunimai;
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

motu: badina be edia badu dinana badana vada e gini dae. Daika baine gini diba?
english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

motu: Bena aneru hahani na itadia, tanobada daigunidia haniosi ai e gini, tanobada ena lai haniosi e lao ahu, lai ta basine toa tanobada ai eiava davara ai, eiava au ta basine toa henia.
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

motu: Ma aneru ta na itaia, mairiveina kahana amo e dae kau, ikouna toana, Mauri Diravana ena, e abia kau. Bena hari mai siahudia tanobada bona davara bae hadika anerudia hahaniosi ia ese e lolo henidia,
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

motu: eto, Tanobada bona davara bona au basio hadika, ela bona eda Dirava ena hesiai taudia bagudia ai ia toana baita karaia.
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

motu: Bena toadia e kara taudia e hagaudia na kamonai: Israel besena edia iduhu iboudiai amo domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani + 7:4 Domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani: 144,000. * toadia e kara:
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

motu: Iuda iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, + 7:5 Gerebu-ta daha-rua: 12,000. * Ruben iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, Gad iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua,
english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Reuben|strong="G4502" * twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" *, of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Gad|strong="G1045" * twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" *,

motu: Asere iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, Napatali iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, Manase iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua,
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Naphtali|strong="G3508" * twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" *, of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Manasseh|strong="G3128" * twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" *,

motu: Simeon iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, Levi iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, Isakara iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua,
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Levi|strong="G3017" * twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" *, of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Issachar|strong="G2466" * twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" *,

motu: Sebulun iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, Iosef iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua, Beniamina iduhuna amo gerebu-ta daha-rua.
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Joseph|strong="G2501" * twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" *, and|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1537" * tribe|strong="G5443" * of|strong="G1537" * Benjamin twelve|strong="G1427" * thousand|strong="G5505" * were sealed|strong="G4972" *.

motu: Ini ḡau muridiai na roha lao, hutuma bada-herea na itadia, asi iduahidia, bese idau-idau bona iduhu idau-idau bona hanua idau-idau bona gado idau-idau amo, ibouboudiai na terono vairanai bona Mamoe Natuna vairanai e gini, edia dabua na kukuro-kukuro, bona imadia na mai retadia.
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

motu: Idia na e lolo badabada, eto “Hahemauri na iseda Dirava, terono ai e helaimu Diravana, bona Mamoe Natuna, ediai”.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

motu: Bena terono bona heitatao taudia bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi e ginidia heḡeḡe anerudia iboudiai ese terono vairanai e goru diho, Dirava e toma henia diho,
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

motu: eto “Amen, hahenamo bona hairai bona aonega bona heimodai bona hemataurai bona siahu bona goada na eda Dirava ese haine abi, harihari ela bona hanaihanai; Amen”.
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

motu: Bena heitatao tauna ta ese e nanadaigu, elo, Ini dabua kurokurodia e hadokilai taudia be daidia? Bona ede amo ema?
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

motu: Bena na haere, nato, Ḡauka e, oi dibamu. Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Ini na hisihisi badana amo vada ema, edia dabua na Mamoe Natuna rarana ai e huri, e hakurokuro.
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He|strong="G2532" * said|strong="G3004" * to|strong="G2532" * me|strong="G1473" *, “ These|strong="G3778" * are|strong="G1510" * those|strong="G3588" * who|strong="G3588" * came|strong="G2064" * out|strong="G1537" * of|strong="G1537" * the|strong="G1722" * great|strong="G3173" * suffering|strong="G2347" *. + 7:14 or, oppression * They|strong="G2532" * washed|strong="G4150" * their|strong="G1438" * robes|strong="G4749" * and|strong="G2532" * made|strong="G3021" * them|strong="G3588" * white|strong="G3021" * in|strong="G1722" * the|strong="G1722" * Lamb|strong="G3004" *’ s|strong="G2962" * blood.

motu: Una dainai idia na Dirava ena terono vairanai gigini, bona ena Dubu Helaḡa lalonai ia isiaina e lao heni boimu e lao heni ranimu. Bona terono ai e helaimu Diravana ese edia taruha ai bainela.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

motu: Idia na basie hitolo lou, basie ranu mase lou; dina eiava siahu ta ese basine raradia.
english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

motu: Badina be Mamoe Natuna ese baine reḡudia; e lohilohimu ranudia mauridia badidiai baine hakaudia; bona Dirava ese iruru-matadia iboudiai na matadia amo baine dahu oho.
english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

motu: Bena ikouna toana ihahituna e hamotua negana ai, asi reḡena ta guba ai, hora kahana sisivana.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

motu: Bena Dirava vairanai e ginimu anerudia hahituosi na itadia, kibi auhitu vada e henidia.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

motu: Bena aneru ta ma ema, pata helaḡana badibadinai e gini. Imana ai gold urona ta, lalonai muramura mai bonana e gabua ḡauna, e abia. Bena muramura mai bonana momo ehenia, helaḡa taudia edia ḡuriḡuri ida baine bulo, gold patana helaḡana ai, terono vairanai.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

motu: Bena muramura mai bonana kwalahuna, hela=a taudia edia ḡuriḡuri ida, aneru imana amo e dae, Dirava vairanai.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

motu: Bena aneru ese gold urona e abia, pata helaḡana lahina amo e hahonua; bena tanobada ai e tahoa kau. Bena ere bona guba-rahu bona kevaru bona tano-laga e vara.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

motu: Bena aneru hahituosi e heḡaegae, edia kibi bae hiriri. Kibi e hiriri matama
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

motu: Aneru gini-gunana ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena medu-hetari bona lahi rara ida e hebulo na tanobada ai e diho. Bena tanobada inogodia toiosi ai inogo ta e ara ore, bona au toi toi amo ta ta e ara ore, bona rei idoinai e ara ore.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, + 8:7 TR omits “One third of the earth was burned up” * and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

motu: Aneru iharuana ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena e kara ororo badana mai lahina ta davara ai e tahoa dobi na heto. Bena davara kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta rara ai ela,
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

motu: bona davara gwarumedia toi toi amo ta ta e mase, bona lagatoi toi toi amo ta ta e mutu.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

motu: Aneru ihatoina ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena hisiu badana ta guba amo e moru dobi, e hururu-hururu kede na heto, sinavai toi toi amo ta ta latadiai e moru, bona lohilohi ranudia toi toi amo ta ta latadiai e moru.
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

motu: Una hisiu ladana na “Idita”. Bena ranu gabudia toi toi amo ta ta e idita. Bena taunimanima hutuma e mase ranu daidiai, badina be vada e idita.
english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

motu: Aneru ihahanina ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena dina kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta e botaia, bena e dibura; bona hua kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta e botaia, bena e dibura; bona hisiu toi toi amo ta ta e botadia bena e dibura. Una dainai, dina kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta se diari, bona hanuaboi kahadia toiosi ai kaha ta se diari.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

motu: Bena ugava ta na itaia, guba padana ai e roho, bona erena na kamonai. E lolo badabada, eto, Tanobada taudia iboudiai madi O, madi O, madi O, aneru tatoiosi edia kibi, do asie hiriri ḡaudia, reḡedia daidiai.
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, + 8:13 TR reads “angel” instead of “eagle” * flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

motu: Aneru iha-imana ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena hisiu ta na itaia, guba amo e moru tanobada ai; bena e dobu masemase gurina kina e henia.
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

motu: Guri dobu masemase e kehoa, bena guri amo kwalahu e dae, amu badana kwalahuna na heto. Bena dina bona guba padana e vabura, guri kwalahuna vaburana.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a + 9:2 TR adds “great” * burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

motu: Bena kwalahu amo kwadi e lasi tanobada ai; bona siahu e henidia, tanohada doadoadia siahudia na heto.
english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

motu: To e haganidia, tanobada reina bona tano ai e tubumu ḡaudia bona au basie hadika, a Dirava toana na bagudia ai asie abia taudia mo.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

motu: E haduadia danu, basie aladia mase, a hua ima bae hahisidia; una hisihisi na doadoa ena hekori hisina na heto.
english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

motu: Unu dinadia ai, taunimanima ese mase bae tahua, to basie davaria; bae ura lalo-dika bae mase, to mase ese baine heautanidia.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

motu: Hari kwadi ita-itadia na tuari hosidia na heheto; kwaradia na e kara gold havava ḡaudia na heheto; vairadia na taunimanima na heheto;
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

motu: huidia na hahine huidia na heheto; isedia na leona isedia na heheto;
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

motu: kemedia na mai ḡaudia, auri na heto. Idia hanidiareḡedia na kariota reḡedia na heheto, hosi momo ese e verimu ḡaudia, tuari ai e heau vareaimu negadia ai.
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

motu: Iudia na doadoa iudia na heheto, mat duridia; bona edia siahu, taunimanima hua ima bae hahisidia, na iudia ai mia.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

motu: Idia na mai edia pavapava, guri dobu-hereana aneruna bunai; ia ladana Heberu gadodia ai be Abadon, a Helene gadodia ai ladana na Apoluon.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, + 9:11 “Abaddon” is a Hebrew word that means “ruin”, “destruction”, or “the place of destruction” * but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”. + 9:11 “Apollyon” means “Destroyer”. *

motu: Dika ta vada e ore; rua be do mimia. Kibi ihatauratoina
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

motu: Aneru ihatauratoina ese ena kibi e hiriria, bena gado ta na kamonai, Dirava vairanai e mia patana helagana, gold ḡauna, doana haniosi edia amo.
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

motu: Una gado ese aneru mai kibina ihatauratoina e hamaoroa, eto, Aneru hahaniosi, sinavai badana, ladana Eufrate, badibadinai vada e ḡuidia, ba ruhadia nege.
english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

motu: Bena unu aneru hahaniosi e ruhadia: anerudia bunu vada e abidia heḡaeḡae, una hora, una dina, una hua, una laḡani, edia; taunimanima tatoi tatoi amo ta ta bae aladia mase.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

motu: Tuari taudia mai hosidia ihagaudia na kamonai: idia na milion sinahu-rua. + 9:16 Milion sinahu rua: 200,000,000. *
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. + 9:16 literally, “ten thousands of ten thousands” * I heard the number of them.

motu: Bena egu mata-hanai ai unu hosi ini na itadia toma: e ḡui kau taudia na mai kemedia auridia, ita-itadia na lahi bona huakina + 9:17 Huakina Nadi hurulu-hururuna ta, asi iadana Motu gado ai dainai Helene gado ai vadaa e torea. * bona teio + 9:17 Teio: Nadi ta ladana, Helene gado ai. E aramu, bena bonana dika-hereana e daemu, taunimanima e hamaseddiamu. Ladana English gado ai na “sulphur”. * na heheto; a hosi kwatadia na leona kwaradia na heheto, bona ududia amo lahi bona kwalahu bona teio e lasi.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

motu: Ini hahedika toiosi daidiai taunimanima tatoi tatoi amo ta ta e mase; hari lahi bona kwalahu bona teio, ududia amo e lasi gaudia, ese e aladia mase.
english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

motu: Badina be edia siahu na ududia ai bona iudia ai; iudia na gaigai na heheto, mai kwaradia, bena unu amo idia ese taunimanima e hahisidia.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

motu: Ḡau tamona, tanobada taudia oredia, ini hisihisi ese asie hamasedia taudia, na imadia ḡaukaradia asie helalolai kerehai; lauma dikadia itomadiho-henidia asie hadokoa; gold bona silver bona auri labora-labora bona nadi bona au e karalai kaivakukudia, asie ita asie kamonai asie raka ḡaudia, itomadiho-henidia danu asie rakatania.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

motu: Edia ala-ala bona edia babalau bona edia heuda-hanai bona edia henao danu asie helalolai kerehai.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, + 9:21 The word for “sorceries” (pharmakeia) also implies the use of potions, poisons, and drugs * their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

motu: Bena aneru goadana ta na itaia, guha amo e diho, ena hahedoki na ori, kwarana daenai na kevau; vairana na e kara dina na heto, bona aena na lahi hururu-hururudia na heheto.
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

motu: Imana ai na buka maraḡina ta hekehona ai e abia. Aena idibana na davara ai e hadaia laurina be tanobada ai.
english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

motu: E lolo badabada, leona e ḡoumu na heto; bena guba e rahua hahitu
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

motu: E rahua vaitani, bena eredia baina tore nato, to gado ta guba amo na kamonai, eto, Guba hahitu e rahua eredia ba kou, basio tore.
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

motu: Bena davara ai bona tanobada ai e gini aneruna na itaia, ia ese imana idibana e duduia dae guba ai,
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

motu: Noho-hanaihanai Diravana, guba mai anina idoinai bona tanobada mai anina idoinai bona davara mai anina idoinaie kara Diravana, ladana ai e gwau hamata, eto, Nega na basine halahe;
english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

motu: aneru ihahituna ese ena kibi baine hiriria matama negana ai Dirava ena hereva hehunina baine momokani, peroveta taudia, iena hesiai taudia, e hamaorolaidia heḡereḡerena.
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

motu: Bena guba amo na kamonai gadona ma e hereva henigu, eto “Aola, davara ai bona tanobada ai e ginimu aneruna imana ai e miamu bukabukana bavabia”.
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

motu: Bena hari aneru dekena nala, nato “Buka maraḡina a henigu”. Bena ia eto “Avabia, avania ore; bogamu ai baine idita, a udumu ai baine gaiho, bada ranuna na heto”.
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. motu: Bena hari buka maraḡina na aneru imana amo na abia, na ania ore; bena udugu ai e gaiho, bada ranuna na heto, to na ania ore murinai bogagu na e idita.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

motu: Bena e hamaorogu, ewto “Taunimanima idau-idau, bese idau-idau, gado idau-idau, pavapava idau-idau, hutuma ba haroro henidia”.
english: They + 10:11 TR reads “He” instead of “They” * told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

motu: Bena siriho ta, itotohi na heto, e henigu, eto, A tore isi, Dirava ena Dubu Helaḡa bona pata helaḡana ba hahetoho, bona lalonai e toma dihomu taudia ba hagaudia.
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

motu: A Dubu Helaḡa maḡuna na basio hahetohoa, badina be bese idau-idau taudia vada e henidia, idia na hua hari-ahui rua hanua helaḡana bae moimoilaia.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

motu: A egu hereva igwauraina taudia raruosi na siahu baina henidia, puse dabuadia bae dokilai, bena dina; daha-ta sinahu-rua tauratoi-ahui bae haroro.
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

motu: Ini na olive audia aurua bona lamepa aurua, tanobada Lohiana vairanai e ginimu.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

motu: Ta ihadikadia urana bema ura, ududia amo lahi bema lasi, inaidia bunu bema aradia ore: taunabunai ta ihadikadia urana baine ura, ia na unu baine mase toma.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

motu: Idia na mai siahudia guba bae koua, bena edia haroro dinadia lalodiai medu basine diho. Mai siahudia danu ranu na rara ai bae halaoa; bena bae ura negadia ai hisihisi idau-idau bae havara tanobada ai.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

motu: Edia haroro bae haḡuḡuru, bena mauri ḡauna mai daḡedaḡena, guri dobu-hereana amo e daemu ḡauna, ese baine tuari henidia, haine hadareredia, baine aladia mase.
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

motu: Bena tau-anidia masedia na hanua badana ariarana ai bae mia, Hehuni herevadia heḡereḡerena ai ladana e gwauraia “Sodoma” na “Aigupto”; raruosi edia lohiabada na e hasatauroa hanuana,
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

motu: Bena dina toi mai dina kahana taunimanima idau-idau, iduhu idau-idau, gado idau-idau, bese idau-idau, taudia ese tau-anidia masedia bae itadia, a iguridia bae lao ahu.
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

motu: Bona tanobada taudia na edia mase dainai bae moale, bae his dae, bona harihari ḡaudia bae hegidu heheni; badina be unu peroveta taudioa raruosi ese tanobada taudia e hahisidiava.
