english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

motu: A dina toi mai dina kahana e ore, bena mauri laḡana Dirava ena amo na raruosi lalodiai e vareai, bena e gini tore. Bena gari bada ese e itadia taudia e butudia tao.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

motu: Bena gado ta guba amo e kamonai, e hereva badabada, e boiridia, eto “Ini aoma”. Bena raruosi na ori ta lalonai guba ai e dae, inaidia vairadiai.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

motu: Una hora lalonai tano-laga badana ta e vara, bena hanua kahadia gwautosi amo kaha ta e kohu; bona tano-laga dainai taunimanima daha hitu e mase. Taunimanima oredia na e gari dikadika, Guba Diravana e heatolaia.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

motu: Dika iharuana vada e ore; to ba itaia, ihatoina danu ma vada ba maimu. Kibi ihahituna
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

motu: Aneru ihahituna ese ena kibi e hiriria. Bena gado badadia guba ai e hereva, eto “Tanobada basileiadia na eda Lohiabada bona ena Keriso edia basileia ai vada ela. Ia na baine lohia hanaihanai”.
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

motu: Bena heitatao taudia ruahui-haniosi, Dirava vairanai terono ai e helaimu taudia, ese e goru diho, Dirava e toma henia diho, eto,
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

motu: Lohiabada e, siahu idoidiai Diravana; o nohomu, o nohova. Ai ese a hanamomumu; Badina be emu siahu badana vada o abia isi, Emu basileia o halohiaiamu.
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, + 11:17 TR adds “and who is coming” * because you have taken your great power and reigned.

motu: Bese idau-idau taudia e badu, A oiemu badu vada eme kau; Mase taudia edia nega danu vada eme kau, ba hahemaoro henidia; Emu hesiai taudia, peroveta bona helaḡa taudia, edia nega danu vada eme kau, Bona oi ladamu e matauraiamu taudia kikina badana edia danu. Iboudiai davadia namodia ba henidia; Bona tanobada ihadikana taudia ba hadikadia negana danu vada eme kau.
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

motu: Bena Dirava ena Dubu Helaḡa guba ai na e kehoa, bona ena taravatu mauna Dubu Helaḡa lalonai na e hedinarai. Bena kevaru bona ere bona guba-rahu bona tano-laga bona medu-hetari e vara badabada.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

motu: Bena hoa ḡauna badana ta guba ai e hedinarai: hahine ta, ena dabua na dina, bona hua na aena henudiai, bona hisiu gwauta-rua kwarana ai e ḡeḡea.
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

motu: E rogorogo, bena hekamonai hisina dainai e tai lolo.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

motu: Bena hoa ḡauna ma ta guba ai e hedinarai: huala badana kakakakana ta, kwarana na hitu, doana na gwauta, ena havava ḡaudia danu na hitu, kwarana ta ta ai.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

motu: Iuna ese guba hisiudia e daro dobi tanobada ai; hisiu toi toi amo ta ta e daro dobi. Bena hari huala na baine mara hahinena vairanai e gini, bine abia merona na ia ese baine ania eto.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

motu: Hahine na e mara, mero e abia; ia ese bese loḡora iboudiai auri itotohina amo bainereḡudia. To mero na e kitoa dae Dirava vairana bona ena terono vairanai.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

motu: Bena hahine na tano ḡaḡaena e heau lao, Dirava ese e heḡaeḡaelaia gabuna ai e noho; unuseni ai dina daha-ta sinahu-rua tauratoi-ahui bae ubua.
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

motu: Bena guba ai tuari e vara, Mikael mai ena aneru ida ese huala e tuari henia. Huala mai ena aneru ida e tuari,
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

motu: to e darere, bena edia gabu asie davaria lou guba ai.
english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

motu: Bena hari huala badana, idau negai gaigaina, ma ladana ta Satana, tanobada idoinai e koiamu ḡauna, na e doria lasi bona e tahoa dobi tanobada ai; bona ena aneru danu ia ida e tahodia dobi.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

motu: Bena na kamonai, gado badana ta guba ai e hereva, eto, Harihari iseda Dirava ena hahemauri bona ena goada bona ena basileia, bona iena Keriso ena siahu, vada eme gini dae; badina be Dirava vairanai varavarada e habadelaidia boi e habadelaidia rani tauna na vada e tahoa dobi.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

motu: Idia ese Mamoe Natuna rarana dainai bona e gwaurai hedinarai herevadia daidiai vada e hadarerea; edia mauri asie lalokau henia, ela bona mase.
english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

motu: Guba e! Guba ai o nohomu taumui e! Idia daidiai ba moale. Tanobada bona davara, madi ihabaimui! Badina be diabolo vada e vasi, e badu dikadikamu, badina be ia dibana ena nega eme kwadogi.
english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

motu: Bena huala ese e itaia, tanobada ai vada e tahoa dobi, bena ia ese mero e abia hahinena na e daḡedaḡe henia.
english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

motu: A ugava badana hanina ruaosi hari hahine e henia, bena ia ese huala e rohotania, tano ḡaḡaena e roho lao, ena gabu korikori ela, laḡani ta bona laḡani rua bona laḡani kahana e ubua gabuna.
english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

motu: Bena huala ese hahine murina amo ela, uduna amo ranu e loria lasi, sinavai na heto, aru ese baine arua isi eto.
english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

motu: A tanobada ese hahine e durua, e kara uduna e haḡaia na heto, huala ese e loria lasi sinavaina ma e hadonoa.
english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

motu: Bena huala ese hahine e badu henia, ela, hahine natuna oredia eha tuari henidia, Dirava ena haheḡani herevadia bona Iesu ena hahediba herevadia e badinamu taudia bunu. Bena kone ai e gini.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, + 12:17 or, seed * who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

motu: Daḡedaḡe ḡauna ta na itaia, davara amo e dae, doana na gwauta, kwarana na hitu, doana doridia ai be havava ḡaudia gwauta, bona kwarana ta ta ai Dirava ihadikana herevadia e tore.
english: Then I stood + 13:1 NU reads he stood * on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

motu: Hari daḡedaḡe ḡauna na itaia, ita-itana na taiga na heto, a aena na bea aena na heto, bona uduna na leona uduna na heto. Bena hari huala ese ena goada bona ena terono bona ena siahu na una ḡau e henia.
english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

motu: Bena kwarana ta na itaia, e kara vada e haberoa dikadika, mase berona na heto, to berona vada e namo.
english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

motu: Bena tanobada taudia ese huala e toma henia diho, badina be ia siahuna na hari daḡedaḡe ḡauna vada e henia; bona idia ese una daḡedaḡe ḡauna danu e toma henia diho, eto, Daika be ina ḡau idaina? Daika mai goadana baine tuari henia?
english: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

motu: Udu ta danu una daḡedaḡe ḡauna e henia, bena ia ese Dirava ihadikana herevadia e gwaurai lalo-dika. Bolla siahu danu e henia, hua hari-ahui rua baine lohia.
english: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

motu: Bena ia uduna e haḡaia, Dirava e ere dika henia, bona Dirava ladana bona ena dubu bona guba ai e nohomu taudia na e hadikadia ena hereva ai.
english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

motu: Siahu danu e henia, helaḡa taudia baine tuari henidia, baine hadareredia, bona iduhu iboudiai boll; l taunimanima iboudiai bona gado iboudiai bon; l bese iboudiai baine lohiadia.
english: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

motu: Bena Mamoe Natuna, e alaia mase gaun; l, ena mauri bukana ai ladadia na tanobada matamana amo asie tore taudia ibouhoudiai ese una ḡau bae toma henia diho.
english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

motu: Mai taiana tauna na baine kamonai.
english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

motu: Daika baine heabi mauri, vada bae abia mauri, bona daika baine heala mase, vada bae alaia mase, dare amo. Helaḡa taudia na bae haheauka hona bae heabidadama. Daḡedaḡe ḡauna ma ta tano amo e dae
english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. + 13:10 TR reads “If anyone leads into captivity, into captivity he goes. If anyone will kill with the sword, he must be killed with a sword.” instead of “If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed.” * Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

motu: Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna ma ta na itaia, tano lalona amo e dae, doana na rua, man-oe natuna ta na heto, a erella na huala erena na heto.
english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

motu: Bena ia ese daḡedaḡe ḡauna gini-gunana ena siahu idoinai e ḡaukaralaia, ia vairanai, bona tanobada mai inoholaina taudia iboudiai e haduadia, daḡedaḡe ḡauna gini-gunana, hari ena mase berona e namo ḡauna, bae toma henia diho eto.
english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

motu: Hoa karadia badadia danu e kara: ta be lahi guba amo e hadihoa taunimanima vairadiai.
english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

motu: Bena unu hoa karadia daḡedaḡe ḡauna vairanai e kara siahudia amo ia ese tanobada taudia e koidia, e haduadia, una daḡedaḡe gaulla, mai dare berona to e mauri ḡauna, laulauna bae karaia eto.
english: He deceives my own + 13:14 NU omits “my own” * people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

motu: Bena ia na mai siahuna, una daḡedaḡe ḡauna Iaulauna baine hamauria, bena laulau na baine hereva. Mai siahuna danu una laulau ese basie toma henia diho taudia baine aladia mase.
english: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

motu: Bena taunimanima iboudiai kikina badana, taḡa taudia bona ogoḡami taudia, ura kwalimu taudia bona e ḡuidia taudia, na toa ta e henidia, imadia idibadia ai eiava bagudia ai e kara.
english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

motu: Taunabunai ta basine hoihoi diba, hari toa, daḡedaḡe ḡauna ladana eiava numerana, e abia tauna mo sibona.
english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

motu: Aonegana binai: lalona e pararamu tauna ese hari daḡedaḡe ḡauna numerana baine hagaua, badina be ia na tau ta numerana. Numerana binai: 666.
english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

motu: Bona Mamoe Natuna na itaia, Siona ororona ai e gini; bona ia ida taunimanima domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani, + 14:1 domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani = 144,000 * ia bona Tamana Iadadia baḡudia ai e torea taudia.
english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

motu: Ma gado ta na kamonai, guba amo ema, sinavai momo reḡedia na heto bona guba e rahua dagumu na heto. Una gado danu e kara gitara taudia edia gitara e hataimu na heto;
english: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

motu: idia na ane matamatana e abia, terono bona mauri ḡaudia haniosi bona heitatao taudia vairadiai. Una ane na tau ta basine davaria diba, hari taunimanima domaga-ta gerebu-hani daha-hani, tanobada amo e hoidia taudia, sibodia.
english: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

motu: Idia be hahine ida asie eno bou taudia; vada e helaga. Idia ese Mamoe Natuna murinai e rakamu, ena loa iboudiai. Taunimanima padadia amo e hoidia, Dirava bona Mamoe Natuna anina roboana ai baela, taudia bunu.
english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

motu: Koikoi herevana ta idia ududia amo se lasi; idia na asi bebeka-bebekadia.
english: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless. + 14:5 TR adds “before the throne of God” *

motu: Bena aneru ta na itaia, guba padanai e roho, mia-hanaihanai sivaraina namona na tanobada ai e nohomu taudia ediai e laohai, bese iboudiai, iduhu iboudiai, gado iboudiai, tano iboudiai e harorolai henidia.
english: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

motu: E hereva badabada, eto, Dirava garina ba gari, ia mo ba imodaia, badina be ena hahemaoro negana vada be gini daemu; guba bona tanobada bona davara bona ranu e lohilohimu gabudia e kara Diravana ba toma henia diho.
english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

motu: Ma aneru ta, iharuana, ia murina amo e roho, eto, Babulono badana, hanua iboudiai na ena heuda-hanai baduna vine-ranuna e ha-inulaidia hanuana, vada e kohu, vada e kohu.
english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

motu: Ma aneru ta, ihatoina, idia muridia amo e roho, e lolo, eto, Ta ese daḡedaḡe ḡauna mai laulauna ida baine toma henia diho, bona ia toana baguna ai eiava imana ai baine abia,
english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

motu: ia ese Dirava ena badu vine-ranuna, ena badu keherena lalonai vada e seia, ranu kavakava ida asie buloa ḡauna, baine inua; lahi bona teio amo bae hahisia danu, aneru helaḡadia bona Mamoe Natuna vairadiai.
english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

motu: E animu hisidia kwalahuna e dae hanaihanaimu, bona dina hanuaboi laḡadia asie animu; daḡedaḡe ḡauna mai laulauna ida e toma henia dihomu bona ladana toana e abiamu taudia ahudia bunu.
english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

motu: Helaḡa taudia, Dirava ena haheḡani e badinamu bona Iesu e abidadama heniamu taudia, do bae haheauka.
english: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

motu: Bena gado ta na kamonai, guba amo ema, eto, Ini ba torea toma “Lohiabada enai e masemu taudia be nanamo”. Ma Lauma eto “Oibe, edia ḡaukara amo bae laḡa ani, badina be edia kara ese e ḡavadiamu”.
english: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “ Yes|strong="G3483" *,” says|strong="G3004" * the|strong="G1722" * Spirit|strong="G4151" *, “ that|strong="G2443" * they|strong="G2532" * may|strong="G2532" * rest from|strong="G1537" * their|strong="G2532" * labors|strong="G2873" *, for|strong="G1063" * their|strong="G2532" * works|strong="G2041" * follow|strong="G3326" * with|strong="G3326" * them|strong="G3588" *.”

motu: Bena na roha lao, ori kurokurona ta na itaia, bona ori latanai ta e helai, ita-itana taunimanima natuna ta na heto; kwarana ai na gold havava ḡauna, bona imana ai ilapa ta mai ganona.
english: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, + 14:14 Daniel 7:13 * having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

motu: Bena aneru ta Dubu Helaḡa amo e raka lasi, ori latanai e helai tauna e lolo henia, eto, Emu ilapa aine ḡaukara; a lapalapa; badina be uit iutuna negana vada eme kau, tanobada uitina vada e lo vaitani.
english: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

motu: Bena ori latanai e helai tauna ese ena ilapa e ḡaukaralaia, tanobada uitina e lapaia vaitani.
english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

motu: Bena aneru ma ta guba dubuna amo e raka lasi, ia danu imana ai na ilapa ta mai ganona.
english: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

motu: Ma aneru ta pata helaḡana amo e raka lasi; una aneru na mai siahuna lahi enai. Bena ia ese hari imana mai ilapana aneruna e lolo henia, eto, Emu ilapa aine ḡaukara; tanobada ena vine takodia ba utu, badina be vine huahuadia vada e maḡe.
english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

motu: Bena hari aneru ese ena ilapa e ḡaukaralaia tanobada ai, tanobada ena vine huahuadia e utu oho; bona moimoi gabuna badana, Dirava ena badu bunai, lalonai e taho uda.
english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

motu: Hari moimoi gabuna na hanua mulimurinai; bena e moia. Bena rara na moimoi gabuna amo e lasi, e aru ela bona maila sinahu-rua; ena dobu danu tano ela bona hosi uduna heḡereḡerena.
english: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia. + 14:20 1600 stadia = 296 kilometers or 184 miles *

motu: Bena hoa ḡauna badana ma ta guba ai na itaia: aneru hitu ese hahehisi ḡaudia oredia hituosi e abi, Dirava ena badu ihaḡuḡuruna ḡaudia bunu.
english: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

motu: Bona davara ta na itaia, hevarivari na heto, to mai lahina. Bona da edaḡe ḡauna bona laulaunaa mai ladana mai numerana ida vada e hadareredia taudia danu na itadia, idia na una davara hevarivari na heto isena ai e gini, Dirava ena gitara imadia ai e abi.
english: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, + 15:2 TR adds “his mark,” * and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

motu: Bena Dirava ena hesiai tauna, Mose, ena ane e abia, bona Mamoe Natuna ena ane danu. Eto, Lohiabada Dirava e, siahu idoinai Diravana, Emu ḡaukara daka bada, hoa karadia. Uru iboudiai edia Pavapava e, Emu kara na mamaoro-mamaoro bona momomo-kakani.
english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “ Great|strong="G3173" * and|strong="G2532" * marvelous|strong="G2298" * are|strong="G3588" * your|strong="G2962" * works|strong="G2041" *, Lord|strong="G2962" * God|strong="G2316" *, the|strong="G2532" * Almighty|strong="G3841" *! Righteous|strong="G1342" * and|strong="G2532" * true|strong="G3588" * are|strong="G3588" * your|strong="G2962" * ways|strong="G3598" *, you|strong="G4771" * King|strong="G3588" * of|strong="G2316" * the|strong="G2532" * nations|strong="G1484" *.

motu: Lohiabada e, daika oi garimu basine gari? Daika oi ladamu basine imodaia? Badina be oi mo sibomu helaḡa. Bese iboudiai baema, bae toma henimu diho, Badina be emu hahemaoro karadia vada ema hedinarai.
english: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and|strong="G2532" * glorify|strong="G1392" * your|strong="G2962" * name|strong="G3686" *? For|strong="G3754" * you|strong="G4771" * only|strong="G3441" * are|strong="G3588" * holy|strong="G3741" *. For|strong="G3754" * all|strong="G3956" * the|strong="G2532" * nations|strong="G1484" * will|strong="G5101" * come|strong="G2240" * and|strong="G2532" * worship|strong="G4352" * before|strong="G1799" * you|strong="G4771" *. For|strong="G3754" * your|strong="G2962" * righteous|strong="G1345" * acts|strong="G1345" * have|strong="G2532" * been|strong="G2532" * revealed|strong="G5319" *.”

motu: Bena na itaia, igwaurai-hedinaraina kalagana helaḡana e kehoa guba ai.
english: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

motu: Bena aneru hituosi, hahehisi ḡaudia hituosi e abi anerudia, na kalaga helaḡana amo e raka lasi; dabua aukadia ḡoevaḡoevadia bona kuroka-kurokadia e hadokilai, kemedia toradia na gold.
english: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

motu: Bena mauri ḡaudia haniosi edia amo ta ese aneru hituosi gold kibodia auhitu e henidia: unu kibo na Noho-hanaihanai Diravana ena badu amo e honuhonu dae.
english: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

motu: Bena Dirava hairaina bona siahuna kwalahudia ese una dubu e hahonua; bona tau ta dubu lalonai basine raka vareai diba ela bona hahituosi ese edia hahehisi ḡaudia hituosi bae ore.
english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

motu: Bena ere badana ta Dubu Helaḡa lalona amo na kamonai, aneru hahituosi e hamaorodia, eto, Aola, Dirava ena badu ai e honumu kibodia auhituosi na tanobada ai ba bubu dobi.
english: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

motu: Aneru gini-gunana ela, ena kibo tanobada ai e bubua. Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna toana e abia bona laulauna e toma henia diho taudia ediai toto badadia mai hisidia eha dudu.
english: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

motu: Aneru iharuana ena kibo davara ai e bubua; bena mase tauna rarana heḡereḡerena ai ela, bena davara lalonai e noho ḡaudia iboudiai vada e mase.
english: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

motu: Aneru ihatoina ena kibo na sinavai ai bona ranu lohilohi gabudia ai e bubua; bena rara ai ela.
english: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

motu: Bena ranu ilohiadia aneruna erena na kamonai, eto, Helaḡa Diravamu e, o nohova, o nohomu; Ini o hahemaoro henidia tomamu na maoromaoro,
english: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

motu: Badina be helaḡa taudia bona peroveta taudia raradia e bubu. Bena rara o henidiamu, bae inua, Edia kara ihaheḡereḡerena.
english: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

motu: Bena ere ma ta pata helaḡana amo na kamonai, eto, Lohiabada Dirava e siahu idoinai Diravana, momokani! Emu hahemaoro na momokani bona maoromaoro.
english: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

motu: Aneru ihahanina ena kibo na dina latanai e bubua; bena e hasiahua taunimanima baine aradia, lahi na heto.
english: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

motu: Bena siahu badana ese taunimanima e aradia; bena idia ese hari hahehisi e biagudia Diravana ladana e uduguiraia; asie helalo kerehai bona asie heatolaia.
english: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

motu: Aneru iha-imana ena kibo na daḡedaḡe ḡauna ena terono latanai e bubua; bena ena basileia e hadiburaia, bena taunimanima maladia e kori, hisihisi dainai.
english: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

motu: Bena Guba Diravana e uduguiraia, edia hisihisi bona edia toto daidiai; asie helalo kerehai, bona edia kara dika asie rakatani.
english: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.

motu: Aneru ihatauratoina ena kibo na sinavai badana, ladana Eufrate. lalonai e bubua, bena ranuna vada e kororo, mairiveina kahana hanuadia pavapavadia edia dala e lailaia.
english: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise. + 16:12 or, east *

motu: Bena na ita, lauma dikadia tatoi, parapara na heheto, huala uduna amo bona daḡedaḡe ḡauna uduna amo bona peroveta koikoi tauna uduna amo e lasi.
english: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

motu: Idia na lauma dika-hereadia, hoa karadia e karamu, bona tanobada idoinai hanua hanua pavapavadia e lao henidiamu, eha gogodiamu, siahu idoinai Diravana ena dina badana tuarina dainai.
english: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.

motu: (A itaia, henao tauna na heto ba vasimu. Hegima tauna, ena dahua e abi heḡaeḡaemu, asi ramina baine loa bena ena hemarai baine hedinarai na garina tauna, ia hari namo.)
english: “\+w Behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w come|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w like|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w a|strong="G5613"\+w* \+w thief|strong="G2812"\+w*. \+w Blessed|strong="G3107"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* watches, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w keeps|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w his|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w clothes|strong="G2440"\+w*, \+w so|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* doesn’\+w t|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w walk|strong="G4043"\+w* \+w naked|strong="G1131"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w see|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w his|strong="G3708"\+w* shame.” *

motu: Bena lauma dikadia ese e gogodia gabu ta ai, ladana Heberu gadodiai ai be Aramagedono.
english: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

motu: Aneru ihahituna ena kibo na guba padanai e bubua; bena guba dubuna teronona amo ere badana ta e lasi, eto “Vada e ore”.
english: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

motu: Bena kevaru bona ere bona guba-rahu e vara; bona tano e laḡa bada, taunimanima tanobada ai e noho matama negana ai ema bona harihari tano na unu se laḡa toma.
english: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.

motu: Bena hanua badana e parara, karoa toi, bona bese idau-idau edia hanua loḡora e heḡiḡi dobi; bona Dirava ese Babulono badana e laloa, ena badu ḡaraḡarana keherenae henia, ena badu vine-ranuna baine inua ore.
english: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

motu: Motumotu iboudiai e heau boio; ororo nallasihidia.
english: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

motu: Medu-hetari badadia, edia metau na pound sinahu ta mai dikooana, na guba amo e moru taunimanima latadiai. Bena taunimanima ese Dirava e uduguiraia, medu-hetari dainai, badina be ena hahehisi na bada herea.
english: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, + 16:21 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds. * came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.

motu: Bena hari kiho auhituosl e abi kau anerudia ta dekegu ema, e hereva henigu, eto, Aoma, ariara hahinena badana, ranu momlo latadiai e helaimu hahinena, ihahemaoro-henina baina haheitalaimu.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

motu: Hanua hanua pavapavadia na ia ida vada e heuda hanai, bona tanobada ai e nohomu taudia ese ena heuda-hanai vine-ranuna vada e inua kekero.
english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

motu: Bena ia ese Lauma ai e laohaigu, tano ḡaḡaena ala; unuseni ai hahine ta na itaia, mauri ḡauna kakakakana ta latanai e helai kau. Una mauri ḡauna na Dirava ihadikana herevadia amo e honu; ia kwarana na hitu, bona doana na gwauta.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

motu: Hahine na dabua kakakakadia bona mia-kakadia e hadokilai, gold bona nadi hururu-hururudia bona aḡeva mai hairaidia e heralai. Ia imana ai na gold keberena ta, ḡau dika-rohorohodia bona ena heudahanai amo e honu.
english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

motu: Ia baguna ai lada ta e torea, anina e hehuni ḡauna, ini e torea toma: “Babulono badana, ariara hahinedia bona tanobada ena kara mirodia idoidiai sinadia”.
english: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

motu: Hahine na na itaia, helaḡa taudia bona Iesu dainai e aladia mase taudia raradia e inu kekero. Na itaia negana ai na hoa dikadika.
english: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

motu: Bena hari aneru ese ma e hereva henigu, eto, Oi dahaka o hoamu? Ina hahine sivaraina hehunina, bona hari mauri ḡauna, latanai e helai kaumu ḡauna, kwarana hitu doana gwauta ḡauna, sivaraina hehunina, aina hamaorolaimu.
english: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

motu: Hari mauri ḡauna o itaia be e nohova, to harihari ia na lasihia. A asi vanahana ia na guri dobu-masemasena amo do baine dae, mase gabuna bainela. Bena tanobada ai e nohomu a tanobada matamana ai ladadia na mauri bukana lalonai se tore taudia ese hari mauri ḡauna, e nohova, ma lasihia, ma bainema ḡauna, bae itaia. bona bae hoa.
english: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present. + 17:8 TR reads “yet is” instead of “shall be present” *

motu: Aonega tauna na lalona baine parara. Hari kwara hituosi na ororo hitu; hahine na latadiai e helaimu.
english: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

motu: Idia na pavapava hahitu danu: laima vada e keto, ta be e nohomu, a ta be do sema; bainema negama ai baine noho taina.
english: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

motu: A hari mauri ḡauna, e nohova a vada lasihia ḡauna, ia na ihataura-hanina; ḡau tamona hituosi ediai ia danu ta, bona ia danu mase gabuna bainela.
english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

motu: A doa gwauta o ita ḡaudia na pavapava gwauta, to edia basileia do asie abi. A hari mauri ḡauna ida pavapava siahuna do bae abia, hora tamona.
english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

motu: Iboudiai lalodia na tamona, edia goada bona edia siahu hari mauri ḡauna bae henia e tomamu.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

motu: Idia ese Mamoe Natuna bae tuari henia, to Mamoe Natuna na do baine kwalimu; badina be ia na lohia edia Lohia, bona pavapava edia Pavapava, bona e bamoamu taudia na ia ese e boiridia bona e abidia hidi, bona idia ese ia e abidadama heniamu.
english: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”

motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, o itil ranudia, ariara hahinena ese e helai heni ranudia, na tano idau-idau taudia, orea idau-idau, bese idau-idau, gado idau-idau.
english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

motu: Bona mauri ḡauna doana gwautaosi o ita ḡaudia ese ariara hahinena bae inai henia; bae havahuraia, kopi kavakava bainela, bena hidiona bae ania, lahi ai bae ḡolea oho.
english: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

motu: Badina be Dirava ese e ha-uradia, ena lalo-hadai bae haḡuḡurua; bena lalodia bae tamona, edia basileia na mauri ḡauna bae henia ela bona Dirava ena hereva baine ḡuḡuru.
english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

motu: Bona hari o itaia hahinena na hanua badana, hanua hanua pavapavadia e lohiadiamu hanuana.
english: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”

motu: Ini ḡau muridiai, aneru ma ta na itaia, guba amo e diho, mai siahu badana ida. Ia hairaina ese tanobada e hadiaria.
english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

motu: Bena e lolo badabada, eto, Babulono badana vada e kohu, vada e kohu! Lauma dikadia edia noho gabuna ai vada ela; Lauma dika-hereadia edia kohua ai vada ela; Manu dikadia bona manu daḡedaḡedia edia ruma ai vada ela.
english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

motu: Badina be bese iboudiai ese ena heuda-hanai baduna vine-ranuna vada e inua; Bona hanua hanua pavapavadia na ia ida vada e heuda hanai; Bona hanua hanua edia hoihoi taudia ese ena lebulebu taḡadia amo edia taḡa vada e habada.
english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

motu: Ma ere ta guba amo na kamonai, eto, Egu orea taumui e, iena amo ba raka lasi, Ia ida ba kara dika hebou na garina, Ia ida ba hisihisi hebou na garina.
english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

motu: Badina be ena dika vada e senua ela bona guba ai, Bona Dirava ese ena kara havara e lalo taomu.
english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

motu: Haida e henidia heḡereḡerena ba henia, Ena kara davadia ba henia harua. Haida adia inuinu ḡauna e buloa keherena ai ia ana ba buloa harua.
english: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

motu: Sibona e heimodaiva bona e lebulebuva heḡereḡerena hisihisi bona tai ba henia, Badina be lalona e hadaia, eto “Lau na pavapava na heto na helaimu, lau na dia vabu, Tai badina egu ai basine kau”.
english: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

motu: Taunabunai ena hisihisi idau-idau dina tamona ai bae kau, Mase bona taitai bona doe; Lahi ese baine araia vaitani. Badina be Lohiabada, e hahemaoro heniamu Diravana, na mai siahuna.
english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

motu: Bena hanua hanua pavapavadia, ia ida e heuda hanaiva bona e lebulebu hebouva taudia, ese ia idouna kwalahuna bae itaia negana ai na ia taina bae tai, bae tai lolololo.
english: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

motu: Ena hisihisi garina bae gari dainai, dauhai bae gini, baeto, Madi o, madi o, Babulono o! Hanua bada hereana, goada hanuana! Hora tamona ai vada eme hahemaoro henimu vaitani.
english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

motu: Bona hanua hanua edia hoihoi taudia danu ia taina bae tai, bae tai dikadika; badina he edia hoihoi kohudia na tau ta ese basine hoi lou:
english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

motu: gold bona silver; nadi hururu-hururudia bona aḡeva mai hairaidia; dabua aukadia bona dahua mia-kakadia; silk dabuadia bona dahua kakakakadia; boto audia bona elefant doadia amo e kara ḡaudia; au namodia bona auri labora-labora amo e kara ḡaudia; aauri bona nadi amo e kara ḡaudia,
english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

motu: muramura idauidau danu, kinamomo bona amomo bona tumiamata bona muro bona libano; + 18:13 Kinamomo: Amomo: Tumiamata: Muro: Libano. Ini na muramura haida, asi ladadia Motu gado ai dainai ladadia na Helene gado ai vada e tore. * vine ranuna danu, bona dehoro; flaoa bona uit; boromakau bona mamoe; hosi bonal kariota; tauunimanima tau-anidia bona laumadia.
english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

motu: Laumamu ese e ura heni ḡaudioa ese vada e rakatanimu. Digara ḡaudia bona diari ḡaudia ese vada e heautanimu, Basio davaridia lou.
english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

motu: Unu ḡau e hoiva, edia taḡa e davariva, taudia na ena hisihisi garina bae gari, dauhai bae gini, bae tai dikadika, bae tai lulololo, baeto,
english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

motu: Madi o, madi o, hanua badana! Dabua aukadia bona mia-kakadia bona kakakakadia o hadokilaiva, Gold bona nadi hururu-hururudia bona aḡeva mai hairaidia o heralaiva:
english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

motu: Hora tamona ai emu taḡa vada eme ore vaitani. Bona lagatoi biagudia, mai edia memero ida, bona hiri taudia, bona davara ḡaukaradia idau-idau e kara taudia, dauha amo e itaia;
english: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

motu: bena idouna kwalahuna e itaia negana ai e lolo, eto. Hanua badana idaina be edena?
english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

motu: Bena tano ḡahuna na kwaradia ai e taho kau, e tai, e tai lolololo, eto, Hanua badana madi o, madi o! Ena taḡa ese laḡatoi taudia e hataḡadia! Hora tamona ai vada eme vahu.
english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

motu: Guba e, ena va hu ba moalelaia; Helaḡa taumui bona aposetolo taumui bona peroveta taumui, ba moale; Badina be umui daimui ai Dirava ese davana vada eme henia.
english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

motu: Bena aneru goadana ta ese nadi-huro badana ta e abia isi, davara ai e tahoa dobi, eto, Babulono, hanua badana, unu bae tahoa dobi toma, Bena basine hedinarai lou.
english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

motu: Gitara e hataimu bona ane e lada isimu taudia, Ivilikou e hataimu bona kibi e hiririmu taudia, Oi lalomu ai basie kamonaidia lou; Ḡaukara namodioa mai dibadia taudia Oi lalomu ai basie noho lou; Uit ibidina nadina reḡena na OLi lalomu ai basie kamonai lou;
english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

motu: Lamepa diarina na Oi lalomu ai basine hururu lou; Headava matamata tauna bona hahinena Oi lalomu ai eredia basie kamonai lou. Badina be emu hoihoi taudia na tanobada lohiadia ai ela, Emu babalau karadia ese bese iboudiai e koidia.
english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

motu: Peroveta taudia raradia, Bona Helaḡa taudia raradia, Bona tanobada ai e aladia mase taudia iboudiai raradia, Ia lalonai e davari.
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

motu: Bena hutuma bada guba ai eredia na kamonai, eto, Aleluia! Hahemauri bona hairai bona siahu na iseda Dirava enai mimia.
english: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

motu: Badina be ena hahemaaoro na momomo-kakani bona mamaoro-mamaoro. Ia ese ariara hahinena badana vada e hahemaoro henia, Ena heuda-hanai amo tanobada e hadikaia hahinena bunai; Dirava ena hesiai taudia raradia davana danu vada e henia.
english: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

motu: Ma eto, Aleluia! Hanua badana kwalahuna e dae hallaihanaimu.
english: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

motu: Bena heitatao taudia ruahui-haniosi bona maurio ḡaudia haniosi e goru diho, terono ai e helaimu Diravana e toma henia diho, eto, “Amen! Aleluia!”
english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

motu: Bona ena hesiai taumui e, Dirava ena hesiai taumui e, Ia garina o garimu taumui e, Kikina badana, eda Dirava ba hanamoa.
english: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

motu: Bena ere ta na kamonai, hutuma bada eredia na heheto, sinavai momo reḡedia na heheto, guba-rahu reḡedia na heheto. Eto, Aleluia! Lohiabada eda Dirava, siahu idoinai Diravana, ia mo Lohia.
english: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

motu: Aita moale, aita hisi dae, ia mo aita heatolaia. Badina be Mamoe Natuna ena headava negana vada eme gini dae, Bona adavana vada e heḡaeḡae vaitani,
english: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

motu: Dabua aukadia vada e hadokilai, ḡoevaḡoevadia bona kuroka-kurokadia. Hari dabua aukadia na helaḡa taudia edia kara maoromaoro.
english: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

motu: Bena aneru ese e hamaorogu, eto, A torea: “Mamoe Natuna ena headava anibouna e vavedia taudia be nanamo”. Ma eto “Ini na Dirava ena hereva momokani”.
english: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

motu: Bena aena badinai na goru diho, baina toma henia diho nato, to e gwaugu tao, eto, Ene asio kara toma; lau danu hesiai taugu, oi bamomu bona varavaramu, Iesu ena hereva e badinamu taudia, bamodia danu. Dirava ba toma henia diho; badina be Iesu ena hereva na peroveta laumana.
english: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

motu: Bena guba na itaia, e parara, bona hosi kurokurona ta e hedinarai, latanai e gui tauna ladana na “Abidadama” bona “Momokani”; ia na kara maoromaoro ai e hahemaoromu bona e tuarimu.
english: I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

motu: Matana na e kara lahi hururu-hururuna na heto. Kwarana ai na havava ḡaudia momo, latadiai lada ta e torea; a e torea herevana ta asi dibana, ia mo sibona.
english: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

motu: Rara ai e urua diho dabuana hadokilaia. Ia ladana e hatoa “Dirava ena Hereva”.
english: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

motu: Guba ena tuari oreadia na ia murinai ela: hosi kurokurodia ai e gui; dabua aukadia, ḡoevaḡoevadia bona kuroka-kurokadia, e hadokilai.
english: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

motu: Uduna amo amo dare mai ganona e lasi, bese idau-idau idapalaidia. Auri itotohina amo baine reḡudia; bona siahu idoinai Diravana ena badu-ḡaraḡara vinena gabuna ai baine moidia tao.
english: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. + 19:15 Psalms 2:9 * He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

motu: Ena dabua ai bona mamuna ai lada ta e torea: “Pavapava edia Pavapava; lohia edia Lohia”.
english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

motu: Bena aneru ta na itaia, dina ai e gini, e lolo badabada, guba padanai e rohomu manudia e boi henidia, eto, Aoma, Dirava ena anibou badana ai ame hegogo,
english: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God, + 19:17 TR reads “supper of the great God” instead of “great supper of God” *

motu: pavapava hidiodia, bona tuari biagudia hidiodia, bona goada taudia hidiodia, bona hosi hidiodia, bona hosi ai e guimu taudia hidiodia, bona taunimanima iboudiai, ura kwalimu taudia bona e ḡuidia taudia, kikina badana hidiodia, bavani.
english: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

motu: Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna bona hanua hanua pavapavadia mai edia tuari oreadia ida na itadia, e hegogo, hari hosi ai e gui tauna mai ena orea ida bae tuari henidia totona.
english: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

motu: Bena daḡedaḡe ḡauna e abia mauri, bona peroveta koikoina, hoa karadia daḡedaḡe ḡauna vairanai e kara dainai daḡedaḡe ḡauna toana e abia bona laulauna e toma henia diho taudia e koidia tauna, danu e abia mauri. Idia raruosi na mauridia ai lahi gohuna, teio e aramu gabuna, lalonai e tahodia dobi.
english: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

motu: A oredia na hosi ai e gui tauna uduna amo e lasi darena ese e aladia mase, bena manu iboudiai ese hidiodi e ani, bogadia e kunu.
english: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

motu: Bena aneru ta guba amo e diho, guri dobu-masemasena kina na imana ai, bona auri gadeana badana ta danu.
english: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

motu: Ia ese hari huala, idau negai gaigaina, ladana ta hatoamu “Diabolo” bona “Satana”, e dabaia tao, e ḡuia, laḡani daha ta iḡui ai baine noho.
english: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, + 20:2 TR and NU omit “who deceives the whole inhabited earth”. * and bound him for a thousand years,

motu: Guri dobu-masemasena lalonai e tahoa dobi, bena guri e koua bona ikouna toana e karaia. Taunabunai, bese idau-idau basine haraiva-raivadia diba ela bona laḡani daha ta bae ore. Una murinai ma bae ruhaia nege, nega taina mo.
english: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

motu: Bena terono haida na ita, bona e helai kau taudia danu na itadia; hahemaoro siahuna na idia imadia ai vada e atoa. Bena Iesu ena hereva bona Dirava ena hereva e gwaurai hedinarai dainai kwaradia e utu oho taudia, bona daḡedaḡe ḡauna mai laulauna ida asie toma henidia diho bona toana bagudia ai eiava imadia ai asie abia taudia, laumadia na itadia. Idia na e mauri lou, Keriso ida eha lohia ela bona laḡani daha ta.
english: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

motu: A mase taudia oredia asie mauri lou ela bona laḡani daha ta e ore. Tore-isi-lou gini gunana binai.
english: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

motu: Ina tore-isi-lou gini gunana lalonai ahuna e abiamu tauna be namo bona helaḡa; mase iharuana na asi siahuna una tau enai. Unuhetomadia na Dirava ena hahelaḡa taudia bona Keriso ena hahelaḡa taudia ai baela, bona ia ida bae ha lohia ela bona laḡani daha ta.
english: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

motu: A unu laḡani daha ta bae ore; bena Satana na ena iḡui amo bae ruhaia nege.
english: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

motu: Bena ia na baine lasi, tanobada daigunina haniosi ai e nohomu besedia, ladadia Gog bona Magog, tuari totona baine gogodia; ihagaudia na kone mirina na heto.
english: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

motu: Bena tanobada lababana e rakaia hanai, helaḡa taudia edia taruha bona Dirava ese e lalokau heniamu hanuana e daidia heḡeḡe; a lahi na guba amo e diho, e habuadia tari.
english: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

motu: Bena Diabolo, e koidia tauna, na lahi bona teio gohuna lalonai e tahoa dobi, daḡedaḡe ḡauna bona peroveta koikoina e tahodia dobi guna gabuna: unuseni ai bae hisihisi boi bae hisihisi rani, ela bona hanaihanai. Hahemaoro badana
english: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

motu: Bena terono kurokurona badana ta na itaia, bona e helai kau Diravana danu. Bena tanobada bona guba na ia vairana amo e heau puki, to edia gabu ta asie davaria.
english: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the sky fled away. There was found no place for them.

motu: Bena mase taudia kikina badana na itadia, terono vairanai gigini; bona buka vada e hekeho. Bena buka ta ma e kehoa, mauri bukana; bona mase taudia na e hahemaoro henidia, edia kara buka ai e tore heḡereḡeredia.
english: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

motu: Bona davara ai e mase taudia na davara ese e henidia dae, bona Mase bona Mase Gabuna danu lalodiai e hekou taudia e henidia dae. Bena idia danu edia kara heḡereḡeredia e hahemaoro henidia.
english: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades + 20:13 or, Hell * gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

motu: Bena Mase bona Mase Gabuna na lahi gohuna lalonai e tahodia dobi. Ina na mase iharuana, lahi gohuna.
english: Death and Hades + 20:14 or, Hell * were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

motu: Bena tau ta bema asi ladana mauri bukana, ia na lahi gohuna ai bema tahoa dobi.
english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

motu: Bena guba matamatana bona tanobada matamatana na ita; badina be guba gunana bona tanobada gunana vada e puki, davara danu lasihia.
english: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

motu: Bona hanua helaḡana, Ierusalem matamatana, na itaia, guba amo e diho, Dirava ena amo, be headavamu ulatona na heto, e haheraia adavana ena.
english: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

motu: Bena ere ta na kamonai, terono amo ema, e hereva badabada, eto, Dirava ena noho gabuna na taunimanima dekedekediai; ia na bogaragidiai baine noho. Idia na iena bese ai baela; ia ese baine hamodia, edia Dirava.
english: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

motu: Ia ese iruru-matadia iboudiai matadia amo baine dahu oho. Mase bona dara-doko bona taitai bona hisihisi bae ore; badina be ḡau gunadia vada e puki.
english: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

motu: Bena terono ai e helaimu Diravana eto, A itaia, lau na ḡau iboudiai na hamatamatamu. Ma eto, A torea; badina be ini hereva na mamaoro-mamaoro bona momomo-kakani.
english: He who sits on the throne said, “\+w Behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w making|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w all|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w new|strong="G2537"\+w*.” * He said, “\+w Write|strong="G1125"\+w*, \+w for|strong="G3754"\+w* \+w these|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w words|strong="G3056"\+w* \+w of|strong="G3056"\+w* \+w God|strong="G3004"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w faithful|strong="G4103"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w true|strong="G4103"\+w*.” *

motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Vadaeni; lau na gini-gunana bona gini-gabena, matamana bona dokona. Ranu mase tauna na e lohilohi daemu mauri-ranuna baine henia, asi davana.
english: He said to me, “\+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* Alpha \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Omega|strong="G5598"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* Beginning \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w End|strong="G5056"\+w*. \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1325"\+w* \+w freely|strong="G1432"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w thirsty|strong="G1372"\+w* \+w from|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w spring|strong="G4077"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w water|strong="G5204"\+w* \+w of|strong="G1537"\+w* \+w life|strong="G2222"\+w*. *

motu: Kwalimu tauna ahuna binai: lau na ena Dirava ai bainala, ia na natugu ai bainela.
english: \+w He|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w overcomes|strong="G3528"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w give|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w him|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w these|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w*. \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w be|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w his|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w God|strong="G2316"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w will|strong="G2316"\+w* \+w be|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w son|strong="G5207"\+w*. *

motu: A gari taudia, asie kamonai taudia, kara bodaḡa taudia, ala-ala taudia, babalau taudia, kaivakuku e toma henidia diho taudia, koikoi taudia, iboudiai ahudia na lahi bona teio gohuna: mase iharuana bunai. Ierusalem matamatana
english: \+w But|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1161"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w cowardly|strong="G1169"\+w*, unbelieving, sinners, * + 21:8 TR and NU omit “sinners” * abominable, \+w murderers|strong="G5406"\+w*, sexually \+w immoral|strong="G4205"\+w*, \+w sorcerers|strong="G5333"\+w*, * + 21:8 The word for “sorcerers” here also includes users of potions and drugs. * \+w idolaters|strong="G1496"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w all|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w liars|strong="G5571"\+w*, \+w their|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w part|strong="G3313"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w lake|strong="G3041"\+w* \+w that|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w burns|strong="G2545"\+w* \+w with|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w fire|strong="G4442"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w sulfur|strong="G2303"\+w*, \+w which|strong="G3739"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w the|strong="G1722"\+w* \+w second|strong="G1208"\+w* \+w death|strong="G2288"\+w*.” *

motu: Bena aneru hituosi, hari kibo hituosi lalodiai hahehisi gabedia hituosi e abi anerudia, ta ema, e hereva henigu, eto, Aoma, headava matamata hahinena, Mamoe Natuna adavana, baina haheitalaimu.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”

motu: Bena lauma ai e laohaigu, ororo badana ta dorina ai. Bena hanua helaḡana, Ierusalem, haheitalaigu, guba amo e diho, Dirava ena amo.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

motu: Ia hairaina na Dirava hairaina; bona diarina na nadi hururu-hururuna, davana bada ḡauna, na heto, iaspi nadina na heto, e negari-negari.
english: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

motu: Ia na mai maḡuna: maḡuna danu lababana na bada bona harana na lata. Ikoukouna na gwauta-rua. Ikoukou badidiai na aneru gwauta-rarua, bona ikoukou daediai Israel iduhudia gwauta-ruaosi ladadia e tore.
english: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

motu: Laurabada kahana ai ikoukou toi, mirigini kahana ai toi, diho kahana ai toi, bona lahara kahana ai danu toi.
english: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

motu: Bona maḡu badina nadidia na gwauta-rua, ohedia ai Mamoe Natuna ena aposetolo taudia gwauta-raruosi ladadia e tore.
english: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

motu: Bena hari e hereva henigu aneruna imana ai na hahetoho ḡauna ta, gold amo e karaiaa ḡauna, hanua bonaa ikoukou bona maaḡu ihahetohodia.
english: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

motu: Hanua na e hadaia kaha haniosi heḡereḡere; roha-maorona bona lababana vada heḡereḡere. Bena ena hahetoho ḡauna amo hanua e hahetohoa, maila daha-ta sinahu-ima roha-maorona bona lababana bona harana-latana vada heḡereḡere.
english: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. + 21:16 12,012 stadia = 2,221 kilometers or 1,380 miles. TR reads 12,000 stadia instead of 12,012 stadia. * Its length, width, and height are equal.

motu: Maḡuna danu e hahetohoa, roha hari-ahui taurahani, taunimanima bona aneru edia hahetoho amo.
english: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, + 21:17 144 cubits is about 65.8 meters or 216 feet * by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

motu: Maḡu be iaspi nadina amo e larebaia, a hanua na gold herea-daena, to e negari-negari.
english: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

motu: Hanua maḡuna badina nadidia na nadi hururu-hururudia e haheralaidia. Gini-gunana na iaspi nadina, iharuana na sapairo, ihatoina na kalakedo, ihahanina na samarago,
english: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, + 21:19 or, lapis lazuli * the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

motu: ihaimana na sadonu, ihatauratoina na sadio, ihahituna na krusolito, ihataurahanina na berulio, ihataaurahani-tana na topasio, ihagwaautana na krusoiparaso, ihagwaautatana na huakinto, ihagwauta-ruana na ametuso. + 21:20 Iaspi: Sapairo: Kalakedo: Samarago: Sadonu: Sadio: Krusolito: Berulio: Topasio: Krusoparaso: Huakinto: Ametuso. Ini na nadi hururu-hururudia haida, asi ladadia Motu gado ai dainai Helene gado ai vada e tore. *
english: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

motu: Ikoukou gwauta-ruaosi na ageva mai hairaidia gwauta-rua; ikoukou ta aḡeva mai hairaina ta. A hanua ariarana na gold, to e negari-negari.
english: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

motu: Hanua lalonai dubu ta asina itaia, badina be Lohiabada, siahu idoinai Diravana, bona Mamoe Natuna, na una hanua dubuna.
english: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

motu: Dina bona hua danu na lasi, una hanua asie raraia; badina be Dirava hairaina ese e hadiaria, bona ena lamepa na Mamoe Natuna.
english: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.

motu: Bese idau-idau ese ena diari ai bae raka, bona hanua pavapavadia ese hairaidia bae rakalai vareai.
english: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

motu: Dina ai hanua ikoukouna basie kou; bona hanuaboi na lasi unuseni ai.
english: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

motu: Bese idau-idau ese hairaidia bona hematauraidia bae rakalai vareai.
english: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

motu: Hahedika ḡauna ta eiava lebulebu tauna eiava koikoi tauna unuseni ai basine raka vareai, a Mamoe Natuna ena mauri bukana ai ladadia e tore taudia mo.
english: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

motu: Bena aneru ese mauri ranuna sinavaina negari-negarina e haheitalaigu: ia na Dirava bona Mamoe Natuna edia terono amo e lasi,
english: He showed me a + 22:1 TR adds “pure” * river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

motu: hanua ariarana bogaragina amo e arua parara. Sinavai kahana kahana mauri auna e gini; huahuana na idau-idau, gwauta rua, hua ta ta mai huahuadia; bona au rauna ese bese idau-idau e hamauridiamu.
english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

motu: Heuduguirai basine mia; a Dirava bona Mamoe Natuna edia terono na unuseni ai. Ena hesiai taudia danu bae toma henia diho;
english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

motu: bona vairana bae itaia; bona ladana na bagudia ai baine hetore.
english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

motu: Hanua na basine boi lou, bona lamepa bona dina diaridia na herevadia, badina be Lohiabada Dirava ese baine hadiaridia; bona bae lohia hanihanai. Lohiabada be maimu
english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

motu: Aneru ese e hereva henigu, eto, Ini hereva na mamaoro-mamaoro bona momomo-kakani. Lohiabada, peroveta taudia laumadia edia Dirava, ese ena aneru vada e siaia, asi vanahana bae vara ḡaudia na ena hesiai taudia baine haheitalaidia.
english: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

motu: Ba heita: lau na ba vasimu. Ina buka e gwaurai gunamu herevadia e badinamu tauna na namo.
english: “\+w Behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w am|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w coming|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w soon|strong="G5035"\+w*! \+w Blessed|strong="G3107"\+w* \+w is|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w he|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w keeps|strong="G5083"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w words|strong="G3056"\+w* \+w of|strong="G3056"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w prophecy|strong="G4394"\+w* \+w of|strong="G3056"\+w* \+w this|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w book|strong="G3588"\+w*.” *

motu: Lau Ioane ini ḡau na ita bona na kamonai. Na ita bona na kamonai vaitani, bena ini ḡau e haheitalaigu aneruna aena badinai na goru diho, baina toma henia diho nato.
english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

motu: Bena e gwaugu tao, eto, Ene basio kara toma; lau na hesiai taugu, oi bamomu, bona varavaramu peroveta taudia bamodia, bona ina buka herevadia e badinamu taudia bamodia. Dirava hari ba toma henia diho.
english: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

motu: Ma e hamaorogu, eto, Ina buka ena peroveta herevadia na basio kou ahu, badina be negana vada eme kahikahi.
english: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

motu: Kara dika tauna do baine kara dika; lebulebu tauna do baine lebulebu; kara maoromaoro tauna do baine kara maoromaoro; helaḡa tauna do baine helaḡa.
english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

motu: Ba heita: lau na ba vasimu. Dava na imagu ai; taunimanima iboudiai edia kara heḡereḡeredia davadia baina henidia.
english: “\+w Behold|strong="G2400"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w coming|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w soon|strong="G5035"\+w*! \+w My|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w reward|strong="G3408"\+w* \+w is|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w with|strong="G3326"\+w* \+w me|strong="G1473"\+w*, \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* repay \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w each|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w man|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w according|strong="G1538"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w his|strong="G3708"\+w* \+w work|strong="G2041"\+w*. *

motu: Lau na Alefa bona Omega, + 22:13 Alefa: Omega. Ini na Helene taudia edia leta ladadia. Edia leta gini-gunana bona gini-gabena bini, ita eda A bona Z heḡereḡeredia. * gini-gunana bona gini-gabena, matamana bona dokona.
english: \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* Alpha \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Omega|strong="G5598"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w First|strong="G4413"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Last|strong="G2078"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Beginning|strong="G4413"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w End|strong="G5056"\+w*. *

motu: Edia dabua e huri taudia be nanamo, badina be idia ese mauri auna bae lao henia diba, bona iduara amo hanua lalonai bae raka vareai diba.
english: \+w Blessed|strong="G3107"\+w* \+w are|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w those|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w do|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w his|strong="G1519"\+w* commandments, * + 22:14 NU reads “wash their robes” instead of “do his commandments”. * \+w that|strong="G2443"\+w* \+w they|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w right|strong="G1849"\+w* \+w to|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w tree|strong="G3586"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w life|strong="G2222"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w may|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w enter|strong="G1525"\+w* \+w in|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w by|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w gates|strong="G4440"\+w* \+w into|strong="G1519"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w city|strong="G4172"\+w*. *

motu: A murimuri ai be sisia bona babalau taudia bona heuda-hanai taudia, bona ala-ala taudia, bona kaivakuku e toma henidia dihomu taudia, bona koikoi herevadia igwauraidia e moalelaimu taudia.
english: \+w Outside|strong="G1854"\+w* \+w are|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w dogs|strong="G2965"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w sorcerers|strong="G5333"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* sexually \+w immoral|strong="G4205"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w murderers|strong="G5406"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w idolaters|strong="G1496"\+w*, \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w everyone|strong="G3956"\+w* \+w who|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w loves|strong="G5368"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w practices|strong="G4160"\+w* \+w falsehood|strong="G5579"\+w*. *

motu: Lau Iesu ese egu aneru vada na siaia vasi, ekalesia oreadia herevadia vada e vasilai. Lau na David ramuna bona tuhutuhuna. Lau na hisiu bada, mai diarigu.
english: \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w*, \+w Jesus|strong="G2424"\+w*, \+w have|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w sent|strong="G3992"\+w* \+w my|strong="G1473"\+w* angel \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w testify|strong="G3140"\+w* \+w these|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w things|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w to|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w you|strong="G5210"\+w* \+w for|strong="G1909"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w assemblies|strong="G1577"\+w*. \+w I|strong="G1473"\+w* \+w am|strong="G1510"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w root|strong="G4491"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w offspring|strong="G1085"\+w* \+w of|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w David|strong="G1138"\+w*, \+w the|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Bright|strong="G2986"\+w* \+w and|strong="G2532"\+w* \+w Morning|strong="G4407"\+w* Star.” *

motu: Lauma bona headava matamata hahinena e tomamu “Aoma”. E kamonaimu tauna danu baineto “Aoma”. Ranu mase tauna na bainema. Bona ranu e uramu tauna ese mauri ranuna baine inua, asi davana.
english: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

motu: Ina buka ena peroveta herevadia e kamonaimu taudia iboudiai na sisiba henidiamu: tau ta ese ini hereva latadiai hereva ta baine atoa kau, Dirava ese ina buka lalonai e tore hisihisidia na ia latanai baine ato kau;
english: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

motu: bona ta ese hereva ta ina peroveta bukana amo baine abia oho, Dirava ese ia ahuna mauri auna enai bona hanua helaḡana lalonai, ina buka ai haridia e tore ahudia, na iena amo baine abi oho.
english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree + 22:19 TR reads “Book” instead of “tree” * of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

motu: Ini ḡau e gwaurai hedinaraimu Tauna e tomamu “Oibe, ba vasimu”. Amen: Lohiabada Iesu e, aoma.
english: He who testifies these things says, “\+w Yes|strong="G3483"\+w*, \+w I|strong="G3778"\+w* \+w am|strong="G3588"\+w* \+w coming|strong="G2064"\+w* \+w soon|strong="G5035"\+w*.” * Amen! Yes|strong="G3483" *, come|strong="G2064" *, Lord|strong="G2962" * Jesus|strong="G2424" *!

motu: Lohiabada Iesu Keriso ena harihari-bada na helaḡa taumui iboumui ai emui ai baine mia. Amen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
